instructions: Combine potatoes and 1/2 cup melted margarine in large bowl. Stir in sour cream soup onion cheese salt and pepper. Place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine corn flake crumbs and 1/2 cup melted margarine; sprinkle over top.

title: Irma Salad
instructions: Mix fruit and chopped bananas with cottage cheese. Fold in Dream Whip. Put dry jello in and mix well. Chill.

title: Wiener Chowder
instructions: Saute frankfurters green pepper and onion in margarine in 3-quart saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

title: Baked Chicken With Mushrooms And Artichokes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place skin side up in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Drain artichokes reserving liquid. Cut artichokes in half. Top chicken breasts with artichokes mushrooms and green onions. Pour reserved marinade and white wine over chicken. Bake until chicken is cooked through about 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Mix margarine and flour together. Press into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese 10x sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over first layer. Mix instant pudding and milk. Spread over second layer. Top with extra Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Quick And Easy
instructions: Tastes like you worked all day over a hot stove.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add softened cheese mayonnaise horseradish and salt. Beat with beater until smooth. Add lemon juice. Chill until partially set. Stir in cucumbers and onions. Turn into a ring mold. Chill until set.

title: Green Goddess Dressing
instructions: Mix and let sit a while. Serve on romaine lettuce and shrimp.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil peel and dice potatoes. Fry bacon and drain on paper towels. To bacon drippings add onions and saut until tender. Add flour sugar and celery seed. Blend until smooth; add water and vinegar. Simmer until thickened. Fold in potatoes. Crumble bacon and fold in. Cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes stirring often. Even better the next day!

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix well. Dip your favorite fruit (strawberries bananas oranges apples etc.). Enjoy.

title: Tangy Yellow Squash
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix gently. Cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours before serving.

title: Apricot Pie
instructions: Bake and cool pie shell. Place apricots in small saucepan and cover with Grand Marnier. Place pan over medium heat boil cover turn off heat and leave pan on burner.

title: Briarpatch Bean Soup
instructions: Melt butter and add crumbled sausage to brown. Add onions and cook until tender. Add 1 can Great Northern beans. Add 1/2 can water. Cook for about one hour.

title: Mock Apple Pie
instructions: Put bottom crust in (9-inch) pie plate. Break crackers coarsely into crust.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Cream butter with sugars. Add eggs and beans. Cream all together. Put in unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle pecans on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Roll out in small balls and press down with fork. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Cream the butter thoroughly. Add grated cheese sifted flour salt and Tabasco sauce. Work up well and roll out very thin. Cut with a fancy cutter and top with pecan half. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Drop Doughnut Balls
instructions: Mix sugar milk and egg; add melted Crisco. Add flour salt baking powder and spices which have been sifted together to the liquid mixture. Combine the two mixtures lightly. Drop from a teaspoon into deep Crisco heated to 365\u00b0 or until an inch cube of bread browns in 60 seconds. Fry doughnut balls until brown and cooked in the center (about 4 minutes). Drain on absorbent paper. Roll in powdered sugar if desired.

title: Pickled Yellow Squash
instructions: Mix well. Salt to taste. Let stand for 1 hour and drain well. Bring to a boil the vinegar sugar mustard seed and celery seed. Pour mixture over drained squash. Bring back to boil for a short time (until peppers lose bright color). Remove from heat and put in hot sterilized jars. Makes 3 pints.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Pour contents of cans into pot. Simmer stirring occasionally until cranberry sauce is melted. Gently put meatballs into sauce and simmer until meat is cooked. Mushrooms (fresh or canned) may be added if desired. Good served over rice.

title: Slow Cooked Beans
instructions: Wash and drain dry beans. Place in crock-pot. Fill crock-pot 3/4 way with water. Place hock in beans. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. When beans are almost done season with salt and pepper. Stir occasionally while cooking.

title: Rich Rolls
instructions: Combine scalded milk margarine sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in 1/3 cup lukewarm water. Stir and combine with cooled milk mixture. Add 1/2 flour and the beaten eggs; beat well. Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn out on a lightly floured board and knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and satiny.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook over medium heat stirring with a fork to break up the meat until lightly brown. Add other 9 ingredients mixing well. Turn into a greased casserole dish. Cover and bake in the oven at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir once or twice during cooking. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Sutton Gourmet Marinara Sauce
instructions: In a hot pan saute the garlic bay leaf and tomatoes for 15 to 20 minutes. Add sugar basil salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Saute mushrooms. Add to spaghetti; mix in almonds. Make a sauce with butter flour and chicken broth. Warm whipping cream. Add to sauce. Cut up chicken in separate bowl. Pour half of sauce over chicken other half over spaghetti. Put spaghetti in greased casserole. Pour chicken over and toss gently. Sprinkle almonds over top. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until golden brown on top.

title: Deer Camp Chili(Makes A Big Pot)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a big pot; stir well. Cover and simmer gently at least 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients except garlic and cook until thick about 2 hours. Then add garlic.

title: Cherry Bars
instructions: Mix batter and put half in a greased and floured 9 X 13 pan for 35 to 40 minutes. Spread pie filling over top. Then dot with remaining butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. While warm drizzle with powdered sugar frosting canned frosting or cooked white icing.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Add onion turnip and celery to meat. Pan fry all ingredients in butter for 5 to 10 minutes. Add salt pepper garlic thyme sage to taste and 1/2 cup red wine. Line a casserole dish with meat mixture. Place mashed potatoes on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Trash
instructions: Melt together margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips. Put cereal into a large bowl. Pour chocolate mixture over it. Stir around until cereal is all covered. Place 1/2 box powdered sugar into a large brown paper bag. Pour cereal mixture into bag and top with remaining 1/2 box of powdered sugar. Roll bag in hands or shake until all covered.

title: Purple Passion
instructions: Let this set up.

title: Saganaki(Flaming Greek Cheese)
instructions: Cut cheese into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place cheese on ovenproof skillet. Broil approximately 7 minutes. The cheese should be just soft and the surface should bubble slightly. Pour Metaxa over cheese and flame. Squeeze lemon over cheese. Serve immediately with Greek bread.

title: Snowflake Treat
instructions: In a large bowl beat 1 egg slightly. Add sugar and salt. Add vanilla and 1 cup of milk or a little more. Mix well then stir in enough clean snow to make it thick. Eat at once.

title: Impossible Zucchini Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients together with a mixer. Add eggs one at a time. Blend well then add Parmesan cheese and oil. Continue to blend well. Grease a 10-inch pie plate. Pour mixture in. Top with grated Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 60 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to cream mixture alternating with banana blending well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Cool. Wrap and store overnight.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Saute onion in a little oil. Add ground beef salt pepper and oregano. Cook until beef is browned. Drain fat. Put meat in large mixing bowl. Add milk catsup bread crumbs and 3/4 of the cheese. Mix and put in baked pie shell. Mix Worcestershire sauce with remaining cheese and spread on top. Cook 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scrumptious Potatoes
instructions: Saute onions in 1/4 stick margarine; add soup sour cream and cheese until cheese is melted. Break up potatoes into small pieces; place in 9 x 13-inch greased casserole. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour mix over. Melt 1/2 stick oleo; add 1 cup crushed corn flakes to this and spread over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Chill 5 to 6 hours.

title: Christmas Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients together blending well. Add next 4 ingredients and blend well. Bake in lightly greased tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Check with toothpick; might need another 10 minutes. (Good for holiday.)

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt chicken fat (or butter) in large saucepan over low heat. Blend in flour salt and pepper. Cook over low heat stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased baking dish (10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch) or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Add sugar and acid in enamel boiler. Add 2 quarts boiling water; dissolve quickly. Add lemon and pineapple juices and 2 quarts water. Add color. Add ginger ale before serving.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook slowly. Pour in crust. Make meringue from the 3 egg whites.

title: Baked Apple Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients except nuts and apples. Fold in nuts and apples. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Old-Fashion Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Cook a little longer than soft ball stage (when tested in cold water) the sugar flour cocoa salt corn syrup and milk. Take off stove. Add the butter or margarine peanut butter vanilla and walnuts. Beat until it starts to get thick; pour in buttered pan (8 x 8-inch). Double recipe for a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix. Sift flour with salt; add 1/2 of it to creamed mixture. Dissolve soda in the hot water. Add to batter then add remaining flour. Mix in chips and nuts. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fancy Pimento Cheese
instructions: Add cheese onion and pimentos. Mix with Miracle Whip and sweet pickle relish to taste.

title: Cheesy Broccoli And Mushroom Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange broccoli in a 12 x 18-inch pan. Whisk together soup salad dressing and milk. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese and croutons. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour salt and pepper. Brown in oil. Do not cook completely. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken which has been put in a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions; drain well. Use a little margarine to saute onion. Add all ingredients to cooked spinach. Put into fridge to cool. Make into balls and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until browned. Makes approximately 50 balls.

title: Spicy Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with blender. Spread on tortillas. Roll tortillas and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Cut into small wheels and serve with picante sauce.

title: Sweet N' Sour Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first six ingredients and shape into 4 individual loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Pour off pan juices. While loaves are baking stir cornstarch and brown sugar together. Add to tomato sauce pineapple juice soy sauce and prepared mustard. Cook sauce stirring until thick. Pour over meat loaves and bake basting often for 40 minutes longer.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package. Brown meat and onion in large skillet. Drain grease. Add all sauces and Italian seasoning to taste. Simmer about 10 minutes. Layer as follows sauce 3 slices Mozzarella cheese and noodles; sauce 8 slices American cheese and noodles; sauce 3 slices Mozzarella cheese and noodles. Spread remaining sauce over top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Clam Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients then thin with small amounts of clam juice.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine corns onion bell pepper eggs and cornbread mix. Pour into baking dish and cover with sour cream and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old Settler Baked Beans
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Fry bacon. Chop. Mix brown sugar white sugar catsup barbecue sauce mustard molasses chili powder salt and pepper. Add kidney beans pork and beans Ranch Style beans chili beans and onion. Mix together and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. This makes a large recipe.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in oil. Add chicken stock. Add chopped broccoli and curry powder. Cook until tender. Make a cream base by blending together Ricotta cheese and low-fat milk. Add to soup mix and blend. Put finished soup in blender and process until smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot or cold.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix cherries pineapple milk Cool Whip and nuts together. Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add cream cheese at room temperature and blend well. Add other ingredients and let set in refrigerator.

title: Po White Trash Dip
instructions: Bring cream cheese to room temperature. Stir in approximately 1/2 jar of Rosarita and mix well. If more Rosarita is needed add and mix well. Add approximately 1/2 bottle of Bac N Chips and stir well. If more are needed add and stir. Best when refrigerated 24 hours.

title: Hamburger Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown together the hamburger and onion; drain. Mix all other ingredients with browned meat. Stir well and bake for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. This recipe is from my cousin Vicki Bowen.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Cook and stir hamburger onion salt and pepper until browned. Stir in 1/2 cup cheese. Cover and set aside. In separate pan heat remaining ingredients except tortillas. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes and pour sauce into pie plate. Dip each tortilla into sauce covering both sides. Place into 12 x 9-inch baking dish and spoon 1/4 cup hamburger mix onto tortilla and roll around filling. Pour remaining sauce and cheese over enchiladas. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes in 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until soft. Allow to cool. Cut a thin slice off top of each potato. Scoop out the pulp and mash it. Blend in milk bacon onion chives salt pepper and 1 cup cheese. Spoon into potato shells. Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Place on baking sheet. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 25 - 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together and form into loaf. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hamburg Soup
instructions: Par boil carrots. Brown beef drain. In large pot saute onions in margarine until onions are soft. Add beef and mix. Add remaining ingredients Cover and cook over medium heat for 45 min.

title: Beef Veggie Soup
instructions: Cook and stir the beef and onion in a Dutch oven until beef is brown. Stir in sauce mix bay leaf salt pepper and tomatoes; heat until boiling. Reduce heat and simmer. Stir in noodles. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.

title: White Wine Chicken
instructions: Bone skin and halve the two chicken breasts. Sprinkle salt and nutmeg on both sides. Brown in a skillet in two tablespoons butter. Add two tablespoons minced onion mushrooms and the white wine. Bring to a boil cover reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove chicken to a warm serving platter. Bring pan juices to a boil and cook stirring juices until liquid is slightly reduced. Stir in a mixture of one teaspoon cornstarch and two teaspoons of wine. Cook stirring mixture until thickened. Spoon sauce over chicken breasts when serving.

title: Alabama Biscuits
instructions: Mix yeast and warm water. Mix together flour salt sugar and baking powder. Cut in oil. Add yeast water then warm milk. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees until done.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Drain rinse and remove any bad beans. Put beans and next 7 ingredients in a large pot. Cover with water. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 3 to 4 hours until done. Serve in soup bowls with a large tablespoon of sour cream on top. Garnish with hard-boiled egg or slice of lemon. Serves 6.

title: Cowboy Taters
instructions: Line pan or foil with bacon. Layer potatoes and onion slices to cover. Salt and pepper to taste. Top with bacon slices. Enclose in foil and cook on grill or cover and put in 350\u00b0 oven and cook until tender 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Hawaiian Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until well mixed. Add coconut flour and salt; mix with fork until crumbly. Press half of crumb mixture into greased 9-inch square pan. Spread Pineapple Filling evenly over crumb mixture. Cover with remaining crumb mixture and gently press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cut into 1 1/2 x 1-inch bars. Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Put all together and mix well with rotary beater. Put in uncooked pie shell and cook slowly about one hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: Dip chicken pieces in milk/egg mixture. Coat with mixed dry ingredients. For crispier chicken double dip chicken again. Fry as usual.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Then roll into balls and cover with chopped pecans.

title: Golden Cheese Salad
instructions: Pour boiling water over gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Stir in sour cream; beat until smooth. Add pineapple; chill until partially set. Fold in carrots and cheese; turn into a 9-inch square pan. Chill until firm.

title: Nut Cookies(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix sweetener with orange juice. Cream butter with orange juice mixture. Add dry ingredients vanilla nuts and grated rind. Form into roll; wrap in foil or wax paper. Chill. Slice and bake on ungreased cookie sheet in a 375\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Fill casserole dish with sliced apples. Cream butter and sugar. Knead in flour and cinnamon (sort of crumbly). Spread on top of apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbly about 35 to 40 minutes. Delicious with ice cream on top.

title: Cheese-Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broth onion potatoes celery and broccoli for 10 minutes. Add mushrooms soup and water. Heat again and add 1 pound Velveeta cheese. This freezes well.

title: California Lemonade
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in 2-quart pitcher. Serve over lemon slices.

title: Leftover Ham With Noodles
instructions: Brown ham in butter. Add onion and cook until soft. Add milk to soup. In casserole alternate layers of ham/onion noodles cheese (cut into strips) and soup mixture. Repeat until all ingredients are used up. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Turkey Mushrooms
instructions: Remove the stems on the mushrooms and chop. Heat liquid Butter Buds in a skillet and cook the onion and ground turkey. Add the chopped mushroom stems and other ingredients. Cook this mixture about 5 minutes. Stuff this mixture into the mushroom caps and sprinkle with grated cheese. Preheat broiler and place in oven for 2 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts. Yields 20 stuffed mushrooms. Per serving .75 fat grams and 33 calories.

title: Best Ginger Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Chill until dough can be handled. Make into rolls about 1 1/2-inch diameter. Cover with wax paper and put into refrigerator overnight. Slice thin and bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 350\u00b0 oven until brown about 15 minutes. Makes a big batch. Recipe can be halved.

title: Mexican Lasagne
instructions: Line a greased heatproof glass dish with quartered and floured tortillas.\tBrown meat; add onion and seasonings; cook until onions are\ttender. Pour off most of the liquid if it has not cooked off. Add undrained beans and mix well.\tRemove from heat. Spoon over tortillas. Cover with cheese. Place soup and tomatoes in a blender. Pour mixture over meat and beans. Top with another layer of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut in squares\tand serve hot with flour tortillas that have\tbeen warmed. Better if assembled a day ahead covered and refrigerated overnight and cooked the next day.

title: Smothered Pot Roast
instructions: Puncture meat with a fork on all sides. Spread about 1/3 of cream soup in bottom of cooking bag. Place roast on top of soup. Sprinkle soup mix evenly over meat. Cover with remaining undiluted cream soup. Gather end of bag. Tie loosely leaving small space for steam to escape. Plan cooking time at 25 to 30 minutes per pound. Microwave at 50% (Medium) power for 1/2 the total time. Turn roasting bag over. Microwave for the remaining time. Let roast stand in bag 20 to 30 minutes to complete tenderizing. Serve meat thinly sliced with its sauce.

title: Cheesy Spinach Bake
instructions: Drain spinach squeezing out excess liquid. Combine all ingredients; pour into 1-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until tests done. Yields 6 servings.

title: Cream Puff Cake
instructions: Bring oleo and water to a boil in saucepan. Add flour and salt all at once. Beat until mixture forms a ball; remove from heat. Add eggs one at a time beating until smooth after each addition. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Cool. Beat cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add pudding mix and milk; beat until thick and smooth. Spread over baked layer. Spread whipped topping over pudding. Chill until serving time.

title: Surprise Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake according to package directions. Fill cupcake cups half full. Mix cream cheese with sugar. Beat in egg and salt; stir in chocolate chips. Drop one teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture into each cupcake cup. Bake as directed on cake mix package.

title: Sfinges
instructions: In a bowl beat egg and sugar until light. Add Ricotta cheese and blend well. Stir together flour baking powder salt and cinnamon. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture; alternate with milk. Blend well. Drop by tablespoon into deep hot oil. Fry 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Turn one time. Drain on paper towel. When cool dust with powdered sugar.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix as directed. Bake cake until done. Remove from oven; poke holes in cake while hot. Pour milk and caramel over cake. Let cool then spread on cool whip and sprinkle with chips.

title: Apples 'N Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine flour salt baking powder and softened butter; mix well. Add pudding milk and egg; beat 2 minutes. Grease 9 x 9-inch pan or 10-inch pie pan. Pour in batter; arrange apple slices on top of batter. Combine cream cheese sugar milk and egg. Beat smooth. Spoon over batter to within 1-inch from edge.

title: Beef Burgundy Barbecue
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Soak beef kabobs for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator. Grill or broil until desired doneness.

title: Meat Curry
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan and add onion garlic celery and apple. Cook stirring often for about 5 minutes. Blend flour curry powder and mustard; sprinkle it over vegetables. Stir. Add bay leaf and chicken broth; rapidly stir with wire whisk. When mixture has thickened let simmer for 15 minutes. Stir bottom often to prevent from sticking. Add meat milk and finely chopped chutney; simmer 4 to 5 minutes longer. Serve with rice.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Put soda pineapple and juice in punch bowl. Add sherbet. Stir.

title: Butterscotch Filling
instructions: Mix brown sugar milk salt cornstarch and egg yolks. Cook until thick. Add vanilla and butter when a little cool. Pour into baked pie shell and top with meringue.

title: D.Q.  Buster Bars
instructions: Smash Oreo cookies. Mix 1 stick melted oleo with cookies. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put ice cream over cookies. Put peanuts over ice cream. Put fudge sauce over peanuts. Put Cool Whip over sauce. Freeze until firm. Cut into small squares.

title: Oven-Fried Ginger Chicken
instructions: Mix the flour pepper sesame seed ginger and bran together in a small bowl. Spray the chicken with the vegetable cooking spray and then dip in soy sauce. Coat with the ginger mixture and place in a metal baking dish which has been coated with nonstick spray. Now lightly spray one more time with the vegetable cooking spray and drizzle the remaining soy sauce evenly over all chicken breasts. Sprinkle bran crumbs on top. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until tender. Makes 4 servings. Contains 175 calories per serving. Contains 23% fat.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour baking powder salt and cocoa together. Alternately add dry ingredients milk and vanilla to creamed mixture. Mix well. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Pumpkin-Date Muffins
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar baking powder salt cinnamon and nuts; set aside. Combine eggs milk pumpkin and butter. Add to dry ingredients. Mix just until moist. Fill greased muffin pans two-thirds full.

title: Ice Cream Cone Cupcakes
instructions: Mix cake mix according to package directions. Fill each cone with cake mix. Place cones on cookie sheet and put them in a preheated oven (follow cake mix directions for temperature and cooking time). Remove from oven and cool. Mix powdered sugar and milk; stir until smooth. Add vanilla and stir well. Frost the cupcakes.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Boil hard 5 minutes the strawberries and sugar. Add Epsom salts. Boil 5 more minutes.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Cream oleo; add powdered sugar. Add eggs (one at a time). Sift flour 2 more times and combine with sugar mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 loaf pans or 1 long loaf pan. Serve with fruit if desired.

title: Easy Macaroni Casserole
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and heat through. Cook macaroni; drain. Place macaroni in casserole dish and dot with cheddar cheese. Put in spaghetti sauce and stir up. Top with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 until cheese is bubbly and melted.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add other ingredients. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Quick Saucy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix chicken soup vegetables poultry seasoning and garlic salt in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Stir baking mix and milk until blended. Pour over chicken mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake 30 to 32 minutes or until crust is light golden brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spread cookie dough on pizza sheet and bake per package directions. Combine cream cheese and confectioners sugar and spread on cooled cookie dough. Arrange fruit on top. Refrigerate.

title: Ritzy Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water for 5 minutes; drain well. Combine soup eggs mayonnaise and diced cheese; mix well. Add drained broccoli and pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with Ritz cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook macaroni. Drain well. Combine soup cheese 1 cup crackers mushrooms milk onion ground pepper and pimiento. Stir in macaroni. Turn mixture into a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle on remaining 1/2 cup crackers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Top with eggs. Makes 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Place roast in roasting pan. Mix ketchup beer sugar onion and sesame seed. Pour over roast. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours. Remove from oven and cool. Remove all fat and any bones. Skim fat from sauce. Shred beef; return to sauce. Reduce oven to 300\u00b0. Cook covered for 4 hours. Serve on buns with onion and cheese if desired.

title: Jal.  Cocktail Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle jal on well greased 9 x 9 inch baking dish. Cover with cheese then eggs. Bake 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and lightly butter two 11 x 17-inch baking sheets. Sift the dry ingredients into a mixing bowl. Cream the butter and sugars together in another mixing bowl. Stir in the milk continuing to stir the egg vanilla and milk until mixture is smooth. Beat in the flour mixture a little at a time then add the oatmeal stirring until the mixture is well blended. Drop the batter by the spoonful onto the baking sheets leaving space between for the cookies to expand. Bake for 12 minutes or until the cookies are lightly browned on top.

title: Cinnamon Pecan Coffee Cake
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; set aside. Combine sugar oil eggs salt and yeast mixture in a large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 1 minute. Add 4 cups flour beating at low speed and scraping bowl occasionally until mixture is smooth and elastic. Stir remaining 3 1/2 cups flour to make a soft dough. Place in a greased bowl. Cover and let rise one hour. Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and set aside. Punch dough down and shape into 1-inch balls. Dip balls in melted butter then in cinnamon mixture. Layer half of balls in a well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan sprinkling with pecans after each layer. Repeat procedure with balls butter cinnamon mixture and pecans in another well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Cover both pans and chill dough 8 hours. Pour topping glaze over dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Invert onto large serving platter. Yields 2 (10-inch) coffee cakes.

title: Barb'S Creamy Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Cover chicken with water; add salt and bouillon cubes.\tCook until chicken is tender (45 minutes to an hour). Remove chicken and set aside to cool. Strain out 2 cups of broth into a large cooker. Pour in milk. Mix flour or cornstarch with 1/4 cup of cooled broth. Bring milk mixture to boil and slowly stir in the cornstarch mixture. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and add to broth. Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite size pieces. Add to noodle mixture and cook a few minutes more.

title: Zola'S Pecan Sticks
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add well beaten eggs. Sift salt and baking powder with flour; add vanilla and pecans. Grease pan and dust with flour. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Ice when cool with butter or caramel icing then cut in sticks or squares. Cool before removing from pan about 20 minutes.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt oleo peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over cereal and nuts. Mix well. Pour into large plastic bag with powdered sugar and shake until well mixed. Pour out on cookie sheet and cool. A good snack!

title: Adeline'S Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tomato sauce and mix together in large pot. Place mixture into greased 9 x 11-inch glass baking dish. Pour tomato sauce on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until set.

title: Green Bean Salad
instructions: Drain vegetables and put into a large bowl. In saucepan mix the sugar vinegar and oil. Heat to dissolve sugar then pour over vegetables and toss. Add sliced onion and bell pepper.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Open can of salmon and drain liquid into bowl. Toast the bread; crumble into liquid. Stir so all liquid is soaked up. Add the egg and the salmon. Flake salmon with fork and mix all ingredients. Put the oil in a pan. Shape salmon mixture into patties (about a heaping tablespoonful). You can just put in pan and press with spoon to flatten a bit. Fry in medium heat until brown; turn and brown other side. Add more oil if needed. Serve with baked potato or macaroni and cheese and salad or fresh sliced tomato.

title: Oreo Dessert
instructions: Place crushed cookies in 9 x 9-inch pan and save some for top. Add ice cream; top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remainder of crushed cookies and nuts over top. Freeze 3 hours before serving.

title: Mexican Stuffed Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook shells and brown ground beef. Combine salsa water and tomato sauce. Of that stir 1/2 cup into ground beef along with green chilies 1 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions. Mix well. Of the remaining sauce pour 1/2 on the bottom of baking dish. Stuff cooked shells with the ground beef mixture. Arrange shells in dish. Pour remaining sauce over shells. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Crab Louis
instructions: Drain crabmeat and remove cartilage; chill. Prepare Louis Dressing. Arrange crabmeat tomatoes eggs and olives on greens. Pour Louis Dressing over salad. Makes 4 servings.

title: Meat Loaf Cups
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first eight ingredients. Add beef mix well. Press into 12 foil lined or greased muffin cups. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink. Drain before serving. Drizzle with ketchup if desired.

title: Shrimp, Crab And Corn Soup
instructions: Saute bacon and onion; stir in corn and margarine. Cook until margarine melts. Add flour and stir well. Add stocks oregano pimento and pepper. Bring to boil. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add shrimp crab and half and half. Season with hot pepper sauce. Bring to boil. Adjust seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. Makes 1/2 gallon.

title: Brunch Sandwich
instructions: Cut crust from bread and butter the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay slices of bread in pan; over this lay ham and cheese. Top with second slice of bread.

title: Red Pepper Lasagna
instructions: Halve red peppers; remove stems seeds and membranes. Place peppers cut side down on a foil-lined baking sheet. Bake in a 425 degree oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until skin is bubbly and blackened. Wrap peppers in the foil and let stand 20 to 30 minutes or until cool enough to handle. Peel skin from peppers and cut into thin strips.

title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Core cabbage; cook until cabbage is almost soft. Combine meat rice onion garlic salt and pepper. Remove individual cabbage leaves. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of meat mixture at the top of the leaf. Roll leaf up tucking in sides. Place cabbage rolls in a roasting dish. Add tomatoes; cover and cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. You may wish to add more tomatoes or a little water if needed.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes and drain. Add all together. Top with crushed Ritz crackers or bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Peel and slice cucumbers very thin. Place in bowl. Sprinkle very generously with salt. Cover and refrigerate 6 to 12 hours. Squeeze handfuls to get rid of excess liquids. In bowl mix all other ingredients. Add squeezed cucumbers and mix.

title: Tomato-Shrimp Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mix with soup. Blend well. Add seasonings blending thoroughly. Add shrimp. Serve with dip chips or crackers.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs 3 minutes. Gradually add sugar. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle walnuts onto dough. Bake 15 minutes. Turn out onto a towel; let cool.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck and onion together. Add tomato sauce water and spices. Mix beef and macaroni together in 10 x 15-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Place pepperoni over cheese. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: In a sauce pan cook (uncovered) broccoli and onions in chicken broth for 8 to 10 minutes. In another sauce pan melt butter and add flour gradually. Add milk and stir with a wire whisk. Add broccoli and broth mixture to cheese sauce. Simmer on low for 5 to 10 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pat'S Pie
instructions: Flour and grease 9-inch glass pan. Mix all of the ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Tomato Gravy
instructions: Slice onion thin and chop green pepper small.

title: Kahlua Toffee Trifle
instructions: Bake cake according to box directions in a 9 x 11-inch pan. Cut in half when cooled and crumble one of the halves in the bottom of a large glass bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the Kahlua over the crumbled cake. Spread 1/2 of the chilled pudding over cake. Top the cake with 8 ounces of the Cool Whip. Sprinkle 3 crushed Heath bars over Cool Whip. Repeat the layers. Keep chilled. Serves 12 to 16 people.

title: Marinated Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in shallow dish or Baggie. Combine all remaining ingredients and pour over pork chops. Marinate in refrigerator 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Grill to desired doneness 5 to 10 minutes each side.

title: Lemon Dessert
instructions: Cream flour with oleo and chopped nuts. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar and half of the Cool Whip.\tSpread\ton cooled crust. Beat pudding with milk and lemon juice. Spread on first layer. Top with remaining\tCool Whip and sprinkle nuts on top. Refrigerate or freeze for later use.

title: Pineapple Cheese Mousse
instructions: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup of cold water. Put on medium heat; cook. Add heated pineapple and stir to dissolve the gleatin. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice sugar and salt. Chill until syrupy. Fold in cheese and cream. Pour into a mold. Chill until firm.

title: Mexican Black-Eyed Peas Casserole
instructions: Cook peas. Brown sausage and onion; drain fat off. Drain peas. Stir all other ingredients into peas. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Salmon-Cheese Pie
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Combine eggs and milk; beat well. Add to dry ingredients and mix only until flour is moistened. Roll out 2/3 of dough to fit 9-inch pie pan. Drain salmon (or mackerel); flake into bowl removing skin and bones. Add onion and salmon juice. Turn into pie pan. Cover with cheese. Roll out remaining dough; place on top of cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients then add crab cheese and onion. Put in pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. You can also use tuna chopped ham cubed cooked chicken or shrimp.

title: Chicken Breasts With Rice
instructions: Put rice and water in baking dish. In medium bowl mix together cream of celery sour cream salt pepper garlic powder and minced onion to taste. Spread over rice and water. Top with chicken breasts with a thin slice of Velveeta cheese under each breast. Bake covered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 4 to 5.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar cocoa peanut butter and milk to a boil. Then add the vanilla and the oats. Shape into cookies.

title: Cream White Icing
instructions: Cream oleo and Crisco. Add flour one tablespoon at a time. Add milk then add vanilla with pinch of salt. Beat until fluffy then beat for about 20 minutes. The longer you beat it it will spread better.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix well all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 until center is done.

title: Porcupine Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup and water. Shape into balls in the size of walnuts. Put into a casserole dish. Mix soup and water; pour over meat balls. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. If desired all beef may be used.

title: Orange Torch Whip Mold
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and chill. Place mandarin oranges on top.

title: Old-Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Prepare 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix according to package directions.

title: Dump It Cake
instructions: Butter a 12 x 9-inch baking dish. Dump pineapple and cherries into pan. Dump cake mix on top of mixture. Press down. Chop walnuts. Sprinkle on top. Slice 1 cube margarine and lay evenly over cake mix. Put in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve with ice cream.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Mix bisquick milk and cheese until soft dough forms then beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Drop dough onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 8 - 10 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Smothered Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Sear pork chops 2 minutes on each side. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour water into skillet. Scatter onions over chops. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes turning chops over once during cooking. Add mushrooms and continue cooking covered for 20 minutes or until pork chops are tender.

title: Vegetable Fettucini
instructions: Saute broccoli zucchini green pepper onion and basil in oleo until tender 5 to 10 minutes. Then add mushrooms and tomatoes diced. Simmer about 5 minutes longer.

title: Baked Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Flake salmon and combine all ingredients. Place in well-greased 6-cup muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving pieces. Dredge meat in mixture of flour salt paprika and pepper. Brown well in shortening. Add onion 57 sauce and water. Pour over meat. Cover. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender. Thicken liquid with a flour and water mixture.

title: Mushroom Curry
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms in cold water; drain well. Cut in halves or if large in quarters. Peel the potatoes. Melt butter in saucepan and fry onions herbs and ginger for about 5 minutes. Add the salt turmeric and chili powder. Fry for 2 more minutes then add sliced tomatoes. Mix thoroughly and cook for 30 minutes over medium heat. If you want liquid cook covered; if not cook uncovered. Add the lemon juice and curry powder and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Boil the first 5 ingredients together for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add the peanut butter oats and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Spoon onto waxed paper; let cool.

title: Banana Muffins(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Set oven to 400\u00b0. Mix all ingredients well. Divide in muffin pan with 12 cups. Bake in oven for 20 to 25 minutes. They should spring back when touched and are slightly brown on top. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except chips. Put into casserole and bake about 15 minutes at 425\u00b0. Place the crushed potato chips on top of casserole before baking or just before serving. Serves about 4 or 5 women.

title: Ranch Style Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper. Mix all together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crab-Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Note I use imitation crab; very good!

title: Chicken Chowder
instructions: Barely cover chicken with water; add salt and onion. Bring to a boil and then simmer until chicken is done. Remove meat from bone and cut into serving pieces. Extend broth with Swansons chicken broth to equal 4 cups. Add carrots celery potatoes and mushrooms. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend milk and flour until smooth. Stir into broth with butter and cheese. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened. Add wine and season to taste.

title: Memaw'S Rich Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven. Sift first 4 ingredients together. Cream butter sugar and vanilla together. Add sifted ingredients; add beaten eggs. Mold with cookie press or drop by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir constantly until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and set aside. In a skillet brown pork chops in oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Fudge Squares
instructions: For fudge squares melt butter and add cocoa. Then mix in sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Mix in flour and vanilla. Add nuts and bake for 30 or 35 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Best Of All Fruitcakes(Really, It Will Make Your Grandmother Jealous!)
instructions: Read completely before starting

title: Ginger Pear Jam
instructions: Chop pears; add juice finely chopped ginger juice of lemon and grated rind sugar and molasses. Cook slowly in a heavy saucepan for 10 minutes. Add pectin and boil rapidly 5 minutes. Pack in hot jars and seal at once.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken with stalk of celery and onion in pot of salted water. Debone; cut into bite-sized pieces. Mix soup and sour cream together. Crush crackers. In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan layer chicken soup then crackers. Sprinkle poppy seed on top and then dribble margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Beat in eggs vanilla and nutmeg. Add the buttermilk alternately with dry ingredients. You will know when you have used enough flour when the ingredients are firm. Roll out on flour and cut the size you like (medium size cookie cutter). Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Meatball And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine ground beef bread crumbs milk onion salt and Worcestershire sauce. Shape into 18 meatballs (1 1/2-inch diameter). Brown in oil. Drain. Place in greased baking dish. Mix together rice celery green pepper soup and water. Pour over meatballs. Bake 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Microwave Bread Pudding
instructions: Spread bread crumbs. Sprinkle evenly with dry ingredients. Peel apple; cut into bite size pieces. Add to bread. Measure milk into 1-quart measuring cup. Add butter. Microwave on High 4 minutes. Stir eggs into milk. Add vanilla cinnamon and sugar to taste. Taste for flavor of eggnog. Pour mixture over bread and apples. Mix up and microwave for 9 to 12 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Drain juices from all fruit and keep it!! Add remaining water until it adds up to 1 1/2 cups. Boil that and add to jello. Stir until thoroughly dissolved. Pour in fruit and sherbet. Keep in refrigerator for 2 hours.

title: Cherry Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cake Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans. Prepare batter as directed on package. Divide batter evenly between pans. Bake and cool as directed on package.

title: Plain Cupcakes
instructions: Cream butter and add the sugar gradually stirring until well mixed. Stir in beaten eggs. Add the milk alternately with the flour (which has been sifted before measuring and sifted again with the baking powder) and salt. When the batter is smooth add the vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 15 (2 3/4-inch) cupcakes. Ice if you want to but these are delicious uniced.

title: Crispy Corn Flake Cookies
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except cornflakes. Add cornflakes. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 to 75 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Peel potatoes and soak them in cold water. Grate them and pour off the liquid. Add the grated onion salt and pepper. Mix flour and baking powder and add to the potatoes. Add well beaten eggs. Drop by spoonfuls on a hot well greased skillet. Brown on both sides. Drain well on paper towels. Serve hot. Serves 4.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Use on seafood.

title: Chicken And Beef Roll-Ups
instructions: Line baking dish with beef. Around each piece of boneless skinless chicken wrap a slice of breakfast bacon. Put this in baking dish over beef. Mix soup water and sour cream. Pour this mixture over the chicken and bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Crescent Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Lightly grease (not oil) a 9 x 13-inch pan. Separate crescent dough into 2 large rectangles. Press over bottom and 1/2 inch up sides of pan to form crust. Seal perforations. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Combine egg sugar corn syrup butter and vanilla; pour over crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes until brown. Cool; cut into bars.

title: Golden Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain. Combine with remaining ingredients. Turn into 1-quart casserole. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Golden Apple Fritters
instructions: Combine flours sugar baking powder salt and cinnamon. Combine eggs milk and oil. Core and finely chop the apples to measure 1 1/2 cups. Add apples and raisins to egg-milk mixture. Add flour mixture; mix thoroughly. Drop batter by tablespoon into oil heated to 375\u00b0. Deep fry and turn until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot with syrup and/or powdered sugar. Makes about 16 fritters.

title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Add brown sugar white sugar and vanilla. Add butter (melted). Mix well. Add peanut butter and mix well. Sift together flour salt and soda then add this mixture to preceding mixture. Add (slowly) oatmeal mixing well. Add chocolate chips; mix well. Form balls in hands about walnut size. Place on cookie sheet so can spread. Bake about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar vanilla cocoa butter and milk over medium heat 2 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and oats. Spoon out on wax paper.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a large skillet saute onions in butter. Add broth and broccoli; cook stirring until heated through and smooth. Add milk and cook until just scalded (do not boil). Serve hot.

title: Frijoles
instructions: Soak ingredients over 12 hours in refrigerator. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer stirring from time to time for about 1 1/2 hours until tender. To serve top with grated Cheddar cheese.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Spray a heavy 4-quart skillet with nonstick vegetable spray. Brown lightly onions potato mushrooms garlic carrot and celery. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer partially covered until lentils are soft (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Add more water if needed during cooking. Makes 6 servings.

title: Egg Delight
instructions: Combine cheese milk flour cottage cheese eggs and 1/2 of the melted butter. Spread remaining 1/2 of the melted butter in a 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Pour cheese mixture into the dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden and set. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in 1 inch water until tender. Place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. (Do not grease.) Beat soup and milk together pour over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix baking mix with firm butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over cheese. Bake until light brown about 20 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. You can add onions if desired.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Place potatoes onion and ham in casserole dish. In saucepan mix milk salt butter pepper and flour. Cook on medium heat until smooth and bubbly. Add cream of mushroom soup. May need to add a little more milk. Pour over the potatoes. Dot potatoes with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes or until tender.

title: Strawberries 'N Cream Cake
instructions: Mix berries with glaze and set aside. Pinch cake into small pieces and set aside. Mix Cool Whip sour cream milk and sugar. In large bowl layer the cake then Cool Whip and berries. Repeat layers cover and chill overnight.

title: Shrimp Dijon
instructions: Prepare marinade; cook shrimp. Mix and chill 24 hours ahead. Serve in a shallow pan.

title: Huntington Chicken
instructions: Stew chicken; remove from bone in large pieces. Thicken broth with flour and fat. Cook macaroni and drain. Combine chicken macaroni cheese broth and soup. Put into greased casserole and cover with crumbs which have been toasted in butter and a little cream. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate the potatoes and add the eggs flour onion salt pepper and garlic. In a skillet heat the oil and butter until hot. Shape the mixture into patties and fry in the hot oil. Serves 6.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in three layers at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Mexican Stuffed Zucchini For Large Squash
instructions: Slice squash lengthwise. Scoop out center. Add enchilada sauce combined with the water in large shallow pan. Skin side down cover and steam at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Saute bacon 4 to 5 minutes. Add bell pepper onion mushrooms and garlic. Cook until onions are clear. Remove from heat; add corn olives rice chili salsa or other Mexican sauce. Add eggs salt and pepper; mix together. Scoop into squash; top with cheese. Cover. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Stewed Tomato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in cubed bread in butter until slightly browned and toasted. Set aside. Mix rest of ingredients in bowl. Add bread and mix well. Put in a 2-quart buttered casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Combine cake mix pudding mix eggs 1 cup orange juice oil and orange peel. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes. Pour into pan.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Melt butter over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add half and half until slightly thickened. Remove; add cream cheese stirring until melted. Stir in chicken and next five ingredients. Fold noodles into mixture and place in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with bread crumbs; coat with cooking spray and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 additional minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter or margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Stir flour salt and baking soda together and add to creamed mixture. Mix and then add nuts or dates and bananas. Mix well and then pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch casserole pan. Layer bottom of pan with 1/2 package hash browns. Place bread on top. Next ham chunks. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over layers. Sprinkle remainder of hash browns and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Allow to set for 10 minutes.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Mix the ingredients together in the order given. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Squash-Carrot Casserole
instructions: Cook the squash onions and carrots in boiling water until tender then drain. Add remaining ingredients except butter and stuffing mix and mix well. Mix butter with stuffing mix and place half the mixture in a greased casserole. Add squash mixture and place remaining stuffing mixture on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Benny'S Juicy Hamburgers
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together; divide the mix into 6 sections forming hamburger patty. Barbecue or broil the patties for 6 to 8 minutes on each side brushing with barbecue sauce. Add cheese if you like when the second side is nearly cooked. Serve on a hamburger bun with toppings.

title: Red Eye Gravy
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a very large bowl. Add the steaks and turn gently to coat both sides of the meat with the marinade liquid. Refrigerate and let marinate overnight. Ready to grill or broil. If cooking the steaks outside on a grill baste your meats with this mixture while steaks are cooking.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Have butter at room temperature. Add sugar. Cream together well. Add flour and eggs. Beat well. Stir in buttermilk vanilla and nutmeg. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar butter and flour until fluffy. Blend in Karo syrup then one egg at a time. Blend in salt vanilla and pecans. Pour in a 9-inch deep dish pie crust. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 then 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips in small saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Pour over cereal in a large bowl. Stir gently until coated. Place confectioners sugar in a large paper bag. Add cereal mix to bag about 1/4 at a time. Shake until coated. Spread on tray to cool and dry. Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Surprise
instructions: Flatten chicken breasts with meat mallet. Put on layer of ham and a layer of cheese. Fold it over and pin with toothpick. Dip the meat in egg beaten and then slip it into bread crumbs. Fry on medium heat until done.

title: All-Vegetable Chili
instructions: In 5-quart Dutch oven over medium heat in hot salad oil cook celery onion and green pepper until tender stirring mixture occasionally. Turn heat to high. Stir in tomatoes with their liquid undrained kidney and pinto beans green chilies zucchini carrot oregano salt and crushed red pepper until boiling. Reduce heat to medium; cover and cook 15 minutes stirring occasionally. To serve ladle chili into bowls and top with cheese. Makes 5 main dish servings.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Chews
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and stir in shortening and salt. Mix eggs and sugar. Add melted chocolate mixture. Add oats and vanilla. Mix well and drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Watch carefully not to overbake. These are a chocolate lovers delight.

title: Butterscotch Dip
instructions: Place in mixing bowl and heat in microwave for 1 minute. Remove and stir. Return to microwave for 1 minute more. Continue until all morsels are melted. Serve warm with apples. Granny Smith are best.

title: Two Lemon Pies
instructions: Mix together the lemon juice milk and pineapple. Let stand in refrigerator for several hours. Remove; fold in Cool Whip and place in pie shells. Place in freezer. Remove 15 to 30 minutes before serving.

title: Mexican Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and onion. Drain thoroughly. Mix the bread mix eggs milk peppers and pimento. Layer half of the sausage corn cornbread mixture and cheese. Repeat the layers. Top with the melted margarine. Bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown (approximately 45 minutes).

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Boil spaghetti as directed on box and drain. Saute all vegetables mushrooms parsley olives onion and green pepper until crisp but not tender. Drain and set aside. Cook meat. When done drain meat and mix in veggies and spaghetti sauce in a bowl big enough to stir the mixture in. Mix the sauce mixture with the spaghetti.

title: Less Work Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub gently under water to remove dirt and dig out any bad spots but do not peel. Cut potatoes in half and boil until tender. Drain well and let sit for 5 minutes covered. Add 4 to 5 tablespoons of butter or margarine. Add Lawrys salt to taste and warm milk to the desired consistency. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients together in order. A mixer can be used until adding flour then it will be too thick for mixer. Mix by hand the rest of the way. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges barely begin to brown.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add berries eggs and oil. Mix by hand until blended. Add food coloring. Pour into two lightly greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add vinegar and beet water; boil for 5 minutes. Add beets to hot sauce and let stand at least 30 minutes. Just before serving bring to boiling point and add butter.

title: Easy Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and put in a graham cracker crust. Put in refrigerator to set. Top with Cool Whip to serve.

title: Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and shortening until mixture becomes crumbs. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs. Mix molasses baking soda and water until soda is entirely dissolved and mixture becomes slightly foamy. Pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle reserved 1/2 cup crumbs on top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until firm.

title: Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar stick and Crisco. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add flour soda buttermilk vanilla and coconut. Fold in egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 3 layers or 2 layers in oblong pans.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Put this in layers as written. Top with corn chips and Cheddar cheese. Put in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Fajitas
instructions: Combine chicken onion olive oil lime juice peppers garlic and salsa in sealed plastic bag. Marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 24 hours. Grill or broil chicken and vegetables from 4 to 5-inches from heat for 5 to 8 minutes per side while bringing marinade to a boil. Cut chicken and vegetables into thin strips. Divide among tortillas and drizzle with marinade. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Roll up. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hidden Valley Oyster Crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Combine ingredients and pour over crackers. Stir to coat. Bake 15 to 20 minutes stirring halfway through.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix well and add just enough milk to give a soft consistency. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Chewy Candy Bars
instructions: Bottom Layer Beat together the butter sugar egg and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla in a bowl. Add flour soda salt and oats; mix well. Pack into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Set aside. Beat milk cream cheese and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla together well. Reserve 3 tablespoons for icing. Spread remainder over bottom layer. Sprinkle nuts over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until set. Frost while hot.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar salt zucchini and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together; add to zucchini mixture. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into 2 large loaf pans or 4 small pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti With Herbed Tomatoes And Cheese
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to the directions on the package. In the last few minutes of the cooking of the spaghetti place a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat; add the olive oil and stir until oil is hot. Cook the garlic in the oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes basil and salt; heat through stirring occasionally. Drain spaghetti. Return spaghetti to pot; add tomato mixture Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Chinese Eggs
instructions: Melt butter and soy sauce in a skillet. Add eggs and cook for 5 minutes basting and turning eggs until the eggs become dark. Brown. Slice eggs and place on serving plate. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped green onion. Can be served warm or cold.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs and pour into buttered dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top and bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Candy Cookies
instructions: Bring to boil the sugar milk Crisco and cocoa. Remove from heat and add peanut butter oatmeal and vanilla. Drop from spoon onto a wax paper. Let set until hard.

title: Beef Diablo
instructions: Trim all excess fat from roast. Place potatoes in bottom of crock-pot. Lay sliced onions over potatoes. Place roast over potatoes. Pour 1/2 cup water over roast. Make paste of remaining ingredients and spread paste over roast. Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours. (I usually put this on to cook in morning. While Im at work my dinner is cooking.) Make a nice tossed salad rolls and tea. You have a lovely dinner.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad(Serves 16 To 20)
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add the strawberries bananas pineapple and nuts and mix thoroughly. Pour half of this mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and let set up. Then spread a thin layer of sour cream and pour the remaining strawberry mixture on top. Let set and cut into squares.

title: Cheese Fondue
instructions: In a greased casserole dish put alternate layers of bread and cheese. Combine eggs and add milk and salt. Pour over bread and cheese. Pour melted butter over top of entire mixture. Keep in refrigerator overnight. Bake in a shallow pan of water at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Potato Chili-Cheese Soup
instructions: Clean potatoes; chop bite size and put in boiling water. Cook until tender. Meanwhile saute green peppers onions salt cumin basil garlic and pepper in butter and olive oil. Add green chiles. Puree 1/2 of potatoes in processor and 1/2 saute in mixer. Add sour cream milk cheese scallions and remainder of potatoes. This is a thick milky soup.

title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 x 1 1/2-inch pieces; set aside. Combine next 5 ingredients. Dip chicken into batter and fry in hot oil (325\u00b0) until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Cottage Cheese-Nut Croquettes
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and mix well. Divide and shape into 10 equal croquettes. Lightly beat egg and milk. Dip croquettes into this mixture then roll into corn flake crumbs. Bake on greased cookie sheet 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good served with any tomato sauce. Makes 10 croquettes 100 calories per serving.

title: Ham Salad
instructions: Grind 1 pound bologna or ham. Add ingredients. Mix thoroughly.

title: Magic Cookie Bars
instructions: Place butter in 13 x 9-inch pan and place in oven to melt. Remove pan from oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter and press down with fork. Sprinkle coconut over crumbs then add layer of chips and pecans. Drizzle surface with condensed milk. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Pepper And Herb Mini Focaccia
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease two cookie sheets. Remove dough from can; separate into 8 coils. Do not unroll breadsticks. Place coils on greased cookie sheets. Press each roll into a 5-inch circle. Brush each with olive oil; sprinkle each evenly with bell peppers basil and oregano. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Green Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut beef into thin strips. Combine soy sauce garlic ginger and beef. Set aside. Heat oil in a large frying pan. Add beef over high heat until brown. If not tender cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes over low heat. Turn heat up; add vegetables. Stir until vegetables are crisp about 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water; add to pan. Stir until thickened. Add tomatoes and heat through.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine lime juice and condensed milk and whip until thick. Add Cool Whip and continue beating until well mixed. Put in baked pie shell and refrigerate. Top with more Cool Whip. Mmm!

title: Rib Sauce
instructions: Let ribs marinate in sauce for a couple of hours to overnight.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Rotel
instructions: Cook all together 30 minutes. Fill jars; seal and put in hot water bath for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Lasagna
instructions: Brown chuck and drain. Add spaghetti sauce and water; simmer 10 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients. Spray baking dish with Pam and layer 1/2 of sauce dry noodles and cheese mixture; repeat with other half. Cook for 45 minutes covered. Uncover and cook 15 minutes more.

title: Spanish Style Eggplant
instructions: Saute eggplant green pepper onion and mushrooms in spray-coated or non-stick fry pan. Add water as needed a tablespoon at a time to prevent sticking. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until eggplant is tender and flavors are blended. This may be served as a vegetable or as a topping over brown rice. Yields seven 1-cup servings.

title: Grilled Fish
instructions: Put aluminum foil on grill. Punch holes in foil. Spray foil with Pam cooking spray. Place fish skin side down. Salt and pepper to taste. Squeeze lemon juice on fillet. Cook on grill at medium temperature for 15 to 20 minutes or until flaky. Top with Molly McButter flakes.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 12-inch baking pan. Add ingredients by layer in order listed. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Let cool in pan then cut into small squares.

title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
instructions: Cream together the oleo sugar and salt. Add the remaining ingredients. Chill for a short time. Make into small balls and bake on an ungreased sheet at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Use a spoon to thumbprint. Add powdered sugar icing when cool. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Brown Sugar Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream butter with sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Blend in flour. Fashion into balls the size of walnuts. Flatten with rolling pin to 1/3-inch thickness and cut with cookie cutter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until light brown. Makes 4 dozen if a cookie stamp is used or 3 dozen if cut out with cookie cutter.

title: Welsh Tea Cakes
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Cut in butter. Add sugar and currants. Make a stiff dough with egg and a little water or milk. Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut into 2-inch circles. Bake on griddle or in electric fry pan set at 340\u00b0 turning cakes once. When cool sprinkle with fine granulated sugar. Serve warm or cold with marmalade.

title: Scalloped Cabbage With Cheese
instructions: Cook cabbage. Put cabbage into a greased baking dish; add a layer of cheese layer of white sauce. Continue layers until all ingredients are used. Cover top with crumbs. Bake in 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Fondant For Chocolates
instructions: Mix with hands until well blended. Separate into dishes and tint with food coloring and flavoring to taste. Roll into balls or patties and dip in chocolate. Place on wax paper and cool or refrigerate.

title: Yummy Zonkers
instructions: Pop popcorn. Add remaining ingredients in a saucepan except soda; bring to a hard boil fast. Add the soda. Mix well and pour over popcorn.

title: Chicken Fingers
instructions: Cut breasts into strips. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with paprika. Dip into egg mixture. Roll in flour. Deep fry.

title: Pink Lady
instructions: Place sugar in pitcher. Add cranberry juice slowly; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add pineapple juice; chill thoroughly. Add ginger ale; pour into serving glasses. Add 1 serving spoon of ice milk to each glass; stir until foamy. Serve immediately. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Simmer chicken in water for 45 minutes or until tender. Drain and reserve 2 1/2 cups broth. Set chicken aside. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and add next 7 ingredients to broth and cook 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Combine milk and cornstarch. Add to vegetable mixture stirring constantly until thickened. Add chicken skinned and deboned to vegetable mixture. Mix well. Spoon into lightly greased baking dish. Roll biscuits thinly and arrange on top. Use canned biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until browned.

title: Porcupine Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup thoroughly and form into balls. Mix tomato soup and 1 soup can of water pour over meat balls in a quart casserole dish. Bake 1 to 1-1/2 hours at 325 degrees.

title: Fudge Candy
instructions: Boil sugar cream shortening and salt until it is a soft ball. Add marshmallow cream chocolate chips vanilla and nutmeats. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and let set.

title: Cauliflower And Ham Chowder
instructions: In a large uncovered saucepan cook celery and cauliflower in chicken broth until almost tender (about 10 minutes). Set aside. In a mixing bowl gradually stir milk into undiluted potato soup. Blend water cornstarch and pepper. Stir into soup mixture; pour over cauliflower mixture in the saucepan. Stir in ham and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes. Just before serving stir in cheese.

title: Roman Grilled Chicken
instructions: Pour a little dressing in a baking pan. Put chicken in (enough to cover bottom of pan). Pour rest of dressing over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Stuffed Dates
instructions: In a small bowl combine peanut butter and 1 teaspoon orange peel; spoon 1/8 of the mixture into each date. Sift an equal amount of sugar over each filled date then sprinkle each with 1/8 of the remaining orange peel.

title: 30 Minute Fried Rice
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp in heavy skillet with tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and all but 1/3 cup drippings. Add rice and brown; add onion cook 1 minute more. Add other ingredients along with crumbled bacon. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Makes large amount and freezes well.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water to soft ball stage; remove from heat. Take out 1 cup sugar mixture and stir into stiffly beaten egg whites; set aside. Return remaining syrup mixture to heat and cook to hard ball stage; pour slowly into egg mixture beating continuously. Add vanilla and nuts; beat until it starts to harden. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan to cool. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Scalloped Cod
instructions: Preheat to 375\u00b0. Melt butter in saucepan slowly add flour until blended. Stir in milk add lemon juice salt and pepper. In greased baking dish lay out cod fillets. Sprinkle 1\\2 of the bread crumbs and all of the celery over the cod. Pour sauce evenly over cod. Sprinkle remaining bread crumbs over all. Dot with butter and grated parmesan cheese. Bake for 25 min. or until bread crumbs are golden brown.

title: Louisiana Hush Puppies
instructions: Cook cornmeal and water over medium heat until all water is absorbed. Remove from heat and stir in milk oil and grated onion. Gradually add beaten eggs flour baking powder sugar and salt. Stir to mix well. Refrigerate about 1 hour; remove and drop by teaspoon into hot grease. Cook over medium heat until golden brown. Yields 18 to 24.

title: Copper Penny Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots in water in a saucepan just until tender; drain. Layer carrots onion rings and green pepper rings in a bowl. Combine soup sugar vinegar oil Worcestershire sauce dry mustard salt and pepper in a saucepan; mix well. Bring to a boil. Pour over layers. Marinate covered in refrigerator overnight. Yield 12 servings.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; add eggs milk pineapple and bread crumbs. Mix thoroughly. Pour in a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Bake immediately after mixing.

title: Southwestern Corn Bake
instructions: Combine everything except cheese and chilies. Pour 1/2 of corn mixture into a 13 x 9-inch dish. Spread chilies on mixture. Cover with cheese. Pour remaining corn mixture on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm.

title: Baked Green Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to directions; set aside. Lightly grease 9 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Combine rice cheese chilies onions and parsley; mix. Melt margarine. Beat eggs and combine with milk and margarine. Mix with rice mixture. Spoon into greased baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Cherry Breeze
instructions: Mix corn flake crumbs and butter in a 9-inch pie pan. Press firmly over bottom and side. Chill. Beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Add milk and blend. Stir in lemon and vanilla. Turn into crust; refrigerate 3 to 4 hours.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread on tortillas. Roll up and refrigerate. When cold cut in pinwheels. Serve with picante sauce for dipping.

title: Sherbet Punch
instructions: Soften sherbet; add 7-Up and blend until slushy. Needs no additional ice.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Blend sugar peanut butter and margarine; add vanilla and salt. Shape into 1/2-inch balls. Place on baking sheet lined with waxed paper. Chill for a few hours or overnight.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and make 1 large or 2 medium loaves.

title: Chocolate Orange Bars
instructions: Blend together margarine flour and sugar. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan; press down firmly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Beat eggs well. Blend in brown sugar. Stir in coconut nuts vanilla and 3/4 of chocolate chips. Add salt and flour. Spread evenly over baked layer. Bake 20 minutes. Cool and frost.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in pie crust. Dot with butter. Cover with crust. Slit top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and margarine. Add rest of ingredients. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sausage And Peppers
instructions: Fry out sausage and pour off fat. Drain. Cook onions and peppers in same pan. Mix sauces and everything together.

title: Triple Layer Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs evenly over melted margarine. Top evenly with coconut then sweetened milk. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. In a small saucepan over low heat melt chips with peanut butter. Spread evenly over hot coconut layer. Garnish as desired. Store in loosely covered dish at room temperature. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

title: Potato Puffs
