instructions: Mix all ingredients. Heat in saucepan or kettle for 1 minute. Drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls 4 or 5 at a time into hot oil. Fry 2 to 3 minutes turning once or until golden brown. They brown very quickly. Drain oil out by paper towel. Yields 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

title: Super Easy Dip
instructions: Mix together. Really good served with Ritz crackers.

title: Angel Pudding Dessert
instructions: Cut cake into 1-inch cubes. Place half of cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan (glass). Combine milk and pudding mix; beat until smooth and slightly thickened. Blend in sour cream. Pour half of pudding mixture over cake. Spoon half of filling next. Repeat layers. Smooth top with spatula. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Very good!

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the onion with the margarine. Add soup. Pour this mixture over broccoli in a casserole dish. Add shredded cheese on top of the broccoli. Put bread crumbs on top of mixture after moistening it with water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Chocolate Butterfinger Ice Cream(Club Member: Brigitte Magee)
instructions: To make 2 gallons use 12 Butterfingers but triple other ingredients.

title: Pickled Okra
instructions: Pack okra into hot jars. Add dill onions red pepper (to taste) and garlic on top of okra. Combine water vinegar and salt; heat to boiling. Pour over okra and seal at once. Let stand 3 to 4 weeks.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: In saucepan add onions and pepper; cook until tender. In processor blend 1 cup milk flour and 1 cup corn on low speed until smooth. Stir corn mixture with the remaining cup of corn and other ingredients. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes.

title: Cheesy Salmon Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch pie plate. Place shredded potatoes in pie plate for crust. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour over potato crust. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until pie is set and top is golden brown.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Brown onion in butter. Combine soups broth and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Add chicken; mix well. Butter 9 x 13-inch dish. Layer chips and chicken mixture and layer of cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Orange Salad
instructions: Put pineapple with juice in large sauce pan bring to boil. Add Jello stir to dissolve. Cool slightly. Add the buttermilk stir. Pour into serving dish. Decorate with dollups of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder salt milk dates and nuts. Pour into a greased 8 x 12 x 3-inch baking pan. Pour brown sugar over (dont mix together). Bake in slow oven for 40 minutes (300\u00b0 or less). Does tend to boil over so larger container would be okay. Cool. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Arrange apples in greased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over apples. Bake until topping is golden brown and apples are tender about 30 minutes. Serve warm and if desired with cream or ice cream. Makes 6 servings with 295 calories per serving.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust(Two Double Crusts)
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt. Combine egg water and vinegar. Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with a spoon just until flour is moistened. This is an easy crust to handle and can be re-rolled without toughening. It also keeps in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: In a skillet brown and crumble sausage. Drain and set aside.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Sift the first four ingredients. Blend the remaining ingredients and add to the flour mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover the last 15 minutes.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Cut up potatoes. Boil and make into mashed potatoes. While potatoes are cooking brown ground beef and drain grease. Mix ground beef can of green beans (drained) and mushroom soup. Put this mixture in bottom of baking dish. Spread your mashed potatoes on top. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Frozen Chocolate Charlotte
instructions: Split ladyfingers but do not separate into individual pieces. Brush flat surfaces with creme de menthe or rum. Line sides of a 9-inch spring-form pan with ladyfingers rounded sides against pan. Separate remaining ladyfingers. Line bottom of pan overlapping to fit.

title: Rye Toast - Censored Zitters
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Add seasonings and cheese (chopped). Spread on bread; freeze on cookie sheet. Store in plastic bag. Before serving brown for 5 minutes on broil. Do not thaw before browning.

title: Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Prepare box of rice following directions on box but leave out butter. While rice is cooking prepare vegetables. Drain artichokes and save liquid. Cut artichokes in half.

title: Macaroni And Ham Casserole
instructions: Saute green pepper and onion in oleo. Mix cheese and milk well. Add this to vegetables macaroni and ham; mix well. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Helen'S Fruitcake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time beating after each. Flour diced fruit with 1 cup plain flour. Sift rest of flour together (2 cups plain 1 cup self-rising). Add gradually to batter; add fruit nuts vanilla and water. Bake 3 1/2 hours at 225\u00b0.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Do not drain tomatoes or beans. In Dutch oven brown meat and onion; add tomatoes and Swiss chard; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Add broth beans water macaroni (dry) Italian seasoning and salt. Cover and simmer until macaroni is tender. Serve with Parmesan cheese sprinkled on top. Serves 6.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well except shrimp. Mixer can be used. Add shrimp. Chill and serve with long saltine crackers.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over margarine and oats. Let stand 20 minutes covered. Add sugars and eggs. Beat. Sift together the salt soda nutmeg cinnamon and flour. Add to creamed mixture. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost in pan with Oatmeal Cake Topping.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook rice and cool. Slice broccoli and onions into food processor and process. Mix all ingredients. Cover and chill. Best made day before. Serves well with grilled chicken breast butter beans okra and sliced tomatoes. Enjoy!

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add two tablespoons margarine and season (salt pepper and garlic salt to taste). Add spaghetti and tomato sauce and simmer 1/2 hour. In mixing bowl combine cream cheese sour cream cottage cheese and chopped green onion; mix well. Cook noodles and add two tablespoons margarine. In a 4-quart casserole baking dish layer sauce 1/2 noodles and spread 1/2 cheese mixture. Repeat layer and top with remaining sauce. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Heat berries in pan on stove. Sweeten with about 1/2 cup sugar to quart of fruit. Melt butter. Make batter of last 4 ingredients. Pour batter over butter then spoon berries on top of batter. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: 1-2-3 Rolls
instructions: Put flour in mixing bowl. Add mayonnaise. Add milk a little at a time. Stir well. Spoon mixture into buttered muffin pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown. Makes 12 large rolls.

title: Raggedy Top Bars
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and brown sugar thoroughly. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Blend in flour salt and baking soda well.

title: Old Fashioned Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine first four ingredients in saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture boils. Continue cooking stirring constantly to hard ball stage (255\u00b0) until small amount forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat. Quickly add margarine and stir. Slowly pour popcorn in large bowl and mix well. Form into balls with butter hands. Makes 15.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese peanut butter and vanilla until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into cookie crust. Refrigerate for several hours or freeze. Garnish with peanuts if desired.

title: Purple Cow Parfaits
instructions: Blend together 2 containers yogurt vanilla and 6 tablespoons sugar in a bowl. In a separate bowl blend together remaining yogurt 3 tablespoons sugar and grape juice. Cut bananas in half crosswise; quarter each banana half lengthwise. Stand up 4 pieces of banana in each of 4 sundae or dessert dishes. Spoon about half of the vanilla yogurt into dish. Dividing evenly spoon about half of the grape mixture into dish. Dividing evenly sprinkle each dish with 1/2 tablespoon of granola. Repeat layering until ingredients are used up. Top with granola and cherry.

title: The Actor'S Ham
instructions: Shake brown sugar over ham. Affix pineapple chunks with toothpicks. Cover with syrup. Garnish with maraschino cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 until heated through. Time will vary according to size of ham.

title: The Best Peach Kuchen
instructions: In large bowl combine flour 2 tablespoons sugar salt and baking powder. Cut in butter until mealy. (If using food processor use metal chopping or plastic mixing blade. Do not overmix; add butter in pieces and process for 1 to 2 minutes until crumbly.) Remove 1/3 flour mixture to small bowl. Put remaining mixture over bottom and halfway up sides of 10-inch quiche pan or 9-inch square pan making a crust.

title: Easy Chicken Dinner Bake
instructions: Place chicken breasts in one end of 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix can of cream of chicken soup egg and milk. Prepare dressing and put in other end of pan. Spread soup milk and egg mixture over entire pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 15 minutes. Remove; place biscuits on top. Bake another 15 minutes or until biscuits are browned.

title: Governor'S Salad
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer lettuce. Mix onion celery and green pepper. Put on top of lettuce. Pour boiling water over peas to thaw but not cook. Drain and cool. Place on layer 2. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise; sprinkle sugar over top of salad dressing. Sprinkle cheese and bacon. Crumble; cover and refrigerate 24 hours.

title: Chocolate Sauerkraut Cake
instructions: *Omit baking powder if using self-rising flour.

title: Wassail
instructions: Combine ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 1 hour. Strain mixture discarding spices.

title: Meringue That Won'T Weep
instructions: Mix cornstarch 2 tablespoons sugar and water and cook until clear; set aside. Beat egg whites with the salt until it stands in peaks. Add syrup mixture. Beat until stiff and creamy adding 6 tablespoons sugar as you beat. Pile on pie. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0 until golden brown. Will stand up 3 days.

title: Grandma'S Casserole
instructions: In Dutch oven saute chopped onion and pepper in butter for 3 minutes. Add meat and brown breaking meat up. Drain off fat. Add salt pepper and sugar. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce and water. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil pudding and milk. Save 1/4 of chocolate bar for topping; mix in the remaining part. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into a Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. After cake has cooled sprinkle with confectioners sugar and chocolate bar.

title: Yellow Squash Muffins
instructions: Squash should be cooked about 15 minutes. Mash squash into a pulp (some chunks are okay). Combine with eggs and butter. Stir well. Set aside. Combine rest of the ingredients. Add to squash mixture. Grease muffin tins and fill 3/4 full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until picks come out clean.

title: Mammie'S One Egg Pudding
instructions: Mix egg sugar and butter. Add milk baking powder vanilla salt and flour. Blend 2 to 3 minutes at medium speed. Pour into 2 greased and floured pans or 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Bring butter and eggs to room temperature. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Stir together flour baking powder salt and nutmeg. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 55 to 65 minutes or until done. Let cool before serving.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl mix flour cocoa baking powder and salt. In a large bowl cream shortening sugar and egg until light and fluffy. Add milk. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in nuts. Spread in greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched. Cut into squares while warm. Cool in pan. Makes 16 squares.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream together eggs butter and sugar. Mix together flour soda and salt; add to first mixture. Stir in bananas and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dried Beef Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with your favorite cracker.

title: Walnut Delectables
instructions: Mix butter sugar and vanilla together. Gradually stir in flour and walnuts. Chill dough in refrigerator. Shape into marble sized balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes until firm but not brown. Roll gently in powdered sugar. Cool and sugar again. Makes 50 delicately rich cookies.

title: Fudge Cake(Mississippi Mud)
instructions: Combine margarine sugar and salt; beat until creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix cocoa with flour and add to egg mixture; mix thoroughly. Stir in chopped nuts. Pour into well greased and floured 9x13 inch cake pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350 degrees. (This will not look done.) Remove from oven and cover hot cake with the marshmallows. Put back in oven momentarily until melted; cool thoroughly. Frost.

title: Tacos(Filling)
instructions: Brown cubed pork slightly. Add remaining ingredients; simmer for 3 to 4 hours. Brown taco shells. Add filling lettuce chopped tomatoes and taco cheese.

title: Methodist Cake With A Baptist Touch
instructions: Mix flour butter and pecans. Pat in bottom of 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes; cool. Mix the cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Add 1 cup prepared whipped topping and spread on cooled crust. Blend pudding mixes. Add milk and beat until thick. Spread on cheese mixture and top with 1 cup whipped topping. Grate chocolate bar on top and serve in squares.

title: Baked Carrots Supreme
instructions: Scrape or peel carrots. Leave whole and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until just tender. Cool. Slice diagonally. In greased casserole dish layer carrots brown sugar onion flakes and crumbled bacon which has been drained. Dot each layer with butter. Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Simple All In One Cake
instructions: For variety add nuts and raisins. Put all into a mixing bowl. Beat 20 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 in tube pan for 45 to 50 minutes. Also chocolate bits can be added.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. In a large bowl combine peas tuna soup salt pepper cheese and cooked noodles. Place mixture into casserole dish.

title: Beef Soup
instructions: Boil beef bones. When meat is almost done add tomato soup beef bouillon cube celery whole onion green pepper parsley carrots bay leaf and some whole tomatoes. Let simmer.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend the two cheeses and add seasonings. Form into a ball and roll in pecans.

title: Tortilla Casserole
instructions: In blender process onion peppers and garlic with 1/2 cup water until finely chopped. Scrape into a saucepan; add vinegar sugar salt oregano and cloves and bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat to low and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Potato Yeast Rolls
instructions: Cook potatoes in enough water to have 2 cups of potato water. Put water aside to cool. Mix yeast salt and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Cream potatoes while hot with Crisco. Add potatoes potato water with yeast salt and sugar. Let sit for 2 hours. Then work in flour.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Grate outsides of all 5 lemons. Squeeze juice from all the lemons. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into two pie shells (unbaked). Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife comes back clean.

title: Old Fashioned Sweet Bread
instructions: Sift together flour and sugar. Add shortening milk eggs and vanilla. Blend ingredients and then beat 2 minutes. Pour batter into oblong pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Diver Dan'S Trauma Chili
instructions: Rinse the kidney beans. In a large pot start simmering the sauce of canned tomatoes. Add kidney beans and Tabasco to the simmering sauce. Dice the peppers and onions and pan fry in a little oil until just tender. Add\tthe peppers and onions to the sauce. Brown the ground chuck in the pan.\tDrain off as much of the fat as you can and add the ground chuck to the simmering pot of sauce. Simmer the whole mixture for a least 30 minutes after adding and mixing in the chili powder. Top with shredded cheddar cheese and a scoop of sour cream.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add rest stirring carefully. Mix by hand (not mixer) and stir just enough to blend. Grease and flour 4 small loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Cool 30 minutes and remove carefully. Wrap tightly to store thoroughly cooled. May be frozen.

title: Pecan Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: In a bowl beat butter and sugar together until creamy and smooth. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour baking soda and salt and mix until combined. Stir in pumpkin vanilla lemon juice and raisins. Pour into buttered tin and bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven until tester comes out clean about 25 to 30 minutes. Remove from tin and cool on wire rack.

title: Marinated Turkey Breast
instructions: Marinate turkey breasts in marinade sauce for 18 hours. Barbecue or place breasts only (no sauce) in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Butterfingers
instructions: Mix corn flakes powdered sugar and peanut butter. Form into fingers. Refrigerate 2 hours. Melt chocolate and dip. Let cool on plastic wrap. Enjoy.

title: Bailey'S Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together. Add alternately evaporated milk and confectioners sugar. Cook 8 to 10 minutes or until thick. Serve hot.

title: Barley Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients in a casserole with one can of chicken broth. Cover and bake for one hour. Top with almonds. Double recipe for large group.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Fry bacon; remove from pan and pour off grease except for one tablespoon. Saute pepper and onion in bacon grease. Cut cabbage in small chunks; add to pepper and onion. Saute about 8 to 10 minutes. Add crumbled bacon cheese and mushroom soup. Pour into casserole dish. Spread buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 5 minutes until bubbly and bread crumbs are browned.

title: Prayer Meeting Punch
instructions: To the tea add the frozen juices then stir in the orange juice. Chill and let sit until your throats are dry.

title: Slow-Cooked Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Combine beef rice mix (reserving seasoning packet) onion and egg in a large bowl. Divide the meat mixture evenly among the pepper halves. Pour tomatoes with juice into a slow cooker. Arrange filled pepper halves on top of tomatoes. Combine tomato soup water and rice seasoning packet in a separate bowl. Mix well and pour over peppers. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pastry and let stand for 20 minutes. Meanwhile prepare pastry for 9-inch pie. Put mixture into pie crust. Dot with 1 tablespoon of butter. Put on top crust. Put aluminum foil around edge. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Chewy Pecan Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat butter sugar eggs milk and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Stir in oats raisins and nuts; mix well. Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown. Remove from baking sheet to cool on wire racks. Yield 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Pistachio Pudding Cake
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. When done remove from pan and cool. Cut in half to make 2 layers. Mix the last 2 ingredients well and put half on first layer. Put rest on top layer.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole stir together peanuts sugar and salt. Microwave 8 minutes on High stirring well after 4 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and microwave on High 3 minutes longer. Add baking soda and quickly stir until light and foamy. Immediately pour into lightly greased baking sheet; spread out very thin. When cool break into small pieces. Store in airtight container. Makes 1 pound.

title: Goldenrod Green Beans
instructions: Chop egg whites and press yolks through sieve. Heat beans in their own liquid. Melt butter and blend in flour salt and pepper. Slowly add milk. Stir constantly and cook until thick. Add egg whites. Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise. Drain beans and cover with sauce. Sprinkle with egg yolks. Makes 4 servings.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well and form balls the size of walnuts. With fork dip balls in chocolate and place on waxed paper to dry. Store in cool place in candy cups or tiny baking papers.

title: Ham With Pineapple Sauce
instructions: In a skillet coated with non-stick cooking spray heat ham slice until warmed. Meanwhile in a saucepan combine the remaining ingredients; simmer for 3 minutes. Serve over ham. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Crescents
instructions: In a medium bowl mix chicken cream cheese soup milk and spices. Separate crescent rolls so you have four squares. Press very flat; spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture into half of square. Fold other half at perforation and seal by pinching edges together. Brush with melted butter and place on a cookie sheet. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Country Cornbread
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl mixing well. Combine remaining ingredients in a separate bowl and add to dry ingredients. Stir until moistened well. Pour into greased dish 13 x 9 x 2-inch or muffin pans. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 35 minutes or 20 minutes for muffins.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Beat the eggs milk and butter or margarine. Add remaining ingredients. Beat only enough to mix. There may be some lumps but dont overmix. These can be made ahead of time or the night before and refrigerate. If refrigerated add 1 teaspoon more baking powder to a little milk to dissolve and add to batter.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Mix together in large bowl sugar and flour (sift twice). Mix in saucepan water butter oil and cocoa. Boil 1 minute. Mix with flour and sugar. Add buttermilk beaten eggs soda and salt. Pour in 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Diet Oven Fries
instructions: Mix potatoes with olive oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder and salt and pepper. Place on nonstick baking pan and bake for 20 minutes at 450\u00b0.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in the warm water for at least 5 minutes or more. To boiling water add shortening sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm and add yeast softened in water. Gradually add 4 to 5 cups of flour. Knead; let rise until double in bulk. Make into cloverleaf rolls (makes 14 to 16) in greased cupcake pans. Let rise again until double in bulk. Bake at 425\u00b0 until brown approximately 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Cheddar Cheese Crispies
instructions: Mix all ingredients but cereal. Toast Rice Krispies cereal until light brown. Mix with the rest; roll and place in wax paper. Place in refrigerator until chilled. Pinch in small balls and place on ungreased pan. Press out with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until golden brown. (May lower amount of salt if desired.)

title: Easy Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix yeast sugar oil egg and flour. Place in tightly covered bowl and refrigerate. Spoon into muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Never stir down the remaining batter and be sure to keep covered. Will keep in refrigerator for 5 to 7 days.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Place apples in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with the sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Combine brown sugar flour and butter. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are tender. Serve warm or at room temperature. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Cheesy Bacon Nibbles
instructions: Spread approximately 1 teaspoon of peanut butter on each side of cracker. Wrap 1/2 bacon slice around cracker; use a toothpick to secure. Place in glass dish on 4 to 5 layers of paper towels. Microwave on Medium to crisp bacon. Top with cheese. Microwave to melt cheese.

title: Chicken And Slide-Downs
instructions: Boil chicken pieces with vegetables in broth and water. Do not overcook. Strain when done and put vegetables in blender and add to stock for thickener. Debone chicken and set aside. Mix flour shortening baking powder water and salt. Cut as would for pie dough. Pat out on floured surface and cut in 2-inch squares about 1/4 to 3/8-inch thick. Let dry out 2 to 3 hours. Drop in simmering broth. Cook on low 15 minutes covered and do not peek. Add chicken; heat through and serve.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in baking dish. Mix flour and sugar. Add milk. Pour mixture over melted butter. Add peaches. Cook at 350\u00b0 until crust comes to the top and browns.

title: Perfect Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until moistened. Fry in a large skillet with oil until edges are bubbly. Turn and cook until done.

title: Vinegar Pie Shells
instructions: Sift flour salt baking powder and sugar together. Cut in shortening. Beat egg. Add the water and vinegar to beaten egg. Mix the egg mixture with the flour and shortening. Mix well. Form into ball and refrigerate for about 15 minutes. Divide dough and roll between plastic wrap. This is enough pastry for 2 single crust 9-inch deep dish pies or at least 4 single crust 8-inch pies.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix all together and cool in refrigerator.

title: Pepper Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins in 3 cups water for 3 minutes. Pour water over shortening. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Roll like small meatballs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks and milk lightly. Mix in flour sugar and cocoa slowly. Cook on stove top until thickens; add margarine and vanilla.

title: Fudge Brownie Pie
instructions: Melt butter and chocolate chips over low heat. In bowl mix eggs sugar and nuts. Pour chocolate into bowl mixture and stir until mixed well. Pour into 2 pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Add enough water to crushed pineapple to make a pint (or 2 cups). Pour this into medium size sauce pan add 3/4 cup of sugar and bring to boil stirring constantly. Add 1 small package of lemon jello stirring until jello is dissolved. Set aside when it begins to get firm - stir in 1 cup of grated American cheese. Fold in 1 cup of cool whip and nuts. Pour into mold (4 cup size) that has been sprayed with Pam and wiped with paper towel. Chill in refrigerator overnight before serving. Very good served on lettuce.

title: Chinese Coleslaw
instructions: Saute almonds and sesame seed in a little butter. Add to coleslaw and onions.

title: No Cook Christmas Cake
instructions: Melt butter and marshmallows together; pour over all ingredients. Mix well with hands. Press into desired shape. Chill 12 hours before serving.

title: * Fruit Cocktail Cake *
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs fruit cocktail (including juice) and vanilla. Mix together and spread in 9 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle over top with dark brown sugar mixed with nuts. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool and serve with whipped cream.

title: Large Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook the ingredients together until thickened. Pour the hot dressing over the prepared fruits.

title: Pao Doce(Portuguese Sweet Bread)
instructions: Dissolve yeast cakes in a small amount of warm milk. Mix them with mashed potatoes. Combine the potato mixture with the other ingredients. Cover the pan with a heavy cloth and set in a warm place to rise until doubled in bulk. Pinch the dough off in sections shape and put into either round or loaf pan. Before baking brush the loaves with egg whites or milk. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: 5 Cup Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Lazy Rice Pudding
instructions: Bring water to a boil. Add rice salt and a dab of water. Stir while boiling about 1 1/2 minutes. Cover and let stand and cool in refrigerator.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar syrup margarine and nuts. Mix together and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: 10 Minute German Sweet Chocolate Cream Pie
instructions: Heat chocolate and 2 tablespoons of the milk in a saucepan over low heat stirring until chocolate is melted. Beat sugar into cream cheese; add remaining milk and chocolate mixture. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping blending until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (about 4 hours). Garnish with chocolate curls if desired. Store any leftover pie in the freezer.

title: Glazed Nuts
instructions: In a heavy 8-inch skillet combine nuts sugar and butter or margarine. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 6 to 8 minutes or until sugar is melted and golden in color and nuts are toasted. Spread nuts on a buttered baking sheet or aluminum foil. Separate into clusters. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Cool. Makes about 1/2 pound.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream softened cream cheese and powdered sugar; add vanilla. Add Cool Whip. Spread over graham cracker crust and top with cherry pie filling. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Mix sugar flour and 3 teaspoons baking powder; stir then add remaining 3 teaspoons baking powder and stir. Fold in raisins. Add milk. Bake in a cast-iron pan. Butter pan and flour good first. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Blend the first 4 ingredients in blender. Saute onion in oil. Prepare 2 cups of macaroni; cook and drain. Mix macaroni and onion and place in dish. Pour sauce over. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with bread crumbs.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter add extracts and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Mix dry ingredients. Slowly add dry ingredients into butter mixture. Chill. Roll out and press cookie shape. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 9 minutes.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add 1 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon sugar; blend in flour. Knead dough until smooth. Cut into small pieces. Roll into ropes and twist into desired shape. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Brush pretzel with beaten egg. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake immediately at 425\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. (For hard pretzels use only 1 1/4 cup water and add 1/4 cup melted butter. Shape smaller and bake until brown.)

title: Banana Butterscotch Parfaits
instructions: Using 1/2 cup custard for each parfait alternate layers of custard sliced bananas and coconut in each of 5 parfait glasses. Repeat layers once. Top with sliced bananas coconut and cherries.

title: Cheese Bread(2 Loaves)
instructions: Mix 2 1/2 cups flour sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Heat water and milk until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Add cheese and 1/2 cup flour. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make stiff dough. Knead 8 to 10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl and turn to grease top. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled about 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Layered Dessert
instructions: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in 2 cups of the whipped topping. Arrange 1/2 of the cake cubes in a 3 1/2-quart serving bowl. Drizzle with 1/3 of the chocolate syrup. Layer with 1/2 of the chopped candy bars and 1/2 of the pudding mixture. Repeat layers ending with pudding mixture. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with remaining whipped topping. Sprinkle with additional chopped candy bars if desired. Sprinkle with chopped nuts (optional). Store leftover dessert in refrigerator. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar egg chocolate buttermilk and vanilla. Stir in flour soda salt and nuts. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Heat oven to 400\u00b0.

title: Maple Cookies(From Canada)
instructions: Combine flour baking powder and salt in bowl. Beat butter with sugar until light. Add eggs one at a time beating until light and fluffy. Beat in syrup and vanilla. Gradually add dry ingredients beating just until blended. Wrap dough and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Brown onions in butter in same pot you are cooking soup. After onions are golden brown add water salt and potatoes. Cook until tender. Add milk and bring to boil.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a greased 2-quart baking dish layer one-third of the potatoes. Combine flour salt and pepper. Sprinkle one-third over the potatoes. Top with one-third of the onions. Combine soup and milk. Pour one-third over onions. Repeat layers twice. Combine bread crumbs and margarine. Sprinkle over top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for hour. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Carolina Barbecue
instructions: Randomly pierce the surface of the roast with a sharp knife. In a Dutch oven brown roast on all sides in hot oil. Meanwhilem in a bowl combine water tomato sauce vinegar Worcestershire sugar salt pepper celery seeds chili powder and hot pepper sauce. Pour sauce over roast and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 2 hours or until pork is fork tender. Baste roast with sauce during cooking time. Slice or chop to serve.

title: Easy Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in bowl of your choice. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Over low heat cook soup cheese mushrooms and onion in 2 tablespoons butter until cheese melts. Add onion salt pepper and Tabasco. Cook broccoli until moisture is gone. Place in greased casserole and pour sauce over broccoli. Mix bread crumbs with 2 tablespoons butter melted and sprinkle over sauce. Then sprinkle with toasted almonds. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken until changes color. Drain off grease. Mix ingredients together. Pour over chicken and bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar add eggs one at a time; beat well. Use part of flour to coat candy nuts and coconut. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add orange rind and coated candy nuts and coconut. Mix well. Bake in a 10-inch tube pan or 3 x 6-inch loaf pan in 275\u00b0 oven for approximately 2 hours or until done.

title: Squash Croquettes
instructions: Cook squash in small amount of water until tender. Drain very well. Mash squash; add other ingredients except meal. Add more bread crumbs if necessary for easy handling. Form into oblong croquettes and roll in meal. Deep fat fry until golden brown.

title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
instructions: Arrange chicken in baking dish. Top with cheese. Combine soup and milk. Stir well. Spoon over chicken. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Cranberry-Currant Muffins
instructions: Lightly coat 12 muffin tin cups with nonstick cooking spray. Set aside. Sift together cardamon cinnamon nutmeg baking powder baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Stir in currants cereal and cranberries. In a separate bowl whisk together buttermilk oil egg and maple syrup. Gently combine contents of two bowls stirring just until combined. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Turkey-Rice Casserole
instructions: Place rice in a greased 2-quart casserole. Combine soup mayonnaise peas pimiento salt pepper and turkey. Pour over rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield 6 servings.

title: Lemon Berry Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese milk and sugar in medium bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice lemon peel and 1 1/2 cups whipped topping. Spread on bottom of graham cracker crust then add a layer of strawberries on top. Mix 2 cups milk with pudding mixes with wire whisk for 1 minute. Let stand for 1 minute or until thickened. Gently fold 1 cup whipped topping mix and add on top of strawberries. Refrigerate for 4 hours.

title: Crab Mold
instructions: Heat soup. Add gelatin mixture. Then add cream cheese and when that is melted add all other ingredients. Mix until smooth. Mold and chill. Makes approximately 4 cups. Serve with Triscuits.

title: Oatmeal Brown Sugar Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg. Add milk and oil; mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add to egg mixture mixing until blended. Stir oats into batter.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together and place in a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Texas Caviar
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix lightly. Cover and chill at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours stirring occasionally. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour in muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Christmas Rock Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix and set aside.

title: Carrot Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix flour soda cinnamon and salt. Beat oil sugar and eggs until well blended. Add flour mixture and beat until smooth. Stir in pineapple carrots and coconut. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Hash Brown Cheese Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Fish A La Delight(For The True Fish Lover)
instructions: Put fish into pressure cooker; cook entire portion(s) until mushy and soft including bones (tuna fish or potted meat mixture). While fish is still hot add cut onions bell pepper flour and crumbled crackers. Make patties. Put patties in deep fry grease; cook to desired taste.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Tie cloves and cinnamon in bag. Boil 3 minutes in water. Tie tea in a bag and steep 3 minutes in the water. Take out tea and spice bags. Add remaining ingredients. Serve hot or iced.

title: Microwaved Banana Yummies
instructions: Slice bananas. Put 1/2 teaspoon corn oil margarine in bottom of microwave dish. Place bananas on top of margarine. Sprinkle cinnamon on top of bananas. Cover and place in microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Yield 2 servings Banana Yummies.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Combine and simmer for about 1 hour. Stir frequently.

title: Bacon And Tomato - Potato Shells
instructions: Bake potatoes until tender. Cool; then slice lengthwise and scoop out the center of each half. Leave about 1/4-inch thick shell. Save the centers for mashed potatoes later. Combine the oil chili powder and hot pepper sauce. Brush inside of each shell with the mixture. Place on a baking sheet and fill each shell with bacon tomato and green onion. Top with cheese and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted and shells are heated through. Serve with sour cream if desired. Shells can be covered and refrigerated for 24 hours before baking for make-ahead ease.

title: Creme Puff Cake(Really Good, Light And Yummy)
instructions: Heat water and oleo to boiling. Add flour stirring constantly. Cool. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Grease a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Spread mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool completely.

title: Chicken Quesadillas Ole
instructions: Saute peppers onions and mushrooms in butter until tender. Place some pepper mixture on flour shell. Sprinkle with cheese. Fold in half; secure with toothpick. Place in a hot buttered skillet; heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with sour cream and salsa. This recipe is great with leftovers or can increase to feed many.

title: Mom'S Bean And Spaghetti Dinner
instructions: Chop onion green pepper and celery. Cook in a little fat. Add tomatoes; cook 5 minutes. Add spaghetti baked beans and corn. Heat and serve.

title: Oil And Vinegar Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix together and pour over 1 cut up fryer. Marinate at least 1 hour or longer if you wish then cook on hot grill until done.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crust. This makes two 9-inch pies. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Simply Beef
instructions: In medium saucepan place all ingredients with just enough water to cover. Bring to a boil; immediately reduce to simmer. Continue to cook until all redness is gone using a fork to separate meat. Drain.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix until smooth in consistency. Serve with fresh fruit. Delicious with sliced apples and strawberries.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef. Drain the fat then add all other ingredients. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Heat slowly. Add more brown sugar or honey to taste. Strain into cups.

title: Easiest Dinner Ever
instructions: Brown 4 to 6 (or number needed) pork chops. Drain. Place back in pan and cover with a jar of salsa. Cook over low heat 30 to 40 minutes. Enjoy with rice noodles or tortillas.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. Add cooked onion. Blend together the soups and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Mix beans with meat after meat is cooked. Crush Doritos chips and place in bottom of casserole dish. Layer meat and onion mixture over the chips. Pour the blended soups and tomatoes over this. Add grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts and casserole is hot.

title: Water Whip Pie Shell
instructions: Mix Crisco water and milk until blended to a milky consistency. Add flour and salt. Mix. Roll into pie crusts. Makes 2 crusts.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: In a large saucepan melt butter. Add soups and water. Stir well to combine. Bring to a boil. Measure rice into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Pour about 2/3 of the soup mixture over rice. Lay chicken pieces on top. Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken. Cover and bake in a 275\u00b0 oven for 3 hours. Serves 6 to 8. \Can be cooking while Im at church.\

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: Saute meat (ground beef and ground sausage) in olive oil breaking it into small bits as it browns. Add spaghetti sauce salt and oregano. Simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Have ready bottom pie shell. Coat pie shell generously with egg white.

title: David'S Brilliant Cookies
instructions: *Measure flour and powdered sugar after sifting.

title: (Make Ahead) Joes To Go
instructions: In a large skillet cook and stir ground beef and onion until beef is brown; drain. Add garlic salt pepper chili sauce brown sugar white vinegar mustard and tomato sauce. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Cool and freeze.

title: Hummingbird Feed
instructions: Boil water and sugar 2 minutes. Take off heat. Add red food coloring. Let cool. Fill feeder.

title: Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until it stands in peaks. Add the sugar gradually beating continuously. Flavor with vanilla. Spread meringue onto a heavily oiled brown paper-lined cookies sheet or force meringue through a cake decorator or cookie tube. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Loosen paper lining. While hot spread the filling. Roll as for jelly roll.

title: Hobo Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and eat with chips as a dip.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add pineapple with its juice. Lightly beat eggs and add. Mix well. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 10 x 13-inch pan.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter or margarine. Add eggs; beat well. Add applesauce and vanilla. Sift together flour soda salt and spices; add to creamed mixture and beat well. Add raisins and nuts. Bake for about 2 hours in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: The mashed vanilla bean may be added to the sugar and stored in an airtight container so the sugar absorbs the flavor of the vanilla this may be done well in advance.

title: Haddock-Shrimp Bake
instructions: Place shrimp and haddock in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread soup over top. Add crushed crackers with melted margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Orange Egg Nog
instructions: Whip eggs in the bottom of a punch bowl. Add the sugar and spices and whip again. Add remaining ingredients. Sprinkle with a little nutmeg and lots of cinnamon. Enjoy!

title: Pizza Pan Breakfast
instructions: Press pizza crust on pizza pan forming the crust. Brown and drain sausage. Crumble and sprinkle over crust. Sprinkle hash browns and cheese over meat. Beat eggs milk and seasonings together. Pour mixture over pizza. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 to 35 minutes. Slice and serve.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix salmon eggs salt and pepper to taste and onion together. Add enough cornmeal to make mixture stiff enough to shape into croquettes. Fry in hot skillet with deep Crisco oil.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add Cool Whip and marshmallows. Fold in fruit and nuts. Cut cherries in half. Cool two hours.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Drain fruit. Add coconut and whipped topping. Stir the ingredients together. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Oreo Cookie Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs. Stir in condensed milk water and vanilla. Fold in cookies and whipped cream. Pour into an aluminum-foil lined 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Cover and freeze for 6 hours or until firm. This mixture may also be frozen in a regular ice cream freezer.

title: Boffo Bread
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet. Saute chopped garlic and onion until brown; add chopped tomatoes and olives. Cook for about 5 minutes then add basil and oregano and cook another 2 to 3 minutes. Cut bread in half lengthwise and then into half again; scoop out bread making a trough (give scooped bread to local ducks or geese); divide sauteed ingredients and spoon into trough. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 10 to 15 minutes or until crisp. Add shredded cheese and place under broiler for 30 to 60 seconds or until cheese melts. Serve as soon as possible. To serve cut into smaller pieces.

title: Italian Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cut potatoes in cubes. Sprinkle Italian dressing over potatoes. Separate onion slices and place over potatoes. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover last 10 minutes of baking time.

title: Corn Custard Casserole
instructions: Saute onion green pepper and salt in the butter. Combine both cans of corn eggs muffin mix and 1 cup cheese. Mix with onion mixture and place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Mix thoroughly the sugar butter and eggs. Add flour cocoa and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Braised Red Cabbage And Apples
instructions: Melt bacon grease in a large skillet; add sugar and cook stirring for 2 minutes. Add onions and cook slowly until lightly colored. Stir in cabbage apples vinegar wine and spices. Cook over low heat covered for 10 minutes then add water and cook with cover askew stirring occasionally for 30 to 40 minutes. Add salt to taste. Serve either hot or cold.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Saute and drain sausage. Beat eggs milk salt and mustard. Layer bread sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour egg mixture over; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Arrange the potatoes in an 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine the butter and garlic in a small microwave safe dish. Microwave on HIGH for 30 seconds or until butter melts; stir. Drizzle the butter mixture over the potatoes. Sprinkle with the green onions and grated cheese. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and light brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Farmhouse Barbecue Muffins(Yield:  8 - 10 Muffins)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0.

title: Golden Lemonade
instructions: Combine fruit juices and water; chill. Add ginger ale just before serving. Serves 36.

title: Flaky Pastry
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut in butter and shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle in the lemon juice or vinegar and 5 to 6 tablespoons cold water 1 tablespoon at a time and toss until dough just comes together in clumps. Shape into 2 discs one slightly larger than the other. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Makes 1 (2 crust) 9-inch pie.

title: Pizza Hot Dish(A Two-Crust Pizza Pie)
instructions: Lay flat one package of crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown hamburger and drain. Add the Sloppy Joe mix tomato sauce and oregano. Mix well and pour over the dough. Sprinkle cheese over the top and place the second package of crescent roll dough over the top. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Place popcorn in roasting pan. In medium pan on stove heat brown sugar margarine white corn syrup and salt to bubbling boil. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes. Stir in soda then mix into popcorn and place in oven for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix milk and Cool Whip; add lemonade. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Easy Carrot-Raisin Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl cover and chill 1 to 2 hours. Serves 4.

title: Jack'S New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Drain clams and reserve juice. Cook bacon until crispy crumble and put aside. Saute diced onion add crumbled bacon potatoes and clam juice and simmer until potatoes are tender. Stir flour into half and half and slowly add this into the pot. Stir until thicker. Add salt pepper and clams. Turn off burner. Add butter and stir.

title: Canadian War Cake(3 Layers)
instructions: Note This cake does not call for eggs.

title: Five Minute Noodle Stew
instructions: Boil 4 cups water with bouillon cubes. Add noodles. Cook 3 minutes. Stir in seasoning from flavor packets. Add stewed tomatoes (and mushrooms). Heat until hot.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Wash blueberries and dry on paper towels. Cream margarine with sugar. Add beaten eggs. Blend in sifted flour sifted with baking powder. Fold in the berries gently. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 12-inch metal pan at 375\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar. Cut into squares and serve from the pan. Top with whipped cream. Makes 16 squares.

title: Raspberry Ribbon Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in raspberries pineapple and chopped pecans. Blend well.

title: Pepperoni And Cheese Loaf
instructions: Thaw dough and allow to rise according to package directions. Divide dough in half and set one portion aside. Turn out one portion of dough on a lightly floured surface. Roll dough into a 10-inch circle.

title: Microwave Pickled Frank Kabobs
instructions: Cut each frank in 8 pieces. Arrange kabob-style on toothpicks. Start with frank then pickle etc. Shake 2 or 3 drops of liquid smoke on each kabob. Arrange kabobs in a circle on plate. Microwave 1/2 minute on High for 6 kabobs. Makes 32.

title: Angel Food Pudding Cake
instructions: Crumble angel food cake in bottom of cake pan. Prepare the vanilla pudding with skim milk and spread over cake. Sprinkle strawberries or cherries over the pudding. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine salad dressing and mustard. Cook rotini; drain and rinse in cold water. Drain. Combine with the rest of the ingredients. Toss with dressing. Chill. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Crazy Crust Apple Pie(Try It And See)
instructions: Combine filling with juice and spice and pour into center of batter. Do not stir. Bake in preheated oven at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Melt In Mouth
instructions: After eggs whites are stiff mix in other ingredients. Drop onto cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix together in large mixing bowl. Place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole dish and bake at 425\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Crock-Pot Meatballs In Gravy
instructions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients except gravy. Shape into meatballs and brown in skillet or on broiler rack in a 400\u00b0 oven. Prepare gravy in crock-pot. Add meatballs. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 9 hours (on high setting for 3 to 4 hours). Makes 4 to 6 servings (about 2 quarts).

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Whip cream. Add enough syrup to taste chocolatey. Place a row of graham crackers in bottom of a square dish or pan. Spread on some chocolate cream. Keep alternating until dish is full. End with cream. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Cut and enjoy.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Bring to a boil potatoes celery onion carrots and green pepper. Boil 15 minutes or until desired tenderness. Turn down on low; simmer. Add corn peas corned beef Veg-All green beans salt and pepper. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve warm with saltine crackers on a cool day.

title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt vanilla pudding butter egg and milk; beat for 2 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan. Place peaches over batter.

title: Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine cream cheese salsa onions and olives. Spread thinly on tortillas. Arrange slices of corned beef on cheese. Roll up tightly. Cover and place in refrigerator at least 3 hours. To serve cut into 3/4-inch slices.

title: Yum Yum Cake(Weight Watchers)
instructions: Slice angel food cake; cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour pineapple with juice over cake. Mix pudding according to directions; pour over pineapple. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with shredded coconut if desired. You can also put sliced bananas over cake before adding pineapple.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease 3 (1 pound) coffee cans. Sift first 5 ingredients together and set aside. In a large bowl blend sugar oil and eggs. Add pumpkin and water. Mix all together well. Pour into greased coffee cans and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until done; drain and mash. Add onions and egg. Cook in pan like dressing with liquid mix and chicken bouillon cube. Add seasonings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or an hour.

title: Outrageously Simple Beef Stew
instructions: In a stew pot with top simmer all ingredients except for vegetables for 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables and cook another 40 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oleo and egg; pat evenly in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar cream cheese vanilla and eggs; pour over cake mix mixture. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Bring to a boil vinegar 6 cups sugar and allspice. Pour over pickles. Next day add 2 cups sugar. Each day add 2 cups sugar. On the third day can. Put a couple of allspice in each jar.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter; add brown sugar. Stir until melted. Add milk and boil 2 minutes. Let cool. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Stir until smooth.

title: Carrot-Raisin Brownies
instructions: Mix flour with salt soda and baking powder. Cream butter. Gradually beat in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until well blended. Stir in dry ingredients. Add raisins and carrots.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Cover with Italian dressing. Roll chicken until covered. Leave remaining dressing in dish. Sprinkle lemon pepper over chicken until completely covered. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown turning once every 30 minutes.

title: Quick Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients but bananas and chill. Add sliced bananas before serving.

title: Pecan - Chicken Log
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Blend in next 2 ingredients. Shape into a 9-inch log or 2 (4 1/2-inch) logs. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 4 hours or overnight. Combine chopped parsley and pecan pieces. Roll logs in this mixture and coat thoroughly. Serve with crackers. Makes 3 cups spread.

title: Individual Baked Alaska
instructions: Combine egg whites cream of tartar vanilla and salt in a mixer bowl. Beat until soft peaks form. Add sugar gradually beating constantly until stiff peaks form. Place sponge cakes on a foil-lined wooden cutting board. Place 1 ice cream patty in each cup. Cover each with meringue sealing meringue to bottom of sponge cups. Sprinkle with crushed peppermint candy. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 2 to 3 minutes or until light brown. Serve immediately. Serves 2.

title: Veal Parmesan
instructions: Mix crumbs and Parmesan cheese; set aside. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Heat oil in skillet. Dip cutlets into egg mixture then into crumb mixture. Brown on both sides. Arrange cutlets in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour Tomato Sauce over cutlets (recipe follows).

title: Chocolate Cornflake Confections
instructions: In top of double boiler melt chocolate pieces. Remove from heat. Stir in milk and extract until smooth and blended. Stir in cornflakes and coconut until well combined. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Gently press cherry piece in middle of each. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until firm to touch. Remove immediately to racks to cool. Makes 4 dozen cookies.

title: Barbecued Hamburger Mix
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add ground beef; brown lightly. Drain. Add rest of ingredients and simmer covered 30 minutes. Makes 30 to 40 hamburger buns.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Sift dry ingredients and stir in. Beat until smooth. Pour in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch long pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or longer until done.

title: Spiced Stew
instructions: Brown meat in hot shortening. Add onions and enough water to nearly cover. Mix sugar and cinnamon with lemon juice and add with bay leaves and salt and pepper to taste. Cover bring slowly to boiling point then simmer until meat is tender about 2 hours.

title: Applesauce Raisin Spice Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with cooking spray. In a medium bowl combine raisins with baking soda and boiling water. Let stand 30 minutes. In a medium size bowl combine flour cinnamon and salt. In a large bowl beat together applesauce sugar egg whites lemon juice and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until blended. Add flour mixture alternately with raisin mixture beginning and ending with flour. Mix by hand until flour mixture is combined with raisin mixture. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean. Remove loaf from pan. Place on wire rack to cool completely. Cut into squares.

title: Granny'S Whipping Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; mix well. Add eggs one at a time mixing well. Measure and sift the flour and divide it into 3 parts. Alternately add one part of the flour and some whipping cream until all the ingredients are mixed well. Add the vanilla; mix well. Pour the batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes. Test with toothpick for doneness.

title: Dandy Beef Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown together hamburg and onion. Season with salt and pepper. Add tomatoes and corn to hamburg. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in 1/4 pound of Cheddar cheese cubes. I use Velveeta. Immediately turn heat off and cover skillet. Cheese will melt in about a minute.

title: Cowboy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla and mix well. Sift together flour soda salt and baking powder. Add to butter mixture and mix well. Add oats and nuts and mix. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by rounded spoonful on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Italian Mushroom Grill
instructions: Combine mushrooms and salad dressing in a small bowl and toss to coat. Let stand 10 minutes. Thread mushrooms on skewers and place 6 inches above hot coals. Grill 5 minutes or until tender turning often and brushing with remaining salad dressing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pound Cake*
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Sift baking powder with flour. Alternate milk and flour. Bake at 275\u00b0 until done.

title: Fried Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with tap water until not too stiff. Drop in skillet of oil on medium-high heat and fry slowly (about 1 or 2 tablespoonfuls at a time) until golden brown.

title: Tasty Sausage And Peppers
instructions: Bake sausages until brown (for approximately 30 minutes at 400\u00b0). Remove sausages; let cool. Dice onions. Slice peppers and leave in a separate pan. Cut sausage into 1-inch sections. Mix sausages onions and peppers into a deep dish pan. Mix in whole tomatoes. Cover with foil. Place into oven and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 400\u00b0.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Boil raisins in water; let cool. Mix other ingredients; add raisins and one cup of raisin liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in 4 (No. 2) cans.

title: Cheesy Dijon Chicken
instructions: Combine crumbs basil and onion powder. Spread one side of chicken breasts with mustard. Coat with crumb mixture. Dip into eggs then again into crumbs. Prepare Rice-A-Roni as package directs. In skillet heat oil over medium heat. Add chicken; cook 6 minutes on each side or until brown. Top rice with chicken and cheese. Cover; let stand 5 minutes. Makes 5 servings.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Combine last 3 ingredients and pour over the combined vegetables cheese and bacon bits. Marinate overnight and serve cool.

title: Sausage Swirls
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Blend in oil. Add enough milk to make soft stiff dough. Thinly roll out dough on lightly floured board into 2 rectangles 10 x 1-inch. Spread sausage on each rectangle and roll up lengthwise. Chill or freeze. Slice in 5/8-inch slices and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken N Cheese Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large casserole dish combine all ingredients mixing well. Cover and bake for 35 to 45 minutes. Remove cover and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serve immediately.

title: Fried Vegetables
instructions: According to amount of vegetables you are going to use Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Wash and drain vegetables until dry. Dip vegetables into a beaten egg salt and pepper mixture. Mix in Ziploc or grocery bag 3/4 cup cornmeal to 1/4 cup flour. Drop in egg-coated vegetables and coat the vegetables with cornmeal/flour mixture then fry in cooking oil until golden brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Smash crackers and add melted butter. Pat into 9 x 13 dish. Mix broccoli and soup together and pour over crackers; even out and cover with American cheese slices. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Alabama Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in milk. Add oil salt baking powder and sugar. Add enough flour to make soft dough. Knead a few times on floured surface. Roll thin. Cut with biscuit cutter and dip in melted margarine. Stack in twos. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 18 to 20 biscuits.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese 3/4 cup of sugar salt and beaten egg yolks. Fold in beaten egg whites. Pour in an 8 x 8-inch pan with graham cracker crust bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Fruit Fluff
instructions: Prepare 3 packages of Dream Whip as per directions on the box. Blend in Jell-O. Mix in drained fruit cocktail and marshmallows. Chill about 2 hours. Serve cold. Very refreshing!

title: Colorado Beans
instructions: Fry bacon until done. Drain and keep until later. Cook sliced onions in bacon grease. It is best to cover skillet and let them cook slowly until they are limp. Add brown sugar and vinegar. Drain all beans except pork and beans. Add beans to onions along with crumbled bacon. Bake in 2-quart casserole or bean pot at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Combine flour oats brown sugar cinnamon and melted butter. Stir until crumbly. Press half of the oat mixture into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Cover with apples. In a medium saucepan combine white sugar cornstarch water and vanilla. Pour over apples. Cover apples with the remaining crumble mixture. Bake in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Dutch Oven Bake
instructions: In Dutch oven bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Coca-Cola Salad
instructions: Place 2 packages jello in saucepan with 3/4 cup liquid (use cherry juice pineapple juice and water to make 3/4 cup liquid) and heat until jello is dissolved. Allow to cool. Add cherries cheese nuts pineapple and Coke. Let congeal; cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit. Mix all ingredients together and place in refrigerator. Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Christmas Potpourri
instructions: Simmer on stove in pan uncovered during the holidays or any time you want that holiday aroma.

title: Golden Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Onkers
instructions: Work cheese and flour together until crumbly. Add butter; mix well with fork. Mold 1 teaspoon of dough around each \surprise\ (olive or wiener). Shape into ball. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Squash Pickles
instructions: Peel seed and cut squash into 1/2-inch cubes. Combine water sugar vinegar turmeric ginger salt and dry mustard in a large saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil; add squash and onions. Boil 10 minutes. Pack hot into jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps (process 10 minutes in boiling water bath). Yields about 2 1/2 pints.

title: Cherries In The Snow
instructions: You may heat the cherries and add 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar for taste (I never do).

title: Super Seafood Salad
instructions: Cut crab delights flakes in half or shred. Combine with mayonnaise celery and onion. Serve as a sandwich or on lettuce.

title: Fried Pie Pastry
instructions: Mix all together. Roll thin. Put filling in and cook in deep oil.

title: Rhubarb Squares
instructions: In a 7 x 10-inch pan spread rhubarb in bottom 1/2-inch thick. Sprinkle the sugar over rhubarb then sprinkle jello and cake mix. Add the water and melted butter. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Apple Diabetic Delight
instructions: In a large stew pot place apples carefully in hot to boiling water. Simmer 3 minutes. Turn over apples and simmer 3 minutes longer. Test often with test needle or toothpick (should slide out easily). Remove apples and place on paper towels to drain. Serve warm or cool with your favorite topping such as Cool Whip drizzled cream cheese or diabetic ice cream. Great stored in a covered container and frozen for future use.

title: 1 Hour Rolls
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups flour sugar yeast and salt. Add warm milk water and oleo. Mix 2 minutes with mixer. Add 1/2 cup flour. Beat 2 minutes. Stir in enough flour to make soft dough. Knead until smooth. Let rise 15 minutes in greased bowl. Make into dinner rolls or cinnamon rolls. Let rise in pan for 15 minutes. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Basic Brownie For The Microwave
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla together. Add melted butter. Continue beating. Mix in flour and cocoa at low speed. Stir in nuts. Spread evenly in greased 8 inch square dish. Microwave on high for 6 minutes. Cut when cook. You can sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Serve with ice cream.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: In covered 2 1/2 quart casserole cook onions and oleo on high for 10 minutes. Stir in broth Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cover. Cook on high for 5 minutes and spoon into soup bowls suitable for microwave use. Sprinkle toast with cheese and float on top of soup. Microwave on high for 30 seconds.

title: Quick Punch
instructions: Put ingredients in gallon pitcher and add water enough to make 1 gallon.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Whip cream and mix in all ingredients. Let stand 1 hour before serving. Makes extra large amount.

title: Twenty Four Hour Cole Slaw
instructions: Cover cabbage and onions with sugar. Bring vinegar celery seed salt and mustard to a boil then add salad oil. Bring to a boil again and pour over cabbage cover and let set 24 hours.

title: Old Time Molasses Cake
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together and pour in boiling water; beat until smooth. Beat eggs and pour into batter. Mix well. May add nuts if you wish. Pour into well-greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan and bake 30 minutes (or until done) at 350\u00b0. Cut into squares and serve hot with butter.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Make centers by mixing margarine sugar peanut butter and vanilla. Roll these in small balls and dip in chocolate mixture (melt chocolate and paraffin wax together). Cool on wax paper.

title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat together shortening sugars egg water and vanilla until creamy. Add combined remaining ingredients and mix will. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.

title: Strawberry Preserves
instructions: Wash drain and hull berries. Leave whole. Put in saucepan. Sprinkle 1/3 cup sugar over berries. Pour lemon juice over top and let stand in cool place overnight (do not refrigerate). Next morning add 2 1/2 cups sugar heat to a boil and boil 7 minutes counting from time boiling begins. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.

title: Company Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wrap dried beef slices (2 each) around each chicken breast. Wrap 1 slice bacon around each beef-wrapped chicken breast and secure with toothpick. Combine mushroom soup sour cream and pour over chicken breasts. Bake covered for 2 hours 45 minutes at 250 degrees. Uncover and brown just before serving.

title: Shrimp And Corn Chowder
instructions: Mix soup and milk in 4-quart saucepan. Stir in potatoes. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Add scallions and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in cooked shrimp.

title: Bleu Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix Bleu cheese and cream cheese. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Can also add shredded cheese.

title: Easy-Do-Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar milk and butter or margarine in a large heavy saucepan. Heat to boiling. Stir constantly about 5 minutes over medium heat or until mixture reaches soft ball stage (238\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Stir vigorously until well blended. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool. Cut into squares. Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Scotch Cakes
instructions: Add soda to butter and cream well. Add dry ingredients which have been sifted together.\tPut in cupcake pan. Bake in a mild oven (275\u00b0 to 300\u00b0) approximately 30 minutes.

title: Tom Selleck Cake
instructions: Poke holes in baked cake and pour Eagle Brand milk over evenly. Pour topping over cake. Frost with Cool Whip and then sprinkle crushed Heath bars over all. Chill.

title: Pineapple Pound Cake
instructions: Combine shortening butter and sugar. Cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla beating well after each addition. Stir in crushed pineapple. Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place in a cold oven; set temperature at 325\u00b0 and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Invert onto serving dish. If desired drizzle glaze over top and sides.

title: Mary'S Cheezy Crab Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except crab and 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Fold in crab meat. Put in 1 1/2 quart greased casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes. Sprinkle 1/4 cup Cheddar cheese and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Cranberry-Nut Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Put orange juice and rind in measuring cup. Add shortening and then fill cup to the 3/4 mark with boiling water. Add to dry mixture and mix.

title: Cheesy Tater Topper
instructions: In a small saucepan stir together milk cornstarch mustard and pepper. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Add cheese stirring until melted. Stir in mixed vegetables and heat through. Serve warm over baked potatoes. Serves 4.

title: Wesson Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs real good with mixer. Dissolve the salt baking powder vanilla and soda in buttermilk. Add this to the sugar oil and egg mixture. Add 6 cups of all-purpose flour; mix well. Use 1/4 cup measure not full and put 6 to a baking sheet. Sprinkle with sugar before baking. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Line large baking dish with tortillas. Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add beans enchilada sauce and chicken or mushroom soup. Add green chilies. Pour over tortillas; add grated cheese over layered tortillas. Top with stewed tomatoes or more green chilies. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Delicious.

title: Shirley'S Banana Bread
instructions: Beat sugar eggs shortening until light and fluffy. Add bananas flour and blend. Add nuts. Place mixture into lightly greased loaf pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Select medium size pickling cucumbers. Wash and pack in sterilized jars. To each quart add 2 bunches dill 1 piece alum (size of small grape) and 2 teaspoons mustard seed. Fill jars with hot brine made from the vinegar water and salt. Seal.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Stir together flour baking powder cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt. Fold into pumpkin. Spread in greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Top with nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll towel and cake together and cool. Unroll. Combine powdered sugar cream cheese butter and vanilla. Beat smooth. Spread on cake and roll up. Chill. Cut into slices.

title: Triple Treats
instructions: Melt chocolate chips and shortening over hot water. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat. Pour half of mixture into 8-inch foil lined pan. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until set. Return remaining half to hot water. Melt caramels and butter. Add water over low heat stirring until melted and smooth. Stir in nuts. Blend well and pour over chocolate chips in refrigerator. Spread evenly. Refrigerate until tacky (about 15 minutes). Top with remaining chocolate. Spread evenly. Return to refrigerator. Cut into squares.

title: Frying Pan Cookies
instructions: Put sugar dates and eggs in greased frying pan. Stir constantly 7 to 10 minutes mashing dates as you stir. Add remaining ingredients. Stir into mixture until well mixed. Start pan on hot. When hot turn to low. When all is mixed turn out on wax paper. On another sheet of wax paper empty can of Angel Flake coconut. As soon as mixture is cool enough to handle grease hands and form balls fingers or any other shape you might want. Roll in coconut.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Brown hamburger in saucepan. Add salt and pepper. When fully cooked drain off grease. Mix in 1 cup spaghetti sauce.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cheeses set out to room temperature. Cream together; add pecans garlic salt and paprika. Roll in additional pecans. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Beat eggs then add the rest of the ingredients. Mix well. Put in pie plate and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Clean the lentils and rinse with cold water. Combine the lentils and the water in a pot. Bring to a boil. Stir and lower the heat. Do not cover and cook until soft for about 45 to 60 minutes. Stir occasionally. Crush in the blender then place back in the pot and add the salt oil and vegetables. Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Serve with your favorite bread.

title: Hot Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Mix sausage cheese Tabasco Bisquick and milk. Make into balls; place on greased (I use Pam) cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Uncooked Oatmeal Fudge
instructions: Mix in a large saucepan the margarine sugar milk and cocoa. Let boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and add the remaining ingredients. Drop on wax paper or tinfoil and let cool.

title: Tapioca Pudding
instructions: Soak 1 box \fish eye\ tapioca in water overnight; drain. Combine all ingredients in double boiler. Cook about 3 hours stirring occasionally. (Make sure water doesnt boil out of pan.) Serve warm with dessert topping.

title: Bean And Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix beans and corn. Put into greased casserole dish. Mix soup sour cream Cheddar cheese onion and salt. Spread over beans and corn. Put crushed crackers and almonds on top. Melt margarine. Pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Disappearing Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients excluding water in a large mixing bowl. Add boiling water. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Frost.

title: Applesauce Pork Chops
instructions: Rinse chops then put in marinade sauce (ingredients above except chops) and leave in for 4 to 6 hours. Shake off excess applesauce and put on the hot grill. Great on the grill! Cooking time varies as to thickness of the chops. Allow 35 to 45 minutes. (Turn often because of the sugar; they brown easily.)

title: Banana Bread
