instructions: Sift together the flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Mix in the wheat germ. Add all remaining ingredients and beat until well-blended. Place in an oiled 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until done.

title: Coconut-Pineapple Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour coconut pineapple and melted butter; mix well. Add vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until well set.

title: Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Mix Jell-O and strawberries in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Let cool. Beat together cream cheese cold milk pudding and sour cream. Line 9 x 12-inch container with vanilla wafers. Cover with half strawberry mixture half pudding mixture and half Cool Whip. Repeat.

title: Enoch'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken(s) until falling off bone. Debone and deskin chicken. Chop into 1/2-inch pieces (can use food processor). Peel and chop apples into 1/4 to 1/2-inch pieces. Chop celery into 1/4 to 1/2-inch piecestoo. Mix chicken apples celery pickles together. Add celery salt pepper salt and mayonnaise. Mix well. Serve cold on sandwiches or with crackers.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Add chicken soup milk and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Fold in broccoli and rice.

title: Company Casserole
instructions: Fry ground beef then add tomato sauce garlic and salt to taste. To cooked noodles add sour cream and cottage cheese.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Prepare pastry. Mix sugar flour and cinnamon. Stir in peaches and lemon juice. Place in pastry-lined pie dish. Dot with margarine. Cover with top crust that has slits in it. Bake 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix sugars and cornstarch. Add egg yolks and a little milk. When mixed well add rest of milk. Cook stirring constantly until thick. Add butter and vanilla. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Cajun Corn Soup
instructions: In a large Dutch oven saute onion green pepper and green onions in oil until tender about 5 minutes. Add flour and cook until bubbly. Add water stewed tomatoes chopped tomatoes and tomato paste; mix well. Stir in the corn ham sausage hot pepper sauce cayenne pepper and salt. Bring to boil stirring frequently. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Combine flour sugar soda cinnamon and salt in large bowl. Combine carrots raisins nuts coconut and pineapple in medium bowl. Add to dry ingredients. Combine eggs oil and vanilla. Add to flour mixture. Stir only until flour disappears. Do not overmix. Fill 18 to 24 muffin tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Shape and put in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pizza Cookies
instructions: Combine flour baking soda salt and baking powder. Stir in melted margarine and brown sugar. Add egg vanilla and hot water. Press into pan. Top with chocolate chips M&Ms pecans coconut and marshmallows. Marshmallows go on last.

title: Brownies
instructions: Beat egg with pinch of salt. Add sugar and shortening and mix well. Add cocoa flour and baking powder sifted together. Add milk gradually; beat well. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir well. Pour into buttered and floured baking pan (8 or 9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring water and salt to a rolling boil. Add grits slowly. Cook stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in margarine and cheese. Put eggs in a cup. Add enough milk to make a cup. Beat well and add to grit mixture. Bake in greased 2-quart casserole dish at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fancy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in roasting pan. Mix French dressing cranberries and onion soup together and pour over chicken. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375\u00b0 in conventional oven.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream(No Cooking)
instructions: Combine eggs cream sugar salt and vanilla in bowl and mix well with mixer. Pour into can; add condensed milk and stir well. Add milk to fill line on can and stir. Churn in freezer per instructions. Makes about 4 quarts.

title: Velda'S Bundt Cake
instructions: Grease Bundt pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon together and let stand. Place chopped nuts in bottom of Bundt pan. Mix cake mix pudding water and oil until moistened; add eggs one at a time. Beat 6 to 8 minutes at high speed. Add flavorings.

title: Uncle Nick'S Famous Meatballs
instructions: Beat eggs; add seasonings and mix with ground beef. Use wet hands to roll into walnut size balls. Can be fried on stove top or baked in oven at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in mixing bowl. Bring water margarine and cocoa to a boil and add to dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes in 12 x 17-inch pan.

title: Light Pumpkin Pie
instructions: In a large bowl add milk sugars and artificial sweeteners. Beat in eggs and spices then add Butter Buds as directed. Add flour and pumpkin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Pistachio Cake(Chocolate May Be Substituted And Is Better.)
instructions: Sift cake mix into large bowl and add pudding mix eggs oil soda and nuts. Beat batter at medium-high speed for 4 minutes. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool on rack for 5 minutes. Remove from pan and cool thoroughly.

title: Fresh Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and serve with fresh veggies.

title: Strawberry-Raisin Scone Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease an 8-inch round cake pan. Combine flour honey and baking powder. Using pastry blender or fork; cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk eggs and raisins; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. With floured hands pat half of dough into bottom of greased pan. Press dough 1/4-inch up sides. Spread dough with jam. Top with remaining dough; spread evenly. Using sharp knife score dough into 8 wedges. Brush top lightly with melted butter and sprinkle with warm honey if desired. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Clean and snap green beans. Blanch for 3 minutes. Pack straight whole beans into pint jars. Three or four jars should be prepared. Add a clove of garlic and one head of dill (or 1 teaspoon dill seed) to each pint. Prepare a pickling liquid from the vinegar pickling salt and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil. Pour this liquid into the jars. Seal with hot lids. No further processing is needed. Beans are ready to eat in three weeks and can be kept indefinitely.

title: Pull Apart Rolls
instructions: Form biscuit dough into 2 rolls about 12 inches long. Cut each roll into 6 pieces and form into balls. Dip balls into melted butter. Dip each ball into mixed nuts sugar and spices. Place rolls in double row in greased loaf pan. Bake in hot oven (400\u00b0) for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Carolyn'S Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli and cauliflower in bite size pieces. Mix all together. Mix mayonnaise milk and sugar together; pour over salad and mix well. Double recipe for dressing if you like more dressing.

title: Tomato And Broccoli Salad Sandwich(Yields 24 Servings)
instructions: Blanch broccoli for 1 minute in boiling water. Refresh with cold water. Combine with tomatoes and onions; reserve.

title: Mrs. S Dokey'S Chicken Carry Out
instructions: Simmer chicken in salted water until tender. Let chicken cool in liquid. Skim fat and save. Take meat from bones and cut into pieces. Melt fat in pan blend in flour adding broth gradually; cook until thickened. Add chicken and thickened broth to dressing. Toss lightly; spoon into greased baking dish (10 x 14-inch) cover and bake 50 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer until browned.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Mix soup broth green chilies and pepper. Set aside. Boil or bake chicken; chop into small pieces. Combine onion chicken and 1/2 the cheese. Wrap chicken mixture in tortillas and line up in a casserole dish. Pour soup mixture over rolled enchiladas. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion together. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Mix package of dressing and oil then spices. Spread crackers on cookie sheet. Pour dressing mixture over crackers. Stir gently to coat well. Spread out. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and place crackers on several layers of paper towels to absorb excess oil. In large covered bowl put more paper towels and place crackers in bowl until munch time.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with water oil and egg. Will keep in refrigerator for a week. Bake at 475\u00b0.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown chopped onion and garlic in heavy skillet. Add hamburger salt and pepper to taste. When brown add soups sauce chilies and milk. Heat thoroughly.

title: Chicken Parisienne
instructions: Place chicken in 11 x 7 1/2 or 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine cream of\tmushroom soup mushrooms and liquid sour cream and cooking sherry. Pour over\tchicken. Sprinkle generously\twith paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until tender. Serve with hot fluffy rice.\tServes 8.

title: Good Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Stir in whole milk. Stir over medium heat until mixture begins to simmer. Simmer 1 minute over low heat; set aside. In a small bowl lightly beat egg yolks. Stir about 1 cup of milk mixture into egg yolks. Stir egg yolk mixture into remaining milk mixture. Cook and stir over low heat 2 minutes or until slightly thickened. Stir in evaporated milk whipping cream and vanilla. Cool to room temperature. Pour into ice cream canister. Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturers directions. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Reese'S Chewey Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt; gradually blend into creamed mixure. Stir in peanut butter chips. Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 9 minutes. Do not overbake! Cookies will be soft; they will puff during baking and flatten upon cooking. Cool until set about one minute. Remove from cookie sheet and allow to cool completely on wire rack.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with a fork mashing shrimp into small pieces. Let stand refrigerated at least 12 hours. Serve with crackers.

title: Wedding Soup
instructions: Place chicken water bouillon cubes celery onions celery flakes and minced onions in a 12 to 14-quart soup pot or canner. Add parsley also. Cook 1 1/2 hours. Cool and debone chicken. While this is cooking make small small meatballs with the ground meat egg onion and crackers (1/2 teaspoon size meatball). Place on cookie sheet and brown in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Drain if needed. Add instant bouillon frozen spinach and meatballs. Cook for 15 minutes.

title: Quick Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and stir all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with green salad.

title: Quick And Easy Apple Cobbler
instructions: Spread apples in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Mix together 3/4 cup sugar cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over apples.

title: Creamy Onion And Potato Soup
instructions: Melt margarine in Dutch oven over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook for 1 minute stirring constantly. Add chopped onion and garlic. Cook 1 minute until onion is tender. Gradually add broth stirring constantly. Add potatoes and next 3 ingredients. Bring to a boil cover reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally. Stir in milk and heat thoroughly. Garnish if desired.

title: Jalapeno Quiche Appetizers
instructions: Grease an 8 x 12-inch glass pan. Grate Cheddar cheese and Swiss cheese. Add to beaten eggs. Mix well. Spread jalapenos on bottom of pan; add egg and cheese mixture. Pat down evenly. Top with Muenster cheese slices. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Let set 10 minutes. Cut into small pieces.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Add sugar to boiling water; bring back to boil. Add instant coffee and vanilla extract. Stir well. Add vodka and brandy. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Do not boil or you lose the alcohol. Ready to drink. Buy cheap ingredients; makes no difference.

title: For The Crowd Casserole
instructions: Combine butter and bread crumbs and set aside. Brown ground beef and onions together. Mix in all other ingredients. Add 3 cups cooked noodles or spaghetti. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over top. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tomato Cups
instructions: Combine eggs crumbs cheese garlic thyme Worcestershire and salt. Add spinach celery and onion; mix well. Cut tomatoes in half crosswise. Scoop out centers leaving 1/4 inch thick shells. Spoon spinach mixture into the shells. Sprinkle with crumbs. Place in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake covered in 375\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Stir lemonade and milk together. Fold in whipped topping and pour into pie shells; chill.

title: Individual Pizzas
instructions: Set oven at 425\u00b0. Place biscuits about 5 inches apart on foil or a cookie sheet. Roll biscuits very thin.\tRemove waxed paper and\tshape edges upon flattened biscuits. Brush each biscuit with oil. Spread 2 rows of sauce or more if desired. Sprinkle with oregano. Top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Chocolate Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together. Add salad dressing cold water and vanilla. Mix well. Bake in layer or loaf tin in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Very good.

title: Fudge
instructions: Cook margarine sugar and milk in skillet until soft ball stage. In mixer put chocolate chips marshmallows and vanilla; then beat until all the mixture is melted. Pour in a greased pan and let stand overnight before cutting. Nuts or pineapple chunks may be added to the mixture while hot if desired.

title: Caramel Crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place crackers on sheet side by side (do not overlap). In a small saucepan melt butter sugar and salt until melted. Do not boil. Remove from heat and add pecans. Spoon over crackers covering completely. Bake in oven for 10 minutes. Remove from heat cool for a few minutes and remove to plate and serve.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix together all ingredients (except popcorn). Grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Put in popcorn and coat with mix and bake for 8 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in heavy deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken cook until meat turns white and tender. Remove from heat and set aside. Heat small amount chicken broth or water in skillet. Add vegetables beginning with those requiring the most cooking time. Stir-fry until all vegetable are tender add more liquid if needed. Do not overcook vegetables. Add chicken to vegetables. Add salt pepper and soy sauce to taste while cooking vegetables. Serve hot over steamed or cooked rice.

title: Fresh Pork Barbecue
instructions: Cook pork shoulder in pressure cooker until it falls off bone. While pork is cooking simmer the ingredients in frying pan. When shoulder is done pull or shred into pieces and put into sauce. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Turkey Soup
instructions: In a large kettle cook turkey carcass with water to make 3-quarts stock. Remove bones; reserve meat for soup. Strain stock; set aside. In saucepan combine onions celery carrots rice and 1-quart of the stock. Cook for 20 minutes; set aside.

title: Holiday In A Bag
instructions: Rub lemon all over chicken; add salt and pepper. Pour oil in brown bag; stuff chicken with stuffing and place chicken in bag. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 4 hours.

title: Fiesta Tamale Pie
instructions: Saute onion and garlic chopped. Mix in rest of ingredients and place in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Mix corn meal milk and eggs. Spread over meat mixture and sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour uncovered.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening brown sugar egg and molasses. Mix in all other ingredients except sugar. Cover and chill 1 hour. Bake at 375\u00b0. Dip tops of balls into sugar; place 3 inches apart on lightly greased pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set. Remove immediately from pans.

title: Any Occasion Punch
instructions: Mix and serve in punch bowl.

title: Ornament Recipe
instructions: Mix flour salt and water. Play with dough. Roll out on floured surface and cut in shapes. Cook at 300\u00b0. Check on every 10 or 15 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Meatballs And Potatoes
instructions: Soak rice in hot water to soften and drain. Mix hamburger salt pepper rice egg and milk together. Form this mixture into balls and cover with water. Boil until they are a little firm. Add peeled potatoes and some salt; cook until potatoes are done. Add tomato juice and bring to a boil. (I usually drain off some of the fat after the meatballs cook for awhile.)

title: Fat Free Strawberry Cake
instructions: Slice top 1/3 of angel food cake lengthwise and lay aside. Make tunnel inside remaining cake by cutting 1/2 inch from outer edge of cake and 1/2 inch from inner edge of cake down to but not through bottom of cake. Pull out in pieces with fingers to remove. Set aside.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients and top with chips or cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Make a dark roux with the oil and flour. Cook this until dark brown. Stir constantly about 25 or 30 minutes. Add the onions celery green pepper and garlic. Cook slowly until vegetables are soft but not brown. Add the tomato sauce tomatoes tomato paste water salt pepper cayenne Tabasco bay leaves Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer very slowly for 1 hour covered. Add shrimp and cook just until done. Add parsley before serving. Serve over rice.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes and 1/2 cup melted butter or margarine in large bowl. Stir in sour cream soup onion cheese salt and pepper. Place in greased baking dish.

title: Quick And Easy Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and shape into bite size balls. Bake on cookie sheet in a 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. These may be frozen and reheated.

title: Breaded Chicken Fingers
instructions: Place chicken strips into a large resealable plastic bag. In a small bowl mix the egg buttermilk and garlic powder Pour mixture into bag with chicken. Seal and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except French fried onions. Put in casserole dish. Top with onion rings. Bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pastrami Dip
instructions: Combine pastrami mayonnaise sour cream dill weed and green onions in a bowl; mix well. Slice off the top of the bread. Cut out the soft center carefully leaving a well; reserve center. Spoon pastrami mixture onto the bread shell. Cut reserved bread into cubes. Serve bread cubes and vegetables with the dip.

title: Wedding Mints
instructions: Roll in granulated sugar.

title: Ice Cream Float
instructions: Put in cup and you have an ice cream float.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
instructions: Melt butter (save 1/2 for topping). Mix all ingredients together. Top with 2 to 3 cups crushed corn flakes mixed with the reserved butter. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Old Fashion Tea Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix eggs sugar shortening and vanilla. Then gradually add flour. Roll out cut put on cookie sheet. Cook until lightly brown.

title: Shrimp Spread
instructions: Warm the undiluted soup. Soften gelatin in water and stir into warm soup. Mix in smoothly the cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add celery green onions and shrimp. Mix well and mold overnight. Unmold and serve with snack crackers.

title: Strawberry-Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crust Melt margarine in the bottom of an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Stir in crushed pretzels and spread evenly in bottom of dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes and cool.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth in a large bowl. Slowly beat in condensed milk then lemon juice then vanilla. Spread evenly into shell.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Pour dry white rice on bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken on top of rice. Mix can of soup with 3 cans water and pour over rice and chicken. Sprinkle onion soup package on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is done.

title: Ham And Cheese Dream Sandwich
instructions: You will need 1 (18 x 26 x 1-inch) sheet pan.

title: H.C.P.B. Sandwich
instructions: On toasted bread place peanut butter first. This is your secret ingredient. Next add mayo ham cheese tomato and lettuce. Very good and different sandwich. Theyll ask for more.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed. Add chopped vegetables. Pour dressing over these items as desired. Sprinkle seasoning over salad.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
instructions: Place chicken in greased pan. Mix nectar and soup; pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions and drain off fat. Stir in soup enchilada sauce milk and 3/4 of the shredded cheese. Bring to a boil. Remove form heat and add 1/2 bag of chips. Stir well and pour into casserole dish. Add remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Old El Paso refried beans.

title: Tuna Wedges
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat eggs with fork. Add rice onions and undrained tuna. Mix well. Place butter in a small glass bowl. Microwave at High 1 minute until melted. Add to tuna along with thyme and crumbs. Mix well.

title: Green Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in margarine. Add soup cheese and thawed broccoli. Add rice salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Cranberry-Lemon Tea
instructions: In heavy large Dutch oven pour boiling water over tea bags and cinnamon stick; steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and cinnamon stick. Add sugar; stir until dissolved. Stir in cranberry juice and lemon juice. Place over medium heat until mixture is heated through. Serve hot with cinnamon stick. Yields about 12 cups.

title: Strawberry Delight
instructions: Mix crumbs and margarine together and press firmly into 9 x 13-inch dish. In a bowl mix strawberries and water together and set aside to thicken slightly. In a separate bowl blend cream cheese Cool Whip and powdered sugar with mixer and spread onto crust. After strawberry mixture has thickened pour over the top of cream cheese mixture. Chill 1 hour and serve.

title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix everything together in bowl except for the barbecue sauce. Mold into loaf pan. Top with barbecue sauce and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Spicy Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Wipe mushrooms clean. Combine all other ingredients except garlic and parsley. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour over mushrooms and add the garlic. Stir well to combine and coat. Place the marinating mushrooms in a container with tight lid. Chill for at least 12 hours shaking or stirring if your lid isnt tight enough. The longer they marinate the better but serve within 4 to 6 days.

title: Mincemeat Cake
instructions: Roll nuts fruit and mincemeat. Separate the hard kind; add to flour. Beat eggs add shortening sugar and milk. Then add nuts and fruit mixture. Mix all together real good. Bake in tube pan or loaf pans at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours until good and brown.

title: Szechuan Chicken Wings
instructions: Clean rinse and drain chicken wings. Marinate the chicken wings in stir-fry sauce at least 1/2 hour or overnight in refrigerator.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion (chopped). Drain off fat. Add beans with tomato sauce. Stir together. Add chili powder and red pepper to taste. (It can be as hot or mild as you want.) Bring mixture to boil. Serve with your favorite crackers.

title: Micro Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine first 4 items in a small bowl; set aside.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with French bread.

title: Fudge
instructions: Place in a large bowl the milk chocolate chopped nuts chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Place in a large pan the sugar large can milk and dash of salt. Place pan over heat and cook for 4 1/2 minutes after syrup comes to a complete rolling boil. Stir frequently so it wont burn. Add butter and vanilla. Pour half the syrup over the chocolate mix. Stir until chocolate is dissolved. Pour remaining syrup into mix and stir. Pour into greased pans. Let stand 24 hours. Store in sealed jars.

title: Seafood Casserole Pilaf
instructions: In skillet brown rice with butter. Add mushrooms with liquid and remaining ingredients. Add 1/4 cup water. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake covered for 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes and fluff with fork. Serves 6.

title: Cheese Round
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Stir in 1/2 c pecans. Stir remaining 1/2 c pecans in bottom of greased bundt pan. Spread in cheese mixture. When ready to serve turn onto platter and spoon preserves in center. Serve with favorite crackers. Should be made day ahead in order for flavors to blend.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Prepare lime gelatin as directed on package. Chill until slightly thickened fold in pineapple. Pour into 8 x 8-inch dish. Chill until firm. Add mayonnaise to softened cream cheese. Beat with mixer until well blended. Add pecans and spread over gelatin layer. Chill until firm. Prepare strawberry gelatin as directed. Add cranberry sauce. Pour over cheese mixture. Chill until firm. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Killer Brownies
instructions: Soften butter. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in greased pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream the butter until smooth and fluffy. Add sugar gradually beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well after adding each egg. Use wooden spoon to stir in flour salt and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon batter into pan. Bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Test with toothpick; let cool for 10 minutes before removing.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Simmer chicken with onion garlic salt and bay leaf until tender. Save stock. In heavy pan melt butter and add flour make roux. Add paprika and slowly add about 2 cups of the stock and mushrooms. Slowly add cut up pieces of cooked chicken and sour cream. Serve over thin spaghetti or rice.

title: Miniature Sausage Pizzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown sausage thoroughly adding green onions. When cooked add mushrooms and Mozzarella stirring until cheese is melted. Remove from heat and add 1 to 2 tablespoons mayonnaise. Spread mixture onto cocktail rye and bake for 15 minutes. Great little appetizer!

title: Easy Sweet Treats
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Boil for 3 minutes. Pour over graham crackers which have been sprinkled with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Immediately cut each cracker into squares.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts until done. When cool enough pull from bones into small pieces. Mix chicken with rest of ingredients. Melt margarine and add Ritz cracker crumbs. Put chicken mixture in buttered casserole dish and put Ritz cracker mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve when mixture is brown on top and bubbly.

title: Rabbit Stew
instructions: Brown rabbit and remove from oil. Make dark roux of flour and oil. Add chopped onions and cook until clear then add other ingredients and rabbits. Cover with water and cook slowly (3 to 5 hours) stirring occasionally until meat is very tender and gravy is thick. Season to taste while cooking. Serve with rice.

title: Broiled Flounder
instructions: Wash and pat dry flounder fillets. Line baking pan with heavy duty tinfoil. Spray foil with Pam. Place fillets on top of foil in pan. Put dots of butter on top of each fillet; then top each with several drops of lemon juice salt pepper and parsley flakes. Broil in oven for approximately 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown and done.

title: Lemon Lime Delight
instructions: Make gelatin. Add drained pineapple and pecans. Chill until set. Whip topping and blend in cream cheese. Spread over gelatin. Mix. Bring to a slow boil 1 cup of reserved pineapple liquid lemon juice eggs sugar and flour. Cook until thickened. Cool. Spread over other mixture and refrigerate.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix flour with sugar. Add beaten eggs margarine buttermilk vanilla and 2/3 cup coconut. Mix well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Sprinkle remaining coconut over pie. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Davie'S Mexican Meat Loaf
instructions: Brown beef. Add remaining ingredients except tortillas and cheese. Bring to boil. Layer beef mixture and tortillas in a casserole. Top with grated cheese. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve in casserole.

title: Banana Nut Bread(Low-Fat)
instructions: Sift the flour with the soda and salt. Cream the butter and gradually add the sugar. Mix well. Add the eggs and bananas and blend thoroughly. Combine the milk and lemon juice (or vinegar) which will curdle a bit. Slowly and alternately fold in the flour mixture and milk mixture beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition. Stir in the nuts (if desired). Pour batter into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan sprayed with Pam and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until the bread springs back when lightly touched in the center. Enjoy!!!

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese to room temperature. Beat on high until creamy. Add lemon juice and marshmallow cream and whip. Excellent with any fruit.

title: Karo Crazy Corn
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients on cookie sheet. Combine sugar oleo and Karo in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Boil 10 to 15 minutes or until mixture turns a light caramel color. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour over popped corn and nuts. Mix to coat well. Spread to dry. Break apart to serve.

title: Western Skillet Stew
instructions: Combine meat crushed tortilla chips 1/3 cup picante sauce green onions egg garlic 1 teaspoon of the cumin and salt; mix well. Shape to form 1-inch meatballs. Brown half of the meatballs in oil in 12-inch skillet until brown on all sides 6 to 8 minutes. Remove and reserve. Repeat with remaining meatballs. Drain drippings from skillet. Add tomatoes beans broth green pepper and chili powder to skillet with remaining 2/3 cup picante sauce and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin. Bring to a boil stirring up browned bits from bottom of skillet. Return meatballs to skillet. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with crumbled tortilla chips over stew. Makes 6 servings about 8 cups of stew.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Soak dried bread in water then squeeze dry. Mix well with apples onion celery and seasonings to make stuffing. Stuff each pork chop. Place in baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Cheese Danish
instructions: Line glass oblong pan with 1 package of crescent roll dough. Mix cream cheese 3/4 cup sugar egg yolk and vanilla together. Spread on crescent roll layer. Put second package of crescent rolls on top of cream cheese layer. Whisk egg white and spread on dough. Sprinkle nuts remaining sugar and cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix the flour with soda. Combine margarine sugars pudding mix and vanilla in large bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Add eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Crab Cakes Delicious
instructions: Combine first 10 ingredients. Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Roll pork chops in flour salt and pepper. Brown in small amount of oil in skillet. After chops are browned add about 1 cup water in skillet and mix with brown drippings. Set aside.

title: Quick Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in large pan. After browning add remaining ingredients. When mixture is steaming reduce heat to low setting and cook 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Chicken
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat margarine and cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet combine soup broccoli water and pepper. Heat to boiling. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and broccoli is tender. Stir occasionally.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Mix tea mix cloves cinnamon Tang sugar and lemonade. Use 1 to 2 teaspoons in a cup of hot water.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; cool and diced. Fry bacon; drain. Brown onions in bacon fat until lightly browned. Blend in flour sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Cook over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat. Add vinegar and water. Heat to a boil 1 minute. Stir in potatoes and crumbled bacon.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan in oven; dont get too hot. Stir in flour until smooth. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese with xxxx sugar then fold in 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Combine pudding with milk and beat until thick. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Spread more Cool Whip over top and add the chopped nuts. Delicious!

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except mayo. Wipe 8 x 8-inch dish with mayo. Pour salad in dish and freeze until firm. Cut pieces with knife to serve. Delicious!

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Mix flour baking powder baking soda pumpkin pie spice and sugar; sift together. In another bowl mix mashed pumpkin oil and beaten eggs. Add to dry ingredients. Stir in vanilla nuts and raisins. Mix until moistened. (Batter may be lumpy.) Spoon into a greased muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Bean And Tomato Salad
instructions: Toss together and chill before serving.

title: Cracker Jack
instructions: Put brown sugar oleo syrup and salt in deep pan and boil 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat. Add soda and stir (will foam). Pour over popcorn and nuts. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Store in airtight container. May be frozen.

title: Cream Of Potato Soup
instructions: Saute the onions in butter for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add broth salt pepper bay leaf and celery. Cover and bring to boil. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Discard bay leaf and celery. Puree soup through electric blender or force through sieve.

title: Blueberry Yum Yum
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and press into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Then beat remaining ingredients together. Fold in Cool Whip then beat until mixed. Pour on top of cooled crust. Top with fruit (your choice).

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Layer potatoes onion and parsley in large bowl. Add salt pepper oil vinegar and chicken broth. Mix lightly. Top with crumbled bacon. May be served warm or cold.

title: Quick Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to the directions on box. Cook rice as directed on box. Melt butter in large pan and put the diced onion in pan. Cook about 2 or 3 minutes. Add the Cheez Whiz milk salt soup and rice stirring until Cheez Whiz is melted. Drain water from broccoli and add the broccoli to the mixture stirring up well. Put it in a casserole dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be cooked in microwave if desired for approximately 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Special K Loaf
instructions: Crush cereal and mix with other ingredients. Spray baking dish with Pam cooking spray. Place mixture in pan. Bake covered about 60 minutes then 30 minutes uncovered. Serve with brown gravy.

title: Italian Salad(Good)
instructions: Mix oil sugar and vinegar to taste. Break noodles in small pieces. Add seasonings. Pour over remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Country Style Hearty Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large kettle or Dutch oven and drain excess fat. Cube potatoes. Cut tomatoes into wedges. Chop onions and add with remaining ingredients. Bring to slow boil. Cover potatoes and cook over medium heat making sure to stir often to prevent sticking.

title: Sunflower Seed Cookies
instructions: Drop by spoonfuls. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Mix mayonnaise with hot water and add to dry ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Holiday Egg Nog Punch
instructions: In large pitcher combine ingredients. Pour into punch bowl and garnish with scoops of orange sherbet. Makes 20 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients with apples and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until done. Makes 1 pie. Freezes well.

title: Hash Brown Potato Bake
instructions: Combine potatoes 3/4 cup margarine soup cheese onion and sour cream. Mix well and place in 11 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Burrito Bake
instructions: Spread crescent rolls in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Brown hamburger. Mix in seasoning mix beans and tomato sauce. Pour mixture over baked rolls and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts. Top with lettuce tomatoes and sour cream. Serves 6. Enjoy.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie(Club Member: Renee Evans)
instructions: Mix condensed milk and lemon juice together until thick. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into crust. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix party dip with sour cream. Add spinach after it has been thawed and drained. Add water chestnuts and blend. If desired tear out the center of the bread. Fill with your dip. May use the removed bread crackers and/or raw vegetables with your party dip.

title: Shortbread(Cookies)
instructions: Beat butter powdered sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Gradually add flour until well blended. Divide dough in 1/2. Shape each into ball. Flatten to 1-inch rounds between 2 pieces of plastic wrap. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 (moderate). Prepare potatoes as directed on box for 2 servings; set aside. Stir meat vegetables gravy and salt together. Pour into 1-quart baking dish. Mound potatoes in a ring around edge of the dish. Bake 30 minutes or until potatoes are browned slightly.

title: El Grande
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add tomato sauce and seasoning mix plus 1 can of water. Cook yellow rice according to package. Heat soup plus 1/2 can of milk. Layer these ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly. Spoon onto plate and top with lettuce tomato cheese and Fritos. You may want taco sauce.

title: Peach Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream together the cheese and sugar until very creamy. Add the rest of ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until lightly brown.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Let cream cheese soften; mix crab meat cheese and mayo. Add Worcestershire sauce onion curry and lemon juice. Mix. Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Serve with crackers (Sociables).

title: Vegetable Pita Melt
instructions: In large pot bring 2-quarts water to a rapid boil. Cut up broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Place cauliflower and broccoli into rapidly boiling water for 4 minutes. Drain in colander and let cool then place in a large bowl and add 3 chopped green onions and 1 chopped tomato. Pour Ranch dressing over vegetables enough to coat mixture. Chop the other tomato up and place on top of mixture for decoration. Chill for 2 hours. Cut pita bread in half; fill pitas up with vegetable salad. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. May be microwaved to melt cheese on top.

title: Baked Bean Surprise
instructions: Brown hamburger with onion celery and peppers. Drain. In baking dish add beans hamburger tomato paste brown sugar molasses bacon bits garlic powder salt and pepper. Mix well. Add slices of butter over top and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy slowly add sugar. Stir in salt vanilla and milk. Add raisins and rice. Pour into buttered 4-quart baking dish and place in pan of hot water. Bake at 375\u00b0 until knife poked in middle comes out clean. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Elephant Appetizers
instructions: Kill clean and cut elephant into small cubes (this will take approximately 2 months). Put in large kettles and simmer over kerosene heat at 465\u00b0 until tender (this will take approximately 14 weeks). Remove meat and set aside. Use flour and make gravy from stock in the pots. Place a toothpick in each cube of meat and arrange on large platters. Pour up gravy into bowls and serve on the side (for dipping).

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: In a large skillet brown meat well. Then stir in Lipton onion soup tomatoes and water. Simmer covered for 30 to 40 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Best Yet Potato Dish
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Add other ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. The last 15 minutes of baking time add 2 cups of cornflakes sprinkled with oleo on top of casserole.

title: Irish Whiskey Cake(1982)
instructions: Blend cake mix and pudding in 1 bowl. Combine milk oil and whiskey in another bowl. Add second bowl mix to first bowl mix. Blend. Beat in eggs one at a time scraping sides of bowl and mixing for 2 minutes until smooth. Stir in walnuts. Pour into nonstick Bundt pan or lightly greased tube cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours lightly brown and tested done.

title: Christmas Cookie Mix(Makes 7 To 8 Cups)
instructions: Mix flour and salt in large bowl; cut shortening into flour until about the size of peas. Store in covered container. Will keep for weeks without refrigeration.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease an 8-cup Bundt pan or ring mold; set aside. In a medium bowl combine brown sugar oil egg and vanilla. Stir in flour baking soda baking powder and salt. When dough is completely blended lightly fold in rhubarb and berries. Pour into greased pan. Bake 25 minutes or until center tests done. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fried Pig Ears
instructions: Boil ears until tender. Season to taste with salt pepper and meat enhancer. Remove from water. Roll in flour on both sides. Place in vegetable oil in a preheated frying pan. Let brown on both sides. Cook longer for crispness.

title: Chocolate Chip Brittle
instructions: Combine butter vanilla and salt and blend well. Gradually beat in sugar. Add flour chocolate pieces and 3/4 cup walnuts; mix well. Press evenly in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup walnuts over top and press in lightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool then break into pieces or cut into bars. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

title: Frozen Dessert Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Serves 16.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat together until well blended the eggs sugar salt butter and syrup. Mix in pecan halves. Pour into unbaked pie shell (9-inch). Bake until set and pastry is nicely browned. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Sock It To Me Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil 1/2 cup sugar and sour cream together. Put 1/2 of mixture into greased and floured tube pan. Mix brown sugar cinnamon and chopped nuts. Sprinkle on top of batter mixture. Pour in other 1/2 of batter mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool before taking out of pan.

title: Tortilla Wedges
instructions: In medium bowl combine sour cream and cream cheese; stir in onions chilies Jalapenos salt & pepper. Spread 1 tortilla with 1/4c. cream cheese mixture. Top with another tortilla - continue spreading and stacking until 4 tortillas high. Top with another tortilla that has not been spread with cheese mixture. Make another stack with remaining tortillas. Refrigerate stacks in plastic wrap one hour. Cut each stack into 18 wedges. Dip in salsa or Picante sauce.

title: Butter Almond Delight
instructions: Crush cookies and mix with melted margarine. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with mixture. Prepare pudding with milk mix in softened ice cream. Top with Cool Whip and sliced pieces of Heath bars. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve cold.

title: Cherry-Pecan Bread
instructions: Mix thoroughly first 3 ingredients. Set aside. In large mixer bowl beat together sugar butter eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture and 1 cup milk alternately to beaten mixture; beat until blended. Fold in chopped pecans and chopped cherries. Turn batter into lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 55 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool.

title: Aunt Mamye'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour. Cream in butter then add in milk and vanilla. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and stir in coconut. Beat egg whites with 3 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Spread over pie and brown lightly.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix all together and then fold in chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Use a greased and floured Bundt pan.

title: Low-Fat Oatmeal Raisin Muffins(Raisins And Apple Juice Sweeten These Muffins.)
instructions: In a large bowl mix oats raisins milk and juice. Let stand 1 hour or refrigerate overnight. Line a 12 cup muffin pan with baking cups or use a nonstick muffin pan. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Stir egg and oil in oat mixture. Add flour mixture and quickly stir with a fork just until moistened. Mixture should be lumpy. Spoon into muffin cups and bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm or cold. Muffins can be frozen and reheated before serving. Makes 12 muffins. Per muffin 1 1/2 bread 1 fat.

title: Christmas Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo powdered sugar vanilla and water. Add flour and nuts. Form in small balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 20 minutes in a 300\u00b0 oven. While warm roll in powdered sugar.

title: Rhubarb Jam
instructions: In a large saucepan stir together sugar and rhubarb. (Do not add water.) Cook gently until rhubarb is tender. Cool for 10 minutes. Stir in 1 package Jell-O. Pour into jelly glasses and cover with paraffin.

title: Chicken Or Fish Cooked In Wok(Serves 4)
instructions: Preheat wok. Add 2 tablespoons salad dressing and fish fillets or chicken. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons chicken soup over fish or chicken. Watch closely and stir often. Just a few minutes before hot add fresh or partially thawed frozen vegetables. Cover and let simmer until done.

title: Homemade Rolls
instructions: Combine milk boiling water sugar salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add to milk mixture with eggs. Mix well. Add 4 cups of flour and beat well. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk about 1 1/2 hours. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic. Roll dough out to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2-inch cutter. Brush tops of rolls with melted butter. Place in a lightly greased baking pan and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk about 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until done well. Yields about 3 dozen.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix cabbage pepper celery sugar and vinegar together. Mix spaghetti egg onion and mayonnaise then combine and mix with hands.

title: George'S Guacamole
instructions: Put into bowl first 5 ingredients. Add juice of lemon for flavor and consistency (also keeps avocado from turning black). Add salt and garlic powder. Combine all ingredients in bowl and beat with a fork.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix well. Dough is very stiff. Form into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Tropical Treat
instructions: Bake cake mixture following package directions. Grease and flour 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and salt. Beat until lemon color. Add butter flour and milk. Beat well and add vanilla and coconut. Pour into shell and bake 60 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Beef And Dumplings
instructions: In Dutch oven slowly brown meat. Add remaining ingredients except biscuits. Cover and cook slowly for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli cauliflower onion green pepper carrot and celery. Stir together mayonnaise oil vinegar sugar and mustard. Stir into vegetable mixture. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Chop Suey
instructions: Brown meat with 3 tablespoons lard or other oil. Put rest of ingredients together; add to browned meat. Simmer several hours. Serve over rice or chop suey noodles.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Form into loaves or in meat balls. Pour catsup or tomato sauce over top. For a snapper taste use barbecue sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine eggs raisins and vanilla in a small bowl; let stand for 1 hour. Mix together margarine sugars and dry ingredients. Mix well and then mix together with egg mixture. Add oatmeal and walnuts; mix well and then drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a medium bowl thoroughly combine cheese eggs bread crumbs parsley salt pepper and nutmeg. Place 1/4 cup cheese mixture in the center of each chicken breast. Roll and secure with toothpicks. In a large skillet thoroughly brown chicken on all sides in hot oil; drain fat. Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken. Simmer covered 45 minutes or until chicken is done. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Goop Delight
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 then let cool.

title: Crisp Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt peanut butter and butter or margarine together in a medium saucepan. Remove from heat; pour in sugar then crisp rice. Blend well and chill. Roll into desirable size balls.

title: Low Calorie Sour Cream
instructions: Put in blender and blend until smooth and creamy. Use wherever you would use sour cream. Delicious on fruit.

title: Taco Squares
instructions: Grease a square baking dish. Brown ground beef; drain. Mix sour cream mayonnaise cheese and onion; reserve. Combine biscuit mix and water until soft dough forms. Pat in pan pressing dough 1/2-inch up sides. Layer beef tomato and green pepper in pan. Spoon sour cream mixture over top. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until edges of dough are light brown about 25 to 30 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
instructions: Generously grease and lightly flour bottom and sides of a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. Drain pineapple; reserve syrup. Reserve 1/3 cup crumbs for topping. In large mixer bowl combine remaining wafer crumbs 1/2 cup reserved pineapple syrup dry cake mix cream or milk and eggs. Blend until moistened; beat as directed on package. Pour half of the batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with coconut. Spread drained pineapple evenly over coconut; sprinkle with chopped nuts. Spread with remaining batter sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 45-50 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes.

title: *Finikia 1(Orange Cookies)
instructions: Mix above ingredients thoroughly. Dough must be able to hold together but not hard. Roll into 1 or 1 1/2-inch balls. May be stuffed in the middle with nuts raisins or dates or leave plain. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until golden. Let cool.

title: Freezer Coleslaw
instructions: Mix cabbage and salt; let stand one hour. Heat sugar vinegar water and celery seed to boiling. Boil and stir one minute; cool to lukewarm.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients well. Put in well-greased Bundt pan. Cook 45 to 60 minutes until done. Let cool. Ice with cream cheese icing.

title: Ruby'S Black Walnut Clusters
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; cook over low heat stirring constantly until melted. Stir in black walnuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill until firm. Makes 4 plus dozen.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese in double boiler; add tomato sauce garlic cumin and chili powder to melted cheese. Combine lettuce tomatoes and crushed Fritos in large bowl. Add hamburger green onion and green pepper. Pour hot mixture over salad.

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
instructions: Cream peanut butter shortening sugar and brown sugar. Add vanilla and egg and mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Roll into balls and place in tassie pans (mini muffin pans). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven and press peanut butter cup in the center of each cookie. Let cool completely. Remove from pan. These cookies are a family favorite that travels well. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Blender Gazpacho
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender container and blend for 30 seconds. Chill and serve in a chilled glass mug.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Put rice in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Mix soups with water and pour over rice. Dip chicken in melted margarine then place on top of rice. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Rolls
instructions: Blend cream cheese with 4 tablespoons margarine and add the next 5 ingredients. Separate rolls and form 8 squares. Spoon 1/2 cup of the cream cheese mixture into center of each square. Fold over and seal. Brush tops with remaining melted margarine and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Jello Berry Cheese Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water. Measure 3/4 cup jello and set aside. Add strawberries to the remaining jello. Stir gently until fruit thaws and separates and jello begins to thicken. Pour into a 6 cup mold. Chill until set but not firm. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually blend in remaining jello and vanilla. Spoon into mold over clear jello. Chill until firm.

title: Yankee Pot Roast(Microwave)
instructions: Put meat into a 4-quart microwave safe casserole dish. Sprinkle with gravy mix. Add onion and enough hot water to cover meat. Cover casserole dish with lid. Cook in microwave 30 minutes at Medium. Turn meat over. Add carrots and potatoes to liquid. Cook covered in microwave 1 hour at Medium or until meat is tender. Remove from oven and let stand covered 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Blend in butter milk eggs and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Top with meringue and brown slightly.

title: Shrimp Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill. Serve with shrimp or other seafood.

title: Chicken And Chip Casserole
instructions: Mix chicken soup and milk. Set aside. Melt butter in a saucepan; add celery and onion. Cook over low heat until onions are glazed. Remove from heat and stir in mushrooms. Stir in chicken and add to rice and soup; mix well. Put in 1 1/2 cups potato chips in bottom of buttered casserole. Line up chips along side of dish. Pour in mixture. Top with remaining chips. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until chips are rigid brown.

title: Apple Delights
instructions: Boil 1 1/2 cups of water. Add to jello and dissolve. Add marshmallows and melt. Add pineapple with juice. Add apples and pecans. Gel.

title: Texas Hash
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet cook and stir ground beef until light brown; drain. Add onions and green peppers. Cook and stir until tender. Stir in tomatoes rice chili powder salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Pour into ungreased 2 quart casserole. Cover and bake 1 hour.

title: Sourdough Bread
instructions: Dissolve water and yeast together. Add sugar and potato flakes. Leave out all day then refrigerate. Feed starter on the fourth day.

title: Scalloped Oysters
instructions: Place layer of crackers on greased container. Add oysters and butter. Repeat layering ending with crackers and butter. Beat egg and add to milk. Pour milk/egg mixture over casserole. Season to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Quick Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Remove and discard large outer leaves of cauliflower. Break cauliflower into flowerets. Arrange flowerets in a steamer rack; place over a small amount of boiling water. Cover and steam 4 minutes or just until crisp-tender. Transfer flowerets to a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potato chips and put in large casserole dish. Crush potato chips and sprinkle on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed in an electric mixer until well blended. Pour into freezer can to \fill line\ only. Freeze according to the manufacturers instructions. Let ripen at least one hour prior to serving. Yields 5 quarts.

title: Garden Patch Potato Salad
instructions: Halve any large potato slices. In a large bowl toss together the potatoes carrots celery olives and radishes. In a small mixing bowl combine sour cream mayonnaise parsley vinegar salt dillweed mustard and pepper; mix well. Pour over vegetables tossing to coat well. Store in an airtight container. Chill several hours or overnight before serving. Stir in additional mayonnaise if necessary for a more moist salad. Trim bowl with lettuce leaves if desired. Makes 12 servings.

title: Chili
instructions: Mix meat chili powder and flour; brown. Add onion and the remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat for 3 hours.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together the cream cheese and salsa. Spread on 14-inch pizza plate. Top with lettuce tomatoes and Cheddar cheese. Serve with taco chips.

title: Salad Dressing(From A Hadassah Cookbook)
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting
instructions: Combine evaporated milk sugar egg yolks margarine and vanilla in saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add coconut and pecans. Beat until cool and thick enough to spread on cake.

title: Succulent Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Cook stuffing according to box directions. Wash mushrooms and remove stems. Chop stems and imitation crab meat into the stuffing. Stuff mushrooms with stuffing mixture; place in broiler pan with water. Bake at 400\u00b0 until mushrooms are tender checking often to add more water to the broiler pan. Remove mushrooms from the oven; drain off any water. Sprinkle mushrooms with cheese; bake until cheese melts.

title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
instructions: Lightly brown beef. Add onion. Cook until tender not brown; drain. Add corn soups sour cream noodles salt and pepper. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Mix melted butter with bread crumbs; sprinkle over top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Brunch Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Beat eggs slightly; stir in remaining ingredients except 3/4 cup cheese. Spread evenly in a 9-inch square pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until top is lightly brown. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 1 to 2 minutes longer or just until cheese is melted.

title: Mushroom Logs
instructions: Drain mushrooms and chop well. Add all but eggs and poppy seed. Spread mixture on each spread out roll/dough. Start at long side and roll up. Slice logs in 1 inch pieces. Put on greased baking sheet. Brush log with beaten egg then sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Honey Crunch
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl combine cereal oats nuts cinnamon and salt. In small saucepan combine butter honey and brown sugar. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until butter is melted and ingredients are well blended. Pour over combined cereal mixture; mix until thoroughly coated. Spread evenly in a 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 25 minutes. Sprinkle raisins over mixture; stir in gently. Continue baking for 5 minutes or until mixture is golden brown. Immediately spread mixture on aluminum foil or an ungreased cookie sheet. Cool. Store in tightly covered container in a cool dry place. Makes about 7 cups.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and sprinkle over apples. Melt margarine and brown sugar. Bring to a boil and pour over apples. Put on top crust and bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: 1 Gallon Ice Cream
instructions: Combine the condensed milk and evaporated milk. Add the plain milk. Stir in the sugar and a pinch of salt. Mix well to dissolve the sugar. Add the cut-up or mashed fruit. Stir well.

title: Oatmeal-Pecan-Raisin Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream butter with granulated sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy scraping bowl several times. Add vanilla and eggs beating well after each addition. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in oats raisins and pecans. Drop by tablespoons 2 inches apart onto baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Cover bran with boiling water. Meanwhile cream sugar and margarine. Add bran mix flour soda well beaten eggs and buttermilk; mix well. Bake in muffin pan at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Cheese Souffle
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Sprinkle bread bits over bottom of buttered 1-quart baking dish. Cover with cheese. Mix eggs milk mustard salt and pepper. Pour over cheese. Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken and next 4 ingredients until chicken is tender. Remove chicken. Strain broth. Remove chicken from bone and cut into bite size pieces. If using fresh carrots boil carrots celery and onions in 2 c. chicken stock until tender. Drain mix all veggies together. Prepare crust according to directions and roll out. Put bottom crust in casserole dish brown in oven at 350\u00b0. Remove and cool. Put vegies in crust. Make roux with 4 Tbsp. oleo and 4 Tbsp. of flour. Add 2 c. stock stir until thickened. Salt to taste. Pour over vegies.

title: Whip Chocolate Cake
instructions: Beat together first 4 ingredients. Add and blend well remaining ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Frost with any kind of prepared frosting. This is the moistest cake ever!

title: Slush
instructions: Mash bananas and add juices and water. Freeze until solid. One hour before using take out of freezer. Fill glasses half full of icy mixture and add 7-Up.

title: Swiss Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain reserving 1/4 cup water. Peel and cube. Saute onions in butter. Combine potatoes onions parsley cheese milk water and salt. Cook until all vegetables are well blended. Makes 4 servings. The parsley can be omitted.

title: Five-Layer Casserole
instructions: In a greased casserole dish or crock-pot place 1 layer each of potatoes carrots and onions in that order. Cover with browned ground beef. Add cream of mushroom and tomato soups (undiluted). Do not mix ingredients. Cover dish and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening margarine sugars eggs vanilla and soda. (Dissolve soda in warm water.) Add flour cream of tartar salt and chocolate chips. Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: That Good Pink Stuff
instructions: Mix well and chill.

title: Eggs Creole
instructions: Cook the onion and green pepper in oil in a large frypan until the onion is lightly browned. Add the tomatoes and water; heat to boiling. Add the uncooked rice salt and pepper. Cover; cook over low heat until rice is tender 25 to 30 minutes. Stir occasionally with a fork to keep from sticking. If the rice becomes dry add a little more water. Drop eggs on rice. Cover; simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until eggs are as firm as desired.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Cream butter sugar egg yolks and salt. Add pineapple and milk. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form then fold into mixture. Put in unbaked pie shell. Add top crust and bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix; marinate chicken overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or broil. Great party appetizers!

title: Honey Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix honey with well beaten eggs. Cream the sugar dry milk and butter. Add to honey-egg mixture. Stir in pecans and vanilla. Turn into an unbaked 9-inch crust and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and add cracker crumbs coconut vanilla chopped nuts sugar and peanut butter. Mix thoroughly and press into small bars.

title: Cherry Pineapple Cake
instructions: Spread ingredients one at a time as listed into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Do not stir. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done. Serve with whipped topping.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix well. Add berries. Pour in graham cracker crust then refrigerate.

title: Saxapahash
instructions: Brown ground beef; add sugar salt garlic salt and tomato sauce. Simmer 20 minutes. Chop onions and mix with sour cream and cream cheese. Cook noodles; drain.

title: Spicy Cabbage
instructions: Saute bacon and onion. Add cut up cabbage and tomato soup and juice. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook in Dutch oven. Simmer until tender.

title: Cinnamon Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together 5 minutes. Sift baking powder with flour over pecans and add to eggs and sugar. Add cinnamon and extract. Drop on buttered pans and bake.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake 1 hour and 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Zingy Party Dip
instructions: Mix together; cover and chill at least 2 hours. Good with crackers or veggies.

title: Caramel Apple Oat Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour oats sugar baking soda and salt. Mix well and cut in margarine until crumbly. Reserving 1 1/2 cups of mixture press remainder into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Bake
instructions: Brown chops in oil. Sprinkle with salt and set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream pepper and 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt. Stir in potatoes 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions. Spoon into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Arrange chops over mixture. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

title: Potato And Leek Soup
instructions: Saute leeks and garlic in some vegetable oil until soft in an 8-quart pot. Add the Wondra flour mixture and stir until well blended. Add the remaining ingredients and fill pot with water until approximately 3/4 full. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened to desired consistency.

title: Cheesy Pepperoni Pizza
instructions: Unroll dough; press into greased 12-inch pizza pan. Cover with sauce 1 cup Mozzarella and Provolone cheese pepperoni mushrooms and peppers. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Delicious Jelly
instructions: Bring to a rolling boil for 20 minutes. Any kind of berries may be used using the same amount of pineapple and sugar.

title: Glazed Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onions and cut into even thin slices. Heat butter in a large skillet. Add onions and toss for a few minutes until coated with butter. Do not brown. Add vinegar brown sugar and curry powder. Stir to blend well. Add parsley. Cook onions for about 5 minutes covered until almost tender-crisp. Remove cover. Cook onions for 2 to 3 minutes more until glazed. Season with salt pepper and paprika. Add chile if desired. Serve onions hot as a side dish or cool as an appetizer. Or use onions as a topping for green or potato salads.

title: Nut Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates; add butter salt flour soda and sugar. Beat in egg and nut meats. Blend well and place in greased floured loaf pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pink Salad Perfection
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into a 9 x 13 dish. Chill overnight before serving.

title: Lemon Snow Flakes
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine cake mix Cool Whip and egg. Beat with mixer on medium until blended. Batter will be sticky. Drop by teaspoonfuls into confectioners sugar. Roll lightly to coat. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

title: Lime Swizzle
instructions: Stir together ingredients one at a time and garnish with fruit slices. Serves 10 (1-cup) servings.

title: Sole With Mushrooms, Lemon And Parmesan Cheese
instructions: Saute onion parsley and mushrooms in 3 tablespoons margarine. Stir constantly until onions become soft. Mix in thyme. Place fillets in greased baking dish; pour sauteed ingredients over fish. Sprinkle with salt pepper and lemon peel to taste. Pour wine over all. Dot with remaining margarine.

title: Hazel'S Punch
instructions: Add water according to package directions to make 1 gallon Kool-Aid. Combine with pineapple juice and chill. When ready to use add ginger ale and sherbet.

title: Apricot Salad
instructions: Bring liquid and sugar to a boil and pour over jello; let congeal. Mix softened cream cheese pineapple and nuts together and spread on top of jello.

title: Broccoli Hollywood
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Blend 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. Sprinkle on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Cheesy Crab-Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Scrub potatoes thoroughly. Rub skins with oil. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Allow potatoes to cool to touch. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Carefully scoop out pulp leaving shells intact. Spoon pulp into a mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients except paprika. Mash with a potato masher. Stuff shells with potato mixture; sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Mix Bisquick and water. Smooth dough into a ball on floured surface and knead 20 times. Pat dough on bottom and sides of pan. Cook hamburger and Italian sausage. Pour tomato sauce over dough. Add beef sausage mushrooms onion and green pepper. Top with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Swedish Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice in milk in double boiler until tender. Put in casserole. Add 4 small or 3 large eggs (beaten slightly) sugar salt and vanilla. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake in pan of water one hour at 350\u00b0 or until custard is set.

title: Dill Pickle *
instructions: Mix vinegar water and salt; boil for 5 minutes. To each sterile quart jar add 2 heads dill a lump of alum about the size of a pea and cucumbers. Pour hot vinegar water into jars and seal. Makes 6 quarts.

title: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Put chicken in pot and cover with water. Add bouillon and cook until chicken is done. Remove skin and remove bone. Cut in bite-size pieces. Add 1 carrot (sliced thin) onion (chopped) celery stalk (cut in small pieces) and sprinkle with sage. Add bay leaf and cook until vegetables are tender. Add thin noodles (cholesterol-free fat-free). Lower heat and cook until noodles are done.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Put butter in 9 x 12-inch baking pan and melt the butter in the oven. Mix the flour sugar salt and baking powder with milk to make a thin batter. Put batter in pan of butter. Put fruit on top of batter. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in oven at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Top with wieners or pork if desired. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Orange Julius Punch
instructions: Combine in blender. Cover and blend until smooth and frothy.

title: Christmas Wreaths
instructions: Melt oleo and marshmallows. Add food coloring and pour over corn flakes. Stir until flakes are coated. Using a 1/4 cup measure coated with cooking spray portion out warm cereal mixture onto cookie sheet. With buttered fingers mold into wreaths. Dot with red hot candies.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Bake pork roast until very done. Cut into string strips and pieces. Throw away fat. Put in large saucepan with onion and pepper; cook until pepper and onion are soft. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for at least 1 hour.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar; blend well.\tAdd beaten eggs and applesauce. Blend. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mock Swedish Brown Beans
instructions: Mix together; simmer 10 minutes. Cook until lightly thickened; salt to taste.

title: Hot Cheese And Artichoke Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Key Lime Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and gelatin. Add orange juice. Mix thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add oil. Stir in thoroughly. Grease and flour three 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until done. Mix margarine cream cheese and powdered sugar thoroughly. Add chopped pecans if desired.

title: Italian Boneless Chicken
instructions: Combine eggs Parmesan and crumbs. Stir in chicken. Mix well. With hands shape mixture into 16 (3/4-inch) thick patties.

title: Susie'S Soft Chicken Tacos
instructions: Remove the bone from the chicken breasts. Season both sides of the breasts with seasoned salt. Combine the Italian dressing Worcestershire sauce picante sauce and cilantro. Marinate the chicken in this mixture for at least 3 hours in the refrigerator.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Cook ground beef drain well and crumble. Spray Dutch oven or large saucepan with nonstick cooking spray. Heat over medium-high heat until hot. Add onions celery and garlic. Cook and stir until crisp-tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except pasta. Bring to boil. Stir in pasta. Cover. Remove from heat and let stand 30 to 45 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Spicy Barbecue Ribs
instructions: Cut ribs into portions. Precook covered in water for 1 hour or until tender. Using tongs remove ribs to a platter. If grilling put on grill. Barbecue ribs 20 minutes turning often and brushing with sauce during last 10 minutes to prevent charring.

title: Twinkie Pie
instructions: Cut Twinkies lengthwise; place in medium dish with cream side up. Pour pineapple over them. Cut up bananas and lay in next. Prepare pudding according to directions; and spread over all. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve. Put Cool Whip on just before serving.

title: Cheese Potato Puff Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain. Add butter cheese milk and salt; beat thoroughly. Fold in beaten eggs; put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 10. Can be made ahead and reheated in oven before serving.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 an hour or until brown.

title: Easy Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to package. Bake in 2 layers. When cool split in 4 layers. Mix coconut sour cream and sugar; set aside 1/2 cup. Spread the rest between cake layers. Mix the reserved 1/2 cup with Cool Whip. Spread over top and sides of cake. Refrigerate at least 3 days. Keep refrigerated.

title: Delmonico Potatoes
instructions: Bake the potatoes. Peel the potatoes as thinly as possible and chop. Place in small baking dish with cream and butter. Add the seasonings. Cook on top of the stove for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese and place under a broiler for 3 minutes. Dish is done when the cheese is brown and bubbly. Serve at once.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Spray 9x13in cake pan with non-stick cooking spray. layer coconut and chopped pecans in prepared pan.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Cook gizzards and livers first and cut into small pieces. Brown meat and vegetables together. When well browned add 2 cups rice and 4 cups water and cook until done. Makes a large amount.

title: Chocolate Souffle
instructions: Ribbon egg yolks sugar and salt heavily. Melt chocolate and let cool. Add heavy cream instant coffee (dissolved in the liqueur) and blend into ribboning yolks. Beat the whites and fold into the base. Spoon into a buttered and lightly sugared 6-cup souffle dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Can freeze. Take right from freezer to oven only put on lower rack; add 5 minutes for light souffle.

title: Chocolate Crunch Squares
instructions: In 13 x 9-inch baking pan melt butter. Remove from heat. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over butter. Pour Eagle Brand evenly over crumbs. Top with chocolate chips coconut and chopped pecans. Press down gently. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Cool. Cut into squares.

title: Southern-Fried Baked Steak
instructions: Pound steak to tenderize. Cut into serving-size pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Dust with flour. Combine milk and egg. Dip meat into egg mixture and back into flour. In a skillet brown meat on both sides in oil.

title: Spoon Rolls
