instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 2 tablespoons warm water. Add the 2 cups water oil sugar and egg. Mix ingredients well. Gradually add flour continuing to mix well. Spoon into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Batter will keep for 3 to 4 days. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Fuss Free Risotto
instructions: In saucepan bring to boil water and salt. Stir in rice. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in butter cream and Parmesan. Serve.

title: Crum'S Freezer Strawberries
instructions: Boil water. Mix with sugar and jello. Fill freezer containers with whole or sliced strawberries. Evenly fill containers with cooled jello solution. Close securely and freeze.

title: Pineapple Delicious
instructions: Mix the grated lime peel lime juice honey and cherry brandy together in a large bowl. Peel the pineapple removing the skin and most of the black holes on the surface of the flesh. Stand the pineapple upright and begin cutting it vertically into 1/4-inch slices stopping when you get to the core turning it 90\u00b0 and cutting again until the pineapple has been rotated 360\u00b0 on the base and all the flesh has been removed. Then stack up the slices and cut them into 1 1/2-inch wide strips. Add the pineapple strips to the bowl containing the other ingredients and mix well. Allow the pineapple to macerate in the lime juice mixture for at least 1 hour. Serve with slices of pound cake or cookies. Yield 4 servings.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown the hamburger with the onion. Add the next 3 seasonings. Cook the noodles with the celery; drain. Mix all ingredients very well. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with foil. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle generous amounts of Mozzarella cheese. Cook until cheese melts.

title: Tex'S Economy Supper
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef and onion. Add soup and soup can of milk stirring constantly. Add hot pepper flakes to your taste. Mix in cooked macaroni. Serve with toast and green beans for a good economical meal. If any is left over you can add a can of tomato soup and warm up for a change.

title: Mushroom And Chestnut Pate
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 9-inch loaf pan.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients mix well. Add to this the next four ingredients (flour etc.). Stir in the last five ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes (metal pan) or 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes (glass pan). Do not overbake. Cool then frost.

title: Easy As 1, 2, 3 Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and cake mix. Add apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Hawaiian Pudding
instructions: Mix wafer crumbs and margarine and press lightly into pan or baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Mix other ingredients in order of listing. Pour milk over bananas and sprinkle pecans over coconut.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients. Pour mixture into pie shell. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking 20 to 25 minutes longer. Cool.

title: Veal Cutlet With Zucchini
instructions: Dip the cutlets in egg whites then in crumbs. Brown the cutlets in oil; pour off excess oil. Add the tomatoes and oregano. Cover tightly; simmer for 30 minutes. Add zucchini. Cover; continue to cook for 20 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Process cheese. Add mayo onion and seasonings. Continue to process until fully blended. Refrigerate 1/2 hour. Process pecan meat. Shape cheese mixture into a ball. Roll in pecan meat.

title: Christmas Pie
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Chill until slightly thick. Fold in cranberry sauce and pineapple. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill until firm.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef and add onion soup; mixing well. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer slowly for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix together butter flour and nuts. Press in the bottom of 8 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0; cool.

title: Halo-Halo(Mixed Ingredients)
instructions: Fill the glass\twith shaved ice about 3/4 full. Put about 1 tablespoon each of the ingredients or fruits over the shaved ice. Pour 4 tablespoons of milk. Mix all the ingredients and shaved ice together. Add sugar to taste.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Wash chicken and brown lightly in olive oil using a large saucepan. Add onions garlic and basil; saute until onions are tender. Add tomatoes and all of puree to chicken mixture. Cover and simmer gently for two hours. Stir chicken a few times during the two hours being sure to push the chicken down under the sauce before covering the pan and leaving it to simmer. Serve over linguine.

title: New Orleans Pecan Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine egg yolks sour cream granulated sugar flour vanilla and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened about 5 minutes. Pour into baked pie shell; set aside.

title: Tamale Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine dry ingredients. Add milk and margarine; beat until smooth. Pour into greased 8-inch square dish.

title: Pineapple Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In small bowl mix crumbs and margarine. Press into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake until lightly browned (10 minutes). Remove and cool. Using 2 cups skim milk prepare the pudding. Pour over crumbs. Top with pineapple. Spread topping over pudding. Cover and refrigerate until chilled.

title: Tomato Stuff
instructions: Chop tomatoes hot peppers bell peppers onion and garlic. Stirring constantly simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with meat vegetables or pasta. Especially good with fried eggplant.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Combine 1 1/4 cups flour baking powder salt 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 stick oleo. Mix as for pie crust. Add egg yolk and milk. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Peel and pare apples. Put in pan and top with mixture of remaining ingredients. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 3/4 hour.

title: Caramel Coconut Pie
instructions: Toast coconut pecans and butter in skillet and let cool. Mix milk and cream cheese together. Fold cool whip into milk and cheese mixture. Pour 1/2 of cream cheese mixture into bottom of graham cracker crust. Put 1/2 of coconut mixture on top of that. Squeeze caramel sauce on then top with the rest of cream cheese mixture. Put rest of coconut and pecans on top and freeze.

title: Asparagus Roll-Ups
instructions: In bowl cream together the cream cheese parsley and horseradish. Spread 1 tablespoon of the mixture over each salmon strip. Place asparagus over cheese on the long side and roll up. Chill 1 hour. Before serving use a sharp knife to cut each roll into four 1-inch pieces and serve. Serves 12. Great!!

title: Pie Crust
instructions: With table knife cut together first four ingredients until finely crumbled. Add combined ice water and food coloring. Mix all again. With hands press mixture into two round balls one slightly larger for bottom crust small one for top. Roll out. Use 8-inch pie pan. Bake 20 minutes at 425\u00b0 then 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Use any leftover scraps of crust for decoration.

title: The Dish
instructions: Cook noodles. Saute hamburger meat in a little fat. Add onions and peppers. Add corn chili powder and tomato paste. Add cheese and noodles last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Delight
instructions: Salt and boil chicken breasts until tender. Then pull from bones and cut chicken into large chunks and place into medium casserole dish. Mix soup sour cream and lemon juice pour over chicken. Top with Ritz crackers and poppy seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hummingbird Cake(4-H Champion)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl; add eggs and oil stirring until all dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat! Stir in pineapple 1 cup pecans and bananas. Spoon batter into 3 greased 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely. Spread frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans on top. Yields 1 (3-layer) cake.

title: Macaroni Cheese Casserole
instructions: Blend soup milk mustard and seasonings until smooth. Stir in macaroni and 1\t1/2 cups cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with\tonions\tand remaining\tcheese. Bake 10 minutes more.

title: Beef Burgundy Pie
instructions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak into 1-inch cubes and set aside. Remove outer skin from onions; set aside.

title: Sugar Ham
instructions: Score each side of ham 1/4 inch deep in a diamond pattern. Combine brown sugar and lemon juice in a small pan and heat to boiling. Place ham on grill; cook 15 minutes on each side basting frequently with mixture. Serve with grilled potatoes and deviled eggs.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except pie filling and cinnamon and sugar for topping. Pour 1/2 of batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Spoon pie filling over batter. Add rest of batter. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Savory Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese with 3 tablespoons butter until smooth. Add remaining ingredients keeping aside the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter. Squeeze seams of 2 rolls together to form a square. Place 1/2 cup chicken mixture in the center of square. Wrap and fold edges under; seal well. Brush with melted butter. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix all ingredients and pour into the graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Put butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt at 325\u00b0 in oven. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in sugar. Add nuts and stir. Put in buttered pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn every 10 minutes. Store in airtight container.

title: Burger With Peas
instructions: Place water in a 2-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and microwave on High for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until boiling. Slowly pour in bulgur. Add onion butter bouillon granules garlic and salt. Cover and microwave on High for 12 minutes. Add peas; cover and microwave on High for 5 to 7 minutes or until bulgur is tender and liquid is absorbed.

title: Smothered Sausage Patties
instructions: Mix meat with crumbs and poultry seasoning. Shape into 12 patties. Brown on both sides. Pour off fat. Mix soup and 1 cup water; bring to a boil stirring until smooth. Add patties and simmer a few minutes. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Shrimp And Fried Okra
instructions: Wash okra; pat dry and cut in 1/2-inch circles. Wash deveined shrimp; pat dry.\tSeason\tsparingly with salt and pepper. Fry bacon\tstrips. Saute\tonion and shrimp in bacon drippings.\tMeanwhile heat\tin skillet 1\tcup vegetable oil. Pour two cups okra in heated oil. Stir constantly making sure okra browns gently not burn. Drain all oil off fried okra. Mix shrimp and\tonions\tin with drained okra in the skillet. Mix other okra with sugar and lightly add bacon pieces on top. Add 2 tablespoons water and cover. Can be served with rice.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken then cook noodles in broth while deboning the chicken. Noodles should be a little soupy. Dice chicken into the noodles and add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Freezes well.

title: Bubbles Galore
instructions: Mix the ingredients in dishpans or large shallow tubs. Set these outside on the grass. (If soap spills on pavement it will make walking slippery.) You may mix it and store it in clean milk jug. Dip your plastic wand or paddles in and wave or blow to make bubbles galore.

title: Chicken Dijon
instructions: Melt oleo in skillet. Add chicken and cook until done and lightly browned. Remove chicken. Stir flour into drippings. May need more oleo to make suitable roux. Cook for 1 minute. Add chicken broth and light cream. Stir and cook until sauce thickens and bubbles. Stir in mustard. Return chicken to skillet; cover and heat for 10 minutes. (Tastes better when made ahead of time and chicken marinates in sauce.) Serve with long grain and wild rice. Makes 4 large servings.

title: Whole Wheat Honey Bread
instructions: Soften yeast in water. Scald milk add shortening honey and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Add softened yeast and flours. Knead well cover and let rise until doubled. Punch down and shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased loaf pans cover and let rise until double again. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Layer in a punch bowl 1/2 cake (cubed); 1/2 cherry pie filling; 1/2 pudding (prepared); 1/2 pineapple; 1 banana; 1/2 whipped topping; repeat layers in same order. Garnish with coconut pecans and cherries.

title: Easy Coconut Cake
instructions: Cook cake in square pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Cool cake and punch holes in it. Pour mixture Coco Lopez and condensed milk over then spread Cool Whip over this. Sprinkle coconut over top. Refrigerate.

title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
instructions: Mix all together and pour into a greased angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Peaches And Cream Punch
instructions: In a teapot pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and brew for 5 minutes. Cool. In a chilled 4-quart punch bowl blend peach nectar with tea. Add champagne or seltzer. Top with scoops of yogurt and garnish if desired with fresh peach slices. Serve immediately. Makes 24 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Bring sugar and Karo to rolling boil. Mix peanut butter and corn flakes together in a bowl. Pour Karo mixture over. Let cool slightly. Pull apart and roll in balls. Finish cooling on wax paper.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Fill shell with whole berries.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook frozen beans in salted water (drain if using canned beans but omit salt). Combine milk soup and pepper and pour over beans. Add 1/2 can onions. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Garnish with 1/2 can onions and pimento; bake for additional 5 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sylvia'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in water with a little salt until tender. Drain off excess liquid. Mash up the squash and onion a little. Add margarine and 3/4 c. of grated cheese. Stir until melted. Beat eggs and add milk and blend well. Add this to squash mixture. Add stuffing mix to squash mixture mixing well.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and drop by teaspoons into very hot deep fat. Fry until golden brown.

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Place ribs in shallow pan and season with salt and garlic powder. Bake at 450\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Mix chili sauce pineapple preserves and vinegar. Lower oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer. Spoon off excess fat. Brush mixture on meat and continue to bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes more basting occasionally with sauce.

title: Fresh Fruit Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and marshmallow cream with mixer until creamy. Chill or serve immediately. Delicious! Spoon over fruit.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Add bell pepper onion celery and water chestnuts to sausage and saute. Add water and bring to boil. Add rice and chicken noodle soup mix. Boil ingredients for 15 minutes. Combine the mixtures and add mushroom soup mushrooms and almonds. Place in a casserole and bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Nutty Tuna Salad
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine tuna feta cheese celery apples nuts and tarragon. Mix well. Stir in salt and pepper. Serve over assorted lettuces. Serves 4.

title: Dad'S Easy Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Pour into greased 8 x 11-inch baking pan; clear glass works best. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 28 minutes. Yield 12 servings.

title: Peppermint Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar. Add sugar slowly until forms peaks. Add mint extract and chocolate chips. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Turn out on paper towel to cool.

title: Chicken Marengo
instructions: Season chicken and brown in mixture of butter and oil in large skillet together with chopped onion. Sprinkle flour on top; add wine tomatoes spices and garlic. Let simmer gently for 20 minutes.

title: Crunchy Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter shortening cream cheese and sugar at medium speed of electric mixer beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Fold in 2 1/2 cups flour; stir in vanilla. Mix remaining 1/2 cup flour with butterscotch morsels and nuts. Fold into batter. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan to cool completely.

title: 8-Minute Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Blend well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set (at least 4 hours).

title: Southern Chicken Casserole
instructions: Dredge chicken parts in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Place chicken in greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with margarine. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over chicken. Cover casserole. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Meatballs
instructions: Mix. Pour over browned meatballs and heat thoroughly.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix together thoroughly the butter confectioners sugar and vanilla extract. Sift together and stir in sifted flour and salt. Add finely chopped nuts to batter. Chill dough. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet (cookies do not spread). Bake until set but not brown in moderately hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. While still warm roll in confectioners sugar. Cool. Roll in sugar again. Yields about 4 dozen 1 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Four Bean Salad
instructions: Mix well and let stand overnight.

title: German Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Stir in drained sauerkraut. Mix ground beef egg bread crumbs milk salt and pepper until well blended. Shape into 24 meatballs. Brown in oleo in a large frying pan. Stir in tomatoes. Spoon half the noodle-sauerkraut mixture into an 8-cup baking dish. Top with half the meatball mixture. Repeat layers. Cover. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bubbly hot in the center.

title: Grandma Ryan'S Hoover Cakes
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar raisins shortening water and seasoning; bring to a boil slowly for 3 minutes. Let cool. Sift together dry ingredients. Add vanilla and mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 24 cupcakes or 2 loaf cakes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Stir in 1 small can or crushed pineapple well drained. Stir in chopped green pepper and add chopped onion. Mix in seasoned salt and add chopped pecans. Chill and form into ball. Roll in finely chopped pecans and chill at least 2 hours.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Mix cut up chicken mushroom soup and Ro-Tel tomatoes together. Cover bottom of casserole dish with crushed chips and layer alternately with chicken mixture. Cover top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Casserole(Club Member: Brigitte Magee)
instructions: Boil hash browns until tender; drain. Combine dip sour cream and soup with potatoes. Top with grated cheese and bake until bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all together and pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Refrigerate. Makes 2 pies.

title: Hominy-Tomato Casserole
instructions: In skillet cook onion and garlic in oil over low heat stirring until onion is softened. Stir in hominies tomatoes chilies salt and pepper to taste and tomato paste. Simmer stirring occasionally for 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish; sprinkle Monterey Jack cheese over it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage green peppers and onions together in a glass container with cover. In a saucepan combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour dressing over cabbage mixture cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving. Slaw in a covered glass container will keep in refrigerator for several weeks.

title: Honey Walleye
instructions: In a shallow bowl beat egg; add honey. In a plastic bag combine crackers and salt. Dip fish in egg mixture then shake in bag until coated. In a skillet cook fillets in oil for 3-5 minutes per side or until golden and fish flakes easily with a fork. Serve with lemon wedges if desired. Yield 4-6 servings.

title: Cream Cheese Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Cream together with sour cream. Stir green pepper onion and dried beef into the mixture. Add pecans and black pepper. Stir well. Add milk and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Coconut Cake
instructions: When cake is done leave in pan; let cool for a while then take a large fork and punch holes all in the cake. While cake is still warm pour liquid over top of cake. Let cake finish cooling then spread 1 large carton of Cool Whip over cake then sprinkle fresh coconut over cake. Keep in refrigerator.

title: * Baked Pork Chops *
instructions: Brown pork chops; salt and pepper to taste. Make dressing according to directions. Lay pork chops in bottom of pan. Pour dressing on top; cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and let bake 5 to 10 minutes or until dressing starts to brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix butter and grated cheese. Add flour sifted with salt and pepper. Press small amount on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cherry Pineapple Crunch
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan empty can of crushed pineapple (spread). Pour can of cherry pie filling over pineapple (spread). Sprinkle yellow cake mix over that. Melt butter and pour over cake. Sprinkle chopped walnuts over that. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Kahlua
instructions: Soak the vanilla bean in the vodka for 2 days. Boil 1/3 cup water and add instant coffee. Dissolve sugar in 2/3 cup water and add to rest of ingredients. Now add rum. Bottle in tightly capped bottle. The longer this sets the better it will taste.

title: Pink Delight
instructions: In a large bowl mix the Jell-O cottage cheese and pineapple. Put Cool Whip on top. Chill in refrigerator for 4 or 5 hours and serve.

title: No Cook Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into well buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Chill until firm.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel dice and cook eggplant for 10 minutes in salted water. Drain eggplant. Blend flour and margarine together in a separate bowl. Cook tomatoes green pepper and onion in a saucepan until tender approximately 10 minutes. Add butter and flour mixture to tomato mixture stirring slowly. Cook until it thickens. Place one layer of eggplant in baking dish then one layer of tomato mixture and then sprinkle with cheese. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Follow Solomons advice (beat well) in Proverbs 2314 third word.

title: Coconut Dessert
instructions: Crust Mix flour 1/2 stick butter and crushed nuts together and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Broiled Mullets
instructions: Prepare charcoal grill at least 1 hour before you begin cooking mullets. Split but do not scale enough medium to large size mullets for number of people you wish to feed. Remove gut and head. Rinse well and drain; pat dry. Lay fish out on waxed paper on counter or table. Salt medium to heavy on both sides of fish. You may wish to use paper towels under fish to help absorb moisture. Turn fish over after 2 hours; let set 2 hours more. Turn fish over again; let set 2 hours more.

title: Chow Chow
instructions: Grind tomatoes and mix with other ground vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Add vegetables and simmer for 4 minutes. Do not overcook. Pour into sterilized jars and seal. Process in hot water bath (212\u00b0) for 5 minutes. Remove jars and complete seal.

title: Boston Shrimp Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain and rinse well with cold water. Put in a large bowl. Add shrimp. Chop vegetables into very small pieces. Fry bacon until well done and crumble. Mix all ingredients together and toss well with mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste. Line a large bowl with fresh lettuce leaves and turn completed salad into bowl. Sprinkle top lightly with paprika and refrigerate. Serve cold.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar soda cinnamon and salt into bowl. Add oil. Beat. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla carrots and chopped nuts (optional).

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in unsalted water; drain. Saute onion drained mushrooms and undrained green peas. Combine soup milk drained tuna and cheese. Add cracker crumbs on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until it bubbles.

title: Whiskey Slush
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a very large bowl or pot. Place in several containers and freeze.

title: Jelly Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder thoroughly. Beat whites and yolks separately. Mix sugar with yolks. Add sifted flour then add whites of eggs and milk. Mix thoroughly and pour into 3 shallow pans and bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. When cooled spread with currant jelly. Place each layer on top of the other and sift powdered sugar on top.

title: Greek Style Kabobs With Pita Bread
instructions: Cut pork into bite size pieces. Season with lemon juice salt pepper oregano and olive oil. Skewer meat and cook on the grill. Brush pita bread with a bit of oil and grill as well. When the meat is tender put 1 skewer on each pita and slowly draw out the skewer leaving the pieces of meat in the pita. Add the onion tomato parsley and sauce. Roll the pita. A piece of grease-proof or wax paper can be rolled along the bottom half of the pita for a less messy sandwich.

title: Peach Cobbler Supreme
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 9-inch pan. Remove. Sift together dry ingredients. Add milk and stir well. Pour this mixture into baking pan. Do not stir. Top with peaches including juice. Sprinkle with nutmeg cinnamon and lemon peel. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown. A surprise cobbler batter rises to top during baking and forms a crust.

title: Cream Cheese Cake Frosting
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine cream cheese butter vanilla and sugar. Stir by hand until mixture is smooth. Spread on Pineapple Surprise Cake while the cake is still slightly warm to the touch.

title: Baked Hickory Smoked Ham
instructions: Wrap ham in aluminum foil. Place in a large broiler type pan. Bake in a slow oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes per pound allowing an extra 30 minutes for the ham to heat through and through. At the end of cooking carefully pull away foil. (Watch the steam!) Cut away the hard skin and score the fat on both sides of the ham. Mix sauce and pour over ham. Return to 400\u00b0 oven and brown for 10 to 15 minutes. Turn ham over and repeat the sauce and brown on that side.

title: Orange Fluff Jello
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water add sherbet and drained orange slices. Blend well. (Melted sherbet will be frothy on top.) Chill. Add cool whip when serving.

title: Cherry Cheesecake Pie
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into pastry shell. Add almond extract to cherry pie filling and spoon over cheese layer. Chill until set.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add vanilla; beat in egg and milk. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 on lightly greased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Bake at 325\u00b0 uncovered for 1 or 2 hours.

title: Apple Impromptu
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Place apples in a well-greased 8 or 9-inch pie pan. Combine 1/4 cup of sugar with the cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Cover with foil. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Meanwhile cream butter and gradually add 1/2 cup sugar; blend in egg and vanilla extract. Sift flour with baking powder then blend into cream mixture. Remove apples from oven and spread cream mixture over apples. Bake another 20 to 25 minutes. Serve warm or cold. (Can use peaches instead of apples.)

title: New Orleans Red Kidney Beans
instructions: Rinse and sort beans. Cover and soak overnight or soak in hot water. Combine beans with ham. Saute in flat skillet the onion bell pepper celery and parsley. Add these with meat bay leaf salt and pepper to taste into the beans. Boil gently stirring occasionally for about 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Add water while cooking if necessary. Or put everything in a slow cooker on slow or high temperature. Allow beans to rest for 1 hour in hot water. They will be ready to use.

title: Angel Food Doughnuts
instructions: Beat milk and cream until foamy. Add eggs sugar and vanilla. Sift together the dry ingredients. Combine with the milk and egg mixture. Chill for 1 hour. Roll out on floured board. Cut with doughnut cutter. Fry in deep fat. As doughnuts rise to the surface of the fat or shortening turn over often until done.

title: Fudge Truffle Cheesecake
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. In medium bowl combine the vanilla wafer crumbs powdered sugar Hersheys cocoa and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan; set aside. In heavy saucepan over very low heat melt chips stirring constantly. In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add melted chips and remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 5 minutes or until center is set. Cool; chill. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Place ingredients in a bowl; mix well with mixer. Spoon into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Add dry Jell-O to Cool Whip; mix well. Add the well drained pineapple and oranges cottage cheese and nuts and mix well.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Break up angel food cake into bite size pieces. Put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan should be about 1/2 full. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread over cake. Take strawberry glaze and spread over the cream cheese mixture. Cut strawberries in half and line them across the top of the red glaze. Chill.

title: Caramel Popcorn Hearts
instructions: Boil sugar syrup butter and cream of tartar for 5 minutes. Quickly stir in baking soda and vanilla (it will foam but its okay). Stir 10 minutes. Pour over popcorn; toss to cover and press into a greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into hearts with a large cookie cutter. Return to 200\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Wrap individually in tight plastic.

title: Puffy Cheese Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Cut each slice of bread diagonally into 4 triangles. Line bottom and sides of baking dish with bread triangles. For a crown effect place 8 triangles upright against sides of dish. Arrange remaining triangles on bottom of pan. Beat eggs slightly; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour mixture into baking dish. Bake uncovered 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a skillet melt butter over medium heat. Saute onion until tender. Stir in potatoes soup and milk. Add cheese green peppers pimiento pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs. Pour into a shallow casserole and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flavoring. Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring and blend in. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk. Beat only until smooth. Bake in 3 greased and floured 8 or 9-inch pans for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Vinaigrette Salad
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Next day cook well. All vegetables should be diced. Drain after cooking. (Do not dice peas.) Also dice pickles. Apples should be diced; leave skin on. Saute onions in little oil. Cook all the vegetables. Let them cool. Mix all vegetables pickles and beans together. Mix in sour cream lemon juice and mayonnaise. Serve plain or with meats just like you would potato salad.

title: Dunbar Macaroni
instructions: Add beef chicken broth and mashed potatoes to a pot. Add macaroni to mix and salt and pepper to taste. Cook for 15 minutes (slow boil) while stirring frequently to keep macaroni from sticking. Cut up 3/4 of the cheese and add to the mixture stirring as you add. After cheese has melted remove from stove. Pour in casserole dish and let stand for 15 minutes. Cut the remaining cheese in thin slices and place on top of casserole. Heat uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Sangria
instructions: Combine sugar and water in small pan over moderate heat. Stir constantly until sugar melts (syrup). Before it boils remove from heat. Add lime and orange when cool (at this time when cool you may add small seedless grapes first washed). Put ice cubes in pitcher add fruit and 1/2 cup of the syrup. Fill pitcher with wine. Let it set in refrigerator about 20 minutes add soda water swizzle and serve.

title: Unfried Fried Chicken(Serves 6)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a baking sheet with three coats of vegetable oil spray. Combine chicken and ice water in large bowl. Put yogurt in a medium bowl set bowl aside.

title: Easy Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sour Cream Twists
instructions: Cut shortening into flour. Add other ingredients (except sugar). Mix with hands and roll into a ball. Place back in bowl. Cover with a damp towel. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Cut dough in half and roll out on sugar. Roll and fold in sugar 3 times. Roll out to an 8 x 16-inch sheet. Cut into 1 x 4-inch strips. Twist and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes (burns easily).

title: Party Biscuits
instructions: Mix all together and shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in 1-quart casserole. Add green pepper and onion. Cook with microwave 3 to 4 minutes or until tender. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Add flour sugar and salt. Mix. Cook 2 to 3 minutes stirring several times. Recipe yields 4 servings.

title: Haystack Candy
instructions: Melt peanut butter and morsels together. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.

title: Excellent Moist Chocolate Flat Pan Cake
instructions: Sift flour and sugar together. Bring oil water oleo or butter and cocoa to a boil. Add buttermilk (with baking soda stirred in) eggs and vanilla. Pour hot stuff over flour and sugar; stir all together. Grease and flour a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cake will spring back when mashed a little. Icing can be poured over cake while warm.

title: Ambrosia(Diet)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Longer it sets the better it gets.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening sugar and egg thoroughly. Stir in pineapple with 1 cup juice. Stir together then stir into first mixture the remaining ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tiger Butter
instructions: Place white chocolate in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High (100% power) for 1 to 2 minutes or until melted. Add peanut butter and cook on High for 2 minutes or until mixture is smooth and creamy. Blend well. Spread mixture into a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan lined with waxed paper or can use cookie sheet. Mixture will not be very thick when spread out.

title: Biscochitos
instructions: Cream lard with milk in large bowl. Add sugar eggs baking powder and anise seed. Mix together real well then add flour a little at a time. Knead well for a few seconds. If dough seems crumbly add more milk until it stays together firm enough to roll on board. Roll out about 1/2-inch thick and cut with cookie cutter. Bake in ungreased pan until light brown in 425\u00b0 oven. Dip cookies before baking in cinnamon-sugar mixture and place in pan with sugar up. Makes about 8 dozen cookies.

title: Bishop Bread
instructions: Beat eggs well add sugar slowly to eggs. Add cherries and juice mix well. Add dry ingredients; fold in nut meats. Place in a loaf pan.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour cream of tartar baking soda and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles fine crumbs. In a separate bowl beat together eggs sugar and vanilla. Add egg mixture to sifted ingredients and mix well. Shape into balls the size of a walnut. Place on greased cookie sheet about 2-inches apart. Press each ball flat with the bottom of a glass or jar. Top with pecan if desired. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except sour cream. Pour 1/2 in Pyrex dish and allow to congeal.\tPut layer of sour cream; add other half of mixture and congeal.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Cream together butter peanut butter and vanilla. Add confectioners sugar and mix thoroughly until you cannot see any sugar. Shape into small balls by rolling in your hand.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream first 6 ingredients. Add nuts bananas and vanilla. Bake in a greased and floured 9x13 or bundt pan at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Cut beef and onions in small pieces. Add to cream cheese with other ingredients. Mix well. Oil hands and shape into balls. Chipped ham may be substituted for beef.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Shake chicken in the flour salt and tarragon. Melt the margarine in baking dish. Coat chicken in margarine and arrange in dish. Pour the lemon juice or chicken bouillon chopped onion and garlic powder. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions and drain. Chop up vegetables and add to pasta. Season with dressing to taste. Can use fat-free dressing if youre watching calories. Refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Angel Strata Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites with vinegar salt and cinnamon (if desired) until soft mounds form. Add sugar gradually beating until meringue stands in stiff glossy peaks. Spread on bottom and sides of baked pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Cool.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for cheese. Pour half of the batter into a greased pan. Sprinkle cheese over batter. Pour remaining batter on top and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Old Fashion Cheese Cake
instructions: Lay rolls on bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Press until covered. Beat cheese and sour cream together. Add sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Pour in pan over rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool completely. Top with cherry pie filling if desired.

title: Impossible Bacon Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion on plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted between center and edge come out clean (35 to 40 minutes). Cool 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa and flour. Mix well. Add milk; mix well. Cook over low heat while stirring until thickened. Remove from heat. Add butter. Serve over hot biscuits.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni drain. Rinse in cool water; chill. Combine with all other ingredients and serve.

title: Hot Cornbread
instructions: Mix corn meal eggs oil salt and milk. Add onion cheese peppers and corn. Mix well. Cook at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 pan. Place nuts and raisins in bottom. Cut each loaf in 8 pieces. In a saucepan heat the remaining ingredients. Place bread dough on the nuts and raisins. Pour hot mixture over dough SLOWLY. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Grandma Bradford'S Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix sugar flour soda egg and fruit cocktail together. Put in 8 x 8-inch pan. Put brown sugar and nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spinach Cheese Squares
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch preheated 350\u00b0 oven. In a medium bowl beat eggs; add flour milk salt and baking powder. Mix well. Add cheese and spinach;\tblend.\tPour into pan.\tBake for 35 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Cut into small squares to serve for appetizer; large squares to serve for lunch or light supper.

title: Mozzarella Beef Pasta
instructions: In a large skillet brown the meat. Drain and set aside. Spray the skillet with Pam and saute the zucchini and tomatoes until tender. Add the meat to the vegetable mixture. Cook and drain the pasta. Arrange on individual plates top with meat and vegetable mixture and sprinkle with grated Mozzarella cheese. Microwave until the cheese is melted. Serve with tossed salad and garlic bread.

title: Cheesy Chowder
instructions: In heavy saucepan cook onion carrot and celery in butter for 5 minutes. Blend in paprika. Add chicken broth. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer covered 10 minutes. Add the cheeses; stir until melted. Add cream. Blend the flour with the milk; add to chowder. Cook and stir until slightly thickened. Add Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Ladle into soup bowls; may put under broiler briefly to brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Nutty Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Stir in brown sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Have popped corn pecan halves and peanuts already mixed together. Stir in soda and vanilla with syrup mix. Pour over popped corn. Stir well. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Cool and break up. Store in airtight container.

title: Tirpetakia(A.K.A.  Three Feet Or Triangles)
instructions: Drain spinach; mix with cheeses. Add the egg some lemon peel nutmeg salt and pepper. Place sheet of phyllo dough on a cutting board and brush with melted butter. Cut the sheet into strips 3 inches wide. Place 1 tablespoon of filling at bottom of each piece and roll up to form a triangle moving one side to the other until the strip is rolled up. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Red Potato Salad(No Peeling Required!)
instructions: Scrub and boil small red potatoes. Drain. Cool and cut potatoes into quarters. Add chopped red peppers and chopped red onion (depending on the amount). I use at least 1 cup red peppers and about 1/4 cup red onion). Add Maries creamy garlic or ranch dressing. Serve.

title: Toasted Party Mix
instructions: Heat oven to 275\u00b0. In oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches melt butter in oven. Stir in salt Worcestershire sauce celery salt and garlic salt. Add cereal pretzel sticks and nuts; toss until well coated with butter mixture. Bake uncovered 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 6 1/2 cups.

title: Capoletti(Italian Hats)
instructions: Grind all meat together; set aside. Grind salt pork and garlic. Fry salt pork and garlic until brown; strain. Add ground meat and cook until meat is well done. When filling is done put in a large bowl (do not use grease). Add salt pepper grated cheese and nutmeg (to taste). Mix well.

title: Garden Patch Ambrosia
instructions: Peel oranges and cut into sections. Place in layers in a bowl with each layer covered with sugar and coconut. Chill for several hours. If desired you may pour sherry or apricot brandy over mixture. Also a layer of thinly sliced pineapple slices may be layered with orange slices.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Grind peppers and onions. Pour boiling water over it. Squeeze out. Then add sugar vinegar and salt. Let come to a boil and can while very hot.

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: Peel and remove seeds from zucchini and dice. Cook in oil in non-stick skillet. Add diced onion. Add salsa. Before serving sprinkle with grated cheese. Serves 2.

title: Mexican Eggs
instructions: In a large skillet cook the tortillas in the liquid Butter Buds until golden. Remove and set aside. Add onion and cook until tender. Drain tomatoes and reserve liquid. Add the liquid to the skillet; cover and heat on high for 3 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir in tomatoes turkey and pepper; heat through. Reduce heat to low; add tortillas and Egg Beaters. Cover and cook 4 to 6 minutes or until Egg Beaters are set. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and heat one minute or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Depression Ice Cream
instructions: Invite 4 or 5 friends over and hand them a container to shake until dissolved then refrigerate until set and enjoy.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: In medium pan bring pineapple and sugar to a boil for 5 minutes. Add cream cheese. Mix until dissolved. Dissolve gelatin in water. Pour into pineapple mixture. Chill until set. Fold in nuts and Cool Whip. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. You need a pizza pan rolling pin blend mixer spatula and a small bowl.

title: Honey Mustard Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Shake well. Add lemon juice to taste.

title: Krissy And Denny Heim'S Peach Pie With French Crust
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Mix oil and milk well. Mix these 2 mixtures together well and form 2 equal balls. Pat one ball into bottom of pie dish and up sides. Pour peach mixture into pie crust. Crumble second ball onto top of peaches. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until desired golden brown on crumbled topping.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Cook and stir beef until brown; drain. Mix sour cream mayonnaise cheese and onion; reserve. Mix baking dough and water until soft dough forms. Pat in pan pressing 1/2-inch up sides of pan. Layer beef tomatoes peppers in pan. Spoon sour cream mixture over top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water. Stir in orange juice. Toss sliced bananas in lemon juice. Add all fruits to orange juice mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish (or similar size). Cover and freeze. Remove from freezer 30 to 45 minutes before serving (until able to break apart with fork).

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk and water in large mixing bowl. Mix well. Add instant vanilla pudding blending well and place in refrigerator. Whip whipping cream in chilled bowl. Add to pudding mixture.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Drain fruit. Reserve juice. You can substitute fresh fruit (kiwi is pretty). Slice cookie dough and bake close together on pizza pan. Take out and cool.

title: Club Soda Pancakes
instructions: Batter will not keep but you can cook and freeze pancakes for later quick use. If you like thin pancakes youll love these.

title: Georgia Special Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oranges with juice and oil. Add eggs one at a time and beat as each is added. Cook in 3 greased and floured cake pans in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine corned beef chunks and noodles then add soup cheese cubes and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Jerky
instructions: Marinate meat strips with all ingredients for 8 hours. Put meat on metal grate on rack. Put in oven at 150\u00b0 no more than 200\u00b0. Dry for 4 to 8 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix cooled diced chicken with the soup and sour cream. Melt the margarine and add approximately 2 packages of Ritz crackers crushed. Mix well. Turn chicken mixture into a greased casserole and top with the Ritz cracker mixture. Bake 45 - 50 minutes in a 350 degree oven. Let set 5 minutes before serving.

title: Crabmeat Stuffed Jalapenos
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and pulp. Rinse. In large bowl mix all ingredients except the Breading Mixture. Fill pepper 1/2 with crab mixture and press the stuffing around the peppers.

title: Orange Easter Pudding
instructions: Mix cut up oranges with 1/2 cup sugar; let rest in refrigerator overnight. Add thickening mixture made from 4 egg yolks 4 tablespoons cornstarch and 1/2 cup sugar; mix well. Add 1 quart hot milk (4 cups); cook on low fire until thick. Cool. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla; pour over oranges. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add 1/4 cup sugar a little at a time. Pour over pudding. Seal edges. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coffee Eggnog
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine hot water and instant coffee. Stir until dissolved. Add eggnog brown sugar and cinnamon. Beat with mixer until sugar is dissolved. Chill thoroughly. At serving time in small mixing bowl beat whipping cream powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form. Pour eggnog mixture into 4-ounce cups or glasses. Top with whipping cream. Sprinkle with instant coffee. Makes 8 to 10 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Strawberry Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello with boiling water. Add strawberries until melted. Add rest of ingredients; pour 1/2 mixture in desired pan. Let chill until firm. Spread sour cream over all this. Add other half of mixture and chill until firm.

title: Egg And Cheese Ball
instructions: Chop eggs fine and mince onion extremely fine.\tCombine cheese eggs and onion and add mayonnaise just enough to form a ball. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with crackers.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine meat with egg and oats milk and seasonings. Mix well and shape into 18 small balls. Roll balls in 1/3 cup flour. Brown slowly in 2 tablespoons hot shortening turning frequently. Remove with slotted spoon.

title: Molasses Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well. Sift the remaining ingredients; add to first mixture. Mix thoroughly; chill dough. Roll dough into balls then roll balls in granulated sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Do not press sugared balls down as they will puff up and then become flat with a crinkly top.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: In a large frypan brown ground beef and drain. Stir in seasoning mix water and olives. Simmer 5 minutes. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place triangles in ungreased 9 or 10-inch pie pan pressing to form a crust. Sprinkle 1 cup corn chips. Spread sour cream over meat mixture. Cover with cheese. Sprinkle remaining corn chips. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pineapple Mint Freeze
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving syrup. In saucepan soften gelatin in syrup. Add jelly and dash of salt; heat and stir until gelatin is dissolved and jelly melted. If needed beat to blend jelly. Stir in pineapple. Chill until mixture is thickened and syrupy. Whip cream with sugar; fold into thickened gelatin mixture. Tint with few drops green food coloring if desired. Spoon into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf dish. Freeze until firm. Let stand at room temperature 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Unmold; slice and place on lettuce-lined salad plates. Garnish with fresh mint sprigs if desired. Serves 8.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and chill in refrigerator until ready to eat.

title: Crazy Cupcakes
instructions: Add ingredients in order; beat 3 minutes in blender. Bake in greased muffin tins at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with favorite frosting. Yields 14 cupcakes.

title: Lentil Salad
instructions: Check lentils and remove any little stones. In a 4-quart saucepan wash lentils several times in 2 quarts of cold water to skim off debris. Use same saucepan to soak lentils overnight in 2 quarts of cold water.

title: Cheddary French Toast
instructions: In a bowl mix the egg cheese cream and salt. Mix well. Heat the butter in a skillet. Dip bread in mixture and fry.

title: Quick English Muffins
instructions: Separate each biscuit and flatten out to size and shape of an English muffin. Dredge each in cornmeal. Heat greased skillet over medium heat. Brown biscuits 7 minutes on each side. Spread with butter jelly or preserves.

title: Dot'S Duck Filets
instructions: With a sharp knife remove skin from duck. Cut meat from breast in 2 filets. Use meat tenderizer as directed on the shaker. Wrap each filet loosely with bacon sliced. Fasten with toothpicks. Cook filets in hot oil over moderate heat until browned and tender about 15 minutes per side. Serve on hot platter with ribbons of cooked bacon.

title: Grandma'S Pumpkin Custard
instructions: Blend pumpkin sugar salt and spices. Blend in eggs milk and cream or evaporated milk. Bake in a lightly greased 8 x 8-inch pan for approximately 50 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and pineapple together. Bring to a boil. Pour over cake and let cool a little while. Mix pudding according to directions and pour over pineapple. Put Cool Whip on top of pudding and spread with nuts.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt and cut in butter. Add coconut. Put into 9 x 9-inch pan coming up the sides 3/4-inch. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 or slightly browned.

title: Pulla - Finnish Coffee Cake
instructions: A large bowl is needed for mixing.

title: Corn Souffle
instructions: Combine the corn salt and sugar. Dissolve the cornstarch in a small amount of milk then add the remaining milk to the corn mixture. Add the eggs and butter. Pour into a buttered casserole and top with pepper rings. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Butternut Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix well in mixer pour into unbaked pie shell or casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 at least 1 hour or until set in center. If desired cover with meringue or miniature marshmallows.

title: Miss Sue'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar syrup nuts salt and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake about 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat with onion. Pour off grease. Add rice water and consomme in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cover casserole dish.

title: Angel Food Cake Roll
instructions: Mix angel food cake mix as directed on box. Grease a pan. Line with wax paper. Pour mix onto pan (its full). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Ida'S Pancakes
instructions: Separate eggs. Mix egg yolks buttermilk and Pet milk. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to milk mixture. Stir in melted oleo. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form and add to mixture. Cook in hot lightly oiled pan. Pancakes should be thin.

title: Easy Choco-Chip Cake
instructions: Pour oil in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and tilt until coated. Stir all other ingredients together in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Mix. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

title: Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins until plump; drain reserving 1/2 cup of the juice. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Add soda dissolved in raisin juice. Add flour and raisins. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Pie Dessert
instructions: Mix together cake milk oleo and egg. Put in cake pan. Mix together remaining ingredients. Put on top of cake mix. Make crumb topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: No-Bake Brownies
instructions: In bowl mix first 4 ingredients until blended using lowest speed on mixer. Spread mixture into greased 9-inch cake pan. Spread melted chocolate chips over top. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or until firm. Cut into wedges.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except peanuts. Mix lightly. Chill for several hours in a tightly covered container. Add peanuts just before serving.

title: Casserole Napoli
instructions: Lightly brown the meat. Sprinkle with salt. Add onion. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in sauce water sugar and spices. Cook noodles until barely tender; drain. Add to meat mixture.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Soften butter. Beat eggs. Add sugar and softened butter. Add vanilla; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until firm.

title: Sweet And Sour Beets
instructions: *Decrease for smaller quantities.

title: Cheddar Garlic Biscuits
instructions: In a bowl combine Bisquick cheese and onion. Stir in milk until a soft dough forms. Stir 30 seconds longer. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Combine butter and garlic powder; brush over biscuits. Serve warm. Yield 15 biscuits.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Blend all ingredients and bake in a greased tube pan or 2 loaf pans for 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Put pork chops in baking dish. Place sliced potatoes on top of chops then add sliced onions on top of potato. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Fill soup pan 3/4 full of water; add chicken bouillon cubes carrots and celery. Let cook for 1 hour. Remove chicken; let cool and then remove chicken from bone. Add cream of chicken soup and noodles. Let simmer for 1/2 hour. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gingerbread Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until just blended. Divide among 12 greased muffin tins. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen muffins.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Season meat and rice. Form into small balls and fry. Brown in butter. Add a small amount of water and simmer until rice is cooked and stands out all over. Serve with tomato sauce made by mixing 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons flour and 1 1/2 cups tomato juice. Boil until thickened or use one can of tomato soup.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix sugar 2 tablespoons flour and cinnamon. Add apples. Put in a 9 x 9-inch pan and sprinkle with walnuts. Mix the oatmeal 1/2 cup flour brown sugar and margarine. Sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tuna And Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix all together with enough mayonnaise to desired consistency. Salt and pepper to taste; stir. Sprinkle top with paprika.

title: Green Bean Chili
instructions: Cook turkey. Add the rest of the ingredients and cook. May want to use seasoning according to taste. May need more V-8 juice as it cooks. Can add cornstarch to thicken if desired. Also package Sweet N Low.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Melt caramels; stir in sour cream. Cut up any kind of fruit and dip into caramel mix.

title: Marilyn'S Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese mayo horseradish and onion until well blended. Spread in bottom of an 8-inch pie plate. Mix chili sauce and lemon juice and pour over layer. Drain and pick through crabmeat. Sprinkle on top of layers. Must sit in fridge overnight before serving. Serve with crackers.

title: Liver Cookies For Dogs
instructions: Heres a way to save the water you use to boil liver for dog treats (and use all those vitamins and minerals you are now pouring down the drain).

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Combine pudding and milk. Mix well. Fold in whipped topping. Beat mixture two minutes at medium speed with mixer. Place a layer of graham crackers in bottom of square 9 x 12-inch container. Place a layer of pudding mix on top of crackers. Continue alternating layers ending with graham crackers. Spread on frosting. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Caramel Dip
instructions: Mix and chill; serve with sliced apples. (Put lemon on apples to avoid turning brown.)

title: Roasted Lemon-Thyme Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Spray an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan with nonstick spray. Mix the oil lemon and thyme and toss with the potatoes. Place potatoes in pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 20 minutes; turn and bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 2 servings 2 grams fat per serving.

title: Calico Pickles
instructions: Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables. Soak for 15 to 18 hours in a cool place. Drain. In a large pot mix sugar spices and vinegar. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Add vegetables and simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Pack hot into jars. Process 15 minutes in water bath. Yields 8 pints.

title: Impossible Ham 'N Swiss Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Sprinkle ham cheese and onions in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Makes 6 servings.

title: No Fat Zucchini And Rice Casserole
instructions: Dissolve cubes with water in skillet. Add zucchini and onion. Cook about 15 minutes or until done (water will evaporate). Follow directions on box of chicken and rice and mix together. Contains 0 fat grams.

title: Barbecued Meatballs
instructions: Mix above ingredients. Add onions and meatballs. Simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour or longer.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into thin strips. Cook in non-stick frypan over medium heat until done. Drain fat. Add fajita seasoning as directed. Simmer until liquid is mostly absorbed. While chicken is simmering stack flour tortillas one at a time separated by wax paper. (If lightly brushed with margarine they hold together better when fajita is made.) When chicken is done heat tortillas in microwave approximately 30 seconds turning 1/4 turn every 10 seconds. Place tortilla in plate. Place chicken down center (not too much) and top as desired.

title: Stew Beef
instructions: Cook beef onions and tomato sauce until beef is almost done. Add potatoes and\tcook until potatoes are done.\tAdd beef stew seasoning and simmer for about 10 minutes.\tSalt and pepper to taste.

title: Rainbow Bread
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Mix in bananas flour and salt. Add nuts chips and maraschino cherries. Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt Velveeta cheese in a crock-pot. Brown meat and drain off the grease. Add meat and salsa to the Velveeta cheese. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking. Keep the crock-pot on low. Serve with tacos or tortilla chips. Enjoy!

title: Zippy Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook meat onion and pepper. Boil macaroni. In 2-quart casserole mix all ingredients except potato chips. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle with chips. Bake 5 minutes longer.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine soups mayonnaise and cheese. Heat until melted. Cook broccoli according to package directions. Line bottom of an ungreased casserole dish with broccoli place chicken evenly over the broccoli. Pour sauce mixture over the chicken. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Mix butter and bread crumbs sprinkle over sauce. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine; mix all ingredients well.

title: Grandma Thelma'S Homemade Chocolate Pie
instructions: Sift flour. Beat egg yolks well and add the remaining ingredients and mix in mixer until blended. Pour in double boiler and cook until pudding thickens.

title: Chicken A La Dee Dee
instructions: Spray casserole (the size pan a little smaller than 9 x 12) with Pam. Spread rice in bottom of pan. Place chicken in a single layer on top of rice and season lightly with Cavenders. Put cheese on top of chicken; set aside. Mix soups wine and milk in a small bowl. Pour over chicken mixture. Sprinkle stuffing mix on top and drizzle with melted butter. Bake uncovered 40 minutes at 350 degreees. After removing from oven let sit about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Seasoned Salt
instructions: Mix. Use on any kind of meat.

title: Garlic Roasted Chicken
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with lemon juice garlic powder seasoned salt and pepper. Wrap chicken loosely in foil. Refrigerate overnight. Place chicken in ovenproof dish and bake uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until chicken is done. Serves 4.

title: Cheesy Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese all the zucchini Ricotta cheese and Parmesan cheese. Spread 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce in ungreased 11 x 7-inch rectangular baking dish. Top with 3 noodles. Spread half the cheese mixture over noodles in dish. Top with 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce. Repeat with 3 noodles remaining cheese mixture and 3/4 cup spaghetti sauce. Top with remaining noodles and sauce. Bake covered in preheated oven about 1 hour until noodles are tender. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with reserved Mozzarella. Let stand uncovered 15 minutes before cutting. Makes 6 servings.

title: Citrus Ginger Chicken
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl stirring well with a wire whisk. Brush half of marmalade mixture evenly over chicken breast halves. Coat grill rack with cooking spray. Place rack on grill over medium-hot coals. Place chicken on rack and cook 10 minutes on each side or until chicken is done brushing frequently with remaining marmalade mixture.

title: Pasta With Chicken And Vegetables
instructions: Best if made 1 hour before serving. In 12-inch skillet over medium high heat in 1 tablespoon hot oil cook red and yellow peppers and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Stir frequently until tender and golden. Remove with slotted spoon and put them into a large bowl. In remaining oil in skillet add an additional tablespoon of oil. Cook mushrooms onions and 1/4 teaspoon salt until tender and golden stirring often. Remove the mushrooms to bowl with peppers. In same skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon oil cook chicken and 1/4 teaspoon salt until chicken is golden brown and loses its pink color throughout. Meanwhile in saucepan prepare pasta as label directs using 1 tablespoon salt in water. Drain. Return pasta to saucepan and keep warm. Drain artichoke hearts reserving marinade from 1 jar. In small bowl combine artichoke marinade balsamic vinegar black pepper dried basil sugar and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Return vegetables to skillet with chicken. Add artichoke hearts and balsamic vinegar mixture tossing to coat well. Heat through. In large bowl toss pasta with chicken mixture. Makes 8 servings.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine ingredients in order shown and turn into pie shells and chill. Delicious!!

title: Lush Dessert
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Orange Juice Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Allow to cool 10 minutes in pan. Bring last 3 ingredients to a boil. Pour over cake while in pan and leave about 5 minutes. Then remove from pan.

title: Cracker Pudding
instructions: While milk is warming on medium heat beat egg yolks and sugar until frothy. Add to hot milk and then add crackers and coconut. Cook until thick. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Beat whites until stiff and fold into cooked mixture.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven or soup kettle saute the carrots onions celery green pepper and garlic in oil until crisp-tender. Then stir in water tomatoes juice cabbage green beans peas corn garbanzo beans and chicken bouillon. Add salt and black pepper. Stir all together; bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until vegetables are tender.

title: Baked Zucchini
instructions: Mix all together and bake in greased 2-quart casserole uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Mix ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls over any fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 until topping is golden brown.

title: Crayfish Etouffee
instructions: In Mazola oil cook onions celery and bell peppers until soft. Add as much crayfish fat as you have and let cook well. Add 1 cup water then add 10 pounds of boiled peeled and deveined crayfish tails. Cook about 15 minutes. Better if made the day before. When heating do so very carefully as tails will cook too much. Serve over rice. Serves 12.

title: Round Brown Bread
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients for 2 minutes. Cream next 5 ingredients together. Add flour salt and nuts. Beat all together.

title: Dill Dip
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Order round rye loaf of bread (not sliced). Cut off top scoop out bread and fill with dip. Cut bread for dipping. Make dip the night before.

title: Chinese Fried Rice
instructions: Cut pork in julienne strips and cook with ham in 2 tablespoons oil until brown. Add onion green pepper parsley and garlic. Cook until tender. Add remaining oil salt pepper ginger and rice. Stir lightly to mix. Make a well in center of rice mixture add eggs and cook until semi-solid. Then stir into rice mixture while cooking over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Crayfish Casserole(10 Servings)
instructions: Saute onions celery and bell pepper in oleo. Add tomatoes to onion mixture. Cook 10 minutes. Add cooked rice. Add soup parsley and crayfish; mix well. Pour into baking dish and top with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Raymella'S Seasoning Mix
instructions: Mix together and store in shaker jars. A good all-purpose seasoning for meats soups stews casseroles and vegetables.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Soak crushed garlic in oil for at least 1 hour. Add egg yolks lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Shake well. Pour dressing in bottom of bowl. On top layer romaine cheese bacon bits and croutons 2 to 3 times. Mix and serve immediately.

title: Five In One Bars
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle over the butter in layers the remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in squares while still warm.

title: Black Magic Steak
instructions: Saute onions in butter until tender. Then place all ingredients in a gallon jar and mix. Fill jar with deer steaks or meat of your choice. Let marinate for 2 to 3 days in refrigerator before using. May add fresh meat up to 3 weeks. Great for barbecue season. Can be cooked on the grill or fried on the stove.

title: Spicy Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon reserve drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute chopped onion celery and green pepper in bacon drippings until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add reserved bacon black-eyed peas and remaining ingredients; stir well. Bring mixture to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Garlic New Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes covered in boiling water (salted) about 15 minutes until tender; drain. Saute garlic in butter until tender. Add parsley and pepper to skillet; pour over potatoes toss to coat.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook rice as directed. Add all ingredients except paprika & cheese. Mix thoroughly. Pour into well-greased shallow 3 quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika & cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes until bubbly.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Put first 3 ingredients in pan; melt together then add peanuts. Spoon out on foil or waxed paper.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the paprika. Spread in 8 x 11-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix powdered milk sugar Pream and Nestle Quik. Store in covered container. To make mix 1/3 cup to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Spinach Stuffed Shells
instructions: Prepare spinach according to directions on package. Drain. While preparing spinach boil shells until tender. Drain. Add spinach to beaten egg Ricotta cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella. Using 9 x 13-inch baking dish spray with Pam. Spread 1/4 cup of picante sauce in bottom of dish. Fill shells with 1 to 2 tablespoons of spinach mixture. Arrange in dish with filling side up. When completed spoon remaining picante sauce on each shell until covered. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes then top with Durkee French fried onions. Return to oven for 10 minutes uncovered. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Yogurt Pie
instructions: Fold yogurt and Cool Whip into pie crust and freeze for 4 hours. Remove and place into refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Jello Salad #2
instructions: Prepare jello according to the quick set instructions then add jello cottage cheese and drained pineapple. Let set a little longer to chill in the refrigerator. Fold in Cool Whip and jello mixture. Chill thoroughly.

title: Peach Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In 2-quart baking dish toss peaches with granulated sugar and cinnamon. In mixing bowl combine flour brown sugar and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over peaches. Sprinkle the top with nuts. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown. Serve with sour cream.

title: Snappy Cheese Bites
instructions: Knead by hand until smooth. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet and sprinkle with salt. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes. They burn easily so watch them.

title: Boiled Mayonnaise
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; boil in double boiler until it thickens stirring all the time.

title: Sugar-Free Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring the shortening and water to a boil. Add flour and salt. Blend quickly. Beat until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat. Let stand and cool. Add eggs one at a time beating until smooth after each egg. Drop by tablespoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool. Mix pudding as directed. Fill cream puffs. Top with teaspoon of lite Cool Whip.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: In a blender puree beans onion and garlic. Add seasonings and blend for 1 minute. Chill.

title: Rolls
instructions: Stir yeast into warm water to dissolve. In small bowl mix well the dissolved yeast cream milk and egg yolks; set aside. In large bowl stir together flour sugar and salt. Cut in 1/2 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir yeast mixture into flour mixture just to moisten. Spread dough with light film of butter to prevent drying. Cover bowl with plastic and refrigerate overnight or up to 4 days. Shape and let rolls rise to double in size and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Stuffed Manicotti
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Remove half of sausage and set aside. Stir tomato sauce paste water and brown sugar into sausage. Simmer 15 minutes. In bowl combine remaining sausage Ricotta cheese 2 cups Mozzarella cheese egg and parsley. Stuff manicotti noodles with mixture. In 9 x 13 x 2 baking dish pour spaghetti sauce over filled noodles. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Southern Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine pudding mix egg yolks and milk in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Remove from heat. Arrange layers of wafers in bottom of a 2-quart baking dish. Add a layer of banana slices and of pudding. Continue layering ending with pudding. Beat egg whites with salt until foamy throughout. Gradually beat in sugar and continue beating. Mixture will form stiff shiny peaks. Spoon lightly onto pudding sealing edges well. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 12 servings.

title: Quick Skillet Enchiladas
instructions: Brown ground beef in an electric skillet. Drain fat. Add enchilada sauce cream of mushroom soup 1/4 cup milk and chopped green peppers. Heat until bubbly.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored. Add cake mix pudding mix water and oil; beat 10 minutes at medium speed on electric mixer. Pour into ungreased 10-inch tube pan with removable bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Leaving cake on pan bottom remove sides of pan from hot cake. Drizzle Lemon Glaze over top of cake and spread on sides of cake.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream oleo sugar and eggs. Add vanilla. Add flour baking powder and soda (previously mixed together) a small amount at a time. Put in refrigerator for about 10 minutes. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Melt butter and blend all ingredients with spoon. Pour into a pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or the crust is brown.

title: Old Fashioned Rice Pudding
instructions: Add all ingredients together well and cook in a moderate oven until set.

title: Breakaway Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. In large bowl pour boiling water over Crisco. Add flour and yeast together with Crisco and water. Add all other ingredients. Turn out on board and knead lightly. Place in refrigerator and let chill.

title: Hay Stacks
instructions: Melt morsels then combine all other ingredients. Spoon out on wax paper and cool!

title: Break Away Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. In large bowl pour boiling water over shortening to dissolve. Add sugar salt eggs flour and dissolved yeast. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out thick; cut with biscuit cutter. Dip each piece into melted butter and stack into Bundt pan or tube pan. Let rise for 2 to 3 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Dump onto plate and break away.

title: Millionaire Candy
instructions: Melt caramel candy in top of double boiler. Add pecans milk and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon out in small pieces on greased waxed paper. Set in freezer until cooled. Dip in melted Hershey bars and paraffin wax.

title: Jicama Pie(Pronounced Hic-A-Ma)
instructions: Combine shredded Jicama sherry and water in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and boil gently 45 minutes or until most of liquid has evaporated. Drain and set aside.

title: Overnight Salad
