instructions: Layer in bowl each ingredient. Refrigerate overnight. Toss salad and serve.

title: Chicken And Rice Bake*
instructions: Stir first 6 ingredients together. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan and add mixture. Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and paprika. Place on mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake 20 minutes longer. (Serves 8.) Exchange 1 meat 1 milk and 1 bread.

title: Crown Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in skillet; stir frequently and drain fat. Add next 6 ingredients; bring to boil. Remove from heat; stir in mayonnaise. Place mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Flatten biscuits slightly. Arrange overlapping around edge of casserole. Brush biscuits with additional mayonnaise; bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until heated and biscuits are browned.

title: Tomato Zucchini Salad
instructions: Slice tomatoes in wedges. Thinly slice zucchini and chop onion. Combine all vegetables. Mix dressing with basil. Add to vegetables and toss. Seal bowl and marinate at least 1 hour.

title: Reuben Dip
instructions: Heat all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat. Add a little more milk if mixture seems too thick. Serve in bowl with rye snack sticks for dipping or hollow out pumpernickel bread round and serve dip inside of bread. Use removed bread for dipping after tearing it into bite size chunks.

title: Sinful Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix 1 egg butter and nuts. This mixture will be thick. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Next mix 3 eggs cream cheese and sugar. Pour on top. Bake for 1 hour at 300\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Unroll rolls on flat jelly roll pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350\u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on top of rolls. Sprinkle shredded raw vegetables on top (carrots radishes peppers cauliflower and broccoli).

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and orange. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Mix together all ingredients. Chill in refrigerator.

title: Chinese Sesame Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in skillet coated with nonstick spray. Remove chicken and set aside. Combine water soy sauce ketchup pepper garlic sugar scallion and apple juice. Add to pan and cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce to low add chicken and cook covered until tender (20 to 25 minutes). Remove chicken. Dissolve cornstarch in 1 tablespoon water add to pan mixture and cook over medium heat until thick (3 to 4 minutes). Pour sauce over chicken on platter. Sprinkle with seed.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meat with onion celery salt poultry seasoning pepper and mustard. Soak bread cubes in milk and Worcestershire sauce; add eggs beat with fork until well-blended. Combine meat and egg mixtures. Form a loaf roll in crumbs. Place in shallow baking dish. Score tops with handle of wooden spoons; fill in with ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until juices run clear after loaf is pierced with a wooden pick.

title: Broccoli Cheese Salad
instructions: Chop broccoli buds discarding stems. Peel and chop onion. Mix broccoli onion cheese and bacon in a large bowl. Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar in a small bowl. Add to broccoli mixture. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours and serve.

title: Ham Banana Rolls With Broccoli
instructions: Spread each slice of ham with mustard. Wrap the bananas with the ham (mustard side next to the bananas). Place the Banana Ham Rolls in a greased oblong flat baking dish with broccoli between each roll. Melt the butter in small saucepan. Stir in flour and slowly add milk cooking and stirring until mixture boils and thickens. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour over ham and broccoli. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bananas are tender. If you have leftover rice line the bottom of dish about 1/4 inch deep with rice before adding other ingredients.

title: Heath Bar Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed. When done poke holes in top with end of a wooden spoon (to make big holes for heavy syrup!). Pour milk and 1/2 of jar of caramel over hot cake. Allow to cool. Cover with Cool Whip. Top with crushed Heath bars.

title: Corn Cookies
instructions: Put sugar and syrup in saucepan and bring to rolling boil. Add peanut butter and stir until smooth. Pour over corn flakes and put in buttered pan. Press down. Allow to cool then cut.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Heat cranberry sauce and pineapple with dissolved gelatin. (I always used an extra teaspoon plain gelatin.) Chill; when partially set stir in celery and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Broccoli-Rice-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook and season rice and broccoli. Cut up cheese or spread in bottom of pan. Add rice then broccoli. Add onions and celery then spread soup over top of all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. May be frozen after cooking or before cooking. Makes 2 large casseroles.

title: Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except crumbs and butter. Pour into baking dish. Spread with crackers or crumbs and butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Apricot Mousse
instructions: Using a large mixing bowl dissolve the gelatin in hot water. Add the cold water. Refrigerate for 1 1/2 hours or until the gelatin becomes syrupy. Whip the gelatin with an electric mixer at high speed until it becomes foamy and triples in size filling the large mixing bowl. At the lowest speed or by hand gently fold in 9 ounces of whipped topping. (Reserve 3 ounces for garnish). Gently fold the orange segments into the mixture. Transfer to a 3-quart serving bowl. Garnish with the remaining whipped topping and refrigerate for 24 hours. Makes 15 servings.

title: Battered Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix milk and egg; stir into the sifted flour salt and baking soda. Beat the batter until smooth and dip in the chicken pieces.

title: Hootenholler Whiskey Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix together flour and baking powder salt and nutmeg add to butter mixture. Add milk. Put soda into molasses and mix. Add that! Then add raisins nuts and whiskey. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Wrap in foil and keep in refrigerator.

title: Glorified Macaroni
instructions: Melt 1 stick oleo in saucepan; add onion and bell pepper. Saute until tender. Add this mixture with macaroni Velveeta cheese pimento mayonnaise and soup; heat on low heat stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Pour into casserole dish that has been sprayed with vegetable spray. Melt remaining oleo and combine with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Easy Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix pudding and milk and cook according to directions on box. Beat in dry chocolate cake mix. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle with semi-sweet chocolate morsels. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Quick Fudge Frosting
instructions: Boil the ingredients 1 to 2 minutes. Then add 1 cup chocolate chips and a handful of small marshmallows. Spread on brownies and cake.

title: Pear Delight
instructions: Drain pears; reserve liquid. Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add reserved juice (and water to make 2 cups). Put liquid and pears in blender and mix well. Add cream cheese 1/4 at a time. Beat until all is used. Continue beating at medium speed for 3 minutes. Pour into molds or suitable dish. May be used as salad or dessert. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Rhubarb Bars
instructions: Mix together until crumbly. Pat 3/4 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in rhubarb mixture and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Place sour cream in a bowl. Mix in mayonnaise and soup mix. Blend well. Blend in onion water chestnuts and spinach. Chill and serve with crackers or vegetable sticks.

title: Pear Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in loaf pan 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexicali Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all these ingredients in a really big bowl and then with clean hands knead it all until its thoroughly blended. Dump it out on a clean broiler rack and form into a loaf; itll be a big loaf about 3-inches thick. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Yield 8 servings.

title: Best Peach Cobbler
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter; then add oats brown sugar and nuts. Mix well. Place peaches in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover with oat mixture. Pat down gently. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake 20 minutes more or until fruit is bubbling. Serve warm.

title: 7-Layer Cookies
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt margarine or butter. Add a layer of each ingredient starting with graham cracker crumbs (do not mix) and continue to layer each one until all gone. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Remove tops and seeds from peppers. Cook in boiling salted water 5 minutes. Drain. Cook meat and onion in skillet until tender; drain fat. Combine remaining ingredients and add to meat mixture. Scoop into peppers. Place peppers in baking dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. (If you dont like peppers stuffing is good alone; just put into casserole and bake.)

title: Mystery Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray a 9-inch pie pan with Pam. In large bowl beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar baking powder and vanilla beating until stiff. Fold in cracker crumbs and chopped nuts. Pour mixture into pie pan; bake for 20 minutes. Cool. Sprinkle 1/2 of the Hershey bar on top. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining chocolate on top. Cover by putting in 3 or so toothpicks into the pie then place plastic wrap over the pie. Remove toothpicks before serving. Keep refrigerated. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Homemade Pot Pie
instructions: In bowl mix Veg-All soup meat salt and pepper to taste. Pour into casserole dish. Mix Bisquick and water as if to roll into biscuits. Spread this mixture over casserole mixture as you would top a pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 30 to 45 minutes or until biscuit mix is golden brown.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Cook beef with taco seasoning according to package directions. Drain well. Mix Bisquick with refried beans. Spread in bottom of baking dish. Pour salsa over Bisquick mix. Spread to edge. Add ground beef then sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is golden. Serve with shredded lettuce chopped tomatoes sour cream and a jar of taco sauce.

title: Sarah'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until done then peel and mash sweet potatoes. Mix 2 eggs and sugar; add 1 stick margarine and evaporated milk and cinnamon and milk well. Add sweet potatoes to mixture; mix well. Pour into unbaked pie crust and cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until done.

title: Casserole Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup of warm water. Sift together flour sugar and salt. Mix yeast mixture and flour mixture together. Add about 1 cup warm water to make a soft dough. Cover and rise until doubled. Grease 2 casserole dishes. Put raised dough on floured board and knead a few times. Divide dough in half. Put in dishes. Raise again. When done butter top and take out of dishes and cool. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Pretzels should not be crushed too fine. Allow some very small pieces to remain for crunch. Mix together pretzel crumbs melted margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar and press into a 9 x 14 glass baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for just 8 minutes (no longer); let cool.

title: Yogurt Pie(Sugar-Free)
instructions: Mix yogurt and pudding together with mixer. Blend in Cool Whip. Pour in baked pie shell or serve as pudding.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Mix brown sugar corn syrup oleo and cream of tartar. Dissolve over low heat then boil 5 minutes stirring often. Remove from heat and add baking soda. Stir well and pour over corn. Mix well. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Pour onto countertop or cookie sheet. Let cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Grease and flour pans.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Drain sauerkraut and bean sprouts. Add the celery green pepper onion and pimento. Heat sugar and vinegar. Let cool. Add to vegetables and mix well.

title: Banana Raspberry Smoothie
instructions: Place sliced banana on plate and freeze for 10 minutes or until slightly firm. Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend on medium speed until smooth. Pour into glasses and garnish with raspberries.

title: Apple Walnut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix peach jello hot water cold water crushed pineapple bananas marshmallows and pecans. Put in refrigerator. Mix melted butter (margarine) pineapple juice sugar flour and egg. Cook until thick. Let cool. Whip Dream Whip and cream cheese. Mix cooled mixture and Dream Whip and cheese. Put on top of jello.

title: No Chill Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cut Crisco into flour then add and mix remaining ingredients. Mix together. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 8 minutes. Do not need to chill dough.

title: Summer Dip
instructions: Chop herbs fine. Blend all ingredients together and chill. Garnish with nasturtium flowers. If too thick add milk.

title: Chocolate Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour batter into two loaf pans (sprayed with Pam). Cover sides and bottom of pans with mixture of cinnamon and sugar as well as top of dough. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve alone or with cream cheese.

title: My Favorite Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Place bran water eggs vanilla chocolate flavoring oil and sugar substitute in a bowl. Mix lightly and let stand at room temperature for 30 to 45 minutes. Timing is important. Place flour cocoa dry milk soda baking powder salt and sugar in a mixer bowl and mix at low speed for 1/2 minute to blend. Add the bran mix to flour mix and beat at medium speed only to blend well. Stir in the chips and drop by level tablespoons onto cookie sheets that have been sprayed with pan spray or lined with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until almost firm. Remove the cookies from the sheet onto wire racks to cool. Use 1 cookie per serving.

title: Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together in double boiler. Add water. Combine yolks with lemon juice and beat. Add to rest of mixture. Cook until thick over boiling water for approximately 25 minutes (this eliminates starch taste). Add lemon extract butter and vinegar. Stir thoroughly.

title: Mexican Okra
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large frypan. Simmer on low for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Squares
instructions: Bake dinner rolls flat on jelly roll pan. Mix the cream cheese Miracle Whip and Ranch dressing. Spread on dinner rolls. Top with broccoli cauliflower carrots and peppers. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Alabama Pecan Bars
instructions: Mix together cake mix 1 egg and butter. Press mixture into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Veal Chops In Port Cream
instructions: Sprinkle veal chops with salt and white pepper. Brown well on both sides in mixture of butter and oil in a large frying pan. Remove veal chops from pan and reserve them. Cook mushrooms and shallot in same pan stirring until mushrooms brown slightly. Return veal chops to pan. Pour in wine and broth. Bring to boiling. Cover reduce heat and simmer until veal is tender (25 to 30 minutes). Remove chops but keep warm.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix cracker crumbs and melted oleo. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Healthy Heros
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; let stand 30 minutes. Slice bun in half lengthwise; pull out soft inside of top and bottom leaving a shell. Spoon mushroom mixture into each half of bun; cover with a lettuce leaf. Top with ham turkey and tomato slices. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and serve.

title: Jeni'S Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients quickly. Pour into pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook 6 to 8 peppers slightly in a little water.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and place in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown (for about 18 minutes).

title: Monday Stew(The Perfect Make-Ahead Buffet Dish)
instructions: Combine the beef onion and soups. Stir in the cooked noodles. Put mixture into casserole. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 5 to 6 servings.

title: Mary G. Boyd'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour over cabbage then refrigerate. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Mandarin Pork Roast
instructions: Sprinkle roast generously with garlic and onion salt. Place fat side up in roasting pan. Roast at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Butter the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Place the juice and 1/2 can of asparagus in dish. Cover asparagus with 1/2 can cream of chicken soup and 1/2 can cream of mushroom soup. Cover soup layer with half of crushed saltine crackers and chopped egg. Continue layering until all ingredients are used. Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top layer. Cover dish with tinfoil or glass lid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Saute onions in butter until golden brown. Soak crumbs in milk. Mix all ingredients together. Drop by teaspoon into pan (salted pan). Brown evenly on all sides. Remove meatballs from pan. Make thin gravy with juice. Place meatballs back in gravy. Let come to a simmer. Ready to eat.

title: 20Th Century Sticky Buns
instructions: Thaw the 2 loaves of bread. In greased 13 x 9-inch pan break 1 loaf in chunks and cover bottom of pan. Combine pudding with brown sugar melted butter milk and cinnamon. Spread this mixture over bread in pan. Break other loaf of bread into chunks and put on top of mixture in pan. Allow to rise about 3 hours or more. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When done invert pan over large cookie sheet for juices to drip down over.

title: Crisco Pound Cake
instructions: Mix together eggs and sugar until fluffy. Add Crisco and mix again. Add vanilla and mix. Add flour a little at a time until you have it all added. Spoon mixture into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until pick comes out clean.

title: Pasta Faziola
instructions: Heat tomato paste on medium heat for approximately 5 minutes. Add celery beans sugar parsley flakes and garlic salt. Cook for 15 minutes. Add the water and simmer 1 hour. Add macaroni to 3 quarts boiling water; when done add to tomato paste mixture.

title: Chicken With Dumplings
instructions: Combine flour and salt; add enough water to make stiff dough. Roll very thin and cut into squares. Drop squares a few at a time into boiling chicken broth and sprinkle with black pepper to taste. Add chicken which has been removed from bone and boil 10 or 15 minutes. If you want richer dumplings add 1/2 cup of milk after everything has been put in.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Line bottom of pan with broccoli. Pour chicken pieces on top. Pour the soup mixture on top of chicken. Sprinkle bread crumbs and little pats of butter on top of soup mixture. Then sprinkle cheese on. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Saute onions in butter until transparent. Add undiluted soup potatoes and sour cream. Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine cheese and corn flake crumbs and spread over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

title: Shrimp Primavera
instructions: Heat oil in skillet; add broccoli and carrots. Cook over medium heat; stir frequently until carrots are tender-crisp about 2 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Whisk in broth and cornstarch; add chicken pieces or shrimp. Cook chicken about 6 minutes and shrimp 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients toss and combine. Contains 306 calories 8 g fat.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: You will need a 13 x 9 glass dish.

title: Cheese Savory Tarts
instructions: Line patty tins with pastry as for jam tarts. Grate the cheese into a saucepan and add the seasonings. Add the egg yolk to the mixture and stir slowly over gentle heat until smooth. Remove from heat. Whisk the white of the egg until stiff and then fold into the cheese mixture. Pour into the prepared pastry cases. Put into oven at gas mark 6 or 7 until the cheese mixture is well browned and gives the appearance of small souffles.

title: Donna'S Chicken Loaf
instructions: Slice the carrots. Mix all the ingredients together and pack into a well-greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Mallow-Whip Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with additional marshmallows and maraschino cherries. Return to oven until browned.

title: Easy Cheese Souffle
instructions: Put bread in buttered casserole dish. Mix eggs with remaining ingredients. Pour over bread. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Bundt Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 12-cup Bundt pan. Drain and rinse blueberries; set aside. Mix brown sugar nuts and cinnamon. In large bowl blend eggs sour cream and water. Blend in muffin mix with a fork. Spread 1/3 of batter in pan; top with half the sugar mixture and 1/2 of the blueberries. Repeat ending with muffin batter. Bake 50 minutes. Mix powdered sugar and milk until smooth. Drizzle on warm cake.

title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. In 9 x 13-inch baking dish layer 1/2 of the meat then add a layer of sliced potatoes to cover another layer of meat and top with another layer of potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover with can of mushroom soup and cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter. Add flour slowly and brown slightly. Add milk and cook until it thickens. Pour over steak or chicken.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs with butter; add salt and sour cream with muffin mix. Beat well. Add cans of corn. Bake in flat dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Spread with Mozzarella cheese.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Take one of the pie crusts and line 9-inch pie plate. Mix all the above ingredients together in bowl. Add to pie crust. Top with second pie crust. Poke holes in it and brush with beaten egg if desired. Cut edges as necessary. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate French Silk Pie
instructions: Beat butter sugar and eggs 5 minutes after adding each ingredient. Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Beat and beat and beat until nice and smooth. Put in baked and cooled pie shell. Top with whipped cream and decorate with shaved chocolate. (Only mix ingredients for one pie at a time.) Yum!

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed of electric mixer until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Gradually add to butter mixture; beating until just blended. Shape into a ball; cover and chill for 1 1/2 hours. Divide dough into thirds. Work with 1 portion of dough at a time storing remaining dough in refrigerator. Roll each portion to 1/4 in. thickness on a lightly floured surface. Cut with cookie cutters to desired shapes. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar crystals. Bake at 375 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until edges are slightly brown. Let cookies cool slightly on cookie sheets then remove to wire racks.

title: Zucchini Pasta Soup
instructions: Saute zucchini and onion in butter until tender. Add water and noodles; cook until noodles have just become soft. Add tomatoes basil and parsley. Remove from heat. Reheat just before serving so noodles will not become to soft. Garnish with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

title: French Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 of the water plus 1 teaspoon sugar. In large\tbowl dissolve sugar and salt in remaining water. Add Mazola and yeast. Mix. Add flour. Place dough in greased bowl and set in warm water. Work dough every 10 minutes\tfor 5 consecutive times. Turn\tdough onto floured board and divide into 2 balls. Let rest 10 minutes. Roll each piece out and roll up as for jelly roll. Seal edges. Place on a greased cookie sheet and score diagonally 6 times. Let rise 1 1/2 hours. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Brush with\tmelted butter. This makes 2 loaves and is delicious as garlic bread.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries. Add sugar and let sit until sugar is well dissolved. Drain pineapple; add to cranberries. Add nuts. Prepare Jell-O according to directions omitting 1/2 of cold water. Quick set Jell-O with ice cubes. Add cranberry mixture. Let gel overnight in refrigerator.

title: Salt Rising Bread
instructions: Stir meal into boiling milk. Let sit until double in warm place (1/2 to 1 1/4 days). Add soda. Make sponge of 2 cups boiling water poured over 1/2 cup sugar and 1 cup milk in crock. Thicken with about 5 cups flour. Add meal yeast. Place pitcher in hot water and let batter double (2 hours). Sift 5 pounds flour into dishpan. Set aside 2 cups of this flour. Cut into flour the shortening 1/3 cup sugar and salt. Put in nest of flour in pan. Pour sponge in nest and rinse pitcher with 6 cups of the warm water in pan. Mix well; put in well-greased loaf pans and set in very warm place to rise to double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes and 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn out on brown paper and butter. Total flour needed is 7 1/2 pounds.

title: Hot And Spicy Rice
instructions: In medium saucepan cook green pepper tomato and onion with garlic in oil until tender-crisp. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook for 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir occasionally. Makes 4 servings (1/2 cup each). Each serving equals 1 Complex Carb and 1 Palate Pleaser.

title: Holly Wreath Punch
instructions: Use a mold size of punch bowl. Arrange 7 or 8 cherry halves (from fruit cocktail) in bottom of mold. Garnish with sprigs of fresh green holly (washed). Add 1/2 inch water and freeze. Add remaining fruit cocktail and enough water to fill 3/4 full and freeze. Unmold place in punch bowl holly side up. Pour chilled ginger ale lemonade pineapple and liquid from fruit cocktail. Blend liquid. Makes 3 quarts or 24 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat onions and garlic; drain. Add sauce and seasoning mix. Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with 6 tortillas. Pour meat mixture over tortillas. Cover with remaining tortillas. Pour soup over top. Pour milk over soup and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Cookies(Similar To Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl; beat until fluffy. Stir in last 5 ingredients. Make into balls and flatten. (My favorite way.) Roll out and use cookie cutters. Great plain but really pretty when iced. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 approximately 12 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Jamaican Curried Goat
instructions: First wash meat then add curry scallions onion garlic pepper and salt. For better taste meat should be seasoned in advance. Pot should also be of adequate size and partially covered. Add water and cook until meat is tender. Creates its own gravy. Can be served with any vegetable.

title: Lemon Squares(Student Favorite)
instructions: Pour these ingredients over hot crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool completely sift powdered sugar on top and cut into squares.

title: Chicken Almond Crunch
instructions: Toss flour into cheese. Combine 3/4 cup cheese 1/2 cup almonds and remaining ingredients except pastry; mix well. Roll pastry into 15-inch square. Fit pastry into 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Trim to 1 inch beyond edge. Fill with meat mixture. Top with remaining cheese and almonds. Bake 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Benghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain all except 1 tablespoon fat. Cook onion in fat until translucent. Combine all ingredients. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Top with grated cheese. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients like a pie crust. Pack in bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.

title: Savory Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cream cheese and 5 tablespoons oleo. Add all but the last three ingredients and mix well. Separate dinner rolls into 4 rectangles and seal perforations. Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture onto center of rectangle. Pull 4 corners together and seal. Brush with 3 teaspoons oleo and dip into bread crumbs. Bake 20 to 25 minutes on ungreased cookie sheets. Each serving equals 3 protein 1 fat 2 bread and 13 optional calories.

title: Low-Fat Pumpkin Cake Or Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and set aside. In a very large bowl beat eggs and sugar until thickened. Add oil and beat. Add ripe bananas and applesauce and beat. With mixer on low alternately add dry ingredients and pumpkin beating smooth with each addition. End with dry ingredients. Stir in chips and/or raisins.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook hamburger until lightly browned. Add onion and green pepper. Drain. Add chopped tomatoes tomato paste sugar oregano basil and garlic. Cook until heated through; keep warm. Butter a 10-inch pie pan one that has at least a 2-inch depth (a cast-iron frying pan works well). Beat the eggs until well mixed. Cook spaghetti and drain. While the spaghetti is hot mix it with the margarine Parmesan cheese and eggs. Spread the mixture across the bottom and push it up the sides of the pie pan to form a \crust.\ Spread the Ricotta over the bottom of the \crust\ and add the meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with Mozzarella. Bake 5 minutes more or until cheese melts. Let stand for 10 minutes. Cut into wedges.

title: Bake Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until lemon color; beat in the sugar then add the other ingredients. Pour in glass 9-inch pie crust. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Cook the first 5 ingredients together. Stir in mushroom soup. Fill dough in the same manner as with the fruit pies. Fry until brown on both sides.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Stir in oil sugar zucchini and vanilla.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and place in casserole; cover with chicken. Mix next 5 ingredients and pour over chicken. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Place in jar; refrigerate. The pickles will be ready in 24 hours and will keep up to 1 year.

title: Spicy Mexican Lentils
instructions: I make it without the green chile and think its quite spicy.

title: Connecticut Beef Supper(This Is A Great One Pan Meat For A Meat And Potatoes Crowd)
instructions: Dredge meat in flour and brown meat in shortening. Add onions and mushrooms and saute. Add water. Cover and simmer until meat is tender. Heat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix drained beans and soup with salt and pepper. Pour into a casserole dish cover with onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions and mushrooms with parsley flakes salt and pepper in butter or margarine. Simmer until onions are soft. Add beef bouillon cubes and 1 cup water/cube. Simmer 1 hour.

title: Marinara Sauce
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil. Cut up tomatoes; add tomatoes and juice tomato sauce salt basil and oregano. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat and cook uncovered stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Cook pasta according to label directions. Drain. Pour sauce over hot cooked pasta. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. In medium saucepan heat sugar and water until sugar melts. Cut shortening into flour until mixture resembles coarse corn meal. Add milk and stir with a fork only until dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn out onto lightly floured board or pastry cloth and knead just until smooth. Roll out dough into large rectangle about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples; sprinkle apples evenly over dough. Roll up dough jelly roll fashion. Dampen edge of dough and seal.

title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sugar eggs sour cream cooking oil pecans and vanilla together. Pour 1/2 of batter into greased tube pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon together on batter then pour remaining batter into pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil the broccoli for 5 minutes. Drain and add all other ingredients (except Ritz crackers). Pour into buttered casserole dish cover with Ritz cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Coconut-Date Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and salt. Put nutmeats dates and coconut in flour. Add soda in water. Mix well with other ingredients. Drop onto baking sheet by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 10 minutes. Maple icing makes these cookies very special.

title: Brandy Slush
instructions: In 3-quart bowl or plastic pitcher mix all 3 ingredients with a wooden spoon. Freeze stirring occasionally until mixture becomes thick slush about 8 hours. Ladle into long stemmed wine glasses and serve with straws. Yields about 12 servings.

title: Diet Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine in order. Mix well. Pour into a greased 10-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Cook apples in water until soft. Strain pulp. Blend in blender until smooth. To each cup of pulp add 1/2 cup sugar. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture sheets from spoon (usually 45 minutes to 1 hour). Pour into hot sterilized jars. Store in cool dry place.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Prepare stuffing add eggs. Cook squash with onion salt and pepper. Drain. Mix squash and stuffing with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add alternately milk and dry ingredients. Gently add blueberries. Bake in greased muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix together. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour & 15 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Crush all the Oreo cookies. I use a Ziploc bag and a rolling pin. A blender may also be used. Spread the cookie crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt margarine and combine with cookie crumbs. Press firmly into bottom of pan to make crust. Smother the entire crust with the chocolate syrup.

title: German Chocolate Bars
instructions: Place cake mix in bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Press 2 1/2 cups into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Immediately sprinkle with chocolate chips. Drop frosting by tablespoons over the chips. Stir milk into the remaining crumb mixture. Drop by teaspoons over top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until bubbly around the edges and top is cracked. Cool on wire rack. Refrigerate for 4 hours before cutting.

title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
instructions: Thaw and drain vegetables. Combine vegetables soup 1/2 cup of cheese sour cream pepper and 1/2 can of onion rings. Pour into casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining cheese and onion rings. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 until browned.

title: Potato-Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook green pepper and onion in a saucepan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray over medium heat stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in broth potatoes salt and pepper. Bring to boil reduce heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Combine cornstarch and milk; stir until smooth. Gradually add to potato mixture; stir constantly. Stir in corn and pimiento. Bring to boil over medium heat. Cook for 1 minute or until thickened stirring constantly. Serve immediately. Yields 6 cups.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni and rinse with cold water until cold. Drain well and set aside.

title: Texas Hot Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt butter with cooking oil cocoa and water in saucepan. Bring to boil. Stir and let cool. Sift flour and sugar in large bowl. Pour liquid mixture over flour mixture. Beat until smooth. Add buttermilk eggs soda cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Watch. Do not overcook.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: White Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Place chocolate in top of a double boiler; bring water to a boil. Reduce heat to low; cook until chocolate melts. Combine cream cheese and sugar; beat at medium speed until smooth. Add chocolate\tand vanilla beating\twell. Stir in chopped pecans or\twalnuts. Press chocolate mixture into a lightly greased 8-inch square pan.\tChill until firm. Cut into squares. Top each piece with pecan\thalf pressing gently. Store in refrigerator. Yield About 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Blueberry Short Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together and set aside.

title: Beef And Olive Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese beef seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce with an electric mixer until well mixed. Place in refrigerator and chill until firm enough to form into a ball or loaf. Cover with sliced olives. Serve with crackers.

title: Mint Sauce
instructions: Heat vinegar and sugar; pour over chopped mint leaves. Let stand 1 hour or more. If you like sweeter sauce add more sugar. Makes about 1/2 cup. Serve with lamb.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Remove skin and bone from breast. Cut up meat and other ingredients except soup. Pour soup over top and bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Boil cabbage until about half cooked. Cool cabbage off with cold water and peel leaves off one at a time; put aside. Cook hamburger and rice and mix together with onions after dicing. Mix with salt and pepper. Take cabbage leaves and put about a baseball size hamburger mixture inside and roll up. Stick a toothpick in to secure it. Repeat the process with all the cabbage. Then put in a large pan with a lid. Pour all of the other ingredients over the cabbage and cook about 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. This will serve about 4 people.

title: Chili
instructions: Saute meat onions and celery. Add tomatoes and V-8 juice. Then add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 2 -3 hours.

title: Microwave Turkey Chili
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart microwave-proof dish combine onion green pepper salad oil and minced garlic. Cover with plastic wrap turning back one section to vent. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir in chili powder cumin salt and pepper. Cover and microwave 1 minute. Add turkey pinto beans and tomato sauce. Cover and microwave for 5 minutes stirring once.

title: Chicken In Tarragon Sauce(French)
instructions: Place drumsticks and thighs along with wine onion stock bay leaves thyme salt and pepper in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. reduce heat; cover and boil gently about 10 minutes. Add breast meat; cover and boil another 10 minutes. Transfer meat to a dish; keep warm.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Blend shortening and brown and white sugars. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Sift remaining dry ingredients together and add to sugar-egg mixture blending well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&Ms. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate tops with remaining M&Ms. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Chunky Tuna Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring well. Cover and chill thoroughly. Serve with assorted crackers or thinly sliced cucumbers. Yield 1 1/3 cups.

title: Round Steak Sauerbraten
instructions: Cut meat in 1-inch squares. In a large skillet brown meat on all sides in hot fat. Remove meat from skillet. Add gravy mix and water. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Stir in remaining ingredients except noodles or rice.

title: Chicken Encore
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix well. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Preparation time 20 to 25 minutes. Cooking time 1 hour. Serves 4.

title: Faye'S Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all together and serve as dip for various fruits. Keep in refrigerator.

title: Frog Eye Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt pineapple juice from canned fruit and eggs in a saucepan. Cook until boiling. Cool until room temperature. Cook acini de pepe until done. Drain then mix with cooked dressing. Let set overnight. (Will be very thick.) Add remaining ingredients and mix using a very large bowl.

title: Heavenly Orange Fluff
instructions: Mix jello and water; add orange juice and mix well. Drain pineapple and oranges; add to jello. Place in bowl and refrigerate to set. After jello has set combine the remaining ingredients together and pour over the set jello mix. Enjoy!!

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Mix well. Roll into balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Low-Fat Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender; process until smooth. Chill. Spoon dip into a serving bowl and serve with assorted vegetables. Serving size is 1 tablespoon (11 calories per serving).

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt butter. Pour over mixture of the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Form into balls. Melt 1/2 cake paraffin and 1 package semi-sweet chocolate chips. Dip balls into mixture until covered. Let cool on wax paper.

title: London Broil
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan. Cook steaks on both sides until done to your taste. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from pan and keep warm. Add wine to pan and simmer. Add garlic fennel and tomato puree mixing well. Cook 1 minute longer. Pour over steaks. Serves 4.

title: Peppers Stuffed With Sausage
instructions: Wash peppers and remove seeds. Boil for 5 minutes in water to cover. Remove from water and fill with the meat rice salt and strained tomatoes which have been mixed together. Place in baking dish add the boiling water and bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

title: Old Pecan Street Special Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Stir in chopped pecans and pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Serve and enjoy.

title: Pineapple Tea
instructions: Combine tea and sugar. Add hot water and stir until sugar dissolves. Add pineapple juice cold water and lemon lime and orange juices. Serve over ice. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Beat together and add to dry ingredients. Stir just until moist. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full and bake. Nuts or chipped fruit may be added as desired (1 cup). If necessary sugar may be omitted. Batter can be kept covered in refrigerator for six weeks. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Heat all liquid ingredients. Add to hamburger and rice mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mom'S Catsup(From Elizabeth Thomas)
instructions: Cook the first 4 ingredients in heavy pot until it reduces to 1/2 in amount. Add 1 to 2 cups sugar at a time and taste after each addition. Make it as sweet as you like. Add salt and taste. Add more if needed. Pack in hot jars and seal. It is very close in taste to a chili sauce.

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Thaw puff pastry for 20 minutes. Shred cheese. Heat chicken breasts and 1 inch water in skillet to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is tender. Drain. Remove skin and bones; cut up chicken into bite size pieces. Place in a large bowl. Prepare broccoli as package directs; drain and place in bowl with chicken. Stir in cheese onion and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Set aside.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together and work the shortening in with a pastry blender. Add the buttermilk and mix until blended. Turn on floured board. Pat 1-inch thick in greased pan. Cut and let stand 15 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all above and put in casserole. Top with crushed saltines and 1/2 stick oleo. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Bring last 4 ingredients to a boil simmer 10 minutes and let set overnight. Then add Cool Whip and stir; put between layers of cake and on tops and sides.

title: Congealed Lime Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate until chilled.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In a 3-quart pot bring rice milk raisins sugar and salt to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Slowly stir in vanilla and cinnamon. Add a dash of nutmeg and stir until well mixed. Serve with milk for a thinner consistency. Serves 6.

title: No Crust Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mixer and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Sweet And Sour Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in a jar. Cover and shake vigorously until sugar is dissolved. Chill. Shake vigorously again before serving.

title: Adan'S Creamy Jello
instructions: Pour cold milk into cup. Sprinkle unflavored gelatine over milk. Let stand 3 minutes. Add hot milk to cup. Stir until gelatine dissolves. Add honey to cup. Add thawed strawberries to cup. Stir. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours until set.

title: Luau Pork Chops
instructions: Mix flour ginger pepper paprika and salt. Coat the chops and brown in shortening. Pour in pineapple juice and vinegar. Add brown sugar and then add pineapple chunks. Cook over low heat for 40 minutes or until tender. Very good served with rice string beans and apples.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Bars
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until fluffy.

title: Herb Butter
instructions: On halibut steaks arrange on greased baking pan which can be used for serving. Spread on steaks. Bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Baste once or twice during baking.

title: Coconut Flake Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given; drop from teaspoon. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown meat drain fat then mix soup with meat. Put in casserole dish top with Tater Tots and bake until Tots are done. Top with cheese and place back in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing(For Fruit Salad)
instructions: Mix sugar salt vinegar dry mustard and onion juice well. Add oil slowly beating constantly with mixer on low speed until thick. Add poppy seed; beat for 4 minutes on medium speed.

title: Heavenly Peach Pie
instructions: Mix milk lemon juice and Cool Whip. Add peaches coconut and pecans (saving out 1/4 cup of coconut and 1/8 cup pecans). Pour mixture into two cooked pie shells. Sprinkle with remaining pecans. Toast 1/4 cup of coconut in cake pan and sprinkle on top of pies. Refrigerate.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Brown hamburg in skillet; add rest of ingredients. Cook over low heat 3/4 hour. Mash hamburg with potato masher as it cooks. If more water is needed add a little more. Serve on top of hot dogs or hamburgers.

title: Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix hot water oil and sugar. Let cool. Add eggs warm water and yeast. Mix well. Add flour and mix well. Let rise 1 hour.

title: Chicken In Pineapple-Guatemala(Pollo En Pina)
instructions: Put chicken into heavy saucepan or casserole dish. If using fresh pineapple be careful to save & use all the juice. If using canned pineapple use the juice. Add all the rest of the ingredients salt & pepper to taste. If using fresh pineapple it may be necessary to add a little chicken stock to cover the chicken pieces as the fresh fruit will not have as much as the canned. Cover and simmer over low heat until the chicken is tender about 45 minutes. If sauce is abundant cook partially covered for the last 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Eggplant-Chickpea Stew(Bitinjan Mah Hommous)
instructions: Place onion and oil in saucepan. Cook until onion is golden brown. Add drained chickpeas and water. Cook until peas are tender (approximately 30 minutes).

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Slice carrots and boil until tender. Cool and alternate layers of carrots pepper and onion. Make marinade of remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour over mixture and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.

title: Bran Flake Muffins
instructions: Mix together flour baking powder salt and sugar; set aside. Put cereal and milk in a bowl until cereal is softened. Add egg and oil. Beat well. Add to flour mixture and stir well. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until done in greased muffin tins. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain fat. Stir in seasoning mix. Simmer until seasoning mix is in beef well. Line casserole dish with chips. Pour meat and other ingredients into casserole dish. Bake for 25 minutes at 300\u00b0 until hot all the way through.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Serve with dip-size Fritos.

title: Whipped Topping
instructions: Chill small mixer bowl and beaters. In small chilled mixer bowl combine all ingredients. Blend at low speed until moistened; beat at high speed until soft peaks form scraping bowl occasionally. Serve immediately as a topping for desserts cakes or salads. Yields 2 1/2 cups 10 1/4 servings 1/4 cup = free.

title: Cabbage
instructions: Fry bacon until halfway done. Add all onions (cut up). Put butter and water into large skillet on high heat. Start adding cabbage. Add bacon onion and bacon grease to cabbage. Simmer until desired consistency.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: Layer first six ingredients in a large salad bowl in order listed. Blend salad dressing and sugar in a small bowl. Spread over salad sealing the edges. Chill overnight. Toss lightly before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes and drain (do not overcook usually 5 minutes). Take 1/2 amount and mash with half and half butter and garlic salt lightly covering top. Add all together with cheese and bacon (should be cooked and crumbed). If a little dry use regular milk until the consistency you want. Simmer until hot do not boil.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Stir in egg and milk and mix together. Just before completely blended add melted shortening. Stir together. Add washed and drained blueberries gently stirring into mixture. Pour into baking cups or greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes until very lightly browned. Delicious served warm.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first seven ingredients. Combine the eggs oil butter and extracts. Mix well. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Fold in zucchini pecans and raisins. Pour into three greased and floured 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes until toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes; remove from pans to wire racks.

title: Grandma Bell'S Apple Pie
instructions: Grate apples in a large bowl. Add sugar and cinnamon. Pour into pie shell. If not level in pan add another apple to fill. Dot top of apples with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Mom'S Pie Crust
instructions: Combine flour salt and Crisco blend together until it resembles coarse meal sprinkle with the water stir with fork until all dry ingredients are moistened shape into a ball. Roll dough to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Makes 2 single pie crusts or crust for a 2 crust pie.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice well then add remainder of ingredients; mix well. Chill 3 hours before serving. May be frozen. Makes 2 pies.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain blueberries and pineapple. Add water to make 3 1/4 cups. Boil and dissolve jello and sugar. Cool. Add fruits and nuts. Top with 1 cup Cool Whip and 1 cup sour cream mixed together.

title: 4 Layer Lemon Or Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Blend until crumbly. Press crumbs into a 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes; chill.

title: Murf'S Favorite Meatloaf
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large mixing bowl shread bread and add milk. Soak 2-5 minutes. 2. Combine all remaining ingredients except ground beef and pickapeppa with bread and milk mixture. Mix well with your hands. 3. Now add ground beef again mixing well. Shape mixture into a loaf. Place in baking pan. Glaze top of loaf with pickapeppa. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tropical Slush
instructions: In a blender container process 1 cup of water bananas and sugar until smooth. Pour into a large container; add the concentrates pineapple juice and remaining water. Cover and freeze. Remove from freezer 2 hours before serving. Just before serving break up and mash mixture with a potato masher. Stir in soda. Yield 40 to 50 servings (about 11 quarts).

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Drop on greased cookie sheets by teaspoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 36.

title: Welsh Cookies (Cakes)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening and add currants. Combine milk and eggs. Add to dry mixture. Mix well and turn out onto floured board. Roll to 1/4-inch thick. Cut with a biscuit cutter. Bake on a moderately hot griddle. Turn when brown on one side and then brown the other.

title: Pink Taffy
instructions: In medium sized heavy saucepan stir together sugar cornstarch and salt. Add corn sirup water and butter. Mix well. Over moderate heat bring to boil stirring constantly until sugar dissolves.

title: Twice-Cooked Pork
instructions: Place pork Chablis and ginger in a 2-quart pan. Cut 1 of the green onions in half and add to pork then add enough water to barely cover meat. Bring to a simmer; cover and simmer until not pink (about 20 minutes to 30 minutes). Lift meat from broth and refrigerate until cold. Cut into 1 1/2-inch square pieces.

title: Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Bake yams in jackets. Remove skins while hot and mash; add crushed pineapple and pecans. Place in a greased casserole dish; top with marshmallows. Heat until marshmallows are brown. Yield 200 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Will keep 3 weeks in refrigerator or 1 year in freezer.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Melt butter and cool. Beat everything except butter and vinegar. Then beat in vinegar and cooled butter. Cook in saucepan over low flame 4 to 5 minutes. Serve with smoked turkey or ham. Can do ahead.

title: Graham Cracker
instructions: Cover a jelly roll pan with graham crackers. Boil together for 2 1/2 minutes only the butter and sugar. Pour boiled mixture over graham crackers and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes only. Take off pan immediately and cool on waxed paper. When cool break crackers in half (serving sized pieces).

title: Quick Nut Or Date Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Have all ingredients about 75\u00b0. Sift into a bowl the first four ingredients. Add the melted butter. Beat the milk with the egg. Beat the liquid ingredients into the sifted ones until well mixed. Fold in the broken nut meats or part dates and part nut meats. Place the dough in a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake for about 40 minutes.

title: Very Best Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars shortening eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Roll into balls or drop from teaspoon onto ungreased pan. Bake until lightly browned (8 to 10 minutes) at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Pumpkin
instructions: Cut pumpkin in half. Remove seeds. Place cut side down in baking pan. Add a small amount of water. Place in a 400\u00b0 oven and bake approximately 30 minutes. Scoop out pulp for pies.

title: Sweet Potato Custard
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pecans and mix well. Stir in pecans. Bake in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 until knife in center comes out clean.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Saute onion in bacon grease or butter. (Do not brown.) Add potatoes and water. Cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients and warm. Serve with bacon crumbled on top and Sue Lacroixs corn bread.

title: Hopping John With Ham
instructions: Sort and wash peas. Place in a heavy saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let soak 1 hour; drain. Combine ham and 2 quarts water in a large Dutch oven. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add peas and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer an additional 30 minutes or until black-eyed peas are done. Remove ham; cut into small pieces. Stir ham into pea mixture.

title: Goo Goo Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients; pour into 10 x 14-inch greased and floured pan. Mix last 5 ingredients; pour over cake and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until tests done.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix together the cake mix eggs and oil; reserve 1 cup. Press remaining mixture into ungreased 9x13 in. pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Beat together the cream cheese lemon juice and eggs; spread over crust. Top with reserved crust. Bake additional 15 minutes. Refrigerate and cut into bars. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Ann'S Sweet Sour Coleslaw
instructions: Boil sugar vinegar and water. Cool. Mix first 5 ingredients. Pour cooled sugar mixture. Refrigerate for one day.

title: Grandma'S Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg whites together until stiff peaks form. Set aside. In large bowl blend remaining ingredients including egg yolks. Fold in egg whites. Lightly oil skillet and spoon in 1/4 cup of pancake batter for each pancake. When bubbles form on top turn pancake. Continue to cook until golden on bottom.

title: Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all and bake at 350\u00b0 or until done. Serve in chili sauce and heat.

title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
instructions: Beat together cream cheese egg and sugar. Stir in chocolate chips; set aside.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and let cool. Add remaining ingredients except parsley and stir gently. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Garnish with parsley if desired. Makes 12 servings.

title: White Bean Salad
instructions: Soak beans overnight in water to cover (or cover beans with water bring to a boil boil 2 minutes let stand 1 hour).

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add the others and mix well. Bake in 2 loaf pans in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Slice onions thin; melt butter in frying pan. Add onion and fry until transparent not brown. Stir in flour a tablespoon at a time. Add the onions to broth in large saucepan. Simmer 45 minutes. Cut bread into 1-inch pieces. Spread garlic powder and butter on bread. Broil until golden. Add cheese and bread.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Especially good served with pumpernickel bread or crackers.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients in frying pan. Mix cornbread mix milk and eggs in a separate bowl. Pour Jiffy mixture into greased casserole dish. Top with meat sauce then 1 cup grated cheese and bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Glazed Peanuts
instructions: Combine ingredients in medium size pan. Stir constantly over medium heat until liquid has evaporated. Pour onto cookie sheets; spread. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven; stir and salt to taste. Bake 15 minutes more. Remove stir and replace in oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven; let cool.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Cover meat with water; add liquid smoke. Then add chili powder paprika red pepper pepper and salt. Simmer on top of stove for 2 hours. Then add vinegar Worcestershire sauce and catsup. Simmer 30 minutes more. Serve on buns.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Combine cinnamon nutmeg sugar flour and butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over apples and orange juice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Dressing
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook in top of double boiler until thick. Cool and fold in Cool Whip.

title: Pineapple Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar together until well blended. Add eggs; beat well. Pour mixture into graham cracker crust; add drained pineapple. Bake for 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Chill before serving. (If canned pie filling is used bake cream cheese sugar and egg filling only. Remove from oven and top with pie filling.)

title: Crock-Pot Apple Butter
instructions: Mix sugar and apples in large pot. Cook until sugar is dissolved. Pour into crock-pot. Cook for 4 hours stirring often. Then take lid off and cook one hour. After done drop 2 drops cinnamon or leave apple taste. Pour into hot jars and seal.

title: Orange Frost
instructions: Pour the first 4 ingredients into a blender and blend. Pour into a glass and top with the whipped cream.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients roll into 1 or 2 balls. Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork well in oil. Add onion cover and simmer 20 minutes. (Always cook pork thoroughly.) Combine vinegar cornstarch salt ginger and pepper. Add jelly and pepper strips to skillet. Bring to a boil stirring. Cover; simmer 5 minutes. Add pineapple and heat. Makes 4 servings. Serve with Chinese Fried Rice.

title: Speedy Shepherd'S Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown beef adding onions peas and carrots. Cook until vegetables are done. Add broth to mixture and boil. Let simmer until most liquid is absorbed. Transfer mixture to casserole. Top with potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake until heated through about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Applesauce Cake(For Diabetics)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream margarine with sugar substitute. Combine soda and applesauce. Add to margarine mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into nonstick 7 x 11-inch pan.

title: Yogurt Squares
instructions: Mix butter and wafers and put in 8 x 8-inch tin. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Turn oven off. Mix other ingredients pour mixture into crust and leave in oven for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie(Makes 2)
instructions: Mix and beat well sugar Karo and eggs. Add nuts vanilla melted butter or oleo and vinegar. Mix well. Pour into 2 frozen pie crusts. Place directly on oven rack in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven. Bake for 8 minutes. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 25 minutes. Check for doneness. May take an additional 3 to 5 minutes (pie will rise and tend to show a small crack in top when done).

title: Sam'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Heat and stir for 5 minutes. This is enough sauce to do 2 chickens. Brush sauce on your chickens as they cook on the grill.

title: Golden Twice-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Slice tops from potatoes; scoop out center leaving a 1/8-inch shell. Mash potatoes. Add 1 cup cheese salad dressing and milk; beat until fluffy. Spoon into shells. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Top with remaining cheese onion and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Jogging In A Jug(Health Drink)
instructions: If weight is under 160 pounds drink 2 ounces per day. If over 160 pounds drink 3 ounces per day. This drink is supposed to curb appetite provide energy and is also good to control cholesterol high blood pressure and arthritis.

title: Soy Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil; add eggs mixing constantly while breaking up with fork. Add eggs and onions to rice with soy sauce to color rice brown. Blend very well and serve hot. (Can reheat in oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.) If desired stir in 1 cup cooked diced shrimp or 1 cup cooked diced pork tenderloin.

title: Carrots In Orange Sauce
instructions: Combine orange juice and cornstarch in a medium saucepan. Add carrots and cinnamon. Cover; cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until carrots are done. Yields 4 servings. (Each 3/4-cup serving contains about 61 calories.)

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and use as a dip for fruit slices or as a dressing for a fruit salad.

title: Hot Bean Salad
instructions: Cook and drain sausage. In a large bowl combine sausage with beans; drain all cans of beans but pork and beans. In another bowl combine tomato sauce mustard brown sugar and onion. Pour over beans and sausage mixture. Mix all ingredients and place in a greased casserole dish. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Serve hot. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sour Cream Banana Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Mix sugar sour cream margarine and eggs in large mixer bowl on low speed scraping bowl occasionally for 1 minute. Beat in bananas and vanilla on low speed for 30 seconds. Beat in flour salt and baking soda; stir in nuts and spread into pan. Bake until brown or about 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and frost with your favorite frosting or powdered sugar frosting.

title: Stir-Fry Vegetables
instructions: In wok at high heat sprayed well add celery carrots onions and water chestnuts and stir-fry about 2 minutes then add bean sprouts cabbage and zucchini stirring an additional 2 minutes or until cabbage begins to wilt. Add spices soy sauce and cooking wine to blend well. Then dissolve water and cornstarch and then pour over vegetables. Reduce heat and simmer until sauce thickens. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Easy Homemade Apple Butter
instructions: Cook apples on low for 12 hours. Do not add any liquid. After 12 hours add sugar cinnamon and cloves. Stir and cook 12 more hours. This makes approximately 4 pints.

title: Salt Substitute
instructions: Mix all together and put in your salt shaker. Makes about 1 cup full.

title: The Edwards Chocolate Cake
instructions: Fill remainder of cup of cocoa with hot coffee. Stir and cool. Add soda to buttermilk. Stir and set aside.

title: Holly Candy
instructions: Melt marshmallows and butter in top of a double boiler. Add both vanilla and almond flavoring. Add green food coloring to color desired. Pour this over cornflakes and mix while hot quickly before it cools. Grease fingers well and pull off pieces. Top each piece with candy. Refrigerate. Should be kept in refrigerator as it will become soft at room temperature.

title: Microwave Rice Pilaf
instructions: Combine onion celery green pepper and margarine in 1-quart casserole. Microwave on High (100%) until vegetables are tender-crisp 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Reduce power to Medium; microwave until liquid is absorbed 10 to 12 minutes. Let stand covered 5 minutes. Fluff with fork before serving. Yields 2 to 3 servings.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms; chop stems. Set mushroom caps and stems aside. In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot butter cook mushroom stems green onion and garlic until tender. Remove skillet from heat; stir in cheese crumbs parsley and salt. Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Fill mushroom caps with crumb mixture. Place mushrooms on a jelly roll pan. Bake 10 minutes or until mushrooms are very hot.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and dust Bundt pan. Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 until done. Cook cake completely. Frost with one 16 ounce tub Cool Whip mixed with 1 package of dry pistachio pudding.

title: Baked Potatoes With Sun Tan Lotion
instructions: Wash potatoes and pat dry. Coat skins with margarine. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 1 hour (potatoes should be placed on cookie sheet).

title: Crepe A La Caviar
instructions: Blend milk and eggs with whisk add flour and oil and mix until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Lightly butter a small frypan and pour just enough batter to coat bottom of pan. When it starts to bubble loosen edges with small spatula pick up crepe with fingers and flip over. Cook 20 seconds more. Wrap cooked crepes in napkin and keep warm in the oven.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix together all the ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let cool slightly before cutting into small squares.

title: Lime Chiffon Pie
instructions: Baked pastry shell or graham cracker crust. Dissolve gelatin in cold water and let stand 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup of the sugar lime juice and salt to the beaten egg yolks. Beat well and cook over boiling water stirring until its like custard. Add the softened gelatin and lime rind. Stir well and cool. Beat egg white until stiff and blend with rest of sugar (1/2 cup). Fold egg whites into cool lime and yolk mixture. Heap into pie shell and chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours. Can cover with whipped cream if desired when serving.

title: Lemon Custard Pudding Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine flour margarine and 1 1/2 cups sugar. Beat egg yolks and add to flour mixture along with milk; mix well (this will be a thin batter). Add lemon juice. In another bowl beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly add 1/2 cup of sugar. Fold into batter. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish. Place baking dish in a shallow pan of hot water and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve warm or chilled. Makes 8 to 10 servings. Prep Time 50 minutes.

title: Fried Streak O'Lean
instructions: Select the number of slices needed. Soak several hours in milk. Drain. Coat with flour. Fry over medium heat in small amount of oil until crisp (be sure it is done). Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Copper Penny
instructions: Slice carrots and cook just until tender. Do not overcook. Chop onion and pepper and layer in bowl. Combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour the sauce over the layered carrots. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. The longer it marinates the better.

title: Punch(The Easy Way)
instructions: Pour ginger ale over frozen juice in punch bowl. Add sherbet.

title: Ham And Broccoli Bake (Strata)
instructions: Grease 13 x 9-inch dish or pan. Partially cook broccoli; drain. Cut each slice of bread with doughnut cutter setting aside bread doughnuts. Put all bread scraps in bottom of pan. Layer cheese broccoli and ham over bread in pan. Sprinkle with onion. Put bread doughnuts on top. Combine and beat remaining ingredients and pour over top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before cutting. Do not use bread crust in this recipe.

title: Fabulous Fruit Salad
instructions: Core applies and dice into bowl. Stir in drained fruit cocktail pineapple and marshmallows. Set aside. Mix flour and sugar in pan. Add 2 beaten eggs and juice of 1 lemon and pineapple juice. Cook dressing over medium heat until it thickens. Cool add mustard. Mix with salad. Sprinkle coconut over top then cover with a layer of grated cheese. Refrigerate. (Should be made the night before it is to be served. Will last several days in refrigerator.)

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Chop celery olives sweet pickles green onions and pimento very fine. Add to cooked macaroni along with salt and mayonnaise. Yields about 1/2 gallon.

title: Cow Pies
instructions: In a double boiler melt chips and shortening. Remove from heat stir in raisins nuts and Krispies. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper. Chill. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water. Add shortening sugar eggs 4 cups of the flour and salt. Stir and then beat until smooth about 1 minute. Stir in remaining flour. This will be a soft dough. Put in airtight container in refrigerator until needed. When ready to use punch down and pinch off 1/3. Put remaining dough in refrigerator in airtight container. It will keep several days. Can be used for rolls or bread. Let rise double. Bake in hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes.

title: Granola (Cereal)
instructions: Mix with hands and place on two cookie sheets. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes; stir. Bake 10 minutes longer or until light brown. Store in airtight container.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Can add anything tomatoes cucumbers carrots celery to make it colorful.

title: Vegetable Seasoned Rice
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat heat broth to boiling. Stir in 3/4 cup rice. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Makes 2 1/4 cups.

title: White Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients together; pour into well-greased pan. Bake.

title: Caramel Apple Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Chill and serve.

title: Taffy Apple Dip
instructions: In a small bowl beat cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread mixture on a small serving plate. Top with nuts. Serve with apples.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cook meat together in salted water. Remove meat when done and cut up or grind up. Put potatoes tomatoes and corn in broth; cook until tender. Use potato masher and mash them real good. Then add rest of the ingredients including the meat. Cool real slow about 45 minutes. Can add sweet barbecue sauce to taste (optional). Very good.

title: Rotini Casserole
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on box. Brown ground beef bell pepper onion and garlic. Drain off grease. Turn to medium heat. Add tomatoes mushrooms and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes. Turn stove off and add Ricotta cheese. Drain pasta and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Mix pasta ground beef mixture and 1/2 bag shredded cheese. Place remaining cheese on top. Cover and bake in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix jello with hot water and dissolve. Add pie filling and pineapple. Mix well and chill.

title: Fresh Green Beans With Almonds
instructions: Stem and wash beans. Put beans in a pot and cover with boiling water. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute; reduce heat. Add seasonings. Cover and cook for approximately 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Put in serving dish; drizzle with butter. Top with almonds.

title: Sausage Lasagna
instructions: Prepare lasagna according to package directions. Drain. In large skillet cook sausage onion and carrot until onion is tender. Add tomato sauce tomato paste water 1 teaspoon salt basil fennel and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend together Ricotta egg and salt.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Wrap hot dog in enough bacon to reach around hot dog and secure with toothpick. Place in baking dish. Mix jelly and mustard together and pour over wieners. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes until bacon is done.

title: Polish Sausage With Red Cabbage
instructions: Place cabbage in a colander. Pour boiling water over cabbage; drain well. Melt butter in a Dutch oven or large heavy skillet. Add cabbage. Stir in lemon juice. Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until cabbage is pink. Add wine salt and pepper. Cover. Simmer over medium-low heat 45 minutes. Mix sugar and cornstarch. Stir into simmering liquid. Bring to boiling stirring constantly. Reduce heat; add sausage. Cover and cook 30 minutes.

title: Nannie'S Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
instructions: In saucepan bring water salt and oil to a boil. Add rice. Stir only once or twice to keep from sticking on bottom. Lower heat. Cover with tight lid. Simmer for about 15 minutes. Let set until all water is absorbed. Lay oleo on top of rice. Do not stir. Just let it melt into rice. Beat the eggs real good then add sugar. Beat more. Add to rice. Pour evaporated milk and 2 more cups sweet milk. Add nutmeg and vanilla mixture. Should be real thin. Pour into large baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for an hour or until light brown on top and middle is set kinda like an egg custard.

title: Yogurt Parfait
instructions: In tall glass place layers of yogurt and then cereal. Makes 1 serving. Kids love it!

title: Raisin Sauce For Ham
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Slowly stir in vinegar and add remaining ingredients and stir over low heat until thickened. Serve hot. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Silver Fox Punch
instructions: Heat the sugar and 4 cups water until melted. Add the remaining ingredients. Freeze for 24 hours.

title: Cracker Snack
instructions: Mix and pour over crackers. Stir well and then occasionally until dry. Store in sealed container such as plastic jar or Baggie.

title: Red Bean Salad
instructions: Cook red beans or use canned one (I prefer canned ones for this as they stay whole better). Drain well. Add chopped onion celery pickle and finely chopped eggs. Toss with mayonnaise salt and pepper to taste. May add a little Worcestershire and hot sauce if desired. Great with barbecue of any kind.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and dry Jell-O together until Jell-O is dissolved. Fold in Cool Whip. Mix together with drained pineapple and drained mandarin orange slices. Chill before serving.

title: Fattening Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix equal parts until smooth. Dip and enjoy!

title: Potato Wiener Cheese Skillet
instructions: Slice potatoes. Cook in skillet in oil and onion until done. Add wieners. Cut in 1 1/2 to 2-inch pieces. Heat thoroughly. Add cheese. Let melt.

title: Citrus Cake
instructions: Cream butter adding sugar gradually in small bowl. In large bowl sift flour baking powder and salt. Add 1 egg at a time to creamed mixture blending well after each addition. Mix creamed mixture with milk and flavorings alternately to flour mixture. Blend well after each addition. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 to 55 minutes.
