title: No-Bake Peanut Butter-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter and milk in a heavy saucepan. Stir well. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Stir in oats peanut butter and vanilla. Drop dough by heaping teaspoons onto lightly greased wax paper. Cool thoroughly. Yield about 4 dozen.

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Mix soup marmalade Russian dressing and honey. Pour over chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve gravy over rice.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Combine unflavored gelatin with 4 tablespoons cold water. Add boiling water and 1 cup sugar. Add to gelatin mixture; stir until dissolved. Blend into mixture the crushed pineapple and juice of 1 lemon. Chill until consistency of egg whites. Prepare as directed the Dream Whip. Fold into gelatin mixture. Break the angel food cake into small pieces and fold into gelatin mixture. Put into a large mixing bowl and chill overnight. Turn onto platter and frost with 1 envelope of Dream Whip prepared according to directions. Then sprinkle Angel Flake coconut over cake.

title: Phoney Champagne Punch
instructions: Boil water and sugar for 1 minute. Cool and add rest of ingredients. Serves 12.

title: Cheesecake Brownies(Yield One 9 X 9-Inch Pan)
instructions: Mix cream cheese with 1/3 cup sugar and 1 egg until light and fluffy; set aside. Cream margarine with sugar then beat in 2 eggs one at a time. Beat until fluffy; add cocoa. Stir in a mixture of flour baking powder and salt; blend. Add vanilla. Spoon half of chocolate mixture into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Spoon cheese mixture over chocolate layer. Add remaining chocolate mixture by spoonfuls to cover cheese layer. Spread carefully. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool before cutting.

title: Applesauce Cream Cheese Salad
instructions: Stir jello and water until dissolved. Add cream cheese. Mash up into jello. Add applesauce. Stir well in jello mixture. Refrigerate in 8 x 8-inch dish. Cream cheese will rise to top.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Drain. Brown hamburger with onion and green pepper. Drain. Mix together Ragu sauce and tomato sauce. Spray 9 x 13 baking dish with Pam nonstick spray. Layer on bottom of dish 1/2 meat 1/2 spaghetti and 1/2 of sauce. Repeat layers. Top with shredded Cheddar shredded Mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Texas Style Mexican Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large saucepan combine the browned ground beef chilies enchilada sauce mushroom soup chicken soup and milk. Simmer mixture over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes until mixture begins to bubble. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish layer the mixture alternating with corn tortillas. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake for 20 minutes. Good!

title: Date Orange Toppers
instructions: In a saucepan combine dates water and sugar. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until it thickens. Remove from heat. Add nuts. Slice cookie dough into 36 slices (thin). Place 27 cookies on cookie sheet. Place 1 tablespoon of date nut mixture on top of each slice. Cut remaining 9 slices into thirds. Place each third onto date top mixture. Sprinkle with orange peel. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden. Cool and serve. Makes 27 cookies.

title: Banana Smoothie
instructions: Place all ingredients\tin blender. Blend for 20 seconds. Pour into glass and serve.\tEnjoy!!!

title: Macaroni And Beef Skillet Dinner
instructions: Cook the noodles. Drain and set aside. Saute the meat onions and garlic in oil until the meat loses its pink color and the onions are tender. Add pepper tomato sauce catsup and Worcestershire sauce. Bring mixture to a boil then simmer gently about 5 minutes. Mix in the cooked macaroni and simmer for 5 more minutes.

title: Orange Pineapple Smoothie
instructions: Blend orange juice pineapple and orange rind in a blender for 20 seconds. Add ice cream and blend 10 seconds more. Makes 2 drinks.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Boil 2 cups water and dissolve the jello; cool. Add the strawberries and pineapple. Refrigerate until firm in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread with mixture of cream cheese and whipped cream. Cut into squares to serve.

title: Poulet Saute Au Vin Blanc
instructions: Dry chicken joints. Heat butter and oil in wide pan with cover and saute chicken briskly. Season cover pan and cook over low heat for 25 to 30 minutes. Remove chicken. Add shallots or onions to pan cook 1 minute. Add wine and boil rapidly stirring occasionally until reduced to half. Stir in cream replace chicken and simmer until sauce thickens slightly. Serve with buttered rice or wild rice. May be made ahead but add cream and wine at last minute.

title: Juicy Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well; pack in a well greased loaf pan. Bake in slow oven (350\u00b0) for 35 minutes or until firm and light brown on top. Loosen sides of loaf with knife; let stand in pan 5 minutes. Slice. Serves 4.

title: Creamy Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix all together. Yields about 1 cup.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix well with wooden spoon. Let stand at room temperature for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Party Dessert
instructions: Crust Crush Ritz crackers and mix with melted butter. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix and cook the egg yolks sugar and crushed pineapple until thick. Add lemon Jell-O (no water); add the 8 egg whites and fold into pineapple mixture after it has cooled. Make 24 hours before serving.

title: Whoopie Pies
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients until well blended. Add milk to creamed mixture. Add sifted dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Mix until well blended. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. Fill vanilla fluff between two cookies when cooled. Makes about 5 dozen.

title: Pink Party Punch
instructions: Dilute lemonade as directed on can. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into plastic container and freeze. Take out several hours before serving. Pour ginger ale mixture making slush color to choice.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat cottage cheese in small mixing bowl on high speed of mixer until almost smooth about 5 minutes. Stir in sour cream coconut honey orange peel and vanilla. Chill covered 2 to 3 hours to allow flavors to blend. Serve with fresh fruit of season. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Skip A Step Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Place shortening sugar and salt in mixing bowl add boiling water. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cool to lukewarm. Add yeast mixture. Stir in eggs and flour. Shape into rolls or doughnuts. Let rise until double. Bake at 375\u00b0 until brown or deep fat fry.

title: Sauerkraut Spareribs
instructions: Rinse chicken; pat dry with paper towels. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces. In a large bowl combine half of the green onion the minced garlic vinegar soy sauce the first tablespoon oil and the red and black peppers. Add the chicken pieces; stir to coat. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain reserving marinade.

title: Dog Chow
instructions: Melt margarine peanut butter and chocolate chips in a large pan. Add the cereal and coat thoroughly. Place in a large paper bag with the powdered sugar and toss.

title: Greek Spanakopita Recipe
instructions: Squeeze remaining liquid from spinach and place in large bowl tear into small pieces. Beat eggs crumble feta cheese and add to spinach. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until brown add to spinach season with pepper and oregano. Butter a large oblong baking dish.

title: Pollo Magnifico(Pibil)
instructions: Place chicken pieces between 2 slices of wax paper and pound with mallet until 1/4 inch thick. In large Ziploc bag combine all ingredients together. Seal bag squeezing out air; turn to coat chicken. Refrigerate 6 to 8 hours or overnight turning bag occasionally.

title: Chicken With Raspberry Vinegar
instructions: Lightly sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Heat a 4 or 6-quart pressure cooker; add oil and brown chicken breasts. Add shallots chicken broth and vinegar. Close cover securely. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe. Cook for 3 minutes at 15 pounds pressure with pressure regular rocking slowly. Cool cooker at once. Remove chicken and keep warm. Return to pan to heat and bring liquid to a boil. Stir in rice; remove pan from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in raspberries. Serve with chicken. Yield 4 servings.

title: Old-Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and pour into pie shell. Bake 30 to 35 minutes on 350\u00b0.

title: Honey-Lime And Mustard Chicken
instructions: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness. Combine honey (2 tablespoons) mustard and lime juice. Pour over chicken and marinade at room temperature for 15 minutes. Cook rice according to package directions adding peas pepper strips and 1 tablespoon honey after rice has simmered 22 minutes. Remove chicken from marinade.

title: Advent Christian Punch
instructions: Mix all together and add the lime or pineapple sherbet when ready to serve. Serves 50.

title: Apple Betty
instructions: Peel apples and slice. Mound them in buttered 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with the orange juice. Combine sugar flour cinnamon nutmeg and salt. Cut in 1/2 cup margarine. Sprinkle this mixture over the apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Foolproof Meringue
instructions: Beat egg whites with salt. Add marshmallow cream and mix. Put on favorite pie. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Place in microwave for 1 minute on High. Stir and repeat for another minute. Stir in vanilla. Put aside and let cool.

title: Orange Pecan Thins
instructions: Cream butter and 1/2 c. sugar in small bowl. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Add flour to mixture along with grated rind.\tMix. Spread mixture evenly over a 10 x 15 jelly roll pan. Beat egg white until foamy and then gradually add 1/4 c. sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form. Spread over base sprinkle nuts on top.\tBake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Stuffed Chicken
instructions: In thickest side of each chicken piece cut a pocket large enough for cheese. Place a cheese slice in each pocket. Beat together egg Parmesan cheese parsley bouillon and dash of pepper. Coat chicken with flour and dip in egg mixture. Brown in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Transfer to 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 4 servings.

title: Herbed Lentil Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except cheese in a 3-quart ungreased casserole. Bake uncovered for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until moist not runny. If using cheese add to top and bake an extra 5 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Cream together first 4 ingredients. Combine next three (chips water and oatmeal) in a bowl and let set for 10 minutes. Sift together flour baking soda and cocoa; add to egg and sugar mixture. Finally add oatmeal mix to the previous mixture and pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan; top with remaining chocolate chips and nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes until done. Serve hot or cold.

title: Hearty Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger with onions then strain off grease. Mix remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Crush up cookies with a rolling pin. Pour melted butter over cookie crumbs. Press half of crumbs into bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish. Reserve remaining crumbs for topping. Beat 1 1/2 cups milk with cream cheese until mixture is fluffy. Add pudding and remaining milk and mix well. Fold whipped topping into pudding mixture. Spread pudding mixture over cookie crumbs. Spread reserved crumbs over pudding layers. Chill and serve.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; let it set until it starts to congeal. Soften cream cheese and mix with whipped cream; fold with other ingredients into gelatin. Pour into mold and chill. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

title: Microwave Munchies
instructions: Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and melt 1 1/2 to 2 minutes on High (glass pan). Stir in seasoning. Mix with rest of ingredients. Microwave 2 to 4 minutes on High. Makes 7 cups.

title: Microwave Rice
instructions: In a casserole dish cook on High for 5 minutes then on 1/2 power for 25 minutes.

title: Chinese Salad
instructions: Crush Top Ramen with rolling pin and toss together with above ingredients.

title: Fruit 'N Pudding Crisp
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in an ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or 8-inch square baking pan; set aside. Combine the remaining ingredients in large bowl until well blended and crumbly. Sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 glass) for 40 to 45 minutes until deep golden brown and bubbly. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Sugar-Free Raisin Cookies
instructions: Boil raisins dates and apples in water for 3 minutes. Add shortening to melt. Cool. Add rest of ingredients with nuts last; mix well. Refrigerate until chilled. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Refrigerate cookies.

title: Oven Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Combine sugar margarine syrup salt and flavoring. Bring to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add soda. Pour mixture over popcorn; mix well. Scatter in large shallow pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring frequently.

title: Corn Fritters(From 1975 Edition)
instructions: Mix thoroughly flour milk and corn. Add dash of salt and pepper. Blend well beaten egg and add. Drop mixture by tablespoon into hot fat and fry a golden brown.

title: Coconut Candy
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; cook until it forms a real soft ball in cold water. Add the coconut; cook until 240\u00b0 or until it forms a soft ball. Add the butter and vanilla. Let cool until bottom of pan is warm. Beat with electric mixer (add a few drops of red coloring if pink color is desired) until it begins to hold its shape when dropped from spoon. Drop onto wax paper; top with pecan halves or pieces. Store in tins.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill over night.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a greased casserole and bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mushroom Meatballs
instructions: Combine soup and water. Measure out 1/2 cup soup mixture and combine with bread crumbs ground beef onions egg and salt. Shape into meat balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Brown meatballs in a large skillet using 1 tablespoon oil. Add remaining soup mixture cover and cook over low heat about 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. You may shape into patties if you prefer.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sour cream sugar oil and eggs for 4 minutes. Pour half of batter in a 13 x 9-inch greased and floured pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle more than 1/2 of mixture over batter. Add remainder of batter and sprinkle rest of mixture over this. Cut across a few times with knife to mix. Cook at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or more. Ice.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Layer cream cheese refried beans and salsa; top with cheese. Heat in microwave for about 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts. Dip with nachos. Its wonderful!

title: Carrot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Grate or shred the carrots. Drain the pineapple. Boil ginger ale. Pour over lemon jello. Mix. Add carrots and pineapple. Refrigerate until firm. Serve on lettuce. May be topped with Miracle Whip/pineapple dressing. Make the day before if desired.

title: Feta Spinach And Fruit Salad With Honey-Lemon Dressing
instructions: Place spinach fruit onion cheese and olives in large bowl. Toss lightly. Mix remaining ingredients; add and toss. Makes 6 cups or 6 side-salad servings.

title: Orange Sherbet Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange gelatin in 3/4 cup boiling water. Add sherbet (which has just been removed from the freezer) and stir until sherbet is completely blended with the gelatin. Pour mixture into a 2-quart mold and spread sour cream over the top. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift flour; measure. Add soda baking powder and salt; sift again. Cream shortening and peanut butter; gradually add the sugars and cream thoroughly. Add well beaten egg. Combine the dry ingredients and creamed mixture. Mix well. Form into balls 1-inch in diameter and place on a lightly greased and floured baking sheet. Flatten with fork making crisscross pattern. Bake in a moderate oven at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 to 4 dozen cookies.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large mixing bowl and beat 2 minutes. Pour half of batter into a well-greased and floured tube pan (10-inch). Combine sugar cinnamon and finely chopped nuts and sprinkle half this mixture onto batter. Pour in the remaining batter and sprinkle with remaining sugar cinnamon and nut mixture on top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Batter Fried Vegetables
instructions: In a bowl stir together cornstarch flour baking powder salt and pepper. Stir in water and egg until smooth. Pour corn oil into a large skillet at depth of 1/2 inch filling skillet no more than 1/3 full. Heat oil over medium heat to 375\u00b0. Dip vegetables a few at a time into batter (stir batter occasionally). Carefully add vegetables to hot oil a few pieces at a time. Fry turning once for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown. Drain.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt butter; add peanut butter and sugar and mix well. Add crumbs and mix. Spread in buttered pan (I use a 9 x 13 pan). Melt the chocolate chips over hot water and spread on top of peanut butter mixture.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: In a large bowl mix brown sugar eggs and butter. Mix well with a wooden spoon. Then add in flour baking powder soda pecans and vanilla. Mix well and pour into a greased baking pan. Spread in pan and sprinkle 1 cup of chocolate chips over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes (center will be soft).

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crush pretzels (use a Ziploc bag). Put pretzels in a bowl. Add margarine and sugar. Mix well with a fork and place in a 9 x 13 dish. Bake for 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool. Beat together softened cream cheese and 1 cup sugar. Fold in Cool Whip and set aside. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add frozen strawberries. Refrigerate until partially set. Spread cream cheese mixture over cooled crust. Add Jell-O with berries and refrigerate. Best if chilled overnight.

title: Seven-Layer Salad
instructions: Break the lettuce into bite size pieces. Layer the ingredients in a 9 x 11-inch Pyrex dish as follows lettuce onion celery bell pepper and peas. Combine the mayonnaise and sugar; spread on top. Cover this with cheese. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Cole Slaw Healthy Eating
instructions: Whip mayo mustard Equal vinegar oil and milk with a wire whip. Pour over cabbage and carrots. Toss until well coated. Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine the first 10 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well and add the pumpkin oil and water. Blend well. Add 4 eggs one at a time blending well. Divide into 3 greased and flour loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Great served warm or cold.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients with electric mixer. Pour into an ice cream freezer and fill with milk. Freeze.

title: Easy Streusel Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 375\u00b0. In large bowl using a wire whisk whisk together the eggs pumpkin milk 3/4 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons spice. Pour filling into 1 frozen crust. Bake on preheated baking sheet for 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Peach Pie
instructions: Boil sugar water and cornstarch until clear. Remove from heat. Add Jell-O; cool. Put peaches in pie shell. Pour mixture over peaches. Refrigerate to jell.

title: Tennessee Dirt Cake
instructions: Crush cookies and put half in 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass cake pan. In a medium mixing bowl mix milk pudding and vanilla; let stand. In another bowl cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth. Add powdered sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Combine the mixtures and pour over the crumbs in the pan. Top with other half of Oreo crumbs. Cover tightly and chill overnight.

title: Easy Does It Meat Pie
instructions: Defrost 2 pie shells. Cover meat with water in frying pan. Cook until brown. Drain all water off meat. Add 1 can or jar gravy; brown with onions. Do not add water into gravy. Pour into pie shell. Cover with the other pie shell. Brush top with 1 egg. Put 4 or 5 slits on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Potato Salad
instructions: Skin chicken before cooking. Boil chicken and let cool. Debone chicken. Add other ingredients. Add mayonnaise salt and pepper.

title: Grandma'S Mac And Cheese
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Place in 2 1/2 qt. greased casserole dish. Melt butter over medium heat stir in flour; mix well. Add milk and cook over medium heat stir constantly until sauce thickens. Add salt sugar and cheese mix well. Mix sour cream and cheese into sauce. Pour over macaroni; mix well. Sprinkle grated cheese and bread crumbs over top. Dot with butter. The dish may be frozen at this point. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes.

title: Strawberry Satin Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch flour and salt in saucepan. Add milk gradually stirring until smooth. Cook until very thick and bubbling. Stir a little of hot mixture into egg. Add egg to hot mixture; cook then chill thoroughly. (Mixture will be very thick.) Beat until smooth and velvety. Whip cream and fold into filling mixture. Add vanilla. Fill shell. Refrigerate until serving time. Add thickened strawberries on top.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: First layer shredded lettuce. Second layer coarsely chopped celery. Third layer coarsely chopped green pepper. Fourth layer Spanish onion separated into rings. Fifth layer the sugar peas that have been drained. Sixth layer spread mayonnaise on top. Sprinkle sugar on mayonnaise. Seventh layer shredded cheese. May sprinkle bacon crumbs on top.

title: Veal Goulash
instructions: Dredge veal with paprika; set aside. Heat oil in Dutch oven. Add chopped onions and saute until lightly browned. Remove onions using slotted spoon and set aside. Brown dredged veal on all sides. Return onions to Dutch oven. Stir in tomatoes tomato sauce and salt. Simmer gently uncovered about 1 hour or until veal is tender. Serve over noodles. Makes about 6 servings.

title: A Whole Meal In A Baked Potato
instructions: Scrub potatoes; dry and place on racks in 450\u00b0 oven. Bake until tender (approximately 1 hour). Cook vegetables in a medium saucepan until tender to taste. Place vegetables in bowl. Measure cooking liquid then add milk to make 2 cups. Pour into saucepan and set over medium heat. Toss cheese with flour. Gradually add to hot liquid stirring constantly until cheese melts and sauce is smooth. Stir in vegetables. Cover; keep warm. When potatoes are tender immediately cut crisscross tops to release steam. Squeeze and press ends toward center to fluff up insides. Place on serving dishes and top each with sauce.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Add ingredients one by one. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 5 minutes then at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; drop by spoons into hot grease and brown.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown and drain meat. Combine other ingredients with meat and simmer until thick. Serve over toasted or untoasted hamburger buns.

title: Wylene'S Potato Bacon Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Remove and drain. Saute onion in a little bacon grease. Remove onion and drain. Cook potatoes in 2 cups water. When cooked add all ingredients and simmer. (Do not boil.)

title: Tuna Spread
instructions: Beat all ingredients except tuna with mixer. Stir in tuna. Refrigerate. Serve with Chicken in a Biskit crackers.

title: Burgundy Beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large roasting pan combine soups and wine. Add beef. Cover tightly and bake three hours. Add noodles. Cover and bake one hour. Serves 8.

title: Sweet Potato Bake(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)
instructions: Cut pineapple chunks in half. Combine pineapple with juice potatoes salt and butter. Place half of mixture in a buttered casserole dish. Top with half of the marshmallows. Add remaining half of potato mixture. Arrange pecans on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove cover about 10 minutes before serving. Add remaining marshmallows.

title: Crepes Suzettes(Thin Pancakes)
instructions: Beat together eggs salt sugar milk and flour until smooth. Heat frying pan. Brush bottom with butter or oil. Pour in a thin layer of batter. Spread by tilting pan. Pancakes must be very thin (almost transparent). Fry on both sides to a golden brown. Spread with jelly or cheese. Roll up and keep warm until served. Dust with powdered sugar. Can be kept warm at 200\u00b0.

title: Bubble Bread
instructions: Grease Bundt cake pan. Place frozen rolls in pan. Mix brown sugar and pudding; sprinkle over rolls. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over mixture. Sprinkle pecans over all this and pour melted butter over pecans. Place on cabinet overnight to rise; do not cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn over and dump on plate to serve.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Crush some vanilla wafers and place crushed wafers in a pie plate. Stand up vanilla wafers around plate. Mix together separated eggs (save whites for frosting) milk and lemon juice. Mix. Place in pie crust. Mix egg whites and 1/3 cup sugar for meringue. Place in oven and let brown.

title: Chicken Skillet Stew
instructions: Cut chicken in serving pieces; roll in flour salt and paprika. Brown in butter; push to side of skillet. Add potatoes and carrot; pour soup over all. Cover; cook on simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are done. When done take up and put on serving platter leaving drippings in pan. Add sour cream to drippings mix until heated through. Serve at once with rolls (or corn sticks) and salad.

title: South Of The Border
instructions: Line bottom of a 5-quart casserole with half the corn chips. Layer the remaining ingredients in the following order onion kidney beans olives burger and remaining chips. In a small mixing bowl combine tomato sauce and taco seasoning mix. Pour the sauce over the top of the layered mixture. Put cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Bake in three greased and floured cake pans. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Place on ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward center. Press over bottom and up sides to form center. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar. Beat remaining ingredients. Pour into crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pesto Sauce
instructions: Place basil pine nuts garlic and cheese in the work bowl of a food processor and process until a near-puree is obtained. Pour oil slowly through the feed tube while the motor runs and scrap down the sides of the work bowl with a rubber spatula once or twice. Run 20 to 30 seconds longer. Remove and reserve. Makes approximately 1/2 cup. This may be frozen. Can be served over pasta and used with seafood and chicken dishes.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix persimmons sugar eggs and flour with soda salt and spices. Using electric mixer stir in milk and melted butter. Add vanilla. Put mixture into a greased baking dish and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 but we have always found 325\u00b0 to work better. It will take approximately 1 hour depending upon depth of pan.

title: Easy Taco Dip
instructions: Mix taco seasoning with refried beans. Spread mixture into a baking dish suitable for serving. Spread sour cream on top of the beans. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top of the sour cream. Bake in oven until cheese is melted.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and eggs. When cooked and cooled cube and add rest of ingredients. Mix well.

title: Sour Cream Beets
instructions: Mix the first 6 ingredients well. Carefully stir in beets. Heat slowly stirring often. Serve warm or cold. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Microwave Islander Chicken
instructions: Cut larger pieces of chicken in half for uniform size. Arrange skin side up in 2 quart baking dish. Combine juice cornstarch salt cinnamon and lime juice. Pour over chicken. Cook covered with wax paper 28 minutes or until chicken is done spooning sauce over chicken during last half of cooking time. Add bananas and nuts. Cook uncovered 1 minute and 30 seconds. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together and put in buttered casserole dish. Spread bread crumbs and slivered almonds on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Pizza
instructions: First you make the dough and toss it up and down. Then you put all the ingredients. You put it in the oven then you will have a pizza.

title: Carol Spack'S Crisp Green Salad
instructions: This salad is very refreshing on a hot summer night. I prefer to use organic vegetables particularly lettuce which has a sweeter and more distinctive taste.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Prepare 1/2 recipe of dough. Shape as desired. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake about 20 minutes on greased baking sheet. Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: No-Process Mustard Pickles
instructions: Mix and pour over washed pickling cukes in jars. Open and enjoy after 3 weeks.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Place popped corn in a large grocery bag. Combine oleo brown sugar corn syrup and salt in a large glass pitcher. Bring to boil on Full Power. Boil 2 minutes. Stir in baking soda. Pour syrup over popcorn in bag. Close bag and shake vigorously. Place bag in microwave. Cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake again. Return to oven for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake again. Return to oven for 1 minute. Remove and pour on cookie sheet. Let cool.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mash potatoes with salt sugar and oleo. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Roll in pecans. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Make a dent in ball with thumb. Place a marshmallow in dent. Bake at 300\u00b0 until marshmallow is melted and brown.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in baking pan. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until creamy and stir in Cool Whip. Add food color. In a bowl mix pineapple fruit cocktail cherries mandarin oranges marshmallows and nuts. Add ingredients and mix. Makes large bowl.

title: Veggie Meat Loaf
instructions: In large mixing bowl mix all the ingredients together using hands. After thoroughly mixed shape into loaf and press into 4 x 10-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours pouring off grease as it surfaces. Let cool 5 minutes after removing from pan. Serves 6.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Season chicken with salt pepper and chili powder. Quickly heat tortillas in hot oil. On each tortilla layer 2 tablespoons of chicken 1 teaspoon onion 1 teaspoon olives 1 tablespoon sour cream and 1 tablespoon cheese. Roll up each tortilla and place in oblong baking dish.

title: Asparagus Mold
instructions: * Broccoli may be used in place of asparagus steam before using.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cracker crumbs and margarine. Stir crumbs into margarine\tand sprinkle on top of the other ingredients. Bake in 2 quart dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until bubbles.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream the butter sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl for about 5 minutes or until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Dissolve coffee powder in hot water. Sift flour cocoa salt and baking powder together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with coffee and buttermilk beating just until blended after each addition. Pour into well-greased and floured fluted tube pan. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes to 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating until blended after each addition. Add vanilla beating until blended.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat butter and sugars until fluffy. Add in the eggs and vanilla. Mix together the dry ingredients and slowly add. Lastly mix in the oatmeal Rice Krispies and coconut. Drop from teaspoon 3 to 4-inches apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Swedish Meat Balls
instructions: Mix beef bread crumbs onions egg and parsley. Shape into meat balls. In skillet brown meat balls. Pour off drippings. Stir in soup and 1/2 can of water (or milk). Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Stir often. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Oven Fried Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In resealable plastic bag combine chicken buttermilk thyme pepper sauce and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove chicken. In separate resealable plastic bag combine chicken and croutons; shake to coat. Place on baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake 30 minutes turning once.

title: Banana Cupcakes
instructions: Mix together and pour batter into cupcake papers. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: My Favorite Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cornstarch together with dash of salt. Add milk; stir well until sugar is dissolved. Cook in double boiler until thick stirring constantly. Add part of mixture (several spoonfuls) to beaten egg yolks. Add back to remaining mixture and cook covered until thick (about 15 minutes) stirring occasionally until cool. Top with Dream Whip topping. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat; spoon off excess fat. Add next 4 ingredients. Cover and simmer 40 minutes. Salt to taste. Cook noodles in water until tender; drain. Layer in baking dish using noodles sauce Mozzarella cheese and cottage cheese. Repeat layers ending with sauce. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cocoa-Buttermilk Cake
instructions: Cream butter or margarine with the vanilla. Gradually add the sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat until light and fluffy. Add cocoa soda and salt. Turn mixer on low speed. Add buttermilk slowly and flour. This makes three 9-inch layers or one 9 x 13-inch pan cake. Ice with your favorite frosting. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Strawberry Freeze
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Add fruit and just a little of the juice. Fold in Cool Whip and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 12.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix dressing with butter. Mix all ingredients with 1/2 of dressing mix. Put in casserole and top with balance of dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Brown hamburger meat onion and green pepper in skillet and drain. Add all ingredients in crock-pot and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Use greased 9 x 13-inch pan and dump first 2 ingredients in. Spread out but dont mix. Shake cake mix over all. Slice 2 sticks margarine on top then coconut and nuts. Bake until done about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hominy Pie
instructions: Brown meat. Add onions add brown lightly. Add salt pepper and chili powder. Blend well. Add flour and tomatoes. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in hominy. Pour into 7 x 12 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese melts.

title: Easiest Souffle
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bring mixture to room temperature before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until is firmly set. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and cocoa. Add eggs. Blend in flour. Add coconut nuts and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes on a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool to warm. Spread marshmallow cream over cake. Cool. Frost cake.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Pie
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar; add spices. Stir in corn syrup. Add eggs one at a time stirring after each addition until blended. Stir in oats. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. During baking the oatmeal forms a chewy crust on top.

title: Cocktail Hot Dogs
instructions: Mix all together and bring to a boil. Add hot dogs. Simmer on stove 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans and put in kettle. Add 2 1/2 quarts of water and bring to boil. Boil uncovered for 2 minutes. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Add next 6 ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer covered for 2 hours or until beans are mushy. Remove bay leaves and ham bone. Remove any meat from bone and put back in soup. Season to taste and if necessary thicken with flour-water paste. Makes about 2 1/2-quarts. Can substitute with ham shanks.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Add vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk. Add coconut. Beat egg whites until they are stiff and fold into mixture. Pour into 4 round cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Saute mushrooms and onions in butter. Mix soup and soy sauce in bowl. Place all in baking dish. Cover with soy sauce. Place shredded cheese on top of mixture. Top with 6 to 8 slices of french bread. Then place 6 to 8 slices of swiss cheese on top of bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes covered uncover and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cream oil sugar and eggs. Add apples nuts dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
instructions: Melt butter and cocoa together. Add sugar Pet milk vanilla and eggs. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cooking spray. Stir well. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish coated with vegetable spray. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple sugar and salt; cook for 10 minutes. Let cool. Combine pineapple mixture and cream cheese; mix with whipped topping. Mix everything together and chill. Top with Mandarin oranges.

title: Irish Bread Pudding
instructions: Break eggs into large bowl beat lightly. Add milk and mix well. Blend in sugar vanilla and raisins. Mix bread cubes into egg mixture until bread is well soaked. Pour into greased baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 about 90 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Mccoy'S Very Famous Salsa
instructions: Finely dice onion chili peppers jalapeno peppers and garlic. Saut all ingredients except tomatoes. Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Cool in refrigerator uncovered. Serve with chips.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix thoroughly and pour in casserole. Top with chips. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken In A Sack
instructions: About 2 hours ahead heat oven to 375\u00b0. Rub paper bags inside and outside with oil. Place a chicken inside each bag after covering the chicken with sauce and pouring some inside the cavity of each chicken. Place the bags side by side in roasting pan or broiler pan. Close ends of paper bags with wooden clothespin. Cover roaster/broiler pan with lid or aluminum foil. Bake for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Snow Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar and flour. Stir and add 3 tablespoons melted shortening. Roll out on floured surface. Cut out; put in greased pan. Let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown on top.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Place in large rectangular casserole dish. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Walnut Cake
instructions: Put all in a large bowl and mix. Grease round pan and put in. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour; set oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes about 1/4-inch thick. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes peas pimento cheese and sauce in a buttered 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Squash And Potatoes
instructions: Melt margarine over medium heat. Saute squash and potatoes until tender.

title: Lemon Rick
instructions: Melt butter in medium saucepan. Add rice and mix; saute for about 3 minutes. Add parsley lemon juice and hot chicken stock mix and let simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Apricot And Walnut Brown Rice Stuffing
instructions: Cook onion and celery in margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp. Add rice apricots walnuts raisins parsley thyme salt sage pepper and chicken broth. Turn into 2-quart baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Stuffing may be baked inside poultry. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together except dried beef into a ball. Add dried beef around the ball.

title: Apple Pie Filling
instructions: In a large kettle put all ingredients. Mix together and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add lemon juice. Add apples and mix well. Keep warm while filling jar with apples and then juice from cooking kettle. Seal and process 20 minutes. Quart jars.

title: Tomato Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables. Add oil. Sprinkle with celery seed.

title: Crab And Shrimp Quiche
instructions: Mix crab and shrimp (rinsed and shredded) together and set aside. Cook shallots in oleo in small saucepan until soft 5 minutes. Beat eggs with whisk; add milk vermouth and hot sauce. Mix together. Add crab and shrimp and additional milk to make 3 cups. Pour into baked pie shell and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Combine first four ingredients. Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Ready to serve immediately.

title: Onion Soup
instructions: Saute the onions with the salt pork and season with pepper until the onions are golden but not dark. Put the onion mixture into a saucepan and add the stock and thyme. Cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes stirring on occasion. Grate the cheese and add it to the soup after about 15 minutes of simmering. Ten minutes before taking the soup off the heat add a glass of wine or beer. Serve with croutons. This is a quick soup that smells wonderful while it is simmering and is a way to use up ends of cheese and some wine or beer.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill before serving.

title: Pasta Bolognese
instructions: Brown ground beef in 1 tablespoon oil until meat is done. Transfer to a pan. Peel and chop onion; dice celery and carrot. Chop ham into small pieces. Saute in remaining oil with onion celery and carrot. Add to ground meat. Add water tomatoes garlic salt pepper and thyme; cover and cook about 20 minutes. Add chicken broth; cook a few minutes more. Cook pasta according to package directions; drain well. Serve immediately with sauce.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together pour into pie shells and bake for 45 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Zucchini A La Jennie
instructions: Saute onion and zucchini in pan over low heat. Cover bottom of pan with olive oil. Simmer until half cooked. Add tomatoes (skins removed) basil garlic and garlic salt. Cut potatoes in small chunks (simmer with zucchini and onions). Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until tender 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Ham And Pasta Salad
instructions: Chill unopened cans of oranges pineapple and ham in the freezer for 10 minutes.

title: Kentucky Cobbler
instructions: Put fruit in bottom of greased 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Combine ingredients. Dot fruit with butter and spread crust mixture over fruit. Pour 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup cold water over mixture. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Mushroom Quiche
instructions: Saute 2 cups chopped mushrooms and 1 cup saltine crackers (crushed). Remove from pan and press into 9-inch pie plate to form crust. Saute 1 cup scallions and place on crust. Grate 1 1/2 cups Swiss cheese and place on top of scallions. Blend together 3 eggs 1 cup cottage cheese basil thyme and cayenne pepper. Pour mixture into pie plate and sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven; wait 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: In small bowl blend cream cheese sour cream avocado dip lemon juice and hot pepper sauce. Spread mixture in large serving plate. Top with olives chilies onions lettuce tomato and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fruit Salad Prize Dressing
instructions: Combine sugar mustard and other ingredients (not celery seed) in blender. Add celery seed and stir well. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Stir all ingredients until blended in a 1 1/2-quart dish. Top with 1/2 cup butter. Microwave on High for 3 minutes; stir until smoothy. Blend in nuts. Pour into an 8-inch square pan lined with waxed paper. Chill; cut into squares.

title: Nell'S Jello Relish
instructions: Dissolve the first 4 ingredients. Let cool off a bit then add a little salt and pepper. Refrigerate until set. Stir a few times to distribute vegetables evenly. If you prefer a bit more vegetables and horseradish you may add to your own taste. Really good with most meats especially ham and corned beef.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Saute onion until wilted. Add garlic. Cut squash into 1-inch cubes. Put into soup pot. Add chicken broth water and nutmeg; boil until squash is tender. Remove from heat. Add curry and pepper; stir. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and peanut butter. Whirl mix in blender or food processor adding cream or evaporated milk. Reheat. Makes 2 1/2 quarts. Freezes well.

title: Pistachio Dessert
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Layer with raspberries blueberries and strawberries. Make the night before.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Butter pan. Mix corn and eggs. Pour 1/2 of mixture in pan. Sprinkle crackers and 1/2 of the cheese on top. Pour remaining corn on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Top with remaining cheese last 15 minutes.

title: Plantation Chicken
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Add flour. Stir and add milk soup pimento and chicken. Bring to simmer and put in buttered casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix all together in 1 bowl; pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Kahlua Sweetheart Cake
instructions: In small heatproof bowl blend cocoa coffee and water. Stir in 1/2 cup Kahlua; cool. In large bowl beat butter shortening sugar eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. In small bowl combine flour baking soda salt and baking powder. Add flour. Add flour mixture to butter mixture alternately with cocoa mixture beating well after each addition. Line bottom of two 9-inch round pans with parchment paper; lightly grease sides of pans. Divide batter evenly between prepared pans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Do not overbake. Let cool in pans on wire racks 5 minutes. Loosen edges; remove from pans. Peel off parchment paper; cool completely on wire racks. Brush bottom of each layer with 1 tablespoon of remaining Kahlua. Prepare Kahlua Fudge Frosting.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix together and pour over first ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat onion and pepper. Mix all ingredients in a casserole and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Arlene'S Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken. Let it cool. Chop it up. Put in large bowl; add all ingredients and mix well.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients using only 1/2 package stuffing mix. Place in buttered casserole and cover with remaining 1/2 package stuffing browned in butter. Bake 25 minutes at 375\u00b0. (Crackers may be substituted for stuffing for top. I like half and half.)

title: White Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. In a double boiler melt chocolate. Fold into cream cheese mixture with pecans. Spread into a greased 8-inch baking pan. Chill until ready to serve. Cut into squares. Yield about 48 pieces.

title: Orange-Apricot Dessert
instructions: Drain oranges; combine with apricot yogurt. Place in glass bowl and garnish with whipped topping and nuts. Serve immediately.

title: Farmer'S Fruit Cake
instructions: In large bowl combine shortening sugar eggs and vanilla and beat well. Sift flour baking soda cinnamon flour cloves nutmeg and ginger and add alternately with sour milk. Beat well. Fold in prunes and nuts and blend well.

title: Summer Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and stir into dressing. Divide and place half onto bottom of 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Combine squash onions soup chestnuts and pimientos and pour over dressing. Cover squash with remaining dressing and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Pineapple Flop Cake
instructions: Stir first five ingredients with wooden spoon not mixer. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Bar-B-Q
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer slowly for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Rinse and sort peas in a large pot. Cover with water and soak for 4 hours. Cook ham hocks for 2 hours. Drain peas; add ham hock onion bell pepper celery red pepper and black pepper to peas. Add water to cover. Cook until peas are tender.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: In large skillet saute onion and celery in butter. Stir in tuna soup mayonnaise milk mushrooms and pimento. Meanwhile cook noodles according to package directions and drain in colander.

title: Beet Jelly
instructions: Bring the first 3 items to a rolling boil then add the mixture of sugar and jello to it. Return to boil and boil hard for 6 minutes. Skim and pour into small jelly jars. The beet juice you get from your beets after youve washed them and put water on them to cook which you would normally throw away. Really good.

title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar with vanilla and add eggs. Sift flour soda salt and baking powder 3 times and add to mixture. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Space about 1/4 inch apart. Flatten with spoon for crispness. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool thoroughly and put in airtight container.

title: Pizza Bagels
instructions: Split bagels and place on cookie sheet. Cover hole of bagel with a slice of pepperoni. Add sauce and top with cheeses and additional pepperoni. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbling.

title: Fresh Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine corn cheese egg substitute and pimiento in large bowl. Mix well. Combine 1 cup milk and flour in small bowl. Stir smooth. Add remaining 1 cup milk sugar and next 3 ingredients. Stir well! Add flour to corn. Mix. Pour corn into 2-quart casserole coated with vegetable oil spray. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Add hot water to a depth of 1-inch. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle peppers over corn. Bake an additional 45 minutes.

title: Beef 'N Dumpling Bake
instructions: Place steak in 3-quart casserole. Cover with onion slices. Add bay leaf. Combine soups mushrooms Worcestershire sauce and flour. Pour over meat and onions. Cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove from oven. Set oven at 400\u00b0. Remove bay leaf. Place peas on top of casserole and pepper rings in center. Drop dumplings by rounded teaspoons around pepper rings. Cover. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Angi'S Best Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix with remaining ingredients. Let rise one hour. Roll 1/2 inch thin. Spread with butter brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up and cut 1 inch thick. (Easiest way is to wrap a piece of dental floss around the roll and pull on the ends of the floss.) Place in a buttered pan. Let rise until double in size. Bake 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. This makes a lot. One half recipe fits into a 9x12 pan and a pie plate.

title: Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes in water for 10 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large heavy pot saut bacon onions and celery over medium-high heat until celery is tender. Drain bacon grease and return bacon onions and celery to pot. Add milk water chicken base salt and pepper. Heat over medium-high heat until very hot. Do not boil.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops and onions. Slice potatoes and lay in bottom of oven-safe casserole dish or Pyrex. Smear 1 can cream of celery soup over the potatoes (not diluted). Lay browned pork chops and onions on top. Smear 1 can cream of mushroom soup (not diluted) on top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Cut a loaf of stale bread into 1/4-inch cubes. Season with melted butter thyme basil oregano salt and pepper. Bake until crisp. In a large bowl grind anchovies to a paste-like consistency. Stir in all remaining ingredients except romaine lettuce. Tear romaine lettuce into large pieces and place in a large bowl. Pour salad dressing over lettuce and toss salad. Serve immediately.

title: Crunchy Topped Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Whisk eggs in a 2-quart microwave-proof bowl or casserole. Blend in next 5 ingredients. Microwave on High uncovered 4 minutes or until hot and thickened stirring once halfway through. Pour into microwave-proof 8-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with dry cake mix. Melt margarine in microwave. Drizzle evenly over cake mix. Microwave uncovered on High 8 minutes or until top is set rotating dish twice. Place dish under conventional oven broiler for 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Refrigerate. Cut in squares. Serves 12 213 calories per serving 10.3 grams fat and 1 mg. cholesterol.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger in skillet; drain excess oil. Cook macaroni and cheese; mix together with hamburger. Layer with hamburger Pizza Quick and macaroni and cheese ending with Mozzarella cheese on top.

title: Baked Seafood Casserole(Joshua Thomas Chapel Cookbook)
instructions: Combine crabmeat shrimp mayonnaise green pepper onion celery salt and Worcestershire sauce. Pour into a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole. Top with crushed potato chips. Sprinkle with paprika.

title: Maple-Walnut Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 370\u00b0. Melt chocolate and butter over low heat. Put in a large bowl; cool slightly. Combine flour and soda. Stir sugar and eggs into chocolate mixture until well combined. Stir in flour mixture milk and extract until blended. Stir in walnuts.

title: Homemade Freezer Slaw
instructions: Cover cabbage peppers carrot and salt with water. Let stand overnight. Drain and rinse well. Boil vinegar sugar and water together. Cool then pour over slaw. Put in container and freeze.

title: Mini Blinis
instructions: Blend the egg yolk 1/4 cup sugar and cream cheese. Roll bread slices flat. Spread mixture and roll up. Cut in half. Dip in the melted butter. Roll in mixture of 1 1/2 cups sugar and cinnamon. Freeze. Bake seam side down at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hash Brown Bake
instructions: In a bowl mix hash browns sour cream soup and cheese. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Mix corn flakes butter and garlic salt together. Spread on top of hash brown mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Blueberry Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and cream cheese. Spread 1/2 in each pie shell. Cover with sliced bananas. Sprinkle with a little lemon juice. Cover with 1/2 can of pie filling per pie. Chill overnight. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Put cooked and cut up chicken in bottom of a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Mix the soups with 2 cups of chicken broth and pour over chicken. Mix herb stuffing with 1 cup of broth and pour on top of soups. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Green Tomato Chow Chow Relish
instructions: Bring to a boil and boil gently for 30 minutes or longer if too juicy. Remove and add 2 tablespoons turmeric. Pack in hot jar. This makes 10 or 12 pints.

title: Yellow Squash Relish
instructions: Wash peel and chop squash. Add onion peppers and pimientos. Sprinkle with salt. Cover and let stand overnight. Rinse (real good) and drain. Bring sugar vinegar mustard seed and turmeric to boil. Add squash mixture. Reduce heat and simmer until heated through. Pour into clean hot jars 1/2-inch headroom. Seal.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Mix all together. Put into buttered baking dish. Bake until firm at 300\u00b0.

title: Quick Cheese Danish
instructions: Mix the cream cheese sugar vanilla and lemon juice together; set aside. Unfold 1 package of crescent roll dough into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan pinching together to form one sheet of dough. Then spread cream cheese mixture on top. Unfold second package of crescent rolls on top pinching together to form one sheet of dough. Brush with egg white. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Mayonnaise Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring just until all dry ingredients are moist. Spoon batter into greased muffin pans filling 3/4 full. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 1/2 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Combine margarine water peanut butter and oil. Bring to a boil. Turn off heat. Cool. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well until blended and pour onto a greased and floured 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. (It will be a very thin batter.) Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. (If using a 9 x 13 greased and floured pan bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.) Cool and frost.

title: Spicy Dry Black-Eyed Peas
instructions: Cook dry peas according to package directions until 2/3 done. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until peas are tender.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower by package directions. Drain. Mix all ingredients except cheese. Put in a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Grate cheese and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Wafer Cake
instructions: Grind vanilla wafers. Cream butter and sugar. Add 6 eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add milk and vanilla wafer crumbs. Fold in nuts and coconut. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag. Add biscuits and shake until coated. Place coated biscuits in greased Bundt pan. Layer nuts with biscuits. Melt margarine in saucepan. Add brown sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Pour over biscuits. Sprinkle with more nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cook 30 minutes then invert on a plate.

title: Pineapple Delight Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve both pkgs. of gelatin in water. Add remaining ingredients and stir thoroughly. Pour into mold and chill in refrigerator until firm. The horseradish is very important but does not predominate the taste. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Roquefort Cheese Ball
instructions: In a small mixing bowl at low speed beat cheeses for 2 minutes. Add green onions optional wine or vermouth and mustard. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes or until fluffy. Cover and chill for 2 hours. With wet hands shape into a 3-inch ball and roll in nuts. Decorate with parsley and serve with crackers.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sprinkle the fruit with lemon juice aside. Mix remaining ingredients adding flour last. Fold in fruit just before baking. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full and bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lemon Sheet Pie
instructions: Mix like pie crust. Pat down dough on cookie sheet with a little lip. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool.

title: Spinach Cheese Puffs(12 Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine all ingredients except pastry. Stir with a fork until well blended; set aside. Cut pastry into twenty-five 2 x 2-inch squares. Place spinach mixture onto the center of each square. Transfer squares to an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes (or longer until pastry is golden brown). Remove from oven and serve.

title: Peach Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly over melted butter or margarine. Drain peaches (reserve juice) and arrange with cherries over the sugar mixture. Mix cake as directed on box using reserved peach juice for all or part of liquid. Pour mixed cake batter over sugar butter and fruit; mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done (45 to 50 minutes). Let stand 5 minutes turn upside down onto large platter. Good warm with whipped cream.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Cook chicken and save broth. Melt butter in a Dutch oven or large stew pot. Add onions celery and carrot. Cook until onions are golden. Add broth rice and seasonings. Cover and cook on low heat until rice is done about 20 minutes. Add chopped chicken and simmer about 15 minutes more. Delicious!

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in a well-greased cast-iron frypan.

title: Rainbow Cake
instructions: Place cake layers top side up in 2 clean layer pans. Prick each cake\twith serving fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve Jell-O in\tboiling water. Add cold water and pour carefully over cakes. Chill 3 to 4 hours.

title: Hot Sausage In Sour Cream
instructions: Fry the sausage until well done (cut brown and serve sausages in half). Pour off grease. Place in chafing dish. Pour chutney wine and sour cream in skillet. Simmer a few minutes and pour over sausage. Serve hot. Serves 12.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oil then add eggs. Mix dry ingredients. Then add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla floured nuts and diced apples. Mix well. Pour into greased pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Four Layer Dessert
instructions: Combine ingredients and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Combine peanut butter butter and sugar slowly until stiff enough to roll in balls. Form into balls on wax paper. Chill 1 hour.

title: White Grape Salad
instructions: Wash grapes and cut in half. Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Mix about 1 oz. pineapple juice with cream cheese until you have the consistency of thick soup. Add all ingredients; coat well with cream cheese mixture. Chill and serve.

title: Hot Wassail
instructions: Mix all ingredients; sweeten to taste. Heat and serve. Can be refrigerated and reheated.

title: Plaki - Fish-Onions-Raisins
instructions: Combine chopped onions tomato sauce and oil in pan. Season with salt and pepper; cook about 20 minutes. Mixture should be juicy. Add raisins and parsley and mix. Pour into baking dish.

title: Grandma'S Polish Bread(Babka)
instructions: Combine yeast and water; set aside. Mix all ingredients adding yeast mixture last. Knead. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Beat down mixture; let rise 1 more hour. Place in loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients. Top with grated cheese and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan the pecans and coconut. Mix German chocolate cake as box directs. Pour over coconut and pecans in pan then mix powdered sugar cream cheese margarine and vanilla. Spoon over cake mixture. Do not try to smooth out. Leave as dropped from spoon and bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Quiche
instructions: For best results heat pie crust in a 400\u00b0 oven for about 5 minutes. Saute onion in oleo in saucepan for about 5 minutes. Pour in pie crust. Add grated cheese then eggs. Season eggs with dash of salt pepper and seasoned salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with bacon ham sausage or Spam. Good wintertime evening meal.

title: Egg Coffee
instructions: Heat 6 cups water to boiling. Beat egg and 2 tablespoons water together. Stir 2 tablespoons egg mixture into 3/4 cup ground coffee. Add enough cold water to completely moisten grounds; pour into boiling water. Heat to rolling boil. Remove from heat; add dash of cold water. Makes 6 to 8 cups.

title: Salmon Roll
instructions: Mash salmon with fork. Add next 3 ingredients. Shape into roll (log) with hands. Roll into cream cheese then pecans and chill.

title: Curt'S 14 Day Pickles
instructions: Cut up thick slices of cucumbers enough to fill a gallon glass jar. Add 1 cup salt and 1 gallon of water and let soak for 7 days. Drain 7th day. Wash well and drain. Next soak 1 tablespoon alum and 1 gallon warm water overnight. Next morning drain and let soak in clear cold water for 2 hours. Drain. Heat 1 quart vinegar 2 quarts sugar 1 tablespoon pickling spice and 1 tablespoon turmeric. Let come to a boil pour over pickles. Do this each day for 7 days. Seal in jars on 7th day. Jars should be hot.

title: Sam Lee'S Famous Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon crisp and keep to the side. Use bacon oil to cook carrots onion and celery. Set aside. Cook potatoes. Set aside. Melt 1 cube butter. Add flour and brown. Add clam juice slowly. Add half and half plus whipped cream. Add clams including juice from can. Add corn carrots celery potatoes and onion. Bring to a boil and thicken. Use cornstarch base. Add bacon and butter. Simmer. Do not let burn. Enjoy! (Do not overcook potatoes.)

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening and butter. Mix until crumbly. Add water.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Sift flour and salt together. Add to butter mixture 1/2 cup at a time beating well after each addition. Spread dough into a 9-inch square pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes or until top is golden brown. Yield 3 dozen cookies. Carbohydrate 7 g protein .5 g fat 5 g calories 75. One cookie = 1/2 bread exchange 1 fat exchange.

title: Hummus Dip
instructions: Blend all together in blender until dip consistency. Serve with pita bread or crackers. Garnish with mint.

title: Seafood Gumbogroves, Texas
instructions: Make roux in thick cast iron pot by stirring flour and oil on very low heat until dark brown. Transfer to big gumbo pot. Add water tomatoes cook about 45 minutes and add celery bell pepper okra onion and garlic. Add shrimp oysters and crab meat season to taste with salt pepper and tabasco. Cook slowly for 1 hour. If too thick add more water. Serve in bowl over hot rice.

title: Tortellini And Vegetables
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions. Parcook vegetables and drain. Melt butter in a pan. Add tortellini and vegetables. Simmer for about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and sprinkle bread crumbs over mixture just enough to hold together. Makes a great side dish.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Surprise
instructions: Mix stuffing according to directions. Mix together sour cream and pineapple. In 9 x 13-inch pan put 1/2 the stuffing in bottom of pan. Add diced meat pour over pineapple mixture then crumble on the rest of the stuffing. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Add mushroom soup cream cheese salt pepper and paprika. Stir until well blended then cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve over hot noodles.

title: Banana Slush Punch
instructions: Blend and freeze first 6 ingredients solid. Remove from freezer 1 hour before using. Chop up and pour 7-Up over. Serve. Yield 2 punch bowls full.

title: Pumpkin Blossom Cookies
instructions: Beat milk and pumpkin until smooth. Add biscuit mix and vanilla. Mix well. Drop 1 1/2 inches apart on baking sheet. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned at 375\u00b0. Press candy in cookie immediately after baking or about 1 minute before done.

title: Lemon Bread
instructions: Blend Crisco sugar and salt and beat well. Add eggs. Add rest of ingredients and beat well. Put in a 9 x 5 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan (well-greased). Bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan and pour over hot bread 1/2 cup sugar and juice of one lemon. Freezes well.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in electric skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Add soup and water mixing until blended. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Add rice and cook until rice is tender. Its ready to eat.

title: Special Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream. Add vanilla coconut and pecans. Pour into 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Snowbound Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet (or electric frying pan) saute onion and celery until soft. Stir in tomato sauce salt curry powder pepper and green pepper. Add dashes of hot sauce to taste (optional).

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Cook pie crust. Combine 1 1/3 cups sugar cornstarch and salt in medium-size saucepan. Gradually stir in water. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and is thick. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Beat egg yolks slightly in small bowl. Slowly blend in 1/2 cup of hot mixture. Slowly stir back into rest of hot mixture. Cook stirring constantly over low heat 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in margarine lemon rind and lemon juice. Pour into cooled pie shell. Cover with wrap and refrigerate until cold (3 hours). Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy white. Sprinkle in 1/2 cup sugar beating until stands in peaks. Spread on pie. Cook at 425\u00b0 for 3 to 5 minutes until brown.

title: Maurine Moon'S Mexican Rice
instructions: Cook rice about half done. Chop 1/2 cup bacon or ham. Add to heavy skillet and cook slowly. Add 2 chopped onions and chopped bell pepper; simmer with bacon. Do not scorch. Add chili powder to taste. Add tomatoes and tomato paste. Add half cooked rice chili powder and salt to taste. Cook slowly stirring to keep from sticking. Garnish with parsley.

title: Grapefruit Chiffon Cake
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well in the middle. Add in order egg yolks oil peel and juice. Beat briefly until smooth.

title: Japanese Pie
instructions: Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Heat chicken pieces water salt garlic and bay leaf to boiling in Dutch oven; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until chicken is done about 45 minutes. Remove chicken from broth; strain broth. Refrigerate chicken and broth. When cool remove chicken from bones (skin can be removed if desired). Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Skim excess fat from broth and place broth and chicken in Dutch oven. Stir in celery onion tomatoes (with liquid) frozen okra corn (with liquid) rice and pepper sauce. Break up tomatoes with fork. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until okra and rice are tender 20 to 30 minutes. Garnish with snipped parsley. Makes 8 servings.

title: Gulf Coast Canned Mullet
instructions: Make a brine of water and salt. Soak fillets 1 hour; drain. Pack mullet to lower neckband of quart jars. Add no water but pack fish firmly in jar. Add Zatarains Creole seasoning to each quart. Process 100 minutes at 10 pound pressure.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Crumble over pie filling and nuts. Top with sugar coated flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not overmix or overbake.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Cook pudding as directed on box. Using a large mixing bowl mix yellow cake mix cooked pudding and 1/2 cup oil. After ingredients are thoroughly mixed pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread the butterscotch tidbits and nuts on top of the uncooked cake mix. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 preheated oven. Very delicious.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine sugar and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Form into small cookies. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Tropical Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and sugar. Stir in Cool Whip and drained pineapple. Pour into crust and refrigerate.

title: Apple Tray
instructions: Soften cream cheese and add other ingredients. Mix until smooth. Serve at room temperature. Garnish with a cinnamon stick. Slice green and red apples of equal size and shape into eighths. Core each slice. Dip in pineapple juice and part water (or other citrus juice) to prevent discoloring of apples. Piece apples back together as halves alternating green and red. Place \striped\ apple halves onto tray of lettuce leaves circling apple dip. May add grapes and/or pears to the tray.

title: Mushroom Soup
instructions: Soak mushrooms for 3 to 4 hours and bring to a boil in a small amount of water. Add the broth and simmer covered for half an hour. Melt the butter; blend in the flour salt and pepper. Add the stock gradually while stirring. Stir in sour cream just before serving. Reheat but dont let the soup boil. Add more seasoning to taste.

title: Summer Delite
instructions: Place lawn chair or hammock in or out of direct sunlight your choice. Open beer and drink along with your choice of chips pretzels or popcorn.

title: Pear-Pecan Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pears and reserve 1 cup of liquid. Bring juice to a boil on high heat. Remove from heat and add lemon-flavored gelatin. Chill until partially set. Place pears and cream cheese in blender container and blend until creamy consistency. Stir in gelatin mixture. Add pecans. If using whipping cream whip and fold in gelatin mixture. If using Cool Whip fold into gelatin mixture. Pour into mold. Chill. Serves 12.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Toss with french dressing 1 1/2 pounds ground beef browned with 1/2 chopped onion. Add 1 package of taco seasoning - cook till done and drain. You can put salsa or taco sauce on it if desired. Mix all together just before serving.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Scald milk in double boiler. Add mixed dry ingredients and chocolate cut in small pieces. Stir until mixture thickens. Stir a small amount of mixture into slightly beaten egg yolks and return mixture to double boiler. Stir until coagulates (2 or 3 minutes) and remove from fire. Add butter and vanilla; beat thoroughly with rotary beater or electric mixer. Cool. Place in a baked shell. Cover with meringue made with egg whites. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until meringue is golden brown.

title: Easy Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Pour pie filling into prepared dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir to form soft dough. Drop dough by spoonfuls into pie filling to form dumplings. Cover with lid or foil and bake 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake additional 15 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Turkey Breast
instructions: Place all in crock-pot on low. Cook 8 hours. You might have to thicken soup for gravy.

title: Marinade For Lamb
instructions: Make slits in lamb; rub in marinade.

title: 4 Layer Cake
instructions: Bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Set aside to cool.

title: Fresh Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries in food grinder or food processor; stir in sugar to blend. Set aside. Dissolve gelatin dessert in water; cool until mixture begins to thicken. Add to cranberry mixture. Add oranges nuts and pineapple. Stir well; pour into lightly oiled 8-cup mold. Chill overnight. Unmold.

title: Grandma'S Lazy Daisy Cake Topping
instructions: Heat oleo and sugar until melted. Add milk and blend well. Add nuts and mix well. Spread over cool cake. Slide under broiler about 3 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Italian Meat Loaf
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Mix all ingredients well. Form into loaf. Bake 30 minutes in 375\u00b0 oven. Pour catsup over loaf and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese and oregano. Bake 20 minutes longer.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Party Dip
instructions: Combine light sour cream and party dip mix in medium bowl. Stir in artichoke spinach and pimientos. Cut slice off top of round loaf of bread. Hollow out center of bread leaving 1-inch shell. Reserve bread pieces for dipping. Spoon dip into bread shell. Serve warm or cold. To serve warm bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cover loaf with foil if browning too quickly. Makes 12 servings.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion until brown. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt. Mix meat mixture with the pizza sauce oregano and 1/2 of cheese. Pour in roaster pan; sprinkle with rest of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts (about 30 minutes).

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Beat eggs and flour until smooth. Add all of ingredients to egg mixture and stir. Pour into greased 10-inch square pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let set 10 minutes before serving.

title: Clam And Corn Chowder
instructions: In a 4-quart saucepan bring chicken broth to a boil. Meanwhile heat oil in a skillet and cook onion garlic and celery for 10 minutes or until slightly soft. Stir in dill and thyme. Add cooked vegetables to broth along with potatoes. Cover pot and simmer about 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in creamed corn and simmer 5 minutes then add milk and undrained clams. Simmer until heated through (do not boil) about 5 minutes. Adjust salt if necessary. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons chopped parsley if you like. Makes about 10 cups (135 calories each if made with low-fat milk).

title: Skinny Meat Loaf
