instructions: Place bread and onion in food processor and whirl. Add tomatoes marjoram paprika parsley and pepper; whirl. Combine beef turkey egg substitute and bread mixture in bowl. Pack into six cup ring mold. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Unmold onto platter.

title: Five Flavor Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs which have been beaten until lemon colored. Combine flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Stir in flavoring. Spoon in 10-inch bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan for about 10 minutes. Put icing over cake.

title: Sausage And Egg Casserole
instructions: Lightly grease baking dish. Place bread on bottom of dish. Spread sausage on bread and sprinkle cheese on sausage. Mix eggs and milk. Pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove cover and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: English Apple Pie
instructions: Fill round pie dish with a layer of chopped apples. Mix flour sugar cinnamon cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together and form into a loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients together add salt to taste. Pour into shallow baking dish dot with butter sprinkle with pepper. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until inserted knife comes out clean about 1 hour.

title: Lemon Butter
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar; mix well. Add rest of ingredients. Cook in a double boiler until thick. Serve on toast muffins or Maryland biscuits.

title: Heroes
instructions: Slice rolls in half. Layer lettuce tomato onions and sprinkle with dressing. Top with meats and cheeses and sprinkle with a small dash of dressing. Any other cold cut or cheese of your desire may be used instead. Put top on and cut diagonally.

title: Polish Cabbage
instructions: Fry the bacon until crisp. Remove bacon into a stewing pot. Saute the cabbage in the bacon grease and add to stew pot. Add the tomatoes to this and boil to finish cooking the cabbage. Thicken the mixture with flour that has been dissolved in water. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crab Salad(A Light, Elegant Luncheon Salad)
instructions: Mix all ingredients and chill at least 1 hour. Tastes great the next day too. Serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Tomato Rice Soup
instructions: Saute onions in small frying pan. Dice and boil potatoes. Leave potatoes in water. Add rice and alphabets then tomato soup. Ready to serve when potatoes and pasta are done.

title: Stuffed Yellow Squash
instructions: Simmer whole squash 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Slice in half; scoop out center leaving firm shell. Combine pulp and remaining ingredients except butter. Fill squash shells and place in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Dot with butter. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain grease. Mix in soup until hot. Add chopped onion and put in casserole dish. Put Tater Tots on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top for approximately 5 minutes or until completely melted. Let set 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mexicale Casserole
instructions: Prepare cornmeal mix to package directions. Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Brown ground beef in large skillet and drain. Stir in taco seasoning chopped tomatoes and corn. Bring to a boil stirring occasionally. Pour in baking dish then pour prepared cornmeal mix over beef mixture. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni and drain. Put milk in saucepan. Add cheese pieces and butter. Stir until cheese is melted. Do not boil. Put macaroni into baking dish (add sliced hot dogs). Add cheese liquid. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Line cookie sheet with crescent roll dough spread out like pizza. Bake until golden brown (375\u00b0 for approximately 10 minutes). Mix dressing mix mayo and cream cheese. Spread on cooled crust. Sprinkle desired shredded vegetables and cheese on cream cheese mixture. Press them down into mixture. Refrigerate until set or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Cookie Pop
instructions: You will also need 10 popsicle sticks.

title: Campfire Corn On The Cob
instructions: Soak ears of corn still in husk for at least one hour in water. While the corn is soaking build fire over loosened dirt let coals burn down. Pull husk back and remove silk; put salt pepper and butter on corn. Pull husk back onto corn. Wrap in foil. Pull coals aside and dig into loosened dirt to make hole 6 to 8 inches deep. Place corn in hole pull coals back over buried corn. Build another small fire to keep coals hot. Roast 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Barbeque Sauce For Spareribs(Yield: Serving For 4 People.)
instructions: 1. Before starting the sauce place the ribs in a pot with water and pour in one beer. Bring to a boil and then simmer for one hour. This will make the meat tender.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Drop small amounts on ungreased cookie sheet to bake.

title: Freezer Punch
instructions: Mix all according to package directions. Put in freezer being sure to stir every hour. Keep in freezer until slushy. When ready to serve add 1 bottle of chilled 7-Up.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together the flour brown sugar and cinnamon. With a pastry blender cut in butter until very fine. Pare core and thinly slice apples. Arrange in an 8-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with flour mixture. Bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven until apples are tender and topping is browned 30 minutes. Serve hot topped with vanilla ice cream. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: *May use 1 to 2 blocks firm tofu and omit eggs and cottage cheese.

title: Pear Preserves
instructions: Slice pears pour sugar over and soak overnight. Cook until bubbly and thick. Add a slice of lemon if desired.

title: Pollo Borracho
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons oil into Dutch oven or large casserole. Over low heat add onion rings parsley sesame seed whole black peppers cinnamon cloves and bay leaf. Mix. Add chicken. Pour over chicken remaining oil vinegar and sherry. Add olives chiles and salt to taste. Cover and simmer 1 hour turning a few times. May be baked at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with steamed white rice. Serves 6.

title: Excellent Divinity
instructions: Using a heavy saucepan dissolve sugars water and syrup over medium heat. Boil until candy thermometer reaches 236\u00b0. Pour one half of syrup slowly beating all the while over the stiffly beaten egg whites. Cook remainder of syrup to 252\u00b0 then beat into whites. Add nuts and vanilla extract and continue beating until gloss of candy lessens and will stand up in peaks. When firm drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper. Mixture sets up quickly. This is really delicious and makes lots of candy.

title: Sausage
instructions: Bring 3 cups water to a boil. Blend remaining ingredients except oats until smooth. Add to the 3 cups of boiling water then add oats. Cook for 1 minute stirring. Shape into patties or links. Bake on a nonstick cookie sheet at 350\u00b0. Cook patties 30 minutes on one side 20 minutes on the other. Links or meatballs cook for 35 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add oil sugar vanilla and grated zucchini to the eggs. (If zucchini is too large remove the seeds before grating.) Mix lightly but not well. Add dry ingredients.

title: Hot Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes. Cook onion and bacon together. Add with drippings to cooked diced potatoes. Add enough mayonnaise to moisten then Worcestershire and celery seed. Add olives and cheese. Add dash of sugar salt and pepper.

title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and green pepper in melted butter. Brown ground beef with\tonion and green pepper; let pan juices cook down or drain. Add Worcestershire sauce\tand cook about 2 minutes longer.

title: Russian Mints
instructions: Cream butter and powdered sugar together. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flavoring and chocolate. Spoon half of wafers into bottom of cupcake liners. Spoon the chocolate mixture on top and cover with the rest of wafer crumbs. Top with dab of whipped cream and cherry. Place in freezer. Makes about 20.

title: Snickerdoodles Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl cream 3/4 cup of sugar and margarine. Beat in egg and vanilla. In a small bowl stir together the flour salt baking soda and cream of tartar. Stir this mixture into margarine mixture. In a small bowl mix the 2 tablespoons of sugar and 2 teaspoons of cinnamon. Shape dough in 1-inch balls and roll in the cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Cereal Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream brown sugar sugar and butter. Blend flour baking powder soda salt eggs and vanilla into creamed mixture. Stir in cereal rolled oats coconut and peanuts. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 9 to 12 minutes. Cool 1 minute before removing.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Spray large pizza pan or large cookie sheet with vegetable spray. Pat out sugar cookie roll to desired thickness. Bake per package directions. Let cool.

title: Life Saver Frosting
instructions: Cook flour and milk until thick and cool (do this while cake is baking). Cream sugar shortening and butter well and add to cooled flour mixture; add vanilla and salt. Beat until fluffy and about the consistency of whipped cream. This is a life saver when you need icing but are out of confectioners sugar.

title: Cheesy Oven Fries
instructions: Scrub potatoes; cut each into 8 wedges. Combine cheese and the next 3 ingredients stirring well. Dip potato wedge in melted margarine. Arrange in single layer in lightly buttered pan. Sprinkle cheese mixture over. Bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and browned.

title: Vern'S Ice Cream
instructions: Mix ingredients and fill 4 quart freezer to fill line.

title: Clothes Line Candy
instructions: Boil sugar and milk until it forms a soft ball in water. Add dates and boil 3 minutes. Take off stove and add remaining ingredients. Beat until almost hard. Pour into a wet cloth. Hang on clothes line to get cold and hard. Cut into slices.

title: Cornbread Or Cornpone
instructions: Combine egg sugar salt and butter. Add milk; mix well. Add all dry ingredients. May be a little stiff. Bake at 375\u00b0 (usually takes 25 or 30 minutes).

title: Rice Krispies Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix the margarine powdered sugar peanut butter and cereal together. Form into small balls. Melt chocolate chips chocolate bar and paraffin in double boiler. Dip balls into chocolate with toothpicks. Cool on wax paper.

title: Oriental Skillet Supper
instructions: In heavy skillet quickly cook green pepper and celery in oil until crisp-tender. Remove; set aside. Add meat to skillet; cook. Combine water soy sauce cornstarch sugar and salt. Add to skillet. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Add celery pepper and tomato. Heat through. Toss rice with ginger. Serve over ginger rice. Makes 2 servings.

title: Milk Punch
instructions: Mix together milk orange juice and sugar. Return liquid to the cartons or pour into ice cube trays and freeze until solid. When you are ready to make punch use 1/2 gallon block at a time. Place frozen mixture into punch bowl break into smaller chunks and pour 2 liters of ginger ale over the frozen chunks. Makes a large punch bowl full.

title: Saltine Toffee Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line cookie sheet with crackers in a single layer. In a saucepan combine sugar and butter; boil for 3 minutes. Immediately pour over saltines and spread to cover crackers completely. Bake 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Seven Up Cake
instructions: You will need a tubular baking pan.

title: Mom'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together well cheeses and bacon bits. Chill on waxed paper in bowl. When firm roll in nuts; place cherry in middle and chill until served.

title: Cranberry Orange Bread
instructions: Combine flour baking powder soda salt and sugar in large mixing bowl; set aside. Mix beaten egg with orange juice rind margarine and hot water. Fold flour mixture until blended. Do not beat. Gently fold in cranberries and walnuts. Spoon into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or smaller pans of choice. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 60 minutes; test in center with wooden pick. Cool on rack for 15 minutes before removing from pan. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Evelyn Wagner'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly with a fork. Mix sugar and flour together. Add to beaten eggs. Stir in syrup vanilla salt and butter. Cover unbaked shell with pecans. Pour mixture over pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes; turn heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 to 35 minutes more. Filling will be slightly less set in the center than the edges. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip if desired.

title: Smokies Or Wieners
instructions: Simmer ketchup and grape jelly until melted. Add wieners or Smokies and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Cocoa Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix shortening sugar eggs and vanilla until well blended. Blend dry ingredients in a separate bowl. Mix into shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Spread in well-greased pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Bake about 30 minutes. Cool; cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 16 brownies.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Mix and spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips and 1 stick oleo. Spread over mixture. Let cool and cut.

title: Cranberry Coffee Cake
instructions: Grease 9-inch tube pan or 10-inch Bundt pan. Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sift flour salt and soda together. Cream shortening sugar and peanut butter. Add vanilla and mix well. Add beaten egg. Mix and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mixture. Roll in ball between palms of hands. Press with fork.

title: Steak Teriyaki
instructions: Combine in a jar and shake until well blended. Pour over steak and marinate several hours turning once or twice. Broil basting 2 or 3 times. Can also be used as roast (London broil) and on the grill.

title: English Green Beans
instructions: Cook green beans with seasonings for approximately 2 hours until very tender. Cook them down so there isnt a lot of water left in them. Add onion and tomatoes and cook for another hour or so. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Picadillo
instructions: Place venison beef or pork in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook until meat is brown. Drain any excess fat. Stir in flour tomato paste salt pepper garlic and ground cumin to coat meat evenly. Add water and vegetables. Bring liquid to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve over dirty rice. Makes 6 servings.

title: Quick Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Shape dough in 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately top cookie with candy kiss pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around edge. Remove from cookie sheets. Cool completely. Yields 3 dozen.

title: Deviled Ham Dip
instructions: Note Can add more sour cream if thinner dip is desired.

title: Honey Hot Fudge Topping
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Stir in cocoa and cornstarch. Add honey water and a shake of salt. Boil until it is thick; remove from heat. Stir in mini marshmallows. Serve over ice cream or pound cake.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix in order given. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Mint Chip Ice Cream
instructions: In a saucepan combine eggs milk sugar and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture reaches 160\u00b0 and coats a metal spoon. Cool to room temperature. Stir in cream vanilla peppermint extract and food coloring. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Stir in chocolate chips. Fill ice cream freezer cylinder 2/3 full; freeze according to manufacturers directions. Refrigerate remaining mixture until ready to freeze. Yield 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Cajun Meat Loaf
instructions: Melt margarine in pan. Add first 6 ingredients. Stir about 5 or 6 minutes. Add catsup and milk. Mix well and cool.

title: 3-Bean Salad
instructions: Rinse kidney beans drain and combine all ingredients. Refrigerate.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Pour cherry pie filling water and sugar into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Mix well. Sprinkle 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix (dry) over the cherry pie mixture. Slice up margarine and place on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Quick Fruit Dish
instructions: Drain the fruit cocktail. Add the pineapple (plus juice). Add the pudding. Mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Easy Apple Cobbler
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients; mix gently. Spoon into a lightly greased 9-inch square baking pan. Dot with 1 tablespoon butter; set aside.

title: Banana Split Brownie Pizza
instructions: Prepare brownie mix by directions. Spread 1/2 of mix evenly on a 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet. Place remaining half on an additional 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 10 to 15 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. (Be careful not to burn.) Allow to cool to room temperature.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Wash and slice okra. Pat dry with paper towels. Combine eggs and buttermilk. Add okra. Let stand 10 minutes. Combine flour and meal. Drain okra small portions at a time using slotted spoon. Dredge okra small portions at a time in flour mixture. Put 2 to 3 inches of oil in a Dutch oven or heavy saucepan. Heat and fry okra to golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to box. Mix nuts and coconut. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put nuts and coconut in bottom of pan. Pour cake mixture over this. Mix the cream cheese powdered sugar and oleo. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and turn out. This will look like it isnt done but will set up after it cools.

title: Dirty Dessert
instructions: Make pudding then break up the cookies in a bowl. Spread part of the cookies on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan then one layer of pudding on top of the cookies then 1 layer of Cool Whip. Continue making layers until all ingredients are used up. Refrigerate.

title: Fruit Cocktail Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl and blend well. Pour into crusts and chill for several hours.

title: Apple Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Pour apple pie filling into unbaked pie shell. Combine cornstarch spices salt and sugar. Add pumpkin molasses and melted butter. Blend well. Combine milk and eggs. Stir in; pour over apple filling. (To avoid spills add last of milk and egg mixture with pie on oven rack--pan will be brimful). Bake at 425\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until knife inserted in pie comes out clean. Chill then garnish with whipped cream.

title: You Name It Casserole
instructions: Mix all spices with hamburger. Layer hamburger potatoes corn and onions. Add tomato soup and water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0; grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. In medium bowl beat egg melted shortening orange juice and water. Stir in flour sugar salt baking powder and baking soda. Stir until ingredients are moistened. Stir in cranberries and walnuts. Pour into prepared loaf pan. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean. Store in refrigerator overnight before slicing or freeze. Makes one loaf.

title: Pink Lemonade Ice Milk Cake
instructions: Slice cake horizontally into 3 layers; set aside. Combine softened ice milk pink lemonade and chopped strawberries in a large bowl; stir well. Place bottom layer of cake in an 8-inch tube pan. Spread half of ice milk mixture over cake and top with middle layer of cake. Freeze 30 minutes. Spread remaining ice milk mixture over middle layer of cake and top with remaining cake layer. Cover and freeze 4 hours or until firm. Slice into wedges. Yield 16 servings (129 calories per serving).

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Butter a casserole well. Place sliced potatoes on bottom. Cover with the orange slices. Add chops seasoned with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Cook in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours or until chops are done.

title: Homemade Hominy
instructions: Cover with water and boil until the skin slips from the grain. Wash well in several waters after removing the skins. Cook the grains until tender.

title: Herbed Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat margarine in medium-size nonaluminum saucepan over medium heat until melted and bubbly. Add 2 tablespoons marjoram and garlic; saute 1 minute or until garlic is tender but not browned. Add tomatoes. Bring to a boil; cook 15 minutes or until mixture is reduced to 3 cups.

title: Ground Beef Dish
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. In large skillet combine ground beef onion celery and mushrooms and cook until beef is browned and celery is tender; drain. In medium bowl blend soup milk sour cream and cheese. Combine noodles ground beef mixture and soup mixture; mix well. Pour into 3-quart casserole. Cover. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven just until hot about 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Serves about 6.

title: Berry Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken in 2-quart baking dish. Mix together sauce dressing and soup mix. Spoon over chicken. Cover with wax paper. Cook in the microwave on High 20 to 25 minutes. Turn 1/4 turn after 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve chilled.

title: Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti as directed on box. Brown ground beef in skillet. Add spaghetti sauce simmer at least 15 minutes. Put spaghetti into glass baking dish add beef and sauce and mix well reserving enough sauce and beef to spread on top. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Bread
instructions: Thaw and let rise 1 loaf of frozen bread dough (follow package directions). On a slightly greased (oil) cookie sheet spread dough into a rectangle. Press pepperoni onto dough. Spread Mozzarella cheese over pepperoni and then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Roll lengthwise and pinch all edges. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes or until brown.

title: Egg Custard(Old Fashioned)
instructions: Slightly beat eggs. Combine with sugar to which the flour has been added. Add milk vanilla and nutmeg. Add to egg mixture. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and dot with slices of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add tomato sauce kidney beans and vinegar. Stir in spices; cover and simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

title: Coconut Macaroon Cookies
instructions: Combine coconut sugar and flour then add egg whites almond extract then last almonds. Stir good. Drop teaspoon size on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Remove stems from peppers and remove seeds and membrane wash and drain. Place in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.

title: Chicken Breast With Crab Stuffing
instructions: Sprinkle inside of chicken breast with salt and flatten by pounding. Top with filling made of egg stuffing soup crabmeat green pepper lemon juice Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Roll up chicken around stuffing. Dip in melted butter and then cereal crumbs. Place seam side down in an ungreased shallow baking dish. Sprinkle lightly with garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sangria
instructions: Put ice in bottom of punch bowl. Pour wine Coca-Cola and Collins mix over ice. Last add sugar and stir. Float fruit slices on Sangria for decoration. If you want to add a kick to your Sangria add 1 cup brandy.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Blend chicken soup and milk in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Stir in cubed chicken cooked rice cheese and peas. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Frozen Strawberry Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into large casserole and freeze.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients into meat with your hand. Spread into casserole dish. Top with additional ketchup. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done approximately 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain zucchini. Place in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. In skillet melt butter add sour cream cheese salt and paprika. When cheese is melted remove from heat and add egg yolk and chives. Pour over zucchini. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top then bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheddar Apple Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add combined eggs milk and margarine. Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan. Yield 1 loaf.

title: Quiche
instructions: Mix ingredients well; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Delicious Brownie Icing
instructions: Melt chocolate Crisco salt and vanilla in saucepan at low heat. Add milk confectioners sugar and pecans. Add more milk if too thick. Pour over cooled brownies.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Place green beans in a 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole. Mix soups together and pour over green beans. Add drained water chestnuts. Stir together. Top with French fried onions. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Pound flour into steak. By pounding it helps tenderize it. Then fry the steak real fast to brown on both sides. Turn heat down to medium slice onion over the steak and add tomato sauce then let cook for about an hour and a half. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Rev. Rose Deer Roast
instructions: Wash off roast in cold water; cut off excess fat. Sprinkle with garlic salt or rub with cloves of garlic. Cut onion into slices. Put onion and bacon over. Wrap in foil. Bake for 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Momma'S Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Pour into greased baking dish. Arrange tuna on top. Sprinkle lightly with pepper. Mix soup and milk; pour over casserole. Cover with potato chips. Bake in moderately hot oven (375\u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4. Serve with salad.

title: Frankfurters Buon Gusto
instructions: Cook bacon in heavy skillet until almost crisp. Add onions and cook for 3 minutes. Add frankfurters and peppers and cook 5 minutes longer. Add olives capers and seasonings. Beat eggs with milk. Pour over ingredients in skillet. Cook until eggs are set stirring occasionally. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and garlic. Warm tortillas in oil; layer meat olives and cheese in tortilla. Roll up tortilla; put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour chili and enchilada sauce over top. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses. If desired sprinkle olives and parsley over top. Another option is to spoon guacamole down center of pan over enchiladas and garnish with olives. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This dish can be made in advance and frozen until ready to cook.

title: Mary Inglis' Crab Cakes
instructions: Check crab for any pieces of shell or cartilage. Mix picked-over crabmeat bread mayonnaise milk and mustard. Form mixture into 6 crab cakes. Fry or saute crab cakes in oil. Makes 6 large crab cakes.

title: Butter Brickle Bars
instructions: Pour melted butter in oblong pan. Add almond flavoring if desired. Add remaining ingredients as listed previously. Bake at 325\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes. Let cool completely before cutting.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 9-inch square baking pan. Combine dry ingredients; stir in remaining ingredients. Mix just until blended. Pour into pan. Bake for 35 minutes. Serves 9.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Mix. Put over chopped vegetables. Let sit for about 24 hours. Drain before serving.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine ingredients; mix by hand thoroughly. Make small balls; place on a cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 100 small Sausage Balls.

title: Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Fold mayonnaise and yogurt together. Fold in remaining ingredients. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Peach Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Line pie crust with peaches. Cream together sugar and butter. Cut in flour and egg. Add vanilla and then spread over peaches. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Vegetable Puff
instructions: Combine melted butter sour cream Parmesan and eggs. When thoroughly mixed add Mozzarella and seasonings. Defrost vegetables and drain; add to mixture then add flour and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes. Top will brown and middle will be firm.

title: Italian Omelet
instructions: Fry potatoes in a little oil until tender. Stir constantly. Add eggs cheese and Italian salami beaten together. Do not stir. (Let form as a pie about 5 minutes on low fire). Turn and cook on other side about 5 minutes. Turn onto plate as pie. Enjoy.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Mix sugar shortening and egg. Stir in milk and bananas. Blend dry ingredients and stir into egg mix. Blend in nuts. Pour into greased pan. Bake 60 to 70 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool before slicing. (Cracks normal.)

title: Chocolate Peanut Crispies
instructions: Combine sugar and corn syrup in a Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until sugar dissolves and mixture begins to boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter stirring until smooth. Gradually stir in cereal and peanuts. Stir in chocolate morsels and press mixture into lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jellyroll pan. Let cool and cut.

title: Scalloped Salmon
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into a greased casserole. Sprinkle parsley flakes on top. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter for 10 minutes on high speed. Add one egg at a time and beat after each egg. Sift and add all dry ingredients and milk to eggs then fold in coconut and flavoring. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter; add cocoa. Add remaining ingredients and blend. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cinnamon Twists(Serves 5 - 2 Rolls Per Person)
instructions: Use a pastry cloth and stockinet covered rolling pin when rolling pie crust. You will use less flour fewer strokes and have a tender more flaky pie crust.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Easy to make and real good.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and salt; blend well. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold egg whites into mixture very carefully. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then lower to 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Paradise Peach Surprise
instructions: Combine flour sugar and pecans. Add margarine; mix well. Press this mixture in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until light and fluffy. Fold in the Cool Whip. Spread over the cooled crust. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add cold water. Chill to consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Put peach slices over cheese mixture. Spoon chilled gelatin over peaches. Cover and chill until firm. This may need adjusting; for some ovens 25 minutes is too long.

title: Custardy Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add 1 cup milk egg and butter. Pour into a baking pan and put 1/2 cup milk on top. Do not stir. This will be soft like spoon bread. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix sour cream oil and eggs together by hand or slowly with a mixer. Pour half of the batter in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over batter. Add remaining batter over the cinnamon. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Compote
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water. Drain fruit and save liquid. Take liquid and water to equal 3 cups. Cook pudding in this liquid until it boils and is thick. Add gelatine to hot mixture and stir well. Add fruit put in serving dishes and refrigerate.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cocoa together first then add beaten eggs melted oleo and the rest of the ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Let dough rise in a warm place. Punch down. Roll loaves together into one 15 x 12-inch rectangle. Layer ham and pepperoni on half of the dough lengthwise. Sprinkle with onion and green pepper. Top with 1/4 cup pizza sauce. Layer Mozzarella bologna salami with basil oregano garlic powder and pepper. Spread another 1/4 cup pizza sauce on top. Fold plain half of dough over filling and seal edges. Place on greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Brush with melted oleo. Heat the remaining pizza sauce and serve with sliced stromboli.

title: Oven Apple Butter
instructions: Mix well. Remove top oven rack and put into 225\u00b0 oven for 5 1/2 hours. Does not require stirring. Put into jars and seal.

title: Dill Bread
instructions: Combine water and yeast let dissolve. Mix in flour cottage cheese and dill seed. Let stand in warm area for 30 minutes. Knead and let stand for 20 minutes. Place into loaf pan (greased and floured) and bake at 425\u00b0 until golden brown. Butter and salt top lightly.

title: Lunch Box Bars
instructions: Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0. While warm sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Molded Liver Pate
instructions: Let liverwurst and butter stand at room temperature for at least an hour. Break liverwurst up with a fork and mash it until no lumps remain. Add soft sweet butter and beat until well blended. Add bourbon and pepper. Stir until thoroughly mixed.

title: Chocolate Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine cocoa and sugar in medium saucepan pressing out all lumps. Then blend in evaporated milk and whole milk. Set over high heat. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes until sugar dissolves completely. Set off heat. Mix in oil and bread crumbs. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.

title: Sopaipillas(Fried Bread)
instructions: Sift flour; measure and sift again with salt baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening and add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let stand for 30 to 60 minutes then roll 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board and cut into diamond shape pieces. Heat about 1-inch of oil in frying pan to about 370\u00b0 to 380\u00b0. Add few pieces at a time. Turn at once so they will puff evenly. Then turn back to brown both sides. Drain on paper towel. Serve with butter or honey. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: After beets are sliced mix together sugar flour water vinegar and salt. Add to the beets; cook until thick over low heat. Add butter or bacon grease.

title: Tenderloin Marinade
instructions: Marinate meat overnight. Turn meat after 8 hours. Roast at 400\u00b0 until desired doneness.

title: Oriental Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can French fried onions; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Summer Tea
instructions: Bring 1 quart to boil and pour over tea bags. Remove from heat. Cover. Let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients stirring until sugar dissolves. Serve over ice. Yield 9 cups.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Coat 9 x 13-inch baking pan with nonstick spray. Layer pecans coconut in pan. Mix cake according to instructions and pour over coconut. Mix butter sugar cream cheese and vanilla. Pour over cake batter and swirl. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Mother'S Pie Dough
instructions: Cut lard into flour and salt thoroughly. Sprinkle water on top and knead gently together. Will make one complete pie crust and one shell.

title: Date Pudding
instructions: Place 1 cup brown sugar in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Pour boiling water over sugar. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a mixing bowl. Drop mixture in sugar and water by spoonfuls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes(Microwave)
instructions: Combine all ingredients; microwave at High setting for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Mix both packages pudding with 3 cups cold milk. When thick fold in whipped topping. Pour into pan. Spread over graham crackers. Add another layer of whole graham crackers. Melt chocolate with margarine. Blend in powdered sugar and 3 tablespoons milk. Spread on top of graham crackers. Chill and cut into squares.

title: Individual Brownie Alaska
instructions: Bake brownies as directed on package. Cut into 3-inch squares; place on baking sheet. Top each with small scoop ice cream and place in freezer 1 hour. Heat oven to 500\u00b0. Beat egg whites until foamy. Beat in sugar 1 tablespoon at a time; continue beating until stiff and glossy. Cover brownies and ice cream with meringue sealing it to edge of brownies. Bake 3 to 4 minutes or until meringue is light brown.

title: Garlic Pretzels
instructions: Break up the pretzels. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl with a lid. Add the pretzels and shake the bowl until the mix is all over the pretzels. Put the pretzels in the broiler and bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour. Theyre ready to eat after cooling off.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Beat butter sugar and egg yolks in small mixer bowl at high speed until light and fluffy about 3 minutes. Combine flour baking powder and salt; mix thoroughly into butter mixture. Pat dough evenly into greased 8-inch round cake pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven until light brown about 15 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on wire rack 10 minutes.

title: Round Steak Baked In Oven
instructions: Place in baking pan 2 pats of margarine 1/2 envelope of onion soup round steak 2 pats of margarine on top of steak and 1/2 envelope onion soup. Cover with tinfoil and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Kris Kringles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg yolk orange and lemon peel and lemon juice. Beat well. Stir in flour and salt. Form small balls about 1/2 inch in diameter. Dip in egg white and roll in nuts. Press half a cherry in center. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Butter Chicken
instructions: Melt butter and combine with other ingredients. Place chicken pieces in a Dutch oven and cover with the mixture. Bake slowly at 150\u00b0 for approximately 2 hours. This step of slow oven cooking works for any grilled chicken recipe to make the chicken extremely tender. Place chicken pieces on the grill for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown. My husbands family owned a chicken business and when the family gathered for dinner this was the recipe they cooked most often.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: In large bowl combine first 8 ingredients in order listed. Mix thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Polynesian Treat
instructions: Heat pineapple and vanilla to boiling in saucepan. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows and nuts. Stir until marshmallows melt. Chill until thickened. Chill milk in refrigerator tray until soft ice crystals form around edges of tray. Whip until stiff. Add lemon juice; whip until very stiff. Fold into marshmallow mixture. Combine gingersnaps and butter. Press half of gingersnap mixture in bottom of a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish or a 9-inch pie plate. Top with half of canned milk mixture. Repeat layers. Chill 2 to 3 hours.

title: Diet Italian Sauced Fish
instructions: Arrange fish in single layer on well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan. Sprinkle with salt. Mix sauce and onion. Pour over fish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts about 3 minutes. Calories per serving 149. Yield 8 servings.

title: Noodles Ole
instructions: Cook noodles. While noodles cook brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain grease from meat and add the corn tomato soup tomato sauce chili powder salt and pepper. Simmer meat mixture. In a large casserole dish alternate layers of noodles and meat mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter; stir in flour salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir constantly until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute; remove from heat and set aside. In a skillet brown pork chops in oil; season to taste with additional salt and pepper if desired. In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish layer potatoes and onion. Pour broth mixture over. Place pork chops on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour; uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. If desired sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Yield 6 servings.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Cover potatoes with water and cook until tender. Potatoes may be sliced before or after cooking. Fry bacon until nice and crispy. Take bacon out of pan but leave drippings. Saute onion in bacon drippings until tender. Add flour sugar salt celery seed and pepper. Stir and cook until thickened and smooth. Remove from heat and stir in vinegar and water. Return to stove and boil 1 minute while stirring. Crumble in reserved bacon. Add sliced potatoes. Serve warm. Also good leftover cold.

title: Olivia'S Crab Squares
instructions: Cut crusts off bread and cut each slice into 4 pieces. Mix all but cheese together and spread on bread. Sprinkle top with cheese and broil until bubbly and brown. Serve hot.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 10-inch Bundt pan and dust with cocoa. Place all ingredients except chocolate chips in large bowl and beat 2 minutes. Mix in chips. Bake 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Spinach Rice
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine all ingredients except pimento; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cheese melts. Stir before serving. Garnish with pimento. Makes 5 cups or 6 servings.

title: Vegetable Dip (2)
instructions: Mix ingredients together chill & serve.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Layer 1/2 cabbage 1/2 beef 1/2 cabbage and other 1/2 beef in buttered casserole. Mix soup with water and pour over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cabbage is tender.

title: Huntington Chicken
instructions: Add garlic green pepper onion celery and noodles to reserved broth. Cook until tender about 15 to 20 minutes. Add chicken and soup. Put in a baking dish. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/8-inch thick slices. On waxed paper mix flour with salt and pepper. Coat tomatoes with mixture and let sit 15 minutes.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: In skillet brown ground beef; drain off grease. Stir in pizza sauce undrained mushrooms oregano and garlic salt. Bring to boiling; remove from heat. Combine rotini and milk. In 2-quart casserole layer half each of meat sauce rotini mixture and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Crumble crackers and mix with butter. Spoon over top of chicken mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Scald milk oil and McButter. Add corn meal stirring or mixing until blended well. Add in the eggs mix well. Pour into a glass baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam or lightly greased with oil. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Grind cranberries and apples. Mix with orange juice and ground orange rind. Add pineapple (juice and all). To each cup of fruit mixture add 1/2 cup sugar. May add nuts if you prefer.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Dice green peppers into 1-inch squares. Dice onion. Flash fry meat cut into 1-inch cubes (2 1/2 minutes on each side). Season steak with black pepper (heavily). Put in crock-pot all ingredients. Cook on low 12 hours.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Cut butter into cake mix. Reserve 1 cup mixture for topping. Pat remaining mixture into 13 x 9-inch pan building up 1/2-inch edge. Spread pie filling over cake mixture to within 1/2-inch of pan edge. Blend nuts and remaining cake mixture sprinkle over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cocktail Bread Sticks
instructions: Combine salad dressing mix mustard and butter. Unroll dough. Cut in half crosswise and then cut each in half lengthwise. Separate strips and twist each slightly. Place on baking sheet. Generously brush with mustard mixture. Makes 32 sticks.

title: Aunt Marie'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add molasses then egg and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Beat until smooth. Roll in small balls then dip in sugar and place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet. Bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Sugared Pecans
instructions: Put in heavy saucepan and boil to soft ball stage (234\u00b0). Pour in 1 1/2 quarts of pecan halves. Stir and beat as much as possible until it starts turning sugary. Pour out on cookie sheet to cool. Try to separate as much as possible.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery onion lemon juice salt pepper almonds and mayo. Press half of mixture into large casserole or Corning Ware dish. Cover with half sliced eggs. Top with remaining chicken and eggs. Top with soup then top with chips. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Mexican Chicken Manicotti
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Cook manicotti as directed on package; drain. Mix chicken carrots Ricotta cheese onion cilantro and garlic. Fill shells with mixture. Arrange shells in an ungreased rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour salsa over manicotti. Sprinkle with Monterey Jack cheese. Cover and bake 35 minutes or until hot in center. Makes 4 servings. Calories 305 per serving (11 fat grams).

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs add oil and sugar and vanilla. Stir in melted chocolate and grated zucchini. Beat in flour baking soda salt cinnamon. Add nuts. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done.

title: Banana Fritters
instructions: Mash bananas to a pulp. Beat egg and sugar together. Add bananas then flour. Fry in hot oil dropping by spoonfuls in hot pan. Sprinkle with granulated sugar if desired.

title: Strawberry Nut Salad
instructions: Combine boiling water and Jell-O until dissolved. In separate bowl combine strawberries pineapple bananas and walnuts. Fold into gelatin. Spread 1/2 mixture in 12 x 8 x 2-inch or 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Refrigerate until firm about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water for 7 minutes; drain. Place macaroni in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Then cut cheese in small cubes. Mix in macaroni; stir well with 1/2 cup ketchup. Pour milk to slightly cover macaroni. Place a few slice of cheese and 2 tablespoons of ketchup. Bake in 350\u00b0 preheated oven until done to specifications. Makes 4 servings. Can increase.

title: Cheese Filled Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cream cheese sugar and lemon juice; mix well. Flatten roll dough and seal perforations; cut each can of dough into 8 rectangles. Spread about 1 tablespoon cream cheese mix on each rectangle.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Using Basic Sweet Roll Dough roll or pat dough into long narrow sheet about 1/4 inch thick and 6 inches wide. Brush with melted margarine. Mix sugar and cinnamon and nuts if desired. Beginning at long side roll up like jelly roll. Pinch sides together. With a sharp knife cut into 1 inch thick slices. Place in greased pan. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. While hot glaze with confectioner sugar icing.

title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
instructions: Cut zucchini in chunks (do not peel). Cook zucchini and chopped onion in salted water 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and sour cream; stir in shredded carrot. Fold in drained squash and onion.

title: Mochaccino Milkshake
instructions: Mix well in blender.

title: Half A Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter (at room temperature) and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour alternately with milk and vanilla. Beat egg whites with baking powder; fold into mixture. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven in a tube pan lined on the bottom with greased wax paper for 1 hour and 15 minutes. This may also be baked in 2 bread pans for 45 minutes if preferred.

title: Squash-Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Wash squash with brush. Cut up and\tpeel eggplant. Boil together until done. Drain and mash well with masher. Add butter cheese eggs and milk. Beat well and add the rest of ingredients. Bake\tin clear glass dish for 45 minutes or longer until brown. Serves 6 to 8 people.

title: Fruit Stick Cookies
instructions: Mix like bread dough (it is very stiff). Roll in finger size rolls and press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Let cream cheese soften. Mix cream cheese and sour cream well. Drain Mandarin oranges and add to mixture. Add marshmallows and shredded coconut and mix well. Place in refrigerator and chill until ready to serve.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix water and sugar together and heat on medium-low heat. Add cornstarch to mixture when all sugar has dissolved. Stir in strawberry Jell-O and cook over medium heat until thick. Turn heat off and set mixture aside to let cool and to let it thicken. Place sliced strawberries in cooked pie crust. Pour mixture over sliced berries. Chill for several hours then top with Cool Whip.

title: Beef Barbecue Sauce
instructions: You will also need 1 pound charcoal briquets for fire.

title: Cake
instructions: Put everything together then cook it in the oven at 400\u00b0 for 4 minutes. Take it out. Let it cool for 2 minutes. Eat it.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix flour and brown sugar together. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Take out 1 cup crumbs for topping. Add to remaining crumbs the next 4 ingredients in the order they are listed. Mix well after each addition. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle reserved cup of crumbs over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Sweet Kugel
instructions: Use skim milk and low-fat ingredients. Add about 2 teaspoons extra sugar if you do.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix eggs oil sugar and dry ingredients. Add milk Bran and additional raisins. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Dough will keep up to 3 weeks. Bake in greased muffin pans at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Good Pork Roast
instructions: Cook slow until meat gets done and then take out of sauce. Let sauce continue to boil until it is as thick as you want it. Then pour over meat and serve.

title: The Ah!  Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until brown and crispy. Remove. Drain on absorbent paper. Place the romaine lettuce on plate. Arrange the vegetables turkey and cheese into long strips on top of the romaine lettuce. The cabbage should be set in one long strip through the center. Garnish with the bacon. Serve with French dressing.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine bell peppers jalapenos sugar and vinegar in a saucepan. Add food coloring. Bring to a boil; remove from heat and add Certo. Return to heat until boiling point is reached; remove. Add lime juice. Pour into sterilized jars stirring often to distribute peppers. Pour melted paraffin on top of jars to seal.

title: Holiday Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg salt and vanilla. Blend in flour. Chill. Roll out the dough. Use cookie cutters and place on baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Cool and be sure to frost the cookies.

title: Blueberry Cream Pie
instructions: Blend blueberries in blender. In large bowl combine blueberries sugar marshmallow cream and Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Put in freezer and serve frozen.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups hot water. Add pineapple juice to cranberry sauce. Chill until syrupy. Fold in cream and nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Sauerkraut-Pork Supreme
instructions: Dredge pork cubes in flour and brown in oil. Brown onions. Add sauerkraut and water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Add green pepper and sour cream. Return to oven for 10 minutes.

title: Paprika Baked Chicken
instructions: About 1 hour before serving (on waxed paper) mix flour salt and paprika. Coat chicken pieces with flour mixture. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish in 425\u00b0 oven melt margarine. Remove baking dish from oven. Arrange chicken skin side down in single layer in margarine. Bake 25 minutes. Turn pieces over. Bake 15 minutes or until chicken is tender and golden brown. Makes 4 servings. Contains 645 calories.

title: Fat-Free Fruit Smoothie
instructions: Place juice frozen or fresh banana and fruit of your choice in blender. Liquify. Add ice cubes and blend until you reach shake consistency. Makes 1 large or 2 small smoothies.

title: Dill Weed Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill about 1 hour. Enjoy with vegetables chips or crackers.

title: Spaghetti Sauce With Meat(Serves 50)
instructions: Brown beef in skillet or oven with 3 tablespoons salt. Drain off fat; set aside. In large kettle combine tomatoes onion 2 teaspoons salt garlic powder oregano and red pepper. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add bell pepper cheese and meat. Cook 15 minutes longer or until pepper is tender.

title: Apple Crumb Pie
instructions: Pare apples; cut in eighths. Arrange in unbaked pie shell. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Mix second 1/2 cup sugar with flour; cut in butter or oleo until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable Clam Chowder
instructions: Place all ingredients except cheese and clams in a large pot and cover with water; bring to a boil. Turn heat down and simmer until potatoes are soft (approximately 1 hour). Remove from heat and add cheese and clams. Reheat until cheese is melted. Serves 12. Can be frozen.

title: Individual Cheese Cakes
instructions: In mixing bowl beat together cream cheese and sugar until well blended about 3 minutes. Add vanilla and eggs; continue to beat until blended. Place cupcake liners in cupcake pans. Place wafer cookies flat side down in cupcake liners. Fill liners with mixture to 1/4-inch from top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool on rack. When cool spoon cherry pie filling over tops. Refrigerate. Makes 24 cupcakes.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl until oranges are broken and batter is smooth. Pour into 3 greased and floured pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes (one flat pan 35 to 40 minutes). Let cool completely and frost.

title: Graham Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Thoroughly blend shortening sugar salt molasses milk and graham flour; cool. Stir in egg and yeast; add white flour to make a stiff dough. Let rise 1 hour or until doubled. Knead well on a lightly floured surface. Place in a greased bowl; turn to grease top. Let rise until doubled. Shape into loaves; place in well-greased loaf pans. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from pans and cool.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Mix lettuce tomatoes onion red cabbage olives and cheese in large non-metallic container.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Cream shortening and sugar in a mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Add bananas vanilla and pecans. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Spoon into greased 4 x 8-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until bread tests done.

title: Special Almquist Chicken Breasts
instructions: Prepare grapes walnuts and mushrooms and set to the side. Clean chicken and remove all fat. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute chicken breasts in olive oil until browned on both sides. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle grapes walnuts and mushrooms over chicken. Drain excess oil from frying pan (but leave browned bits). Add wine and cook down about halfway on medium-high heat. Add sour cream and stir until bubbling and smooth. Pour over chicken and bake covered for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve over wild rice. Serves 4.

title: Deep-Dish Brownie
instructions: Blend butter or margarine sugar and vanilla in mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar salt and flour together; add milk. Cook in double boiler until thick. Add vanilla and coconut after filling is done.

title: French Apple Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix 1 cup white sugar 1 cup brown sugar sour milk eggs flour baking soda 2 teaspoons cinnamon and salt. Fold in apple pie filling and spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cold Pizza
instructions: I chop all my vegetables fine and mix them in a mixing bowl (except tomato) then spread them over crust. Add tomato then add cheese last.

title: Pink Lady Cake
instructions: Add all the ingredients and beat well. Put in three layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Squares
instructions: Blend first 4 ingredients together. Sift together dry ingredients and stir into egg mixture; mix well. Fold in apples and nuts. Bake in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool then cut.

title: Veal Marsala
instructions: Cut veal in small pieces. Flatten with a mallet to tenderize. Dredge in flour with salt and pepper added. Saute in frying pan in butter and oil. Remove to plate.

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt butter; add onion and broccoli. Cook until tender; add soup and Cheez Whiz. When cheese melts add hot mixture to cooked rice. Pour in dish; top with bread crumbs. Dot with butter; sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Cake With Lemon Sauce(Heritage)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add molasses shortening and eggs. Mix well in mixer. Add 1/2 cup boiling water. Beat for one minute. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan or 2 loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with Lemon Sauce.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix chicken broth soup and seasonings. Add drained peas and carrots and mushrooms. Heat slowly stirring occasionally until bubbly hot. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Arrange biscuits on top of casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Serves six.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Prepare the pudding with 1 cup less of milk. Mix together pudding milk and 1/2 of Cool Whip.

title: French Fried Liver
instructions: Cut liver in strips in the shape of French fries. Mix cornmeal cracker crumbs salt and pepper together. Place in a plastic bag. Add liver and shake to coat liver evenly. Fry in deep fat. Drain on paper towels. Try it youll like it!

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Skin and cut elephant into 1-inch cubes. This should take about 3 weeks. Put into a pot and simmer over a kerosene fire about 3 months. Add vegetables to suit your taste. After simmering make gravy from broth. This will serve 3800 people. If you happen to have a few extra show up throw in a couple of rabbits but do this only in an emergency! Most people do not like hare in their stew.

title: Surprise Supper Casserole
instructions: Cook drain and set aside the macaroni. Mix remaining ingredients together. Alternate layers of macaroni and corned beef mixture in a 2-quart casserole baking dish (which has been sprayed with Pam). Spread buttered bread crumbs over top. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Check during the last 15 minutes of baking to make sure it doesnt get too brown.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and drop by spoonfuls into hot fat.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Put dry yeast in the 1/4 cup water to soften. Heat the buttermilk sugar and shortening until the sugar is melted. Do not boil. Pour in bowl; add part of the flour and stir well. Add the softened yeast; stir until blended well and add the remainder of the flour. Knead until well mixed. Sometimes it takes more than the 5 cups of flour. Do not make the dough too stiff. Roll out. Makes about 90 (2-inch) party biscuits to a batch of dough. The biscuits can be frozen for further use.

title: Dump It Cake
instructions: Put ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan as listed. Do not stir. Bake for 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Boil cabbage until tender in small amount of boiling salted water. Drain cabbage and save liquid. Melt shortening in saucepan gradually add flour stirring constantly. Add milk.

title: Vermicelli
instructions: Brown ground sirloin and onions. Cook noodles grate cheese drain meat and drain noodles. Mix meat and noodles. Mix in tomatoes. Mix in cheese and season to taste.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Add the rest of ingredients. If desired add 1/2 cup nuts or raisins. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Allspice or pumpkin spice can be used in place of the cinnamon.

title: Linguini And Clams
instructions: Cook pasta; set aside. Heat butter and add garlic. Cook 1 minute. Stir in flour and juice from clams. Bring to a boil stirring. Add clams parsley and dill; simmer 5 minutes stirring. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over hot cooked pasta.

title: Billy'S Baked Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef bell pepper and onion together. Drain before putting in crock-pot. Put drained mixture in crock-pot with pork and beans Campbells barbecue beans catsup barbecue sauce sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Stir all together and cook on low in crock-pot for at least 2 hours. Longer doesnt hurt.

title: African Beef Stew
instructions: Heat oil in a large preferably nonstick skillet. Stir in onions and cook over medium-high heat 4 to 5 minutes until translucent. Add beef and cook 5 minutes stirring with a fork to break up chunks or until browned. Drain off fat. Stir in broth peanut butter tomato paste salt and red pepper until well blended (mixture will thicken). Stir in squash reduce heat cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until squash is hot. Uncover and simmer 5 minutes longer for flavors to blend.

title: Poultry With Sage Dressing
instructions: Mix bread cubes sage salt onion celery and nuts. Beat eggs; add 1/2 cup warm water. Pour over mixture. Mix well. Perhaps add 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper or single slice of lemon; dice the rind. If fresh bread dont pack bird firmly.

title: Jello Icebox Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add strawberries to hot mix; stir until melted and starts to congeal. After it has congealed whip Dream Whip. Add sugar and vanilla. Fold into your jello.

title: Baked Fish Roll-Ups
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in small skillet. Cook until crisp-tender. Stir in bread crumbs basil salt and pepper. Mix well. Spread mixture on fish fillets; roll up. Place seam side down in 8-inch baking dish. Drizzle 1 tablespoon melted margarine over fish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Serve with tartar sauce or lemon wedges. Makes 2 servings.

title: Ring Around The Skillet
instructions: Cut round steak into 2 x 3-inch pieces; set aside. Shred cabbage after washing set aside. Peel and cut thin slices of potatoes and set aside. Slice onion thin and set aside. Drain tomatoes in a stainer over a bowl. Without mashing the tomatoes squeeze out the seeds over the strainer.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large skillet brown ground turkey or beef. In large saucepan bring to boil water to cook peppers for 5 minutes (peppers have had the tops cut off chop up tops to add to the cooked meat without stems). Remove peppers from water drain and salt insides. Add to browned meat the tomatoes onion chopped pepper tops Worcestershire sauce salt and pepper. Cook until onion and etc. are soft. Add 1/8 pound Velveeta cheese (sliced up) to meat mixture and Minute rice. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Fill the peppers to top and use remaining Velveeta to top the filled peppers.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage celery onion and pimento with salt until tender. Put in large baking dish. Cook milk and flour until smooth. Add cheese and margarine; stir until melted. Pour sauce over cabbage. Place bread crumbs on top. Cover with lid or foil. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Waldorf Crown Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Chill until partially set. Fold in apples celery and nuts. Pour into 4 1/2 cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold surround with lettuce. Fill center.

title: Jim Fankhanel'S Oyster Stew
instructions: Simmer oysters and liquid in margarine for 3 minutes or until edges begin to curl. Scald milk in separate pan over very low heat or in double boiler. Add oysters liquid and seasonings. Serve hot; do not boil!

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients. Pour this mixture in a greased sheet cake pan. Sprinkle the chocolate chips as evenly as possible on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. Pie is done when top is golden brown and knife inserted in middle of pie comes out clean.

title: Pear Honey
instructions: Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add pears. Process until finely chopped. Do not puree. Measure pears to equal 4 cups. Combine 4 cups pears pineapple and remaining ingredients in a heavy saucepan; bring slowly to a boil. Cook stirring frequently until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer stirring frequently 40 minutes or until thick. Spoon mixture into hot sterilized jars filling to 1/4-inch from top; wipe jar rims. Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands. Process in boiling-water bath 5 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Store in a cool dark place. Yield 3 half pints.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and mix for about 1 minute. Store in a jar in the refrigerator. Will keep for about 2 weeks.

title: Crock-Pot Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix Veg-All tomato sauce mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Set aside. Tear bread into small pieces. Mix in the eggs. Add ground chuck and soup mix. Put in crock-pot. Pour sauce over meat loaf. Cook on low for 8 hours.

title: Marinades For Meats
instructions: Heat and pour over meatballs.

title: Sweet Basil Dressing(For All Green Salads And Vegetable Salads.)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a jar. Cover and allow to stand at room temperature (not cold) so flavors mix. Toss with greens or vegetables.

title: Praline Yams
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place drained yams in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or baking dish.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook eggplant until mushy; drain. Add all ingredients reserving 1/2 cup cheese 1/2 cup crumbs and a small amount of margarine. Mix well. Pour into baking dish; sprinkle with remaining cheese cracker crumbs and melted margarine. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Prepare pie shell and cool. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. In blender blend eggs and juice. Add sweetened milk and whip. Pour into pie shell and bake 7 minutes. Cool and refrigerate. Serve with whipping cream.

title: Crabmeat And Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix together. Place in square baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 until heated and slightly browned.

title: Corn Pudding(Serves 8)
instructions: Mix ingredients well; put in 9 x 13-inch greased dish. Bake in moderate oven until firm.

title: Texas Millionaires
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add nuts and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool.

title: Candied Nuts
instructions: Bake the pecans at 250\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Bring to a rapid boil the sugar water vanilla and cinnamon. Put nuts in cooked mixture and spread on a lightly greased cookie sheet and cool.

title: Cherry Cheese Tarts
instructions: Line cupcake pan with liners. Place a vanilla wafers in each liner. Beat together cream cheese sugar vanilla eggs and lemon juice. Fill each cup 3/4 full. Bake 15 minutes in 375\u00b0F. oven. Cool and spoon pie filling over each tart. Chill in refrigerator until ready to serve. Can be made a day ahead. Makes 18-20 tarts.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease pie pan with butter. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Marvelous Macaroons
instructions: Combine coconut sugar flour and salt. Stir in egg whites and almond flavoring. Stir in nuts. Mix well.

title: (Uncooked) Figs
instructions: Mix crushed fruit and Sure-Jell and let stand 20 minutes. Add Karo syrup and stir well. Add sugar and stir thoroughly. Place in containers and freeze. Good on biscuits toast or as a topping for ice cream.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well and add the remaining ingredients. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in loaf pans or 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Lazy-Way Beef Burgundy
instructions: Place beef cubes onion wine and consomme in a 2 1/2 qt. casserole. Mix flour and bread crumbs together; add to casserole. Stir all ingredients together until completely blended. Cover. Bake at 325 degrees for 3 to 3 1/2 hours or until meat is tender...stirring once every hour.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Melt margarine in small oblong Pyrex dish. Cook apples a few minutes; sweeten as desired. Pour in buttered dish. Pour flour mixture across apples in strips. Bake at 375\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Heath Bar Ice Cream
instructions: Beat the eggs milk sugar and vanilla. Add chocolate bits. Pour in freezer and freeze. Makes 1 quart.

title: Wacky Chocolate Cake
instructions: Place all dry ingredients in a mixing bowl. Mix with all other ingredients;\tpour in an ungreased single cake pan 9 x 13-inch size. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. (Mix by hand only.)

title: Chicago Public School Lunch Room Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter with electric mixer until light and creamy. Gradually add 1 1/2 cups sugar until the dough isnt grainy. Add flour 1/2 cup at a time. Add vanilla. Drop dough by heaping tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Pour sugar on plate and press 2 fingers into sugar and then onto cookie to flatten. Bake in a preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Deer Stew
instructions: Brown meat; cut into pieces in bacon fat. Add 2 large onions sliced. Continue browning. When nicely browned stir in 3 tablespoons flour. Place in baking dish and add vinegar catsup sugar and salt and pepper to taste. Cover meat with water and bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours or until tender adding water as needed to keep meat covered. When done thicken gravy and serve.

title: Brown Sugar Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and cornstarch then add butter milk and vanilla. (Use wooden spoon or whisk not electric mixer.) Cover bottom of unbaked pie crust with pecans or raisins; pour pie mixture in pie crust and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 275\u00b0; bake until firm.

title: Peanut-Mallow Light Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar salt syrup and milk. Cook until soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add vanilla margarine peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Pour into buttered 9-inch pan.

title: Mexican Cherry Cobbler
instructions: In 9 x 13-inch glass casserole place flour tortillas rolled up with cherry pie filling. In each saucepan cook oleo with water sugar red coloring and almond flavoring. Bring to boil and pour over top of tortillas. Let set 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray baking sheet lightly with Bakers Joy. Cream Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in large bowl. Blend until creamy. Blend in egg. Combine flour salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 3-inches apart on baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies (they will look light and moist) or 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies.

title: Hearty Pork Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven heat oil; add pork garlic and onions; cook and stir until meat is cooked through. Add remaining ingredients except rotelle; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Prepare rotelle as package directs and drain. Stir into soup. Heat through. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Red Hot Candy
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat until it reaches hard-crack stage. Add cinnamon oil and food coloring. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Let cool. Remove from pan and break into small pieces. Store tightly sealed.

title: Pecan Pie Muffins
instructions: Combine pecans brown sugar and flour. Beat eggs add butter. Mix well. Add to dry mixture. Stir till just moistened. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 9 muffins.

title: Chopped Coins
instructions: Cook carrots approximately 20 minutes until just tender. Mix carrots onion and green pepper.

title: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Fry hamburger and onion together until done. Add chili powder mustard catsup and soup. Simmer until real thick about 1 hour on medium heat.

title: Butterfinger Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg. Sift dry ingredients mixing in pieces of Butterfinger. Chill. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.

title: Mother'S Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix. Roll thin and cut. Bake in medium oven until light brown.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and sour cream to which the soda has been added. Mix in bananas vanilla flour and salt. Bake in jelly roll pan at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Ice with Powdered Sugar Icing.

title: Crunchy Pea Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except bacon. Chill. Garnish with bacon just before serving.

title: Cherry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Beat cream cheese and mayo. Add to lemon Jell-O mix. Add undrained pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Chill 1 hour until firm. Dissolve cherry Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water. Add pie filling and spoon over top of lemon Jell-O mixture. Chill until set.

title: Aunt Alice'S Stromboli
instructions: Cut bread in half lengthwise. Spread tomato sauce on both sides of the bread. Fry sausage and drain grease then put on bread. Cut up pieces of onion and green pepper and scatter over sausage. Scatter pepperoni over everything and then cover with Mozzarella cheese. Cover the bread with other piece of bread. Wrap loosely with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. If top of bread gets hard sprinkle a little water on top of bread and put back in oven for a few minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pineapple Bread
instructions: Beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add eggs and mix well. Mix flour and baking powder together. Combine sugar and flour mixtures. Blend. Add pineapple mix to combine. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cut into 20 slices.

title: Hawaiian Butterscotch Cookies
instructions: Sift flour; add baking powder and salt to flour. Blend. Cream sugar butter and egg. Add dry ingredients to the mixture. Stir in butterscotch morsels pineapple and nuts. Drop by teaspoons. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Buttercream Decorating Icing
instructions: Cream butter and shortening together with an electric mixer. Add vanilla and salt. Beat in sugar one cup at a time blending well after each addition. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl often with a spatula. Add milk and beat at high speed for 10 minutes. Keep icing covered with lid and store in refrigerator. Chill before making roses. To use as frosting thin with milk. Yields 3 cups. It can also be frozen.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook in slow cooker until thickens.

title: Crock Pot Steak And Gravy
instructions: Do not trim meat. Place in 4 - 5 quarts crock pot. Sprinkle with onion-mushroom soup mix and 1/2 cup Water. Cook on low for 8 hours. After cooking remove steak and keep warm. Remove juices to sauce pan add hot Water and Corn Starch. Cook on medium-high stirring constantly with a whisk until gravy thickens and starts to bubble. Serves 4.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Peel onion leaving root end intact. Cut onion vertically into quarters cutting to within 1/2-inch of root end. Cut each quarter vertically into thirds. Place onion in boiling water 1 minute; remove and place in ice water 5 minutes. Loosen petals if necessary. Drain onion cut side down. Place flour in a zip-top plastic bag; add onion shaking to coat. Dip onion in egg. Place cracker crumbs in plastic bag; add onion tossing to coat. Chill 1 hour.

title: Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and let stand 1 hour. Boil last 3 ingredients for 1 minute; cool and pour over cabbage. Great for freezing.

title: Avocado Tostado Salad
instructions: Brown meat. Drain. Add chili beans with juice salt and chili powder. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Saucy Franks
instructions: Score franks in corkscrew fashion. In skillet brown franks lightly in butter. Add remaining ingredients except green pepper. Simmer covered about 10 minutes. Add green pepper and cook covered 5 minutes more. Serve over hot cooked noodles or over buns. Serves 4 or 5.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a bowl. Let stand refrigerated for at least 12 hours.

title: Lake Charles Dip
