instructions: Mix together. Chill. Serve with vegetable sticks.

title: Peanut Butter Sauce
instructions: Place peanut butter chips milk and whipping cream in a medium-sized microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High 2 to 2 1/2 minutes; stir. If necessary microwave on High an additional 30 seconds at a time stirring after each heating until chips are melted when stirred. Stir in vanilla. Serve warm over ice cream. Mmmmmmmmm! Refrigerate leftovers if any.

title: Cheese Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape in loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour until browned. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Salsa Chicken
instructions: Cube chicken breasts. Saute the onion green pepper and chicken in the oil. Cook until chicken is cooked. Add corn chicken broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Add the Minute rice. Stir; cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff up then sprinkle on the cheese. Cover for 2 more minutes until the cheese melts. Serves 4.

title: Zucchini Supreme
instructions: Combine cooked zucchini or squash sour cream chicken soup chopped raw onion carrot salt and pepper. Mix well. Put in baking dish. Top with Pepperidge Farm seasoned dressing dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Beer Chili
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp in Dutch oven; remove and crumble. Brown beef in drippings. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Add crumbled bacon; simmer for 15 minutes more. Serve with shredded cheese if desired.

title: Mom'S Meatloaf
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients. Place in 6 x 9 x 1-inch pan. Cover with foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Drain excess grease.

title: Crock-Pot Potatoes
instructions: Mix together onion butter celery seed paprika and garlic salt. Put potatoes in crock-pot. Fill 3/4 full. Pour all other ingredients over potatoes. Add water if needed. Cook on low for 4 hours.

title: Sour Cream Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well. Blend in well beaten egg. Sift flour salt and soda together and add to mixture alternately with sour cream. Blend in flavoring. Drop by spoon on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar 1/4 cup sugar to 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix vanilla pudding chocolate pudding with cold milk; whip. Pour over layer 1.

title: Lemon Dessert(Makes 20 Servings.  Prep Time:  20 Minutes.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine. Add flour and pecans. Mix well and spread in 9 x 13 baking dish. Press into dish with butter coated fingers. Should be thick enough to handle and about 1/4-inch thick in pan. If you dont have enough dough make more. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain; add onions mushroom soup and cheese. Mix well. Pour into a baking dish; sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and celery in skillet. Drain off excess fat. Put this mixture in bottom of baking dish. Top with soup then cheese then Tater Tots. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until potatoes brown and cheese bubbles.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Pour boiling water into corn meal. Add Crisco; stir in well beaten eggs milk and salt. Pour into lightly greased casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 1 hour or until delicately brown.

title: Pecan Delights
instructions: Mix together Quaker Oat Squares & pecans in a 9 X 13 inch pan. Mix rest of ingredients in microwavable bowl and cook to a boil about 2 minutes. Pour over oat squares and mix thoroughly. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Crumble 1 layer cake in punch bowl. Add 1/2 pudding mix 1/2 pie filling and 1/2 pineapple Cool Whip and nuts. Repeat each layer.

title: Scallops
instructions: Rinse scallops and dredge in flour. Heat butter in a heavy skillet and brown scallops. Set aside to keep warm. In the same pan slowly add scotch and vermouth stirring to make a smooth roux. Add 1/4 cup cream if desired to make a smooth sauce. Spoon over scallops. Serves 4.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Work together with fingers. Top and bake 20 more minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can French fried onions. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Marinated Grilled Chicken Breasts
instructions: Combine soy sauce lemon juice and garlic in a Ziploc bag. Add chicken breasts. Marinate for 2 hours or overnight. Grill 2 inches from hot coals for 8 minutes on each side or until done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mushroom Sandwich Filling
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter or margarine. Add Worcestershire sauce while cooking. Add heavy cream and salt to taste. Thicken mixture with flour adding additional flour if needed. Refrigerate. This filling is best made the day before using.

title: Peach Velvet Upside Down Cake
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons oleo in 9-inch round pan add brown sugar. Arrange peach slices and cherry halves in pan. In a small bowl mix Bisquick sugar oleo egg and vanilla. Continue beating 1/2 minute. Pour batter over fruit. Bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes or until done. Invert at once onto serving dish (allow pan to remain over cake a few minutes to allow sugar mixture to run down over cake). Serve warm plain or with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Blend in blender until smooth. Chill thoroughly before using.

title: Apple Dump Cake
instructions: In an oblong Pyrex dish spread pie filling. Sprinkle top with brown sugar. Spread cake mix on top then top with pecans. Dot top with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until bubbling and brown.

title: Barbecue Joes(Microwave)
instructions: To brown meat crumble ground beef in a microwave-safe dish. Add vegetables. Cover and cook for 5 to 7 minutes or until meat is no longer pink stirring once.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with cooking spray. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. In mixer bowl mix sugar and Butter Buds. Add water to sugar mixture and beat until well mixed. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour mixture and milk alternately to egg mixture at slow speed. Add vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Stove Top Meat Loaf
instructions: Chop onion pepper and celery finely. Mix all ingredients except soup. Shape into 2 rounded loaves. (Add an egg if it seems dry or more bread crumbs if its too wet when you shape it depending on the amount of ground beef.) Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and heat on medium. Brown the loaves on each side for a total of about 10 minutes. Pour in a can of soup and a can of water. Reduce heat to low and cook for about 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar water and cornstarch in saucepan. Boil until thick and clear. While hot add jello. Place 1 quart fresh strawberries into 9-inch baked pie shell. Then pour glaze over strawberries and chill.

title: Super Skillet Nachos
instructions: In large skillet brown beef with onions; drain the liquid. Add the 2 cups picante sauce beans and chili powder and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato and olives. Remove from heat and sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top. Spoon sour cream onto the center of the meat mixture. Place a row of tortilla chips around the edge of the skillet and serve immediately with additional chips and picante sauce.

title: Holiday Ham Sauce
instructions: In medium size glass bowl combine raisins water jelly and orange juice. Heat in microwave on High power for 3 minutes stirring after 1 1/2 minutes of cooking. In separate bowl combine sugar cornstarch and allspice. Stir mixture; blend into raisin mixture. Cook in microwave on High power for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes until thickened stirring every 30 seconds. Serve over ham pork chops or duck. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Sausage Cornbread Bake
instructions: Grease pan. Brown sausage and onion; drain well. Combine eggs cornmeal milk and oil. Pour half of cornmeal mixture into dish. Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese. Pour remaining batter over top. Cook at 425\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: Saute in olive oil the onions peppers and garlic. Remove from heat. Brown meat and drain grease. To meat add sauteed mix. Add 2 cans of stewed crushed tomatoes. Simmer for a few minutes. Add brown sugar baked beans and chili powder to taste. Simmer.

title: Mussel Stew
instructions: Put mussels in ice water and throw out any that do not close. While soaking mussels saute onions until transparent. Add wine. When boiling add mussels. When mussels are open (throw out any unopened ones) pour into bowels serve with bread.

title: Prune Apple Cake
instructions: In large bowl beat sugar oil and eggs 2 minutes with electric mixer at medium speed. In another bowl combine dry ingredients; gradually mix into egg mixture. Mix in prunes apples and nuts at low speed to blend thoroughly. Spoon into buttered and floured 10-inch tube pan. Smooth top.

title: Pralines(Candy)
instructions: Mix sugar and milk. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until sugars are dissolved. Continue cooking over medium heat to soft ball stage. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Cool and beat until it begins to thicken. Add pecans; mix well and drop rapidly with tablespoon on waxed paper or foil.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Crust Mix well roll thin and cut into strips. Line bottom and sides of bowl with strips and add alternately with layers of fruit filling.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together when room temperature. Chill then roll in nuts.

title: Microwave Stuffing
instructions: Combine mushrooms onion celery and margarine in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave at High (100%) until vegetables are tender 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Microwave at High (100%) until heated through 4 to 7 minutes stirring once during cooking. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except margarine) together. Have pork chops moist. Lightly salt and pepper before turning over in mixture. Line baking dish with foil and spray with Pam. Place chops on foil and drizzle margarine on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes or until done (lightly brown).

title: Marshmallow Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Pare and cut potatoes into chunks. Cook in pineapple juice until tender. Drain and reserve syrup. Mash potatoes add reserved syrup and remaining ingredients (except marshmallows) and mix well. Put mixture in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Lightly press marshmallows into top. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven about 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies No. 3
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream in a large bowl the sugar brown sugar and butter. Add eggs and peanut butter. Set aside. In a medium size bowl mix together the flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for about 8 minutes. Makes approximately 9 dozen.

title: Cucumber Sauce(Serve With Tuna Or Salmon Loaf)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.

title: Crab Puffs
instructions: Combine crab meat salt and pepper in a bowl. Blend well. Add cream cheese. Mix until smooth. Place a scant 1/2 tablespoon of crab mixture in wonton wrapper. Brush edges of wrapper with egg white. Fold wonton diagonally to form a triangle. Seal edges. Again brush edges with egg white. Join all corners of the triangle and crimp together. Deep fry in salad oil heated to 375\u00b0 for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and drain well after browning evenly. Serve hot. Makes 20 puffs.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Saute cabbage and onion in butter. Add water green beans carrot and Cup-a-Soup. Simmer 1 to 2 hours. Serve in bowl with Muenster cheese on bottom.

title: Chocolate Chip Surprise
instructions: Pour 2 cups milk into small mixing bowl. Quickly dip one cookie at a time in milk and place in bottom of 8 x 12-inch cake dish. Do not hold cookies in milk for more than 1/4 second! When bottom of cake dish is full cover cookies with a thin layer of Cool Whip. Repeat layers to fill cake dish. Refrigerate overnight. Serves 8.

title: Crab Casserole
instructions: Mix half of stuffing with all ingredients. Add remaining stuffing on top of large casserole. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Banana Bobs
instructions: Peel bananas. Cut crosswise into 4 pieces. Insert wooden ice cream stick in each piece. Place on baking sheet. Freeze until bananas are firm about 2 hours. In top of double boiler over boiling water melt shortening and chocolate pieces stirring occasionally. Dip bananas into mixture spreading over pieces. Roll in nuts. Place on waxed paper-covered baking sheet. Freeze until firm. When firm wrap each in aluminum foil. Return to freezer. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving. Makes 16 Banana Bobs.

title: Lemon Sherbet
instructions: Chill the lemon and orange juices in the freezer. Add the milk and cream. Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. Freeze. Makes 3 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and put into casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the potato mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hopping John Soup
instructions: Drain peas reserving liquid. Add enough water to pea liquid to make 2 cups. Combine peas soup mix liquid and sausage. Bring this mixture to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cover tightly and cook until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed about 30 minutes. Add more water or liquid if needed.

title: My Mother'S Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together. Pour into ice cream container. Continue process in making ice cream.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Add melted butter to grated cheese. Add dry ingredients and add to cheese mixtures. Knead well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes but dont brown.

title: Buttermilk Fudge
instructions: Place buttermilk and baking soda in heavy 4 quart saucepan. Stir thoroughly. Let stand five minutes. Stir again. Add sugar syrup and butter. Blend thoroughly. Cook over low heat stirring constantly. Soda will cause mixture to look foamy. Mixture will become brownish in color during the cooking process. Cook to softball stage. Remove from heat and add nuts and vanilla. DO NOT STIR. Cool to lukewarm. Beat to creamy consistency and pour into buttered pan.

title: Sweet-Sour Meatball Appetizer
instructions: Combine hamburger and salt into balls. Mix together ketchup and ginger ale; bring to a slow boil. Drop in meatballs. Simmer 3 to 4 hours occasionally skimming off fat that rises to top. Meatballs are ready to serve when sauce thickens. Makes 40.

title: Green Beans Scandia
instructions: Drain liquid from beans into saucepan (1-quart or larger). Add next 6 ingredients. Heat to boiling stirring. Stir in cornstarch mixed with water. Cook and continue stirring until mixture thickens and is clear about 5 minutes. Add cabbage; heat to boiling. Simmer covered 3 to 5 minutes. Add drained beans and cook until beans are hot. Serve at once. Serves 5 or 6.

title: Fluffy Fruit Dressing
instructions: Mix fruit juices. Add eggs and sugar. Cook in top of double boiler until thickened. Cool. Add whipped cream. Makes 1 quart.

title: Microwave Peppers With Green Rice
instructions: Cut the top off each pepper crosswise; remove stem and dice remaining pepper top into bowl. Remove seeds and hollow out whole peppers. To chopped pieces in bowl add spinach eggs garlic rice Parmesan cheese butter and half tomato sauce. Mix well and divide evenly into hollowed peppers. Arrange in 2-quart casserole. Spoon remaining half tomato sauce over peppers cover. Microwave on High 15 to 20 minutes until heated. Top with cheese.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Melt cheese soup and 1 stick of margarine; mix cooked rice and cooked broccoli together. Pour melted sauce over and stir real well. If desired add one jar sliced mushrooms. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Saucy Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients; form into a loaf. Place in a buttered oblong baking dish.

title: Apple Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: In pie plate melt margarine. In a bowl sift flour and sugar. Add milk and vanilla to flour mixture. Be sure it is mixed thoroughly. When margarine is melted pour flour mixture into the melted margarine. Do not stir. Drain apples and place them evenly on top of flour mixture. Do not stir. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Potato Soup With Cucumber(Feine Kartoffelsuppe Mit Gurken; Makes 6 Servings)
instructions: Peel the cucumber and slice it lengthwise into halves. Scoop out the seeds and cut into 1/4-inch dice and set aside. In a heavy 4-quart saucepan bring the potatoes and water to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to moderate. Add the salt and pepper and cook uncovered until the potatoes are soft and can easily be mashed against the sides of the pan. Then pour them and all the cooking liquid into a sieve set over a bowl. With a large spoon force through the sieve. Dont use a blender it makes the mixture too smooth. Return the potatoes and liquid to the saucepan and stir in the cream milk grated onion and cucumbers. Simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes or until the cucumber is tender but still firm. Add the dill and taste for seasoning. Serve hot.

title: Mexican Chicken Lasagne
instructions: Pour both jars of salsa into a large non-aluminum saucepan. Add the pepper chili powder cumin and garlic. Bring to a boil; reduce the heat and simmer uncovered stirring often until the sauce is reduced to 4 cups about 10 minutes. Meanwhile cook the lasagne noodles according to package directions and drain well.

title: Date Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in eggs. Add pineapple carrots dates and vanilla beating well. Combine dry ingredients and gradually add to creamed mixture. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool completely. Sprinkle top of cake with powdered sugar.

title: Quick Italian Spaghetti
instructions: In a skillet brown ground beef and onions. Add next 5 ingredients. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add olives; simmer 5 more minutes. Spoon over spaghetti; sprinkle with cheese and bacon bits if desired. Yield 4 servings. This dish can be ready by the time the spaghetti is cooked.

title: Delightful Delectable Ribs
instructions: Cut ribs. Brown in iron skillet. Place in a pan over medium heat. Add soup water onions Worcestershire sauce and pepper over ribs. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours turning and adding water if thick.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Beat sugar and egg yolks until light. Add oil and beat. Mix together all dry ingredients and add to sugar egg and oil mixture. Add crushed pineapple carrots and butter flavor. Add nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cinnamon. Mix lightly through sliced apples. Heap up in unbaked pastry shell. Dot with butter and add topping.

title: Pickled Eggs
instructions: Hard boil eggs. Plunge into cold water. Remove shells. Place in sterilized jar. Heat vinegar and water; add seasoning. Pour over edges. Let eggs stand for at least 1 week. Refrigerate after opening.

title: Yellow Rice And Shrimp
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions. If shrimp are uncooked drop in boiling water until pink and remove. If precooked prepare for use according to package instructions.

title: Pumpkin Waffles With Warm Cider Syrup
instructions: Beat together the buttermilk egg yolks oil and brown sugar. Stir in pumpkin puree until smooth. Combine flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon salt and cloves. Stir flour mixture into pumpkin mixture just until blended. Batter does not need to be smooth. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into batter. Bake waffles in a heated iron according to manufacturers directions. Keep waffles warm on a rack in a 200\u00b0 oven until all batter is used. Serve waffles with Warm Apple Cider Syrup. Yields 6 round 7-inch waffles.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped peppers celery onions and garlic in margarine until glazed. Add oysters and juice. When oysters start to curl add soup hot sauce and cracker crumbs. Put in greased casserole. Sprinkle top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans. Press into an oblong pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove and cool in pan. Mix cream cheese sour cream sugar and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip and spread mixture on crust. Top with pie filling and chill.

title: Smoked Gar
instructions: Season gar. Smoke 4 hours over ash or hickory. Remove and cut into 1-inch pieces. Melt butter and brown gar for 1 minute. Add the rest of ingredients. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. To serve pour desired amount of beans over rice. Add a few pieces of gar and sauce. Enjoy.

title: Cavatini
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Cook noodles. Combine all ingredients saving 1 1/2 cups of cheese for topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Makes 2 large pans.

title: Poppycock-Popcorn
instructions: In a very large bowl mix first 3 ingredients and set aside. In a saucepan combine the sugar corn syrup and butter and cook to little more than soft-ball stage. Add vanilla. Pour over popcorn mixture and mix well. Spread on cookie sheet to cool.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease and flour pan well. Mix sugar and eggs well. Add other ingredients. Bake in four 1-pound coffee cans halfway full.

title: Fruit Pizza Pie
instructions: Slice and spread cookie dough in pizza pan to cover the edges. Bake for 11 to 13 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool. Beat cream cheese vanilla and sugar together. Spread on cooled cookie dough. Then arrange fruit.

title: Green Enchiladas
instructions: Heat tortillas in skillet one at a time. Place 2 tablespoons of cheese chicken and onion in each tortilla and roll. Place seam side down in 11 x 7 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Do not stir ingredients. Place crushed pineapple with juice in bottom. Add blueberries. Sprinkle 3/4 cup sugar over berries. Pour cake mix over ingredients. Pour melted margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar over mix. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Karin'S Bread
instructions: Mix in above order adding yeast after warm water. Add flour gradually. Makes large amount of dough. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in medium size pans.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate in water let cool. Sift flour and salt together; set aside. Cream butter. Add 1 1/2 cups of the sugar and continue creaming until light and fluffy. Beat in egg yolks. Blend in dry ingredients alternating with sour cream and vanilla. Dissolve soda in chocolate; stir chocolate mixture and coloring into batter. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add remaining 1/2 cup sugar and continue beating until soft peaks form; fold into batter. Pour into 2 - 8 inch round pans (lined with wax paper). Bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes. Frost with White Icing Recipe (do add the peanut butter).

title: Rutabaga Casserole
instructions: Mix all together well and pour into a well-greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Pound Cake With Raspberries
instructions: Heat jam in saucepan until just melted. Cut cake in cubes and divide among 6 dessert dishes. Top each serving with jam yogurt and fresh raspberries and serve immediately.

title: Baked Whiting
instructions: Split fish lengthwise. Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with tomato sauce and diced onion. Bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray an 8 x 8-inch pan with cooking spray. In large bowl combine flours brown sugar spices baking powder and soda. In small bowl combine buttermilk applesauce molasses and eggs. Add to flour. Beat with electric beaters until mixed. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Do not substitute all-purpose flour for whole wheat.

title: Apple Cheese Snack
instructions: Wash apples. Cut into quarters. Core the apples then cut the quarters into smaller pieces. Place on a serving tray. Put the cheese wedges in the center.

title: Holiday Cheese Ball
instructions: Beat cream cheese slightly; gradually stir in pineapple 1 cup pecans green pepper onion seasoned salt and chutney. Chill well. Shape into a ball and roll in remaining pecans. Chill until serving time. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Zucchini Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar butter egg vanilla and zucchini together then dry ingredients need to be added. Drop dough onto cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0. Cookies will be soft like. Sift powdered sugar over hot cookies.

title: Chocolate Gravy(For Breakfast)
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in large saucepan. Add milk. Cook until the thickness of gravy. Pour over homemade biscuits.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine broccoli onion bacon raisins and peanuts. In separate bowl combine mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Pour over broccoli. Mix well and refrigerate overnight. The combination of ingredients is wonderful! Serves 4 to 6.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix everything together. Pour into buttered pie plate or casserole. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
instructions: Combine soup milk and pepper. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole arrange alternate layers of potatoes meat onion and sauce. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are tender. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in order. Drop by rounded spoonfuls on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0 temperature.

title: Victoria'S Salad
instructions: Dressing In blender blend parsley and shallot well. Add vegetable oil olive oil vinegar mustard sugar salt and pepper. Blend well.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter and sugar. Add eggs meal flour vanilla milk and nuts. Fill unbaked pie shell and bake 30 to 40 minutes. Check center to see when done.

title: Crispy Cornflakes Cookies
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into cornflakes mixture.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion garlic salt tomato sauce and ripe olives and set aside. Combine cottage cheese sour cream and chilies. Place half of meat mixture half of sour cream mixture layer of cheese and layer of Doritos. Repeat. Heat in oven at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pa Pa'S Pepper Steak
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add salt and pepper and cover with water. Let boil and turn to medium heat. Simmer. Add dash of red crushed pepper. Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch and 2 tablespoons Kitchen Bouquet. Then add the bell peppers chopped. Cook 20 minutes and serve over rice.

title: Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inch. Cook and stir beef and onion until brown; drain. Stir in seasoning mix. Spread in pie plate top with chopped pepper. Beat milk Bisquick and eggs until smooth 15 seconds blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into pie plate. Bake 25 minutes.

title: Lemon And Lime Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and heat juice to dissolve jello. Mix well and chill.

title: American Potato Salad
instructions: Stir together first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix lightly. Chill. Serves 6.

title: Dijon Marinade
instructions: Remove fat. Blend spices and then beat in oil by drop. Use a rubber spatula and paint on lamb.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Sift dry ingredients together. Mix in shortening. Add milk and yeast. Roll out on floured surface; cut. Dip in butter. Place on greased baking pan. Let rise for about 30 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Mix flour baking powder salt milk and egg together. Dip apples into this mixture then deep fry until brown. Sift confectioners sugar over drained apples.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix well in bowl and chill.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening with hand. Beat in one egg at a time with mixer. Add flour and milk then vanilla and lemon. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Do not open door until time is up.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese sit at room temperature until soft. Mix all ingredients together and roll into ball. Roll ball in finely chopped pecans. Serve at room temperature.

title: Apple Macaroni
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray roaster with Pam (then sprinkle bread crumbs over bottom-optional). In salted water cook noodles; bring to boil and cook for 2 minutes from the time the water starts to boil. Drain off water. Rinse very well to remove starch. Melt butter and mix into noodles. Peel and slice apples. Mix apples with sugar cinnamon and lemon juice.

title: Orange Dream Pie
instructions: Mix butter and sugar. Sift flour with salt and mix with butter mixture just until dough will form (if using electric mixer use low speed). Place 1/3 cup of the mixture in a small pan to use for crumb topping.

title: Lemon Pudding Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar and beat until very stiff. Set aside. Beat egg yolks and add milk a little at a time. Add sugar lemon juice rind salt and lemon extract. Add flour. Mix well. Fold in egg whites. Pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Set in pan of water and bake at 300\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Cake will brown slightly when done.

title: Birds Nests
instructions: Melt paraffin in microwave at 70% power for 2 or 3 minutes or until almost melted. Add butterscotch and microwave another 2 or 3 minutes at 50% power. Mix noodles and nuts into melted mixture. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes soup salt pepper onion sour cream cheese and half of melted butter. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Toss corn flakes with remaining butter and spread over potato mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 to 60 minutes usually needs to be cooked an hour. Serves 10. Serve hot.

title: Cheese Pecan Wafers
instructions: Using an electric mixer combine all ingredients to make a soft dough. Divide into quarters and roll each piece into a log about 1 inch in diameter. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate until firm at least 2 hours.

title: Teriyaki Beef Ribs
instructions: Separate beef ribs. Set aside. Heat and stir remaining ingredients until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Marinate ribs in sauce for two hours or overnight. Next day lift ribs from marinade gently shaking off excess. Barbecue basting occasionally with remaining marinade. Makes 6 servings. (Sauce is also good for Teriyaki Steak.)

title: Greek Vegetables
instructions: Clean leeks. Discard green tops. Cut in half lengthwise. Clean mushrooms; cut in half. Clean zucchini; cut into 3-inch pieces and into 1/2-inch slices (also carrots and green beans).

title: Baked Crabmeat Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Pineapple Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in buttered casserole dish cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Good served with ham or turkey.

title: German Cheesecake
instructions: Blend crumbs 1 tablespoon sugar cinnamon and butter together. Press in a 9-inch pie plate using smaller plate to press down. Add egg yolks 1/2 cup sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla and lemon juice to smoothly beaten cream cheese. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold egg whites into cheese mixture. Turn into crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Combine 1 teaspoon vanilla sour cream and 3 tablespoons sugar; spread over cooled cake. Return to oven. Bake for 5 minutes longer. Cool.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Pour all ingredients over carrots and refrigerate overnight.

title: Salad
instructions: Layer top with the Hellmanns mayonnaise and the sugar. Cover with grated cheese.

title: Pineapple Nut Refrigerator Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour in graham cracker crust; chill. Makes 2 pies.

title: Berried Delight
instructions: Press graham cracker crumbs 1/4 cup sugar and 1/3 cup melted butter firmly into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 15 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pie
instructions: Drain cherries; cook pineapple cherries flour and sugar until thick. Remove from heat. Add dry jello and let cool. Add chopped bananas and nuts. Put in graham cracker crust and let set in refrigerator. Top with whipped cream. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Pork Chops With Kidney Beans
instructions: Wash chops and pat dry. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper then dip in flour covering both sides. In large skillet with a little oil on bottom (about 1/4 cup) brown chops on both sides. Pour off oil; add tomato sauce and water. Cook on low heat for 30 minutes. Add kidney beans; cook 15 minutes more or until chops are done.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to directions. Melt oleo in skillet and add broccoli and onion. Saute for 15 minutes. Stir while cooking. Mix Cheez Whiz soup and milk and add to broccoli. Add together with rice. Place in baking dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
instructions: Note Light low calorie and low salt products can be substituted.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in the order given. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured cake pans.

title: Sugar Coated Pecans
instructions: Mix sugar cinnamon and salt together. Beat egg white and water until soft peaks form. Add nuts to egg mixture and mix well. Add sugar mixture. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Cocktail Spread
instructions: Blend first 3 ingredients. Spread in a 12-inch dish or platter. Scatter shrimp over cheese mixture. Add layer of seafood sauce then cheese onions tomato and green pepper. Cover until ready to serve. Serve with crackers. (Best eaten on the day its made.)

title: Linda'S Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken breasts in half. Mix together the Wesson oil oregano soy sauce ginger and garlic. Place chicken in shallow baking dish and pour sauce over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Baste or cover. Serves 6.

title: Apple Nut Cake
instructions: *I used 1 1/2 teaspoons of pumpkin pie spice. Also the recipe says to peel the apples; I didnt.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Melt butter in boiling water. Add flour and salt all at one time; stir vigorously. Cook stirring constantly on medium low heat until mixture forms ball and doesnt separate. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time; beat hard after each addition until mixture is smooth. Form puffs on cookie sheet about a heaping teaspoonful (dont mash down) 2 inches apart. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Should be a nice golden brown. Take toothpick to let air out. Take extra strings. Fill with Cool Whip whipped whipping cream or pudding.

title: Apple Cider
instructions: Mix together and allow to simmer for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 medium muffins.

title: Creamy Crab Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients except almonds. Mix well. Spoon mixture into ungreased 8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Therapeutic Vegetable Juice
instructions: Place carrot pieces in blender bowl. Cut 1-inch off a raw celery stick and place in blender bowl. Add garlic to blender bowl. Add ginger powder to blender bowl. Add cayenne pepper to blender bowl. Place all concentrated juices and other ingredients in blender together. Add distilled water to fill blender bowl. Blend for a few seconds. Add Vegit (an all vegetable seasoning) as desired (optional). Conversely this drink may not be the most palatable however it is certainly therapeutic in its design.

title: After-The-Holidays Salad
instructions: In a mixing bowl toss first 6 ingredients. In a small bowl combine all remaining ingredients except lettuce leaves. Pour over turkey mixture and mix gently. Chill. Serve on a bed of lettuce if desired. Yield 4 servings.

title: Quick Spaghetti Dinner
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain. In a skillet brown the beef. Stir in tomatoes tomato paste and sauce mix. Simmer about 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in Cheddar cheese. Return to low heat to melt cheese if necessary. Serve over spaghetti. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and rice in greased baking dish. Add chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle chicken pieces with paprika. Bake 2 hours at 350\u00b0. (Ovens vary; keep checking to make sure when chicken is done and that the rice is not becoming too dry.) An extra can of mushrooms can be added if you like.

title: Roasted Corn Black Bean And Mango Salad
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds. Stir in corn; cook 8 minutes or until browned stirring occasionally. Place corn mixture in a large bowl. Add mango and remaining ingredients except greens; stir well. Arrange 1 cup greens on each of 8 plates. Spoon 1 cup corn mixture over greens.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef with onion; drain. Add chili beans tomato sauce stewed tomatoes and soup. Add chili powder to taste and simmer on low heat for 3 hours.

title: Special K Candy
instructions: Heat in pan on stove sugar corn syrup. Heat to dissolve sugar. Off heat add peanut butter and mix. Add Special K cereal. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan (ungreased); sprinkle with chocolate chips. (May need to bake 3 to 5 minutes at 350\u00b0 to melt chocolate.) Spread chocolate over top. Refrigerate. Cut into small squares when cooled.

title: Martha Washington Candy
instructions: Mix the whipped milk with the sifted sugar adding hot oleo. Add coconut and chopped nuts. Drop onto waxed paper in medium size balls. Let set 1 hour.

title: Hoppin' John
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Serve with pork loin and cracklin bread.

title: Banana Split Salad
instructions: Make graham cracker crust with melted margarine and crackers in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs and soft margarine until light. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat good and spread mixture over graham cracker crust. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Add drained pineapple on top. Slice bananas and put on top of pineapple. Spread Cool Whip on top. Garnish with cherries and nuts. Serves 14.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a 2 quart casserole and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Black Cherry Sparkle
instructions: Drain cherries and set aside juice. In a saucepan melt butter and add juice from the cherries; mix well. Add cornstarch and sugar. Stir until smooth. Heat stirring constantly until clear and thickened; remove from heat. Add cherries and almond extract. Put cake on individual plates. Pour sparkling cherry sauce over slices.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine flour baking soda salt baking powder cinnamon and nuts. Set aside. Beat eggs slightly in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients stirring only until moistened. Spoon batter into two well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan.

title: Pinto Beans
instructions: Sort and wash beans and place them in a large pot and cover them with water. At this point you can let them soak overnight or cook them overnight. I prefer the latter. Add all the other ingredients cover pot and bring to a boil. Then reduce heat and simmer on low heat all night or day. Check the water and stir occasionally.

title: Curried Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Slice peel scoop out seeds and cut squash into bite-sized pieces.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 25 minutes. Yields 8 servings. Has 250 calories 2 g fat.

title: Cheese Cake #2
instructions: Follow directions for making graham cracker crust off of package. Press firmly into a greased 8-inch cake pan (spring-form pan is best). Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Dissolve jello in yogurt. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker pie crust and refrigerate overnight.

title: Refrigerator Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Shred or thinly slice onions and cabbage. Combine the first 6 ingredients and bring to a full boil. Alternate cabbage and onions in a large bowl. Pour hot dressing over and cover tightly. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before using. Keeps for weeks in refrigerator.

title: Chocolate Frosting
instructions: In a mixing bowl beat margarine and cocoa powder until margarine is softened. Gradually add 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar beating well. Slowly beat in 3 tablespoons skim milk and vanilla. Slowly beat in 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar and additional skim milk if needed to make of spreading consistency. Makes 1 cup.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water. Combine spices salt pumpkin milk and 1/2 cup of the sugar. Add beaten egg yolks and blend. Cook over low heat until slightly thickened stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Cool and chill until partially thickened. Whip egg whites with the remaining sugar. Fold into pumpkin mix. Turn into baked pie shell. Refrigerate.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Shape into 1-inch balls and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes on lightly greased cookie sheet. Makes about 100.

title: Six Minute Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar milk and cocoa together. Bring to a boil and let boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add oats vanilla and nuts. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper.

title: Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cream cheese milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl and add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Mixture will be thick. Stir in pumpkin and spices with whisk and mix well. Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Garnish with additional Cool Whip (and nuts if desired). Serves 8.

title: Leek And Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes in water about 10 minutes. Saute leeks and onion in oil until golden. Add to potatoes and stir in milk and seasonings. Simmer until the flavors are blended (about 15 minutes). Add parsley and heat almost to boiling stirring frequently. Enrich soup with cream and serve hot.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion and celery. Add cream of mushroom soup. Cook for 1/2 hour. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with the hamburger mixture. Put mashed potatoes on top of hamburger mixture. Line top of potatoes with any kind of cheese to your liking. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Date Strips
instructions: To eggs add all other ingredients except only add half of package of dates. Pour batter in 9 x 13-inch pan; press rest of dates evenly on top of batter in the pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar; cut into strips when cool.

title: Peanut Butter Crispy Treats(Microwave)
instructions: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In 3-quart microwave dish stir Karo syrup sugar and peanut butter until blended. Microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes or until entire surface is bubbly. Add cereal; toss to coat well. Press into pan. Cool and cut into squares. Makes 32 squares.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: First-layer of lettuce. Second-layer of cauliflower. Third-crumble unthawed green peas. Fourth-spread mayonnaise over all above ingredients except the seasoning. Add the seasoning mix as directed on the package to above ingredients. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on the top. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Simmer boiling water rice butter and salt for 15 minutes. Add scalded milk to rice mixture and simmer 15 more minutes. Add beaten eggs sugar and vanilla. Cook for 3 to 4 more minutes. Pour into serving bowl. Cinnamon may be sprinkled on top.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Stir in flour and soda to batter. Mix well. Add sour cream and vanilla. Bake in a greased tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Check for doneness.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat; add next 6 ingredients with meat. Simmer 1 hour until thick. Boil noodles. Combine cottage cheese with eggs salt pepper parsley and Parmesan cheese. Layer 1/2 noodles 1/2 cottage cheese mixture 1/2 Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 meat mixture. Repeat. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting. Use 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Blend together eggs oil and sugar. Sift together flour salt and soda and add to mixture. Add walnuts apples and vanilla. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in large oblong pan.

title: Chocolate Fudge Icing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Do not overcook. Cool and spread over cake. This is excellent over ice cream for hot fudge sauce. Double the recipe for a 9 x 13-inch loaf cake. Cut the cake and pour the icing on cake while hot.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
instructions: In saucepan melt peanut butter and butter. In large bowl combine powdered sugar and cereal. Pour peanut butter mixture over cereal mixture. Blend together with hands. Form into 1/2-inch balls. Chill until firm. Melt butterscotch pieces and chocolate pieces in separate double boilers. Dip half the candies in each coating; swirl tops with back of teaspoon. Place on waxed paper lined baking sheet. Chill. Makes about 100.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water. Add fruits and their juices and pecans. Congeal mixture in 9 x 12-inch glass cake pan. Whip cream cheese and sour cream with sugar; spread smoothly over congealed salad. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top. Chill and serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream the cheese. Mix in the dry mix and the breast of chicken. Shape into a ball and roll in finely chopped pecans. Chill and serve with assorted crackers.

title: Chopped Chicken Liver
instructions: Saute onions for 5 minutes. Remove from oleo. Add livers and saute for 10 minutes. Grind livers onions and eggs in food grinder or chop fine by hand. Add seasoning. Chill. Serve on lettuce or on crackers. Good at parties!

title: Broccoli Beef
instructions: Marinate beef with soy sauce sesame oil and cooking wine. Heat peanut oil in preheated wok. Quickly stir-fry beef until meat changes color. Pull beef up on the side of the wok to stop it from cooking. Add water to wok and place broccoli along sides of wok and steam with the lid on the wok for 4 to 5 minutes. Remove excess water from the wok. Pull all the food down into the center of the wok and stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Serves 5 to 6.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix together butter 2 cups flour and confectioners sugar. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Clean and cut broccoli into florets. Clean and cut green pepper into pieces. Cut cheese into bite-size pieces (I use Longhorn cheese). Add grated carrot. Cut hard-boiled eggs into pieces. Add bacon.

title: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat in microwave 3 to 4 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Mix together and chill.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Layer crushed Doritos on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour chicken broth over this. Layer cubed chicken onion pepper and 1/2 cup cheese. Blend soups with chili powder and pour over cheese. Chop Ro-Tel tomatoes and pour over soups. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Avocado Dip
instructions: Put all in blender and mix well. Pour on platter and cool. Top with onion peppers tomatoes and cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Apple Spice Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Drumstick Torte
instructions: Oil and flour 9 X 12 inch pan; bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.

title: Soft Raisin Cookie
instructions: Boil raisins in water until water is almost gone. Cool. Cream together shortening sugar vanilla and eggs. Add to raisins. Sift flour and soda together and add to cookie dough. Drop onto cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and cookie sheets to 375\u00b0. Boil sweet potatoes in water until easily pierced by fork. Cool slightly. Place cooked and peeled potatoes in a large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Stir in butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in spices salt and evaporated milk. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake on preheated cookie sheets near center of oven for 70 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack garnish with marshmallows if desired. Makes two 9-inch pies.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Saute onion celery and green pepper in margarine in a skillet. Add a Tbsp. flour and stir to thicken. Add chicken broth milk mushroom soup pimentos olives and margarine. Cook spaghetti.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine and shape ingredients into a loaf. Place the loaf in a lightly greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Cut carrots into strips. Mix garlic and minced onions in oil. Saute carrots in mixture for 5 minutes. Stir in salt pepper mustard and vinegar. Simmer 5 minutes. Remove pickling spices and put carrots and juice in shallow dish. Cover with thinly sliced onions. Baste carrots for added flavor while they chill. For pickle flavor dont tie spices in cheesecloth. You can leave spice bag in carrots until cool and squeeze to get full flavor.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to instructions on box. Combine cooked macaroni with next 5 ingredients. Put in casserole dish and top with crushed cheese crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Adobo
instructions: Marinate meat for at least 1 hour. Boil all together. Dont mix while boiling; it will become too sour. When meat is cooked and tender take out meat and fry meat until brown. Pour liquid over fried meat and serve warm.

title: Dutch Meat Loaf
instructions: In medium bowl lightly mix beef bread crumbs onion 1/2 can Hunts tomato sauce egg salt and pepper. Shape into loaf in shallow baking pan. Combine remaining Hunts sauce with rest of ingredients; pour over loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Baste loaf several times. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Melt chips and white chocolate in large saucepan on low heat. Stir in marshmallows cereal and peanuts. Pour onto greased 12-inch pizza pan. Decorate as desired. Refrigerate until firm. Store at room temperature. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Philly Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cheese cream cheese and margarine until well blended. Add everything else except pecans. Refrigerate until chilled. Shape into a ball. Roll in chopped pecans.

title: Foolproof Apple Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Add vanilla butter flavoring cinnamon nutmeg and salt to cream mixture. Sift soda and flour and add to mixture until smooth then add apples nuts and raisins. Bake in tube pan that has been greased. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 60 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Veal And Gravy
instructions: Salt and pepper tenderloin slices. Roll in flour. Place in casserole dish. Pour milk over the top. Cover and bake approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Makes its own gravy.

title: Herbed Green Beans
instructions: Break beans and place in 1 1/2 quart dish add water. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave at High for 10 minutes. Let stand for 3 or 4 minutes. Place pepper oil and onion in 1 quart dish. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Drain beans add pepper mixture and remaining ingredients stir well. Cover and microwave on High for 3 minutes. Yield 4 servings.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 2 round 9 x 1 1/2-inch pans. Combine first 6 ingredients in mixing bowl. Add next 3 ingredients and beat well. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into pan(s). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 40 minutes in round pans. Cool 10 minutes and turn out of pans. Cool and frost.

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: Put first 6 ingredients into skillet. Cover and cook 1 minute. Uncover and cook turning with spatula until barely tender (about 5 minutes). Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Toss. Put in serving bowl. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Crumble 1 package Ritz crackers over casserole. Pour margarine over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Can easily be doubled.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Set in refrigerator for 1 hour to cool then pour over strawberries in cooked and cooled pie crust. Chill until set.

title: Pickled Shrimp
instructions: Place shrimp and onions in layers in a sealable container. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp. seal. Refrigerate for 6 or more hours. Shake occasionally. This will keep for over a week.

title: Impossible Taco Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inches. Cook and stir beef and onion until brown; drain. Stir in seasoning. Mix; spread in plate. Top with chilies. Beat eggs milk and Bisquick. Mix until smooth 15 seconds in blender or 1 minute with mixer. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes. Top with tomatoes and cheese. Bake until center is set 8 to 10 minutes longer. Cool 5 minutes. Serve with sour cream chopped tomatoes lettuce and cheese if desired.

title: Egg Crouton Casserole
instructions: Grease 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish. Place croutons on bottom then add cheese reserving a little followed by crumbled bacon. Combine eggs milk salt mustard pepper and onion powder. Pour over crouton mixture. Top with reserved cheese. Bake in preheated 325\u00b0 oven for 60 minutes or until set. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Ham Chowder
instructions: In stock pot cook carrots celery onion and potatoes in 5 cups water until tender about 20 minutes. Add ham butter salt and pepper. Blend flour into milk; stir into soup. Heat stirring constantly until mixture boils; turn heat to low and allow to simmer partially covered 10 to 20 minutes to develop flavor.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine in pan peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme; set aside. Bring sugar milk and butter to a boil. Boil and stir constantly for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add to Marshmallow Creme mixture. Beat until thick. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Fudge will set slowly.

title: Baked Apple(Serves 1)
instructions: Core apple; sprinkle with cinnamon and wrap in foil. Bake in shallow pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Baste chicken in sauce while broiling. Cook about 1 hour. Makes enough sauce for 2 chickens.

title: Apple Dapple Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs. Add nuts and apples. Stir in flour one cup at a time. Mix well. Batter will be stiff. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. You can add 1 pound of candied fruit. Makes a delicious and easy fruitcake.

title: Bacon Monkey Bread
instructions: Combine bacon Parmesan cheese and onion. Set aside. Cut biscuits into quarters. Dip each piece in margarine and layer 1/3 in a lightly greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle half of the bacon mixture over the biscuits. Repeat ending with biscuits. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden. Cool 10 minutes in pan.

title: Hot Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit. Melt butter and dissolve sugar; add curry powder. Pour butter and sugar mixture over fruit and bake at 325\u00b0 until bubbly. Delicious with any kind of meat.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans and drain. Put beans and water in a pot and bring to a boil. Continue to boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand one hour. Add onion salt ham and carrots to the beans. Cover and simmer about 2 1/2 hours or until beans are soft. For thicker soup simmer longer. Add additional water for thinner soup. This soup freezes very well and tastes just as good.

title: Marimore Cake(Yields One 8-Inch Double Layer Cake Or One 9 X 13-Inch Cake)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks; mix well. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk starting and ending with flour mixture. Add cooled melted chocolate and vanilla. Fold in egg whites and chopped nuts. Pour into 2 greased 8-inch cake pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.

title: Apple Cider Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans or eighteen muffin cups. Cream the butter and 1 1/4 cups of the sugar together in a large bowl. Add eggs and cream thoroughly. Sift the dry ingredients together. Add them to the egg mixture alternating with the cider. Stir in chopped apples. Divide the batter between the prepared loaf pans. Combine the remaining 1/4 cup sugar with cinnamon in a small bowl and sprinkle it over the batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 70 minutes for bread or for 30 to 40 minutes for muffins or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Yields 2 loaves or 18 muffins.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Mix broth pepper carrot and celery in saucepan. Heat to a boil. Stir in noodles and chicken. Cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until noodles are done.

title: Ladyfinger Dessert
instructions: Line a loaf pan sides and bottom with split ladyfingers. Mix pudding mix Dream Whip and milk. Beat 5 minutes until fluffy. Pour into pan and chill or freeze. Before serving remove from pan and garnish with whipped cream chopped nuts and maraschino cherries.

title: Chicken Strata
instructions: Mix all ingredients except mushroom soup eggs and milk. Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Spread mushroom soup over the top before baking. Beat eggs and milk; pour over casserole. Sprinkle more cheese on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Never Fail Meringue
instructions: Blend cornstarch and cold water in a saucepan. Add boiling water and cook stirring until clear and thick. Let stand until cold. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar; beat until stiff but not dry. Beat at low speed. Add salt and vanilla. Beat in cold cornstarch mixture. Beat on high until well beaten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes after putting on pie.

title: Pecan Sandies
instructions: Mix in order given. Roll into small balls not more than 1-inch wide. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet. Do not allow to brown. Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.

title: Beefy Ball
instructions: Be sure beef pecans and onion are all chopped fine. Mix well and make into a ball. Refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle paprika on the next day (optional). Spread on crackers to serve.

title: Bacon Rolls
instructions: You will need toothpicks.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sprinkle sugars and cinnamon on top of batter after mixing the ingredients together. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour in bread loaf pan lined with wax paper. This recipe doubled makes 3 loaves.

title: Festive Tossed Salad
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine sugar vinegar lemon juice onion and salt. Cover and process until blended. With blender running gradually add oil. Add poppy seeds and blend.

title: Microwave Enchilada Roll-Ups
instructions: On an enchilada spread a layer of mayonnaise and place a couple of slices of roast beef or turkey. Add small amount of lettuce and place in microwave for about 1 minute. Remove and place 1 tablespoon of picante sauce over enchilada. Tomato may be added if desired.

title: Lo-Cal Lasagna
instructions: Spray a pan with Pam. Brown turkey with onion green pepper salt and oregano. Remove from heat and add spaghetti sauce and pizza sauce. Put 1 to 2 teaspoons of this in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Add uncooked lasagna noodles. Layer with turkey mix Ricotta cheese and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese and bake covered with foil for 45 minutes. Bake uncovered 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 servings.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Sift flour soda salt and sugar together into a large bowl. Add buttermilk beaten egg and melted margarine. Stir in raisins. Knead well and put in greased 8 x 8 x 3-inch pan. Cut cross on top and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Gum Drop Fudge
instructions: Line a 9 inch square pan with foil. In sauce pan heat the candy coating milk and salt over low heat until melted. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and gum drops. Spread into lined 9 inch square pan. Cover and put in refrigerater until firm. Using foil remove from pan and cut into 1 inch squares. Store at room temperature. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Layered Party Plate
instructions: Soften cream cheese and mash on serving plate. Pour cocktail sauce over cheese. Sprinkle shrimp over sauce and top with grated cheese. Mix onions bell pepper and tomatoes; sprinkle over cheese layer.

title: Hershey Bar Pie
instructions: Melt Hersheys in microwave or saucepan. Add Cool Whip to melted mixture. Stir in nuts. Quickly pour into pie crust and cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine; add broccoli and cook until tender. Add soup cheese (cut up) Accent mushrooms and almonds. Put in large casserole dish and sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Charleston Red Rice
instructions: Cook rice in 6 cups salted water until light and fluffy not soft and sticky. Fry bacon until brown and crisp. Saute onions in 4 tablespoons of bacon fat until clear. Add tomato sauce and paste sugar Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce and cook slowly for 10 minutes. Place the cooked rice in a buttered baking dish and stir all seasonings in rice. Place in oven and bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Crumble bacon over top. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Tomatoless Chili
instructions: Chop garlic and onions. Saute in small amount of butter. Add 1 tablespoon chili powder and stir to mix. If needed add 1 more tablespoon chili powder. Brown hamburger and add 1 tablespoon chili powder and a dash of salt. Add 1/4 cup flour to hamburger and stir in. Add beans water pepper and more chili powder to taste. Turn flame down low and cook 4 or 5 hours. Serve with crackers or buttered bread.

title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into cubes. Mix together flour cheese salt and pepper. Roll potatoes in mixture. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place potatoes in pan and bake 1 hour at 375\u00b0. Turn potatoes after 1/2 hour of cooking.

title: Triple Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Line an 8 inch sq. pan with waxed paper or foil. Set aside. Melt chocolate in a saucepan over low heat stirring constantly. Remove from heat cool slightly. Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until creamy. Add confectioners sugar beating continually until smooth. Beat melted chocolate into the cream cheese mixture. Add pecans and mix well with a wooden spoon. Pour fudge into prepared pan. Refrigerate until firm about 1 hour. Cut into 1 inch squares.

title: Applesauce Cake Squares
instructions: Place unsweetened chocolate and butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat; stir until chocolate melts. Set aside. Combine sugar applesauce eggs and vanilla in a large bowl; mix well. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt; add to applesauce mixture stirring well. Stir in chocolate mixture. Spoon the batter into a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely. Top with Nutty Coconut Frosting; cut into squares. Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Pistachio-Coconut Surprise Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream and pudding mix. Add coconut and pineapple; stir until blended. Spoon into an 8 x 4 or 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Freeze until firm. Or instead of freezing fruit salad can be served immediately or chilled.

title: Lemon Chess Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pie shell. Beat all together very thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Tahitian Punch
instructions: In large punch bowl stir together juices and add lemon-lime drink. Using an ice cream scoop or spoon float sherbet on top. Serve immediately.

title: Cold Pizza Dip
instructions: Spread cream cheese out on to the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan. Pour chili sauce over cream cheese and spread out. Sprinkle the rest of the ingredients (except the cheese) over it. Last sprinkle the cheese on top. Eat with Fritos.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan; cook at medium heat. Keep stirring until dough comes off side of pan. Take out of pan and let cool for a few minutes; knead for 5 minutes.

title: Choc Shake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until desired consistency. Makes a great low-fat shake.

title: Hello Dolly Bars
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan melt margarine or butter. Layer in the following order on top graham cracker crumbs coconut chocolate chips butterscotch chips nuts and condensed milk. Pour on top; dont mix. Just put one on top of each other. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Let cool a very few minutes and cut in squares as you wish.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cream butter eggs vanilla and saccharin. Add other ingredients. Fold in dates applesauce and nuts. Bake at 340\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Cut angel food cake in half; slice one half in slices. Put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover with soft ice cream. Chunk other half of angel food cake put on top of ice cream. Freeze. Serve with strawberries.

title: Hot And Spicy Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: In a large skillet melt 1/2 cup butter to saute mushrooms. Once tender place to the side. Use same skillet to melt second 1/2 cup butter. Add peppers green onions and garlic. Cook over\tmedium\theat until crisp-tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir once\thalfway through cooking. You can use canned mushrooms.

title: P-Nut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix together with mixer and pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze for 1 hour before serving. Keep remainder in refrigerator after serving. The ready baked chocolate crust is great with this also.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Combine with salad dressing.

title: Beef And Biscuits Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and pepper in large skillet. Drain grease. Stir in tomato sauce chili powder and garlic salt. Simmer while preparing dough. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits. Layer over the\tbottom\tof ungreased 8 to 9-inch square baking pan.\tCombine 1/2 cup cheese (reserve remaining cheese for topping) sour\tcream and egg; mix well. Remove meat mixture from heat and stir in sour cream mixture; spoon over dough. Arrange remaining\tbiscuit layers on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Crab Dip Mold
instructions: Mix Knox water and mushroom soup together and heat to boil; cool. Mix cream cheese onions celery mayo and crab meat together. Combine with Knox mixture. Place in 5 to 6-cup mold and chill 5 to 8 hours. Remove from mold to serve.

title: Christine'S Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cake mix oleo and 1 egg and mix well. Put into 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan patting dough with hands to cover bottom of pan completely. Beat together all remaining ingredients. Spread mixture over cake crust. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. It tastes better if made 24 hours before serving.

title: Rum Balls
instructions: Mix crushed wafers sugar nuts and cocoa together well. Work up with hands and gradually add rum. Make into small balls and roll each one in powdered sugar. Store in tin box for a few days before using. This makes about 36 balls.

title: Potatoes With Cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours. Tastes best made day before serving and reheated.

title: Jack'S Cocoa Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix flour sugar and salt. Set aside. Bring to a boil the water oleo oil and cocoa. Pour over flour mixture. Add vanilla. Stir in eggs (do not beat). Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Pepper Cabbage
instructions: Mix all ingredients; let marinate overnight.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix vanilla pudding eggs water and Crisco oil at cake speed for 5 minutes. Fold in 1 cup of semi-sweet chocolate chips and grated chocolate. Pour in Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and 1/4 cup grated German chocolate.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Put points together. Press bottom and sides to form a crust. Spoon sausage over dough. Sprinkle with hash brown potatoes and cheese. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over sausage mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients and pour into and uncooked 8-inch pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 until filling is firm.

title: Bran Rolls
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients and cool to lukewarm. Mix the yeast in the lukewarm water egg and flour. Combine the two mixtures; cover and let rise 2 hours. Pinch off about 32 rolls. Add enough flour to handle. Place in 2 well-greased pie plates. Let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: When adding the Miracle Whip be sure to spread a good smooth thick layer. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 4 hours or more. Dont toss it the salad stays crispier longer.

title: Hot Punch
instructions: Let ingredients come to a boil. Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes. Add 2 cups orange juice.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Melt cheese together with all ingredients on top of stove. Pour over unbaked pie crust and top with another unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown.

title: Sugared Popcorn
instructions: Pop a large bowl of popcorn and set aside. Mix butter sugar and syrup. Put burner on medium heat and when mixture starts to melt and it begins to boil time for 6 minutes. When time is up add baking soda. Stir until mixture turns smooth. If adding peanuts mix them with the popcorn before pouring mixture over the popcorn. Mix well.

title: Broccoli Bread
instructions: Combine softened butter or margarine with garlic. Cook broccoli until tender drain well. Season with salt and pepper. Mash with a fork. Slice bread lengthwise and hollow out both halves. In bottom half spread with garlic butter; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese then alternate layer of mashed broccoli Parmesan and Mozzarella. Spread garlic butter on top layer of bread. Put halves together and wrap tightly in foil. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Slice and serve hot or warm.

title: Chicago Cocktail
instructions: Stir brandy and bitters with ice. Strain into champagne glasses. Fill with iced champagne.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
instructions: Add ingredients in order and mix. Add boiling water very slowly stirring until mixture reaches a doughlike consistency. Let cool and knead until smooth. It will stay good for a long time. Store in an airtight container. Smells great.

title: Taco Baskets
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Drain. Add taco seasoning beans and water. Simmer 15 minutes. In large deep fryer have oil hot and drop in tortilla shell. Hold clean emptied one pound coffee can in middle of shell. Tortilla will curl up around can and turn light brown when done. Drain on paper towel and set aside. Fry remaining shells and drain. Prepare cheese sauce by blending cheese mix and milk; stir over medium heat for 7 minutes or until thick. Fill each fried shell half full of lettuce. Cover with meat. Pour cheese sauce over meat and garnish with green onions.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: In skillet put in 1 tablespoon hot oil. Cook beef half at a time until brown stirring often. Remove; set aside. Put in remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Cook peppers and onion with garlic powder until tender stirring often. Stir in gravy and Worcestershire sauce. Heat to boiling. Return beef to skillet. Serve over rice.

title: Apricot-Pineapple Delight
instructions: Drain fruits separately; reserve juices. Chop apricots. Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups hot water; add 1/2 cup pineapple juice and 1/2 cup apricot juice. Chill until thickened. Add marshmallows pineapple and apricots. Place in an 8 x 8-inch container. Chill until firm.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients in food processor thoroughly. Form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts.

title: Slush
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil. Simmer for 15 minutes then cool. Add orange juice lemonade and gin. Freeze mixture. When ready to serve fill glass half full of mixture and half with 7-Up or Sprite. Great to keep on hand in the freezer.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar syrup butter vanilla and nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until set in middle.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Place carrots onions and peppers in layers in a bowl. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix other ingredients and pour over carrots. Refrigerate at least 12 hours before serving.

title: Shower Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Freeze some the night before in an ice ring.

title: Classic Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender. Drain and cool. Peel and cube potatoes. Combine potato celery sweet pickles eggs and onions and toss gently. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise lemon juice salt pepper and dry mustard. Spoon mayonnaise mixture over potato mixture and toss gently. May be served warm or cold.

title: Butter Balls
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Blend in vanilla and gradually add flour. Add pecans. Chill several hours. Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet. Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm. Cool on rack.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat cook bacon on both sides until crisp. Drain on paper towel. Save half of 1 slice for garnish. Crumble remaining bacon. In medium bowl blend soup mix bacon sour cream horseradish and mustard. Cover and chill 2 hours. Serve with chips or cut up raw vegetables. Garnish top with bacon.

title: Cheezy Meat Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl mix ground beef onions bread crumbs salt pepper egg green peppers cheese and tomato sauce. Place mixture in a 9 x 13 pan. Form to shape of pan. Mix tomato paste and sugar in a small bowl and pour over top of meat mixture. Cook for a hour or until firm.

title: Artichoke Spread
instructions: Mix together and bake in small shallow bowl or pie plate at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with a mild cracker.

title: Apple Butter Cake
instructions: Stir together flour baking soda salt nutmeg cinnamon and ground cloves. Beat butter and sugar together until fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Combine buttermilk and apple butter. Add alternately with the flour mixture mixing well after each addition. Pour into 2 greased 9-inch round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from pan and cool thoroughly on cake rack. Frost cooled cake with creamy vanilla frosting.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Follow directions on back of taco seasoning in preparing ground beef. Dice tomatoes in large bowl; chop lettuce and place on top of tomatoes. Add can of kidney beans to beef mixture and pour over lettuce. Pour crushed Doritos over beef. Add Thousand Island dressing over Doritos. Put cheese over all just before serving.

title: Cinnamon Potpourri Ornaments
instructions: Select an apple that is ripe but firm and well shaped. Peel smooth then ream out stem and blossom ends. Youre now ready for carving. Use a very sharp knife. Dip the apple in lemon juice to prevent discoloration. Start carving by cutting brow line. Then cut two vertical lines at right angles for the nose. Cut in and around nose and out over cheek. Hollow out slits for eyes about 1/2-inch below brow line and in toward nose bridge. Remove enough below nose to form chin and mouth. Carve mouth by cutting very thin slits which will dry into perfect shape.

title: Honey Mustard, Ham And Potato Salad
instructions: Cut ham into bite size strips. Set aside. Cut potatoes into quarters. Cook potatoes in boiling water in a large skillet until tender about 10 minutes.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed. Add melted butter; mix well. Pour 1/2 batter in 9 x 13 greased pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Melt caramels and milk in double boiler or microwave. Spoon over cake. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over caramel. Pour remaining batter over mixture and bake approximately 15 minutes or until cake is done.

title: Egg-Rice Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beef Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown ground beef; add sauce. Cook noodles and drain. Mix noodles with sour cream cream cheese and green onions. In casserole dish put layer of meat sauce noodles and then grated cheese. Bake for 35 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Kool-Aid Pies
instructions: Chill Pet milk until its icy then whip. Fold in other ingredients. Pour into pie crust. Put in icebox. Serve in 1 hour. Will make 2 small pies.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
