instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be topped with cracker crumbs or bread crumbs.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Cut up apples into small pieces and place into bottom crust. (Use frozen pie crust or make own from basic pie crust recipe.) Mix the remaining ingredients except condensed milk and 1 tablespoon sugar. Pour over apples. For top of crust mix the condensed milk and 1 tablespoon of sugar together. Brush on sides of bottom crust then place top crust on and brush mixture over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream or plain.

title: Crock-Pot Stew
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Turn crock-pot to high heat and cook 2 hours. Lower heat to low and cook until all ingredients are fork-tender. Serves 6.

title: Curried Shrimp
instructions: Cook bacon until almost done. Dice shrimp to very small pieces (run through a coarse grinder if youd prefer). Dice water chestnuts in same manner. Combine shrimp water chestnuts mayonnaise curry powder and lemon juice. Season to taste. Split Kaiser rolls and scrape out soft centers of both halves. Spoon shrimp mixture into hollows of Kaiser rolls. Top with slices of tomatoes and bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt butter and toss with herb seasoned dressing mix. Take 1/2 of this mixture and mix with squash soup sour cream and onion. Pour into greased baking dish and spread. Put rest of dressing mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Islander'S Delight
instructions: Cook apple pepper and curry in butter until pepper is tender. Add soup and water. Heat. Stir now and then. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Pink Delite
instructions: Fold together; chill for 2 hours.

title: Miniature Cream Puffs
instructions: Melt butter in 1 cup boiling water. Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously. Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesnt separate. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Next add eggs one at a time making sure you beat smooth after you add each egg.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Drain noodles. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour and seasonings. Stir in milk gradually. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Combine noodles sauce and ham. Pour into buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: No Bake Fruit Cake
instructions: Crumble wafers; then mix all ingredients together. Press into pan. If you have a Jell-O mold press into it. Then chill. Serve.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Mix all ingredients except peanuts in top of a double boiler. Add peanuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto wax paper.

title: Butterscotch Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 glass pan). Melt morsels and margarine. Stir in crumbs and nuts. Press 1/2 in 9 x 13-inch pan. In large mixing bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Mix Eagle Brand vanilla and egg. Pour into prepared pan and top with remaining crumb mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick into center comes out clean. Cool to room temperature and chill before cutting. Keep refrigerated!!!

title: Crispy Raisin Drops
instructions: Cream the butter and sugars until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Mix flour salt and soda. Gradually blend into creamed mixture. Stir in granola and raisins. Drop by heaping teaspoonful on greased or nonstick baking sheets. Bake at 375\u00b0 until golden brown 10 to 12 minutes. Let stand a few minutes on baking sheets before removing to wire racks to complete cooling.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Dip fresh cauliflower broccoli celery cubed radishes onions or green peppers. Blend all the ingredients well before you do so.

title: Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Dissolve sugar in evaporated milk. Add vanilla flavoring salt and bananas. Stir in sweet milk to fill line of ice cream churn. Freeze in ice cream churn as directed.

title: Chicken Acapulco
instructions: Cook chicken. Remove bones and dice. Melt oleo and stir in flour. Add sour cream; cook and stir until bubbly. Add soup chicken and chili. Put in casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove and sprinkle with cheese then bake 10 minutes longer. Serve over rice or crepes.

title: One Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll into walnut size balls and flatten on a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle each cookie with 1 tsp. red or white sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 - 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Lamb Curry And Rice
instructions: Cut lamb legs in strips. Add black pepper and salt to 3 tablespoons flour; mix good with flour. Pour 1 cup oil into skillet or frying pan. When oil is hot add lamb. Keep turning until meat is soft; then add rest of flour. Keep turning until gravy thickens. Add water; stir. Move to larger pot if needed. Cook. Lower heat for 20 minutes of until meat is soft and gravy is right. Fry bacon until crisp; chop up. Cook 1 1/2 cups rice. Put in separate bowls chopped pepper celery eggs peanuts coconut raisins orange peel bacon and curry powder. Put spoon of rice on plate and all of each kind of chopping over rice. Serves 4 to 5 people.

title: Vidalia Onion Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Saute onions in butter in large skillet until crisp-tender. Remove from heat.

title: Quick Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef in large pot. Add onion and cook 5 to 10 minutes. Drain grease off meat. Stir in the flour to thicken. Add all other ingredients. Cook about 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with crackers or cornbread. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fluffy White Icing
instructions: Cream together shortening and oleo. Add remaining ingredients. Beat until fluffy.

title: Caramel Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Whip with mixer until well blended and fluffy. Serve with apple slices.

title: Turkey Or Chicken Casserole
instructions: Partially cook noodles and set aside. Mix soup and milk; add peas meat and noodles. Layer in greased casserole half of mixture then layer of cheese. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Pour the grits into boiling water to which salt has been added. Mix well and cook until thickened. Add the butter beaten eggs milk and cheese. Stir thoroughly and place in a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Whiskey Sauce
instructions: Cream 1/2 cup butter. Add 1 cup confectioners sugar. Cream together and then blend in beaten egg. Pour into double boiler or use saucepan and heat slowly. Beat well with a wire whisk. When heated but not boiling remove from heat and add 2 tablespoons of good whiskey. Serve over steamed pudding warm apple pudding or baked apple.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix and put in bread pan. Use lid or aluminum foil.

title: Pound Cake Favorite
instructions: Cream the butter. Add 2 cups sugars (sift sugars together). Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat until well blended. Mix in flavoring. Add flour that has been mixed with baking powder. Alternate mixing flour and milk. Add egg whites that have been beaten to stiff stage; fold into batter. Pour into cake pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Zucchini Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 8 1/2-inch loaf pans or 3 (6-inch) loaf pans.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix flour soda cinnamon and salt together. Make a well in center of dry ingredients and add eggs oil and strawberries. Mix by hand. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325` for one hour.

title: Fettuccine With Fresh Tomato And Basil Sauce(Serves 6 - 358 Calories Per Each Serving)
instructions: Combine tomatoes garlic oil and salt and pepper to taste in a large bowl. Stir to mix well. Serve over hot freshly cooked fettuccine in a warmed serving bowl.

title: Barbecue Green Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large casserole. Cover and bake at 250\u00b0 for 4 hours. Remove cover the last 3 hours. Serve hot or cold. Makes enough for 12 picnic servings.

title: M&M'S Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients and chill dough about 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Irish Bread
instructions: Mix flour baking soda sugar and salt; with fingers rub in butter. Add raisins then buttermilk until moistened. On floured board knead dough for 1 minute. Add little more flour to dough if sticky. Shape dough into ball and put in buttered dish. With sharp knife cut an X on top of loaf and brush with milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Turn out on rack and cool completely before slicing.

title: Chicken Au Miel
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients in paper bag. Add the chicken and shake. Put chicken pieces skin side down in shallow casserole. Pour 1/2 cup melted margarine over. Sprinkle with remaining flour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Blend the honey lemon juice tarragon and 1/2 cup melted margarine. Turn chicken over; cover with mixture. Return to oven for another 30 minutes or longer basting twice.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine marshmallows and drained fruit. Let stand until marshmallows have softened. Combine mayonnaise whipped cream and cheese. Mix well until creamy. Add fruit. Pour into refrigerator tray and freeze 3 hours. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce with whipped cream if desired. Yields 8 large servings.

title: Cantaloupe Pie
instructions: Mix and cook in double boiler until thick. May be a little thin until cool. Pour in baked pie shell.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except bread and refrigerate overnight. Cut out middle of bread. Slice up sections removed and put around outside edge of tray. Put dip in middle of bread.

title: Bourbon Slushies
instructions: Mix together and freeze. Freeze in container you can scoop the semi-frozen slushies from. Put a couple of scoops in a glass and pour 7-Up or ginger ale over and stir. Should look like or have the consistency of a frozen Margarita.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix together the sour cream Miracle Whip onion and drained squeezed dry spinach. Blend in the soup mix. Put into an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving. It spreads well onto crackers or rye toast. It will keep for 3 days before it becomes watery.

title: No Bake Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix milk lemonade and topping together well. Spoon into pie crust. Chill well before serving. This pie freezes well.

title: Freezer Dumplings
instructions: Mix; let stand in refrigerator 2 hours. Roll thin; cut and put on cookie sheet. Freeze. When frozen put in freezer bags.

title: Quick And Easy Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Mix ground chuck salt chili sauce and oregano together lightly. Split English muffins in half. On each half spread meat mixture about 1/2-inch thick. Place several slices of onion on top of meat. Cut pieces of cheese in half and crisscross them on top of meat and onion mixture. Place in a 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve immediately.

title: Squash And Hominy Dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large skillet combine the zucchini or squash onion butter and water; cook slowly until tender. Add the hominy pepper sour cream salt and 1 cup cheese. Pour into a greased 3-quart baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with crushed corn chips. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Delight
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients in a medium bowl. Add oil and eggs; mix well. Add milk and sweet potato; mix well then add nuts last. Bake in pound cake pan for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Hamburger Sour Cream Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles according to package directions. Brown meat and drain grease. Add tomato sauce and flour. Simmer until thickened. Combine sour cream and salt. Place cooked noodles in bottom of quart casserole. Layer with the sour cream mixture and top with the hamburger mixture. Cover and bake 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Custard Pie Or Egg Pie Without Coconut
instructions: Combine eggs sugar salt milk vanilla and coconut. Blend; pour into pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0 and bake 25 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.

title: Eggless Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together flour spices soda and salt. In a bowl mix oil sugar and pumpkin by hand. Add flour mixture to pumpkin a little at a time until blended. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Put chicken in buttered dish 8 x 8-inch or 13 x 9-inch depending on number of chicken breasts. Pour undiluted soup over chicken breasts. Place 1 slice cheese on each piece of chicken. Spread prepared dressing over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add milk and cook slowly. Add cocoa and stir. Beat egg yolks and stir them into hot mixture. Add butter and vanilla. Continue stirring and cook until stiff. Cool and put in cool pie shell. Add meringue and bake until light brown. Cool.

title: Recipe For Child Raising
instructions: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Beat eggs. Add milk sugar salt cinnamon vanilla and nutmeg; beat again. Add bread and raisins then stir. Pour into a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Bake until light brown on top. Serves 8.

title: Cake Mix Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs and oil. Add remaining ingredients as desired. Mix well and drop by spoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle pecans and coconut in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions. Pour over pecans and coconut. Combine cream cheese butter and confectioners sugar; pour over cake batter leaving 1/2 to 1-inch on sides. Bake for 50 minutes. Serve from pan.

title: Loaf Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Beat eggs (separated); add other ingredients. Bake in loaf pan at 300\u00b0 for around an hour.

title: Light And Crispy Pecan Chicken(Makes Eight 3-Ounce Servings)
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Combine flour cayenne and salt. Combine egg whites and water. Combine bread crumbs and pecans. Dip chicken pieces in seasoned flour then egg whites then bread crumbs mixture. Brush sheet pan with oil. Place chicken on pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Turn chicken and bake additional 5 to 8 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cow In The Garden
instructions: Brown beef onion and green pepper. Place a layer of beef mixture a layer of corn and a layer of tomatoes in casserole; repeat ending with tomatoes. Sprinkle crumbs over top. Top with butter. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Finish filling with water up to a gallon. May freeze and serve slushy.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Cook cranberries sugar and water until thick. Before removing from heat add jello and marshmallows. Allow to dissolve. Stir in celery apples and nuts.

title: Grasshopper Pie
instructions: Combine marshmallows and milk in saucepan over low heat stirring constantly until marshmallows melt. Remove and cool. Add liqueurs. Whip cream until it peaks. Fold into marshmallow mixture and pour into pie shell. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Cream Drops
instructions: Cream the margarine cream cheese and sugar. Add egg milk and vanilla. Add cooled chocolate and dry ingredients. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Chili Mac
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling water with 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Drain off liquid. Meanwhile brown beef and onion. Add tomato juice brown sugar salt pepper chili powder and cooked macaroni. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Pour into dish and serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: 30-Minute Spanish Chicken
instructions: Heat water for the noodles and let come to a boil in a separate pot. Add noodles to boiling water when you add the mushrooms and black olives to the Spanish chicken mixture in the large skillet. Begin by sauteed chicken strips in a large/deep skillet on medium-low heat with the olive oil turning occasionally.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Let stand 5 minutes. Sift flour baking soda baking powder salt and sugar together. Add shortening and cut in with pastry blender. Add yeast to buttermilk. Add to flour mixture slowly stirring in with a fork. Turn dough out onto lightly floured board; knead several times. Roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream margarine and sugars; add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate for 8 hours. Spoon out and make a ball with dough. Put on cookie sheet and press down with a glass to make it round. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Burgundy Stew
instructions: Mix meat and vegetables in Dutch oven. Mix flour sugar and salt. Add to meat mixture. Stir in tomatoes and wine. Cook in oven for 4 hours at 325\u00b0 covered. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Orange-Date-Nut Cake
instructions: Dredge chopped nuts and dates in 1/2 cup of the flour. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat until fluffy. Sift flour salt and soda together. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add nuts dates and orange rind. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Sauce(For Potatoes, Broccoli Or Cauliflower)
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Add flour and stir into a dry paste. Add milk slowly about 1/4 cup at a time. Stir often. After all milk is added and a thickening is formed add chunks of cheese. Pour melted sauce over any vegetable.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Press bread out on greased cookie sheet. In center of dough layer the rest of the ingredients. Fold end to end and pinch together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Soak biscuits in enough milk to soften biscuits. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar 3 eggs and vanilla; mix well. If you like you may now add raisins coconut or pineapple for a different taste. Put in a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Stuffed Baked Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Rinse and dry sweet potatoes well. Place potatoes on baking sheet; bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until tender. Do not turn off oven. Cool potatoes until easy to handle. When potatoes are cool cut in half lengthwise. With spoon scoop out pulp from 8 potato halves into large bowl and discard skins. Scoop out pulp from remaining 8 potato halves leaving 1/4 inch potato intact on skin to make shells. Place pulp in same large bowl; return potato shells to same baking sheet.

title: Hello Dollies(A Perfect Treat For Any Occasion)
instructions: Melt stick of butter in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with graham cracker crumbs 1 layer of chopped walnuts 1 layer of semi-sweet chocolate bits and 1 layer of coconut. Cover with condensed milk.

title: Spinbeefchee
instructions: Squeeze liquid out of spinach. Brown beef and onion in large skillet. Add garlic salt pepper and salt. Stir in mushrooms. Cook over low heat 5 minutes; drain off all liquid. In large bowl combine tomato sauce sour cream basil oregano cottage cheese and eggs. Stir in bacon spinach and meat mixture. Add 1/2 cup Parmesan and 2/3 cup of Cheddar cheese; mix well. Spoon into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cheeses. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jellies
instructions: Combine gelatin and cold water; stir and let stand at least 5 minutes until thick.

title: Low-Fat Chicken And Noodles
instructions: Skin chicken breasts or legs. Boil until cooked. Chop in cubes. In chicken broth cook celery and broccoli just a few minutes. You still want it to be crispy. Cook noodles. Drain. Put all in 3-quart casserole dish.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Melt oleo in pan. Add the brown sugar. Mix and add eggs and vanilla. Blend in flour baking powder soda and salt. Will be thick. Spread in cookie sheet pan. Sprinkle the chocolate chips on top of mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Brown beef in a large pot. Drain fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce and water. Bring to a boil. Add spaghetti. Cover and cook on medium heat until tender (about 20 to 30 minutes) stirring occasionally. In a bowl mix Ricotta eggs parsley salt oregano and garlic powder. Scoop half of spaghetti into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top with Ricotta cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Put rest of spaghetti mix on top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. After baking let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Milly'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix together the first 7 ingredients and shape into loaf pan. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 minutes basting often. Serve with the sauce.

title: Walnut Cream Sauce(This Recipe Is For Those Times When You Throw Your Diet Out!)
instructions: Saute onions tomatoes nuts basil and garlic in olive oil for 2 minutes. Add cream and simmer until thickened. Serve over cooked fettucini immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lush Mush
instructions: Mix well and freeze. When serving fill glass one-half to three-fourths full and the rest with 7-Up. Will last a long time frozen.

title: 3-Bean Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse kidney beans with string bean juice. Drain wax beans. Dissolve sugar in vinegar. Add oil pepper and salt and stir well. Add the drained beans green pepper and onions. Stir well but gently in order to keep beans whole. Place in large covered dish and let set in refrigerator overnight mixing and stirring occasionally. Serve until thoroughly chilled.

title: Orange Macadamia Nut Cookies
instructions: In a large mixing bowl stir together flour powdered sugar and cornstarch. Using a pastry blender cut in butter till mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in nuts.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Place apple slices in pan. Mix remaining ingredients thoroughly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake 30 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown. Serve warm with cream whipped topping or ice cream.

title: Diabetic Holiday Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Serve in a chilled punch bowl.

title: Fruity Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: In an airtight container stir together cottage cheese apple dried fruit bits mayonnaise and cinnamon. Chill overnight.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Heat English peas until hot; drain liquid. Add chopped onions and mayonnaise. Mix thoroughly. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ginny'S Light Melody
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large baking dish add sausage and milk. Bake for 20 minutes. Add shredded cheese flour salt and pepper. Stir well. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Parboil cabbage onion potatoes carrots celery and bell pepper for about 20 minutes. Add parboiled vegetables to the sausage mixture. Add some vegetable broth if you have room in baking dish. Add English peas or kidney beans. Bake for 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Cut light cheese slices in half and place on top of casserole for the last 5 minutes of baking time.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and soup on low heat. Then mix shrimp onion celery and mayonnaise with cream cheese and soup. Chill for several hours. Good with chips or party crackers.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water together. When almost jelled add pineapple marshmallows and banana. Let set until jelled. Cook sugar flour egg pineapple juice and margarine stirring constantly until thick. Cook over low heat. Let cool and stir in Cool Whip. Spread over top of Jell-O and sprinkle grated cheese on top.

title: Huck Finn Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl mix margarine brown sugar eggs and vanilla until smooth. Stir in rest of ingredients until blended.

title: Church Cookies
instructions: Cream the sugars and shortening. Add eggs vanilla buttermilk and dry ingredients. Drop on a cookie sheet and flatten a little. Sprinkle sugar on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Mama'S Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until medium-hard ball stage. Take off and beat. Add pecans if desired. Beat until begins to thicken. Pour up quickly. Cut before it sets too long.

title: Hawaiian Crunch Appetizer
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cereal peanuts raisins and banana chips in ungreased jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch). Heat margarine and honey in 1-quart saucepan over low heat until margarine is melted. Stir in cinnamon and salt. Pour over cereal mixture. Toss until evenly coated. Bake for 10 minutes stirring once. Stir in popcorn and coconut. Sprinkle with additional salt if desired. Cool. Store in airtight container.

title: Chicken Rice Dinner
instructions: Combine flour salt and pepper; coat chicken pieces. In a large skillet over medium heat brown the chicken in oil. Place rice in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with onion and garlic; top with mushrooms. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water; pour over all. Place chicken pieces on top. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken juices run clear and rice is tender. Sprinkle with parsley if desired. Yields 5 servings.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order. Mix well until well blended. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff. Fold into batter. Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts if desired. Place in well-greased and floured 9-inch tube pan and bake for approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Scatter cheese in pastry shell. In a bowl beat eggs with half and half then pour onto cheese. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting. Makes 6 servings.

title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Have beef and pork ground together. Slowly saute meat onions garlic and other seasonings until meat is tender. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 4 to 5 hours.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Mix spaghetti butter eggs and Parmesan cheese together. Arrange in bottom of an ovenproof pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Cook ground beef and onions; stir in can of tomatoes tomato paste oregano and garlic salt.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut meat into serving pieces. In small bowl combine flour salt and pepper. Coat meat with seasoned flour.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Combine above ingredients. Sprinkle with Ritz crackers. Melt 1 stick oleo; pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together the Ritz crackers pecans and 1/2 cup sugar in plastic bag. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add pinch of cream of tartar 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla. Mix.

title: Artichoke Pie
instructions: Pat artichokes dry and cut in half. Blend artichokes with eggs pepperoni Mozzarella salt pepper and grated cheese. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until a toothpick when inserted comes out clean.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Wash and dry chicken. Place chicken skin side up in baking dish. Salt and pepper; dot with butter and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Adeline'S Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain off grease. Put in a 10 x 13-inch pan and add onion green pepper and margarine. Break up (uncooked) spaghetti into meat mixture. Pour tomato juice and paste on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Stir 3 times while cooking. May add cheese on top and bake a little longer. May double ingredients. Delicious even the next day.

title: Tuna Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions. Arrange broccoli in the bottom of a dish. Put tuna over broccoli. Pour soup over tuna. Crush chips and put them on the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hot. Sometimes I put slices of American cheese on top of the soup before I put the chips on. It gives it a different taste.

title: Goat Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Prepare the Pico De Gallo and set aside. Prepare the Guacamole; cover tightly with plastic wrap and set aside.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place frozen meatballs in a single layer in a baking pan for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot. In a medium saucepan combine cranberry sauce tomato sauce and 6 Tbsp. orange marmalade. Bring to a low boil and reduce to a simmer for 5 minutes. Cover meatballs in sauce and keep warm. Makes approximately 5 cups sauce.

title: Deer Hunter'S Pie
instructions: Saute the hamburger in a skillet until it is lightly browned and completely separated. Arrange a layer of potatoes over the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole. Follow with a layer of meat a layer of onions and a layer of apples. Repeat until you have used up all of the ingredients. Heat the beef stock add the nutmeg pepper and salt. Stir well so that all of the salt is dissolved. Pour this over the casserole. Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the top and add little dabs of butter if you like. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes.

title: Flower Pot Dirt Cake
instructions: Mix and set aside pudding and milk. Mix together butter and cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip. Blend into pudding mixture. In food processor crush Oreos until crumbly like dirt. Layer cookies and pudding mix in flower pot ending with cookies. (You may want to line pot with foil.) Decorate with gummy worms and silk flowers. Have fun watching peoples reactions.

title: Golden Delicious Torte
instructions: In a bowl blend butter with 1/4 cup sugar. Sift in flour baking powder and salt and blend. To the butter mixture add walnuts egg yolks lemon rind and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. Wrap in wax paper and chill for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Parfait
instructions: Divide yogurt between 2 (8 ounce) glasses and layer other ingredients with yogurt. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serves 2.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix flour sugar and cocoa; add milk. Cook until thick.

title: Spanish Lemon Pie
instructions: Separate eggs. Beat yolks. Add to yolks-the milk and the lemon juice with rind. Beat whites till stiff. Fold into egg yolk mixture.

title: Cinnamon Rolls(Serves 15)
instructions: Barely bring milk shortening and sugar to a boil. Chill. Mix yeast with lukewarm water. Add enough flour to make cake-like batter. Let rise 2 hours. Add salt soda and baking powder. Add flour to make a soft dough still sticky but not much. Refrigerate overnight. Roll out. Add butter sugar and cinnamon. Roll out and slice 1 1/2 to 2-inches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Bristol Inn Cheese Roll
instructions: Grate or break up Cheddar. Mix with cream cheese and garlic. Divide into 3 parts. Roll out by hand into uniform 1 inch thick. Roll thoroughly in chili powder. Can be made a day or two ahead. Excellent for holiday serving.

title: Grandma Garrett'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and pour over cabbage and carrots. Add mixture until it is as creamy as you like.

title: Baked Chicken Breasts
instructions: Wrap in foil unbrowned chicken with all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Sift together sugar and cocoa. Put in large bowl. Cut butter on top of mixture. Pour milk and vanilla into mixture. Dont stir. Cook 4 minutes on High. Pour into pan until it hardens. Cool then cut and eat.

title: Pepper Relish
instructions: Chop or grind as fine as you can. Let stand in warm water 30 minutes with salt. Drain. Add vinegar and sugar. Heat and seal. Makes 8 pints.

title: Mom'S Molasses Cookies
instructions: Measure first 5 ingredients into sifter. Cream shortening; add sugar; cream until fluffy. Beat in egg and molasses. Sift dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients to mixture and blend well. Form into small balls; roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with 24 graham crackers (place side by side); set aside.

title: Fruit Sangria
instructions: Mix juices of your choice of flavoring (example if you like more cranberry put more cranberry juice in mixture) then mix club soda and Sprite to desired flavoring. Chill before serving. Garnish with orange and lime slices. You can use mint and lemon if desired.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spray an 8 x 8-inch pan with Pam. Layer chicken mixture of soup sour cream and 1/2 of the stuffing mix. Layer remaining stuffing on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: In saucepan melt chocolate and butter; cool. In a small bowl beat together the 2 eggs and the 1 teaspoon vanilla; gradually add the 3/4 cup sugar. Continue beating until thick and lemon-colored. Sift together flour baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture beating well. Blend in cooled chocolate mixture and the nuts; set aside. In mixer bowl cream together cream cheese and the remaining sugar until fluffy. Blend in the remaining egg and vanilla. Spread half of the chocolate mixture in greased and lightly floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Pour cheese mixture over chocolate mixture; top with spoonfuls of the remaining chocolate mixture. With narrow spatula swirl through layers to marble. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Cut into squares when cool. Makes 16.

title: Graham Cracker Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar together. Beat yolks of eggs until light; add to this. Add milk. Roll the crackers fine. Mix baking powder with cracker crumbs; add this to other mixture together with salt and chopped nuts. Add beaten whites of eggs. Bake in 2 layers at 375\u00b0. When cool spread whipped cream (sweetened) between layers and on top of cake.

title: Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 1/2 cup hot water. Add other ingredients; stir. Congeal.

title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Combine chicken sour cream salt and pepper. Quickly fry 1 tortillas at a time in hot oil (375\u00b0) to soften. Spoon a heaping tablespoonful of chicken mixture onto each. Spread down center and roll. Place seam side down in an oiled 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. When all tortillas are filled and rolled spoon over either green chilies or enchilada sauce. Top with cheese. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and enchiladas are hot.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend graham crackers into crumbs. Melt margarine. Pour over crumbs. Press into a 9-inch pie pan.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch dish. Coat blueberries with 3/4 cup sugar and set aside. Pour pineapple into dish and then blueberries. Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit. Melt margarine and drizzle over mix. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar and chopped pecans on top. Do not stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

title: Sugar Snap Peas With Mushrooms
instructions: Cook the sugar snap peas in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Slice the mushrooms. Heat the butter and oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook until they are soft and liquid has evaporated 10 to 12 minutes. Add peas 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper; heat through 2 to 3 minutes.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Bring vinegar sugar salt and spices to a boil. Slice cucumbers and chop vegetables; mix. Pour liquid over vegetables. Store in refrigerator in jars. Stir daily for 4 to 5 days. Will keep in refrigerator.

title: Microwave Everyday Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients until well blended. Press into a 9-inch round glass cake dish. Cover with a paper towel. Microwave 14 to 17 minutes. Give dish a 1/4 turn twice during cooking. If desired spread catsup over top of meat loaf and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lazy Lasagne
instructions: Brown the ground meat and salt in Dutch oven; drain the fat. Add spaghetti mix tomatoes tomato sauce basil and a generous amount of Parmesan cheese; simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Cold Oven Cake
instructions: Combine sugar butter and Wesson oil. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix flour baking powder and salt. Add a small amount of milk and flour mixture at a time. Beat well. Add lemon and vanilla extract. Bake in large tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bessie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Blend flour sugar Crisco and milk for 2 minutes. Add eggs and vanilla; mix 1 minute on medium speed. Cook in large pan 45 minutes at 225\u00b0.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Place all ingredients into big saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat cover and cook two hours. Add sausage to beans the last 30 minutes of cooking time.

title: Pecan Crescent Danish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In a small mixing bowl combine sugar flour nuts cinnamon and butter. Mix well. Separate crescent dough into two large rectangles. Overlap long sides of rectangles. Firmly press edges and perforations to seal (this prevents separation during baking). Spread sugar and nut mixture over dough. Starting at shorter side roll up pressing edges to seal. Cut into 16 slices. Place cut side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with egg white. Bake for 12 to 18 minutes until golden brown. Frost while warm.

title: Pannekeeken
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Combine eggs flour and milk in a mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly with a wire whisk. Heat butter in 10-inch frying pan in oven while preheating. Add batter and bake for 25 minutes or until pancake is puffed and golden. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve like normal pancake. Serves 2.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Brown rice and onions in butter or margarine. Separately flour chicken and lightly brown in oil. Place mushrooms rice onion and broth in large buttered casserole dish. Add chicken cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apple celery nuts and mayonnaise; toss. If desired mound salad in lettuce cups and garnish with maraschino cherries. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Babe Ruth Bars
instructions: Can use crunchy peanut butter (use a little more if using crunchy peanut butter).

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa butter and milk in saucepan. Bring to boil. Boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat; add peanut butter vanilla and oats stirring between each item in order. May add 1 cup nuts. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Allow to cool.

title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt margarine. Add peanut butter sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Roll into balls and freeze. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip frozen candy in mixture.

title: Peanut Butter Cake
instructions: Make cake according to box directions. Make stack or sheet cake. Cool completely. Mix all other ingredients in a medium saucepan; heat over medium heat until of smooth spreading consistency. Spread on cool cake and enjoy.

title: Crab Meat Dip
instructions: In a 2-quart dish saute butter onion parsley and celery on High for 4 minutes. Stir in cream cheese and microwave on High for 1 minute. Add garlic powder Tabasco sauce salt and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Fold crab meat in gently and microwave on High for 4 minutes; serve with crackers or Melba toast.

title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken; debone. Cut in small pieces. Mix in a large bowl the chicken soups and sour cream. In a 13 x 9-inch pan line bottom with crackers. Dot with butter. Pour chicken mixture on top. Crumble crackers on top and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle top with slivered almonds.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar flour and salt in top of a double boiler. Combine egg yolks and milk; stir into flour mixture and blend well. Cook over hot water until thickened stirring constantly. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer. Cool slightly and stir in vanilla. Pour into pie shell and chill in refrigerator until firm. Before serving top with cream and sprinkle with the coconut.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Mix melted butter with box of muffin mix and both cans of corn and sour cream. Add slightly beaten eggs. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart buttered baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together the margarine and sugar at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add egg substitute and sweetener to creamed mixture; beat at medium speed for 1 minute. Stir flour oat bran baking powder and soda to blend well. Add bananas to creamed mixture along with flour mixture; beat for 1 minute at medium speed. Add nuts to batter; mix lightly. Spread evenly in greased loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Cut into 14 equal slices then serve.

title: Butterscotch Delight
instructions: Combine flour pecans and butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 and cool. (Will turn slightly white.) Cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in 1 small carton of Cool Whip with ingredients. Make butterscotch (add milk). Spread cream cheese mixture over crust. Add butterscotch mixture next. Then top with large carton of Cool Whip. Finish with chopped pecans. Refrigerate.

title: Barbari Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in very warm water; add oil. Add 1 cup flour and salt. Add flour in small amounts stirring until stiff dough is formed. Place in greased bowl cover and place in warm place to rise for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Knock down and knead until soft. Divide in 4 parts. Grease 4 baking sheets. Flatten each piece and shape into flat oblong loaves about 1/4-inch thick. Make 3 lengthwise ridges on each loaf with the side of hand. Brush with butter and sprinkle with sesame seed. Cover with cloth and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Serve at once.

title: George'S Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding oil water and eggs together. Grate chocolate and add to first mixture. Add chocolate chips and stir. Pour into greased and sugared tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done. Cool for 3 to 4 minutes and turn onto rack or plate.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Gradually add egg yolks beating well. Add soda to buttermilk. Add alternately buttermilk and flour to sugar mixture while beating slowly. Add coconut and pecans. Beat egg whites and fold into mixture. Pour mixture into 3 layer cake pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Crumble 1/2 cake in bottom of punch bowl then layer 1/2 of pudding 1 can pineapple 1 can pie filling 1 container Cool Whip 1 cup pecans and repeat as listed layered with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours (can be made the night before).

title: Chicken Elegant
instructions: Saute mushrooms in butter. Add the rest. Heat and serve on toast points rice or puff pastry shells.

title: Margaret Bobbit'S Barbecue Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and form into a loaf. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce. Chill for several hours. Serve on lettuce.

title: Hamilton Cooler
instructions: Mix and let stand in refrigerator until ready to use. Pour over ice and add a little ginger ale.

title: Mock Wild Rice
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in a heavy skillet over low heat. Add soup mix rice water and mushrooms. Simmer covered 45 minutes or until rice is tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Blueberry Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Beat egg and add the flour sugar baking powder and baking soda. Add buttermilk and vegetable oil. Whisk until mixture is smooth. Fold in fresh blueberries. For each pancake pour about 1/4 cup batter onto hot lightly greased griddle. Turn when tops are covered with bubbles and edges look cooked. Yield 8 pancakes.

title: Baked Red Snapper Fillets
instructions: Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper. Lightly dust with flour. Shake off excess. Place in single layer in lightly greased shallow casserole. Cover completely with sauce. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily with forks. Garnish with chives. Makes 4 servings.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Crush vanilla wafers with a rolling pin. Chop cherries and nuts keeping out 4 whole cherries and 16 pecan halves. Mix cherries nuts and raisins with vanilla wafer crumbs. Beat eggs well. Add sugar salt and milk. To this mixture add fruit nuts and Jacksons vanilla wafers mixture mixing well. Let stand while preparing pan with wax paper. Pack in pan. Decorate top with cherries and pecan halves. Bake in moderate oven 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well mixed. Place mixture into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken water chestnuts grapes celery and 1 cup almonds. Mix all remaining ingredients and add to chicken mixture. Chill for several hours. Serves 6 on lettuce leaves. Sprinkle with remaining almonds.

title: Chicken And Biscuit Casserole
instructions: In a greased 8 x 12-inch baking pan mix bacon chicken vegetables tomatoes and 2/3 cup grated cheese. Blend soup and milk; pour over ingredients in pan and stir. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Combine Bisquick milk and 1/2 can onions. Drop by spoonfuls to form biscuits on top. Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Top with cheese; bake until melted.

title: Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Layer in casserole dish in roaster. Cover and place in a 250\u00b0 oven. Forget it for 5 hours; do not stir until ready to serve. Do not disturb while baking.

title: Chili
instructions: In large saucepan cook and crumble meat until almost brown. Add onions pepper and garlic. Cook until meat is brown and onions are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients; bring to boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: Plum Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 to 40 minutes. Remember this is a pudding not a pie. Goes good with a tea cake.

title: Sand Tarts
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; roll in desired shape and bake until light brown at 350\u00b0. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Beef In Cheese Crescents
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Brown beef with onion drain. Stir in barbecue sauce set aside. Unroll dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides; firmly press perforations and edges to seal. Form a 15 x 13 inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4 inch wide strip down center of dough to with in one inch of ends. Top with cheese. Fold shorter sides of dough 1 inch over filling. Bring long sides of dough over filling over lapping edges; pinch edges to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 20- 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Mix together cornstarch and sugar. Add 1 cup milk. Beat together eggs and 2 cups milk. Mix all together and keep stirring. Cook slow until thickened; then beat in vanilla 3 cups milk and evaporated milk. Makes one gallon. Serve with your favorite fruit toppings.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Combine sugar vanilla salt water flour and oleo. Bring to a rolling boil. Peel and core apples. Stretch and wrap each apple half in 1 biscuit. Lay wrapped apple flat side down in baking dish. Pour hot sauce over apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until a beautiful golden brown basting occasionally while baking.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix together and put into a well-greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream oil sugar and eggs. Sift flour and salt and add alternately with buttermilk. Add soda and vanilla. Add red food coloring mixing well. Bake in three 8-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Put gelatin and lime rind into blender container. Add boiling water. Cover and blend at medium speed until gelatin is dissolved and rind is finely chopped. Add lime juice and egg yolks. Cover blend at medium speed until thoroughly mixed. Add condensed milk. Cover and blend at medium speed until mixed. Beat egg whites with electric mixer until stiff but not dry. Fold gently into lime mixture. Turn into crust. Chill until set. Makes one 9-inch pie.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and oranges well. Mix all other ingredients with drained fruit. Chill in refrigerator overnight.

title: Raspberry Icebox Dessert
instructions: In a bowl combine gelatin and water. Stir until gelatin is dissolved.\tFold in raspberries. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until syrupy. In a small bowl combine the cracker crumbs brown sugar and butter. Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. In a mixing bowl beat the milk and pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes. In another bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add the pudding mixture. Layer over crust. Spoon gelatin mixture over the top. Chill until set. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Blend oleo and sugar. Mix flour baking powder and salt together. Alternate flour mixture with 1/2 cup milk and oleo mixture. Lay peaches in bottom of pan (1 large can of peaches drained). Pour mixture over top. In separate bowl mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg and 3/4 cup sugar. Sprinkle over top. Pour 1 cup boiling water over mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix eggs with milk and salt. Sift the flour and baking powder together.\tAdd to liquid. When ingredients are well mixed stir in lard. Bake in waffle iron until done. (Use about 3/4 cup mix for each waffle.) Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 5 waffles.

title: Baked Asparagus
instructions: Combine asparagus crackers and eggs. Cut eggs in quarters. Make a rich white sauce using liquid from the asparagus butter and milk. Thicken with cornstarch. Add 1/2 cup shredded cheese and a pinch of garlic is optional. Pour white sauce over other ingredients and stir. Roll about 6 crackers and sprinkle over top dotted with butter. Bake at about 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Apple Butter
instructions: In a roaster (no lid) mix everything together. Bake at 325\u00b0 stirring 2 to 3 times per hour until thick. Pour into hot jars and process 10 minutes or freeze after the jars cool. Yields nearly 7 pints.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Pour rice in bottom of casserole dish. Add 1 cup of chicken broth. Add chicken breasts that have been broken into small pieces. Add soups that have been mixed with water as can directs. To the stuffing mix add melted margarine and 1 cup of broth; spread over casserole. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes.

title: Ham Creole
instructions: Cook chopped onion and chopped pepper in 2 tablespoons fat for a few minutes. Add stewed tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add ham cubes and cook 5 minutes longer. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown ground chuck or turkey and drain fat. In a large pot add onion soup mix to meat. Stir in chili beans tomatoes tomato sauce salsa and chili seasoning. Cook until hot. Feeds about 6.

title: Zesty Carrots(Serves 8)
instructions: Mix onion horseradish and mayonnaise together with the liquid. Place cooked carrots in a buttered casserole dish. Pour mixture over top of carrots. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and top with melted butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Goulash
instructions: In a large skillet cut bacon into small pieces and cook to crisp stage; drain. Add hamburger stirring until done. Add onion celery green pepper rice tomato sauce plus 1/2 can water. With lid on simmer for approximately 20 minutes or until rice is done. If too dry add either more water or tomato sauce (to taste). Just before serving and while still hot grate cheese over top.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Mix flour baking powder brown sugar and rolled oats. Cut in butter until blended. Press 2/3 in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread this crust with the jam. Sprinkle on the remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 35 minutes. Cool and cut. Makes 24 bars.

title: Beefy Chili Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef; drain. Add all remaining ingredients. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Pizza
instructions: Mix and knead into ball (in mixing bowl) the first 5 ingredients. Set aside in warm place and cover with a towel for 1 hour. Toss or roll into a circle on greased pizza pan. Add pizza sauce and cheese. You may add any other ingredients that you may wish. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Let sit for 2 to 3 minutes before cutting.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix first four ingredients together and pat into cookie sheet with sides. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients; pour on crust. Return to oven for 25 minutes longer. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Combine the flour and salt; set aside. Cream the oleo and sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time. Combine soda and buttermilk. Add 1/2 cup flour mixture to the coconut. Add buttermilk mixture alternately with flour mixture. Add candy mixture. Turn into 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured). Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

title: Savory Crescent Chicken Squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl blend cream cheese and 2 tablespoons margarine (reserve 1 tablespoon) until smooth. Add the next 6 ingredients; mix well. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal. Spoon 1/2 cup meat mixture onto center of each rectangle. Pull 4 corners of dough to top center of chicken mixture; twist slightly and seal edges. Brush tops with reserved 1 tablespoon margarine. Dip in crouton crumbs. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Makes 4 sandwiches.

title: Polish Chop Suey
instructions: Brown and drain beef and onion. Add to cooked cabbage and cooked noodles.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix pudding mix sour cream eggs and oil. Stir until blended. In separate bowl mix sugar nuts and cinnamon. Grease well and flour a Bundt cake pan. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of nut mixture in bottom. Spoon in 1/2 of cake batter on top. Top this with remaining mixture; then put in rest of the batter. Do not preheat oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Put drained vegetables in a casserole dish. Spread raw hamburger over vegetables. Pour soup over meat. Lay Tater Tots over top. Bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. A nice meal in one dish.

title: Green Bean Bundles
instructions: Drain the green beans; wrap a half piece of bacon around 5 or 6 green beans. Place them seam side down in a glass 9 x 12 baking dish. When the dish is full pour the whole bottle of dressing over the bean bundles. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hobo Supper
instructions: Will need a 12-inch square of foil for each serving.

title: Mom'S Favorite Recipe
instructions: Place all in well-greased car and head for nearest restaurant.

title: Patti'S Fried Chicken
instructions: Wash the chicken and pat dry. Marinate chicken in covered bowl of the buttermilk. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Gradually add sugar until thick. Add remaining ingredients then process in ice cream machine.

title: Chocolate Pixies
instructions: Melt the margarine and cocoa in a saucepan on low. Take off heat then add the sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add the flour baking powder and salt. Mix with wooden spoon and cool for awhile. Roll into 1/2-inch balls into powdered sugar. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes until just set.

title: Dewberry Pie
instructions: Place dewberries into pie shells. Mix next 5 ingredients and pour over berries. Mix last 3 ingredients until crumbly and sprinkle over custard and berries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Cherry Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta and drain. Rinse with cold water. Combine chicken pasta celery onions and cherries.

title: Easy Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake in baking pan by directions on box. While cake is still hot poke holes in top of cake pour whole can of Eagle Brand milk over cake. It will soak into cake. Make icing by recipe box. Ice cake and sprinkle coconut over top. Delicious.

title: Pumpkin Cake(Very Easy To Prepare And Freezes Well.)
instructions: Combine all cake ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer until thoroughly blended. Add raisins. Pour batter in a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until cake tests done. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack. For variety try white pecans or chopped pecan or walnuts to the cake batter.

title: Bola'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix flour into sugar. Add cocoa milk and egg yolks. Cook in\tdouble\tboiler until thick. Add vanilla and butter; cool. Whip whites of eggs and after filling has cooled pour into crust. Top with meringue.\tBrown top in oven.

title: No Bake Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour into baked pie shell; top with Cool Whip.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour and sugar in bowl. Mix cheese and pineapple in bowl. Pour flour and sugar over pineapple and mix. Put into 9x13 glass baking dish.\tCrush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top of pineapple mixture. Melt butter and pour over Ritz crackers. Pour juice over crackers. Bake 30-40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 15-20.

title: Grandma'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually. Beat constantly. Add eggs one at a time. Beat hard after each egg. Fold in flour and pour into a buttered and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Potato-Tuna Salad
instructions: Place potatoes in saucepan; cover with water and boil until tender (about 10 minutes). Drain potatoes and cut into bite-size pieces. Toss potatoes with remaining ingredients and refrigerate until cold. Yield about 6 cups. Per serving Calories 135. Carbohydrate 15 g. Protein 10 g. Fat 4 g. Sodium 352 mg. Exchanges per serving 1 starch/bread and 1 lean meat.

title: Picnic Passion
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl combine pineapple and pudding mix. Let stand about 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients except cherries. Fold together. Garnish if desired. Chill until serving time.

title: Brown'S Cream Cheese And Onion Spread
instructions: Get cream cheese soft. Add chopped onion olives and cheese; then add mayonnaise. Mix well. Better if left overnight before using. Good on crackers or whole wheat bread.

title: Charlotte'S Chicken & Rice
instructions: Boil one whole chicken. When done debone and strain the broth. Add two cups of rice to the broth and cook rice per directions. Add deboned chicken two cans of cream of mushroom soup and one can of cream of chicken soup onion celery seed and black pepper to taste.

title: Buttermilk Gravy
instructions: Melt grease in a skillet. Add meal and brown. Add salt and pepper; brown some more. Add buttermilk and water; stir until thick.

title: Spiced Walnuts
instructions: Combine sugar cinnamon cream of tartar and water in heavy saucepan. Cook to 246\u00b0 on candy thermometer firm-ball stage. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spread.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Beat together first 4 ingredients. Fold in remaining. Beat well; put in 3 (1 pound) coffee cans or 2 bread pans (greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Put a pan of water in the oven for moisture.

title: Lemon Whipper Snaps
instructions: Combine cake mix topping and egg. Drop by teaspoonfuls into sugar. Roll in balls. Place on a Pam sprayed cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Place on wire rack to cool. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Prick bottom of unbaked pie shell with fork and rub a mixture of 1 tablespoon each flour and sugar into holes (this prevents a soggy crust). Bake 10 minutes in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place seasoning packet and butter in bowl. Add water then stuffing mix. Toss. Mix soup and milk in casserole dish. Stir in chicken vegetables and thyme. Cover with stuffing.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients as listed stirring well as moistened. Pour into well-greased 9-inch skillet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 or 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Clam Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease 9-inch layer cake pan or quiche dish. Spread mixture evenly in pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot with your favorite crackers.

title: Fudge Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put in buttered pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Patchworks Pasta
instructions: Cook and drain macaroni. Chop heads and stems of broccoli. Crumble the bacon. Mix everything together. Add Miracle Whip vinegar and sugar as the dressing. Cool before serving.

title: Fettucini With Spinach
instructions: In a large skillet cook spinach and garlic in oil for 5 minutes stirring frequently. Dissolve bouillon in water or spinach juice. Add bouillon mixture basil and cottage cheese to spinach. Stir over low heat to blend. Toss spinach mixture grated cheeses and noodles together in a large bowl that has been heated. Garnish with fresh parsley. Refrigerate leftovers if there are any. Serve with garlic bread or breadsticks.

title: Polish Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Boil cabbage removing each leaf just as it becomes tender. Drain leaves. Mix ground beef rice and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Line bottom of 4 1/2-quart pot with sauerkraut. Place 3 to 4 tablespoons of meat mixture in center of leaf and roll bringing in sides of leaf as you roll. Arrange cabbage rolls in pot stacking as you go. Place remaining leaves over top. Pour V-8 juice over top. Simmer on low for 3 to 4 hours.

title: Sandbakkles
instructions: Combine ingredients in order. Put in sandbakkle tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter And M&M Cookies
instructions: Stir together flour soda and salt. In a mixer bowl beat butter for 30 seconds. Add peanut butter and sugars; beat until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture; beat until well combined. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar if desired. Place 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet; crisscross with tines of a fork. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes. Press M&Ms into cookies before baking. Makes 48.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda together and place aside. Cream shortening with sugar and add beaten eggs and beat until mixture is smooth and fluffy. Add peanut butter and really beat. Fold flour mixture into sugar mixture and add vanilla.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add lemon juice and put in refrigerator until it gets slightly thickened. Blend or whip cream cheese and sugar then whip or blend large can of Pet milk to cream cheese and sugar. (Optional to add extra half of lemon juice to Pet milk and cream cheese and sugar mixture while blending.) Mix jello mixture with cream cheese sugar and milk until creamy. Pour into crust and chill for several hours.

title: Sheet Cake(For Birthday, Etc.)
instructions: Cream Crisco. Add sugar and eggs. Mix flours together. Add flour alternately with milk. Add flavorings. Cook in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Grease bottom only. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Gallon Jug Muffins
instructions: Mix together oats All-Bran shredded wheat (4 large biscuits) and oil. Pour boiling water over all and let cool. Then add buttermilk eggs and sugar and mix. Sift together salt flour and baking soda. Mix all together well and store in glass gallon jar in refrigerator. Keeps fresh up to 3 months.

title: Crab Balls
instructions: Saute onion pepper and celery in oil. Mix rest of the ingredients together and shape into balls. Deep fry until brown. Serve hot or cold with seafood sauce.

title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour baking powder and salt. Cream butter; add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add egg vanilla and milk. Add sifted dry ingredients then gradually add remaining flour until dough is stiff enough to handle. Chill at least 1 hour. Roll 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board and shape with floured cookie cutters. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Sprinkle with plain or tinted sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Fried Fish Batter
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Coat fish with pancake mix. Dip fillets in batter. Fry 4 to 6 minutes.

title: Rice, Cheese And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients in casserole (2-quart). Bake uncovered for 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Stir occasionally. May top with cracker crumbs if desired.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream the first 4 ingredients together. In a separate bowl mix all dry ingredients together. Add the flour mixture to the wet mixture and mix well. Add nuts if desired. Place on a greased cookie sheet by teaspoon and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Baked Beans Deluxe
instructions: 1) Brown beef with onion.

title: Hot Sauce
instructions: Mix in large pan and cook over low heat. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Cook to desired consistency about 2 hours. Pour into sterilized jars and seal. Process in boiling water bath for 35 minutes.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Drain salmon and add all remaining ingredients except bacon. Mix well and put in greased loaf pan. Top with bacon slices. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with green peas.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and roll into 1-inch balls. In a double boiler melt chocolate chips and wax. Dip peanut butter balls in chocolate mixture. Place on wax paper and cool.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Boil chicken. While boiling scrape away top layer of film. Add vegetables. Cook until tender. Strain. Cook spaghetti in broth.

title: Creamy Pralines
instructions: Boil first 4 ingredients in a 4-quart heavy gauge aluminum pot. While this is boiling burn 4 tablespoons sugar on the side in a Teflon pot until dark brown. Remove from heat. When cooled enough add about a cupful of the candy mixture. Stir until well mixed to keep from caramelizing then pour back into mixture. When soft ball forms when added to cold water remove from heat and add a pinch of soda and vanilla. Beat until its ready to drop on slightly greased cookie sheet.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar and cocoa. Put eggs in medium bowl and beat with a fork until fluffy. Mix other ingredients into eggs stirring until smooth and bubbly. Pour into 9-inch prepared or frozen crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 on bottom rack. Pie is done when center shakes like congealed jello and knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes one pie. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

title: Chicken In Cream And Butter Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Flour chicken and place in greased baking dish uncovered. Bake until golden brown (about 20 to 30 minutes). Remove from oven and put butter on top of chicken. Bake until butter is melted. Remove from oven and cover the chicken 2/3 of the way with milk. Cover and place back in oven for 45 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Passover Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and 3 ounces of chocolate in pan in a 325\u00b0 oven. In bowl beat 2 eggs sugar and cake meal. Add melted shortening and chocolate mixture. Beat well and add remaining chocolate bits. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Butterscotch Pecan Fudge
instructions: Combine pudding mix brown sugar milk sugar pecans butter and vanilla in saucepan. Bring to a boil; cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Beat until cool. Pour into buttered pan. Cut into squares.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Grate cabbage and carrot in bowl. Add diced celery. Mix all other ingredients in small bowl and thin with milk or cream to your taste. Add to cabbage mixture. Mix together. Chill and serve.

title: Christmas Gumbo
instructions: Cook together for 10 minutes the butter onion celery carrots and turnips. Add peppercorns bay leaves cloves vinegar water lemon peel and fish.

title: Country Ham-Redeye Gravy
instructions: Place ham slices in a cold cast-iron skillet. Cook over medium heat until fat is crisp turning several times for even cooking. Remove ham to warm platter. Pour excess fat from skillet leaving about 2 tablespoons. Stir sugar into fat and meat drippings in skillet. Add coffee and water; heat to boiling. Serve over ham slices.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix other ingredients with yeast. Let stand\t15 minutes after cutting out and before putting in oven.\tBake 12 to 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. (Can be frozen.)

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine over low heat and add milk; add cocoa and sugar. Stir well then turn setting to high and bring to a boil. Boil one minute on high then turn down one notch and boil 1 1/2 to 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and add vanilla (and nuts if desired). Place pan in cold water and beat fudge until it loses its gloss and thickens enough to spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: In blender combine and blend for 1 minute the eggs milk Bisquick cheese and butter. Grease and flour a 9 to 10-inch pie pan. Place in bottom of dish the bacon ham or sausage onions and green pepper. Pour blender mixture over chopped items. Let stand for 5 minutes before baking. Sprinkle with nutmeg and pepper over top and bake 55 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish mix soup water and rice. Pour in a casserole dish and arrange chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle dried soup on top and cover with aluminum foil and cook in oven for 1 hour at 370\u00b0.

title: Heavenly Hash Salad
instructions: Cream together cream cheese and mayonnaise add fruit cocktail oranges and marshmallows; mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Cool Whip and place in freezer until ready to serve.

title: Authentic Irish Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Remove core from cabbage (as much as possible). Boil whole cabbage until it is soft enough to roll the leaves but not fully cooked. Leaves will peel off one at a time.

title: One Leg Turkey And Dressing
instructions: Cut off one leg and thigh of turkey. Cook using broth for dressing plus broth from baking turkey. Mix bread ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Next cool bread. Mix with broth eggs celery onion deboned turkey meat and salt and pepper to taste. When you think too soupy mixture is just right to bake. (No dry dressing.) Bake in moderate oven about 30 minutes or until light brown and bubbly.

title: Banana Nut Bread(Makes 3 Loaves)
instructions: Beat eggs bananas and oleo. Add to dry ingredients and stir just enough to combine. Add nuts. Pour into well-greased and floured loaf pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Put crushed pineapple sugar and lemon juice in pan; simmer for 5 minutes. Dissolve lemon jello in 2 1/3 cups hot water. Stir in previous ingredients with jello; mix well and set in refrigerator until almost firm. Add 1 cup grated cheese and the whipping cream. Set until firm.

title: Better Than Ever Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions using milk instead of water. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat pineapple with sugar. Punch holes in cake. Pour hot pineapple mixture over cake. Mix pudding according to directions; blend in cream cheese. Spread on cooled cake. Slice bananas over pudding mixture. Cover with Cool Whip coconut and cherries.

title: Clothes Pin Cookies
instructions: Add sugar to flour. Cut in 1/4 of the Fluffo. Add eggs and water. Mix as for dough. Place dough in refrigerator for 1 hour then roll out and spread with 1/4 of Fluffo (fold like envelope). Repeat this 3 times. Will take 3 hours in all. Take 1/4 of the dough at a time and roll. Cut into 8-inch strips. Wind loosely around clothespins. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 minutes then at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Work off pins and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a bowl combine sugar oil and egg. In another bowl combine baking soda salt and vanilla; add to sugar combination. Alternately add flour; mix well. Fold in raw rhubarb and nuts; spoon into 2 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 3-inch bread pans. Combine sugar and melted butter; mix thoroughly. Scatter on top of dough. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from pan immediately; cool.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: In a 4 quart pan brown beef sausage and onion. When brown add soup\tpuree\ttomatoes and seasoning. Add 1 (14 ounce) can water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 to 2 hours. Stir often. If mixture becomes too thick add water to desired thickness and simmer. Can be frozen.

title: Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Mix Jell-O with hot water. Stir well. Add strawberries pineapple and bananas. Pour half of the mixture into mold (set other aside). Put mold into refrigerator. When mixture is firm spread most of the sour cream on top then add liquid mixture that has been set aside. Set mold in refrigerator until set.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Cream the cream cheese; add marshmallow cream. When well blended add Cool Whip. Serve with chunks of cantaloupe honeydew melon pineapple apple banana grapes strawberries etc.

title: Chicago Style Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch pie pan. Brown ground meat and onion; drain off grease. Stir in pizza sauce Parmesan cheese oregano salt and pepper. Simmer while preparing crust. Arrange biscuits in pan. Press over bottom and sides. Parbake for 10 minutes. Spoon on meat mixture. Put on mushrooms etc. Sprinkle on Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Place flour sugar and salt in large bowl. Mix well. Add Crisco and mix until crumbly. In small bowl mix 1/2 cup water vinegar and egg. Combine two mixtures and stir well with fork. Makes 3 to 4 (9-inch) crusts.

title: Apple Pudding Dessert
instructions: Combine the flour oleo and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Pat this crust mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Cherry Dessert Squares
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs and melted oleo by hand. Spread in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Spread cherry pie filling over cake mixture. Add chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Drizzle with glaze mixture when cooled. Cut in 1-inch squares.

title: The Big Dipper
instructions: Cook chili in a medium saucepan until hot. Spread cream cheese and cover a 10-inch round dish. Pour heated chili over cream cheese. Spread shredded cheese over chili layer and top evenly. Dip Fritos Scoops into dip and enjoy!

title: Party Smokies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Slice bacon strips in thirds. Wrap 1/3 bacon strip around a Little Smokie. Secure bacon with a toothpick. Place in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Sprinkle brown sugar to cover. Drizzle water on top. Bake until bacon is cooked (around 50 minutes).

title: Vegetables, Different Ways
instructions: Season with your choice Hi-Energy Onion Chicken Asparagus Mushroom Soup Supplements etc. and canola oil.

title: Pot O' Beans
instructions: Fry drain and crumble bacon. Leave grease in pan and add next 6 ingredients. Drain beans. Add beans and bacon to mixture. Cook slowly 20 minutes on stove then bake covered 30 to 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 or use crock-pot.

title: Swedish Apple Pie(Easy, Quick, Yummy Dessert)
instructions: Mix the first five ingredients together with a fork. Grease pie plate. Peel and core apples (enough to fill to heaping); put into pie plate and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Spoon dough on top of fruit and bake at 325\u00b0 until golden brown or about 1 hour.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix lemonade and condensed milk until thick. Add Cool Whip until all mixed together; pour into crust. Refrigerate until set.

title: Easy Guacamole Dip
instructions: In a small bowl with a fork mash soft ripe avocados. Add dash of lemon juice to prevent darkening. Salt and pepper to taste. Add garlic powder if desired. Blend in one jar of Gerber garden vegetable. Add picante sauce and garnish with nacho chips and enjoy.

title: Microwave Apple Crunch
instructions: To the oleo stir in the next 5 ingredients. Mix and set aside. In an 8-inch square microwave-safe dish put the sliced apples. Toss with the sugar. Sprinkle topping evenly over apples. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes on High. Rotate halfway through. Let stand on heatproof surface for 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Herb Seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Toss gently with a spoon until well blended. Store in an airtight container in a cool dry dark place for up to six months. Makes approximately 1 cup. Use with chicken fish and turkey.

title: Play Dough For Children
instructions: Mix together then heat in a frypan until cooked through stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. Turn onto table and knead. Add a few drops of food coloring.

title: Shrimp Dish
instructions: Boil shrimp 7 minutes or until pink. Chill. Remove shells and devein. Chop into small pieces.

title: Cucumber-Onion Salad
instructions: If you like sugar to your own taste (I like about 6 teaspoons). Peel and thinly slice cucumbers and onion. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Marinate for several hours in the refrigerator.

title: Raspberry Jam
instructions: Bring the tomatoes and sugar to a rolling boil for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off heat. Add the Jell-O. Stir until dissolved. Pour into jars and seal.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Mix well. Shape; roll in flour and fry. Place in skillet. Cover with mushroom soup and 1 can water. Simmer until done.

title: Grandma'S Peanut Butter Cookies
