instructions: Cream together the butter peanut butter sugars and eggs. Add flour salt and soda. Mix together. Roll in walnut size balls and flatten with a fork or bottom of a glass. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 325\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Noodles And Tomatoes
instructions: Boil noodles until done. Drain water and add tomatoes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Squash Pie
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain and mash. Cream sugar and margarine. Add squash and flour. Mix well. Beat egg and add to mixture. Add remaining ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Boil 6 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in pectin; boil 3 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from heat and skim off foam with a metal spoon. Quickly pour hot jelly into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims. Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. Yields 7 half-pints.

title: Shortcake
instructions: Mix together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. This is a heavy sweet cake for strawberries etc. (somewhat like a sugar cookie).

title: Rice And Black Bean Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Before serving use this topping

title: Potatoes Poupon
instructions: In medium saucepan over medium heat cook shallots in 1 tablespoon butter or margarine until tender. Stir in cream mustard and remaining butter or margarine. Simmer for 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low; add 1/2 cup shredded cheese and basil stirring until cheese melts.

title: Easy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone. Add broth to chicken. Mix croutons onion and celery together. Add soup and chicken with broth. Put into a large oiled casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients including sugar into a large mixing. Make a well in dry ingredients and add all remaining ingredients. Mix until smooth. Divide batter into greased and floured loaf pans (2). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Allow to cool before removing from pan.

title: Pecan Balls
instructions: Cream the margarine and confectioners sugar. Add vanilla flour and salt. Mix and add pecans. Roll in balls. Put on cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar after cool.

title: Beef And Potato Bake
instructions: Place uncooked ground beef in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish. Cover with a layer of onion slices. Add a layer of frozen Tater Tots covering beef and onion. Spread soup evenly over top. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Surprise Casserole
instructions: Place chicken potatoes milk soup and corn in greased casserole. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crunchy Chicken Cheese Bake
instructions: Place chicken in oblong pan. Top with cheese. Stir soup and spread over cheese. Top with tomatoes. Combine margarine and stuffing; sprinkle over tomatoes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Serve over rice. Garnish with oregano (optional).

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cheese; stir in pineapple 1 cup pecans and seasoned salt. Mix everything and let harden. Form into ball and roll in remaining pecans.

title: Cream Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix flour oleo and 1 C. nuts together. Put into the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool. Cream the cheese and sugar. Fold in 1 C. Cool Whip; spread on first layer. Mix well the vanilla pudding and milk. Pour onto the second layer and spread out. Use remaining whipped topping and pour over third layer. Cover with nut halves shaved chocolate or coconut. Refrigerate. Can be made a day ahead and kept in the refrigerator.

title: Meal-In-One
instructions: Cook macaroni in a large amount of boiling water until tender. Drain. Rinse in cold water. Melt fat in a large skillet. Add onion and cook until lightly browned. Add beef salt and pepper; cook until meat is done. Add macaroni tomatoes and chili powder. Turn mixture into baking dish and sprinkle cheese over top. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Heavenly Harmony Rhubarb
instructions: In small bowl mix flour sugar and oleo. Spread in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. In medium bowl mix egg yolks 2 cups white sugar flour salt cream and rhubarb. Pour over crust. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with meringue made with egg whites 8 tablespoons sugar and vanilla. Beat whites; add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time. Add vanilla. Spread on cake and brown lightly.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Add onion when beef is done. Remove from heat and cover. Mix chopped lettuce diced tomatoes and Cheddar cheese. Add bag of crumbled Doritos. Mix with Catalina dressing until well coated.

title: King Ranch Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add soups tomatoes broth milk olives and chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Grease or Pam a 9 x 12-inch dish. Layer chicken mixture and tortillas ending with chicken mixture. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 hour.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar oleo and dates. Cook for 5 minutes. Pour in Krispies and pecans. Butter hands; make into balls and roll in coconut flakes.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Press butter peanut butter cracker crumbs and sugar into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not bake. Spread topping over peanut butter mixture and refrigerate; then cut into squares.

title: Fun Sub
instructions: Thaw bread dough as instructed on package. Roll into rectangle then cut strips on each side approximately 2-inches deep. Fill center with meats cheese and dressing. Braid the strips of bread over center of meats. Brush top with egg white. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Microwave Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix baking mix paprika salt and pepper; coat chicken. Arrange pieces skin side up in microwavable dish with thickest part toward edges. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on High for 10 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave additional 8 to 12 minutes until done.

title: Mix Casserole
instructions: Brown in butter onion hamburger meat and bell pepper. Place in large bowl and mix all the other ingredients to it.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Mix 2-3 lb. raw hamburger as you would normally for meatloaf. Flatten the meatloaf out on a cookie sheet in the shape of a rectangle. Take 1 pkg. frozen broccoli thawed and drained and lay it down the middle 1/3 of the rectangle the long way. Roll up rectangle from both sides to the middle. Turn the roll so the seam is on the bottom. Pinch the ends closed and cook as you would regular meatloaf. You can use any vegetable and you can add cheese to the middle.

title: English Pea Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and garlic until clear but not brown. Combine all remaining ingredients except cheese and dried crumbs with onion and garlic. Pour into casserole and top with cheese and crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 until hot (about 30 minutes).

title: Chris' Favorite Mini Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and pumpkin until light and fluffy. Stir together the dry ingredients. Add to pumpkin mixture. Pour into mini muffin pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla. Stir until sugar dissolves over medium heat. When mixture comes to rapid boil 1 minute. Add vanilla. Cool and beat.

title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
instructions: Combine flour sugar spices and salt. Add apples and lemon juice. Stir and combine. Place in a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dot with butter. Roll pastry 1-inch longer than top of pan. Cut vents. Trim and flute edge just inside of pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 about 50 minutes until pie is brown and apples are tender.

title: Cube Steak Special
instructions: Flour and salt steaks and brown. Toast buttered bread in oven. Place 1 slice of meat on each slice. Keep warm. Add remaining ingredients to drippings in skillet. Heat to boiling. Pour over steaks.

title: Shrimp And Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and add other ingredients. Stir in soup. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Garnish top with pimento. Cook in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Toffee Topped Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease 13 x 9 inch baking pan. In large bowl mix together the brown sugar and flour. Use a pastry cutter or 2 knives to cut butter into mixture until it is course crumbs. Remove 1 cup of mixture set aside.

title: Nutty Apple Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine apples celery grapes and marshmallows. In a chilled mixing bowl beat milk until frothy. Add sugar salt and vanilla. Beat in mayonnaise and peanut butter. Pour over apple mixture; stir until coated. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving stir in nuts if desired. Yield 12 to 14 servings.

title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
instructions: Mix until crumbly. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Apple Impromptu
instructions: Pour pie filling in 8-inch cake pan and cover with topping. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Mix soup milk noodles peas and cheese in a large bowl. Pour into casserole dish. Dot with butter. Sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. In medium bowl combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. In large bowl beat (with mixer at medium speed) peanut butter and corn syrup until smooth. Beat in eggs one at a time. Gradually beat in milk. Stir in flour mixture just until moistened. Pour in pan; bake 50 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing from pan to wire rack.

title: Peanut Butter Clusters
instructions: Stir well the sugar and Karo; put on stove and bring to a boil. Add crunchy peanut butter. Take off stove and quickly add Special K cereal. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper. A favorite of all sand baggers.

title: Magnificient Mushroom Surprise
instructions: Beat these ingredients together in a large bowl. Wrap in floured cloth or waxed paper and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Broccoli Bites
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain and place in a bowl. Add the remaining ingredients; mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place in a greased 15-inch x 10-inch x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 11 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Place remaining in a single layer in a freezer container and freeze for up to 1 month. Yield about 5 dozen.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork
instructions: Brown pork in small amount of oil. Add 1/2 cup of water and simmer 1 hour. Combine pineapple juice sugar flour salt vinegar and soy sauce. Add to pork and cook until gravy thickens. Add pineapple pepper strips and onions. Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Sift flour baking powder soda salt cloves nutmeg ginger and cinnamon and add to mixture; stir in. Mix well and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Frost when cooled.

title: 4 Layer Dessert
instructions: First Layer Mix flour nuts and margarine. Press in 9 x 12-inch glass baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Made Up Pie
instructions: Whip cream cheese until fluffy and set aside. Whip Jell-O in milk and Cool Whip. Blend into the cheese. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with fresh fruit if desired or add nuts or brickles or be creative. Refrigerate overnight. Serves 6. Must do ahead.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Sift sugar and flour into large bowl. Put margarine Crisco water and cocoa in saucepan. Bring to a rapid boil. Pour this over sugar and flour mixture; stir well. Add buttermilk mixed with soda eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until done.

title: Pretty Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook drain well and chill pasta. Combine with remaining ingredients. Chill. Serve fairly soon after preparation.

title: Frog Eyes
instructions: Mix cream cheese and Worcestershire sauce; spread over slices of bread. (Cut crust off.) Roll each pickle in one slice of bread; chill and then slice.

title: Frosted Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream the oleo or butter brown sugar and vanilla and add beaten eggs. Combine flour with soda baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture to batter alternately with sour cream. Stir in nuts. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Fried Banana Bread
instructions: Mash the banana and all the ingredients. Keep adding water little by little and mix well until you get a batter as thick as the muffin baller. Heat oil and drop the batter into the oil with a tablespoon. When it is golden brown turn it over. Take it out when both sides are golden brown.

title: Mock Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Mix all together; place in a small casserole. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 cup noodles on top. Cashew nuts may be used on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add dry ingredients. Mix and shape into 4 rolls. Wrap in wax paper and store in refrigerator. Slice and bake as needed on ungreased baking sheets. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Easy Cookie Recipe
instructions: Drop by teaspoon on greased sheet and bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Shrimp Newburg
instructions: 1. Peel and devein shrimp removing tails.

title: Beef Fajitas
instructions: Cut steak into paper thin slices. Combine next 9 ingredients and marinate at least 4 hours.

title: Potato Stuffed Sausage
instructions: Cut sausage pieces lengthwise almost through to bottoms. Spread open. Place cut sides up in ungreased baking dish. Prepare potatoes and stir in onions and mustard. Spread over sausage pieces and sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Dump together and stir. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Combine split peas and water in soup kettle. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 1 hour. Add vegetables bay leaf and thyme. Simmer partially covered 2 1/2 hours or until peas are soft. Press mixture through food mill. Return to kettle. Add knockwurst and additional water if necessary. Simmer 30 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with croutons. (I skip the food mill since we like the vegetables as they are.)

title: Spinach Souffl
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare a souffl dish by lightly brushing with olive oil; set aside. In a large frying pan cook the onion and garlic in olive oil until softened but not browned 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in spinach souffl Parmesan cheese and pepper. Spoon into prepared souffl dish.\tPlace on baking sheet and bake for 60 to 75 minutes. Top will be browned when done. Adjust baking time according to your oven.\tCan be served immediately or at room temperature. Serves 10.

title: Banana Sour Cream Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs sour cream bananas and vanilla. Mix well. Add baking powder baking soda and salt. Add flour. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0 or in a tube pan for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken In Beer
instructions: Wash and dry chicken pieces. Put them in a shallow baking dish; dot with butter or margarine between pieces and fill the dish about 1/2 full of the beer. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6. Really easy.

title: English Muffin Pizzas
instructions: Thoroughly mix in large bowl the meat onion red pepper black pepper salt and garlic powder. Brown and drain. Split butter and lightly toast muffins. Spread each half with Cheez Whiz; top with sauce meat sauce again parsley and Parmesan cheese. Easily frozen. Cook 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 from frozen state.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 375\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars together. Blend in egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by tablespoons onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.

title: Orange Mallow Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. After cake has cooled punch holes in cake with fork. Prepare jello with boiling water and pour over cake holes. Let cool. Mix extract Marshmallow Creme cream cheese powdered sugar and food coloring to make orange. Frost cake with topping.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pies
instructions: Boil sugar cornstarch and water until clear. Stir in jello. Cool. Place fresh strawberries (sliced) into a baked pie shell. Cover with cooled jello mixture. Put into refrigerator for several hours to set. Top with whipped cream and serve.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Combine all vegetables in skillet and saute in margarine until tender. Mix soups with chicken and broth; heat. Add vegetables and spaghetti to soup mixture heat for a few minutes.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to boil the oleo water and cocoa. Sift flour sugar and salt and add. Beat in remaining ingredients. Pour in 18 x 12 x 1-inch greased cookie pan (sheet pan). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Ice while warm.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Stir in the remaining ingredients until acquire a dough consistency. Chill dough. Roll dough into balls the size of a large walnut. Place 3-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in flour crisscrossed. Bake until set but not hard at 350\u00b0. When done remove from baking sheet and cool.

title: Homestyle Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook; drain macaroni. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Toss cooked macaroni in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into lightly greased casserole dish. Stir well. Bake approximately 25 to 40- minutes until cheese begins to brown.

title: Baked Shells With Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine pasta sauce chicken peas and mushrooms in large bowl; spoon into 2-quart baking dish. Combine cheese and bread crumbs in small bowl; sprinkle over pasta mixture. Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cut dough into 1/8-inch slices. Line 14-inch greased pizza pan with slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Blend softened cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Spread over cookie crust. Top with banana slices blueberries strawberries or any favorite fruit.

title: Pasta Red Sauce
instructions: Add all to saucepan and cook slowly 1 hour to combine flavors. Pour over favorite pasta.

title: Tomato-Zucchini Rice
instructions: Put the onion and margarine in a microwavable bowl cover and cook until almost soft. Add zucchini and mushrooms and continue cooking to the stage you prefer. Sprinkle with McKays to taste. Stir in the tomatoes and allow the vegetables to heat through. Serve over rice.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Sprinkle diced apples with ascorbic powder. Add next 6 ingredients; mix well. Spoon into a lettuce lined bowl.

title: Moist White Cake
instructions: Mix in order. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in greased and floured pan. Ice with favorite icing.

title: Chicken-Broccoli-Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli a few minutes. Drain and place in buttered casserole. Cover with cooked chicken. Combine mushroom soup lemon juice mayonnaise and curry powder. Pour over chicken and cover with grated cheese and bread crumbs. Dribble melted butter over this. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Layered Guacamole Dip
instructions: Spread refried beans on bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Combine avocado hot pepper sauce Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice; spread evenly on top of beans. Top with sour cream picante sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Chill well. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all together and bake in loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Tomato-Rice Sandwich
instructions: Cook meat and onions very slowly over low heat. Dont brown; cook just enough so its not pink. Drain off grease. Add tomato sauce and spices. Simmer with cover long enough for flavors to blend.

title: Chocolate Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar melted chocolate bits and coconut. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate oven about 10 minutes.

title: Frosty Apple Shake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until frothy. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or when done.

title: Another Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Cut up bacon and brown until crisp; drain. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt margarine in 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Pour croutons on top of margarine then sprinkle cheese on this. Beat eggs milk and seasonings; pour over. Sprinkle with bacon. Bake uncovered for one hour. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: In a bowl combine apples and egg. Stir and mix well. Add sugar and salad oil and stir well. Stir in cinnamon nuts and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt together. Add to mixture and blend well. Bake in greased oblong pan in 350\u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes or until done. Double recipe for 2 loaf pans.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef and add cream of chicken soup milk and mild taco sauce. Let simmer for about 10 minutes. Butter the bottom of baking dish and pour in. Add grated cheese and put on the top. Put in oven long enough to melt cheese. Just before serving crunch taco chips and put on top of casserole.

title: Turkey Spices
instructions: Mix this in a pint jar and fill with about 3/4 jar of hot water. Stir or shake up every day about 3 or 4 times a day for 3 or 4 days. Then strain it and inject it into the turkey. Melt butter and inject into turkey. Pour some of the butter over the turkey.

title: Rice Sabrosa
instructions: In an ovenproof skillet saute beef onion and green pepper with seasonings until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Stir frequently to crumble meat. Add tomatoes and rice. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Makes 6 to 7 servings.

title: Zucchini Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Let zucchini stand 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess moisture. Combine zucchini eggs flour Parmesan cheese 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese salt and pepper in a large bowl. Mix well. Spread mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Spread small amount of oil over crust. Broil 5 minutes. Cover crust with tomato slices and remaining 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Steak Smothered With Onions
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet. Cut steaks in 4 pieces. Dip each piece in seasoned flour. Brown in hot fat; add water. Cover and cook slowly for 1 hour. Add onions salt and pepper. Cover and continue cooking for 30 minutes more or until steak and onions are tender.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: In 9-inch square pan put about 4 cups fruit. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over fruit. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar on top then pour 1/2 cup water on top of sugar. Sprinkle cinnamon over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: The Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine Crisco brown sugar milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed until creamy. Beat egg into mixture. Combine flour salt and baking soda into creamed mixture until just blended. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies (cookies will appear moist; do not overbake) or 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookie.

title: Passion Popsicles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

title: Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon teaspoon size balls onto cookie sheet. Bake 350 degrees for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wax paper.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients. Add cereal and stir. Cool slightly. Shake in paper bag with powdered sugar. Great snack food.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Put water sugar cranberry sauce and juice from pineapple in saucepan over low heat. Stir occasionally until sauce is melted. Remove from heat; add jello and stir until dissolved. Cool in refrigerator. Add pineapple and nuts. Congeal.

title: Pumpkin Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs; mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with pumpkin. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread evenly in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool; spread with Orange Frosting. Yield 12 servings.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Coat bananas with lemon juice. Mix other ingredients with it and add pudding powder in last. Chill.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Mix together. Let stand overnight or longer.

title: Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix and refrigerate the first 6 ingredients (dressing).

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Combine. Drop by spoonfuls into very hot chicken broth; do not crowd them even if you have to make it in two pans or kettles. Cover to cook slowly. Do not peep in else the cool air hinders them!

title: Mom'S Minute Rice Meatballs
instructions: Combine rice with beef egg onion salt marjoram pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Mix lightly. Shape mixture into 18 balls and place in skillet. Add 1/2 teaspoon of sugar to remaining 2 cups of tomato juice. Pour juice over meatballs in skillet. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes basting occasionally. Makes 6 servings of 3 meatballs each.

title: Saucy Steak Skillet
instructions: Coat steak pieces with flour.\tBrown beef in oil. Set aside. Cook and\tstir onion in oil until tender. Add enough water to reserved potato liquid to measure 1 cup. Mix potato liquid catsup Worcestershire sauce pepper flakes instant bouillon salt marjoram and pepper;\tpour on beef and onion. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until tender for 1 1/4 hours. Add remaining ingredients.\tCover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Clam Chowder(For 50)
instructions: Saute bacon with onions. Drain fat and add celery. Cook 5 minutes. Add potatoes nectar and water to cover. Cook in roaster in oven for 1 hour. Add clams. Continue cooking until potatoes are done. Thicken with instant potatoes. Cream with evaporated milk. Salt and pepper as desired. This makes approximately 5 gallons.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs 1 or 2 at a time beating after each addition. Sift flour then measure and mix with baking powder. Add flour and milk alternately to sugar mixture ending with milk. Add flavorings and mix well. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Southern Fried Chicken
instructions: Whip eggs until smooth. Dip chicken in crushed corn flakes. Heat shortening or oil in electric skillet to 350\u00b0. Use about 2 to 3-inches of shortening melted in skillet. Fry a few pieces at a time until fork-tender. Drain on paper towel. Keep warm at 300\u00b0 in oven.

title: Okra And Tomatoes
instructions: Add vinegar to hot mashed potatoes. Decorate with hard-boiled eggs.

title: Prune Cream Pie
instructions: Cook prunes with as little water as possible using 3 tablespoons molasses to sweeten. Make syrup of sugar and prune juice. Add molasses prunes and coconut. Cook 10 minutes. Remove from fire and add egg yolks and other ingredients and fill pie shell. Bake at moderate oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Add meringue. Brown for a few minutes in oven.

title: Vicki'S Goulash
instructions: Saute until brown the hamburg and rice in olive oil. Add salt pepper and garlic. Add 1 1/2 cups of water; cover and cook 10 minutes. Add the zucchini tomatoes green pepper onion and parsley. Cook 10 minutes.

title: Tuna Fish
instructions: Take a piece of bread. Take the tuna fish. Mix it with mayonnaise. Then spread the tuna with mayonnaise on the piece of bread. Then take another piece of bread and put it on top of the bread and tuna fish and mayonnaise. Then eat.

title: Classic Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300\u00b0. Butter a 12-inch spring-form pan. Mix the pulverized graham crackers sugar and melted butter and pat this dough into the bottom of the spring-form pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until set; remove and cool before filling. Raise the temperature to 350\u00b0. With an electric mixer beat the cottage cheese sour cream cream cheese eggs sugar flour and vanilla. Beat for 10 minutes; batter will be very thin. Pour over crust and bake for 40 minutes. Turn off oven but leave cake in for an additional 30 minutes. Do not open oven door. Remove cake from oven then cool cake for 2 hours. When cool run a thin metal spatula around the edge of cake. Loosen and remove sides of spring-form pan. Note that when cooling cheesecake will develop a large crack across the top. Slide cake onto plate. If you wish top with pie filling or serve a wedge of cake with fresh berries. Yield 12 to 16 servings.

title: Hot Pineapple Dish
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together; add pineapple and Cheddar cheese. Pour into greased casserole. Melt butter and mix with Ritz crackers that have been rolled into crumbs. Put crumbs on top. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Ham Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Add celery onion and pepper. Cook and chill broccoli flowerets. Add mayonnaise sugar Cheddar cheese and shredded ham. Refrigerate.

title: Helpful Hint
instructions: To remove onion smell from your hands rub stainless steel spoon and dishwashing liquid between hands under running water.

title: Barbecue Sauce(William Casteel'S)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan. Boil until completely mixed. Can be used on\tchicken or can be used with pork or beef.

title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil raisins and water. Let cool. Cream together brown sugar shortening and eggs. Add the raisin mixture. Add the following ingredients salt cinnamon nutmeg allspice flour oatmeal vanilla baking powder baking soda and nuts. Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until brown. Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

title: Turkey Rolls(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Prepare Stove Top according to package directions. Place 2 tablespoons Stove Top on each turkey slice. Roll up and place in a casserole dish. Top with one jar of gravy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes (covered) until heated through. Heat second jar of gravy and serve with turkey.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Place in a 10-inch round serving dish and top with shredded lettuce diced tomato and Cheddar cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Gucky Chicken
instructions: Roll chicken in flour; brown in hot oil in skillet. Place in baking dish and cover with the mushroom soup mixture.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place dutch casserole dish with stick of butter inside dish and place in oven to melt. Mix sugar flour and milk together. Remove dish with melted butter from oven and pour the milk sugar and flour mixture into dish. Pour peaches with liquid on top of everything. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes until top is golden brown.

title: Mexican Chicken Kiev
instructions: In a small bowl combine Cheddar cheese chilies and 1 tablespoon of margarine. Melt over low heat. Set aside mixture.

title: No Crust Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix together on high speed for 2 minutes. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 15 to 20.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Cook beef in fat remaining in skillet until no pink remains. Add onion; saute until tender. Combine beef onion ketchup salt brown sugar mustard and vinegar in a 3-quart baking dish. Partially drain all the beans. Add to baking dish stirring gently to mix. Sprinkle with bacon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Applesauce Pecan Dressing
instructions: Prepare 3 skillets of cornbread according to directions on package including 1 tablespoon sugar with each preparation. Crumble cornbread in large bowl and add other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Boil half or whole cabbage as desired approximately 10 minutes until limp. Slice wieners in half lengthwise and lay on leaf of cabbage. Spread a small amount of mustard and 1 teaspoon of cream cheese. Sprinkle in some onion a slice of cheese and slivers of green pepper. Roll and place on baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Pour tablespoon of hot soup over top of each and serve.

title: Broccoli-Corn Bake
instructions: Saute cracker crumbs in 4 tablespoons butter; set aside. Cook broccoli until tender-crisp and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt remaining butter. Add onion; cook until soft. Add flour and mix. Add milk; cook until thickened. Add cheese corn and 3 tablespoons sauteed crumbs. Mix and spread over broccoli. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cincinnati Chili
instructions: Vegetarian meat alternative may be used in lieu of beef.

title: Whisk Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Add beaten eggs and cream. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Cream Cheese Mints
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and peppermint flavor. Gradually add powdered sugar; knead until no longer sticky. Divide into 4 portions. Knead in food colors of your choice. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in sugar; flatten balls with a fork. Let dry at room temperature. Store loosely covered in the refrigerator. Makes 6 to 7 dozen.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef with onion and bell pepper. Drain grease. Mix remaining ingredients and cook on medium or medium low. Cook approximately 40 to 45 minutes. Stir every 3 to 5 minutes. Do not scorch. Serves approximately 4 to 5 people. Some people tell me that it could feed an army.

title: Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Remove crust from bread slices. Flatten bread with rolling pin. Spread each slice with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with cheese. Place 2 or more asparagus spears on each slice. Bring opposite corners of slice together. Fasten with pick. Brush with butter. Place on baking sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes 15 servings.

title: Lemon Delight
instructions: Beat egg whites adding tartar and slowly adding 1/3 cup of sugar for each egg white. Spread into 9 x 13 buttered pan. Bake for 1 hour in a preheated 250\u00b0 oven. Remove and let cool.

title: Water Chestnut Wrap
instructions: Wrap bacon around water chestnuts fastening with toothpicks. Cook in microwave 10 minutes.

title: Cherry-Topped Icebox Cake
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 pan with some of the graham crackers breaking crackers if necessary. Pour cold milk into bowl add pudding mix. Beat on low speed until well blended 1-2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes then blend in whipped topping. Spread half of pudding mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Top with remaining pudding and another layer of crackers. Spread cherry pie filling over crackers. Chill 3 hours.

title: Pumpkin Gobs
instructions: Cream brown sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and pumpkin and stir well. Gradually add dry ingredients; mix well. Drop by well-rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. When cool fill with filling. Place 2 cookies together.

title: Marinated Tomato Slices
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour over tomato slices. Cover and marinate in refrigerator several hours. As tomatoes are eaten add more slices until marinade is diluted.

title: Chili Egg Puff
instructions: In bowl beat eggs. Add flour baking soda salt cheese bacon and melted butter. Blend then stir in chilies and pour into well-buttered 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Angel Gingerbread
instructions: Combine molasses egg and sugar. Sift flour soda salt and spices. When ready to bake add dry ingredients to molasses egg and sugar. Add melted shortening. Add hot water last. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all; pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/4 cup margarine over top. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0; after 30 minutes baking time cover the top with French fried onion chips and return to oven.

title: Mildew Remover
instructions: Vinegar can be substituted for T.S.P.

title: Marshmallow Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar egg whites and water in double boiler. Beat with electric mixer over boiling water until soft peak forms. Add Marshmallow Creme. Beat to stiff peaks. Remove from heat. Beat in vanilla.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Simmer all ingredients together for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Barney'S Banana Muffins
instructions: Grease 12 muffin cups. In a large bowl combine all of the ingredients. Stir just until moistened. Pour the batter into the prepared muffin cups. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for about 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix crumbs and butter; toss lightly. Pat firmly on bottom of pan. Cream the cheese well; add vanilla and powdered sugar. Beat until fluffy. Blend in Dream Whip well. Spread over crust. Pour in pie filling. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

title: Summer Coolers For The Over 21 Set
instructions: Steep tea bags in boiling water for 5 minutes. Add rest of ingredients; mix. Put in freezer containers and freeze. Spoon into cups to serve. Eat with a spoon while still frozen.

title: Wedding Punch For 50
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in glass jar and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Add the orange juice sugar and pineapple juice the next day. Add ginger ale just before serving.

title: Whipped Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients except walnuts and marshmallows in a large bowl with mixer. Stir in the chopped walnuts (optional). Pour into a 9 x 12-inch casserole. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Remove from oven. Cover with marshmallows (about 1/2 bag) and put back in oven for 3 to 5 minutes to toast marshmallows.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Add ingredients as listed. Mix for 1 minute. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in either 2 round 9-inch pans or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.

title: Peanut Butter Pie(Low Calorie)
instructions: In large bowl using electric mixer beat together peanut butter and both ream cheeses until smooth. Gradually beat in milk and lemon juice. Fold in whip topping and 4 Tbsp. of chocolate mini chips. Spoon peanut butter mixture into pie crust and sprinkle remaining chocolate chips over top. Chill in refrigerator at least 4 hours or overnight. Slice into 10 pieces. 6 Points.

title: Special Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook the potatoes in boiling water to cover in a saucepan until tender. Bring the butter and cream to a simmer in a saucepan. Drain the potatoes and place in a mixing bowl. Beat at low speed until mashed. Add the cream mixture gradually beating constantly until smooth and creamy. Stir in the horseradish adjusting the amount to suit your taste. These are really good with new red potatoes with the skin on.

title: Grandma'S White Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and margarine/butter for approximately 15 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla; stir. Add 1 cup walnuts.

title: Marinated Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender-crisp. Add onion and green pepper. Heat remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Stir well. Refrigerate. (Stir periodically.) Serve with a slotted spoon if too liquidy.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix well and chill overnight. Recipe may be cut in half.

title: Sweet Potato Cobbler
instructions: Cover potatoes barely with water and cook until tender. Add sugar vanilla and 1/2 stick margarine stirring together. In a large baking dish melt 1 stick of margarine. Mix flour sugar and milk (separately). Pour batter over melted margarine. Do not stir. Spoon potato mixture over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

title: Pepper And Tomato Stew
instructions: Plunge the tomatoes and peppers into boiling water for 10 seconds. Drain and peel. Chop the tomatoes; seed and slice the peppers. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and saute until clear; do not let them brown. Add the pepper slices and salt to taste. Cook for 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes and oregano. Cover. Reduce heat; cook slowly 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add the basil and cook for 2 to 3 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Peach Dessert
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cook next seven ingredients on the stove until thick. Pour over crust. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Gradually add sugar. Spread over filling. Brown in oven watching closely.

title: Economy Punch
instructions: Mix all together. You may want to freeze a small amount in ice tray. Chill then serve in punch bowl.

title: Basic Pastry
instructions: In large mixing bowl cut butter cream cheese and flour until mixture resembles crumbs. Gather dough into a ball. Divide into 4 equal parts. Form ball; wrap each separately into clear plastic and refrigerate about 1 hour or until ready to use. Pastry will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator or several months in freezer. Each ball will make pastry equal to 2 pie crusts.

title: Greek Pastitsio
instructions: Cook macaroni in 2 teaspoons salt according to directions but firm. Drain rinse and set aside. Heat 2 tablespoons oleo in 10-inch skillet saute onion until brown. Add meat and saute until done. Add tomato sauce 1 teaspoon salt garlic and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Simmer 20 minutes. Grease 8-inch baking dish put in 1/2 the macaroni. Top with meat sauce put in rest of macaroni.

title: Chow-Chow
instructions: Chop all vegetables. Sprinkle salt over vegetables and let stand overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine remaining ingredients; add chopped vegetables. Boil for 5 minutes. Put into sterilized jars and seal.

title: Meat Loaf Wellington
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup gravy with beef bread cubes egg onion salt and pepper; mix thoroughly. Shape firmly into loaf 7 x 3-inch; place in shallow baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Separate rolls place crosswise over top and down sides of meat loaf overlapping slightly. Bake 15 minutes more. Heat remaining gravy and serve with loaf.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients 5 minutes and pour over popped corn. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and stir; bake 10 minutes more. Place on foil; cool and break into pieces.

title: Turkey And Nectarine Salad
instructions: For dressing in a small bowl gradually stir buttermilk into mayonnaise dressing or salad dressing until smooth. Stir in dill salt onion powder and garlic powder. Arrange greens on 4 plates. Top with turkey nectarines or peaches and sweet pepper. Pour dressing over salads. If desired sprinkle with black pepper and additional dill. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chocolate Delight Angel Food Cake
instructions: Melt chocolate chips; add sugar and cool. Separate egg whites and yolks. Beat yolks and add to chocolate mixture. Beat whites until they form peaks and add to mixture. Beat whipping cream until it forms peaks and add to mixture.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix on medium for 3 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured.

title: Whole Meal French Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in margarine in soup pot until translucent and light brown. Sprinkle with flour; mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Dissolve bouillon in water. Pour over onion mixture. Add Worcestershire sauce. Let stand for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Ladle into ovenproof soup mugs. Top each with 1 slice of bread; turn to soak both sides. Place 1 slice of cheese over bread. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and golden brown. Yield 8 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Dice and fry bacon. Remove some of the grease and set aside. Mix sugar and flour in a bowl. Add water and vinegar. Stir well. Add to bacon and heat to thicken (as gravy). Pour hot bacon gravy over sliced potatoes diced green pepper and diced celery. Mix with large spoon and garnish with parsley. Optional diced onions.

title: Lemon Cheese Bars
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup of mixture. Pat remaining mixture lightly in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Beat cheese sugar lemon juice and 1 egg until light and smooth. Spread over baked layer. Sprinkle with remaining dry mixture. Bake 15 minutes longer at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown beef and onion; drain. Add next 5 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil. Add rice; cover and remove from heat. To serve garnish with cheese sour cream and taco sauce.

title: Zucchini Brownies
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. In separate bowl mix next 4 ingredients. Combine mixtures and add chopped nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Squash Relish
instructions: Take two heaping cups of patience one heartful of love two handfuls of generosity a dash of laughter and one headful of understanding. Sprinkle generously with kindness. Add plenty of faith and mix well. Spread over a period of a lifetime and serve everybody you meet.

title: Onion-Cheese Bread
instructions: Saute onion in shortening until golden. Mix egg and milk then blend with Bisquick. Add onion and half the cheese. Spread dough in greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round cake pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and poppy seed. Pour melted butter over all. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot with butter. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil. Pour over hot cake and let soak in.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Lay the chicken pieces skin side up in a 9x13-inch greased casserole. Completely cover chicken with the swiss cheese slices. Combine the soup with the water or white wine and pour over the above. Mix 1 cube of melted margarine with the 2 cups of herb stuffing mix. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Easy and delicous!

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt butter; blend in cocoa until smooth. Add vanilla and eggs; mix well. Add to dry ingredients. Bake on large cookie sheet. When done take out of oven and put the mini marshmallows on top of cake. Return to oven until marshmallows are melted. Top with chocolate fudge frosting.

title: Mexican Pork Chops
instructions: Trim off any fat from chops. Season with salt and pepper as desired. Place in baking dish in bottom of dish side by side. Top each chop with a slice of onion a green pepper ring and 1 tablespoon of uncooked rice. Cover entirely with tomatoes and juice (making sure all rice is in tomato juice). Sprinkle with salt. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Serves 4.

title: Party Scrambles
instructions: Mix these all together. Add 2 tablespoons garlic salt. This makes a large amount. Use a large roasting pan using top and bottom both for oven. Put 2 cups of salad oil in mixing bowl. Add 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce. Mix well and pour over the 2 pans of ingredients. Stir well. Place in a slow oven about 200\u00b0 to 225\u00b0 and bake 2 hours stirring every 15 minuets. Add extra nuts or pecans as desired. Will keep well for several weeks in Tupperware. Wonderful to have for holidays.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix milk lemonade lemon rind and lemon juice. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shells. Refrigerate at least an hour before serving. Freezes well.

title: Peach Melba Dessert
instructions: Drain peach halves well. Rinse strawberries or raspberries well. In food processor or blender combine berries sugar and water. Puree until thickened. Toast almonds in a hot skillet until lightly browned. Arrange peach halves on serving plates; add 1 scoop of vanilla ice cream to each plate. Glaze peach halves with pureed berries. Sprinkle with toasted almonds. Good served with macaroons or wafers. Calories 237; cholesterol 30 milligrams.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Mix at high speed for 2 minutes after the ingredients are all in the bowl. Spray Bundt pan with Pam and sprinkle pan with a little sugar for glaze. Pour in batter. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour. Let cool in pan for 15 minutes before removing.

title: No Crust Apple Pie
instructions: If you have all-purpose flour add 1/2 teaspoon baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Cheese And Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all together by hand and form into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen balls.

title: Granny Smith Apple Salad
instructions: Cook ingredients until thick. Chunk 4 unpeeled Granny Smith apples; fold into thickened mixture then fold in 1 (8 ounce) container of Cool Whip thawed. Top each serving with ground dry roasted peanuts.

title: Salmon Log
instructions: Drain and flake salmon removing skin and bones. Combine salmon with cheese lemon juice onion horseradish salt and liquid smoke. Mix thoroughly. Chill several hours.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Divide popped corn into 2 ungreased baking pans (13 x 9 x 2-inch). In saucepan heat sugar butter corn syrup and salt stirring occasionally until bubbly around edges. Remove from heat. Stir in soda until foamy. Pour onto corn stirring until all is coated. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove and cool.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Using large (at least 15 x 11-inch) cake pan grease bottom only of pan. (If you use smaller pan cake will overflow.)

title: Powdered Doughnuts
instructions: Take can of biscuits and poke holes in middles. Deep fry in 3-inches of hot oil. Drain; drop into powdered sugar. Add cinnamon or cocoa to sugar for flavor.

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: Skillet brown meat. Combine meat potatoes tomatoes pizza sauce water and seasonings. Stir. Cook for 4 to 5 hours on low heat 10 to 15 minutes on high. Add cheese. Stir.

title: Diane'S Crab Dip
instructions: Mix first seven ingredients with mixer. Add crabmeat and refrigerate. Serve on fresh bagel pieces or crackers.

title: Sauteed Broccoli Italiano
instructions: Trim and set aside the woody ends of broccoli stalks; cut tops into florets. Using a vegetable peeler peel the stalks and cut them diagonally into 1/4-inch thick slices. In a 5-quart Dutch oven or stockpot heat oil over moderate heat. Add the diced broccoli stalks and saut for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic water and the florets. Cover and cook the broccoli until it is crisp-tender about 5 more minutes. Remove the Dutch oven from the heat.

title: California Casserole
instructions: Brown beef in batches. Saute onions and garlic with last batch of meat. Return all meat to pan. Sprinkle chili powder over meat. Blend tomatoes picante sauce green chilies and olives into meat mixture. Simmer on stove top 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Medley
instructions: Cook broccoli until done; drain well. In pan combine broccoli onion soup rice and celery. Spread Cheez Whiz on top. Top with almonds. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Beat eggs. Add butter flour sugar milk and seasonings. Add corn last. Mix well and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Spice Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix warm oil ranch dressing and spices in covered container. Shake well to mix. Drizzle over crackers stirring slowly to coat well. Coat 1 pkg. at a time.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Mix together and press firmly in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish to make crust.

title: Nacho Beef-N-Bean Dip
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion salt and pepper. Add taco seasoning pack and make taco meat following directions on package. In 9 x 9-inch (approximately) pan layer refried beans on bottom meat mixture jalapenos black olives salsa then top with grated Monterey Jack pepper cheese. Bake in oven at 425\u00b0 until cheese is melted and bubbly 15 to 20 minutes. Dip with nacho chips!

title: Pecan Log Roll
instructions: Combine marshmallow cream sugar and vanilla. Shape into 4 x 1-inch logs. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Combine caramels and water in doubler boiler and melt. Dip logs into melted caramels and roll in pecans. Chill 1 hour. Cut into slices.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil sugar and eggs until creamy. Mix dry ingredients and blend eggs. Fold in apples and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Taco Salad Dip
instructions: 1st Layer 2 cans Old El Paso bean dip.

title: Gerry'S Muffins
instructions: Grease pan. Mix by hand to moisten. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 large muffins.

title: Truly Different Cupcakes
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in heavy pan. Add pecans. Stir until nuts are well coated. Add butter flavoring. Blend together (do not beat) the sugar eggs flour and vanilla. Turn into paper lined muffin tins. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 24 cupcakes.

title: Baked Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spray baking dish and lay chicken in dish. Next add beef and bacon. Spread sour cream over all then put soup over all and bake at 275\u00b0 for 3 hours.

title: Mexicali Chicken
instructions: Bone chicken and break into pieces. Mix all ingredients except chips and cheeses together. Place tortilla chips in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour chicken mixture over chips. Place grated cheese over layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about thirty minutes. Serve with chopped or mashed avocado over each serving and add red or green taco sauce. Serves 6.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Cook rice brown sausage onion hot pepper and salt; drain. Mix all together and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Farmer Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Mix together flour salt soda and baking powder; add corn flakes and oats. Stir in coconut and nuts. Drop from teaspoon on baking sheet 2 inches apart. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove to wire rack.

title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; mix together with flour oatmeal salt baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips Hershey bar and nuts.

title: Diabetic Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix together; press into 9-inch pie pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Quesdillas
instructions: Blend all ingredients (by hand) except tortilla and salsa. Mixture should remain somewhat lumpy. Refrigerate before spreading on tortilla.

title: Salami Pizza Squares
instructions: Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Roll out crescent rolls in bottom of pan. Mix all the ingredients together. Pour over rolls. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until lightly brown. Cool and cut into squares. Serve.

title: Jane'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape in small loaves. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pizza
instructions: Break spaghetti into 2-inch pieces. Cook according to package directions; drain. Cool. Beat eggs in large bowl; add milk 1 cup Mozzarella cheese salt and garlic salt. Stir in cooked spaghetti; mix well. Spread mixture evenly in an oiled 10 1/2 x 15 1/2-inch jelly roll pan with sides to prevent sauce from running over. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Spread sauce evenly over spaghetti; sprinkle with oregano basil and 3 cups cheese. Top with pepperoni. Return to oven and bake 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Put in blender on liquefy. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450\u00b0 reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake until done in center.

title: 1-2-3 Fruit Cups
instructions: Drain pineapple and thawed raspberries to reserve syrup. Stir together syrup and breakfast drink powder. Divide fruit among 6 cups. Pour on syrup mixture.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix and bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Sliced Potatoes And Onions
instructions: Slice potatoes and onions into 1/4-inch slices. Place overlapping slices in a buttered Pyrex baking dish. Mix butter and oil. Brush slices and pour remaining over potatoes and onions. Sprinkle with spices. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are done and browned at the edges. Serve immediately. Best with broiled steaks or hamburgers. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Tarte 'A La Tomate
instructions: Bake shell and cool. Sprinkle tomatoes with salt and drain for 30 min. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Put cheese overlapping in pastry shell. Place tomatoes side by side on top of cheese. Sprinkle with pepper basil and parmesan cheese. Dribble margarine over tomatoes. Bake on top rack for 25 min. or until cheese is melted.

title: Easy Cheese Souffle
instructions: Combine soup and cheese in a saucepan over low heat stirring until the cheese melts. Remove from heat. Beat the egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Slowly add cheese mixture to the yolks stirring constantly. Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold cheese mixture into them. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart casserole. Bake in a slow oven (300\u00b0) for an hour.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit well and arrange in a 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan or baking dish. Blend sugar cornstarch margarine and curry powder together. Pour over fruit. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Angel Corn Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients together. Add eggs oil and buttermilk stirring until well mixed. Spoon into greased muffin pans and bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Mushroom Meatballs
instructions: Form meatballs and fry until done. Drain off fat. Mix soup and water together to gravy consistency. Pour over meatballs and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix first 12 ingredients; pour into buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix and pour into a greased dish. Cook approximately 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Polynesian Sausages
instructions: In 1-quart casserole blend brown sugar cornstarch ginger garlic powder water soy sauce and pineapple juice. Cut each sausage into thirds. Stir into casserole with pineapple chunks. Microwave at High 3 to 7 minutes or until sauce is thickened stirring 2 or 3 times. Skewer on toothpicks before serving.

title: Corn Dog Twists
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Unroll dough into 1 long sheet. Seal crosswise center perforations. Separate dough into 8 long strips (2 cornbread twists each). Wrap each strip around a wiener. Place on ungreased cookie sheet with ends of dough tucked under wieners. Brush each with margarine; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 16 minutes or until light brown. Remove from cookie sheet. Serve immediately.

title: Easy Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain thoroughly. Spread broccoli evenly over bottom of a buttered 9-inch square baking dish. Evenly distribute chicken over broccoli. In a small bowl blend together soup and mayonnaise; spread over chicken. Sprinkle cheese evenly over soup mixture.

title: Jezebel Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients with a wire whisk. Put in a covered container and refrigerate for several days. This mixture will keep indefinitely and actually improves with age.

title: Hash Brown Bake
instructions: Thaw potatoes before mixing. Mix soup milk sour cream salt onions and 1/4 cup oleo. Then stir in potatoes. Pour into greased 9x13-inch pan. Top with 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese. Crumble corn flakes enough to cover the top. Then drizzle 1/4 cup of melted oleo over top.

title: Peach Nectar Cake(Our Mama'S Favorite Recipe)
instructions: Combine cake mix and sugar. Add nectar and oil. Beat for 2 or 3 minutes. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool right side up for 15 minutes then remove from pan. May be sprinkled with powdered sugar or pour over warm cake 1 cup powdered sugar and lemon juice. Let it drizzle down sides.

title: Double Pasta Surprise
instructions: Cook pasta twist as directed; drain. Separate into two casserole dishes. In one mix salt pepper oregano and pasta. Sprinkle cheese on top and dot with butter. In the other dish mix spaghetti sauce and pasta. Salt and pepper to taste. Dot with margarine. Bake both at 350\u00b0 for about 5 minutes until the cheese melts. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Drain liquid from potatoes; set aside. Empty potatoes in medium size mixing bowl. In separate bowl add brown sugar and maple syrup. Mix with mixer until creamy. Add nuts and 1/2 cup of potato liquid. Put potatoes in greased pan and pour liquid over them. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes until knife comes out clean from center.

title: Chicken Spread
instructions: Mix together and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Dip
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate. Needs to sit for several hours to let flavors combine.

title: Devilishous Pinwheels
instructions: With an electric knife cut away brown edge of white bread and roll with rolling pin. Roll up and cut off in wheels. Chop peppers very fine. Mix with remaining ingredients. Spread.

title: Classic Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes with salt until tender. Drain and sprinkle with celery seed while hot. Let cool. Combine rest of ingredients except parsley and eggs; mix well. Garnish with parsley and sliced hard-boiled eggs if desired.

title: Pigs In A Blanket(Quick Method)
instructions: Chop cabbage into medium pieces; spread on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Brown meat; stir in onion rice salt and pepper and pour over cabbage. In small saucepan heat tomato soup and water to boiling and pour over all ingredients; sprinkle with cheese and cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until cabbage is soft. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring to a boil the 2 sticks butter cocoa water and sugar. Pour over the remaining ingredients. Bake in a large cookie sheet pan with edge on it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter brown sugar and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. In a separate bowl combine flour oatmeal salt baking powder and baking soda and add to first mixture. Then add chocolate chips Hershey bar and both nuts and blend. Make into golf ball size balls and place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 6 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Banana Pie
instructions: Soak bananas in pineapple juice for 30 minutes. Drain and reserve juice. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place bananas in pie shell. Sprinkle with combined sugar flour and spices. Add 3 tablespoons of pineapple juice. Top with pastry crust and vent. Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until crust is browned.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Cook potatoes; drain. Add Italian dressing toss lightly and chill 2 hours.

title: Party Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes day before and cool in refrigerator overnight. Grate potatoes and onion; dot with butter and salt and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap to store overnight. Before placing in oven add whipping cream or half and half. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Blend well. Spoon into ovenproof dish. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease 2-quart casserole dish. Cook broccoli as directed. Cut into bite-size pieces and arrange in casserole.

title: Strawberry Cream Salad(Serves 12)
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; stir in berries and mix until thawed. Add pineapple and bananas. Pour half of mixture in flat dish or mold. Chill until firm and spread sour cream over in even layer. Pour over the remaining jello. Chill firm.

title: Ground Buffalo Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together well. Form into loaf; spray with nonstick spray on broiling pan. Place meat loaf on broiling pan and brush top with ketchup or barbecue sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 1 hour.

title: Mel'S Type Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Cook hamburg in a large pot breaking into tiny pieces. Drain and rinse. Return to pot. Run onion celery mushroom and garlic through food processor or food grinder until it becomes a mush. Add to hamburg. Add remaining ingredients simmer uncovered for 3 hours. Stir often. Makes 9 quarts.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Mix sauces and beef. Cook eggplant until tender. Drain well. In a 2 1/2 or 3-quart casserole dish layer beef eggplant and cheese until the last layer is cheese. Heat until cheese is melted and hot.

title: Acini De Pepe Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Mix fruits and marshmallows together.

title: Sopapilla Cheesecake
instructions: Mix cream cheese 1 cup sugar and vanilla together. Line bottom of pan with one can of crescent rolls top with cream cheese layer and the final can of crescent rolls. Melt butter and mix with 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Spread butter mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Best served 3 to 4 hours after baking.

title: Louisburg Cafe Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Blend in pieces of bread rolls or donuts. Pour mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Boil in favorite seasonings and let cool. Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender until desired smoothness is obtained. Adjust taste by adding either more Miracle Whip or sour cream. Eggs may be added when making large batches. Serve with Ritz or Town House crackers or your favorite chip or cracker.

title: Never Fail Pie Meringue
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar water and salt; cook thick and clear. Cool slightly. Beat egg whites until frothy. Continue beating while slowly pouring cooked mixture over and continue beating 5 minutes. Cover cooled filling in pie shell with meringue sealing edges to crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes or until golden.

title: Best Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all in blender except fruit. Chill for 1 hour. Serve in dish with fruit.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in margarine. Add pimento. In a bowl beat eggs. Mix in bread crumbs seasonings and corn. Add onion and bell pepper and mix well. Pour into casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 in a pan of water.

title: Laura'S Stew
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Cover tightly and bake 3 hours in 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Mama Faye'S Coconut Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place beaten eggs in large mixing bowl add next 6 ingredients to the eggs mix thoroughly. Pour into pie shells and bake for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Clean and slice mushrooms. Fry in butter 5 minutes. Add flour and blend. Add stock. Cool slightly; add cream and seasonings. Heat through and serve. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Neiman-Marcus Squares
instructions: Combine cake mix margarine and 1 egg. Pat into bottom of 8 x 12-inch pan or 13 x 9-inch (cook little longer). Beat 2 eggs cream cheese and sugar together and pour over cake mixture.

title: Manicotti With Cheese
instructions: Cook manicotti according to package instructions; drain. Combine cheeses parsley salt and pepper for filling; spoon into manicotti. Spread a thin layer of sauce on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange manicotti in single layer over sauce. Cover with remaining sauce. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli and carrots until tender. Add the half and half and cheese. After cheese is melted thicken with margarine and flour. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Saute onion apple oleo mushrooms and water chestnuts until tender. Add the remaining ingredients in order (flour curry powder sugar ginger salt chicken broth and evaporated milk). Cook about 15 minutes on medium heat until thickened. Add 3 cups diced cooked chicken. Let set for 24 hours in refrigerator. Heat and serve over hot rice.

title: Cherry Dessert
instructions: Sift flour salt and soda. Add sugar and oats. Cut in margarine. Press half in ungreased 12 x 8-inch pan. Spread with pie filling. Cover with remaining mixture and press down. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sauerbraten(Quick And Easy)
instructions: Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper. Add enough water to cover. Cook over low heat for about 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Remove the meat from the liquid and strain. Thicken gravy with 7 tablespoons flour and 4 teaspoons sugar. Slice meat; serve with hot gravy and buttered noodles.

title: Whole Kernel Cornbread
instructions: Beat ingredients together. Bake 30 minutes in greased 9 x 13-inch dish at 400\u00b0. Cut in squares and serve hot. Serves 8.

title: Mike'S Crab Au Gratin
instructions: Saute butter and flour. Add milk chicken bouillon egg sherry tabasco Worcestershire salt and pepper. Simmer until warm. Add crab meat and grated cheese. Turn into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix sugar flour and eggs together. Add pineapple salt and bread. Mix together and pour into buttered dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chunky Bran Drops
instructions: Cream together butter or margarine brown sugar egg and vanilla until well blended. Mix flour bran baking soda salt and cinnamon. (Dough will be stiff.) Stir in dates and nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets. Top with date slices. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown. Remove to racks to cool. Store airtight. Can add sliced dates or raisins for tops of cookies.

title: Out Of This World Relish
instructions: Prepare tomatoes onions peppers celery and cabbage. Mix together with salt. Let mixture stand for 2 hours then drain. Mix the remaining ingredients with the vegetables. Cook for 30 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Mix 1 large box of vanilla instant pudding with 3 cups of milk. Then add 18 ounce carton of Cool Whip. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers on bottom of pan (leave crackers whole). Then add layer of the pudding and Cool Whip mixture. Then add another layer of graham crackers. Continue until all mixture is used up (crackers last). Top with a can of blueberry pie filling. Refrigerate.

title: Gourmet Pizza Bagels
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Slice bagels in half. Spread Ragu pizza sauce over bagels. Sprinkle shredded cheese over sliced bagels. Sprinkle a pinch of oregano over bagels. Place bagels on a cookie sheet. Throw the cookie sheet in the oven. Bake for 12 minutes at 450\u00b0 or until bagel is toasted and cheese is melted. Take out and let the bagels cool for approximately 5 minutes. EAT!!

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach and green beans. Combine with onion water salt garlic powder basil nutmeg and pepper. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally; remove from heat. Gradually stir vegetable mixture into beaten eggs. Stir mixture well. Turn into 8 inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Cornbread Stuffing
instructions: Mix all together. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350\u00b0 covered with foil for 1 hour. Uncover and bake until browned.

title: Polynesian Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery grapes carrots and almonds. Blend mayonnaise with sour cream and seasonings; pour over chicken and toss lightly. Chill thoroughly. Makes 6 servings. (I think it best if made the day before.)

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix pudding milk pumpkin and spices in large bowl with electric mixer. Beat on low speed for 1 minute. Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell or a graham cracker pie shell. Chill; garnish with whipped topping if desired.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Bisquick then add Bisquick and coat evenly. Pour into a buttered 10-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Reheats well.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Combine eggs and sugar; mix well. Add pumpkin oil and water. Blend then add the dry ingredients. Mix then put ingredients into cans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 60 minutes. When finished baking let cool for 15 minutes and just pop out of cans then slice bread; serve.

title: Golumpki'S(Polish Stuffed Cabbage)
instructions: In a large pot boil cabbage until tender. Remove cabbage. Set aside to cool. In a large bowl combine hamburger rice onion garlic powder and salt and pepper. Mix until all ingredients are combined. In a large pot add your tomato soup with 2 cans water. Stir until soup and water are creamy. Next you take your cabbage leaves and stuff with hamburger ingredients. Roll and drop into tomato soup mixture. Do this until all the hamburger mixture is gone. Cook with a lid on pot on medium to low heat for 1 hour. Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Combine all ingredients and simmer in skillet for 1 hour.

title: Cranberry Orange Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and set aside. Mix egg oil and orange. Add to the dry ingredients. Stir until moist. Pour into greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Crunchy Hawaiian Salad
instructions: Combine oil sesame oil vinegar sugar salt and pepper in small bowl; mix well. Chill in refrigerator. Combine cabbage green onions and mandarin oranges in bowl; mix well. Reserve seasoning packet from noodles for another use; crumble noodles into salad. Sprinkle with almonds and sesame seed. Add dressing; toss to mix well. Yields 12 servings.

title: Hamburger Balls
instructions: Combine hamburger eggs bread crumbs ketchup and onion. Shape into balls and place in baking dish. Combine vinegar mustard brown sugar hot water and ketchup. Pour over meatballs and bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Apple Cake Pie
instructions: Place apples in pie plate. Sprinkle with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Remove foil and cover apples with batter made from remaining ingredients. Bake 20 minutes longer.

title: Easy Fruit Salad
instructions: Chill fruit. Drain reserving 1 cup. Combine the juice with the dry pudding to form a dressing. Pour over fruit and stir lightly. Chill until served. Keeps well 24 hours.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool cookies and store in an airtight container. They will remain soft and chewy.

title: Red Beans And Rice(Serves 6)
instructions: Rinse and sort beans; soak overnight. Cook beans bacon and ham hock in 2 quarts water for 1 1/2 hours in a very large pot. In skillet saute onions pepper and garlic until tender. Add vegetable mixture chopped parsley spices Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce to the beans salt pork ham hock and water. Brown sliced sausage; drain and add to beans. Add the tomato sauce. Cook about 2 to 3 hours more stirring often adding water as needed. Serve over cooked rice.

title: English Muffin Pizzas
instructions: Spread each half of muffin with tomato sauce and sprinkle with oregano. Place cheese on top and bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Serves 2.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Place in a deep dish. Place 1/4 cup butter or margarine on top. Cover lightly with tinfoil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring once after 30 minutes of cooking. Cover again and continue cooking.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Blend Biscuit Mix sugar and water together well. Pour into greased pan. Blend together brown sugar margarine cinnamon and nuts. Dot cake batter with mixture. Bake in box oven until inserted straw or twig comes out clean.

title: Tasty Carrot Sticks
instructions: Peel the carrots cut them in 2 inch lengths. Cook them in boiling salted water for about 10-12 minutes. (Cooking time varies according to the thickness and freshness of the carrots.) In order to cook the carrots uniformly put the thickest parts into the water first then the thinner tapered ends. You want the carrots tender but quite firm for this recipe because the marinade will continue to soften them.

title: Cookie Sheet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Melt butter in skillet. Combine sugar flour and salt. Add cocoa to butter and stir this mixture into the combined dry ingredients also adding water. Add eggs baking soda and vanilla. Mix thoroughly and pour into greased cookie sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Make frosting.

title: Delicious Beans
instructions: If desired add ham wieners or bacon. If they are soupy more beans may be added. Mix everything together and bake.

title: Cocoa
instructions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Gradually add the water. Boil for 5 minutes stirring all the time. Add the evaporated milk. Heat; do not boil. Add the vanilla.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix flour salt baking powder and cream of tartar together. Cream butter 1/2 cup of sugar and eggs. Add this to flour mixture. Make balls and roll in remaining sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Tear first can biscuits into 4 pieces. Put 1/2 cup granulated sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon together in paper bag. Put first torn biscuits into bag and shake. Put in greased Bundt pan.
