Sprinkle a small amount of sugar mix from bag on top of biscuits in pan and nuts. Second and third cans of biscuits do the same way. Sprinkle nuts. Melt brown sugar and margarine for 1 minute. Pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together in large bowl. Place meat in bowl with mixture. All meat must be covered. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 200\u00b0. Place meat on cookie sheet by single layers. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 3 hours. Turn meat over 1 1/2 hours before done.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix everything but milk together and pour into ice cream freezer and fill to fill line with milk and freeze.

title: French Silk Frosting
instructions: Beat powdered sugar margarine or butter chocolate and vanilla in a small bowl on low speed. Add milk gradually; beat until smooth and fluffy. Frosts 2 (9-inch) layers or 3 (8-inch) layers.

title: June'S Muffins
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Add milk oil molasses and eggs. Mix well. Store in refrigerator and use as needed. Keeps up to 6 weeks. Fill muffin tins (greased) 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 48 muffins.

title: Grandmother'S Delicious Gingerbread
instructions: Blend sugar Crisco and eggs. Stir in molasses. Add combined ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Beat well. Spread in a well-greased and floured 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with warm ice cream whipped cream or applesauce. To make sour milk add 1 tablespoon vinegar or lemon juice to 1 cup milk.

title: Perfect Turkey Loaf
instructions: Combine ground turkey bread eggs onion green pepper horseradish salt mustard milk and 1/4 cup ketchup. Mold into loaf pan. Spread with remaining ketchup and bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Unmold and use pan liquid for gravy or chill and slice for sandwiches.

title: Strawberry Jello Cake
instructions: Blend frozen strawberries. Mix ingredients and cook it in a cake pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Make 2 (9-inch) rounds. If need help read cake mix.

title: California Cream Soup
instructions: Combine all soups milk cream salt and pepper. Simmer over low heat stirring. Add avocado olives and pimiento; heat thoroughly. Serves 6.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Bring first 5 ingredients to a boil. Pour boiling vinegar and sugar mixture over the kraut vegetables garlic powder and celery salt. Cool and store in fridge. Will keep a couple of weeks.

title: Cheddar Spinach Quiche
instructions: Cook spinach and drain well on paper towel. Toss cheese with flour. Add spinach milk eggs bacon and seasonings. Mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Fried Rice(Serves 2 To 4.)
instructions: Fry eggs in 1 tablespoon oil; remove and cut into small pieces. Put remaining oil into hot skillet or wok. Add shrimp and diced meat; stir-cook until heated. Add mushrooms soy sauce seasonings and diced eggs; blend well. Stir in rice and heat thoroughly. Serve piping hot garnished with green onions.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup very warm water. Cream shortening sugar beaten egg 2 cups warm water and softened yeast. Add about 6 or 7 cups of flour. Make batter that is easy to handle not stiff. Put in large greased bowl. Cover and put in refrigerator until ready to use. Knead well. Place on a greased baking sheet for about 3 hours. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Good Old Meat Loaf
instructions: With wet hands mix all the ingredients and shape into a loaf. Place in the center of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Peel and slice 1/4-inch thick 3 medium potatoes and onions and peel quarter lengthwise or slice the carrots. Put vegetables around meat. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more to brown meat.

title: Mandarin Almond Salad
instructions: In a small skillet melt 3 tablespoons of sugar over low heat. Add almonds; stir until coated. Cool break into small pieces and set aside.

title: Hot German Potato Salad
instructions: Wash and pare potatoes (remove eyes). Heat 1-inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon to each cup water) to boiling. Add potatoes cover tightly. Heat to boiling again cooking 30 to 35 minutes or until tender. Drain; set aside.

title: Coussa
instructions: Use coussa or yellow summer squash. Squash should be 6-inches long. Scoop out insides with a grapefruit spoon taking care not to damage exterior of coussa. Mash garlic with salt and spearmint. Add water. Put hollow coussa in water mixture. Mix beef rice 1/2 can tomatoes 2 tablespoons tomato paste salt pepper and cinnamon. Put this stuffing into coussa. Place a small piece of tomato on each one. Stand coussa in a deep pot. Using 1/2 of spearmint water add remaining tomato paste and tomatoes. Pour liquid over coussa. If necessary add more water and tomatoes. Liquid should cover bottom half of coussa. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until squash is tender.

title: Apricot Nougat
instructions: Combine powdered sugar butter orange juice and vanilla. Add apricots and knead mixture. Shape into balls and roll in nuts. Store in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Green Chili Souffle
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix cheeses with chilies and set aside. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Beat yolks a little. In small bowl mix together yolks milk flour and salt. Put cheese and chili mixture into baking dish. Fork yolk mixture into egg whites. Pour over cheese and chilies and work in (\fluff\) with a fork. Bake 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Garnish with tomato slices or eat as is. Serves 8 to 12. Let sit 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Bring 3 cups of milk to a boil; add broccoli. Simmer stirring occasionally for 5 minutes. Stir in soup. Blend flour with remaining milk; add to mixture. Bring to boil and simmer stirring occasionally 10 minutes until soup is thick.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Make stuffing. Pour water about 1 to 2 cups in bottom of pan or casserole making it 1/4-inch deep. Place pork chops in pan and put a spoon of soup wherever there is space between chops. Put stuffing on top of chops. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Check after 1 hour to see if more water is needed.

title: Old Fashioned Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar butter and syrup till smooth. Add flour salt eggs and heat slightly. Add vanilla and nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Justin'S Chicken
instructions: Cook it to make it hot. Then eat it for lunch.

title: Zucchini Relish
instructions: Place zucchini onions and salt in a large bowl; mix well and cover. Refrigerate overnight. Next day place mixture in a fine strainer; drain well. Rinse under cold water and drain 1 hour.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order. Bake in prepared tube pan approximately 40 minutes (350\u00b0). Frost with simple powdered sugar glaze while warm if desired.

title: Strawberry-Lemon Jello Mold
instructions: In small bowl combine strawberry jello and hot water making sure jello is dissolved. Add thawed strawberries and syrup. Pour in mold. Chill until set.

title: Crazy Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Dip
instructions: Mix pumpkin and dry pudding. Add cool whip.

title: English Muffin Loaf
instructions: Combine 3 c. flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat liquids until very warm (120\u00b0-130\u00b0 F.). Add to dry ingredients; beat well. Stir in the rest of the flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into two 8-1/2x4-1/2 pans that have been greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Cover; let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes. Bake 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pans immediately and cool. Makes 2 loaves. To serve Slice and toast.

title: Jello Dirt Cups
instructions: Note Need 8 to 10 (7 ounce) plastic cups.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken and debone. Refrigerate broth overnight and skim off fat.

title: Casserole
instructions: Cook the first 4 ingredients until done. In a large baking dish put layer of macaroni then meat then Cheddar cheese; repeat once. Mix together soup and milk; pour over casserole. Top with dressing or bread crumbs. Dot with butter. Bake until bubbly (15 minutes in microwave uncovered).

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Place cabbage in casserole dish. Melt better in saucepan. Add soup milk and mayonnaise. Blend well. Pour over cabbage. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Turkey Pasta Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine turkey dressing and vegetables. Toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Before serving toss again to remix. Serve over pasta.

title: Isabel'S Bohemian Sauerkraut
instructions: Mix together and cook for about 30 minutes over medium heat all ingredients except the potato. Take the potato and grate into the sauerkraut. Cook 5 to 10 minutes longer. Real good when served over creamed potatoes.

title: Out Of This World Chocolate Pie
instructions: Place chocolate bar in top of double boiler and melt over hot boiling water stirring until fully melted. Remove from boiler and let stand until cooled. Fold the Cool Whip into the chocolate until fluffy. Pour into pie shell. Place in refrigerator for several hours before stirring.

title: Corn And Lima Bean Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in flour and add milk gradually stirring constantly. Cook until thick and then simmer 2 or 3 minutes. Add cheese salt pepper and pimento. Combine this sauce with lima beans corn and onion tops. Pour all into well-greased casserole dish. Sprinkle top with pulled bread crumbs. Drizzle with melted butter and bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. If crumbs are not brown after 30 minutes place under broiler for a few minutes but watch closely.

title: Oyster Pie
instructions: Cook oysters in their liquor until edges curl. Add milk cream margarine and spices and heat until hot and margarine is melted. Pour into a casserole sprayed with Pam saving out about 3 cups of the milk. Add cooked potatoes and crackers. Top with Bisquick biscuits rolled very thin (like pie crust). Bake at 425\u00b0 until crust is brown. Top any serving with some of the liquid saved for anyone who wants more on top of their crust.

title: Lemonade Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemonade\ttogether. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with remainder of Cool Whip. Makes 1 pie. Freeze.

title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Helpful Hint Soften cream cheese in microwave on High 15 to 20 seconds.

title: Stuffed Hot Dogs
instructions: Add in order of ingredients list. Add water if necessary. Split hot dogs and stuff. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese on top. Cut hot dogs in fourths after stuffing. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add salt and vanilla. Fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker shell. Cover all with a can of cherry pie filling; chill overnight.

title: Tuna And Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles. Mix mushroom soup water onions mushrooms mayonnaise and cheese. Combine tuna and noodles. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cut tomatoes into small pieces; set aside. In large saucepan saute butter and onion for 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken broth and water. Tie together with string bay leaf oregano parsley sprigs and lemon zest; add to pan along with tomatoes carrots potatoes celery salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium heat reduce to low cover and cook (over) 20 minutes. Cut kernels off corn cob and add to soup along with green beans and zucchini. Simmer covered for 15 minutes more. Remove herb bundle. Taste adjust seasonings and serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: The Best Pecan Pie
instructions: Brown butter in saucepan until it is golden brown; do not burn. Let cool. In separate bowl add ingredients in order listed; stir. Blend in browned butter well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then lower heat to 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
instructions: Crush strawberries to make 1 cup. Combine crushed berries water cornstarch and sugar. Bring to a boil stirring constantly then turn to low heat. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until mixture becomes clear in color. Line pie crust with the remaining whole berries and pour glaze over strawberries. Refrigerate until pie is set. Prior to serving garnish with strawberries and Cool Whip.

title: Hershey'S Disappearing Cake
instructions: Grease and flour two 9-inch cake pans or 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake pan. Cream butter shortening sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Blend in eggs. Combine cocoa flour baking powder soda and salt in bowl; add alternately with milk to batter. Blend well. Pour into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan; frost when cool.

title: Dog Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Open packages of franks and biscuits. Put a slit into hot dog and insert cheese (fold if you like). Wrap each hot dog with a roll or biscuit which has been flattened. Place hot dog slit side up on a baking sheet and place in oven for 10 to 12 minutes (roll or biscuit should be lightly browned). To serve Dip into mustard as you like.

title: Faye'S Cukes
instructions: Pour over cukes and let set 1 hour. Will keep several days.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Press sugar cookie dough on pizza pan or cookie sheet. Bake until light brown.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: First Layer Mix pretzels margarine and sugar. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. This is crust. Bake for 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Do not overbake.

title: Black Bean Salad
instructions: Combine parsley lime juice salt and black pepper. Stir well with a whisk. Add remaining ingredients tossing well. Cover and chill 2 hours. Serve over salad greens. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Reserve 1 cup cake mix.

title: Fresh Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients as for a stiff cake batter. Put batter in slightly greased 6 x 10-inch glass baking dish. Put rhubarb on top of batter; sprinkle gelatin on top.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown ground beef and season with Tabasco  salt and pepper. Drain excess fat. Add kidney beans and heat thoroughly. Keep warm. In a large mixing bowl combine lettuce tomato onion cheese and olives. Toss well. Add dressings and toss again. Serve with chips.

title: Party Pizza
instructions: Crumble sausage. Fry until done and barely brown. Drain on several paper towels. Mix with cheese and spoon on party rye bread and top with a spoon of pizza sauce. Bake 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Easy Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large baking dish. Bake at 275\u00b0 until done. Should be stirred occasionally. Will take 2 or 3 hours to bake. Great with homemade cornbread.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Beat Cool Whip and pudding mix. Add other ingredients and chill.

title: Brown Bread
instructions: Add all together adding boiling water last. Steam 3 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Skim and debone chicken breasts. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Put 1 slice of Swiss cheese over each piece. Mix mushroom soup with white wine and pour over chicken. Sprinkle bread crumb and butter mixture over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until done.

title: Crystals(Bread Crumb Cauliflowers)
instructions: Cut cauliflower into small pieces. Steam and drain. Melt butter in a large saucepan and add bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Brown lightly. Add cauliflower and coat. Serve as main course or as side dish.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Remove skin from chicken breasts. Place in covered boiler adding just enough water to cover chicken. Add basil cumin celery salt celery seed salt and thyme. Cook until very tender. Remove chicken. Cool. Reserve any remaining water. Cut chicken into small pieces. Add pickle relish lemon juice onion and mayonnaise. If needed add reserved water to make more moist. Chill well.

title: Old-Time Pear Mincemeat
instructions: Core and quarter pears (7 pounds). Cut lemon in quarters (seeds removed). Put pears lemon and raisins through food chopper (can use the blender). Combine all ingredients in large kettle; bring to a boil over medium heat and simmer 40 minutes. Pack in pint jars and process in boiling water 25 minutes or pack in plastic containers and freeze. Makes about 9 pints.

title: Gala Fresh Fruit Bowl
instructions: Peel and section the oranges over a large glass serving bowl to catch the juices. Add the sifted powdered sugar to the orange sections and juice in the serving bowl. Toss and coat. Gently stir in the halved strawberries and sliced kiwi fruit. Cover and chill the mixture until serving time. Before serving the fruit sprinkle the coconut over the top of the mixture.

title: Brown Sugar Cookies
instructions: Roll on floured board and cut.

title: Brownies With Peanut Butter Chips
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan.

title: Baked Bean And Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion in a small amount of fat. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients; add to meat mixture. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole with butter and add the sliced chicken pieces. In medium pan mix the soups. Add the milk to the soups. In separate pan melt oleo or butter and mix with water. Add to soup mixture. Pour entire mixture over sliced chicken and top with the stuffing cubes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes.

title: Eva Lois' Biscuits
instructions: Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400\u00b0 for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Sausage Ring
instructions: Cook sausage patties (can do ahead). Take uncooked biscuits and pull apart. Put sausage patties inside. Melt butter (1/2 stick) and brown sugar (1/2 cup) together in microwave. Put butter and brown sugar mixture into sausage ring pan. Sprinkle pecans and cherries on top of mixture. Place sausage biscuits on top and bake until biscuits are done. When done turn out on dish. Sugar mixture cherries and nuts will be on top. Serve.

title: Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Dissolve first three ingredients. Then add the rest of the ingredients. Stir well until a dough then knead well. Let rise until doubled in size. Then make into 2 loaves and let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mom'S Pineapple Punch
instructions: Combine concentrates and pineapple in blender. Blend until smooth. Pour in a gallon pitcher add water. Just before serving pour in cherry juice and ginger ale. Garnish with cherry lemon and lime slices.

title: Blanche'S Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except stuffing mix. Put one cup of stuffing mix into bottom of 2 qt. casserole. Add other mixed ingredients. Top this with other cup of stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30-40 minutes.

title: Beer Batter Fish
instructions: Cut fish into 3-inch pieces. Sprinkle with lemon and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Combine other ingredients and add beer.

title: Savory Spinach Diamonds
instructions: Heat oil in medium skillet over medium heat. Add onions cook and stir until soft and golden 5 to 6 minutes. Stir in garlic; cook 30 seconds. Remove from heat. Squeeze spinach to remove excess moisture. Whisk eggs and milk. Stir in spinach onion mixture and bread crumbs; mix well. Stir in cheeses. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Place mixture in pan; spread evenly. Bake 40 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature. To serve cut diagonally into 2 to 3-inch diamonds. Makes about 40.

title: Pineapple Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 2 round cake pans. Mix cake and bake in prepared pans according to package directions. Cool as directed and slice layers in half. Mix pineapple sugar cornstarch and lemon juice until thick. Add margarine. Cool. Add sour cream and vanilla to cooled filling. Spread filling over each layer and stack. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours.

title: Polish Pickle Soup
instructions: Put water in kettle and then add pork hocks and onion. Cook 1 hour. Remove pork hocks and cool. When cooled dice meat and set aside. Add potato cabbage and carrots to kettle. Cook until tender. Then add pickle juice pickles dill weed pepper and diced meat. Cook until heated through. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fourth Of July Parfaits
instructions: Into each of 8 (6 ounce) cold drink cups (or parfait glasses) pack 1/4 cup strawberry ice cream then 1/4 cup vanilla ice cream. Top with about 2 teaspoons blueberry preserves. Cover with foil; freeze 2 hours or until firm. Before serving let stand at room temperature 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Christmas Punch
instructions: Place orange juice lemon juice cranberry juice and sparkling water in punch bowl. Add mint ice cubes. Let stand 10 minutes. Garnish with orange slices studded with whole cloves. Yield 3 quarts or 24 1/2 cup servings.

title: Cheese Marinated Onions
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let marinate 30 minutes minimum and serve.

title: Banana Coffee Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Stir in banana.\tSift together dry ingredients. Add to banana mixture mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cinnamon-Sugar Pretzels
instructions: Thaw the bread dough in refrigerator overnight. Divide each loaf into 10 (2-inch) balls. Sprinkle work surface with flour. Roll each ball into an 18-inch long rope. On greased baking sheets form pretzels. Let stand in a warm place for 30 minutes.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Beat until fluffy first 5 ingredients. Add oleo and salt; mix well. Add raisins. Pour into uncooked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Herbed Biscuits
instructions: Place margarine in small microwavable bowl. Microwave on High (100%) until melted. Mix baking mix and milk until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Turn onto surface well floured with baking mix. Turn to coat with baking mix. Knead 10 times. Divide dough into 12 equal parts. Dip each part into margarine coating all sides. Roll in Herb-Cheese Coating. Place in 6-cup microwavable ring dish. Microwave on inverted microwavable dinner plate on Medium (50%) for 4 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Invert on heatproof serving plate. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dad'S Famous Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Cut up broccoli into small pieces. In a large saucepan boil broccoli until just tender drain and remove broccoli from saucepan. In same pan melt 2 sticks butter and saute onions add lemon juice. Slowly add flour until blended and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add water and bouillon cubes and cook while stirring until mixture is thickened. Add 1/3 of the broccoli to this mixture and blend in blender. Repeat until all the mix has been blended. Return blended mix to pan add salt pepper cream and remaining broccoli. Heat to boiling and serve.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake covered in greased casserole at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 20 minutes (optional). Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and bake uncovered about 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Pancakes
instructions: Mix or sift dry ingredients in a large bowl. Combine milk pumpkin yolks and margarine. Beat the 4 egg whites until they are stiff. Fold into batter. Pour onto lightly greased griddle. Cook until top if bubbly; flip. (You may need to add a little extra milk to thin the batter if desired.)

title: Can'T Fail 5 Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine milk sugar and salt in a saucepan over low heat. Boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add marshmallows chocolate or caramel chips vanilla and nuts. Stir until marshmallows melt. Pour in buttered 9-inch pan or spoon on waxed paper.

title: Democrat Salad
instructions: Stir well and chill.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and press into mold or shape into a ball. Roll in pecan meal or finely crushed pecans and refrigerate to set. Serve with crackers.

title: Green Onion Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cream cheese Worcestershire sauce soy sauce and Accent until creamy. Mix. Make into a ball and top with remaining 1/2 of ham.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg\tyolks and beat well. Add soda to buttermilk and add alternately with flour and salt. Stir in lemon flavoring. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into other mixture. Cook 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Spinach Salad With Oranges And Warm Goat Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut peel and white pith from oranges with a sharp small knife. Working over a sieve set over a bowl cut orange sections free from membranes letting sections drop into sieve. Cut goat cheese into fourths and gently form into a disk. Dip into pecans all over each disk to coat. Bake on a small baking sheet in middle of oven until heated through about 5 minutes. Measure out 1 tablespoon orange juice from bowl and whisk together with mustard vinegar salt and sugar in a large bowl. Add oil and whisk until blended. Add spinach onion and orange sections to dressing and toss well. Season with pepper. Divide among 4 salad plates and carefully transfer 1 goat-cheese disk to each salad. Yield 4 (first-course) servings. Prep Time 15 minutes. Cook Time 10 minutes.

title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix eggs sugar oil lemon peel and vanilla thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with a greased bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pennsylvania Dutch Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Line a greased 8-inch spring-form pan with nut grease. Mix together flour and sugar. Add cream cheese and blend thoroughly. In separate bowl beat eggs slightly. Add cream and vanilla. Combine with cheese mixture. Pour into prepared shell. Reduce oven heat to 325\u00b0 and place cake in center of oven. Bake 40 minutes. Center will appear soft. Turn oven off and let cake cook in oven with door open. Cake may crack but this is typical. The cake is best served at room temperature. It will keep refrigerated a week to 10 days if tightly wrapped.

title: Easy Penuche Icing
instructions: Melt margarine in saucepan. Add brown sugar; boil over low heat. Heat 2 minutes stirring constantly. Stir in milk; bring to boil stirring constantly. Cool to lukewarm. Gradually add powdered sugar. Beat until thick enough to spread. If too stiff add a little hot water.

title: Lazy Day Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles by package directions; drain. In 10 x 6 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish alternate layers of noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella and spaghetti sauce using sauce on top layer. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Quick And Easy Vegetables Romano
instructions: Saute zucchini and onion in margarine or olive oil about 10 minutes. Add spices and tomatoes. Continue cooking over low heat about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with Romano to taste.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream margarine. Add 1/2 cup powdered sugar and 2 cups of the flour. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Beat 4 eggs well. Add 2 cups sugar lemon peel and juice 1/4 cup flour and baking powder. Spread on baked crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool completely and dust with powdered sugar. Cut into bars.

title: Beefy Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Chop onion and brown with grated chuck; drain off grease. Stir together in bowl the beef onion and soup. Slice buns. On each bun put mixture and 1 slice of cheese. Wrap in aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Good Stuff Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on box. Add sour cream and Cool Whip to pudding and mix together well. Layer in large bowl the vanilla wafers sliced bananas and then pudding mixture. Continue layers until all pudding mixture is used. You can crush wafers and sprinkle on top if you like.

title: Flaky Pie Crust
instructions: Blend flour with Crisco. Add salt and egg mixture. Mix well. Roll on floured board or just press into two 9-inch pans.

title: Texas Buttermilk-Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine buttermilk sugar biscuit mix eggs butter vanilla and nutmeg in blender container. Cover and blend 3 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 or 45 minutes. Serve warm or cool. Makes 6 servings.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Shape a pan from a 12 x 10-inch sheet of foil by turning up edges to form a rectangle about 10 x 8-inches. Sprinkle nuts in pan; set aside. In 1 1/2-quart saucepan melt butter or margarine over medium-high heat. Immediately begin to stir in sugar gradually with a long handled wooden spoon (should take about 45 to 60 seconds). Continue to cook over medium-high heat about 6 to 7 minutes until mixture turns golden brown stirring only enough to prevent burning. Pour over nuts in prepared pan. Cool and break into pieces. Makes 3/4 pound candy.

title: Prize Winning Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil carrots celery and green onions in 2 cups of water for 5 minutes. Saute white onion in butter. Add flour and blend well. Boil milk and chicken broth. Stir briskly into white onion mixture with a wire whisk. Add cheese salt pepper and cayenne. Stir in mustard and boiled vegetables including the water in which they were cooked. Bring to a boil and serve immediately. Serves 8.

title: Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix cornstarch sugar and salt in double boiler top. Slowly stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly until thick enough to mound slightly when dropped from spoon. Stir a little hot mixture into beaten egg yolks then add to remaining mixture and cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat and add vanilla and coconut. Cool to room temperature. Turn into pie shell.

title: Spaghetti
instructions: Brown hamburger with green pepper and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Add spaghetti sauce and simmer while spaghetti cooks. Boil spaghetti in a pan of boiling water until tender. Drain off water and add to meat mixture. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with tossed salad and French bread.

title: Old Fashioned Lemonade
instructions: Place the sugar 2 cups water and lemon rind in a saucepan. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Add lemon juice and cold water. Chill thoroughly. Garnish with a sprig of mint or marshmallow in each glass.

title: Baby Ruth Bars
instructions: Boil sugar brown sugar and syrup together just to a full boil. Stir in peanut butter. Add corn flakes and peanuts. Press in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread melted chocolate chips or large Hershey bars. (I use half and half candy and chips.)

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Sprinkle bacon cheese and onion in pie shell. Beat eggs slightly. Beat in remaining ingredients; pour cream mixture into pie shell. Bake for 15 minutes. Reduce oven to 300\u00b0; bake 30 minutes longer. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Sugar And Spice Pecans
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except the pecans. Mix well. Add the pecan halves and stir until evenly coated. Spread on large greased cookie sheet. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Turn halfway through. Remove to wax paper while still warm. Cool and store in airtight container. Makes 9 cups.

title: Opera Fudge
instructions: Cream butter and cream cheese. Add vanilla and sugar. Chill overnight. Roll mix between wax paper on cookie sheet. Cut unto small squares. Put mix in freezer for 2 hours before coating.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Fry bacon and remove from pan. Brown ground beef and onion; drain off bacon grease. Grease large casserole dish. Combine drained beans with meat and onion. Add brown sugar ketchup and vinegar. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crusty Cheese Rings
instructions: Combine flour and butter in bowl; cut butter into flour until smaller than peas. Mix in cream and vinegar. Stir in cheese; form dough into a ball.\tRoll dough out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into rings with doughnut cutter. Place rings and holes on ungreased baking sheet about 1 inch apart; chill for\t30 minutes. Brush tops with egg white. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Cut cucumbers in four sections and soak in lightly salted water for 10 minutes. Remove and dry with paper towel. Grate cucumbers coarsely and drain. Mix with cheese onion and salt. Spread both sides of bread with mayonnaise. Add cucumber filling. Trim or cut sandwiches as desired.

title: Salmon Muffins
instructions: Drain and flake salmon saving liquid. Add sufficient milk to liquid to measure 1 cup. Mix and sift flour baking powder salt and sugar into mixing bowl. Make a hole in center of dry ingredients. Combine oil egg and milk mixture. Add to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened to make a lumpy batter. Do not overmix. Fold in salmon. Spoon into greased muffin tin (2/3 full). Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen muffins. Nice served with a salad.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple with juice and pudding mix. Carefully stir in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Refrigerate covered about 2 hours or more.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Cook chicken in Dutch oven about 1 hour. When cool enough skin and cut up. Keep warm. Strain broth and measure. You should have 6 cups; if not add water. Put stock back in pot and add potatoes onion parsley and celery stalks. Cook for 15 minutes before adding dumplings. Bring stockpot to rapid boil.

title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
instructions: Melt in top of double boiler over hot water the cheese. Then add the pimientos condensed milk and mayonnaise. Add as much finely chopped pickle as desired. Mix thoroughly.

title: Tamale Bake Salad
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix corn meal cold water margarine and salt. Add boiling water and heat until mixture thickens. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Spread corn meal mixture in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake 15 minutes. While this is baking brown ground beef taco mix and onion soup mix. Drain off fat. Press half hamburger mixture in corn meal crust; sprinkle with 1 cup cheese. Bake 20 minutes uncovered. Mix remaining ground beef mixture with lettuce; put on baked corn meal crust. Garnish with sour cream taco sauce olives and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain and set aside. Cook noodles; drain and set aside. In casserole dish put meat and onion in bottom. Add noodles. Pour soup over this. Add cheese and crackers. Pour melted butter on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill until ready to serve.

title: Casserole
instructions: Toss together all vegetables. Stir together soup and sour cream and fold into vegetables. Spread with topping and bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes till crumbs are browned.

title: Salmon Pate
instructions: Line a 2-cup bowl with buttered plastic wrap. Blend salmon with the dressing mix cream cheese and onion. Press into lined bowl and chill. Serve with sliced cucumbers and crackers.

title: Skillet Date Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet. Add dates sugar and beaten eggs. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Form into small balls and roll in additional Rice Krispies.

title: Broccoli Carrot Casserole
instructions: Place pkg. of unopened broccoli on microproof plate. (If broccoli is in foil-wrapped pkg. remove foil.) Cook on HI for 2 minutes; set aside. Combine carrots flour onion salt pepper and sour cream in 1 1/2 quart microproof casserole. Cut broccoli into 1 inch pieces and stir into carrot mixture. Cover with casserole lid and cook on HI for 3 minutes. Stir gently. Place butter in 2 cup measure and cook on HI for 45-60 seconds or until melted. Stir in stuffing. Spoon stuffing mixture over broccoli. Cook uncovered on HI for 4-5 minutes or until hot. Note Total cooking time 9 3/4-11 minutes.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: *Could put 1 whole onion in center of casserole and remove before serving.

title: Cutout Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar vanilla and egg; beat until light. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Chill dough for several hours or overnight wrapped tightly in foil or wax paper. Roll out to 1/8 inch thickness. Cut into shapes with floured cookie cutter. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 325\u00b0 oven for about 8 minutes. Cool on wire rack and decorate.

title: Bacon And Cheddar Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cover potatoes with water in large saucepan. Bring to boil; reduce heat to medium. Cook 20 minutes or until tender. Drain. Mash potatoes. Add milk dressing bacon and garlic powder and beat until fluffy. Season to taste with the salt and pepper. Stir in cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Ranch Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients. Separately combine the dressing mix with mayonnaise and juice. Add to chicken mixture and toss well to coat. Chill.

title: Filled Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients and then slowly add flour. Divide dough and roll. Cut into pieces. Add 1 teaspoon of filling per cookie. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes approximately 14 dozen.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Heat pineapple juice to boiling. Add enough water to make 2 cups juice; mix well with jello. Add pineapple and blueberries; allow to set. Allow cream cheese to soften; mix with the powdered sugar. Add sour cream; mix thoroughly. Spread on top of congealed jello. Top with chopped pecans.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar vanilla oil salt soda baking powder zucchini and flour. Mix; then stir in the remaining ingredients. Mix really well. Bake in 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Gourmet Peas
instructions: Boil peas according to directions. While peas are boiling chop green onions and shred lettuce. When peas are done drain and add remaining ingredients.

title: Salmon Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; form into loaf. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Delicious!

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix all together. Bake according to cake mix directions. Cool completely. Makes 2 layers.

title: Cherry-Cheese Brownie Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare brownie mix as directed on package except bake 20 minutes.

title: Frozen Pie
instructions: Let ice cream melt a little then mix all ingredients together. Put mixture in graham cracker pie crust. Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Blend margarine brown sugar white sugar eggs and vanilla. Beat well.\tSift together flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to first mixture. Blend in oatmeal cornflakes and coconut. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Turkey Gravy(Mama Williams' Style)
instructions: Note Broth will already have some salt.

title: Orange Cheese Pie
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold milk in blender or food processor.\tLet stand while assembling remaining ingredients. Add hot milk and process at low speed until gelatin dissolves. Stop blender; add remaining ingredients. Cover and process at high speed until smooth. Pour into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle a few crumbs on top to garnish; chill until firm.

title: Easy French Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender for a few seconds or with a mixer for 2 minutes. Store covered in the refrigerator. Makes 1-1/2 c. dressing.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Put cherry pie mix in bottom of 9 x 5-inch baking pan. Sprinkle cake mix over cherries. Cut margarine in thin slices over cake mix. Sprinkle coconut over top. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Puree(Baba Ghanouge)
instructions: Pierce eggplants at different points. Broil for 30 minutes turning occasionally (the surface should be burned and cracked). Remove skin drain pulp. Combine all ingredients in blender; puree until smooth. Garnish with chopped parsley and olive oil. Eat with fresh pita bread.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream the sugar and oil. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour salt and cocoa together; alternately add to creamed mixture with buttermilk. Add vanilla and coloring then fold in soda. Bake in two 9-inch pans at 350\u00b0 for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Canoe Crab Dip
instructions: Hollow out one loaf of bread. Break or cut the part you have removed and the entire second loaf into dipping-sized pieces. Combine mayonnaise cheese crab and onion in baking dish. (May be done ahead to this point and refrigerated.)

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Saute onion garlic green chilies and Ro-Tel tomatoes in 4 tablespoons butter in a large pot. Add tomatoes broth and corn. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Add cubed chicken and simmer 15 to 30 minutes longer. (The longer this simmers the better the flavor.) Serve over tortilla chips and top with shredded cheese.

title: Peanut Butter Bread
instructions: Combine flour and baking powder in a bowl. Add peanut butter and sugar. Mix well. Beat eggs and milk together. Add to flour mix and mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Wash eggplant. Do not peel. Slice about 1/2-inch thick. Dip in flour then egg then cracker crumbs until well coated. Saute in olive oil (a few slices at a time) until golden brown. Arrange in baking dish and top each with a slice of Mozzarella cheese.

title: Master Mix
instructions: Sift together the flour baking powder salt cream of tartar sugar and dry milk. Cut in shortening with pastry blender until mixture looks like coarse cornmeal. Store in covered container at room temperature.

title: Orange Dessert
instructions: Combine pudding and water. Cook until thickened. Add orange Jell-O just as it comes from the box. Stir well. Cool in refrigerator. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Layer pudding then orange slices then pudding etc. until bowl is full. Add a few slices of orange on top. Chill at least 2 to 3 hours before serving. Keeps overnight well.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Slice cucumbers leaving peeling on. Mix cream cheese mayonnaise and dressing mix and spread on bread. Put on cucumber slices to cover spread on bread. Put top bread slice on and cut into 4 pieces.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Sift dry ingredients; add egg yolks and water. Add to creamed mixture. Add carrots and nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans for about 30 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Picnic Pinto Bake
instructions: Brown beef and drain well. Add all ingredients except cornbread mix. Pour in large dish. Mix cornbread as directed on package. Pour over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is brown.

title: Crab Stew
instructions: Saute onions celery and bell pepper in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook on low heat 30 minutes stirring constantly. Do not boil.

title: Tasty Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix thoroughly and shake in airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup.

title: Country Style Smothered Chicken
instructions: Salt chicken; roll each piece in flour and place in roasting pan. Lay 4 to 5 pieces bacon onion slices and celery leaves on top of chicken. Cover with water and bake 3 hours.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers; cover with 1/2 cup salt and ice for 3 hours. Drain water. Bring liquid to a boil. Add cucumbers and onions. Bring to a boil. Pack in hot jars and seal. (Have lids hot also.)

title: Orange Pineapple Cake
instructions: Follow the directions for making the cake mix but use the juice from the pineapple and oranges instead of water. Add oranges. Pour cake in 3 round 8-inch pans. Bake according to box instructions. Cool.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole layer half the beans with half the water chestnuts half the bean sprouts half the mushrooms and half the chopped onion. Cover with half the mushroom soup. Sprinkle lightly with salt and cheese. Repeat layering. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until bubbly hot. Top with crumbled French fried onion rings the last 10 minutes.

title: Oven Fried Chicken With Red Rice
instructions: Cut up chicken. Season with seasoned salt and pepper. Place in pan skinned side up. Use 1/2 stick of butter and place small piece on each piece. Cover with foil and cook until done in 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with paprika. Uncover chicken and pour broth off and save. Cook rice in pot until tender. Saute onions pepper and celery with 1 stick of butter. Add cooked rice and stir. Pour broth in rice. Add tomato paste. Add sugar and stir until rice is red.

title: Best Yet Cracker Jacks
instructions: Boil sugar syrup butter and cream of tartar for 5 minutes. Add soda quickly stirring in. Pour over popcorn. Mix well and spread on lightly greased cookie sheet (I use 2 cookie sheets). Put in 200\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Take out and let cool.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Over low heat in a saucepan combine semi-sweet chocolate chips and sweetened condensed milk. Before you take off burner add dash of salt and stir. Take off heat and add vanilla and nuts.

title: Cream Cheese Tarts
instructions: Beat cream cheese eggs sugar and lemon juice until smooth and fluffy (at least 5 minutes). Place vanilla wafers in bottom of cupcake papers and place in muffin pan. Pour cream cheese mixture on top of vanilla wafers until cups are at least half full. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Tarts will crack across the top but will go back together as they cool. Refrigerate. Remove cupcake paper and top with your favorite topping just before serving.

title: Taco Party Dip
instructions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream until smooth; spread on large platter or round pizza pan. Sprinkle 1/2 package taco seasoning on top. Add salt and pepper. Brown hamburger; drain and let cool. Put on top of cream cheese layer. Chop up tomatoes onion and green pepper; mix in bowl then layer over hamburger. Sprinkle on rest of taco seasoning. Layer grated cheese and top with olives and 1 tablespoon sour cream in middle.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: In medium bowl mix canola oil balsamic vinegar sugar pepper garlic and ketchup. Cut vegetables into bite size pieces and stir into mixture. Serves 4 to 6. Best when chilled.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together (except chocolate chips) until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with chocolate chips and let cool.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice and drain well. Put butter in drained hot rice to melt or melt it in a small pan. Add sugar salt and milk and stir. Add eggs and blend well. Add raisins if desired and lemon peel and mix to blend. Turn into buttered baking dish and sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 45 to 55 minutes or until done.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the pineapple and save the juice. Add enough orange juice to make 1 1/3 cups. Mix juice and pudding in a saucepan and cook until thick. Drain the other fruit. Cut the bananas into the hot tapioca. Add the other fruit. Pour into a bowl. Garnish with cherries. May be served either warm or chilled; delicious either way.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Melt stick of margarine in 9 x 11-inch pan. Mix sugar milk and flour. Pour over melted margarine. Drop spoonfuls of pie filling over batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve hot topped with vanilla ice cream.

title: Turkey With Pineapple
instructions: Place turkey breast skin side up on rack in shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer so tip is in thickest part of meat and does not touch bone. Roast uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Place sweet potatoes and brown sugar in baking dish. Slice margarine and place on top of yams. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Add enough marshmallows to cover sweet potatoes. Bake 5 minutes more until marshmallows are browned.

title: Soy Baked Chicken
instructions: Blend soy sauce fruit juice undiluted bouillon garlic and ginger. Pour over chicken. Cover and marinate 1 hour. Remove chicken pieces from sauce and arrange in large oblong baking pan. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour basting chicken about every 15 minutes with some of the remaining marinade. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Pour rice into boiling water; remove from heat. Let cook for 5 minutes.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter in the top of a double boiler. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Combine eggs sugar salt and syrup in a mixing bowl. Beat to blend. Add cooled chocolate and butter mixture. Beat to blend. Place pecans in the bottom of the pie shell. Pour egg mixture over pecans. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 50 minutes. The top should be soft and the center not fully set when shaken. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar and shortening. Mix until smooth; add eggs and vanilla. Add milk. Stir in dry ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add eggs and blend well. Add food coloring and cocoa and blend in buttermilk. Add flour and salt mixing well. Gradually add vanilla and beat. Mix vinegar and soda and stir in last. Dont overbeat. Pour mixture into 9-inch pans and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Fanny Farmer Fudge
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Put Carnation milk sugar and marshmallows in pan. Bring to boil and cook 6 minutes stirring constantly. Pour this mixture over the mixture in the bowl until the chips are melted. Pour in greased pan and cool. Cut in squares.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar flour buttermilk butter vanilla and salt. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Passover Carrot-Almond Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Heavily oil tube pan. Dust with matzo meal. Beat egg yolks until thick. Add sugar and beat until pale yellow and very creamy. Beat in honey. Mix in lemon juice. Fold in carrots and almonds. Mix cake meal almonds and cinnamon. Combine into mixture. Beat egg whites to peaks and fold into batter. Pour into oiled and dusted 8 cup pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until brown and springy. Place on rack and cool in pan. Run knife around edges to loosen after cooled. Invert onto serving plate. Dust with remaining tablespoon sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet or make into balls and press out with fork; dip fork in water. Instead of pressing out with fork put a hole in center of cookie ball and fill hole with jelly. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Shred the zucchini and mix with eggs salad oil sugar and vanilla. Blend well. Sift together all the dry ingredients. Add to zucchini mixture. Stir only until well moistened. Fold in nuts and raisins or dates. Pour batter into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. (Some use pumpkin pie spice instead of cinnamon.)

title: Company Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix sour cream and soup with cooked chicken. Put in casserole. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Pour melted butter over top of crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ceviche
instructions: Add to ingredients one 6 ounce can shrimp drained and rinsed. Serve over rice cooked according to package directions. Season to taste with Tabasco sauce. Serves 4.

title: Rhonda'S Christmas Breakfast
instructions: Put sausage in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Toss bread in melted butter and layer over sausage. Add cheese. Beat eggs milk and seasoning. Pour over layered mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Best if let stand in refrigerator overnight before baking.

title: Biscuits
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Add shortening and stir with fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Put in all milk and stir until dough follows fork in bowl. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead 8 or 10 times and roll out. Cut biscuits into rounds and bake at 450\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Cheese Potato Soup(Serves 6)
instructions: Melt butter. Saute onions until tender. Place water in large kettle. Dissolve bouillon. Add salt potatoes and onions. Cook until potatoes are tender 40 minutes or 5 minutes in pressure cooker. Blend in processor with 2 cups of milk.

title: One Pot Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: In 3-quart pot bring water and salt to a boil. Stir in macaroni and return to boil. Stirring occasionally boil for 4 minutes. Lower heat to medium and continue boiling for 7 minutes stirring frequently. Last 2 minutes may need to lower heat to prevent sticking. Drain all water off. Add remaining ingredients and stir well until cheese is melted.

title: Nine-Day Cole Slaw
instructions: Stir together cabbage onion green pepper and 1 cup sugar. Bring to a boil salad oil vinegar celery seed salt and 2 more tablespoons sugar. Pour hot mixture over cabbage; toss well and chill overnight before serving. Recipe makes about 2 quarts.

title: Barbecue Hot Dogs
instructions: Score hot dogs diagonally. Combine all ingredients and pour over 8 to 10 hot dogs. Simmer 10 minute or until done.

title: Chocolate Bundles
instructions: Thaw pastry 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. On a lightly floured surface roll pastry to a 12-inch square; cut into 4 (6-inch) squares.

title: Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding as directed on package. When set fold in thawed Cool Whip. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers. Top with all of the pudding mixture. Layer another layer of graham crackers on top. Top with rest of the pudding mixture. Layer another layer of graham crackers on top. Mix the chocolate butter or margarine syrup milk vanilla and sugar together until creamy. Spread on top of last layer of crackers. Chill overnight. Must be made day ahead.

title: Pecan Clusters
instructions: Put sugar evaporated milk and corn syrup into a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture boils and is bubbly all over top. Boil and stir over medium heat 2 minutes more. Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate morsels until completely melted. Stir in pecans. Drop with 2 teaspoons on wax paper. Chill until set. Makes 24.

title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon; swirl through batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Mushroom Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in 1 teaspoon butter for 10 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add additional butter to pan and saute onion garlic and mushrooms until moisture is absorbed. Add milk soup and pepper; mix well. Add chicken breasts and heat an additional 10 minutes. Prepare noodles and drain. Place noodles and chicken breasts on a serving platter; cover with sauce.

title: Tuna Cheese Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the rolls. Mix well. Slit rolls and fill with tuna mixture. Wrap each roll in foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Turkey Mandarin Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine turkey onion and salt; mix well. Add grapes celery oranges and macaroni; toss lightly to mix. Cover and refrigerate. Just before serving combine mayonnaise and whipped cream; fold into salad along with almonds. Top with toasted almonds if desired. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Curried Goat
instructions: Mix salt pepper and flour. Dredge pieces of meat and shake off excess flour. Heat oil in skillet. Chop onion and garlic. Brown in skillet until transparent. Remove with slotted spoon and place in Dutch oven or suitable stew pot. Add meat to skillet and brown on all sides. Add to stew pot with garlic and onion. Deglaze skillet with 3 tablespoons of wine vinegar or 1/4 cup red wine. Add to stew pot with water to cover. Simmer slowly until tender (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Stir in curry powder to taste.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Fill cups almost 1/2 full. Add hot water.

title: Raw Apple Bread
instructions: Sift together the flour salt and baking soda in small bowl. In large bowl cream together shortening eggs and sugar. Mix in flour mixture the vanilla and milk. Add apples and nuts; mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. This recipe will also make 3 small loaves which will bake in 45 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Put 2 tablespoons of oil in pan to coat it. Combine rest of ingredients including rest of oil. Mix well and pour in oil. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Fudgy Pecan Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell; set aside. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In medium saucepan over low heat melt margarine. Add cocoa and stir until mixture is smooth. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Stir in sugar salt eggs and corn syrup. Blend thoroughly. Stir in chopped nuts. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Place pecan halves over top. Bake 40 minutes. Cool. Cover; let stand about 8 hours before serving.

title: Black Forest Appetizers
instructions: Brown meat and drain grease. Melt cheese with meat and mix remaining ingredients. Spread on cocktail rye bread. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Ritz Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites. Fold in sugar and baking powder. Fold in Ritz crackers and nut meats. Pour into well greased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Put carrots zucchini and onion in a large pan. Put enough water in to cover vegetables. Bring to a boil and boil for 15 minutes. Drain.

title: Black Bottom Witches' Pie
instructions: Crush wafers; place in bowl. Add sugar and butter. Mix. Press into 9-inch pie plate. Chill.

title: Stromboli
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan flatten out 1 package of crescent rolls in bottom. Thaw out spinach and squeeze out all the water. Mix spinach with egg in bowl and spread mixture over crescent rolls. Cover spinach mixture with 1 cup cheese. In a bowl mix tomato sauce garlic salt and oregano to taste. Spread sauce over cheese. Place pepperoni down and cover with 1 cup cheese.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Dessert
instructions: Butter 9 x 13 glass pan. Slice angel food cake and put in layer in bottom of dish. Make strawberry jello with water. Add frozen strawberries. Pour over layer of cake. Make instant vanilla pudding. After strawberry layer is set spread pudding over top. Put in refrigerator to get cold. Frost with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Best if let to set overnight.

title: Deviled Clams
instructions: Pour clam juice over bread slices and let stand until soft; set aside. Mix all remaining ingredients well (mixture should be moist). Put into buttered clam shells or roll into clam cakes. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Casserole With Herbs
instructions: Soak rice 2 to 3 hours if brown is used then drain and put in well-buttered casserole. Slice carrots potatoes and onions into thick slices. Slice celery into fairly large pieces. Place in layers on top of rice. Sprinkle each layer generously with garlic chips. Season with pepper and parsley. Add a pinch or two of bay leaves and caraway seed or sweet basil. Lay cabbage wedges over top and pour over all the mushroom soup beef base sour cream and water (well mixed). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until vegetables and rice are done about 1 1/2 hours. Bake covered to keep from burning cabbage.

title: Cottage Cheese Pie
instructions: Drain the cottage cheese in a sieve for several hours to remove liquid. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Make a pie crust according to your favorite recipe and fit it into a 9-inch pie plate.

title: Cucumber Soup
instructions: Mix soup water and sour cream until smooth (wire whip works well). Add rest of ingredients then chill for several hours before serving. Hope you enjoy it.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 10-inch skillet.

title: Chicken In A Blanket
instructions: Blend cream cheese and margarine. Add other ingredients except rolls. Combine 2 rolls and arrange in flat rectangle; place 2 Tbsp. of filling in each. Pinch ends together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Cake Recipe
instructions: Mix fruit and pour into cake pan. Cover fruit with dry cake mix making sure all of fruit is covered. Slice butter into squares and place on top of cake mix.

title: Crawfish Etouffee
instructions: Saute seasonings (onions etc.) in oleo. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 to 30 minutes. Green onion tops and parsley may be added. Serve over hot rice.

title: Buttermilk Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Mix well and set in refrigerator immediately. This will keep up to a week in the refrigerator. Just pinch off and roll out the amount needed. Heat oven to 425\u00b0 and bake until golden brown.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Saute vegetables in margarine. When tender add soups and cheese. Heat until cheese melts. Stir in pimento and mushrooms. Cook vermicelli in chicken broth drain and fold in sauce. Stir in deboned chicken. Pour into large casserole dish or into two small ones. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 until very hot. Freezes well. If freezing do not bake until thawed.

title: Pumpkin Dump
instructions: *May use 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice in place of cinnamon cloves and ginger.

title: Barbecue Chicken Bites
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces and brown in saucepan. Brown onion in oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes. Pour over chicken. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 hour. If you want to cook chicken longer cover with foil until desired tenderness. Baste often. This sauce is also good with other meats. Serves 4.

title: Basic Waffle Recipe
instructions: Put dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Beat milk oil and eggs with a wire whisk.\tMix everything together until smooth. Cook in electric waffle iron.

title: Microwave Chicken Or Turkey Tetrazzini
instructions: Microwave spaghetti in 6 to 7 cups very hot water with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon oil in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish for 9 minutes or cook on top of stove per package directions. Drain spaghetti and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish sprayed with Pam butter flavored cooking spray.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions in oleo until tender stir in soup and Cheez Whiz and cook over low heat until cheese melts. Cook broccoli until tender; drain well. Combine all ingredients and place in casserole dish. Cook 20 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until heated thoroughly.

title: Springtime Sole(Microwave)
instructions: Place fillets in 1 1/2-quart utility dish. Sprinkle with thyme. Cover loosely with heavy-duty plastic wrap. Cook covered on full power for 3 to 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Drain.

title: Mom'S Garlic Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Dissolve your yeast in warm water. Add sugar; then add rest of ingredients in order knead until smooth. Let stand in warm place and punch down well every 10 minutes for 5 times. Divide into 3 equal parts. Roll out into rectangle and roll up as jelly roll. Brush with cold water and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise and bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Let cool. Mix fruit condensed milk and pecans. Crumble spice cake into fruit mixture and mix well. Press into greased loaf pans. Makes 2 loaf cakes.

title: Texas Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown meat with the onion and bell pepper chopped fine. Add the catsup chili and relish. Simmer for 1 hour and serve on warm hamburger buns.

title: 30-Day Friendship Cake
instructions: Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done.

title: Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt bark and chips until smooth. Stir in peanuts. Drop by spoon on wax paper.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut steak in 3 x 3-inch pieces. Rub meat with garlic salt and pepper. Brown steak in oil. When brown on each side add onion tomatoes 1/2 can water and green pepper strips. Simmer 30 minutes or until tender.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Break lettuce into bite size pieces into bowl; top with cauliflower also broken into bite size pieces. Top with onion crisp bacon (crumbled can use bacon bits) and Parmesan cheese. Mix Miracle Whip and Italian dressing; pour over other ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Toss just before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle on top of potato mixture and bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes.

title: Coffee Frappe
instructions: In punch bowl break ice cream into chunks. Pour chilled coffee over and stir until ice cream is partially thawed. Stir in whipped cream. Should be the consistency of a milk shake. Serves 35.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Slice zucchini 1/2-inch thick. Cook with onion until almost done; drain well. Cook rice as directed on package; reserve. Place zucchini mixture in buttered 9 x 12-inch shallow casserole dish. Sprinkle with rice. Mix soup and milk together then pour over rice. Top with cheese slices; sprinkle top with bread crumbs that have been mixed with the melted butter or margarine. Place casserole in pan of water. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Blend in flour and salt; gradually add milk and cook stirring constantly until thickened. Add cheese and broccoli. Stir until cheese is melted. Makes 6 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Potatoes And Ham Casserole
instructions: Combine butter flour and mustard; cook over low heat stirring constantly until bubbly. Gradually add milk; stir constantly until smooth and thick. Season sauce with salt and pepper. Add 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Stir until melted. Stir in ham and onions. Place cooked potatoes in a lightly greased 2-quart dish; pour sauce over potatoes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Finger Drumsticks
instructions: Divide wings in half at joint and cut off and discard tips. Place in single layer on rack in broiler pan. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0. Turn once. Mix dry ingredients in saucepan. Stir in water lemon juice and soy sauce. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and boil 3 minutes. Brush part over chicken wings. Continue baking turning and basting several times for 40 minutes or until richly glazed.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Place sweet potatoes in baking pan. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over sweet potatoes and bake at 350\u00b0 until all ingredients are fully heated about 1/2 hour.

title: Settlers Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Spaghetti Amore
instructions: Lightly brown ground beef chopped onion and green pepper in shortening; stir occasionally. Add 1 can each of cream of mushroom and tomato soups 1 soup can water and 1 minced garlic clove; heat. Blend with 1/2 cup shredded sharp process cheese and 1/2 pound spaghetti (cooked and drained) in a 3-quart casserole; top with 1/2 cup more cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings. This is delicious served with a spinach salad.

title: Fruit Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Combine fruits; sprinkle with lemon juice and chill. Add whipped cream dressing; toss lightly. Serve on crisp lettuce; garnish with coconut. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in hot fat. Brown onion in 2 tablespoons fat. Add remaining ingredients; simmer for 30 minutes. Pour over chicken. Bake uncovered in a slow 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Sauce may be used for meats also. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hummus
instructions: Cook chickpeas in enough water to keep covered. Cook for approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Taste peas from time to time until done. Save water when done. In a food processor add the ingredients in \batches.\ Add chickpea water to keep it smooth (a thicker than pudding look). Mix batches in a bowl with a wooden spoon. Serve on a plate with olive oil drizzled on it also with pita wedges and veggies.

title: Cream Puff Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Beat in eggs one at a time. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Top with pudding mix (optional add cream cheese to pudding). Top with whipped cream (Cool Whip). Grate chocolate for topping.

title: Provencal Vegetable Soup
instructions: In 2 1/2 qts. water cook together leek onion green beans potatoes carrots tomatoes and salt. Cook for 45 minutes or until tender. In the last 1/2 hour add zucchini. If youre using any frozen vegetables add them the last 15 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Prepare a garlic paste by crushing together garlic and basil. Gradually work in tomato paste parmesan cheese and olive oil. Add a few Tbsp. of the broth to the garlic paste mix well then stir the paste into the soup. Heat 5 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Tallarina
instructions: Cook noodles in water until done. Saute beef onion pepper and salt for a few minutes in a skillet. Add soup and corn. Mix this with noodles a layer of one and then the other. Add olives. Put in casserole and cover with cheese. Bake 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve hot.

title: Gladys Howard'S Angel Biscuits
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in shortening.\tStir in yeast and milk. Roll and cut as desired or make Parker House rolls. Bake on middle rack of oven at 450\u00b0. Dough may be covered and refrigerated as long as a week using as needed.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Note May substitute 1 teaspoon dried onion flakes.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream up sugar and shortening. Add eggs and mix well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and vanilla. Mix well. Use 1/2 dough at a time. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured board and cut out. Bake on ungreased sheets.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Put cranberries in stew pot. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Cut fire. Lift cranberries out and mash through colander. Peel most of orange. Quarter and blend in blender. Use only 1 cup of water to each package of jello. Drain pineapple; use only fruit. Add together with cranberry and nuts. Chill.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl combine shortening. Add sugar gradually. Add eggs and pumpkin and beat until mixed well. Sift together flour salt baking powder and spices. Slowly add dry ingredients to the creamed mixture. Mix until well blended. Stir in nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Add rice and salt to cold water and cook until all the water is cooked out. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix together butter crumbs sugar and peanut butter. Pat out in 13 x 9-inch pan. Melt in saucepan chocolate chips. Spread this over peanut butter mixture. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Microwave Spicy Apple Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Place apples and blueberries in a microwave round 8 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of dry pudding mix. Set aside.

title: Best Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Stir in nuts. Spread in 9 x 11-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until brownie pulls away from sides of pan 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut in squares.

title: Cheese Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onions and peppers in butter. Add beans catsup and cheese. Bake in 2 qt. casserole 30 minutes until bubbly. Garnish with 1/2 c. shredded cheese.

title: Red Cherry Party Dessert
instructions: Crust Combine all ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 or 20 minutes. Cool.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Cook the first 3 ingredients in a pan for about 5 minutes. Stir together next 3 ingredients to make stiff shortcake dough. Spread dough roughly in buttered 6 x 10 x 2-inch pan. Pour above heated mixture with peaches evenly over the dough. Sprinkle nutmeg over the top lightly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken And Rice
instructions: Rinse rice. Beat all the soups and water together. Put rice on bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Pour soup on top and stir around. Lay chicken pieces on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine everything but the cheese. Put in a 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Bonnie'S Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and egg yolks together; add all other ingredients. Mix well. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff; fold dough and whites together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Manhattan Supper Soup
instructions: In large kettle cook meat until it loses its red color. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 50 minutes. You can add 1 (10 ounce) package frozen peas if you wish but dont add until last 10 minutes of cooking time.

title: Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Cream sugar butter and eggs. Blend in peanut butter and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients and press into a greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until done. Cool. Frost.

title: Caramel Sauce
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan. Add sugar. Melt slowly. Mix cornstarch in water. Add this slowly to the melted margarine. Bring slowly to a boil. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Very good served warm over gingerbread.

title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove chicken and cook noodles in broth until tender. Mix well the soups and broth together. Add chicken and noodles to the soup mixture; mix well and put in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quesadillas
instructions: Blend together the first 5 ingredients. Refrigerate 1 hour. Spread mixture over 5 tortillas covering with remaining tortillas. Brush tops with oil.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Simmer vegetables in water and bouillon until tender about 12 to 15 minutes. Add spaghetti sauce and simmer gently 5 minutes longer. Makes eight 1-cup servings.

title: Banana Tea Bread
instructions: Cream together oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs sour cream milk and almond flavoring to creamed mixture and mix well. Mix together flour baking powder soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with mashed bananas. Pour into well-greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done.

title: Chocolate Cake(Fat Free)
instructions: Spray 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray. In large bowl combine flour cocoa cornstarch baking powder baking soda and salt. In medium bowl using a fork or wire whisk stir sugar and water until sugar is almost dissolved. Add egg whites and corn syrup. Stir until thoroughly blended. Gradually add to flour mixture stirring until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan or wire rack. Makes 16 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Orange Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo; add eggs one at a time. Add soda to buttermilk and add milk and flour alternately to sugar mixture also mixing in orange rind. Bake in loaf or angel food cake pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Remove cake from oven. Combine 1 cup orange juice and 2 cups sugar. Heat in saucepan until sugar dissolves. With cake still in pan add juice and sugar mixture to cake by slipping knife into cake for small holes and letting juice mixture soak through. Continue until all of juice mixture is absorbed.

title: April'S Buffet Surprise
instructions: Place beef in a large pot at least 4-quart size. Place sauerkraut on top of meat. Sprinkle brown sugar over sauerkraut and pour tomatoes on top of that. Place onions and pieces of apples in the pot and grind pepper over everything. Cover the pot and cook in slow oven at 300\u00b0 until meat falls apart and is very tender 3 to 4 hours. This can be made ahead and frozen or refrigerated to be reheated before serving. Serves 4 to 6 adults.

title: Pecan Delights
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add and mix other ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 2 1/2 dozen.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in butter. Blend in flour and Milnot. Cook until smooth. Add salt 1/2 of cheese chicken mushrooms and pimento. Grease a casserole dish. Alternate sauce with spaghetti. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Parmesan Twists
instructions: Cream the butter. Gradually add cheese and sour cream mixing well. Combine flour and seasoning. Gradually add to creamed mixture blending until smooth. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide in half. Roll out half of dough to a 12 x 7-inch rectangle and cut into 6 (1/2-inch) strips. Twist each strip 2 or 3 times and place on a greased cookie sheet. Repeat with remaining dough. Combine egg yolk and water. Brush strips with egg mixture; sprinkle with seed. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Bring potatoes 1 teaspoon salt and water to cover to a boil in a Dutch oven or stockpot; cover reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until tender; drain.
