Beat potatoes remaining 3/4 teaspoon salt butter half-and-half garlic cloves and pepper at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in fresh parsley. Serve immediately. Makes 8 servings.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and bell pepper in oleo. Combine with all other ingredients. Place in casserole and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown hamburger. Add refried beans and 1/2 can of enchilada sauce. Dip tortillas one at a time in hot Crisco just a couple of seconds. Drain on paper towel. Fill each with meat mixture tomatoes onions olives chillies and lots of cheese. Roll up. Lay in a 9 x 13-inch pan with folded side down. Fill and roll all 12 tortillas. Before baking top with rest of enchilada sauce and shredded cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let stand a couple of minutes before serving.

title: Sweet And Sour Vegetables
instructions: Mix 1 cup of sugar 1 cup of vinegar 1/2 cup of oil and 1 tablespoon of water. Bring to a boil and cool.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Slice ham off bone and dice. Cover with water and boil for 2 or more hours or until marrow falls out. You want to scrape off the platter especially that amber looking gel. After boiling strain the juice and place in refrigerator until fat is hard. Scrape fat off and throw away. Put pot back on stove and bring to a boil. Add cabbage onions celery carrots tomatoes potatoes sugar bouillon cubes and navy beans. Add water with tomatoes are as needed. Add diced ham and some parsley. Its done in a day but tastes better the second day.

title: Coffee Cloud Sponge Cake
instructions: Dissolve together the coffee in the boiling water. Cool. Sift together the flour baking powder and salt. Beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar. Add 1/2 cup sugar to egg whites 2 tablespoons at a time. Set aside.

title: Ranch Beans
instructions: Season ground beef with season salt and pepper; brown. Drain and crumble into large roasting pan. Mix in remaining ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or can prepare in crock-pot or slow cooker.

title: Betsy'S Cheese Paste
instructions: Soften cream cheese; finely chop onion and pepper in blender; drain. Add other ingredients to cream cheese. Mix until smooth. Chill and serve with pretzels crackers or vegetables.

title: Apricot Marmalade
instructions: Soak apricots in 4 cups water for 2 days then add pineapple juice and cook slowly 1 hour. Now add pineapple and sugar; cook for 1/2 hour stirring constantly. Put in jars and paraffin or you can refrigerate.

title: Betty'S Fried Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in small rounds. Fry in a little oil (grease not too hot). Take up from pan. Fry onion in oil. Saute until soft. Take up. Wipe out pan with paper towel after draining any remaining oil. While you are doing this let potatoes and onion drain on paper towels. Put back in pan and stir together for a short time. Stir constantly so mixture wont stick. Take up. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt butter over low heat; stir in sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Let boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over corn. Mix well. Turn into two large baking pans. Bake in slow oven (250\u00b0) 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven; cool completely. Store in tightly covered containers.

title: Yuka Blossoms
instructions: Fill blender 1/2 full with ice. Add remaining ingredients. Blend until ice and mixture are free of lumps and slushy.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients together except for butterscotch chips and pecans. Put butterscotch chips and pecans on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.

title: Fettuccine With Chicken And Mushrooms
instructions: Saute chicken in melted butter until golden around the edges about 5 minutes. Cut mushrooms into 1/4-inch slices. Add to chicken and saute 5 more minutes. Add scallions and garlic. Saute 2 minutes. Add tomatoes heavy cream and spices; heat to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce is thickened. Cook fettucine according to package directions and drain. Toss fettuccine and chicken-mushroom mixture together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with parsley and grated Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients together mixing well. Bake in a loaf pan at 325\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Cool.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Break chicken wings in half at joint. Wash and pat dry. Mix orange juice and soy sauce. Marinate chicken wings overnight.

title: Pecan Pralines
instructions: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place crackers on pan. Spread nuts over crackers. Boil margarine and sugar for 3 minutes then pour over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes. Let cool then break apart.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Beat eggs powdered sugar margarine and vanilla until stiff about 20 minutes. Spread this over crust. Drain the crushed pineapple and spread over creamed mixture. Slice bananas over pineapple then a layer Cool Whip. Top with nuts cherries and chocolate syrup.

title: Cucumber Salad(Must Do 1 Day Ahead)
instructions: Pare cucumbers and score lengthwise with tines of fork. Slice thinly. Put in salted ice water. Add sliced onions. Let stand 1 to 2 hours.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Kale Soup(Serves 8)
instructions: Chop up kale or greens discarding the stalks. Chop cabbage; cut potatoes into cubes. Peel carrots and sweet potatoes. Set all the ingredients aside. You need a large pot filled with water. Add your meat and beans and simmer for 1 to 2 hours or until tender. Add sweet potatoes; cook for awhile. In a large bowl add water to the kale or greens and squeeze out the greens (water will be very green). Discard water and add kale to pot with all other ingredients. Make sure you still have enough water and cook until potatoes are tender stirring frequently. Depending on how much meat you have this soup could take 3 to 4 hours to cook. Cook on medium heat. Enjoy!

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine milk and soup. Pour over beans. Add 1/2 can onions. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Garnish with 1/2 can onions and pimento. Bake 5 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Tangy Mustard Cauliflower
instructions: Cook cauliflower in a small amount of water loosely covered 15 to 20 minutes (fresh whole) 8 to 12 minutes (fresh flowerets) or cook frozen as directed on package. Drain well. Remove cauliflower to heatproof dish. Combine salad dressing and onion and mustard. Spread on hot cauliflower; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts (or leave in saucepan spreading with salad dressing mixture and sprinkle with cheese; cover and let stand until cheese melts about 3 minutes). Serve immediately.

title: Acapulco Party Shrimp
instructions: Simmer shrimp in seasoned water until opaque. Drain and cool under running water. Layer cooked shrimp orange slices and onion. Combine oil vinegar lemon juice sugar paprika mustard garlic salt and chilies. Pour over shrimp cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. To serve arrange shrimp orange slices and onions on platter.

title: Light And Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease lightly square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Spread broccoli in dish. Beat sour cream cottage cheese Bisquick margarine and eggs with hand beater 1 minute. Pour over broccoli. Arrange tomato slices on top; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean about 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Pick through crab meat to eliminate any shell pieces. Combine meat and cream cheese. Shape and pour 1/2 bottle sauce over top.

title: Gramma'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco sugar eggs and vanilla. Combine cocoa baking powder baking soda plain flour and salt. Add this alternately with 1 3/4 cups milk to batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water cool whip milk until stiff. Add lemon juice. Cream 1 cup sugar and cheese; add to jello. Mix well. Add vanilla then add this to whipped milk.

title: Almond Deviled Eggs
instructions: Lightly brown almonds in butter over low heat; remove almonds and drain. Reserve for garnish. Blend melted butter egg yolks cream cheese sour cream and seasoning mix until smooth. Stuff into egg white. Chill. Sprinkle with almonds and serve. Makes 24 appetizers.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in dish and dot with margarine. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and cook until brown about 30 to 35 minutes. Corn pudding is done when it still shakes a little in middle.

title: Turkey Ragu
instructions: Brown sausage and slice thin in 1 to 2-inch pieces. Saute pepper onion and garlic until tender. Add parsley tomato sauce plum tomatoes cut into wedges and sausage. Simmer about 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serve over pasta of choice.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Soak beans a few hours. Wash and place in deep pan with all but the tomatoes and salt pork. Cook about 1 hour then add tomatoes and boil for 1/2 hour. Dice salt pork and fry to golden brown; add to soup. Before serving add 3 frankfurters sliced thin.

title: Potluck Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta; cool. Cut and mix all ingredients. Add salad dressing just before serving or toss and make ahead. Totes easily for parties/groups. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Cheese Roll
instructions: Mix ingredients and knead with hands. Form into two cheese rolls. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of chili powder on wax paper. Roll each cheese roll in chili powder. Wrap foil around wax paper so it wont dry out.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix together and let stand 2 to 3 hours before serving. Chill. You can also add sliced black and green olives ham cheese and spam.

title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese Sauce
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Melt butter; add flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth and well blended. Gradually add milk; cook until thick. Add cheese; cook until melted. Combine with macaroni. Place in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crusts.

title: Chocolate Slush Cake
instructions: Mix flour and margarine. Add 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Put into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Beat chocolate pudding with milk and spread over cream cheese mix. Top with Cool Whip and chopped nuts. Refrigerate for 6 hours.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Heat cider with sugar and cinnamon sticks. Place cloves and peels in cheesecloth and secure tightly. Add to liquid cider mix. Boil and reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove spices and ladle into mugs.

title: Hoagies - Quick Sandwiches
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Spread on buns. Top with grated cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain juice from can of whole corn. Combine all ingredients. Put in casserole dish (2-quart). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: When whole eggs are called for replace with egg substitutes.

title: Autumn Apple Salad
instructions: In saucepan combine pineapple and sugar. Bring to a boil; cook for 3 minutes. Add gelatin. Stir in cream cheese. Cool. Fold in apples nuts celery and Cool Whip. Chill until firm.

title: Cracker Jill'S Cookies
instructions: In large bowl combine cream cheese flour sugar butter corn syrup soda and egg. Mix low speed. Fold in peanuts and crackers. Cover; chill about 2 hours. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 60 cookies.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Stir in buttermilk sugar salt baking soda oil and baking powder. Add enough flour to make a medium dough (slightly sticky). Place dough in greased bowl. Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to use (up to 7 days). Punch down daily.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook debone and dice chicken. Mix Miracle Whip to taste. Add pickles and celery as much as desired. Toss with noodles just before serving.

title: Chicken Corn Soup
instructions: Cook chicken in salted boiling water until tender. Cut it up and put back in broth. Add noodles and corn; cook 15 minutes. Add parsley and eggs. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat lightly. (Whisk or wooden spoon works best.) Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. After 25 minutes cover edges of crust with foil.

title: Calico Baked Beans
instructions: Dice bacon. Fry drain and set aside. Brown hamburger and drain. Then mix all ingredients. Pour in a greased pan or baking dish. Bake 1 1/2 hours uncovered at 350\u00b0. Delicious and easy to prepare.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: To bacon drippings add 1 rounded tablespoonful flour and stir. Pour in vinegar water and sugar. Cook until thick add egg and crumbled bacon. Pour over potatoes. Serve warm. (I often increase the sauce.)

title: Oatmeal Coconut Cookies
instructions: Mix all; add pecans and coconut last. Make little balls and place on greased pan. Press balls and sprinkle with little sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 8 1/2 to 9 dozen.

title: Inside Out Sandwiches
instructions: Bake bread sticks as directed. When cooled cut in half to make 2 short bread sticks. Place lettuce on counter. Next place cheese then meat. Brush the bread sticks with your choice of dressing. Roll up with lettuce on the outside. Secure with a toothpick.

title: Ham And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook pasta shells or bows in boiling water according to package directions. Make cheese sauce according to package directions or mix canned cheese sauce with a little milk. Drain pasta and put in a 2-quart casserole pan. Mix in ham pieces and corn. Slowly pour cheese sauce over pasta mixture; mix well. Bake covered in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven for 30 minutes. Easily serves 4.

title: Brandy Velvet
instructions: Combine brandy coffee and 1/4 cup chocolate syrup. Put in blender with ice cream and whirl until just blended. Pour in tall glasses. Keep in freezer until ready to serve. Top with additional chocolate syrup. If desired turn mixture into pan and freeze.

title: Sheath Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar and cinnamon. Combine oleo water and cocoa in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cool. Add to flour mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Use your favorite frosting.

title: Matrimony Cake
instructions: Mix flour salt soda butter baking powder and 1 cup brown sugar until crumbly. Pack half in greased pan. Combine remaining ingredients and boil 5 minutes spread over crumbs. Cover with other half of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chunky Egg Salad
instructions: Mix well. Serve on a bed of leafy lettuce. Top with peaches or tomatoes.

title: No Bake Coconut Krunchies
instructions: Mix sugar margarine dates and beaten egg together on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes. After it begins to boil stir often. After dates have almost melted set aside to cool about 10 minutes. Add nuts Rice Krispies and vanilla. Roll into small balls and then roll in coconut. Makes 2 to 3 dozen.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Place one pie crust in a casserole dish then pour in the chicken mixture. Put the remaining pie crust on the top. The pie crusts may need to be stretched with a rolling pin. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Plum Cake-Bread
instructions: Mix oil sugar eggs and plums. Add flour soda salt cloves cinnamon nuts and food color. Mix well. Pour into Bundt pan greased and floured. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lemon Curd Tarts
instructions: Mix butter sugar 6 eggs and lemon juice and mix thoroughly in the top of a double boiler. Cook stirring constantly until thick. It should be the consistency of pudding before you take it off the heat. May take 10 minutes or so. Take off the heat and cool.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Dissolve soda in milk add to creamed mixture. Place flour in large bowl. Add dates nuts cherries and orange slices. Stir to coat each piece. Add flour mixture and coconut to creamed mixture. Bake in two loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inch) or three smaller loaf pans or bake in tube pan at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Let sit in pan overnight. Will keep 8 months as good as it was when cooked. This can be wrapped in Saran Wrap about three layers to keep moisture in; freeze.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Add all ingredients plus brown sugar and herbs to taste. Then bring to a boil and pour over meat.

title: Homemade Clay
instructions: Mix the flour and the salt together. Next add the oil and water. Work the mixture with your hands until it is dough like. If the dough is wet add more flour. If it is dry add more water. When it is just right add the hand lotion. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Quick Key Lime Pie
instructions: Pour milk into a bowl. Add limeade and fold in Cool Whip. When thick pour into cooled baked pie shell. Refrigerate for 3 hours before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Korean Meatballs
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into bite-size meatballs. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes on each side turning until evenly cooked. Serve immediately or place over warmer to keep hot. Serve with picks. Double or triple for a large crowd. These are good plain or with the sauce.

title: Bread:  Cranberry Loaf
instructions: Sift together flour sugar and other dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Combine egg orange juice and orange rind in small bowl. Add to crumb mixture all at once stirring just enough to moisten.

title: Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0F 20 - 25 min. In microwave 10 min. on HIGH. Good with blackberries or peaches.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: 1. Put a little bit of boiling whater in a pot.

title: Mama'S Italian Cream Cake
instructions: In large mixer bowl cream the butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks. Beat until light and fluffy. Mix together flour and baking soda. Add flour to the creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk; mix until smooth. Stir in vanilla coconut and nuts. Whip egg whites until stiff. Fold into the cake batter. Blend well. Grease and flour 3 round 9-inch cake pans. Turn batter into pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Mix together the flour and baking powder and set aside. In a medium bowl beat the egg and add the sugar mixing well. Add the margarine. Alternately add the flour and milk. Fold in the blueberries. Bake in a greased and floured 9 inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Can be doubled.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Beat Eagle Brand milk and peanut butter. Add biscuit mix and vanilla. Shape into 1-inch balls.\tRoll in granulated sugar. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned at 375\u00b0.

title: Potato Donuts
instructions: Beat mashed potatoes; add eggs sugar milk and butter. Beat well. Add yeast that has been dissolved in water. Beat in flour and salt until smooth. Let rise until double. Roll dough out and cut into donuts. Let rise again. Fry in oil at 375\u00b0 until golden.

title: Candy Quick
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt butter on cookie sheet. Add pecans; roast until brown stirring frequently. Melt 1/2 pound Candiquick in double boiler. Add pecans and mix. Spoon onto waxed paper.

title: Marinated Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage green pepper onion and carrot. Whisk together oil sugar honey salt vinegar pepper and mustard. Pour over and mix well with cabbage mixture. Chill for several hours.

title: Glazed Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine ground beef oats salt pepper onion egg and milk; mix well. Shape into loaf and place in a shallow baking pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Combine catsup mustard and brown sugar; spread over loaf. Bake for an additional hour.

title: Cheesy Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet. In a large mixing bowl stir together ground beef refried beans and soups. In a casserole dish lay 6 tortilla shells then half of the mixture and half of cheese (cut in slices). Repeat a second time. Cook in oven at 425\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Remove and serve.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown meat slowly; drain. Add next 5 ingredients. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine remaining ingredients except Mozzarella. Place half the noodles in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread 1/2 the cheese mixture on top then 1/2 of the Mozzarella and 1/2 of the meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix and form into ball (I do it on Saran Wrap). Serve with crackers.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Place one layer of noodles in greased 1-quart casserole. Cover with one half can tuna add another layer of noodles and another layer of tuna. Top with third layer of tuna mixture. Top with cornflakes and dot with butter. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until top is browned and contents heated through. Makes four servings.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Saute onion in heated butter in a saucepan for 3 minutes until softened. Add the flour and stir in chicken broth. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Mix together the cooked broccoli and 1 cup of the liquid. Beat or process mixture in a blender until smooth. Return puree to the soup mixture in the saucepan. Add salt pepper and cream; heat to boiling. Serve in warm bowls and garnish with grated Cheddar cheese. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Punch Slush
instructions: Combine bananas and fruit juices in blender until smooth. Mix other ingredients in blender then mix all together. Pour into plastic freezer container to freeze (day ahead).

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend cake mix pie filling and eggs in large bowl. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Spread half of batter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with half of the cinnamon-sugar. Repeat with remaining batter and cinnamon-sugar. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Fudge Brownies
instructions: In medium saucepan melt butter and chocolate. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar. Blend in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Spread in a greased 8-inch square pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes (be careful not to overbake). Cool. Cut into 16 squares.

title: New Mexico Corn Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine yeast and lukewarm water. Sprinkle the sugar on top and set aside until the yeast begins to bubble (5 to 10 minutes). Add the honey salt and 1/4 cup of the oil and beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until blended (about 30 seconds). Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Gradually beat in 2 cups of the flour at moderately high speed for 3 minutes. Mix in 1 cup of flour by hand.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Skillet
instructions: Brown pork chops in skillet. Combine potatoes onion flour and seasonings. Toss lightly. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Put chops on top of mixture. Add soup and milk to drippings in skillet. Bring to boil over medium heat. Pour over potatoes and pork chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours (1 hour covered 1 1/4 hours uncovered).

title: Sausage Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Microwave soup and cheese 3 to 4 minutes or until cheese melts. Stir. Add drained sausage. Keep warm in crock-pot. Serve with corn chips.

title: Saint Matthew'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and egg and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients; mix well. Roll into small balls. Dip in sugar. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate (375\u00b0) oven for 15 minutes. Makes 48 cookies. Do not overbake. Take out when still soft. Place on board until cool.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown beef and sausage in large heavy pot; drain. Add all dry seasoning and mix. Add onions green pepper tomatoes and sauce. Simmer 1 to 2 hours. Mix flour and oil in bowl. Add beans and mix. Add bean mixture to chili. Cook about 1/2 hour longer.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash and break broccoli. Fry bacon until crisp then crumble in a saucepan. Heat raisins sugar and vinegar to boiling. Remove from heat; cool. When cool stir in mayonnaise onion salt and bacon. Pour over broccoli; stir in cashews. Make 4 hours before using.

title: Spiced Pineapple Pork Roast
instructions: Place roast on rack in shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of roast not touching bone. Roast uncovered in 325\u00b0 oven until thermometer registers 170\u00b0 about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix the sugar oil and vinegar for syrup. Heat and pour over the vegetables. Add the pimentos. Cool.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Spread broccoli in pan or casserole dish. Mix soup mayonnaise onion and eggs; pour over broccoli. Spread herb stuffing over all until it is covered. Sprinkle margarine over all; cover and bake for 1 hour at 400\u00b0. Uncover and spread grated cheese over; put back in oven just until it is melted.

title: Pea Salad
instructions: Dice eggs and pimento. Add to peas. Mix together mayonnaise salt and pepper. Add to peas; stir well.

title: Mushroom Bake Dish
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 until veggies are done.

title: Special Tea
instructions: To tea bags add enough boiling water to cover. Let steep 15 minutes. Add sugar juice and Kool-Aid. Mix well. Add enough water to make 5 quarts.

title: Pastitsio
instructions: Saute the ground beef and the onion with the olive oil. Add the salt the parsley and the wine. When all of the wine is gone you add the tomato juice and let the ground beef to be cooked for about 30 minutes. Boil the bugattini into 5 liters of water and add 1 tablespoon of salt. When they are ready pour 1 cup of cool water into the pan and then strain. Put half of the bugattini into a large buttered oven pan then sprinkle with cheese and cover with the ground beef. Then you put the rest of the bugattini and sprinkle again with cheese.

title: Popcorn Cake
instructions: Grease tube pan with butter. Melt the marshmallows with the margarine. Combine in a large bowl all of the ingredients. When thoroughly mixed press into tube pan. Let cool. This makes a festive looking dessert that kids all ages like to munch on.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage. Chop carrots celery onion and pepper. Combine cabbage with chopped ingredients. Mix with sugar.

title: Sugar Plums
instructions: Beat together butter and sugar until creamy. Blend in cocoa and almond extract; mix thoroughly. Stir in almonds and oats. Chill dough until stiff. Break off pieces of dough and shape them into balls. Roll in coconut; chill.

title: Non-Hardening Clay
instructions: This recipe wil make six balls the size of large oranges. Stir together and knead. Add food coloring if desired. Keep covered when not in use. Stays soft for a long time.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients in large bowl. Add undrained pineapple. Mix only by hand. Add chopped bananas (I mash mine) and nuts. Mix again. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Let cool in pan for 1 hour before removing. Ice or glaze as desired.

title: Cheesy Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cut cheese into cubes. Place in a saucepan with 1/4 cup butter. Heat over medium heat until melted and smooth stirring often.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts chip into bite sized pieces. Mix in cream of chicken soup and chicken broth (you can use the broth the chicken was boiled in). Mix in 3/4 bag of dressing mix. Put into baking dish. Put remaining dressing on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 until slightly browned.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream shortening sugar eggs pumpkin and water and mix together. Sift together flour baking powder baking soda salt and spices. Add to pumpkin mixture. Stir in nuts and raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 1 hour. DO NOT GREASE PANS. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Lazy Man Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan on top of stove. Mix together remaining ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with ice cream. Yum! Yum!

title: El Paso Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain. Add onion taco seasoning mix and Ranch-style dressing mix; stir well. Put pinto beans tomatoes kidney beans and corn in big pot. Bring to a boil. Add hamburger mixture. Then simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Bake
instructions: Mix mashed potatoes sour cream milk and garlic powder. Spoon 1/2 of mixture into a 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle with 2/3 c. onions and 1/2 c. cheese. Top with remaining potato mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining onions and cheese. Bake 5 minutes until onions are golden. Makes 6 servings.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Melt the margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Open biscuits and let set at room temperature. Cut apples in half; peel and core. Roll biscuits very thin. Place apple half rounded side down on biscuit. Wrap biscuit over apple. Place apple in melted butter flat side down. Sprinkle cinnamon on each apple.

title: Potato Nachos
instructions: Spread potato slices on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes. Place on serving dish. Heat cheese spread according to label directions; pour over potatoes. Top with green onion tomatoes and sour cream. Serves 6.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: Cook peeled potatoes in boiling water until tender and drain. Mash until smooth. Add remaining ingredients until light and fluffy. Cool. Cover and refrigerate. They may be used anytime within 2 weeks or freeze. To use place desired amount in greased casserole dish. Dot with butter and bake covered in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Mrs. Hodge'S No-Fail Popcorn Balls
instructions: Use double boiler. Combine all ingredients but vanilla. Beat egg whites 1 minute or until blended. Set in place over water. Beat constantly at full speed while cooking for 7 minutes or until stiff peaks form. Frequently scrape boiler. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Beat 1 or 2 minutes. (Dont scrape bowl too close.)

title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli; drain. Fix the 2 boxes rice as instructions say. Chop up Velveeta cheese. Pull or chop chicken up in small pieces. Mix all together. Butter your casserole dish. Put mixture into casserole dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Sherried Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Add soup mushrooms cheese and sherry. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until tender. Remove chicken to rice covered platter; keep warm. Stir sour cream into sauce. Serve over chicken and rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Transylvanian Grilled Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients very well until it looks like a paste. Refrigerate 8 to 10 hours. Roll into meatballs or approximately 4-inch rolls and cook on hot grill on all sides. Serve hot with mustard and other side dishes.

title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and vanilla. Blend in sour cream butter and shortening. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and baking soda. Add to sugar mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop on greased sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Oven-Steamed Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine rice salt and pepper in 1 1/2-quart ungreased casserole. Dot top with butter. Pour boiling water over rice mixture and stir in butter. Cover and bake 45 minutes. (Dont peep - dont stir!)

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar butter and milk in saucepan over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches softball stage (235\u00b0). Remove from heat and add Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Pour into greased pan. Cut when cold.

title: Fried Peach Or Apple Pie
instructions: Boil 2 packages of fruit until tender. Add sugar. Let fruit cool before making pies.

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: In a saucepan mix all ingredients except mushrooms. Bring this mixture to a boil; simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain mushrooms and add to mixture. Place in a covered dish. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Quick Method Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and let stand 5 minutes. Add remaining water salt and sugar; beat. Add shortening and beat. Add eggs and beat. Add flour and mix until elastic. Put in refrigerator and let double in size. Take out and knead amount desired. Return rest to refrigerator. Let rise. Bake at 450\u00b0 until brown.

title: Three Bean Curry
instructions: Melt butter in large frying pan over medium heat. Add garlic and saute one minute. Add carrot onion mushrooms and saute until tender. Stir in curry powder. Add water lima beans green beans and peas and simmer until tender. Serve over rice; top with dollop of yogurt and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

title: Golden Baked Chicken
instructions: Break egg into bowl and beat with water salt pepper and basil. Drop chicken pieces into this and stir around until pieces are well coated. Roll each piece in wheat germ or crumbs. Place in buttered shallow baking pan and dot with remaining butter. Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Prize Apple Cake
instructions: Cut apples and combine with chopped nuts. Set aside. Cream oil eggs and sugar until light. Add flour baking soda salt baking powder vanilla and lemon flavor. Add apples and nuts to this with mixing spoon. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop by teaspoonful. Squash with fork to make cross marks. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 to 8 minutes.

title: Pickled Peaches
instructions: Drain peaches; set aside. Combine other ingredients with peach juice. Put this in a pot; bring to a boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. Pour hot syrup over peaches. Put into jars and refrigerate.

title: Magic Cookies
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan with butter. Layer ingredients starting with crumbs then chips coconut and nuts. Pour milk over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Chop celery onion pepper and lettuce each separate. Put each item in a layer in a bowl. Spread mayonnaise on top and then sprinkle bacon bits on that. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Mix well before serving.

title: Annie Wingate'S Chocolate Macaroon Cake
instructions: Beat one egg white with 1 teaspoon vanilla until peaks form. Add 1/2 cup sugar. Gradually stir in coconut; stir in one tablespoon flour. Set aside. Dissolve cocoa in hot coffee. Set aside. Beat 3 egg whites until soft peaks form. Add 1/2 cup sugar and continue beating. Set aside. Add soda to sour cream. Set aside.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: In 3 quart pan saute garlic and ginger root in oil. Dissolve sugar in soy sauce and add to pan. Heat to nearly boiling. Place raw chicken in mixture and bring to a boil. Lower heat\tand simmer until tender turning chicken occasionally.

title: Mormon Muffins
instructions: Add soda to hot water and let cool then add salt sugar and shortening. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Slowly mix well. Add buttermilk flour salt mix well. Add soda water very slowly. Fold the two bran cereals into mixture. Add nuts. Bake in muffin tins at 350 degrees for 18 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in refrigerator and let chill.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Place in a bowl the onion and cucumber. Combine the mayonnaise vinegar oil salt and pepper in a small bowl. Mix and pour over cucumber slices. Chill and serve. Add onion and/or celery seed.

title: Microwave Pralines
instructions: Mix cream and brown sugar in a 4-quart bowl. Microwave on High (100% power) for 13 minutes. (Stirring is not necessary.) Candy thermometer should reach 236\u00b0 for soft ball. Quickly add pecans and margarine stirring to mix. Drop candy by teaspoons onto a sheet of foil. Yield About 40 pralines.

title: Paul'S Brunswick Stew
instructions: Cut chicken in 8 pieces and simmer for 2 1/4 hours in water. Remove chicken. Add lima beans tomatoes onions potatoes and okra to broth. Simmer until limas are tender about an hour. Add hot water if necessary and stir to prevent scorching. Add corn and chicken boned and diced and seasonings. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Creamy Cucumber Dressing(Low-Fat)
instructions: Blend ingredients together in a jar and store in the refrigerator. Has 19.4 calories and .081 g fat per 1/4 cup.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Fry ground beef; drain. Mix with taco seasoning. Cook and cool then mix all ingredients together.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 1 1/2-quart loaf pan. Mix egg cream and oil together with a whisk or beater until well combined (set aside). Combine flour baking powder baking soda and salt; set aside. Whip up the ripe bananas and sugar until watery. Slowly pour the egg mixture into the sugared bananas bit by bit. Beat 1 to 2 minutes. Add flour mixture and continue beating 1 to 2 minutes more. Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix together and store in refrigerator. Pour over chef salad. Good on tossed salad.

title: Cauliflower And Cheese Soup
instructions: Heat the soup slowly as you whisk in these ingredients. Saute in butter 1 1/2 cups more cauliflower and add to soup. Serve with chopped scallions or more cheese.

title: Sara Lee Coffeecake
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together for 8 minutes. Add the vanilla and butter extract. Mix well. In another bowl mix the sugar and cinnamon. Pour half the batter into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour half the sugar mixture over the batter. Put the rest of the batter over this and sprinkle the remaining sugar mixture on top. Mix well with a knife. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

title: Date Nut Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar flour and vanilla. Stir 1 teaspoon flour into dates and mix well. Bake in tiny muffin tins in 350\u00b0 oven about 10 minutes.

title: Corn-Cherry Tomato Salad
instructions: Combine yogurt ketchup and mustard in a large bowl. Stir in green onions and dill set aside. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add corn and cook for 45 seconds or until just tender. Drain in colander rinse under cold water and drain again. (If using canned corn do not cook rinse and drain in colander.) Add dressing along with cherry tomatoes and green pepper toss well to mix. Place lettuce leaves on plate spoon on corn mixture and serve.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients over low heat until smooth. Mix cake mix following package directions. Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mandarin Orange Delight
instructions: Mix all of the cottage cheese Cool Whip and orange jello together. Then stir in the pineapple and mandarin oranges. Save some of the mandarin oranges and pineapple to garnish the top of the salad.

title: Easy Vegetable Beef Soup
instructions: Heat oil in Dutch oven or large saucepan over medium high heat; brown meat. Stir in remaining ingredients except mixed vegetables; bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover. Simmer 1 1/4 hours stirring occasionally. Add vegetables; simmer 15 to 20 minutes until beef and vegetables are tender stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Bacon And Swiss Spread
instructions: Mix first four ingredients and put in shallow dish. Microwave 4 1/2 minutes rotating dish after two minutes. Sprinkle cracker crumbs and bacon on top. Serve with crackers.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans and layer with other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining onion rings and bake 5 more minutes.

title: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Combine water and 2 tablespoons picante sauce in a large shallow dish. Let tortillas stand for 5 minutes in mixture. Drain. Cook ground beef and onion in heavy skillet until brown; drain. Stir in next 6 ingredients. Simmer meat mixture for 5 minutes. Melt margarine in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat and add sour cream; stir until well blended.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar oleo eggs and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients. Roll dough on floured surface. Cut in desired shapes. Bake until golden brown in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Drain ground beef and let cool. Add all ingredients in very large bowl and serve at room temperature.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Mix well milk cocoa butter and sugar. Let come to hard boil about 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat add vanilla nuts oats and peanut butter. Cool a little and dip with a spoon on wax paper.

title: Sausage Supreme
instructions: Form the sausage into cakes. Brown on both sides in a hot skillet but do not cook done. Remove and place in a casserole. Add all the other ingredients. Cover and bake in a moderate oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until the rice is tender. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Halve and core apples. Mix honey raisins almonds nutmeg and cinnamon. Fill each apple half with mixture and place in a greased flat baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake in single layer sheet cake pan. While cake is hot use fork to make holes in layer. Pour cream of coconut over cake letting it soak in good then while still hot pour Eagle Brand milk over it letting it soak in also. Refrigerate until cold. Spread Cool Whip over top then sprinkle coconut on top of Cool Whip. Best when refrigerated overnight.

title: Strawberry-Sparkle Punch
instructions: In punch bowl combine pineapple juice strawberries strawberry soda and ice cubes. Float small scoops of strawberry sherbet on punch. Ladle into small glasses or punch cups. Makes 2 2/3 quarts ((20 half cups servings).

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Cream eggs oil and sugar. Add sifted dry ingredients and vanilla. Mix well and then fold in nuts and apples. (Note Batter will be very thick.) Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 340\u00b0 for 90 minutes. Start baking in cold oven. Do not preheat.

title: Hamburger Chowder
instructions: Brown the ground beef in skillet. Saute onions. Add tomatoes corn soup and water. Season with salt pepper and Lea & Perrins to taste. Simmer.

title: Mostaccioli
instructions: Saute onions in oil until golden. Add ground beef and brown. Add tomato sauce salt garlic salt pepper and bay leaf. Simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup
instructions: Cook asparagus in 1 cup water until tender-crisp. Drain reserving liquid. Saute onion in butter until transparent. Stir in flour salt and pepper; cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk 1 cup water reserved liquid and bouillon granules. Cook stirring with wire whisk until mixture is thickened. Stir in asparagus. Heat through and serve.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme
instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 3 pieces (remove bones and skin). Beat eggs and salt; add chicken strips to egg mixture. Let set 1 hour; remove chicken from eggs. Roll in bread crumbs; using skillet melt oleo and saute chicken a few minutes. Place sauteed chicken in baking dish; top with mushrooms and chunks of cheese. Add broth; bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Chili
instructions: Boil spaghetti in large pot; do not drain. Add chili beans. In skillet brown hamburger and onion. Add salt and pepper to taste. When brown add chili powder and the tomato puree. Let cook a few minutes. Add noodles and serve.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle last 2 ingredients on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes until pumpkin is set.

title: Golden Tomato Preserves
instructions: Select fully ripe tomatoes; cover with boiling water. Let stand a few seconds then drain and dip into cold water. Peel carefully and place in layers in bowl sprinkling sugar over each layer. Cover and let stand overnight (keep in refrigerator). Drain off juice and sugar and heat to boiling with orange juice orange rind and lemon rind. Boil until syrup spins a thread. Add tomatoes and sliced lemons. Cook until syrup is thick. Pour into sterile jelly jars and seal. Place in boiling water bath for 25 minutes.

title: Armadillo Eggs
instructions: Mesh first 3 ingredients together. Roll into oblong ball size of egg. Crease down center and insert jalapenos. Close together. Roll these in eggs and then in Shake n Bake or Oven Fry. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Squares
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan and place 1 package chocolate chip cookie dough in pan evenly. Mix together your cream cheese vanilla sugar and eggs until well blended. Pour cream cheese mixture over cookie dough in pan. Take second package of cookie and make 3/4-inch slices laying the slices on top of the cream cheese mixture. Place pan into oven and bake at 350\u00b0 for about an hour or until golden brown. Let cool in pan and then cut into squares. Tastes better when refrigerated.

title: Squash Hush Puppies
instructions: Stew squash with chopped onion. Drain well. Add egg margarine salt and pepper then stir in corn bread mix. Drop by tablespoon into hot grease. Cook until golden brown.

title: Regular Recipe Punch
instructions: Mix well and serve.

title: Ham And Fried Rice
instructions: Put rice water and salt in a medium size saucepan. Bring the water to a boil over high heat. Cover the pan reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and all the water has been absorbed. Remove the pan from the heat and set aside.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Bring the sugar milk and oleo to a boil and boil 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and Fluff. Beat until smooth. Pour into a greased pan.

title: Eggs In A Cloud
instructions: Toast and butter bread. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Cut salami in half; arrange cut side down around edge of prepared dish. Arrange bread over bottom of dish; place cheese slices on top of bread. Separate eggs placing each yolk in a shell half; place in egg-carton compartments until ready to use. Place whites in a large bowl of electric mixer; at high speed beat egg whites with 1/2 teaspoon salt and the mustard until stiff and moist peaks form.

title: Impossible Quiche
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender 5 to 7 seconds. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Top with cheese and meat. (You may also add cooked broccoli etc.) Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let quiche set for 10 to 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Cauliflower Scallop
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Place in 10x6x1-1/2 inch baking dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Shrimp Dip For 30
instructions: Dissolve gelatine in 1/2 cup hot water. Heat soup in double boiler; add gelatine cream cheese celery onions and seasonings. Mix until blended; refrigerate 5 minutes then add crumbled shrimp and pour in ring mold sprayed with Pam. Refrigerate 5 hours; unmold and serve with crackers or large chips.

title: Apples And Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes in water until almost tender. Peel and slice when cooled. Alternate layers of sliced potatoes and apples beginning with sweet potatoes and ending with apples. Cover each layer with some of the sugar and bits of butter. On top layer of apples sprinkle remaining brown sugar and butter. Then sprinkle nutmeg. Mix hot water and honey and pour evenly over top. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1/2 to 3/4 hours or until apples and potatoes are tender. Delicious with ham or turkey. Serves 8.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix eggs corn oil onion chilies and corn meal. Add enough water to make the batter thin enough to spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan that has been greased and floured. Pour 1/2 of the batter in the pan and then place the 6 slices of cheese on the batter. Pour the remaining mixture to cover the cheese completely. Cook at 375\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Cashew Chicken
instructions: Cut deboned and skinned chicken breasts into 6 small pieces. Soak in milk for a couple hours then roll in a mixture of crushed cashews flour and salt. Fry. Use cornstarch for gravy and chicken bouillon.

title: Crock Pot Roast
instructions: Place roast soup salt and pepper in crock pot and cover with water. Cook on low overnight.

title: Buffet Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Arrange asparagus evenly in large casserole dish. Top with peas. Spoon mushroom soup over peas. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Bake in preheated oven at 350 for about 30 minutes ir until bubbly.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt in a 1 1/2-quart bowl. Stir in corn syrup and melted butter. Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in milk pecans and vanilla. Pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake 50 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Sauce For Chicken
instructions: Fill the tomato sauce can which you have emptied with vinegar. Add vinegar to the remaining ingredients (except chicken). Put in saucepan on stove; bring to a boil. Take off heat and pour over chicken which has been place in an oven-proof casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Raisin Sauce
instructions: Combine cold water sugar raisins and cornstarch. Mix. Heat on low in small pot. Add grape jelly cinnamon and butter. Simmer until thickened. Serve with baked ham or ham slices. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar flour salt egg yolks and 1 whole egg. Melt in saucepan chocolate Karo and butter. Add milk. Add this to other ingredients. Cook in double boiler until thick. Pour into pie shell and cover with meringue.

title: Cheese Straws
instructions: Cream together butter hot sauce Lea & Perrins and lemon juice. Grate cheese and let come to room temperature. Then add it to butter mixture. Mix dry ingredients and add to cheese mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hershey Bar Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a well-greased tube pan. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. When cool sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken cream of chicken soup peas and carrots; pour into baking dish. Combine stuffing mix and melted margarine; sprinkle over casserole to make a crumb top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until top is turning brown.

title: Fruited Pot Roast
instructions: Brown roast on all sides in hot oil in Dutch oven; pour off drippings. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Add apple juice water and cinnamon sticks. Bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.

title: Yummy Brownies With Cream Cheese
instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together on low heat making sure you stir it constantly. Set aside to cool for at least 10 minutes. Blend the softened cream cheese into this mixture stirring until smooth. Now gradually add the rest of the ingredients one at a time and stir until smooth. If you use a mixer use low speed. Add the nuts and fold them into the mixture. Spread the batter into a lightly buttered baking dish (8 x 8-inch). Smooth into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Frost if desired using a light chocolate frosting. Ice cream on the unfrosted brownies is wonderful. Serve in squares.

title: Caribbean Loin Of Pork In Black Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Brown on all sides in hot lard with sliced onions. The meat must be thoroughly browned. Discard onions. Pour off excess fat. Sprinkle meat with vinegar. Add olives capers raisins sugar and water. Bring to boil; lower heat. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours to 2 hours. Turn meat occasionally. Add chopped onions and simmer for 30 minutes longer. Add potatoes and cook for 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are done and sauce thickens. This dish must be cooked over very low heat. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Christmas Salad
instructions: Mix together and keep cold.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain; stir in sauce mushrooms and seasoning. Simmer 20 minutes. Boil noodles until tender. In a large casserole dish arrange in 2 to 3 layers noodles meat sauce Ricotta cheese with 1 egg beaten egg added slices of Swiss cheese and grated Mozzarella cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fantasy Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar margarine and milk in heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan and bring to full boil stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat stirring constantly to avoid scorching. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate bits until melted. Add marshmallow cream vanilla and nuts beating until well blended.

title: Fudge
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a heavy pan. Let boil for 5 minutes. Take off stove. Add the chips. Stir until chips are melted. Add the vanilla. Add nuts or coconut if desired. Pour into greased pan. Let set.

title: Seasoned Oyster Crackers
instructions: Put crackers in \plastic\ bowl. Sprinkle with dressing mix. Pour oil over crackers and mix well. Season with lemon pepper and dill weed to your taste.

title: Peanut-Butter Banana Shake
instructions: Process first 3 ingredients in blender until smooth stopping once to scrape down the sides (mixture will be thick). Pour into glasses; drizzle each serving with chocolate syrup.

title: San Francisco Style Cioppino(Recipe Adapted From Recipe In Simply Seafood)
instructions: In a very large pot or Dutch oven heat olive oil. Saute all the vegetables for 4 or 5 minutes. Add spices and rest of ingredients. Also add in white wine sauce from cooking seafood after veggies have been sauteed. Cover and simmer over very low heat for 3 hours. Do not boil. During simmering taste and add more spices to taste. The more the better. The sauce should be very thick.

title: Honey Mustard Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients in blender. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine sugar pudding mix and vanilla. Add eggs and dry ingredients then stir in chips and nuts. Drop from spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Old Fashioned Raisin Bars
instructions: Combine raisins and water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in oil. Cool to lukewarm then stir in sugar and egg. Sift together dry ingredients and beat into raisin mixture. Stir in nuts. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until done. When cool cut into bars and dust with 10x sugar.

title: Fresh Blueberry Cream Pie
instructions: Combine sour cream flour sugar vanilla salt and egg. Beat 5 minutes at medium speed of mixer or until smooth. Fold in blueberries peaches or raspberries. Pour filling into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from oven. Combine remaining ingredients stirring well. Sprinkle over top of pie. Bake 10 more minutes. Chill before serving.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix margarine sugar milk and salt in pan. Boil for 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter vanilla and oats; mix well. Drop on wax paper.

title: Wock'S Favorite Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Combine oil sugar and eggs. Add apples raisins and coconut. Stir thoroughly. Add soda salt cinnamon and vanilla. Stir in flour until batter is very stiff. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2 baking pan. In small bowl combine raisins and water. In large bowl cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat eggs and blend thoroughly. Add applesauce. Add flour and all dry ingredients to small bowl and mix. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Blend in raisins and water. Stir in nuts. Pour into baking dish. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Coconut Creme Dessert
instructions: Mix together Ritz crackers and melted oleo. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix instant pudding with 1 1/2 cups milk until thick. Add ice cream; mix well. Pour over crust. Spread Cool Whip over pudding mix. Save some crumbs for top. May be frozen.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Boil fresh yams in skin until just fork-tender. Peel when cool. Slice lengthwise in half and into serving pieces. Put in glass baking dish (metal works but glass is easier to clean).

title: Cherry Nut Pie
instructions: Drain cherries and mash. Add 1/2 bottle red food coloring. Let soak. Drain until dry. Add other ingredients and pour into graham cracker pie shell. Makes 2 pies.

title: Mini Pizzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cut bread into one-inch thick slices. Cover a baking tray with aluminum foil and place slices on tray so they wont overlap. Top each slice with one teaspoon tomato sauce and an even sprinkling of diced ham and cover with shredded cheese. Bake about twenty minutes or until cheese bubbles. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Place butter and water in pan. Let come to a boil. Pour flour in all at once. Remove from heat. Add one egg at a time smoothing after each egg. Grease a baking sheet; wipe off excess grease. Drop cooled batter on pan. Bake in hot oven at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool on rack. Cut off tops and fill with favorite pudding; replace tops. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine chicken celery eggs pickles and salt. Moisten with mayonnaise. Serve on lettuce.

title: Easy Apple Dumplings
instructions: Wrap each apple quarter in strip of rolls (will have 16) and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix melted oleo orange juice sugar and cinnamon to form sauce. Pour over apple roll and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Welsh Rarebit
instructions: Melt butter add seasonings and grated cheese. Stir until cheese is soft over low heat. Add milk. Stir until all blended. You may add 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce and 1/2 teaspoon paprika. Serve on toast or crackers. Makes 4 servings.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients as given except for cheese. Pour mixture into greased cookie sheet pan or jelly roll pan. Sprinkle cheese over top of mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in a skillet. Pour out the juice from pineapple can and mix with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into skillet to cover pork chops. Simmer until chops are fork-tender about 1 1/2 hours. May have to add water as sauce thickens.

title: Stuffed Shrimp
instructions: Blend softened cheese with mayonnaise thyme paprika and lemon juice. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise and place 1/2 teaspoon filling between halves. Dip edge in parsley. Fasten with cocktail pick. Makes 40.

title: Cheese And Egg Sandwich Filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend. Makes 3 cups filling.

title: Summer Squash
instructions: In saucepan cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine stuffing mix and butter. Spread 1/2 of stuffing mixture over bottom of a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix rest of ingredients with squash and onion; spread this on top of the stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Serves 6 to 10.

title: Poor Man'S Lasagna
instructions: Put ground beef in skillet. Mix up and stir well. Put noodles in boiling water. Add salt and 1 teaspoon cooking oil. When ground beef is done drain then add cream cheese to skillet. Stir well then add ketchup. Stir well then heat. When noodles are done drain. Put noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass pan. Add sour cream to noodles and mix well. Add garlic salt. Put ground beef mixture over noodles. Spread evenly then put Mozzarella cheese on top. Put in oven at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients using only 1/2 stick of the margarine. Pour the other 1/2 margarine on top and bake at 37% for about 1 hour.

title: Easy Omelet For Four
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Break eggs in mixing bowl; beat until blended. Add milk to taste. Melt butter in Pyrex pan or similar pan; coat sides. Add omelet ingredients into egg mixture (can add any ingredients you like). Pour omelet mixture into Pyrex pan. Grate cheese enough to cover pan. Do not add to omelet. Bake omelet (without cheese) for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese and bake another 5 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes. Flip omelet into half shell. Slice and serve.

title: Health Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl mixing well. Spoon into lightly greased casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Grandmom'S 5-Egg Cake(Pound Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 312\u00b0. Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time beating 5 minutes at high speed between each egg (25 minutes in all). Add cake flour and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Bob'S Beer Spareribs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; use as a marinade. Marinate; cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove ribs from marinade; reserve marinade. Use as a basting sauce for the spareribs while they cook. Makes 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Ribs(Korean Style)
instructions: Cut the meat thin. Mix all the ingredients and mix well. Mix the thin sliced meat over sauce. Marinate 2 to 3 hours. Cook in grill and barbecue and taste it.

title: Watergate Cake
instructions: Mix together in any order. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Bake in bundt pan.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients; let stand while combining remaining ingredients or may refrigerate first mixture overnight. Gently toss both mixtures together. Yield 12 servings.

title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix Bisquick milk and cheese until a soft dough is formed. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Mix margarine and garlic powder. Brush over warm biscuits. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Stuffed Boneless Chicken Breasts
instructions: Prepare stuffing following label directions. Butter baking dish. Divide stuffing. Top with chicken breasts tucking chicken down around stuffing covering completely. Brush chicken with margarine; sprinkle with salt pepper paprika and garlic. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Combine soup and water; heat until bubbly. Place chicken and stuffing on plate. Spoon soup mixture over chicken. Serves 2.

title: Oriental Chicken Medley
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. To cooked rice in saucepan add chicken green pepper soup water soy sauce pimiento ginger and 1/2 can onions; stir well. Pour into 2 quart casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining onions; bake uncovered 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

title: Beefy Baked Beans
instructions: Saute bacon in a large skillet until slightly brown. Add ground beef and onion and cook until beef is fully browned and onion is translucent. Drain off any fat in pan and pour mixture into a 3 or 4-quart baking dish. Stir all remaining ingredients into baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 8 cups 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweet And Spicy Bean Macaroni Skillet
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion until done; drain. add remaining ingredients stir well. Bring mixture to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender stirring occasionally.

title: Brunswick Stew
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion; drain. Mix all ingredients in a large pan. Simmer approximately 1 hour stirring often to prevent sticking.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until brown.

title: Dark Hazelnut Toffee
instructions: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan with foil extending foil over the edges of the pan. Sprinkle the 3/4 cup hazelnuts on the bottom of the foil-lined pan. Set pan aside.

title: Corn Bread N' Corn
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add liquids and mix well. Pour into well-greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Melt 1/4 cup butter or oleo. Pour over top. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Let cheese and margarine soften at room temperature. Mix together cheese and margarine; add dry ingredients. Stir in Rice Krispies and chopped nuts. Shape in marble-size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown.

title: Cucumber Tuna Boat
instructions: Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise and scrape out seeds. Cut a small slice from bottom of cucumber so it will not rock. Salt cavities.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix #1
instructions: Mix together; store in an airtight container. Use about 1/3 cup cocoa mix to 6 ounces hot water or to taste.

title: Chex Quarterback Scramble
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt butter in large shallow roasting pan in oven. Remove. Stir in seasoning packet. Add Chex mix and nuts. Mix until all pieces are coated. Bake 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes. Add beef jerky and cheese; stir to coat evenly. Bake an additional 15 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan. Add cornstarch and cook over medium heat until thick. Add color and vanilla. Let mixture cool. When cool add berries. Pour into prebaked pie shell.

title: Crisp Taco Turnovers
instructions: Brown together ground beef onion and garlic in a heavy frying pan over medium heat. Stir until meat loses its pinkness. Add salt and chili pepper. Place 1/2 cup ground beef filling 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 cup diced tomatoes onto 1/2 of each tortilla. Fold other half over. Remove any air pockets by pressing down. Pour oil into skillet to 1/4-inch depth. When oil is hot place filled tortillas into pan a few at a time. Saute over medium to high heat until golden on each side 45 seconds on each side. Remove from pan onto paper towels. Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Arroz Con Pollo
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet. Add diced onion crushed garlic 2 tablespoons oregano oil from annato cumin diced green pepper 1/4 cup pitted olives and 4 tablespoons capers. Saute until peppers and onions are cooked but not brown. Add 1 can tomato paste and 1/2 cup chicken broth. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove skin from chicken pieces. Put chicken into the spicy sauce mixture and stir over medium heat for 10 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside. Add rice to the spicy sauce mixture and combine. Continue stirring constantly so that rice doesnt burn (for about 5 to 8 minutes). Add the 2 1/2-quart chicken broth and stir to mix well. Allow to cook undisturbed for 15 minutes until the broth is dried. When the broth has been absorbed stir the rice. Cover and simmer on low until done about 10 minutes longer. Serves about 8 people more or less.

title: Humus
instructions: Place sundried tomatoes in small bowl. Add hot water to cover; let stand 10 to 15 minutes or until tomatoes are softened. Drain well; cut tomatoes into quarters. In food processor or blender process chickpeas yogurt tahini olive oil lemon juice garlic and ground pepper until smooth. Stir in sundried tomatoes. Refrigerate humus 3 hours or longer to blend flavors. To serve spoon humus into small bowl; serve with pita wedges and celery carrot and zucchini sticks for dipping. Yield 12 servings.

title: Pork Chops With Cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet. Brown pork chops with garlic. Lower heat and let pork chops simmer in covered skillet for 5 minutes. Remove pork chops from skillet and drain half of the liquid. Stir in your tomato juice vinegar shoyu sugar salt and pepper. Put the sliced onion in skillet; simmer. While simmering cut your pork chops into bite size pieces; discard bones. Stir into the sauce with onion; let simmer for 15 minutes. Put chopped cabbage into skillet; let simmer for 1/2 hour stirring occasionally.

title: Lentils And Rice
instructions: Rinse lentils and place in a pan with water. Boil for 20 minutes on medium fire. Saute chopped (or julienned) onion in oil until light brown. Add onion and residue seasonings and rice to the lentils. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve on a platter; this thickens as it cools.

title: Orange Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Put half the batter into a greased floured Bundt pan or tube pan half of apple mixture rest of batter then apple mixture.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13 pan. Mix together Bisquick baking powder sugar and milk and pour over melted butter. Add fruit of your choice on top of batter. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0 (until dough is done in middle).

title: Cherry Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend all ingredients well and refrigerate. Very good salad.

title: Green Beans With Bacon
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp but not brittle; drain. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons bacon fat from skillet. Add onion and cook over low heat until onion is soft but not brown. Add vinegar and salt. Add beans and crumble bacon on top.

title: Oatmeal Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugar and pudding in mixing bowl and beat until smooth. Beat in eggs. Add flour then oats. Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes.

title: Cranberry And Nut Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add milk egg cinnamon vanilla and orange extract. Beat well. Add mixture of flour baking powder and salt. Fold in cranberry sauce and pecans. Pour in greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 60 to 65 minutes.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients thoroughly. Sift remaining ingredients together and stir in. Mix dough thoroughly and divide into 2 equal parts. Press into 2 ungreased pizza pans. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until lightly browned. Cool.

title: Refrigerator Rolls No Knead
instructions: Soften yeast in warm water; add sugar and salt. Put in Wesson oil. Add part of flour then put in egg. Add rest of the flour; stir until smooth. Cover with damp cloth or waxed paper. These can be kept in refrigerator for 3 or 4 days but are better if used right away. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: A Variation Of Pies
instructions: Mix the flour sugar and salt together. Gradually add milk. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens then cook 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add small amount of egg yolks into mixture and cook 1 minute. Add butter and flour. Cool slightly. Pour in shell.

title: Chinese Wontons
instructions: Cook ground meat ginger root and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat until browned stirring until meat crumbles. Drain. Combine meat mixture with other ingredients and mix well. Set aside.

title: Mrs. Thalia'S Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken and debone; cook vegetables in margarine until tender. Add chicken stock soups and spices. Then chicken meat. Simmer sauce mixture while boiling spaghetti noodles until cooked; drain noodles and combine with sauce mixture. Simmer 1 to 2 hours.

title: Cheesy Apples
instructions: Place apples in a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. Combine remaining ingredients in\ta saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until cheese melts and ingredients are well blended. Spread over apples. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40\tminutes until top is lightly browned. If used as dessert increase sugar to 1 cup. This travels well.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients in one bowl. Combine eggs vanilla and pumpkin in another bowl. Add all together and spray muffin pans with Pam cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mash artichoke hearts and mix with mayonnaise cheese and garlic powder. Put mixture in casserole and sprinkle with a few bread crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Pork Chop And Carrot Casserole
instructions: Use any number and type of pork chops you prefer. Slice desired amount of carrots in bottom of casserole dish. Put pork chops on top of carrots and sprinkle with salt pepper and sage. Put 2 or 3 rings of onion on top of chops. Slice one apple and put on top of chops and onion. Sprinkle approximately 1/8 cup brown sugar on top of apple slices. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Whoopee Pies
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Beat until smooth. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 minutes.

title: Ham And Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Prepare pie crust as directed on package for one-crust filled pie using 9-inch glass pie pan. (Refrigerate remaining crust for a later use.)

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Line bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls. Beat cream cheese and sour cream until smooth. Add sugar and blend. Add eggs one at a time beating after each egg. Add vanilla. Pour into pan over the crescent rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. If desired top with strawberries.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook first 5 ingredients for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to low and add last 3 ingredients. Simmer until butter melts. Serve with cornbread crumbled bacon and/or Cheddar cheese if desired.

title: Pear Relish Or Pear Pineapple Honey
instructions: Combine in pan. Mix and simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until thickened. Pour into hot jars and seal. Yields 3 to 4 pints.

title: Sweet Potatoes Calypso
instructions: Note Substitute canned sweet potatoes and pineapple if desired

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: Sift out old maids from popped corn; pour into a large paper grocery bag. In a 2-quart ovenproof bowl heat in microwave on\tHigh the brown sugar butter or margarine corn syrup and salt. Heat to boiling stirring after every minute (3 to\t4 minutes). When mixture comes to a boil microwave 2 minutes more. Remove from microwave; stir in baking soda until foamy. Pour over popped corn. Stir with long handled wooden spoon or\tshake vigorously until kernels are coated. Put\tsack in\tmicrowave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.\tStir or shake bag well; microwave for 1 1/2 minutes more. Turn out into large pan (roaster or cookie sheet) to cool.

title: Frosting Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix water oil and eggs; beat 2 minutes. Add frosting and pecans and beat well. Pour into a well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from pan as soon as taken from the oven. Cool on rack. It is just as good without pecans.

title: Oven Stew
instructions: Cut meat into 1-inch cubes coat with flour salt and pepper toss with oil in 3 qt. casserole. Bake 400\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes. Stir once. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 hours or until meat is tender. Makes 6 - 8 servings.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Bring 1/2 cup water to boil. Add Jell-O. Chill until thickened. Add crushed pineapple with juice cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Mix well and pour into a serving dish. Chill.

title: Lamb Patties
instructions: Stir the first 5 ingredients together; mix with ground lamb. Form into 4 large balls. Wrap each ball with 1 strip of bacon; fasten together with toothpick. Bake on broiler pan at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Serve with mint jelly.

title: Lobster In Tomato Shell
instructions: Saute lobster in melted butter with shallot. When thoroughly warmed through add sherry wine cream sauce parsley oregano salt pepper and for true taste satisfaction the Accent. Cut the tops of tomatoes; empty the contents and save for soup salad or sauce. Fill tomatoes with lobster mixture. Top with a peeled mushroom; sprinkle with butter. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 18 minutes. Remove from oven and set on a bed of your favorite rice that has been marinated with a good tart French dressing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dutch Noodle Dish
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Add cheese and ham or bacon. Beat eggs flour milk cream salt pepper and dry mustard. Place noodles in buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour egg/cream mixture over noodles. Pour over melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange-Nut Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar baking powder soda cinnamon and nutmeg into mixing bowl. Add milk oil orange juice grated orange rind and 1 egg. Beat at medium speed just until mixed. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8-inch round pie pans.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter and add the salts and pepper. Put potatoes through coarse sieve if boiled and add to mixture. Stir in milk and simmer slowly for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. For just the right finishing touch sprinkle with grated cheese and pop under the broiler to brown.

title: Custard Dressing
instructions: Whisk eggs sugar cornstarch and mustard together. Slowly whisk in water and vinegar. Cook until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and stir in butter and then mayonnaise. Chill.

title: Chile 'N Cheese Spirals
instructions: Combine cream cheese Cheddar cheese chilies green onions red peppers and olives in a bowl. Spread 1/2 cup cheese mixture over each tortilla. Roll up. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Remove plastic wrap. Slice each roll into six 3/4-inch pieces. (Usually discard or eat ends.) Serve with salsa for dipping.

title: Guacamole
