instructions: Cook fresh tomatillos if using them. Combine tomatillos and chiles in blender or food processor until smooth. Smash avocados with a fork. Stir in tomatillos mixture and onion. Stir in cilantro and lime juice.

title: Easy Apple Dumplings
instructions: Place one slice of apple in large end of each triangle. Roll up and fold opening as best you can. Place in greased heavy pan (11x9-inch). Melt margarine sugar and cinnamon together and pour over dumplings. Pour Mt. Dew around dumplings. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Take foil off after half the baking time to brown and thicken up.

title: Strawberry Banana Freeze
instructions: Combine orange juice honey banana and strawberries in electric blender. Cover and swirl at high speed until smooth. Gradually add ice cubes crushed until\tdesired thickness. Serve immediately.

title: Bath Crystals
instructions: In glass or metal bowl pour Epsom salts. In separate cup mix glycerin food coloring and perfume. Blend well and slowly add to Epsom salts stirring until thoroughly mixed. Store in tightly covered decorative container. Add to your bath water when you feel like a treat.

title: Jiffy Corn Bake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in casserole. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swiss Mocha Coffee
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Pour in boiling water. Stir. Add vanilla and cream and stir. Serve hot.

title: Beef Tacos(Quick Low Calorie Meal, Feeds 1 To 22)
instructions: Cook ground beef in iron skillet on medium heat. Add 1 can of beef or chicken stock. Season with spices or package of taco seasoning. When stock is reduced serve meat with slotted spoon. Chop veggies and put each in its own serving bowl. Put grated cheese in bowl. Heat shells on cookie sheet in 300\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

title: Freezer Pickles
instructions: Heat just to dissolve the vinegar water sugar salt and celery seed. Cool and pour over cucumbers and onions. Put in refrigerator. Ready to eat the next day.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Brown together sausage and onion then add rice. Pour enough water over this to cover. Simmer until rice is cooked. You may have to add more water until rice is cooked but simmer down until all liquid is gone. Put this over chow-mein noodles sprinkle with soy sauce.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Dump undrained pineapple into pan. Spread evenly. Dump pie filling and spread evenly. Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer. Spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix. Pour melted butter over nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve warm or cooled. Good with Cool Whip on top. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Mix jello and water together then set aside to cool. Mix next 4 ingredients together thoroughly with jello; put in refrigerator to set. Mix sugar and flour together to get lumps out. Then add pineapple juice and egg; cook in double boiler until thick. Set aside to cool. Then mix in Cool Whip. Spread over jello mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Return to refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Sigiyaki(Fried Eggplants In Miso Sauce)
instructions: Slice eggplants about 1/2 inch thick. Mix miso honey Sake ginger and water in a pot and simmer over low heat stirring for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Dry eggplant slices with a towel. In a skillet heat the sesame oil. Add eggplant slices. Cover and fry both sides until brown. Arrange eggplant slices on a plate. Pour the miso sauce on top. Sprinkle with sesame seed.

title: Lime Jello Salad
instructions: Take package of lime Jell-O and sprinkle dry on cottage cheese. Add other ingredients. Add Cool Whip and fold together.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Combine cream cheese sour cream and mayonnaise. Add sugar. Stir in grapes and pecans. Chill.

title: Apple Slaw(Fruit Salad)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; toss until well mixed.

title: Inexpensive Punch
instructions: Place sherbet in large bowl. Pour red punch onto sherbet in bowl. Pour in ginger ale. Carefully break up sherbet or break it in small chunks. Place ice in bowl to keep cold. Serves 20 to 25 at a cost of $3.00.

title: Cream Cheese Roll
instructions: Beat together cream cheese sugar egg and vanilla. Unroll crescent rolls. Arrange triangles overlapping. Pour filling down the middle. Fold ends to center and pinch together to hold.

title: Millionaires
instructions: Melt caramels water and oleo in double boiler. Add pecans and drop by teaspoon onto wax paper lined cookie sheet. Chill or freeze about 30 minutes (needs to be very cold and stiff). Melt paraffin and Hershey bar in the double boiler. Dip each millionaire in the chocolate and drain on wax paper.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: Stir marshmallows into Jell-O mixture and dissolve. Cool. Add pineapple. Let set. Top with Dream Whip and Miracle Whip salad dressing. Spread cream cheese over top.

title: Deep Sea Delight
instructions: In a flat casserole dish place a layer of noodles (after cooking until tender) a layer of tuna and a layer of peas. Add mushroom sauce and mix in white sauce that you have prepared. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: To 1/4 cup flour add salt pepper and cayenne to create seasoned flour. Dip meat\tin seasoned flour and brown in oil in 12-inch Dutch oven. Add rosemary and onions. Pour in beef broth. Simmer 1\thour. Add more water as needed to keep moist. Add vegetables and replenish coals before simmering 45 more minutes until vegetables are done.

title: Amazing Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine milk sugar biscuit mix egg butter and vanilla in electric blender. Blend on low speed for 3 minutes.

title: Caramelitas
instructions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Add melted butter. Crumble this mixture and save 1 1/2 cups for top. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Melt the caramels in heavy saucepan or double boiler. Add 8 tablespoons milk. Pour this over crust. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips 1 cup chopped nuts and remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

title: Surprise Delight
instructions: Brown meat. Sprinkle with flour salt and pepper. Add soups and milk. Cook in a casserole at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve over noodles macaroni or toast.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Cook the chicken until\tpartly tender.\tDrain and place in baking dish. Mix all ingredients and pour over chicken. (May use pork or beef ribs in place of chicken.) Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Leftover Turkey
instructions: Saute celery and onions in butter. Mix all ingredients. Put in baking dish\tand cover top with Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan bring water to boil. Add broccoli onion and celery. Cover and return to boil about 5 minutes. In small pan melt butter and stir in flour. Add to vegetables and cook until bubbly. Mix chicken broth and yogurt together. Pour into broccoli mixture and bring to simmer. Add cheese broken into chunks.

title: Peggy'S Lemon Salad
instructions: Dissolve lemon jello in hot water. Add cold water and ice cubes. Let set until semi-firm. Add softened cream cheese. Beat until well mixed and smooth. Let set until firm. Serve on lettuce leaves and sprig of parsley. Can use a mold or cake pan. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Put cooking oil on hands. Roll cheese ball in crushed Bacon Thins crackers or nuts. Makes 2 medium or 4 small balls. Let cheese come to room temperature before mixing with mixer. Cheese balls freeze well.

title: Latkies(Potato Pancakes)
instructions: Finely chop potato cubes in blender with onion. Mix then with other ingredients. Spoon 2 tablespoons batter on to griddle (pan) with peanut oil heated to 360\u00b0. Cook 2 minutes each side. Place on paper towel lined platter. Serve with sour cream.

title: No-Rise Yeast Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix dry ingredients and add half of yeast and water. Beat with mixer. Add egg and shortening and beat. Add remaining dry ingredients. Spoon into muffin pan. Fill each cup 1/2 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 24 rolls.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
instructions: Heat in deep skillet oil salt and pepper. Add celery bean sprouts and sugar. Stir in chicken stock and cook for about 10 minutes. Blend cornstarch cold water and soy sauce add to vegetable mixture and stir until mixture thickens. Add chicken. Heat through and serve over chow mein noodles.

title: Orange Smoothie
instructions: Pour all ingredients into blender. Blend until foamy. Serve at once. Serves 3-4.

title: Vegetable Sandwich Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread on bread slices. Better if prepared with food processor.

title: Hello Dolly
instructions: Put ingredients into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan in order given. Melt stick margarine in bottom of pan then add remaining ingredients in order given previously. Pour over top the Eagle Brand milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut and serve.

title: Corned Beef Dinner
instructions: Barely cover corned beef with hot water. Add onions and seasonings. Cover. Simmer about 1 hour per pound of meat or until tender. Remove meat from liquid. Add potatoes and carrots. Cover. Bring to boiling Cook 10 minutes. Add cabbage. Cook 20 minutes more.

title: Golden Puffs
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients. Add last three ingredients.

title: Japanese Fruit Cake
instructions: Mix together the butter sugar flour milk and eggs. Use half of the batter and bake 2 layers. Add to remaining batter the cloves cinnamon and raisins. Bake 2 more layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Vodka Penne
instructions: Saut garlic in oil for 1 minute taking care not to burn the garlic. Add the vodka then light it with a match. Watch that the vodka doesnt flame up too high and be very careful (very flammable). Add stock cream basil tomatoes and the crushed red pepper. Let it get hot then add the cooked noodles. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cream potatoes as normal. Add salt and pepper stick of butter sour cream and cream cheese. Place in baking dish and cover with butter pats. Top with sprinkled cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 until butter and cheese melt about 30 minutes.

title: Grandmother'S Company'S Coming Cake
instructions: Mix drain and set aside the cherries. Set aside the brown sugar nuts and cinnamon. Sift together and set aside the flour salt baking powder and soda. Cream the butter vanilla and sugar together. Add the sour cream and beat until well blended. Add the flour mixture to cream mixture alternately with eggs beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Beat well and scrape bowl frequently. Pour half of batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Top with 1/3 cherries and 1/3 nuts. Repeat this a second and third time. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Autumn Squash-Tomato Casserole
instructions: Cook onion in butter 5 minutes. In buttered 2-quart casserole layer squash and onions. Measure seasonings into tomatoes then pour over. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 until crisp done 40 minutes for tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: White Mountian Frosting
instructions: Boil sugar syrup and water for a few minutes. Beat egg whites until stiff and pour into syrup a little at a time. Add vanilla. Spread on allready cooled cake.

title: Curried Fruit Dessert
instructions: Chop fruit. Place in shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar and curry powder. Dot with oleo. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Autumn Fruit Salad
instructions: Place torn lettuce in a large lettuce-leaf-lined bowl. Arrange apples around edge of bowl. Arrange raisins almonds carrot and coconut in a circular design atop lettuce. Cover and chill.

title: Sweet Potato-Apple Casserole
instructions: Peel and slice sweet potatoes lengthwise in 1/2-inch thick slices. Place in saucepan with water and tight-fitting lid; steam until tender about 15 to 20 minutes. Layer sweet potatoes in casserole.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs beat. Sift flour cocoa and salt. Add to mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 13x9x2-inch pan and bake 35 minutes at 300 degrees. Take out spread on marshmallows evenly return to oven for 5 minutes. Take out and apply frosting.

title: Sweet Potato Muffins
instructions: Puree sweet potatoes in food processor or blender. Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in egg and potatoes. Add dry ingredients with milk nuts and raisins. Do not overmix! Can sprinkle cinnamon and sugar to top. Bake for 25 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven. Makes approximately 15 large muffins.

title: Fried Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and place in frying pan over low heat. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 teaspoon flour. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Slice onion rings and Polish sausage on top. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Chocolate Kiss Drops
instructions: Beat until fluffy. Add 2 cups self-rising flour; mix thoroughly. Chill. Wrap small amount of mixture around kisses. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool; dust with powdered sugar.

title: Breakfast Eggs
instructions: Combine ingredients. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate 12 hours. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Is best if made a day ahead.

title: Zesty Party Crunch(Microwave)
instructions: In a 4-quart microwavable bowl microwave butter at High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until melted. Stir in cheese and seasoning. Add remaining ingredients stirring well until all coated. Microwave at High 6 to 7 minutes stirring every 2 minutes. Cool. Store in covered container. Freezes up to 3 months. Thaw at room temperature.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix butter and sugar; add brown sugar and eggs. Mix well with hands. Add vanilla and peanut butter.

title: Ten Minute Fruit Cake
instructions: Place egg whites in a small mixing bowl; beat until stiff. Set aside. Combine mincemeat raisins walnuts sugar vanilla melted butter and egg yolks in a large bowl. Mix until well blended. Sift dry ingredients together. Fold dry ingredients into mincemeat mixture. Fold in egg whites. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake in a slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tangy Fruit Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl until thoroughly blended. Serve with your favorite fruit or combination of fruits for a salad or dessert. Makes 1 cup.

title: Dad'S Broccoli And Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli just until tender; drain. Fry beef until well done. Rinse with hot water and drain again. Add rice and seasonings. Stir until mixed. Put half of broccoli in the bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish. Layer 1/2 of beef and rice cottage cheese rest of beef and rice and rest of broccoli. Spread soup over top and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Pour enough beverage over sherbet to fill punch bowl and chill.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Mix together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can top with caramel sauce. Serves 12.

title: Hot Stuff Dip
instructions: Brown beef; drain. Add pepper and tomato paste garlic and Worcestershire sauce. Mix. Add cheese. Keep in crock-pot. (Use on crackers or chips.)

title: Dill Pickle - Cream Cheese Swirls
instructions: Bread should be ordered the day before you need. Trim all hard edges and roll each slice flat as possible with rolling pin just before spreading with cheese mixture. Place a dill pickle at end of bread slice and roll in a jellyroll fashion. Wrap each roll in waxed paper separately and twist the ends so as to hold firm. Chill overnight if possible. When ready to serve slice in approximately 1/2-inch slices.

title: E. C.'S Zesty Chilli
instructions: Dump hamburger mixture into stew pot and continue to simmer for 10 more minutes.

title: Sliced Tomatoes With Three Herb Dressing
instructions: Place basil parsley oregano olive oil lemon juice sugar garlic salt and pepper in a food processor fitted with the metal blade or a blender. Process 30 to 60 seconds or until emulsified. Pour into a glass jar and set aside.

title: Cream Cheese Icing
instructions: Combine ingredients and mix well.

title: Potato-Cheese Soup
instructions: Boil diced potatoes and onion until tender. With a potato masher mash potatoes slightly. Add mushroom soup milk oleo and cheese. Heat over low heat until cheese is melted. Add salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Cold Caramel Sauce
instructions: Cream butter and sugar well; blend with egg. Fold in whipped cream and vanilla.

title: Holiday Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple; reserve syrup. Add boiling water to syrup to make 1 cup. Dissolve jello in hot liquids; stir in cranberry sauce and orange peel. Chill until partially set. Fold in orange sections and pineapple. Whip cream and fold into mixture. Pour into 6-cup mold. Chill until set. Unmold; garnish with a few green grapes that have been dipped in beaten egg whites and granulated sugar to coat.

title: Easy Spaghetti
instructions: Combine ground beef and onion in a large skillet; cook until beef is browned stirring until it crumbles. Drain. Stir in tomatoes and next 4 ingredients; cook over medium heat stirring occasionally about 1/2 hour or longer. Serve over spaghetti and sprinkle with cheese. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Crunchy Fish Fillets
instructions: Pat fillets dry. Line bottom of baking dish with cereal salt pepper and parsley. Dip fish into melted oleo and place in baking dish on top of cereal mix. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli With Mustard-Dill Sauce
instructions: Bring fresh broccoli and salted water to boil; cover and cook until just tender about 6 minutes. (Cook frozen broccoli as directed.) Melt diet margarine; add flour and cook about 1 minute stirring constantly. Add salt dill weed mustard and milk. Stir until smooth; bring to a simmer; cook 2 minutes while stirring constantly.

title: Pineapple Ice Box Pie
instructions: Mix lemon juice and milk. Add cool whip and pineapple. Mix well. Pour into two graham cracker crust. Chill until it sets.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix by hand. (Do not use mixer.) Makes 3 layers.

title: Barbecue Beef Or Pork
instructions: Incredibly easy with spectacular results. Makes a great family supper or bake at home and rewarm in the coals of a campfire.

title: Cherry Nut Crunch(Quick And Easy And Good)
instructions: Grease a 9-inch square pan. Pour in pie filling. Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling. Sprinkle broken nut meats over top. Top with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold with or without whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Cream all ingredients together. Then form into ball. Roll cheese ball in nuts or press nuts on outside of cheese ball.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Beat at high speed for 5 minutes. Pour over baked crust and return to oven for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while still warm. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: In saucepan cook beets in water until tender. Drain. Pour cold water over beets and skin them by rubbing between your hands. Cut off ends. Slice beets. Dissolve sugar and salt into the 2 cups water and vinegar. Pour syrup onto beets. These keep in the refrigerator for months.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix pudding according to box directions. Then in another bowl mix 2 packages Dream Whip with 2 1/2 cups milk. Mix pudding Dream Whip pineapple marshmallows and nuts together. Refrigerate.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet that has a tight-fitting cover. Brown the pieces of chicken evenly on all sides in the melted butter. Add the onions green pepper garlic tomatoes and tomato sauce. Mix well then stir in the wine salt and pepper. Add the bay leaves and thyme. Cover tightly and cook over low heat for 35 minutes. Turn the chicken pieces once during this cooking period. They are done if you can pierce the thickest portions with a fork. This chicken is excellent served with cooked spaghetti or cooked broad egg noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Creamy Cucumber Dressing
instructions: Combine ingredients in small bowl; stir until well blended. Chill. Refrigerate in tightly covered container. Makes 1 cup dressing.

title: Lazy Wife Biscuits
instructions: Mix together. Spoon onto baking sheet and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar eggs and butter until blended well. Stir in chocolate chips pecans and coconut. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake 350\u00b0 for 30-35 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and peanut butter in large mixing bowl. Add granulated and brown sugars; mix well. Add egg and vanilla. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt. Blend in creamed mixture. Roll into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Press and shape with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Enjoy.

title: Quick Honey Dijon Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and blend well. Keep refrigerated.

title: Texas Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly then ready for use. Great with beef.

title: Cherry Punch
instructions: Chill ingredients; mix well. Add sherbet stir. Ice ring may be used instead of sherbet. Serves about 20 people.

title: Corn Custard
instructions: Mix flour and sugar together. Beat eggs. Add all ingredients to corn. bake in 8 x 8-inch flat casserole placed in a pan of water at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sausage Wheels
instructions: Roll out pastries and spread uncooked sausage out to the edges. Roll up as a log chill and slice. Bake on broiler pan at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 7 dozen.

title: Frogs' Legs A La Creole
instructions: Put frogs legs in boiling water with lemon juice salt and pepper. Scald for 4 minutes. Drain legs and pat dry. Dip legs into eggs and roll in bread crumbs.

title: Watergate Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix well and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan or layer.

title: Holly Candy
instructions: Melt margarine. Add marshmallows; cook only until melted. Remove from heat. Add coloring. Add corn flakes; mix real good. Drop onto wax paper by spoonful; apply a few red hots to each. Allow to cool and serve. Makes approximately 6 dozen.

title: Four Minute Fudge
instructions: In sauce pan add sugar and cocoa. Add milk and stir. Bring to a boil. Boil for 4 minutes. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Add nuts. Drop by teaspoons full onto wax paper. Let cool.

title: Chicken Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken or turkey into bite size pieces. Wash mushrooms pat dry and saute in butter with onion. Follow package directions for firm rice. Combine chicken rice mushrooms and onion. Blend sour cream and undiluted mushroom soup. Toss together with chicken mixture in a 2-quart casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings. Double the ingredients to serve 10 to 12.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix together eggs sugar melted butter lemon juice and coconut. Put in unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Dressing
instructions: Pour melted butter into a baking dish. Mix sugar crushed pineapple (drained) bread eggs and milk. Pour over butter. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar cinnamon and roasted pecans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes. (This is good served with ham.)

title: Walnut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; gradually add sugar and continue beating until thick. Add remaining ingredients; beat well. Fold in nuts and pour into 8 or 9 inch unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 300 degree oven for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Banana Pudding Pie
instructions: *Can use Jell-O vanilla flavor sugar-free instant pudding and Cool Whip Lite whipped topping.

title: Thyme Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. In a large bowl stir together thyme salt garlic and oil. Add vegetables and mix gently to coat. Place vegetables in a 9x13 inch baking pan. Cover with foil and bake stirring occasionally for 25 minutes. Uncover; continue baking for 15 to 20 minutes stirring once until vegetables are tender and just start to brown.

title: Ike'S Elk Chile Recipe
instructions: Saute the mushrooms onions green pepper garlic buds and celery and mix into the browned meat. Mix the tomato juice tomatoes pinto beans and kidney beans into meat mixture and add the cumin chili powder cayenne pepper bay leaf and salt. Vary the seasonings to the taste you like. The above ingredients make a mild flavor. Simmer in large crock-pot for 6 hours or so.

title: Pumpkin Delight
instructions: Place whole graham crackers in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt margarine and drizzle over graham crackers. Put light cream cheese and Cool Whip into a bowl and blend well. Spread one-half of this mixture over graham cracker crust.

title: Breast Of Chicken On Rice
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend soup and milk. Reserve 1/2 cup of the mixture. Stir together remaining soup mixture the rice mushrooms (with liquid) and half the onion soup mix. Pour into ungreased baking dish (11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).

title: Spaghetti Bake
instructions: Cook spaghetti and drain; mix egg and Parmesan cheese with spaghetti. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan and spread with cottage cheese. Cook meat and onion; drain and spread over cottage cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with Mozzarella cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Karen'S Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray 9 x 13 pan with non-stick spray. Mix all ingredients right in pan. Smooth top out. Bake about 1 hour or until top is slightly browned. MARINATED VEGETABLES

title: Norwegian Te-Brod
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar beaten eggs extract and flour which has been sifted with baking powder salt and cardamon. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in and spread with a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes in 300\u00b0 oven. Remove and cool. Split lengthwise then into slices. Put on cookie sheet and put in 350\u00b0 oven to brown. Turn over and brown other side.

title: Pear Mincemeat(From The Files Of Ola Dortch Williams)
instructions: Grind all fruit and mix with remaining ingredients. Cook 2 hours slowly.

title: Jane'S Famous Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix Crisco butter sugar brown sugar real vanilla and eggs well. In separate bowl combine flour soda and salt. Blend mixtures. Add chocolate chips. Drop big blobs of dough onto cookie sheet. Cook about 10 minutes. Cookies are done when they start to \tan\.

title: Hurry-Up Leftover Rolls
instructions: Spread 1/2 cup taco sauce in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat 1 cup of taco sauce and add leftover meat and olives. Place heaping tablespoon of meat mixture in center of tortillas and roll up tortilla. Set in pan.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add strawberries. Refrigerate until thick. Stir in whipped cream and marshmallows. Pour in baked pie shell. Refrigerate and top with whipped cream.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Put all ingredients except broth in heavy frypan and cook until rice turns a slight transparent color or yellow stirring constantly. Place in a casserole dish with the broth. Cover tightly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Cream Shortening and Sugar until light. Add Egg and Molasses; beat thoroughly. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to creamed mixture alternately with Water; beating after each addition. Bake in greased and lightly floured 8 x 8 x 2 inch pan at 350 degrees for 35 - 40 minutes. Serve warm. Recipe can be doubled.

title: Sausage Ring
instructions: Set oven at 350\u00b0. Lightly butter 9-inch ring mold. Mix all ingredients and pack into mold. Bake for 20 minutes. Pour off excess fat and then cool 20 minutes more.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: In a casserole dish combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in beans and 1/2 can of onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake an additional 5 minutes.

title: Quick Lasagna
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in skillet on low. Cook egg noodles; drain. Add sour cream cream cheese and chopped green onions. Mix with meat sauce. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Grease 12-cup muffin tin. In a medium bowl use a fork to stir in together corn meal flour both sugars baking soda and salt. In a small bowl beat egg slightly with buttermilk and corn oil. Join both mixtures and stir until moistened. Spoon into prepared muffin tins. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until golden. Remove from pan and cool before serving.

title: Champagne Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and cream cheese. Add strawberries and juice crushed pineapple (drained) sliced bananas nutmeats or coconut and Cool Whip. Mix well. Put in 9 x 15-inch cake pan or 2 small pans and freeze. Take out about 10 minutes before serving. Keeps well.

title: Brownies
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients into mixing bowl. Add shortening eggs vanilla and corn syrup. Mix ingredients for 2 minutes on low speed of mixer. Scrape bowl and beaters during mixing. Stir in nuts. Spread batter in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool. Cut into 16 to 18 bars.

title: Corn Patch Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles in 2 quarts boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and pour into deep casserole. Mix in corn soup milk salt and Spam. Top with grated cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Croissants
instructions: Cream butter with 1/3 cup flour. Chill and roll out between 2 sheets of wax paper into an oblong 12 x 6 inches. Chill until ready to use.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: Soak pickles in 2 gallons of water with lime for 24 hours. Next day rinse 2 or 3 times and soak in clear water for 24 hours. Heat the remaining ingredients and pour over pickles. Let stand overnight. Next day simmer for 45 minutes and seal.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cube roast; add meat tenderizer and Worcestershire sauce. Let set 30 minutes. Dice green onions and garlic. Slice long strips of peppers. Add remaining ingredients then cook until done.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together and roll in chopped pecans.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Parboil for 10 minutes the potatoes green peppers and scallions. Saute the beef until redness is gone. Mix together cheese salt sugar and tomato sauce. Place a layer of meat in a greased 2-quart casserole; cover with vegetables. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used. Pour tomato sauce mixture over all. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Cheese Dip
instructions: Steam broccoli; add other ingredients in microwave bowl and heat until all is melted. Add cooked broccoli. Use dip with king size Frito chips.

title: Potato Dumplings Kartoffelkloesse
instructions: Peel potatoes and cook in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Let stand several hours uncovered until dry.\tAdd flour eggs and salt. Mix well. Flour hands form into 1 inch balls with crouton in center. Drop into a large kettle of gently boiling salted water. Boil uncovered for 15 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Clam Balls
instructions: Mix all together; form into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter well. Gradually add sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each other. Add flour alternately with milk beginning and ending with flour. Mix until just blended after each addition. Add and stir in extract. Pour in greased and floured 10-inch pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 minutes. Cool in pan 15 minutes before removing to wire rack.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Fritos. Chill. Just before serving add Fritos and toss.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. Cook 40 to 45 minutes with foil over the dish and 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter peanut butter sugars eggs and vanilla. Beat in soda and salt. Stir in flour. Shape in 1 inch balls; roll in granulated sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press Hersheys Kiss in center of each ball. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until light brown on bottom. Cool slightly then place on cooling racks. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.

title: Stuffed Cheeseburgers
instructions: Divide into 8 parts. Flatten into very thin patties. Season half of patties with salt and pepper and top with minced onion and cheese slice. Cover with remaining patties and pinch edges together to seal. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until done.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Reserve 1/4 cup chicken broth. Mix cracker crumbs and margarine over heat. Put half in bottom of casserole dish. Combine other ingredients in bowl. Remove chicken from bones and cut into small pieces. Add to other ingredients in bowl mix. Pour into casserole and bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pour last half of cracker crumbs on top and sprinkle with paprika. Brown in oven.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour boiling water over 100% bran. Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs. Combine soda flour and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk. Add All-Bran and mix well. Dates currants raisins or blueberries may be added if desired. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. This keeps well in the refrigerator 6 to 8 weeks. Do not cover tightly.

title: Snowy Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes; mash in large bowl with mixer. Add softened cream cheese sour cream salt pepper and garlic. Beat at high speed until smooth and light. Blend in chives. Spoon into lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup cracker crumbs if desired. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar with a wire whisk. Add the cabbage and carrots and mix well. Let chill 1 hour.

title: Hummers(Frozen Drink)
instructions: Mix together and store in freezer.

title: Tropical Fruit Punch
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill.

title: Potatoes Any Way
instructions: Choose one medium sized or large potato for each person at the table. Wash and make sure all spots or imperfections are removed but do not peel. Dice potato into half inch pieces and place on baking sheet that has been liberally greased or sprayed with Pam. A jellyroll pan makes a good baking pan. Sprinkle potatoes with any good mixture of spices and/or herbs. Spray with Pam. I use powdered garlic dried chives powdered cheese like is used for Mac and cheese. I often use curry or hot spices or sauces over the potatoes depending on how adventuresome the invited guests or family members are.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
instructions: Combine egg margarine milk and lemon rind in bowl. Add to dry ingredients. Stir until combined. Spoon batter into prepared 2 1/2-inch muffin pans. Bake 20 to 22 minutes in 400\u00b0 oven.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Beat 3 eggs for 3 minutes; add 2 eggs and beat 3 minutes and add 2 more eggs then beat 6 minutes. Cream sugar and shortening. Sift flour and baking powder. Add sugar and shortening to eggs. Then add sifted flour and baking powder; beat all for 5 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour using greased and floured tube pan.

title: German Red Cabbage
instructions: Slice cabbage fine. In a pan add oil and fry onion until soft. Add water vinegar and apple; simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Add cloves the last 1/2 hour. Taste for seasoning. Blend with small amount of cornstarch or flour. Serve with Rouladen and potato dumplings.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Heat chicken dice in sauce to which celery salt has been added.

title: Pink Delight Salad
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in pineapple juice over low heat. Mix jello in this mixture and cool. Add crushed pineapple and cottage cheese and mix well. Whip at high speed the Pet milk until stiff. Fold into mixture. Add nuts. Chill until firm.

title: Roast Beef And Sloppy Joe Mix
instructions: Place roast in baking dish. Place sliced bell pepper and onion on roast. Place carrots and potatoes around roast. Mix Sloppy Joe mix with tomato juice then pour over roast. Cover baking dish with foil then put lid on baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 2 hours or until tender.

title: Oscar'S Chili
instructions: Cook beef; pour off fat. Add sauce and beans. Cook for 10 minutes over low heat uncovered.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: Pour lemon juice over peaches. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs until foamy. Gradually add sugar. Blend in milk vanilla and salt. In a large bowl beat cream to soft stage. Add milk mixture to cream and add 2 or 3 drops of food coloring. Add peaches.

title: Chicken Parmesan(Microwave)
instructions: Place butter in flat casserole or pie plate. Microwave on High for 30 seconds. Combine remaining ingredients except chicken and paprika. Dip chicken into melted butter and then into the crumbs. Arrange in the casserole thickest part toward the outside. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover tightly with plastic wrap or casserole cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes. Uncover and microwave another 5 minutes. Test for doneness. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients and sprinkle them into a pie pan sprayed with Pam. Ingredients should be in bottom of pan. Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over ingredients in the pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Prick for doneness. Cool 5 minutes before serving.

title: Crab Patties
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir well shape crab mixture into 12 patties. Pour oil into skillet (depth of 2 inches). Fry patties until golden brown.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream butter sugar oil eggs and crushed bananas; sift flour and all the spices. Then add to mixture. Add raisins and nuts last. Beat well. Bake at 350\u00b0. Use tube pan or loaf pan. Let cool on a rack in pan for 10 to 15 minutes. Then dump.

title: Corinne'S Cannon Balls(Appetizer)
instructions: Crumble and fry sausage; drain well. Combine sausage Bisquick and cheese; mix well. Form into walnut-size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; blend the next 3 ingredients. Stir into tuna mixture. Form into 4 patties. Fry in lightly greased skillet over medium heat about 5 minutes or until browned. Serve on hamburger buns with lettuce and tomato slices. Makes 4.

title: Puffit
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and melted butter. Add flour and baking powder alternately with milk then egg white beaten stiff. Put in greased pan; bake at 450\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg yolks. Beat well. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Roll into balls. Roll balls in white sugar; press with fork. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. These will melt in your mouth.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: To defat broth place can in refrigerator overnight. Open and skim off fat. In saucepan combine all ingredients except pasta. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Stir in pasta. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6. (Low-fat.)

title: Party Mix
instructions: Melt almond bark and oil on cookie sheet in oven. Mix well other ingredients spread thin on aluminum foil and break when cool.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook tortellini noodles as directed on package. Chop all vegetables and cheese up while noodles cool in fridge at least 3 to 4 hours. Rinse noodles and drain. Add vegetables and dry seasonings. Mix salad with spoons. Pour at least 4 to 6 ounces dressing to taste over salad and mix again. May need to add more seasonings and grated cheese to personal tastes.

title: Curry Dip
instructions: Combine chill and serve.

title: Cloverleaf Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix eggs sugar and salt. Break yeast into small pieces and add warm water. Mix all together and add melted (cooled) shortening. Add flour gradually and mix well. Make dough into round ball and let sit in greased bowl for 10 minutes. Work down and let raise double about 1 hour. Pinch off enough dough to make 3 balls that will fit into sections of a muffin pan. Roll balls in melted grease. Place 3 balls into each section of greased muffin pan. Let raise double and bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 24 cloverleaf rolls.

title: Ooey Gooey Bars
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients with electric mixer. Pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch inch pan. Sprinkle nuts and coconut on top. Mix cream cheese eggs and vanilla with mixer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cut when cool.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Fry sausage with onions and garlic; drain well. Add cream cheese and stir until blended. Dip each mushroom into melted butter and stuff with mixture. Place in baking dish. Cook uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Aunt Dorothy'S Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg yolks (reserve egg whites) and mix. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add alternately the flour mixture and the buttermilk. Add lemon orange and almond extracts. Beat egg whites to peaks then fold beaten egg whites into mixture. Bake 1 1/3 hours at 350\u00b0 in 2 greased loaf pans.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar then add eggs and mix well. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to cream mixture then add chopped raw apples and chopped black walnuts. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan or 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven or until cake tests done.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Put in 9 x 13-inch glass dish. Place in dish in order given. Serve with nacho chips.

title: Cranberry Spritzer
instructions: Combine ingredients in a large pitcher stirring well. Serve over ice or well chilled. Yields 2 quarts.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Spread undrained pineapple in a glass 9 x 13 pan. Spoon in pie filling evenly over pineapple. Dump dry cake mix onto cherry layer evenly. Spread butter slices on top. Sprinkle pecan pieces on top of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs. Add to corn along with sugar nutmeg and salt. Pour into shallow baking dish. Dot with butter. Cover top with buttered crumbs. Bake in slow oven at 320\u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.

title: Fried Sugar Pies
instructions: Place brown sugar and margarine in center of dough; crimp edges together. Fry in deep fat until brown. (Any thick preserves can be used in these pies also.) These are good for childrens snacks or on coffee break.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine meal flour and onion. Add egg. Gradually beat in milk. Drop from a spoon into hot fat in which fish was fried. Fry until golden brown. Fat or oil should be deep and heated to about 375\u00b0. Fry about 2 to 3 minutes or until brown. Drain on absorbent paper towels.

title: Bacon Cheeseburger Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to directions. Meanwhile in a skillet cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink drain and set aside. In the same skillet cook bacon until crisp remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels. Discard drippings. Drain pasta add to the skillet. Add soup beef and bacon heat through. Sprinkle with cheese cover and cook until the cheese is melted. Serve with barbecue sauce and mustard if desired.

title: Chicken Sopa
instructions: Dilute soup with some of chicken broth. Add diced chicken (use approximately 1 cup broth). Mix together chicken mixture chilies cheese and tortilla chips. Bake in 1 to 1 1/2-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 until bubbles form on top of cheese.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Use a 13 x 9 pan. Smear margarine on bottom and sides of pan. Dip dry cake mix into bottom of pan mashing out the lumps as you go. Cover cake mix with pineapple then cover pineapple with blueberry pie filling. Sprinkle and cover with brown sugar then sprinkle chopped nuts over the sugar. Slice the margarine thin and distribute over the top of the cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Crush crackers and shred cheese. Put a layer of crackers into the casserole dish. Then add a layer of soup (a thin layer) then a layer of asparagus. Do this until the casserole dish is full. The top layer must be crackers. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then remove and place cheese on top. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 10 more minutes. Cool and eat.

title: Pizza Hut Pizza
instructions: Dissolve in water the yeast and sugar. Add the remaining ingredients and knead. Let rise until doubled in size. Preheat oven to 475\u00b0 with large black cast-iron pizza pan in oven. Put 2 tablespoons oil in pan. The pan gets very hot so be careful. Divide dough into two. Roll out to fit pan and put into it. Top with pizza sauce cheese and other toppings desired. Bake 8 minutes in 475\u00b0 oven.

title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
instructions: Combine tomato juice celery and onion. Stir often. Heat gently for 30 minutes. Add lemon juice sugar salt horseradish Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce. Simmer 10 minutes. This can be served hot or chilled. Makes 5 pints.

title: Copper Pennies Or Glazed Carrots
instructions: Cook carrots until tender; cool and slice. Layer carrots pepper and onion. Cook salad oil vinegar Worcestershire sauce tomato sauce mustard and sugar until blended. Pour sauce over carrot mixture. Better if allowed to marinate for 24 hours. Refrigerate.

title: Italian Cracker Snacks
instructions: Preheat oven 250\u00b0. Place crackers in a large shallow baking pan. In a small bowl combine butter salad dressing mix Worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour butter mixture over crackers; stir well. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Pour onto waxed paper to cool. Store in airtight container. Yields approximately 4 cups snack mix.

title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Lightly grease jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch) or cookie sheet. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms. Gently smooth dough into ball on floured surface. Knead 20 times. Pat dough on bottom and sides of pan with floured hands. Cook and stir beef onion salt and garlic until the beef is brown; drain. Mix the tomato sauce and Italian seasoning. Spread evenly over dough. Spoon beef mixture evenly over sauce. Top with mushrooms green peppers and cheese. Bake until crust is golden brown about 20 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Paula'S Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Bake cake according to directions on box; let cool. Drain pineapple. Blend cream cheese and vanilla pudding with a little milk to soften. Add the rest of the milk. Fold in pineapple. Spread mixture on top of cake. Put sliced strawberries on top of mixture. Spread on Cool Whip. Enjoy!

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: In saucepan cover carrot slices with water and cook until tender. Drain carrots reserving liquid. Cool. In saucepan combine vinegar sugar onion parsley pickling spice and 1/2 of the reserved carrot liquid. Simmer to blend flavors then add carrots. Cool covered then refrigerate at least 8 hours to marinate. Can be reheated in liquid or serve cold. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and cook on low for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Date Cheese Ball
instructions: Form into a ball and cover with toasted slivered almonds. Serve with crackers.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Peel apples and cut in halves remove the core. Wrap each half of apple in biscuit by stretching it over the apple half. Place in baking dish. In a boiler heat water margarine sugar and cinnamon until margarine is melted. Pour over apples. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes basting with juice every 15 minutes.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix well. Bake in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan in a 350\u00b0 oven about 40 minutes\tor you can bake in two (9-inch) layer pans for 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Scald milk. Separate eggs. Beat egg yolks gradually adding sugar and salt. Add scalded milk. Cook slowly for 10 minutes. Cool completely. When ready to churn beat egg whites stiff. Fold into milk. Add evaporated milk (add peaches if desired). Freeze until hard then it is ready to eat.

title: Holiday Dip
instructions: Combine all with mixer. Chill overnight. Serve with crackers toast points and chips. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Miniature Date Fruitcakes
instructions: In mixing bowl prepare mix per instructions on package. Add candied fruit pecans and raisins. Mix. Spoon into 24 paper-lined cups (muffin small). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Glaze with warm corn syrup and garnish with candied cherries.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Will also need a well greased 10-inch tube pan.

title: One-Pan Chicken Pasta Meal
instructions: Saute chicken garlic and onions in small amount of vegetable oil until onions are clear. Add pasta and veggies. Add approximately 3 cups of hot water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until pasta is done. Salt to taste.

title: Irish Creme Liqueur
instructions: Put all the ingredients into blender. Blend until smooth. Store tightly covered up to one month in refrigerator.

title: Caviar Pie
instructions: Prepare an 8-inch spring-form pan by covering bottom with aluminum foil and lining sides with plastic wrap. Spread 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese on bottom of pan. Sprinkle with onions. Combine eggs and mayonnaise and spread gently over onions. Combine 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese with sour cream. Spread gently over egg mixture. Cover with plastic and chill overnight. To serve release spring-form and place pie on the foil covered spring-form bottom onto serving dish. Just before serving spread black caviar over cream cheese/sour cream layer. Serve with crackers.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Pour into greased pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Toss ingredients together and just prior to serving add 1 can shoestring potatoes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and stir in sugar and oil. Mix dry ingredients except soda. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add alternately with dry ingredients to sugar mixture. Stir in prunes and nuts. Bake in greased pan for 55 to 60 minutes or until tests done. Remove from pan and frost.

title: Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Mix chicken soup and sour cream. Place in rectangular baking dish. Top with prepared dressing. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Luscious Guava Gelatin
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. Dissolve strawberry gelatin in boiling water. Add guava concentrate sugar and softened gelatin. Stir in and pour into container. Chill until firm.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine sugar and pineapple. Boil 3 minutes. Add lemon jello and set off eye of stove. Add cream cheese. Cool and add rest of ingredients. If you double this recipe it will make a 9 x 13 pan; otherwise 6 x 9 or 8 x 8.

title: Little Devils
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in heavy pan. Add butter flavoring and nuts. Stir to cool and remove from heat. Combine sugar flour eggs and vanilla. Mix until blended. Do not beat! Add chocolate mixture and again mix carefully but do not beat. Put into 18 paper cups and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Add water and ice. Do not put in metal container. Makes 5 gallons.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sweet-Sour Dressing
instructions: Chop up onion. Put in blender and liquify it. Add all the other ingredients and blend until sugar and salt are completely dissolved. Add 1 pint of salad oil 1 cup at a time. Blend well.

title: Dessert
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and add 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together for 5 minutes using mixer the remaining ingredients. Pour over cake mixture in pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cut in squares.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Combine and refrigerate for 24 hours stirring occasionally.

title: Super Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix sugar peanut butter egg and vanilla in a bowl with spoon. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on nonstick cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until light. Remove to wire rack to cool. (Be careful cookies have a tendency to burn on the bottom. Watch carefully.) Yields approximately 2 dozen cookies.

title: Waldorf Astoria Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and margarine. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and food coloring. Combine cake flour and cocoa. Dissolve soda in vinegar; add to buttermilk. Mix well. Pour into 3 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Pizza
instructions: Pour yeast and sugar into warm water. Let stand until bubbles up. Mix yeast mixture in with flour salt and olive oil. Knead dough. After kneading form into ball. Place in bowl and let rise. Should take 45 minutes.

title: Seafood Dip
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients. Serve on Ritz crackers and top with cocktail sauce.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix pudding with milk. Add Eagle Brand and vanilla. Stir in Cool Whip. In large dish layer 1/2 box cookies sliced bananas and pudding. Top with rest of cookies. Make one day ahead.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cocoa and salt. Add eggs milk butter and vanilla. Mix well with mixer. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Cut large okra in 1-inch or more slices. Sprinkle with meal. Dip in egg and meal again (roll or shake in bag). Fry in shortening. Drain on paper towels.

title: Rice Crispy Cookies
instructions: Heat corn syrup and sugar on medium heat just until boiling. Cool. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and Rice Krispies. Press into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips together and frost cookies with this mixture.

title: Wet Crust Shoo-Fly Pie
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and shortening. Reserve 3/4 cup mixture for topping. To remainder add other filling ingredients. Beat well. Pour into pie shell. Add reserved crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Whole Wheat Loaves
instructions: Sprinkle yeast on 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water; stir to dissolve. Add flour sugar and salt. Beat until batter is smooth. Cover and let rise in warm place until light and bubbly. Combine 1/2 cup hot water brown sugar and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Add brown sugar mixture to yeast; mix well. Add enough whole wheat flour to make a soft dough that leaves the side of the bowl. Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth and satiny. Place dough in lightly greased bowl; turn over to greased top. Cover and let rise until doubled. Divide dough in half. Shape into balls. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Shape each half into a loaf. Place in two greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until loaves sound hollow when tapped. Remove from pans. Brush tops with melted butter.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine meal flour and onions. Add the egg and oil. Stir in milk. Mix until all ingredients are damp. Drop by tablespoon into hot cooking oil. Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

title: 5 Bean Soup(Very Hearty)
instructions: Place all beans (except limas) in bowl and cover with water. Soak overnight. Soak limas separately. Cover ham hock and sausage with water and boil. Add carrot celery and parsley. Simmer 1 hour but remove sausage after 15 minutes. Set aside. Saute onion in olive oil. Add garlic and set aside. Drain and remove grease for hock water. Discard veggies. Remove meat from hock and chop coarsely. Dispose of skin and bone. Drain mixed beans and put in a large pot. Measure degreased water and add water to make 4 cups. Pour over beans. Boil. Add onion-garlic mixture. Simmer; add spices. Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add tomatoes beef stock and lima beans. Simmer another 30 minutes. Cut sausage into 1/4-inch rings. Add to soup with ham and vinegar. Simmer 10 minutes more. Serve! Very good. Hot. Good Tex-Mex!

title: Hamburger-Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: In a skillet brown the hamburger salt pepper onion sugar and green pepper. Add the drained beans and tomatoes and stir gently. Transfer to a casserole dish. Pipe outer edge with mashed potatoes. Sprinkle grated cheese over potatoes.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
instructions: Cut cucumbers lengthwise into halves; remove seeds. Cut into 1/2-inch slices. Mix cucumbers soup water chestnuts and milk; heat to boiling then reduce heat. Cover and simmer until cucumbers are tender (about 6 minutes). Stir in dill weed and pimiento.

title: Chicken Spaghetti With Cheese
instructions: Cook the chicken in boiling salted water until tender enough to fall off the bones. Remove meat from bones and dice. Measure stock and add water to make 1 quart. Add the celery onions peppers and spaghetti to pan. Cook until pasta is tender. Fold in the chicken pimiento and mushrooms. Cook until just warm. Stir in the cheese. Pour into baking dish and chill 24 hours. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes before serving. Makes 10 servings. Garnish each serving with sliced green olives and serve.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Wash rice in hot water until all starch is removed. Saute onions in margarine for 5 minutes. Pour over rice and stir until all grains of rice are covered with margarine. Mix chicken base and white pepper with hot water until dissolved. Stir into rice. Place in suitable pan and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Mix green and red diced pepper into cooked rice.

title: Quick Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Put margarine cocoa and milk in pot and bring to a boil. Pour over xxxx sugar. Beat until smooth. Spread on cake.

title: Swiss Cheese Lasagne
instructions: In a large skillet cook the beef onion and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Add Prego sauce bring to boil. Lower temperature to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook lasagne noodles according to package directions; drain. In a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish spread some of the meat sauce in bottom of pan. Layer noodles swiss cheese slices cottage cheese and some mozzarella. Cover with meat sauce; then repeat layers. Reserve a portion of mozzarella cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover add mozzarella to top and bake for 15 minutes uncovered. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Yields 12 servings.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together and enjoy. Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Kitchen Spice Potpourri
instructions: Mix well. Must be kept in an airtight glass jar.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil and serve hot.

title: Tomato Gravy
instructions: Heat bacon drippings; add a little flour at a time until it is a golden brown. Pour in tomatoes. Let thicken. Use salt and pepper to taste.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Cook in 1-quart saucepan. Mix sugar and flour together in a saucepan. Add water and vinegar. Cook on medium heat until thick stirring occasionally. Add salt butter or margarine and diced beets. Cook until beets are heated through. Serves 4 to 5.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place peaches in bottom of 1 1/2-quart glass baking dish. Add sugar and water. Mix and sift dry ingredients. Cut in fat and add milk. Mix lightly and spread dough over peaches. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Snowballs
instructions: Cream margarine vanilla sugar salt flour and pecans. Shape in 1-inch balls place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Bonbons
instructions: Mix sugar coconut milk butter and nuts. Make into balls and chill. Melt chips and paraffin in double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate. Place on wax paper.

title: Tortellini Salad
instructions: Cook tortellini as directed. Rinse and cool. Toss all ingredients in creamy Italian salad dressing and serve.

title: Angelloni Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients thoroughly. Dough will be sticky. Let dough set for about 1/2 hour. Place on greased cookie sheet in small balls. (Be sure there are no cracks in the balls). Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Do not overcook; will be very light. When completely cooled frost.

title: Sweet And Sour Pork(Serves 12)
instructions: Place pork water soy sauce and garlic in pot; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 50 minutes until pork is tender. Discard garlic. Drain broth and reserve.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add well beaten eggs and spices. Dissolve soda in water; add to mixture. Add flour jam raisins coconut and vanilla; beat well. Bake in 2 large pans for 30 to 40 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven or until done.

title: Copper Penny Relish
instructions: Wash and scrape carrots. Cut into round slices cover with salt water and boil just until tender (firm not soft). Drain and cool the carrots.

title: Seven Layer Cookies
instructions: Melt stick of butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 300\u00b0. Spread 1 cup graham cracker crumbs in pan. Put the other 4 ingredients in one layer at a time. Put Eagle Brand milk over all. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Hot Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Place in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Dissolve bouillon cube in water. add soup celery salt and pepper. Add spaghetti. Stir in cubed chicken and half of cheese. Pour in a greased pan. Top with remaining cheeses. Bake 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: 36 Lady Prune Cake
instructions: Beat prunes and water until prunes are chopped. Blend with remaining ingredients. (I use large spoon instead of mixer.) Bake in greased and floured 12-cup tube pan for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Icebox Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs. Beat well. Spread 1/2 of crumbs in pan or dish. Add sugar mixture. Add layer of whipped cream combined with nuts. Top with remaining wafer crumbs. Chill at least 12 hours.

title: Crabmeat Canape
instructions: Mix and spread on muffin halves. Cut each half into quarters. Freeze at least 10 minutes then broil until bubbly and brown. Can freeze for later use if desired.

title: Ham And Succotash Chowder
instructions: Saute onion in oil until tender. Add thyme celery seed broth beans corn and ham. Boil on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Add potato flakes whisking in until thick and smooth then stir in milk and bring to desired temperature.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Mix together and sift the flour baking powder soda salt and sugar. Then add corn oil buttermilk and dry yeast dissolved in warm water. Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Store in refrigerator in a tightly closed container. Dip out as needed. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes on a greased cookie sheet. Mixture should be stored at least 1 day before using.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Press crescent rolls into pie crust for 9-inch pan. Brown hamburger onion oregano basil salt and pepper. Drain. Add tomato paste and pour into pie shell. Top with cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pinoy Chicken Adobo
instructions: Clean chicken thoroughly with lemon or salt. Rinse well. Place all the ingredients into a casserole dish. Mix and marinate for at least 1 hour. Taste. Simmer but do not mix for 20 to 25 minutes. Mix well so the juices are evenly distributed. Lower the fire and cook for another 10 minutes. Serve when ready.

title: Liv'S Candy Bar Cookies
instructions: Chop Snickers bar into small pieces. Break or chop Hershey bar. Mix brownie mix with other ingredients except candy and nuts. Fold in candy and nuts. Place on greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven 7 to 9 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Chow Mein Noodle Cookies
instructions: Melt peanut butter and butterscotch morsels over a double boiler. In a mixing bowl put noodles and marshmallows. Add your melted mixture over noodles and marshmallows then mix. Then drop by spoonful on a piece of foil. Let cool. No cooking or baking. Makes lots.

title: Strawberry Jam
instructions: In a large kettle mix together strawberries sugar and corn syrup. Quickly bring to a boil over medium heat stirring until sugar is dissolved. Cook rapidly 30 to 40 minutes or until jam sheets from a metal spoon and becomes clear in color. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and skim with a metal spoon as foam rises to the surface. Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes stirring gently. Pour into hot sterilized jars. Seal according to jar manufacturers directions.

title: Hoppin' Good Salad
instructions: In a bowl beat cream cheese and gelatin powder. Stir in water until gelatin is dissolved. Refrigerate 1 hour or until thickened stirring frequently. Set aside 10 to 12 oranges for garnish. Fold Cool Whip 3/4 cup marshmallows and remaining oranges into gelatin mixture. Transfer to a 2 1/2-quart serving bowl. Sprinkle with remaining marshmallows. Chill until firm. Garnish with reserved oranges. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Lemon Drop Cookies
instructions: Mix cake mix Cool Whip and egg by hand. Chill. Roll into balls then drop into powdered sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 12 minutes. Dont overbake.

title: Gulliver'S Creamed Corn
instructions: Combine ingredients (except butter flour and cheese) in a 3-quart pan and bring to a boil. Simmer 5 minutes. Melt butter in small pan and blend in flour. Add to corn. Mix well and remove from heat.

title: Eggplant Patties
instructions: Drain eggplant from juice. Mix eggplant egg and onion until sticky. Stir flour and baking powder into milk; stir in eggplant mixture. Form into patties or drop with spoon into hot Crisco. Fry until golden brown about 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Put the first 7 ingredients (add in order) all together in a bowl and mix well with a whisk. Put into unbaked pie shell. Bake 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Linda'S Tarbox Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken until brown. Add other ingredients. Simmer covered for 45 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Barbecue Sauce And Meat
instructions: Cook until brown sugar dissolves (about 20 minutes in electric skillet). Place chicken or pork in sauce until done.

title: Wild Plum Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and oil continue beating well. Add flour and plums. Add allspice and nuts. Mix well. Fill muffin tins 1/2 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Coleslaw
instructions: Grate and mix together first three ingredients. Mix rest of ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil and pour over slaw. Refrigerate before serving.

title: Corned Beef Balls In Celery Sauce
instructions: Flake corned beef with fork. Add bread onion egg and potato. Mix and shape into 12 balls. Brown on all sides in hot margarine in frying pan. Place in casserole dish. Add hot water to celery soup and mix. Pour over balls. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes until hot and bubbly. (Can be prepared day before adding soup when ready to cook.) Serve over medium-wide noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Melt margarine; add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add buttermilk coconut and vanilla. Pour in unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

title: Yam And Cranberry Casserole
instructions: Combine flour brown sugar oats and cinnamon. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Toss 1 cup crumb mix with yams and cranberries. Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Sprinkle with marshmallows and broil until brown.

title: Lo-Cal Ambrosia
instructions: Mix well; cover and refrigerate.

title: Fluffy Orange Pie
instructions: Combine crumbs and butter. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch pie plate or use a ready made pie crust. Beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in milk. Add juice concentrate and orange rind; mix well. Fold in whipped topping; pour into crust. Freeze for 2 hours and enjoy.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer ingredients in order listed. Cover and store in refrigerator overnight. Stir just before serving mixing well.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Heat water vinegar and salt to boiling. Pack pickles in jar. Add 1 large head dill 1/4 teaspoon turmeric and 2 sections garlic per jar. Cold pack to boiling point. Turn heat off and let stand 5 minutes.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix together and place 3 or 4 slices of bacon on top. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour baking soda baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Add buttermilk mashed bananas and chopped nuts. Mix well. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0.

title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Pies
instructions: In a large bowl beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Add confectioners sugar and peanut butter beating until well blended. Gradually stir in milk. Fold whipped topping into cream cheese mixture; spoon into crust. Garnish each pie with chopped peanuts.

title: Yellow Cake Mandarin Orange
instructions: Beat together all ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Venison Roast
instructions: Serve orange juice cereal warm rolls and hot coffee with scrambled eggs which have been garnished with broiled bacon liver tomato and eggplant. Good.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix well and form into ball.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cut peeled potatoes into cubes. Chop onion up finely. Cook potatoes onion and parsley flakes until almost done. Add remaining ingredients except cornstrach to pot and simmer about 10 minutes. Add cornstarch to 1/2 cup water and add to potatoes; continue to simmer until thickened. If thickness is not to desired level continue to add cornstarch a little at a time until you reach desired thickness.

title: Low Cholesterol No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix cocoa milk margarine sugar and vanilla together in pan. Bring to a boil; then add peanut butter. Stir until melted. Remove from heat and immediately stir in oatmeal. Drop on wax paper by the spoonful. Makes 4 dozen. One cookie equals 0 mg cholesterol.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Pie
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each egg. Blend in flour lemon juice and vanilla. Stir in buttermilk and pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until set. Cool on wire rack. Store in refrigerator.

title: Raisin Bars
instructions: Combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup sugar; cut in 1/3 cup butter with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Press into bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Combine eggs and next 8 ingredients stirring until blended. Pour over baked crust. Bake batter at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Jennifer'S Divinity Candy
instructions: Combine frosting mix corn syrup vanilla and boiling water in a small mixer bowl. Beat on highest speed for about 5 to 6 minutes or until stiff peaks form. Transfer to a large mixing bowl on low speed; gradually blend in sugar. Stir in nuts and then drop small amounts onto waxed paper. Let dry for about three to four days before eating. It helps to turn them over after one day.

title: Cranberry Relish
instructions: Chop cranberries and oranges (with peel on) in food processor. Add pecans and sugar. Make Jell-O according to package using less water. Add Jell-O to mixture and stir well. Refrigerate overnight.

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine sugar and corn syrup and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter. Pour this over corn flakes and coconut. Mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and let set.

title: Pesto Sauce
instructions: Blend all ingredients in food processor. Can be frozen.

title: Microwave Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes (French fry style). In a Corning Ware dish layer potatoes onion salt pepper and 2 or 3 tablespoons butter until all potatoes are used. Cover; cook for 10 to 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Senator'S Bean Soup
instructions: Cover ham hock with water and cook. Debone and cut up fine. Put aside and save broth. Combine celery and tops green onions and tops garlic and carrots. Cover with water and simmer until tender (not overdone). Combine ham broth vegetables beans and potato flakes and heat until hot and blended.

title: Chicken With Cashew Nuts
instructions: Dice chicken breasts. Add the egg white and cornstarch. Season with salt ajinomoto soy sauce and sugar. Blend very well. Set aside. Fry cashew nuts in cooking oil until brown and crisp. Set aside. Deep fat fry chicken breasts. Drain out fat. Disperse 1 tablespoon cornstarch in 1/4 cup water. Add to chicken and continue cooking. Top with crisp cashew nuts. Serve.

title: Stir And Roll Pastry
instructions: Mix flour and salt together. In another bowl mix oil and milk. Mix oil and milk with flour and salt. Make into dough divide in half and roll between two pieces of wax paper. Makes two crusts either top and bottom crust or two bottoms.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Take graham crackers and 1 stick butter. Melt butter and mix together. Put in bottom of pan. Beat 2 sticks of butter with 2 cups powdered sugar and 1 egg; beat 15 minutes at high speed. Put in pinch of salt. Pour cream mixture over crust. Put layer of banana and pineapple. Top with Cool Whip. Put cherries and nuts on top.

title: Sally'S Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Bake one hour 350\u00b0. Test with toothpick. This makes 3 loaf pans or 5 small loaf pans. This will freeze well.

title: No Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Mix egg and water. Combine both mixtures and form a ball. Chill at least 15 minutes. Makes 5 (9-inch) pie shells.

title: No Cook Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and fill 1/2 gallon jar with whole cucumbers. Do not cut or slice. Add vinegar salt pickling spices and alum and finish filling jar with cold water. Seal jar. Let stand at least 2 months before opening.

title: Never Fail Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl mix all ingredients together. Batter will be very stiff. Drop by teaspoons. Bake at 350\u00b0. Makes 12 dozen. You can do anything with these cookies by adding something to them like nuts coconut chocolate chips gumdrops M&Ms etc.

title: Caramel Turtle Brownies
instructions: Combine cake mix with melted butter and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Press 1/2 of mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes. Remove from oven; sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Melt caramels with remaining milk. Pour in pan. Cover with reserved cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into bars. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Easy Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream and pudding mix. Add pineapple and coconut. Stir until blended. Spoon into a loaf pan and freeze until firm at least 3 hours. Unmold by dipping pan in warm water. Makes 3 cups or 6 servings.

title: Bread Or Rolls
instructions: Mix first four ingredients and cool to lukewarm. Add yeast; mix in enough flour to make sponge (a good sponge is about like cake batter only a little stiffer) then add and whip in good the melted shortening. Let rise then add more flour as you knead into a good soft bread dough. Let rise twice more and then mold into rolls and bake.

title: Mona'S Pound Cake
instructions: Combine margarine and shortening. Beat in the sugar and salt. Add eggs one at a time while beating on low speed. Gradually blend flour milk and flavorings. Beat mixture at high speed for 15 minutes. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour or until done at 300\u00b0.

title: Baked Lasagna
instructions: Brown hamburger and onions in skillet. Drain. Put hamburger back in skillet and add tomato sauce and the next 4 ingredients. Simmer uncovered 3/4 hour. Mix cottage cheese Parmesan cheese parsley flakes salt and oregano. In oblong baking dish layer 1/2 of the noodles sauce and cheese mixture; repeat. Reserve enough sauce for thin layer on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 45 to 55 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: One Step Supper Rolls
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine sour cream and egg. Add pancake mix (measure by lightly spooning into cup and leveling off) blend until well moistened. Drop by tablespoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with poppy seeds or sesame seeds. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. Serve warm. (To reheat - wrap loosely in tin foil and heat at 350\u00b0 for about 10 minutes.)

title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together Snowdrift sugar and eggs. Add milk and vanilla; blend. Stir dry ingredients together to creamed mixture. Blend well. Mix in oats raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Hot Hamwiches
instructions: Butter bread on both sides. Place 6 slices in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Mix ham and mustard and spread over bread slices. Sprinkle with cheese; cover with remaining buttered bread slices. Cut hamwiches diagonally. (At this point may be covered and refrigerated overnight.) Combine eggs milk and salt and pour over bread. Chill 1 hour. Bake in slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice (preferably the day before and keep in fridge overnight; otherwise allow cooked rice to cool). Finely slice bacon and chop onion and green pepper. Set aside.

title: Sausage And Peppers
instructions: In 10-inch covered skillet over medium heat cook sausage and 2 tablespoons water for 5 minutes. Uncover; cook until sausage is browned on all sides. Add green peppers onion and garlic; cook until vegetables are tender stirring frequently. Stir in soup 1/2 cup water and basil; reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

title: Summer Sausage
