instructions: Add liquid smoke to water and mix well with hamburg before adding dry ingredients. Mix well. Shape into 2 or 3 rolls and put each in foil shiny side towards meat. Refrigerate 24 hours. Before baking punch holes in bottom of each roll. Put on rack so grease may drain while baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Mix sugar and flour; stir into melted butter. Stir in milk eggs and baking powder. Mix well. Stir in corn. Pour mixture into 2-quart buttered casserole dish. Bake until top is golden brown and center is set about 45 minutes.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a 3-quart casserole dish. Place covered in oven and bake at 450\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove cover and stir well. Continue baking uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until pepper is soft.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries orange apples and pineapple. Add sugar. Let stand 24 hours or more.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add ground beef chili powder cumin and salt and pepper to taste. Add green olives with pimentos and tomato sauce. Bring 1 1/2 quarts water to boil. When boiling add 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Pour half of cornmeal mixture into 9 x 13 baking dish sprayed with Pam. Add all of meat mixture then put rest of cornmeal mix on top of meat. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Whipped Honey Lemon Yogurt
instructions: Mix together the yogurt honey lemon rind and juice. Beat the egg white until stiff and fold into yogurt mixture. Spoon into 4 glasses and top each with thin curls of lemon rind. Serve chilled. Serves 4.

title: Zesty Jalapeno Squares
instructions: Spray a 9 x 9-inch baking dish with Pam. Line bottom of pan with jalapenos approximately 1 per bite. Beat eggs and pour over jalapenos. Sprinkle grated cheese over eggs. Sprinkle salsa over grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Wait 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Clark Bar Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Spread peanut butter on a small cookie sheet. Boil Karo syrup sugar and water to 300\u00b0. Pour over peanut butter and stir. Pour onto another cookie sheet. When hard cut into strips and pieces.

title: My Party Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill and serve.

title: Watergate Salad Or Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients chill and enjoy.

title: Poppy Seed Cake #1
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix vegetable oil eggs and instant pudding then add water poppy seed and cinnamon. Mix well. Place batter into well-greased Bundt pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from pan (if difficult wait 1 or 2 minutes more). Invert onto plate and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Delicious Spice Tea
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix well. Divide into 3 parts. Roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Mix together coconut sour cream and sugar the night before you make the cake. Leave in refrigerator. Make cake by the directions on the Duncan Hines yellow cake mix box. Bake in two cake pans. After cake cools slice the layers in half will be four layers instead of two. Ice all four on tops and sides. Refrigerate for four days then its ready to eat or this cake freezes well after its been in refrigerator for 4 days.

title: Quick Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over high heat. Cut chicken into strips. Add to skillet with garlic; stir-fry 3 minutes. Add vegetables; stir-fry an additional 3 minutes. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in Miracle Whip soy sauce and ginger. Simmer 1 minute. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

title: Nankipoo Salsa
instructions: Cook over medium heat until comes to a boil. Place in warm clean jars (pint). Process in water (boil) 40 minutes.

title: French Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil. Gradually add oil and mix well. Refrigerate.

title: Athenian Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover bottom of pan with very thin layer of olive oil. Place chicken in pan and squeeze lemon on each piece. Season each piece with oregano basil salt and pepper. Place a thin pat of butter on top of each piece of chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine cornstarch sugar and water. Cook until dissolved. Add jello and berries. Chill. Makes 4 servings.

title: One Dish Meat Loaf, Potatoes And Vegetables
instructions: Mix all ingredients except potatoes peas and tomato soup. Shape into a large deep ring. Put frozen peas in center of ring. Put potatoes around outside of ring. (If potatoes are large cut in half.) Mix soup with equal amount of milk; pour over all. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until potatoes are done.

title: Chess Pie Squares
instructions: Mix the cake mix 1 egg and margarine together. Press in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Blend the cream cheese 3 eggs and vanilla together until smooth. Slowly mix in powdered sugar until smooth. Pour over mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until top is golden brown.

title: Coconut Chess Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake 50 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Pickle Sticks
instructions: Use fresh firm cucumbers; wash and cut into sticks. Pour boiling water over them and let stand 4 to 5 hours. Pack solidly into jars. Boil solution for 5 minutes. Pour boiling hot over cucumbers in jars. Put lids on tightly. Fills 6 pints.

title: Crepes
instructions: Mix until smooth. Bake on both sides until browned in small greased skillet. Batter is thin. Pour just a little in skillet and tilt until it covers the bottom. Grease or oil again for next crepe.

title: Roast Raccoon With Gravy
instructions: Rub the raccoon with salt and pepper. Cut small slits in the animal and insert garlic slivers into these. Place on a rack in a roasting pan and roast about 3 hours at 300\u00b0 while basting with the drippings every half hour or so.

title: Cheesy Chili Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add pepper and onion. Saute. Stir in corn sauce and chili powder. Add 1/2 cup cheese spread. Stir until melted. Spread 1 cup meat mixture onto bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with 1 cup chips. Repeat layering twice. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with remaining chips tomato and cheese spread. Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Favorite Squash Casserole
instructions: Mash cooked squash. Add other ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased 1-quart casserole dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

title: Friendship Recipe
instructions: Stir it all together. Put it in the oven to bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle it with self control. Then you have a good friendship.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Mix everything just until blended. Pour into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 425\u00b0 (goes great with chili).

title: Banana Drop Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt. Cut in shortening. Add beaten eggs bananas and vanilla; beat well. Drop by teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet about 1 1/2-inches apart. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 12 minutes. Remove cookies from pan immediately.

title: Chocolatetown Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell. Set aside. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small mixer bowl cream the butter. Add eggs and vanilla or bourbon. Combine sugar and flour. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until golden. Cool 1 hour. Serve warm. Garnish with festive whipped cream.

title: Steak Marinade
instructions: Sprinkle garlic powder lightly on both sides of steak. Prick both sides with fork. Combine soy sauce Worcestershire sauce and oil. Pour over steak. Marinate 6 to 8 hours turning frequently.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into greased and floured bread pans. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: My Favorite Cake
instructions: Beat sugar shortening and eggs together; add flour salt and vanilla. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Best eaten while warm.

title: Veal Ala Parmesan
instructions: Bread chops or cutlets and brown. Saute vegetables with 2 tablespoons fat. Add tomato sauce. Place chops in baking pan and use 1/2 vegetable mixture to cover. Add thin layer of Mozzarella cheese and rest of vegetables over cheese. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good.

title: Jane Anne'S Broccoli
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix with other ingredients (save small amount of cheese for top). Cover with buttered bread crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Melt margarine and brown sugar. Pour over dry ingredients and mix. Put half in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon in softened ice cream. Pour remaining Chex mix over top and freeze. Cut in squares.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook vegetables separately and drain. Do not overcook. Mix mayonnaise with other ingredients and let stand at least 6 hours. Mix with vegetables and let stand 24 hours.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Mix cooked macaroni vegetables and salad dressing together. Serve chilled.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cook peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes. Cook rice. Brown meat and onions; drain fat. Add tomato sauce; cook for 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Stuff peppers with mixture. Place in a shallow pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour soda and cream of tartar. Add to creamed mixture; mix well. Chill 30 to 45 minutes. Roll out 1/8-inch thick. Cut and bake until slightly golden color. Bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Mongolian Chinese Beer Beef Dukiyaki
instructions: Brown beef in oil. Add vegetables broth and other seasonings. Simmer 20 minutes. Add cornstarch and cook until thick.

title: Onion Bread
instructions: Saute onions in butter. Combine with mix just until blended. Spoon into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 or 60 minutes.

title: Pimento Cheese
instructions: Grate cheese and let set at room temperature until soft. Blend Cheddar cheese cream cheese and pimento together. Add all other ingredients and beat until smooth. I use a mixer. You can use food processor.

title: Sugarless Apple Crisp
instructions: Put cut up apples in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with tablespoon of liquid artificial sweetener lemon juice and cinnamon. Combine last 4 ingredients in separate bowl. Toss with fork and blend well. Sprinkle over apples. Pour 3/4 cup hot water over topping. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Danish Coffee
instructions: Chill bowl and beater. In medium saucepan mix chocolate water sugar coffee and salt. Set over low heat stirring until chocolate melts and comes to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 3 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir constantly while adding milk. Return to heat until scalded not boiled. Beat whipping cream in well-chilled bowl until cream stands in peaks. Serve coffee piping hot each serving topped with whipped cream. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients well. Mixture will be crumbly. Roll into 1-inch balls. Press into sugar and bake 9 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Mix margarine and corn flakes. Place half of mixture in pan. Spread cabbage and onions. Mix soup mayonnaise salt pepper and milk. Pour over cabbage. Shred cheese over soup mixture. Spread crumbs. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apricot Jello
instructions: Bring Jell-O sugar and water to boil then add cream cheese apricot baby food and crushed pineapple; not drained. Set aside and let cool.

title: Microwave Peanut Butter Eggs
instructions: In 1 1/2-quart bowl or casserole microwave margarine at High for 1 to 2 minutes until melted. Add crumbs sugar and peanut butter; mix well. Chill until firm. Shape into eggs and refrigerate. Microwave chocolate chips in covered casserole at Medium for 6 to 8 minutes stirring every two minutes until completely melted. Using toothpicks dip eggs into melted chocolate to coat. Chill eggs on cookie sheet until firm.

title: Cranberry Crimson Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Gradually whisk salad dressing into gelatin until smooth. Stir in cranberry orange sauce and applesauce. Pour into a 5-cup ring mold which has been sprayed with no-stick cooking spray. Chill until firm. Makes about 5 cups or 10 servings.

title: Dirty Rice
instructions: Break up sausage with a fork and cook until brown in a large heavy pot. Add chopped bell pepper green onions and garlic. Saute until soft. Stir in uncooked rice and salt. Put in casserole dish and add broth. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 35 minutes until liquid has been absorbed.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake uncovered in 9 x 13-inch pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar and milk in saucepan until a little dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and coconut. Beat until thick. Pour in pan to cool.

title: Shortcake(For Strawberries Or Raspberries)
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt. Mix oil vanilla and sugar until light and fluffy. Combine with flour mixture. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add milk. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8 x 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Special K Cookies
instructions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a boil. Boil 90 seconds. Remove from heat stir in peanut butter. Mix well. Add Special K cereal mixing well. Drop by spoon onto wax paper. Makes 38 to 40 pieces.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Combine the first six ingredients in Dutch oven. Simmer covered for 2 hours or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from broth. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer covered for 30 minutes or until carrots are tender. Remove skin and bone from chicken and return meat to broth. Add 1 cup frozen peas. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serves 10.

title: Chocolate Ice Cream
instructions: Boil 1 qt. of milk. Set aside. Mix flour salt and 1/2 c. sugar with enough milk to make a paste. Beat eggs and add to mixture and add to boiled milk. Run through strainer. Pour into a 4 qt. freezer. Add sugar syrup and remaining milk. Add vanilla and freeze.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add grated Cheddar onion dip onion salt and and garlic salt to taste. Form into ball and refrigerate. When chilled roll in crushed pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
instructions: Debone cooked chicken. Mix together soups and sour cream adding one can of chicken broth. Place egg noodles into the pot you boiled the chicken in. You may have to add some water to the chicken broth to cook the noodles tender. When noodles are tender mix together with mixture and chicken. Place in a casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Roast or cook chicken. Let cool. Pick meat from bones and chop fine. Chop gherkins and celery. Add to chicken along with pickle juice mayonnaise salt and pepper and hard-boiled eggs.

title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and cook onions. Butter a casserole dish and line with cracker crumbs. Add onion and soup in layers until dish is full. Beat eggs and add to milk. Pour over the casserole ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown and bubbly.

title: Creamy Peach Pie
instructions: Prepare pastry shell and reserve remaining pastry for lattice top. Drain peaches thoroughly and set aside. Sift together in a bowl the sugar cornstarch spices and salt. Add cream and lemon juice gradually blending until smooth. Gently mix in peaches. Turn filling into pastry shell top with pastry strips to form lattice design. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until pastry is light brown. Serve warm or cold. Pears may also be used.

title: Beer Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Stir only until mixed well. Mixture may be lumpy. Pour into a loaf pan that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili Cheese Casserole
instructions: Place chilies in baking dish cover with cheese. Beat eggs milk flour and salt. Pour over chilies and cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Best Ever Cookies
instructions: Cook raisins in water until water is gone. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add cooled raisins. Blend in sifted dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about six dozen cookies.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Add the first 2 ingredients and let cool. Beat the next 3 together. Add all the rest together and then put in the All-Bran mixture last. Add raisins dates and nuts. Spray muffin tins with Pam and bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and vinegar. Pour over salad and mix.

title: Navajo Fry Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add lard until mixture is like coarse crumbs. Stir in water. Knead on floured surface. Divide dough into balls. Cover and let rest. Roll each ball into flat circle. Make hole in center. Fry each one in hot fat until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 8.

title: Easiest Chocolate Mousse
instructions: In a small saucepan heat heavy cream until warm not hot. Combine egg vanilla and chips in a blender. Do not blend until cream is added. When cream is warm add to blender and mix on high for 30 to 45 seconds. Pour mixture into dessert cups and chill. Makes approximately 4 (1/4 cup) servings.

title: Holiday Crab Dip
instructions: Blend together first five ingredients. Fold in the rest of the ingredients. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Mix mayonnaise chicken bouillon vinegar sugar and water. Pour over onions celery eggs potatoes and 3/4 of the bacon. Sprinkle remaining bacon on top.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Boil peppers for 5 minutes. Mix hamburger onion pepper salt and 1 can of tomato sauce together. After peppers boil for 5 minutes stuff hamburger ingredients inside boiled peppers. Pour 3 cans of tomato sauce over stuffed peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 until hamburger meat is done (about 1 1/2 hours).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes. Mix first 8 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole. Melt the 1/4 cup butter and mix crushed corn flakes with the butter. Put over top and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar in bowl. Add eggs; beating well. Combine flour baking powder soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Mix just until smooth. Stir in oats coconuts and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Seasoned Green Beans
instructions: Open can of green beans. Put in saucepan. Add 1 can water onion and beef bouillon. Bring to boil. Lower heat and cook for about 1 hour. Liquid should be almost cooked away. Serves 2.

title: Rudolph Sandwiches
instructions: Cut the bread from corner to corner. Cover with peanut butter. Put on raisins for eyes. Give him a red cherry nose. Make antlers with the pretzels.

title: Orange Julius
instructions: Combine all ingredients into blender. Blend on high for 1 minute. Pour into tall glass and enjoy.

title: Collard Greens
instructions: Wash and cut greens into 3/4-inch slices. Put 1 1/2 quarts water into pressure cooker bring to boil. Drop greens into boiling water and stir occasionally until all greens are wilted. Remove from heat and pour off water. When all water is removed add 1/2 cup water salt to taste and the drippings and oil. Stir until well coated. Put pressure on greens and when pressure is up cook 5 minutes. Let pressure go down and stir. Serve hot.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all together and bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Melt butter. Add sugar and syrup then eggs nuts and vanilla. Pour into an unbaked crust and bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Fix jello as always and let cool; whip until foamy. Cream together sugar cheese and jello. Whip can of chilled milk; add to other ingredients folding in. Add vanilla. Place in a graham cracker crust saving some crumbs to spread over top. Pour jello mix over crust. Put in refrigerator and let set for 12 hours.

title: Spoon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons water. Combine all remaining ingredients. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven. Batter will keep several days in refrigerator.

title: Betsy'S Prime Rib
instructions: Set thawed roast out at room temperature for 4 hours before cooking. Put in oven fat side up. No water no cover no salt no basting.

title: Crabmeat Rounds
instructions: Mix well and spread on Melba or garlic rounds. Broil until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

title: Sherrie'S Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add shortening and eggs. Make into small patty cakes. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for approximately 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Baked Spaghetti Southwest Style
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil for pasta. Add salt and cook until al dente; drain. Beat together the milk and egg and mix with hot pasta. Spread mixture in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish (3-quart).

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket
instructions: Rub into brisket nutmeg mustard salt pepper and garlic salt. Wrap tightly in foil. Bake for 2 to 3 hours. Drain off stock. Cool meat then slice across grain very thin. Arrange meat in casserole dish. Mix and pour over sliced meat the catsup vinegar water sauce brown sugar and liquid smoke. Return to oven and reheat for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Beef Jerky
instructions: Mix all ingredients and marinate for 24 hours. Meat can be cooked in an oven on racks at 150\u00b0 for 7 hours or for best results use a dehydrator. Cook 4 to 5 hours at top temperature turning once during cooking time. Jerky should be pliable but dry when done. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator. (Works well with venison and turkey too.)

title: 5 Minute Clam And Parsley Pasta Sauce
instructions: Crush the garlic. Fry the garlic and loosely chopped parsley for 2 minutes in the olive oil. Add clams including juice lemon juice and pepper. Serve over pasta.

title: Mexican Wedding Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Beat well. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cook onion in butter until soft. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: One Dish Chicken Broccoli Rice
instructions: In large skillet in hot margarine cook chicken until browned. Add broccoli and carrots. Cook until tender. Stir in soup milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork.

title: Brownie Mix
instructions: Mix and store in airtight container.

title: Zesty Baked Flounder
instructions: Rub mayonnaise on both sides of flounder. Place on broiler pan which has been sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle cheese on each side of flounder. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 until tender and light brown. Flounder should be flaky.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Combine graham crackers and 1 stick melted butter in mixing bowl. Press into bottom of 9 x 13 cake pan.

title: Instant Russian Tea
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together and store. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

title: Praline Dream Pie
instructions: Heat nuts margarine and sugar in small saucepan until margarine and sugar are melted and mixture comes to boil. Boil 30 seconds. Spread on bottom of shell and cool. Beat whipped topping 1 cup milk and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on high speed about 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks. Add remaining milk and pudding mix; blend on low speed. Beat on high speed 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spoon into pastry shell. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or until ready to serve. Garnish as desired. Makes 8 servings.

title: Saucy Baked Beans
instructions: Saute onions and bacon in large saucepan until lightly browned. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil then simmer at least 15 minutes stirring occasionally (or bring mixture to a boil then pour into casserole or baking pan and bake at 425\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until bubbly).

title: Light Corn Bread
instructions: Combine cornmeal flour sugar and salt. In separate bowl lightly beat buttermilk and eggs. Beat in baking soda followed by the melted shortening. Combine egg mixture with dry ingredients blending lightly but thoroughly. Do not overbeat. Divide batter between 2 greased 9 x 5 loaf pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot. Serve with crackers or toasted pita bread.

title: Nut Bread(Norway)
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients. Add nuts and dates. Combine liquids; stir into first mixture. Stir. Turn into three Number 2 size greased cans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Turn tins on sides during last 15 minutes. To remove from tins cut out bottoms of cans. Nice for holiday gifts!

title: Sauerkraut Apple Relish
instructions: Add sugar and vinegar together to dissolve. Add apples and sauerkraut. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and chill at least 4 hours before serving. Overnight is best. Stir a few times. Flavor improves on standing. Keep refrigerated. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together saving breadcrumbs and 1/4 cup melted butter for topping. Put into well-greased casserole dish. Combine breadcrumbs and butter; crumble on top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. In blender process oatmeal until powdery. In a separate bowl combine oatmeal flour salt baking powder and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Add chocolate chips Hershey bar and chopped nuts. Cook on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes. (Bake only six minutes; cookies will not seem done but will set.) Yield 50 to 60 large cookies.

title: Party Cheese Ball
instructions: Place cheeses in mixing bowl and allow to soften to room temperature. Add onion and Worcestershire sauce and beat until fluffy. Shape into large ball and roll in finely chopped nuts. Cover and refrigerate. Serve with assorted crackers.

title: Corn Muffins
instructions: Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add other ingredients. Beat well. Pour into greased muffin pan 1/2 full each. Bake at 400\u00b0 until just golden brown. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Beat eggs. Add oil sugar pumpkin and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add to first mixture. Add nuts if desired. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool on wire racks.

title: Zucchini And Tomato Soup
instructions: Microwave 18 minutes stirring periodically the first 7 ingredients or simmer 10 minutes or until done then add remaining ingredients and microwave 1 1/2 minutes or simmer 2 to 3 minutes longer. Serves 4. Calories 40 cholesterol 1 mg and fat 1 g.

title: Pure Fruit Wedding Punch
instructions: Mix hot water sugar pineapple juice orange juice and lemon juice and freeze. When ready to use take out 2 hours before serving. Right before serving chop frozen ingredients and add ginger ale. Makes 30 (6 ounce) cups.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Melt Hershey bars in chocolate syrup over low heat and let cool. Cream butter and sugar together. Beat in eggs one at a time. Sift flour; add soda and sift again. Add flour soda and buttermilk to sugar/butter mixture. Fold in vanilla and chocolate syrup. Pour into large Bundt pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

title: Chicken Cashew Casserole(Serves 15)
instructions: Combine; pour into greased casserole dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle extra noodles on top before serving.

title: Beef And Rice Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper meat. Roll in flour and brown in hot oil. In a buttered baking dish spread the rice. Chop garlic and mince onion spreading both over rice. Arrange browned beef over this and pour consomme and water over all. Salt and pepper as desired. Spread can of mushrooms with liquid over all and bake in a covered dish for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Wedding Cake
instructions: Beat egg whites adding about 1/2 cup sugar until stiffly beaten. Cream sugar and Crisco together well. Sift flour baking powder and salt together and add alternately with the milk to the creamed sugar mixture mixing thoroughly. Fold in the egg whites. Pour batter into a 14-inch a 12-inch and an 8-inch greased and floured cake pan for a tiered Wedding Cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Yu Nien-Tze Chang'S Chow Mein(Fried Noodles)
instructions: Shred cabbage. Cut chicken into short thin strips. Dice green pepper. Cut mushroom pieces into thin strips. cook spaghetti only until firm; drain. Heat peanut oil in wok. Stir-fry meat cabbage green pepper bean sprouts and mushroom pieces. Chop up spaghetti and add to other ingredients in the wok. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add soy sauce until light brown color is achieved. Mix ingredients thoroughly. Heat until warm. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Old-Time Turkey Bake(Quickie)
instructions: Prepare gravy mix increasing water to 1 1/4 cups. Stir in the diced cooked turkey and the frozen peas. Heat to boiling. Spoon into casserole dish. Top with refrigerator biscuits. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serves 5 to 6 people.

title: Taco Sauce
instructions: Mix all together and bring to boil; simmer for 1 hour. Serve with lettuce tomato cheese relish or any other topping with hamburger in tortilla shells.

title: Gala Cheesecake
instructions: Warm cream cheese sour cream butter and eggs until room temperature. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a large bowl whip cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in butter and sour cream then add cornstarch sugar vanilla and lemon juice. At high speed beat mixture until very well blended. Beat in eggs one at a time. Pour cheesecake batter into a well-buttered 10 inch spring form pan. Place pan in a larger pan and add enough warm water to come halfway up side of pan.

title: Nelma'S Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni per package directions. Melt butter. Stir in flour. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add milk and cook mixture until thickened slightly. Add cheese. Stir into milk mixture. Pour over cooked and drained macaroni. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. The best macaroni and cheese youll ever eat!

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Melt butter and saute vegetables. Stir in flour and cornstarch. Add stock and milk gradually blending into a smooth sauce. Add soda and cheese and stir until thickened. Add salt pepper and parsley. Do not boil. Garnish with paprika.

title: Chicken Vegetable Stir-Fry Burritos
instructions: Cut skinless chicken into small 1-inch pieces. Season chicken with lemon pepper. Heat small amount of oil or butter (1 to 2 tablespoons) in a large skillet; add chicken. Cook 2 minutes. Add stir-fry vegetables. Cook an additional 4 to 5 minutes. Add stir-fry sauce. Fill tortilla shell with desired amount of chicken/vegetable mixture. Fry tortillas in small amount of butter.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Add broken pecans and dot with 1/4 stick oleo; pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with whipping cream.

title: Travis' Favorite Pita Pizzas
instructions: On a large cookie sheet place uncut pita breads. Spread pizza sauce; top with pepperoni grated cheese and chopped olives. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pookie Louise Green Chile Corn Bread
instructions: Mix everything together and put in cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: American Chop Suey
instructions: Brown the meat until crumbly in a large pot. Add celery onions tomatoes and beans and simmer until celery is soft. In the meantime boil noodles in 3 quarts salted water for 15 minutes; drain. Combine all in a large casserole. Brown bread squares or Kelloggs croutons and sprinkle over casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes until bread is browned.

title: John'S Easy Pie Crust
instructions: Cut lard or shortening into small chunks. Pour boiling water over this and stir into a creamy mass. Add salt and sugar. Stir sifted flour and baking powder into mixture. Use a cutting motion until it is well blended. Gently shape into large ball; wrap in wax paper and set in refrigerator for 1 hour.

title: Cheese And Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a heavy bottom 2-quart saucepan cook onion in butter until tender. Add milk and cubed cream cheese stirring over medium heat until the cream cheese has melted. Stir in cubed processed cheese cooked and drained broccoli and seasonings. Heat through gently. Makes 5 cups soup.

title: Chocolate Delight Dessert
instructions: First Layer Mix flour margarine nuts and the 2 tablespoons sugar. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool 45 minutes.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Combine mayonnaise flour eggs and milk. Stir in cheese and onions. Fold in crabmeat. Season to taste. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Applesauce Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients except tomato sauce. Shape into balls. Pour sauce over meatballs and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Kelly'S Chicken Stuff
instructions: Preheat oven 400\u00b0. In frying pan brown cubed chicken add seasoning salt and 1/4 cup water turn down burner to low and cover. In large mixing bowl combine soup milk and green peppers. When chicken is done add to soup mixture. Line a 9 X 13 greased pan with layer of corn chips. Then spoon on soup and chicken mixture. Sprinkle with cheese (about 1/3 of a pound). Repeat. Then cover with a layer of chips and the rest of the cheese. Cook for 15-20 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Mom'S In A Hurry Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and salt; drain. Mix browned hamburger potatoes soup sour cream cheese and chopped onion. Mix well. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with fried onions. Bake 15 minutes more or until bubbly.

title: Coconut And Pecan Frosting
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened about 12 minutes. Add the coconut and pecans. Beat until thick enough to spread. Makes 2 1/2 cups and enough to ice a German chocolate cake.

title: Old Fashioned Johnnycake
instructions: Beat with beater until smooth (about 1 minute). Dont overbeat. Bake in greased 8-inch square pan in 425\u00b0 hot oven (preheat) for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into squares.\tServe hot. Good with syrup or jelly.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix jello and boiling water. Mix sugar and water. Mix everything together and freeze in 3 containers 7 2/3 cups to each. To serve mix one container plus 1 (3 liter) Sprite. Yield 3 bowls.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Cut in Crisco with flour with a fork. Add other ingredients. Roll out and cut. Place on greased pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Mix together and pour over meat and refrigerate for 4 hours. For beef marinate overnight. Turn several times. Amount good for 4 steaks; for more than 4 steaks double the recipe.

title: Ziti Bake
instructions: Boil ziti until tender. Brown ground beef. Remove from heat stir in Ricotta Parmesan parsley egg salt and pepper. Add ziti and half of spaghetti sauce. Toss to cook well. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with rest of sauce. Sprinkle with Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until Mozzarella is melted. Serves 8.

title: Gelatin Blocks For Snacks Or Treats
instructions: In a large bowl combine all gelatins; add boiling water and stir until dissolved completely. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and chill until firm. Cut with a knife into bite size \blocks\ or cut with cookie cutters for different shapes.

title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Dish
instructions: Mix until melted and thickened. Heat oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Sift dry ingredients and add to cream mixture. Add bananas by hand. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Hot Applesauce
instructions: Combine applesauce horseradish and nutmeg in blender or food processor. Whirl. Place in a saucepan and heat. Serve in small bowl. Especially good with pork or ham.

title: Cabbage Stew
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef. In large soup pot add beef and diced potatoes. Cover potatoes with water. Cook 20 minutes on medium heat. Quarter cabbage and add to pot. Cook until cabbage is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all together. Pour in loaf pans. Bake about 1 hour at 350 degrees. Place on racks to cool. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Quick Soup
instructions: Divide corn pepper and cheese between 4 large coffee mugs. Heat tomato juice to a boil. Pour into mugs. Put 1 bread stick in each mug and serve.

title: Salsa Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; simmer for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Pour into 6 quart jars and seal then process in pressure canner at 5 pounds for 10 minutes.

title: Sandwich Spread To Can
instructions: Grind peppers and onions. Wash; pour hot water over peppers and squeeze. Make a paste of sugar mustard flour and salt. Add peppers and onions; boil 10 minutes. Stir in mayonnaise; bring to boil. Can and seal like canning any vegetables. Be sure it seals; will keep for months. Serve alone or with meat or sliced cheese.

title: Sausage Appetizers
instructions: Roll all ingredients together into balls. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Can be frozen. Makes 30 appetizers.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix first three ingredients and pat out in bottom of cookie sheet pan with sides. Mix last four ingredients and pour over bottom layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cut into squares and serve hot or cool.

title: No Bake Raisin Sour Cream Pie
instructions: Blend together the sugar cornstarch and salt. Combine with beaten eggs sour cream raisins grated lemon rind and lemon juice. Cook and stir over hot water until thick. Stir in walnuts. Pour into baked shell. Sprinkle top with additional grated lemon rind if desired.

title: Baked Fish
instructions: Clean fish and cut into servings or cut in half down the back. Season and sprinkle with cracker meal. Heat oil in pan or roaster in oven (450\u00b0). Add fish to hot oil. Cook uncovered; baste it with the oil to brown nicely. When brown drain off oil. Cover the fish; return to oven and turn off and let fish steam for 25 to 40 minutes. Serves 2 to 4.

title: Chicken Parmegiana
instructions: Place chicken breasts on cutting board and pound lightly with cleaver until 1/4-inch thick. Combine eggs salt and pepper. Dip chicken into mixture then crumbs. Heat oil until very hot in a large frying pan. Quickly brown chicken on both sides remove to shallow baking dish. Pour excess oil from frying pan. Stir tomato sauce basil and garlic powder into frying pan. Heat to boiling simmer 10 minutes or until thickened. Stir in butter. Pour sauce over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and cover. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes then uncover. Place Mozzarella cheese over chicken. Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts and debone. Add chicken soup and other ingredients except taco chips and cheese. Put taco chips on bottom of oblong dish. Top with chicken mixture then with cheese. Place in oven uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Marinated Beef Kabobs
instructions: Using small holes of hand grater grate orange peel. Cut orange into quarters. In medium glass or stainless steel mixing bowl combine orange quarters orange peel beef mushrooms and scallions. In a 1-cup liquid measure combine remaining ingredients except cornstarch. Add to beef mixture; toss to coat. Cover; refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight.

title: Yogurt Cucumber Sauce
instructions: Wash and grate cucumber. Combine yogurt cucumber and spice in small bowl.

title: Cinnamon Decorator Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Take a small amount of dough and flatten. Cut out shapes with cookie cutters. If planning on hanging decorations punch hole by sticking a cut up drinking straw through the top. Allow dough to dry for 48 hours.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Melt butter in large saucepan. Blend in flour salt and basil. Stir in chicken broth and cook until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add chicken. Mix cottage cheese with beaten egg.

title: Peanut Butter Rolls
instructions: Take the sugar hot water and syrup and let boil until forms a little hard ball. Beat egg whites separately. Pour sugar mixture in egg whites. Roll out. Put peanut butter in warm water; spread on mixture. (Guess at peanut butter 2 to 3 tablespoons.)

title: Butter Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix frosting eggs oil water and pecans with mixer. Bake in Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Hot Fruit
instructions: Combine oleo sugar flour and wine and bring to boil. Pour over drained fruit and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Bavarian Pound Cake
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients well; then add coconut and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Grease loaf pan. Mix all ingredients. Pack into loaf pan.

title: Potato Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Place potatoes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add onion salt pepper and cabbage. Top with sliced corned beef. Mix soup and milk and pour over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Flour Tortilla Appetizers
instructions: Mix together first 6 ingredients. Spread mixture on tortillas and roll up. Chill for at least 2 hours then cut in 1-inch slices.

title: Chili Con Carne
instructions: In a large kettle cook beef onion green pepper and garlic until meat is brown. Stir in remaining ingredients in this order tomatoes kidney beans tomato sauce chili powder cumin paprika basil and cocoa. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

title: Honey Glazed Chicken Wings
instructions: Split wings at each joint; discard tips. Sprinkle seasoned salt and garlic on wings. Combine flour and paprika in paper bag. Add wings; shake well to coat. Drop and fry wings in 400\u00b0 oil for 12 to 15 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 2 minutes stirring until thicken. Place wings on baking sheet. Pour sauce over wings; bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hamburger-Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking dish with frozen Tater Tots. Brown hamburger; drain and spread over Tater Tots. Mix cheese soup and milk together; pour over hamburger. Dot top of casserole with a few Tater Tots; sprinkle shredded cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Mix together cranberries sugar and pineapple. Let set for 12 hours. Then add Cool Whip and miniature marshmallows and nuts if desired.

title: Banana Macadamia Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine flour sugar butter eggs baking soda salt orange peel and vanilla. Beat at low speed scraping often for 2 to 3 minutes. Add bananas and orange juice. Continue beating until well mixed (1 minute). By hand stir in coconut and nuts. Spread into 1 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or 3 (5 1/2 x 3-inch) greased mini loaf pans.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onions bell peppers celery and green onion in margarine or butter. Place in a large greased casserole with all other ingredients and mix well. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Banana Split Dessert
instructions: Slice bananas on top of mixture. Pour pineapple on top of bananas. Whip the Dream Whip and put on top of pineapple. Garnish with maraschino cherries and nuts. Chill for a short time.

title: Rich'S Chili
instructions: Cook meat until brown. Drain off grease. Add onion and some chili powder to meat while it cooks. Combine meat and other ingredients in a large cooking pot. DO NOT add any beans to this recipe. Bring chili to boil and reduce heat to simmer. Stir often tasting for the right flavor. Let chili age before serving. Preferable 4 to 6 hours.

title: Roast Turkey
instructions: Wash turkey; remove giblets. Separate skin from breast and push slices of onion and pieces of celery into spaces. Fill all other cavities with celery and onion after rubbing with spices.

title: Banana Molasses Bread
instructions: Stir dont beat. Mash bananas (no lumps). Add unbeaten egg; mix. Beat in sugar molasses and shortening. Mix and sift flour baking powder soda and salt. Stir in nuts. Bake in greased 8 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Fry wings or bake on cookie sheet at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes then check for doneness. Mix dry salad mix melted margarine lemon juice and hot sauce. Pour mixture over cooked wings. Spread wings on cookie sheet in single layer. Bake 10 to 20 minutes until lightly brown and crisp.

title: White Grape Punch
instructions: Combine apple juice grape juice and lemonade; chill well. Stir in club soda when ready to serve. Makes 3 1/2 quarts.

title: Easy Peach Pie
instructions: Peel and slice peaches. If they are bitter add some sugar. Melt the butter in baking dish. Put fruit on top. Pour batter on fruit. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand in the refrigerator for 24 hours before using. Bake in 425\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Use as needed as the batter keeps refrigerated for 1 month. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Chop ingredients. Add to cooked macaroni with mayonnaise and mustard. Salt to taste. Garnish with sliced hard-boiled eggs.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Combine flours and remaining dry ingredients in a bowl. In a second bowl combine milk with eggs then oil then apples and raisins. Add dry ingredients. Place tablespoon of batter in 375\u00b0 oil. Turn in oil until golden brown. Serve with maple syrup or powdered sugar.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onions in margarine. Add water and bouillon cubes; bring to a boil. Add noodles and salt; bring to a boil and cook 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli and garlic powder; cook 4 minutes. Add milk and heat on low until hot. Add cheese and heat on low until cheese is melted. Gets better after reheating.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and add remaining ingredients. Roll into balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix according to directions. Cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with rhubarb. Sprinkle Jell-O over rhubarb. Sprinkle sugar over Jell-O. Cover with marshmallows. Pour cake batter over this. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Use large pot deep enough so you can put lid on over cabbage. Bring water to a boil. Put cabbage in and let stand for 1 hour. Mix all other ingredients then put in cabbage leaf. Roll and put toothpick through. Place in pot. Pour over cabbage rolls. Cook about 3 hours on low heat or overnight in crock-pot.

title: Yabba-Dabba-Doo Squares
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan stirring frequently. Add marshmallows and cereal. Stir until marshmallows start to melt and stick to cereal. Remove from heat. Press mixture firmly into buttered 8-inch square pan. Chill about 1 hour. Cut into squares. Store in cool place. Makes 16 squares.

title: Oven-Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish or zip top bag. Dip tomato slices in water; dredge in cornmeal mixture. Spray a baking sheet. Place tomato slices on pan. Coat each slice with cooking spray. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until golden brown. Contains 1.1 gram of fat.

title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease a pie plate (10 x 1 1/2 inches). Brown beef and onion; drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spread in plate. Beat the milk baking mix and eggs until smooth 15 seconds in blender or 1 minute in mixer. Pour in plate. Bake for 25 minutes. Top with tomato (if desired) and cheese.

title: Gooey Bars
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients. Press into jelly roll pan that has been buttered. Beat remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over cake already in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 (not on lowest rack) about 25 to 30 minutes. Top should be golden brown. Dip knife in water for easier cutting. Freezes well!

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Cook ground beef onion bell pepper garlic and salt. Set aside. Wash and peel eggplant; slice into rounds. Dip into beaten egg and roll in crumbs. Melt butter 1/4 stick at a time in a skillet and brown eggplant on both sides. Put eggplant in casserole dish add a layer of meat mixture cover with tomato sauce and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Chicken Caliente
instructions: In 13 x 9 casserole place layer of chicken (1/2) - sprinkle with half the chili powder and garlic salt then 1/2 of soup mixture (soups broth tomatoes). Then layer of tortillas. Top with 1/2 the onion green pepper and grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes uncovered for 15 minutes. Serves 6 - 8.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple. Partially thaw strawberries. Add to jello dissolved in water. Add nuts. Pour 1/2 of mixture into mold or 9 x 13-inch pan. Let set 1/2 hour in refrigerator. Add sour cream then remaining jello.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Combine sliced berries sugar or honey and orange juice. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Sift all dry ingredients together into a medium bowl. Add orange rind. Add butter and shortening and work them into flour mixture thoroughly. Lightly mix in sour cream with fork to form a soft dough. Roll dough out onto lightly floured board 3/4-inch thick. Cut into 4-inches 4 circles. Place on ungreased baking sheet bake at 400\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until golden. While still warm use fork and split cakes in half place each on dessert plate top with drained berries and second half of cake. Top with additional berries. Pour juice on top decorate with whipped cream and berries.

title: Cream Of Tartar Pickles
instructions: Cut tips off cucumbers and quarter lengthwise. Put in jars with dill and onion slices. Boil syrup and pour over cucumbers hot. Liquid covers 4 quarts.

title: Candy Bar Pie
instructions: In a small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Crush the candy bars; fold 1 cup into the cream cheese mixture. Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with remaining candy bar crumbs. Refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours before slicing. Serves 6 or 8.

title: Lemon Gelatin Salad(Serves 16)
instructions: Mix Jell-O as directed on package using juice as part of water. Mix other ingredients with Jell-O. Let set several hours or overnight.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine and beat; put in large cookie sheet with sides and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta With Shrimp And Jalapeno-Orange Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook until just pink (about 1 minute per side). Transfer shrimp to plate. Add shallots and jalapeno to skillet and saute 1 minute. Add wine; bring to a boil. Mix in orange juice and cream; boil until reduced to thin sauce stirring occasionally about 10 minutes. Can be prepared 4 hours ahead. Cover and refrigerate shrimp and sauce separately. Cook pasta. Bring sauce to simmer and add shrimp. Serve over pasta.

title: Baked Apple Pancakes
instructions: Combine pancake mix oil milk and egg. In cast-iron skillet melt butter. Add brown sugar and apple. Pour batter over butter mixture and cook until bubbles come to top. Move skillet to preheated 350\u00b0 oven and cook for 12 to 17 minutes. Invert pancake onto platter and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and salt together and add remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Makes two pies.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Cut apples into small pieces. Put a layer of apples and sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar then a layer of batter then apples cinnamon-sugar batter then more apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Check with toothpick or cake tester after 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Mexicali Spaghetti Bake
instructions: Cook spaghetti as package directs; drain. Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Saute ground chuck until partially browned. Add onions peppers and garlic. When meat is browned add spaghetti tomatoes corn salt black pepper chili powder and Worcestershire sauce. Toss and turn into 2 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 1 hour uncovered.

title: Dilled Green Beans
instructions: Mix last 6 ingredients and combine with green beans. Mix well and refrigerate. Prepare 24 hours before serving.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: In a bowl combine vegetables. Stir in dressing. Cover and refrigerate until serving. Yield 8 servings.

title: Company Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Drain after beef has cooked. Add soup tomatoes half and half and Velveeta. Cook until cheese melts. Add mixture to cooked spaghetti. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with grated Longhorn cheese.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Add onion green pepper tomato sauce and oregano. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Make jello per package instructions. Add mandarin oranges and pineapple to jello. Add marshmallows. After jello is set put on topping of 1 cup Miracle Whip and 1 cup whipped cream (mixed). Sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Hellmann'S Amazin' Raisin Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Set aside apples raisins and nuts. In a large mixer bowl mix remaining ingredients at low speed for about 2 minutes scraping bowl. (The batter will be very thick.) Stir in apples nuts and raisins. Spoon into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Layered Ravioli Meat Loaf Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ground beef egg onions salt crumbs milk parsley and Worcestershire sauce; mix well. Divide into thirds. Spread 1/3 meat mixture on bottom of 2-quart casserole. Arrange one can of beef ravioli on top of meat then another third of meat mixture. Top with second can of ravioli. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Serves six.

title: Devilish Chocolate Cookies
instructions: In large bowl cream together butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. In second bowl combine flour cocoa baking soda salt and powdered oats. Add flour mixture to butter mixture in small batches. Blend all well. Stir in chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Pork With Clams
instructions: Marinade Combine wine garlic and salt in medium-size glass bowl. Cut pork in 1-inch cubes; add to marinade turning pork to cover. Store overnight in refrigerator; turn meat occasionally.

title: Sweet And Sour Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Place cabbage leaves in boiling water until wilted. Season meat egg and rice. Roll a portion of meat mixture in each cabbage leaf. Place rolls in skillet with the rest of ingredients and simmer until sauce thickens and cabbage is tender.

title: Apple And Blue Cheese Salad
instructions: In salad bowl beat together sour cream mayonnaise Blue cheese lemon juice celery salt and pepper until well blended. Fold in apples and celery. Sprinkle with walnuts; serve on greens. Serves 4.

title: Frank'S Shrimp Creole
instructions: Cook in deep frypan (electric or regular). Add butter and melt. Add onions celery okra garlic green pepper and mushrooms. Saute until tender. Blend in flour and seasonings. Add tomatoes and tomato paste; cover and simmer for about 10 minutes over medium heat. Stir. Add shrimp. Serve over hot rice.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Bring ham and bacon to a boil; add potatoes carrots and onions. Cook approximately 20 minutes. Add the rest of ingredients cook until done. Season to taste. This is better the next day.

title: Tartar Sauce
instructions: Measure all ingredients into blender jar (or a deep cup if using a hand held blender). Blend on medium speed until mixture reaches desired consistency (30 to 40 seconds). If using hand held blender start with blades on the bottom of the cup and pull up through the mixture slowly with blender on medium speed.

title: Snow Tunnel Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. Slice 1-inch layer off the top. Gently hollow out a trench in the cake 1 1/2-inches deep. Tear cake pieces from trench into small pieces. Combine milk and pudding mix. Fold cake pieces and 1 3/4 cups topping into pudding mix. Fill trench with mixture. Replace top of cake. Spread remaining topping over sides and top. Chill until set. Serves 6 to 8 people. Keep stored in refrigerator.

title: Waldorf Rice Salad
instructions: Combine oranges apple pear rice celery and craisins in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream; add to rice mixture. Cover and chill. spoon salad mixture onto individual plates or into lettuce lined bowl. Sprinkle with walnuts just before serving. Yields 8 servings.

title: Banana Fruit Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Blend in beaten egg and fruit. Stir in dry ingredients alternately with liquid. Blend in nuts. Pour batter into greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Berried Delight
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9x13 pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 4 minutes. Cool. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in 1/2 of the Cool Whip and spread over crust. Arrange strawberries bananas and pineapple in even layers. Prepare pudding with the 3 cups cold milk as directed and pour over fruit. Chill several hours. Before serving spread remaining Cool Whip on top and decorate with extra strawberries.

title: Custard Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
instructions: Mix all ingredients on highest speed in a blender. Pour into a large pie plate which has been well greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until set (a knife comes out clean).

title: Stir-Fried Beef
instructions: Combine stock soy sauce vinegar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Mix cornstarch with 1 tablespoon of water. In a large frying pan heat 1 tablespoon of oil. Add mushrooms and cook about 3 minutes. Stir in snow peas and cook 1 minute. Remove vegetables and any liquid. Heat remaining oil; add meat and sear about 3 minutes. Stir in garlic ginger and stock mixture. Bring to a boil. Stir in cornstarch. Cook briefly to thicken. Stir in mushrooms snow peas scallions and water chestnuts and serve.

title: Chocolate Fondue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in pot. Warm in medium saucepan.

title: Candy Bar Angel Cake
instructions: Bake and cool cake as directed on package for angel food cake. Remove from pan. Split cake horizontally to make 2 layers. (To split mark side of cake with toothpicks and cut with long serrated knife.)

title: Blonde Brownies Or Congo Bars
instructions: Blend the butter brown sugar white sugar eggs and vanilla. Add the flour baking powder and salt. Stir in the chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Tuna-Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus. Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Place a small amount of soup over asparagus. Place sliced eggs on top of soup. Spoon tuna evenly over eggs; add remainder of soup. Cover top with grated cheese or crushed potato chips. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until mixture is bubbly and top has browned. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Grease a 10 x 14-inch pan. Mix pecans and coconut and spread in bottom of pan. Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Pour over pecan mixture. Mix together the margarine vanilla and cream cheese; spoon over the cake dough in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Best served warm.

title: Curried Green Beans And Potatoes
instructions: Place potato slices in a medium saucepan. Cover with water; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cover; cook for 5 minutes. Add green beans; cook uncovered for 8 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Drain; set aside. Combine curry powder and the next 4 ingredients in a large nonstick skillet; cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Stir in yogurt and garlic; cook until mixture is warm. (Do not overcook or yogurt will separate.) Combine potato mixture and yogurt mixture in a large bowl; toss gently. Sprinkle with peanuts. Yields 6 servings (serving size 1 cup).

title: Popcorn Ribbon Of Fudge Bars
instructions: In large Dutch oven over low heat melt marshmallows with butterscotch chips and butter; stir occasionally until smooth. Add popcorn; toss until well coated. Press 1/2 of mixture firmly into a greased 9-inch square pan. Spread fudge sauce evenly over mixture. Press remaining popcorn mixture over fudge. Allow mixture to cool and harden. Slide spatula under entire mixture and slice onto a cutting board to cut into bars. Makes 16 bars.

title: Butterscotch Tassies
instructions: Cream butter and cheese together. Mix in flour a little at a time creaming after each addition. Chill about 3 hours. Break off pieces the size of walnuts (depending on size of muffin pan) and with fingers pat dough to cover bottom and sides of each lightly greased muffin cup.

title: Kid Chow
instructions: Melt peanut butter chocolate chips and butter in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir halfway through cooking. Put cereal in a large bowl and pour melted ingredients over the cereal. Stir to coat well. Put half of the powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag. Add cereal mixture then the rest of the powdered sugar. Close bag and shake well to coat. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Soup-Er Teacher
instructions: Take one teacher fresh from home. Add above ingredients. Put into morning classes until thoroughly shaken approximately four hours. Then place in teachers lounge; add one cup of coffee. Let simmer for half an hour. Then add a heaping cup of courage and send back into afternoon classes until teacher comes to a full boil. Serves approximately 25 to 30 students. Send leftovers (if any) home!

title: Easy Biscuits
instructions: Place flour in bowl. Stir in whipping cream until you have dough. Sprinkle enough flour so dough isnt sticky. Pat out biscuits with hands. Place on greased and floured cookie sheet or pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Makes 8 big biscuits or about 12 small.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix together. Store in covered container up to 6 months. Use 1/3 cup mix to cup of hot water.

title: Cape Cod Cooler
instructions: Fill tall glass with lemon-lime soda and cranberry juice. Serve over ice with lemon twist.

title: Quick Peach Pie
instructions: Melt 1 stick of margarine and place in bottom of pan. Add flour mixture then the peach mixture. Peel peaches. Add sugar; let set overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Thoroughly cream vegetable oil butter and both sugars. Add vanilla and eggs. Sift dry ingredients. Stir in and blend. Roll a teaspoon of soft dough into a ball. Roll ball in granulated sugar. Press down on lightly greased cookie sheet with a glass tumbler dipped in sugar. Press dough with a fork to make a design. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Makes about 8 dozen.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake and pudding mixes eggs water oil and sugar reserving 1 cup batter. Pour nuts and chocolate bits into bottom of greased Bundt or tube pan flat bottom. Pour Hersheys syrup into reserved batter; mix well. Pour big batch of batter in pan then pour syrup and batter mixture on top. Bake 1 hour; cool for 20 minutes. Remove from the pan.

title: Chili Chicken
instructions: In large skillet saute chicken in oil until no longer pink; set aside. In same skillet cook onion pepper and garlic until tender; drain. Stir in chili and stewed tomatoes. Add rice; arrange chicken on top of mixture and top with shredded cheese. Simmer 10 minutes.

title: Raw Vegetable Dip
instructions: Stir or mix with mixer all ingredients. Good on all raw vegetables and baked potatoes.

title: Cheese And Potatoes
instructions: Put hash browns in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat cheese and mayonnaise until the cheese is melted. Pour over potatoes mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Grease 13 in. x 9-inch dish. Arrange potatoes; add onion. Crumble bacon over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Top with sliced butter. Salt and pepper. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Blend butter and cheese. Add flour and seasonings. Press dough flat on lightly floured surface. Cut into rounds with biscuit cutter. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 7 to 8 minutes. Makes 24 biscuits.

title: Red Beans And Rice
instructions: Wash and sort dried beans. Put to boil covered with water. Add baking soda. Cover and allow to stand in water at least 1 hour or overnight then drain and rinse well. Add remaining ingredients and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cover and cook at medium heat until beans are tender (can mash easy with fork). Serve over cooked rice.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with coarsely chopped pecans. Roll thawed bread dough into walnut-sized pieces. Fill the pan with a single layer. Heat other ingredients and pour over dough. (Do not use microwave.) Let rise in refrigerator overnight covered. Leave pan set out 1/2 hour before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Invert to serve.

title: Lemon Cookies
instructions: Beat egg with a fork; add oil and juice. Mix well. Add oatmeal and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Frost with lemon icing.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef onions and garlic. Drain. Mix with other ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

title: Pina Colada Punch
instructions: Dissolve lime Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Dissolve sugar in 6 cups boiling water. Mix with lime mixture. Let cool and chill. Mix remaining ingredients (except ginger ale) and keep cool. Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook and stir ground beef pork onion and garlic in Dutch oven until meat is brown and onions tender. Drain off fat. Add tomato and break up with fork. Stir in tomato sauce 1/4 cup parsley flakes sugar 2 teaspoons salt and basil. Heat to boiling stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered about 1 hour or until mixture is like spaghetti sauce.

title: Aunt Tommie'S Pecan Pie
instructions: \When our blackberry bushes at the Westwood Circle house in Decatur were full of berries our boys Alan and Mark would start begging Granny Bertha Brooks Austin to come to our house to cook a Juice Pie. Vernon and the boys didnt like the seeds in the berries so Bertha would put water on the berries bring to boil strain the juice and make a cobbler. I always had to call her for the recipe so this may not be exactly right.\

title: Honey Dressing For Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in jar with tight-fitting lid. Shake vigorously until thoroughly blended and chill before serving. Yield about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Butterscotch No-Bake Bars
instructions: Mix together crackers walnuts coconut and marshmallows in large bowl. In double boiler or heavy saucepan cook eggs sugar and butter until it bubbles. Cool until almost cold then mix with graham cracker mixture. Press in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Cool.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or micro on Medium 5 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Prepare yellow cake mix as directed on the box. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake is baking boil pineapple and sugar 5 minutes. Pour over cake as soon as it comes out of the oven. Poke holes on top. Let cool. Prepare instant pudding as directed and spread over cooled cake. Spread 8 ounces Cool Whip over pudding. Sprinkle coconut and nuts on top. Refrigerate.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix broccoli cheese onion and bacon bits. In small bowl mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Mix well. Pour over broccoli. Mix well. Marinate 8 hours before serving for best flavor.

title: Quick Healthy Burritos
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. If desired add 2 tablespoons organic salsa to this mixture. Place mixture in the center of tortilla and fold. Next place all burritos on a microwave-safe dish and cook on High for 1 minute uncovered.

title: Apple Enchiladas
instructions: Cut each apple into 8 wedges. Wrap each wedge with crescent roll. Bake until done.

title: Spiced Tea Mix
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and mix well. Put in a tightly closed jar. Use 3 tablespoons to 1 cup boiling water.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes. Blend all ingredients together and beat for about 2 minutes until potatoes are creamy. Pour into pie crust and cook at 400\u00b0 until medium brown approximately 45 minutes.

title: Steamed Brown Bread
instructions: Grease four 16-ounce vegetable cans (4 1/4 x 3-inch) or 7-inch tube mold. Beat all ingredients in large mixer bowl scraping bowl constantly 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed until blended. Fill cans about 2/3 full. Cover tightly with aluminum foil.

title: Skillet Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Beat in egg. Add brown sugar flour baking powder nuts raisins and vanilla. Mix well and pour into greased 8-inch skillet. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Rice Cereal Pie Crust(Diabetic)
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Line bottom and sides of 8-inch cake pan. Chill well before adding fillings.

title: French Baked Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken breasts in 1/2 stick butter. Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt. Pour small carton of whipping cream over browned chicken. Cover with foil. Cook in oven until done (30 to 45 minutes) at 350\u00b0. Serve with rice or noodles.

title: Fireman'S Apple Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients in bowl. Mix until crumbly. Press in 2 greased 8-inch pie tins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix crumbs and melted oleo. Place in the bottom of oblong pan. Mix sugar oleo vanilla and eggs and beat for 15 minutes at high speed. Be sure and beat for 15 minutes. Pour over crumb mixture. Slice bananas and arrange on cake. Spread drained pineapple over bananas; top with Cool Whip. Put nuts and cherries on top. Refrigerate 24 hours.

title: See-Kum-Chee Kook(Korean Spinach Soup)
instructions: Mix beef onions garlic sesame seed soy sauce salt and pepper. Saute in bottom of heavy pan with a little oil until meat is seared. Add water; cook until meat is tender. Add spinach and cook until tender. Serves 6.

title: Wafer Thins
instructions: In mixing bowl combine butter and cheese with a fork then blend in flour and pepper by hand. Roll mixture into 1-inch balls. Place on buttered 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking pan and flatten with heel of your hand until balls are about 1/4-inch thick. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven uncovered for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. Cool on rack. Makes 12 wafers.

title: Johnny Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour in greased pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Cover 9 x 13-inch rectangular dish with graham crackers. Combine pudding mix with milk. Mix pudding and whipped topping. Pour half of the mixture on crackers. Place another layer of crackers. Pour in the rest of the mixture. Place a layer of crackers on the top. Microwave icing slightly so to soften. Pour icing over crackers and spread evenly. Refrigerate.

title: Apple Julep
instructions: Chill juices. Combine first 4 ingredients with ice cubes; mix well. Garnish servings with mint if desired.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cut bacon into 1/2-inch pieces. Saute in skillet until crisp. Remove bacon and pour out all but 2 tablespoons of bacon fat. Saute onion in bacon fat for 3 to 4 minutes until soft.

title: Pecan Pie(Makes 2)
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add eggs well beaten and blend well. Add syrups pecans and salt. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then lower to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheese Straws 2
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put through cookie press. Bake at 300\u00b0 until slightly brown.

title: Marinated Onions
instructions: Mix all together and let sit overnight.

title: Speedy Chili
instructions: Cook onion peppers and beef together in a pan until the meat is lightly browned. Then add tomato sauce; cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Add the kidney beans and salt. Heat. Stir in chili powder taste. Add a little more if you like.

title: Angie'S Favorite Potatoes
instructions: Mix Potato Buds according to directions on box. Add sour cream cream cheese and garlic powder. Pour into greased baking bowl and place pats of butter or margarine on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour or until golden brown on edges.

title: One-Step Brownies
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix for 4 minutes (margarine should be softened). Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake for 25 to 35 minutes until done. Do not overbake. While hot spread chocolate chips on top. Let melt and spread like frosting. Put back in oven (1 minute) if too hard to spread chocolate chips.

title: Spudnuts
instructions: To 1 pint warm water add the dry yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar. Mix yeast mixture and all other ingredients except flour and eggs. Beat in the eggs then mix in flour. Do not knead! Roll cut and deep fry. Glaze.

title: Asparagus Luncheon Platter
instructions: Cook asparagus in boiling salted water 10 minutes. Mix mushroom soup cream lemon juice and egg yolk; season. Heat thoroughly. Pour over drained asparagus arranged on toast. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Chicken Almond Rice
instructions: Saute pork (pour off fat) onions green pepper and celery for 10 minutes. Add other ingredients. Cook on top of stove for 5 minutes (large pan). Pour into two casseroles and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour or until rice is soft and all liquid is absorbed. Serves 20. A great crowd pleaser!

title: Butterscotch Pull-Apart Rolls
instructions: Place frozen rolls in a greased Bundt pan. Mix sugar pudding mix and nuts; pour over rolls. Add the melted margarine. Let rise overnight and next morning bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Imperial
instructions: Melt butter and mix in flour; add milk until smooth. Bring to boil until thickened. Mix in onion Worcestershire sauce and bread. Let cool. Fold in mayonnaise lemon juice and salt and pepper. In another pan melt 2 tablespoons butter; add crab meat and warm. Combine the two and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 450\u00b0 until slightly brown approximately 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Simple Chocolate Cheesecakes
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Line muffin pans with foil cups. Place 1 wafer in bottom of each. In large bowl beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar cocoa and flour; blend well. Add eggs; beat well. Stir in sour cream and vanilla. Fill each cup near full with mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Cool 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Corn And Green Chilies
instructions: Drain corn. Melt margarine and cream cheese. Stir in corn chives sugar and chilies. Spoon into a greased casserole. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: One-Step Pasta Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: In a 2 1/2-quart casserole cook onion and garlic in oil covered on High for 3 to 5 minutes stirring halfway through cooking. Add beans with their liquid tomato sauce pasta bouillon and 3/4 cup water.

title: Apple Pancakes
instructions: In heavy 10-inch skillet heat 2 tablespoons margarine. Add apples and cook over medium heat until tender.

title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs; beat until light. Mix salt and soda with flour and add alternately with juice. Mix in fruit cocktail last and bake in moderate oven.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine sugar vinegar and water in heavy saucepan. Cook over heat to hard ball stage.

title: Aunt Sally'S Cheese And Macaroni
instructions: Cover macaroni with water in a pot; bring to boil. Cook until soft; drain. In a large pot add macaroni Velveeta cheese cut into cubes sour cream margarine cream and water. Simmer on low heat until thickens. Remember it will thicken up even more as it cools down. This is one of the most favorite recipes of the nieces and nephews. She had to bring it to every family get-together.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Beat at medium for 3 minutes. Place in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: In pan melt butter corn syrup and milk. Add sugar. Bring to boil. Reduce to medium. Cook and stir for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Blend with mixer until smooth.

title: Kansas Corn
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Fold in crushed crackers. Add beaten eggs and onion. Season with salt and pepper; top with paprika. Pour into buttered casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Crescent Italiano
