instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown beef onion and mushrooms drain. Add salt and pepper and tomato sauce. Place in ungreased 8 x 12-inch dish and sprinkle with cheese. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Mix sour cream and herbs; spread one spoonful of the sour cream mixture on each triangle. Roll up crescent roll starting at wide end. Arrange on top of meat mixture and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: No Bean Chili Dip
instructions: Place in crock-pot and mix thoroughly. Serve hot with your favorite tortilla chips.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown round steak in margarine. Push meat to side and stir flour into any meat drippings. Add water and dry soup mix. Simmer 20 minutes. Add sour cream and mushrooms in juice to form stroganoff gravy. Serve over prepared egg noodles.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt butter milk and caramels. Grease and flour 13 x 9 cake pan. Mix cake mix as directed. Pour 1/2 of cake mixture in cake pan. Bake 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Remove cake from oven and pour caramel mixture directly on top. Sprinkle chocolate chips and chopped nuts over caramel mixture. Pour remaining half of cake mix over entire mixture. Bake 20 minutes at 250\u00b0. Then turn oven up to 350\u00b0 and cook 15 minutes longer. Serve warm.

title: Strawberry Gelatin Cake
instructions: Sift cake mix and gelatin together. Add oil; add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add strawberries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes in layer pans or bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in Bundt pan.

title: Cheesy Beef Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet brown ground beef with onions and green pepper. Drain and discard fat. Add green beans and tomato sauce; cook until warm. In a greased 10-inch glass pie plate pat enough biscuits together to form a bottom crust. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until slightly brown. Remove from oven and spoon ground beef mixture over crust. Arrange shredded cheese over beef mixture. Cut remaining biscuits in halves or quarters and roll in small balls. Arrange on top of cheese. Return to 350\u00b0 oven and bake until biscuits are golden brown 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Salami
instructions: Knead all together. Cover and place in refrigerator. Knead each day for 5 minutes. Cover and replace in refrigerator. On 4th day knead and form in 5 rolls. Bake 9 hours at 160\u00b0. Bake in broiler pan so excess grease drops off. Cool on paper towel.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Combine milk and bread and let soak then add all remaining ingredients. Mix well. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Place in baking pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Drain then add sauce and cook 10 minutes.

title: Pancake Syrup
instructions: Did you ever get ready to have pancakes and find that your syrup is low? Just make your own. Combine ingredients in saucepan. Boil 3 minutes. (My mother used to make this.)

title: Mom'S Nutmeg Sauce
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Gradually stir in 2 cups boiling water. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Stir in butter and nutmeg. Keep hot until serving time. Great on bread pudding gingerbread or cottage pudding.

title: Tortilla Pinwheels
instructions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and spread on one side of tortilla; roll up tightly. Wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Slice into 1-inch pieces. Serve with salsa or picante sauce. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Mother'S Cherry Cobbler
instructions: Melt margarine in long glass casserole dish and add cherries. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour. Peach halves may be used instead of cherries and are good with nutmeg and cinnamon sprinkled on top. Crust rises to the top.

title: No Flop Dessert
instructions: Mix flour butter and sugar with a fork. (If using vanilla pudding can add 2 cups of coconut.) Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Stir last 15 minutes. Cool. Put 2/3 in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Mix together hamburger noodles sauce mushrooms and oregano in a big pan. Spread Mozzarella cheese. Place pepperoni on top of cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 to 1 hour.

title: Slaw Dressing
instructions: Mix together and refill quart jar. Mix will keep several months in refrigerator.

title: Lettuce Fruit Salad
instructions: Chop up lettuce; add cut up apples and bananas. Cream mayonnaise and sugar together. Mix all ingredients together. Use about 1 teaspoon sugar to 3/4 cup of mayonnaise.

title: Sauted Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Season chops to taste. Dont be afraid to season; the more seasonings the better flavor of the final dish.

title: Classic Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat. Drain. Add garlic and onion. Brown lightly. Add water and cook 15 minutes covered. Mix cumin salt flour pepper and chili powder. Mix in cooked meat. Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Chocolate Sundae
instructions: Mix flour and oleo. Put in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Shortbread
instructions: Cream the butter and confectioners sugar. Add the flour about 2 cups at a time mixing well. Knead the mixture until all flour is mixed completely. Place batter in a 3/4-inch deep pan and pat it out so it is 3/4 inch high. Cut into 1-inch squares. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Ham Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Chop wafer ham onions and water chestnuts. Mix together. Form a ball. Eat with crackers.

title: Creamed Cabbage
instructions: Slice cabbage carrots and smoked sausage. Chop onion. Cook in small amount of water (2 cups). When vegetables are done cooking (steaming) add enough milk to cover all then add 1/2 stick butter. Season with salt and pepper to desired taste. Mix flour with water in bowl to make thick mixture. When mixture comes to a boil thicken with flour and water to desired thickness (allow to cook for short period after every addition of flour and water so mixture does not become too thick). We enjoy this over toast on a cold winter day!

title: Spinach Filled Pitas
instructions: Thaw and squeeze out the spinach. Combine chopped onion onion soup mix cream cheese and spinach. Chop water chestnuts and add to spinach and cream cheese mixture. Cut pitas in half; fill with the mixture. Smooth out and cut halves into serving pieces.

title: Banana Fritters
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and sugar. Add milk and water and then the egg to the dry ingredients and mix until batter is smooth. Peel bananas and slice lengthwise. Roll in flour then dip in fritter batter completely coating each piece. Fry in hot fat turning fritters to brown evenly. Drain and serve hot.

title: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Mix together cream cheese sour cream and Hidden Valley Ranch. Set aside. Press crescent rolls in bottom of cookie sheet and bake according to package directions. Cool. Spread cream cheese mixture on dough. Sprinkle with your favorite veggies. Cut and serve.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter. Pour in medium size baking dish. Mix flour sugar and milk together. Pour into the butter. Do not stir. Pour peaches and juice into baking dish. Do not stir. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Greek Tortellini Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine cooked pasta sweet peppers onion and olives. For dressing combine vinegar oil mint lemon juice sherry seasoned salt garlic powder black pepper and red pepper. Pour over salad; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill for 4 to 24 hours. Stir in cheese. Use a slotted spoon to serve. Makes 12 to 14 side-dish servings.

title: Joy'S Quiche
instructions: Mix eggs well beaten salt and pepper together. Line a 9-inch pie dish with prepared shell. Sprinkle cheese ham and whatever else desired on bottom of pie shell. Add egg mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes; set oven back to 325\u00b0 and bake for 40 minutes longer. Done when knife inserted in middle comes out clean.\tServes 8.

title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Add flour and salt then pecans. Shape into 1 inch balls. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Do not brown. Cool then roll in powdered sugar.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and shortening with sugar. Add egg yolks. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla coconut and pecans. Last fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes (test). Make 3 layers or one 9 x 13-inch pan (large cake).

title: Pineapple Cheese Pie
instructions: Blend sugar and cornstarch together. Add to undrained crushed pineapple. Cook stirring constantly until thick and clear. Cool and set aside. Blend cream cheese sugar and salt. Add eggs one at a time. Blend in milk and vanilla. Spread cooled pineapple into unbaked pie shell. Pour cream cheese mixture on top. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Set in refrigerator until ready to serve. Do not cover (makes it soggy). Just before serving pour and stir sauce over broccoli. Mix together well.

title: Velvet Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple and gelatin over medium heat until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Combine Cool Whip cream cheese and nuts. Add pineapple mixture. Stir well. Pour into Pyrex dish and congeal overnight.

title: Shrimp Salad
instructions: Boil macaroni; drain and set aside. Chop celery onion and eggs into small pieces and mix with macaroni. Combine with all other ingredients. Chill before serving.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Wash and grind cranberries adding 1 cup of sugar and allowing it to drain overnight. Remove seeds from grapes. Add whipping cream. Mix all together. Pecans improve flavor. Marshmallows may be added for bulk.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken and bone chicken. Cook spaghetti and onion in chicken broth. Drain spaghetti. Add diced Velveeta cheese. Stir until melted. Stir in chopped celery (not cooked) pimiento and soup etc. Put in dish and bake at 300\u00b0 until light brown. Serves 8 people.

title: No-Bake Oaties
instructions: In a medium saucepan melt butter. Add brown sugar orange juice and orange rind. Cook stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Fold in oats and walnuts. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls. Roll in shredded coconut. Chill 1 to 2 hours or overnight. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Orange Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix together cake mix eggs and oil. Add mandarin oranges and juice. Pour into sprayed cake pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Allow to cool before frosting.

title: Honey Muffins
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt. In a separate bowl pour milk over cereal and let stand for 2 minutes or until milk is absorbed. Add egg and mix thoroughly. Pour in oil and honey and mix by hand. Combine bran mixture and dry ingredients. Stir only until combined. Spoon into greased muffin tins and bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yields 1 dozen.

title: Chunky Garden Salsa
instructions: Blanch tomatoes; peel and core. Cut into chunks. Cook slowly over low heat. Add small chunks of green or banana peppers chopped onion diced garlic and cut fresh and dried ground herbs and spices. Add hot peppers to taste.

title: Lemon Things
instructions: Mix cake mix (dry) 1/2 cup oleo and 1 egg. Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Banana Cream Supreme
instructions: Mix together crackers butter and sugar. Press into bottom and sides of spring-form pan. Combine Cool Whip pudding and sour cream and mix with a wire whisk.

title: Wassail
instructions: Slowly bring all ingredients to a boil on the stove. Simmer for 15 minutes. Best served hot.

title: Quick Herb Rolls
instructions: Melt butter in a 9-inch Pyrex dish. Mix in herbs and cheese. Cut biscuits into halves or fourths and swish around in herb-butter to coat all sides. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Soak Shredded Wheat in milk and combine with meats in which onion green pepper salt pepper tomato catsup and egg have been mixed. Form into loaf and place in greased loaf pan. Cut bacon strips in half and place on top of meat loaf. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) about 50 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Rice Pudding Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until foamy. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm. After baking top with whipped cream.

title: Tomato Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook onions for 10 minutes in boiling water. Lightly grease casserole. Layer 1/2 tomatoes 1/2 onions and 1/2 cheese. Repeat. Sprinkle with melted butter salt pepper and basil. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake 30 to 35 minutes uncovered.

title: Asparagus Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Preparation Cut asparagus into thin slices diagonally; slice flank steak very thin; mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup of water and seasonings; cut green onion for garnishing.

title: Hot Pizza Sandwiches
instructions: Preheat sandwich maker according to directions. Spread sauce on 2 slices of bread not all the way to edges. Sprinkle pepperoni on sauce. Add cheese. Place slice of bread on top of each evenly. Carefully place sandwiches in heated sandwich maker. Press to close lock and leave 1 1/2 minutes or according to directions on appliance. Open carefully and remove sandwiches very carefully.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix in hot water the gelatin which has been soaked in the cold water. Add to the vegetables and congeal.

title: Scallop Oysters
instructions: Butter baking dish. Put 1/2 inch crackers in dish. Put in oysters; add salt and pepper and pats of butter. Put in 2 cups of cream. Add more crackers about another 1/2 inch. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Honey Sauce For Baked Chicken
instructions: Use equal amounts of honey melted butter and lemon juice. Heat on low just until blended. This should be used during the last hour of baking of chicken.

title: Tuna Dip
instructions: Mix with a mixer. Chill and serve.

title: Chops In Beer
instructions: Brown chops. Cover with catsup beer and brown sugar. Cook at low heat for 1 hour.

title: Cashew Pea Salad
instructions: Thaw frozen peas under running water. Drain & combine next five ingredients. Mix sour cream and ranch dressing. Pour over pea mixture; toss gently. Refrigerate until chilled.

title: 30 Minute Supper
instructions: Saute onion and jalapenos in oil. Add meat after browning. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes black pepper chili powder and red pepper. Cover. Cook on medium heat. When meat has cooked 10 to 15 minutes add corn. Cook over medium heat 5 to 10 minutes covered. Serve over elbow macaroni rice or boiled diced potatoes. Serves 3 to 5 depending how much rice you use. If red pepper and jalapenos are both used it may be warmish!

title: Squirrel Stew
instructions: Cut up 3 squirrels in convenient-size pieces and place them in a large kettle; add 3 quarts of water. Bring to a boil slowly and simmer until the meat is tender (about 1 1/2 to 2 hours) or cook in a pressure cooker 30 to 45 minutes depending on age of squirrel. REMOVE THE MEAT FROM THE BONES and put back in the water. Add bacon cayenne black pepper salt onion tomatoes tomato paste potatoes and frozen vegetables. Cook for 1 hour. Then add corn and cook for another 10 minutes. Serve with corn bread. Serves 6.

title: Sukiyaki
instructions: Brown meat in hot oil. Combine bouillon soy sauce sugar and sherry in bowl. Add 1/2 mixture to meat. Push meat to one side of frying pan. Add onions and celery and cook over low heat 3 minutes. Add remaining bouillon mixture bamboo shoots mushrooms water chestnuts and cooked spinach. Cook for three minutes. Add green onions. Cook 1 hour over low heat. Serve over the cooked vermicelli.

title: Tater-Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and onion; drain off fat. Place in bottom of a well-greased 2-quart baking dish top with undiluted cream of mushroom soup then top with cheese. Finally cover with rows of Tater Tots; bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts and Tots are golden brown.

title: Vegetable Marinade
instructions: Whisk all ingredients (except vegetables) in a deep bowl until well combined. Add vegetables. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator 4 hours or overnight.

title: Strawberry Sherbet Punch
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add about 1 quart of water after all is thawed. Add ginger ale and sherbet just before serving.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together by hand. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cake will crack slightly on top. Cool in pan for 1 hour before removing. Can be iced with cream cheese frosting if desired.

title: Sloppier Joes
instructions: Brown the hamburger until it is all broken apart. Add the diced onion and cook until it is glazed. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes without a cover. Stir from time to time to prevent scorching. Remove from heat and place a heaping spoonful of the meat mixture on the bottom of each hamburger bun (set aside the tops temporarily). Sprinkle with the crisp bacon then top with the grated cheese. Place under the broiler until the cheese is melted. Cover with bun tops and serve.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Place Brisket in heavy foil pan. Mix other ingredients and pour over top. Seal foil. Bake 3 hours. Enjoy!

title: Impossible Coconut Pie
instructions: Grease and flour 2 pie pans well. Mix all the ingredients well; pour into the pie pans. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 2 pies.

title: Banana Bars
instructions: Cream the oil sugar and eggs. Add buttermilk soda salt and vanilla alternately with the flour. Beat well and add mashed bananas. Blend well. Put into a greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Old Fashioned Tea Cakes(100 Years Old)
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add rest of ingredients except flour. Work in as little flour as possible approximately 3 1/2 cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Put the margarine water and cocoa in saucepan and bring to a boil. In a bowl put the sugar flour and salt. In another bowl beat the eggs sour cream soda and vanilla. Mix all 3 together. Bake on a cookie sheet for 20 minutes in a 400\u00b0 oven and ice while hot.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Cook onion and celery in 1/2 cup oleo. Mix soup Cheez Whiz and rice. Heat together on low heat so it will mix well. Add broccoli; mix altogether. Put in buttered 9 x 13-inch dish and cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hunting Style Quail
instructions: Brown birds in hot oil. Sprinkle onion garlic parsley and tomato on them. Pour over white wine; add salt pepper mustard bay leaf and rosemary. Braise until meat is tender. Meanwhile chop mushrooms coarsely and saute with bacon in a small amount of oil. When meat is nearly done add bacon and chopped mushrooms. Thicken with a paste of flour and water if desired. Serves 6.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directions state in two 9-inch cake pans. Let cool and split each layer. Mix Eagle Brand with lemonade (not diluted). Fold in Cool Whip. Spread layer of icing between each layer and then ice the sides. Pretty and good. (Tastes like lemon icebox pie.)

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Roll dough 1/4-inch thick; cut small round cookies. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 25 minutes. (Take out just as edges begin to brown.) I roll into log refrigerate cut thin and bake. Sprinkle with powdered sugar bottom and top.

title: Bland'S Vegetable Sandwiches
instructions: Room temperature for spreading. Cut off edges of bread.

title: Quick And Easy Cherry Fluff
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and chill.

title: Wanda'S Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Combine eggs cream sugar salt and vanilla in bowl and mix thoroughly with mixer. Pour into can; add condensed milk and stir well. Add dairy milk to fill line on can and stir. Makes 4 quarts. If fruit is desired add approximately 1 quart then add milk to fill line on can.

title: Moist Apple Loaf
instructions: Mix apples sugar and nuts together; let stand for 1 hour. Sift flour cinnamon nutmeg salt and soda together; add to apple mixture alternately with oil vanilla and eggs. Pour batter into tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Wrap in aluminum foil to keep moist. Very good!

title: Dumplings
instructions: Beat egg. Add milk and melted shortening and mix well. Pour into self-rising flour and mix until just dampened. Drop by spoonfuls onto meat or chicken which is barely covered with liquid. Cover tightly and boil gently 10 to 14 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Measure all ingredients into a pan and heat to boiling. Keep hot for basting. This is enough for 3 chickens.

title: Homemade Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix in order given. Spread on oiled pan that has been sprinkled with corn meal. (This makes bottom crispy.)

title: Chunky Chicken Rice Soup
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Add water and the rest of the ingredients. Cook until done.

title: Sauce Bordelaise
instructions: Peel and chop shallots and place in saucepan. Add red wine thyme bay leaf and salt. Bring to a boil and reduce by half. Meanwhile melt 1 tablespoon of butter in another saucepan. Add flour; cook stirring until roux has browned. Add stock salt and pepper to taste stirring well. Cook over a low heat for 15 minutes stirring frequently. Dice the marrow and poach for 5 minutes in boiling water then drain. Remove the thyme and bay leaf from the wine reduction. Add the marrow cubes adjust the seasoning and leave to simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Add meat juice. Remove from heat and add remainder of butter and chopped parsley stirring continuously.

title: Nutty O'S
instructions: Butter a 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Heat brown sugar corn syrup butter and salt stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in cereal and nuts; mix until well coated. Spread in pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Loosen with metal spatula. Let stand about 1 hour. Store in a covered container.

title: Pork Pies
instructions: Place all ingredients except potatoes in large pan. Cook on medium heat until meat is done. Boil potatoes in salted water then drain. When meat is cooked add potatoes and mash together.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw spinach. Squeeze out water. Combine; refrigerate at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Serve in loaf of \King Hawaiian\ bread.

title: Better Than Sex Cake
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients; press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Allow to cool. Cream together cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Blend thoroughly. Spread over crust. Chill. Combine pudding and milk. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Spread over cheese layer and top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

title: Solyanka(A Russian Fish Soup With Capers And Onions)
instructions: In a large soup pot heat the wine. Add the onion and cook until softened. Add the celery carrots and the tomatoes and continue to cook for 5 minutes. Peel seed and slice the cucumber (about 1 1/2 cups); cut the fish in large chunks. Add both to the soup and cook 3 minutes longer. Add the water; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until the fish flakes easily (about 10 minutes). Turn off the heat. Add remaining ingredients and serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Soap Balls (Not Eatable)
instructions: *Add any of these ingredients to equal 1/4 cup food coloring flavoring for scent and water. Mix this and Ivory Snow. Shape into balls. Makes 3 large balls.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin or 3 miniature muffin tins (12 each) with vegetable cooking spray or grease lightly. (Paper liners wont need oil.) Beat egg oil and milk. Stir in bananas. Mix dry ingredients together and stir into banana mixture until flour is moistened. Fill tins 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake about 23 minutes (15 to 18 minutes for small muffins). Let cool about 15 minutes before removing from pans to let texture firm up.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: In the order the ingredients are listed place them in a 9 x 9-inch dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Great Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan greased lightly at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 14.

title: Rebel'S Delight
instructions: Mix in pan. Season to taste with butter salt and pepper and heat. Field peas can be substituted but do not use black-eyed peas. They dont have much taste. If you like succotash youll love this simple but tasty dish. It gets its name from \goober peas\ which were the staple of the Confederate Army.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix the beef bread crumbs milk and onion thoroughly. Shape into bite size balls. Brown in margarine all around. Pour off the fat. Mix the wine catsup oregano and paprika. Pour over the meatballs in the skillet. Simmer 20 minutes. Keep checking so they dont burn. Serve spiked with toothpicks.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Combine pumpkin sugar cinnamon ginger nutmeg and salt together in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and with fork lightly beat eggs into pumpkin mixture. Add the milk and evaporated milk. Mix well. Place in 9-inch pie plate and bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes with edges of pie covered with foil. Remove foil and bake for 25 more minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean. Cool and chill to serve.

title: Barbecued Ribs(5 To 8 Servings)
instructions: In large pan with cover cook ribs in boiling water 45 to 60 minutes or until tender. In medium saucepan combine remaining ingredients; simmer 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove ribs to grill. Turn often and brush with sauce. Chicken may be used instead of ribs.

title: Mountain Dew Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Dissolve jello with boiling water. Add Mountain Dew and pineapple juice. Cool. Add crushed pineapple and marshmallows. When firm spread pie filling on top. Spread Cool Whip on top of pie filling.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger with 1/2 package of taco seasoning; drain. Warm refried beans and mix with remaining package of taco seasoning. In your casserole dish bottom layer of refried beans. Next layer hamburger. Then add sour cream and next salsa. Final step shredded cheese on top. Put in oven at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve warm with chips.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: In medium saucepan gradually blend milk and pudding mix. Add egg yolks and 1 teaspoon vanilla beating until smooth. Cook stirring constantly until pudding comes to a full boil. Remove from heat. Cover with plastic wrap and cool thoroughly about 30 minutes. Fold in whipped cream to which remaining vanilla had been added. Arrange 1/2 ladyfingers in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole baking dish. Spoon 1/2 pudding over cake and 1/2 bananas over pudding; repeat layers again.

title: Connie'S Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Pour 1/2 of cornbread mix in casserole. Add sausage and cheese; do not mix. Pour rest of mix over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cheese Potatoes In Foil
instructions: Slice potatoes into a large piece of foil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Crumble bacon over potatoes. Add onion and cheese. Dot with butter. Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour or until done turning occasionally. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Imperial Crab
instructions: In saucepan melt 1 tablespoon butter; mix flour. Gradually add milk until it comes to a boil and thickens. Mix onion and Worcestershire sauce and bread and cool. Fold in mayonnaise salt pepper and lemon juice. Melt 2 tablespoons butter until brown; add crabmeat and mix all together. Put in casserole. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Blackberry Cobbler
instructions: Line baking dish with pie crust. Mix 1 cup sugar and 1 cup flour together. Put 1/2 of this mixture into pan (over the crust). Mix remaining sugar and flour mixture into the blackberries. Add this onto the crust and sugar layer. Add the remaining 2 cups sugar on berries. Add enough water to cover the berries. Top with crust. Sprinkle top with a little sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is brown and berries are done.

title: Medallion Of Pork(With Mushroom Sauce)
instructions: Cut pork into 1/8 inch thick medallions. Heat 1 tsp. oil in a large skillet. Add medallions and saute over high heat until they are golden brown on both sides.

title: Block-Party Beans
instructions: In large Dutch oven brown ground beef and drain off fat. Add onion and celery. Cook until tender. Stir in soup tomato paste and catsup. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: I make my dumplings and freeze at least overnight. They do not break up as easily.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add other ingredients in order given (not nutmeg). Beat egg whites stiff and fold into the mixture. Pour into buttered casserole and sprinkle nutmeg on the top. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Boiled Cookies
instructions: Cook sugar milk butter and cocoa for 1 1/2 minutes. Start counting when mixture reaches a full rolling boil. Remove from heat. Add oats vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until blended. Spoon onto wax paper or cookie sheet.

title: Grandma Annie'S Plain Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until done. Serve with fruit and topping. A great cake for serving with strawberries. Serves 10.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Saute onions in margarine until soft. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes on low stirring occasionally. Cool and store covered in refrigerator.

title: Cornmeal Pastry
instructions: Measure flour cornmeal and and salt into bowl. Cut in shortening thoroughly. Sprinkle in water 1 tablespoon at a time mixing until all flour is moistened. Gather into a ball. Roll into a rectangle 12 x 8-inches on lightly floured cloth covered board. Fold lengthwise in half; cut slits in folded edge.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour salt and soda together. Add to sugar mixture. Add oats and nuts. Mix together. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Soup
instructions: In a Dutch oven combine lentils water pepperoni onion tomato paste salt oregano sage and cayenne. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Add tomato carrots and celery; cover and simmer 40 minutes.

title: Chicken A La Easy
instructions: Mix cheese and stuffing mix. Dip chicken in oleo and then roll in mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 in covered dish for 45 minutes. Remove top and cook an additional 15 minutes.

title: Simple Granola
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil and honey in large mixing bowl. Mix oil and honey together; pour over oat mixture. Mix well. Spread into 2 (15 x 10 x 1-inch) baking pans. Bake in a 300\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes stirring once. Remove from pan when cool. Store in tightly covered container.

title: Cake(Easy And Delicious)
instructions: Prepare gingerbread according to directions on box. Add some mincemeat. Bake. Frost with brown sugar and nut frosting.

title: Chafing Dish Mushrooms
instructions: Melt butter in electric skillet at 250\u00b0. Add mushrooms caps round side up. Sprinkle garlic salt over mushrooms until completely covered (additional garlic salt may be needed); add onions cover leaving vent open. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes depending on the size of the mushrooms. Stir once. Drain butter. Fold in sour cream and sprinkle with paprika. (The butter can be used to saute the mushroom stems.)

title: Hearty Manicotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cook sausage 5 minutes in 1/4 cup water until brown. Set aside. Brown ground beef with onion. Stir in tomato paste and puree salt basil sugar pepper and water. Simmer 45 minutes. Add sausage. Cook another 15 minutes. Boil shells according to pkg directions. Drain. Mix cheeses and parsley. Pour half of meat mixture into casserole pan. Stuff shells with cheese mixture. Place on top of meat mixture. Cover with remaining meat mixture. Bake 30 minutes or until hot.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into greased muffin tins and bake in a preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until brown. Serve warm. Yields 6 to 8 muffins.

title: Minute Steak And Gravy
instructions: Salt and pepper minute steaks.\tRoll in flour.\tPut in skillet with melted Crisco. Brown on both sides. Add 2 cups water over steaks.\tPut lid on skillet and let simmer about 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Lasagna Bake
instructions: Cook lasagna according to package directions; drain. Rinse with cold water drain again set aside. Combine soup broth stir until smooth; set soup mixture aside. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl; beat at medium speed with electric mixer 1 minute or until smooth. Stir in onion and next 3 ingredients. Set cream cheese mixture aside. Layer half each of lasagna noodles cream cheese mixture chicken and soup mixture in a lightly greased 13x9x2-inch baking dish. Repeat layers. Combine breadcrumbs and butter sprinkle over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. 12 servings.

title: Impossible Zucchini And Tomato Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 10-inch quiche dish or pie plate 10 x 1 1/2-inch. Sprinkle zucchini tomato onion and cheese in plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean about 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into greased baking dish.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add enough buttermilk to make a thick batter. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven in a small greased pan until done.

title: Hershey'S Chocolate Syrup Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs ONE-AT-A-TIME beat well after each egg. Add syrup and vanilla. Beat add stir in flour. Bake in 9 X 13 pan that has been greased and floured in a 350 degree for 45 - 50 minutes. Cool completely. Sprinkle with confectioner sugar for garnish.

title: Basic Quaker Oat Bran Muffins
instructions: This is a low fat low cholesterol recipe adapted from Quaker Oat Bran recipe on its box by a heart patient. Ive tried them and I think they are great. There are other brands of oat bran on the market but I prefer the Quaker brand texture. I dont like bran muffins too sweet so 2 tablespoons of sweetener is enough for me.

title: Beef Burgundy
instructions: Tumble the beef pieces in a Dutch oven with the soup mix. Add 1 cup of wine and place in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add soup after 1 hour; stir well. It may be necessary to add water if in a \holding pattern.\ Serve over hot pasta.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat with seasonings and drain. Stir in soup and sour cream. Season again with soy sauce and Worcestershire. Add color with Kitchen Bouquet. Serve over macaroni or rice.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan the pretzels butter and sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Slim Dip
instructions: Place milk and cottage cheese in blender container. Process on high speed until smooth and creamy. Stir in soup mix. Refrigerate covered for 1 hour. Serve with fresh vegetables.

title: Creamy Basil Fettucini
instructions: Cook fettucini according to package directions. Drain and immediately toss with oil garlic and yogurt. Add Parmesan cheese basil salt and pepper. Serve immediately. Makes 1 serving.

title: Lemon Pudding Pound Cake
instructions: Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored. Add cake mix pudding (dry) water and oil; beat at medium speed 10 minutes. Pour into ungreased 10-inch tube pan with removable bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes. Remove hot cake on bottom pan from pan. Using a 2-tined fork prick holes in top of cake. Drizzle glaze over top and spread on sides of cake.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar until creamy. Add eggs and beat well. Mix dry ingredients. Add dry mix.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake according to directions. Cool and split layers. Combine sugar sour cream and coconut. Reserve 1 cup of sour cream mixture for frosting. Spread remainder between layers of cake split side up.

title: Sausage, Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Saute onions and mushrooms in 2 tablespoon of butter or oleo. Cook rice according to package directions.

title: Soda Cracker Torte
instructions: Beat eggs until stiff. Add remaining ingredients. Fill buttered 9-inch pie tin. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Cover top with apricot jam and whipped cream or soft ice cream.

title: Quick Cookies
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add dry cake mix and eggs; mix. Fold in chocolate chips. Mixture will be stiff. Press into bars. Makes 48 bars.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pudding as directed. Stir in Eagle Brand milk. Place in the refrigerator. Line pan with vanilla wafers and bananas. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture. Pour half of the mixture over bananas and wafers. Repeat. May top with vanilla wafers. Refrigerate 4 to 8 hours.

title: Cinnamon 'N Sugar Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups. Beat eggs in a large bowl until frothy. Stir in milk applesauce and 1/4 cup butter. Stir in raisins 1/4 cups sugar baking powder salt and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon all at once just until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy). Divide batter evenly among muffin cups (about 1/3 full). Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Mix in 1/4 cup sugar and 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Immediately dip tops of warm muffins into 1/4 cup melted butter then into cinnamon mixture.

title: Hi-Protein Honey Wheat Bread
instructions: Heat water honey margarine and cottage cheese until 120\u00b0. Add 2 cups flour eggs salt oats nuts and yeast. Beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour to form a soft dough. Knead dough on floured surface for 10 minutes. Place in greased bowl and cover. Let rise until double about 1 hour. Punch dough down. Form 2 balls and let rest for 15 minutes. Shape into 2 loaves. Place in pans and cover; let rise until double. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Rocky Road
instructions: Melt chocolate butterscotch and butter in double boiler. Fold in marshmallows and nuts. Spread on buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate until set 2 hours. Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and celery together add chicken. Mix chow mein noodles milk and soups together. Add to chicken mixture pour all in large casserole dish. Melt one stick butter and toss with stuffing mix or croutons. Use this mixture as topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until brown.

title: Three-Cheese Macaroni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish (lightly greased) combine hot macaroni soup milk seasonings 1/4 cup each of the cheeses and 1/2 can French fried onions. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until heated through. Top with remaining Parmesan cheese French fried onions Cheddar and Swiss cheeses. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Use 9 x 13-inch pan. Put coconut and nuts in bottom. Mix chocolate cake mix as directed on box. Pour over coconut and nuts. Mix margarine sugar and cream cheese. Drop by spoonfuls over cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 1 hour.

title: Evalene'S Christmas Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water in saucepan to boiling point; stir constantly. Reduce heat and continue cooking until a few drops tested in cold water forms a hard ball at 250\u00b0 on candy thermometer.

title: Cherry Crunch
instructions: Combine flour margarine sugar and pecans. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool 1 hour.

title: Chinese Macaroni Salad
instructions: Simmer onion green pepper and celery in oil until cooked. Add drained mushrooms. Mix onion mixture and mushrooms to macaroni. Add cooked chicken and soy sauce. Serve.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Blend corn and beans; spread in bottom of rectangular Pyrex dish. Mix next 4 ingredients together and spread over vegetables. Stir crackers into melted butter. Sprinkle topping on top of other ingredients. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Hearty Beef Enchiladas
instructions: In a Dutch oven cook beef and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Stir in beans 2 cans enchilada sauce and 1 cup salsa; set this aside. In a skillet heat 1/4-inch of oil. Dip each tortilla in hot oil for 3 seconds on each side or just until limp. Drain on paper towels. Top each tortilla with 2/3 cup beef mixture; roll up and place seam side down in 4 (13 x 9 x 2) baking dishes. Drizzle with remaining enchilada sauce and salsa. Sprinkle with cheese and olives. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 28.

title: Almond Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together margarine and almond paste; beat in sugar and eggs. Add flour and salt; pour in pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 40 minutes. Cool and then cut.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Oven 425\u00b0. Add sugar and warm water to yeast. Set in warm place. Cut butter into flour. Add yeast and enough milk to make soft dough. Pat out on floured surface. Melt butter in oven in 9-inch round pan. Remove when melted dip biscuits and turn over. Bake until golden brown 12 to 15 minutes. Double for larger recipe.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar salt and cornstarch. Add vinegar and water; stir until smooth. Cook for 5 minutes. Add beets to the hot sauce and let stand for 30 minutes. Just before serving bring to a boil and add butter. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pizza Appetizers
instructions: Fry and crumble meat. Drain and set aside. Melt cheese. Add seasonings and meat. Spread generously on slices of party rye. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until hot and bubbly (about 10 minutes). Can be made ahead and frozen unbaked.

title: Cream Cheese Streusel Brownies
instructions: Grease bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Cut margarine into 1/2 cup dry brownie mix until crumbly; stir in nuts and reserve. Mix remaining dry brownie mix 1 egg oil and water. Spread in pan. Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla mixing on medium speed until well blended. Add 1 egg and spread over brownie mixture in pan. Sprinkle with reserved brownie mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Rice Krispies Candy
instructions: Bring first 2 ingredients to a boil. Remove from heat and add last 3 ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Kisses
instructions: Knead all together and roll into balls. Roll into mixture of ground nuts and sugar. Press in with thumb and fill with lekvar or jelly. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Peel and slice carrots. Boil 5 minutes in salted water until tender but not mushy. Mix other ingredients and pour over warm carrots (after draining). Stir well then refrigerate. Last up to one week in refrigerator. Yields 8 servings.

title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into small pieces. Add green onions (tops too). Add bacon crumbles and raisins. Make dressing with remaining ingredients and blend into salad.

title: Low-Fat Double Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray an 8 x 8-inch cake pan with nonstick spray. In medium bowl using electric mixer on high speed beat eggs until doubled in volume. Slowly add sugar one tablespoon at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in liqueur. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients except chocolate chips. Add to egg mixture stirring and folding just until combined. Pour into cake pan and bake for 20 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove to wire rack and cool.

title: Miami Beach Birthday Cake
instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter; cool. Stir in nuts and 2/3 cup chocolate chips; set aside.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin and water together. Add strawberries with juice pineapple chopped pecans and sliced banana. Pour half of mixture into 9 x 9-inch dish. Refrigerate 15 to 30 minutes until set. Pour sour cream over chilled mixture. Pour remaining strawberry mixture over sour cream. Chill until firm. Ready to serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Persian Chicken
instructions: Remove skin from chicken if desired. Mix all ingredients and add chicken. Cover and marinate 24 to 48 hours. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours additional 1/2 hour uncovered. Makes wonderful gravy. Serve over rice.

title: Thin 'N Crispie Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and butter. Add eggs and flavorings; mix thoroughly. Stir dry ingredients together and blend in. Refrigerate dough 2 to 3 hours. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Divide dough and roll 3/16-inch thick on lightly floured pastry cloth. Cut with cookie cutter; sprinkle with sugar. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 7 to 8 minutes or until golden.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Put together flour soda cream or tartar and salt and stir into shortening sugar and eggs. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll each in mixture of 2 teaspoons sugar and cinnamon. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned but still soft (cookies puff up at first then flatten down) in 400\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Sauteed Squash And Tomatoes
instructions: Wash squash well scrubbing with a brush. Slice into 1/2-inch thick diagonal slices. In butter in medium skillet with tight fitting cover saute onion stirring until golden about 3 minutes. Add squash and remaining ingredients; toss lightly to combine. Cook covered over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until squash is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Oven Baked Fudge Pies
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar salt and vanilla with a spoon. In a separate bowl melt oleo or butter and pour over the mixed dry ingredients. Add eggs one at a time mixing well in between. Add the can of Pet milk very slowly mixing well. Pour into pie shells and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce oven to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Sour Cream Pancakes
instructions: First beat egg add sour cream and buttermilk. Mix the rest of ingredients together. Let stand 10 minutes before baking batter swells. Makes 10 4 inch pancakes. Yum! Yum!

title: Easy Dill Pickles
instructions: Drain juice from pickles. Cut into quarters or rounds and put back into jar. Mix sugar vinegar and spices and pour over pickles. Shake occasionally to get sugar to dissolve.

title: Bean And Beef Burito
instructions: Drain salsa and reserve liquid. Brown ground beef. Drain. Add seasoning mix beans chilies and liquid from salsa and simmer uncovered 5 minutes. Spoon 1/3 cup mixture on a tortilla and top with 1 tablespoon each of salsa lettuce and cheese. Fold nearest edge of tortilla over to cover filling and fold in both sides envelope fashion and roll.

title: Cranberry Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large mixing bowl combine flour oats 3/4 cup brown sugar and margarine. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture. Press the rest into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Sausage And Beans
instructions: Fry sausage onion and celery; drain. Mix remaining ingredients all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Break taco shells in medium size pieces. Cook beef and onion; drain. Combine chilies soup and tomatoes. Add to meat with chili powder salt and pepper. Arrange 1/2 of taco shells on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spoon 1/2 of meat on top. Sprinkle 1/2 of cheese over meat. Repeat layers ending with cheese. Cover loosely with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Strawberry Sparkle Punch
instructions: Puree strawberries in blender; dissolve gelatin in hot water. Stir in lemonade concentrate until melted; add cocktail and cold water and puree. Pour over ice in punch bowl; slowly pour in ginger ale. Makes about 30 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Chicken Dish
instructions: Saute the onion pepper and celery in 1 stick butter. Mix cubed bread mayonnaise eggs chicken and milk then add the sauteed mixture. Put in bowl and refrigerate overnight.

title: Pizza Burgers
instructions: Mix well. Put on buns under broiler until hot.

title: Applesauce Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Put sweet potatoes in a baking pan; sprinkle with salt. Put applesauce on sweet potatoes. Mix brown sugar rolled oats and cinnamon. Stir in margarine or butter. Sprinkle over sweet potatoes. Bake at 375\u00b0 (moderate oven) about 45 minutes until lightly brown. Makes six servings about 1/2 cup each.

title: Brownie Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt margarine and chocolate in saucepan over low heat. When margarine and chocolate are melted remove from heat. Add in vanilla and eggs; mix in well. Add flour and sugar; stir well. Pour mixture into pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes. Let cool thoroughly.

title: Potato Slices
instructions: Scrub potatoes and slice 1/4-inch thick. Put in cold water for 30 minutes.

title: Lime Pickles
instructions: Combine first three ingredients and let stand for 24 hours. Rinse and pour off. Rinse once each hour for four hours.

title: Fried Plantains(Tostones De Platanos - Spanish Recipe)
instructions: Peel plantains and cut into diagonal slices 1-inch thick. Add salt to water. Soak plantain slices for 15 minutes. Drain well and deep fry in oil heated to 350\u00b0 for about 7 minutes. Remove from pan and place on absorbent paper. Fold the paper over the slices and pound flat with the palm of the hand. Deep fry in fat heated to 375\u00b0 until crisp and golden. Remove and drain on absorbent paper. Sprinkle lightly with salt. Makes 12 to 18.

title: Heavenly Caramel Apple Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar sour cream eggs and vanilla on medium speed for 3 minutes. Mix dry ingredients then add to sour cream mixture. Stir in apples and 1/3 cup pecans. Pour into greased loaf pan. Top with remaining pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool and remove from pan. Melt butter with brown sugar in saucepan and boil 1 minute. Drizzle on bread and serve with butter or cream cheese.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Pour fresh boiling water over tea; steep for 5 minutes. Strain. Add orange and lemon juices. Chill thoroughly. Add ginger ale and pour over ice in punch bowl. Float orange slices and halved strawberries.

title: Spinach Dip I
instructions: Mix well. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Verona
instructions: Mix bread crumbs with Parmesan cheese parsley salt pepper and mustard. Mix melted butter with garlic. Dip chicken pieces in melted butter mixture dredge in the crumb mixture and arrange in layers in pans. Sprinkle remaining butter over chicken and bake 350 degrees for about 45 minutes to one hour.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0. Melt butter then blend sugar eggs and vanilla. Gradually add flour. Mix by hand. If batter is too thick add 2 tablespoons of milk. Mix well and drop cookie mixture with a teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes or until done.

title: Claudia'S Fantastic Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease loaf pan. Sift flour and measure; resift flour with powder soda and salt.\tSet aside. Cream shortening and sugar in 3 quart mixing bowl until smooth and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Stir in freshly mashed bananas. Add flour a little at a time and mix. Turn into prepared pan and bake for 50 minutes or until a cake tester inserted into bread comes out clean. Remove cake to rack to cool before slicing.

title: Homestyle Bean Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours). Remove bones bay leaf peppercorns and celery sprigs before serving. Taste for salt adjustment. Trim meat from ham bone and return cut-up pieces to soup. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine the ingredients in the order listed and pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes; then reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 45 minutes longer or until filling is firm.

title: Chile Con Queso Dip
instructions: Heat margarine or oil until hot. Stir in flour. Add vegetables and approximately 1 1/2 cups water stirring until mixture is thick and bubbly. Add cheese cubed and picante sauce. Stir constantly until mixture returns to a simmer. Turn heat down very low and simmer about 30 minutes stirring often.

title: Microwave Chili Cheese Dogs
instructions: Split buns partway through. Spoon 1 tablespoon chili on each. Place frankfurters in buns. Top each frankfurter with another tablespoon of chili and add 2 strips of cheese. Arrange 4 paper napkins or paper towels on carousel. Place filled buns on napkins leaving an open center. Microwave on Medium-high until filling is heated and cheese starts to melt (2 to 5 minutes). If you do not have a carousel in your microwave rearrange once or twice.

title: Ground Beef Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion over medium heat. Spoon off excess fat. Add chili powder garlic salt and salt; mix well. Add tomato sauce and 1/2 can water and beans. Spread over meat mixture.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Remove any cartilage from the crab meat and set the crab aside. In a thick pot warm cream sherry chicken base and seasoning to slow simmer. In a separate pan toast the roux (flour and butter) for a few minutes until it smells of toasted nuts (do not burn). Add roux to cream; bring back to a simmer and whisk until smooth. Serve garnished with the chopped parsley and pass a cruet of sherry. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Bobby Burger
instructions: In large pot cook onion slightly in butter. Add meat and cook. Do not brown! Mix chili sauce mustard onion hot sauce and chili powder. Add mixture to meat and simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Serve on hamburger buns or hot dog buns.

title: Sugarless Banana Muffins(Low Calorie)
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine vegetable oil brown sugar flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add buttermilk Egg Beaters oat bran oatmeal and wheat germ. Stir lightly with spoon to moisten. Stir in banana. Fill paper lined muffin tins or spray tins with nonstick vegetable spray. Fill 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out dry. Remove muffins from tins and cool on wire rack. These muffins freeze well. Yields 18 muffins.

title: Linguine With White Clam Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan combine olive oil butter and garlic. Heat for 3 minutes. Add clams. In separate pot cook linguine to preferred doneness. Drain. Place linguine in large bowl and pour clam sauce over it. Add parsley to taste.

title: Noodle Pudding
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Remove from stove. Mix eggs sugar milk cottage cheese pineapple and vanilla together. Pour melted butter over mixture. Place noodles in casserole. Pour pudding mixture over noodles. Press noodles into casserole bottom to cover with liquid. Sprinkle crushed cornflakes on top (with a pinch of nutmeg and cinnamon). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Quick Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook beef until brown stirring to crumble; drain off excess grease. Spoon beef into 8-inch square baking dish. Top with pizza sauce and cheese. Combine Bisquick milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Pour mix over casserole covering evenly. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand for a few minutes before cutting into squares for serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Dip For Fruit
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Good for all types of fruit.

title: Stuffed Pepper Cups
instructions: Cut off tops of green peppers. Remove seeds and membranes. Precook pepper cups in boiling salted water about 5 minutes then drain. Cook ground beef and onion until meat is lightly browned. Season with salt and pepper. Add tomatoes water rice and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer until rice is tender about 15 minutes. Stir in American cheese. Stuff peppers. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Dredge fruit in flour. Add salt coconut and nuts. Add milk and mix thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 275\u00b0 oven.

title: Reuben Sandwich
instructions: Spread Russian dressing on six slices of rye bread. Divide corned beef evenly among slices then the Swiss cheese. Top each with about 2 tablespoons of sauerkraut. Spread remaining bread slices with mustard if desired and put this slice mustard side down on sandwiches. Lightly butter both sides of sandwiches and grill slowly on each side until browned and cheese is melted. Serve with dill pickles.

title: No Milk Rolls
instructions: Cream the first 2 ingredients together. Add as listed using yeast water last; beat well. Let stand for 2 hours. Beat dough down. Put into covered container. Rolls will keep up to 2 weeks. Take dough out knead and roll out rolls as you need them. Let stand 1 hour then bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Toffee Coffee Mix
instructions: You will need a 1-quart wide-mouth jar.

title: Honey Banana Muffins
instructions: Combine flour baking powder salt sugar and 2/3 cup almonds in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine egg banana milk and oil. Add to dry mixture stirring just until moistened. Spoon batter into greased and floured muffin pans filling 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from pans immediately. Combine honey and butter mixing well. Dip top of muffin in honey mixture and sprinkle with almonds. Yields 14 muffins.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef onions and green pepper. Add V-8 juice tomatoes and water. Simmer for 45 minutes. Add cabbage and continue cooking 1/2 hour. Serve with crusted bread.

title: Individual American Pizzas
instructions: Brown meat with seasonings. Drain well. When ready to serve open 1 can biscuits flatten out and place on greased baking sheet with 2 spoonfuls of meat on each one. Top with cheese. Place in 350\u00b0 oven and bake until biscuits are done. Serve while hot. Very good with a tossed salad.

title: Strawberry Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O sugar and salt in 1 1/4 cups boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. When mixture starts to jell fold in Cool Whip. Crumble angel food cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour strawberry mixture over cake. When set cut into squares.

title: Buttermilk Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in pan. Combine flour salt and pepper. Dip chicken in 1/2 cup buttermilk. Roll chicken in flour mix. Place in pan. Bake uncovered at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn. Bake for 10 more minutes. Mix soup and 1 cup buttermilk. Pour mix over chicken. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Continue to bake until chicken is tender.

title: Steak Bake
instructions: Place meat in a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with flour salt and pepper. Toss to coat meat. Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add onion green pepper tomatoes mushrooms molasses and soy sauce. Mix well. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir in beans.

title: Baked Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown onion green pepper celery and ground beef. Put Ragu sauce catsup salt pepper garlic powder and oregano into the beef mixture. Simmer for 20 minutes. Cook spaghetti. Grease baking dish. Put a layer of cooked spaghetti in dish; add 1/2 of spaghetti sauce on spaghetti then repeat layers until all is used. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple; add water to make at least 2 cups. Heat to boiling; add eggs sugar cornstarch and salt which have been beaten together. Cook until thick; remove from heat and add marshmallows. When dissolved add pineapple and vanilla; cool then add Cool Whip and nuts.

title: Blueberry Oat Muffins
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add milk egg and oil. Stir until moist. Fold in blueberries. Fill muffin pans sprayed with Pam. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Sift flour then measure. In mixer cream the sugar butter and cream cheese; mix well. Add eggs one at a time; beat after each egg at low speed. Add vanilla. Add flour a little at a time. Grease and flour a Bundt pan or an iron skillet. Place in a cold oven; bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Sprinkle nuts in bottom of well-greased 10-inch round Bundt pan. Set aside.

title: Pecan Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup; boil 5 minutes. Add nuts and boil 5 minutes. Add soda and stir well. Pour in buttered pan. Cut in squares.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and flavoring. Add flour. Beat until smooth. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Oriental Rice
instructions: Cut up green onions. Fry in oil stirring constantly approximately 10 minutes. Then stir in eggs until done. Add mushrooms and soy sauce; cook 4 minutes. Add rice and mix.

title: Rice Krispies Treats
instructions: Melt 1/4 cup margarine. Add in marshmallows (melt) stir until creamed. Add in Rice Krispies and stir. Pour into dish and let set and cool. When completely cool cut into squares for serving.

title: Patable Pie Crust
instructions: Spray a 9-inch glass pie plate with nonstick coating; set aside. Combine flour oil and salt in mixing bowl. Add water and stir to form ball. Place dough in prepared pan and use fingers to pat onto bottom and sides. Flute edges. Prick bottom and sides with fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pink Lemonade Pie
instructions: Whip Eagle Brand milk. Stir in lemonade Cool Whip and lemon juice. Fold all ingredients together. Spoon into pie crust. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Chicken 'N Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Place broccoli in bottom of flat bakeware. Add cooked and boned chicken. Mix soup broth and mayonnaise. Heat and pour over chicken. Cover with generous amount of Cheddar cheese. Top with cracker crumbs which have been tossed in melted oleo. Bake at 375\u00b0 until crackers are browned.

title: Vegetable Dip (Amish)
instructions: Mix until smooth and creamy. Serve with crackers cauliflower celery chips whatever.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place frozen broccoli in microwave-safe casserole dish. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover; microwave on High for 10 minutes. Stir after 5 minutes. Stir in soup then sprinkle cheese over broccoli. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Place in layers on bread cheese kraut and beef. Toast.

title: World'S Greatest Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and peanut butter together. Gradually add the white and brown sugars. Cream until blended. Add eggs one at a time and beat until smooth. Sift flour measure and then sift again with soda into the mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop from a teaspoon onto a greased baking sheet. Then slightly flatten cookie dough with the back of spoon. Bake in moderately slow oven at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Pour into casserole. Top with crumbled Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until set.

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Measure 2/3 cup of cake mix. Cut butter until crumbly. Mix sugar and nuts. Set aside. Beat eggs lightly with fork. Add sour cream to eggs and rest of cake mix and beat. Batter will be thick and slightly lumpy. Pour 1/2 the batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of topping with nuts. Repeat in 2 layers. Top with rest of topping. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Check after 30 minutes. Cake will pull away from sides when done.

title: Tennessee Hoe Cakes
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Shape with hands into oblong cakes. Bake on a well-greased griddle turning when partly done so both sides will brown.

title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Bring sugar cocoa milk and oleo to a boil for 1 minute. Add oats vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper.

title: Fruit Punch
instructions: Make syrup by combining sugar and water. Heat to boiling. Cool. Combine fruit juices. Add cooled sugar syrup. Chill. Just before serving add ginger ale. If desired add food coloring of your choice.

title: Shrimp Appetizer
instructions: Mix together in a double boiler and cool. Serve with crackers.

title: Instant Hot Chocolate
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Add 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup hot water. Makes about 48 cups hot chocolate.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and salt together. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Add drained cucumbers and onions. Boil for 15 minutes. Jar and seal.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: Combine margarine buttermilk and cocoa in saucepan. Stir until it begins to boil and thicken. Add vanilla nuts and sugar. Beat until thick.

title: Angel Food Cake
instructions: Sift flour and 1/2 cup sugar together 4 times. Mix egg whites cream of tartar salt and flavorings with beater until soft peaks form. Add the remaining sugar in 4 additions; fold the flour mixture into the egg whites. Turn into an angel food cake pan and bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Cheeseburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain; add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce. Heat thoroughly. Put in 8-inch dish. Put cheese into strips and place on top of meat. Top with biscuits. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or an 8-inch square baking pan. In a large bowl mix together cornmeal flour sugar baking powder and salt.

title: Hawaiian Style Barbecued Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight in all of the ingredients up to pineapple chunks. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 for an hour until done. During the last 15 minutes add the pineapple chunks oranges and almonds and continue to bake. Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Walnuts
instructions: Heat walnuts halves in moderate oven (375\u00b0) 5 minutes stirring once. Butter sides of heavy 2-quart saucepan. In saucepan combine sugar water cinnamon and salt. Heat and stir until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil. Cook without stirring to soft ball stage (236\u00b0). Remove from heat. Beat by hand one minute or until the mixture begins to get creamy. Add vanilla and warm walnuts. Stir until coated. Turn mixture out onto buttered platter. Separate at once using two forks. Yields 1 pound.

title: Special Cake
instructions: Bake the cake mix in sheet cake pan as directed on box. Mix the pineapple with the sugar; bring to a boil (5 minutes); pour over cake while still hot. Let cool. Mix the pudding as directed on box. Add sour cream. Spread on cool cake. Top with Cool Whip after entire cake has cooled. Keep in cool place.

title: Overnight Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Mix and let stand while preparing vegetables.

title: Pink Stuff
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except Cool Whip. Fold in the Cool Whip and chill. Serves 8 to 10 or more.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Place chicken wings in a single layer in a large baking dish. Combine all other ingredients excluding the sesame seed in a bowl and stir until sugar dissolves.

title: Jalapeno Pie
instructions: Lightly grease Pyrex pie dish. Slice jalapenos into bottom of dish; add onion. Spread cheese over peppers and onions. Salt eggs; beat well and pour over other ingredients. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Meat Loaf Pizza
instructions: In skillet brown onions and pepper. In bowl season meat with Season-all pepper and garlic powder. Mix together onion and pepper with meat mixture. Pat meat mixture gently into 10-inch pie plate. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes drain off excess fat with spoon. Spread on sauce cheese and oregano. Bake for 10 minutes. You may add the chopped onions and green peppers with the cheese mixture instead of the meat mixture. Serves 4.

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Bring to boil vinegar water sugar and pickling spice. Add other ingredients and heat until cucumbers change color.

title: Turkey Fruit Salad
instructions: Toss all ingredients together lightly. Chill and serve.

title: Banana Cake Supreme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put all ingredients in bowl. Mix until smooth. Bake for 1 hour in an angel food pan or Bundt. A large tube pan is best. Let cool 5 minutes before turning onto wire rack.

title: Everyday Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening sugars and oil. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well so oil doesnt separate. Add flour mixed with cream of tartar soda and salt. Stir in cereals oatmeal coconut and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten slightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cookies are slightly browned.

title: Never Fail Corn Pudding
instructions: Combine butter eggs milk flour sugar and salt. Beat with wire whisk. Add corn and whisk again. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 70 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix eggs oil and sour cream together and pour half the batter in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon together. Sprinkle over batter. Pour remaining cake batter over the sugar and cinnamon. With knife cut through cake in a swirling motion. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients together. Poke holes in cake while hot and pour topping over cake.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Beat butter until creamy. Add shredded cheese and blend with butter. Sift flour and add salt and paprika. Add dry ingredients into cheese mixture. Shape into 1 inch balls. (These can be frozen until ready to bake.) Place on cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Balls will be puffed and brown.

title: Good & Spicy Meatballs & Sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Crush cornflakes add remaining ingredients and shape into little balls. Bake on cookie sheet 12 minutes or until brown. Place on paper towels while making sauce.

title: Fiesta Cornbread Salad
instructions: Combine sour cream mayonnaise and salad dressing mix and set aside.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and add little juice from pineapple if needed. (Do not add milk to pudding.)

title: Snowy Coconut Cottage Ring
instructions: In a small pan sprinkle gelatin over water to soften. Stir over low heat until gelatin dissolves. Cool. In a large bowl combine cottage cheese sweetened condensed milk and coconut. Stir in cooled gelatin and mix well. Turn into lightly oiled 1 1/2 quart ring mold. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves and fill center with fruit or melon.

title: Lemon-Dill Steamed Carrots
instructions: Arrange carrots in a steamer basket; place over boiling water. Cover and steam 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Transfer carrots to a serving dish; keep warm. Combine cornstarch water and lemon juice in a small saucepan stirring until smooth. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add dill and remaining ingredients stirring until margarine melts. Toss with carrots.

title: Wedding Cake Frosting
instructions: Cook milk and flour until it thickens stirring constantly. Use egg beater if it lumps. Cool. Gradually beat in remaining ingredients into cooled flour sauce. Frosts 3 layers.

title: Pam'S Garden Special
instructions: Cook for 20 minutes; freeze or can.

title: Pineapple Crumb Pudding
instructions: Use 2/3 crumbs in bottom of pan. Mix margarine sugar eggs and pineapple. Fold in whipped cream. Put over crumb layer. Refrigerate for 12 hours then sprinkle with rest of crumbs.

title: Brandy Apple Crisp(Special Diet)
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in an 8-inch square baking pan. Toss well; set aside. Combine oats and brown sugar and flour in a small bowl. Cut in margarine until well blended. Sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings; 1/2 cup per serving.

title: Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain grease; mix meat Ragu mushrooms and cheese (grated or cubed). Place in a rectangular baking dish. Pour cornbread batter over hamburger mixture.

title: Chocolate-Caramel-Nut Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Spoon half of batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. (Cake will not test done.) Cool cake for 10 minutes.

title: Chipa Guazu
instructions: Grind corn onion and cheese together in meat grinder. In a large bowl cream shortening. Add eggs and salt then corn mixture and milk. Bake in greased square baking dish at 400\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Cook chicken in salted water for 45 minutes then tear in pieces. Mix soup sour cream chicken and mushrooms in casserole dish. In separate bowl add butter and water to moisten the dressing. Sprinkle dressing over casserole ingredients. Bake one hour at 350\u00b0 (20 minutes in microwave).

title: Gramma'S Cranberry Cake
instructions: Place cranberries walnuts and sugar in greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix and pour the remaining ingredients over cranberry mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Corn Scallop
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Bake in a greased dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Add cheese on top; melt. Serve.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Cook chicken with salt in 3 or 4 quarts water until done (about 1 hour). Bone chicken and let broth cool enough until fat comes to top then skim off. Add boned chicken broth carrots onion and celery. Cook until tender then add egg noodles and let simmer for few minutes. Do not overcook noodles.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Dip tomatoes in flour and fry or dip in Shake n Bake and put in oven until done.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: In large skillet melt margarine. Coat chicken with flour and cook chicken in skillet over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Set chicken aside.

title: Peanut And Chocolate Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease baking pan or cookie sheet. Place pizza crust on pan. Brush dough with vegetable oil. Bake 5 to 6 minutes until puffed and lightly browned. Place on wire racks.

title: Foil Cooked Onion Rings
instructions: Mix all together wrap in foil grill for 30 minutes on grill or bake in oven for 30 minutes at 375.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients. After loaf is formed place strips of bacon on top of loaf.

title: Icebox Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg pineapple and pecans; mix well. Layer vanilla wafers; spread 1/2 of mix over vanilla wafers. Add rest of mix. Top with vanilla wafers. Fix the day before serving. Top with whipped cream or topping.

title: Sausage Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cook drain and crumble sausage. Cool completely and mix with other ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until puffed and golden. Can be frozen and reheated at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Pancake Appetizers
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Wrap potatoes in several layers of paper towels; squeeze to remove excess moisture. Beat egg flour salt and pepper in large bowl. Add potatoes carrot and zucchini; mix well. Oil 2 nonstick baking sheets. Place vegetable mixture by heaping spoonfuls onto baking sheets; flatten slightly. Bake 8 to 15 minutes until bottoms are browned. Turn; bake 5 to 10 minutes more. Stir together sour cream and herbs; serve with warm potatoes.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberry orange and sugar together. Let stand for 1 hour. Mix plain gelatin with cold water. Dissolve this with lemon Jell-O and hot water. Let it cool a little then add juice. When Jell-O mix begins to congeal add celery pecans and the cranberry mix. Let salad finish congealing.

title: Hot Jezebel
instructions: Mix preserves and seasonings together. Can store for months in a tightly covered jar in the refrigerator. To serve slice cream cheese into thick slices and place in attractive bowl (slightly separated or fanned). Pour over the cheese about 1/2 cup of the mix. Serve with crackers and a \spreader\ knife. (Cream cheese is too thick to use crackers as a scoop.)

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Mix cocoa sugar salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Cream in butter; add beaten egg yolks milk flour and soda. Add nuts jam and raisins that have been soaked in hot water and finally fold in beaten egg whites.\tPour in a greased and floured tube pan and bake for 1 hour or until tester comes out clean when inserted. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Hazel Walker'S Cranberry Tea
instructions: Cook cranberries and 1 quart water until they pop and are soft. Strain (not push) and set aside. In pan put 2 cups water red hots and cloves in bag. Cook until red hots dissolve. Add sugar and heat until dissolved. Pour in cranberry orange and lemon juice strain if you would like. Add 2 quarts of water. Heat and serve.

title: Tasty Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix the cream cheese Cheddar cold pack and butter together until blended. Add the chopped onion green pepper (if desired) Worcestershire sauce and chopped dried beef. Mix well; refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour. Shape into one ball or two and roll in chopped pecans. Wrap in Handi-Wrap then foil. Chill. May be made several days ahead of serving. Good with crackers.

title: Chicken Dijon
instructions: Wash and pat chicken dry. Sprinkle with salt. Combine sour cream and mustard. Dip chicken breasts in mixture to coat both sides then dredge in seasoned bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese and garlic salt. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 15 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Casserole
