instructions: Put rice in bottom of large baking dish. Roll chicken in melted butter; place on rice. Mix chicken soup water salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Chili Cheese Quiche
instructions: Melt butter in 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish in microwave or oven.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and beat well. Add nuts. Sift dry ingredients and add to the first. Shape into roll. Wrap in waxed paper and let stand overnight. Cut into slices and bake in moderate oven.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: In large 10 x 13-inch or 9 x 12-inch pan spread 1/2 crushed cookies in bottom. Beat softened ice cream. Fold in Cool Whip and rest of cookies. Freeze; thaw 5 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken With Rice
instructions: Place chicken on uncooked rice. Use one cup in bottom of casserole. Sprinkle onion soup mix on chicken. Mix together the soups with 1 cup of water or a little more. Pour over chicken in pan. Cook covered for 1 1/2 hours at around 375\u00b0. I place foil over it and the last 15 minutes of baking uncover.

title: Old Fashioned Corn Meal Pancakes
instructions: Mix well but allow bubbles to remain in batter. Grease griddle and make pancakes as large as you desire. Dont try to fry pancakes too fast. If batter is too heavy add a little more buttermilk.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onions and garlic; drain. Mix soup sauce milk and meat; stir well. Line bottom of casserole dish with tortillas and place around side of dish. Pour half of mixture on tortillas and sprinkle with half of cheese. Pour rest of meat mixture and top with remainder of cheese. Bake until hot and bubbly at 350\u00b0.

title: Bill'S Quick-Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Microwave potatoes on High power for 4 to 6 minutes or until nearly done. If you wish paint potatoes with oil and sprinkle with coarse salt. Place on middle oven rack with foil or baking sheet on lower. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes depending on size of potatoes. Yield 4 servings.

title: Cavatina
instructions: Brown hamburger. Saute onions and peppers. Cook pasta. Mix hamburger onions peppers and pasta together. Add spaghetti sauce. Add pepperoni and cheese. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Coconut Cream Pie(Makes 1 Pie)
instructions: I usually dont measure my milk. If you think it needs a little more add some. I usually double this when I make it.

title: Italian Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend Ricotta and cream cheese. Blend in sugar. Beat in eggs 1 at a time. Add vanilla lemon juice cornstarch flour and butter. Fold in sour cream and blend well.

title: Creole Grillades With Gravy (New Orleans)
instructions: Cut beef in 3-4 inch squares. Season with salt pepper cayenne. Heat lard in skillet. Add onion and garlic saute. Stir in flour and brown. Add tomatoes; cook two minutes. Add meat brown on both sides. Combine vinegar and water and pour over meat. Simmer over low heat until done.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all together well bake till done at 350.

title: Sausage And Asparagus Dinner
instructions: Remove casings from sausage. Cut into bite size pieces. Saute until browned. Drain fat. Clean and cut asparagus into pieces. Pare and slice potatoes 1/4-inch. Add asparagus potatoes onion and tomatoes to sausage. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender about 20 to 30 minutes. Do not stir during cooking time. Sprinkle croutons over vegetables; cover and heat 5 minutes more.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cut flowerets from broccoli; peel the stems and dice. Combine broccoli flowerets stems onion water bouillon and garlic. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until broccoli is tender. Cool slightly.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix well and baste last 1/2 hour.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef tomatoes tomato sauce sugar and salt. Cook until meat is done and most liquid has cooked out. Cook egg noodles until tender. Cream sour cream and cream cheese. Add onions and fold into the drained egg noodles. Layer meat noodles and cheese in a large casserole dish. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven until cheese melts.

title: Wet Burritos
instructions: Brown ground beef. Drain. Prepare taco seasoning mix as to package directions. Add to ground beef. Add refried beans to meat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes on medium to low heat. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray. Put ground beef mixture on tortilla. Add olives and onions. Roll up and place in baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce over burritos. Top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve with sour cream salad tortilla chips and salsa.

title: Cheesy Oven-Fried Chicken
instructions: Coarsely crush dried bread. Combine crushed bread Parmesan cheese salt onion powder thyme garlic powder and pepper. Dip chicken pieces in melted margarine or butter; roll in cheese mixture to coat. Place chicken pieces skin side up and not touching in greased large shallow baking pan. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 40 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender. Do not turn. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown meat with 1/2 onion and the garlic powder; drain. Saute green onions separately. Julienne all vegetables and saute just until soft. Drain on paper towels (can steam vegetables to avoid fat). Mix all together. Put in wrappers and moisten edges to seal. Deep fry until brown. Freezes well.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Saute onions in butter until transparent. Add stuffing mix and all other ingredients. Drop on cookie sheet in walnut size balls. Freeze. Transfer to plastic bag when frozen and return to freezer. Bake as needed at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Homemade Kahlua(Adults Only)
instructions: Boil water. Add sugar coffee and rum. Pour in 1/2 gallon jug and add vanilla bean. Put in cool dark place (basement) for 6 weeks. Shake once a week or so. Serve with half and half in tiny glass for an after dinner drink.

title: Rhubarb Mandarin Crisp
instructions: In a bowl toss rhubarb sugar and tapioca; let stand for 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. Top with the oranges. In a bowl combine brown sugar oats flour and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs sprinkle evenly over oranges. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve with ice cream if desired.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. In large mixing bowl whisk together milk buttermilk egg oil sugar salt and baking powder. Add corn meal and flour; mix well. Blend in red peppers jalapenos and corn. Place in greased pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Zucchini Apple Pie
instructions: Bring zucchini apple juice lemon juice spices and margarine to a boil; boil for 3 minutes.\tAdd cornstarch and water stirring constantly. Cook\t1 minute more; remove from heat. Place in uncooked\tpie shell; add top crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Crumble corn bread and sliced bread finely. Add sage onion celery salt and pepper. Mix well then add eggs and broth with bouillon dissolved to crumb mixture. Use enough broth to thoroughly moisten to cake batter mixture. Pour into crock-pot and cook on high for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in saucepan. Add liquids; stir. Cooking over medium heat stir constantly until stiff (less than 5 minutes).

title: Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and vanilla pudding mix (mix dry). Add oil and water. Add one egg at a time beating mixture after each egg addition. Grease and flour an angel food cake pan and put in mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Yeast Biscuits
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add flour salt sugar 1/4 cup Crisco and remainder of water. Add flour if needed and work dough until it isnt sticky. Grease top of dough. Cover and let double in size (about 2 1/2 hours). Pinch off dough and roll into biscuits (about the size of a small peach). Flip biscuits over in a greased baking pan (remaining 1/4 cup Crisco goes in pan for baking). Let rise until doubled again. Bake at 350\u00b0 until starts browning then turn oven to 400\u00b0 and bake until golden brown.

title: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan
instructions: In a 9-inch casserole dish arrange broccoli. Top with chicken. Combine soup and milk and pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Wanda'S Company Casserole
instructions: Bring water to boil. Add spaghetti. Cover and turn off heat. Let stand for 20 minutes.

title: Quick Apple Cake
instructions: Cream together margarine and the 1/2 cup sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir in vanilla and flour mixing well. Spread evenly in buttered 9-inch round cake pan. Place apple wedges into cake batter to form a circular pattern. Mix together 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over cake. Sprinkle top with almonds.

title: Bobka
instructions: Cut shortening into flour. Add milk to beaten egg. Stir into flour. Wrap and chill. Divide dough in half and roll. Divide the meat mixture and spread on each piece of dough like a jelly roll. Place on a greased pan and bake at 375\u00b0 about 25 minutes. Slice to serve.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour melted margarine in bowl with other ingredients. Mix together and return to pan. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breast Supreme
instructions: Brown chicken in butter. Place in casserole dish. Pour soups over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix over top. Add cooking sherry and small amount water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Put thawed chicken in large pot of water and let boil until chicken is done or until chicken falls off the bones. Place 1/2 stick of butter and the bouillon cubes in the pot with chicken and let it all cook together.

title: Instant Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Store in an airtight container. Makes about 3 cups mix. To serve Spoon 2 tablespoons mix into a cup. Add 1 cup hot milk and 2 tablespoons rum (if desired). Stir until well mixed. Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream and a cinnamon stick.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: In casserole dish add pork and beans and first 4 ingredients; mix well. Sprinkle brown sugar on top. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Pie
instructions: Cream the cream cheese until smooth and blend with eggs 2/3 cup sugar and vanilla. Pour into pie crust. Bake in a moderately hot oven at 370\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove pie from oven; cool 15 minutes. Meanwhile combine sour cream with 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Carefully spread over filling. Return pie to very hot oven at 425\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes. Cool pie then let sit overnight before serving.

title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix together Jell-O water and pineapple. Store in refrigerator until soft set. Fold in chopped nuts and Cool Whip. Pour into mold. Let set to firm and serve.

title: Chow Mein Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onions and celery. Drain off fat. Add rice soy sauce mushroom soup chicken rice soup water and garlic salt. Mix well. Place all ingredients in a casserole dish and mix well. Top with chow mein noodles. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Makes 8 servings.

title: Apricot Spread
instructions: Mix and serve with pumpkin bread.

title: Can'T Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix right in pie pan flour sugar and salt. Add oil and milk. Mix with mixture only until blended. Pat dough evenly up sides and bottom of pie pan. Make ridges on top. Prick with fork if you are making a single crust. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Bake crust until done. Cool. Line bottom of crust with bananas. Mix sugar milk and cornstarch. Cook in double boiler until thick. In another bowl beat egg yolks and add small amount of cooked mixture to yolks. Beat until smooth. Add yolk mixture to remaining cooked mixture. Cook about 2 more minutes. Remove from heat and add butter flavoring vanilla salt and butter. Let cool. Pour over bananas and top with Cool Whip.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Set aside egg whites. Cook in boiler until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 3 tablespoons sugar and spread on pie. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Missouri Depression Fruit Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in 2 cups water. When tender drain. Mix together with lard or vegetable oil cinnamon cloves nutmeg cocoa flour soda and 1 cup cold water or fruit juice. Add nuts and candied fruit. Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours. Makes 4 (3 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch) loaves. When cool wrap in foil. Store in refrigerator or freeze.

title: Butter Pecan Cheesecake
instructions: Combine first four ingredients mixing well. Reserve 1/3 cup mixture; firmly press remaining mixture on bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy; gradually add 1 1/2 cups sugar and mix well. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after each. Add sour cream and flavorings; mix well. Pour into prepared pan; sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 10 minutes; reduce to 300\u00b0 and bake 50 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Chill.

title: Baked Stuffed Rabbit With Carrots
instructions: For stuffing mash potatoes to make 2 cups. Season with butter salt pepper savory and celery. Fill body of rabbit with this stuffing and sew it up. Place quartered carrots beside it.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Melt butter or margarine. Add flour; blend. Add beet liquid; cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add brown sugar vinegar salt pepper and cloves; stir until sugar dissolves. Drain beets. Add. Heat thoroughly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Squares
instructions: Mix peanut butter sugar and egg. Pat into 10 x 7 rectangle. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet. Smooth with rolling pin. Bake 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Put the chocolate bar on top of the pastry and cover with aluminum foil. When melted spread chocolate. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Ground Beef - Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute ground beef and onions until browned. In large casserole mix the green beans tomato soup and sauteed meat.

title: Rich Creamy Fudge
instructions: Coat a 13 x 9 pan with butter. In a large heavy saucepan combine sugar evaporated milk and butter. Heat over high heat until butter is melted and mixture comes to a boil stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium; boil 6 minutes until candy thermometer reaches 234\u00b0 stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate chips Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Pour into buttered pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into 1-inch squares.

title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Mix preceding ingredients (except cherry tomatoes). Cut large cherry tomatoes in half and/or cut bottoms off small cherry tomatoes. Drain cherry tomatoes upside down on paper towels. When cherry tomatoes are gutted and drained fill with preceding mixture.

title: Bananas Supreme* * * * *
instructions: It is unbelievable how easy this barbecue recipe is. It was given to me by a friend from South Carolina back in the 50s. The pepper rings are from a cookbook my youngest son gave me for Christmas one year. It is so pretty and if you are entertaining at Christmas time it makes a festive looking salad with the Christmas colors. You could also serve the rings with an Italian meal because the colors are the same as the Italian flag.

title: Roast Chicken Stuffing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until bread has absorbed all the egg. Lightly salt and pepper chicken cavity and add stuffing.

title: Chipped Beef Dip
instructions: Combine cream cheese and sour cream. Add remaining ingredients. Make up the day before. Serve on Triscuits.

title: Sunny Italy Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix the warm water with sugar then add the rest of ingredients and mix well.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place potatoes in greased casserole dish. Melt cream cheese butter and celery soup together. Pour over potatoes. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook uncovered for 45 minutes. Cover and cook for 15 additional minutes.

title: Autumn Fruit Salad
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar and flour. Stir in water. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla. Cool to room temperature. In a large bowl combine apples grapes celery and walnuts. Add the dressing and toss.

title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan combine butter cocoa sugar and milk. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat; add quick oats and peanut butter mix well. Add softened butter. Mix well and drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool and they are ready to eat.

title: Barbecue Brisket
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the brisket liberally with the following liquid smoke celery salt nutmeg paprika garlic salt and meat tenderizer. Wrap in heavy-duty foil and leave in the refrigerator for 8 hours preferably overnight. Cook in foil in large shallow pan for about 3 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0. Cool; drain juice reserving 1 cup liquid. Slice brisket and set aside.

title: Slippery Elms
instructions: Peel and quarter ripe cucumbers. Remove seeds and put in large pan with 1/2 cup salt. Let set overnight. Drain and pour hot water over them and drain again. Cook until tender in following mixture brown sugar white sugar vinegar hot water mustard seed and turmeric. Put in jars while hot. Turn over to seal.

title: Layered Salad
instructions: Combine top 5 ingredients in layers. Cover with Swiss cheese. Cover top with mayonnaise sealing the edges. Let set for 24 hours. Mix well when ready to serve.

title: Orange Balls(No Baking Required!)
instructions: Mix cookie wafer crumbs coconut and powdered sugar in a bowl. Add orange juice concentrate. Roll into 1-inch balls. Roll in additional powdered sugar. Store in covered container overnight. If mixture is too soft add a few more vanilla wafers (crushed).

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat eggs in large bowl. Beat in cheese flour salt and pepper. Drain broccoli and pat dry. Stir into egg mixture. Pour into 9 x 9-inch greased pan. Spread with spoon. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until firm and pulls away from sides.

title: Pasta With Tomatoes
instructions: Combine tomatoes basil garlic salt and pepper; set aside at room temperature for several hours. Serve over hot pasta. If desired garnish with basil and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Cut all vegetables into bite size pieces. Toss with dressing. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Crunchy Minglers Snack Mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients except Ranch dressing and toss well. Heat in microwave on High for 1 minute. Sprinkle dressing mix on top and toss again until well blended. Makes 13 cups.

title: Candied Fruitcake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Butter loaf pans and line with brown paper. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Brush corn syrup on cakes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except stuffing. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish and sprinkle stuffing on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Blueberry Surprise
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix butter sugar flour and pecans. Press evenly in bottom of ungreased 9 x 9 x 2 pan. Bake until light brown about 12 minutes. Crumble with spoon and cool. Set aside 1 cup crumbs and press rest of crumbs in bottom of pan. Pack ice cream on top of crumbs. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs on top of ice cream. Wrap and freeze. Heat filling until hot. Cut ice cream in 3-inch squares. Spoon warm pie filling onto ice cream bars. Serve immediately.

title: Flour Tortillas
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until the size of small peas. Add water a little at a time. Gather dough into a ball. Cut into 12 parts. Roll into balls; brush with shortening. Cover; let rest a few minutes. Roll into circles; cook on dry hot griddle or skillet over medium-high heat. Cook about 2 minutes and turn. Cook an additional minute.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix and let stand for 3 to 5 minutes. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Soft Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together the brown sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix well. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook ground beef; drain. Cook spaghetti (3 cups); stir in butter Parmesan cheese and eggs. Place spaghetti as crust in pie pan or casserole dish. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti. Spread ground beef over cottage cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Then sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake 5 minutes more. Serves 6.

title: Veg-All Chestnut Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All cheese onion mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Put in casserole dish and cover with cracker crumbs and margarine.\tBake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes until bubbly and crumbs are lightly browned.

title: Dutch Oven Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all but last 2 ingredients in a bowl. Put in a 2-quart Dutch oven or meat loaf pan. Top with bacon strips and squeeze a little more catsup on top. Bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Drain excess fat; serve.

title: Cinnamon Red Hot Cucumber Pickles
instructions: Peel seed and slice cucumbers. Soak in lime and 1 gallon water for 24 hours. Wash; soak covered with ice water for 3 hours. Mix 1 cup vinegar red food coloring alum and water to cover. Pour over cucumbers and simmer 2 hours; pour off water. Bring 2 cups vinegar 2 cups water sugar cinnamon sticks and red hots to boil. Pour over cucumbers and let stand 24 hours; pour off and boil. Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal. These cucumbers taste like cinnamon apple rings.

title: Sandy'S Homemade Bread
instructions: Put salt sugar shortening and water in large mixing bowl. Add warm water and stir. Sprinkle yeast over water and let set for 5 minutes. Do not stir. Add 2 cups of flour and beat thoroughly. Add remaining flour 1 cup at a time beating well after each addition. When unable to mix well with a spoon mix with your hands. Mix until dough begins to get stiff and hard to mix in flour. Pour dough onto a well-floured surface; sprinkle with flour on top. Let dough rest for 5 minutes while you wash your bowl. Knead dough 5 to 10 minutes; sprinkle with flour as necessary until dough is smooth elastic and no longer sticky.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly first 5 ingredients. Blend in the remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Use fork dipped in flour for crisscross pattern. Lightly grease baking sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Makes approximately 9 dozen.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in baking dish. Cover top with bacon strips. Bake until bubbly.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Boil squash and onion until soft. Salt and pepper. Drain squash. In mixing bowl add squash butter cheese egg and half of broken crackers. Pour mixture into baking dish. Sprinkle remaining crackers on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Heat juice and pudding stirring constantly until thick. Cool. Add the fruit.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Drain juice. Should be 1 cup if not add water. Bring to boil and add jello. Stir until dissolved then add 2 cups of cold water. Add blueberries and pineapple. Let congeal.

title: Easy Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In medium bowl beat cheese until its light and fluffy. Add condensed milk vanilla and lemon juice. Mix well. Pour into pie crust. Let chill until mixture gets firm. Top with cherry pie filling. Any fruit can be used as topping.

title: Good Red Kool-Aid Punch
instructions: Mix in a 1-gallon jug. Fill with water. At serving time add 1 quart ginger ale per gallon to punch bowl.

title: Tijuana Pie
instructions: Brown meat and season to taste. Drain. While meat is cooking mix all cans and heat through. Grease crock pot with non-stick cooking spray. Layer chips meat sauce and cheese until all is used. Heat in crock pot until cheese is melted.

title: Never-Fail Meringue
instructions: Add the cornstarch and sugar to the water. Heat until mixture boils and turns clear. Beat egg whites to a peak. Add cornstarch mixture to the egg whites. Add 7 teaspoons sugar to this and beat until whites are stiff.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a large bowl beat eggs condensed milk and lime juice. Pour into pastry shell. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes. Cool and chill 1 hour. Top with Cool Whip. Slice lime into thin slices and garnish pie. Refrigerate.

title: Fudge Scotch Squares
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until crumbs are moist. Spread into greased 8 x 8-inch glass pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fairy Food(Angel Food Candy)
instructions: Butter 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. First measure out baking soda. Combine sugar syrup and vinegar in heavy saucepan. Continue to cook without stirring to 300\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat and quickly stir in baking soda mixing well. Pour in buttered pan. It will spread itself. Cool. Break into pieces. Dip in melted chocolate and put on waxed paper to harden. Makes about 3 pounds.

title: Peach Supreme
instructions: Mix together the egg yolks macaroons oleo and sugar. Put peach halves in shallow baking pan. Put a large tablespoon of macaroon filling in each peach. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream. Serves 8.

title: Chicken Pods
instructions: Use a 9 x 9-inch deep pan.

title: Rosemary Jalapeno Roasted Chicken Breast With Grilled Vegetables
instructions: Remove skin and wing bones from chicken; season. Squeeze lime juice on chicken and sprinkle with jalapeno and rosemary. Set aside for 2 hours. Thickly slice zucchini and tomato (1/4-inch thick). Blanch scallions for 5 seconds. Brush vegetables with olive oil. Season and grill until well marked. Chill and dice. Add sour cream and cilantro. Gently pound chicken and roll up slightly overwrapping the edges. Place chicken loin side down on a roasting sheet. Brush with oil and roast until done approximately 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chill and serve.

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water juice and sugar. Chill. When ready to serve add ginger ale. Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

title: Cream Of Crab Soup
instructions: Remove cartilage from crabmeat. Melt butter in a large saucepan. Blend in flour. Stir until smooth. Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Add half and half slowly and then the milk slowly. Stir constantly until thick. Do not let it boil. Add crabmeat and salt. Sprinkle Old Bay seasoning over soup after it has been put in bowl. Serve hot.

title: Orange Salad 2
instructions: Drain oranges. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Refrigerate. Use dry jello.

title: Blueberry Crescent Pastries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Divide cream cheese in to 8 equal pieces. Spread 1 piece on square corner of each triangle about 1/4-inch from edge. Top with 1 teaspoon preserves. Fold 2 remaining points to square corner making square shaped pocket. Press edges to seal. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with margarine. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over pastries. Bake 10 to 13 minutes at 375\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes 8 pastries.

title: Green Grape Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; chill and serve.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: In a skillet cook sausage until brown. Drain off excess fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with point toward center. Press over bottom and sides to form a crust. Seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with Cheddar cheese.

title: Plum Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredient together with a spoon. (DO NOT USE MIXER.) Bake in greased and floured pan for 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Souffle And Baked Eggs
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Spoon spinach into 2 ramekins. Make indentations and break eggs into cups. Bake 20 minutes until spinach is hot and puffed and eggs are done. Sprinkle cheese and paprika over mixture.

title: Oven Fried Green Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine cornmeal salt and pepper in a bowl and set aside. Beat egg and water together in another bowl. Dip tomato slices first in egg and then dredge in cornmeal. Place tomato layers in baking dish using only enough vegetable cooking spray to keep tomatoes from sticking. Bake 20 minutes and turn with spatula and bake 20 more minutes.

title: Date Balls
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients; cook slowly in an iron skillet at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until thick stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add vanilla nuts and Rice Krispies. Cool slightly. Shape into balls with buttered hands. Roll in coconut. Keep in a cool place. Yield 50 balls.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain. Set aside to cool. When it is fully cooled add grated cheese kidney beans and tomatoes. Add just before serving the crushed nacho chips and salad dressing. That way it wont get soggy. Mix well.

title: Almond Toffee Triangles
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease jelly roll pan. Mix brown sugar margarine corn syrup egg and vanilla. Stir in flour and salt. Spread dough in pan. Bake until light golden brown 18 to 20 minutes. Prepare topping.

title: Eggrolls
instructions: Brown meat in oil and set aside. Saute garlic until golden brown; add onion. Cook until done add meat then carrots. Continue stirring until half done add green beans. Cook until half done; add cabbage celery and water chestnuts. Season with salt soy sauce and pepper to taste. Cook until half done. Remove from heat and put in strainer to drain. Let cool. Put filling in wrappers following instructions on package. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve with sweet and sour sauce.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix ingredients and heat to boiling; remove garlic. Dip meats in sauce before broiling or roasting or use to baste during roasting. Approximate yield 2 cups sauce.

title: Salisbury Steak
instructions: Combine 1/4 can of the mushroom soup with all the ingredients except the water and the mushroom gravy. Shape into patties. Arrange in shallow pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Combine remaining mushroom soup and water. Pour this and the mushroom gravy over the patties and bake another 10 minutes.

title: Inside Out Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Saute cabbage and onion in skillet with pam. When tender combine remaining ingredients and pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

title: Easy No-Roll Pie Crust
instructions: Place all ingredients in pie pan and mix with a fork. Press dough in pan and along sides. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown. Makes 1 crust.

title: Cincinnati Famous Chili Recipe
instructions: Brown meat; cook onions with meat and drain grease. Place meat and onions in large pan or crock-pot. Add rest of ingredients. Cook slowly 4 to 5 hours covered. Remove bay leaves and garlic before serving. Serve on a bed of spaghetti and top with grated Cheddar cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Piquant Pickles
instructions: Drain pickles and put slices in large bowl. Add all ingredients to pickles and stir occasionally. After sugar dissolves put back in jar or in pint jars.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake according to directions on cake mix box. Cool and ice.

title: Fried Cheese
instructions: Cut cheese into 2 1/2 x 1/2-inch strips. Dip each in flour then beaten egg then bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil for 1 minute turn and fry 1 more minute or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with pizza sauce if desired.

title: Alabama Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Mix flour salt and baking powder together. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture a cup at a time. Alternate with milk. Add flavoring. Pour in prepared tube pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour in floured and greased pan.

title: Chicken In Spicy Cream Sauce
instructions: Mix garlic paprika and salt in bowl. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Rub with garlic mixture; let stand for 15 minutes. Cook in hot oil in large skillet for 7 to 8 minutes or until brown on both sides. Spoon mixture of half and half and lemon juice over chicken. Simmer covered for 1 hour or until tender turning once. Place chicken on warm serving dish. Spoon sauce over top; garnish with parsley. Yield 4 servings.

title: Date Ball
instructions: Place everything in pan over medium heat except Rice Krispies and nuts. Cook 6 minutes; remove and add nuts and Krispies. Roll in ball and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Carrot Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce; stir well. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Serve on lettuce leaves. Yields 6 servings.

title: Mee Mee'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs on low speed. Mix all other ingredients together. Put in unbaked pie shell and dot with butter. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. After it has browned as much as you want then cover with foil.

title: Sesame Seed Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Chill dough 3 to 4 hours. Bake about 10 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until brown.

title: Chili Beans
instructions: Cook beans as directed on package. In skillet saute onions and bell pepper in cooking oil for about 1 minute. Add hamburger and brown stirring often. Drain off fat. Add tomatoes chili powder and chili pepper. Salt to taste and simmer about 15 minutes. Add all to beans. Bring to a boil then lower heat and simmer for about 1 hour. For smaller amount use half recipe.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over the oatmeal. Set aside and cool. Combine the white sugar brown sugar and oil. Add the eggs and cream together. Add the flour soda cinnamon vanilla and salt. Add the oatmeal mixture. Beat 3 minutes and bake in oblong pan for 25 or 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and frost.

title: Cucumber Dill Pasta Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Drain beets. Cover with vinegar; add cloves sugar and lemon. Bring to boil and remove from heat. Separate onions into rings; add to beets. Chill until serving time.

title: Barbecued Hamburgers
instructions: Combine bread crumbs milk meat onion salt and pepper. Form into patties with your burger press. Combine Worcestershire sauce vinegar sugar and catsup. Brown the burgers on both sides in the hot bacon fat; add the sauce. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Makes 8 hamburgers.

title: Deer Path Salad
instructions: Drain juice from 1 large can crushed pineapple save 1/4 cup liquid. Add 1/4 cup juice to 1 envelope of unflavored gelatin. Add 1/2 cup of sugar to pineapple. Stir and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add gelatin mixture. Break 8 ounces cream cheese into mixture. Stir until cream cheese is nearly melted. Add 2 cups Cool Whip. Mix well and pour into mold or square pan. Set until firm. Can be made 2 to 3 days ahead.

title: Diabetic Cake
instructions: Cook raisins or fruit cocktail in water until the water is gone. Then add applesauce eggs sweetener and cooking oil. Mix well. Blend in baking soda and flour. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 35 minutes or until done.

title: Cathy'S Beef Burgundy
instructions: Cut beef into bite size pieces and brown in oil. Add onions and flour; stir to coat meat. Add wine broth and seasonings. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes. Remove bay leaf and add mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over noodles or rice.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Line a greased pizza pan with the crescent rolls. Bake until golden brown. Allow to cool. Mix cream cheese mayo and Ranch dressing together until smooth. Spread onto the cooled crescent rolls. Add the broccoli cauliflower carrots and ripe olives. Refrigerate for 1 hour and slice and serve.

title: Marshmallow Cream Fudge
instructions: Combine marshmallow cream sugar evaporated milk margarine and salt in medium saucepan. Bring to a full boil stirring constantly over moderate heat. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add chocolate morsels and stir until melted. Stir in nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm. Makes about 2 1/2 pounds.

title: Taco Chicken
instructions: Place chips in casserole. Put chicken on top. Mix soup tomatoes and water or broth together. Pour over chips and chicken. Heat until boiling hot.

title: Flossie'S Yeast Bread
instructions: Mix and pour out on floured cloth. Knead 10 minutes. Put in warm place to rise until double in bulk. Punch down cover and let rest a few minutes. Divide. Roll out into oblong rolls about 18 inches. Roll up and put in greased loaf pan. Put seam in batter. Makes 2 loaves. Let rise again. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. May have to put foil over top to keep it from browning too much.

title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Ball
instructions: In a medium bowl combine all ingredients except nuts. Chill until slightly firm. Form into desired shape. Garnish with nuts. Chill several hours. (All \light\ products may be substituted.)

title: Hamburger Stuffed Bread
instructions: Cut top of French bread. Hollow out bottom of loaf. Leave approximately 1/2 inch on sides and bottom. Tear the bread which was hollowed out into 1 inch pieces; set aside.

title: Lemon-Poppy Seed Loaf
instructions: Mix together. Pour 1/2 full into 5 baby loaf pans (5 3/4 x 3 1/4 x 2 inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40-45 minutes. Remove from oven and pierce holes in top of loaves using toothpick. Just before loaves are removed from oven cook glaze.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter peanut butter and sugar. Add egg; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients and combine mixtures. Stir until dough is stiff. Shape into balls and press with a fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Clam Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean mushrooms and saute chopped stems in butter for 10 minutes. Add minced clams parsley salt pepper and garlic powder and saute 5 minutes. Stuff caps; place in greased baking dish and chill. Combine mayonnaise and mustard and top each cap. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: In a large bowl sift together the flour and onion salt; mix in basil. Cut in butter and lard until it resembles coarse meal. Gradually add enough water to hold dough together mixing lightly with a fork. Roll out on lightly floured board. Line 9-inch pie plate with dough.

title: Pumpkin Pies (2)
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into unbaked pie crusts. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes then in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Elephant Stew
instructions: Cut elephant into small bite sized pieces. This will take about 2 months. Add enough brown gravy to cover and cook over kerosene fire about 4 weeks at 450\u00b0. This will serve 3800 people. If more are expected then add 2 rabbits. But do this only if necessary as most people do not like hare in their stew.

title: Oatmeal Crispies Cookies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well and add flour soda nuts and oatmeal. Mix well. Chill and drop by teaspoons. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Potato Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl except oil. Mix well. Drain any liquid that accumulates. Pour oil in skillet to 1/8 inch deep. Heat to 350\u00b0. Drop potato mixture 1/4 c. at time into hot oil. Flatten forming a circle. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until potatoes are brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Wassail(English Holiday Drink)
instructions: In 3-quart casserole place cider allspice cloves nutmeg cinnamon sticks orange juice lemon juice sugar and apples. Microwave on High (10) for 15 to 18 minutes until hot. Strain and serve.

title: Corned Beef And Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Arrange asparagus and corned beef in layers in casserole dish. Mix together butter milk and flour and cook to make a white sauce. Mix Creamettes and soup and pour over casserole contents. Add the white sauce and sprinkle with 1/4 pound grated Alberta cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Ranch House Steak
instructions: Cut meat in serving size pieces; trim excess fat. Slash edges of meat to prevent curling. Combine flour mustard salt and pepper; coat meat with mixture. (Set aside any remaining flour mixture.) In heavy skillet brown meat on both sides in hot oil. Add reserved flour mixture to skillet. Combine water and Worcestershire. Stir into mixture in skillet. Cover lightly; cook over low heat for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat. Skim excess fat from pan juices. Drizzle juices over meat.

title: Dirt Dessert
instructions: Note Need 8-inch diameter plastic flower pot.

title: Sourdough Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Mix in order given. May be baked immediately or pinched off as needed. Keep in refrigerator. Bake at 450\u00b0.

title: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all of the above ingredients together. Pour into a hot greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until bread is brown.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Sift flour baking powder sugar and salt together. Add egg milk and corn. Stir until blended. Drop in hot oil a teaspoonful at a time. Brown. Remove and drain. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Serve hot. They look like little oblong doughnuts when finished.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Drain beets reserving 1/2 cup of the liquid. Combine all ingredients except beets. Bring to boil stirring to dissolve sugar. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove cinnamon stick and add beets. Let cool some and put in airtight container jar with lid. Store in refrigerator mixing occasionally for 1 week. Serve cold.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix potatoes eggs sugar margarine pudding mix vanilla flavoring ginger and milk in a large mixer bowl until well blended. Pour into shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes two 8-inch pies.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in top of a double boiler; cool to room temperature. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Beat in sugar until creamy. Add chocolate mixture to eggs beating by hand. Add salt flour nuts and vanilla; blend well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes about 20.

title: Humdingers
instructions: Cook chopped dates melted butter and sugar. Cook on low until mixture comes to a boil about 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients. Let cool. Make into balls and roll in confectioners sugar.

title: Banana Cake Delight
instructions: Mix all together thoroughly. Pour into a tube pan and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Better Than Fried Chicken
instructions: In a large bowl combine first eight ingredients. Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. Remove chicken from marinade; coat each piece with crumbs. Arrange on a shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until juices run clear. Yield 8 servings. Diabetic Exchanges One serving equals 3 1/2 lean meat 1 starch 1/4 skim milk; also 271 calories 293 mg sodium 76 mg cholesterol 22 gm carbohydrate 32 gm protein and 5 gm fat.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Fry onion in butter. Stir in flour; add water and cook over low heat stirring until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Blend in cheese and add broccoli. Mix in eggs until gently blended. Use 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Cover with crackers and dot with butter before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Jayme'S Tuna Casserole
instructions: Prepare macaroni as directed. Stir in soup and milk. Gently fold in tuna and peas. Heat to serving temperature.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat for 4 minutes. Pour into tube pan greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Chocolate Decadent Pie
instructions: To Make Crust In food processor crush chocolate wafers and add butter. Press into 9-inch pie plate and freeze for 1 hour.

title: Fruit Squares
instructions: Mix and put in a 15 x 10-inch pan. Cut or mark out 20 squares. Place 1 heaping tablespoon of pie filling on each square. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into 9 x 13-inch or a bit larger jelly roll pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: El Toro Cheese Dip
instructions: Cube cheese into a crock-pot. Add water and remaining ingredients. Heat until cheese is melted.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Boil noodles then drain. Brown meat then drain. Add sauce. Pour into pan. Add cheese. Bake until cheese melts and browns. Let sit about 10 minutes then serve. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
instructions: Set oven to 425\u00b0. Cream shortening and the brown and white sugars. Add pineapple and egg to the cream mixture. Add the dry ingredients flour baking powder salt and baking soda to mixture. Add vanilla and walnuts to mixture. Drop by level teaspoon on greased or sprayed cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.

title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
instructions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat cook beef until browned stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soups water mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon into 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbling. Meanwhile cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven and stir. Arrange biscuits around hot beef mixture. Top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Slaw (Tart!)
instructions: Shred cabbage. Place in a plastic container a layer of cabbage then a layer of shredded onions and chopped pepper until all used up. Mix oil vinegar sugar salt mustard and celery seed. Heat to a boil. Spoon hot mixture over cabbage. Do not stir. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Will last for a week or more.

title: Marinated Cheese
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small jar; cover tightly and shake vigorously to blend. Set aside.

title: Perfect Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Add eggs milk and oil. Mix. Grease 8-inch pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Tasty Turkey Pot Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix dressing flour bouillon and pepper in saucepan; gradually add milk. Cook stirring frequently over medium-low heat until thickened. Add turkey and vegetables. Cook stirring occasionally until thoroughly heated. Spoon into 8-inch square baking dish. Unroll dough in 2 rectangles. Press perforations together to seal. Place rectangles side by side to form square; press edges together to form seam. Cut dough into 1-inch strips. Arrange in lattice design over turkey mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Flumery
instructions: Combine in a saucepan 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch salt and milk (a wire whisk works great). Cook and stir until it boils and thickens. Remove from heat. Stir about a cup of warmed ingredients into the egg yolk in a separate bowl. Add this mixture back into saucepan with the hot mixture. Return to stove and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in vanilla and pour into a dish. Chill. Serve with strawberries on top.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Chop cranberries and apples in food processor; mix together. Add sugar and cover. Let set in refrigerator for 1 hour. Add dry Jell-O water and nuts. Mix together and refrigerate or freeze some for later.

title: White House Pies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs raisins walnuts hot water and vanilla. Line 12 or 16 patty shells with pastry. Fill and bake in moderate oven at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Slice mushrooms into thin slices. Melt butter. Add chopped onions and parsley flakes. Add mushrooms; season with garlic and seasoning salt to taste. Simmer 5 to 7 minutes. Serve with chips crackers or on steaks.

title: Three Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Place in large bowl. Add peppers and onions. Blend other ingredients. Pour over beans stir cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hummingbird Nectar
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan or pot. Boil for 1 minute. Let cool. Add red food coloring.

title: Creamy Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onions in salt water until tender 12 to 15 minutes. Drain well. Add next 5 ingredients. Melt 3/4 stick of butter in frying pan. Add stuffing and mix well. Add all the stuffing mixture (except enough to sprinkle over top of casserole) to the squash mixture. Mix well. Pour into well-greased baking dish and sprinkle stuffing mix over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Slow Burn Chili(Serves 8)
instructions: Brown chuck in oil. Remove from skillet. Brown onion garlic green pepper and jalapeno pepper. Stir in beef tomatoes beer and spices. Heat to boiling over medium-high. Reduce to low. Cover and simmer for 2 to 4 hours. Uncover and cook 1 hour. Add water if necessary. Stir in kidney beans. Heat 1/2 hour. Serve with grated cheese.

title: Chicken With Feta Stuffing
instructions: Wash chickens and rub with lemon juice salt and pepper. Cut chicken livers in half and place in bowl. Add cheese garlic olive oil lemon juice and seasonings. Let stand to marinate for 1 hour. Then stuff chickens and secure firmly with skewers. Arrange in baking pan and brush with melted butter. Add water to pan and bake at 375\u00b0 basting and turning chickens frequently until tender and browned. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Italian Sirloin Stew
instructions: Cut beef steak into 1/4-inch strips. Cut each strip into 1-inch pieces. Combine garlic and 1 tablespoon oil. Stir into beef and reserve. Saute onion in remaining oil in large saucepan. Cook 3 minutes. Sprinkle with basil and pepper cook and stir one minute. Add tomatoes beef broth and zucchini. Bring to a boil cover; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Meanwhile heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir beef 1 to 2 minutes. Add to sauce. Stir 2 teaspoons cornstarch dissolved in 2 tablespoons water into stew and cook until slightly thickened about 2 minutes. Serve with grated cheese. Makes 4 servings.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: In a large bowl mix chopped cauliflower lettuce and onion; fry or microwave bacon until crisp then drain on paper towel. Break in small pieces. Mix all together; add dash of salt and mix in mayonnaise. You might need to add a little extra mayonnaise. Put in refrigerator.

title: Chicken - N - Dumplings
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Add seasonings. Tear off pieces of the biscuits and drop them into the pot. Cook until dumplings are done.

title: Chocolate Fudge(Foolproof)
instructions: Melt chocolate and milk in saucepan on low heat. Remove from heat; add other ingredients. Chill 2 hours; cut into squares.

title: Creamed Chicken And Biscuits
instructions: Saute chopped onion and celery in butter until tender. Add flour to onion and celery. Slowly add chicken broth and milk. Cook to smooth paste stirring constantly. Add chicken and salt.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix corn and cracker meal. Beat egg separately. Stir in then add cheese and milk. Add salt and pepper to taste. Put in oven with butter diced on top. Bake for 35 minutes in a fast oven. Can be prepared in advance.

title: Country Club Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients in order given. Grease miniature muffin pans and heat slightly before filling 2/3 full with batter. Bake at 300\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Loosen edges with knife blade for easier removal. Makes 24 muffins.

title: Oatmeal Apple Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In a medium bowl combine margarine brown sugar applesauce and vanilla. Stir by hand. Add oats raisins cinnamon and baking powder; mix well. Pour batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 30 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Let cool and cut into bars. Makes 24 squares.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Beat eggs add milk and sugar; Bake in slow oven.

title: El Grandeo
instructions: Brown meat and onions; drain and add chili mix according to directions. Add tomatoes and simmer while rice cooks. Line bottom of dish with rice. Spread meat mixture on top. After mixing cheese soup with milk pour over meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Dinner In A Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger until done; drain. Layer in 2-quart casserole 1/2 meat 1/2 green beans 1/2 of potato slices 1/2 of vegetables and 1/2 of cream of mushroom soup. Repeat once ending with soup. Bake 1 hour in 325\u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

title: Cranberry Apple Relish
instructions: Put cranberries and apples through food grinder. Quarter oranges and lemon and grind. Add sugar and blend. Chill. This relish will keep in refrigerator for several weeks.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugars thoroughly. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with sour milk and bananas; beat well. Fold in nuts. Bake in a 6 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan which has been lined with wax paper (buttered). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. (Do not ice.)

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Mix together. Make into balls about 1-inch round. Glaze.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine corn meal milk egg and onion. Drop by spoonfuls into hot fat heated to 375\u00b0 frying only a few at a time. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Red Cabbage
instructions: In a large skillet cook the sugar and fat for 2 minutes. Add the onion; cook until slightly colored. Add the balance of the ingredients except flour and water. Cook for 15 minutes and stir in flour and water. Continue cooking for 30 to 40 minutes more. Add more liquid if necessary or if too much liquid simmer with lid off. Serve either warm or cold. Tastes even better the second day. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix milk and pudding until pudding starts to get thick. Add sour cream. Mix well stir in whipping cream. Layer bananas and wafers then pudding until last layer is pudding on top.

title: Mom'S Barbecue Spareribs
instructions: Salt and pepper ribs. Cover with onion slices. Mix rest of ingredients and pour on ribs. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove cover the last 20 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut up chicken. Dredge chicken in a mixture of salt pepper Natures Seasons blend and flour. In another bowl beat egg and milk together. Dip chicken in this then roll again in flour mixture. Fry over medium heat in deep oil until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine; stir in milk a little at a time. Blend in vanilla and salt. Mixture may be slightly dry. Coat each cherry with mixture. Melt chocolate and paraffin in top of a double boiler. Dip cherries in chocolate then place on wax paper. Make a few days before serving so cherries will be moist inside.

title: Cream Cheese Cups
instructions: Combine ingredients above. Mix for 5 minutes on high speed. Line cupcake liners with vanilla wafers. Pour batter 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Let cool then top with desired pie filling.

title: Apple Walnut Supreme Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine apples and sugar; set aside. In a large mixing bowl mix eggs oil and vanilla; then beat 1 minute at medium speed. Add combined dry ingredients alternating with apple mixture. Stir in walnuts. Bake in a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes until cake tests done with a toothpick. Do not underbake.

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream butter; add sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each. Add crumbs alternately with milk. Add coconut nuts and vanilla. Pour in well greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours. Invert pan to cool.

title: Doogers Clam Chowder
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes. Drain and mash lightly. Put clams in pot and heat. Add potatoes and seasonings. Let simmer. Heat milk. Add clam mixture. Add butter.

title: Strawberry Angel Food De-Light(Serves 12)
instructions: When cake has cooled completely trim brown crust and remove from pan. Cut cake into 3 layers using thin serrated knife. Prepare whipped topping as package directs using skim milk. Stir in yogurt 1/2 the strawberries and the food color. Spread 1/3 of the whipped topping between each layer and on top of cake. Top with remaining strawberries.

title: Shortcut Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef along with chopped small onion; drain. In crock-pot put spaghetti sauce tomatoes and ground beef. Add remaining ingredients; stir well. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Serve over 1 pound cooked spaghetti or vermicelli or 1 pound of your favorite pasta cooked and drained.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: In a 9-inch spring-form pan dust with graham cracker crumbs. Sieve the cottage cheese into a mixing bowl. Add cream cheese. With mixer at high speed beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in sugar. Add eggs. With mixer at low speed beat in next 3 ingredients. Beat in margarine and sour cream until smooth. Pour into pan. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 70 minutes or until firm around edge. Turn off oven. Let cake stand in oven about 70 minutes or until firm in center. Remove and chill.

title: Baked Apple Carrot Casserole
instructions: Combine and blend flour and sugar; layer 1/2 of apples in a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Cover with 1/2 carrots. Sprinkle with a small amount of flour and sugar mixture. Dot with margarine. Repeat layers. Pour orange juice over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad With Curry Dressing
instructions: For dressing in a 1-cup measure combine buttermilk mayonnaise or salad dressing sugar and curry powder. Cover and chill in freezer while preparing salad.

title: Asparagus Casserole
instructions: Drain asparagus and place in a layer in the bottom of a greased casserole dish. Follow with a layer of sliced eggs and sprinkle crumbs over eggs. Add a layer of cheese. Pour 1/2 of soup and milk over all. Repeat layers in order given and dot with butter. Allow to set for 1/2 hour before baking in a 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until heated through and bubbly.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift the flour baking soda and salt. Cream butter. Gradually add the sugar creaming well. Add eggs and bananas; blend thoroughly. Combine milk and lemon juice. Add dry ingredients to banana mixture alternating with the milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Grease bottom of a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Pour in the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes until bread springs back when lightly touched in center. Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack.

title: Sugar-Free Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until dry. Mix all ingredients well. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan greased and floured (or Bundt pan) at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake mix as directed on package in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool cake for 15 minutes. Poke holes on top of cake with utility fork (not quite through). Mix all of the milk and sugar with 1/2 cup coconut. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Spoon on top of cake into holes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies With Pudding
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter both sugars vanilla and pudding mix in large mixer bowl beat until smooth and creamy. beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture then stir in the chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded tsp. about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix well flour sugar cornstarch soda and salt. Add remaining ingredients with fork; mix thoroughly. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Orange Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix flour sugar baking powder cinnamon and salt in bowl. Mix cereal and milk in another bowl and let stand 3 minutes. Stir well. Stir in egg oil and peel. Add to flour mixture; mix enough to moisten flour. Fold in cranberries. Spoon into greased muffin pans filling 3/4 full. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Carrot Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift together flour salt spices and baking powder. Mix with sugar mixture. Add orange juice carrot and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Quick Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet; drain. Add pork and beans brown sugar and mustard to meat. Mix well place in microwave-safe dish. Microwave on High until bubbly.

title: Brownies By Pam Murphy
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Queen Ann Holiday Brunch Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour yeast sugar salt ginger and orange rind. Mix well. In a saucepan heat milk water and margarine until warm. (Butter does not need to melt.) Add to flour mixture. Add eggs and cream cheese. Blend on low until moistened then 3 minutes on medium speed. Add fruit and coconut by hand. Gradually stir in enough flour to make a stiff batter. Arrange almond slices on bottom of well-greased and floured 10-inch (12 cup) Bundt pan. Spoon batter into pan. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled (2 hours). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown. Cool on wire rack 15 minutes then turn out of pan. Drizzle with glaze.

title: Tangy Lemon Streusel Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Reserve 2 tablespoons of dry cake mix. Beat remaining cake mix yogurt oil water and eggs in large bowl on low speed for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes.

title: Squash Bread
instructions: Mix together first 3 ingredients mix well. Add remaining ingredients blend well. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Ham And Potato Microwave Casserole
instructions: Line microwave dish (greased) with 1/3 of the potatoes and 1/3 of the ham; sprinkle 1/3 of the onions. Mix salt pepper and flour and sprinkle 1/3 over other ingredients in dish. Repeat 2 more times; top with cheese. Pour milk over all. Cover with plastic wrap (venting one side). Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Rotate; cook 2 more minutes. Remove plastic wrap and cook 2 to 4 more minutes longer. You may place under broiler to brown.

title: Malmakarona(Honey Dainties - Greek)
instructions: In mixer bowl beat cooking oil into butter until blended. Beat in the 1/3 cup sugar. Add orange juice baking powder and baking soda; mix well. Add enough of the flour a little at a time to make a medium-soft dough. Shape dough into 2-inch ovals and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cookies are golden. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Cherry Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil water for pasta. While water is boiling slice tomatoes in half and place them in large bowl. Add olive oil and vinegar. Chop fresh basil and add to tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Mix and set aside.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes and place one layer in a casserole dish. Layer with cheese and butter. Continue layering with potatoes cheese and butter. Mix soup with 1/2 can of milk; pour over potatoes and cheese. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mabel'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan (except salad dressing) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add salad dressing and mix well. Yield enough for 10 pounds potato salad.

title: Italian Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Put flour into oven cooking bag and shake. Place bag into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour sauce into bag and place chicken in bag. Close with tie and make 2 small slits in top of bag. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Nine High
instructions: Use oblong large baking dish. Brown ground beef. Add package of taco seasoning. Add can of refried beans. Heat together. Place in single layer in large baking dish. Sprinkle half of grated cheese over top. Spread carton of sour cream. Slice drained black olives and spread over sour cream. Add chopped tomatoes green onions guacamole. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts. Serve with tortillas picante sauce on side.

title: Glorified Gingerbread
instructions: Mix sugar flour and oleo as for pie crust. Take out 1 cup for the topping. Sprinkle soda nutmeg and cinnamon over the remaining mixture. Add to well beaten eggs. Mix; add milk. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Add pecans to the cup of mixture saved for the topping. Sprinkle this crumb mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Use a toothpick to check for doneness. Serve warm. (This may be reheated in the microwave.)

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Cook potatoes until soft; in large bowl beat potatoes with mixer until smooth. Beat in eggs 1/4 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup of butter salt and cinnamon. Beat in orange juice slowly to make mixture fluffy. Put mixture into 2 to 3-quart souffle dish and smooth top. Arrange pecans over top; sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar over pecans. Drizzle remaining 1/4 cup butter over sugar. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until top is bubbly.

title: Creamy Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Beat until fluffy then beat a little more. This may be tinted with food coloring. Should be kept cool after on cake. May be refrigerated.

title: Olive Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix cheese and flour; add butter. Form around olives. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Roasted Sweet Onions And Carrots With Pecans(Yields 24 Servings)
instructions: Combine carrots oil and 3 ounces margarine; spread on a sheet pan. Sprinkle with half the salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 until carrots are tender and golden brown about 40 minutes. Reserve; keep hot.

title: Butter Cream Mints
instructions: Cream together butter milk and powdered sugar. Add flavoring and color to taste. Roll balls in granulated sugar. Press into mold and unmold at once. If candy sticks add more powdered sugar.

title: Mississippi Bean Salad
instructions: Rinse; sort beans. Place beans in saucepan covered and let stand overnight. Boil and cook for about 2 hours. Drain well and chill.

title: Roast Beef With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle salt pepper and garlic salt over beef; put in a bag or tinfoil. Mix the remaining ingredients together for sauce and sprinkle over roast. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Miniature Mexican Frittatas
instructions: In a medium bowl combine the spinach cottage cheese Parmesan cheese and Cheddar cheese. In another bowl stir together the eggs milk cumin and pepper. Stir into spinach mixture. Stir in the cilantro or parsley.

title: Frozen Chocolate Bananas
instructions: Will also need two wooden sticks or forks will work.

title: Chicken Dressing Dinner
instructions: Melt butter in skillet and sear celery and onion until tender. Break bread into small pieces and moisten with broth. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. If too dry add more broth. Must be firm enough to cut but not dry. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in moderate oven. Makes 15 servings.

title: Lemon Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and cook in double boiler until creamy. Let cool. While this cools crush vanilla wafers for 3/4 cup. Beat egg whites stiff. Fold in custard; whip whipping cream and fold in.

title: Sally'S Pie Crust(One Pie Crust)
instructions: Mix together with a fork.

title: Grated Potato Cheese Torte
instructions: Coarsely grate potatoes; measure 6 cups. In large mixing bowl combine potatoes with remaining ingredients except parsley; mix thoroughly. Turn into buttered 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Loosen edges and remove side of pan. Garnish with parsley. Serve warm cut in wedges. Makes 6 servings.

title: Rice Krispies Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar and Karo syrup over medium heat. Stir until boiling. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and rice krispies. Spread in buttered 13 X 9 pan. Melt chocolate chips and butterscotch chips in microwave. Spread on top of rice krispies. Cut into bars.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and sugar. Cut in Crisco. Beat egg water and vinegar together. Add to flour mixture. Knead well. Divide into 5 balls. Chill 1/2 hour before rolling out. (Can put extra pie crust in pans and put in freezer.)

title: Tuna-Chip Bake
instructions: Drain tuna; break up in bowl. Mix soup with 2/3 can of milk. Crush 1/2 bag of chips. Make layers of tuna soup and chips. Crush remaining chips and put on top. Bake in dish sprayed with Pam for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: French Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until no longer pink. Remove from water and let cool. Mix two cans cream of mushroom soup and one cup of sour cream in separate bowl. Shred or cube chicken breasts and place in casserole dish. Pour soup and sour cream mixture over chicken. Crumble crackers over top. Drizzle with butter (optional). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each).

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash 2 or 3 fully ripe bananas to make 1 cup banana pulp. Cream shortening sugar lemon rind and beaten egg. Sift flour with baking powder and soda. Add sifted ingredients in 3 parts to the sugar mixture alternately with the banana pulp. Beat the batter after each addition until smooth. Place in greased bread pan 4 x 8-inch. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. You may add 1/2 cup nuts or 1/2 cup raisins soft dried prunes apricots or dates if desired.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Pack in an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle with catsup. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Mix thoroughly the shortening butter sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients and stir in. Roll dough into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon and place 2-inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes until lightly browned but still soft. These puff up at first then flatten out. Yields about 5 dozen.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni until tender. Drain. Cut up cheese in small pieces and mix in soup. Place in casserole dish. Microwave on High for 1 minute and stir. Continue to microwave and stir until cheese is melted. Add cooked macaroni. Stir to coat. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Substitute sliced boiled potatoes for macaroni to make a great potato-cheese casserole.

title: Irresistible Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a 3-quart pan over low heat melt butter. Remove from heat. Add sugar flour cocoa baking powder salt eggs and vanilla; stir with spoon until batter is well blended. Stir in 1 1/2 cups chips. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with remaining chips. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

title: Meal In One
instructions: Fry cube steak as usual and drain. Boil macaroni as package states. Place meat back in skillet and pour noodles on top. Add stewed tomatoes. If more liquid is needed add water. Salt and pepper to taste and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Frosted Date Nut Bars
instructions: Gradually add sugar to eggs and flavors beating until light and fluffy. Sift together salt cinnamon and flour. Add slowly to sugar mixture. Blend well. Add pecans and dates. Spread evenly on well-greased 10 x 15-inch sheet pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 35 minutes. Cool. Top with orange frosting. Cut into 1/2 x 3-inch bars. Makes about 30 bars.

title: Chocolate Delight Cookies(Unbaked)
instructions: Melt both chocolate over hot water. Mix in nuts salt and corn flakes stir well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Bring to a boil the rice water and salt. Turn heat down to low setting and cover with a lid. Simmer 14 minutes. Saute bell pepper and onion in butter or bacon grease until onion is tender. Add this to the rice then add tomato sauce and pepper. Mix thoroughly and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Rich Peanut Butter Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Melt peanut butter and margarine or butter in bowl over hot water. Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Yields about 2 dozen squares.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown the ground beef; cook onions with meat. Drain fat. Add taco seasoning; mix water seasoned salt and beans. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes. Reserve some of the tomato wedges avocado slice and tortilla chips for use as a garnish. Just before serving toss ground beef mixture with other ingredients. Garnish with reserved tomatoes avocado and tortilla chips. The salad is best served immediately. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Lemon-Grilled Catfish
instructions: Mix all the seasoning ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid; shake well to mix thoroughly. The marinade will keep in the refrigerator for several weeks if you do not use it all. Wash the catfish fillets and pat dry. Cover the fillets with the marinade; refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 4 hours. Grill over a medium-hot fire basting with the marinade and turning the fish several times. Cooking time will be about 10 minutes. Serve immediately with a wedge of lemon.

title: Sausage Rice-A-Roni
instructions: Cook the Rice-A-Roni as directed. Brown the sausage. Alternate cooked Rice-A-Roni and sausage. Sprinkle each layer with onions. Pour the soup over top. Sprinkle with the cheese. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix butter cake mix butter one egg and chopped pecans and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 8 ounce package cream cheese 1 box confectioners sugar 3 eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well and pour over cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Shrimp Nantucket
instructions: Put mushrooms and onions in large frying pan. (Do not add liquid at this time.) When mushrooms begin to brown add 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Fry until brown. Remove from heat. In a medium size pan put 3 tablespoons butter and garlic. Add shrimp and sprinkle shrimp with garlic salt. Fry about 4 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Do not overcook shrimp. Remove shrimp from butter and add to mushroom mixture. Add fried bacon. Place large frying pan back on heat and mix all ingredients. Heat through about 3 minutes. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Saut onions and peppers in margarine. Mix all ingredients stirring gently. Pour into greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: White Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Sift salt baking powder and flour four times. Add flour and milk alternately. Beat well and add flavoring. Fold in well beaten egg whites. Put in greased and floured pan. Bake in moderate oven.

title: Easy Coconut Cake
instructions: Follow directions on cake box then add 1 package of the coconut and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Cook as directed. When cake is done punch holes in cake and pour the following on hot cake 1 can evaporated milk 1/2 cup confectioners sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla and enough water to make this mixture 2 cups liquid. After cake is completely cool spread the Cool Whip on top then sprinkle another package of coconut on top.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all together until just blended and turn into greased and lightly floured pan (14 x 8 x 2-inch). Bake about 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. Can be baked in loaf pan for 50 minutes. Pour over the sauce while hot.

title: Richmond Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch chocolate and salt. Add water; cook until mixture thickens. Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla. Spread on cake while hot for a glossy frosting which remains soft and smooth.

title: Norwegian Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage; add 2 cups water and salt. Let stand 2 hours and drain. Add celery and green pepper. Have the other ingredients cooked and cooled to pour over mixture. Boil 8 to 10 minutes. Cool cover and let stand at least 24 hours before using. Will keep good if stored in refrigerator.

title: Cheese 'N Chicken
instructions: Place boneless chicken in a baking dish. Put slices of Swiss/Mozzarella cheese on chicken. Spread 1 can of cream of chicken soup over chicken and cheese. Spread a small package of Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing over the entire mixture. Melt 2 sticks of margarine and drizzle over stuffing mixture.

title: Jello And Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix cottage cheese and dry Jell-O. Add drained pineapple and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Serves 16 to 20. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top.

title: Breakfast Rolls
instructions: Sprinkle pudding over rolls. Top with nuts. Blend butter sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil; cool. Pour over rolls. Let set at room temperature overnight. In A.M. bake for 25-30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pig Lickin' Cake
instructions: Mix together and beat well. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Dietetic Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream margarine with sugar substitute. Combine soda and applesauce; add to creamed mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into nonstick 7 x 11-inch baking pan. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven 40 to 50 minutes. When cake is cool cut into 15 equal slices. Each serving may be exchanged for 1 1/4 breads and 1 1/4 fats.

title: Low-Fat Chicken Salad
instructions: Boil chicken in large pot to disperse fat. Place whole pot in refrigerator overnight. The fat will congeal and can be removed with a kitchen knife or spatula. Remove meat from the bones; cut into 1-inch pieces. Place in bowl with about 3 tablespoons of nonfat mayonnaise and celery; mix with spices.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Mix butter sugar and eggs until creamy. Add flour 7-Up and flavoring; beat well. Bake in floured tube pan for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Jam-Pecan Scones
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt in medium bowl.
