Cut in chilled butter or margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add yogurt and stir until dry ingredients are moist. (Dough will be sticky.) Turn dough out onto floured surface. With floured hands form ball and knead 4 to 5 times. Spray or grease a baking sheet. Pat dough on baking sheet to 8-inch circle. Cut into 12 wedges cutting almost but not all the way through dough. Make small slit in each wedge and fill with 1 teaspoon jam. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar beat again then add Karo syrup salt vanilla and nuts. Place in uncooked crust and dot generously with butter. Cook about 10 minutes in hot oven at 425\u00b0 reduce heat to 325\u00b0. Continue cooking until done about 45 minutes.

title: Broccoli-Stuffed Shells
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Saute onions until tender but not brown. Cool. Cook shells in boiling water until tender.

title: Peanut Butter Flakes
instructions: Microwave or heat in a pot on the stove your peanut butter and butterscotch chips until melted. Mix in your Frosted Flakes (enough until all your mix is used and all your flakes are covered). Spoon out onto a cookie sheet and refrigerate until hardened then serve and eat.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in loaf pan and cover with tomato sauce. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cut flank into strips with the grain and at angles. Combine ingredients and soak meat overnight.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops in own fat. Place in Dutch oven or roaster. Cover with slices of onion green pepper and tomato soup. Cover and bake at oven temperature 350\u00b0; baking time for 1 hour.

title: Fried Chicken
instructions: Soak chicken in buttermilk salt and pepper for 30 minutes. Take out and roll in flour; fry until light brown. Place on rack; bake in low heated oven for 30 minutes.

title: Mississippi Mud Pie
instructions: For the crust mix together flour butter and pecans. Press into pie plate. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes. Set aside. For the first layer of filling mix together cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread on cooled crust. For the second layer of filling mix 2 boxes of instant chocolate pudding according to the directions on the box. Pour pudding on top of cream cheese mixture. Top pie with Cool Whip. Chill. Serves 8.

title: Curry Dressing For Steamed Cauliflower
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Pour over steamed cauliflower and serve. Good hot or cold.

title: Poor Man'S Stew
instructions: Fry meat onion and pepper together. Drain grease then add pork and beans. Heat about 10 to 15 minutes then serve.

title: Daddy'S Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into iron skillet or cake pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Place pot roast in slow cooker. Pour soup over roast and cook until done. This will make your gravy when done.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Chop all ingredients. Cool until tender. Pour into jars and heat seal while hot.

title: Very Low-Fat Banana Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly coat 2 (9-inch) loaf pans with nonstick cooking spray. Set aside. The recipe also will make 4 (3 1/2 x 2-inch) mini loaves.

title: Poke Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. When cake is done poke holes in cake and pour condensed milk over cake.

title: Margaret'S Icebox Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over sugar salt and shortening. Stir and let cool until lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water with teaspoon sugar. Let stand and work 10 minutes. Add yeast eggs and flour (1 cup at a time) to cooled mixture. Beat only until flour is worked into dough. Place in greased bowl and tightly cover with foil. Should chill at least 12 hours.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix together the first 6 ingredients. Make into small balls. Brown. Mix together last 2 ingredients. Alternate browned meatballs and sour cream mixture in casserole dish starting and ending with sauce. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0 or in crock-pot for 4 to 6 hours on low. Freezes well without sauce.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix. Roll into marble size balls. Freeze in a bowl. Bake in single layer while frozen at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Fruit De Mer(A La Lisa)
instructions: Dip fish in egg wash then dredge through flour coating well. Set aside on dish. In medium saucepan melt 1 1/2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Saute fruit until warm but not too soft about 3 to 4 minutes. Set aside. Take remaining butter and melt in separate pan over medium-high heat. Saute fish. Add salt and butter to taste. Fish will be golden brown on both sides. Put on plates. Re-warm the fruit and pour over fish. Top with Hollandaise Sauce.

title: Natilla(Cuban Custard)
instructions: In a bowl mix egg yolks with 1 cup milk. In another bowl mix cornstarch with another cup of milk then add the sugar and remaining milk. Strain the egg yolk mixture through a fine strainer into the cornstarch mixture and stir to combine well.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients well and pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. (Eggs should be at room temperature.)

title: Escalloped Corn
instructions: Butter a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle half of the corn in the bottom of dish. Sprinkle half of shredded cheeses over corn. Cover with half of croutons. Repeat with remaining corn cheeses and croutons (making 2 layers). Combine eggs milk salt and pepper. Pour over ingredients in baking dish. Press down gently; make sure croutons are moistened. Dot with butter. Bake 1 1/2 hours in 300\u00b0 oven or until golden brown and puffed.

title: Double Chocolate Drops(No Cholesterol; 40% Less Fat.)
instructions: Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray coating; set cookie sheet aside. In a large mixing bowl beat the margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add the brown sugar cocoa powder baking powder and baking soda. Beat until thoroughly combined scraping the sides of the bowl occasionally. Beat in the applesauce egg and vanilla. Beat in as much of the flour as you can with a mixer. Stir in any remaining flour with a wooden spoon. Stir in chocolate pieces. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on prepared cookie sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are light brown. Remove the cookies from the cookie sheet. Cool on a wire rack. In a small bowl stir together the powdered sugar and milk. Drizzle over the cookies. Store any leftover cookies in the freezer. Makes about 36 cookies.

title: Countryside Chicken Bake
instructions: Place rice in greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with combined vegetables and seasonings. Combine soup and salad dressing. Mix well. Add water gradually to soup mixture until well blended. Pour half of soup mixture over vegetables. Top with chicken then rest of soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and rice is cooked. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Mix all together and store in Tupperware. Use 1 1/2 teaspoons for a cup. Stores well. Good keeper.

title: Breakfast Bran Muffins
instructions: Grease muffin tins. Mix all together put in icebox. Use as needed. Batter will keep six weeks.

title: Spiced Cider
instructions: Tie spices loosely in a cheesecloth bag. Add sugar and spice bag to cider in large kettle. Bring slowly to a boil. Cook about 15 minutes then remove spices. Serve hot or chilled. A few slices of orange in punch bowl are very attractive.

title: Chicken Sweet 'N Sour
instructions: Cut chicken in 1/2-inch pieces. Brown in oil. Reduce heat to low; add onion. Cover; cook for 10 minutes. Add carrots and green pepper. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into skillet. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes longer. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Iced Banana Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar egg and flavoring and bananas. Beat well. Sift and add dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Makes 40 soft cookies.

title: Squash-Onion-Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix flour with margarine. Add salt and pepper. Stir in milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add cream cheese. Stir until smooth. Pour over squash rice and onions. Fold together until mixed well. Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Trifle Salad
instructions: Layer the ingredients beginning with the cake on the bottom (in the order they appear) in a large glass bowl. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Butterscotch Pies
instructions: Pour into baked pie shells when done.

title: Chicken Asparagus
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Spread chicken in pan. Top with asparagus. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Top with almonds the last few minutes of baking. Serves 8.

title: Turkey Sausage Patties
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Scoop out and form into patties. Coat with flour to hold together. Brown in 1 tablespoon shortening to golden brown and serve. Makes up to 8 patties.

title: Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown pork chops slowly but not too brown. Saute onion in grease where chops were cooked. In a large baking dish mix all ingredients together and lay pork chops on top. Cover tightly and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream fat sugar and vanilla (medium speed) 10 minutes. Add bananas and eggs. Mix (medium speed) 5 minutes. Add combined dry ingredients alternately with sour milk (low speed). Mix (medium speed). Bake.

title: Holiday Cherry Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 pan with butter flavored crisco. Chop 1/2 c. nuts coarsely for topping set aside. Chop remaining 1/2 c. finely. For crust combine flour and brown sugar cut in crisco until fine crumbs form. Add 1/2 c. finely chopped nuts and coconut. Mix well. Remove 1/2 c. mixture set aside. Press remaining crumbs in bottom of pan. Bake for 12-15 minutes until edges are lightly browned.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream margarine cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla then eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour small amounts at a time. Let mixer \go\ for several minutes. Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels sugar and butter. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 7 minutes and cool. Blend cream cheese and powdered sugar; beat until smooth. Add Cool Whip. Spread on cooled layer of crust.

title: Sugar-Free Chocolate Pudding Sandwiches
instructions: Mix pudding and milk 1 to 2 minutes. Gently stir in whipped topping and marshmallows. For each sandwich spread approximately 2 tablespoons of mixture onto each cracker half. Lightly push cookies together to form sandwich. Wrap each square in plastic wrap and freeze. Makes 22 sandwiches.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Mix blueberries 2 tablespoons flour lemon juice and sugar together. Pour into lightly greased pan. Mix 3/4 cup flour oats brown sugar salt vanilla and butter together. Pour over blueberry mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes.

title: Fruit Trifle
instructions: Cook pudding per package directions. Use milk and juice as cooking liquid. Cool. Save 1 tablespoon raisins for garnish. Stir remaining raisins and 3/4 carton whipped topping into pudding. Measure and drain 1/2 cup pineapple for garnish. Cut cake into chunks. Pour 1 cup pudding mixture into 3-quart glass bowl. Top with half each of cake jam remaining undrained pineapple undrained tropical fruit and pudding. Repeat layers. Chill 20 minutes or overnight. Spoon remaining whipped topping over trifle. Garnish with reserved pineapple raisins almonds and raspberries. Serves 12.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together and serve with your favorite fruits.

title: Crab Quiche
instructions: Spray large shallow baking dish with Pam. Mix ingredients in following order Bisquick milk mayonnaise eggs onions cheese mushrooms crab meat and salt and pepper to taste. Spoon into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until light brown on top. Let set before serving. Cut in squares and top with sour cream.

title: Lemon Basil Chicken
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients and whisk well until thoroughly blended. Add chicken breasts and marinate for 4 to 5 hours in the refrigerator. Chicken may be oven-broiled pan-broiled or grilled using the marinade mixture as a baste. Cook approximately 15 minutes or until a fork inserted into the thickest part releases a clear white fluid when withdrawn. Serves 2.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits For Two
instructions: Melt butter. Mix all ingredients and spoon into muffin tin. Bake at 400\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Sugarless Persimmon Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Beat Crisco sweetener and eggs together well. Add to dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in puree nuts and raisins. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place the apples water and cinnamon in a buttered casserole dish. Mix together the sugar flour and margarine and sprinkle the mixture over the apples. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until apples are soft. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Cinnamon Bundt Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix oil eggs and water. Beat 10 minutes (or longer). Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix nuts sugar cinnamon and vanilla. Stir in lightly as you would for a marble cake.

title: Three Flavor Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs one at a time. Add flour and milk. Add a pinch of salt. Add flavorings last. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Chip Blonde Brownies
instructions: Sift first 4 ingredients together. Add chopped nuts and set aside. In saucepan melt butter or shortening (if shortening add 1 teaspoon hot water). Add brown sugar and mix well. Cool slightly and add slightly beaten egg and vanilla. Blend then add flour mixture a small amount at a time. Spread in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 package chocolate chips on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool in pan then cut in bars. Will make 24 small bars.

title: Cauliflower Incognito
instructions: Break cauliflower into flowerets and cook in very little water until fork-tender. Mash it with a little of the water used for cooking. Add all the other ingredients and blend in a blender or whip with an electric beater until fluffy. Put the mixture in a casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Have fun while your guests wonder what this is!

title: Almond Custard
instructions: Combine cream and cinnamon in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove cinnamon. Add almond rose water and sugar. Beat egg and yolks together in separate pan. Place over low heat and add hot cream mixture stirring constantly. Continue cooking and stirring constantly until the custard coats a spoon. Stir in the brandy and chill.

title: Jessica'S Homemade Stew
instructions: Cut meats into 1/2-inch pieces and season to taste. Put meat into Crockpot or slow cooker. Fill with water and cook on low heat. Two hours later add tomatoes Picante sauce and steak sauce. Continue cooking on low heat. One hour before serving turn to high heat. Add the rest of the ingredients. Makes 6 quarts. Cooks 8 hours.

title: Kidney Bean Dinner
instructions: Mix beans and tomatoes. Simmer. Put 1/4 tablespoon margarine butter or lard in skillet. Add ground beef and onions. Cook until brown 10 minutes. Add water and cover. Add green pepper (cut fine) to beans and tomatoes. Add browned meat and onions. Simmer for half an hour. Add tomato soup and stir well.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Sift flour sugar salt and spices into mixing bowl. Add oil and buttermilk. Mix and add eggs; dissolve soda in mashed prunes and fold into batter. Mix in nuts and vanilla. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven in tube pans about 45 minutes or 2 (9-inch) layer pans for 30 to 35 minutes or until tested done. Pans are to be greased and floured. Frost with Raisin Pecan Frosting.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add 1 egg at a time. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt. Gradually add flour and buttermilk alternately. Blend in melted chocolate. Add vanilla. Bake 3 layers at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Scalloped Hash Brown Potatoes
instructions: Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Wassail
instructions: Simmer all ingredients for 20 minutes. Remove spices and serve hot. I usually halve this recipe and it fits in the crock-pot. This is great to make for the holidays and the aroma is wonderful!

title: Marinated Mushrooms
instructions: Combine last 8 ingredients and pour over mushrooms. Let set several hours turning occasionally. Drain and serve.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Add cornmeal while stirring to the boiling water. Cook 20 minutes. Stir often to prevent lumping. Saute ground beef in 2 tablespoons oil (Mexicans would use lard). Add tomatoes olives onions and seasonings. Put half the cornmeal in the bottom of a 2-quart buttered casserole. Spread meat mixture on top. Cover with the rest of the cornmeal mush. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine syrup sugar and margarine. Let it come to a boil. Add peanuts and cook until it turns brown then add soda. Stir and pour into buttered flat pan. Let cool then break.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients. Crush potato chips and sprinkle on top. Cook uncovered 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dinner Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand until bubbly.

title: Dream Pie
instructions: Beat whipped topping mix with 1 cup milk and the vanilla using large mixer bowl; beat at high with electric mixer about 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks. Add remaining milk and the pie filling mix; blend at low. Beat at high for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spoon into pie shell. Chill at least 4 hours.

title: Coconut Cream Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Bake cake per instructions on box. Then cool cake and poke holes in the cake. Pour Eagle Brand milk all over top of cake and then cool cake. Spread Cool Whip on the top of cake and sprinkle coconut on top of Cool Whip.

title: Homemade Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in pan in oven while oven preheats to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar milk flour and vanilla in bowl. Once butter has melted pour mixture in pan. Spoon fruit around in middle of pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until golden brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Herb Chicken With Lemon
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except chicken and lemon slices. Pour over chicken breasts; bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Garnish with lemon slices. Goes nicely with Near East rice pilaf and/or vegetables.

title: Delicious Fruit Frappe
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

title: Souper Spud Casserole
instructions: Mix hash browns sour cream grated cheese and soup and pour into 9 x 13 buttered pan. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add flavor and sugar; mix well. Spread on cake. Sprinkle nuts. Makes 3 layer or sheet cake.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake cake as directed on package. While still warm cut or break into 1 to 2-inch squares. Arrange half of pieces in a 3-quart serving bowl. Spoon one package prepared pudding over the pieces. Cover with half of whipped topping. Sprinkle with Heath chips. Repeat. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.

title: Dutch Spinach Salad
instructions: In a small frying pan cook bacon until crisp; do not drain. In a 1 cup measure place egg sugar vinegar and enough water to make 3/4 cup. Pour over bacon and grease. Cook stirring constantly until dressing thickens. Season to taste. Pour the hot dressing over greens and onion. Toss. Garnish with egg slices. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Arrange broccoli in large baking dish. Combine soup chicken and mayonnaise; pour over broccoli. Mix crumbs and cheese together; sprinkle on top. Bake 40 minutes at 375\u00b0 until bubbly. You can serve over rice.

title: Barbecue Biscuit Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Brown beef and onions. Drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients and cook until bubbly. Pour into a 2-quart casserole and bake 15 minutes. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Take casserole from oven and place cut side of biscuits on top of the casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Canned Peach Pie
instructions: Mix together sugar salt spices and flour. Lightly combine with peaches. Fill pastry lined pie pan. Melt butter and lemon juice. Drizzle over pie filling. Adjust top crust; vent with fork prongs on top of crust. Seal edges of crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crust is nicely browned. Cool before slicing.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain. Cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers leaving 1/4-inch shell. Chop center portion; set aside.

title: Tandoori Chicken(Serves 10 People)
instructions: Skin the chicken pieces and score them deeply. Mix thoroughly chili and curry powder tomato paste salt and yogurt. Marinate chicken pieces in the mixture for four to five hours. (If desired this can be marinated in the refrigerator overnight.) Arrange the chicken pieces in the baking pan and pour the remaining excess marinade over chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes occasionally basting. Drain well; brush melted butter and grill or broil for 5 minutes. Delicious Tandoori Chicken is ready!

title: Delicious Beef And Rice
instructions: Brown ground meat with rice and onion in oil in skillet stirring until crumbly. Add remaining ingredients except cheese with 1 1/2 cups of boiling water. Bake covered for 1 hour. Top with cheese. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

title: Messy Hanks
instructions: In a small bowl combine onion soup mix chili sauce grape jelly and water. In skillet brown ground beef with green pepper over medium-high heat; drain. Stir in soup mixture. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer stirring occasionally 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve on rolls. Makes 6 servings.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Preheat griddle to 350\u00b0. Beat together egg milk and oil. Add dry ingredients to liquid and stir just until mixed. Do not overmix! A few small lumps are okay. Spray griddle with Pam oil or margarine. Pour batter onto griddle with 1/4 cup measuring cup. Cook until bubbles come to surface and the edges are dry. Turn over to brown other side. Makes about 15 (5-inch) pancakes.

title: Quick Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Fry onions and garlic in oil and butter until tender. Add 1 pound of hamburger. Add package of spaghetti sauce mix. Stir good. Add can of sliced mushrooms and juice tomato soup and mushroom soup. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Salt to taste.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and oatmeal beat well. Add flour soda salt and blend. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Dip in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Saute onions and garlic in oil over medium heat. Stir in eggplant zucchini peppers basil and parsley. Reduce heat and cook uncovered stirring occasionally for 30 minutes. Add 4 tomatoes and stir to blend. Cook 15 minutes more uncovered until eggplant is very tender. Season to taste. Serve hot or at room temperature. Garnish with the remaining tomato. Can refrigerate covered up to 1 week.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Bar
instructions: Beat the eggs. Gradually beat in the brown sugar. Stir in the melted butter and vanilla. Sift together and add the flour baking powder and salt. Add the chocolate chips. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle top with granulated sugar then with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until done. Dont overbake. Leave in pan. Cut.

title: Sauerkraut Kielbasi
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove from pan. Add onion to drippings and brown. Put tomatoes and sugar in and boil a few minutes. Add sauerkraut sliced kielbasa and crumbled bacon strips. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook 20 minutes or until done.

title: My Mom'S Dill Pickles
instructions: Bring to boil vinegar water sugar salt and alum then cool. In bottom of jar put the dill heads onion and garlic. Put large cucumbers quartered and sliced lengthways packed in jar. Put 4 more heads of dill and onion on top and put cooled brine over them. Put in refrigerator. Ready in 5 days. Keeps 4 to 5 months.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; put in loaf pan. Mix ketchup and water; pour over the top. Top with bacon if you prefer. Bake at 400\u00b0 until done.

title: Broccoli And Rice
instructions: Mix all together and place in greased dish; bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Saute celery and onion in butter. Add remaining ingredients. Add to cooked noodles and chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 long enough to brown. Makes 20 servings.

title: Praline Grahams
instructions: Separate each graham cracker into 4 sections. Arrange in a jelly roll pan with edges touching. Melt butter in a saucepan; stir in sugar and pecans. Bring to a boil; cook 3 minutes stirring frequently. Spread mixture evenly over graham crackers. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool on wax paper. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans. Line bottom of pans with waxed paper. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In medium bowl combine flour sugar baking soda salt and baking powder; blend well. Set aside. In large bowl combine remaining cake ingredients; add dry ingredients. Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at highest speed. Pour batter into prepared pans. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely.

title: Tea Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add next 4 ingredients. Add flour and mix well. Roll in tiny balls; press thumb in center and fill with preserves cherries jam jelly nuts or chocolate chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Pie
instructions: Cook rice in salted water until soft. Stir in butter and all ingredients including cooked shrimp. Add enough milk to make mixture a thick custard. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown on top approximately 30 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Mix well and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Herbed Chicken En Casserole
instructions: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper. Brown chicken slowly in margarine or butter in a skillet (frying pan). Arrange browned chicken skin side up in 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch or similar size baking dish. For the sauce add soup to drippings in skillet. Slowly add sauterne stirring smooth. Add the remaining ingredients and heat to boiling. Pour sauce over chicken. Cover with foil or a cover and bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 25 to 35 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve with hot fluffy rice if desired. Makes six individual servings.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix sugar graham crackers peanut butter and nuts. Blend real good. Blend in hot butter. Shape into tight balls. Dip into chocolate chips and paraffin wax melted over hot water in double boiler. Use toothpicks to hold the balls for dipping. Place on waxed paper until firm.

title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: In double boiler mix dry ingredients. Sift flour and cocoa. Add to sugar. Mix together Pet milk and egg yolks. Gradually stir into dry ingredients. Add butter. Cook until the mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Pour into a baked pie crust. Prepare egg whites. Beat 1 teaspoon sugar per egg white until the egg whites peak. Spoon onto pie mixture. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven until egg whites brown.

title: Lemon Bonbons
instructions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix with mixer. Use ungreased cookie sheet. Make small balls and bake at 350\u00b0 only 10 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar. Makes approximately 100 cookies.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Cook zucchini in water until tender. Strain. In large bowl beat eggs. Stir in mayonnaise onion green pepper cheese salt and pepper. Add zucchini. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Combine oleo peanut butter; add both sugars and cream together. Sift flour and soda together and work into creamed mixture. Form into balls roll in sugar. Place 1 inch apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Top each with a kiss pressing down firmly.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: *If using sour milk add 1 tablespoon vinegar to 1 cup milk.

title: Brunch Bread
instructions: Sift baking powder salt sugar and flour together; add eggs and mix thoroughly. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 bread pans for 50 to 60 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
instructions: Bring to a boil the pineapple sugar and lemon juice. Soak the gelatine in 1 cup of water. Add to hot pineapple mixture. Cool until it thickens and add the cream pecans and cheese. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Serve on lettuce leaf.

title: Cobbler
instructions: Put all butter into 13 x 9 pan. Melt at 350\u00b0. Mix together flour sugar and salt; stir in milk and vanilla until mixed. Remove pan from oven and pour mixture into it. Spoon fruit evenly over batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Really Fast Fudge
instructions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish stir sugar cocoa salt milk and vanilla together until partially blended. Put butter in center of mixture. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir until smooth. If all butter has not melted it will as the mixture is stirred. Blend in nuts. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan lined with wax paper. Chill for 1 hour in refrigerator.

title: Lone Star Barbecue
instructions: Cook meat until tender and pull apart into small pieces. Mix together all other ingredients and simmer about 15 minutes. Add meat and simmer 15 to 30 minutes. You may freeze this too. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix Veg-All onions water chestnuts mayonnaise and celery. Mix melted butter with Ritz cracker crumbs; put cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Molasses Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook first 4 ingredients to a hard crack stage 260\u00b0. Add popped corn and stir with a strong wooden mixing spoon quickly. Butter hands frequently; form corn into balls and lay on waxed paper. Cool.

title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
instructions: Dice ham cheese and green pepper. Add uncooked noodles and rest of ingredients. Pour into greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix ingredients. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Sprinkle corn flakes on top. Bake for 1/2 hour until hot at 350\u00b0.

title: Rum Praline Cake
instructions: Sprinkle the pecans in bottom of greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan.\tIn large mixer bowl combine cake mix pudding mix eggs the 3/4 cup water oil and the 1/4 cup rum. Blend well. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into prepared pan.\tBake in 325\u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Invert on serving plate. Prick cake with long-tined fork.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix well. Tastes better if made the night before.

title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie(Meat-Free Dish)
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Thaw vegetables in microwave; drain. Grease a 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Put prepared vegetables onions bell peppers and cheese in pie plate; mix lightly. Beat remaining ingredients in mixing bowl for 1 minute with hand mixer then pour over vegetables evenly. Bake in oven until golden brown for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into wedges. Makes 4 to 8 servings. Preparation time 1 hour.

title: Ann'S Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook potatoes and mash as usual. Mix mashed potatoes with cream cheese and sour cream. Add salt garlic salt and onion salt to taste. Bake covered for 1/2 to 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0. Sprinkle paprika if desired or grate cheese on top.

title: Lavosh
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with dough hook until all is incorporated. Place dough on floured sheet pan. Chill and rest dough at least 3 hours. The dough needs to be firm and cold to roll. Prepare garnish in pan. Cover dough with garnish. Roll floured dough until paper thin. Cut and place on dry sheet pan. Brush excess flour off and cut into desired serving size. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp and golden brown. Best served warm with butter.

title: Honey Baked Ham
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham and shake or blend until well mixed. Line roaster pan with enough foil to completely cover the ham. If possible preslice ham then place in the foil. Pour mixture over ham. Finish wrapping ham in foil. Marinate overnight if possible. Cook ham as directed or at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour for each pound.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine 1 cup sugar flour and salt in a large saucepan. Blend in 2 cups of the milk. Heat over moderate heat stirring often to prevent scalding. Beat egg yolks into remaining 2 cups of milk and stir into hot milk mixture. Cook and stir until mixture thickens. Add margarine and vanilla. Cool completely.

title: Lemon Pudding Dessert
instructions: In a bowl cut butter into flour until crumbly. Press into ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 22 minutes. Cool. In mixing bowl beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth. Fold in 1 cup of Cool Whip. Spread this over cooled crust. In mixing bowl beat milk and pudding mixes on low speed for 2 minutes. Carefully spread over cream cheese layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. (Can use any kind of pudding.)

title: Honey-Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Add milk oil egg and honey to combined remaining ingredients mixing just until moistened. Fill 12 greased or paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake in preheated hot oven at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Caramel Bars
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients and pat 3/4 of it into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Double Good Fudge
instructions: Coat a 9-inch square pan with cooking spray. Line bottom of pan with wax paper; coat with cooking spray. Set pan aside.

title: Horseradish Pot Roast
instructions: Stir together flour 1 tablespoon plus 2 teaspoons salt and pepper. Rub mixture on meat. Melt shortening in large skillet; brown meat over medium heat about 15 minutes; reduce heat. Spread horseradish on both sides of meat. Add water. Cover tightly and simmer on top of stove or in oven at 325\u00b0 for 4 hours or until tender. About 1 hour before done add vegetables and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Roll out crescent rolls onto rectangle cookie sheet. Press perforated edges together with your fingertips. Flatten with a rolling pin to fit the pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown. Cool.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice from both cans and save. Pour pudding mix in a bowl and use all of pineapple and about 1/2 fruit cocktail juice to mix with pudding. Add all of fruit and toss to coat. Chill before serving.

title: Terry'S Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes; drain good. Mix remaining ingredients and broccoli. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Cover with Ritz cracker crumbs; dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 8 to 12 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Speedy Enchiladas
instructions: Brown beef and mix the corn beans tomatoes and soup together. Place shells in a pan and put 1 scoop in the shell and roll. Place the cheese on top. Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Easy Buffalo Wings
instructions: Put your dressing in shallow dessert bowls (good for dipping) and put it in the refrigerator. (Its got to be cold.) Cut your chicken wings into the two main pieces and throw the third little piece away. Fry these (no batter).

title: Cocktail Sandwiches
instructions: Drop on rye party bread. Put on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes then eat or put on cookie sheet and freeze for later date.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Crust Melt margarine with flour; press into pan and add some nuts on top. Press in. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown; cool completely.

title: Apple Macaroon Dessert
instructions: Slice apples thinly into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Then sprinkle coconut and nuts over apples. Cream shortening butter sugar and egg until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Stir in flour. Spread batter evenly over apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 to 35 minutes or until done. May be served with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Freezer Blueberry Bread
instructions: Sift flour with baking soda baking powder and salt. Cream shortening until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in sugar. Stir in eggs milk lemon juice and pineapple. Beat in dry ingredients. Fold in blueberries nuts and coconut.

title: Have Ready Casserole
instructions: *Green peppers may be substituted.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine rice 2 cups milk salt cinnamon nutmeg sugar and raisins. Bring to boil; stir. Reduce heat; boil slowly 10 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts. Bone skin and cut in bite size pieces. Cook the broccoli in the chicken broth. Drain. Heat soups and mayonnaise in saucepan. Layer soup mixture chicken and broccoli. Repeat layers. End with soup mixture. Top with stuffing mix. Drizzle oleo over entire casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crumb topping is golden brown. You can make a day ahead and refrigerate. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Broccoli Lasagna
instructions: Melt margarine in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Stir flour milk onions salt mustard and thyme; cook stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Reduce heat to low. Add Monterey Jack cheese. Cook sauce about 1 minute until cheese is melted. In an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish layer starting with 1/3 of sauce on the bottom and alternate noodles broccoli cheese and sauce making 2 layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Puto Mays(Rice Balls - Philippines Dessert)
instructions: Cook rice according to the package. Form rice into a ball about the size of regular meat balls. Then roll rice in sugar. Then roll it again in Bakers coconut flakes. Serve.

title: White Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring margarine and water to a boil. Add flour sugar soda salt sour cream eggs and almond extract. Beat well and pour into a greased and floured sheet cake pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Snowballs
instructions: Make large snowballs with the vanilla ice cream. Roll quickly in the minced nuts and serve with the butterscotch topping.

title: Apple Fritters
instructions: Heat 2 or 3 inches of shortening in heavy skillet or deep fryer. Combine egg and milk in larger bowl. Stir in one tablespoon of melted shortening. Add apple or pineapple. Combine flour granulated sugar baking powder and salt. Add to egg mixture stir just until mixed. Drop by tablespoon into shortening. Fry for 4 minutes or until golden brown. Remove drain on paper towels. Combine confectioners sugar and cinnamon sugar in small bowl. Roll fritters in mixture. Serve warm.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl combine 3/4 cup sugar flour and 3 tablespoons cocoa. Blend in milk melted margarine and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

title: Husband'S Delight
instructions: Mix the cream cheese sour cream and onions; set aside. Brown meat. Add tomato sauce sugar salt pepper and Worcestershire. Cook noodles according to package directions.

title: Plain Ole' Potato Salad
instructions: Boil and peel 12 eggs. While eggs are boiling bake 5 pounds of potatoes in microwave. While potatoes are baking chop onion and put in large bowl. Chop bell pepper and celery and add. Put in remaining ingredients. After potatoes are baked peel and add to bowl. Add eggs. Serves 15 to 20 people.

title: Cottage Cheese Puff
instructions: Combine cottage cheese bread crumbs flour 1/3 cup parsley onion butter and salt. Beat eggs for 5 minutes. Pour cottage cheese mix over eggs and fold to combine. Pour mix in ungreased 5 to 6-cup souffle casserole dish. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until knife comes out clean.

title: Baked Chicken Reuben
instructions: In greased pan place chicken and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place sauerkraut over chicken and top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese.

title: Cookie Sheet Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix in one bowl flour sugar and salt; set aside. Bring to boil water margarine and cocoa and pour over first mixture. Stir well and add eggs. Beat after each addition. Add soda dissolved in buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well; pour in pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured cookie sheet.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Place in baking dish. Cover with chow mein noodles. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve hot.

title: Pauline Wertz'S Dixie Dinner Rolls
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar. Add the package of yeast and let dissolve. Now combine with the softened margarine and 3/4 cup warm water. Add the two beaten eggs 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt. Mix well making a soft dough. Add more flour (1/4 cup) if necessary. Grease a bowl and put the dough into it. Grease the top and cover with wax paper. Refrigerate the dough until three to four hours before serving. Roll out 1/4 of the dough at a time. Cut into eight pie-shaped wedges. Roll up tightly beginning at wide end. Let rise 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. Dough can be kept in the refrigerator for three to four days. Makes 32 rolls.

title: Zesty 3 - Bean Salad
instructions: About 30 minutes before serving or early in day

title: Caspar Fish
instructions: Adjust recipe accordingly. Roll out crackers until fine. Beat eggs in flat bowl; mix in Lawrys for seasoning. Put flour on plate. Place crackers on plate. Take fillets and cover with flour. Dip in eggs until covered and bread with crackers. Place in medium-high oiled frypan turning when golden brown. When both sides are golden put fillets on paper towel to drain.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
instructions: Cut squash in halves and discard the seeds. Arrange the halves cut side up in a baking sheet. Place 1/2 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon butter in each half. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until squash is tender.

title: Six Cup Salad
instructions: Stir together and refrigerate.

title: Frozen Cucumbers
instructions: Prepare first 3 ingredients and refrigerate in covered container for 24 hours. Drain. Add sugar and vinegar and let stand in refrigerator again for 24 hours. Then put in freezer containers and freeze. These stay crisp and are very good.

title: Chicken Croquettes
instructions: Boil chicken (with seasoning if desired). Cut chicken into small pieces. Mix in bowl the cream cheese chicken pieces onions to taste and spinach. Unroll crescent rolls and make chicken mixture into balls. Roll into crescent rolls and bake on cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown. Mix can of soup with 1/2 can of milk. Heat and use as gravy.

title: Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add onion bell pepper. Cook egg noodles. Mix all ingredients together and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fran'S Chicken Liver Pate
instructions: Put onion garlic and egg in blender. Cover and process for 1 minute at high speed. Add chicken livers; cover and blend for 2 minutes or until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; cover and blend at high speed 2 more minutes until smooth. Pour into well-buttered 2-cup souffle dish; cover with foil. Set in pan of hot water. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0. Remove foil; cool. Cover and chill overnight.

title: Maw'S Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and cucumber. Chop tomato into small pieces. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Pork And Peas
instructions: Brown pork. Add bay leaves and simmer about 5 minutes. Add tomato sauce pimento mushrooms and garlic powder. Cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add frozen peas; cook for 5 more minutes and serve.

title: Butterfinger Pie
instructions: Mix Cool Whip with crushed Butterfingers. Pour in pie shell and enjoy. Has to be kept in refrigerator until serving time.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Store in tight container until ready to use.

title: Italian Beef And Noodles
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes. Cook noodles. Mix sour cream cream cheese and onions together and add to noodles. In large casserole dish arrange layers of meat mixture noodle mixture and Cheddar cheese. Repeat layers. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly. May be frozen. Serves 8.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: *I use Hersheys Skor English toffee bits and chopped nuts.

title: Polka Dotters Cake
instructions: Mix dates and water. Cook on stove until soft (cooled). Beat until creamy soft butter sugar and eggs. Sift flour and soda and stir in gradually. Stir in date mixture vanilla and chocolate chips.

title: Pea Soup
instructions: Rinse peas (sort over first so there are no small stones etc. to break a tooth on). Heat peas and 8 cups water in large pot to boiling. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 1 hour. Stir onion salt and pepper into peas. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until peas are tender about 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Skim fat if necessary. (I trim most fat off before cooking.)

title: Fruit Delight
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Double recipe bake for 40 to 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Tabbouleh(A Middle Eastern Salad)
instructions: Rinse burghul well; drain and place in a large bowl. Add all chopped vegetables and mix well. Add oil lemon juice salt and pepper. Allow burghul mixture to set about 1 hour so juice will be absorbed by wheat. Serve on fresh green lettuce with Pita bread.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Crisp Onion-Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In shallow baking pan thoroughly blend all ingredients except potatoes. (It is possible to do these with less oil and margarine than the recipe calls for. I use only enough to coat the bottom of the pan Im using.) Add potatoes and turn to coat. Bake turning occasionally 60 minutes (usually less) or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish if desired with parsley. Makes about 8 servings.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift all dry ingredients together and cut in Crisco. Add buttermilk and yeast. Mix and knead well. Roll out and cut biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 until done.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; add flour salt and nutmeg. Stir until smooth; add milk and cook on medium heat until thickened (stir constantly). Mix the next 8 ingredients together and add to white sauce. Pour into a baking dish. Mix cracker crumbs and butter; sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Shelly'S Lasagna
instructions: Saute onion in oil; then add hamburger meat and brown in skillet. Add spaghetti sauce and seasonings; simmer.

title: Raisin Bread
instructions: Mix raisins boiling water and soda together. Let set for 8 hours. Add next 5 ingredients to first 3 ingredients; mix well. Pour into 3 (1 pound) greased and floured cake loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn out on rack to cool.

title: Pasta Shells With Walnuts And Cream Cheese
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add crushed garlic and oregano and cook for 1 minute. Add butter and cream cheese chopped walnuts and salt and pepper to taste. Stir and leave to simmer gently for 5 minutes. Meanwhile cook pasta shells in boiling water for 10 minutes or until shells are tender but still firm. Drain thoroughly. Pour into warmed serving dish. Remove sauce from heat; add cream and stir. Pour over shells and toss to coat evenly. Garnish with walnut halves. Serve immediately with Parmesan cheese.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: In a large bowl stir together flour sugar cinnamon salt baking powder soda zucchini nuts and raisins. In another bowl beat eggs and oil. Pour over flour mixture and stir until moistened. Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes invert on rack turn top side up and cool completely. Doubles well.

title: Green Tomato Jam
instructions: Mix together all ingredients. Bring to a boil. Boil 10 minutes. Pack in jars and seal. Makes 3 pints.

title: Orange Frost Punch
instructions: Pour mixture into bowl. Beat with mixer until foamy. Pour in cups.

title: Peanut Butter Richies
instructions: Mix brown sugar peanut butter and margarine together. Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Mix milk and eggs; add to other mixture and mix well. Drop from spoon (dough should be the size of walnuts) on greased baking sheet about 3 inches apart. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar together thoroughly. Add egg yolks and mix well. Add Carnation milk and mix well. Bake in uncooked pie crust until filling is done then add meringue on top. Filling will turn light brown on top. May test for doneness with knife or toothpick. When it comes out clean the pie is done. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. You will need a cookie sheet with sides.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Melt one stick of butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread cherry pie filling on bottom of pan. Next spread chunk pineapple over pie filling. Spread dry cake mix over pie filling and chunk pineapple. Melt one stick of butter and sprinkle over dry cake mix. Add chopped nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool. Best if cold.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in water; add dressing mustard and horseradish. Pour mixture into a shallow pan. Chill in freezer until mixture is firm around the edges. It should be soft in center. Empty into bowl and beat until fluffy. Fold in rest of ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan for squares or large mold. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix together thoroughly butter sugar and vanilla. Sift together and stir in flour and salt. Mix in nuts. Chill dough. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet (cookies do not spread). Bake until set but not brown.

title: Russian Wedding Cakes
instructions: Cream margarine and add honey flour salt and vanilla. Mix well and add pecans. Form into small balls. Place on greased baking sheets. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still hot. Roll again in powdered sugar when cool.

title: Fruit 'N' Nut Cherry Pie
instructions: In a saucepan combine pie filling pineapple sugar cornstarch and food coloring (if desired); mix well. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Cool. Fold in bananas and nuts. Pour into pie shells. Chill for 2 to 3 hours. Garnish with whipped cream. Store in the refrigerator. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a good boil over medium heat. Pour into 1-quart casserole or individual dishes. Place plastic wrap directly on surface of hot pudding. Chill.

title: Spaghetti Pie
instructions: Cook spaghetti; drain. Stir butter and eggs into hot spaghetti. Add Parmesan cheese. Mix well. Form spaghetti mixture into crust in greased 10-inch pie plate. Spread cottage cheese on top of spaghetti. In skillet brown ground meat and onion until tender; drain off fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes paste sugar oregano and garlic salt; heat through. Turn mixture into spaghetti crust. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and bake until melted about 5 minutes.

title: Romany Creams
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add flour baking powder salt and coconut. Dissolve cocoa in boiling water and add. Place teaspoonfuls on greased baking tray. Bake in moderate oven for 6 minutes. Melt chocolate over boiling water or in a microwave oven at defrost. Spread between biscuits.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Skinny Soup
instructions: Let juice on all vegetables. Cook for 1 hour or until tender. Eat and enjoy no fat recipe.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix the cake mix 1 egg and the softened butter thoroughly. Press into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Outstanding Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Use beef lean pork or ribs. If you use a roast it will cook faster if cut in several pieces.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Cook the bacon until it is crisp and break up. Brown hamburger and onion. Add all other ingredients and all beans. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat stirring until butter melts. Remove from heat; whisk in sugar and vanilla. Pour over warm cake.

title: Lollipop Cookies
instructions: You will need 20 to 24 wooden sticks.

title: Chicken Marseilles
instructions: Cut breasts into fillets. Dip fillets into flour and fry in 1 to 2 tablespoons oil. Combine oil vinegar mustard and spices together. Warm and serve over the top of the chicken fillets. Garnish with lemon slices.

title: Egg Rolls
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Set aside. Finely chop onion. Finely chop celery. Finely chop cabbage. Cook onion celery and cabbage 15 minutes. Drain well. Cool. Add hamburger. Add black pepper. Add garlic powder. Add soy sauce. Mix real good. Put in wrappers. Wet edges. Roll up. Deep-fry at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes.

title: Mashed Potato Doughnut
instructions: Beat eggs then add sugar and mix well. Add potatoes baking powder salt shortening and vanilla; mix well. Alternate milk and sifted flour. Mix with fingertips on floured board and roll to 1/4-inch thick; cut and fry.

title: Swiss Tuna Noodle
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Heat soup and milk. Add cheese to soup and heat until cheese melts. Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Water Chestnuts Appetizers
instructions: Soak water chestnuts in soy sauce overnight. Roll in sugar and wrap in bacon. Broil until bacon is crisp. Can also be cooked in oven at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Snowball Cake
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add hot water. Add to sugar lemon juice and pineapple. Chill until thickened. Prepare 2 packages dessert topping mix according to directions on package (or use Cool Whip). Fold into pineapple gelatin mixture.

title: Zucchini Squares
instructions: Combine all ingredients except zucchini; beat well. Stir in zucchini. Pour mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 10 minutes. Cut into squares to serve. Yields 12 servings.

title: Special Chocolate Cremkles
instructions: Cream thoroughly sugar shortening and vanilla. Add eggs beating well then chocolate. Sift together dry ingredients. Blend in alternating with milk. Add nuts. Chill 3 hours.

title: Chili Con Carne With Tomatoes
instructions: Brown ground beef or vegeburger. Saute onions and green pepper until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except the kidney beans. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 2 hours. Stir occasionally or cook uncovered for 45 minutes. Stir in beans last 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Barbecue Sauce(Like Ridgewood'S)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bring to gentle boil for 2 minutes. Chill. Pour over chipped pork or beef.

title: Chocolate Mousse(Serves 6)
instructions: Over double boiler mix egg whites and sugar and dissolve sugar (whites should be warm not hot). Add a drop of lemon juice and whip whites to stiff peaks. Chop chocolate and melt over double boiler; cool slightly. Fold chocolate into egg whites. Whip heavy cream stiff. Fold in liqueur. Fold whipped cream into chocolate mix. Divide into 6 glasses. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Boil chicken and shred. Saute onion and garlic together. Simmer all ingredients together for 1 hour. Add beans. Heat until hot. Top with Monterey Jack cheese and tortilla chips.

title: Yuk Salad
instructions: Cut cauliflower in small pieces. Cut red apples and onions. Add dressing.

title: Sawdust Pie
instructions: Preheat oven. Combine sugar coconut pecans graham cracker crumbs and egg whites in bowl. Mix well but do not beat. Turn into unbaked pie shell. Bake until filling is set at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Do not overbake. Mix sliced bananas with whipped cream and spoon over each slice and serve.

title: Buttermilk Rosemary Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl combine the first 5 ingredients. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in buttermilk just until moistened (mixture will be dry). Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full; brush with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 13 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack. Serve warm. Yield 1 dozen.

title: Janie'S Lemon Bars
instructions: Sift 2 cups flour and powdered sugar together. Cut in margarine. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or lightly browned.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: In a large bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into crust. Refrigerate until chilled (at least 5 hours).

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix as indicated on box; set aside. Spray cake pan. Sprinkle coconut then pecans on bottom of pan. Pour in cake mix. Combine powdered sugar cream cheese and butter. Spread over cake mix. Bake for 1 hour.

title: Lime Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill for several hours. This has a tendency to become a little watery after a few days so eat up and enjoy.

title: Pickled Beans
instructions: Cook green beans until tender; drain and cool. Fill quart jars with beans (shake down beans as you fill jars). Add 1 tablespoon canning salt and 1 tablespoon vinegar to each quart jar. Fill with cold water. Seal and store in cool place.

title: The Impossible Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a blender. Pour into a 9-inch greased pie plate. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until custard is set.

title: Cream Chicken On Toast
instructions: Melt butter. Add flour and mix well. Cook several minutes over low heat. Pour in milk. Add sauce salt mushrooms and chicken. Serve over either muffins or toast.

title: Cinnamon-Apple Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Microwave Grease 1 1/2-quart casserole. Slice sweet potatoes and layer alternately with apples in prepared casserole. Mix orange juice brown sugar lemon juice salt and cinnamon. Pour over potatoes and apples. Dot with butter and sprinkle with nuts. Cover tightly with Saran Wrap turning back edge to vent. Microcook 100% power for 18 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender spooning sauce over and rotating casserole twice. Let stand covered 5 minutes before serving.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt butter in baking pan or dish. Mix together sugar flour and milk. After butter melts pour in mixture and then pour in peaches and stir together a little. Bake until done approximately 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Beat eggs and mix with cheese and sausage. Grease pan lightly. Place layer of crescent rolls in the bottom of the pan. Pour in sausage mixture. Then put layer of rolls on top. Brush lightly with margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Buckeyes
instructions: Mix ingredients with hands and shape into balls. Take 12 ounces of chocolate chips and paraffin and melt in double boiler. Roll balls in chocolate with a toothpick. Cool on waxed paper.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Rinse with cold water; drain well. Combine macaroni and next 7 ingredients; toss gently. Cover and chill.

title: Boiled Cake
instructions: Boil shortening sugar cold water and raisins for 10 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Sift together flour baking soda cinnamon cloves and salt. Add to cooled mixture. Mix thoroughly. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Use a cake tester for doneness. Bake in a well-greased and floured tube pan. One cup chopped nuts may be added.

title: White Loaf Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Mix the remaining ingredients together with the yeast mixture. Put into a well-greased loaf pan. Let rise for about 2 hours. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cilantro Corn Salad
instructions: Mix salad dressing yogurt cilantro and ground ginger. Add corn red pepper and jalapeno pepper; cover. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: German Christmas Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 8-inch square cake pan. Cream butter until soft then gradually add sugar creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks; blend well. Add flour gradually and mix thoroughly. Spoon one-half of this mixture into the prepared pan. Smooth surface and spread with jam then spoon the rest of mixture on top and pat down lightly to cover jam layer. Bake for 50 minutes. Makes 12 to 16 bars.

title: Polish Reuben Casserole
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients together. Layer cheese and bread crumbs on top. Dot with melted butter or oleo. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Basil Parmesan Marinade
instructions: In a food processor or blender add ingredients and pulse in short bursts until just combined. Marinate. Should have a bit of texture. This especially good with grilled tomatoes and onions. Wonderful.

title: Beverage
instructions: Mix all together and freeze. One-half recipe makes plenty. Fill glass 1/2 with slush and add Sprite.

title: Fran'S Ice Cream Surprise
instructions: Combine chocolate margarine milk sugar salt and vanilla. Bring to boil. Cook 4 minutes. Cool.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix powdered sugar peanut butter cream cheese and whipped topping until smooth. Pour in crust. Chill until set.

title: Quick Cobbler
instructions: Mix sugar flour milk and egg together in a bowl. Melt 1 stick of margarine in the pan you are going to cook in. Pour mixture into pan. Pour fruit into pan over dough. Do not stir! Place in oven and cook approximately one hour at 350\u00b0. Crust will rise to top while cooking.

title: Caramelized Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium-high heat. Add all onions leeks shallots garlic bay leaf sage and thyme. Cook until onions turn deep golden brown stirring frequently about 45 minutes. Add Madeira and bring to a boil scraping up browned bits. Boil until liquid is reduced by half about 10 minutes. Add stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until mixture is reduced to 8 cups about 2 hours.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes celery and onion with the water until tender. Stir and dissolve the chicken bouillon and butter in potatoes. Add salt and pepper. Mix flour and sour cream together and add to potatoes. Stir until thick. Serve with shredded cheese and bacon bits.

title: Jelly Roll Pan Cake
instructions: Mix together butter oil water and buttermilk. Bring to a boil. Add eggs vanilla sugar flour cocoa and chocolate pudding. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
instructions: Melt 1 stick oleo. Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan with crumbs and oleo (melted). Cream the cream cheese (softened to room temperature). Add confectioners sugar; mix well. Add Cool Whip. Spread over cookies. Mix chocolate and vanilla pudding mix with 3 cups milk. Beat until thick. Spread over cream cheese. Cover and let set 2 to 3 hours. Add 8 ounces Cool Whip. Sprinkle top with cookies saved. Let set overnight.

title: Marinated Bean Salad
instructions: Drain all canned vegetables. Rinse kidney beans. Chop peppers onions and pimento and combine in large carton with tight lid.

title: Bisquick Lasagne Squares
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in dish. Mix beef herbs paste and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Spoon evenly over top. Beat milk eggs Bisquick salt and pepper with wire whisk until smooth about 1 minute. Pour into dish. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean (30 to 35 minutes). Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

title: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
instructions: In a heavy saucepan over low heat melt morsels with sweetened condensed milk. Remove from heat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread evenly into wax paper-lined 8-inch square pan. Chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm. Turn fudge onto cutting board. Peel off paper and cut into squares. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add melted margarine sugar pineapple and coconut. Bake 40 minutes or until firm at 350\u00b0 in unbaked pie shell. Makes two (9-inch) pies.

title: Chicken With Rice
instructions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix together in bowl undiluted soups water and uncooked rice. Pour into baking dish over melted margarine. Mix well.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Cream the butter shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add strawberries and jello; beat well. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Add vanilla; beat well. Fold in egg whites. Turn into 3 lightly greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Frost.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown hamburger with chopped onion. Drain off grease. Add both cans of soup and water. Heat through. Add sour cream; stir in but do not boil. Serve over noodles rice baked potato or toast. This is quick and delicious!

title: Smoky Salmon Ball
instructions: Drain salmon; remove bones and flake with a fork. In medium bowl or processor combine cream cheese lemon juice onion horseradish liquid smoke and salt. Mix well. Gently mix in salmon and form into a ball. Wrap in plastic wrap; chill until firm about 1 hour or up to 2 days. Before serving combine pecans and parsley and coat salmon ball with mixture.

title: Onion Bread
instructions: Simmer onion soup in water about 10 minutes. In the meantime dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water and sugar. Take milk butter salt and sugar and mix with soup mixture. Add yeast when cool. Mix in not too stiff dough. Allow to rise. Form 2 long loaves on cookie sheet; slash top of loaves with shears. When light bake in 400\u00b0 oven for beginning and lower to 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Veal Paprika
instructions: Saute bacon pieces with veal shoulder or shank and onion until meat and onions are golden brown. Add canned chicken broth paprika and salt. Cover and simmer slowly until veal is tender about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Saute onion add ground beef garlic and spices. Simmer 15 minutes. Add tomatoes that have been mashed lightly and tomato paste. Simmer another 20 minutes. Cook noodles according to directions.

title: Heavenly Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk and cook exactly 5 minutes after coming to a boil. Pour over remaining ingredients which are not cooked. (I add Marshmallow Creme to the cooked mixture then pour over chocolates.) Mix ingredients well and pour into buttered pan. Let cool then cut into squares. Makes 7 to 7 1/2 pounds of delicious candy.

title: Best Cobbler Yet
instructions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine flour baking powder sugar and milk. Pour over melted margarine. Pour prepared fruit over flour mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish. Microwave 20 minutes stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: In a small bowl mix and cream the butter. Beat in whipping cream a little at a time. Beat in cheeses. (If done ahead chill; bring to room temperature to serve.) Toss with cooked hot noodles. Serve at once.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Melt all three ingredients in a double boiler. Dip each cherry (twice if desired) in chocolate.

title: Pepperoni Pinwheels
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Separate dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal. Place 8 pepperoni slices on each rectangle. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese. Starting at the shortest side tightly roll up each rectangle. Pinch to seal. Slice each roll into 4 equal slices. Pinch dough together on one side of each slice to seal. Place sealed side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve pinwheels with warm pizza sauce if desired or just eat as they come out of oven. Makes 16.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Blend salad dressing ketchup cream cheese onion lemon and chili powder well. Fold in shrimp and horseradish. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Italian Biscotti Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs. Add flavoring. Add flour baking powder and salt. Add more flour if needed to form 2 (2-inch) rolls the length of a cookie sheet. The dough will spread out as it bakes but not touch each other. Bake 30 minutes or until lightly brown in 350\u00b0 oven. Slice rolls into zwieback type cookies. Toast each side lightly. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

title: Carnation Meat Loaf
instructions: Makes 7 1/4 x 4 1/4 x 2 1/4-inch loaf. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Mix lightly but thoroughly to blend. Place in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake in moderate 375\u00b0 oven about 50 minutes. Let stand about 10 minutes. Slice to serve.

title: Frosted Sausage Potato Bake
instructions: Press sausage in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake 350 for 25 minutes. Spoon off excess fat. Frost with mashed potatoes. Top with Soup. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon over top. Bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Cranberry Apple Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 1 hour.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water. Add sugar salt and half of flour. Beat for 2 minutes with fork. Add shortening and half of flour. Mix until easy to handle. Knead until dough is smooth. Cover and let stand in warm place until double in size. Pat into pizza pan. Top with favorite toppings and bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: No Tear Meringue
instructions: Boil until clear. Let cool. Beat egg whites and stir the cooled mixture into the egg whites.

title: Barley Soup With Vegetables
instructions: Heat all ingredients to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until barley and vegetables are tender about 15 minutes.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice as directed on box. Mix the carrots celery onions eggs and bacon together with the rice. Add the soy sauce to taste.

title: Granny'S Preacher Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Line cookie sheet with waxed paper. Mix milk sugar and butter in medium saucepan. Heat to boiling and boil for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add cocoa oats nuts and vanilla. Stir to mix. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Bake 8 minutes. Cool on racks.

title: Praline Uniques
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Arrange Triscuits wafers in single layer trimming to fit if necessary on bottom of well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch baking pan. Set aside.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup - With No Cream
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in the oil with bay leaf until soft or in saucepan sprayed with Pam 3 to 4 minutes. Add broccoli potato and stock. Simmer gently covered 10 minutes when the broccoli should be tender but still bright green. Remove bay leaf and let cool a little. Puree in a blender (not totally smooth). Season to taste. Add lemon juice. May need reheating in clean pan before serving. Add a dollop of yogurt just before serving. Serves 4.

title: Oatmeal Scotchties
instructions: Combine flour baking soda salt and cinnamon in small bowl. Beat butter granulated sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla in large bowl. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in oats and morsels. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheets. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 7 to 8 minutes for chewy cookies 9 to 10 minutes for crisp cookies. Cool for 2 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool completely. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix white cake mix according to package directions. Blend together the lemon pie filling and pineapple juice. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. Pour the cake batter in and then pour the pie filling and juice mixture over the batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut into squares and serve with whipped cream.

title: Wacky Chocolate Cake
instructions: Sift sugar flour cocoa salt and baking soda together. Add vinegar oil water and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until done.

title: Cheese And Sausage Biscuit
instructions: Mix all together spoon onto pan. Put down just a little. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly brown.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Crush corn flakes and sprinkle over top. Melt margarine and pour over corn flakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Quick Blueberry Pie
instructions: Mix milk and lemon juice together until thickened. Pour in blueberries. Stir until all blueberries are covered with milk mixture. Pour into baked pie crust. Chill and serve.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Crumble cornbread; mix with melted butter. Cook squash with onion and green pepper. Mash squash. Add sour cream soup and sugar. Put 1/2 of cornbread mixture in the bottom of the pan. Add the squash mixture and the rest of cornbread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 or 40 minutes or until brown.

title: Egg Casserole
instructions: Place 6 slices bread in 9 x 3-inch greased pan. Mix milk salt and beaten eggs; set aside. Shred cheese and sprinkle over top of bread. Fry bacon to crisp stage; crumble over cheese layer. Add remaining 6 slices of bread. Pour egg mixture over all. Cover with foil; let stand overnight. Bake with foil or until almost done then remove to brown. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: *Can use low-fat sour cream and milk.

title: Garden-Style Chicken Salad
instructions: In a 2-quart saucepan in boiling water cook broccoli cauliflower and carrots 3 minutes; drain. In shallow baking dish arrange cooked vegetables tomatoes and chicken. In cup combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables and chicken. Cover; refrigerate until serving time at least 4 hours stirring occasionally. Makes 3 cups or 2 servings.

title: Kentucky Fried Chicken
instructions: Cover chicken with mixture of water and salt. Chill in bowl for at least 1 hour. Combine msg onion powder seasonal salt instant chicken broth and pepper in blender and mix well. Place mixture in bowl. Add flour and mix well.

title: Tabouli (Lebanese Salad)
instructions: Place wheat in bowl; cover with warm water and set aside until cool. Squeeze moisture out of wheat with hands. Toss with chopped vegetables salt lemon juice and olive oil. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Nebraska Shore Lunch
instructions: You will also need tinfoil.

title: Pasta And Sausage
instructions: Prepare macaroni according to package directions. In large skillet add oil and heat. Dice onions and cook about 2 minutes until tender. Add garlic. Cook additional minute until tender. Add cut up sausage. Cook about 7 minutes until sausage is hot. Remove all from skillet keep warm. Add cut up zucchini and bell peppers. Cook until tender. Place broccoli in colander and run under hot water until partially thawed. Drain. Add to skillet. Cook until broccoli is tender. Return sausage to skillet. Mix soup with 1/2 can of milk. Pour over ingredients in skillet and stir. Let heat thoroughly. Drain macaroni when done. Pour sausage mixture over macaroni and mix well. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Breaded Pork Chops - Italian Style
instructions: Trim pork chops; remove marrow and fat. Wash chops and pat dry. In bowl beat eggs and add spices. Add pork chops to egg mixture and mix well. Place bowl in freezer for 3 minutes (so egg coagulates on chops and bread crumbs stick better). Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 with grill in center. Remove chops from freezer; cover both sides with bread crumbs. Place in shallow baking pan sprayed with Pam and lightly spread with olive oil. Cook each side 20 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Brown hamburger and onion. Add salt and pepper. Set aside. Combine flour salt pepper oregano eggs and milk. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle lightly with cornmeal. Pour batter into pan. Sprinkle meat over and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Spread sauce over meat and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip cream cheese; blend in marshmallow cream. Add cherry juice to color. You can also add bits of fruit or nuts. Serve as dip for fresh cut up fruit tray.

title: Great Grandmother'S Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and chill several hours before rolling out. Cut and sprinkle with sugar before baking. Bake in a moderate 375\u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Grandma'S Chicken Soup
