instructions: Cook the chicken in water and broth along with all other ingredients. Simmer approximately 2 to 2 1/2 hours adding water as necessary. Let cool and strain. (At this point you may freeze about 2 cups of mixture for future use.) Bone the chicken and refrigerate with remaining broth.

title: Chocolate Mint Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix and pudding mix. Add eggs water and oil; mix well. Add flavoring and coloring; mix. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into a 9x13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not underbake.

title: Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jello in boiling water add pineapple let stand in refrigerator until it begins to get firm. Remove and beat with mixer or by hand. Add the rest of the ingredients and put into mold. When firm you may place on lettuce leaves. This makes a delicious and large amount.

title: Light Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic; saute 1 minute. Stir in flour. Gradually add milk stirring with a wire whisk until blended; cook 8 minutes or until thickened and bubbly stirring constantly. Stir in cream cheese; cook 2 minutes. Add 1 cup Parmesan cheese stirring constantly until it melts. Pour over hot cooked fettuccine; toss well to coat. Top with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese fresh parsley and pepper. Yield 4 servings (serving size 1 cup).

title: Leek Soup
instructions: Cook all vegetables in water or broth to cover. Season with salt and pepper. When vegetables are tender put them through the blender with the liquid. Blend until smooth. Add 1/2 cup sour cream (optional) and serve hot.

title: Quiche Provencale
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat saute onion green pepper and mushrooms in oil. Cook spinach by directions on package; drain well. Beat together eggs flour and milk until well blended. Add vegetables garlic salt basil and pepper. Spread bacon and grated cheese over pie shell in pan. Pour other ingredients over cheese and bacon. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven until knife inserted near center comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients except milk. Pour into ice cream freezer. Fill the rest of freezer with milk. Freeze according to your freezers instructions.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: Cook potatoes onion and celery in water until tender. Add seasonings and 2 1/2 cups milk. Blend flour with remaining 1/2 cup milk until smooth. Add to potato mixture and bring to boiling point. Cook about 5 minutes. Blend in sour cream and butter. Add ham. Heat thoroughly and serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Stir in flour and add remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook pie crust and pour mixture in them. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake until cheese melts.

title: Beef Burritos
instructions: Brown steak in oil in large saucepan; stir in beans 1 cup tomatoes 1 cup onion and Worcestershire sauce. Cook stirring occasionally for 10 minutes.

title: French Toast
instructions: Mix together thoroughly and dip diet bread on both sides into mixture. Heat nonstick skillet with 1 teaspoon oil and place dipped bread inside. Brown on both sides. (You can use canola spray instead of oil if you choose.) Sprinkle with Hi-Energy Vanilla Supplement lightly on top and serve. Makes 1 serving.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Microwave margarine in 4-quart microwave-safe bowl on High 1 minute or until melted. Add sugar and milk; mix well. Microwave on High 5 minutes or until mixture begins to boil stirring after 3 minutes. Mix well. Scrape bowl. Continue microwaving 5 1/2 minutes; stir after 3 minutes. Stir in chips until melted. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased 9-inch square or 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Beat sugar oil and eggs together. Add flour. Add vanilla pecans coconut and apples. Bake in tube pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Grease pan if desired.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Put half in bottom of pan. Mix 1 cup brown sugar and 3 teaspoons cinnamon; sprinkle half of sugar over mix. Put rest of mix then rest of sugar. Take knife and run through batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch greased and floured pan.

title: Cheese Sausage Squares
instructions: Add sausage to eggs and 2 cups cheese. Line an 8 x 12-inch baking dish with 1 package rolls. Spread sausage mixture on top. Place another package of rolls on top of sausage mixture. Melt butter and spread on top of rolls. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Follow baking directions on package of rolls. Cut in squares.

title: Doughnuts Number 1
instructions: Knead and shape with doughnut cutter. Drop into very hot oil. I cook mine at 375\u00b0. This is a very old recipe.

title: Hearty Tuna Casserole(Microwave)
instructions: Drain and flake tuna. Set aside. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse in hot water. Combine noodles with tuna celery and green onion. Blend in the sour cream mustard mayonnaise thyme and salt. Spoon half the mixture into a buttered 2-quart casserole. Top with half the zucchini. Repeat layers. Cover. Microwave at High for 6 to 8 minutes. Top with cheese and tomato. Microwave at High for 2 minutes; let stand for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Western Sandwiches
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; divide into four portions and drop into hot frypan. Flatten with spatula; turn when brown. When other side is brown remove from frypan and put on bun or bread slices. Great with ketchup.

title: Crab Bisque Or Oyster Bisque
instructions: Remove cartilage from crabmeat if making crab soup or put oysters with liqueur in small pan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: In a large saucepan bring the butter water and cocoa to a boil. Remove from the heat. Combine the flour sugar baking soda and salt; add to cocoa mixture. Stir in the sour cream until smooth. Pour into a greased 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.

title: Ham And Potato Casserole
instructions: Butter 2-quart casserole. Add cubed ham cheese sauteed onion and butter; stir. Then mix flour and milk and heat. Pour over potato and ham mixture; salt and pepper to taste. Stir thoroughly; sprinkle lightly with bread crumbs (Italian flavored are best). Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Lemon Chess Bars
instructions: Grease and flour 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Mix and press into pan.

title: Zucchini Babka
instructions: Baking Temperature 350\u00b0. Baking Time 45 minutes.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Mix in pan the gelatin and boiling water until dissolved. Add undrained pineapple and blueberry pie filling. Stir and let set.

title: Italian Bread
instructions: Place 1/2 cup warm water in large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved. Add remaining water salt and 2 cups flour; blend well. Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic about 6 to 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm draft-free place until doubled in size about 20 minutes. Punch dough down. Remove dough to lightly floured surface; divide in half. Roll each half to 12 inch circle. Roll each circle tightly as for jelly roll to make loaf. Pinch seams and ends to seal; taper ends by gently rolling. Place loaves seam side down on greased baking sheet. cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in size about 20 to 40 minutes lightly dust with flour. With sharp knife make diagonal slashes across top of each. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Turnip Greens
instructions: Fill pressure cooker with greens and half water. Steam 5 to 10 minutes with meat (until tender). Add molasses. Continue to cook until liquid reduces.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill about 2 hours.

title: Tina'S Pasta Salad
instructions: *I marinate my own artichoke hearts (overnight) with oregano basil and sliced purple onion and lots of Bernsteins dressing and add all this to salad.

title: Stuffing
instructions: Melt butter in skillet and cook onion and celery until tender. Place bread and seasonings in a large bowl and pour butter mixture over mixing gently. For dry stuffing add little or no liquid. For moister stuffing add broth to moisten crumbs. Cool. Place in bird when ready to bake. Enough for 12 pound turkey.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Sprinkle on cheese and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more.

title: Cracked Wheat Bread
instructions: Soak cracked wheat in cold water overnight. Mix together the milk shortening salt and molasses. Add soaked cracked wheat. Dissolve yeast in the warm water; add to other ingredients. Add half the flour and beat 2 minutes. Add remaining flour to make stiff dough. Knead 10 minutes. Grease dough; cover and let rise until double in size. Divide into 2 loaves. Let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Saute bread in butter until lightly browned. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into buttered casserole. Top with crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Good with ham salad.

title: Delicious Corn Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Put margarine in baking dish and place in oven to melt. Meanwhile mix all ingredients stirring well. Pour mixture into baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes until set and golden brown.

title: Bavarian Salad
instructions: Melt marshmallows in water over low heat. When melted remove from heat and add lime gelatin. After gelatin has dissolved place mixture in refrigerator long enough to cool but not set. Whip mixture until large bubbles disappear. Add remaining ingredients folding in Cool Whip. Congeal in refrigerator.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook rosamarina in boiling water 5 to 8 minutes; drain. In a large bowl combine rosemarina chicken celery onion and eggs. Save 2 eggs for garnish. In a small bowl combine Miracle Whip lemon juice salt white pepper and poultry seasoning. Fold into chicken mixture. Refrigerate covered overnight. Makes 1 gallon. Serves 16 (1 cup servings)

title: Easy Mexican Noodles
instructions: Brown and cook the ground turkey. Add the salsa and corn to meat mixture. Stir in the cooked noodles and simmer until hot. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

title: Fruit Salad And Dressing
instructions: Mix and serve on bed of lettuce. Top with dressing.

title: Crab Spread
instructions: Mix 1st five ingredients together and spread mixture on a plate. Pour desired amount of sauce or salsa over mixture. Sprinkle drained and deboned crab meat over top. Use crackers of your choice to scoop up spread. Enjoy!

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1 cup cold water. Add thawed strawberries diced bananas and pineapple. Pour half of the mixture into container (mold or glass dish). Place in refrigerator to jell. Leave remaining gelatin mixture at room temperature.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking soda. Set aside. Mix butter and peanut butter. Add white and brown sugar. Mix well. Add eggs. Beat well. Stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture. Drop dough from a teaspoon on baking sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375\u00b0 until lightly brown. Makes 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

title: Pecan Chess Pie
instructions: Combine flour and sugar; stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Sunday Dinner Steaks
instructions: Dredge steak in flour and pepper. Brown lightly on both sides in oil. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle dry soup mix over top. Cover with mushrooms and liquid. Add a layer of sliced onions. Pour can of gravy that has been mixed with water over the top. Do not stir.

title: Museli Morning Bread Or Muffins
instructions: Mix together sugar milk oil eggs and almond extract. Set aside. In another bowl mix together flour Museli cereal mixture baking powder and salt. Now pour the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0. Or spoon into greased muffin tins and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Potato Salad(Dutch Recipe)
instructions: Peel boil and then slice potatoes. Dice and fry bacon. Add flour to bacon and mix. Add vinegar sugar and water to the flour and bacon. Bring to a boil and add to the potatoes which have been mixed with the onion and celery. Add salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley.

title: Fudge Mud Slide
instructions: Place brownie in a large bowl. Add ice cream and top with hot fudge sauce and crushed cookie. Add whipped cream and drizzle with chocolate syrup. Sprinkle with almonds and top with a cherry.

title: Turkey Dip
instructions: Chop egg very fine and mix with mayonnaise. Add ginger crushed garlic onion and celery minced very fine. Add curry powder salt lemon and turkey. Add white wine if desired to make a thinner dip.

title: Low-Fat Ice Cream Sandwiches
instructions: Spread Cool Whip over 1 graham cracker sheet. Top with another graham cracker sheet. Place on flat plate or pan. Freeze overnight.

title: Pasta With Garlic
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salt water cook the spaghetti until done; drain. Mince the garlic. Combine the oil garlic anchovy paste parsley cayenne and butter into the hot pot. Return the spaghetti to the pot and toss over low heat until butter has melted. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken With Pastry
instructions: Place chicken in 3 cups water with onion celery and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until tender over medium heat. When tender remove chicken from broth and debone. Cut into large chunks and place in the bottom of a greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish.

title: Easy Pineapple-Cheese Spread
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except nuts. With damp fingers roll mixture into a ball and roll in nuts. Refrigerate uncovered until ready to serve. Serve with variety of crackers.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate for several hours.

title: Pocketbook Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast into warm water. Sift together and mix the flour milk sugar and salt. Let rise until doubled in bulk about 1 hour. Knead in enough flour to keep dough from sticking to hands. Pat or roll out and cut with small orange juice can. Dip in melted butter. Fold into pocketbooks. Allow to rise until doubled about 1 hour. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. May be frozen after this step. When taken from freezer allow 3 hours to thaw and rise.

title: Venison Ragout
instructions: Place carrots celery onions marjoram pepper bay leaf water olive oil and salt in a bowl. Cut meat into 3-inch strips 1-inch thick. Add to vegetable and spice mixture. Add more water if meat is not covered. Refrigerate covered for 5 hours. Remove meat; drain vegetables and reserve marinade. Roll meat in flour and brown in skillet. Brown vegetables in casserole dish. Boil marinade and bouillon for 1 minute. Add bouillon marinade and meat to casserole dish; cover and bake for 2 hours at 325\u00b0. Add water if it boils dry.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Layer ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan by the order given. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cajun Chicken
instructions: Season chicken. Brown lightly in butter or oil. Remove from fire and drain. In a large Dutch oven make a roux of flour and butter stirring until rich brown. Add vegetables and stir until soft. Slowly add water stirring constantly. Add chicken and seasonings. Cover and simmer 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice.

title: Skillet Cabbage
instructions: Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet. Add cabbage celery green pepper onion tomatoes sugar salt and pepper. Mix well. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until cabbage is tender but still crisp. Serves 6.

title: Holiday Nuggets
instructions: In mixing bowl cream butter margarine and sugar; blend in vanilla and almond extracts. Gradually add flour and salt. Stir in nuts. Shape into 1 1/4 inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten slightly with fingers. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until the bottoms are lightly browned. Cool on a wire rack. When cool sprinkle with mixture of confectioners and colored sugar. Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Brenda'S Spinach Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

title: Southern Hot Cornbread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add onions peppers corn cheese oil milk pimento and sugar. Stir in flour and meal. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 until brown. Let set 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Grilled Shrimp With Marinade Sauce
instructions: Mix soy sauce Worcestershire sauce honey lemon onion and white wine. Marinate shrimp for 2 hours. Thread shrimp and fruit on skewers. Place on grill. Baste with marinade sauce and cook for 10 minutes. Serve over 1/2 cup of cooked rice.

title: Fruit Fantastic
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Combine ginger ale and ice to make 2 cups. Add to gelatin; stir until slightly thickened. Remove unmelted ice. Chill until thickened about 10 minutes. Arrange apple slices in 6-cup bowl. Add enough gelatin to just cover apples. Repeat layering fruits and gelatin. Chill until set about 1 hour. Garnish if desired. Makes 12 servings.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Brown chuck in skillet until crumbly. Stir in garlic salt pepper sugar and tomato sauce. Simmer 15 minutes. Combine sour cream softened cream cheese green onions and 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese. Mix well. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Alternate layers of noodles meat mixture and cheese mixture in 8 x 8 x 2 baking pan or dish until all ingredients are used ending with cheese mixture. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes.

title: Quick Mushroom Steak With Rice
instructions: In large skillet brown steaks (thoroughly cook). In separate bowl combine soup with water. Add mushrooms. Mix together. Pour over steaks. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Roast Beef
instructions: Place roast in baking dish; salt and pepper. Add potatoes and carrots. Mix soups together (in blender or food processor). Pour over meat and vegetables. Cover with foil. Punch holes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 4 to 5 hours.

title: Snowballs
instructions: Beat cream cheese sugar and milk in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in Cool Whip. Hold cupcakes top side down in palm of hand; spread Cool Whip mixture on bottom and sides. Press coconut onto frosting. Place cupcakes top side down on serving platter. Drizzle with melted chocolate. Refrigerate at least 1 hour. Store any leftover dessert in refrigerator. Makes 24 snowballs.

title: Orange-Date Nut Bread
instructions: Combine dry mixes. Blend eggs and water; stir into dry mixes until completely moistened. Fold in walnuts. Pour into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Remove from pan; cool.

title: Cheesy Pork Chops And Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spoon cheese into 8 x 12-inch baking dish and place in oven until cheese melts (5 minutes). Heat oil in a skillet. Brown pork chops with seasoned salt.

title: Taco Crackers
instructions: Mix together and pour over crackers. Mix well. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Praline Cookies
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with foil and cover bottom with whole graham crackers placing them as close together as possible. Bring margarine and brown sugar to a boil; let boil for 2 minutes. Stir occasionally. Add nuts and spread mixture evenly over crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut and separate. Let cool. Store in tin with tight lid.

title: One Bowl Holiday Fudge
instructions: Microwave chocolate and milk in large microwavable bowl on High 2 to 3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted stirring halfway through heating time. Remove from microwave. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir in vanilla and walnuts. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares.

title: Chicken Paprika
instructions: Flour chicken and brown. Season with lots of paprika and some salt. In a pot put in 1 layer of chicken topped with a layer of onions. Put in another layer of chicken with onions on top. Add 2 cups of water and bouillon cubes. Cook on low heat about 1 hour. Check to see if more water is needed.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Mix cake batter as directed on package. Put 1/2 of the batter in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. In a saucepan over low heat melt caramels with butter and milk. Pour over hot half-baked cake. Top with chocolate chips and pecans. Pour rest of batter over caramels; bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes longer.

title: Two-Tone Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Cream butter with sugars until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Add flour but do not stir in yet. Sprinkle soda and salt over flour and fold in so these are well distributed. Mix thoroughly then add chips. Bake about 8 minutes or until light golden.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Place in a 1-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbling hot. Yield 4 servings. Diabetic exchange 2 meats and 1 bread.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In a medium size mixing bowl combine 3/4 cup sugar flour 3 tablespoons of cocoa baking powder and salt. Blend in milk melted butter and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Pour batter into square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch).

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Cut up fresh broccoli in small pieces or use frozen broccoli. Cook until crisp-tender along with small onion. Use small amount of water when cooking. Then add cream of celery soup (do not dilute). Add milk and heat. Add grated Cheddar cheese and heat together. You can thicken with cornstarch or flour if needed. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening together until fluffy. Stir in already beaten eggs pumpkin and water. Sift dry ingredients. Blend them into the mixture. Stir in the raisins. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes in 2 medium loaf pans.

title: Fast Chocolate Pecan Fudge
instructions: Melt butter. Add cocoa; stir until smooth. Stir in sugar and vanilla (mixture will be dry). Stir in evaporated milk. Microwave 30 to 60 seconds or until mixture is hot. Stir until smooth. Add pecans. Pour into 8-inch pan. Cover. Chill until firm in refrigerator.

title: Supper On A Bread Slice
instructions: Will also need heavy duty aluminum foil.

title: Chris' Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grease (do not flour) a 9 inch x 13 inch pan. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix all ingredients for the cake together using hand mixer until well blended. Pour into pan. Bake 30 minutes.

title: Country French Chicken Breasts
instructions: In a 12-inch skillet melt butter over medium-high heat and brown chicken. Stir in soup mix blended with water and lemon juice. Arrange lemon slices on chicken. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened and chicken is done. To serve arrange chicken over rice and spoon sauce over chicken.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Chill and serve as salad or on rolls or bread.

title: Celia'S Ribs
instructions: Have the butcher crack the ribs at 2-inch intervals. Cut ribs into 2-inch pieces. Marinate the ribs best overnight. Set oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Take ribs out of marinade and roast for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Baste with marinade frequently. Turn up oven for the last few minutes to crisp the ribs.

title: Great Grandma Amiot'S Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and spices. Add egg and molasses. Stir in dry ingredients mixing well. Make into small balls roll in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and pudding mix in bowl; mix well. Stir in pecans and marshmallows. Add whipped topping; mix well. Chill until serving time. Yield 6 servings.

title: Stuffing Casserole
instructions: Remove meat from cooked chicken and chop it up. Save broth from cooked chicken and use some of it in the stuffing mix instead of water.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients and toss. Use only the tender stems and flowerets of broccoli.

title: Crescent Onion Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Generously grease a 9-inch round can or pie pan. Separate each can of dough into 2 long rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal.

title: Glazed Chocolate Cherry Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients stirring until blended (batter will be thick). Spread evenly into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan on a wire rack 15 minutes. Pour Chocolate Glaze evenly on cake.

title: Barbecups
instructions: In large skillet brown beef; drain. Add barbecue sauce brown sugar and onion. Separate dough into biscuits. Place each biscuit in an ungreased muffin cup pressing dough up sides to edge of cup. Spoon meat mixture into cups. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 10 to 12.

title: Alabama Stew
instructions: Brown ground beef in bottom of stew pot. Cut potatoes into bite-size pieces and place on top of ground beef. Add all other ingredients. Cook until potatoes are done. Tastes great served with cornbread or crackers.

title: Peanut Butter Candy
instructions: Boil sugar and water for 5 minutes stirring rapidly. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients stirring rapidly to prevent sticking to pan. Pour into buttered dish and refrigerate. Cut into squares before serving.

title: Original Nilla Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix 1/2 cup sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler. Blend in 3 egg yolks and milk. Cook uncovered over boiling water stirring constantly for 10 to 12 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Reserve 10 Nilla wafers for garnish. Spread small amount of custard on bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole; cover with layers of 1/3 each of the wafers and sliced bananas. Pour about 1/3 of custard over bananas. Continue to layer wafers bananas and custard to make a total of 3 layers of each ending with custard. Beat egg whites on high speed of electric mixer until soft peaks form. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar beating until stiff but not dry. Spoon on top of custard spreading to cover entire surface and sealing well to edges. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned. Cool slightly or refrigerate several hours until chilled. Top with reserved wafers. Makes 12 (2/3 cup) servings. Prep 30 minutes. Bake 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ball(Scampi Palle)
instructions: Mash shrimp. Beat remaining ingredients together and mix with shrimp. Shape into ball and roll in parsley flakes or ground nuts. Chill and serve with crackers or fresh cut up vegetables if desired. Makes 1 large ball.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together shortening sugar eggs and vanilla. Stir in milk. Sift flour and salt. Stir into creamed mixture blending well. Chill 1 hour. Roll on floured surface to 1/4-inch thick. Cut into desired shapes. Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) about 10 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet and let cool. Makes 2 dozen medium cookies.

title: Molasses Taffy
instructions: Melt margarine in a saucepan. Tip the pan to grease the sides. Add sugar and molasses. Stir until well dissolved. Bring this mixture to a boil stirring slowly and constantly. (Candy is done when a drop dropped into cold water becomes brittle.) Pour taffy into well-greased platter. When cool enough to handle grease hands and pull candy from hand to hand until firm and of a gold color. Draw into a smooth band or twist into rope. Cut into short lengths with kitchen shears. Spread on wax paper to finish cooling.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown steak with onions in margarine. Add salt pepper soup water and sour cream. Mix well and simmer for 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Cook noodles; drain and mix with meat and sauce.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Mix milk Cool Whip and lemonade together. Pour into pie crust and chill.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Chill and serve with Melba rounds or crackers.

title: Chocolate Carrot Cake
instructions: Grease and flour Bundt pan. Beat the first ten ingredients together then stir in carrots and coconut. Spoon into Bundt pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 or 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Serves 16.

title: White Castle
instructions: Mix ingredients; press flat on cookie sheet (will fill the whole cookie sheet). Prick with fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool and cut in squares to fit bun; place pickle on each bun. Place back on cookie sheet sprinkle with water and cover with foil. Store in refrigerator until ready. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes (makes about 40 mini White Castles). Use small dinner rolls.

title: Meatballs - Anna B'S
instructions: Combine all ingredients except olive oil. Roll into meatballs. Brown the meatballs in olive oil then put in the sauce.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and blend well. Cover; refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Whip pineapple in blender until foamy. Pour into saucepan. Add sugar and flour. Beat eggs and pour into mixture. Cook until thick. Let cool then add Cool Whip. Chill.

title: The Best Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together. Let cool until lukewarm. Add eggs sugar and vanilla to chocolate. Mix well. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add to chocolate mixture and mix well. Stir in pecans. Cover and chill overnight. Shape into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 18 large cookies! Yum! Yum!

title: Carrot Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and carrots. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add dry ingredients to mixture. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Make thin confectioners sugar. Use orange juice for the liquid and frost while the cookies are warm.

title: Fiesta Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Chill. Serve with chips (tortilla) or veggies. Makes 2 cups.

title: Homemade Barbecue
instructions: Brown the roast in a large frying pan. Place in 5-quart crock-pot. Cook on high for 6 to 8 hours or until done.

title: Easy Milkshake
instructions: Pour milk into shaker. Add ice cream and pudding. Shake for at least 1 minute. Pour drink into glass.

title: Recipe For Leo'S Shepherd'S Pie(Serves 4)
instructions: Peel boil and mash the potatoes. Brown the hamburger (loose). In a 2-quart casserole dish put in potatoes (bottom layer) put in loose hamburger (middle layer) and add creamed corn (top layer). Place in oven preheated to 350\u00b0. Heat until creamed corn starts to bubble (15 to 20 minutes). While heating wash potato pan and frying pan. Eat and enjoy!

title: Griddle Cakes
instructions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Beat egg add milk and pour slowly on first mixture. Beat thoroughly. Add butter drop by spoonful on a greased hot griddle. Cook on one side when puffed and full of bubbles and cooked on the edges turn and cook other side. Then spread with butter and maple syrup.

title: Diabetic Apple Muffins
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt sugar substitute and spices into a medium mixing bowl. Combine egg milk and oleo. Add egg mixture to dry ingredients. Blend only until flour is moistened. Fold in apples and pour batter into 12 non-stick muffin cups filling 2/3 full. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
instructions: In saucepan mix sugar cornstarch salt lemon juice water and 1 can blueberries. Cook and stir over low heat until thick. Add other 3 cups of berries and butter. Mix well and cool. Pour into pie shell. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening. Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth. Add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla dash of salt the coconut and chopped nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.

title: Chocolate Pudding Squares
instructions: Blend with pastry blender or 2 forks and press into pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool.

title: Doves Or Quail
instructions: Brown doves or quail in real butter after salting and flouring. Add bouillon cubes dissolved in water. Add mushrooms and parsley flakes. Put game back in and simmer until tender. Add sherry 10 minutes before serving. Serve over rice. Dont cook too long.

title: Award Winning Snow Covered Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with shortening butter or margarine. Beat cake mix water oil and eggs in large bowl on low speed 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes or 299 strokes by hand. Pour into pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Check with toothpick. Cool for 10 minutes. Frost completely. Add coconut flakes (optional).

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Quarter frozen rolls while still frozen and drop into greased tube pan. Sprinkle dry ingredients pecans and raisins. Drizzle butter on top. Cover with cloth and let set until morning. Bake on bottom rack at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix well and chill overnight.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Debone chicken in large casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add diced onion and Velveeta cheese. Crush Doritos and sprinkle on the chicken mixture. Mix cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup and Ro-Tel. Pour over the ingredients already in dish. Sprinkle remaining chips on top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Skinny Blueberry Cobbler
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a shallow 2-quart casserole. Fork blend the biscuit mix and skim milk. Spoon on top of blueberry mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Wild Rice
instructions: Cook wild rice 5 minutes then drain. Cook both rices together for 15 minutes; drain. Saute celery and onion in butter. Place rice in baking dish adding celery onion cheese and water chestnuts. Add one cup of milk. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Scot'S And Mike'S Skillet Trout
instructions: Into pie plate pour milk. On waxed paper place flour. Dip fish in milk then in flour to coat. In 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat get oil hot. Cook fish turning carefully with pancake turner once for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Place on warm plate.

title: Crescent Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until done. Chop. Roll chicken into each crescent roll. Place in buttered casserole dish. Melt cheese and soup in smaller boiler; pour over crescents. Place in preheated oven uncovered at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken. Saute oleo chopped celery onion and green pepper. Mix soups chicken broth Tabasco olives salt and pepper Worcestershire sauce pimentos and chili powder. Cook spaghetti; drain. Grate American cheese. Mix and bake for 35 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven. After it cooks sprinkle some cheese on top and let melt. Can divide and put in freezer. Serves 10 to 12 people.

title: Stromboli
instructions: Roll out both loaves of dough. Place 1 loaf on a cookie sheet. Layer ingredients in any order. Top with other loaf of dough. Seal all the way around. Vent the top of dough to let steam escape. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Crescent Roll Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and dice into small pieces. Unfold one crescent roll. Put a layer of chicken on roll and then a layer of cheese. Place second crescent on top of first and pinch together. Continue this with other crescents. You will end up with 4 of these. Lay these 4 filled crescents on a large baking dish. Next heat cream of chicken soup 1/2 cup milk and remaining cheese until cheese melts. Pour this mixture over rolls. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 4.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Grease baking sheet. Combine sugar corn syrup and salt in a 3-quart Pyrex dish. Stir in peanuts. Microwave on High until light brown (8 to 10 minutes) stirring once or twice. Remove from microwave. Stir in remaining ingredients until light and foamy. Quickly spread on greased baking sheet. Quickly spread out as thin as possible for a brittle candy. Break into pieces. Makes about 1 pound.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Prepare pie crust according to package directions (9-inch pie pan).

title: Apple Delicious
instructions: Cut off top of each apple. (Save to use as a lid.) Carve out core and a little bit of apple with a spoon. Mix raisins spices and nuts in a bowl. Fill the hole in each apple with raisin mixture. Put top back on each apple. Bake the apples in an ovenproof dish at 375\u00b0 until apples are done.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients in saucepan. Cook until mixture boils continue cooking stirring constantly until a hard ball forms when dropped in very cold water or 260\u00b0 on a candy thermometer. Remove from heat and quickly blend in butter or oleo. Pour slowly over popped corn in a large bowl mixing well. Shape into balls using as little pressure as possible. Butter hands if necessary. Mixture will be very hot. Keep a bowl of cold water for dipping hands to cool. Makes 14 medium balls.

title: Shrimp With Curry
instructions: Combine the shrimp undiluted soup onion dip curry powder and cayenne pepper in a skillet and mix well. Cook until heated through. Serve over hot rice. Serves 4.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a bowl combine all ingredients. Transfer to a greased 11 x 7 baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until heated through.

title: Chicken Huntington
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Add juice from noodles if too dry. Bake at 400\u00b0 until bubbles in center.

title: No Cook Strawberry Jam
instructions: Slice and crush 1 pint strawberries. Drain pineapple and reserve 3/4 cup juice. Add pineapple and 4 cups sugar to strawberries. Set 10 minutes. Stir pineapple juice into one box Sure-Jell; heat and boil 1 minute. Stir into pineapple strawberry mixture. Stir 3 minutes. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil; cool until lukewarm. Sift salt soda and baking powder into plain flour; do not sift flour before measuring. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Add yeast mixture to liquid mixture. Mix in flour. Let stand 2 hours. Knead on floured board; roll dough to 1/4-inch thick (or thinner). Cut with biscuit cutter. Make mark across each roll with knife; roll in melted margarine (I use Parkay). Place in pan leaving space for each to rise. Let rise until at least double in size. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 425\u00b0 depending on oven until brown.

title: Sour Cream Salad
instructions: Drain all fruit. Mix all ingredients and set overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Pickled Jalapeno Peppers
instructions: Wash peppers and pack tightly in hot jars.

title: Forgotten Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to about 300\u00b0. Grease cookie trays in advance. Beat 2 egg whites until semi-stiff. Slowly add 3/4 cup sugar while continuing to beat. When egg whites and sugar are stiff add a small package of chocolate bits or nuts etc. Place by small spoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Place in oven. Turn off heat. Take out when hardened.

title: Admonition Coconut Cake
instructions: The night before baking the cake combine sugar sour cream and coconut. Store in refrigerator in a covered bowl. Next day prepare cake and bake. Turn out layers and cool. Split each layer to a total of 4 layers. Fill and frost with sour cream mixture. Store in the refrigerator in cake box. Do not cut for 4 days.

title: Sweet And Sour Pot Roast
instructions: Sprinkle flour on sirloin tip with salt and pepper. Brown the sirloin tip in the fat add onions and bay leaf. Combine water and wine vinegar cinnamon brown sugar and vermouth. Cook covered (low heat) 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Add water if necessary. Turn meat cook until tender about 30 minutes. Add 4 to 6 crumbled gingersnaps cook until sauce thickens.

title: Pierogie Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and butter. Cook noodles as directed and cool. Prepare mashed potatoes and add some cheese to the potatoes. On bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan place a layer of onion and butter a layer of noodles then potatoes then onions and cheese. Repeat layers 3 or 4 times. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (Egg noodles may be substituted for lasagna noodles.)

title: Coconut Fingers
instructions: Cut and quarter each slice into 4 pieces. Dip strips into condensed milk. Cover all sides and roll in coconut. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until delicately brown. Cookies become crisp when cool. (Ground or cut up nuts may be added to coconut.)

title: New England Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in small amount of oil.\tBrown the onion and then simmer with all remaining ingredients for 30 minutes. Pour over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening brown sugar sugar vanilla and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Put in 1/2 c. M&Ms. drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with 1 cup M&Ms. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Buttery Bread Pretzels
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water. Mix 3/4 cup water with the sugar and salt. Add yeast mixture. Stir once and add flour. Stir until dough begins to stick; add melted butter. Mix well. Knead on board 2 minutes. Rest dough (covered) for 15 minutes. Divide and roll pretzel shape. Place on greased sheets. Beat egg yolk with 2 tablespoons water. Brush each pretzel. Sprinkle with salt (optional). Let rise 30 minutes. Should double in size. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Rotate pans to ensure even browning. Serve warm. Makes 24 (3-inch) pretzels.

title: Ham And Cheese Ball
instructions: Blend ingredients. Firm up in refrigerator. Roll in chopped nuts.

title: Lucky If There'S Any Left Cake
instructions: Mix flour margarine and finely chopped pecans together and spread like a graham cracker crust in 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 until light brown. Cool completely.

title: Make A Dream Pie
instructions: Combine whipped topping mix 1 cup milk and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Beat on high with electric mixer about 6 minutes or until thick enough to form peaks. Add remaining milk and pie filling mix. Blend on low; beat on high for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine sugar eggs and oil; mix well. Add flour cinnamon and allspice. Fold in zucchini and nuts. Grease two loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chili
instructions: Brown meats. Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil and then simmer for about 30 minutes. For more juice add water.

title: Peanut Butter Squares
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Mix eggs peanut butter vanilla salt and soda. Add flour and oats. Spread dough in slightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 to 24 minutes at 350\u00b0. While hot cover with milk chocolate pieces and allow to melt before icing.

title: Sherry Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken with mixture of flour Parmesan cheese and garlic powder. Brown chicken in olive oil. Remove chicken and brown onion until clear. Add sherry bouillon and chicken. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Liver And Rice Dish
instructions: Cut liver into small pieces. Saute onion in margarine in saucepan. Add liver and brown. Put rice liver and onion and stock (or water) into a casserole dish. Mix together with dash of salt and pepper. Cover. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Serve.

title: Linguini With Roasted Tomatoes And Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine cherry tomatoes 1 tablespoon oil 1/4 teaspoon salt pepper and garlic in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish; toss gently. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until garlic is browned stirring occasionally. (Tomato skins will pop.) Squeeze the garlic cloves to extract the pulp; discard skins. Mash the garlic pulp. Add this mashed pulp to the tomato mixture stirring gently. Combine tomato mixture 1 tablespoon oil 1/4 teaspoon salt pasta parsley and basil in a large bowl; toss gently. Yield Four 1-cup servings.

title: English Muffin Loaves
instructions: Combine 3 cups (or 1/2) of the measured flour yeast sugar salt and soda. Heat liquid until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). Add dry mixture; beat well. Stir in remaining 3 cups of flour to make a stiff batter. Spoon into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch) bread pans (greased and sprinkled with cornmeal). Sprinkle top with cornmeal. Cover; let rise in warm place for 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove immediately from pan and cool.

title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in flavorings. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pan then turn out on wire rack.

title: Copy Solution(Make Prints From Comics)
instructions: Will need a small dish 2 spoons bright colored comics scissors white paper and extra newspaper.

title: Potatoes Romanoff
instructions: Combine salt cottage cheese and sour cream in blender. Blend and pour over potatoes and onions. Sprinkle American cheese on top and bake in 2 quart casserole for 40 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Italian Casserole
instructions: Brown beef onion and seasonings. Add soup water and noodles and place in 1 1/2 qt. casserole. Sprinkle cheese around edges of casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. 4-6 Servings.

title: Crab Bisque(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Saute onions and crabmeat in butter. Add soups and blend. Add sherry milk and a lot of parsley. Serve hot.

title: Burger Mix Burgers
instructions: Grind the beans nuts seeds and oats in the blender to consistency of coarse flour. For best results process only 1/2 cup at a time. Combine mixture with remaining ingredients and mix well. Store in a covered container at cool room temperature or refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake
instructions: Pinch off pieces of cake and place in a large bowl making a layer. Cut up strawberries and layer on cake. Mix together Cool Whip sour cream and powdered sugar. Put a layer of this over the berries. Repeat layers using all ingredients.

title: Blueberry Banana Pie
instructions: Drain blueberries. Mix cornstarch and sugar. Add to juice. Cook until thickens stirring constantly. Remove from fire and add butter and lemon juice. Add berries. Cool. Cut 1/2 banana into small pieces and add to berry mixture. Line baked pie crust sides and bottom with rounds of bananas. Pour cooled mixture over crust. Refrigerate. Top with whipped cream.

title: Chiffon Layer Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a small bowl beat egg whites with 1/3 cup sugar until thick and glossy but not stiff. Set aside. Combine flour 1 cup sugar baking powder and salt in a mixing bowl. Add milk oil vanilla and egg yolks. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Scrape bowl frequently. Fold or stir egg whites into batter until well blended. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch layer cake pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 10 to 20 minutes before removing from pans.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook and drain sausage; set aside. Separate dough and make pizza on greased 12-inch pan. Press and seal. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0. Spoon sausage over dough and sprinkle with cheeses. Combine eggs milk oregano and peppers and pour over sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening in a large kettle or saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat; let cool. Add sugar molasses and eggs; beat well. Stir together the flour soda cloves ginger cinnamon and salt; add to first mixture. Mix well and chill. Form balls; roll in sugar (granulated) and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Recipe may be halved.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Dip
instructions: Cook and drain package of chopped broccoli. Brown the celery and onion in 1/3 cup butter. Add to this mixture the broccoli mushrooms and garlic cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: In a saucepan bring water and bouillon cubes to a boil. Meantime make a paste with flour and water. Add to boiling mixture stirring constantly. Gradually add beaten egg to boiling mixture stirring constantly and continue to boil 1 to 2 minutes until egg is done. Remove from heat and season with pepper Worcestershire sauce or teriyaki sauce if desired.

title: Cheese Puffs
instructions: Cream the cheese and butter. Add flour. Make in balls and bake for 10 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Fudge Meltaways
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup butter and 1 square chocolate in small saucepan. Blend sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla eggs crumbs and coconut into butter and chocolate mixture. Mix well and press into ungreased baking dish 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches. Refrigerate.

title: Summer Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into serving size pieces into salad bowl. Add Mandarin oranges pecans and salad dressing. Toss lightly.

title: Corn And Potato Chowder(Yields 8 To 10 Servings)
instructions: Cut bacon into small pieces. Combine bacon and onion in a 4-quart casserole. Cook on High for 9 to 11 minutes or until bacon is cooked and onion is tender. Stir halfway through cooking time. Drain.

title: Fried Turkey Seasoning
instructions: Rub turkey with seasoning inside and out (baste generously). Let turkey baste overnight in refrigerator. Fry at 250 for 5 minutes per pound. Do not cover pot.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients except Sprite. Freeze. Take out of freezer 1 or 2 hours ahead of serving time. Serve when slushy. Add Sprite just before serving. Serves 35.

title: How To Cook A Turkey Breast
instructions: Wash and remove rib case (optional). Sprinkle with lemon pepper salt pepper and paprika. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Place in large Corning dish with a cup of water. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Cut heat off and leave dish in oven until oven cools. Turkey is ready to slice and serve. Roast or ham may be cooked the same way.

title: Watermelon Rind Pickles
instructions: Peel rind and remove all pink. Cut in 1-inch squares. Soak 3 hours in salt and water. Rinse and drain and cook in enough water to cover until just tender. Make syrup of sugar vinegar water lemon and cinnamon. Add rind and simmer until it looks clear. Pack in hot sterile jars and seal. Makes 6 to 8 quarts.

title: Turkey Cobb Salad(Makes 4 Servings)
instructions: Individually prepare 4 salad plates. Line plates with lettuce. Distribute turkey tomatoes and avocado on plates. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese. Top with sour cream green onions and olives. Serve with salsa.

title: Lit'L Link Wraps
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Unwrap dough and separate along perforations. Cut each piece into 3 sections. Cut each section into 3 lengthwise pieces. Braid the dough and then wrap around meat and bake 10 to 12 minutes on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Oven Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all together. Place in 250\u00b0 oven for 4 hours. Bake in covered casserole.

title: Double Apple Salad
instructions: Sprinkle diced apples with citric powder. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover and chill.

title: Chinese Pepper Steak
instructions: Season meat with salt and brown in hot oil in large skillet. Add soy sauce garlic and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until meat is tender. Add green pepper onions and celery. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes. Add tomatoes.

title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Cook peeled potatoes in boiling water. Mash until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; beat until light and fluffy. Cool. Cover and place in refrigerator. Use anytime within 2 weeks.

title: Baked Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook bacon and remove from pan. Brown onion in bacon grease and remove from grease. Add all ingredients and mix. Put in casserole dish and cook at 350\u00b0 until bubbling.

title: Orange Candy Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs beating one at a time. Add vanilla. Mix dates candy coconut and nuts with 1/4 cup flour. Sift remaining flour with baking soda and salt. Fold sifted dry ingredients into creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk. Fold in fruit and nut mixture. Spoon batter into well-greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix cornbread stuffing with the melted butter or oleo. Put half of the mixture in baking pan. Put the carrot and onion in a blender or chop very fine. Mix the vegetables with the soup a little salt and pepper squash and sour cream. Pour over the first mixture and top with the remaining cornbread stuffing mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Beer Biscuits
instructions: Mix together and roll into 1-inch thickness. Cut out biscuits. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until done.

title: Golden Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients; beat with rotary eggbeater until light and fluffy. Makes about 1 1/3 cups.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and drain. Drain tuna. Cook peas and carrots. In large bowl mix soup and milk. Add tuna noodles and vegetables. Put in baking dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and put a few pieces of butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chops With Apple Rings
instructions: Use apples that are unpeeled cored and sliced into rings. Brown chops on both sides. Place apple rings in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Dot with margarine. Place pork chops on top of apples. Cover. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours. Yield 6 servings. Carbohydrate 19 g protein 3 g fat 16 g calories 288.

title: Kuchen
instructions: Use apples peaches plums blueberries or mix blueberries and peaches for the fruit.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Place ingredients in large bowl and beat for 3 minutes. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake at 325\u00b0 for one hour until done. Use loaf pan or tube pan.

title: Cranberry Wine Salad
instructions: Pour water over Jell-O. Add cranberry sauce while hot and stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and wine. Cool to jelling point and fold in nuts. Refrigerate until set. Serve with or without dressing.

title: Liver Fricassee
instructions: Pour boiling water over liver; let stand 5 minutes. Drain wipe dry and cut into strips. Dredge with the next 3 ingredients. Brown quickly in hot bacon fat (or other). Add rest of the ingredients. Simmer for 45 minutes. Thicken with a little flour. Serve with cooked noodles.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Spread small jar of Marshmallow Creme over cooled cake.

title: Easy Spinach Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan melt 2 1/2 Tbsp. butter. Add the carrots scallions and clove of gallic; saute until the scallions are soft. Bring the chicken broth to a boil stir in rice or pasta. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Just before serving stir the spinach into the hot liquid. Cook for two to three minutes until spinach is done. Add salt and pepper to taste. Top with parmesan cheese and/or croutons if desired.

title: Speedy Baked Beans With Wieners
instructions: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces. Cook in skillet until crisp; add remaining ingredients. Simmer covered for 15 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Taylor'S Spicy Pretzels
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl except pretzels. Stir in broken beer pretzels. Spread out on baking pan. Bake at 200\u00b0 for 2 hours; stir often.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Add horseradish and ketchup to taste. Serve with crackers or carrots and celery sticks.

title: Oatmeal Hermits
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat shortening and sugars until creamy. Add vanilla. Sift flour baking powder salt and spices together. Add alternately with milk to creamy mixture. Stir in oatmeal nuts and raisins. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Oven Cashew Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix in order given except for 1/2 of onion rings and paprika. Bake in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole (covered) for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Top with remaining onion rings and paprika and bake an additional 5 minutes uncovered.

title: Delight And Leeman'S Soup
instructions: In a frying pan with the oil cook the stew meat. When its done put the meat and the drippings in a pot; add the can of soup and one can of water. Add all of the other ingredients. On medium heat cook until potatoes and carrots are done. Serves 4.

title: Crab Ala King
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix flour with margarine. Slowly add milk. Cook until thickened to make white sauce. Add all other ingredients. Keep hot over double boiler. Serve over crisp toast biscuits patty shells or rice.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: In cake pan mix fudge brownie mix cherries marshmallows and walnuts. Bake for 35 minutes. Remove; let cool for 15 minutes on rack.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cocoa and butter. Add eggs and beat with mixer about 2 minutes. Add salt milk and vanilla. Stir until well blended and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: In electric skillet combine sugar cream and butter; set control at 280\u00b0. Bring mixture to a boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Turn off. Beat. Stir marshmallows and peanut butter in until melted and blended. Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Marinated Beef Kabobs
instructions: Mix wine oil garlic thyme and pepper in large plastic bag then add meat. Push out air tie bag securely and turn gently to coat meat. Store in bowl; marinate at room temperature for 1 hour (in refrigerator if longer). Arrange meat cubes about 1/2 inch apart on skewers. Broil in preheated broiler about 3 to 4 inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes for rare to medium-rare or until of desired doneness turning once. Serves 8.

title: Reuben Dip On Rye Party Rounds
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat and serve hot on rye party rounds.

title: Grandma'S Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Butter 8-inch square pan. In medium saucepan combine butter milk sugar and salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Boil 4 to 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows chocolate chips vanilla and nuts. Stir for 1 minute until marshmallows melt completely. Pour into pan. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Turtle Cake
instructions: Melt caramels. Add margarine in top of double boiler. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour half of batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pour caramel mixture over cake. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over mixture. Pour the other half of batter over all. Bake another 20 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Brown beef. Pour off any accumulated grease. Add celery green pepper and onion; saute. Add tomatoes and their juice. Add remaining ingredients except for the Cheddar cheese. Simmer 20 minutes. Pour into 9 x 12 casserole. Spread Cheddar cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together in top of double boiler. Add 2 cups water. Combine egg yolks with juice and beat. Add to rest of mixture. Cook until thick over boiling water for 25 minutes. (This does away with starchy taste.) Now add lemon extract butter and vinegar. Stir thoroughly. Pour into deep 9-inch pie shell and let cool. Cover with meringue and brown in oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: In a 9 x 13 dish place a layer of graham crackers. Mix instant pudding by box directions. Stir in Cool Whip. Pour half on layer of crackers another layer of crackers ending with filling. In sauce pot mix cocoa milk & sugar. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute. Then stir in margarine & vanilla. Remove from heat. Let it get cold then spread over filling.

title: Sherbet Punch
instructions: Just before serving place sherbet in punch bowl. Add ginger ale and soda; stir until sherbet is almost dissolved.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; put in a 7 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle over the remaining ingredients. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Party Meatballs
instructions: Mix together the ground beef sausage onion parsley and crumbs. Beat egg with spices; add to meat mixture. Mix well. Shape into meatballs. You can make them whatever size you prefer. Usually 1-inch size meatballs work best! Brown meatballs in the oil; drain on paper towel. Add flour to oil that has meat residue in it. It makes it taste better!!! Brown flour until you get a light brown paste. Add can of soup and broth to make a gravy. Add your meatballs; simmer for about 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream; keep warm. Makes about 60 meatballs.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix the first four ingredients and roll in pecans.

title: Joey'S Bean Dip
instructions: In medium saucepan bring Hormel chili to a boil then add onion comino chili powder and garlic salt. Stir well. Add hot sauce. Bring to a boil again then add cream cheese (to make it thicker). Turn heat off; add shredded Cheddar cheese. Stir well. Good with tortilla chips. Enjoy.

title: Anna'S Fudge
instructions: Melt margarine pour over sugar mixture. Blend well. Add cocoa. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix together. Place into square pan. Cut into small pieces.

title: Cornbread Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add other ingredients. Cook 15 minutes. Pour into baking dish. Mix 3/4 cup self-rising cornmeal and 3/4 cup milk. Pour over top and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Mexicorn Salad
instructions: Mix above ingredients together. Taste to see if you need to add any salt. Add salt if needed.

title: Beth Harris'S Slimming Quiche(This Is Quick, Easy, Good Hot Or Cold, And Dietetic Too.)
instructions: *Note Add to spinach juice enough water to make 1 cup and blend in 1/3 cup dry milk powder if desired.

title: Pumpkin Bar
instructions: Mix all together. Put in greased jelly roll pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Summer Vegetable Salad With Basil Marinade
instructions: Whisk together orange juice basil shallots oil vinegar mustard salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add tomatoes zucchini and corn; toss to combine. Refrigerate covered for several hours tossing occasionally. Remove from refrigerator about 1 hour before serving.

title: Stuffing Lasagne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown meat in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add 1 cup of sauce and water; bring to a boil. Add stuffing mix; stir just to moisten. Remove from heat.

title: Cheese And Salsa Dip
instructions: Add onions and green pepper if desired.

title: Indiana Lemon Angel Pie
instructions: 1. Meringue Shell Beat egg whites with cream of tartar in a medium size bowl until foamy white. Beat in the one cup of sugar in Tbsp. at a time until the meringue forms stiff white glossy peaks. Lightly butter a 9-inch pie plate. Spoon meringue over bottom and up sides to form a shell.

title: Crescent Rolls
instructions: Put nuts and syrup in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut biscuits and put on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until biscuits are light brown.

title: Cowboy Beans
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain fat. Mix pork and beans. Heat until bubbly. This is great served with corn bread. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Vegetable Marinade
instructions: In a boiler bring to a boil sugar oil vinegar salt and pepper. Cool. Add to drained vegetables. Marinate in refrigerator for several hours. Keeps well.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Mix in baking dish.

title: Summer Sandstorm
instructions: Pour ingredients in glass; fill glass with milk and top with nutmeg.

title: Potato Chowder
instructions: In a large Dutch oven combine potatoes onion carrot salt pepper parsley flakes and bouillon cubes. Add enough water to cover vegetables. Cook until vegetables are tender about 15 to 20 minutes. Do not drain. Scald milk by heating to 180\u00b0 or until tiny bubbles form around the edges of pan. Remove 1 1/2 cups of milk and add butter and flour to hot milk stirring with wire whisk. Add remaining 4 1/2 cups hot milk to undrained vegetables. Then stir thickened hot milk mixture. Stir until blended. Simmer 15 minutes on low. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Salted Peanut Crisps
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix brown sugar margarine shortening eggs and vanilla. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten with greased bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake until golden brown 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet.

title: Bread Sticks
instructions: Melt butter. Brush on rosemary thyme basil and garlic. Bake in 250\u00b0 oven until dry.

title: Bean And Sausage Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan combine juice cocktail undrained beans potatoes and sausage. Bring to boiling reduce heat. Simmer for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender and mixture is heated through. Sprinkle each serving with some of the cheese. Makes 4 main-dish servings.

title: Hungarian Meatballs
instructions: Combine ground chuck garlic salt parsley seasonings milk egg and crumbs. Mix thoroughly. Shape into small meatballs. Heat oil and add Kitchen Bouquet. Brown meatballs in oil mixture. Remove meatballs and stir in flour. Add mushrooms and sour cream; cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add meatballs. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes. Serve with noodles or rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix butter 1 cup flour and powdered sugar thoroughly and put in 8 x\t8-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Mix eggs lemon juice lemon rind sugar flour and baking powder. Spread over crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and dust with confectioners sugar. Can\tbe doubled and bake at 350\u00b0 in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch salt syrup and water in saucepan. Stir and cook until mixture thickens (about 5 minutes). Add gelatin and blend well. Cool. Put berries into cooled baked crust. Spoon gelatin mixture and over berries. Chill thoroughly.

title: Hamburger Dip
instructions: Lightly brown meat (be sure its well done); drain real well. I cook hamburger meat first then my sausage.

title: Potato Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Heat milk and soup until smooth. Put hamburger and potatoes in casserole. Pour soup mixture on top. Put onion rings on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: River Potatoes
instructions: Line large pan with foil. Layer starting with potatoes then bacon sliced onion and sliced pepper. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix flour with oleo then add milk baking powder and salt. Mix thoroughly and turn onto floured surface. Roll quite thin and pat on melted oleo. Mix raisins cinnamon and sugar. Spread on dough and roll up like a jellyroll. Cut into slices 1-inch thick and arrange in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.

title: Honey Custard
instructions: Combine eggs salt and honey. Add milk slowly stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Pour in custard cups; sprinkle with nutmeg. Place cups in pan of hot water and bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until set. (If desired instead of using custard cups pour into a large mold and bake as above for 45 minutes.)

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together. (Do not overmix.) Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes (or until done).

title: Lazy-Way Quiche
instructions: Toast bread cut into cubes and arrange in bottom of small casserole. Arrange tomatoes on top of bread cubes. Sprinkle cheese over tomatoes. Mix in small bowl milk egg mustard cayenne pepper salt and pepper. Pour over bread cheese and tomatoes. Bake in preheated oven 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 2 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix cheeses; add sauce and let stand several hours in refrigerator. Form into two balls; roll in finely chopped nuts or parsley. Paprika also may be sprinkled on.

title: Blueberry Torte (Or Cherry)
instructions: Gradually add 2 cups sugar to egg whites. Fold in nuts and saltines and bake in 13 x 9-inch buttered pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool.

title: Beau Monde Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together ingredients. Chill at least 2 to 3 hours.

title: Sour Cream Potato Soup
instructions: Combine water diced potatoes and beef powder in a 3-quart pot. Simmer until potatoes are very tender. Mash potatoes but do not drain. Add pepper Beau Monde and cumin. Simmer 10 minutes. Blend flour into Pet milk and stir slowly into soup. Blend sour cream into soup. Heat just to boiling. Sprinkle with parsley and serve at once. Serves 6.

title: Turketti
instructions: Boil pasta in salty water until barely tender; drain. Saute onion celery green pepper and garlic in oil. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese then add sauteed vegetables and spaghetti. Pour into large casserole sprayed with Pam. Top with cheese. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until contents are bubbly and top is brown about 25 minutes. With French bread and a green salad this recipe serves a large group. We always made Turketti to take to the beach during spring break.

title: Spinach Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tops from tomatoes; remove pulp leaving shells intact. Reserve pulp for other uses. Sprinkle inside shells with salt; invert to drain.

title: Beer Batter
instructions: This batter is used as a coating when deep frying chicken fish or any vegetable.

title: Frosty Banana Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water; bring to boil. Stir until dissolved. Cool. Combine juices; stir in sugar syrup. Add bananas which have been crushed and mashed in a blender. Freezer until of a thick mushy consistency. Spoon mushy mixture into punch bowl. Mix in club soda. Serve immediately. Makes 50 (4-ounce) servings.

title: Walking Sandwich
instructions: For each sandwich fill between slices of rye with Swiss cheese 2 slices of corned beef and Summer Slaw. Makes 6 sandwiches.

title: Amaretto Mousse
instructions: Heat sugar in water until dissolved. Set aside. Mix eggs salt and chocolate in blender. Add sugar mixture slowly. Blend until thickened. Cool. Add Amaretto. fold in 3/4 of whipped cream. Pour into small wine glasses. Chill 4 hours. Before serving spoon a dollop of whipped cream on each serving.

title: Farmer'S Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix together corn sour cream milk butter egg and Jiffy mix. Pour into a baking dish coated with Pam non-stick spray. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until nicely browned.

title: Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Melt shortening in large skillet. Coat chicken pieces with flour. Cook chicken in shortening over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown. Remove chicken; set aside.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and put in casserole dish.

title: E-Z Potato Salad
instructions: Mix together well the salad dressing mayonnaise and sugar. Blend in the onion celery and parsley. Mix into the potatoes; salt and pepper to taste. (You may wish to add a couple of hard-boiled eggs stirred into the salad; be my guest.)

title: Kansas Dirt Cake
instructions: Spread half the cookie crumbs in an 11-inch dish. Cream margarine confectioners sugar and cream cheese into mixer bowl until smooth. Combine pudding mix milk and whipped topping in large bowl; mix well. Spread in prepared dish; top with remaining cookie crumbs. Chill until serving time. Garnish with gummy worms. Yield 12 servings.

title: Turkey-Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese. Arrange 1/2 of mixture in a buttered shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with half the cheese. Add remaining turkey-noodle mixture and top with rest of cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; batter will be slightly lumpy. Pour on hot griddle. Cook on each side until done. Serve warm with butter and warm maple syrup.

title: Skillet Macaroni And Hamburger
instructions: Brown beef and onion in shortening; drain excess fat. Stir in water and next 5 ingredients. Add macaroni and mix well. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Stir occasionally. Makes 5 1/2 cups.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and mix with mayonnaise and salt to taste.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and cover with soups. Place in casserole dish. Cover with stuffing mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Dressing
instructions: Place cornbread crumbs into a large bowl; pour in hot chicken broth. Cover and let set for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients in given order. Pour mixture into a large greased baking pan. Bake for 1 hour at 400\u00b0.

title: Cheese Stuffing
instructions: Mix together and stuff celery. This is one lunch protein.

title: Chocolate Cake(Very Rich)
instructions: Beat together eggs sour cream water and oil until thoroughly mixed. Add cake mix and instant chocolate pudding. Beat until smooth and stir in package of chocolate chips. Pour into greased and floured Bundt or angel food cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Frost with chocolate or vanilla icing.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt butter and mix all ingredients together (except chocolate and paraffin). Roll into balls. Stick toothpicks into the balls. Dip balls into chocolate paraffin mixture.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken(Easy And Low Fat)
instructions: Wash and dry chicken breasts. Sprinkle with Tonys and put in crock-pot. Cook for 4 to 5 hours. Do not add any liquid.

title: Pacific Lime Mold
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water. Add juice from pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until frothy. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill until set. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place cooked broccoli in bottom of greased casserole. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Combine egg soups mayonnaise and juice in bowl. Pour over chicken. Spread cheese on top. Melt butter; mix with stuffing. Pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Mix sugar and margarine. Add egg. Mix sour milk and baking soda. Add to sugar-margarine-egg mixture along with flour and vanilla. Mix in rhubarb. Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking pan for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle with sugar five minutes before removing from oven.

title: Quick Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix flour white sugar Wesson oil brown sugar and salt. Take out 1 cup mixture to crumble on top of cake. Then add egg buttermilk soda pecans and vanilla to the first mixture. Mix well and pour in greased and floured pan. Then sprinkle the 1 cup of mixture you took out before on top of the cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oats; add margarine. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Mix dark brown sugar white sugar soda cinnamon eggs plain flour and nutmeg together. Stir into the oatmeal mixture. Blend these together well. Pour into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes until done.

title: Chicken Spectacular Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly greased a 2-quart casserole (shallow) baking dish. Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish until well blended. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title: Quick Mini Pizzas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place biscuits on cookie sheet and press centers to form small bowl shape. Add 1 teaspoon Ragu to each biscuit. Cube cheese and place one cube on each biscuit. Bake 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Marie'S Cookies
instructions: Cream oleo sugars egg and milk. Add cream of tartar soda salt and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and mix in well. Stir in oatmeal corn flakes coconut and nuts. Roll in balls and flatten with a glass. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 100 balls (small). Can leave out cheese if desired.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Shred cheeses. Combine first five ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup chopped nuts into oiled seven cup ring mold. Press cheese mixture into mold. Sprinkle remaining pecans. Chill until firm 4 or 5 hours.

title: Dieter'S Strawberry Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth or beat with electric mixer until smooth. Use as a basic fruit dip.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate until served.

title: Southern Punch Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together and put in pie plate. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Top with whipped cream. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add unbeaten eggs; beat well. Add vanilla and crushed pineapple. Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Add to first mixture. Stir until smooth. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Low-Sodium Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onion garlic and mushrooms in olive oil in a large saucepan. Stir in tomato paste water and seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Ice Cream(Electric Or Hand Crank Machine)
instructions: Mix eggs sugar salt flour vanilla 1/2 can milk and 1 cup of water (bring to a scald). When thickened strain and cool (chill remaining milk). When ready to freeze add rest of milk water and chocolate; stir well. Enjoy.

title: Buffet Salad
