instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add pineapple with juice. Chill until slightly thick. Mix rest of ingredients and fold into congealed Jell-O. Mold in pan or muffin pans. Serves 12.

title: Italian Spaghetti
instructions: Brown beef and drain well. Add other ingredients. Simmer slowly 1 hour or more depending on how much time you have. Cook spaghetti separately. Drain when spaghetti is tender. Serve meat sauce over spaghetti.

title: Texas Fudge
instructions: Grate cheese put 1/2 in bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish. Cover with chilies. Top with other half of cheese. Mix eggs with Worcestershire pour over cheese and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool until it falls out of dish.

title: Marinade Steak(Great For Venison)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl or a marinater. Lay meat in and let soak 24 hours. If using marinater turn over a couple of times in the 24 hours. If using bowl just mix meat so all the meat gets soaked. You dont have to fry this meat long.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a small pan and boil for 3 minutes. With steel blade in place add cream to the mixing container of food processor. Process until very thick whipping cream forms about 1 minute. Transfer to 2-quart mold.

title: Veg-All Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread crumbs or grated cheese halfway through baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes total cooking time.

title: John'S Brown Cake
instructions: In large bowl mix flour and sugar together; set aside. In a saucepan mix butter water and cocoa; bring to a rapid boil. Pour mixture over flour and sugar; mix by hand; add buttermilk eggs baking soda cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well; pour in well greased 11x16x1-1/2 pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes. Ice while warm.

title: Bringhurst Pecan Cake
instructions: Cream butter in large mixing bowl; gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating mixture well after each addition. Combine 3 3/4 cups flour baking powder and nutmeg; add to creamed mixture alternately with bourbon beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix well after each addition. Dredge raisins and pecans in remaining 1/4 cup flour; stir into batter. Spoon batter into a heavily greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool cake in pan for 15 minutes. Remove cake from pan and let cool completely.

title: Oyster Stew
instructions: Put oysters in a dish with water and boil 6 to 8 minutes. Salt and pepper. Add milk and heat. Add butter. Serve hot.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix together soup water onion Cheez Whiz rice and melted butter. Add broccoli to the other ingredients and pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Combine tuna noodles soup salt pepper and milk in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Crumble potato chips on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until chips are brown.

title: Fat Free Mountain Frosting
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in medium or small saucepan. Bring to boiling quickly. Boil rapidly; dont stir. Boil until temperature is 242\u00b0 or until 6 to 8-inch thread spins when dripped from a spoon. While mixture boils beat egg whites to stiff peaks. When boiled mixture reaches proper stage pour in a thin stream into egg whites beating on high constantly. Beat until glossy peaks form. Put in food coloring.

title: Horseradish Cheese Spread
instructions: Melt cheese in double boiler with remaining ingredients. After it is all melted and mixed thoroughly put into 6 to 8 (1/2 pound) oleo tubs or put in fancy dishes and give away as gifts. Super good with crackers or celery sticks!

title: Colorado Curried Tuna Dip
instructions: Mix and chill serve with crackers and veggies.

title: Morning Glory Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Make sure it isnt too loose. Scoop into muffin tin and bake at 350\u00b0 approximately 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Curried Fruit
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and curry. Drain and dry fruits and place in large 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add butter mixture. Bake 1 hour uncovered.

title: Festive Chicken Supreme
instructions: Flour chicken and brown in oil. Mix all ingredients except asparagus and pour into a shallow 3-quart casserole. Arrange chicken over mixture and pour some of the mixture over the chicken breasts to coat. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Meanwhile prepare asparagus and cut in half crosswise. Remove casserole from oven and arrange asparagus between the chicken breasts. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes until chicken is tender an asparagus is tender-crisp.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Cooking meatballs on the stove requires constant attention. Instead arrange uniformly sized meatballs (you can use a small ice cream scoop to measure) in a shallow greased baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes no turning necessary. Simply add your favorite sauce and continue cooking until done.

title: Cherry Salad
instructions: Mix together and keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

title: Easy Pecan Rolls(Uncooked)
instructions: Combine Marshmallow Creme confectioners sugar vanilla and butter flavoring. Knead until all sugar is thoroughly blended. Shape into 8 rolls. Wrap each in plastic and freeze.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and all ingredients together. Chill.

title: Favorite Elegant Butter Creams
instructions: Mix butter and cream cheese at room temperature. Add vanilla. Then add 3 cups of flour and mix good. Roll out on a floured cutting board. Cut with small cutter and add small amount of filling. Pinch ends together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Governor'S Apple Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease an 8 or 9-inch round cake pan. Combine apples nuts and melted butter in large mixing bowl. Stir in egg vanilla and oil. Sift together flour soda spices and salt. Add to apple mixture stirring only until blended. Pour into pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes until lightly browned and tester comes out clean. This cake can be served warm but is even better if made ahead of time wrapped in plastic and refrigerated. Yields 8 servings.

title: Popover Upside-Down Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Cook and stir sausage and onion in 10-inch skillet until brown and onion is tender. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce green pepper 2 tablespoons flour basil fennel seed and marjoram. Heat to boiling. Boil 1 minute. Pour into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Arrange Mozzarella cheese slices on top. Beat eggs milk oil 1 cup flour and the salt with hand beater until smooth. Pour over cheese slices. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake until puffy and golden brown 25 to 30 minutes. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.

title: Mexican Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Process well. Let tortillas get soft at room temperature. Spread mixture on tortillas. Roll tortillas up tightly. Line up in 9 x 13-inch casserole cover tightly and refrigerate overnight or a minimum of 3 hours. Remove from refrigerator slice tortillas in 1/2 inch rounds. Serve with Paces medium Mexican sauce.

title: Carrot And Raisin Salad
instructions: Combine carrots and raisins. Moisten with mayonnaise or French dressing. Serve on lettuce. Makes 6 servings.

title: Peaches `N' Cream Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly coat a 10-inch pie pan with cooking spray. In a medium mixing bowl add flour salt and baking powder and stir to combine. Add melted margarine milk egg and pudding mix. Mix all ingredients on medium speed of an electric mixer. Pour mixture into prepared pie pan. Lay peaches over pudding. In separate bowl combine cream cheese and 1/3 cup sugar and mix on medium speed until well-combined. Gently spread cream cheese mixture over peaches; leaving 1-inch from edge of pie plate uncovered. In a small bowl combine 1 tablespoon sugar with cinnamon. Mix and sprinkle over pie. Bake for 35 minutes. Served hot with a dollop of fat-free vanilla ice cream and additional peaches. Makes 10 servings.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Let cheese soften at room temperature. Blend in cheeses onion beef olives and Ranch dressing. Blend all this very good and form a ball. Roll in chopped pecans. Serve with Sociables crackers.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Drain pineapple saving 3 tablespoons of juice. Combine sugar and flour; stir in pineapple juice. Add cheese and pineapple chunks; mix well. Spoon mixture into 1-quart greased casserole baking dish.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Bring margarine water and cocoa to boil. Add flour and sugar. Cream together with first mixture. Add eggs and sour cream. Bake in cookie sheet (15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inches) for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: English Muffin Pizza
instructions: Toast English muffins. Put toasted muffins on a flat pan. Put spoonful of tomato sauce on muffins. Put 2 slices of cheese on muffins then put a teensy bit more sauce. Sprinkle oregano on top. Drizzle with olive oil. Put pan in oven at 365\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter honey and dry milk. Roll into quarter size balls then roll in desired coating. After coating place on sheet cake pan lined with wax paper and chill.

title: Candied Apples
instructions: Bring sugar water and red hots to a boil. Add cinnamon sticks and food coloring. Drop peeled quartered apples (preferably Jonathan) into boiling liquid. Cook until tender. Enough syrup for about 10 or 12 apples.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Slice apples and place in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Mix together shortening brown sugar and flour. Cover apples with this mix and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

title: Pork Hot Dish
instructions: Cook pork celery pepper and onion in oil until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. In large bowl combine pork mixture noodles soups corn milk salt and pepper; mix well. Put in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until heated through.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Spray a tube pan lightly with Pam. Cut each biscuit in quarters. Place pieces in a covered bowl. Shake pieces well in sugar and cinnamon. Place 1 cup chopped pecans in bottom of pan. Arrange biscuit pieces on top placing them in brick fashion. Melt margarine and brown sugar and pour over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from pan and glaze.

title: Okra Pickles
instructions: Wash and cut stems 1/2 inch from okra pod. Place okra and peppers in hot jars. Bring vinegar mixture to a boil; pour over okra and seal. This makes a very crisp and tasty pickle.

title: Louisiana Cream Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and cream in large pot (2-quart). Bring to a boil. Stir constantly until (soft ball) 234\u00b0 to 240\u00b0 on candy thermometer. Remove from heat; let set for 5 minutes. Add butter; beat for 5 minutes. Add flour and beat for 15 minutes. Add nuts; pour into buttered pan. Cool; cut into squares. Store in airtight container.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Wash cucumbers and pack in jar. Pour hot water (boiling) over them and let stand. While preparing vinegar mixture put vinegar and water in pot and boil. Add 1/8 teaspoon alum clove of garlic and sprig of dill. Drain off first water and pour vinegar mixture over cucumbers and seal.

title: Mildred Hammond'S Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Gradually stir in grated Cheddar cheese pineapple 1 cup nuts green pepper seasoned salt and onions. Chill. Form into 2 balls. Roll in 1 cup chopped nuts.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Brown sausage. Melt cheese; mix together with Bisquick and shape into balls. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid jello and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water and pineapple juice. Freeze 4 to 6 hours until it becomes slush. Put in punch bowl and add ginger ale. Serves 20.

title: Cottage Cheese Whip
instructions: Add softened Cool Whip to cottage cheese. Mix in dry jello. Drain fruit well and add to mixture. Refrigerate to stiffen.

title: Chicken Cashew
instructions: Bring 2 1/2 cups water and salt to a boil in a medium-size saucepan; add rice. Cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender. Keep warm. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned; stir often. Remove chicken from skillet. Add mushrooms green onions green pepper and water chestnuts to skillet. Saute 5 minutes or until tender. Dissolve bouillon in 1 1/4 cups water. Combine soy sauce cornstarch brown sugar and ginger. Stir in bouillon mixture; cook over low heat stirring constantly 1 minute or until thickened. Stir in cashews. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Chocolate Chip Cream Cookies(Very Soft Moist Cookie)
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Add chopped nuts and chips; blend well. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet at once and cool. Makes 7 to 8 dozen cookies.

title: Homemade Soap
instructions: Caution When mixing lye and water follow precautions to prevent injury. Never mix lye with hot or warm water (always cold water). Clean rancid fats by boiling in equal amounts of water. Remove from heat. Chill by adding 1 quart cold water for each gallon. Remove fat from top.

title: Creamed Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in pot. Add next 4 ingredients. Cook until thickened stirring at same time. Add cut up chicken (boiled). Just before serving add 2 tablespoons cooking sherry. Serve over rice.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: With mixer cream the sugar and margarine. Add other ingredients one at a time. Roll dough in small balls; press with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until brown at edges. Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Pare and core apples saving skins and core and simmer in water. Drain and reserve liquid from syrup. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening. Add milk; stir only until moistened. Roll out to size of tea towel; cut into 6 or 8 squares. Put apples on each square of dough. Put 1 teaspoon butter 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon mixture in each apple. Pinch dough together over apple.

title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 9 x 9-inch ungreased baking dish stir together first 5 ingredients. Mix in milk oil and vanilla with fork until smooth. Stir in pecans. Stir together brown sugar and remaining cocoa; smooth over top of mixture in baking dish. Pour hot water over all ingredients.

title: Magic Cookie Bar
instructions: Melt margarine. Mix crumbs together and press into pan 13 x 9-inch. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 preheated oven (or until lightly browned). Cool thoroughly before cutting into bars.

title: Mexican Layered Dip
instructions: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan or a large platter. Spread bean dip. Spread guacamole. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and taco seasoning; spread on top. Chop tomatoes and spread. Spread black olives. Spread on onions (tops and bottom). Spread grated cheese. Serve with chips.

title: Spoonburgers
instructions: Brown meat and onion in skillet. Add salt pepper catsup and milk. Simmer until thick. Spread on buns.

title: Spaghetti Ala Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a lot of salted water al dente. At the same time saute the pancetta with Parmigiano and a little salt. In another pan melt butter; put eggs whipped. Drain spaghetti and mix everything. Let it sit for a couple of minutes then serve.

title: Texas Sheet Cake
instructions: Melt 1 cup butter water and 4 tablespoons cocoa in microwave. Mix in flour sugar and salt. In separate bowl mix eggs sour cream and soda. Mix the two batters together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes (even if center doesnt appear done).

title: Bernadine Davis' Potato Salad
instructions: Boil whole unpeeled potatoes about 1 hour. Test potatoes with a fork to see if they are done. Pour off hot water. Let sit in cold water about 20 minutes to cool down. Peel and cube potatoes into bite size chunks.

title: Fruitcake Cookies
instructions: Mix all fruit in a large bowl. Combine all dry ingredients; sift over fruit mixture. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Add to fruit and flour mixture; mix by hand adding enough orange juice to make right consistency. Drop by teaspoon onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Oysters Rockefeller
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Place the first 4 ingredients in a blender or food processor and chop finely. Add the rest of the ingredients to the blender. Puree until all ingredients are smoothly blended into a sauce.

title: Easy Key Lime Pie
instructions: Blend and pour into pie shell. Chill; top with more Cool Whip.

title: Green Bean Stew
instructions: Place meat in pot. Cover with water; let boil for half an hour skimming broth. Wash and cut beans. Add to meat and cook until meat is tender. Add onion tomatoes and spices. Fry garlic in butter; add to beans. Cook until beans are tender. Serve with fluffy rice.

title: Oougooie
instructions: Combine cake mix butter 1 egg and pecans (will be crumbly). Spread into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

title: Pork Chops L'Orange
instructions: Season and brown chops on the top of the stove. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle rice in pan. Pour orange juice over rice. Add chops on top. Pour chicken stock (well salted) over chops. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Salsa
instructions: Mix all together and dip with nacho chips.

title: Lemon Jello Salad
instructions: Mix jello water pineapple juice vinegar and salt. Chill. When slightly thickened add remaining ingredients.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine butter sugar and corn syrup; cook over low heat stir constantly until sugar is dissolved. Cool and then add eggs vanilla and salt; mix well. Pour filling into pie shell and top with nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Chicken Monterey
instructions: Cut chicken into little pieces. Brown chicken and put into baking dish. Pour picante sauce over chicken. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted.

title: Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Mix together. Put in a greased oblong 3-quart glass dish. Cover with foil. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Continue baking at 325\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours until done. Uncover during last 1/2 hour.

title: Cow Patties
instructions: In a double boiler simmer water. Melt chocolate chips and shortening. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat stir in rest of ingredients. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper and chill.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers. Melt margarine; pour over Ritz cracker crumbs. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.\tMelt 1/2 gallon ice cream in a large bowl. Add fresh milk and chocolate pudding; combine thoroughly. Pour into cooled crust and freeze. Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle with chopped nuts. Return to freezer.

title: Cheese Enchiladas
instructions: Set aside 1/3 of the farmer cheese and chiles for garnish. Cover the bottom of a 12 x 7-inch casserole dish with half of the enchilada sauce. In blender or food processor combine 2/3 of the farmer cheese and chiles onion yogurt Neufchatel cheese cottage cheese and hot salsa; blend well.

title: Shoo-Fly Cakes
instructions: Mix the flour brown sugar butter and salt; save 1 cup for crumbs. Mix water Karo and soda together; add to flour mixture. Sprinkle crumbs on top; bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. May also make cupcakes.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain and cool. Mix with beans. Add all other ingredients in large bowl except Fritos and dressing. Just before serving add these and toss.

title: Banana Cookies
instructions: Sift together all dry ingredients. Add oil egg bananas oatmeal chips and pecans. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes in a 350\u00b0 preheated oven.

title: Pasta Chicken Carbonara
instructions: Place bacon in 3-quart casserole. Cover with paper towel and microwave on High 8 to 12 minutes stirring after 5 minutes until crisp. Remove bacon with slotted spoon; drain and reserve. Drain fat reserving 1 tablespoon in casserole. Stir onion and garlic into fat in casserole. Cover tightly and microwave 1 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover tightly and microwave 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Toss with bacon.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Peel eggplant cube and boil until tender in salt water. Drain and mash. Mix bread that has been soaked with eggplant and add eggs onion oleo and seasonings. Mix well and pour into a greased one-quart casserole. Top with cheese and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Bubba'S Bourbon Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat the oven to 350\u00b0. Cream the butter and sugar beating until the mixture is fluffy. Add the eggs gradually beating after each addition. Add the corn syrup salt and bourbon. Coat the pecans in the flour and add to the mixture. Pour the filling into the crust and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the filling is firm.

title: Cheese Hash Brown Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes margarine onion soup sour cream cheese salt and pepper. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan (may butter if you wish). Mix corn flakes and margarine (add garlic to taste if desired) and spread over top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Punch For A Party
instructions: In a blender or food processor blend the water sugar and bananas until smooth. Pour into a large container. Add pineapple juice orange juice and lemon juice; mix well. Freeze stirring occasionally until slushy. Add ginger ale when ready to serve. Yield About 24 servings.

title: Apple Or Peach Coffee Cake
instructions: In a bowl mix together butter or margarine and sugar. Add eggs and milk. Cream. Stir in vanilla. Add flour salt and baking powder. Mix well. Pour onto greased cookie sheet. Arrange sliced fruit on top. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine sugar oil eggs and vanilla. Stir in zucchini. Blend in dry ingredients. Stir in 1/2 cup nuts and 1/2 cup raisins or 1 cup nuts or 1 cup raisins. Bake in 2 (5 x 8-inch) loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Cool 20 minutes on rack before removing from pan.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar butter and cream cheese. Beat until creamy. Add eggs one at a time. Sift the flour and baking powder. Add to creamy mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours in oven at 325\u00b0.

title: Date And Nut Loaf
instructions: Sprinkle dates with soda and pour boiling water over all. Set aside. Cream sugar butter and egg. Gradually stir in walnuts flour and vanilla. Combine with date mixture. Pour into ungreased paper-lined loaf pan or 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Fluffy Mustard Sauce
instructions: Place eggs in a bowl and add sugar mustard vinegar water and salt. Mix well. Pour mixture into a double boiler and cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens about 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Blend in butter and horseradish. Cool thoroughly. Fold in whipped cream. Serve with warm meat. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in roaster. Add onions and saute until slightly brown. Sprinkle rice over it. Lay chicken over rice. Mix soup and water; pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Pour peaches in baking pan. In medium bowl combine flour sugar and milk. Flour will be lumpy. Pour over top of peaches and cut pieces of margarine or butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Scallop Potatoes
instructions: Melt butter; add flour salt and pepper. Add milk; stir until boiling. Pour 1/2 sauce in dish. Add potatoes; add remaining sauce. Cover; cook 20 minutes in microwave.

title: Cheesiest Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Melt butter or margarine in shallow 2-quart baking dish. Add minced garlic. Brush to coat bottom and sides of dish.

title: Toffee Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix and bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Saucy Chicken Casserole
instructions: In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan combine soups sour cream broth onion mushrooms and seasonings. Arrange chicken on top of sauce. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Serve chicken and sauce over noodles or rice. Garnish with parsley. Serves 6.

title: Poppy Seed Loaf
instructions: Mix all together for 2 minutes. Bake in 4 small loaf pans at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Hot Tuna Appetizer
instructions: Mix tuna onion mayonnaise lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce together. Can be stored in refrigerator for a day or two. Put small amount atop a Ritz cracker; top with a square of Cheddar cheese and broil until cheese melts. Serve warm.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt butter in baking dish in oven. Mix cheese flour salt and pepper in plastic bag. Shake potatoes in bag coating thoroughly with mixture. Place potatoes in baking dish in a single layer. Bake for 45 minutes or until done. Serves 6.

title: Microwave Caramel Fudge
instructions: In large glass bowl combine sugar milk and butter. Microwave 2 minutes. Mix well and microwave 5 minutes stirring twice during cooking. Add caramels and microwave 45 to 60 seconds. Beat until caramels are melted and mixture is smooth. Stir in nuts. Pour into lightly greased 8-inch square dish. Cool and cut into pieces.

title: Molasses Cookies(Soft And Chewy)
instructions: In a medium bowl combine Quick Mix 1/4 cup sugar cinnamon ginger and cloves. Mix well. Combine egg yolk and molasses in a small bowl. Add to dry mixture. Blend well. Refrigerate at least one hour. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F (190\u00b0C). Lightly grease baking sheets. Shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place on prepared baking sheets. Flatten balls with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until edges are browned. Makes about 30 cookies.

title: Ham And Chicken Dish
instructions: Wrap a slice of ham around each breast and place in long casserole dish. Mix the soup and sour cream together. Pour over meat and bake at 350\u00b0 until done (about 35 to 40 minutes). This is excellent with rice.

title: Low Calorie Beef With Peppers And Snow Peas
instructions: In 12-inch no-stick skillet heat oil. Add ginger and garlic and saute until garlic is golden. Add pepper strips snow peas mushrooms and green onions and saute until tender-crisp. Add steak and cook stirring constantly until heated through. Add soy sauce and stir to combine. Each serving is 342 calories (39 g. protein 14 g. fat 16 g. carbohydrate).

title: Barbecued Green Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put into a casserole with lid. Or could use a crock-pot on low setting. Cook 3 hours at 275\u00b0.

title: Barbecued Spareribs(Serves 6)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except spareribs in a blender or large lidded jar and blend or shake until mixture is thoroughly combined. Place the ribs in a large shallow baking pan and cover them with the sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and marinate at room temperature for several hours. Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0. Leave the foil in place and bake for 45 minutes; uncover and bake another 30 to 40 minutes. Serve cut in portions of 2 to 3 ribs.

title: Snickerdoodles
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. Add flour to mixture. Stir in vanilla. Shape into balls the size of walnuts. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Roll each ball in sugar mixture. Place on a cookie sheet. Flatten slightly with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes or until cookies begin to fall.

title: Perfect Potato Salad
instructions: In covered pan cook whole potatoes in enough boiling salted water to cover for about 25 minutes or until almost tender. Drain well. Peel the warm potatoes. Quarter and slice potatoes; transfer to mixing bowl. Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar. Add the sliced celery onion sweet pickle salt and celery seed to the potatoes; stir the mixture to combine. Add mayonnaise or salad dressing; fold into potato mixture. Carefully fold in the sliced eggs. Cover and chill thoroughly. Makes 4 servings.

title: Nana'S Hearty Beef Stew
instructions: Cover bottom of pan with oil. Shake and coat beef with Durkee brown gravy. Brown beef in oil. Add water to cover meat. Add onion soup mix. Cover and cook 1/2 hour. Add potatoes. Cover and cook 1/2 hour. Last 10 minutes add carrots.

title: Kapusta
instructions: Combine hamburger eggs salt pepper rice and 1/3 can tomato juice. Make into meatballs. Put layer of cabbage meat and sauerkraut. Pour rest of juice over it. Add water. Bake 1 hour or until cabbage is done.

title: Glazed Peanuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large frying pan. Simmer and stir constantly until all liquid has been absorbed. Spread peanuts onto a greased cookie sheet in a single layer. Bake in a 250\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes stirring every 10 minutes. Cool and store in airtight container.

title: Cauliflower And Spinach Salad
instructions: Combine spinach bacon and cauliflower; add mixture of Miracle Whip sugar and Parmesan cheese. Serves 6.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Boil chicken. When done debone and set aside to cool. Turn oven on to 350\u00b0. Mix together the vegetable soup salt and pepper to taste. Put deboned chicken into soup mixture. Put in oven for about 1 hour. When hot and bubbly add biscuits on top and bake until golden brown. Take out and serve.

title: Aunt Corrie'S Heritage Pound Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs; mix well. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture alternately with milk and flavorings; mix well. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done at 300\u00b0.

title: Toll House Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Add flour sugar and brown sugar. Blend in butter; stir in chocolate chips and add walnuts if desired. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream or ice cream or enjoy as is.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Makes 1 pie.

title: Radish Relish
instructions: Grind radishes celery and onion. Put in a large bowl and mix well. Add other ingredients. Let stand overnight or at least 3 hours in the refrigerator. Bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes. Put in hot sterilized jars. Makes 3 1/2 to 4 pints.

title: Clams Royale
instructions: Scrub outside of clam shells thoroughly discarding any broken or open clams. Soak clams in salted water for at least 3 hours to clean. Rinse and drain clams. Place water in 2-quart casserole. Microwave at High for 2 to 3 1/2 minutes or until water boils. Add clams. Cover. Microwave at High for 3 to 5 1/2 minutes or until clams open stirring once. Remove clams from casserole as they begin to open. Remove each clam from shell. Reserve half of each shell. Mince clams. Set aside.

title: Fluffy Hard Sauce
instructions: Fluffy Hard Sauce Cream butter. Stir in egg yolk. Gradually cream in sugar until fluffy and light. Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Vary flavor with lemon or orange juice and grated peel or add 1 tablespoon of rum or brandy. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Dr. Bird'S Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs and oil mixing well. Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 cup nuts and bananas. Spoon into 3 well-greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes before removing from pans. Cool completely. Spread with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Hearty Potato Soup
instructions: Combine potatoes carrots and celery in a large pot. Add water. Cook for 20 minutes or tender. Drain liquid. Set vegetables aside. Saute onion in butter in small pot. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Add milk gradually. Stir gently. Pour into vegetables. Add a cup or more of liquid.

title: Sherri'S Vegetable Salad
instructions: Combine vegetables in a large bowl.

title: Ravioli
instructions: Mix together in a bowl the Ricotta cheese 5 eggs Romano cheese and salt and pepper to taste. Beat with electric mixer. Set aside.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Mix flour and butter; mix with other ingredients except pecans. Butter edges of pie crust; put 1 cup of pecans in each crust. Pour 1/2 of mixture in each crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Tuna Fish Luncheon Dish
instructions: Place mound of tuna salad on English muffin; then slice of pineapple on top of salad. Top all with Swiss cheese slice. Broil until cheese melts and serve hot!

title: Noodles And Cheese
instructions: Boil water for noodles. Cook 5 to 6 minutes. Drain and put noodles in a bowl.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix together and refrigerate.

title: Swedish Cabbage Rolls
instructions: In bowl combine egg salt pepper Worcestershire sauce onion and milk and mix well. Add ground beef and cooked rice and mix well. Immerse cabbage leaves in boiling water for 3 minutes or just until limp. Heavy center vein of leaf may be split about 2 1/2-inches.

title: Parsley Pinwheel Loaf
instructions: Prepare hot roll mix with one egg and let rise. Beat other egg in a cup. Stir in cheese. Heat remaining ingredients in small saucepan until greens wilt. Cool and blend in beaten egg mix. Punch down dough. Knead a few times. Roll out to an 18 x 6 rectangle. Spread with parsley mix. Roll jelly fashion and place seam side down in greased 9 x 5 x 3 pan. Cover. Let rise again until double in size (about 45 minutes). Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until bread gives a hollow sound when tapped.

title: Pasta Pesto Florentine
instructions: In food processor process walnuts and garlic until smooth. Thaw and drain spinach. Add spinach and all remaining ingredients to walnuts and garlic and process until smooth. Spoon over choice of cooked pasta. Serve hot or cold. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Funeral Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Bake until crust forms on top.

title: Fruited Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Combine oil juice vinegar and salt. Pour over chicken and toss. Chill 1 hour and then drain off liquid. Stir mayonnaise into salad. Delicious.

title: Oven Apple Butter
instructions: In a large covered kettle simmer the apples and water until tender. Press through a sieve or food mill. Measure 1 gallon of pulp; place in a large roaster. Add sugar vinegar cinnamon and cinnamon stick. Cover and bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 hours stirring occasionally. Uncover and bake 1 hour longer stirring occasionally until very thick. Remove the cinnamon stick. Pour hot into hot jars leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Adjust the caps. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath. Yield 8 pints.

title: German Apple Cake
instructions: Sift together the flour baking soda salt and cinnamon into a large bowl; set aside. Combine eggs sugar oil and vanilla into a large mixer bowl. Beat on low speed until well blended. Add dry ingredients mixing until well blended. Fold in apples and walnuts. Spoon into a well-greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done (batter will be very thick).

title: French Coconut Pies
instructions: Mix sugar eggs and butter. Add flour flavor buttermilk and coconut. Pour half into each shell and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour on 275\u00b0.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: In 8 x 12-inch dish mix all together

title: Candied Pecans
instructions: Cover pecans with water in saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute and drain well. Mix sugar and spices; set aside. While pecans are still warm toss with sugar mixture. Spread on tray in single layer; let dry 8 to 24 hours. Heat oil to 350\u00b0. Fry nuts about 2 minutes until sugar caramelizes and nuts are dark brown. Drain well. Sprinkle with salt while still warm if desired. Store in airtight container. Makes 4 cups.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix zucchini eggs sugar vanilla molasses and oil together. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add nuts. Put in 4 loaf pans sprayed with Pam and floured. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Mom'S Huckleberry Pudding
instructions: Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tested done and brown. If using blackberries do not flour them. Fold berries into batter. Eat like cake or in dish with milk on.

title: Moo Goo Ngaw(Beef With Mushrooms)
instructions: *Note Canned mushrooms may be used added at very end of cooking.

title: 44 Calorie A Cup Of Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate. Ranch Free dressing is also good.

title: Biscuits Supreme
instructions: Sift together first 5 ingredients; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk all at once; stir only until dough follows fork around bowl. Turn out on lightly floured surface; knead gently 1/2 minute. Pat or roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on ungreased baking sheet at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 16.

title: Sopa De Fideos(Soup With Vermicelli)
instructions: Brown fideos in hot oil carefully to avoid breaking coils. Add tomato sauce broth and seasonings.

title: Mrs. Rock'S Surprise Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and bake in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: French Silk Pie
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating with mixer for 3 full minutes after addition of each egg. Pour into shell and chill for 1 hour. Cover with whipped cream and chocolate.

title: Better Than Recess Cake
instructions: Make cake. While cooling prepare pudding adding in cream cheese. Mix into pudding leaving a little lumpy. Spread on cake then drain the pineapple very well and spread over cream cheese. Spread the Cool Whip. Refrigerate at least 2 hours then serve.

title: Vegetable Wreath
instructions: Cover 10 to 12-inch Styrofoam ring completely with foil. Attach parsley to floral picks. Insert into ring covering top and sides completely. Cut broccoli cauliflower and green pepper into bite-sized pieces. Make curls of carrots and celery. Cut radishes into roses. Insert wooden toothpick into each vegetable. Stick vegetables into ring. Place ring on serving tray. Place candle or bowl of dip in center of ring. Yields 20 servings.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: In a well-greased 9 x 13 pan place pecans in a layer then top with a layer of coconut. Prepare cake mix as directed and pour over the coconut.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Beat eggs and mix well with sugar syrup vanilla salt and butter/margarine. Pour over 1 cup pecans in pie shell. (Pecan halves are difficult to cut though they look good. I suggest slightly chopped.) This recipe is generous for pie or 12 tarts. Usually I use light brown sugar and white syrup or vice versa; all dark makes it too strong. Baking time is not exact. Watch it carefully. Bake at 400\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for no more than 10 minutes to brown the crust. Then lower to 350\u00b0 to 325\u00b0 until done; firm but not overdone or hard on top.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Pour into 2 small uncooked pie shells. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until brown.

title: German Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Mix Pet milk sugar margarine and egg yolks well. Cook over medium heat until thickened about 5 to 8 minutes. Take off heat and add coconut and pecans. Add vanilla. Beat until cool. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Ding-A-Ling Penders
instructions: In a 1-quart casserole combine peanuts and noodles. In a 1-quart glass measuring cup melt butterscotch pieces in microwave oven 3 minutes at High. Stir until smooth. Add to peanut mixture. Toss gently until coated. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Chill to harden.

title: Meat Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Makes 2/3 cups.

title: Crab Canapes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease baking sheet and set aside. Combine crab meat onions Swiss cheese mayonnaise curry powder salt and lemon juice. Mix well. Separate each roll into 3 pieces. Place on baking sheet. Spoon crab mixture on top of rolls. Top with water chestnut. Bake 12 minutes or until puffed and brown.

title: Angel'S De Lite
instructions: Gradually add\tsugar to egg whites. Fold in vanilla crushed crackers and nuts. Bake in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.\tCool and frost.

title: Shrimp Mold
instructions: Heat soup (do not add any milk or water). Mix gelatine with water and stir into soup. While hot add other ingredients shrimp last. Pour into mold. Chill overnight. Unmold and serve with crackers.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine milk and egg yolks at low speed. Slowly add juice until well blended. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate overnight.

title: Nescafe(A Popular Cypriot Beverage)
instructions: Heat milk slowly. When it begins to froth pour into cup with instant coffee and stir (no water). Sugar may be added if desired. Makes 1 cup.

title: Crab Newberg
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan. Add crab meat and spices and simmer on slow heat for 3 minutes. Add 2 ounces of sherry and let it reduce by one-half about 2 minutes then add cream. Dilute egg yolks with 1 ounce sherry. Add and mix carefully. Cook and stir until thickened. Serve over rice. Serves 4 people.

title: Friendship Tea
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in covered jar. Dissolve 2 teaspoons tea mix in 1 cup hot water to serve.

title: Stollen
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water; scald milk; add butter and sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Cool to lukewarm. Beat egg and add to milk mixture with yeast almond extract and salt. Stir in 2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Stir in almonds raisins and cherries. Add remaining flour and mix until smooth. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled in size. Punch down; knead lightly and pat to 12-inch circle. Fold in half; press edges together firmly. Place on greased sheet (baking). Brush top with melted butter. Let rise 1/2 hour in warm place. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes. Spread top with icing while warm. Makes one large loaf.

title: Lumpia
instructions: Mix pork and beef together. Add chopped onion and saute. Add shrimp and cook 1 more minute. Add beaten eggs and cool. Add mushrooms carrots onion shoyu salt and pepper. Mix well. Wrap in lumpia wrappers. Use only about 1 heaping tablespoonful on a wrapper. Always cool filling before wrapping otherwise wrapper will fall apart. Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Lemon Squares
instructions: Mix and pack first 3 ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Beat last 4 ingredients and pour on top of baked crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for an additional 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cool before cutting.

title: Coconut Brunch Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar salad oil and flavoring until light and fluffy. Alternate dry ingredients with buttermilk. Add coconut and nuts. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Put into two greased and floured loaf pans or 1 prepared Bundt pan or 6 mini loaf pans.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Peel carrots and cook in salt water until tender. Heat together butter brown sugar and cloves. Add carrots. Cook 3 to 5 minutes until glazed.

title: Chocolate Layer Cake
instructions: Beat all together about 5 minutes. Bake in tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about\t1 hour. Grease and flour pan bottom only. When cool cut cake in 4 layers.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together using 1/2 of the cheese in the mixture. Place in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fried Pies
instructions: Sift salt and baking powder with sifted and measured flour. Blend in shortening. Combine egg yolk sugar and milk; stir into flour mixture. Roll out on a floured board to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into circles 4 or 5 inches in diameter. Spread a small amount of fruit filling on half of each round. Fold the other half of crust over filling. Seal edges with fork dipped in flour. Fry in deep fat at 360\u00b0 until browned. Drain on absorbent paper; sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Easy Day Hamburger
instructions: Brown ground beef. Pour off fat and place meat in a 2-quart casserole dish. Prepare egg noodles according to package directions. Drain. Add to casserole dish. Add soups and mix well. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Molasses Crinkle Cookies
instructions: Melt shortening in a 3 or 4-quart saucepan over low heat. Cool. Add sugar molasses and egg and beat well. Sift together rest of dry ingredients. Add to first mixture. Mix well. Chill. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar and place on greased cookie sheets 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Deer Jerky
instructions: Remove all fat from meat and cut 1/4-inch slices along grain. Combine dry and liquid ingredients for marinade. Marinate meat overnight in refrigerator. Drain and lay meat strips on oven rack. Place foil on bottom to catch drips. Leave oven door ajar and bake at 150\u00b0 for 6 hours. Turn oven off and leave meat in another 6 hours. Yields approximately 1 pound.

title: Cherry Coffeecake
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and butter with electric mixer. Add eggs and flavorings. Beat until fluffy. Add flour and baking powder; mix until smooth. Place 2/3 of the batter in a greased 10 x 15 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Spread evenly. Place the pie filling evenly over the batter. Drop remaining batter by teaspoonfuls over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Drizzle with icing made of 1/2 cup powdered sugar and 1 to 2 tablespoons of milk while warm.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Lay strips of bacon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chop Onion-Rice Bake
instructions: Brown chops in drippings. Spread rice in bottom of 13 1/2 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Reserve 1 tablespoon of onion soup mix and then sprinkle rest over rice. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid and distribute mushrooms and pimento over rice. Add hot water to reserved mushroom liquid to total 3 cups; pour over rice. Arrange chops on top of rice and sprinkle reserved onion soup mix on chops. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove foil and cook 10 minutes longer.

title: Brine For Fish
instructions: Soak 10 hours or overnight. Smoke 8 to 10 hours.

title: Frozen Banana Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Stir well and pour into a 9-inch square pan or foil cupcake holders. Freeze. Serves 9.

title: Awesome Appetizers
instructions: Mix sugar and ketchup together. Wrap whole water chestnuts with 1/2 slice of bacon and secure with an uncolored toothpick and place in a baking dish. Pour sugar-ketchup mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from baking dish and place on serving tray. Let stand before serving; very hot.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Mix all together and drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Chiffon Cake
instructions: Into large mixing bowl sift flour sugar baking powder and salt. Make a well and add in order salad oil egg yolks pineapple juice and lemon rind. Beat with spoon until smooth. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar in large mixing bowl until they hold very stiff peaks. Slowly pour egg yolks mixture over beaten whites gently folding until just blended. Fold in coconut. Pour into thoroughly clean ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Bake in preheated slow oven (325\u00b0) for 55 minutes then moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 10 to 15 minutes. Invert pan. Hang until cold. Garnish with whipped cream and drained pineapple (crushed).

title: Grandpa O'S Salad
instructions: Mix together and cool.

title: S O S Potato Pancakes
instructions: In top pan of double boiler melt butter or oleo over medium heat. Add flour salt and pepper to melted butter or oleo; stir until smooth over low heat. Gradually stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly until sauce is thickened and smooth. Set aside. Brown hamburger or ground chuck in skillet with minced onion until well browned. Drain off grease. Pour hamburger mixture into white sauce; set aside.

title: 14 Layer Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and put 4 tablespoons of batter in cake pans. Do not overcook. Just dry out.

title: Chuck Wagon Roast And Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet brown roast in oil. Place in roaster. Add flour to meat drippings. Add buttermilk water and bouillon. Cook stirring until bouillon dissolves (about 10 minutes). Place carrots and onions around meat. Pour sauce over meat. Cook 1 hour and 45 minutes. Add remaining vegetables. Cook 15 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Applesauce Cake
instructions: Blend all together except chocolate chips and nuts in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Needs no frosting; serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Tamale Pie
instructions: Cook shortening onions and meat until meat turns color. Add tomatoes corn chili and salt. Add eggs milk and cornmeal. Stir into meat.\tCook and stir until thickened. Place in casserole with ripe olives. Bake 1/2 to 3/4 hour at medium heat. An \old faithful\ during \the girls\ growing up days.

title: Banana  Cheesecake Dessert
instructions: Set aside filling and strawberry topping packets from cheesecake mixes. Place the contents of the crust mix packets in a large bowl; add butter and sugar. Press into an ungreased 13-inch x 9-inch x 2-inch dish. In a large mixing bowl combine the milk and contents of filling packets. Beat on low speed until blended. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes or until slightly thickened. Spread over crust. Refrigerate for one hour. Spread contents of strawberry topping over cheesecake. Top with pineapple and bananas. Drizzle with chocolate and caramel topping (1/4 cup each). Spread with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Before serving drizzle remaining chocolate and caramel toppings. Top with pecans and cherries.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: In skillet over medium heat brown meat and cook onion until done. Pour off drippings. Stir in corn tomato sauce rice steak sauce and pepper. Set aside.

title: Baked Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all together except cheese. Place the cheese on top and press down into mixture a little. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes or until done. Bake covered.

title: Monterey Casserole
instructions: Heat oil saute onion and garlic. Add meat and brown. Blend in tomatoes taco seasoning and chilies simmer 10 minutes. Grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer 1/2 chips over bottom of pan. Spoon in meat mixture the Mozzarella cheese and next sour cream then top with rest of chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and continue baking until cheese is melted.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: *Set aside approximately 1/2 cup flour to dredge the gumdrops raisins and nuts so that the fruit wont sink to the bottom. Be sure and add remaining flour to the cake.

title: Old Fashioned Pot Roast
instructions: Sprinkle roast with meat tenderizer. Place roast in baking dish lined with foil. Pour mushroom soup and water over the roast. Cover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours or until tender.

title: Golden Cheddar Broccoli Bake
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons oleo. Stir in flour and salt. Add milk gradually. Mix until smooth. Cook until mixture boils. Stir constantly. Add cheese; stir until melted. Mix in 1/4 cup flakes and corn. Arrange broccoli in 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Pour cheese sauce over broccoli. Toss remaining 1/2 cup crumbs with 2 tablespoons butter melted. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pecan Cookies
instructions: Mix together the butter and powdered sugar. Add flour vanilla and chopped pecans. Roll into balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fingers. Place in oven set at 325\u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while still slightly warm.

title: Spinach Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Beat egg yolks mash cream cheese and add both to hot (not boiling) soup. Add spinach beaten egg whites and Parmesan cheese to the above mixture. Put in large casserole and top with French fried onions. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. No salt is needed in this recipe because of the use of concentrated soup. However if you must use more salt do it sparingly. Serves 8.

title: Baked Fish Fillets With Wine Sauce
instructions: In double boiler saute onion in butter; stir in flour 1 teaspoon salt pepper and milk. Cook over boiling water until thickened. Remove from heat. Pour Sauterne into 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt; pour on salt. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes basting 3 times. Sprinkle with parsley.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Crumble ground beef or pork into 2-quart glass casserole. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until no longer pink stirring once to break up meat. Add taco seasoning mix and kidney beans. Microwave on High for 10 to 11 minutes or until flavors are blended stirring twice. Let stand about 10 minutes to cool slightly.

title: Fluffy Cheese Omelet
instructions: Set oven thermostat at 350\u00b0.

title: Amish Pie Crust
instructions: Cut flour salt and lard together. Stir egg in measuring cup then add enough to measure 2/3 cup of liquid. Mix liquid into flour mixture. Chill then roll.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Dissolve sugar in 1/2 cup cold water. Bring to a boil. Add remaining water to cornstarch to make a smooth paste. Add paste to sugar mixture. Cook until transparent. Remove from heat. Add salt lemon juice and enough coloring to make a light shade of red. Reserve 1 cup of berries for garnishing pie. Cut remaining berries into 2 or 3 pieces. Pour mixture over cut berries. Let cool. Pour into pie shell. Garnish with whipped cream and whole strawberries.

title: Gnocchi Au Gratin
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup cheese and butter. Drop dumpling batter in 3/4-inch pieces into boiling water seasoned with additional tablespoon salt. Cook gently until dumplings rise to surface. Remove with slotted spoon. Drain on paper towels. Place in shallow buttered casserole. Keep hot in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. When all dumplings are boiled pour on butter. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Broil until golden brown. Serve with meat.

title: Pop'S Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Cover pork roast with water and boil slowly until well done. Cool then shred into small pieces. Mix sauce in pan and simmer for 30 minutes. Add meat and continue simmering stirring occasionally for about 1 hour. Serve on buns.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and onion. Drain grease. Add next 8 ingredients and simmer for 25 minutes. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

title: Butternut Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook drain and mash squash. Add sugar flour margarine eggs milk salt and vanilla. Mix thoroughly and pour into greased casserole. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven. Marshmallows may be added and browned or serve squash with whipped topping.

title: Lemon Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix jello salt and water. Cool slightly. Add mayonnaise cottage cheese celery onion pimento and green pepper. Let set until congealed.

title: Popular Punch
instructions: Combine orange juice concentrate lemonade concentrate and cranberry cocktail. (Chill.) Just before serving stir in ginger ale. Garnish with orange slices. Makes 12 (6 ounce) servings.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour baking powder salt and soda. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles crumbs. Add buttermilk all at once and stir until dough follows fork around bowl. Knead 1/2 minute. Roll 1/2-inch thick. Brush with melted fat. Fold over and cut double biscuits. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 450\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Apple Pancakes
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to boil. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Makes 1 cup. Serve with sour cream for brunch.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over melted butter. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet. Add coconut; stir constantly over low heat until golden brown. Spread coconut on paper towel to cool. Cream 2 tablespoons butter with cream cheese; add milk and sugar alternately beating well. Add vanilla; stir in 1 3/4 cups of coconut. Spread on bottom and top layer and the sides. Sprinkle top with brown coconut.

title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix cereal with sugar flour soda and salt. Use a very large bowl. Add eggs shortening and milk. Store in a covered container in refrigerator and use as desired. Batter will last 6 weeks. To bake fill greased tin 2/3 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Almond Bake
instructions: Blend soup and milk. Combine chicken celery almonds onion and Worcestershire sauce. Sprinkle 1/2 noodles in bottom of greased casserole dish. Add chicken mixture over top of noodles. Then top with remaining noodles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: The Best Ever Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine eggs raisins and vanilla. COVER AND LET STAND FOR 1 HOUR. Cream together butter and sugars. Add flour salt cinnamon and soda. Mix well. Blend in egg-raisin mixture; oatmeal wheat germ and chopped nuts. Dough will be stiff. With a tablespoon or cookie scoop scoop out a ball shape amount. Put on cookie sheet. Press down just a little to flatten dough a little. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 6 dozen depending on the size you make.

title: Easy Potato Rolls
instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream the sugar and shortening. Add the potatoes salt and eggs. In a small bowl dissolve yeast in 3/4 cup warm water. Add to creamed mixture. Beat in 2 cups flour and remaining water. Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough. Shape into a ball. Do not knead. Place in a greased bowl turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour. Punch dough down. Divide into thirds. Shape each portion into 15 balls and arrange in three greased 9-inch round baking pans. Cover and let rise until doubled about 30 minutes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 45 rolls.

title: Potato Wedges
instructions: Wash and scrub potatoes. Cut into wedges. Melt margarine. In a large pot combine melted margarine and potato wedges. Cook on low to medium heat for 30 minutes covered stirring occasionally. Mix together flour and onion soup mix. Add mix to potato wedges and stir. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Turn out onto a baking pan and cook about 25 minutes uncovered. Turn wedges once during baking time. More time may be necessary depending on how brown and crisp you prefer.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Line glass cake pan with graham crackers. Mix pudding and milk and leave set. Add whipped topping. Pour half of pudding mixture on the crackers in pan. Add another layer of crackers and pour the rest of the pudding mixture over the crackers then top with third layer of crackers. Heat the frosting mix in microwave a minute then pour over top of crackers let cool.

title: Three Beans
instructions: Fry bacon; saute onions green pepper and celery. Fry hamburg. Add all 4 cans of beans. Mix catsup mustard Worcestershire sauce vinegar and brown sugar. Add this mixture to rest of ingredients. Mix well and cook for 45 minutes in electric skillet. Also may cook in crock-pot or oven.

title: Snooker Doodle Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll in small balls. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Dip cookies in above mixture and place on a cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Bake at 400 for 8 minutes.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Mix well and put 1/2 of mix in Bundt pan. Put the brown sugar mixture over it. Add remainder of cake mix. Take a fork and swirl the mixtures together. Cook 50 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Punch
instructions: May leave out Hawaiian Punch. Mix and chill.

title: Artichoke Spread
instructions: Cut up artichoke hearts into big chunks. Mix together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm. Can be used with various breads.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Drain pineapple and reserve juice. Mix jello in hot water and 1 cup of pineapple juice. In separate bowl blend cream cheese and mayonnaise until creamy. Add crushed pineapple and nuts. Combine jello with pineapple mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and refrigerate.

title: Cheese Carrots
instructions: Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes; melt over hot water. Cool slightly. Blend with the cheese salt and Worcestershire sauce. Chill just enough to stiffen slightly. Divide into 1/2 teaspoon portions; roll in the grated carrots until well coated. Place on wax paper and chill. Stick a sprig in the end of each.

title: Morning Rolls
instructions: Grease Bundt pan or spray with Pam. Line pan with frozen rolls. Sprinkle dry pudding on top of rolls. In saucepan (or microwave) melt oleo sugar and cinnamon until dissolved and stir until mixed together. Pour over rolls. Add nuts by sprinkling over top. Cover with foil that has been sprayed with Pam. Let stand overnight on counter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let set in pan 30 minutes then invert on serving dish.

title: Italian Meatballs And Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients; roll meatballs and brown in vegetable oil and then place in Italian sauce and simmer for about 3 hours.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and butter for nine minutes. Add chocolate chips 1 package at a time and stir each time until dissolved then add Marshmallow Creme; add vanilla.

title: Mustard Pickle
instructions: Chop peppers and onions fine. Cook them separate; drain. Put in kettle with next 7 ingredients. Bring to boil. Mix the last 3 ingredients with water to make paste. Pour in with other ingredients and boil 5 minutes. Stir because it will stick quick. Put in jars and seal. Makes about 10 pints.

title: Baked Bean Surprise
instructions: Brown ground chuck onion and bell pepper. Add pork and beans. Stir in A.1. sauce and brown sugar. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Green Punch
instructions: Mix and sweeten Kool-Aid by directions on the package. Add pineapple juice and ginger ale. Sweeten to taste and chill. Makes 2 to 4 gallons.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and place in baking dish. Stir together soup and cheese. Gradually add milk mayo and egg; blend together. Pour over broccoli. Combine bread crumbs and melted butter and sprinkle over all. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Grape Salad
instructions: Mix and dissolve well the first 3 ingredients. Add the next 2 and chill. Mix the sour cream cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla together. Spread over the chilled jello and chill.

title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
instructions: Cook vegetables in boiling water until tender. Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except meat. Stir well. Add meat and mix well. Shape into loaf in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes in boiling water. Drain well. Combine soup mayo eggs cheese onion and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well; add broccoli. Spread in casserole dish (greased with Pam). Dot with butter or margarine and sprinkle with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Rhubarb Skillet Cake
instructions: Put rhubarb in a heavy iron skillet or pan with brown sugar. Mix the sugar and oleo; add eggs soda and sour milk. Add flour. Pour this over the rhubarb. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Turn upside-down so rhubarb is on top.

title: Merichka'S Salad Dressing
instructions: Add all ingredients together and shake well. Refrigerate. Makes 1 pint.

title: Brian'S Favorite Instant Hot Tea Mix
instructions: Mix well. To a cup of hot water add two or three teaspoons or to taste. Store tea mixture in an airtight container jar plastic or Ziploc baggie.

title: Quick And Easy Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients all together. Grease 18 muffin tin cups. Fill about 1/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Makes 18 Quick and Easy Rolls.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Melt bacon drippings in heavy pot or Dutch oven. Add sliced onion shredded cabbage and soup stock. Cover pot and bring to boil then simmer for 1/2 hour. Serve with cornbread. Pass a cruet of cider vinegar with this cabbage. Dunk cornbread in the pot likker. Good.

title: Apple Salad
instructions: Combine Miracle Whip with enough pineapple juice to make it thin. In a medium size bowl combine apples pineapple and celery. Pour in pineapple juice and Miracle Whip and blend well. Put into refrigerator and allow to become cool. Serve either plain or with lettuce.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Bring potatoes water and onion to a boil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Reduce heat cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes stirring once or twice until potatoes are tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer uncovered 3 to 5 minutes for flavor to develop. Serves 4.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Sift together confectioners sugar and cocoa then add peanut butter and vanilla. Melt margarine and mix together. Place in a 9 x 12-inch pan and refrigerate for 1 hour until set. Remove from refrigerator and cut into squares.

title: Polish Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine cabbage tomatoes puree water butter juice sugar and salt in a large kettle. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Beat egg yolks and sour cream\tin a small bowl. Gradually add 1\tcup of hot soup into egg mixture.\tStir contents of bowl gradually into soup kettle. Remove from heat and stir constantly to prevent eggs from curdling. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add other ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake on bottom shelf of oven at 300\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Zesty Bacon Dip
instructions: In small bowl combine sour cream milk bacon green onions and horseradish. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to blend flavors. Garnish as desired. Serve with crackers. Makes 2 cups.

title: Mike'S Cookies
instructions: Mix well first four ingredients. Add soda baking powder and vanilla. Stir in all dry ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 on sprayed cookie sheet.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread chopped pecans and coconut on bottom. Prepare cake mix. Pour over nuts and coconut. Mix next 4 ingredients. Spread on top of cake mixture. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Layer cooked macaroni alternately with grated cheese in 1-quart ovenproof casserole. Beat eggs with milk; pour over macaroni-cheese mixture. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 40 minutes or until custard is set and top is crispy brown. Serves 4.

title: Famous Pear Relish
instructions: Grind pears in food processor and drain. Grind peppers and onions. Combine all ingredients and boil for 25 minutes. Fill jars and seal. Process in water bath canner for 10 minutes. Delicious with dried beans and vegetable soup.

title: Chicken And Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables (bell pepper celery onions and garlic) in broth until tender. Cook spaghetti and drain (better if cooked in chicken broth). Mix spaghetti chicken cheese soup mushrooms and vegetables with broth and remaining ingredients. Fill buttered casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. You may freeze dish before cooking. Does not require covering; if you do cover remove cover about 10 minutes prior to removing from oven. This will make 2 casseroles; 1 to eat now and 1 to freeze for later.

title: Corn Meal Mush
instructions: Mix yellow corn meal with cold water enough to get it stirred together. Add it to boiling water until well blended. Stir until well blended with boiling water. Cook for 2 hours in double boiler. Pour into oblong pan and slice when cold. Fry slowly until brown. Serve with syrup.

title: Beef Soup
instructions: Cook beef onion and garlic in a large saucepan over medium heat until brown stirring to separate meat. Drain drippings.

title: Flamingo Punch
instructions: Cook sugar and water (8 cups) in a large pot until all sugar is dissolved; cool. Strain fruit juice and combine with sugar mixture in large container. Add water and ice just before serving. Makes 6 gallons. May divide recipe by 8 4 or 2.

title: Potato Cakes
instructions: Cook enough Irish potatoes to make 2 cups mashed potatoes. Mash and add flour milk salt and pepper. Mix until well blended adding more or less flour and milk. Drop by patties in hot shortening and fry until golden brown.

title: Orange Beets
instructions: Moisten cornstarch with 1/2 of the water to make a smooth paste; set aside. Mix the juice remaining water vinegar and brown sugar in a saucepan. Heat to boiling and add the cornstarch mixture. Stir to prevent lumping cooking until clear and thickened. Add butter and beets. Cook on low until beets are heated through and serve.

title: Never Fail Popovers
instructions: Break eggs into bowl. Add flour milk and salt. Mix well with spoon. Do not smooth out lumps. Fill greased muffin tin 3/4 full. Put into cold oven set at 450\u00b0. Bake for 30 minutes. Dont open oven during baking and they will \pop up\ every time.

title: Mazola No-Roll Pastry Shell
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into pie pan. Combine oil and milk; whip with a fork. Pour over flour mixture mixing until flour is completely dampened. Press evenly and firmly with fingers to line bottom sides and rim of pan.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
instructions: *Substitute for pourable fruit 3/4 cup no-sugar added strawberry fruit spread and 1/4 cup warm water.

title: Pretzel Jello
instructions: Cream the 3 tablespoons sugar and butter together. Add pretzels and stir. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Twice Baked Potato Dish
instructions: Melt butter; add soup mix. Cut unpeeled potatoes into slices. Put in baking dish. Pour butter and soup mix over potatoes and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle bacon and cheese on top and bake an additional 10 minutes.

title: July Salad
instructions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Thoroughly mix in cold water. Refrigerate until mixture begins to thicken. Blend in peaches honeydew blueberries and grapes distributing fruit throughout gelatin mixture. Refrigerate several hours or overnight until firm. Serve on lettuce or other greens.

title: No-Cook Modeling Dough
instructions: Mix ingredients together well. Add vegetable oil. Store in airtight container.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Mix salt nutmeg and flour in plastic bag. Shake chicken in flour mixture. Brown in shortening in skillet. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch pan. Drain pineapple reserving juice. Arrange pineapple over chicken. Blend reserved juice and soy sauce with cornstarch sugar and celery salt in saucepan. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 1 1/4 hours. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: Quiche Noel
instructions: Line a 9-inch quiche dish or pie pan with pastry; trim excess pastry around edges. Prick bottom and sides of pastry with a fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 3 minutes; remove from oven and gently prick with a fork. Bake 5 minutes longer; let cool on rack.

title: The Red Heads Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 9-inch baking pan; set aside. In a 2-quart saucepan melt butter with chocolate over lowest heat setting stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and stir in sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs then flour then nuts. Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until top is dull and barely set. Cool in pan on rack to room temperature then cut into squares.

title: Catalina Salad
instructions: Cut up lettuce and tomatoes. Add any other salad fixings you wish (cucumbers peppers etc.). Cut onion in large pieces. Add 1/2 can kidney beans and/or 1/2 can Great Northern beans rinsed. Add dressing and mix. Before serving add olives and Fritos.

title: Chicken Ole
instructions: Combine taco sauce mustard and lime juice in large bowl. Add chicken turning to coat. Cover; marinate in refrigerator at least 30 minutes. Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat until foamy. Remove chicken; reserve marinade. Add chicken to skillet; cook about 10 minutes or until brown on both sides. Add marinade; cook about 5 minutes or until chicken is tender and marinade glazes chicken. Remove chicken to serving platter. Boil marinade over high heat 1 minute. Pour over chicken. Garnish with parsley. Serve with sour cream.

title: My Aunt'S Large Crock Spiced Pickles
instructions: Wash and dry cucumbers. Mix all ingredients above together. Put enough cucumbers into mixture so that they are about 2 inches below the liquid.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix chicken vinegar oil orange juice and salt. Marinate overnight. After marinated combine ingredients. Mix thoroughly.

title: Hungarian Goulash With Noodles
instructions: Brown meat on all sides in heavy frypan or Dutch oven. Add onions. Combine mustard paprika brown sugar and salt. Combine Worcestershire sauce vinegar and ketchup and add to mustard mixture. Add to meat. Add 1 cup of the water; stir. Cover. Cook over low heat 2 1/2 hours or until meat is very tender. Blend flour with remaining 1/2 cup of water; add to meat mixture. Stir until thickened. Boil noodles in salted water until tender. Drain. Serve mixture over noodles. Serves 8.

title: Veggie Salad
instructions: Mix last 3 ingredients together. Mix all of the ingredients together; put in refrigerator.

title: Pineapple Slaw
instructions: Mix as listed. Let stand overnight in an airtight container.

title: Glaze
instructions: Mix and use. Can be stored in sealed container.

title: Chicken Legs
instructions: Layer in a large baking dish chicken onion green pepper tomatoes and tomato sauce. Then pour in soy sauce Worcestershire sauce and spices. Bake at 375\u00b0 uncovered for 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil and water. Beat well. Add mix gelatin flour and crushed strawberries. Pour into rectangle pan Pammed and floured. Bake according to package directions. When cool frost with following.

title: Pulled Molasses Candy
instructions: Boil molasses and vinegar to hard ball stage. Add butter and soda and let boil to crack stage. Pour into a buttered pan. When cool enough to handle pull until light and porous using tips of fingers and thumbs. Cut into a small piece using scissors and place on buttered plate to cool.

title: Sweet Potato-Pumpkin Puddings
instructions: Combine dates and water. Blend sugars egg and butter. Sift together dry ingredients; add to sugar mixture. Stir in nuts and cooled date mixture. Pour into 11 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Top with brown-sugar sauce. (Combine 1 1/2 cups brown sugar 1 tablespoon butter or margarine and 1 1/2 cups boiling water.) Bake in moderate oven (375\u00b0) about 40 minutes. Cut in squares; invert on plates. Serve warm with whipped cream. Makes 9 servings. Use 1/2 cup more water for more pudding.

title: Fish Batter
instructions: Mix first two ingredients. Beat well and soak fish in it for 15 minutes.

title: Liver And Onions
instructions: Roll slices of liver in flour. Saute in butter until brown on both sides. Saute thinly sliced onion rings in another frying pan until golden brown. Place liver on platter. Turn onion rings into pan in which liver was cooked. Add 2 tablespoons hot water. Stir to loosen sediment in pan. Mix. Pour over liver and let stand for 10 minutes.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Chop artichokes; drain well. Place in mixing bowl. Add mayonnaise pepper and cheese. Spoon into ungreased casserole dish. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown (20 to 30 minutes). Serve hot with crackers or toasted pieces of Italian bread.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream together the brown sugar molasses Crisco and egg. Add the remaining ingredients; mix together. Roll in ball and sugar before baking. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. They will appear not to be done. Makes soft cookies.

title: Easy Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin pan. Mix all ingredients together; fill muffin pan. Bake 25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Dietetic Spice Cake
instructions: Cook raisins in water until all water is gone (cool). Add applesauce eggs sweetener and oil. Beat well sift dry ingredients together. Add to other ingredients; mix well. Bake in loaf or tube pan sprayed with Pam (or use grease) at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (It cooks in my oven in about 30 minutes.)

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Dip fruit chunks and enjoy.

title: Cucumber Soup
instructions: Blend all ingredients in blender. Chill at least 2 hours. Serve with slice of lemon if desired.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease muffin tins. Beat egg with a fork; stir in milk and oil. Blend dry ingredients and mix with liquid just until flour is moistened. Batter should be lumpy. Add blueberries. Mix lightly but do not overmix. Fill pans 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until brown. Serve warm. Yields 9 medium or 12 small.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add strawberries and chopped nuts; let jell. Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Add Dream Whip that has been whipped as directed on package.
