Put on top of Jell-O. Sprinkle with nuts if desired. You may use any type berry with Jell-O in that flavor.

title: Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; add berries with sugar and stir well. Stir in pineapple and bananas. Pour half of this mixture into 9 x 13-inch oblong dish. Let set in refrigerator until firm then spread with sour cream. Cover the sour cream with the remaining gelatin mixture. Do not refrigerate the last half of the gelatin mixture until you pour it over the sour cream. Chill until set and serve.

title: Frankfurter Pate
instructions: Advance preparation Place first 8 ingredients in blender container. Cover and blend smooth stopping to scrape sides often. Chill mixture in small mold or bowl until firm.

title: Black Forest Pie
instructions: In saucepan combine sugar cocoa and flour. Add margarine and milk. Bring to boil stirring constantly. Add small amount of mixture to eggs. Return mixture to pan. Fold 1/2 can cherry filling. Pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until center is set. Cool and chill for 1 hour. Combine topping with chocolate. Spread on top of pie. Place remaining cherries on top of pie around edge.

title: French Coffee Cake
instructions: Knead dough gently until smooth. Roll dough to measure 12 x 18-inches. Spread soft butter over 2/3 of dough. Turn 6-inches of unbuttered dough over and then other 6. Put in cookie sheet with wax paper and cover with towel. Let stand 1 hour. Then take dough out and cut in half then roll out 8 x 14-inches. Put about 1/2 cup filling in center of dough. Put on lightly greased sheet cut or leave plain. Put in refrigerator for about 20 minutes then bake in 400\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Then butter over the top.

title: Pickled Green Tomatoes
instructions: Combine tomatoes onions and salt in large bowl. Let stand for 1 hour. Combine green pepper vinegar sugar celery seed and mustard seed in a large pan and bring to boil. Add tomatoes and onions and bring to boil again. Pack pickles into hot jars; cover with boiling vinegar mixture. Place hot lids on jars immediately. Makes 3 pints.

title: Chinese Soyameat Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and top with potato chips dry Chinese noodles or croutons. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0 in deep dish or less time in shallow dish.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix everything but vanilla. Cook until thick. Add vanilla. Pour into baked pie shell. Beat egg whites with 1/4 cup sugar. Top pie with meringue. Brown meringue.

title: Creamy Caramel Dip
instructions: Stir together caramels and half and half in a 4-cup glass measure. Microwave on High for 4 to 5 minutes or until dip is smooth stirring every minute. Serve warm or at room temperature with fresh fruit round cake or angel food cake cubes.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Skin breasts and pat dry. Dip in melted butter then dip in dry ingredients. Pour enough butter in a baking dish to cover bottom. Place chicken in and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Log
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape into log and roll into nuts. Serve with assorted crackers or small toast triangles.

title: Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain. Mix in butter. Add cheese to macaroni. Heat milk. Mix in eggs; stir into macaroni. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Mother'S Eggs And Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until almost tender about 20 minutes. Drain. Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. Set aside. In heavy 10-inch skillet saute bacon until crisp and drain on paper towel. Reserve drippings. In 3 tablespoons drippings saute onion and bell pepper until tender. Add potatoes 1/3 at a time and saute until lightly browned. Remove from pan as they are browned. Saute 1/3 more until they are all browned making sure that they lie flat. Return potatoes to skillet. Add more drippings if needed. Keep heat low. Beat eggs with salt and pepper until well blended but not foamy. Pour egg mixture over potatoes. Slowly and evenly sprinkle with bacon bits. Cover and cook over low heat until eggs are set about 5 to 6 minutes. Taste for seasoning and serve from skillet.

title: Strawberries In The Snow
instructions: Mix first five ingredients and refrigerate 1 hour. Make into shape of strawberries and roll in red sugar. Insert a slivered almond as the stem.

title: Wheaties Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Cream together. Add flour soda baking powder salt and vanilla. Mix together. Add Wheaties and pecans folding in. Drop by teaspoonful on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown about 10 minutes.

title: Jan Hagel Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolk. Mix well. Then add flour and cinnamon. Knead if necessary. Pat down on a greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fingers. Brush with the egg white mixed with a little water. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.

title: Tomato Soup Dressing
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender. Mix well. Place in glass jar. Makes 1 quart.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix sugar flour and margarine until mixture resembles coarse corn meal. Put peaches into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle mixture over peaches. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until brown.

title: New Orleans Dip
instructions: Mix ingredients together and chill. Serve with vegetables or crackers.

title: Yams With Oranges
instructions: Arrange half of yam slices in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with half the orange slices 2 tablespoons brown sugar and some nuts and spices. Then repeat layers. Garnish with additional orange slices. Combine juice and margarine; pour over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 50 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Touchdown Taco Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spread refried beans over bottom of 9 x 9 baker pan. Combine cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning. Press garlic into bowl with creamy mixture and mix well. Spread over beans. Shred cheese over the top and bake 15 to 18 minutes. Chop olives Snip Cilantro. Sprinkle chopped tomato onions olives and cilantro over hot dip. Garnish with additional sour cream if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Rice
instructions: Brown rice in oleo; add chopped onion and green pepper. Put in 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Add 1 to 2 cups water. As it cooks if too dry add more water. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients; refrigerate 1 hour. Roll thin; cut and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix together. Roll in 3/4 cup chopped nuts.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Combine sugar salt and cocoa in bowl. Stir in evaporated milk vanilla eggs and butter. Stir in coconut and pecans. Place in pie shells and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool on racks.

title: Don'S Chili
instructions: Combine ground beef and onions in a covered skillet; add pepper and cook until the redness is gone. Add the chili powder and about 1 cup water. Add some salt to the cooking meat and simmer 15 or 20 minutes. In a separate 5 to 6-quart pot combine the V-8 juice tomato soup Tabasco sauce Worcestershire sauce catsup garlic powder 1 to 2 cups water (for desired consistency) sugar and beans. Mix thoroughly and heat to near boiling. Add the cooked meat and onions. Bring to a boil and add the spaghetti (broken into 2-inch pieces) and cook until spaghetti is tender. Add more salt sugar or water as you wish. Skim fat from chili and serve immediately or later. Sometimes chili is even better the second day!

title: Lemon Curd Tarts
instructions: In the top of a double boiler combine the lemon juice lemon rind and sugar. Add the butter and heat over boiling water until the butter is melted stirring occasionally. Now stir in the eggs and continue cooking stirring constantly until the mixture is thick enough to pile slightly (about 15 minutes). Cool thoroughly then chill.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Slice stems from bell peppers and scoop out seeds etc. Add salt and pepper to insides to taste. Put peppers into boiling water for 2 to 4 minutes and drain well.

title: New England Clam Chowder
instructions: Coat a Dutch oven with cooking spray; add margarine. Place over medium heat until margarine melts. Add onion celery and bacon; saute until vegetables are tender and bacon is browned. Drain clams reserving juice; set clams aside. Add reserved clam juice broth and potato to pan. Bring to a boil; cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until potato is tender. Combine flour and 1 1/2 cups milk; stir until smooth. Add flour mixture remaining 2 1/2 cups milk clams pepper and hot sauce to potato mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly about 10 minutes or until mixture is thickened (do not boil).

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole dish with Pam. Mix ingredients and add butter to top. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Tomato Dressing(Salt Free, Oil Free, Low-Cal)
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a small jar with a tightly fitting lid. Seal the jar and shake well to mix ingredients. Refrigerate for 1 hour to allow dressing to thicken. Excellent on simple green salads.

title: Angel Buns
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water in medium bowl. Mix in baking mix and milk until dough forms. Gently smooth into ball on surface dusted with baking mix. Knead 10 times. Roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with 2-inch biscuit cutter dipped in baking mix. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Let rise in warm place about 30 minutes or until soft and puffed. Heat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Zesty Picante Bake
instructions: Grease pan (10 x 1 1/2-inch). Mix Bisquick water beans and add meat then sauce then cheese. Spread in pan.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter in a large baking dish. Mix all ingredients together except cheese. Add 2 cans water with the soup and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Add cheese to top of casserole and bake for 15 minutes. Total cooking time 1 hour.

title: Midwest Squares
instructions: On greased cookie sheet pat dough into a rectangle about 10 x 13-inches and about 1/4-inch thick. Press crushed cereal on top. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Cool slightly and cut into squares or diamond shapes.

title: Nut Horns
instructions: Grease cookie sheets. Mix yeast with 1/4 cup warm water then add sugar and small amount of sour cream to ferment. Add oleo to salt and flour in a large bowl and mix until crumbly. Add egg yolks yeast mixture and remainder of sour cream; mix well. Form into ball; turn out on board sprinkled lightly with flour. Knead until smooth about 5 to 10 minutes. Divide dough into 6 equal parts. Wrap in waxed paper. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight. On board sprinkle with sugar roll each part into a 12-inch circle. Cut into 12 triangles. Spread with Walnut Filling. Roll up and bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0 about 25 minutes. When cool dust with confectioners sugar (optional). Makes 6 dozen.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together adding pecans last. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 400\u00b0 (hot) oven 15 minutes; reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer. Outer edges of filling should be set center slightly soft.

title: Brownies(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Mix the applesauce and the sugar. Add the remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour into a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Make meatballs and put them in the oven until brown at approximately 350\u00b0. Put oil in a frying pan and deep fry onion and peppers. Put meatballs in a big pan and mix all the ingredients together. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup water and cook in pan until thick.

title: Bacon Quiche
instructions: Stir together all ingredients and put into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Let set for a few minutes.

title: Good Old Southern-Style Tasty Meat Loaf
instructions: In bowl combine and mix well all ingredients for meat loaf except bread; then saturate each slice of bread with water squeeze water out and add to mixture in bowl crumbling wet bread as you do so. Mix all well again. Pour this mixture into a meat loaf pan. Bake for approximately 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Take out and loosely cover with tin foil for about 30 minutes before slicing. (It seems to slice better and not fall apart this way.)

title: Wilted Lettuce
instructions: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and fry until crisp. Add onions and saute for a couple of minutes. Add rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour over lettuce and turn pot over lettuce to wilt. Serve immediately.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes into desired shapes and sizes. Add sugar water and margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done and syrup is thick.

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan coated with nonstick spray or margarine and floured. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts for toasted effect instead of icing. Nuts inside are optional. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 50 minutes. Cool in pan on rack.

title: Pig Pick'N Cake
instructions: Cake Mix cake mix oil eggs and mandarin oranges. Divide into 3 equal layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 22 minutes. Cool.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients and put into a loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix and place in casserole.

title: Caramel Pecan Pie(From Watkinsville Garden Club Cookbook)
instructions: Place 1 cup nuts in bottom of pastry shell and cover with half of caramel topping. Combine cream cheese sugar and vanilla mixing well. Add eggs 1 at a time mixing well after each. Pour over topping. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes; cool. Garnish with additional 1/2 topping drizzled over top and additional nuts.

title: Glazed Carrots And Pineapple
instructions: Cook carrots with salt and water covered until barely tender. Drain any remaining liquid into measuring cup then add pineapple syrup to measure 1 cup in all. Mix with cornstarch in saucepan. Cook stirring constantly until thickened and clear. Stir in butter. Add carrots and pineapple tidbits. Makes 4 servings.

title: Best Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Melt butter; stir in sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add cocoa; beat until well blended. Add flour baking powder and salt. Beat well. Stir in nuts. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until brownies just begin to pull away from sides. Cool; cut into bars. Makes about 36 brownies.

title: Light Whole Wheat Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Stir together the first 4 ingredients. Add milk to make a soft dough. Knead on floured surface. Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut with biscuit cutter. Place on baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Aunt Grace'S Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Mix boiled eggs chicken pepper to taste and enough broth to make soupy. Pour over crumbled cornbread. Bake at 350 degrees until done.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook diced potatoes and bay leaves in water for 15 to 20 minutes. Add salt pepper and vinegar; stir well. Remove from heat add gravy mixture and mix well. Return to heat and bring to a boil. Saute onions in a little shortening and stir into soup.

title: Tangy Chicken
instructions: Mix ingredients; marinate chicken for one hour. Put in broiler for 10 minutes or so.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Cut cucumbers thin place in a bowl and cover with water and 1/4 cup salt. Drain add sliced onion and sprinkle 1/2 to 3/4 cup sugar. Let stand until liquid forms (about 1 hour). Add vinegar to cover cukes season with salt and pepper. Chill and serve.

title: Window Cleaner
instructions: Place 1 frozen T.V. Dinner in oven and bake 35 minutes. Take shower read paper and remove dinner after timer goes off. Grouse carp and whine either before during or after your meal. But remember you really havent got it that bad after all. Who made sure that it was in the freezer!

title: Baby Rough'S Rosemary Muffins
instructions: Simmer milk raisins and rosemary in pan. Remove from heat add butter to melt. Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Beat egg into the cooled milk mixture. Add to the dry ingredients mix slightly until dry ingredients are moist. Spoon into greased muffin cups 1/3 full then put 3/4-inch cube cream cheese in the center. Cover with remaining mix. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Yields 12 muffins.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except corn flakes. Mash corn flakes to be topped over mixture. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Have prepared 1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust. Mix sugar salt ginger cinnamon nutmeg and pie spice together with a fork. Add eggs beating well then add milk. Mix then add pumpkin. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0 and continue baking until a knife blade inserted in the center of pie filling comes out clean. Cool before cutting.

title: Fruited Chiffon Squares
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add ice cubes; stir 3 to 5 minutes. Remove unmelted ice. Fold 1 cup Cool Whip into 1/2 of gelatin until smooth. Pour into 8-inch square pan. Chill for about 5 minutes until set. Add fruit to remaining gelatin and spoon over creamy layer. Chill until firm.

title: Apricot Bars
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar. Add vanilla egg flour salt and coconut. Mix well. Spread three quarters of this mixture on greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Spread apricot preserves on top. Combine remaining 1/4 mixture with chopped nuts and crumble on top. Pat to spread evenly. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown on top. Cut into bars when warm.

title: Friendship Cake
instructions: Keep in large nonmetallic bowl and wrap loosely with Saran Wrap.

title: Italian Chops And Rice
instructions: Season chops with salt and pepper to taste. Brown on both sides in oil in a large ovenproof skillet. Remove chops and set aside. Add onion and green pepper and saute until tender-crisp. Stir in tomatoes broth seasonings and rice. Bring to a boil. Arrange chops on top. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Fluff rice with fork. Makes 6 servings with 409 calories per serving.

title: Skillet Herb Roasted Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine in large skillet. Coat chicken with flour sage and thyme. Cook chicken in margarine 10 minutes. Mix soup and water. Pour over chicken. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer 15 minutes or until tender. Serve over rice.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and butter. Mix saltines with milk and other ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Roll steak in flour; fry until done. Mix onions celery green peppers 1 can tomato soup and 1/2 can water. Simmer for 1 hour or until gravy is thick.

title: Peach Ice Cream
instructions: In heavy pan heat milk on low until hot but not boiling. Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved. Gradually stir about a quarter of the hot mixture into the beaten eggs mixing constantly. Return all to the saucepan stirring constantly. Continue to cook and stir for 10 to 12 minutes or until mixture coats the back of a metal spoon. Remove from heat and cool. Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. In a large bowl combine the cream fruit vanilla and almond extract. Add the chilled milk mixture stirring well. Pour into a chilled freezer can of a 1 gallon ice cream freezer. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions.

title: Kale And Red Peppers
instructions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven combine oil red peppers garlic and chili pepper. Saute over medium heat for 2 or 3 minutes stirring until peppers are tender. Stir in chicken broth and kale mustard or turnip greens. Bring to a boil then toss greens in pan and cover with liquid. Reduce heat to medium and cook 25 minutes or until greens are tender. Serves 4. Contains 0 cholesterol and 2 grams fat.

title: Baked Caramel Corn
instructions: Place popped corn in a large bowl that will allow it to be stirred. Set aside. In a saucepan melt butter then stir in brown sugar corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Allow it to boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour mixture over popped corn. Mix well.

title: Corn Bake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Bake in sprayed casserole at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar and oil until well blended then add dry ingredients. Mix again until well blended. Add zucchini nuts raisins and pineapple. Bake in 2 (9 x 5 x 4-inch) bread pans or 3 smaller pans. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Awesome Stuffed Shells
instructions: Boil shells like lasagna or spaghetti noodles and coat lightly with olive oil. Drain and save. Fry ground beef (or sausage and beef) with 1 green onion garlic and mushrooms. Cool and drain. Mix beef mixture with cottage cheese 1 green onion salt pepper and cayenne pepper to taste and egg. Stuff into shells. Then pour 1/2 jar or can of your favorite marinara sauce or spaghetti sauce into glass casserole dish. Set in shells and proceed to cover with sauce. Top with grated Cheddar and bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add sugar melted butter flour buttermilk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Toasted Butter Pecan Cake
instructions: Toast pecans in 1/4 cup butter in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Stir frequently. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Cream 1 cup butter; gradually add sugar creaming well. Blend in eggs; beat well\tafter each. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition. Stir in vanilla and 1 1/3 cups pecans. Turn into\t3 (9-inch) round layer pans greased and floured on bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Butter Pecan Frosting should be under cake.

title: Congealed Strawberry-Buttermilk Salad
instructions: In a large saucepan mix jello and pineapple until jello is dissolved. Set aside and let cool then add buttermilk nuts Cool Whip and fruit. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Golden Chili Chicken
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat with hot oil cook the chicken until it is brown. Drain the excess fat. Add all other ingredients to the chicken. Heat to boiling then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until tender stirring occasionally. Serves 4.

title: White Star Peanut Clusters
instructions: Melt together the candy stars and wax over hot water. Mix all together and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.

title: Carrot Soup
instructions: In a 2-quart microwave proof casserole combine the garlic onion orange juice carrots and potatoes. Cover tightly; cook on High for 7 minutes or until tender stirring only once. Puree in food processor or blender; pour the cream into the bowl of processor and continue processing until smooth. Return to casserole dish; add broth black pepper cayenne nutmeg and chives. Stir well and chill for at least 1 hour or up to 4 days. To serve divide soup among 4 bowls. Arrange 3 pieces of chive tops on top of each bowl of soup. Serve.

title: Mom'S 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese and dressing mix. Add shrimp. Chill. Serve with chips.

title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
instructions: Combine rhubarb with sugar margarine and flour. Mix well. Beat egg yolks and add. Beat egg whites until fluffy and fold in. Pour into unbaked crust. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 and 45 more minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Applesauce Fruit Cake
instructions: Sift first 7 ingredients together. Cream butter and sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and beat well. Mix raisins fruit and nuts with flour mixture. Add to creamed mixture alternately with hot applesauce. Pour into large tube pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Butterfinger Delight
instructions: Crush graham and saltine crackers together. Add butter and sugar. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan for crust. Mixt together pudding and milk. Add softened ice cream. Pour over crumb crust. Chill. Spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with crushed Butterfingers. Can be frozen or keeps well in refrigerator.

title: Baked Corn
instructions: Take 10 to 12 crushed saltine crackers not fine but in chunks (about 2 handfuls). Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix until cracker crumbs are moist but not dissolved. It will look sloppy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until set and slightly brown on edges and middle doesnt jiggle.

title: Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream the shortening with sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add beaten egg yolks and beat thoroughly. Add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately in small amounts beating well after each addition. Add nuts and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour in greased tube pan. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs vanilla red food coloring and water. Sift together in separate bowl cocoa salt and flour. Add to mix alternately with buttermilk. Mix vinegar with soda; then fold into batter. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Nut Bread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Caramel Corn
instructions: Melt the butter; stir in sugar syrup and salt. Stir constantly until mixture comes to a rolling boil. Boil for 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Slowly pour mixture over popped corn and mix well. Turn into shallow baking pan. Bake for 45 minutes in a 250\u00b0 oven stirring every 15 minutes. After cooling break into small chunks or into individual kernels.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Mix ingredients and roll 1/8-inch thick rolls (as for butterhorn rolls). Roll around a date. Makes 80 to 100.

title: Chicken Spectacular
instructions: Cook rice according to directions on box. (I use chicken broth instead of water.) Mix all ingredients except chicken. Mix well. Fold in diced chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles. This freezes well. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Granny Black'S Ham Pasties
instructions: Mix softened margarine and softened cream cheese together. Add flour and ice water to make dough. Cover and chill overnight. When ready to make pastry mix remaining ingredients to a spreading consistency for filling. Break off dough one piece at a time large enough to make one pastry. Roll out thin in a circle about 2 inches in diameter. Scoop filling on top and fold over into half moon and seal pastry. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Great for parties. Freezes very well.

title: Four Layer Dessert
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans thoroughly and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Crunchy Caramel Snack Mix
instructions: Combine cereals pretzels and nuts. Set aside. Cook sugar margarine and syrup over medium heat until mixture comes to boil. Cook without stirring 4 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda and cream of tartar then vanilla. Pour syrup over cereals until coated. Bake at 170\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Let cool. Makes 10 cups.

title: Potato-Bean Soup
instructions: Place potatoes carrots onion and celery in large pot; cover with water. Add bay leaf and salt. Bring to boil; simmer gently for 30 minutes. Add beans ketchup dill and parsley. Continue simmering.

title: Pudding
instructions: Mix cream cheese sugar Cool Whip crushed pineapple with juice cream pudding and coconut. Add marshmallows. Mix altogether.

title: Old-Fashioned Cracked Sugar Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening until fluffy. Add sugars beating well. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour salt soda and cream of tartar. Gradually add to creamed mixture beating well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar and place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool 2 minutes on cookie sheet and remove to rack to cool completely. Makes 5 dozen.

title: Oriental Chicken Soup
instructions: Simmer all but vinegar together until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add vinegar.

title: Fudge
instructions: Leave cheese out of refrigerator 24 hours. Mix all the ingredients with electric mixer for 5 minutes. Chill before serving.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt shortening and chocolate together over hot water; cool. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Beat eggs until light; add sugar and chocolate mixture. Add flour vanilla and nuts. Put into greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Delight
instructions: Crust Melt margarine. Mix in flour sugar and nuts. Press into pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool completely.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar medium speed. Add eggs one at a time. Beat after each egg. Stir in bananas vanilla and cinnamon. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Beat until blended. Stir in chips and walnuts. Spoon batter into loaf pan (greased). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Shield with foil after 1 hour. Test with toothpick until comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool completely. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Baked Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in casserole dish at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Lemon Cheesecake
instructions: Soften cream cheese; blend with 1/2 cup milk. Add remaining milk and the pudding mix. Beat slowly with eggbeater or mixer on low setting until well mixed. (Do not overbeat.) Pour at once into graham cracker crust. Sprinkle cracker crumbs lightly over top. Chill about one hour.

title: Hot Spiced Cider
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large crock-pot. Simmer on high until butter and candy are completely melted. Keep hot. Serve from crock-pot.

title: Chocolate Pudding Dessert
instructions: Mix together and pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish.

title: Five Flavored Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter Crisco and sugar. Add extracts. Beat eggs until light and fluffy and add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cranberry Bread
instructions: Sift flour with dry ingredients; add beaten egg melted shortening and orange juice. Combine only until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in nuts cranberries and orange rind.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Brush uncooked chicken with butter salt and pepper to taste. Mix rice with all other ingredients and place in large pan. Put chicken on top and bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Saturday Salmon Supper
instructions: Saute onion in the margarine until golden. Blend in flour. Gradually add soup and milk stirring. Boil 1 minute. Add flaked boned salmon. Drop Bisquick dumplings by teaspoons on top after youve put salmon mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are done.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Split rolls lengthwise. Mix last 5 ingredients. Spread mixture on rolls. Layer ham and Swiss cheese. Replace top half of roll. Cut each roll. Heat at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Buttercream Frosting
instructions: Beat egg white stiff. Set aside. Scald cream. Set aside and cool. Cream the Crisco and butter. Add sugar and vanilla and beat. Add egg white and beat. Add cream and beat until smooth.

title: Tuna Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in greased loaf pan and bake 40 to 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet Potato Bake
instructions: Place potatoes and enough water to cover in a saucepan and cook until tender. Cool slightly and peel. In a large bowl mash potatoes. Stir in butter sugar and raisins. Place in a 2 qt. baking dish and sprinkle with nuts and marshmallows. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or heated through and marshmallows brown. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Winnie Pooh Potato Pancakes
instructions: Grate potatoes and onion. Mix in eggs flour salt and pepper thoroughly. Pour as thin as a pancake and fry in a little oil on a grill until brown.

title: Chicken Boursin Bundles
instructions: Combine Boursin cheese chicken onion milk salt and pepper and mix well. Roll the puff pastry into 1 large square and cut into 4 squares. Spoon 1/4 of chicken mixture into the center of each pastry square. Bring the 4 corners together in the center pinching seams to seal. Beat the egg with water in a small bowl. Brush the top of each pastry bundle. Sprinkle bread crumbs over the top of each bundle and arrange on a baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. May be prepared ahead and chilled or frozen to enjoy later.

title: Lemon Icebox Pie
instructions: Beat eggs well. Add 3 cans milk and 1 glass lemon juice. Makes 3 pies.

title: Easy Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef onion and green pepper. Drain. Add beans and soup. Cook 10 minutes. Make chili powder flour water and salt into a paste. Blend into meat mixture. Cook over low heat 45 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Pour water over oatmeal; let stand for 10 minutes. Add margarine sugar eggs etc. Stir in half the chocolate chips. Spread the other half on top after cake is baked. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes in jelly roll pan or a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

title: Rugalach
instructions: Mix together first four ingredients. Blend with hands and roll into 2 balls. Wrap balls and refrigerate overnight. Next day combine sugar cinnamon and walnuts. Set aside. Roll out each dough ball to 1/4-inch thickness. Place dinner plate over dough and cut into large circle using plate as a guide. Slice each circle into 8 pie slices. Place tablespoon of cinnamon-sugar mixture on large end of pie slice and roll. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheesy Moon Bread
instructions: Generously grease a loaf pan. In a large bowl combine warm water with yeast (from hot roll mix). Stir until dissolved. Stir in egg butter and seasonings. Add flour and mix; stir in olives and cheese. Cover; let rise until doubled in size. Knead dough 10 strokes.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Put cheese ball in refrigerator to chill then roll in 1 cup chopped pecans.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven and prepare and bake brownies according to package directions; let cool. Prepare chocolate mousse according to package directions. Break candy bars into small pieces. Break brownies into small pieces and place half of them in the bottom of a large glass bowl or trifle dish. Cover with half the mousse half the candy and half the whipped topping. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients sprinkling second layer of whipped topping with crushed candy. You may use pecans instead.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine; mix other ingredients with margarine. Pour in buttered casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Jewell'S Rocks (Christmas Cookie)
instructions: Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs. Sift the flour baking powder baking soda and salt together. Add to creamed mixture; mix lightly. Fold in raisins nuts and some red cut up candied cherries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Banana Crush Punch
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water; add juices and mashed bananas. Mix everything except carbonated beverage. Divide into 6 equal portions in 6 freezer cartons and freeze ahead of time. Take out about 2 hours before serving time. Mix 1 portion with one bottle of carbonated beverage (lemon-lime soda or ginger ale). Makes about 72 punch cup servings of slushy-type punch. No extra ice is needed.

title: Almond Bars
instructions: Beat together the sugar and eggs until thick and light. Add the margarine flour almond extract and dash of salt. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl beat milk peanut butter egg and vanilla until smooth. Add biscuit mix; mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with fork with a little flour so mix wont stick. Bake 6 to 8 minutes until brown.

title: Golden Peachy Chicken
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces in single layer in shallow roasting pan. Combine peach syrup with lemon juice soy sauce and mashed peach halves. Pour over chicken; dot with margarine. Bake at 375\u00b0; baste often until chicken is done about 1 1/2 hours. Place 8 canned peach halves around chicken 15 minutes before chicken is done.

title: Crisco Pie Crust
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and mix well. Add water 1/2 at time and mix just until it goes together into dough. Do not knead. Roll out on floured board. Make 1 pie crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients thoroughly. Add vanilla and buttermilk. Mix thoroughly. Beat in melted margarine. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost as desired.

title: Spinach And Artichoke Casserole
instructions: Put thawed spinach in skillet. Add garlic and 2 tablespoons oil. Coat well. Saute 2 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Set aside. In a mixing bowl add cream cheese and mayonnaise. Blend well with mixer until creamy. Set aside.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients togther. Bake at 350 for 35 - 45 minutes.

title: Windex Mixture
instructions: *Cut 1 roll in half.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix first four ingredients to form paste then add dry ingredients and then vinegar. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Split two round pans into 4 layers.

title: Chutney Glazed Cheese Pate
instructions: In a bowl beat together cheeses curry powder dry sherry and salt. Spread mixture\t1/2-inch thick on a serving dish. Cover and chill until firm. At serving time spread top with chutney and sprinkle with finely chopped green onion. Serve with bland crackers. Serves 18.

title: Spicy Meatballs
instructions: Combine first eight ingredients. Form into balls and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine soup mix water and tomato sauce and pour over meatballs. Cover and bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover. Top with cheese. Bake 10 minutes more. Serve over rice or mashed potatoes.

title: Bisquick Mixture
instructions: Mix to cornmeal consistency.\tStore in covered can or bowl and store at room temperature.

title: Baked Apples
instructions: Cut corn from cob and scrape cob. Put in heavy pan. Add some bacon grease and a small chunk of butter. Add enough water to keep from sticking. Bring corn to a\tboil and add salt and sugar to taste. Cook down to desired consistency.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Combine eggs oil flour sugar cinnamon and vanilla in a large bowl. Stir in apples nuts and raisins. Pour in a greased loaf pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

title: Hot Cheese
instructions: Put cream cheese Velveeta and pecans in mixing bowl. Place 2 squares of waxed paper on table flat. Sprinkle paprika heavily on wax paper (all over). With your hands thoroughly mix the cheese and pecans until thoroughly blended. Dash in the Tabasco sauce (about 1/2 bottle) and mix well.

title: Classic Blueberry Pie
instructions: For filling combine sugar cornstarch and salt in medium saucepan. Stir in water and add 3 cups blueberries. Cook and stir on medium heat until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Remove from heat. Cool slightly. Place remaining 2 cups blueberries in pie pan lined with pastry. Stir butter and lemon juice into cooked berry mixture. Spoon over fresh berries in crust. Cover pie with gashed top crust. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Glace Pie
instructions: To 3 cups of whole large hulled berries add 1/2 cup sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Cut remaining berries in pieces. Put in a small saucepan and add 3/4 cup of water. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Combine the cornstarch and 1 cup sugar. Mix well. Add to simmering berries. Cook until mixture is thick and clear stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and 3 drops red food coloring. Cool. Stand whole berries cut side down in pie crust. Cover with cooled sauce. Chill thoroughly. Decorate with border of sweetened whipped cream.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding and milk together with electric mixer about 2 minutes. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture. Set aside. Line bottom of pan with whole graham crackers. Put a layer of pudding mixture on top then repeat layering. Finish with layer of crackers on top. Ice with chocolate icing and refrigerate.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In saucepan mix soup milk cheese garlic powder pepper broccoli and carrots. Heat to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp stirring occasionally. Add macaroni and chicken. Heat through.

title: Mandarin Orange Pie #1
instructions: Mix Eagle Brand milk\tand ReaLemon juice until thick. Blend in Cool Whip. Cut mandarin orange slices into chunks; mix in with rest\tof ingredients. Add pecans if wanted.\tPut in pie shell and chill before serving.

title: Yum Yum Cake
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy. Stir in pineapple. Add flour which has been sifted with baking powder. Mix well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Easy Chili Verde
instructions: 1. Pierce roast with garlic. Put as much or as little as you want. Sprinkle lightly w/ cumin and lemon pepper. 2. Slow cook roast in oven until done. I cook it at 250\u00b0. Check temp with a meat thermometer. Takes appx 6-8 hrs to cook. 3. When done trim fat and shread meat into crockpot. Add remaining ingredients and cook in crockpot several hrs. As with American chili there are many variables. You can make this as hot or as mild as you want depending on heat of salsa and green chilies. 4. If your Chili Verde is too thick add more chicken broth and if too thin add cornstarch and water mixture.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut steak into small pieces. Brown in margarine. Add onion soup and a soup can of water. Cook slowly until tender 1 to 2 hours. Add water as necessary. Add sour cream and heat for 5 minutes. Serve over noodles.

title: John Mozetti
instructions: Put 1 tablespoon of oil in skillet and brown ground beef. Cook with onions and pepper until done. Drain part of grease off. Add 1/2 of both cheeses and all other ingredients. Put in casserole dish and top with balance of cheese. Heat in oven about 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 before serving. Serves 6 big appetites.

title: Taco Mountain
instructions: Mix sour cream and taco seasoning together set aside. Spread beans in bottom of 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Cover with sour cream mixture followed by a layer of each guacamole lettuce tomato and olives. Sprinkle cheese over top. Serve cold with tortilla chips for dippers.

title: Health Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 2 large empty fruit cans (tin cans). Grease well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Good to eat with cream cheese.

title: Italian Flank Steak
instructions: Pound flank steak and season with salt pepper and crushed garlic. Evenly spread bread crumbs and mushrooms over the steak. Roll the steak with seasonings toward the center and secure with string or toothpicks. Place the steak in a medium or large pot and completely cover with the spaghetti sauce. Simmer for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and spices; add 1 cup cider and heat until sugar dissolves. Add remaining cider and orange juice concentrate. Chill.

title: Art'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Take onion carrots celery green pepper and put into blender to liquify. Heat olive oil in large pot. Brown garlic in oil and then discard garlic. Stir in tomato sauce tomato paste and 16 ounces of water and contents of blender. Add spices and simmer 3 hours. Serve on spaghetti. (Italian sausage hamburger or lean pork can be added but cook in another pot first to get rid of excess grease.)

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples and sugar. Let stand 1/2 hour. Separate eggs. Beat yolks; beat whites until stiff. Fold yolks into whites. Fold in oil and let mixture set while you mix dry ingredients.

title: Hot Chocolate For The Family
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in airtight container. Add 1/4 cup of mixture to a cup of boiling water for each serving.

title: Chicken Loaf
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and place into an 8 x 8-inch greased baking dish. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Banana Layer Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar beating well. Add egg yolks one at a time. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add alternating with flour. Beat egg whites; fold in. Bake in greased and floured pans at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Apple Squares
instructions: Combine cake mix and oleo. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 2/3 cup for topping. Add brown sugar and cinnamon to the reserved topping and mix well. Add chopped nuts if desired.

title: Super Chicken
instructions: In a large nonstick casserole combine rice chicken bouillon and mushrooms. Place chicken on top. Sprinkle dry onion soup over top. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
instructions: Saute chicken breast in butter. Add cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup and sour cream. Stir in chopped mushrooms and jalapeno peppers to taste.

title: Parmesan Pillows
instructions: Prepare biscuit mix as directed on package for rolled biscuits on lightly floured surface. Knead dough 10 times. Roll 10 x 6-inch rectangle. Cut into 2-inch squares. Cut each square in half diagonally. Dip into margarine. Coat with Parmesan cheese. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Artichoke Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until blended. Chill overnight for best flavor.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix water sugar jello and cornstarch together. Cook until clear then boil 3 minutes. Cool. Pour over quartered berries in baked crust. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook onion and bell pepper in small amount of oil until onion is clear then mix all ingredients together (reserve 1 cup stuffing crumbs and enough cheese for top). Pour into casserole dish. Put cheese on first and top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Cake
instructions: Blend Crisco and sugar together. Add eggs and beat very well. Add bananas soda and water mixture vanilla and lemon juice. Add all dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Add nuts. Bake slowly for about 1 hour in a Bundt pan.

title: Potato Rags
instructions: Shred potatoes and drop into deep fryer until crispy. Let them drain on paper towels to soak up oil.

title: Blueberry Sponge Cake Roll
instructions: Lightly grease 15 1/2 x 1 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line bottom with waxed paper and grease again; set aside.

title: Hot German Bean Salad
instructions: Spray a cold large skillet with nonstick coating. Heat skillet over medium-high heat. In a hot skillet stir-fry carrot onion and celery for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

title: Butternut Souffle
instructions: Mix all these ingredients together. Put into a greased baking dish.

title: Creamy Orange Tapioca
instructions: Combine all but vanilla in saucepan and let stand 5 minutes. Heat to boiling stirring often. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Let cool then cover and refrigerate until chilled and firm. Makes 6 servings. Contains 109 calories each and .2 g. fat.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Beat the egg yolks. Add all the ingredients except the egg whites beating well. Beat the egg whites and fold into the first mixture. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Turn oven a little lower and bake until light brown.

title: Wet And Good Chocolate Cake
instructions: Stir together the oatmeal and boiling water and let sit for 10 minutes. Reserve 1/2 of the chocolate chips for the top of the cake. Add the rest of the chips and all of the remaining ingredients to the oatmeal mixture. Mix well. Pour mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Spread 1/2 of the chocolate chips on top of cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done or approximately 35 minutes.

title: French Toast(Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Whisk the first 5 ingredients together in bowl until well beaten. Soak bread in milk mixture on both sides. Fry in nonstick pan or griddle until lightly browned on both sides but still moist inside. Serve with maple syrup orange marmalade or powdered sugar.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugar pumpkin and egg in mixer until creamy. Mix together remaining ingredients. Add dry ingredients to sugar mixture; mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Pink Jello Salad
instructions: Stir all ingredients and chill.

title: Black Bean Soup-Cuban Style(Frijoles Negros)
instructions: Wash and rinse beans carefully selecting out damaged beans (chipped or broken). Soak beans two hours before cooking. (Do not drain this water which may become discolored use it for cooking the beans.) Poke green pepper with a fork and roast lightly over flame or heat enough to peel off its skin. Remove its seeds and discard.

title: Holiday Trash
instructions: Preheat oven to 250\u00b0. Melt margarine in oven in large pan (bottom of roaster works great!). Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add all other ingredients. Mix until coated. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Lentil Barley Soup
instructions: Add everything except carrots. Cook to boiling. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Add carrots and simmer for 15 minutes or until tender. Top with one cup of Swiss cheese and serve.

title: Marinated Sliced Tomatoes
instructions: Peel and slice tomatoes (about 5 slices each). Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour over tomatoes. Chill covered for at least one hour. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Glorified Hamburg
instructions: Put in 2-quart casserole. Add more cheese to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Slice squash after washing and cook 25 minutes. Use very little water. Add while hot the cream cheese; let cool. Add American cheese. Place in casserole. Add grated Cheddar cheese sprinkled over top then bread crumbs. Pour melted butter on top of crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Will serve 10 people.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Combine the cake and pudding mixes then add the eggs oil and 7-Up. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes a 3 layer cake. Frost with vanilla frosting or frosting recipe for 7-Up cake.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except milk and margarine. Cook over medium heat for 40 minutes covered. Add milk and margarine; simmer for 30 minutes. For cream of potato soup mash 1/2 of cooked potatoes and add finely shredded Cheddar cheese. May reduce water and use milk instead of evaporated milk.

title: Creamy Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Brown chicken and onion in margarine. Add tomatoes peppers milk and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is done. Uncover. Cook 20 minutes.

title: Banana Bread(Diabetic Recipe)
instructions: Put all ingredients into bowl and mix well. Spray pan well with Pam. Bake in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Cream butter and cheese together; add flour salt and pepper. Mix well. Add Rice Krispies. Drop spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 minutes. These store well for later use. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Great Peach Cobbler
instructions: Put Bisquick in bowl. Add cinnamon nutmeg and butter. Mix all and sprinkle over peaches that have been placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Drizzle glaze made from powdered sugar and water over cobbler while still hot.

title: Strawberry Cheese Pie
instructions: In a large mixing bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared pie shell. Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with desired amount of glaze and strawberries. Refrigerate.

title: Lightning Cake
instructions: To melted butter and lard add eggs milk and vanilla. Add all to the dry ingredients. Bake in a loaf pan at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 about 30 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Tarts
instructions: Beat together cream cheese eggs sugar and vanilla extract until smooth. Put 1 vanilla wafer in cupcake paper round side down. Fill with 1 tablespoon of filling about 3/4 full. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes about 24 tarts.

title: Astoria Hotel Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and food coloring. Add sifted flour salt and cocoa alternately with buttermilk. Mix in flavor. Stir in vinegar and soda without beating. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
instructions: Cream the fat. Add the brown sugar gradually then the well-beaten eggs milk and flour (mixed and sifted with the soda). Stir in the melted chocolate chopped nuts and vanilla. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Beef Chow Mein
instructions: Cook until vegetables are tender. Serve over rice with chow mein noodles and soy sauce.

title: Copper Pennies
instructions: Mix carrots pepper and onion. Combine other ingredients and add to vegetables. Marinate at least 24 hours. Serve cold from refrigerator. These will last from 1 to 2 weeks or longer.

title: Sesame Chicken
instructions: Combine sesame seed paprika and salt. Dip chicken in milk; roll in crumbs. Pour butter or margarine in baking dish. Place chicken in pan; turn once. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. In small glass measure combine milk with vanilla and almond extract and set aside. In a large bowl of electric mixer at high speed cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Alternately add 1/4 flour with 1/3 milk mixture. Place in prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 40 minutes. Cool cake in pan on wire rack 15 minutes. Serve plain or sprinkled with powdered sugar.

title: Incredible Edible Crabmeat
instructions: Place cream cheese in the middle of serving dish. Combine all ingredients except crabmeat in a small bowl and blend well. Pour over the cream cheese. Pile the crabmeat on top of the sauce and season with the meat seasoning. Serve with your favorite crackers. Serves 4 to 6 people.

title: Cherry Almond Preserves
instructions: In a large kettle bring the cherries and water to a boil. Boil for 15 minutes. Add sugar and bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly. Boil for 4 minutes. Stir in pectin. Return to a full rolling boil. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in extract. Skim off foam. Pour hot into hot jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust caps. Process 15 minutes in a boiling water bath. Yields 11 half pints.

title: Crispy French Onion Rings
instructions: Mix flour salt milk oil and egg white; beat until smooth. Add enough water to make a medium thin batter (about 6 tablespoons). Peel 2 to 3 large onions; slice about 1/4 inch thick and separate into rings. Dip rings into batter and drop in hot oil. This makes a lot of onion rings.

title: Popovers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix. Spoon into well-greased muffin tin and bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes. Makes 12 large or 24 small muffins. Kids love these.

title: Cabbage Melange
instructions: In a large heavy skillet heat the oil over medium heat. Add the remaining ingredients except the soy sauce. Stir the mixture until the vegetables are lightly coated with the oil. Cook covered for 5 minutes. Sprinkle the mixture with soy sauce. Serve hot. Serves 6.

title: Apricot Gelatin Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in the boiling water then add rest of ingredients. Pour into 2-quart Pyrex and set until firm.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: In saucepan combine cranberry sauce vinegar brown sugar and broth then mix cornstarch and water and add to mixture. Cook sauce until thickened. Add pineapple chunks to sauce. Place chicken breasts in baking dish. Pour sauce over chicken. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Uncover. Add green pepper strips and keep basting with sauce. Bake; uncover for additional 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Heat oil in skillet (cast-iron works best) and saute onion garlic pepper and rice. Add seasonings and brown the rice. Then add the tomato sauce and 1 can water. Stir cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Cook broccoli according to package directions in a 2-quart casserole. Cook uncovered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Grit Bread
instructions: Cook 1 c. grits & 4 cups water until thick. Add 1 stick butter 4 oz. grated sharp cheddar cheese 1 roll Kraft garlic cheese and cook until melted. Add 3 beaten eggs. Stir until mixed. Put into a 1 1/2-2 qt. casserole and top with sharp cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until set in middle.

title: Viennese Raspberry Squares
instructions: Mix the butter and about half the flour. Add the sugar and egg yolks and beat on medium speed until combined scraping sides of bowl. Stir in remaining flour. Press into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Add cream of tartar to the egg whites. Beat on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add powdered sugar beating until stiff peaks form. Fold in the chopped nuts. Spreads preserves over the top of the hot baked crust. Spread meringue over the top of the preserves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut out centers of tomatoes. Turn tomatoes upside down on paper towel to drain. Put good tomato centers in bowl with celery salt pepper onions and enough bread to soak up moisture. Fill drained tomatoes. Sprinkle sugar on shell when filled if baking (if not sprinkle in stuffing) and butter on top. Put tomatoes on pan of water. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.\tPour into 2 unbaked pie shells and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until brown. Insert a toothpick.\tIf it\tcomes out clean it is done. Let cool before cutting.

title: Yum Yum Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand 20 minutes; scald milk and pour over sugar butter and salt. Let cool to lukewarm then add yeast. Beat eggs and add. Beat in flour. Place in bowl; brush top with melted fat and let rise until double in bulk about 1 hour. Make in buns; bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Molded Strawberry Delight
instructions: In large bowl stir gelatin and water until gelatin is dissolved; set aside 1 cup. To remaining gelatin add 3/4 cup cold water; chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in strawberries; pour into 4-cup gelatin mold or bowl. Chill until almost set about 1 1/2 hours. In small bowl stir reserved gelatin yogurt honey and almond extract; pour over strawberry-gelatin mixture. Chill until set about 2 to 3 hours. Unmold onto serving platter garnish.

title: Easy Lasagna Ever
instructions: In large skillet brown ground beef; drain. Add spaghetti sauce to beef and mix thoroughly. Spread a thin layer of sauce mixture into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Top noodles with half of remaining sauce mixture followed by half of cheese then remaining noodles. Top noodles with remaining sauce mixture and all but 1/4 cup remaining cheese. Pour boiling water right into the edge of the pan to within 1/2-inch of the top. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake in preheated oven at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes. Sprinkle remaining cheese on during last 10 minutes of baking time. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing. Serves 12.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Put chicken in food processor or cube very small. Add all the ingredients. Chill. Serve on bed of leaf lettuce. Great on croissants.

title: Pumpkin Roll
instructions: Oil a large cookie sheet and line with wax paper. Mix together the sugar eggs and pumpkin. Add the flour cinnamon and dash of salt. Pour mixture on the cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Will be a thin layer. When done sprinkle with powdered sugar. Lay a tea towel over warm cake and flip over carefully. Remove wax paper. Roll cake up with towel. Let rest for 1 hour. Unroll and spread with filling.

title: Lou'S Hamburgers
instructions: Mix altogether and wet hands. Make patties. Cook on grill until done or as desired.

title: No Bake Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix cheese 1 tablespoon of milk and sugar until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread in bottom of pie crust. Mix 1 cup of milk with instant pudding until smooth. Let set 3 minutes. Stir spices in pumpkin. Fold in instant pudding. Spread over cheese in pie crust. Chill for 2 hours. Garnish with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nutmeg and sliced toasted almonds.

title: Grandma Olson'S German Chocolate Cake(Very Easy Cake To Make Plus Serves A Large Crowd)
instructions: Put all ingredients into large mixing bowl. Boil 1 cup water; add 1 teaspoon baking soda. Add to mixture beating with a spoon until smooth. Mixture will be very thin. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 35 minutes; check for doneness with a toothpick.

title: Penne St. Martin
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter with garlic. Cook until garlic is golden then remove pieces and discard. Add tomatoes to oil; simmer 4 minutes. Add mushrooms; cook 5 minutes. Add all spices and peas; cook until peas are tender. Heat water to boil in large pot. Cook pasta al dente. While pasta is cooking stir cream into sauce. Cook until heated through. Pour hot sauce over penne. Add half Parmesan cheese and toss. (Pass remaining Parmesan cheese at the table.) Makes 6 servings.

title: Glazed Chicken(From Mjb Rice)
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Cut chicken into 1/2-inch strips. Mix flour paprika and garlic. Add chicken and toss to coat. Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until lightly browned. Add broth; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Combine cornstarch and next 5 ingredients. Blend mixture into ingredients in pan stirring until sauce boils. Add pea pods. Cover and cook until tender-crisp. Serve over rice.

title: Lasagna
instructions: In a large bowl combine the sauces. After browning the meat add some of the sauce to the meat. Mix well. Add Ricotta to meat mixture and mix well. Spray lasagna pan with nonstick spray and put a little sauce in the bottom. Now start layering meat and cheeses until everything is gone finishing with cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until hot all the way through. Serve with hot garlic bread or fresh Italian bread.

title: Po-Boy Mix
instructions: Place roast in large covered roasting pan. Add 6 to 8 cups water (more if needed) Lipton soup mix salt and pepper to taste. Cook until meat is fork-tender. Remove meat from broth and allow meat to cool overnight in refrigerator. Slice meat thin across the grain. Add onions garlic tomato sauce and Lea & Perrins to broth. Cook until vegetables are tender. Place sliced meat back in broth and heat through. Freezes well. Happy cooking.

title: Girdle Buster
instructions: Crumble cookies. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour margarine over mixture. Spoon softened ice cream over layer. Pour syrup and nuts over layer of ice cream. Cover and freeze overnight. Next morning spread Cool Whip over top and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Easy Chocolate Delight Pie
instructions: Heat all but 3 squares of chocolate with 1/4 cup milk in large microwavable bowl at High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir until completely melted. Or heat in heavy saucepan over very low heat. Beat in cream cheese sugar and remaining milk. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature until pie can be cut easily. Melt remaining chocolate about 15 seconds; drizzle over pie.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Mix well and pat into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan the cake mix melted butter and eggs. Beat well and pour over cake mixture the cream cheese eggs and powdered sugar. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Parmesan
instructions: Parboil whole zucchini; allow to cool. Slice 1/4 to 1/2-inch thickness; allow water to drain on paper towels. Grate Mozzarella cheese. Layer ingredients in baking pan in following order 1) sauce 2) zucchini slices 3) Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Go back to 1. Top layer should be cheese. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Last 15 minutes bake uncovered to allow cheese to brown slightly.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Dip fresh vegetables in dip. Best if made day before.

title: Brownies
instructions: In double boiler melt oleo and chocolate. Cool slightly. Beat eggs sugar and vanilla. Add to chocolate mixture. Add flour and milk. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes in a 13 x 15-inch pan.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together eggs corn syrup 2/3 cup sugar melted butter and brown sugar. Beat the filling mixture until well combined. Stir in pecan halves. Pour filling into the unbaked pie shell. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes or until a knife inserted between the center and edge comes out clean.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Break cauliflower and broccoli into small pieces. Combine mayonnaise and sugar. Toss all ingredients together adding mayonnaise and sugar mixture just before serving coating all ingredients well.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and chill. Serve on a croissant or lettuce leaf. Makes 8 to 9 croissants.

title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
instructions: Grate cheese; cut onions. Put sour cream soup chilies and onions in saucepan and heat. Drop tortillas in 1/2-inch oil for a few seconds. Put tablespoon of heated mixture in center of tortillas. Sprinkle small handful of cheese inside tortilla; roll and put seam side down in baking pan. Pour remainder of heated mixture over tortillas. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sea Coast Salad
instructions: Prepare dinner as directed. Add remaining ingredients and mix lightly. Chill. Add additional salad dressing before serving.

title: Greek Meatballs
instructions: Mix hamburger with rice yellow onion parsley dill and egg. Mix and mold into small meatballs. Roll each in flour. In a large frying pan put tomato juice and water. Bring to heavy simmer and add butter. Gently drop meatballs into this sauce cover and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Four Chip Fudge
instructions: Line 13 X 9 X 2 inch pan with foil and grease with the 1 1/2 tsp. butter set aside. In a large heavy sauce pan melt the remaining butter over low heat. Add the next five ingredients. Cook and stir constantly until smooth. Remove from heat; stir in butterscotch chips marshmallow cream and extracts until well blended. Stir in nuts if you like.

title: Angel Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Beat egg whites stiff. Slowly add both sugars beating constantly. Lightly butter 9 or 10-inch Pyrex pie plate. Pour in meringue mixture. Bake 1 hour. Remove from oven; cool. If center of pie shell doesnt fall push in. When cooked fill with sweetened whipped cream. Top with grated chocolate. Decorate with strawberries or raspberries. Refrigerate.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter margarine vanilla salt and sugar. Form 1-inch balls. In a double boiler melt chocolate bits and paraffin. Dip balls in liquid. Place on wax paper.

title: Jimmy'S Pico De Gallo
instructions: Chop tomatoes; discard seeds. Add chopped onion and chopped peppers. Discard seeds. Mix and sprinkle with salt. Chop about 1 cup of cilantro leaves (rinse to remove grit). Add cilantro and mix. Squeeze all lemon juice from 1 lemon over mixture. Refrigerate about 2 hours then break out the chips or flat bread. Excellent on fajitas hot dogs omelets crackers burgers; get the picture!

title: Homemade Mincemeat
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large pot and simmer 1 hour. Pack hot into jars and process pints and quarts for 20 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Chocolate Graham Cracker(Refrigerator Pudding)
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients together. Remove from heat and beat white egg yolks one at a time. Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites (stiffly beaten). Pour 1/2 of mixture over a layer of 12 graham crackers on a 13 x 9 inch pan. Repeat second layer. Refrigerate 24 hours. Serve with whipped cream. You may spread on top of dessert.

title: Lomo Saltado
instructions: Chop steak into pieces. Fry potatoes steak onion and tomato. Add spices. Serve over rice.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix pudding and eggs. Pour in greased and floured cake pan. Top with chips sugar and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Hot Bean Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheeses well. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Layer cheeses on top.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Mix together ingredients in order listed. Drop by large tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Cheese And Beefaroni With Biscuit
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine all ingredients together and place in a\tcasserole dish. Place biscuit on top and bake for at least 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry-Eggnog Shake
instructions: Soften ice cream in a large chilled mixer bowl. Add mashed berries; beat with electric mixer just to blend. Stir in eggnog. Serve in tall chilled glasses. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Peach Torte
instructions: Bake cake in 3 layers according to directions. Mix the cream cheese sugar nutmeg and milk. Mix with electric mixer until fluffy. Drain peaches; reserve juice. Mash peaches (save a couple to decorate with). Take drained mashed peaches and add 1 cup of icing mix. Stir then use to fill between layers. Pour peach juice over each layer as you stack cake then filling. Top cake and sides with the plain icing and decorate with peaches. This cake can be done with pineapple instead of peaches.

title: John'S Favorite Pie
instructions: Melt butter; add sugar and stir with wooden spoon. Add sifted flour and all other ingredients. Cook on medium heat in an iron skillet until thickened. Mix until smooth and pour into pie shell.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and eggs. Peel and cool. Dice potatoes eggs celery pepper and onion. Mix all together and add salad dressing pickle relish sugar mustard and salt and pepper. Chill until ready to serve. Serves 6.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Combine brown sugar sugar and flour in heavy saucepan. Stir in milk and eggs. Cook on medium-high heat until comes to boil stirring constantly. Cook for 5 minutes. Stir in margarine and flavoring. Remove from heat. Allow to cool for 5 minutes. Pour in pie shell. Cool and serve with Cool Whip.

title: Italian Love Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to box directions. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan; set aside.

title: Christmas Salad(Yields 12 Servings)
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water in bowl. Stir in 1 cup cold water. Chill until partially set; combine cranberries with a small amount of water in blender container; process at medium speed for several seconds or until chopped. Drain; combine with celery apple orange pineapple pecans and sugar in bowl and mix well. Fold in gelatin. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill until set. Serve as sauce with turkey or on lettuce leaves as salad.

title: Baked Angel'S Wings
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt with oleo as for pie crust. Combine yolks sour cream and flavoring. Mix together. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into 1/2 x 4-inch strips. Twist or knot. Place on ungreased pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 7 to 10 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar.

title: Crescent Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Cut or tear into pieces. salt and pepper to taste. Separate crescent rolls. Roll chicken into individual crescent rolls and place in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Mix together cream of chicken soup and milk. Pour over crescent rolls. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and bake approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Ham And Cheddar Rolls
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls. Tear along perforations. Place 4 triangles on an ungreased baking sheet. Spread lightly with mustard. Sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese and 1 tablespoon cooked ham. Starting at large end roll dough toward point. Fold ends in slightly to form \rolls.\ Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden. Serves 4.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Grease a shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cook broccoli until almost done. Arrange broccoli in baking dish. Cover with chicken. Blend mayonnaise lemon juice and soup together. Pour it over the broccoli and chicken. Mix bread crumbs and melted butter. Cover casserole mixture. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Preparation time 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Double-Deck Brownies
instructions: Melt shortening; add sugar and eggs and mix well. Mix flour and baking powder and add to first mixture. Add nuts and vanilla. Divide in half and add chocolate to one half. Spread chocolate mixture in 8-inch square greased pan. Spread remaining half on top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Coca-Cola Fried Chicken
instructions: Remove skin from chicken and place in skillet. Mix Coke and ketchup together. Pour mixture over chicken. Bring to a boil then lower heat to simmer. Let simmer until chicken is tender.

title: Apple Muffins
instructions: Measure and mix dry ingredients flour soda salt and all spice and set aside. Cream shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and egg and mix well. Add flour mixture and buttermilk. Mix until blended. Fold in apples. Spray muffin tins with Pam. Makes 12 small muffins. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Mary'S Orange Carrots
instructions: Simmer sugar margarine and orange juice for 15 minutes or until thickened. Pour over carrots and oranges in casserole. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Heat until bubbly and carrots are candied. (May be mixed the day before and refrigerated overnight.)

title: Momma'S Raspberry Velvet Pie
instructions: Drain berries; reserve syrup. Add enough water to make 1 cup. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add marshmallows; stir until partly dissolved. Add juice. Chill until partly set. Beat mixture. Add berries and fold in whipped cream. Pour into crusts. Top before serving with more whipped cream.

title: Cherry Cake Dessert
instructions: Mix together pie filling and pineapple (do not drain) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 box white cake mix over top. Dot one stick of butter on top of cake mix. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with Cool Whip to eat.

title: Hungarian Goulash
instructions: Fry ground beef in 1/4 inch of oil. Cube green pepper onion and celery. Put in skillet with ground beef. Simmer until tender. Cook macaroni until tender. Drain. Pour in tomato sauce then add ground beef mixture to macaroni. Simmer about 15 minutes.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix pudding mix milk eggs chips and nuts in a big bowl. Mix by hand until well blended about 2 minutes. Pour into a well-greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes until cake springs back when lightly touched. Do not overbake. Cool 15 minutes in pan. Remove from pan. Finish cooling on rack. Ice with chocolate icing.

title: Spinach Balls
instructions: Cook spinach according to package directions; drain and squeeze to remove excess moisture. Combine spinach and remaining ingredients mixing well. Shape mixture into 3/4-inch balls; place on lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 10 dozen.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Brown chicken well in oil. Remove and drain. Saute onion and garlic. Add chicken and remaining ingredients. Reduce heat to low and cover. Cook for 20 minutes.

title: Corn For Freezer
instructions: Boil gently together for 10 minutes stirring frequently. Chill in pan with ice around it and stir part time while cooling.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together. Beat eggs until light and add to sugar. Blend mashed bananas and lemon juice to creamed mixture. Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Add to creamed mixture. Add nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan (9 x 5-inches) in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for about one hour. This recipe may be doubled. Bake in 2 loaf pans.

title: Wheat Thins
instructions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and mix with fingers. Add enough cold water to stick together. Knead. Roll thin and cut in squares. Prick each with fork. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until brown and crisp. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on cake rack.

title: Chopped Apple Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a loaf pan (8 1/2 x 4 x 2 1/2-inch). On wax paper thoroughly stir together the flour baking soda salt and spices. In a large mixing bowl beat together until smooth the sugar corn oil eggs and vanilla. Slowly beat in the flour mixture; stir in apples and nuts. Turn into prepared pan. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven until a cake tester inserted in center comes out clean 1 1/4 hours. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes then turn out on pan. Cool completely before slicing.

title: English Pea Salad
instructions: Mix peas eggs mayo relish salt and pepper well. Chill for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Fig Bars
instructions: Mix all ingredients with a spoon. Spread over greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into bars while warm.

title: London Broil Marinade
