instructions: Mix all ingredients and simmer on stove for a minimum of one hour.

title: Scallop And Squid Stir-Fry
instructions: Chop all vegetables (slice mushrooms). Clean squid (very important). Stir-fry squid in 1 tablespoon olive oil for 40 minutes. Add sesame oil. Add broccoli and peppers. After 8 to 11 minutes add the rest of the vegetables; stir-fry for 10 to 15 minutes longer. Add spices/soy sauce while stirring occasionally. Add scallops; stir-fry for 5 minutes. Begin to boil water for pasta when cooking broccoli and peppers. Add pasta to water in time to finish with scallops. Serve stir-fry over fettucine.

title: Chocolate Frosting 3
instructions: Cook over low heat until margarine is melted and smooth. Add powdered sugar; take off heat and stir until desired consistency. Pour over cake. Add pecans (optional).

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken breasts until tender. When they have cooled debone the chicken. Place 1/2 package of dressing in bottom of casserole dish. Melt margarine; pour over dressing mix. Place chicken in casserole dish. Blend sour cream and soup together; spread over chicken. Put remaining dressing over sour cream mixture. Pour 2 cups broth over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chewy Brownie Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients together reserving some stuffing crumbs for topping. Bake in casserole dish at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes.

title: English Toffee
instructions: Place sugar butter or margarine and water in large heavy pan. Cook for 10 minutes on very high flame until mixture turns golden brown stirring constantly. Pour on lightly buttered cookie sheet and quickly spread Hershey bars over hot base. Sprinkle with finely chopped pecans. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Brazilian Black Beans
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Salt and pepper roast. Brown in oven for 30 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325\u00b0. Add beans to roaster with enough water to cover beans. Season with salt and pepper. Bake for approximately 2 hours adding onion more water and salt and pepper after first hour. Beans become soft in a soup like broth. Slice roast and serve beans over hot rice. Serves 6.

title: Coconut Cake
instructions: Make yellow cake mix by directions on box into sheet cake. Punch holes in cake while hot. Pour cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk over cake while hot. Cool and put Cool Whip and frozen coconut on top.

title: Ham And Egg Breakfast Souffle
instructions: Fry bacon; drain and crumble. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease. Mix together cornmeal cheese salt and pepper. In a skillet heat 1 tablespoon bacon grease with half of cooking oil. Coat tomato slices well with cornmeal mixture. When grease is sizzling hot cook tomatoes on both sides until crisp and lightly brown. Repeat with remaining. Drain on paper towel. Transfer fried tomatoes to a large plate; sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Serve hot.

title: Vegetable Aspic
instructions: In saucepan heat 2 cups V-8 juice. Add lemon jello and stir until dissolved (you may add 1 package dissolved in 1/4 cup hot water for a firmer set). Add remaining V-8 juice vinegar and salt and pepper to taste. Chill until syrupy. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into mold and chill until set.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together then add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan put crushed wafers. Add butter until thoroughly mixed. Spread on bottom and sides of pan.

title: Thanksgiving Dressing
instructions: Put day old bread slices on cake pans in oven at 250\u00b0 until slices are browned. After cooled soak browned slices a few seconds in water. Squeeze out water well and gently. Put bread in large bowl. Brown chopped celery onion and butter together. Add this to bread. Next fold in cut up chicken (cooked). Lastly add rest of ingredients. Stir gently. Stuff turkey and put rest of dressing in a 10 x 7 baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. All stuffing ingredients are already cooked except eggs so this doesnt need to be overbaked.

title: Italian Tomato Soup
instructions: Saute celery and onion until soft but not brown. Add soup broth tomatoes and seasoning; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Zucchini In Cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Butter a 6 x 10 x 2-inch baking dish. Peel potatoes. Cut lengthwise into one-sixteenth inch thick slices. Place in a large bowl. Cover with cold water; soak 5 minutes. Drain rinse and pat dry. Using an electric mixer beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour 1 cup into prepared dish. Top with 3 to 4 layers of potatoes arranged in crisscross pattern. Cover with 1 cup of cream mixture. Continue layering ending with cream. Press potatoes down to submerge. Cover with foil. Bake until knife easily pierces center about 2 hours. Remove foil and continue baking until golden brown about 10 minutes. Cool 15 minutes. Run knife around edge of dish. Cut into squares and serve.

title: Catfish Gumbo
instructions: Chop pepper onions celery and garlic; saute in hot oil in Dutch oven until tender. Stir in broth and next 6 ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Cut catfish into 1-inch pieces; add to gumbo. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in okra; cook an additional 5 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Serve over rice. Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

title: Almond Date Squares
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients together well. Press into a 9 x 9-inch greased pan. Set aside. Boil dates in water for 5 minutes. If mixture is too dry add a little more water. Spread carefully over bottom layer. Beat egg whites until frothy and turning white. Add brown sugar and continue beating until stiff. Spread over dates. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Cover to store. Cut with clean knife.

title: Nutty Salmon Patties
instructions: Combine salmon with its liquid crackers and Grape-Nuts cereal. Mix well. Add egg milk and onion. Stir until well blended. Make into small patties. Fry in melted butter (I use Pam) in a skillet. Brown on both sides. Serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Far East Celery
instructions: Parboil celery in small amount of water for 8 minutes. Drain. Add soup pimentos milk chestnuts and cheese. Put into a greased casserole. Toss crumbs with almonds in melted butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugar vanilla and pudding mix in large bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in chips. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

title: Chicken-Mushroom Bake
instructions: Combine flour salt pepper and paprika. Shake chicken in flour mixture. Melt butter in skillet. Brown chicken. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Combine soup sour cream and mushrooms. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until tender. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Slice potatoes put in casserole dish then mix up the soup like you would for soup (with milk or water). Pour over potatoes. Wash off the pork chops and place them on top of the potatoes. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serves 5 people.

title: Parsley Soup
instructions: Combine and bring to a boil potatoes onion butter curry powder Worcestershire and water. Simmer until potatoes and onions are tender. Combine parsley and chicken stock in blender and blend until smooth; add to potato and onion mixture. Combine milk heavy cream and pepper and add to rest of ingredients. Heat and serve or chill and serve cold.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients 2-5 with bread crumbs.\tFold in ground beef and form into two loaves. Place in lined roaster uncovered.

title: Company Olives
instructions: Drain liquid from jar of olives into saucepan. Add garlic and pepper; simmer 5 minutes. Add vinegar dill and red pepper flakes. Pour over olives (still in jar) and shake well. Let stand in sealed jar in refrigerator at least 4 days. The longer the better.

title: Homemade Ice Cream
instructions: Blend together and pour into ice cream maker.

title: Underwood Holiday Bells
instructions: In small mixing bowl beat together cream cheese deviled ham Worcestershire sauce and cayenne pepper until smooth. Stir in green and red peppers. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Serve with crackers and vegetables.

title: Cocktail Meatballs
instructions: Mix hamburger with garlic powder; shape into small balls. Pan-fry until well cooked; drain. Mix chili sauce and jelly. Add meatballs; heat mixture. Serve warm in chafing dish with toothpicks neatly. Yield 12 servings as cocktail appetizer.

title: Angel Food Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Tear cake into three sections and place each section in a bowl. Pour one flavor of Jell-o (dry mix) over each section. Mix well. In a tube pan or other deep dish layer as follows orange cake mixture drained mandarin oranges ice cream. Raspberry cake mixture blueberries ice cream. Strawberry cake mixture ice cream drained strawberries. Place in freezer until ready to serve. Let sit out for about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Honey Dijon Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Combine apricot spread mustard honey pepper and garlic powder in a medium bowl and stir well. Measure 1 cup apricot mixture and set aside. Dip chicken pieces in remaining apricot mixture. Dredge in crushed pretzels. Place on 2 large baking sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until chicken is done.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well; if not creamy enough I add a bit of half and half or milk. Heat at 350\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Spicy Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; remove and drain fat. In saucepan heat soup (do not add milk or water) stirring until smooth. Add tomatoes and sausage. Heat thoroughly. Serve hot or at room temperature. Great on taco chips.

title: Beef Triangles
instructions: Add powdered soup mix to ground beef and fry until brown. Open crescent rolls and cut each triangle in half; flatten out and place on wax paper. Take one spoonful of beef mixture and place in the triangle. Fold ends of crescent roll up to cover meat and form a triangle. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

title: Midnight Muncher
instructions: For each sandwich hard-fry an egg fry 3 slices of bacon slice tomato and add lettuce. Toast your bread and add mayonnaise or butter.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Press into an 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan and bake 1 1/2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven or 20 minutes in microwave. Top with ketchup when taken from oven.

title: Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: Place butter in a 4-cup glass bowl. Microwave on High for 1 minute or until butter is melted. Add remaining ingredients. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. Cook on medium for 1 minute beating every 15 seconds until thickened. Remove from oven and beat with mixer until light and smooth.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Fold in strawberries last. Bake in two 9 x 5-inch pans at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Carrots Au Gratin
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in small saucepan. Remove from heat. Add cornflake crumbs. Mix well. Set aside. Melt remaining margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add onion and cook only until tender. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Remove from heat and add milk gradually stirring until smooth. Return to medium heat and cook until bubbly and thickened stirring constantly.

title: Seafood Mousse
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cover sole with 3/4 cup boiling water and poach 2 to 3 minutes. Cool and drain. Put fish cooked shellfish and egg whites in the bowl of a processor and process until smooth. Turn into a large chilled bowl and add brandy and seasonings. Stir to blend. Add cream slowly mixing thoroughly until well blended and thick. Pour into a buttered ring mold; place it in a pan filled with a few inches of hot water and bake 35 minutes or until top is firm. Unmold and serve hot with sauce.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Pork Chops
instructions: Trim all fat from chops. Place in casserole. Combine all other ingredients and pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or 250\u00b0 for 2 hours or until chops are tender. Sauce is very good over baked potatoes.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients then add the rest of the ingredients and mix. Add one can of Bakers poppy filling. Add one cup chopped walnuts (optional). Beat well on medium for 2 minutes.

title: Windsor Hotel Fricassee Chicken
instructions: Clean and cut chicken at the joints. Put in large kettle; add water to cover chicken completely. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 30 minutes. Add onion celery and carrots; season to taste. Continue to simmer for about 2 hours. Remove chicken and vegetables. Strain stock; remove all fat and measure stock. There should be 2 to 3 cups.

title: Heavenly Layered Fruit
instructions: Mix together softened cream cheese powdered sugar and milk and then blend in Cool Whip. Set aside. In a 9 x 13-inch container layer angel food cake drained pineapple and Cool Whip mixture. Other fruit can be used.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix butter and both sugars until well blended. Add eggs and mix well; add bananas buttermilk and water with baking soda and mix well. Slowly add flour and mix until well blended. Do not overbeat. Stir in chopped nuts. Pour into 9 1/2 x 5 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes then remove from pan and place on cooling rack. Store in refrigerator (this tastes better after it has been stored in refrigerator for 24 hours). This bread freezes well.

title: Funnel Cake
instructions: You will need a funnel.

title: Beer Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Grease 12-cup muffin pan. Pour into muffin pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Makes 12 muffins.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix together with a spoon the cake mix oil and pineapple. Beat the eggs together with a fork; add to first mixture and mix together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. After cake has cooled frost.

title: Delicious Braunschweiger Log
instructions: Blend all together and shape into a log. Mix another 8 ounces cream cheese softened with dry mustard salt pepper and onion powder to taste. Beat with electric blender until it looks like whipped cream. \Ice\ the log and refrigerate. Serve with crackers. Recipe will feed several.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pudding and crushed pineapple well; stir in other ingredients and mix well. Let set overnight in refrigerator.

title: Turtle Brownies
instructions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk; set aside. Mix cake mix butter and remaining evaporated milk. Place half the batter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle chips on top then pour melted caramels over chips. Sprinkle nuts on top of that. Pat down. Put rest of batter on top and spread as well as possible. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Poor Man'S Meal
instructions: Peel potatoes and cube. Boil in 2 quarts of water until tender. Drain potatoes. Add milk and margarine and mash. Set aside. In large skillet brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Spread ground meat evenly in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Place green beans evenly over meat. Spread mashed potatoes over beans. Sprinkle shredded cheese over potatoes. Cover with foil. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Fat-Free Carrot Cake
instructions: Coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Crinkles
instructions: In bowl with mixer at medium speed beat oleo peanut butter sugar brown sugar eggs and vanilla until fluffy. At low speed beat in next 4 ingredients; shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Put popped corn on cookie sheet (nonstick is best). Remove all unpopped kernels. Sprinkle chopped nuts over popcorn. Melt butter in heavy saucepan on low heat. Stir in brown sugar Karo and salt. Bring to boil on medium heat. Do not stir. Boil 4 minutes no more no less. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Pour mixture over popcorn. Stir until coated. Will not coat completely. Place in hot oven (middle rack) for 15 minutes. Take out. Stir again until all popcorn and nuts are completely coated. Then bake for 15 minutes longer. Empty onto foil. Let cool completely. Break into pieces. Place in airtight container.

title: Batter Rolls
instructions: Add yeast sugar salt oil and egg to milk. Add 2 cups flour and beat well. Gradually stir in more flour until mix is stiff. Let rise until double in bulk. Drop by spoonful into well-greased muffin tin. Let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 2 dozen rolls.

title: Shrimp Tempura
instructions: Blend and refrigerate 30 minutes. Heat 3-inches oil in deep pot or 2-inches if using frypan. Test oil with drop of batter. When drop goes to bottom of pan and pops back up light brown oil is hot enough. Dip cleaned shelled shrimp in batter and fry until done.

title: Stir-Fry Collard Greens
instructions: Break off and discard stems of collard. Wash leaves thoroughly. Slice leaves into bite-size pieces by rolling several leaves together and cutting into 1/4-inch strips. Blanch greens in boiling water for 30 minutes. Drain well. Melt drippings in a large skillet. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in tomato and cook until just tender. Add greens to onion mixture and stir until well coated. Cook until tender. Stir in a pinch of nutmeg.

title: Whiskey Slush
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags and brew for a few minutes. Combine all ingredients. Put one ice cream scoop in tall glass. Fill with 7-Up or ginger ale. Makes pretzel container full.

title: Durango Drummettes
instructions: In large skillet combine water soy sauce sherry brown sugar and green onions. Add drummettes and stir to coat. Heat to boiling and lower heat. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Uncover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes more. Serve warm.

title: Southern Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Melt bacon drippings in a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven. Combine corn meal flour baking powder salt and soda. Whisk eggs into buttermilk; add to the corn meal mixture stirring just until blended. Pour hot drippings from skillet into batter; blend well. Pour batter into hot skillet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown. Cut into wedges to serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Lora'S Bran Muffins
instructions: Put ingredients into a bowl. Just fold until mixed. Put into muffin pan. Makes about 8 muffins. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pizza Cups
instructions: Brown meat and drain off excess grease. Add the onions Italian seasoning salt and tomato paste and warm through. Grease muffin tins and pat out biscuits and place in the tins. Add 1/4 cup meat mixture and top with cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Aunt Goldie'S Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple into saucepan. Add the sugar flour and eggs. Cook stirring constantly until mixture bubbles and thickens. Cool.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Cook Karo butter water and sugar to form soft ball stage. (When dropped in cold water it will form a soft ball.) Pour mixture over popcorn and mix. Put butter on your hand and dip your hands in cold water. Form popcorn into balls. Food coloring may be added to cooked mixture to color for different seasons. Put balls on wax paper to cool.

title: Lemon Meringue Pie
instructions: Combine first three ingredients in a large heavy saucepan. Gradually stir in lemon mixture. Add butter. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Cook 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon rind. Pour into shell. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy. Add 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar. Beat in vanilla. Spread meringue over hot filling. Seal to edge of crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yield 1 (9-inch) pie.

title: Pork Cantonese
instructions: Brown meat in a large skillet. Drain mushrooms and pineapple chunks; combine and measure liquids. Add enough water to measured liquid to make 2 cups. Add to skillet; bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Stir in molasses soy sauce and vinegar. Add mushrooms pineapple chunks green pepper and onion. Cook 15 minutes longer. Blend cornstarch with small amount of water; stir into hot mixture. Cook stirring until slightly thickened. Serve with hot cooked rice.

title: Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and margarine. Mix well. Add eggs and 1/2 flour; mix well. Add other 1/2 of flour to fruit and nuts. Mix well. Add batter to fruit and nut mixture and mix well. Drop by tablespoon onto greased cookie sheet. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until done. Yields a large amount.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Put ingredients through sieve 3 times. Store in airtight container.

title: Whipped Dream Dressing For Fruit Salad
instructions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise by hand until smooth. Stir in preserves lemon juice and curry powder. Chill until about an hour before serving. Stir in whipped cream and refrigerate until serving time. Yield about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream powdered sugar and peanut butter together until crumbly. Stir next 8 ingredients together in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly. Bring to a boiling point and cook a few minutes. Sprinkle 2/3 of peanut butter mixture in bottom of baked pie shell. Pour custard over this. Beat egg whites and spread on custard and sprinkle remainder of peanut butter mixture over egg whites and brown in oven.

title: Potatoes Supreme
instructions: Boil potatoes until firm (not soft). Cool peel and shred on large part of grater. Heat butter cheese and sour cream until almost melted. Add sour cream salt pepper and green onion to cheese mixture; fold into potatoes. Put in 2-quart casserole; heat until just heated through. Reheat in microwave about 3 minutes.

title: Oyster Snack Crackers
instructions: Pour crackers into a gallon Ziploc bag. Mix oil dressing and spices together in a bowl. Stir well. Pour mixture into the bag with the crackers. Seal the bag and shake well. Continue to shake once a day until all crackers are eaten.

title: Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Put pineapple and sugar in pan. Boil 4 minutes. Dissolve jello in water; mix with pineapple. Refrigerate until set. Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese. Add to jello. Mix well. Chill until set.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl stir well chill overnight.

title: Death By Chocolate Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix. Pour into 9 x 13 inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over it. Bake at 350 degrees until done. Remove from oven. Poke holes in it while still warm. Heat ice cream topping. Pour over warm cake. Let cool completely. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Tomato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Spray pie plate with cooking spray. Flatten biscuits in pie plate to form a crust. Spread olive oil on biscuits. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes. Spread tomatoes on biscuits. Sprinkle seasonings on tomatoes. Mix cheese and mayonnaise. Spread on tomatoes. Bake until biscuits cook and cheese bubbles.

title: Bacon Twists
instructions: Wrap slice of bacon around each bread stick. Roll in Parmesan cheese. Place on microwave bacon cooker and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Will be very crisp. Place paper towel over and under to absorb grease.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls then roll in powdered sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 7 dozen.

title: Green Beans Viennese
instructions: Cook green beans according to the package directions and drain.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: In a saucepan (3-quart) combine the rice and water. Simmer for 10 minutes; add milk and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 60 to 70 minutes or until rice is tender. Add sugar salt and butter; mix well. Add cinnamon to taste. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Fat Boy Apple Pie
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Arrange in pie shell. Combine other ingredients and mix until crumbly; sprinkle over apples. Bake at 425\u00b0 for first 15 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for another 45 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Cherry Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Combine Crisco sugar egg milk and vanilla in large bowl. Mix at medium speed until well mixed. Add oats flour soda and cinnamon. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed until well mixed. Fold in nuts and raisins. Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.

title: Hamburger Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie pan. On floured surface roll each biscuit to 1/8-inch thick. Arrange biscuits on bottom and sides of pie pan to form a crust. Brown meat onion green pepper and celery. Stir in tomatoes with their liquids salt and oregano. In a small bowl beat eggs and milk and add meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Cook noodles (or can substitute spaghetti) according to package directions. Pour boiling water over smoked franks and let stand 5 minutes. Dry. Slice (cutting on a diagonal is nice for this salad) in small slices. Add peppers. Mix dry Italian seasoning mix vinegar oil sugar and a few onion flakes. Pour over salad and mix together.

title: Cheese Pecan Spread
instructions: With a beater or spoon combine cream cheese with steak sauce. Add pecans garlic Tabasco sauce and parsley. Mix well; form in ball and roll the ball over more pecans. Then wrap in plastic wrap and chill for several hours.

title: Cream Of Tomato Soup(Freezer)
instructions: Melt butter. Saute garlic celery and onions. Add cored cut-up tomatoes stock and parsley. Simmer 30 minutes. Put all through food mill. Return to pot and reheat. Add salt and pepper.

title: Chocolate (Star Cookie) Filled Snowballs
instructions: Beat butter sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add sifted flour and nuts; blend well. Chill dough. Remove foil from kisses. Shape dough around kisses until about 1 tablespoon dough for each ball. Be sure to cover kisses completely in ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 12 minutes or until set but not brown. Cool slightly. Remove carefully to wire racks. While still warm sprinkle top with confectioners sugar; cool. Store in tightly covered container. Roll in sugar again before serving if desired. Makes about 40 cookies.

title: Peppered Steak
instructions: Cut beef in 1/8-inch thick strips. Combine soy sauce garlic and ginger. Add beef; toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.

title: Birdie Roquefort
instructions: Brush chicken with melted butter and A.1.; combine sour cream with Roquefort salt and paprika. Pour over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Superb Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Make cake according to directions on box with the following variations Use 2 more eggs than the directions call for and substitute pineapple juice for liquid. Then add the can of drained crushed pineapple to the cake batter and mix well.

title: Oatmeal Cake(Edna Jean Alfson)
instructions: Pour hot water over quick oatmeal and let stand for 20 minutes. Sift the flour and add cinnamon. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Washed and pat dry the chicken breasts. Marinate with garlic powder onion powder cajun seasoning and crushed red pepper flakes. Add a bit of water and boil until chicken is tender. Let cool then cut into thin strips. Set aside.

title: Sour Cream Muffins
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Combine egg sour cream and cooking oil. Make a well in center of dry ingredients add liquid ingredients all at once. Mix only until all ingredients are moist. Fill well greased muffin cups 2/3 full and bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Baked Macaroni 'N Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in pepper salt mustard and flour. Add milk and cook until thick. Combine sauce cheese and macaroni. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake 25 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Beef-Broccoli-Potato Bake
instructions: Brown ground beef. Place potatoes in 2 1/2-quart pan. Spread cooked ground beef over potatoes. Spread frozen broccoli broken apart over beef. Sprinkle powdered mixture from the potatoes over the broccoli. Add butter to 1 cup of boiling water to melt. Mix in sour cream and pour over casserole. Pour remaining water over casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Reuben Casserole
instructions: Place sauerkraut in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with layer of beef then cheese. Combine both dressings; spread over cheese. Top with tomato slices; set aside. Combine butter and bread crumbs; sprinkle over tomato slices. Microwave at 70% power for 12 to 14 minutes or bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Potatoes Au Gratin
instructions: In a very well buttered pan alternate layers of potatoes onion cheese and salt and pepper until the pan is full. Pour milk or cream over all; dot with butter. Cover the pan with foil or lid. Begin cooking over medium heat until cover is very hot to touch (about 20 minutes). Reduce heat to low; cook about 25 minutes more. Take cover off; cook additional 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash; mash and drain. Combine squash onion sour cream and soup. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish and top with stuffing that has been mixed with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Queen Elizabeth Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over dates and soda. Let stand while other ingredients are mixed. Add to date mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes in a 9 x 12-inch pan.

title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add eggs one at a time. Add other ingredients. Bake in Bundt pan at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. Store while hot in airtight container.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: As soon as the potatoes are cooked drain. Mix other ingredients except paprika and toss. Sprinkle paprika on top.

title: Hush Puffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease 8 muffin cups. In medium bowl combine all ingredients; mix well. Spoon into muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean. Remove from pan. Serve warm.

title: Good Dumplings
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Combine beaten egg milk and oil and add to dry mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls into at least 3 cups of liquid or into boiling water. Cook 15 minutes or until done part uncovered and part covered.

title: Russian Tea
instructions: Mix the ingredients. Make tea as desired.

title: Dried Beef Snacks
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients well. Spread on slices of dried beef. If slices of beef are small use more than one slice to each roll. Roll up tight like jelly roll. Chill. Cut in 1/2-inch pieces and pierce with toothpicks.

title: Beefy Rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake 350 degrees for one hour.

title: Mocha Toddies
instructions: In mixing bowl combine coffee crystals and water. Stir to dissolve crystals. Add chocolate syrup rum and vanilla. Store covered in refrigerator. To serve stir tablespoons Mocha Base into 3/4 cup milk in a mug. Top with ice cream.

title: Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and evaporated milk until well mixed. Add fresh milk and sugar substitute. Cook in top of double boiler until mixture is consistency of soft custard. Add vanilla; mix well and remove from heat. Toss sliced bananas with lemon juice and arrange in bottom of 9-inch graham cracker crust reserving several slices for garnish. Pour custard mix over the bananas. Arrange reserved slices on top and chill until well set.

title: Christmas Eve Salad
instructions: Place oranges bananas beets pineapple and jicama in bowl. Mix reserved beet liquid and pineapple juice then lemon juice 2 tablespoons sugar and the salt; pour over fruit. Let stand 10 minutes; drain. Arrange fruit on shredded lettuce. Garnish with lime peanuts and pomegranate seed. Mix anise seed and 1 tablespoon sugar; sprinkle over salad. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Peppermint Patties
instructions: Mix the milk and extract. Start adding powdered sugar 1 cup at a time. Knead the last cup or so of sugar into the dough. Dough will be smooth and not too sticky. Pinch off small pieces and pat into mint sized patties. Place on cookie sheet lined with waxed paper. Dont make patties too big as it makes them difficult to dip in the chocolate. They shouldnt be any wider than a fork. Let patties dry about an hour the turn them over and dry on other side. Dip in chocolate melted in a double boiler one at a time. Pull them out of the chocolate by scooping them up with a fork tapping the extra chocolate back into the pan. Turn the fork upside down and let the mint slide off onto another waxpaper lined cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Broiled Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Stir together butter or margarine basil paprika garlic powder and pepper. Place potato slices in a single layer on the unheated rack of a broiler pan. Brush margarine mixture over both sides of potato slices. Broil about 5-inches from heat for 8 to 9 minutes or until potatoes begin to brown. Using a wide spatula turn potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil for 4 to 6 minutes more or until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings.

title: Judy'S Dried Apple Cake
instructions: Mix apples sugar and butter while apples are still warm. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake in tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Italian Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth; add egg yolks and beat well. Combine flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla and coconut and chopped nuts. Fold in egg whites (beaten). Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until tests done.

title: Emerald Isle Mold
instructions: Cream the cream cheese and blend with Jell-O. Add water and juice. Pour into mold and chill.

title: Blueberry Streusel Muffins
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture.

title: Quick Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Melt butter in 10 1/2 x 2-inch cast-iron skillet. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over butter. Arrange 7 pineapple slices over brown sugar reserving remaining slice for other uses. Place a cherry in the center of each pineapple slice. Sprinkle with pecans. Set aside.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts
instructions: Melt chips together in heavy saucepan. Stir in peanuts. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper-lined cookie sheets or plates. Chill. Makes 48 pieces of candy.

title: Nutty Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients together. Pour into a 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until ingredients are set. Remove from oven. Sprinkle peanuts and marshmallows over the top. Place back in oven for 15 minutes.

title: Deep Fried Pretzels
instructions: Combine flour and plain salt in a bowl. Cut in shortening. Add water 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix until dry ingredients are moistened and dough can be gathered into a ball. Knead gently a few times. Pinch off pieces of dough and shape into 1-inch balls. Roll each ball between hands to form a 10-inch rope. Form each rope into a pretzel shape. Set on waxed paper. Heat shortening to 365\u00b0. Fry 3 pretzels at a time for 3 minutes or until brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with coarse salt.

title: Crisp Chicken With Herbs
instructions: Mix eggs 1/2 teaspoon salt milk and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper together.\tIn another bowl mix other dry ingredients. Dip chicken in liquid mixture and then in the flour mix to coat. Fry in oil in 14-inch Dutch oven turning after 5 minutes. Cover and\tsimmer 15 minutes turning once. Remove lid and cook for 15 minutes more. Drain and serve.

title: Breast Rolls
instructions: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Pound to 1/4-inch thickness. In a large glass bowl mix together butter and pepper sauce for marinade. Add chicken turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate 15 to 30 minutes. Remove chicken spoon 1 tablespoon cheese onto center of each chicken breast. Fold in sides of chicken around cheese. Fasten with toothpicks. Place in baking dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on Medium-high (70%) 8 to 9 minutes. Serve on lettuce leaves. Garnish with celery leaves.

title: Chicken Asparagus
instructions: Place asparagus in casserole dish. Brown chicken and layer over asparagus. Mix soup mayo and lemon juice; pour over chicken. Brown crackers in butter and sprinkle over soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until bubbly.

title: Yummy Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple. Mix pudding in the juice off of the fruit with a whisk. Add Tang and mix until well blended. Put fruit into the pudding mixture; chill. Add sliced bananas before serving. Makes 6 servings.

title: Hummingbird Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil. Stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla pineapple 1 c. nuts and bananas. Spoon batter into 3 well greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely. Spread frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle with remaining nuts.

title: Pumpkin Cookies
instructions: Mix everything well. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until done.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together. Grease 4 coffee cans. Fill 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and leave in cans until ready to serve.

title: Celery Casserole
instructions: Cook celery in water until tender. Add salt milk cheese minced onion and celery soup. Brown almonds in margarine. Add to celery mixture and pour into a buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Flan
instructions: Sift brown sugar into bottoms of 8 custard cups or 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Beat slightly. Add sugar and salt; blend in milk and vanilla. Pour custard mixture over sugar in custard cups or baking dish. Place cups or baking dish into shallow baking pan and fill halfway up baking dish with hot water.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with mayonnaise. Cover and refrigerate overnight if possible.

title: Oneida Corn Soup
instructions: Cook corn in water with bits of venison wild edible greens like cowslip ferns or milk weed and a handful of wild rice.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine well in large bowl. Fashion into football shaped loaf in bottom of roaster pan. Dust top with garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3 hours plus or minus.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Cook beef; then drain.

title: Celery Seed Dressing
instructions: Mix dry ingredients except celery seed in a bowl. Add a small amount of vinegar to make a paste. Add oil and vinegar alternately in small amounts. Beat after each addition. Add celery seeds. Yields 3 cups.

title: Pork Barbecue
instructions: Cook pork in water and salt and pepper to taste. Remove pork when done and shred into small pieces. Set aside. Measure 1 cup broth and 1/4 cup onion into pot. Add ketchup mustard parsley and Worcestershire sauce. Add pork. Allow to simmer 15 to 20 minutes on low heat until onions are done.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions on box then cream with Cool Whip and let get solid and ready to spread. In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan put a layer of graham crackers (leave whole) 1 layer of cream mix another layer of graham crackers a layer of cream mix another layer of graham crackers a layer of chocolate icing. Refrigerate until used.

title: Company'S Coming Beef Roast
instructions: Line roast pan with foil. Place nice size sirloin roast in pan. Add soup mix and golden mushroom soup on top of roast. Pour 1 cup of water (use soup can to measure and pour over roast). Cover roast with foil and roast pan cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours. This roast makes its own gravy and when meat is tender carrots and potatoes can be added and returned to oven for about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Roast
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly and put in oiled pan. Bake about 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Kid Size Pizzas
instructions: Let bread dough thaw until pliable. Divide into 6 pieces. Pat each piece on floured board into circles 4 or 5 inches in diameter. Put onto greased baking sheet. Top with sauce and shredded cheese. Top with toppings as desired. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Pinto Beans And Hamburger Meat
instructions: Cook beans until nearly done. Brown hamburger meat and drain. Add all of the ingredients to the hamburger meat and saute a few minutes. Add to the beans and finish cooking until well done. Cook in at least a 5-quart pot. Serve with corn bread green salad and tea. This will make a complete meal.

title: Yum-Yum Salad
instructions: Bring to boil lemon juice sugar and water. Mix gelatin in cold water; pour into lemon juice mixture. Let cool completely. Add pineapple and juice cottage cheese and whipped cream that has been sweetened. Pour into large mold. Chill. To serve cut in squares.

title: Chipmunk Pie
instructions: Mix dry ingredients with eggs. Add vanilla apple nuts and raisins. Mix. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Top with Cool Whip to serve.

title: Venison Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine venison egg Worcestershire sauce pepper onion or dry onion soup and oatmeal. Mix well. Cook in loaf pan at 350\u00b0 until done about an hour. Mix brown sugar and ketchup together. Put on top of meat loaf. Place in oven for 5 minutes more.

title: Beef 'N Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef; salt to taste and drain. Mix all ingredients in a 1 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake about 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Nacho Salad
instructions: Place nacho chips in glass baking dish. Dip teaspoons of Cheez Whiz over chips. Add peppers over this. Place covered in microwave 1 1/2 minutes.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Set oven at 375\u00b0. Mix sugar flour spice and salt in a 3-quart mixing bowl. Add the pumpkin milk and egg and stir until smooth. Pour into the unbaked shells. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife comes out clean 2-inches from edge. Serve warm or cold. One pie serves 6.

title: Mixed Pickles(Looks Like Grammy Williamson'S Mustard Pickles)
instructions: In saucepan blend mustard with a little vinegar; stir in remaining vinegar sugar salt celery seed mustard seed cloves and turmeric. Cover; heat to boiling. Add cucumbers and remaining vegetables. Cover; heat just to boiling. Simmer while quickly packing one clean hot pint jar at a time. Fill to within 1/2-inch of top making sure vinegar solution covers vegetable. Cap each jar at once. Process 5 minutes in boiling water bath. Makes 8 to 9 pints.

title: Chicken Enchilada
instructions: Mix soup and sour cream together. Tear tortillas in pieces. In 9 x 13-inch baking dish place a layer of soup mixture a layer of tortillas layer of chicken then chilies then onions then a layer of shredded cheese. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used up ending with cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with extra sour cream if desired.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco oleo and flavoring; add eggs one at a time. Add sugar; mix well. Add flour and milk alternately. Add baking powder last. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Freezes well.

title: Nannie'S Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and cocoa in black skillet. Add milk stirring constantly. Add egg yolks vanilla and butter. Cook on medium heat until thick. Pour in baked pie shell. Using the whites of the 3 eggs make meringue for top of pie.

title: Apple Bars
instructions: Put first 4 ingredients in a bowl and mix for pie crust. Pat about 3/4 of this mixture into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Reserve balance of mixture for topping.

title: Easy Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger onion salt and pepper. Cook macaroni and drain. Add hamburger macaroni and corn together. Add Prego sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered 1 hour.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix powdered sugar margarine egg vanilla and almond extract. Mix in flour baking soda and cream of tartar. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

title: Oatmeal Lace Cookies
instructions: Mix oatmeal with melted butter. Add sugar powder salt eggs and chips. Line cookie sheet with non-shiny side of aluminum foil. Put on lowest rack in oven. Let cookies cool before removing from cookie sheet.

title: Chili Cheese Dip
instructions: Brown beef; drain fat. Add next six ingredients. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cheese. Serve hot with chips.

title: Cran-Apple Relish
instructions: Wash cranberries and apples well. Cut apples into quarters and remove cores. Put cranberries and apples through a blender or food processor using medium blade. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight to blend flavors. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

title: Pickled Beets
instructions: Prepare beets. Wash; leave roots and 1 inch of stem on. Cook until done approximately 1 1/2 hours. Remove skins and cover with vinegar; add sugar and salt. Let heat thoroughly; put in jars.

title: Popcorn Balls
instructions: Combine the corn syrup sugar and water and boil until a little when tried in cold water forms a hard ball 254\u00b0F. Add the vanilla and pour into the popped corn from which all hard grains should be removed. Stir till coated rub hand with Mazola corn oil and form the corn into medium sized balls pressing closely together.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Salad
instructions: Mix everything together except tomatoes and chill overnight. Add tomatoes before serving.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook the spirals and cool making sure not to overcook them. Add the Good Seasons Italian dressing and Wish-Bone Italian dressing. Mix in all the remaining ingredients and grated Parmesan cheese. Mix well all together in a large bowl. Let set overnight before serving.

title: Stir And Drop Sugar Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix eggs sugar vegetable oil lemon peel or juice and vanilla thoroughly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop dough by teaspoon about 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with greased bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Yields 4 dozen cookies.

title: Granny'S Oyster Stew
instructions: Melt margarine in heavy saucepan. Add flour (do not brown just moisten flour). Add oysters that you have cut into several pieces. Cook 5 minutes over medium heat. Add mushroom soup. Stir well. Add milk and seasonings. Bring just to a boil. Serve immediately.

title: Sausage Corn Bread
instructions: Brown sausage in medium skillet (cast iron); do not drain. Add mangoes and onion. Mix corn bread mix egg sugar and milk until blended well. Pour over sausages in skillet; bake at 350\u00b0 until brown. Invert on plate and top with cheese.

title: Baked Shrimp Dip
instructions: Heat oven to 300\u00b0. Mix all ingredients except snack. Spoon into small ovenproof bowl. Bake for 45 minutes. Serve with snack. Makes 2 1/3 cups dip.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix onion egg tomato sauce dry onion soup oatmeal and hamburger. Place in baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. When it is finished add ketchup to the top and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Krispies
instructions: Heat corn syrup and sugar (almost to boiling). Add peanut butter. Turn off heat and add Rice Krispies and stir until coated. Put in buttered cake pan and allow to cool.

title: Faye'S Glazed Pecans
instructions: Combine sugar and sour cream in a heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until mixture reaches soft ball stage (240\u00b0). Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Continue stirring until mixture begins to cool. Add pecans mixing well. Place individually on waxed paper; cool completely.

title: Potluck Potato Casserole(Serves A Group!)
instructions: Mix first 6 ingredients. Pour into large baking dish. Sprinkle with corn flake crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 covered for 30 to 45 minutes (uncover for the last 5 to 10 minutes).

title: Busy Day Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and pour off grease. Add water soup mix tomato sauce and spices. Boil 5 to 10 minutes to thaw soup mix. Serve.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix by hand. Make into small balls. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes on ungreased baking sheet.

title: Grits Casserole(Also Known As Cheese Grits)
instructions: Cook grits in salted water according to the directions on the package. When the grits are done add cheese and butter. Combine cream with egg yolks and garlic powder mixing well. Stir into grits. Bake covered for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 8.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Grind cranberries and whole orange (be sure to remove orange seeds first). Add sugar and let stand.

title: Meat Sauce
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions. Add green peppers and cook slowly until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer until thick enough for serving. Skim off excess fat before canning. Pour hot into jars leaving 1-inch head space. Adjust caps. Process pints 1 hour and quarts for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Marinate potatoes by tossing with French dressing. Chill potatoes and seafood thoroughly. Mix together lightly with pickles and mayonnaise. Arrange lettuce on serving plates. Heap salad in mounds on lettuce. Surround with tomato wedges and eggs. Top each mound with olives.

title: Hot Spiced Percolator Punch
instructions: Perk in percolator (brown sugar cloves and cinnamon go in the basket).

title: No Sugar Cookies(For Diabetics)
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over raisins. Let stand. Thoroughly cream butter Sucaryl and beaten egg. Sift dry ingredients and add to butter mixture; add raisins vanilla toasted oatmeal and nuts. Drop by teaspoonful on baking sheet. Cook 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Penne Pasta Casserole
instructions: Cook Penne pasta noodles. Brown ground beef. In a greased lasagna pan mix noodles ground beef Ragu sauce cheese soup and 8 oz. Mozzarella cheese. Cover pan with foil and bake 30 - 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Uncover and sprinkle the rest of the Mozzarella cheese. Return to oven to melt cheese.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Potato Soup
instructions: Cook broccoli potatoes and onions until tender. Drain all but 1 cup of broth. Place 3/4 of the broccoli potatoes and onions into blender. Puree. Return to pan and add milk and cheese. Cook until cheese is melted and soup is heated through. If soup is too thin thicken with a bit of cornstarch dissolved well in warm water. Serve with croutons.

title: Pecan Cheese Pie
instructions: Combine cream cheese 1/3 cup sugar salt 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 egg. Beat until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle with pecans. Combine 1/4 cup sugar corn syrup 1 teaspoon vanilla and 3 eggs. Pour over mixture in crust. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until top is firm. Cool and refrigerate before serving. The best of two favorites cheesecake and pecan pie.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken mixture in deep-dish pie crust. Turn 9-inch pie crust upside-down over the deep dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove 9-inch pie pan. Bake 15 minutes more.

title: Date Nut Crumb Roll
instructions: Roll crackers into fine crumbs. Whip the whipping cream and combine 1/2 of crumbs dates nuts vanilla and marshmallows. Form into roll; roll in remaining crumbs. Chill. Slice.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Warm and mix margarine chocolate chips and peanut butter until smooth and completely melted. Pour over Crispix cereal. Gently stir until cereal is covered. Pour into a large grocery bag with powdered sugar. Shake until well coated.

title: Western Barbecued Beans
instructions: Cook ground beef salt pepper and garlic in oil until brown. Add other ingredients and bake 40 to 45 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven.

title: Country Skillet Gravy
instructions: Spoon flour into hot meat drippings. Blend over low heat until smooth. (You can brown it if you like brown gravy.) Gradually add milk stirring constantly until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Ranch Style Beans For Fifty
instructions: Wash beans. Add boiling water. Cover and let stand for 1 hour or longer. Add bacon to beans. Add additional water to cover. Cook slowly until tender about 1 hour. Soak chili peppers in warm water. Remove seeds. Add pods to beans. Add tomatoes and other seasonings. Cook slowly in kettle an additional 2 hours or pour into a 12 x 20 x 4-inch baking pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Grams Stuffed Cabbage
instructions: Brown hamburger and drain fat. Mix hamburger rice eggs and seasoning together. Stuff cabbage shell with mixture. Place in pot. Add tomato soup and water. Simmer for at least 1 1/2 hours.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Follow directions on graham cracker crumb box to make crust out of graham cracker crumbs sugar and margarine. Press in 9 x 13 inch pan. Beat 2 c. powdered sugar 2 eggs and 2 sticks margarine for 10 minutes. Pour on top of crumbs. Layer bananas crushed pineapple and top with cool whip. Garnish with nuts and cherries.

title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar buttermilk eggs and extract. Mix well then add pecans coconut and melted butter. Mix well and pour into a greased Bundt pan and bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Baby Wipes
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Pour over each section of paper towel. Squeeze out excess liquid; put in airtight container. If wipes dry out repeat first 3 ingredients.

title: Mahimahi With Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle salt and pepper on fillets. Coat with flour. Pan-fry in butter until done.

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes in a large pot in the quart of water until slightly tender. Add all other ingredients. Cook slowly until all seasonings are tender. Add parsley just before serving.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook and drain broccoli. Spread in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Spread chicken over broccoli. Mix soup and mayonnaise together. Slowly blend in milk. Pour over chicken. Add crumbled bread over sauce layer. Spread cheese over bread. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Sweet And Sour Smokies
instructions: Pour grape jelly and mustard over cocktail smokies and bake in slow oven until glazed well. Serve hot or cold.

title: San Antonio Salad
instructions: Combine lettuces artichoke hearts hearts of palms onion pimento salt and pepper in salad bowl. Add Parmesan cheese; toss to mix well.

title: Ham Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Wash mushrooms. Finely chop stems and onion. Saute in butter until tender but not browned. Add ham bread crumbs and pimiento. Stir until combined and crumbs are soft. Place mushroom caps in buttered baking dish; spoon ham mixture into caps. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Raisin-Pineapple Muffins
instructions: Beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Beat in egg juice and orange peel. Combine remaining ingredients; stir into juice mixture until moistened. Spoon batter into six muffin cups coated with a cooking spray. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool on rack; serve warm. Makes 6 large muffins.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients thoroughly. Add the next 4 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Add nutmeg cinnamon (optional) and vanilla (optional). The\tdough may be rolled and cut or made as\tbiscuits by hand. Bake at 425\u00b0 until as brown as desired.

title: Triple Baked Beans
instructions: Slightly drain beans and mix the tomato and catsup brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Place in a shallow dish. Top with crumbled bacon onion and grated cheese. Bake for 1 hour in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Gourmet Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain peas carrots and beets and dice them. Put in a bowl with celery and pickles. Mix mayonnaise mustard and lemon juice and mix with vegetables. Sprinkle dill weed to taste and for color. The amounts of mayonnaise mustard and lemon juice may be varied to your taste. Serves 6.

title: Sugar Peanuts
instructions: Place in large skillet. Stir with wooden spoon over medium heat. When tiny bit of liquid is left spread nuts on cookie sheet. Place in 250\u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Christmas White Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add slightly beaten eggs gradually mixing well after each addition. Beat in salt and orange juice. Add flour a cupful at a time mixing well. Combine fruits with batter. Add nuts and mix well into batter. Grease baking pans then line with foil. Fill with batter. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 2 hours for smaller loaf pans and 2 1/2 hours for larger loaf pans. You may also use a ring pan. Cool thoroughly then remove from pan.

title: Black Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking soda salt and cocoa together in a large bowl. Add oil and hot water. Beat until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Pour into a buttered and floured cake dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 50 minutes.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Combine sugar flour and milk. Microwave 2 minutes on Roast. Beat well and cook 1 1/2 to 2 minutes more (or until mixture thickens). Add butter and beat until smooth. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Add vanilla and beat with electric mixer until light and fluffy.

title: Bean Dip For Tortilla Chips
instructions: Bring to boil. Remove and add 1 (8 ounce) package of shredded cheese. Let melt and stir.

title: Dilly Beans
instructions: Wash beans snap top and tails and wash again in several changes of cold water. Pack beans lengthwise in sterilized quart jars. Place garlic and dill in each jar. Add 1 hot pepper if desired.

title: Zucchini Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large bowl combine sugar oil eggs flour zucchini and 1 teaspoon of the vanilla. Mix well. Add salt soda baking powder and rolled oats. Mix until well blended. Fold in walnuts. Spoon into a greased 15 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool in pan. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Corn-Bacon Bake
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain reserving 3 tablespoons drippings. Crumble bacon finely; set aside. Stir together flour sugar soda and salt. Stir in corn meal; add buttermilk and reserved drippings and bacon. Mix well; pour into well greased 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is golden brown. Cool; invert. Cut into thin slices. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Mom'S Warm Potato Salad
instructions: In a large pot boil the potatoes with the skins on for 10 to 15 minutes until tender. Let the potatoes cool just to the touch and cut into cubes. In a large bowl combine remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and mix gently. Serve at room temperature.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Take out half of chopped beef. Mix all other ingredients. Roll ball in reserved beef.

title: Cookie Sheet Cake
instructions: Bake cake on cookie sheet for 15 minutes or until done. (Cake will be thin.) Mix together until fluffy and smooth 1 small box instant vanilla pudding 1 cup milk 8 ounce package softened cream cheese and 8 ounce package Cool Whip. Top cake with mixture. Add chopped walnuts cherries and pineapple. Rich and delicious. Keep cool until serving.

title: Double Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients. Shape in small ball pat 1/2 teaspoon peanut butter on each cookie. Put cookie in top and seal edges with a fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: Jana'S Dump Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except for the frosting. Spread on jelly roll pan (cookie sheet with sides). Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. When cool frost with cream cheese frosting.

title: Scotch Cookies
instructions: Mix and let stand overnight. Roll in small walnut sized balls and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 6 minutes or until puffed up cookies flatten. Remove from pan immediately; cool on wire racks.

title: Busy Woman Peach Cobbler
instructions: Place peaches in a baking dish. Mix in bowl the flour sugar oil and milk. Pour mixture over peaches. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top and bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown.

title: Cheese Dollars
instructions: Sift flour salt and\tred pepper together.\tCut in margarine; add Tabasco sauce Rice Krispies and cheese. Work with hands until mixture sticks together. Shape into small balls and flatten to 1/4 inch thickness. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 70 to 100 cheese dollars.

title: Divinity Candy
instructions: Combine sugar syrup hot water and salt in 2-quart saucepan. Stirring constantly bring to a boil. After mix comes to a boil cook without stirring to hard ball stage. Remove from heat. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour hot mixture slowly into the egg whites while beating constantly. Add vanilla and beat until candy forms soft peaks and begins to lose gloss. Add nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef in a skillet until done. Add onions and celery. Cook 5 minutes. Drain excess fat. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Put in covered dish and bake 30 to 45 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Hot Spice Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. In a 9-inch square pan melt butter. Stir in pecans. Roast 30 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Mix soy sauce salt and Tabasco. Stir well. Drain on paper towels. Serve.

title: First Prize Beans
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak overnight. Drain. Put beans in a large pot and add fresh water to a depth of 3-inches above the beans. Stick cloves into peeled onion and add to bean pot with bay leaf and salt. Bring to a boil. Boil rapidly 5 minutes. Skim foam from top of beans. Reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender but not mushy. Drain and reserve liquid.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Use half ham (butt section will have more meat).

title: Dot'S Spanish Omelet(Breakfast Or Brunch)
instructions: Beat these first 3 ingredients together well. Grease both sides of an omelet pan lightly with margarine and place over medium heat. Divide egg mixture in half and pour part in each side of the omelet pan. When 3/4 of the way done spoon some Prego sauce (with meat) grated sharp Cheddar cheese some chopped onion and some chopped green pepper over each side of the divided omelet. Then flip omelet over and cook a few seconds more so that the Prego sauce and other ingredients have a chance to warm through thoroughly. Place on dish and enjoy!

title: Deviled Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Cook Brussels sprouts as directed on package. Drain leaving 1/2 cup water in pan. Combine all ingredients; simmer 2 to 3 minutes and serve hot. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Cream butter and cheese together. Add rest of ingredients and mix well. Shape into long rolls with a diameter about the size of a half dollar. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap. Chill in refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. Slice thin and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until golden. This freezes well. Dough may be kept in the fridge for 2 to 3 weeks.

title: Curry-Glazed Sole(Or Any Good Whitefish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Wash fillets; dry with paper towels. Arrange in single layer slightly overlapping in greased shallow baking dish. In small bowl mix mayonnaise sour cream onion and curry powder. Spread evenly over sole. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily and starts to brown.

title: Stroganoff
instructions: Mix hamburger soup and water over heat until hot. When ready to serve add sour cream and serve over noodles.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into loaf pans (greased and floured) at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Turn oven down to 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until set in center. To make round bread grease and flour tall tomato juice cans. Mint flavored chocolate chips are also excellent at Christmas.

title: Salmon Patties
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Spoon into large frying pan with 1/3 cup oil until golden brown.

title: Italian Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Combine cauliflower olives green pepper pimento and onion in a bowl. Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Chill for 1 hour or longer before serving.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Combine ground beef onion and green pepper in Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat until beef is brown stirring to crumble meat. Drain! Add soup tomatoes beans chili powder salt pepper and garlic powder. Stir well. Cover reduce heat and simmer 1 hour stirring occasionally. Sprinkle each serving with Cheddar cheese.

title: Meringue Torte
instructions: Beat until stiff the egg whites cream of tartar and pinch of salt. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Pour into 2 well-greased cake pans. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Turn off oven and leave in oven overnight. Next morning prepare 2 envelopes Dream Whip according to directions. Stir in 4 large crushed Heath bars which had been prefrozen for easy crushing. Ice the meringues as a cake. Chill in refrigerator for at least 8 hours before serving as cake slices.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine ingredients except pecans. Mix well. Form into a ball. Place on waxed paper and chill. Roll cheese ball into finely chopped pecans. Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Add noodles juice and seasonings. Cover and simmer 1/2 hour until noodles are done. Add mushrooms and sour cream; stir easy. Cook until heated.

title: Baked Fish In Cheese Sauce
instructions: Cut fillets into serving pieces. Arrange in a single layer in greased 2-quart baking dish. In saucepan melt margarine. Stir in flour and cook until bubbly. Add salt dry mustard dill and cayenne. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk. Return to heat and cook stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Mix in 1 cup of cheese stirring until melted. Mix in shrimp. Pour sauce over fish and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until top browns and fish flakes easily when tested with fork.

title: Microwave Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Makes 1 1/2 cups.

title: Brazilian Black Beans And Rice
instructions: Soak beans overnight. Rinse well. In a large pan add enough water to cover beans about 1 inch. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 3 hours.

title: Chicken Wreath
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls - separate. On a round cookie sheet place unrolled rolls in the shape of a ring - wide part in center - overlapping small points to the outside. Fill with chicken mixture. Fold point back over chicken mixture making a wreath. Brush with egg white. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Adam'S Nachos
instructions: Get Mommy to drive you to store to buy stuff for nachos. Wear clothes that she dont mind getting dirty. Get Mommy to sit you up on table with your nacho stuff around. Put the nachos on plate (I like a lot of them). Pour salsa on nachos. Be careful or it will all go on one spot. Put cheese on top and try to get it even. Get Mommy to put them in microwave and let you push the buttons. It takes about 45 seconds for the cheese to melt. Goes really good with iced milk.

title: Classic Karo Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl stir eggs corn syrup margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool. Serves 8.

title: 7-Up Cake
instructions: Beat all ingredients for 3 minutes. Bake in 3 cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake is done in center.

title: Low Carb Sugar-Free Ketchup(Makes 24 Ounces)
instructions: Put all ingredients into a saucepan and simmer slowly for 1 1/2 hours stirring often. It will thicken like the store bought stuff. Take off heat and cool. Stir in 2 packages Splenda. Pour into a jar. Keeps 4 months in the fridge.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix in a large bowl and beat the cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust. Chill 3 hours or overnight. Top with desired amount of pie filling. Refrigerate.

title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
instructions: In skillet saute onion and green pepper in margarine until tender. Remove from the heat. Stir in the soup mushrooms pimentos and basil. Set aside. In a large bowl combine egg noodles chicken and cheeses. Add mushroom mixture and mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 12 to 15.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Chop apples and stir in sugar. Let stand 20 minutes. Add Wesson oil soda egg flour and nuts last. Bake in loaf pan 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Kuchen
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut margarine into dry cake mix until crumbly. Mix in pecans. Pat mixture lightly into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake 10 minutes. Arrange apple pie filling over warm crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Combine sour cream and egg. Drizzle over apples. Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown. Serve warm or cold. Great with vanilla ice cream.

title: Hot Dog Snacks
instructions: Cut each hot dog into 4 pieces. Cut bacon into 3 pieces. Wrap bacon around hot dog and secure with a toothpick. Put in a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish. Pack in fairly tight. Cover with a 1/2-inch of brown sugar packed down. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Blueberry Upside Down Cake
instructions: In a small saucepan melt 2 tbsp. butter; stir in brown sugar. Spread in ungreased 8 in. baking dish. Arrange blueberries in a single layer over brown sugar mixture. Set aside. In a large mixing bowl cream remaining ingredients and beat in sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Mix well. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Carefully pour over blueberries. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Immediately invert on a serving platter. Serve with whipped topping if desired.

title: Indonesian Fried Rice
instructions: In electric skillet brown onion in a little oil. Add pork or shrimp; brown. Add frozen vegetables celery and scallions. Simmer for a few minutes. Add Arturos sauce; stir good. Add cooked rice; mix and let simmer until rice is hot. Add soy sauce. Garnish with scrambled egg cut in strips or pieces.

title: Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet stirring until crumbly; drain. Spoon into large bowl. Brown hash brown potatoes with onion in large skillet stirring frequently. Add to sausage; mix well. Scramble eggs in skillet until done to taste stirring frequently. Add to sausage mixture. Add chopped green chiles salt pepper salsa and shredded cheese. Mix well. Place 2 tablespoons mixture along one side of each tortilla; roll to enclose filling. Serve with additional salsa. Makes 24 servings.

title: Ham-N-Cheese Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie plate. Mix ham vegetables and Parmesan cheese in plate. Stir Bisquick milk and eggs with fork until blended. Pour into plate. Bake 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Spaghetti Primavera
instructions: Cut tofu into pieces 2 x 1/2 x 1/8-inch. Marinate for 2 hours in bowl with soy sauce 2 tablespoons oil and vinegar. Brown the tofu lightly in leftover marinade plus 2 tablespoons oil; set aside. In boiling water cook until tender broccoli fresh or frozen. Reserve water. You may substitute 2 cups broccoli and 2 cups asparagus for the 4 cups broccoli.

title: Mushroom Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix well the vinegar soy sauce and sugar. Pour over the mushrooms and sprinkle with sesame seed. Marinate 45 to 60 minutes. Remove from sauce and serve.

title: Baked Chicken-Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Skin chicken pieces;\tcoat with flour that has been seasoned. Put in\ta 13 x 9-inch dish. In a saucepan combine oleo and flour; brown slightly.\tAdd soup and water to make gravy consistency.\tAdd bell pepper onion salt and pepper to taste. Pour over chicken.\tCover with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve gravy over rice.

title: S'Mores Cookie Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Press cookie dough into 2 ungreased 12-inch pizza pans. Bake 10 minutes or until golden. In medium sized saucepan melt chips with Eagle Brand milk. Spread over crusts. Sprinkle with milk chocolate candies marshmallows and peanuts. Bake 4 minutes or until marshmallows are lightly toasted. Cool. Cut in wedges.

title: Cheese Noodle Beef Casserole
instructions: Set aside the cooked noodles. Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add tomato sauce and vegetables. In a 2-quart casserole mix cottage cheese and sour cream. Layer noodles meat and cottage cheese/sour cream. Repeat until all is used. Cover with Cheddar cheese. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble and fry sausage or ham. Drain well on paper towels. Beat eggs in a small bowl and add milk. Blend. Add salt and pepper to taste. Put crescent rolls in a 9 x 12-inch pan (use nonstick spray). Layer sausage over crescent rolls. Place hash browns over sausage. Put Cheddar and Velveeta cheese over hash browns. Pour egg mixture evenly over cheese. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cheese will be golden. Egg mixture will be cooked up. If it is runny then longer.

title: Divinity
instructions: Cook sugar syrup and water to 255\u00b0. Beat egg whites stiff. Pour syrup mixture in a fine stream into egg whites while beating with electric mixer. Add vanilla and continue to beat. Beat by hand until mixture begins to lose gloss. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

title: Texas Cabbage Casserole
instructions: In 10-inch skillet brown sausage. Add onion and pepper. Saute and drain. Add cabbage and tomatoes. Cover and simmer over low heat until cabbage is tender. Serves 6.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels butter and 3 tablespoons sugar. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy skillet. In hot oil saute rice over medium heat stirring with a metal spoon about 5 minutes or until golden. Stir eggs into rice; cook stirring constantly and over medium heat until eggs are cooked about 3 minutes. Stir in bacon soy sauce and pepper; combine well. Garnish with green onions.

title: Crescent Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add remaining ingredients and shape into small crescents. Bake on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes at 325\u00b0. Roll in extra confectioners sugar while warm.

title: Scalloped Cabbage
instructions: Place cabbage in a greased 2-quart casserole. In a saucepan heat oil over medium heat. Stir in flour salt and pepper. Cook until bubbly. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir until thick. Fold in cheese. Pour over cabbage.

title: Zucchini Hater'S Casserole
instructions: For Oven Cook sliced zucchini in salted water. Drain and mash. Add sour cream eggs cracker crumbs and Cheddar cheese. Put in buttered 8 x 8-inch casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with Mozzarella cheese.

title: Cocktail Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Combine cream cheese grated onion and enough mayonnaise to make spreading consistency. Separate sliced ham. Spread mixture on slices and place an asparagus spear on ham and roll. Cut each roll into 4 pieces. Spear each piece with a toothpick for serving. Refrigerate.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook shrimp in olive oil until pink. Add vermouth garlic salt and pepper. Cook until liquid is almost gone. Sprinkle on parsley and lemon juice. Serve over rice.

title: Blueberry Chiffon Pie
instructions: Drain blueberries. Boil juice. Add 1/2 cup sugar and jello. Add Cool Whip and evaporated milk with 2 tablespoons of sugar. Fold blueberry mixture into whipped milk. Add berries. Pour into baked pie shell. Chill.

title: Enchilada Pie
instructions: Place the sliced beets in a shallow casserole dish. Melt the butter in a saucepan add the mustard honey and Worcestershire sauce. Season with salt and paprika; heat well. Pour the sauce over the beets in the casserole dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
instructions: Measure dry ingredients in a bowl. Mix oil and water into dry. Mix well and knead until well blended. Keep in a sealed container. Refrigerate after using.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Beat shortening until creamy. Add sugar. Add egg; beat well. Sift together soda flour baking powder and salt. Add sugar to mixture. Add banana and nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. While hot spread with butter; sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

title: Golden Wassail
instructions: Pour juices into 20 cup electric percolator. Place remaining ingredients in basket. Allow to go through perk cycle. Serve hot. Yields 20 (1/2 cup) servings.

title: Hot Fudge Pudding Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine 3/4 cup sugar flour 3 tablespoons cocoa baking powder and salt. Blend in milk melted butter and vanilla; beat until smooth. Pour batter into square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch. In smaller bowl combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar brown sugar and remaining 4 tablespoons cocoa; sprinkle mixture over batter.
