Pour hot water over top; do not stir. Bake 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Let stand 15 minutes; spoon into dessert dishes spooning sauce from bottom of pan over top. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In 1 1/2-quart casserole combine soup milk soy sauce and pepper. Stir in green beans and 1/2 can of the fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until hot and then stir. Sprinkle remaining onions on top and bake for additional 5 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: No Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Boil 2 minutes. Remove and add the remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Cool. May be frozen in airtight container.

title: Pate Beau Monde
instructions: Mix several hours before serving. Serve with crackers or thin sliced bread or toast. Beau Monde is a Spice Island product.

title: Savory Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; pour over chicken in large bowl. Turn to coat; refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Put all in oven to bake. Can be grilled. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Ground Beef Casserole
instructions: Mix ground beef with a fork to separate in bottom of casserole dish. Sprinkle cornstarch or flour on top lightly. Spread mixed vegetables over top of beef layer. Add enough water to come halfway up on beef layer. Spread mashed potatoes over top of vegetables using a cake decorator to make fancy decorations on top. Cook in microwave 5 minutes then move to oven at 400\u00b0 to brown top of potatoes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Combine first five ingredients. Separately combine second five ingredients. Mix together the wet and dry mixtures and pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 90 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Rice Krispie Topped Brownies
instructions: Cream together melted oleo sugar cocoa and vanilla until fluffy. Add eggs flour and salt to mixture. Pour into a greased jelly roll pan. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and spread with jar of marshmallow cream.

title: Italian Broccoli
instructions: Partly defrost broccoli. In a large skillet heat olive oil and butter. Cut garlic in half and saute until golden. Remove garlic; spread broccoli in a single layer in pan. Saute turning gently for 10 minutes until tender. Arrange in heatproof serving dish. Sprinkle with cheese; place under broiler for 1 minute. Serves 6 to 8.

title: German Bean Soup
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak overnight. Drain rinse and cover with fresh water. Add the ham bone and simmer until beans are soft. Skim off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until vegetables are almost soft. Remove ham bone and return picked meat to soup.

title: Louisiana Crunch Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix 1 egg and stick of soft margarine with mixer then add cup of nuts. Press mixture in lightly greased cookie sheet. Mix cream cheese and 2 eggs; beat on low speed. Add confectioners sugar. Mix well and pour over the first mixture spreading evenly. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Cream cheese and gradually add sugar until all sugar is dissolved. Stir in whipped topping and mix well. Layer cream cheese mixture and pie filling onto cooled crust.

title: Spicy Short-N-Bread Nuggets
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients. Cut in butter until crumbly. Make a ball; knead until smooth. Cut into 12 parts. Out of each part make a 10-inch rope on floured surface. Cut into 1/2-inch nuggets. Place on ungreased sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 325\u00b0 until edges are firm and bottoms brown lightly. Remove cookies and cool on paper towels.

title: Sesame-Cheddar Scones
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Grease a large baking sheet. In a large bowl stir together the flour cornmeal and baking powder. Add the shortening and butter and blend with your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Mix in the cheese.

title: Nancy'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Add eggs oil milk and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in boiling water. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring to a boil first 4 ingredients and cook 2 minutes. Add red food coloring; cool. Place strawberries in pie shell and pour mixture over berries. Let pie stand in refrigerator overnight.

title: Velvet Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello pineapple sour cream Cool Whip and nuts together. Chill in mold before serving.

title: Cherry-Topped Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Measure out 1 cup of dry cake mix; set aside. In a large mixing bowl stir together remaining dry cake mix 1 egg and oil (mixture will be crumbly). Press crust mixture evenly into bottom and 3/4 of the way up the sides of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. In the same bowl blend cream cheese and sugar together. Add 3 eggs and reserved cake mix. Beat 1 minute at medium speed. At low speed add milk lemon juice and vanilla extract; mix until smooth. Pour into crumb crust. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes or until center is firm. Cool to room temperature. Spoon cherry filling over cheesecake. Cover and chill 1 hour before serving. Store in refrigerator.

title: Better Potatoes
instructions: Mix beer onion (diced) garlic powder oregano and basil and store in refrigerator 12 more hours. Dice 4 to 6 large potatoes in pot and fill 1/2 way with mixture. Add butter and cover slightly with water. Boil until potatoes are done. Drain and serve as is mashed or whipped.

title: French Toast Casserole
instructions: Spray a 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Slice Italian bread about 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick and line pan. In a bowl mix eggs milk salt sugar and vanilla. Pour over bread and let soak 4 to 24 hours. Cover and refrigerate turn bread over after several hours.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil broccoli about 20 minutes seasoned with salt and pepper. Drain broccoli. Mix all ingredients and cook in casserole dish for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: 100,000 Frosting
instructions: Put in pan flour milk and salt. Cook until thick. Cool then beat a little before adding sugar soft oleo and Crisco. Beat sugar oleo and Crisco real good until thick; add vanilla.

title: Barley Soup
instructions: Melt the margarine in soup pot. Add barley celery and onion and cook stirring constantly until the barley is slightly transparent. Stir in the flour. Add hot chicken broth. Simmer covered stirring occasionally for 1 hour or until barley is tender. Add the cream just before serving. Serves 6.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt margarine and chocolate over low heat. Stir occasionally. Cool thoroughly. Beat chocolate mixture into eggs; add vanilla. Add sugar flour and salt. Beat well. Stir in nuts. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: London Broil
instructions: Marinate meat in mixture overnight. Broil in oven or cook on grill until desired doneness.

title: Rainbow Punch
instructions: Mix juices and Sprite. Add sherbet before serving.

title: Sour Cream Cookies(Club Member: Laine Shoemake)
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together; add egg and sour cream. Add remaining ingredients. Chill 1 hour at least. Very important. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter. Sprinkle sugar on top of cookies before baking. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Place the cookies in a tight container to keep crisp.

title: Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans in water overnight. Rinse and put into pot. Simmer 6 to 8 hours in a crock-pot.

title: Indian Shrimp Curry
instructions: Saute onion in the butter in top of double boiler over direct heat until tender. Stir in flour curry powder salt sugar and ginger. Add bouillon cube dissolved in boiling water and milk and cook over boiling water stirring constantly until thickened. Add shrimp from which black vein has been removed and the lemon juice. Heat well and serve with rice. Serves 6 generously.

title: Soda Cracker Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar together. Gradually add sugar beating after each addition. Fold in soda crackers nuts and vanilla. Place in a buttered pie pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until light brown.

title: Tropical Fruit Smoothie
instructions: Put fruit in blender. Add equal parts water and ice to cover fruit. Blend until smooth and serve!

title: German Stollen
instructions: In large mixer bowl combine yeast 2 cups of flour and cardamon. Heat milk butter sugar and salt just until warm stirring occasionally to melt butter. Add to dry mixture in bowl; add egg. Beat at low speed with electric mixer for 1 minute scraping sides of bowl. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes. By hand stir in fruits and peel (or extract). Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough that is easy to handle. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic about 8 to 10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from draft until double about 1 3/4 hours.

title: Steak Bake
instructions: Toss steak with flour salt and pepper. Put in casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover. Bake for 40 minutes at 400\u00b0. Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Fresh Spinach And Basil Salad
instructions: Toss spinach and basil together in large bowl. Saute garlic in olive oil over medium heat. (Do not let garlic brown.) Sprinkle salad with vinegar. Pour garlic mixture over salad and toss. Serve salad and add roasted pine nuts individually. Sprinkle with cheese and fresh ground pepper. Serves 6.

title: Sweet Tater Casserole
instructions: Mash sweet taters; stir in 1/2 cup of brown sugar. Beat egg and add milk and orange juice. Stir in sweet tater; mix gradually and add cinnamon. Put in casserole; dot butter. Sprinkle the remaining brown sugar and top with nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch or 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan. Mix sugar bananas oil and eggs in a large bowl with wooden spoon. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour in pan. Bake until a wooden toothpick comes out clean when inserted about 60 to 70 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes 1 loaf.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Mix with heavy mixer the oleo flour sugar and butter flavoring. Roll teaspoonful size balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; press center with thumbprint. Spoon tiny amount of colored jellies or pecan halves in the center. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. They are not brown. They get a golden color and brown on the bottom. Makes 100 cookies.

title: Banana Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water; boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Add lemon juice to bananas; add pineapple juice. Mix well with sugar mixture. Freeze. Mash until mushy; add carbonated water just before serving.

title: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix and pineapple with juice in a large bowl. Beat with mixer until well blended. Pour batter into an ungreased tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes until cake springs back when lightly touched. Invert and cool before removing from pan.

title: Recipe For A Happy Marriage
instructions: For extra flavor add recreation and a dash of happy memories. Stir well and remove any specks of jealousy temper and criticism. If you like a sweeter product add generous portion of love. Keep warm with a steady flame of devotion. Never serve with cold shoulder or hot tongue. Add to this recipe the presence and love of God and you will have quite a home.

title: Dyno-Mite Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed; add coconut flavoring and 1/2 bag of coconut. Bake as directed until done (takes longer because of coconut). Add water to evaporated milk to make 2 cups and add sugar. Punch holes in cake as soon as it is done and pour milk/sugar over cake while still hot. Refrigerate until ready to serve. When ready to serve spread crushed pineapple and juice on top Cool Whip and finally rest of coconut. Keep refrigerated.

title: New England Yam Bake
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving 1/4 cup syrup. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with pineapple. Arrange yams in dish. Pour reserved syrup over yams. Sprinkle nuts over yams. Combine dry ingredients and cut in margarine until a coarse texture. Top yams with dry mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with marshmallows and brown lightly. Yields 6 to 8.

title: Ham Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup corn flakes and almonds. Put in buttered casserole. Pour soup over all then top with corn flakes and almonds. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 min.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix and bring to boil first 4 ingredients. Add to above mixture remaining ingredients. Grease large casserole dish with melted butter. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Tang Fruit Salad
instructions: Cook vanilla pudding in 2 cups of the drained fruit juice. If not enough for 2 cups add a little water. Add the Tang to cooking pudding. When pudding is cool add the fruit and chill in the refrigerator.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt soda baking powder and cocoa. Mix butter and Coke and bring to boil. Pour over dry mixture. Add buttermilk eggs and marshmallows. This will be a thin batter. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 60 minutes.

title: One-Pot Spaghetti
instructions: Crumble ground beef into a Dutch oven. Cook and stir over medium-high heat about 10 minutes or until brown. Pour into strainer to drain off any fat. Put beef back into Dutch oven. Wash and chop onion and stir into ground beef. Add tomato sauce spaghetti sauce salt water and spaghetti. Heat about 15 minutes or until the spaghetti is tender. Remove from heat and stir. Sprinkle just before serving with Parmesan cheese.

title: Skillet Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in large skillet. Beat eggs and sugar together and add to butter. Add dates. Stir constantly and over very low heat for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add cereal nuts and vanilla. Put mixture in a bowl and cool . Make into balls about the size of a quarter and roll in flaked coconut.

title: Griddle Cakes(Pancakes)
instructions: Combine well-beaten egg milk and melted shortening. Add liquid ingredients to the dry stirring only until smooth. Do not overmix; the batter will/should look slightly lumpy. Stir by hand. Bake on hot griddle wiped generously with shortening/oil.

title: Popcorn Crunch
instructions: In medium saucepan melt vanilla-flavored candy coating over low heat stirring constantly. In a very large bowl combine popped popcorn candy-coated chocolate or peanut butter-flavored pieces and raisins. Pour warm melted coating over popcorn mixture tossing to coat. Spread onto a greased cookie sheet. Cool thoroughly. Break apart.

title: Asparagus Souffle
instructions: Mix everything together except butter. Pour into greased loaf size pan. Add cracker or bread crumbs to top and dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt shortening and chocolate. Add sugar and blend. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well!! Add flour and salt. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in a greased pan 30 minutes.

title: Pecan Logs
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Gradually knead enough powdered sugar into mixture until consistency is stiff. Divide mixture into 8 (6-inch) logs. Wrap each log and freeze for 1 hour. Combine caramels and milk in saucepan; cook over medium heat stirring often until mixture is smooth. Dip logs into caramel mixture and roll in pecans. Wrap in plastic wrap. Store in refrigerator or freezer up to 1 month. Cut into 1/4-inch slices to serve.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream oil and sugar. Add eggs. Blend. Mix pumpkin water and flour. Add vanilla. Add to mixture. Mix and add soda salt baking powder spices and nuts. Bake in loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 75 minutes or small loaves 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Stuffed Green Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops of green peppers and clean inside. Mix rice tomato sauce ground beef salt and pepper and Accent. Fill peppers with mixture. Put in large pot. Pour can of tomatoes and 1 can of water over peppers. Cook over medium heat for 1 hour.

title: Puff Pizza
instructions: Cook meat with onions until done. Mix sauce and meat and drop in cut up biscuits and mix well. Add cheese. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Put pepperoni on top; sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Macaroni Salad
instructions: Combine macaroni and vegetables. Mix mayonnaise vinegar sugar and salt. Pour over salad and mix well. Chill before serving.

title: Mexican Salad
instructions: Blend the avocados lemon juice salt and pepper. Set aside. Mix the mayonnaise sour\tcream and taco mix. Layer bean dip on bottom of pan; continue to layer avocado mix sour cream mixture onions tomatoes olives and Cheddar cheese. Chill and serve. Serve with nacho chips optional.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
instructions: Grease bottoms of 2 (8 x 4 x 2-inch) loaf pans. Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips and walnuts. Blend well on medium speed. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Pour into pans. Bake in center of oven for 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Lima Beans In Tomato And Garlic Sauce
instructions: Put the lima beans in a large pot with about 2 quarts of water and some salt. Bring the water to a boil then reduce the heat and simmer the beans until they are tender but dont let them get mushy. Drain them and save the broth to use in a soup its delicious.

title: Shrimp Victoria
instructions: Saute shrimp and onion in butter for 8 minutes. Add mushrooms; cook 5 minutes. Sprinkle in flour salt and pepper. Stir in sour cream; cook gently for 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Stir-Fry Tofu And Veggies
instructions: Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes. In wok or skillet bring soy sauce garlic ginger and wine to a boil. Add tofu cubes cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove tofu and remaining broth from wok or skillet. Heat oil in wok and stir-fry vegetables over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Add remaining broth tofu and cashews or almonds. Heat and serve.

title: Best Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef bell pepper celery onion salt and pepper. Then add cracker crumbs. Mix milk eggs and 1 can tomato sauce in a bowl and then pour into the meat mixture. Take half grated cheese and mix with meat. Form loaf with meat mixture. Pour remaining can of tomato sauce on top of loaf when the loaf is well done. Sprinkle remaining grated cheese on top of loaf. Remove from oven when cheese is melted.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Bake shell. Heat milk and margarine to boiling. Combine brown sugar flour egg yolks and vanilla. Mix with small amount of warm milk. Continue to cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick. Pour in shell. Mix egg whites with sugar 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar and salt to make meringue.

title: Italian Meat Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. In a large nonstick skillet brown the beef over medium heat and drain well. Add the onion bell pepper and garlic and cook stirring 5 minutes. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water and add to the skillet along with the tomato paste and all the seasonings. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle half of the Parmesan cheese over the bottom of the pie shell. Cover with half of the meat mixture then half of the Mozzarella. Layer with the remaining meat and the Parmesan cheese. Bake on a cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the Mozzarella and return to oven until the cheese melts about 5 more minutes. Makes 6 servings. Fat 16 g.

title: Barbecued Chicken Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. In a small bowl combine chicken and barbecue sauce; mix well. Place bread shell on ungreased pizza pan. Spread chicken mixture over shell. Arrange tomatoes over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese and dried basil. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bread shell is browned. If you would like sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Reserve a few pieces of olives and celery for garnishing the top of casserole. Brown turkey or ground beef and celery in nonstick skillet. Do not drain grease. Pour in taco seasoning olives and mushrooms. Heat until seasoning is dissolved.

title: Heavenly Carrots
instructions: Boil carrots until crisp-tender in salted water. Place cooked carrots peppers and onion in layers and cover with sauce which is made by blending well the remaining ingredients.

title: Vanilla No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Stir the margarine and sugar over medium-high heat until full boil is reached; boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add the oats coconut and vanilla chips. Also add the vanilla and food coloring as desired. Quickly drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper to cool. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

title: Pico
instructions: Dice tomatoes onions and jalapenos. Mix together. Pick the cilantro leaves from stems. Chop leaves. Use about 1/4 cup cilantro. Mix all together. Squeeze juice from lime. Add salt to taste. Refrigerate for a few hours before eating.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Cook sugar milk butter and salt until ball is formed. Then beat in dates and nuts. Pour onto sheet of wax paper. Roll into log form. May need to use towel to protect hands from heat. Slice after cooled.

title: Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and chips. Lightly pile in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese and chips. Cook at 400\u00b0 about 25 minutes. If you add more chicken add more celery.

title: Oreo Balls
instructions: Mix together Oreos and cream cheese until you have a large ball. Make tiny balls (dime size). Cool in refrigerator. Dip into melted almond bark and sprinkle with festive sprinkles before balls dry.

title: Dill Dip (Served In Pumpernickel Loaf)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. This needs to sit in refrigerator for at least 3 hours (preferably overnight). Take a 2 pound round loaf of pumpernickel bread and hull out the center of the loaf. Cut this center portion of the loaf into bite size cubes and place around the loaf. Now fill the loaf with the dill dip. Use bread cubes to dip. I usually buy an extra 1 pound loaf to cube ahead of time and place in a Ziploc bag. This will serve a large crowd. Garnish with a sprig of fresh dill.

title: Salmon Croquettes
instructions: Mix salmon. Add egg cracker crumbs salt pepper and onion. Make into patties and fry slowly until brown. Use only enough grease to keep from sticking.

title: Italian Pizzilla
instructions: Mix melted butter oil and sugar. Beat eggs and add to mixture. Add vanilla. Then fold in flour. Mix well.

title: Party Punch Recipe
instructions: Before serving add the ginger ale. Serve.

title: Pizza Dough
instructions: Mix together and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 20 to 30 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Saute sausage or bacon; drain well. Crumble sausage or bacon. Beat eggs with milk salt and mustard. Place bread cubes in the bottom of a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish then sausage or bacon then cheese. Pour egg mixture over all; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Drop by scoops into hot oil.

title: Easy Wings
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and pour over the wings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Penuche
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk and cook stirring only until sugar is dissolved and a little dropped in cold water forms a soft ball (238\u00b0). Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm then beat until mixture begins to hold its shape. Stir in walnuts and turn into greased pan about 3/4-inch thick. Cut into squares when firm.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Put into prepared graham cracker crust. Chill until firm.

title: Rivel Rice Potato Soup
instructions: Cook beef until soft; add diced raw potatoes rice and rivels.

title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
instructions: Defrost hash browns. Melt 1 stick of butter. Mix together hash browns butter soup sour cream and cheese. Spread evenly in 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Melt 1/2 stick of butter. Add to the cornflakes and stir until cornflakes are coated with butter. Top potatoes with cornflakes. Bake at 375\u00b0 for about 40 to 45 minutes. These can be made the night before and kept in the refrigerator.

title: Fish Stew For 35
instructions: Fry bacon crisp; save grease. Crumble bacon. Pour drippings in bottom of pot. Place layers of potatoes onion and fish. Spread bacon unevenly over layers. Add salt and pepper. Place layers in this order until youve used them. Pour 2 cans of tomato juice over ingredients. Add water. Cook over medium heat for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. The last hour lower heat. The last 10 minutes of cooking break eggs one at a time in top of stew pot. At no time stir this stew.

title: Apple Pie In A Jar
instructions: Cook syrup until thick and bubbly and add lemon juice.

title: Scallops
instructions: Toss scallops in mixture. Broil 2 1/2 to 4 minutes. This can also be microwaved.

title: Unbaked Cookies
instructions: Combine margarine sugar cocoa and milk in large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a rolling boil. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until well melted. Add uncooked oatmeal and stir mixing well. Drop from teaspoon on waxed paper. Let cool. Enjoy!

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Spread pineapple in small ungreased cake pan; spread pie filling over pineapple. Sprinkle cake mix over cherry filling. Sprinkle oats and pecans over cake mix. Pour butter evenly over top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

title: Rolls
instructions: Mix. Roll 1/4 inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter. Let raise 20 minutes. Butter and shape; let rise again. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pralines
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Lightly spray a cookie sheet with vegetable oil spray. In a large mixing bowl cream the margarine with the sugar. Add egg and vanilla; beat. Add flour and mix well. Mix in nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on prepared cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven and allow to cool on a rack. This recipe has 4 grams of fat and 3 milligrams of sodium.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Bring the brown sugar Spry and butter to a boil. Remove from stove. Add the milk. Bring to a boil and boil exactly 3 minutes. Remove from stove and add the 10x sugar. Mix with beaters until smooth. Put on cake.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and Crisco together. Add sugar one cup at a time beating after each addition. Add eggs one at a time. Add other ingredients and bake in tube or Bundt pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Brown flour in margarine. Add onions smoked sausage and garlic. Saute until onions soften. Add chicken. Cover and let steam but stir often. Add water bay leaf salt and pepper. Let cook until chicken is done. Turn off burner and add one pinch file.

title: Homestyle Chicken And Biscuit Dumplings
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shake flour in cooking bag (14 x 20-inch). Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add gravy mix garlic powder and water. Squeeze bag to blend ingredients. Place carrots and celery in bag in even layer. Sprinkle chicken with seasonings. Place on top of vegetables. Arrange biscuits around chicken. Close bag with nylon tie. Cut slits on top. Bake until chicken is tender about 1 hour.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: In covered saucepan cook carrots onion and celery in butter over low heat until tender. Stir in flour. Add broth and salt. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in milk and cheese and cook until cheese melts and soup is heated through. Do not boil. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Orange Cottage Cheese Salad
instructions: Mix dry jello into cottage cheese. Add the rest of the ingredients. Mix ans chill.

title: Shrimp Creole With Rice Or Pasta
instructions: Cook shrimp; set aside. In large skillet saute onions and garlic in oil for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes pepper sugar and broth; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add basil and pepper; cook 5 minutes. Combine cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water; stir into sauce and cook until thick. Add shrimp parsley and green onion. Serve over rice or pasta. Serves 4.

title: Pumpernickel Bread Dip
instructions: Hollow out one loaf of bread and cut the second loaf into squares. Mix the remaining ingredients together. Place mixture into hollowed loaf. Refrigerate 4 hours before serving. Dip bread squares into mixture.

title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
instructions: Cook first four ingredients to a boil for 1 minute and set aside. Mix pudding and 3 cups milk; fold in Cool Whip. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan layer graham crackers. Pour one half of the custard then line another layer of graham crackers. Top with the last of the custard and a third layer of crackers. Cover this with the icing that was made from the first four ingredients. (Takes almost a box of graham crackers.)

title: Wild Rice With Olives
instructions: Saute both rices in the 1/4 cup oleo until slightly brown. Chop and saute in 1/4 cup olive oil the onion green onions and bell pepper. Add sauteed greens to browned rice. Add the chicken broth olives olive juice sliced water chestnuts and mushrooms to the rice mixture. Mix all together and bake covered with foil at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan or a 3-quart oblong Pyrex baking dish.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Place a layer of bread then a layer of chicken. Alternate layers. Beat eggs milk and broth. Add salt and pepper. Pour over mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix the sugar and pineapple juice in bowl and cut bananas first then other fruit; add. Refrigerate until chilled. Serve in fruit cups or on lettuce leaves. Top with teaspoon of mayonnaise.

title: Japanese Pie
instructions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Chocolate Chess Pie
instructions: Mix altogether and pour into 9-inch unbaked pie crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until set.

title: Peach Puff Pie
instructions: Cream butter with half the sugar. Add beaten eggs gradually and lemon rind. Add flour salt and baking powder alternately with milk. Line a pie plate with pastry. Put peaches into it with remaining sugar then spread batter over all and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes; then 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Canned peaches can be used.

title: Wassail (Christmas Drink)
instructions: Mix together and simmer for 30 minutes. Makes a delicious holiday drink \here we go a wassailing.\

title: Jarrett Anderson Tartar'S Salad
instructions: Mix container of Cool Whip with crushed pineapple and box of vanilla pudding. Add colored marshmallows maraschino cherries cut up in small pieces. Sprinkle nuts on top. Use whatever amount desired of last three ingredients.

title: Cranberry Buttermilk Scones
instructions: In a bowl combine the flour 1/3 cup sugar baking powder salt and baking soda; cut in butter. Stir in the buttermilk just until combined. Fold in the cranberries and orange peel. Turn onto a floured surface. Divide dough in half. Shape each portion into a ball and pat into a 6 inch circle. Cut each circle into six wedges. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and brush with milk. Combine the cinnamon and remaining sugar; sprinkle over scones. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients and put in ice cream freezer and churn.

title: Lazy Man'S Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Mix ketchup and Coke in skillet. Heat until ketchup is dissolved. Add chicken and cover. Cook over low to medium heat until chicken is done 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Dilled Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water until crisp (4 to 5 minutes). Drain well and cool. Combine remaining ingredients with broccoli stirring gently. Chill covered at least 3 hours. Serve with sliced eggs and chopped olives as garnish.

title: Macaroni And Ham Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in the boiling water. Add the 1 cup mayonnaise and mix together thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and place in a salad mold. Let stand in refrigerator until use. Serves 8.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; add rest of ingredients. Cover and simmer at least one hour.

title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
instructions: Spray a medium baking dish with Pam. Place bite size pieces of chicken in bottom of dish. Mix soup and 1 1/2 cups of broth from cooked chicken; pour over chicken. Make a batter of 1 stick margarine (melted) 1 cup flour 1 cup buttermilk and black pepper; pour over top of chicken. Bake at 425\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Onion Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Add cream cheese stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water add to cream cheese mixture. Heat thoroughly. Yields six (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together well. Add vinegar cloves catsup oil salt vanilla and beet juice. Mix well and cook until thick. Add beets and heat thoroughly.

title: California Blend Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables until almost tender. Put in buttered casserole dish. Cut cheese in chunks and mix with vegetables. Melt butter and add crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle on top of vegetables. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is bubbly.

title: Souffle Sandwich(Chicago Recipe)
instructions: Cut crusts and butter the bread. Place 8 slices butter side down in large flat pan. Cover the bread with filling. Cover filling with cheese. Place remaining 8 slices of bread on top of cheese butter side up. Beat together remaining ingredients and pour over sandwiches. Place in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Top with hot undiluted mushroom soup when serving. Serves 8.

title: Cheese Hash Browns
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in ungreased baking pan. Sprinkle cornflake crumbs on top; drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Mix all ingredients together. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into loaf pans. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecued Steak
instructions: Combine all ingredients except steak in saucepan. Bring to a boil then simmer gently 5 minutes. Pound round steak. Cut into serving size pieces. Place in a roasting pan or casserole dish. Pour hot sauce over meat. Cover tightly and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Shrimp Jello Mold(Serves At Least 12)
instructions: Turn blender to liquify until everything is well blended. Boil 4 1/2 cups water. Add 3 large packages lemon jello. When blended add part to blender. Liquify. Pour extra jello and contents in blender into large pan where first vegetables and shrimp are. Mix very well. Chill overnight. Serve with dab of salad dressing and crackers.

title: Delightfully Chinese Salad
instructions: Combine all vegetables. Toss lightly. (Best served with \Darlenes Delight\ salad oil dressing!)

title: Soft-Shell Tacos
instructions: Cook hamburger in skillet until lightly brown. Add taco seasoning with small amount of water. Simmer until water is gone; stir occasionally. Take up into bowl. Chop or shred onion tomatoes and lettuce; place in separate small bowls. May also serve with sour cream and taco sauce.

title: Taboulah
instructions: Soak the bulgur in lemon juice for 1/2 an hour. Chop all the first 4 ingredients very fine. Mix all together. Add olive oil salt and pepper to taste. Serve with romaine lettuce!

title: Cissy'S Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes (enough to fill approximately a 2-quart casserole dish). Partially boil potatoes and drain. Let cool.

title: Incredible Crab
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and heat over a double boiler or in the microwave until all the cheese is melted and mixture is hot (not boiling). Pour into a chafing dish and serve hot with crackers. A great dish for parties!

title: Congealed Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pistachio pudding and pineapple; add Cool Whip cherries and marshmallows. Put in freezer to firm. Take out a little while before serving.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Slice margarine in several pieces and place on bottom of large casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/2 of stuffing over margarine.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix peanuts sugar salt and syrup in 2-quart microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on High for 4 minutes; remove and stir. Cook 4 minutes; stir. Add butter and vanilla; blend well. Cook 2 more minutes. Mixture should be dark brown. Add soda; stir until light and foamy. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet and spread. Let cool; break apart and eat.

title: Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Cut squash in half lengthwise. Place cut side down in dish in microwave. Microwave on High covered 2 to 3 minutes or cook in boiling water 3 to 4 minutes. Scoop out pulp leaving a quarter-inch shell; set aside. Cook onion in hot oil until tender. Add chopped zucchini and cook 1 minute. Stir in flour basil and pepper. Cook and stir one more minute. Gradually add zucchini to egg stir in Parmesan. Spoon mixture into shells. Bake in square baking dish uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. Makes 4 servings.

title: Peach Angel Food Cake
instructions: In a large bowl combine cake mix peaches and juice (do not add water). Mix well. Pour into tube pan or 2 loaf pans. Bake according to directions on cake package. If desired top with whipped topping. This is a great tasting super easy low fat/calorie dessert.

title: Curried Egg Sauce
instructions: Blend a little White Sauce with the curry powder. Stir curry powder mixture parsley and egg into remaining White Sauce. Good on spinach broccoli and asparagus. Yield 1 1/4 cups.

title: Blondie Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Combine butter and milk in saucepan. Place on low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar; add egg. Stir until blended. Combine flour baking powder and salt. Stir into sugar mixture. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Spread into pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 27 to 30 minutes or until pick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan. Cut in squares.

title: Dashi
instructions: Wipe konbu with dry cloth lightly. Do not wipe off the white powdery substance on the surface which is one element that provides a unique savory flavor.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Coat beef with flour and salt. In large heavy sauce pan or skillet brown beef in oil. Stir in water sauce and seasoning. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add vegetables and simmer until tender about 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Pop Up Rolls
instructions: In a bowl stir together all ingredients until thoroughly combined. Fill greased muffin cups half full. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 18-20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Spray Pam in an ovenproof frying pan. Heat pan until it is medium-hot. Brown pork chops on both sides and remove from pan. Melt margarine in pan. Brown rice over medium-low heat stirring to prevent burning. When brown take off heat. Return pork chops. Add soup and 1/2 can of water. Cover with lid and bake at 350\u00b0 in oven for 45 minutes to an hour. When rice has absorbed the soup it is done.

title: Sugar Gems
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and flavoring. Mix flour soda and salt; add to batter. Mix well and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocados and then add all other ingredients. Place plastic wrap directly on food and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Stir well and serve with chips.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In a large bowl mix first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Layer in casserole dish - beans hamburger meat (cooked with onions) cheese and cornbread mix (Mix cornbread pkg. according to instructions and add corn). Bake for 45 minutes or until done at 350 degrees.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Mix apple cinnamon and sugar on bottom of 8 x 8 dish. Mix rest of ingredients to crumble stage. Crumble over apple. Bake 30 minutes at 400\u00b0 or until apples are tender and top is brown.

title: Onion Pie
instructions: Crush crackers in baking dish; add melted margarine to crackers to make the crust on bottom of dish. Slice onions and saute in frying pan with margarine until white or soft. Pour onions into dish. Mix eggs in milk; pour over onions. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cool Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook whole chicken. Boil until falls easily off the bone. Let cool. Pull chicken meat off bones and place in bowl. Prepare lettuce for salad. Cut up grapes into lettuce. Place cooled chicken into lettuce and grape bowl. Mix in mayonnaise to taste. Season with black pepper. Place in refrigerator and eat when chilled. Easy and refreshing!

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Mix all of the above thoroughly. drop well apart with 2 inch ice cream scoop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees until brown; remove while centers are still chewy.

title: Marble Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine cocoa and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside. Beat 1 cup sugar with 1/2 cup butter; add eggs and vanilla. Alternate dry ingredients with sour cream. Spread 1/2 of batter in 9-inch tube pan. Sprinkle with half of cocoa mixture; repeat. Sprinkle crumb topping over batter. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Grease 9-inch pie plate or 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl until lightly coated with batter. Pour into greased pan and bake until golden brown at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Blend flour shortening and salt. Beat egg and add water and egg to flour mixture. Knead and roll out very thin. Cut into squares and drop in chicken broth.

title: Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Drain green beans pimentos peas and corn. Dice pepper onion and celery. Mix and cook the remaining ingredients. Pour the ingredients over the drained and diced vegetables. Best if left to set overnight in the refrigerator.

title: Soft Pretzels
instructions: Heat oven to 475\u00b0. Dissolve yeast in hot water. Stir in warm water and brown sugar. Slowly add flour. Stir until smooth and dough doesnt stick to sides of bowl. Knead dough on lightly floured surface. (Put flour on your hands.)

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Melt 1 stick margarine; mix with graham cracker crumbs and spread mixture in bottom of an oblong 9 x 13-inch pan for crust. Slice bananas over crust. Whip 2 sticks margarine confectioners sugar and eggs for 15 minutes. This makes sauce. Pour over bananas. Drain the pineapple and spread over sauce. Spread Cool Whip over pineapple. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries.

title: Pytel'S Post Game Pot Of Beans(Feeds 4 Hungry Coaches And Friends)
instructions: Place baked beans in a large kettle. Throw in onion that is chopped barbecue and red hot sauces and heat. Dont worry about heating to a boil thats what the cayenne pepper sauce is in for.

title: White Cake(Fat Free)
instructions: Spray 9-inch square baking pan with cooking spray. In large bowl combine flour cornstarch baking powder and salt. In medium bowl using fork or wire whisk stir sugar and milk until sugar is almost dissolved. Add egg whites corn syrup and vanilla; stir until thoroughly blended. Gradually add to flour mixture stirring until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan or wire rack.

title: Remainder Salad
instructions: Mix gelatin and boiling liquid together then add sherbet. Stir until melted. Add the oranges. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart ring mold. Chill. Unmold and fill center with Ambrosia.

title: Ranch Mashed Potatoes
instructions: In a 3-quart saucepan cover potatoes with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are very tender; drain. Return potatoes to saucepan; mash. Stir in remaining ingredients.

title: One Step Chili
instructions: Combine all ingredients in microwave-safe casserole dish. Cover; microcook on High 5 minutes. Stir to break up meat. Microcook additional 20 minutes stirring every 10 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Place peppercorns on a work surface or cutting board. Cover them with a paper towel and using a rolling pin or mallet crunch the peppercorns into coarse pieces. Press the crushed peppercorns onto both sides of steak.

title: Lazy Gal'S Casserole
instructions: Place cabbage in greased casserole. Brown ground beef with onion and drain. Add salt pepper and garlic powder. Add tomato soup and water. Mix thoroughly and add rice. Mix all and pour over cabbage; mix lightly. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake covered 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Apple Bread
instructions: Sift first 5 ingredients into medium bowl. Cream butter and sugar into large bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each. Add flour mixture and apples 1/2 at a time mixing well after each. Stir in walnuts. Pour into well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until tested done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes then remove to wire rack to completely cool.

title: Three Bean Pizza
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add onion. Add garlic. Add beans salsa and cilantro. Cook 5 minutes. Meanwhile prepare pizza dough. Sprinkle dough with 1/2 grease. Spoon on mixture on top of cheese. Cover with cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Cajun Cabbage(Serves Six.  Preparation Time:  One Hour)
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Saute garlic in bacon fat; add onion and saute. Add bell pepper and continue to saute. Add cabbage and continue sauteing. Add tomatoes and one can of water. Add cayenne pepper and cover. Simmer for one to three hours stirring occasionally. You really cant overcook it. You may use two large onions two bell peppers and two cans of tomatoes instead of a can of water. You can vary this receipt to taste on garlic and cayenne pepper.

title: Double Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter brown sugar and white sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix dry ingredients and add creamed ingredients. Add chocolate chips and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hot Cheesy Almond Spread
instructions: Mix all ingredients except almonds until well blended. Stir in almonds.\tMicrowave on Medium temperature until cheese is melted stirring occasionally. Garnish with almonds and serve with crackers.

title: Blueberry Crisp
instructions: Mix crumbs sugar and butter. Sprinkle 1/3 of mixture in 8-inch square pan and cover with half of the blueberries. Top with half of remaining crumbs then rest of berries and crumbs. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Serve by spooning in individual dessert dish. Top with whipped cream. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Orange Popcorn
instructions: Place popcorn in a 4-quart pan; set aside. In 1-quart bowl place butter and microwave on High power 30 to 60 seconds or until melted. Stir in gelatin and corn syrup. Microwave on High 2 to 3 minutes until mixture comes to a boil stirring once. Mix in soda until well blended. Pour over popcorn. Toss to coat evenly stirring 2 or 3 times. Turn onto wax paper spread out and allow to cool. Break into small pieces. Store in covered container.

title: Sauteed Dandelion Flowers
instructions: Do not wash the dandelion flowers or they will close so it is important that they are clean when picked. Heat the butter in a skillet. Dip each blossom into the beaten eggs then into flour; saute briefly in the butter. Season with salt and pepper. Serve as a vegetable or special side dish. Serves 2.

title: Good Slaw
instructions: Mix to desired consistency.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
instructions: Rinse chicken; pat dry. Place chicken skin side up in lightly oiled baking pan. Pour melted butter over chicken. Sprinkle chicken with salt pepper and ginger. Top with diced celery. Bake chicken at 325\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Drain pineapple juice into a cup. Blend in brown sugar water soy sauce vinegar and cornstarch. Pour mixture over chicken in pan. Continue baking for 45 minutes until chicken is done to your liking. Top with pineapple chunks and sliced red pepper. Makes 4 servings. Good served with buttered rice steamed broccoli string beans and a salad.

title: Christmas Log
instructions: Cut up marshmallows and cherries. Mix raisins marshmallows pecans and cherries together. Warm milk and add to other ingredients. Form a log from mixture. Roll in cracker crumbs. Wrap in wax paper and put in refrigerator until ready to use.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix cranberries and sugar. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Then add nuts and Cool Whip and mix well.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix together everything except chips and vanilla. Then add chips and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Instant Cappuccino
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Store in a tight container. Put 1 heaping spoonful in 1 cup hot water.

title: Conga Bars
instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar; cool slightly. Add eggs one at a time; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients nuts and chocolate chips. Bake in a 10-inch square pan in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool and cut into 2-inch square bars.

title: Apple Crisp Delight
instructions: Cut up apples in baking pan add sugar. Mix together cinnamon butter and flour and pour over apples. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: (Cinnamon) Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all together all ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in a slow oven at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours or crock-pot for 4 to 6 hours.

title: Just Soy Cheese Cake
instructions: Mix together. Pour into shallow baking pan and bake for 20 minutes at 300\u00b0. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut into squares. Can top with cherry strawberry blueberry or raspberry pie mix or one fruit on each square.

title: Lemon Fluff
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; let stand until cold but not thick; add sugar slowly and blend. In large chilled bowl whip milk until light and fluffy. Add jello mixture and beat until well mixed. Add rind and juice of lemon. Roll cracker crumbs and spread 1/2 of them in bottom of drip pan. Pour in jello mixture and sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Refrigerate.

title: Didee Chicken
instructions: Let sauce boil. Salt and pepper fryer (also remove skin). Cut fryer in half. Put into sauce. Cook with lid on for 45 minutes. Remove lid and brown.

title: Pinto Bean Cake
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and egg. Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Stir in beans apples raisins nuts and vanilla (can plump raisins in hot water). Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 or 50 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Good with cream cheese icing powdered sugar white cooked icing or just whipped cream.

title: Tomato Aspic Salad
instructions: Dilute soup with 3/4 can water. Heat to boiling. Pour over gelatin and stir until dissolved thoroughly; cool. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into molds and chill. Serve on lettuce leaf and top with mayonnaise. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Make cake as directed on package and split into 4 layers. Mix coconut sour cream and sugar. Frost cake.

title: Nanny'S Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Prepare unbaked pie shell. Separate eggs (save yolks). Beat egg whites until stiff (set aside). Blend potatoes milk sugar applesauce rum flavoring and at least 1 egg yolk (all 3 if youd like) until smooth; fold in egg whites. Pour 1/2 mixture into pie shell. Sprinkle generously spices over mixture. Pour remainder of mixture into shell. Sprinkle generously spices over top. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350\u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes. Remove when toothpick comes out clean.

title: Corned Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Heat corned beef in pan. Heat enchilada sauce and heat oil. Dip corn tortilla in oil to soften dip in enchilada sauce put on plate and fill with corned beef and roll. Top with cheese. Sprinkle on a few teaspoons enchilada sauce. Top with olives and serve.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Alternate in greased 2-quart baking dish with 8 ounce package cooked noodles. Top with 3/4 cup crumbs or crushed Wheaties. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Oklahoma Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients. Cook in crock-pot about 4 hours on high or in oven at 350\u00b0 until heated thoroughly. Reheat leftovers in microwave.

title: Cranberry Chiffon Pie
instructions: Place gelatin in custard cup. Add cold water and let stand for 2 minutes. Place cup in pan of boiling water until gelatin dissolves. Add to cranberry sauce which has been crushed with fork. Add salt rind and juice; chill mixture begins to set. Beat egg whites until stiff and beat in sugar. Fold in cranberry mixture. Pour filling into baked shell and chill until firm. Top with whipped cream if desired.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix mashed berries sugar salt and cornstarch. Add water lemon juice and coloring. Cook stirring constantly until clear and thick. Cool. Arrange berries in pie crust. Pour cooked mixture over berries. Refrigerate. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Combine cream cheese eggs and 2 cups sugar; mix. Add vanilla lemon juice and sour cream; mix well (no lumps). The heavy cream is most important. You must whip heavy cream until fluffy then fold into cream cheese. Mix slowly until well blended. Set aside.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate.

title: Mom'S Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In iron skillet saute first 3 ingredients. Add meat and cook for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Cajun Salt
instructions: Mix well and keep in airtight container. Do keep a shaker bottle of this on stove. Use sparingly on all your favorite meats.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Mix mashed potatoes cream cheese salt and Cheez Whiz in bowl. Saute onion in butter until brown.

title: Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Butter sides of heavy 2-quart pan. Combine sugar and milk. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves and mixtures boil. Cook to soft boil stage (234\u00b0). Remove from heat. Add Marshmallow Creme chocolate chips and vanilla. Stir. Pour into square cake pan.

title: Martha Washington Balls
instructions: Melt chocolate and wax in double boiler. Dip balls in chocolate using toothpicks and let dry. Freezes well.

title: Ice Cream Sandwich
instructions: Mix crushed Oreo cookies with margarine (save a little for topping). Place into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Put ice cream on top of cookies. Soften a little then add chocolate topping. Then Cool Whip on top. Sprinkle with remaining crushed Oreos. Freeze. (Let ice cream soften a little before spreading.)

title: Goblin'S Delight Cupcakes
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar egg salt orange peel and food color in a small mixer bowl; beat until smooth. Add Hersheys chocolate chips; set aside.

title: Hamburg Barbecue
instructions: Brown meat with celery onion and green pepper. Drain grease and add rest of ingredients. Simmer for a few minutes; serve on rolls.

title: Coconut Cream Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed on box. Poke holes in warm cake with a fork. Mix Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut together. Pour over cake. Top with Cool Whip and flaked coconut.

title: Play Dough(Do Not Eat This!)
instructions: Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until a ball forms. Remove from pan; cool slightly and knead. Store in airtight plastic containers or in plastic bags.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in a buttered casserole. Blend together sugar butter and flour. Cover apples with water and cinnamon. Now add sugar mixture (just sprinkle over apples). Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pork Chops Braised In White Wine
instructions: Combine sage rosemary garlic salt and pepper. Press mixture on both sides of chops. Melt butter and add oil to 10 to 12-inch skillet using moderate heat. Add chops and brown for 2 minutes on each side. Remove from pan. Pour off excess fat leaving a light film of fat in pan. Add 1/2 cup wine. Bring to a boil. Return chops to pan. Cover and reduce heat; simmer 25 to 30 minutes basting with pan juices. Transfer chops to heated platter. Pour rest of wine into skillet and boil to reduce slightly. Pour over chops. Serves 4.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Combine sugar flour soda salt nutmeg allspice cloves and cinnamon in large bowl. Mix eggs pumpkin oil and water; combine with dry ingredients. Beat well until mixed. Fold in pecans and raisins. Bake in large greased pan.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice in rice cooker. Cut bacon in pieces and fry. When bacon is almost done put in sliced green onions. Add cooked rice. Fry on high. Move rice to the sides. Fry an egg in the middle. Mix with rice. Add soy sauce to your desired taste.

title: Buttery Cinnamon Skillet Apples
instructions: In 10-inch skillet melt butter over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in sugar and cornstarch. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over medium heat spooning sauce over apples occasionally until apples are fork-tender and sauce is thickened (12 to 15 minutes).

title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
instructions: Remove 1 cup of dry cake mix and set aside for topping. Add egg and melted butter to the rest of the cake mix and mix well. Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Set aside.

title: Tea Balls
instructions: Cream margarine; add sugar. Gradually add flour and salt. Mix well. Work in vanilla and nuts. Chill dough. Form 1-inch balls. Place on greased cookie sheets and bake at 370\u00b0 for 14 to 17 minutes. While warm roll in sugar. Repeat when cold.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake Cookies
instructions: Knead together eggs sugar and margarine. Sift flour and mix with egg mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. (I shape them in little balls.) Bake at 275\u00b0 for 25 to 28 minutes. \Do not overbake.\ Best after 2 to 3 weeks. Bake in advance for Christmas!

title: Coconut Delight
instructions: Layer 1 Mix together 1 cup chopped pecans flour and margarine. Spread into 9X13 inch dish. Bake at 250 degrees for 35 minutes. Cool.

title: Strawberry Salad
instructions: Mix Jell-O with 1 cup boiling water. Add strawberries bananas pineapple and pecans. Divide into half. Refrigerate 1/2 of mixture until jelled. Remove from refrigerator. Top with sour cream. Pour 1/2 remaining mixture over sour cream. Refrigerate until jelled.

title: Golden Nugget Meatballs
instructions: Combine ground beef bread crumbs green pepper dry mustard garlic salt salt pepper egg and catsup; shape into 16 balls (3 to 4 tablespoons per ball). Place a cheese cube in center shaping meat around. Brown in lard; pour off drippings. Add tomato sauce cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes. Remove cover and continue simmering 5 to 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened.

title: Bernice'S Beautiful Black Cake
instructions: Put in saucepan the oleo water cocoa and Wesson oil. Bring to a boil. Cool. In mixing bowl add sugar flour and salt. Pour the cool mixture over dry ingredients and mix well. Add buttermilk soda cinnamon beaten eggs and vanilla. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. When you remove from oven have the icing ready.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Beat milk peanut butter egg and vanilla. Add biscuit baking mix; mix well. Chill at least 1 hour. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. At this point you can flatten with a fork and bake or leave and bake as is and insert kisses after they come out. Bake 6 to 8 minutes. If you leave in ball form press candy kiss into ball immediately after baking.

title: Coconut-Caramel No-Bake Cookies
instructions: Mix butter milk sugar and salt. Cook 3 to 5 minutes (on low) stirring. Remove. Add caramels. Return to heat until melted. Add vanilla. Add coconut and oatmeal. Mix well. Drop by tablespoons. Refrigerate until set. (Makes 4 1/2 dozen.)

title: Ham Salad Sandwich
instructions: Use amounts of each ingredient as desired. Grind pork roll and pickles. Add grated cheese. Add enough salad dressing for desired consistency. Spread between 2 pieces of bread. Wrap in aluminum foil and heat in oven.

title: Wilted Salad
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite-size pieces. Chop onion and toss together with lettuce. Meanwhile cook bacon until crisp. Remove from pan. Drain on paper towel. Mix 1/2 cup vegetable oil with bacon drippings left in pan. Add vinegar. Heat and pour over lettuce and onion. Serve immediately.

title: Raw Apple - Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream eggs sugar oil and vanilla. Then mix in other ingredients except apples and nuts. Add apples and nuts to mixture which will be very stiff. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased and floured. Bake for 50 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool and ice with frosting.

title: Microwave Cracker Snacks
instructions: Microwave butter until melted. Add the celery salt onion salt garlic salt and paprika to the melted butter and mix thoroughly. Add cheese and crackers and stir around until crackers are coated thoroughly. Microwave for 2 minutes stir well until butter mixture is absorbed by crackers. Stores well in an airtight container.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Toast sesame seeds by swirling in a nonstick skillet until they smell nutty.

title: Grilled Herb Chicken Salad
instructions: Rinse and pat chicken breasts dry cut the chicken into chunks. Spray a medium skillet with vegetable spray. Over medium-high heat place chicken in skillet and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Cook until chicken is no longer pink. In a large bowl place romaine lettuce olives and red onion. In a small bowl or pitcher mix dijon mustard white wine vinegar Worcestershire sauce salt pepper and olive oil. Pour mixture over salad and toss well. Place tomato quarters around the inside edge of bowl. Serve immediately. Serves 4 as a meal or 6 as a side salad.

title: Green Tomato Dippers
instructions: Using a paring knife trim vine cores from tomatoes. Slice in rounds 1/4-inch thickness. Place in a large mixing bowl. Add dressing salt pepper and garlic powder. With a wooden spoon toss lightly to cover each slice evenly. Chill 30 minutes. Mix cornmeal and flour in a shallow dish. Place vegetable oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Pour tomatoes in a strainer; rinse lightly with warm water and allow to drain. Coat each slice of tomato in cornmeal-flour mixture.

title: Avocado And Crab Filling
instructions: If using frozen crabmeat thaw and drain. In a medium bowl use 2 forks to flake crabmeat. Stir in smashed avocado lemon juice chives yogurt chili powder and salt. Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture into toast shells or crackers.

title: Brownies
instructions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased dish and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: No Crust Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients except whipped cream in blender.Blend at medium speed until well mixed. Pour into greased (or Pam sprayed) 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be served warm or cool with a dollop of Cool Whip or plain.

title: Taco Soup
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Put all ingredients in a large pot. Cook on low covered for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with Mexican finely shredded cheese and Santitos tortillas chips.

title: Fantabulous Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix well and press thinly in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Let cool.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Fry bacon; add onions green pepper celery and parsley. Cook until vegetables are soft. Add flour and stir until slightly brown. Add tomatoes salt and chili powder. Cook slowly until thick. Add rice and shrimp. Heat for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Applesauce Custard
instructions: Heat applesauce; add yolks sugar salt flour vanilla and butter. Beat egg\twhites\tuntil stiff; put on top and brown lightly.

title: Witches' Hats
instructions: Attach chocolate kiss to chocolate bottom of each cookie with decorating icing. Pipe decorating icing around base of chocolate kiss. Makes 32 witches hats.

title: Crunchy Oven-Fried Fish
instructions: Thaw fish if frozen and cut into serving size pieces. Combine flour salt and lemon-pepper in a shallow dish. Set aside. Beat egg white in a bowl until frothy. Combine bred crumbs cornmeal lemon peel and basil. Dip top of fish fillets into flour mixture shaking off any excess. Dip into egg white. Coat with bread crumb mixture. Spray an unheated shallow baking pan with nonstick coating. Place fillets in baking pan coating side up tucking under any thin edges of fish. Bake in a 450\u00b0 oven for 6 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Shoo-Fly Cupcakes
instructions: Mix flour sugar margarine and salt. Take out 1 cup for crumbs for top. Add molasses water and soda (mix liquid with soda and combine with dry ingredients). Put in cupcake papers and top with crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 20 cupcakes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs sugar oil and vanilla together and add shredded zucchini.

title: Hot Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Cream the stick of margarine with the Old English cheese. Add salt red pepper and flour gradually. When smooth drop in small balls on greased cookie sheet. Place in refrigerator or freezer for at least 3 hours or overnight. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven until slightly browned about 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Veggie Dip
instructions: Blend all together until smooth. Serve with a big bowl or tray of veggies whatevers handy or in season.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: In a 2-quart casserole combine pork and beans onion green pepper brown sugar barbecue sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Top with bacon. Bake uncovered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
instructions: This recipe is for two 9-inch pies. Mix dry ingredients; add to sour cream in double boiler and cook. Add small amount of hot mixture to beaten egg yolks and blend. Add eggs to hot mixture and cook 10 minutes or until thick. Add vanilla and raisins. Fill baked shells. Top with meringue and bake until meringue turns a pretty tan.

title: Googie'S Banana Bread(Yield: 2 Loaves)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Chili
instructions: In Dutch oven or kettle brown beef. Drain well. Add onion celery garlic and green pepper. Cook until soft. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer covered 2 hours. Correct seasoning to taste. Simmer covered 1 more hour. Makes about 5 quarts.

title: Busy Day Casserole
instructions: Cook ground beef and green pepper in oil until done. Add the rest of the ingredients mix well. Pour into greased 2-quart casserole cover and bake in 350` oven for 45 minutes.

title: Pineapple Surprise Dessert
instructions: Cream together the sugar and butter. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each one. Add the pineapple. Add the pecans. Roll the graham crackers very fine. Sprinkle half in bottom of 2 pans each 8 x 8-inch. Spread mixture over the crumbs. Sprinkle rest of graham cracker crumbs on top. Store in the refrigerator overnight (not in the freezer). Serves 8 to 10 nicely.

title: Tuna Burgers
instructions: Mix all. Form patties. Fry. Serve with lettuce and tomato on toasted buns.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large pan and boil for 2 hours.

title: Swedish Minted Meringue Trees
instructions: Grease cookie sheet. Dust with flour. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar and salt until foamy white and double in volume. Beat in sugar until it dissolves completely and meringue stands in firm peaks. Stir in peppermint extract and food coloring. Form into tiny tree shapes. Sprinkle with decorating candies. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Yield 3 dozen.

title: Cocktail Smokies
instructions: Melt jelly and mustard together over low heat. Boil Little Smokies in water a few seconds; drain and add to jelly mix. Slowly let come to a boil. Cool and refrigerate until time to serve. Heat again and keep warm in fondue pot or chafing dish. (Best if made one or two days ahead of time.)

title: Millionaire Pie
instructions: Mix together and place in pie shells. Refrigerate.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Cook hamburger until brown. Drain fat. Add Cheez Whiz and let it melt over hamburger. Add the taco seasoning mix by stirring all the ingredients together. Serve with nacho chips or tortilla chips.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients except raisins together. Add raisins. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350\u00b0. Chopped walnuts may be added if desired.

title: Cranberry Mousse
instructions: In a saucepan heat cranberry juice cocktail to boiling. Remove from heat. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. In a bowl beat cranberry sauce with electric mixer on high speed for 1 minute. Stir into gelatin mixture. Chill in refrigerator until thickened (about 2 hours). Fold in whipped topping until mixture is thoroughly blended. Spoon into dessert dishes or 9-inch prepared pie shell or graham cracker crust. Chill until firm at least 2 or 3 hours or overnight. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Strawberry Bread
instructions: Mix oil and dry ingredients eggs and berries. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Broccoli And Egg Au Gratin
instructions: Trim off large leaves and tough ends of broccoli. Wash and separate into spears. Cook in a small amount of boiling water for 10 minutes or until tender. Arrange spears in a greased 2-quart baking dish. Top with eggs and cheese. Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan over low heat; add flour stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour sauce over broccoli mixture. Melt margarine in saucepan and stir in breadcrumbs. Brown lightly and sprinkle over sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Zucchini Pilaf
instructions: Saute zucchini in the oil and garlic. Remove from the pan. Add the rice and brown in butter. Place the rice in a saucepan. Add the soup stock and white wine. Bring to a boil without the lid. Add salt. Place the zucchini on the top of the rice. Do not stir. Cover and simmer until rice is tender about 20 minutes. Add the cheese when serving.

title: Midwest Bacon And Cheese
instructions: Makes enough canape spread for 24 Melba toast rounds or dry crisp crackers.

title: Pineapple-Strawberry Salad
instructions: Bring pineapple to boiling point. Add and dissolve Jell-O. Let cool. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Add cottage cheese pecans and strawberries. Refrigerate and congeal.

title: Little Cheesecakes
instructions: Place cupcake papers in muffin tins. Place a vanilla wafer in each paper. Mix all the other ingredients together except pie filling. Pour into each cupcake paper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. You can use any kind of pie filling to top cake after they are cooled.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Boil peeled and sliced carrots in salted water until soft; drain. Mix cheese and butter with cooked carrots. Pour in baking dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake at 300\u00b0 until brown. Its a lot better than it sounds.

title: Corned Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles. Cut corned beef and cheese into cubes. Layer in a greased casserole (save some cheese for top). Pour soup-milk mix over and add more cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix and pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 until brown about 30 minutes.

title: Chew Cakes
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time mix well after each. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: In large skillet or slow-cooking pot with browning unit cook beef and onion until meat loses its red color. Pour off excess fat. In slow-cooking pot combine beef and onion with tomato sauce wine oregano garlic salt basil salt and pepper. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours.* Pour into greased shallow baking dish. In the meantime cook whole zucchini in a regular pan of boiling salted water about 15 minutes or until barely tender. Cut lengthwise in halves and arrange cut side up on top of meat mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven 30 to 45 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

title: Baked Onion Soup
instructions: Saute onions in butter and oil in covered saucepan for 5 minutes. Add sugar and salt; cook over moderate heat until onions are transparent. Add flour and stir for 3 minutes. Raise heat and add broth and wine. Season and simmer partly covered for 45 minutes.

title: Aunt Gayle'S Fruit Pizza
instructions: Cover a 14-inch pizza pan with foil. Slice cookies and place overlapping on pizza pan. Freezing cookie dough will make it easier to slice. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Let cool completely. Remove foil.

title: Palacinka
instructions: Add more flour; sift it in if batter is thin.

title: Never Fail Pie Pastry
instructions: Mix together flour Crisco and salt with a pastry cutter. Mix remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture. Mix thoroughly but do not overwork! This recipe makes 4 pie crusts or 2 double crusts. Divide dough into 4 balls. Roll out on floured board being very sure not to overwork the dough because it will get tough. Balls may be frozen. Just allow thaw time and roll out as needed. Can do ahead.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mash bananas and lemon juice until smooth. Cream oil and honey together. Add bananas. Sift dry ingredients and mix in wheat germ. Add to bananas and stir in nuts. Turn into a greased pan; bake 45 minutes.

title: Quick Strawberry Pie
instructions: Wash the strawberries and cut into slices. Put the slices in a bowl; put the glaze into bowl and mix. Pour the mixture into crust; cover evenly. Put Cool Whip on top. Chill 30 minutes. Ready to serve.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix all together and shape in a ball. Roll in chopped pecan pieces. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate.

title: Daddy'S Favorite Gumbo
instructions: Rub generous amounts of salt garlic powder Cayenne pepper on chicken and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. In frying pan cook smoked sausage until brown. Drain and set aside. In medium bowl combine onion bell pepper and celery. Set aside. Combine flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. garlic powder and 1/2 tsp. Cayenne pepper. Coat chicken well in flour mixture. Reserve 1/2 cup flour mixture. In large cast iron skillet (no other type will work) heat 1 1/2 inches of cooking oil and fry chicken until brown on both sides. Drain. Pour hot oil into glass measure cup leaving brown particles in skillet. Return 1/2 cup hot oil to pan. Place skillet over high flame. Use metal whisk and gradually stir in 1/2 cup flour mixture. Cook stirring constantly until roux is dark red brown about 3 1/2 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and add vegetable mixture until vegetables are soft. Place stock in large Dutch oven and bring to a rolling boil. Add roux to stock by spoonfuls stirring until each spoonful is dissolved. Reduce heat to simmer. Bone and dice chicken. Add sausage minced garlic and chicken. Continue simmering for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Serve over hot cooked rice.

title: How To Be A Great Friend
instructions: This recipe will make you a great friend.

title: Quick Poppy Seed Loaf
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Beat well. Stir in pecans and poppy seed.

title: Holiday Applesauce Cake
instructions: Set oven to 350\u00b0. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs to mixture singly beating after each egg. Sift flour soda baking powder cinnamon allspice and cloves together and add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce mixing after each addition. Blend in raisins and nuts. Bake in wax paper lined layer pans. Grease sides and bottoms of pans. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Cherry Cheese Pie
instructions: In a large mixer bowl beat the cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours until set. Top with cherry filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Poppy Seed Nut Bread
instructions: In a large bowl combine the flour sugar poppy seeds and baking powder. In another bowl beat eggs with milk oil and vanilla until blended. Stir liquids into dry ingredients until smooth. Mix in the nuts. Pour batter into two greased and floured 9 x 5 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50-60 minutes or until loaves test done. Cool for 5 minutes. Remove from pans. Finish cooling on racks. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Basic Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: You can use sugar substitute if desired. For a richer tasting mix add 1/3 cup powdered nondairy coffee creamer and/or a tablespoon or so of malted milk powder.

title: Vegetarian Minestrone Soup(8 Servings)
instructions: Thaw bread dough and let rise once. Divide dough into 4 round loaves about 4-inches in diameter. Place on baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray. Let rise 1 hour. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Cool loaves on wire rack. Slice top third of each loaf. To make bread bowls remove bread inside each loaf leaving about 1/3-inch shell. Reserve shells and tops. Save inside of bread for breadcrumbs.

title: Party Dip
instructions: With electric mixer gradually blend soup into cheese; beat just until smooth. Mix remaining ingredients. Chill. Makes 2 1/2 cups of dip.

title: Graham Cracker Squares
instructions: Line 11 x 17-inch pan with graham cracker squares. Mix margarine egg sugar and milk. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add nuts coconut and graham cracker crumbs. Spread this mixture over crackers. Add layer of crackers on top of this. Put vanilla icing on top. Cut in squares to serve.
