title: Peanut Butter Sticks
instructions: Trim crust from bread and cut each slice into 5 strips. Place in oven 200\u00b0 for 2 hours to make crisp. Combine peanut butter and cooking oil in saucepan stirring constantly until smooth. Dip bread slices in this mixture. Combine graham cracker crumbs and powdered sugar; dip bread sticks into this mix after dipping in peanut butter and oil mix.

title: Haystacks
instructions: Melt almond bark; stir in peanut butter. Add Capn Crunch cereal and nuts. Stir well. Drop on wax paper by spoonfuls. Allow to harden.

title: Grandma'S Red Potato Salad
instructions: Skin potatoes and boil whole until soft (stick a fork through easily). Drain potatoes and cool enough to handle. Slice potatoes into large bowl. Add mayonnaise for desired consistency. Add chopped onions and celery (again only add enough to your taste). Mix well; add chopped eggs salt and pepper. Again mix well. Top with paprika and egg wedges for decoration. Refrigerate and serve.

title: Special Potato Soup
instructions: Saute celery & onion in butter in a large dutch oven until tender. Add next 9 ingredients; cover and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Remove from heat and mash vegetables with a potato masher. Add milk & cheese. Cook on low heat stirring consistently until cheese is melted. Makes 10 cups.

title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
instructions: Drain canned vegetables. Mix in chopped vegetables. Mix together the remaining ingredients in small saucepan; bring to a boil. Pour over vegetables. Refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving. Keeps well.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Separate biscuits and tear into bite-size pieces. Melt margarine. Dip pieces into margarine then into cinnamon-sugar mixture. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
instructions: Cook bacon. Cook onion in bacon drippings. Add cabbage (cut in quarters) salt pepper and water. Cook on low for 10 minutes. Add vinegar and brown sugar. Cook 15 to 20 minutes more. Add crumbled bacon. You may add a tart sliced apple the last 15 minutes if desired.

title: Seafood Soup
instructions: Mix together and heat. Do not boil.

title: Broccoli-Rice Bake
instructions: Saute celery margarine and onion. Melt milk and mushroom soup over low heat. Add Cheez Whiz. Add everything together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Cover with foil.

title: Larri Jean'S Vodka Voo-Doo Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients; serve over ice. Yield 35 punch cups.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Beat egg whites with dash of salt and vanilla until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar beating until stiff. Fold in coconut.

title: Huguenot Torte
instructions: In a bowl beat eggs until frothy and lemon-colored. Add sugar flour baking powder and salt. Mix until smooth. Stir in apples pecans and vanilla. Mix well. Put mixture in a buttered 12 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until crusty and brown on top. Serve with vanilla ice cream. Serves 6.

title: Oyster Dressing
instructions: Cook celery and onion in shortening until golden. Add crumbs and parsley mixing thoroughly. Add oysters seasonings and eggs. Add small amount of stock if oyster liquid does not moisten stuffing enough. Place in buttered casserole cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fiesta Beef Pie
instructions: In large skillet saute onions green pepper and garlic in oil until onion is tender-crisp. Add beef and cook until meat is browned. Drain excess fat. Stir in ketchup and next 3 ingredients. Heat to boiling.

title: Mixed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook the mixed vegetables on the stove or in the microwave until crisp-tender. Drain. Place in a large bowl. Add kidney beans celery onion and green pepper. In a saucepan over medium heat bring sugar vinegar and cornstarch to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Cool slightly. Pour over vegetables and toss. Refrigerate.

title: Easy To Make
instructions: Pour pineapple juice into a saucepan. Mix together flour sugar eggs and butter. Add to pineapple juice. Mix and cook until thick. When cool add pineapple chunks bananas and marshmallows. Chill and enjoy.

title: Hot Chocolate
instructions: In a saucepan combine water chocolate sugar and salt. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until chocolate melts. Gradually stir in milk. Heat just to boiling. Do not boil.

title: Molded Pineapple Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water; add juice from drained pineapple. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Combine sour cream with mixture and beat with a mixer until light and fluffy. Fold in nuts and pineapple. Pour into lightly oiled mold. Congeal.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Brown ground meat onion peppers salt and pepper. Add tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Add cheese and heat until cheese has melted. Serve with chips.

title: Microwave Creamy Fudge
instructions: Set your microwave on 50% power. Combine sugar butter milk marshmallows cornstarch and salt in 4 quart mixing bowl. Cook until it boils. (I stir every 2 or 3 minutes) When it starts to boil time it for 3 minutes stirring after 1 1/2 minutes. Remove the bowl from the oven and add the chocolate chips. When they are pretty well melted add the vanilla and nuts. Use an 8 x 8 inch pan or the small glass utility pan. Line with foil leaving it stick up around the edges. Pour in the fudge. Put in freezer for 1 hour. Lift the fudge out with the foil peel off the foil and cut the fudge. Store in covered container in refrigerator.

title: Hot Dip
instructions: Put ingredients in blender and blend for one minute. Put in medium saucepan. Cook on low for 15 minutes. Refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Peppermint Dessert
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and chocolate. Mix well. Cover 9 x 13-inch pan with 2/3 of crushed wafers. Pour chocolate mixture over crumbs. Combine Cool Whip and marshmallows. Pour over chocolate. Top with candy and remaining crumbs. Chill 24 hours.

title: Homemade French Fries
instructions: Preheat deep fryer on medium with the vegetable oil add onion salt to the oil. Cut potatoes into quarters. Deep fry for 1 1/2 minutes check stir occasionally. Remove when brown. Place on paper toweling to drain. Add salt as desired.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter cocoa and milk in bowl. Do not stir! Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Add vanilla. Beat for 2 minutes or until thick. Pour into buttered 8-inch dish. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Lumpia
instructions: Roll and deep fry.

title: Chocolate Chip Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add sugar to egg whites while beating. Beat until stiff but not dry peaks form. Fold in chocolate. Fold in nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet and place in preheated 350\u00b0 oven. Turn off heat. Leave for at least 3 hours. Makes 60 small kisses. Store in airtight container.

title: That Pasta Stuff
instructions: Cook pasta according to pkg. directions. Mix pasta chicken peppers onions and olives. Pour Italian dressing over mixture and refrigerate until chilled. Before serving sprinkle with feta cheese.

title: French Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Tenderloin Casserole
instructions: Roll tenderloin in flour; brown in oil with onion celery and garlic. Add soup and water with rice and pour all into casserole; cover tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk. Place batter into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Julie'S Kielbasa
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Marinate 1 hour or more (baste with marinade). Kielbasi and/or links should be cooked (in marinade) according to package directions.

title: Chicken Divine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Place cooked drained broccoli in the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place layer of cut up chicken over this. Mix lemon juice sour cream mayonnaise and soups. Spoon over chicken layer then sprinkle cheese on top. You may top with buttered bread crumbs crushed chips or Ritz crackers crushed. Refrigerate at this point. Allow to come to room temperature and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Julia'S Moist Chocolate Chocolate Cake
instructions: Add dry ingredients together; mix. Add wet ingredients to dry. Use electric mixer; mix well. Add chocolate chips last by hand.

title: Aunt Rosey'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown beef mixed with salt pepper and cumin. Add ingredients in layers. Bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes in 13 x 15-inch casserole sprayed with Pam. Makes 6 servings.

title: Barbecue Hamburger
instructions: Brown ground chuck in small amount of favorite shortening and break up into small pieces. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour or until thick. Serve hot on your favorite bun.

title: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Bake at 700\u00b0 until the timer dings. This is real tasty and I had it for my 4th birthday.

title: Trout Almondine
instructions: Put fillets in shallow pan and add milk to cover. Let stand for 1 hour. Put almonds with peel in small bowl; cover with water. Place in microwave on High for 1 minute. This will make peeling come off easily. Sliver the almonds with paring knife and set aside. Remove fillets from milk and put in flour mixture (flour salt and pepper). Toss lightly and shake off excess. Brown fillets in oil until lightly brown on both sides. Discard oil. Put butter in skillet and add nuts. Saute until golden brown. Place fillets on platter and covered with toasted almonds. Serve.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water add strawberries breaking with fork as you stir. Chill until slightly thickened. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill until set.

title: Barley Hot Dish
instructions: Brown hamburger with one onion. Cut up celery. Soak barley in water; drain. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Texas Toffee
instructions: Line pan with foil. Place crackers flat on bottom of pan. Boil butter and sugar 3 minutes. Spread over crackers. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over this while hot. Return to oven to melt. Remove and spread evenly. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Break into pieces when cool.

title: Cherry Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix together the flour soda and salt. Set aside.

title: Stir And Store Bran Muffins
instructions: Pour boiling water over bran cereal. Add remaining ingredients in order given. Cover and keep refrigerated up to six weeks. Bake in greased muffin tins at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Dressing
instructions: Mix corn bread celery onion and seasoning. Add well beaten egg and butter; mix thoroughly. Moisten with hot chicken broth until soft. Pour into a well-greased baking pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or use to stuff a small chicken or turkey.

title: Pinwheel Snacks
instructions: Let cheese reach room temperature. Then thinly spread cheese on slice of meat. Roll up and secure with a toothpick. Tray freeze. When frozen slice 3/4 to 1-inch pieces. Place on party dish with toothpicks on the side or freeze and use at a later date.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry; set aside. Layer broccoli chicken soup mixture cheese and crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Dad'S Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat milk until just under boiling. Add sugar and salt. Set aside to cool. Beat eggs slightly. Add vanilla. Cut bread into cubes and spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix milk and egg mixture. Pour over bread. Sprinkle cinnamon and raisins over top. Place pan in larger pan with 1/2-inch of water in it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes (until knife inserted in center comes out clean). Serves 6.

title: Tired Grandma Cake
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Stir lightly. Place in sheet cake pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 475\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Arni Tis Tihis - Lamb Surprise
instructions: Cube meat from leg of lamb in 4 to 5-inch pieces. Place 1 cube of meat on a large square of heavy-duty aluminum foil. Add 1-inch cube of cheese 1 small carrot 1 small onion 1 piece of celery 1 medium potato which has been pared and cut in half and rubbed with butter. Add a squeeze of lemon juice salt and pepper. Fold the foil and refold tightly. Bake 2 hours in 350\u00b0 oven. Serve each foil package intact on dinner plate allowing each guest to open his own.

title: Snickers Bars
instructions: First Layer Melt together 1/4 cup chocolate chips 1/4 cup butterscotch chips and 1/4 cup peanut butter. Microwave about 1 minute. Mix well. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Select young tender pods of okra. Wash cut off ends and slice crosswise. Mix salt pepper meal and flour in a bag or bowl. Add okra and shake or stir until okra is covered with dry mixture. Have the shortening hot in a skillet. Add the okra. Cook until tender and browned stirring occasionally.

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Combine first 8 ingredients and make into meatballs. Brown in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Saute remaining ingredients for sauce. Cook until well blended; thicken. Add meatballs. Simmer until well blended. Serve with toothpicks or over rice.

title: Strawberry Fluff
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Make up to 3/4 cup with cold water. Refrigerate until almost set.

title: South Of The Border Spinach Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Butter a 1-quart baking dish. Combine all ingredients. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or toasted pita bread. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Combine onion and water in a 1 1/2-quart covered casserole dish and microwave 2 to 3 minutes. Add crumbled ground beef. Microwave 2 1/2 minutes. Drain and add cheese sour cream parsley salt and pepper; set aside. Wrap tortillas in paper towel and microwave 1 minute. Combine remaining ingredients; pour half of this sauce into a 12 x 8-inch dish. Place 2 1/2 tablespoons of meat mixture in center of each tortilla and roll up. Place seam side down in the sauce. Top with remaining sauce. Cover with plastic wrap. Heat 11 to 12 minutes. Turn after 5 1/2 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Crescent Cheeseburger Pie
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion until onion is transparent; drain. Stir in tomato sauce mushrooms parsley salt oregano and pepper. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. Top with cheese then top with other pie crust. Brush top with beaten egg and cut slits in top crust. Bake according to pie crust directions (until crust is brown).

title: Penny'S Kugel (Noodle Pudding)(Served Hot, As Sweet Vegetable, Or Dessert)
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Beat eggs; add rest of ingredients (room temperature). Mix together and add noodles. Mix well. Pour into large rectangular pan or glass casserole either greased or sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix together mayonnaise vinegar and sugar and pour over other ingredients. Chop all remaining ingredients into small pieces with bacon fried crispy and cut into small pieces. Mix in last 3 ingredients into salad bowl. Serve and eat.

title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix and form into 1-inch balls. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Can be frozen and baked as directed when needed.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Cut shortening in. Add the yeast and buttermilk. Mix with large spoon real good. This makes a large bowl full. Pinch off each day just the amount you want to bake. This keeps a week to 10 days. Keep remainder of dough in refrigerator. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Cook and mash potatoes. Do not add any milk to mash. Add 1/2 stick margarine or butter and Velveeta. Beat until melted. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook noodles. Saute onion and 1 stick margarine. Put 1/2 onion mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch lasagna pan. Add 3 noodles 1/2 potato mixture 3 more noodles rest of potatoes last 3 noodles rest of the margarine and onions. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pork Chops And Apple Casserole
instructions: In large skillet brown chops slowly on both sides without added fat. Remove chops and pour off fat. Put apples in a shallow baking dish and distribute onion evenly over the top overlapping if necessary. Sprinkle lightly with salt pepper and paprika. Add 1/2 cup water. Cover tightly with lid or tinfoil and bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven 45 minutes.

title: Evelyn'S Famous Tangy Green Beans
instructions: Cook green beans in water; drain and keep warm. Dont overcook as the beans will become mushy. Combine mustard sugar butter salt and pepper in a small pan. Heat slowly stirring constantly until the butter melts. Stir in the lemon juice and vinegar. Pour over hot green beans. Can be prepared ahead adding the sauce to the beans just before serving.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except butter and seasoning. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add butter and season to taste. Serves 4.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl. Shape dough into balls about the size of a small pecan. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 35 minutes or until lightly golden brown.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch). Mix all ingredients until moist. Stir vigorously for 30 seconds. Pour batter into pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck. Drain. Crumble meat over bottom of a 2-quart casserole. Slice onion on top of meat. Add chicken soup (undiluted) and spread over onions then put on a layer of Tater Tots. Add the diluted cream of mushroom soup. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Tea Cakes
instructions: Mix butter and sugar well with mixer. Add eggs salt soda and vanilla. Mix well. Add buttermilk and flour. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Fried Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes. Cut into thin slices. Brown potatoes in hot oil. Turn heat to low. Dot with butter and sprinkle sugar on top. Cover with lid and turn off heat. Let set for 10 minutes.

title: Raisin Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix ingredients and add Raisin Bran. Allow to chill for 24 hours. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Can add more raisins if desired. Makes large batch. Batter will keep 6 weeks in refrigerator.

title: Holiday Macaroons
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and let stand 5 minutes. Then drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to cool on wire racks right away or theyll stick! Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

title: Burgundy Stew
instructions: Combine meat carrots celery and onions. Mix flour sugar salt and basil; stir into meat mixture. Stir in tomatoes and wine. Cover tightly and bake at 300\u00b0 for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Sir in mushrooms and water chestnuts; cook 10 minutes longer.

title: Beef Burger Casserole
instructions: Place layers in a greased shallow pan. Put ground beef on layers. Add tomato soup and then mushroom soup. Bake for 1 hour at 375\u00b0. (Cheese may be added.)

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream peanut butter and cream cheese together. Add confectioners sugar; mix well. Beat in Cool Whip with electric mixer on low speed. Pour into crust. Chill for 2 hours or until firm.

title: Alicia'S Punch
instructions: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar in a 1 gallon container. Add 8 cups water stirring until well mixed. Pour in pineapple juice. Add enough water to fill container. Yields 25 servings.

title: Rabbit
instructions: Brown rabbit with garlic in bacon drippings. When brown add other ingredients. Cover tightly and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until rabbit is tender.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Sift together flour salt baking powder sugar and soda. Cut in softened margarine. Add buttermilk and shape into large ball. Knead 6 to 8 times on lightly floured surface. Roll out and cut biscuits. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Banana-Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour oblong pan 13 x 9 x 2-inches or two 9-inch or three 8-inch round layer pans. Beat all ingredients in a large mixing bowl at low speed for 30 seconds scraping the bowl constantly. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes scraping the bowl occasionally. Pour into pans. Bake until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean (about 45 to 50 minutes for oblong 35 to 40 minutes for layers). Cool. Frost with Vanilla Butter Frosting if desired.

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Put in bowl. Mix and pour over

title: Yummy Egg Noodles(Fun To Make!)
instructions: Beat egg and add milk and salt. Add flour until mixture is stiff. Roll mixture on pastry cloth (well floured) and let sit for approximately 20 minutes. Fold pastry in half and cut into strips. Leave strips long enough to make them fun to eat! Use immediately or refrigerate until ready to use!

title: Marinade Sauce
instructions: Good marinade for pork chops. After standing in sauce overnight broil or charcoal grill chops.

title: Basic Pastry Puffs
instructions: Mix the water butter and salt in a medium saucepan. Heat just to boiling. Immediately remove from heat and add the flour all at once. Stir with a wooden spoon until mixture forms a ball. Return to medium heat and cook stirring constantly until paste has dried slightly. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes. Beat in eggs one at a time waiting until each is incorporated before adding another. When each egg is added and you start to beat it in the mixture separates slightly and look like Southern dumplings. Continue beating until the mixture looks like mashed potatoes. Do this with each egg.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Put all ingredients in large bowl; beat until smooth. Drop onto hot griddle or frying pan. Serve with maple syrup or jelly hot coffee or tea.

title: Pizza Quiche
instructions: Brush pie shell with Worcestershire sauce. Add cheese mushrooms pepperoni ham and olives etc. Beat eggs cream and hot sauce; pour over other ingredients. Top with onions rings if desired. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let set 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: Mix cake as directed on box. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom of pan with coconut and nuts. Pour cake mixture on top. Mix margarine cream cheese powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth and creamy. Spoon in globs on top of cake mix. Bake at 325\u00b0 about 40 minutes.

title: Krafty-Cheesy Green Beans
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1/4 cup drippings. Crumble bacon reserving 2 tablespoons. Microwave beans as directed on package. Drain well. Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in large skillet. Cook on medium-high heat for 10 minutes; drain. Add bacon hot green beans and pepper. Mix lightly.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Have a baked pie shell ready. Mix the water sugar cornstarch and jello in saucepan. Bring to boil. Put stemmed berries in pie shell and pour mixture over all. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Dill Dip For Raw Vegetables
instructions: Combine ingredients in order given and mix well. Good as vegetable or chip dip.

title: Cincinnati Pie
instructions: Combine ground beef potato peas corn cauliflower carrots and onion in a large cast-iron skillet. Add mushroom soup spreading evenly over vegetables-beef mixture. Pour batter over all to create topping. Place skillet in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for approximately 45 minutes. Test corned beef topping with a toothpick for doneness. Remove skillet from oven. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Mix together the sugar cocoa salt and milk in a glass bowl; top with 1/2 cup butter. Cook on High in 9 x 9-inch glass dish for 3 minutes. Stir well. Mix in nuts or leave plain. Refrigerate. Cut after 30 minutes.

title: Hamburger Stuff
instructions: Mix ground chuck onion garlic salsa salt and pepper. Cook until onions and garlic are tender. Layer meat mixture and flour tortillas until all are used. Sprinkle small amount of cheese between each layer. End with meat mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Christmas Cole Slaw
instructions: Mix cover and chill several hours.

title: Coffee Walnut Chocolate Chip Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour 12 (3-inch) muffin pans cups (or use paper cups). Cream the butter with the sugars coffee and vanilla. Beat together the eggs and milk. Combine the flour salt and baking powder. Alternately add the wet and dry ingredients to the butter mixture. Stir just to combine (use wooden spoon). Add chips and walnuts. Fill the tins full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes (depending on your oven). Cool 5 minutes then remove and cool on racks. Beat eaten soon after baking but can be warmed in oven or toaster.

title: Creamiest Banana Puddin'
instructions: Mix 2 boxes of vanilla pudding and milk. Mix 1 cup at a time until all 5 are blended. Let set for a few minutes. Add Cool Whip to pudding mixture. In another bowl mix cream cheese and condensed milk. Add to pudding mixture. Layer cookies on bottom and sides of pan. Pour in some of the pudding mixture. Add a layer of sliced bananas. Repeat layers several times.

title: Jeannette'S Hot Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix together. Put in greased casserole. Top with 3/4 cup crushed potato chips and 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle paprika over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
instructions: Saute first 3 ingredients until the cheese becomes stringy. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in buttered casserole or pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or a little longer.

title: Glaze For Ham
instructions: Melt all together and baste over grilled or baked ham.

title: Opie'S Lemonade Pie
instructions: In a large bowl combine the Cool Whip lemonade and milk blending well. Pour in graham cracker crust and chill for 2 hours.

title: Caramelized Grahams
instructions: On foil lay graham crackers. Boil in sauce pan butter and brown sugar. Pour on 100% of crackers and cover with foil and cook in oven for 10 minutes at 350 degrees.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: In a large bowl mix meat oats chopped tomatoes and chilies eggs onion salt and pepper. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Then if necessary drain grease from pan. Pour tomato sauce over the top of meat loaf and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage in skillet; drain. Mix eggs milk mustard and salt; stir in bread sausage and cheese. Pour in greased dish; refrigerate for 2 hours or 24. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Oriental Chicken(Microwave)
instructions: Pierce chicken breasts with a fork. Arrange in a 3-quart casserole. In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients; pour over chicken. Cover. Microwave on High (power 10) for 11 to 13 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Hot Fudge Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add 1 egg at a time. Add sifted flour salt and blend in chocolate syrup flavoring and black walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes. Make icing and pour over cake while hot.

title: Millet Loaf
instructions: Brown millet and onion in oil (or may omit this step and add to rest of ingredients without oil). Add enough water to tomatoes and soup to make total of 4 cups. Mix all ingredients and place in a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. May top with Cheddar cheese if desired.

title: Lemon Sauce
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch. Add boiling water gradually while stirring constantly. Boil 6 minutes then remove from heat. Add butter lemon juice salt and nutmeg. Serves 6. Serve with bread steamed or cottage pudding.

title: Banana Nut Bread(Ada Recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs; beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with banana mixing well. Stir in nuts. Pour into 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch) loaf pans sprayed with vegetable Pam spray. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until toothpick comes out clean. (Freezes well.) Remove from pan. Cool on rack. Makes 17 slices (1/2 inch) per pan. Each contains 132 calories.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Place cubed potatoes (leave peeling on) in bowl. Pour oil over potatoes. Add dressing mix and toss well. Place on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender.

title: Scorned Woman Buffalo Wings
instructions: Deep fry wings at 400\u00b0 (high) for 12 minutes or until completely cooked and crispy then drain. Pour melted butter or margarine over wings in a large bowl or pan coating them. Then pour the hot sauce over the wings again thoroughly coating the wings. (If cooking a larger amount or using a smaller deep fryer cooked wings may be kept warm in oven at low temperature until others are ready.) Finally sit back. Enjoy and have a fire extinguisher nearby if desired.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 can onions and mix well. Pour into dish. Sprinkle reserved onions on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Dump Cobbler
instructions: Pour cans of filling or fruit cocktail in bottom of Dutch oven. Sprinkle cake mix over top of fruit DO NOT STIR! Sprinkle with cinnamon and cut pads of butter and let fall on surface. DO NOT STIR it will burn. Cover and bake until bubbly and top is lightly browned about 30-45 minutes. Any combination of fruits can be used. I recommend 1 can apple filling and 1 can of fruit cocktail.

title: Zucchini Stew
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Add celery and saute 10 minutes. Add rest of ingredients except peppers and simmer for about 40 minutes. Add green peppers and cook about 10 minutes longer. Serve with Parmesan cheese and Italian bread or over pasta.

title: Beer Batter
instructions: Mix butter eggs and beer. Add to dry ingredients.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Drain artichokes and crush smooth. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be served at room temperature or hot with your favorite wheat crackers.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in butter. Combine corn rice pimientos pepper sugar salt and pepper. Beat in egg; pour in casserole dish. Butter; top with grated cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Five Flavor Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees; use a 10 inch bundt pan. Cream butter in small mixer bowl until thick and lemon colored.\tBlend into creamed mixture. Add flour and baking powder alternately with milk mixing well after each addition. Stir in 1 teaspoon coconut rum butter vanilla and lemon flavorings.\tSpoon into greased and floured bundt pan.\tBake for 1-1/2 hours or until cake tests done. Bring remaining flavorings 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup water to a boil in saucepan; stir until sugar is dissolved. Pour half the mixture over cake in pan. Cool for several minutes invert cake onto cake plate. Pour remaining glaze over top.

title: Hanky Pankys
instructions: Brown meat; drain. Add cheese stirring until melted. Add spices and mushrooms. Spread on party bread slices. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Watch time. Mixture may be frozen.

title: Baked Acorn Squash
instructions: Cut squash in half scoop out seeds and spread butter over cut wedges. Place cut side down in a greased baking dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Turn cut side up; brush with lemon juice. Place 1 teaspoon butter in each cavity. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon brown sugar over each acorn squash half; sprinkle with coriander. Return to oven and bake about 5 minutes or until sugar has melted. Yields 4 servings.

title: Sweet And Sour Wieners
instructions: Combine mustard and jelly. Add wieners. Cook in crock-pot for 2 hours. Serve hot.

title: Autumn Apple Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix flour baking powder baking soda salt and nuts. In a large bowl beat margarine or butter sugar and 1 egg until smooth. Add second egg and beat well. Stir in vanilla. Stir in apples. Pour flour mixture into batter. Stir until moistened. Scrape into a loaf pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: Butterscotch Walnut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly; add corn syrup salt vanilla brown sugar and butter; mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 35 minutes or until filling sets in 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Shrimp Batter
instructions: Combine ingredients and dip seasoned shrimp in batter. Fry until brown.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix vinegar with milk and allow to curdle. Add onion garlic parsley mayonnaise Blue cheese lemon juice salt pepper and cayenne. Mix well and refrigerate.

title: Sale Creek Strawberry Pie
instructions: Bring to a boil and strain 1 cup of the smallest berries the sugar and the boiling water. Now add the cornstarch mixture. Cook over the fire for a couple of minutes stirring constantly. Remove from fire and beat. Return to a slow fire and cook slowly until thick. Have ready a baked pie shell. Arrange the rest of the berries which have been washed and picked over in the pie shell. Pour the hot sauce over them. When cool spread with whipped cream that has been sweetened with powdered sugar.

title: Chex-Muddy Buddies(Kids')
instructions: Pour cereals into large bowl and set aside. Combine chocolate chips peanut butter and margarine in 1-quart microwave bowl. Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth stirring after 1 minute. Stir in vanilla.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine butter sugar and vanilla in a large bowl. Mix until smooth and creamy. Add chips and flour. Mix well. Form into small balls and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Press flat with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven 16 to 18 minutes.

title: Pepper Steak With Rice
instructions: Sprinkle steak with paprika and allow to stand while preparing other ingredients. Cook steak and garlic in butter until meat is brown. Add onions and green peppers; continue cooking until vegetables are wilted. Add tomatoes and broth; cover and simmer about 15 minutes. Blend water with cornstarch and soy sauce. Stir into steak and cook until thickened. Serve over rice.

title: Carne Asada
instructions: Pierce steak with fork on both sides and coat with oil. Place in large resealable plastic bag. In measuring cup combine Fajitas Skillet Sauce orange juice and oregano. Pour over steak. Marinate in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours turning steak occasionally. Remove steak; reserve marinade. Broil steak 4 to 5 minutes on each side until cooked to desired doneness basting often with reserved marinade. Serve with salsa. Makes 4 servings.

title: Poor Man'S Steak
instructions: Mix all ingredients except soup. Shape into patties. Chill or freeze overnight. Remove from refrigerator. Roll in flour and brown in skillet (in Crisco or oil). Put in shallow pan. Cover with soup. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Irish Tater Candy
instructions: Peel and boil potato when done mash up with fork. Add pinch of salt and pour in a box of confectioners sugar. This makes a stiff dough. Roll out on a dough board that has been floured real good in a layer 1/4-inch thick. Spread peanut butter all over top. Roll up like a jelly roll. Makes 2 rolls if you like. Put in the refrigerator and chill. Cut with knife and serve.

title: Pepperoni Pie
instructions: Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan. Mix 1/2 the cheese with all other ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn oven off and sprinkle 1/2 the cheese on top. Remove from oven when cheese is melted. Cut into squares and serve warm.

title: Stir-Fry Vegies
instructions: Scrub potatoes well and place on oven rack. Bake at 375\u00b0 about an hour to hour and a half (depends on size of potatoes). Potatoes should feel soft when squeezed with pot holder. Store the ones you are not using right away in plastic wrap in the refrigerator. They will keep at least a week. Heat in microwave and eat.

title: Chinese Peas
instructions: Heat oils then put in vegetables and cook about 15 minutes or until tender. Stir occasionally. Dissolve 1/4 cup of broth and cornstarch then add remaining broth and soy sauce; cook until thick. Pour over vegetables and heat. Serves 10.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix pretzels and oleo. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes. Cool. Cream the sugar and cheese together; spread Cool Whip over cooled pretzels. Spread cheese mixture over Cool Whip. Combine boiling pineapple juice and water with strawberry Jell-O; cool. Add pineapple and strawberries to Jell-O. Chill and pour over layers.

title: Snacks
instructions: Cut apples into quarters. Put 1 spoonful of peanut butter in center. Add raisins and eat.

title: Butterfinger Brownies
instructions: In small bowl combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed combine margarine and brown sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla until smooth. Stir in flour mixture and 1 cup crushed Butterfinger candy bars. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crushed candy bars over top of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool and cut into 3 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Makes approximately 20 bars.

title: Raisin-Nut Whole Wheat Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; add salt oil and molasses. Stir well. Add wheat germ flours nuts and raisins. Use about 1 cup of white flour in kneading. Flour varies so use enough flour to make a proper dough. Knead well. Set aside to rise until double in bulk. Knead again and form into 6 loaves. Let rise again in loaf pans.

title: Harker'S Island Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon in bottom of stew pot until crisp. Crumble bacon and add remaining ingredients. Simmer stirring often until potatoes are tender.

title: Fruited Cream Cheese Spread
instructions: Mash fruits until desired consistency and then blend in cream cheese. Keep cold. Serve with bagels gingersnaps etc. Yields 2 cups.

title: Whole Wheat Biscuits
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add milk stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead about 1 minute. Shape dough into 12 balls. Place in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray. Flatten dough slightly. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 12 biscuits.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice and put aside. In a large bowl combine rest of ingredients. Then add rice. Put in casserole dish and bake in oven at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Make Ahead Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spread croutons on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch dish. Crumble sausage and cook until browned. Drain drippings and spread over croutons. Whisk eggs and milk. Stir in soup spinach mushrooms cheeses and mustard. Pour egg mixture over sausage. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325\u00b0 and bake 50 to 55 minutes or until set and lightly browned. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Western Bean Dish
instructions: Fry bacon crisp put aside. Brown hamburg with onion in a large skillet. Drain off. Combine all remaining ingredients. (Be sure to drain all liquid from beans.) Put in casserole. Heat in oven until hot through and through. Sprinkle bacon over and serve.

title: Cholesterol-Free Apple Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Blend together cake mix pie filling and egg whites in a large mixer bowl. Beat for 3 minutes on medium speed. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Spread half of the batter in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 of sugar and cinnamon over batter. Repeat with remaining batter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 20 to 35 minutes until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool.

title: Whole Wheat Dinner Rolls
instructions: In small saucepan heat first 3 ingredients until very warm (120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0). In large bowl blend warm liquid 1 cup all-purpose flour 3/4 cup whole wheat flour sugar salt yeast and egg at low speed until moistened. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. By hand stir in remaining wheat flour and enough all-purpose flour to form stiff dough. Knead for 5 minutes. Place dough in vegetable-sprayed bowl. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size 45 to 60 minutes. Then punch down dough. Divide dough in 20 pieces; shape into balls. Place on greased pan; cover and let rise for 30 to 45 minutes. Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Bake 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage and drain. Slice two eggs into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. In saucepan melt margarine and blend in flour salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Stir sausage and corn into sauce and pour over eggs. Slice remaining eggs; arrange on top of mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
instructions: *Milk and cheese can be substituted with low-fat variety.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Peel avocados and tomato; mash together leaving small lumps. Add all other ingredients. Mix well with hand. Add salt and stir with a spoon. Serve cold with taco Doritos.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in a heavy saucepot; add eggs and milk mixing well. Cook over low heat stirring constantly 25 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.

title: Easy So Easy Fruitcake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Grease a 9-inch tube pan; line with wax paper and grease again (or use generously greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan). Sift together flour and baking soda; set aside. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients; blend in dry ingredients. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes. Turn out of pan; remove wax paper. Glaze and garnish as desired.

title: Carrot, Sweet Potato And Apple Tzimmes
instructions: Cook the carrots and sweet potatoes until tender; drain. Pare quarter core and slice the apples but not too thin. Alternate these in layers in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Season each with brown sugar salt pepper and fat. Add water. Cover and bake in a moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 30 minutes or until apples are tender. Remove cover and continue baking until top is golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Fritata
instructions: Drain juice from one artichoke jar into frying pan. Chop both jars of artichokes and set aside. Saute onion and garlic in frying pan of marinade. Beat eggs. Add bread crumbs salt pepper oregano and Tabasco. Stir in cheese parsley and artichokes. Add onion mixture. Put in 7 x 11-inch greased pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour water over oats. Cream shortening and add sugar. Add eggs one at a time then add flour. Fold in oats with dates and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Spinach Omelet
instructions: Cook and drain chopped spinach. Put 2 slices of bread in bottom of buttered loaf pan. Top with layer of spinach and cheese. Repeat having cheese on top. Beat eggs; add milk and seasoning and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Heat butter until melted; add garlic. Stir in flour and salt and cook until bubbly. Stir in milk and broth and boil one minute stirring constantly. Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan Mozzarella onion basil oregano and pepper until cheese melts.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables. Drain. Mix next four ingredients. Stir in vegetables. Moisten cracker crumbs with butter put half in casserole. Pour in a casserole dish. Put remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 until bubbly.

title: Party Dip
instructions: Mix first five ingredients together. Add Worcestershire sauce and spinach. Mix well. This needs to be made a day before or at least eight hours before serving.

title: Delicious Frozen Cole Slaw
instructions: Boil 3 to 4 minutes and let cool.

title: Rice Pudding Supreme(Serves 6 To 8)
instructions: Combine milk pudding mix rice and raisins in deep glass bowl (2-quart preferred). Microwave 11 to 13 minutes or until mixture boils. Stir once during last half of cooking time. Cool. Fold pudding whipped cream and fruit together in large mixing bowl. Refrigerate until served.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Mix all ingredients; cook over low heat for about 45 minutes. Turn to moderate heat and bring to a boil; remove from heat immediately. Add the Certo; stir well. Put in jars.

title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Mold
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice. Add water to juice to make 1 1/2 cups. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; stir in measured liquid. Pour 2 cups of the gelatin into medium bowl. Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened. Stir in pineapple. Spoon into 5-cup ring mold. Refrigerate about 2 hours until set but not firm. Stir remaining 1 cup gelatin gradually into cream cheese in small bowl until smooth. Refrigerate 1 1/2 hours or until thickened. Stir in walnuts; spoon into mold. Refrigerate 4 hours or until firm; unmold.

title: Chocolate Caramel Treats
instructions: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugars. Gradually beat in flour and oats. Stir in chocolate chips; set aside 1 cup. Press remaining mixture into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are light brown. In small heavy saucepan over low heat melt caramel candies with milk. Drizzle over base. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Cut into 2-inch squares. Makes about 2 dozen squares.

title: Sugar Cream Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Add cream melted butter and vanilla. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Asparagus Egg Casserole
instructions: Prepare asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces. Cook in 1-inch of boiling salted water until tender. Make white sauce of butter flour seasonings and milk. Stir in cheese.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch oblong pan or 2 round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream together shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with banana blending well after each addition. Stir in nuts. Pour into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 to 50 minutes or until done. Remove from pan; cook on rack. Wrap and store overnight.

title: Hawaiian Beans
instructions: Fry bacon. Drain and crumble. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons drippings. Cut pineapple slices in half and saute in drippings until light brown. Combine other ingredients in skillet. Arrange pineapple on top. Heat until bubbly.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Saute onions and peppers in olive oil until onions are soft. Do not brown them. Pour in saucepan. Add tomato sauce and water. Simmer on low heat. Using the same skillet brown beef and garlic. Pour in pan with onions and other ingredients. Add spices and salt to taste. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Finger Appetizers
instructions: Open canister of French loaf and unroll. Layer with sliced pepperoni. Cover pepperoni with grated Mozzarella. Re-roll. Pierce with fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Let cool 5 minutes. Slice into 1 inch strips. Serve hot.

title: Party Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
instructions: Cream the oleo and sugar. Stir in oil and egg. Mix the rest of the ingredients. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.\tShape 1/2-inch balls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Dip balls in green sugar and flatten with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes.

title: Lebkuchen Cookies
instructions: Mix walnuts fruit and orange peel. Combine flour soda spices and coffee. Sprinkle over fruit and nut mixture. Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg. Add honey and sourdough starter alternately with flour and nut mixture. Mix well. Spread on greased jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until done. Remove from oven. Frost with rum glaze. Cool. Cut into bars. Yields 2 dozen cookies.

title: Spanish Rice
instructions: Melt shortening in heavy skillet. Pour in rice and onion; brown over low heat stirring frequently. Add broth and tomatoes. Do not stir. Cover and let steam over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Raisin And Coconut Pie
instructions: Cream eggs and sugar. Add raisins coconut nuts and vinegar. Melt margarine and pour in mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Then cut oven back to 350\u00b0 and bake 20 minutes more.

title: Momma'S Peanut Brittle
instructions: You also need 1 buttered pan; have ready ahead of time.

title: Tomato-Cheese Fondue
instructions: Pour tomato juice over bread crumbs and let soak. Stir in cheese melted butter and salt. Beat egg yolks and stir into bread crumb mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in thoroughly. Turn into buttered 6 cup casserole and bake in moderate oven (325\u00b0) for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until a sharp knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Chicken Dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a saucepan bring broth soup and vegetables to a boil. Stir well. Add chicken and cook 10 minutes. Pour mixture into baking dish and top with biscuits. Bake until biscuits are golden brown.

title: Beet Pickles
instructions: Wash beets and boil until fork-tender. Peel and cut to desired size. Boil vinegar sugar cloves and salt. Add beets and reheat to boiling. Pack into jars and cover with liquid. Seal.

title: Baked Beans And Tomatoes
instructions: Cook beans until done then mix with cooked macaroni. Add tomatoes and sugar. Season with salt pepper and butter. Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Combine sugar syrup and water and cook to the soft ball stage. Add peanuts and cook until mixture turns dark. Remove from heat; add baking soda salt and vinegar. Stir well and pour onto buttered cookie sheet. Cool and break into pieces.

title: Brownies
instructions: Heat chocolate oil and sugar on low. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Pour in greased pan (13 x 9-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Artichoke Toast
instructions: Cut crusts from bread. Quarter bread slices. Spread on cookie sheet. Toast both sides under broiler. Combine mayonnaise and cheese. Spread lightly on toast pieces. Cut artichokes in quarters. Place on each toast piece. Top with teaspoon of mayonnaise mixture. Place under broiler until golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Eggless, Butterless And Milkless Cake
instructions: Put ingredients in a pan and boil 3 minutes. When cool stir in 1 teaspoon soda dissolved in a little hot water then add 2 cups flour in which 1/2 teaspoon baking powder has been sifted.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Mix altogether and refrigerate. Add more dressing and cheese if so desired.

title: Sauteed Chicken In Red Wine Vinegar
instructions: Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium heat. Add onion and saute until very soft 10 to 15 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon. Increase heat to medium-high. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and juices run clear when pierced with tip of a knife. Remove chicken. Add vinegar and boil until reduced to 2/3 1 to 2 minutes. Add cream and boil until thickened 3 to 4 minutes. Return onion and chicken to skillet and spoon sauce over. Serve hot. Serves 4.

title: Cornish Pasties
instructions: Peel onion; set in same pan as the meat and roast until fairly tender. Cut meat and onion up fine. Boil potatoes and turnip; dice. Mix with meat. Add salt and pepper. Roll out pastry fairly thin (1/4-inch). Cut into rounds the size of a saucer. Put meat mixture in the center of each round. Bring 2 opposite sides of pastry together in a join at the top and flute edges. Brush with beaten egg. Bake in hot 425\u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes. This mixture will make several dozen pasties.

title: Imperial Pound Cake
instructions: Scald 3 cups of milk in top of double boiler. Mix 1 cup cold milk with cornmeal; pour cornmeal mixture slowly into hot milk. Place mixture over boiling water and cook 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Add sugar butter and molasses and remove from heat. Add salt and spices; stir in beaten eggs and pour into well buttered 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Bake in preheated 300\u00b0 oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours stirring every 15 minutes during first hour. After first hour pour cream over top of pudding and continue to bake without stirring in cream. Serve warm topped with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

title: Seven Course Casserole
instructions: Layer all ingredients in casserole dish. Season each layer. Bake 2 to 3 hours in slow oven at 325\u00b0 in covered dish.

title: Easy Cheesecake
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip blending well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set at least 4 hours.

title: Dawn'S Meatloaf
instructions: Break egg into bowl beat slightly. Add milk salt pepper and bread crumbs. Beat until bread has blended in well. Add onions carrots cheese and beef. Mix well with hands. Pack into a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Combine brown sugar catsup and mustard. Spread over surface of loaf. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Let stand 10 minutes. Can freeze raw for baking later.

title: Smoked Ham
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Punch about 8 holes in top of can with can opener. Put in oven about 15 to 20 minutes to melt gelatin around ham. Pour off gelatin. Pour liquid smoke into can. Bake 3 hours at 250\u00b0.

title: Homemade Pot Pie Dough
instructions: Cut shortening into flour and salt. Beat egg and add to mixture. Add milk until dough is soft. Divide into 4 to 6 batches. Roll out paper thin keeping your area well floured. Keep flipping your dough from top to bottom as you roll it out. Bring your broth to a boil and drop in your pot pie once it is cut into small squared 1 x 1-inch or 2 x 2-inch pieces. Boil 20 minutes; add meat and seasonings such as parsley and onions.

title: 15 Minute Super Sundae Pie
instructions: Spoon ice cream into crust. Place in freezer with plastic lid inverted on top of ice cream. Remove from freezer when hard. Spoon jar of strawberry topping onto pie. Cut and place on plate. Garnish with chocolate syrup whipped cream and cherry.

title: Crab Cakes
instructions: Clean and pick over crabmeat removing any membrane pieces. Combine the other ingredients together and add to crabmeat. Mix gently until blended. Form into 8 crab cakes. Fry each in oil deep enough to come up to one half the side of the crab cake. Brown lightly on each side.

title: Yummy Yams
instructions: Butter casserole dish. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat yams until smooth and add all other ingredients (except marshmallows and pineapple). Blend until smooth. Pour 1/2 of mixture into baking dish. Layer small can of pineapple on top slices chunks or crushed will work. Add rest of yam mixture. Top with marshmallows and pecans. Bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Pot Roast
instructions: Dredge roast in flour; brown in Dutch oven with a little oil. Add salt and pepper. Add a little water (about 2 cups). Cook 2 hours; watch so it doesnt dry out. Add more water if needed. Add cut up carrots onions and potatoes as desired. A bay leaf or two may be added to roast if desired.

title: Easy Beef Stew
instructions: Put raw cubed beef into a 3-quart casserole. (Do not brown.) Sprinkle with salt pepper and basil. Top with celery carrots onions and potatoes. Combine tomato soup and water. Pour over meat and vegetables. Do not stir leave in layers. Cover tightly and bake for 3 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Never Fail Meringue
instructions: Combine water sugar and cornstarch; cook and stir until thick and clear. Cool slightly; add vanilla. In a large bowl beat egg whites and salt until droopy peaks form. Continue beating as you slowly pour in the water and sugar mixture. Beat until peaks stand up straight.

title: Perfect Pie Crust
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening until well blended.

title: Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Mix and sift first 4 ingredients. Cut in butter or margarine until mixture resembles coarse corn meal. Stir in raisins. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into dry mixture until just moistened. Bake in 1-quart casserole (greased) at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.

title: Tutti-Frutti Ice Cream
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients and blend well. Add milk and juice; mix well. Freeze in ice cream freezer following manufacturers directions.

title: Dill Pickle Surprise
instructions: Rinse and cut in thick slices; put in 2 (1 gallon) jars. Add 1/2 garlic to each jar. Pour 1/3 cup oil over each jar. Add 4 1/2 cups sugar to each jar and seal. Shake until all sugar is dissolved. I shake ever so often for about 2 hours and chill in refrigerator for about 3 days. Delicious.

title: Oyster Crackers
instructions: Mix all together except the crackers. Put crackers in a bowl and coat with the mixture. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 250\u00b0.

title: Squash Puffs
instructions: Combine all ingredients then add enough water drained from squash for consistency to drop with a teaspoon in deep fat to form puffs about the size of hush puppies. Makes 20 to 25 puffs.

title: Corned Beef Salad
instructions: Make jello according to directions. Mix in rest of ingredients and chill to set.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: In a deep casserole dish dump in peaches. Then sprinkle the cake mix across the top to cover peaches. Cut butter into small pieces and place it over the cake mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.

title: Ham And Cheese Souffle
instructions: Trim crusts off bread and butter both sides and then cube. Butter casserole dish. Layer bread ham and cheese then layer another layer of bread ham and cheese. Pour beaten eggs and milk on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Green Goddess Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients but olive oil together in blender then slowly add olive oil in steady stream while blending.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together including spaghetti which has been broken into pieces. Place in a 2-quart casserole and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Top with Cheddar cheese and bake another 15 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Linguini And Chicken Scampi
instructions: Cut chicken into 1/2 pieces. Dip in egg and bread crumbs seasoned with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Heat oil in skillet. Add 1/3 of chicken and saute 30 seconds until golden. Remove with slotted spoon and repeat with remaining pieces. Discard oil. Cook pasta.

title: La Crepe Francaise
instructions: Place flour and eggs in mixing bowl. Add salt and sugar; mix well. When ingredients get too heavy to mix add milk and mix well. Add vanilla and melted butter; mix well. Cover bowl; let stand for 1 hour. Using heated skillet or pan use a small amount of Crisco to grease pan. When pan is hot (not too hot) spread pancake mix in pan and brown both sides (golden brown only). Serve with warm maple syrup. Serves 4.

title: Deluxe Beef Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Brown ground beef then drain excess grease off of meat. Then take ground beef margarine and tomato sauce. Mix together. Combine cottage cheese cream cheese sour cream onions and green peppers in a bowl. Spread half the drained noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish and top with cheese mixture. Add remaining noodles. Spread meat and tomato mixture on top. Cover with foil and bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Green Chili Pie
instructions: Brown meat and onion; drain off fat. Add tomatoes and soup. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes. Using 9 x 13-inch pan layer the following ingredients put refried beans down first; tortilla chips second; meat mixture third and follow through with cheese. Repeat procedures ending with cheese. Bake 30 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven. Cover with foil first 20 minutes to prevent cheese from burning.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut round steak in bite size pieces roll in flour and brown it. Put in large pot and simmer meat in soup onion and celery until meat is tender about 2 hours. After meat is tender put mushrooms in. About 30 minutes before you want to serve add sour cream. If you need more liquid add more soup. Serve over rice noodles or potatoes.

title: Butter Roll Delicious
instructions: Cream together butter with half cup sugar. Mix together and bring to a boil 1/2 cup milk water nutmeg and vanilla. Make a dough out of flour baking powder salt shortening and 1/2 cup milk. Roll out 1/8-inch thick. Spread butter and sugar mixture over this then roll dough as for jelly roll. Cut into 1-inch rolls and place in large shallow greased baking dish. Pour the syrup over this and bake at 375\u00b0 until syrup thickens about 30 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon before baking if desired. Makes 12 servings.

title: Glorified Rice
instructions: Cook rice; drain rinse and set aside to cool for at least 1 hour. Mix Dream Whip as directed on package. Fold in pineapple cherries and sugar. Blend in rice and chill.

title: Lit'L Smokies Corn Wraps
instructions: 1) Separate dough into 16 strips; cut each strip in half.

title: Five Minute Fudge
instructions: Combine Carnation milk with sugar in a saucepan. Heat on medium heat to boiling. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Pour into a buttered pan and cool.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Cool and remove skin and bones. Place chicken in a long baking dish. Add salt and pepper and dot with butter or margarine. Save the chicken broth in which chicken was cooked. Mix the cream of chicken soup 1/4 cup of chicken broth and the milk. Pour this over the chicken. Saute the celery and onion in butter or margarine. Add to this the Pepperidge Farm dressing the beaten egg and 2 1/2 cups of the chicken broth. Spread this over the chicken and soup layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Salsa
instructions: Process in blender for 10 seconds or desired consistency. Simmer 1 hour. Cool then store covered in refrigerator. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Heavenly Nut Cake
instructions: In saucepan combine milk butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Bring to boil. Then mix into remaining ingredients and blend together. Pack into pan with stem that has been buttered well and refrigerate overnight.

title: Coconut Macaroons
instructions: Combine all dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Mix well. Add water honey and flavoring into dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Roll into balls and press with a fork. Spray cookie sheet with Pam and place cookies on it. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Yields 24 cookies.

title: Quick And Easy Casserole
instructions: Quickly saute the cooked ham in butter cream basil salt and pepper. Place the macaroni in a well oiled casserole dish. Set ham on top. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbs. Place casserole in a 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Buttermilk Waffles
instructions: Mix all ingredients but oil until well blended. Add oil and beat until smooth. Pour onto hot waffle iron; cook until golden brown.

title: Pinto-Cornbread Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Drain. Put into large rectangle baking dish. Layer the beans. Layer the sauce. Pour cornbread mix on top. Bake until bread browns at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Rice Pilaf
instructions: Place a marshmallow on top of half a graham cracker. Microwave on High for 10 to 15 seconds. Immediately top with half of a 1.5 ounce chocolate bar.

title: Liverwurst Spread
instructions: Slightly soften liverwurst and cream cheese. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Make a few days in advance. Serve with party rye bread.

title: Jam Cake
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar beating together well. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time beating well after addition. Add jam and beat. Sift flour salt and spices together. Add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk alternately to cream mixture beating after each addition. Bake in greased and floured 9-inch tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine liquids. Freeze some in a ring mold to keep punch cold.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef chopped onion and chopped green pepper together; drain off grease. Mix with beans tomato sauce ketchup steak sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Put in a cake pan; sprinkle black pepper all over. Prepare corn bread according to directions on the package; add sugar. Pour batter evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 1/2 hour or until cornbread is browned.

title: Broccoli-Bacon Salad
instructions: Cook and drain bacon. Crumble; reserve 1/3 for salad top. Wash drain and pat dry the broccoli. Slice onion in thin rings. Combine broccoli onion 1/2 cup cheese (reserving 1/2 cup to put on top of salad) raisins and 2/3 of bacon bits. Blend mayonnaise lemon juice and sugar to make dressing. Mix dressing with other ingredients and marinate overnight. When ready to serve toss lightly and top with reserved cheese and bacon bits.

title: Family'S Favorite Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Store in refrigerator. Shake when serving.

title: Bagel Pizza
instructions: Place bagels on baking sheet. Spread with tomato sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (lightly) oregano basil garlic powder pepper and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Margie'S Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 9-inch pie pan. Mix all ingredients and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Enough for 2 pies.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough. Scrub and wash. Cut potatoes into the skin in thin slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in a baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Blueberry Delight
instructions: Combine ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven. Cool and refrigerate.

title: Banana Split Smoothie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender except yogurt. Cover and process until smooth. Add yogurt. Process until blended. Serve immediately.

title: Rice Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients except oleo in a rice cooker. Put oleo in pats over the top of mixture. Cook according to rice cooker instructions.

title: T.V. Mix
instructions: Melt butter in a very large baking pan. Pour rest of ingredients over butter and stir very well. Bake 2 hours in 200\u00b0 oven stirring every 20 minutes.

title: Avocado Salad
instructions: Sprinkle avocado with 2 to 3 tablespoons lemon juice and salt; toss gently to coat. Combine avocado olives and celery; mix gently. Combine mayonnaise and 1 tablespoons lemon juice; mix well. Stir mayonnaise mixture into rest of mixture. Serve salad on lettuce leaves; garnish with egg quarters and pimiento strips. Makes 6 servings.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Layer corn and crushed saltine crackers in a buttered casserole dish. Cover with milk and put pats of butter across the top. Bake until golden and not soggy. Serve hot.

title: Scalloped Tomatoes
instructions: Cook onion in butter until tender but not brown. Stir in bread crumbs. In a 1-quart casserole layer half the tomatoes; sprinkle with salt pepper and sugar. Cover with half the crumb mixture. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Breaded Pasta
instructions: Heat oil in medium skillet. Add garlic and saute. Add bread crumbs and cook until browned. Add pasta and stir. Cook until hot.

title: Skillet Steak And Rice
instructions: Pound steak; cut into serving size pieces. In skillet brown steak in shortening and pour off fat. Add soup water wine onion and salt. Cover and cook over low heat 1 hour and 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Add rice and Brussels sprouts bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover. Cook 10 minutes or until done. Makes 4 servings.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except sherbet together. Add 1 can of water for the pink lemonade and 1 can of water for the orange juice. Make an ice mold of fruit punch and raspberries. Add the sherbet just before serving.

title: Mixed Vegetable Salad
instructions: Cook or heat vegetables onion and beans then drain. Combine other ingredients and cook until clear. Pour over vegetables. Let set for 8 hours.

title: Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Stir together first four ingredients. Add melted butter; mix until crumbly. Pat into an ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Cream together the cream cheese and 1/3 cup sugar. Add egg lemon peel and lemon juice; mix well. Pour over baked layer. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with the 2 tablespoons graham crackers. Cool; cut into bars. Store in refrigerator. Makes 36.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Blend ingredients and serve by the teaspoonfuls into cups of boiling water. Store in airtight container.

title: Graham Cracker Cookies
instructions: Place a layer of graham crackers in the bottom of a cookie sheet. Beat the egg. Add butter sugar and milk. Heat until thick. Add graham cracker crumbs. Cool. Pour this mixture over the layer of graham crackers. Top with another layer of graham crackers. Cut into squares and add icing.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Beat egg. Mix in sugar and melted margarine. Sift together flour baking powder and salt. Add to sugar and margarine mixture alternately with milk. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven about 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 14 to 16 small muffins.

title: Terrific Taco Biscuit Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Separate dough into 10 biscuits. Arrange 7 biscuits around sides and 3 on bottom of ungreased 9-inch pie pan. Press biscuits to form crust (biscuits will form petal-like shape around rim of pan).

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Add cheese sour cream and salts. Beat; add chives. Sprinkle with paprika. Dot with butter. Bake in a 2-quart casserole dish at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels margarine and 1/4 cup sugar in bowl; mix well. Press into baking pan (9 x 12-inch) and bake at 375\u00b0 for 5 minutes. Cool. Beat cream cheese and 1 cup sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon over pretzel layer. Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Stir in strawberries. Spread over cream cheese layer. Chill until gelatin is set.

title: Lemon Pie(Yields 1 Pie)
instructions: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan with butter lemon rind lemon juice and egg yolks. Stir in milk and cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and cool. Fold in sour cream. Place in baked shell. Use egg whites 1/4 cup sugar and cream of tartar. Make meringue and ice pie. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown. Chill 2 hours.

title: Company Cole Slaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and carrots. Add pineapple and marshmallows then commercial salad dressing with leftover pineapple juice and toss cole slaw.

title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
instructions: Mix together the coconut and nuts. Put in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix according to directions. Pour over coconut and pecan mixture.

title: *Custard Pita(Pita Di Lapti)
instructions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place cooked noodles in pan covering bottom of pan. Beat eggs and add balance of ingredients. Slowly pour into pan over noodles which should not float. Place in preheated 400\u00b0 oven. Bake 1 hour.

title: Southern Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven at 375\u00b0. Combine first four (4) ingredients. Add eggs and pecans to first mixture mixing thoroughly. Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool and serve.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: In casserole dish layer beans onions bacon beans onions....etc. Add sugar and vinegar to bacon drippings until dissolved. Pour over layered green beans and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: In a small bowl mix beef broth with cornstarch and teriyaki sauce. In a large skillet or wok heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat; add asparagus pepper and onions; stir-fry until tender-crisp. Remove to bowl. Add remaining oil and beef; stir-fry until cooked. Add beef broth mixture and cook stirring constantly until thickened; add vegetables and toss. Serve in warm pastry shells.

title: Pineapple-Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl on medium speed for about 2 minutes. Bake in tube pan (one with lift out bottom is best) for about 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
instructions: Bring water to a boil; add salt and macaroni. Cook for 7 minutes stirring occasionally. Reduce heat; add margarine cheese and pepper. Stir to melt cheese. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Quick Chili
instructions: Melt shortening in heavy skillet. Add onions and cook until brown. Add ground beef and brown. Stir frequently so there will be no lumps of meat. Add green pepper tomato soup salt chili powder black pepper red pepper and kidney beans. Heat mixture thoroughly and serve piping hot. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cornmeal Griddle Cakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk oil and egg yolks. Blend well.

title: Chili Con Queso Dip
instructions: Heat chilies tomatoes and onion. Add cheese. Cook 1 minute on high. Stir and continue cooking for 7 to 8 minutes. Serve with chips.

title: Hamburger And Potato Hot Dish
instructions: In a casserole or small roaster place hamburger. Add potatoes and soups. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour until potatoes are done.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients except flavoring in saucepan. Cook over medium heat until thickened 25 to 30 minutes stirring often. Add salt if needed. Add flavoring and dried fruit if desired. Serve hot or cold.

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Combine the sugar flour and nutmeg. Add fruit. Mix well and let stand 20 minutes. Spoon into (9-inch) pie crust. Dot with butter. Put on top crust. Moisten edge of crust to form seal. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 45 minutes.

title: Apple-Carrot-Pineapple Dessert
instructions: Make the jello to box directions. (Pineapple juice can be used along with water.) Let jello cool until it starts to thicken then add the rest of the ingredients and chill in refrigerator.

title: Nonfat Yogurt Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Spray 6 large or 12 regular size muffin tins with baking spray. Fill batter 3/4 way up. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

title: No Fail Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream together sugar syrup and butter. Ad eggs one at a time and beat well. Fold in vanilla and pecans. Pour into an unbaked pie shell. Do not preheat oven. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes or until center is firm.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Slice cucumbers & onions. Cover with salt & ice. Let stand 3 hours. Drain & put in gallon jar. Dissolve sugar vinegar celery seed turmeric & alum. Pour over cucumbers & onion & put in refrigerator. They are ready to eat in 7-10 days. Can be kept in refrigerator for a long time. I have had them for a year.

title: Barbecue Beef(30 Buns)
instructions: Dump into big roaster pan. Cover. Bake 6 hours at 300\u00b0. After 3 hours take forks and shred. Remove fat and bones. Every hour or so do this until all is removed.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Basting a turkey all night is \for the birds!\ Rub thawed turkey with melted butter. Stuff it with onion celery and potato; salt and pepper bird. Place in covered container. Add 5 to 6 cups hot water. Cover pan with foil then put lid on. Preheat oven to 500\u00b0. Place pan in oven and bake at 500\u00b0 for 1 hour then turn oven off and leave overnight (dont open oven door!).

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt bars with marshmallows. Add milk and Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust; let set. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Veal Saute With Dutchess Potatoes
instructions: Mix flour 2 teaspoons salt the paprika and pepper. Coat veal with mixture. Cook veal in hot oil in 12-inch skillet until brown; drain. Add wine water onions carrots and rosemary. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until veal and vegetables are tender about 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix together the eggs oil sugar and zucchini. Add vanilla. Gradually add flour soda cinnamon raisins and nuts. Put into 2 loaf pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients except lettuce. Chill thoroughly. Serve on lettuce. Makes about 6 servings.

title: Sausage Bread
instructions: Allow dough to rise until nearly doubled. Meanwhile in a skillet over medium heat cook and crumble sausage. Add garlic powder and chopped onion. Cool. Roll bread dough into a 16 x 12-inch rectangle pan. Spread the sausage mixture over dough to within 1-inch of edge. Spread Mozzarella cheese on top of sausage mixture. Use as much cheese as you desire. Roll jelly style and seal edges of roll with your hands. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

title: Pink Lemonade Pie
instructions: In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy; gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk then lemonade concentrate and food coloring if desired. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Chill 4 hours or until set. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Overnight Rolls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Knead well and cover dough. Every hour for 5 hours knead the dough down again. Then shape the dough into hamburger buns or rolls. After they rise (I wait until morning) bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes or light golden brown.

title: Chicken Salad
