instructions: Drain chicken well and flake into bowl. Add onion eggs green pepper and pickles (to individual taste). Add enough mayonnaise to hold together. Taste and salt if needed. Chill overnight to allow flavors to marry. Just before serving add almonds and mix well. Do not add almonds sooner as they will soften.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix and blend together well first 4 ingredients. Add chopped onion. Spread mixture on flour tortillas and roll up. Chill for 1 hour. Slice into round sections and serve.

title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with sour cream. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Lemon Chicken
instructions: Put oil and melted butter in 13 x 1/2 x 2-inch pan. Shake chicken pieces in bag containing flour salt pepper and paprika. Place chicken in pan skin side down. Bake for 30 minutes at 425\u00b0. Turn chicken skin side up. Return to oven for 15 minutes. Spoon lemon sauce over chicken pieces and return to oven for 15 minutes.

title: Polish Mistakes
instructions: Brown hamburger meat and sausage; drain. Melt in Velveeta over low heat. Add dash of garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon onto bread. Bake for a few minutes at 250\u00b0 to melt onto bread. Serve hot or can be frozen to bake at a later time.

title: Tom'S White Chili
instructions: In small frypan over medium heat in hot salad oil cook onion garlic and cumin until onion is tender. Put all ingredients into a crock-pot (except cheese and Tabasco sauce). Simmer overnight or make in the morning and cook while youre at work! Make sure chicken is cooked thoroughly at least 4 to 5 hours on high simmer. Add hot pepper sauce to taste and garnish with shredded cheese. Great with corn bread and a real hit at Superbowl parties! Makes approximately 8 main dish servings. Lo-Cal too!

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and add orange juice. Refrigerate until partly congealed. Add mandarin oranges (drained) and crushed pineapple (drained). Chill until firm. Mix lemon instant pudding pie filling to directions on box and fold in Cool Whip. Pour over Jell-O mixture.

title: Savory Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Cook onions and garlic in bacon grease or oil in skillet for 5 minutes. Add chuck; cook stirring occasionally until meat loses its red color. Stir in salt pepper and tomatoes. Simmer covered for 30 minutes. Discard garlic. Add chili powder and water. Break half of the uncooked spaghetti into greased 2-quart casserole dish. Pour on half of sauce; sprinkle with half of cheese. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes at 325\u00b0. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer or until brown. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cheese Biscuits
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and salt in a bowl. Mix Crisco into flour mixture with blender or a fork until the mixture looks like coarse cornmeal. Stir in grated cheese. Add milk to Crisco-flour mixture. Mix enough to hold dough together. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick. Cut and bake on ungreased cookie sheet in 425\u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.

title: Fruit Kabobs In Honey Mustard
instructions: In a medium bowl stir together the vinegar honey poppy seed and mustard. Cut any large slices of plum or nectarine. Add plum nectarine strawberries and grapes to the vinegar mixture. Toss until coated. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Drain fruit; keep marinade. Put fruit onto skewers (can use bamboo). Brush with marinade before serving.

title: Easy Chocolate Fondue
instructions: *Suggested fondue dippers Angel food or pound cake squares; banana apple or pineapple chunks strawberries seedless grapes or marshmallows.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook spinach according to directions. Drain well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill. May serve in a hollowed out loaf of French bread or a round loaf of sourdough bread using cut out bread pieces for dipping.

title: 7-Up Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortening butter and sugar together. Add eggs and continue beating. Add flour alternately with extracts and 7-Up. Pour in a large greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done at 325\u00b0.

title: Hot Water Corn Bread
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Remove from heat. Add corn meal and salt. Mix briskly with a spoon until mixture is smooth and thickened. Mixture should be thick enough to hold its shape when dropped from spoon. Heat skillet with oil until hot. Spoon a big tablespoonful of corn meal mixture into hot skillet and cook for about 6 to 8 minutes turning once until bread is brown and crispy.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Boil and debone chicken. Cook rice and drain; mix all remaining ingredients together. Bake in casserole pan at 325\u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Shred favorite cheese and sprinkle on top. Serve hot.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Dump the pineapple in a 9 x 13-inch lightly greased pan. Dump the cherry pie filling over the pineapple and spread evenly. Sprinkle the cake mix over the cherry pie filling. Sprinkle the nuts over the cake mix. Cut the butter in slices and place over the cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream is nice!

title: Rhubarb Pie
instructions: Drain rhubarb after you barely heat it. Add butter. Stir sugar flour and eggs together. Pour over rhubarb that you have placed in an uncooked crust. Bake slow. Dont forget to sprinkle some flour on crust before you put rhubarb in the crust. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix in egg white apple juice concentrate and melted butter. Add flour and baking soda; mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray.

title: Hot Pepper Relish
instructions: Wear plastic gloves to work with this mixture.

title: Yummy Good Cake
instructions: In large mixing bowl combine ingredients. Mix together well. Pour into graham cracker crust and top with a few crumbs.

title: Cracker Cookies
instructions: Line a well-greased cookie sheet with soda crackers. Boil oleo and brown sugar for 2 1/2 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake in oven for 10 minutes at 350\u00b0. Immediately put chocolate bits on top. When melted spread out. When cooled remove from cookie sheet.

title: Sweet Nothings
instructions: Combine eggs half and half and salt in mixing bowl and mix well. Stir in enough flour to form a stiff dough. Knead on floured surface for 10 minutes. Pinch off marble-sized portions and roll each portion thin. Deep-fry in 375\u00b0 oil until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Impossible Turkey Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Lightly grease a 10-inch pie plate. Sprinkle turkey mushrooms onions salt and cheese in pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and a knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

title: Play Dough
instructions: Combine and stir until smooth. Cook on top of stove 3 minutes. Stir constantly. Take off burner and let sit. It will look like you messed up but after it sits 20 minutes or so mix it up (with hands). Its the best play dough Ive ever come across.

title: Broken Ice Glass Cake
instructions: Mix 1 1/2 cups boiling water per package of flavored gelatin. Pour each mixture in separate pie pans. Chill until set.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Sprinkle rice in bottom of 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Heat soup and milk. Pour over rice. Arrange chicken over this and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Caramel Dip
instructions: Blend ingredients until smooth. Serve dip with sliced apples.

title: Apple Tart(Easy)
instructions: Beat eggs vanilla and sugar together. Mix flour baking powder and salt; add dry ingredients to egg mixture. Add sliced apples and walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 in shallow greased pan (9 x 13-inch) for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Buttermilk Pancake Batter
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Whisk until blended. In a medium bowl combine buttermilk milk eggs and melted butter. Whisk until blended. When your griddle pan is hot and ready to cook pancakes add buttermilk mixture to the dry ingredients. Mix vigorously with a wooden spoon just until blended. Dont overmix the batter; a few flour lumps are okay.

title: Delicious Cheese Cake
instructions: Line spring-form pan with ladyfingers. Mix together cream cheese sugar egg yolks vanilla and lemon juice. Add sour cream then fold in beaten whites of eggs. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour. Leave in open oven 1 hour. Leave in open oven 1/2 hour.

title: Greek Fried Meatballs(Keftethes)
instructions: Brown onion in a little butter. Place onions in a mixing bowl and add meat bread crumbs eggs and seasonings. Blend well and shape into size desired. Roll lightly in flour and fry in very hot oil or butter.

title: Giblet Gravy
instructions: Simmer in pan just before serving dinner. Excellent for turkey dressing.

title: Philly 15 Minute Cheesecake
instructions: Combine together and press into the bottom of a spring-form pan.

title: Cabbage Soup
instructions: Combine cabbage and smoked sausage. Cover with water. Cook until cabbage is cooked stirring occasionally. Drain 3/4 of the water off. Add soups and milk; stir. Heat only until hot. Makes about 12 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

title: Shredded Yams
instructions: Shred yams into gallon of water with salt added. Combine sugar syrup and\twater in a heavy saucepan and cook until a light syrup forms.\tDrain potatoes rinse and pat dry. Place in a\t12 x 6 x 3-inch Pyrex dish. Pour pineapple juice over potatoes then the cooked syrup. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 about\t40 to 50 minutes or until potatoes are translucent.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Spray a 9 x 13 in. baking dish. Pour in and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until done.

title: Golden Fizz Drink
instructions: Mix apple juice orange juice concentrate and carbonated water. Pour over crushed ice and top with lemon slice.

title: Avocado Stuffed With Pimientos
instructions: Drain the pimientos and pat dry then chop fine. Place them in a bowl with the onion. Combine the oil vinegar pepper lemon juice and salt. Pour over the pimientos and onion. Marinate for about 1/2 hour. Cut the avocados in half and remove the seeds. Place each half on a crisp lettuce leaf on a flat salad plate. Spoon the pimiento mixture evenly into the avocado halves. Do not peel the avocado! To eat scoop the avocado pulp toward the center with the fork and mix with the pimiento stuffing.

title: German Chocolate Pie
instructions: Melt chocolate and margarine in microwave. Then mix all ingredients except coconut and pecans in mixing bowl. Mix well. Then fold in coconut and pecans. Pour into pecan shells. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spanakopeta (Spinach Pie)
instructions: Chop spinach cook briefly to reduce bulk. Cool; add to eggs spices and cheese.\tUndo the package of filo cover pastry with towel. Place\t1 sheet at a time in 9 x 13-inch jelly roll pan (butter). Do\t10 to\t12 sheets then spread spinach mixture on\tthem. Sprinkle with olive oil.\tCover with remaining sheets buttering each one. Cut\ton the diagonal then vertically. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Burritos
instructions: Mix together the cream of mushroom soup and sour cream; put in bottom of roaster. Fry hamburger; mix taco seasoning and refried beans with meat. Put mixture on top of first layer. Put soft tacos on top of that layer. Bake for 1 hour then add cheese. When ready to serve add lettuce and tomatoes.

title: Christmas Eggnog(Makes 25 Cups)
instructions: Beat separately 6 egg yolks and whites. Add 1/4 cup sugar to yolks while beating. Beat whites stiff and then add 1/4 cup sugar. Mix yolks and whites carefully. Stir in heavy cream and milk. Mix in vanilla. Add whiskey rum and brandy. Stir thoroughly. Serve very cold with grated nutmeg.

title: Barbecue Cups
instructions: Brown ground meat and onion in skillet. Drain. Add barbecue sauce (and brown sugar and Ranch Style beans if desired). Press biscuits into a muffin tin forming a cup. Fill with meat mixture. Top with cheese. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Mix food coloring and cocoa. Let stand. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs then coloring and cocoa mixture. Beat well.

title: Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: In a covered Dutch oven or saucepan simmer beef in water for 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Drain cooking liquid reserving 3/4 cup. Cool beef; shred and return to Dutch oven. Add cabbage barbecue sauce ketchup Worcestershire sauce horseradish mustard and the reserved cooking liquid. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Serve warm in buns. Serves 10.

title: Spanish Bean Soup
instructions: Combine ham bone beef bone bacon potatoes onions and water in stock pot. Cook until vegetables are almost tender. Add undrained beans pepperoni and saffron. Stir in salt to taste. Simmer for 45 minutes or to desired consistency adding additional water as needed. Remove bones. Cut off meat and return to soup. Heat to serving temperature. Ladle into soup bowls.

title: Rumaki
instructions: Drain water chestnuts. Mix soy sauce brown sugar and water. Put water chestnuts in marinade and let set at least 6 hours in refrigerator.

title: Crispy Rice Krispie Cookies
instructions: Mix together flour baking soda and salt. Blend butter and sugar thoroughly. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients and mix in Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 13 minutes.

title: Easy Crispy Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan combine apricot preserves mustard and curry powder. Cook over low heat stirring constantly until preserves are melted. Dip chicken in apricot mixture then roll in cashews. Place chicken in a greased 15 x 10 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is done. Bring remaining sauce to a boil. Serve sauce with chicken.

title: Easy Strawberry Salad
instructions: Put pineapple in a small saucepan and cook 2 minutes. Add jello and cook 2 more minutes. Combine cottage cheese and Cool Whip. Then add to cooled gelatin and pineapple mixture. Chill.

title: Stove Top Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix meat crackers onions eggs salt pepper and 1/3 can tomato soup together. Make big patties. Cook in shortening on medium heat until brown on bottom. Turn and reduce heat to low for approximately 30 minutes. Add water and mustard to soup until can is full. Stir well. Once meat is brown all the way through add soup mixture and baste. Place cheese slices on top of patties and baste until cheese is melted.

title: Icebox Fruit Cake
instructions: Melt marshmallows in\tmilk stirring constantly. Mix with rest of ingredients. Pack in a buttered loaf dish.

title: Sausage Cheese Balls
instructions: Mix Bisquick and water. Add remaining ingredients to Bisquick mixture; make into balls. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until light brown.

title: Mexicali Meat Loaves
instructions: Combine meat egg 1/4 cup tomato sauce 2 tablespoons of green chilies 1 tablespoon minced onion chili powder and salt; mix well. Shape to form 4 x 2-inch loaves. Place in 8-inch square baking dish. Bake in preheated moderate oven (375\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix and drop on greased sheet and flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Chicken Oriental
instructions: Rinse pea pods. Mix pea pods soup milk chicken onions celery and chestnuts in a 3-quart saucepan. Boil and continue stirring. Keep warm. Mix Bisquick water and soy sauce until dough-like (20 vigorous strokes). Roll dough and cut into squares. Pour mixture into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with squares and spread with melted butter. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake approximately 15 minutes at 425\u00b0 (or until golden brown).

title: Apple Butter
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large cooker. Cook 30 minutes. Pour into hot jars and seal. Really good and easy.

title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
instructions: In Dutch oven brown beef and onion. Add all other ingredients except parsley; bring to boil and simmer covered 1 hour. May garnish with parsley. This freezes well.

title: Festive Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Spoon into lightly greased 8-inch pan.

title: Cheesy Wiener Wheel
instructions: Spread a small amount of tomato paste on cracker. Cut slice of cheese into 1/4s. Place cheese on cracker. Cut wiener in slices and place on cheese. Bake in oven until cheese melts. Great for kids snacks!

title: Tamale Cheese Dip
instructions: Saute yellow onion in butter first. Then combine remaining ingredients to the pan; mix and melt all ingredients together and serve in a crock-pot.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes with skins on. Peel and cut into medium size pieces. Brown onion and green pepper in butter. Add soup. Simmer several minutes. Stir mixture into prepared potatoes and bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly on top.

title: Broccoli Bake
instructions: Drain cooked broccoli. Combine soup mayo eggs and onion to broccoli in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Sprinkle cheese on top. Melt oleo and add stuffing. Pour on top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can be made ahead and frozen.

title: Chicken And Coke
instructions: Spray crock-pot with Pam. Skin and wash chicken. In crock-pot put chicken Coke ketchup and chopped onion. Cook 6 hours on low. Serve over rice. (Pick bones out before serving.) Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Giant Chewy Peanut Butter And Apple Cookies
instructions: Beat peanut butter and margarine with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Add sugar and half of flour egg whites milk and baking soda. Beat well. Stir in remaining flour; add oats and apple. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls on greased cookie sheet; flatten slightly with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes until brown. Remove cool on wire rack. Store in moistproof container. Can freeze up to 6 months. Makes 16 to 18 cookies.

title: Taco Pie
instructions: Brown hamburger; drain grease. Add olives and stir in taco seasoning and water. Cover and let simmer for several minutes. Line a Pyrex pie plate or oblong dish with crescent dinner rolls. Top with crumbled corn chips. Add hamburger mixture and top with sour cream. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Top with more corn chips. Bake in 375\u00b0 oven for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Margarita Fajitas
instructions: Slice partially frozen round steak into thin long strips. Marinate 2 hours in flat dish with mixture of tequila and lime juice. After draining tequila and lime marinade mix cooking oil liquid smoke Worcestershire sauce pepper salt and paprika and marinate meat covered for four days.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Bake cake and let cool. Put about 1/3 of the cake in bottom of bowl. Begin to layer each remaining ingredient using 1/3 of each item. This includes the cake. When you finish using all the ingredients the first time begin another layer until you use all ingredients. Top off with the coconut.

title: Chicken Souffle
instructions: Melt margarine and saute celery and onion; blend with stuffing mix and broth. Set aside. Mix chicken mayonnaise salt and pepper (just a touch). Layer half of stuffing mix in an 8 x 12-inch pan. Top with all of chicken mix and then the remaining stuffing mix. Mix eggs with milk and pour evenly over the chicken mix. Refrigerate overnight. One-half hour before baking spread mushroom soup over casserole. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 12.

title: Kathy'S Cranberry Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender; process until smooth. This sauce is excellent on any barbecue meats and poultry.

title: Hot Bacon Dressing
instructions: Cube and brown the bacon and pour off the grease. Beat together eggs vinegar and water. Mix cornstarch sugar and salt separately. Add bacon and liquid ingredients to saucepan on medium heat. Add dry ingredients stirring constantly with whip until hot and thickened. Use over lettuce endive or tossed salad.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
instructions: Layer in a 9x13 pan all ingredients in the above order. Bake 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Orange Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Gradually add sugar beating at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition.

title: Creamy Garlic Dressing
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sour cream garlic powder and pepper together with a wire whisk until creamy. Gradually add the milk and beat until smooth. Refrigerate in a covered bowl for several hours. Dressing keeps well but may thicken as it stands. To thin add a little milk. Makes approximately 2 cups.

title: Beef Roast
instructions: Salt and pepper roast. Place in a baking pan. Pour mushroom soup dry onion soup mix and water over roast. Cover and bake at 300\u00b0 until done. (May add potatoes and carrots.)

title: Pat'S Favorite Spanish Rice
instructions: Brown onion and rice in oil in a large skillet. Add tomato green chilies seasoning and stock. Cover and simmer until rice is fluffy and moist. Make 6 to 8 servings.

title: Kielbasi Bourbon Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix ketchup brown sugar and bourbon together and let simmer over medium heat together until it comes to a boil. Turn heat down and simmer on low for 5 minutes. Toss kielbasi into mixture and let simmer for an additional 15 minutes. Serve with toothpicks.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Boil sugar milk and salt in Dutch oven pan to soft ball stage. Remove from burner. Add peanut butter and mix. Add jar of marshmallow. Put in buttered dish and let set.

title: Hamburger Hot Dish
instructions: Brown the hamburger and place in buttered casserole. Add the peas celery and onion. Thin the soup with the milk. Pour over the ingredients. Sprinkle the potato chips over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Cocoa Mix
instructions: Store ingredients in a dry can with a tight cover. To use fill cup 1/2 full with mix. Add boiling water.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix Crisco and sugar; add egg yolks flour baking powder vanilla and egg whites. Cut apples into thin wedges and put in batter on edge; sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top with bits of butter. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Stuffed Shells Italiano(Yield: 20 Servings, 2 Shells Each)
instructions: Cook pasta shells according to package directions. Hold in cold water until ready to fill. Combine garlic powder salt chicken bouillon and flour. Add milk gradually; blend with wire whisk until smooth. Bring to boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Stir in Mozzarella cheese. Set aside 2 cups of sauce. Combine eggs chicken onion mushrooms pimento spinach Parmesan cheese and pepper. Stir in 2 cups of reserved sauce. Place #30 scoop (approximately 2 tablespoons) of filling into each shell. Place 20 shells in each 12 x 10 x 2-inch steamtable pan. Spoon remaining sauce over shells. Cover with foil and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until heated thoroughly.

title: Yummy Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in their skins in salted water. Let cool. Peel and shred into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine remaining ingredients and cover potatoes. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes. Bake 5 minutes more until cheese bubbles.

title: 4 Layer Dessert
instructions: Layer 1 Cream the margarine and flour. Add the chopped walnuts. Pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0 and cool.

title: Memorial House Chicken
instructions: Combine soups with mayonnaise. Add onion water chestnuts or celery and chicken. If very thick add 1/4 to 1/2 cup chicken broth. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. About 10 minutes before it is done spread bread cubes over mixture and then sprinkle cheese on top. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Favorite Dressing For Salad
instructions: *I use 1 tablespoon parsley 1/2 teaspoon each chives celery salt paprika and garlic and salt and pepper.

title: Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix together the rice and onion soup mix. Add margarine in the water. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Pour enough oil into pot to cover bottom. Sprinkle in as much garlic salt as desired. When oil is hot add the rest of the ingredients. Simmer sauce for 2 hours stirring occasionally. After simmering for 2 hours sprinkle in about 1/4 cup Romano cheese and simmer for another 30 minutes. Pour over spaghetti.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Mix persimmons beaten eggs and milk together. Sift dry ingredients together and pour liquid mixture into them. Pour into shallow oiled pan to depth of 2-inches. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or until done. When cool cut into squares.

title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
instructions: Remove bone from cooked chicken and break chicken into bite size pieces. Layer in large deep dish casserole dish. Heat soups and milk; season. Then pour over chicken.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Combine flour sugar baking powder and salt; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add milk mixing with fork; shape into ball. On lightly floured surface roll out 2/3 of dough to fit a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Line dish with pastry; flute edges.

title: Chili Relleno Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Brown beef and onions; drain off grease. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Butterscotch Chewy Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with\trotary\tbeater\tin top of double boiler just until blended. Blend in brown sugar and butter.\tPlace over rapidly boiling water stirring\tconstantly until hot (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add all at once to cooked mixture; mix until well blended. Stir in\tchopped nuts. Turn into well-greased and lightly floured 13\tx 9-inch pan.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream or sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar while still warm.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Beat yolks of eggs until lemon color. Add condensed milk and beat again lightly. Add lime juice and beat until smooth. Pour mixture into pastry shell. Top with meringue.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken; chop in chunks. Keep broth. Dip tortillas in pint of warm broth. Grease casserole dish and line with tortillas overlapping. Layer ingredients in this order chicken onion pepper mushroom soup and chicken soup. Cover with grated cheese. Be sure casserole is completely covered. Then spread tomatoes (mash well so there are no lumps) over the cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. It should not be juicy.

title: Overnight Potato Bake
instructions: Boil potatoes. Mash with cream cheese and butter. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Refrigerate overnight in buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Mix the condensed milk lime juice and sour cream together. Make crust for pie using approximately 2 cups of cinnamon bear cookies. Mix with margarine until well blended. Press into a 9-inch pie plate. Pour filling into crust; then refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Cherry Cheesecake
instructions: Place 1 wafer in bottom of each of 12 paper-lined muffin pan cups. Beat cream cheese sugar and eggs in large bowl with electric mixer on medium until light and fluffy. Spoon filling into each cup filling about 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Turn off oven. Open door slightly. Let cool in oven. Remove. Cool completely. Top with pie filling. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Milky Way Cake
instructions: Melt candy bars with 1 stick oleo. In separate bowl cream together sugar and 1 stick oleo. Add alternately flour baking soda and buttermilk to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in melted candy mixture. Add nuts. Pour mixture into a greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done.

title: Zucchini Squash
instructions: Slice zucchini and saute in butter in skillet. Debone chicken (amount to taste) and add squash. Add stewed tomatoes. Season as you like and eat over rice.

title: Peanut Butter Candy Balls
instructions: Mix peanut butter butter sugar and Rice Krispies in a bowl. Roll well blended batter into balls and place on waxed paper covered cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add sherbet and juices. Chill. Mash oranges and fold into jello. Add crushed pineapple. Chill until firm. Top with sour cream and marshmallows mixed together.

title: Hamburger Quiche Pie
instructions: Brown beef. Drain grease on paper towel. Add to other ingredients. Pour into 2 unbaked 9-inch pie plates. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn to 350\u00b0 and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Crunch
instructions: Mix flour brown sugar and 1/4 cup white sugar. Spread in rectangular baking pan. Melt butter and pour over flour and sugar mixture stirring with a fork until completely moist. Bake at 400 degrees stirring every 5 minutes until golden brown (at least 20 minutes). Remove from oven and stir in pecans. Bake another 5 to 10 minutes to keep broken up. Remove and let cool.

title: Five Cup Salad
instructions: Sprinkle orange jello over mandarin oranges pineapple and cottage cheese. Fold in prepared envelope of Dream Whip.

title: Mini-Pizzas
instructions: Put Ritz crackers on a plate. On each cracker put one slice of pepperoni. Sprinkle grated cheese on top of the pepperoni. Put in the microwave and heat on High for 35 seconds.

title: Peach Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Generously grease two round (8 1/2-inch) pans. Drain peaches. Save syrup. Add enough water to syrup to measure 1 1/4 cups liquid. Prepare cake mix by package instructions except use the syrup mixture instead of water called for. Bake and cool.

title: Sweet And Sour Chicken(It'S Time For A Hawaiian Delight!)
instructions: In a small bowl combine 1/2 cup water cornstarch brown sugar and salt. Stir until mixture is smooth. Combine with reserved pineapple juice and brown sugar mixture in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat about 5 to 7 minutes until mixture starts to thicken. Add Chicken Mix soy sauce and vinegar. Cover and simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Put Chicken Broth and 2 cups water in a saucepan. Add rice. Cover and cook about 25 minutes. Add pineapple chunks onion slices and green peppers to Chicken Mix mixture. Cook until vegetables are slightly tender. Just before serving stir in tomato wedges. Serve over the hot cooked rice. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Kolache
instructions: Stir well. Roll out dough cut out with cookie cutter. Make small indentation in the middle of kolache. Put jelly or jam in the middle of the indentation. Put on pan and bake for 10 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Crab Imperial
instructions: Beat egg; blend in mayo. Add seasonings and stir until blended. Fold in green pepper pimento and crab. Bake at 350\u00b0 until top is brown. Serves 4.

title: Hot Dog Sauce
instructions: Brown onions and hamburger. Add all other ingredients except cornstarch. Let simmer for awhile then add cornstarch mixture and cook until thick. Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix Ranch and cream cheese. Beat. Add Cheddar and blend. Freeze 30 minutes. Shape into ball and roll in almonds.

title: Dill Pickles
instructions: Sterilize quart jars. Fill jars with seasonings and cucumbers. Add boiling liquid. Seal jars. Cold pack in canner for 20 minutes.

title: Mini Cheesecakes
instructions: Line cupcake pan with paper cupcake holders. Put vanilla wafer on bottom of each. Blend remaining ingredients and fill cupcake holders 1/2 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Top with cherry pie filling or any other topping.

title: Buried Treasure
instructions: Remove the grass and dirt it is growing in. Save top put on top later. Dig a hole 8-inches deep and 1 foot long and wide. Put the dirt on the board or wheel barrow to protect the ground. Drop your buried treasure in the hole. Be easy. Space the bulbs 4 to 6-inches apart with the points up. Cover with dirt. Replace the dirt and grass. Wait. The buried treasure will grow up to surprise you.

title: Margaret'S Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Prepare your favorite pancake batter. Dip teaspoon into batter and let excess drain off. Using the batter remaining on the spoon draw any letters or numbers on the hot greased griddle. Make the letters or numbers backwards. When the underside is lightly browned pour additional batter over the letters or numbers to form the pancake. Make certain batter covers all of the letters or numbers. Cook until bubbles appear; turn and brown second side. The letters or numbers will stand out being darker than the surrounding pancake. (You can make animal pancakes in much this same way.)

title: Cowboy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix sugar Crisco and eggs until creamy. Add flour then stir in nuts chocolate chips and oatmeal (will be stiff). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until brown. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

title: Rice Ortega
instructions: Saute onions in butter until light brown. Add the cooked rice jalapeno (if used) the cottage cheese Longhorn cheese and crumbled bay leaf. Alternate layers of rice mixture with strips of the chili peppers to form 4 layers in a greased casserole. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. Top with 1/2 cup grated Longhorn cheese. Bake for 10 minutes more. Serves 10.

title: Spoon Bread
instructions: Scald 1 cup of white corn meal with 1 1/2 cups of boiling water. Cool for 1 hour. Add the well beaten eggs milk baking powder salt and sugar. In baking dish put 1 tablespoon of butter and melt in a 400\u00b0 oven. Remove dish and swish butter around sides and bottom. Add batter and bake at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Watergate Salad
instructions: Combine instant pistachio pudding mix miniature marshmallows chopped nuts and crushed pineapple. Mix well. Blend in Cool Whip. Chill.

title: Polly'S Refrigerator Wheat Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Pour other water over Crisco and sugar. When cool to lukewarm add yeast eggs salt and flour. Put in greased bowl. Place in refrigerator and use as needed. Let rise until double after cutting. Bake at 400\u00b0 until brown.

title: Cheese Balls
instructions: Add sausage and Bisquick to cheese. Mix well. Form into small balls. Bake at 400\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Recipe may be doubled.

title: Cranberry Chutney
instructions: In large saucepan combine all ingredients except the ginger preserves. Cook over moderate heat until the mixture thickens and the cranberries pop 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Night Before French Toast Casserole
instructions: Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Arrange bread in pan. Beat together eggs milk sugar salt and vanilla. Pour over bread evenly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Before baking uncover and dot the top with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cut into squares and serve immediately with warm maple syrup.

title: Rock Hen Or Quail Italiano
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix the butter rosemary garlic and oregano. Brush on hens; season to taste with salt and pepper. Add a few dashes of paprika and Parmesan cheese. Wrap in foil; cook for 1 hour or until done inside. When meat is done open foil to brown. Serve with steamed rice. Pour butter juices from hen over rice before serving. (Can add chicken or beef bouillon to juice before adding to rice.) Serve with chilled white Zinfandel wine. Serves 2.

title: Hot Dog Chili
instructions: Brown hamburger. Drain. Add paste juice ketchup and sugar. Simmer for 30 minutes. Freezes great!

title: Holiday Spinach And Artichoke Party Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream and party dip mix in medium bowl. Stir in artichokes spinach and pimientos. Spray a 2-quart baking dish with Pam; spread mixture in pan. Bake in preheated 400\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. A big hit at any gathering!

title: Layered Cranberry Mold
instructions: Dissolve raspberry jello in boiling water; stir in 1 cup cold water. Pour 1 1/2 cups of this mixture in 6-cup mold. Chill until slightly firm. Reserve remaining jello. Do not chill. Beat 1/2 cup sugar and cream cheese until smooth. Add evaporated milk slowly and vanilla. Soften unflavored gelatin in remaining 1/4 cup cold water in small saucepan. Heat until gelatin dissolves. Blend into cream cheese. Spoon over jello in mold. Chill until slightly firm. Add remaining 1/2 cup sugar and cranberries to reserved raspberry jello. Stir until blended. Pour over cheese layer. Chill until firm; unmold.

title: Tortillas
instructions: Brown ground beef or chicken until done. Add taco seasoning mix plus 1/2 cup water refried beans and 1/2 bottle of salsa. Put in flour tortillas and top with cheese plus remaining amount of salsa.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and place in a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until brown on top. When you can see butter bubble in the top this will tell you it is not too dry.

title: Pie Pastry
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut in the butter and shortening until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Add the water 1 tablespoon at a time tossing until the dough forms a ball. Add more than 1/3 cup water if needed.

title: Hodgepodge
instructions: Brown ground beef and onions together and drain. Mix together all remaining ingredients in large pot. Add in beef and onion mixture and simmer covered for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 12 to 14.

title: Chocolate Crinkles
instructions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Cool. Sift flour baking powder and salt. Mix oil cooled chocolate and sugar in bowl. Beat eggs in one at a time. Add vanilla and sifted dry ingredients; mix well. Fold in chocolate chips. Chill covered for 4 hours. Preheat oven to 350. Roll mixture by teaspoonfuls in powdered sugar. Arrange on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 9-11 minutes or until cookies test done. Cool on cookie sheet for 5 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Melt oleo. Add rice milk cheese and vegetables. Mix. Pour in casserole (9 x 13-inch pan). Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Hawaiian Venison
instructions: Cut steaks in 1-inch cubes. Flour and brown in hot margarine. Add water and salt. Simmer until tender. Cut peppers in 1-inch squares. Boil 10 minutes and drain. Add peppers and pineapple to meat. Pour sauce over meat mixture. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over Chinese noodles or rice.

title: White Chocolate Party Mix
instructions: Combine last 6 ingredients and mix well. Melt chocolate in double boiler. Pour over mix and spread on wax paper. Let cool; break in pieces. Store in tight container and refrigerate.

title: Bean Salad(Oriole Maggard)
instructions: Toss lightly and chill. Serve with slotted spoon.

title: Sausage Swirls
instructions: Mix pastry ingredients (will be stiff). Roll into 10 x 18-inch thin rectangles. Spread sausage; roll from long side. Chill. Slice and bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked Ham With Pineapple
instructions: Remove and discard casing from ham. Score top of ham in a diamond design and stud with cloves. Place ham in a shallow baking dish. Arrange pineapple slices over top. Pour ginger ale over ham and evenly sprinkle each pineapple slice with cinnamon. Bake ham at 325\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Cut into 12 slices and serve. Yields 12 servings (1 slice each). Calories 174. Exchanges 2 medium-fat meat.

title: Vanilla Lemon Nutmeg Sauce
instructions: Mix first 2 ingredients in saucepan. Add boiling water; boil 1 minute. Add rest of ingredients as wanted. Good on plain cake or gingerbread.

title: Meat Loaf Parmesan
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs and milk. Add meat egg Worcestershire sauce salt cheese green pepper onion and garlic salt. Mix thoroughly. Pack into 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Low-Fat Orange Dream Cheesecake
instructions: Sprinkle crumbs on bottom of 8 or 9-inch spring-form pan (or 9-inch pie plate sprayed with Pam). Stir boiling water into Jell-O until completely dissolved. Cool 5 minutes. Pour into blender. Add cheeses; cover. Blend at medium speed until well blended. Scrape down sides occasionally. Pour into large bowl. Add whipped topping. Stir gently until blended. Pour into pan. Smooth top. Refrigerate 4 hours. Store in refrigerator. Makes 8 servings.

title: Marshmallow Pie
instructions: Prepare pie filling with 1/2 cup sugar and egg yolks by package directions. Prepare meringue with egg whites and remaining sugar. Fold meringue and marshmallows into pie filling. Pour into pie shell. Chill until firm.

title: Chicken And Brown Rice
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in 9 x 13-inch pan. Put chicken on top and pour dry onion soup mix over top. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Wild Turkey Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Philly Cheese Ball
instructions: Combine cheese softened cream cheese food and 2 tablespoons oleo. Mix until well blended. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Mold into preferred shape. Chill.

title: Spice Dream Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a large bowl then beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly. Cool right side up for about 25 to 30 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Cucumber Relish
instructions: Mix cucumbers onions and mangos; ground fine. Add 1/2 cup salt. Let stand overnight. Squeeze out with hand; add sugar vinegar and celery seed. Simmer 1 hour. Can in hot jars.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Slowly add enough buttermilk mixing well until dough is of right consistency to hold its shape when rolled into a ball. Drop in a couple of inches of hot grease and deep fry until brown and crispy. Drain on paper. Serve hot.

title: Letourneau Candy
instructions: Mix together and stir carefully sugar cream of tartar salt and 1 cup of cream. Wipe sides of bowl so no sugar sticks to sides. Cook mixture on medium heat stirring until it forms a soft ball when dropped into cold water or 238\u00b0. Slowly add second cup of cream to mixture as it continues to boil. Cook until it forms a soft ball again when dropped in cold water. Slowly add the Karo and continue cooking until soft ball stage. Slowly add the third cup of cream and continue boiling until it forms a hard ball when dropped into cold water or 248\u00b0. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into well buttered pan. Do not scrape bowl. Have a buttered dish set aside to pour scrapings into. When mixture is cool and well set turn it out on a cutting board and cut in small squares. Wrap each piece in waxed paper. Do not let it set too long or it will be difficult to cut.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until golden. Sprinkle with flour; add salt and pepper. Stir and cook about 3 minutes. Add hot milk slowly stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until it melts. Simmer covered about 15 minutes. Add tomato sauce and Tabasco sauce then simmer 10 minutes.

title: Saucy Broccoli Topper
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan combine soup cheese mustard and pepper. Over low heat heat until cheese is melted. Stir often. Add broccoli. Heat through. Stir often. Serve over potatoes.

title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
instructions: Place 1 cup uncooked rice in bottom of greased casserole dish. Lay pieces of fryer chicken on top of rice. Sprinkle with 1 package onion soup mix. Combine 1 can cream of chicken soup with milk and salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 1/4 hours. Cover with foil for first part of baking.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
instructions: Drain pineapple; mix juice brown sugar and Worcestershire to make marinade. Place chicken pieces in 13 x 9-inch glass baking pan; pour marinade over chicken and let stand 3 to 4 hours turning chicken occasionally. Remove about 1/2 to 3/4 cup marinade. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour basting often. Turn oven to 375\u00b0; add pineapple chunks and bake 7 to 10 minutes until chunks are glazed. Add toasted almonds. Serve over rice.

title: Yams And Apples
instructions: Peel potatoes and apples. Slice thin. In a large pot heat 1/4 cup water to boiling. Add potatoes and simmer for about 5 minutes. Add apples butter vanilla and cinnamon. Cook over low heat for about 5 minutes. Add syrup and cook until tender. Makes about 6 to 8 servings.

title: Pineapple Philly Pie
instructions: Blend 1/3 cup sugar with cornstarch; add pineapple. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is thick and clear. Cool. Place the cream cheese in a bowl and cream it until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in 1/2 cup sugar and salt. Add eggs stirring well after each egg is added. Blend in milk and vanilla. Spread cooled pineapple mixture over bottom of pie crust. Pour in cream cheese mixture and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes then reduce to 325\u00b0 for additional 50 minutes. Cool before serving.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Blend graham crackers and butter and press into pan. Mix confectioners sugar margarine eggs and vanilla together and beat mixture for 5 minutes. Spread over crust and chill overnight. Slice 3 or 4 bananas lengthwise. Drain 1 medium can of crushed pineapple and spread pineapple over the bananas. Spread Cool Whip over the bananas and pineapple. Top with nuts and cherries and refrigerate.

title: Banana Nut Bars
instructions: Blend in a large bowl the margarine sugars eggs vanilla and bananas. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add flour mixture alternately with mashed bananas raw oats raisins and walnuts. Bake in a well greased pan at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and cut into squares.

title: Open Jar Dill Pickles
instructions: These ingredients do not need to be boiled. Put sliced cukes into one 2 quart canning jar. Pour the rest of the ingredients into the jar after mixing them in a separate bowl. Put cap on and let stand on counter for 3 to 4 days. Refrigerate. They should be ready to eat. You will find they are delicious.

title: Monster Cookies
instructions: Blend together sugar peanut butter butter eggs baking soda syrup and salt; mix well. Add oatmeal chips M&Ms and nuts. Mix well. Use ice cream scoop or large spoon to shape cookies. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes. Do not overbake!

title: Chili Dip
instructions: Combine chili and cream cheese in medium saucepan. Cook until cheese melts stirring occasionally. Stir in salsa and drained olives. Serve warm with chips. Yield 3 cups.

title: Cream Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together the cream cheese egg sugar and vanilla until smooth. Line bottom (not sides) of pan with 1 package of crescent roll dough. Pour in cream cheese mixture. Cover mixture with other package of dough. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Allow to cool before serving. Also good after being refrigerated.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Cover chicken well; salt and cook until tender. Stand in broth to cool. Then remove and debone. Save broth. Saute peppers in butter on low heat. Add chicken to water (broth) and cook. Add cheese and stir until melted. Add onions peppers tomatoes peas chopped chicken olives and pimentos. Mix well. Makes 2 large 13 x 9 casseroles. Bake until heated. Freezes well.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients. Put zucchini in last. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and shred. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix soup sour cream broth and dash of lemon juice together. Pour over chicken. Crumble crackers and mix with melted margarine. Place on top of casserole and bake for 30 to 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Slip out yolks and mash with fork. Mix in mayonnaise mustard salt and pepper. Fill egg whites with yolk mixture. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours.

title: Banana Shake
instructions: In blender container combine all ingredients except ice; blend well. Gradually add ice blending until smooth. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Janet'S Oven Beef Casserole
instructions: *If no mushrooms use cream of mushroom soup.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit And Nut Rice Casserole
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions (substitute chicken broth for water and omit butter). Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet melt 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat. Add cashews; cook for 2 minutes. Remove from skillet. Add celery and carrots; saute for 5 minutes in remaining butter. Remove from heat. Stir in rice cashews and remaining ingredients. Spoon into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Loosely cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes in preheated oven. Makes 6 servings.

title: Beef Barbecue
instructions: Put brisket in roasting pan. Add remaining ingredients to beef. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 5 to 6 hours. Reserve 1 cup juice. Let meat cool and refrigerate.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Pat into an 8 x 8-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. (I usually melt the butter in the oven then mix with a fork.)

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and cornstarch together. Add 7-Up. Cook until it comes to a boil. Cook on low until clear. Keep stirring; add jello. Pour over strawberries that have been placed in the pie shells. Top with Cool Whip and chill. Makes two pies.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs; add oil sugar vanilla and grated zucchini and beat again. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to batter and beat until smooth. Fold in nuts and coconut (reserving 1/2 cup to sprinkle over batter). Pour batter into 2 greased loaf pans and sprinkle with remaining coconut. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Hamburger Corn Pone Pie
instructions: Cook together ground beef onion and oil until done. Add chili powder salt Worcestershire sauce tomatoes kidney beans and corn bread batter on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan. Keep frozen.

title: Zucchini And Parmesan Casserole
instructions: Mix zucchini tomato green pepper and onion in a buttered casserole dish. In separate bowl mix flour salt pepper and Parmesan cheese. Pour over vegetables; mix well and dot with butter. Cube Velveeta over top. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Connie'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil breasts 1/2 hour then dice. Saute vegetables in butter. Cook noodles. Throw in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spray large baking dish with spray oil. Put uncooked rice in bottom of dish (you may want to use more rice). Pour chicken soup and 1 can liquid (water or milk) over rice. Place the deboned chicken on top. Place mushrooms over chicken then mushroom soup. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 until chicken is tender.

title: Cathedral Window Cookies
instructions: Place marshmallows and nuts in a large bowl; set aside. In a saucepan melt chocolate chips and butter over medium-low heat. Pour over marshmallow mixture and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Shape marshmallow mixture into a 12-inch roll; wrap in wax paper. Refrigerate up to 4 hours or until firm. Unwrap and cut into 3/8-inch slices; cut slices in half. Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

title: Monkey Bread
instructions: Warm butter and 1 cup sugar together in a saucepan. Cut biscuits into quarters. Shake each piece in a Ziploc Baggie with 1 1/2 cups sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. Line Bundt pan with a layer of biscuits. Pour some of the butter mixture over top; sprinkle with nuts. Put another layer of biscuits more butter mixture and nuts. Keep doing until all biscuits and butter mixture are gone. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cool inverted onto plate. Pull apart with fingers to eat. Makes 12 servings.

title: Mushroom Beef Roast
instructions: Sprinkle roast with salt pepper and garlic powder to suit taste; brown in oil or shortening and drain. Add desired amount of onions soup and beef stock; cover and simmer until tender 3 to 4 hours.

title: Marinated Steak
instructions: Mix together the wine sherry soy sauce and seasonings. Place the steak in a long glass baking dish and pour the marinade over the meat. Cover and chill at least 12 to 18 hours turning meat once or twice.

title: B & K Coney Sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and simmer 1 hour after it starts to cook. Can be frozen.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix sugar oil and eggs. Mix well. Combine flour salt soda spices and flavorings. Add nuts coconut and apples. Mix well. (Important to mix well.) Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Italian Crescent Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large skillet brown beef and onion; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Heat through.

title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
instructions: Blend together then set aside the cream cheese 1/3 cup sugar egg 1/8 teaspoon salt and chocolate chips. Mix in separate bowl the flour cocoa 1 cup sugar baking soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt. To this add water oil vanilla and vinegar; mix well. Fill paper liners 1/3 full with chocolate mixture. Spoon heaping teaspoonful cream cheese mixture on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until soft. Let cool. Add all the other ingredients. Mix well and chill before serving.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs in large bowl. Add sugar salt vanilla nutmeg and milk and mix well. Pour in unbaked pie crust. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0 and bake about 30 minutes or until a knife in center comes out clean.

title: Nana'S Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine with the sugar. Add eggs and sour cream. Add flour baking powder baking soda vanilla and lemon juice and mix thoroughly.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time and vanilla; beat. Gradually add flour soda and salt. Stir in oatmeal pecans and chocolate chips. Drop by spoon on well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Franya'S Corn And Potato Soup
instructions: Mix soup with corn using the corns liquid to dilute soup. Add green onion and pepper to taste; heat. Serve topped with bacon bits.

title: Pina Colada Fruit Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Blend 30 seconds. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Cream Cheese Ball
instructions: Form in ball; put in freezer 15 to 20 minutes. Roll in chipped beef (chopped). Very good.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix together in a large bowl shortening brown sugar white sugar vanilla and eggs. Add flour soda and salt in with the rest. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Hamburgers
instructions: Melt shortening in skillet. Add onion. Cook a few minutes. Add browned ground beef. Mix well. Add all other ingredients. Cook well.

title: Chicken Breasts
instructions: Thoroughly mix chicken and celery soup with rice. Spread on bottom of a large casserole. Place chicken breasts (unseasoned) on top. Sprinkle with dry onion soup over chicken. Cover very tightly with heavy foil. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours. Delicious!

title: Deviled Ham Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Spread deviled ham on the bottom of the pastry shell. Sprinkle cheese and onion on top of ham. In a bowl lightly beat eggs; beat in cream salt and nutmeg. Mix thoroughly. Pour mixture into pastry shell over cheese and onion. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted into center comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Makes 8 to 10 appetizer servings.

title: Slush Punch
instructions: Mix all but pop. Freeze thoroughly in large Tupperware container. Remove from freezer 1/2 hour before serving. Scoop or scrape into punch bowl as much as desired. Pour pop over and slightly mash with potato masher. Serve thick or thin. Add pop and scoop mixture as needed. Keeps in freezer for a few months. Just use leftovers as desired.

title: Onion Corn Bread
instructions: Mix well and pour into a well greased pan (or muffin tins). Bake at 400\u00b0 about 30 minutes or until brown on top.

title: Hamburger Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion. Add remaining ingredients except tomato juice. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Add tomato juice; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Bring onions to boil in 1 cup water. Add chili sauce ketchup and brown sugar and mix. Drop in meatballs. Cook for 1 hour.

title: Great Grapes
instructions: Give each child a cone to fill with grapes.

title: Summer Dessert
instructions: Bake cake in an 8 x 9-inch pan according to directions. Let cool. Mix pudding. Spread pudding on top of cake in the pan. Spread pineapple on top of pudding. Cover with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Bonbon Candy
instructions: Mix butter sugar milk coconut and pecans together. Let set 2 hours then roll into balls.

title: Dad'S Mexican Casserole
instructions: In a large skillet brown meat and onion. Add all other ingredients except cheese and chips in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Layer meat mixture and Doritos repeating until meat is all gone. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is all melted.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: After chicken is cooked reserve broth for cooking spaghetti. Do not drain. Saute onion bell pepper and mushrooms in margarine or butter. Add to spaghetti along with deboned chicken Ro-Tel tomatoes and cheese. (Cheese should be grated or cut in small pieces.) Mix thoroughly and place in casserole dish. Cook for an hour at 350\u00b0. Let set a few minutes before serving.

title: Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients adding milk and flour last. Pour into greased and floured pan. Put into cold oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Pina Colada Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Stir in buttermilk and cake mix. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake according to cake mix box directions. When done and still hot punch holes in the top. Pour Eagle Brand milk over the top. When cool pour coconut cream over the cake and top with Cool Whip. Store in refrigerator until serving time.

title: Chicken-N-Dumplings
instructions: Place chopped onion celery and carrots in large stock pot. Add cut up chicken and bouillon cubes. Cover with water. Cook until chicken falls off the bone. Remove bones. Bring broth to boil and add the Bisquick dumplings. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes. (Note This recipe calls for grated carrots but we like them better sliced or chopped.) Serves 6.

title: Green Chili Enchiladas
instructions: Brown meat. In a saucepan mix soup green chilies onions and cheese. After mixture is hot add browned meat. Layer casserole dish with tortillas and pour mixture over them.

title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
instructions: Prepare Minute rice and set aside. Cook slightly the frozen broccoli and drain; melt Velveeta butter and onion over low heat. Mix broccoli rice cheese and cream of mushroom soup and bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Many women like to make up enough dry mix for several pies. Use these amounts depending on how much mix you wish to keep on hand.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Put in 9 x 11-inch buttered baking dish the apples sugar and cinnamon. Mix remaining ingredients together. Sprinkle over apples. Work in 1/3 cup butter. Press lightly over sliced apples. Bake at 350\u00b0 until apples are done and topping is golden brown.

title: Mary'S Old Fashioned Corn Bread
instructions: First heat oven to 450\u00b0. Grease generously 12 medium muffin cups. Then beat eggs until fluffy. After that mix in the other ingredients until smooth. Pour batter into hot pans until almost full. Bake muffins for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve piping hot. Makes 12 servings.

title: Raspberry-Topped Lemon Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. In small saucepan combine raspberries and cornstarch; cook and stir until thickened and clear. In medium bowl beat egg yolks with sweetened condensed milk lemon juice and food coloring if desired. Pour into crust; bake 30 minutes. Spoon raspberry mixture evenly over top. Chill 4 hours or until set. Spread with whipped cream. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 1 pie.

title: Pot Pie Dough
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll out dough on floured surface. Cut into squares. Drop squares into prepared broth and cook 20 minutes.

title: Easy Lemon Pie
instructions: Mix all but last ingredient together. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill.

title: Hot Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the soup and potato chips. Place in a 2-quart casserole. Pour soup over top without mixing. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll in balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. These can be frozen.

title: Hoska
instructions: Scald milk. Stir in sugar salt oleo and vanilla. Cool to lukewarm. Put warm water into warm bowl and add yeast. Stir until dissolved. Stir in lukewarm milk mixture 2 eggs and 3 cups flour. Beat until smooth. Add enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic (about 10 minutes). Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in size (1 hour). Punch down. Turn out onto lightly floured board. Knead in raisins until well distributed. Bake as a loaf or form a braid. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Brush with melted butter.

title: No Fail Meringue
instructions: Cook 2 tablespoons of sugar cornstarch and water until clear. Cool and set aside. Beat egg whites adding remaining 5 tablespoons of sugar gradually. Add salt and cooled cornstarch mixture to egg whites and beat well. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Dorito Casserole
instructions: Brown beef and drain; add soup and Ro-Tel and stir well. Add beans and heat to boiling. Place Doritos in large casserole; cover with beef mixture and top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts about 15 minutes.

title: Mexican Cornbread
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Set aside. In another bowl combine buttermilk and eggs. Add corn and remaining ingredients. Pour over dry ingredients and stir until blended. Do not overmix. Pour batter into a greased 8-inch square baking dish or pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until bread tests done. Cool 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Russian Tea Cakes
instructions: Cream the butter in a large mixing bowl. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar beating until light and fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Combine flour salt and pecans; gradually add to creamed mixture blending well. Chill until firm. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Roll in additional powdered sugar while warm. Cool on wire racks. Roll again in powdered sugar. Yields about 4 dozen.

title: Yummy Cake
instructions: Mix and pour 1/2 of batter into tube pan. Pat 1/2 cup chocolate chips 1/2 cup nuts and miniature marshmallows on top of batter. Add remaining batter. Put on top of the batter 1/2 cup chocolate chips and 1/2 cup nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Goulash
instructions: Brown meat and saute onion. Add remaining ingredients; simmer for 1 hour.

title: 7-Layer Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce green pepper onion celery peas and cheese. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and sugar. Pour over all layers. Crumble bacon on top.

title: Tiny Pecan Tarts
instructions: Combine cream cheese and butter; blend in flour. Chill about 1 hour. Shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter. Press into lightly greased or sprayed tart pan or mini muffin pan.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles. Brown hamburger; drain. Add spaghetti sauce. Layer ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan starting with small layer of sauce then noodles then cheese then sauce ending in cheese on top. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted on top.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Make jello with boiling water and lemon juice. Cream the cheese and sugar; mix with jello mixture. Put your mixer bowl in freezer with Pet milk in it until ice forms around bowl. Beat until stiff peaks then fold into the lemon mixture.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce onion and bacon in order. Layer cauliflower on top. Spread sugar mayo Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper over the top. Cover tightly and chill overnight. Toss just before serving.

title: German Heaven And Earth
instructions: Boil potatoes in water for 10 minutes. Add apples and boil until tender. Drain and mash mixture. Add sugar and lemon juice. Add butter spices and mix well. Cook bacon and crumble; set aside. Saute onion. Mix onion with bacon and sprinkle over mixture. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Creamed Tacos
instructions: Combine ground meat tomatoes and chili beans mixing well. Add brick chili whipping cream and cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Pour over Doritos chips.

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg milk and vanilla; mix well. Combine flour cocoa baking soda and salt. Beat into creamed mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients; place in a greased 8-inch pan. Mix together the next 3 ingredients; sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Mexican Tortilla Soup
instructions: Cut raw kernels off corn cob with a sharp knife. In a large saucepan melt the butter over moderate heat. Add the garlic onion celery corn carrots and chili and cook for 3 minutes stirring occasionally until the onion is translucent. Stir in the cumin chili powder and oregano and continue stirring another minute to toast the spices. Add the tomatoes stock cilantro and chicken. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Broccoli Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into greased skillet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: White Brownies
instructions: Sift and set aside flour baking powder and salt. Melt shortening in pan. Stir in brown sugar and allow to cool slightly. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add flour mixture nuts and chocolate chips. Pour into greased or wax paper lined cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Keep in an airtight container.

title: Pistachio Pineapple Salad
instructions: Pour pineapple and juice into bowl. Add the mix and blend well. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Read to eat in 5 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Stir together margarine and peanut butter. Gradually add sugar until combined. Roll into 1 inch balls and place on waxed paper. Let dry about 20 minutes. Melt almond bark or confectioners coating. Let cool slightly. Dip balls and let excess coating drip off. Place on waxed paper until coating is dry.

title: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seed and scald slightly. Combine beef rice egg onion salt pepper and 1/4 can tomato sauce. Pile meat mixture lightly into pepper halves. Place in large baking dish. Top each pepper with rest of tomato sauce. Add 1/4 cup water in bottom of pan. Cover dish tightly. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until peppers are tender. Baste occasionally.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Butter casserole. Add all ingredients together; mix all and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs before baking.

title: Butterscotch (Or Chocolate) Crunchies
instructions: 1. Place chips in a medium microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on medium for 3-1/2 to 5-1/2 minutes until chips are melted. Stir until smooth (or melt using a double boiler).

title: Dirt Cake
instructions: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add pudding mix and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Sprinkle half the crushed cookies into clean decorative flower pot. Spoon in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle remaining crushed cookies over top to resemble \dirt\. Chill until serving time. Place silk flowers in mixture to resemble potted plant. Yield 15 servings.

title: Apple Cake(Diabetic)
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased tube pan for 1 hour.

title: Speedy Little Devils
instructions: Combine melted butter and dry cake mix. Reserve 1 1/2 cups of this topping for top crust. Pat remaining crumb mixture into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Top layer with combined peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme. Spread evenly. Crumble remaining mixture over that. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool. Makes 3 dozen bars.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Stir together cake mix and pie filling (do not use electric mixer) and pour into ungreased jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch pan). Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. When cool frost with powdered sugar frosting. These bars freeze well.

title: Witch'S Brew(Hot Cinnamon-Apple Punch)
instructions: In a large electric percolator (24 to 30 cups) combine cider sugar orange juice and water. In basket (where you usually put the coffee) add cinnamon sticks allspice and cloves. Plug in coffee maker and let it complete regular cycle. Serve!

title: Yum Yum Pudding
instructions: Mix instant pudding as directed on box and set aside. Crush or break cookies in small pieces and layer in large bowl as follows cookies pudding Cool Whip and mini chips. Repeat layering ending with Cool Whip on top and sprinkles of mini chips.

title: Jello Pudding Pecan Pie
instructions: Blend pudding and corn syrup. Gradually add milk and egg blending well. Add pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 until firm and top cracks about 40 to 45 minutes. Cool at least 3 hours. Serve with Cool Whip if desired.

title: Devil'S Food Cake
instructions: Sift together first 4 ingredients. Mix cocoa and hot coffee; set aside.\tCream Crisco and sugar; add eggs slightly beaten. Add flour mixture and cocoa mixture alternately to sifted ingredients and beat well.\tPour into large flat cake pan that has been greased and lightly floured. Bake 45 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Test with toothpick.

title: Cherry Delight
instructions: Crumble graham crackers. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Make crust from cracker crumbs butter and 3 tablespoons of sugar. Chill.

title: Party Punch
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except ginger ale. Pour over ice in punch bowl. Add ginger ale before serving. Makes twenty 4 oz. servings.

title: Dressing Covered Pork Chops
instructions: Brown pork chops on both sides. Prepare dressing. Line pan (at least 2-inches deep) with aluminum foil leaving enough to cover top. Place 3 pork chops in pan and cover with 1/2 of dressing. Place other 3 pork chops on top and cover with remaining dressing. Bake at 375\u00b0 until meat is tender. Serves 6.

title: Buttermilk Dressing
instructions: Measure ingredients into container seal and shake well. Refrigerate several hours then shake before serving. Makes 1 cup.

title: Teriyaki Steak
instructions: Marinate overnight. Grill or broil in oven. Also great with chicken.

title: Coconut Pineapple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine flour baking soda and salt. In separate bowl whisk together oil buttermilk eggs and vanilla. Stir in sugar pineapple and 1 1/2 cups coconut; mix well. Stir in flour mixture. Pour into pan. Bake on center oven rack for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack.

title: Banana Sticky Buns
instructions: Heat oven to 450\u00b0. Place 2 teaspoons brown sugar 2 teaspoons butter and 3 pecan halves in each of 12 medium muffin cups. Place in oven to melt sugar and butter. Stir baking mix and banana to a soft dough. Gently smooth into a ball on floured cloth covered board. Knead 5 times. Roll into rectangle 15 x 9-inch. Spread with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle with 1/4 cup brown sugar. Roll up beginning at long side. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal. Cut roll into twelve 1 1/4-inch slices. Place slices cut side down in muffin cups. Bake 10 minutes. Immediately invert pan onto serving tray or baking sheet; let pan remain a minute so butterscotch drizzles down over buns. Serve warm. Makes 12 buns.

title: Coconut-Banana Cream Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0; mix coconut oats and 4 tablespoons butter by hand. Pat coconut mixture onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate. Bake crust 15 minutes until golden; cool. In saucepan combine milk cornstarch salt egg yolks 1/2 cup sugar and remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Cook over medium-low heat stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Line pie crust with bananas (sliced 1/4-inch thick); pour filling over bananas. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until cold. Mix whipping cream and 2 teaspoons sugar until stiff peaks. Spread over pie; garnish with sliced toasted almonds. Serves 8 to 10.

title: No Sugar Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 and lightly spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray. In a large bowl combine all ingredients until moist. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet about 1-inch apart. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Easy Cobbler
instructions: Melt butter in oblong baking dish. In a separate bowl mix well sugar milk flour and baking powder. Pour into baking dish. Cover with fruit and syrup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Pour jello into pan with pineapple. Stir and bring to a boil. Refrigerate until half jelled (not hard). Mix in cottage cheese. Mix in the Cool Whip. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and oil with fork then add water mixing with fork to form ball. Using hands mix a little before rolling out between 2 sheets of wax paper. Do not double recipe. (No flour on wax paper.) Makes one 8 or 9-inch pie crust.

title: Carrot Cake(Diabetic Dessert)
instructions: Combine flour whole wheat flour baking powder baking soda cinnamon and ginger. In second bowl combine oil sugar or substitute eggs pineapple juice and vanilla. Stir liquid into dry ingredients until smooth. Stir in carrots raisins and pineapple. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan on rack for an hour. Unmold cake and serve. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.

title: Berry Chocolate Pie
instructions: In medium microwave-safe bowl combine chocolate chips and milk. Microwave on Medium 1 1/2 minutes stirring every 30 seconds. Stir until chocolate is completely melted and smooth. Stir in vanilla.

title: Marinated Fish
instructions: Place fish in shallow serving dish. Marinate with mixture of lemon juice soy sauce melted butter garlic green onion and lemon pepper. I measure to my taste.

title: Yummy Cookies
instructions: Cream butter or margarine with sugar. Add flour and then vanilla baking powder and egg. Mix all.

title: Diabetic Spice Cookies
instructions: Boil water shortening raisins and spices together for 3 minutes. Let cool; beat in eggs. Dissolve salt soda and saccharin tablets in water and add to eggs. Sift flour and baking powder and add and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: In large pot boil water. Add tri-color pasta and cook until done. Drain and rinse with cold water until pasta is cool. In large bowl cut cheese. Add pepperoni olives and shrimp. Then add pasta. Pour dressing on pasta and stir.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes and cornflakes. Mix potatoes throughout all combined ingredients. Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan and sprinkle cornflakes over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes thin. Put a layer of potatoes mushroom soup garlic and salt; repeat. Pour canned milk and sweet milk. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour until brown.

title: Creamy Chicken - Rice Casserole
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions. Combine rice and next 10 ingredients; spoon into a shallow 3-quart baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Mincemeat Cookies
instructions: Combine ingredients as listed adding enough flour to make soft but not stiff. Spoon onto greased cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Butterfinger Cake
instructions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. After cooling slightly poke holes in cake with the end of a knife. Pour the caramel topping over the cake spreading it to fill the holes and cover the cake. Allow the cake and topping to cool to room temperature then spread the Cool Whip on top of the caramel topping. Sprinkle Butterfinger crumbs on top of the Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

title: Noodle Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook noodles as directed and drain. In a large bowl combine hot noodles eggs and 1/2 of cheese. Mix well. Press mixture into greased 12 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Spoon sauce onto noodle \crust.\ Add topping and additional cheese. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more. Serves 8.

title: Polynesian Chicken
instructions: Melt butter. Add mushrooms onion and pepper. Saute until tender. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until thoroughly heated. Serve over rice. Serves about six.

title: Sunday Morning Caramel Rolls
