instructions: Melt together margarine brown sugar and cinnamon. Place frozen rolls in Bundt pan. Sprinkle pudding over rolls. Pour melted mixture over all. Keep uncovered overnight on counter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Invert on large plate. Serve.

title: Stuffed Shells
instructions: Saute last four ingredients until cooked. Add sauce and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Freezer Corn(Cream Style)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in roaster or similar pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool. Freeze.

title: Christmas Rock Cookies
instructions: Mix butter sugar; cream then add eggs and water. Mix cinnamon cloves and flour; all but 1/2 cup sprinkle over fruit to keep it from all sticking together. Stir fruit into dough mixture. Bake at 375\u00b0 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown around edges. Cool on wire rack. Store tightly in plastic container for up to 3 weeks.

title: Beef Brisket
instructions: Brown beef brisket. Put on rack in pressure cooker. In a separate bowl mix together remaining ingredients. Pour over beef. Cook according to pressure cookers manufacturers directions. This recipe can also be used with roast.

title: Sour Cream Biscuits
instructions: Combine flour soda and sour cream in bowl. Mix until smooth. Knead several times on lightly floured surface. Pat dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2-inch biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly golden. Yields 6 servings.

title: Fruit Dessert
instructions: Drain juice from fruit and reserve. Mix juices with vanilla pudding. Cook. Pour over fruit.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix and cook on medium until clear. Cool slightly.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Salt and pepper to taste. Place in a greased dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Ice Cream Pies
instructions: Mix cream cheese and condensed milk until creamy. Fold in Cool Whip. Place 1/4 mixture in each pie crust. Top with 1/2 of coconut/nut mixture. Drizzle about 1/2 of the caramel syrup on that. Repeat. Place plastic covers on pies and freeze. Before serving remove from freezer a few minutes so that it will be the consistency of ice cream.

title: Spoon Yeast Rolls
instructions: Mix sugar yeast and water in large bowl stirring until dissolved. Blend in flour and let stand 10 minutes. Spoon into greased muffin pan and bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Remaining dough will keep 1 week in refrigerator if covered tightly.

title: Dad'S Vegetable Soup(Canning)
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large stockpot. If too thick add more tomatoes or a large can of tomato juice (do not add water). (Note Okra turnips butter beans or any other vegetable may be added. Commercial canned vegetables can be substituted if fresh or frozen are not available.) Cook on high heat to bring to boiling point. Lower heat slightly and continue to cook until all vegetables are soft and flavors blended (2 to 3 hours).

title: Chocolate Chip-Cheese Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut cookie dough in half; press into bottom of greased 8-inch baking pan. In a mixing bowl combine cream cheese sugar and egg; mix until smooth. Spread over crust. Crumble remaining cookie dough over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool and enjoy. Refrigerate any leftovers. Really good with ice cream.

title: Chocolate Cake(Dark And Moist)
instructions: Put 2 squares unsweetened chocolate the shortening and boiling water in microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave just until chocolate melts. Cool slightly. Add the sugar; mix. Add the flour; mix. Put the 1 tablespoon lemon juice in measuring cup. Add milk to 1/4 cup. Stir. Add soda; mix and add to batter. Mix well. Add egg; mix well. Batter will be very thin. Put in greased 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until center is done. Double for 2 layer cake.

title: Caramel Apple Dip
instructions: Mix and cream the brown sugar and cream cheese; add vanilla and peanuts. Quarter apples; take out seeds. Leave apple peel on apples. Dip apples in dip and eat.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Heat milk to scalding. Pour milk over bread cubes; cool. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 for 40 or 45 minutes. Serve warm with cream. Makes 6 servings.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: In a quart saucepan over moderate heat bring the 1/2 cup of sugar corn syrup and butter to a boil stirring occasionally. Meanwhile in a medium size mixing bowl beat eggs lightly. Stirring vigorously slowly pour hot mixture over eggs. Stir in vanilla salt and pecans. Shake 1 tablespoon of flour and sugar together and sprinkle in bottom of unbaked pie shell. Add hot mixture and bake at 350\u00b0 for a metal pan for 45 minutes. Use cake tester; insert halfway between center and outside if it comes out clean its done.

title: Shrimp Creole
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp. Cook onions and pepper in butter until almost tender. Add celery and cook a little longer. Add water and tomato paste; simmer. Add shrimp and cook until done (about 5 minutes). Serve over white rice.

title: Chicken Florentine
instructions: Grease (or Pam) 9 x 9-inch casserole. Spread spinach on bottom then chicken. In saucepan melt 3 tablespoons butter. Stir in flour to form roux. Slowly stir in milk then add seasonings. Cook until thick and just beginning to boil. Add Parmesan and cream stirring over low heat until cheese melts. Pour sauce over chicken. Combine crumbs and melted butter. Sprinkle on sauce. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until heated through. Serve with rice. Serves 6. Can be doubled in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Spread croutons in 9 x 13-inch lightly greased pan. Cook sausage and cover croutons with it. Mix eggs milk soup mushrooms and mustard together and pour over croutons and sausage. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Remove; let stand 30 minutes before putting in oven. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes uncovered. Add cheese and cook 5 more minutes.

title: Italian Cookies
instructions: Cream eggs sugar and butter together. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Poppycock
instructions: Microwave on High for 11 minutes in a large bowl. Pour over popped corn. Can add nuts if desired. Mix well. Be careful syrup is very hot. Spread out on cookie sheet until cool then break up and store in airtight container.

title: Squash Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Melt butter onion and basil in pan. Add zucchini; cook 2 minutes on medium-low. Remove from heat; add bread egg cheese salt and pepper. Stuff mixture under skin of chicken. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Frozen Frappuccino
instructions: Make double strength coffee by brewing with twice the coffee. (2 Tbsp. Coffee per Cup). Chill. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend on high until ice is crushed and drink is smooth. Makes 2 - 16 oz. Glasses. Add Whipped Cream.

title: Cheyenne'S Cajun Roast
instructions: Stuff roast with garlic. Brush sides of roast with hot pepper sauce brown gravy mix and Creole seasoning. Put oil in Dutch oven pan or roasting pan; brown meat well on all sides over high heat. Add water; cover and simmer gently over a low heat for 2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Orange Frost Soda
instructions: Place 2 scoops of orange sherbet in a tall glass; fill with orange soda. Yields 5 servings.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Bake brownies. Cool. Punch holes in brownies with fork. Pour Kahlua over brownies; set aside. Make Jell-O mousse. Break candy bars into small pieces. Crumble 1/2 the soaked brownies and place in bottom of glass trifle dish. Cover with 1/2 of mousse. Layer with 1/2 of candy; add 1/2 topping. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Hot Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and drain on paper towel. Cook onion and hash browns. Add drained sausage and cook slow about 5 minutes. Place in baking dish rotating layers beginning with potato mixture then cheese. Top with cheese then warm just enough to melt cheese.

title: Speedy Scalloped Corn
instructions: Combine corn cracker crumbs evaporated milk egg onion salt and pepper in a buttered 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Allow to stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Ranger Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into balls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on a baking sheet sprayed with Pam.

title: Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Butter casserole dish and layer with potatoes pepper and onion. Cover each layer with soup. Top with pork chops and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. After first 30 minutes take out and turn pork chops over for next 30 minutes. Rice can be used instead of potatoes.

title: Barbecue Cocktail Franks
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in slow cooker. Cut hot dogs in 1-inch pieces and add to sauce mixture in slow cooker. Heat on high until hot dogs are thoroughly heated then cook on low until ready to serve. (If you double the recipe dont add more vinegar.)

title: Bible Cake
instructions: Beat Jeremiah 1711 until light. Blend in Jeremiah 620. Beat in Judges 525. Into another bowl sift 1 Kings 422. Add Amos 45 Leviticus 213 and 2 Chronicles 99. Combine dry ingredients with liquid mixture alternately with an additional 1 1/2 cups of Judges 419. Fold in 1 Samuel 1425. Chop Nahum 312 and Numbers 178. Add to the mixture folding in gently. Beat well.

title: Chicken Diablo
instructions: Mix together in baking pan. Dip both sides of chicken in mixture. Baste once or twice during cooking. Will be golden brown. Serve hot or cold. Freezes well. Bake at 375\u00b0.

title: Cucumber-Party-Slices
instructions: Soften cream cheese; blend in Italian dressing mix. Spread on party slices. Place a cucumber slice on each piece and sprinkle with dill weed. Refrigerate until serving time.

title: Sandwich Spread
instructions: Grind and drain tomatoes and sweet and hot peppers. Cook together sugar flour salt mustard and vinegar. Bring to a boil (stir constantly to prevent scorching). Add drained vegetables. Cook 10 minutes. Remove from stove and add 1 pint salad dressing. Mix well and put in jars. Process jars for 10 minutes in boiling water.

title: Pork Chop With Rice Casserole
instructions: Salt and pepper chops to taste. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Place rice in large baking dish.. Mix soup water soy sauce and onion. Add drained vegetables. Place pork chops on top. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Treats
instructions: Roll out crescents. Using a small glass cut dough into circles. Put in small muffin tin. Brush with melted oleo. Cut ham into small pieces. Mix with cheese garlic powder and onion. Fill crescent dough. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Makes 24. (I always double the recipe.)

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
instructions: Cream cheese mayonnaise and sugar in mixer. Mix bananas with lemon juice. Fold in fruit nuts and marshmallows. Stir in Cool Whip and freeze. Serve frozen.

title: Ambrosia
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill overnight.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix together crushed pretzels sugar and melted butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 8 minutes at 400\u00b0. Cool thoroughly.

title: Fresh Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake in tube pan 1 1/2 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: In a 9-inch pie plate preferably Pyrex starting with the cream cheese spread each ingredient over the one before ending with the Cheddar cheese. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted and bubbling approximately 20 to 25 minutes. May be microwaved.

title: Strawberry Shortcake Biscuits
instructions: Mix together flour baking powder salt and sugar then add the egg and milk. Stir together with a fork. Pat into 6 mounds on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Rocky Road Cookie Pizza
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Line 12-inch pizza pan with foil; grease foil. Press cookie dough into bottom of foil-lined pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 13 to 16 minutes or until light golden brown. Remove from oven. Sprinkle peanuts marshmallows and chocolate chips. Drizzle with caramel. Bake an additional 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Remove foil from pizza. Cut into wedges. Makes 16 servings.

title: Tasty Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into bite size pieces (skins on). Put in shallow casserole dish (greased). Sprinkle on top the cheese and garlic. Put pat of butter on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In bowl combine bread crumbs and 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese. Put egg in another bowl and beat thoroughly. Dip chicken into egg and then dip into the bread crumbs. Shake chicken to remove excess crumbs. In large skillet heat 1/4 cup of olive oil. Add chicken and cook 5 minutes on each side until golden brown. In small bowl mix spaghetti sauce garlic and oregano; mix thoroughly. Pour into a baking dish and arrange chicken over mixture. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove chicken from oven and put slice Mozzarella cheese on top chicken. Bake another 10 minutes. Serve with ziti with parsley sprinkled on top.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Boil eggplant onions and pepper until tender and drain well. Mix in other ingredients except crackers and cheese. Place a layer of broken crackers and a layer of eggplant mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Repeat layers. Put crackers on top. Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Baked Cheese Grits
instructions: Cook the grits and water slowly until the mixture thickens. While hot add the grated Cheddar cheese Longhorn or Velveeta cheese butter or oleo seasoning salt (Lawrys or Beau Monde) salt eggs and Tabasco sauce. Mix together and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Chex Mix
instructions: Bring the oleo and sugar to a boil stirring constantly; let this come to a full boil then pour over crackers. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes; take out of oven and add chocolate and butterscotch chips. After they melt spread over all then sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Wash chicken breasts; cover with water in pan and bring to a boil. Cook slowly for about an hour. Cut up into small pieces. Crumble 1/2 of the crackers into bottom of baking dish. Mix chicken soups and sour cream; pour over crackers. Crumble rest of crackers on top. Slice stick of butter or margarine into small pieces and scatter over top of casserole. Bake in oven at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 45 minutes. Delicious and easy. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix together and bake in oven at 325\u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.

title: Mustard Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. If desired you may add Tabasco sauce or Texas Pete to make hot. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Pumpkin Pecan Bisque
instructions: In large saucepan melt butter; saute onion and garlic 7 to 8 minutes until lightly browned. Add broth pumpkin water brown sugar thyme rosemary cumin and salt. Bring to simmer. Reduce heat; cook 10 minutes stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Stir in half and half. In blender combine soup mixture and pecans in two batches at low speed for 1 minute. Pour into same saucepan. Heat through stirring often. Yields 6 servings.

title: Lite Vegetable Spread
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor. Spread on crackers or use as a dip with raw veggies.

title: Picante Sauce
instructions: Mix in large kettle and bring to boil. Reduce to simmer. Cook for 1 1/2 hours uncovered stirring frequently. Ladle into jars and seal. Yields 8 to 10 pints.

title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
instructions: Combine salt flour and sugar in large mixing bowl; set aside. Bring to boil 1 stick margarine cocoa water and Crisco. Pour over the mixture. Add 2 eggs milk vinegar soda and vanilla. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes in greased cookie sheet.

title: Kraut Salad
instructions: Mix sugar and vinegar. Bring to a good boil and pour over mixture. Let set overnight before eating.

title: Sweet Potato Pudding
instructions: Beat eggs; add sugar milk potatoes and vanilla. Fold in raisin and coconut. Stir in butter and pour in greased casserole dish. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until pudding is set.

title: Frozen Fruit Cups
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into baking cups and freeze.

title: Salsa
instructions: Boil tomatoes and then peel and chop. Add rest of ingredients and blend to the desired texture.

title: Skillet Bread
instructions: Grease an iron skillet. Mix the ingredients and pour into skillet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Persimmon Pudding
instructions: Add sugar to the persimmon pulp then add beaten eggs stirring well. Add soda to buttermilk and stir until foaming ceases. Add buttermilk mixture to the persimmon mixture and stir well. sift flour salt and baking powder into persimmon mixture and beat well.

title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 400\u00b0. In small bowl mix together flour salt sugar and nutmeg. In another small bowl mix together egg sour cream and extract. Add to dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in apples. Pour into pie crust. Bake on preheated cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue baking for 30 minutes or until golden. Meanwhile prepare topping.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine dressing ingredients and toss with salad.

title: Black-Eyed Peas Casserole
instructions: Cook peas well done. Mix with rice ham tomatoes chopped onions and chopped green pepper. Mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into buttered casserole and bake for 45 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Country Dinner Grits And Cheese
instructions: Combine grits water and salt. When almost done add cheese and milk and cook about 15 minutes longer or until thick. (Serve with smothered chicken or pork chops and hot buttered biscuits. Use gravy from chicken over grits.)

title: Green Tomato Mincemeat
instructions: Cook until thick about 1 hour. Add 1 cup vinegar. Seal in hot jars or cool and freeze. Makes 2 cups per container.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: First Layer Spray 13 x 9 Pyrex (or 11 x 8) with Pam. Mix flour margarine and pecans and pat in Pyrex. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and add Second Layer.

title: Honey Apple Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients except apples in small mixing bowl. Beat with electric mixer on low speed about 4 minutes. Stir in apples. Bake in 8-inch or 9 1/2-inch round pan in 350\u00b0 oven about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Mix the first 7 ingredients together; pour into 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle yellow cake mix over the mixture. Melt oleo; sprinkle over cake mix. Put in a 350\u00b0 oven for 38 minutes. Remove and sprinkle nuts over the cake and bake for an additional 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Gumbo
instructions: Saute celery onions and bell pepper in butter; salt and pepper to taste. Add this to other ingredients. Simmer for 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: My Favorite Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat together until smooth. Serve with fresh fruit; especially good with apples.

title: Easy Meat Loaf
instructions: Put oatmeal in a bowl with milk and eggs and let soak for 5 minutes. Mix all other ingredients then add the oatmeal mixture. Shape in a loaf in baking dish. Cover well with catsup. Bake in oven at 300\u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until meat is done.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook and drain spinach. Mix in other ingredients. Chill. Cut center out of bread and fill with dip. Cut bread into dipping-size pieces.

title: Puppy Chow
instructions: Melt first 3 ingredients fold in cereal. Put all in Ziploc bag and shake it up . Get the kids involved in this one.

title: Butterscotch Delights
instructions: Mix flour and butter and press in baking dish then press nuts on top of it. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Let cool.

title: Scripture Cake
instructions: Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients;\tmix well. Bake in tube pan at 325\u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

title: Mocha Swiss Chocolate Almond(Homemade Ice Cream)
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy 1 or 2 minutes. Whisk in the sugar a little at a time then continue whisking until completely blended about 1 minute more. Add the cocoa and coffee and whisk to blend. Whisk in the cream and milk thoroughly. Transfer the mixture to an ice cream maker and freeze following the manufacturers instructions. After the ice cream stiffens (about 2 minutes before it is done) add the almonds then continue freezing until the ice cream is ready.

title: Old Time Bread Pudding
instructions: Put into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish toast cut in quarters. Sprinkle raisins over toast. Mix eggs 1/4 cup sugar salt Pet milk water and vanilla. Pour over toast. Let stand 10 minutes then sprinkle with 4 teaspoons sugar and the cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

title: Cheese Ball
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese with all ingredients except pecans. Roll the cheese ball in the pecans. Place in refrigerator over night.

title: Sour Cream Fudge
instructions: Mix sugar corn syrup butter and sour cream together. Cook over medium heat until reaches the soft ball stage. Cool to room temperature. Beat until thick and pour all at once onto buttered platter. Do not spread top it will be glossy and uneven.

title: Cream Cheese Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and 3 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over very low heat stirring constantly. Cool. Blend remaining butter with cheese until softened. Gradually add 1/4 cup of sugar beating well. Blend in 1 egg 1 tablespoon flour and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Set aside. Beat remaining 2 eggs until thick and light color. Gradually add remaining sugar; beat until thick. Add baking powder salt and 1/2 cup flour. Blend in cooled chocolate mixture nuts and vanilla. Spread about 1/2 of the batter in a greased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Add cheese mixture; spread evenly. Top with tablespoonfuls of remaining batter. Zigzag a spatula through to marble. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until top springs back when touched. Cool. Cut into bars.

title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
instructions: Drain beans fry bacon then saute onions in bacon fat. Mix in sugar and vinegar. Pour over beans while hot. Top with bacon pieces; marinate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cream peanut butter cream cheese powdered sugar and milk together. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Blend on low speed. Pour into crust. Chill. Top with chocolate shavings cinnamon or crushed nuts.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Bushrod'S Corned Beast Hash
instructions: Saute onions and garlic. Add corned beef (or any cooked \beast\) sliced potatoes and chopped celery. Cook until hash is heated through and potatoes are tender. Season to taste. For Red Flannel Hash add chopped cooked beets (or canned).

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients except for the pecans; mix thoroughly by hand. Stir in the pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes.

title: Butterdips
instructions: Melt butter in an oblong 13 x 9-inch pan. Sift together dry ingredients; add milk. Stir slowly until dough just clings together. Turn onto a floured board. Coat with flour and knead lightly about 10 times. Roll dough out to 1/2-inch thick rectangle. Cut into strips using a pizza cutter. Dip strips into melted butter on both sides and arrange in pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 450\u00b0 in a metal pan or 425\u00b0 in a glass pan.

title: German Chocolate Fudge
instructions: Combine chocolate chips Germans sweet chocolate and Marshmallow Creme in large bowl. Combine sugar butter evaporated milk and salt in heavy skillet. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook for 6 minutes stirring constantly. Pour hot syrup over chocolate mixture. Stir with wooden spoon until smooth. Stir in pecans.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except stuffing and margarine. Mix stuffing with melted butter. Put 1 cup of stuffing in bottom of buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Top with squash mixture. Add remaining stuffing mixture to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Donna'S Chicken Casserole
instructions: Heat the soups onion green chilies chicken broth and celery together. Layer Doritos chicken sauce and Cheddar cheese and then start over until full. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until it has boiled good at 350\u00b0. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Sauce Bake(Microwave)
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces skin side down and thick edges to outside of 2-quart baking dish. Cover with plastic wrap pierced with holes. Microwave 10 minutes. Drain and turn chicken. Mix soup with milk and spices. Pour over chicken. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on Medium 24 minutes or until tender. Let stand 5 minutes. This may be served over rice.

title: Ham, Eggs And Fried Rice
instructions: Have all ingredients handy. Heat skillet or wok over high heat for 30 seconds. Add 1 tablespoon oil; fry eggs until very moist film appears; remove and set aside. Add 2 tablespoons oil; stir-fry rice 2 to 3 minutes. Add thawed peas; stir through until warm. Add ham and green onions; stir through until warm. Add eggs; stir until all ingredients are warm and well mixed then serve.

title: Garden Casserole
instructions: Brush both sides of eggplant with oil. Place in microwave dish; cover tightly. Microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes until tender. In small bowl microwave onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon of oil at High temperature for 3 minutes. Oil a microsafe dish. Arrange eggplant slices slightly overlapping. Sprinkle half of garlic mixture over eggplant. Top with half of cheese basil salt and pepper. Arrange tomatoes over eggplant. Sprinkle with remaining garlic mixture seasonings and cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave on Medium-high for 7 to 10 minutes until melted.

title: Peppermint'S Cough Remedy
instructions: Put peppermint candy and rock candy into a glass gallon jar. Pour in whiskey (dont cheat and drink a swallow) and let dissolve. Add honey lemon juice and brown sugar. Stir or shake until mixed thoroughly. Take about 1 tablespoon every 4 hours or to your own needs. Good for coughs colds and bronchitis. Not good for hangover.

title: Dill Potato Salad
instructions: Cook and dice tomatoes. Stir in other ingredients. Mix well.

title: Raymond'S Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Melt 1/2 stick margarine in baking dish. Mix ingredients together in a bowl; pour in baking dish. Place fruit of your choice on top not too much juice. Sprinkle cinnamon on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Orange Tapioca Salad
instructions: Combine jello pudding and water in pan. Bring to full boil. Let set. Add Cool Whip and fold in oranges. May change to strawberry jello and strawberries.

title: Oven Deodorizer
instructions: Fill an 8 oz. drinking glass 1/3 full of water. Dissolve 2 aspirins in the glass Add ll drops of Spirits of Ammonia (aromatic). You can purchase over the counter at any drugstore. 1/2 tsp. of baking soda. Stir well and drink immediately.

title: Peanut Butter Drops
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar. Mix in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies and mix well. Form small balls. In top of double boiler melt Hershey bar chocolate chips and paraffin. Stir until well blended. Dip balls into chocolate and cool on waxed paper.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and egg together. Add molasses and tea. Gradually add dry ingredients. Roll out on floured board and cut. Bake on an ungreased pan for 10 to 13 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Cauliflower Nut Loaf
instructions: Saute onions and cauliflower in butter. Combine all other ingredients except beaten eggs; mix with\tonions\tand cauliflower. Place in bread loaf pan. Pour in beaten eggs. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Zucchini Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs oil sugar and salt together. Combine flour soda baking powder and cinnamon. Blend together. Fold in zucchini and pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Grapefruit Pineapple Slush
instructions: Mix juices and tequila. Pour all but one cup into ice cube trays (preferably metal) fitted with dividers. Freeze for several hours or up to 2 days. Refrigerate remaining one cup mixture.

title: Beer Batter Halibut
instructions: Open beer; pour into pancake mix until it is the proper consistency for batter. Drink remainder of beer. Deep fry batter dipped halibut chunks in hot oil. Halibut should rise to the top of oil quickly or oil is not hot enough. Do not overcook.

title: Herb Roasted Chicken And Vegetables
instructions: Mix soup water 1 tsp. Oregano carrots and potatoes in shallow roasting pan. Top with chicken. Season with remaining oregano and paprika. Bake at 400 degrees for 50 minutes or until done. Stir vegetables.

title: Easy Sunday Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine rice and broth in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay chicken on rice mixture. Pour melted margarine over chicken. Combine soups and soup mix; spoon over chicken. Cover tightly with foil and bake 3 hours at 275\u00b0. Its ready when you come home from church.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Combine ingredients from corn meal through oil in mixing bowl. Stir well. Add enough milk for desired consistency. Pour batter into greased baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until bread tests for doneness.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix sugar Karo butter and flour and set over a low heat stirring constantly until sugar is melted. Remove from heat and add well beaten eggs and vanilla also pecans. Turn into unbaked pie shell and bake in slow oven until mixture will not shake in the middle or until knife blade inserted in filling comes out clean.

title: Calico Beans
instructions: Brown and drain hamburger. Chop brown and drain bacon. Chop and saute onion. Add to bean mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Sugar-Free Jello Cake
instructions: Slice loaf angel food cake into 1-inch slices. Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch clear baking pan. Mix jello with boiling water until dissolved. Add cold water pour over angel food cake slices. Let jello set. May frost in pan with Cool Whip or set in hot water and unmold then frost with Cool Whip.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together in order. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Place on lower rack of oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix pineapple juice dry Kool-Aid and ginger ale. When ready to serve add sherbet.

title: Banana Cream Pie(Or Meringue)
instructions: Combine flour sugar and salt in saucepan. Blend scalded milk in slowly. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils. Continue cooking and stirring 1 minute. Remove from heat and add a little hot mixture to beaten egg yolks. Quickly stir into mixture in saucepan. Return to medium heat and cook stirring constantly for 3 minutes or until it thickens and mounds slightly. Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla stirring until margarine is melted. Cool.

title: Mildred'S Famous Tamale Pie
instructions: Blend cornmeal and milk together then mix in tomatoes corn and eggs. Saute in olive oil the chopped onions garlic cloves bell pepper chili powder pitted olives and salt and pepper to taste. Add boned chicken vinegar and sugar. Bake 1/2 hour at 350\u00b0. Serves 15.

title: Strawberry Baked Alaska
instructions: Chill baked pie shell well. Spread bottom with strawberry jam or topping. Reserve a little to drizzle over top. Soften ice cream at room temperature. Beat with electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Spread ice cream evenly over bottom of pie shell mounding it in the center. Place in freezer immediately while preparing the meringue topping.

title: 9 Or 10-Inch Double Pie Crust
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in 1/3 cup of shortening and then cut in the other 1/3 cup. Add about 1 more tablespoon of Crisco and cut in with pastry blender. Sprinkle water one tablespoon at a time over the mixture. Gently mix with fork. Push mixture to one side of bowl and sprinkle the next tablespoon of water over dry part. Mix and repeat until all is moistened. Gather up with wet fingers and form into a ball. Let stand in refrigerator for a little while. Cut in half and use for 2 crusts. Roll on floured cloth to size needed.

title: Delicious Grilled Burgers
instructions: In a medium bowl combine beef onion garlic salt and pepper. Mix well. Shape into 6 patties. In a small bowl combine cheese mushrooms bacon and mayonnaise; refrigerate. Grill burgers over medium-hot coals turning once. During the last 3 minutes spoon 1/4 cup of cheese mixture onto each burger. Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with sugar; add oil and beat. Add honey and beat then milk. Sift flour with baking powder and soda. Then add a little flour at a time and continue beating on low speed. When ingredients are mixed add walnuts and mix. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Do not fill pan with cake mixture more than half.

title: Sangria
instructions: Combine wine juices and sugar in large glass pitcher with ice. Add sliced fruit and stir. Yields 1 3/4 quarts.

title: Vegetable Pizza
instructions: Flatten dough in a pizza pan and seal edges. Bake 10 minutes at 375\u00b0. Cool. Mix ingredients. Spread on crust. Chop any vegetables desired and layer on top. Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese. Refrigerate.

title: Spicy Chip Dip
instructions: Brown beef and drain off grease. Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir well. Cover and cook on High 1 hour stirring until cheese is fully melted. Serve with corn chips.

title: Joe'S Favorite Meatballs
instructions: In medium bowl beat eggs slightly. Add milk and bread; mix well. Let stand 5 minutes. Add chuck onion parsley garlic salt and pepper; mix until well blended. Shape into 24 meatballs. Cook meatballs directly in sauce for added flavor. Skim fat from sauce.

title: Grandmother'S Sugar Cookies
instructions: Mix sugars and butter. Add egg and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Use 1/2 teaspoon of dough and roll into ball. Mash flat with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Apple Walnut Cake
instructions: Combine apples and sugar; let stand. Beat eggs slightly; beat in oil and vanilla. Mix and sift flour baking soda cinnamon and salt; stir in alternately with apple-sugar mixture. Stir in walnuts. Pour into greased and floured oblong pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour or until cake tests done. Let stand in pan until quite cool; turn out on rack to complete cooling. Frost with Lemon Butter Frosting; decorate with whole walnut meats. Cut in squares to serve. Makes twelve or fifteen squares.

title: Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix well. Make in balls. Fry in butter until brown; drain. Make gravy with flour 2 beef bouillon cubes and 1 tablespoon instant coffee. Simmer until done.

title: Jambasette
instructions: Melt butter in frying pan. Add beef and cook until lightly browned. Remove from pan and fry onions (diced) until transparent and tender. Add tomatoes and meat to onion in skillet. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cook noodles in boiling water. Combine with meat mixture. Add half of grated cheese. Place in casserole and cover with remaining cheese. Let set 1 hour to blend flavors. Bake 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar and add eggs one at a time. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add flour alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture. Roll nuts candy and date in extra flour. Add coconut to this and add to mixture. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

title: Parmesan Chicken
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Melt butter and soak chicken in it for 5 minutes. Dip chicken in cheese mixture. Put in pan or dish. Pour remaining butter on top. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar soda and salt. Add eggs and mix well; add pineapple. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour soda and salt; set aside. Mix butter sugar vanilla and water. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Add flour mixture and chips.

title: Peach Cream Pie
instructions: Mix flour sugar and salt. Spread 3/4 of this mixture in the bottom and around edges of unbaked crust. Place drained peach halves (hollow up) in crust. Pour whipping cream over this being sure each hollow is full of cream. Sprinkle remainder of flour and sugar mixture over this. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 hour.

title: Egg Noodles
instructions: Mix eggs until fluffy with mixer. Add water and salt. Then add flour and mix.

title: Cherry Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Hot Salsa
instructions: Drain liquid from 1 can of tomatoes. Pour into blender or food processor. Pour entire contents of the other can into liquid from previous can of tomatoes. Add onion salt garlic salt cilantro leaves and jalapenos; blend well. Add the tomatoes from the drained can; blend just slightly to break up the tomatoes into pieces. Pour sauce into container and chill. Will last for a couple of weeks in refrigerator.

title: Cheese Filled Pears
instructions: Combine cream cheese crushed pecans and honey. Beat until well blended. Fill pear halves with mixture. Place in shallow baking dish or pan. Sprinkle with vanilla wafer crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until tender.

title: Spice Bars
instructions: Mix the first 4 ingredients. Let stand overnight. Add the remaining ingredients. Grease a cookie sheet and put the mixture in it. Spread it to cover all the pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Quick Cherry Dessert
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs. Beat until fluffy. Add the almond extract. Stir in flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth.

title: Goulash
instructions: Cook macaroni until tender. Meanwhile brown ground beef and onion in a skillet that has been treated with a nonstick spray. Drain and rinse macaroni; mix all ingredients in skillet. Heat over a low fire until heated through. If not moist enough add 1 can tomato sauce. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Use large mixing bowl. Pour 2 cups hot water over Kelloggs All-Bran and let cool. Cream sugar salt and Crisco. Add eggs buttermilk and Nabisco All-Bran cereal. Sift together soda and flour and add then add Kelloggs All-Bran. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Store remainder of dough in refrigerator in glass or plastic (not metal) containers. Cover; will keep for weeks. Bake as many as needed in muffin tins. Nuts and raisins may be added for variety.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli tops into small florets. In large bowl combine broccoli onion raisins and bacon. Mix together mayonnaise sugar and vinegar; pour over broccoli mixture and toss lightly to combine. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Mexican Chicken
instructions: Season chicken. Combine flour and chili powder. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and brown in hot oil. Remove chicken from skillet. Add onion green pepper and garlic and saute until tender. Stir in rice tomatoes and water. Arrange chicken over rice and vegetables; cover and simmer 35 minutes.

title: Chilli
instructions: Cook and stir beef onion and green pepper in large skillet until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients except beans. Heat to boiling then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Stir in beans and heat to boiling. Cook uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix in order given. Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan in moderate oven (350\u00b0) or will make two nice 8 x 8-inch cakes.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Crumble sausage cook and drain. Line bottom of greased 9x 13-inch pan with crescent rolls firmly pressing perforations to seal. Sprinkle with sausage and cheese. Combine milk eggs salt and pepper. Pour over sausage and cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot. This can be assembled the night before in pan and refrigerated then baked the next morning for a quick and easy breakfast (just serve with juice and coffee.) Great for when you have company. You may use just one kind of cheese or experiment with combining all three kinds.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Process all ingredients in blender until smooth. Store in refrigerator for at least 24 hours before using. One can of condensed milk will keep for 2 weeks.

title: Peach Cobbler
instructions: Mix ingredients and place in baking dish. Top with cinnamon. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and firm.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Melt butter on griddle and add to batter.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Melt butter add milk and beat over fire until scalding. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and vanilla. Brush crust with unbeaten egg whites. Add milk to mixture and stir. Strain into 9-inch pie crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn control to 375\u00b0 and bake 10 minutes longer.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time. Beat only enough to blend well. Sift together dry ingredients. Add dry mixture alternating with the milk to the creamed mixture. Mix thoroughly but do not overbeat. Fold in flavoring. Pour batter into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool in pan approximately 5 minutes. Invert on a rack to complete cooling.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Stir over low heat until well blended. Bring to a boil over moderate heat. Do not mistake air bubbles for boiling. Boil slowly stirring constantly for 5 minutes or soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Turn into well buttered 9 x 9-inch pan and cool.

title: Favorite Meat Loaf
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix together. Bake in desired loaf pan or casserole. Bake for 1 hour or until no longer pink inside. Drain; let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Cacciatore(For Low-Fat Diets)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In a large skillet lightly brown skinned chicken in corn oil. Remove from skillet and place in baking dish.

title: Corn Relish
instructions: In a large saucepan cover corn with water. Bring to boiling. Simmer 5 minutes. Drain.

title: White Chocolate Mousse(By Executive Chef Song Of Norway Cruise Ship)
instructions: Melt white chocolate butter and milk in double boiler. Set aside. Add egg yolks slowly to the melted chocolate and fold in the beaten whites with sugar. Fold in whipped cream with sugar and put in refrigerator for approximately 6 hours. Fill glasses with mousse and garnish with shaved dark chocolate fresh berries etc.

title: Jewish Coffee Cake
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk and beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Stir in cherries and nuts. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes.

title: Brunch Casserole
instructions: Use a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Place bread as a liner in bottom of dish then cheese then sausage. Sprinkle these evenly over the bread. Mix together eggs milk salt mustard and pepper. Pour mixture over the bread sausage and cheese. Chill overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. (If you want for supper fix in A.M.)

title: Jalapeno Cornbread
instructions: Mix meal and flour; add buttermilk oil eggs and corn. Mix well. Stir in pepper onion and cheese. Grease an oblong baking pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes until done.

title: Ground Beef And Noodles
instructions: Cook macaroni in separate boiler until tender. Cook remaining until done. Add tomato juice to macaroni also tomato sauce. Mix all ingredients together.

title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tops off tomatoes; scoop out tomato pulp. Mix together bread crumbs celery onion and butter. Stuff tomato shells with this mixture. Place in greased baking dish. Bake in moderate 375\u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Goes good with pork chops or meat loaf.

title: Milky Way Bars
instructions: Combine flour oatmeal butter salt soda brown sugar and egg. Pat 2/3 of mixture in bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Melt condensed milk choc. chips and butter together and pour over crust layer. Sprinkle rest of dry ingredients on top and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Gary'S Margaritas
instructions: Put all in blender. Fill blender with crushed ice and blend until slush.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Put vegetables in food chopper and chop fine. Mix all ingredients well. It is better if allowed to sit overnight.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix all together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake until golden brown.

title: Homemade Pot Pie
instructions: Roll dough thin. Cut into squares. Drop into ham beef chicken or venison broth. Boil 10 to 15 minutes. Add dry parsley flakes and dry celery flakes to the broth which has been salted to taste. This may be frozen. Roll and cut. Place between wax paper and place in a plastic bag in layers or freeze on a cookie sheet and put in a plastic bag after freezing. Thaw and cook as directed.

title: Holy Cow Cake
instructions: Cook cake mix as directed. While hot poke holes in cake and pour caramel over. Crush 1 candy bar and spread over caramel topping. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Take Cool Whip and spread over cake. Take the other candy bar crush and spread over Cool Whip.

title: Apple-Raisin Cake(Sugarless)
instructions: Beat oil eggs sugar substitute cinnamon cloves vanilla and milk. Add baking powder soda and flour; mix well. Add apple which has been peeled cored and chopped finely. Then add raisins. Mix well. Bake in floured loaf pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Combine jello sugar and pineapple in saucepan with water. Boil 3 minutes. Place in refrigerator until it starts to set. Add Cool Whip nuts and grated cheese. Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix cheese eggs sugar and vanilla. Cut one roll in 1/8-inch slices; place on greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread cheese mix. Sprinkle with 1/2 of walnuts. Cut second roll of cookies. Place on top of cheese. Sprinkle remainder of nuts. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Combine sausage stewed tomatoes tomato paste 1 tablespoon parsley and 2 teaspoons sweet basil; cook for 45 minutes on low. Boil noodles until tender; put aside. Combine in bowl cottage cheese 3 eggs 3 tablespoons parsley and a pinch of salt and pepper; mix.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Mix pudding milk and sugar. Cook until boiling. Remove from heat and add evaporated milk. Add eggs. Pour into container and fill with half and half. Freeze.

title: Broccoli-Ham Shortcake
instructions: Melt butter in medium sized saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir constantly until smooth and frothy. Let mixture bubble about 3 minutes stirring often to prevent browning. Gradually stir in milk. Increase heat to medium and simmer stirring often about 5 minutes until thick and smooth. Add cheese frozen broccoli and ham. Cook stirring occasionally until cheese has melted and broccoli is cooked. Cut corn bread into 4 equal pieces. Slice each in half horizontally. Place bottoms on plates. Top with half of sauce remaining corn bread and remaining sauce.

title: Caraway Seed Soup
instructions: Put caraway seed into the water and let it come to a boil. Simmer slowly for about 5 minutes and set aside. Melt butter; add flour and brown lightly. Keep stirring to avoid burning. Remove from heat and add paprika and salt. Strain the water into the paprika and salt stirring all the time. Return to heat and simmer slowly for about 10 minutes. Serve with egg drops or with eggless pasta or noodles.

title: Athletic Director'S Pork And Beans Bake
instructions: Place beans into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Arrange chops over beans. Season chops with salt and pepper. Top with brown sugar and catsup. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 325\u00b0. Place onion and lemon slice atop each chop. Bake for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Combine strawberries and jello in a boiler. Cook until mixture comes to a boil. Cool; fold Dream Whip and cheese into jello mixture. Pour into a mold; chill. Fruit cocktail may be substituted for frozen strawberries and Cool Whip may be used for the Dream Whip.

title: Patio Chicken
instructions: Prepare Minute rice as directed making fairly large servings per person. Place rice on individual squares of heavy duty aluminum foil. Sprinkle with dry soup mix. You may also add cashews water chestnut slices or fresh mushrooms to rice. (Let your taste and imagination be your guide.) Place on top of rice your chicken pieces and sprinkle with more dry soup. Top this with 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon evaporated milk. Seal edges of foil in individual packages. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: In large bowl mix mayonnaise sour cream dill garlic lemon juice and salt; add onion celery and cucumbers. Toss gently. Chill 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Melt butter. Saute onions and celery. Place cooked rice on bottom of buttered baking dish layer of cooked chicken breast and celery and onions. Then cover with soup mix and cover with cooked chopped broccoli. Top with cheese. Bake 30 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Scalloped Cabbage Dish
instructions: In a saucepan melt the margarine. Stir in flour salt and dashes of seasonings listed. Slowly add milk while stirring to avoid lumps. Cook until fairly thick stirring constantly.

title: Appetizer Meatballs
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl. Roll mixture into 1-inch balls. Bake approximately 10 minutes in a preheated 375\u00b0 oven.

title: 90 Minute Dinner Rolls
instructions: Mix 3/4 cup flour sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Heat milk water and butter to 120\u00b0 to 130\u00b0. Add liquids in dry ingredients; beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer. Add 1/4 cup flour; beat at high speed for 2 minutes. Stir in enough additional flour to make soft dough. Divide in 12 equal parts. Shape into balls.

title: Hot Buttered Rum
instructions: Heat until everything is well blended. Add 1 jigger more rum to preserve. (Spices can be adjusted as desired.)

title: Breakfast Eggs Plus
instructions: Grease cake pan (9 x 13-inches); whip eggs and set aside. Cube bread enough to cover bottom of pan with a good layer. Dump on broccoli and cooked and drained bacon and egg mixture. Top with cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cheddar Squash Bake
instructions: Mix squash with egg yolks sour cream and flour. Fold in egg whites. Mix melted margarine with croutons or bread crumbs. Layer 1/2 squash and 1/2 of first mixture and 1/2 cheese. After second layer top with crumbled bacon and croutons or bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

title: Wild Rice Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and sausage; drain fat. Add mushrooms cut fine. Cook to blend. Add wild rice. Make white sauce of flour cream and chicken broth. Mix these and combine with sausage and mushrooms. Accent with monosodium glutamate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with almonds on top.

title: Meringues
instructions: Add sugar gradually to beaten egg whites (stiff but not too dry). Also add cream of tartar. Put brown paper on cookie sheet. Drop and shape meringue on paper. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 275\u00b0. Take out and loosen and return to oven for a few minutes longer.

title: Broccoli Quiche
instructions: Grease round pie pan. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. In medium bowl beat 5 eggs and add oil mixing on low speed. In another medium bowl combine remaining ingredients. Stir first mixture into spinach mixture blending well scraping bowl with spatula to be sure all Bisquick is well blended. Bake 35 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Sausage Grits Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage; drain. Spoon into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine hot grits cheese and butter. Stir until cheese and butter melts. Combine eggs and milk; stir into grits. Pour into sprayed casserole dish over sausage. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes about 15 servings.

title: Papaya Salad Dressing
instructions: Put all in blender. Seeds look and taste like pepper.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Mix eggs sugar butter and buttermilk together. Mix well. Add coconut and vanilla. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pineapple Nut Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl by hand. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes (325\u00b0 if glass pan). Top with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Old Virginia Chocolate Cake
instructions: Heat butter and milk to boiling point (do not boil). Add brown sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time; beat after each addition. Add dry ingredients and beat. Add vanilla. Bake in 9 x 13 pan at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Corn Filled Corn Bread
instructions: Melt butter. Mix with corn sugar meal egg flour and milk. Pour in iron skillet or muffin tin (well oiled) and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Layered Vegetable Salad
instructions: Layer in order listed. Dont stir. Spread dressing on top of salad. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

title: Gingered Lime Gelatin
instructions: Drain pineapple reserving juice; set the pineapple aside. In a bowl dissolve the gelatin in water. Stir in ginger ale ginger and the reserved juice. Chill until syrupy about 45 minutes. Fold in pineapple. Transfer to a 6-cup mold coated with nonstick cooking spray. Refrigerate until firm. Unmold onto a serving platter. Yield 12 servings.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Remove egg yolks from whites. Mash yolks and combine with next 6 ingredients. Refill egg whites using pastry tube if desired. Chill. To serve sprinkle tops with paprika.

title: Stuffed Pumpkin
instructions: Cook hamburg in frying pan with a little water adding small pieces of onion and sage black pepper and some garlic to taste. Cook potatoes. Mash or cube.

title: Gretchen Fayhey'S Quick Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Line buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish with buttered bread. Spread sausage over bread. Add cheese and spread evenly. Beat eggs and half and half together. Pour over sausage and cheese layers. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 uncovered for 40 minutes. Serve hot. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Mix all together with electric mixer. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.

title: Bacon Hamburger Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles and set aside. Brown bacon till crisp set aside. Saute onion in bacon drippings till tender add hamburger meat. Cook till no longer pink. Mix soup sour cream bacon onion & meat. Toss with noodles. Garnish with chopped parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 till bubbly.

title: Chiffon Bars
instructions: Blend flour brown sugar and butter together. Pat down into buttered square pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 minutes and remove.

title: Cherry Nut Cake
instructions: One recipe makes Two\t9 x 13-inch one 7-inch and one 10-inch round or one 13-inch round.

title: Bananas Allspice
instructions: Peel and cut bananas into 2-inch pieces. Brush with lemon juice. Roll in mixture of bread crumbs sugar and allspice. Place each piece on skewer and toast over hot coals or fry in hot buttered skillet.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Place pecans in prepared pastry shell; set aside. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium saucepan. Cook over low heat until chocolate melts stirring until smooth. Remove from heat and add corn syrup and remaining ingredients mixing well. Pour mixture over pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Yield One 9-inch pie.

title: Pat'S Shrimp Dip
instructions: Have mini snack crackers on hand to dip with. Good party dish.

title: Pig Eaten Cake
instructions: Mix and beat well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Put all together in blender. Grease and flour 10-inch pie pan. Pour blended mixture in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Margaritas
instructions: Put in a blender and add chopped ice to tequila mixture and blend. Get a Margarita glass that has been salted on the rim with a wedge of lime. Serve immediately with the enchilada casserole.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli according to directions. Drain well. Mix other ingredients in casserole. Add broccoli. Mix well. Top with crushed crackers. Dot with butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until brown.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken breasts in water (chopped). Combine chopped chicken breasts onion mushrooms and 1/2 cup cheese. Fry each tortilla in butter. Put spoonful of chicken mixture in middle of tortilla and roll. Lay in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Pour over tortillas. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until cheese melts.

title: Lucky If There'S A Bite Left
instructions: Mix together margarine flour and pecans; press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Double Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Beat the cake mix oil and eggs well and blend in sour cream. Add chocolate chips and chocolate. Blend well. Bake 55 minutes at 350\u00b0 in greased tube pan.

title: Date Nut Roll
instructions: Cook milk and sugar to soft ball stage (235\u00b0) stirring constantly. Add dates and cook to soft ball (236\u00b0) stirring constantly. Add nuts. Cool.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute onions and almonds in butter. Mix with beans and soup. Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly. Last 5 minutes sprinkle can of chow mein noodles on top.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Sprinkle soup mix evenly in oblong pan. Sprinkle rice over soup mix. Lay chicken pieces on top of rice. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Pour soup and water over all. Bake at 325\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Ali'S Creamy Clam Chowder
instructions: Peel and chop potato into small cubes. In a medium pot mix flour and evaporated milk. Pour the juice from clams in pot. Add remaining ingredients except clams. Stir and cook 3 minutes on high. Turn heat to medium and simmer 13 minutes. Stir in clams and heat then serve.

title: Pecan Kisses
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In large bowl combine all crust ingredients (except marshmellows) until crumb mixture forms. Press in bottom of ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12-15 minutes or until light golden brown. 2. Immediately sprinkle with marshmellows. Return to oven for 1-2 minutes or until marshmellows just begin to puff. Cool while preparing topping. 3. In large saucepan heat corn syrup margarine vanilla and peanut butter chips just until the chips are melted and the mixture is smooth stirring constantly. 4. Remove from heat; stir in cereal and nuts. Immediately spoon warm topping over marshmellows and spread to cover. Chill and then cut into bars ... and enjoy !

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Cook in double boiler until thick as you like.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Layer bananas and wafers. Mix other ingredients and put after each layer. Save some for topping. May add cherries or pecans on top if you want to decorate.

title: Cowboy Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs flour salt soda baking powder and then the rest of the ingredients. Add oatmeal and chocolate or butterscotch chips last and gently stir in. Drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: Place cracker crumbs in bottom of large dish. Put chopped pecans on top of crumbs. Mix sugar and cream cheese until creamy. Spread over cracker crumbs and nuts. Add Cool Whip. Spread cherry pie filling on top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Candied Walnuts
instructions: Mix together brown sugar salt orange zest and orange juice. Add walnut halves and bake on cookie sheet (spread out) covered with foil for 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool on foil.

title: Applesauce Salad
instructions: Empty applesauce into saucepan. Heat until hot. Remove from heat; stir into applesauce the Jell-O. Add crushed pineapple. Pour in Seven-Up. Mix well. Pour into Pyrex dish or pan. Chill until set. Top with whipped topping and sprinkle crushed nuts on top.

title: Salad Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth; chill before serving. Yields 1 cup.

title: Bean Dip
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Blenderize beans and add to meat. Add catsup cumin chili powder and salt and pepper to taste. Layer in casserole dish the meat and cheese ending with cheese on top. Heat in 400\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Put broccoli in buttered casserole dish or an 8-inch Pyrex. Cut chicken in bite size pieces; put on top of broccoli. Mix soup with mayonnaise and water. Pour over chicken. Mix crumbs with butter and spread over casserole. Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingerbread Cake Roll And Spiced Cream
instructions: Oil bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan with oil; line with wax paper and oil and flour wax paper. Set pan aside.

title: Mandarin Orange And Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Sprinkle gelatin over mixture and stir well. Spoon mixture into 13 x 9-inch dish. Combine pecans and coconut. Sprinkle over salad. Chill 6 hours or overnight.

title: Seven Layer Bean Dip
instructions: Place the beans cilantro and chili powder in a food processor and process until smooth. Spread the mixture in a 9-inch deep dish pie pan or a shallow serving dish. Peel and finely chop the avocado. Toss with the lemon juice and set aside.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: Melt butter. Stir in flour salt and pepper stirring constantly until it bubbles. Stir in milk; keep stirring until sauce thickens. Stir in cheese until melted. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

title: Chocolate Raisin Cookies
instructions: Melt Crisco; let cool. Mix together coffee sugar and cocoa and bring to boil. Let cool. Sift flour; add dry ingredients. Add raisins and nuts. Mix Crisco and sugar; mix well. Roll into balls as walnut size. Use sugar icing. Put on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: Combine cabbage and carrots in a large bowl. Sprinkle with sugar salt and pepper; toss gently. Stir in mayonnaise. Cover and chill thoroughly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Refrigerator Cookie
instructions: Cream sugars butter and eggs. Add vanilla sifted dry ingredients and nuts. Form into rolls. Refrigerate. Slice and bake in moderate oven 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until done.

title: Marinated Garden Salad
instructions: Quarter potatoes. Cut beans in half. In a 4 1/2-quart pot cook potatoes beans and carrots in lightly salted boiling water for 15 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain in large strainer. Transfer vegetable mixture into a large salad bowl. Pour dressing over vegetables; let stand 10 minutes to cool. Mix well to coat vegetables. Cover and chill in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.

title: 7 Layer Salad
instructions: Amounts can be varied. Also vary broccoli for cauliflower etc.

title: Pay Day Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix 1/3 cup butter and egg together. Press into ungreased cake pan. Bake for 15 minutes and while hot put marshmallows on top.

title: Chocolate Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan add 1/2 cup water. Heat until hot. Mix sugar salt cocoa and flour well. Add to the hot water. Cook until thick. Take off heat. Add 1 1/2 tablespoons butter and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.

title: Steamers
instructions: Brown onion hamburger and green pepper. Drain. Put in saucepan or slow cooker. Add Worcestershire sauce and mix. Add rest of ingredients. Stir. Cook 45 minutes on low.

title: J.J.'S Slaw
instructions: Shred first four ingredients in food processor. In mixing bowl add last three ingredients with slaw mixture. Mix well. Place in refrigerator. For best results leave overnight.

title: Meringues
instructions: Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry. Add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating constantly. Add flavoring and nuts. Line cookie sheet with foil or brown paper. Drop meringues by rounded teaspoons or larger if desired. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Meringues should be slightly browned. Remove from oven and place meringues on rack to cool.

title: Peanut Butter Dressing
instructions: Blend ingredients together. Serve with your favorite salad ingredients.

title: Marzetti (Lasagne)
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together in large pan; add soups catsup salt pepper and sugar. Let simmer while cooking wide lasagne noodles. Layer in separate loaf or cake pan the meat noodles and Mozzarella cheese. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Easy Apple Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix apple pie filling and eggs. In separate bowl mix cinnamon and sugar. Grease a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Spread half of cake mixture in pan. Sprinkle half the cinnamon and sugar on top. Repeat layers. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

title: Pumpkin Pound Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour tube pan. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pan and bake for 1 hour or until done.

title: Blonde Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Punch With Sherbet
instructions: Boil water and sugar. Add water to syrup. Add juices and cool. Add ginger ale and sherbet when served.

title: Salmon Cakes
instructions: Open salmon and drain juice. Set aside. Remove bones. In mixing bowl mash salmon well. Add beaten egg to salmon; mix well with fork. Add juice from salmon to flour and pepper. Add cracker crumbs to flour mixture then add to salmon. Melt shortening in frying pan and fry salmon patties. Fry to golden brown.

title: Pork Spareribs In Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In a small saucepan saute onion in oil until transparent. Add remaining ingredients except spareribs. Mix well. Simmer 15 minutes. Pour over spareribs in a large glass baking dish; let stand 1 hour turning occasionally. Arrange on shallow rack or broiler pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Turn ribs and baste with remaining barbecue sauce two or three times during baking. Cut in portions to serve. Makes 4 servings.

title: Nut Filled Cookies
instructions: Mix together. Shape into 24 small balls. Press into small muffin tins and work up around sides making a small cup.

title: Soft Brownies
instructions: Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Very very good.

title: Lemon Chiffon Pie
instructions: In large bowl fold lemonade Cool Whip and milk. Pour into pie crusts and chill. Makes 2 pies.

title: Easy Chipped Beef
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Slice beef into very small pieces. Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Cool until stiff. Form into a ball.

title: Split Pea Soup
instructions: Combine ham bone water peas carrots onion and bay leaf in a large kettle. Bring to boiling; cover. Simmer 1 hour until peas are soft. Remove ham bone; cut off bits of meat and add to soup. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed. Remove bay leaf.

title: Barbecue Beef
instructions: Brown meat in fat. Add rest of ingredients. Cook at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve on toasted hamburger buns.

title: Smell Of Williamsburg
instructions: Pour 1/2 of water cider and juice in pot. Add several sticks cinnamon ginger cloves and nutmeg. Boil slowly. When it begins to boil down add the rest of liquids. Add remaining spices depending on how strong you wish the smell.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Combine cake mix oil sugar and buttermilk. Add eggs one at a time. Add poppy seed. Pour into a well-greased and lightly floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pineapple Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cut celery leaves from stalks; reserve stalks. Combine tops in 6 cups water chicken bay leaf 1 teaspoon salt and pepper in Dutch oven. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken; chill and cut in bite size pieces. Combine broth potatoes carrots onions and celery; cook until tender. Dissolve cornstarch in 1/4 cup water. Stir into vegetable and broth mixture and cook until clear and thick. Stir in chicken. Put into 3-quart greased casserole. Combine flour milk oil and remaining salt. Stir and spoon into mounds over top of chicken mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Bundles
instructions: Blend cream cheese and butter together until smooth. Add chicken salt pepper milk onions and pimentos. Stir. Separate rolls into four rectangles. Seal perforations. Spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture into center and pull four corners of dough to center and seal. Brush tops with butter and sprinkle on crushed croutons. Bake on cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine ingredients with hands. Mix well. Will be dry. Pinch off small pieces and roll into balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Stacked Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix sugar butter and eggs. Add flour salt and baking powder. Mix soda with sour milk. Add vanilla. Mix all ingredients together. Spread in 9-inch round pans a small amount in each pan. Makes 8 or 9 layers. Bake 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven. When the layers are done turn out on flat dish one layer at a time. Spread applesauce between layers and stack.

title: French Silk
instructions: Stir together. Pat down in large 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Stir again. Pat down and chill.

title: Persimmon Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients; pour into ungreased loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Red And White Jello Salad
instructions: In small saucepan dissolve the lemon jello in 1/2 cup of boiling water. Have cream cheese at room temperature or soften in microwave. Add cream cheese and marshmallows cut up to the jello mixture and stir over low heat until dissolved completely. Cool.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Dice 8 to 10 whole pieces of chicken. Cut sausage into rounds (may use shrimp). Saut chicken and sausage until you think chicken is nearly done.

title: Applesauce Snacking Cake(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix bran applesauce egg product and molasses; let stand 5 minutes. Blend flour baking soda and cinnamon; set aside. With mixer beat sugar and margarine until creamy. Beat in bran mixture until smooth. Blend in flour mixture; stir in raisins. Spread batter evenly in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar if desired; cut into 48 (2 x 1-inch) bars.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Grind pears peppers and onions with coarse blade of food chopper. Add salt sugar and vinegar. Boil well for 10 to 15 minutes. Put into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes about 6 pints.

title: Bran Raisin Muffins
instructions: Grease 12 muffin cups. Combine bran cereal and milk in a large bowl. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add raisins butter brown sugar molasses and egg to cereal; mix well. Stir in flour until moistened. Batter will be lumpy. Do not overmix. Fill muffin cups 2/3 to 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Ground Turkey Quick Dish
instructions: Brown the ground turkey. Cook the instant rice according to directions using a microwave-safe casserole dish. Combine the ground turkey rice tomatoes and beans. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes until hot.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients and spread thinly on tortillas. Roll up. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Slice into bite-size pieces. Dip in salsa.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put in pie shell and cover with the other shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Orange Sherbet
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in ice cream freezer. Freeze until hard.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes(Published In Asheville Times Newspaper, 1936)
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes until fairly tender but not done. Allow the potatoes to cool. Skin them and cut lengthwise in halves. Arrange the pieces in one layer in a buttered baking dish or shallow pan; do not pack too closely. Boil corn syrup or maple syrup brown sugar butter and salt until thickened. Pour the syrup over the potatoes. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven 45 minutes to one hour turning pieces carefully and browning on both sides.

title: French Strawberry Pudding
instructions: Crumble wafers. Put half of the crumbs in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Whip butter sugar vanilla and eggs together until light and creamy. Spread over crumbs. Add whipped cream and spread. Next add strawberries. Mix other half of crumbs and pecans and spread over top. Chill overnight.

title: Grandma Pearl'S Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Mix the sugar cocoa and flour then add the milk. Blend and cook on top of stove until it begins to boil and get thick.

title: Pork Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients in large bowl. Pour into large baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Incredible Edibles
instructions: Combine cracker crumbs sugar margarine and peanut butter. Pat into greased 11 x 9-inch baking pan. Melt chocolate over low heat. Spread over crumb mixture. Refrigerate until cool. Cut into squares.

title: One-Bowl Brownies
instructions: Mix all ingredients (will be stiff batter). Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Do not overcook. These brownies are chewy. Store in airtight container.

title: Mexican Tamales(Foil Cooking)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in pouch. Seal edges. Cook 25 minutes.

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions: Mix and chill overnight.

title: Microwave Turtles
instructions: Place caramels milk and margarine in 1-quart glass measuring cup or casserole dish. Heat on Full power two to three minutes or until caramels are melted.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: Sift flour sugar salt soda and baking powder all together and cut in shortening. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add yeast and buttermilk and mix well. Dough will keep 2 days or longer covered in the refrigerator.

title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together chicken soup mayonnaise vegetables rice juice onion mushrooms and almonds in greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cornflakes and butter on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Brown meat drain off fat. Mix all ingredients together. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Citrus Punch
instructions: In a large punch bowl mix cranberry juice cocktail lemonade concentrate orange juice concentrate and water. Just before serving add ginger ale. Garnish with lemon and orange slices. Makes 36 (4 ounce) servings.

title: Fresh Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables 5 to 15 minutes. Mix cheeses. Place 1/2 of noodles in a 10 1/2 x 15-inch greased pan. Add half of vegetables tomato pieces and puree then 1/2 of cheeses. Repeat. Cover pan with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (approximately). Let stand 1/2 hour.

title: Ice Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put in ice cream freezer. Add ice and lots of rock salt.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Cook sugar margarine cream and vanilla until it forms a soft ball in cold water then you add peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme and beat. Pour into greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 7/8-inch pan. Set in refrigerator until cold.

title: Granola Cookies
instructions: Combine the granola flour cinnamon and salt; set aside. Beat 4 egg yolks and then add the water and honey. Combine the dry and wet ingredients and mix well. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff and fold into the batter. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Hopscotch
instructions: Melt peanut butter and butterscotch pieces in a double boiler over (not boiling) water stirring until blended.

title: Rachel Angel'S Grated Apple Pie
instructions: Melt margarine. Beat with sugar and egg. Add apples and spice. Bake in an unbaked frozen pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Use Cool Whip or ice cream on slices.

title: Gooba
instructions: Rinse barley 3 times; parboil 1 1/2 hours then rinse and drain. Saute onions until clear in margarine. Add mushrooms to onions; saute until mushrooms are tender. Combine onions mushrooms barley and chicken stock. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 3/4 hour.

title: Spanish Pork Chops And Rice
instructions: Brown chops in oil over medium-high heat for about 8 minutes. Remove. Add onions and green pepper; cover and cook 3 minutes. Add tomato garlic spices salt and rice; stir 1 minute. Add stock; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add chops and any accumulated juices. Cover and cook until rice is done and chops are cooked through about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with olives and parsley.

title: Russian Cream
instructions: Heat cream with sugar; soak gelatin in cold water; combine with hot cream. Cool until slightly thickened. Whip sour cream and vanilla and combine as first mixture congeals. Pour into ring mold. Chill until firm.

title: Hot Artichoke Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except chips in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot with chips.

title: Swiss Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Combine chocolate chips and water melt. Sift together flour baking soda and salt; set aside. Blend sugar butter and vanilla. Beat in eggs one at a time.
