Blend in melted chocolate. Stir in alternately flour mixture and buttermilk. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 or 10-inch pans. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until tested done.

title: Peanut Blossoms
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Sift together flour baking soda and salt; set aside. Cream together shortening and peanut butter. Add sugar and brown sugar; cream well. Add egg milk and vanilla; beat well. Blend in dry ingredients. Shape by teaspoonful into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove promptly. Place unwrapped Hershey Kiss in center of each cookie until cookie cracks. Return to oven for 3 minutes.

title: Harvard Beets
instructions: Drain beets. Save liquid. Mix sugar cornstarch and salt. Add vinegar and beet liquid. Cook stirring constantly until thick and clear. Add beets and oleo. Heat.

title: Date Squares
instructions: Pour 1 cup boiling water over the dates and soda. Let stand at least 1/2 hour or more. Blend the margarine sugar egg vanilla baking powder and salt. Add dates and water. Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Add well drained pineapple and rest of ingredients. Wrap in wax paper to chill. Reserve some of the nuts to roll ball in after it has chilled.

title: West Indies Salad
instructions: Spread half of the onion on bottom of large mixing bowl. Spread crab meat on top of onion. Spread the remaining onion on top of crab meat. Pour oil on mixture to be followed by vinegar and ice water. Salt and pepper to taste. Marinate for 12 hours. Salad should be tossed not stirred.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Mix together ingredients except for small amount of cheese to sprinkle on top. Put mixture into small baking container and sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until bubbling.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Mix melted butter and vanilla wafer crumbs. Form crust in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. While crust is cooking mix eggs cream cheese granulated sugar and lemon juice. Fill cooked crust with filling. Return to oven for 75 minutes (1 hour and 15 minutes). Turn off oven; mix sour cream and powdered sugar. Pour over cheesecake and return to cooling oven. Remove in 15 minutes.

title: Chicken - Spiced Beef Casserole
instructions: Grease 8 -inch or 9-inch square casserole. Place chicken breasts in bottom of casserole. Top each breast with 4 slices of sandwich beef. Mix soup sour cream mushrooms and almonds; pour over chicken and beef. Bake uncovered at 325\u00b0 for one hour.

title: Cherry Yum-Yum
instructions: Melt margarine; mix with cracker crumbs. Whip Dream Whip with sugar vanilla 3/4 cup milk and cream cheese. In a 2-quart Pyrex dish put a layer of crumb mixture 1/2 of the Dream Whip mixture and cherry pie filling. Add rest of the Dream Whip mixture; place layer of crumbs on top. Chill. Makes 12 servings.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple tidbits and marshmallows together; cover and refrigerate. Stir together vinegar sugar egg and flour and cook until thick. Let dressing mixture cool. Add diced apples to large mixing bowl. Stir in pineapple mixture and cooled dressing. Stir in peanuts and Cool Whip.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Cook until the peanuts pop open. Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda. Stir and pour on a buttered dish or greased tinfoil. When cool break into pieces.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix soups and rice in crock-pot. Place chicken on top of mixture and add chopped celery. Cook for 3 hours on high or 4 hours on low. Serves 4.

title: Buffet Potatoes
instructions: Set hash browns aside to thaw. Leaving a handful of cheese to top casserole stir all remaining ingredients together in a large bowl. Stir in hash browns until all are coated. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese and chives. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Karen'S Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package then add to next seven ingredients. Mix Good Seasons Italian dressing as directed on package and add garlic. Toss salad and dressing and marinate overnight.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Combine wet ingredients. Mix together. Bake in two loaf pans until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Tango
instructions: Combine sour cream brown sugar and amaretto; mix well. Fold in sliced strawberries. Spoon in serving dish; garnish with whole berries.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix cheese and chiles. Spread over tortillas. Roll up and cut into bite size pieces. Chill 2 hours. Serve with picante sauce (mild).

title: Acadiana Seafood Gumbo
instructions: Saute celery bell pepper and garlic in cooking oil. Add smothered okra Ro-Tel tomatoes seasoning bay leaf Worcestershire sauce and bouillon mixture into a large pot. Then stir in seafood. Cook for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours until seafood is tender. If not spicy enough add Tabasco sauce to taste. Add parsley and serve over rice. Remove bay leaf when cooked. Serves four to six persons.

title: Ashley'S Grown Up Punch
instructions: Mix directly into punch bowl and serve immediately. Dont mix ahead or it will go flat. Raspberries will give a lovely pink tint and add a bit of flavor.

title: Picnic Beans
instructions: In large pan cook and stir ground beef onion and celery until meat is browned. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water; stir bouillon and remaining ingredients into meat mixture. Cover; bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Makes 12 servings.

title: Rhubarb Crunch
instructions: Place rhubarb in greased baking dish. Combine 1/2 cup sugar cornstarch and water; cook and stir until thick and clear. Add vanilla and pour over rhubarb. Combine remaining ingredients; sprinkle over rhubarb. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm plain or with whipped cream.

title: Pizza Dip
instructions: Mix sour cream and cream cheese; spread on bottom of large pan. Spoon sauce on cheese layer.\tTop with any or all toppings. Top with cheese.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Add ground meat mixing thoroughly. Form into large ball and place into baking receptacle. Iron skillet works nicely.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Enjoy.

title: Guacamole Dip
instructions: Peel and mash avocados; add onion and mix well. Add other ingredients and mix well.

title: A Good Casserole Dish
instructions: Cook together ground beef and onion. Pour off excess grease. Cook noodles in salt water for 20 minutes; drain. Heat mushrooms on top of stove. Combine all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Put buttered corn flakes on top.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Combine ingredients in baking dish and add bacon on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches
instructions: Melt butterscotch morsels with peanut butter stirring until blended (in double boiler). Stir in Rice Krispies. Press 1/2 into 8-inch pan. Chill. Set remainder aside.

title: Spiced Tea
instructions: Mix all together and store in airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons for 1 cup boiling water.

title: Beacon Hill Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter in saucepan over very low heat stirring constantly. Cool slightly. Beat eggs sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl on high speed for 10 minutes. Blend in chocolate mixture on low speed. Add flour beating just to blend. Stir in nuts. Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. (Do not overbake.) Cool in pan; cut into squares. Makes 24 to 32.

title: Hot Lobster Ring
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Melt butter. Stir in flour until blended. Gradually stir in chicken bouillon or 1 cup bouillon and 1 cup cream. Add parsley bread crumbs egg yolks lobster meat salt and pepper. Whip the egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold lightly into the other ingredients. Bake the lobster mixture in a well oiled 9-inch ring mold until firm about 20 minutes. Unmold and serve with Mushroom Sauce.

title: Easter Bunny Salad
instructions: Put a lettuce leaf on a plate. Put pear half on lettuce leaf upside down. Add 2 cloves for eyes 2 almond halves for ears and 1 teaspoon cottage cheese for tail.

title: Flaky Cake Bars
instructions: Prepare 1 package 1 layer size yellow cake mix according to package directions. Pour batter into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 25 minutes or until done. Cool.

title: Cran Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Stir in pineapple cranberry sauce and wine. Chill until slightly thick. Fold in pecans. Place in 2-quart dish.

title: Bermuda Cheese Straws
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Shred cheese in food processor; add flour caraway seed pepper salt mustard and butter. Process until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. With processor running add ice water. Process until dough forms a ball.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix apples in 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon in a buttered dish.

title: Easy Roast
instructions: Place roast in a heavy roasting pan. Mix soup Coke soup mix and water and pour over roast. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 until roast is tender and gravy has thickened.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook sausage onion and thyme in skillet until sausage is browned stirring to separate meat. Pour off fat. Stir in soup tomatoes and vegetables. Heat to a boil. Remove from heat. Add stuffing. Mix lightly. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until hot throughout. Serves 6.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Spray loaf pan with nonstick coating. In large mixing bowl stir together the flour baking powder baking soda and salt. In medium mixing bowl stir together beaten egg whites banana sugar cooking oil and lemon peel. Add to flour mixture stirring just until combined. Fold in nuts. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 50 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Caramel Banana Pie
instructions: Cover unopened can of milk with water in a deep boiler. Bring to a rolling boil for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Keep adding water to keep can covered. Let can cool 30 minutes in cool water and open. Pour over sliced bananas in cooked pie shell. Cool completely and top with Cool Whip.

title: Mom'S Lo-Cal Cream Cheese Pie
instructions: Stir cream cheese until soft. Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until mixture is very smooth. Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Beat slowly with eggbeater for 1 minute. Pour at once into cooled crust.

title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Make a paste of the oleo powdered sugar and flour. Press into a long baking dish; bake for 15 minutes at 325\u00b0. Mix 2 cups sugar flour baking powder eggs lemon juice and grated rind together. Pour into hot crust. Bake for 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top while hot.

title: Baked Round Steak
instructions: Cut round steak into serving pieces and pound flour on both sides. Brown in skillet and slice onion on top. Heat mushroom soup in saucepan with 1 can of water add can of mushrooms. Put on steak and bake in oven for 3 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Hayley'S Hearty Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan. Season with 1/2 the mount of chili powder onion powder salt and pepper. Drain fat from ground beef. Set aside. In a 3 quart pan mix in tomato sauce. kidney beans water remaining chili powder onion powder salt and black pepper. Add ground beef. Mix well. Add slices of green pepper and onion. Heat covered on low for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove green pepper and onion before serving.

title: Blueberry Cake
instructions: Cook cake mix as directed on package. Cool. Combine sour cream Cool Whip and vanilla. Frost cake with this mixture. Put pie filling on top of cake. Refrigerate.

title: Cheese And Bacon Potato Skins
instructions: Bake potatoes in a 500\u00b0 oven for 1 hour or in microwave. Cut baked potatoes in half and scoop out center leaving 1/4-inch shell. Deep fry potato skins 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towel then season to taste. Fill potato halves with cheeses. Sprinkle with onion and bacon. Place under broiler 2 to 3 minutes. Top with sour cream.

title: Cheese Wafers
instructions: Cut butter into flour; add cheese and seasonings. Fold in cereal. Drop by small rounds on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with spoon. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Mix together; cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Peel and cut eggplant into 1/4-inch slices. Dip each slice in eggs then coat with bread. In large skillet heat oil. Cook eggplant 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towel. Spread 1/3 cup sauce over bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange half of eggplant slices in dish. Cover with half of sauce Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Repeat layers with remaining eggplant sauce and cheeses. Cover with foil.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except potato chips. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Crab Mousse
instructions: Heat soup in medium saucepan add cream cheese and blend until it disappears. Dissolve the gelatine packets in the hot water add to mixture and set aside to cool. Add the rest of the ingredients into the pot of tomato mixture. Blend until well mixed. Turn mixture into a large mold and refrigerate for about 8 hours.

title: Chicken Taco Bake
instructions: Mix chicken soup enchilada sauce and green chiles. Line a casserole dish with 1/2 chips. Pour chicken mix over top. Top with remaining chips and all the cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet and flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Bean Dip For Taco Chips
instructions: Brown the beef or turkey and drain. Stir in the salsa Velveeta (cut in pieces) and the refried beans. Stir all together and put in a crock-pot on low for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serve warm on taco chips.

title: Oat Bran Raisin Muffins(Heart Healthy)
instructions: Baking Temperature 425\u00b0. Baking Time 17 minutes.

title: Carolyn'S Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Melt margarine and toss stuffing and season mix in pan. Spread 1/2 of stuffing in dish. Top with cut-up chicken. Mix broth soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Sprinkle remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Glazed Pineapple Chicken
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Pour into Ziploc bag and add chicken to marinade. Cook chicken on grill.

title: Chess Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Cream together butter sugar cornmeal and flour. Add eggs vanilla lemon juice and milk. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
instructions: Use a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread chopped nuts in bottom of a greased pan. Sprinkle coconut on top of nuts. Mix cake mix by directions on box and spread over nuts and coconut. Melt margarine and mix with cream cheese and sugar. Spread this over cake mixture and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pismo Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken slowly in melted butter. Add salt and pepper and arrange in shallow baking dish. Brown mushrooms in drippings. Add remaining ingredients and heat to boiling. Pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes then uncover and continue baking for 25 to 30 minutes or until done. Serves 6.

title: Eye Of Round Roast
instructions: Heat oven to 250\u00b0. Prepare eye of round and place on rack over water. Salt and pepper to taste. Arrange sliced garlic onion and bay leaves over roast. (I hold in place with toothpicks.) Cover roast with foil; seal edges around pan. Bake for 5 hours. Cool completely for easy slicing for sandwiches. Strain broth for cooking noodles or making gravy. Excellent!

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix together the sour cream and dry taco mix. Spread onto a jelly roll pan. Layer on lettuce onions tomato and black olives. Cover for 1 hour in fridge. Dip with chips.

title: Tanis' Supreme Corn Casserole
instructions: Drain liquid from corn to just cover the corn about 1/4 inch. Mix remaining ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Adobong Carne(Beef In Soy And Vinegar Sauce)
instructions: Combine all ingredients and let stand overnight. Put in a pot and bring to a boil. Let simmer for an hour or until beef is tender. Serve hot.

title: Kraft Dinner Casserole
instructions: Brown ground beef with salt and pepper (to taste) and chopped onion. Drain. Cook macaroni from the Kraft dinner. Add cooked macaroni stewed tomatoes and Kraft dinner cheese packet to ground beef mixture. Stir together well. Tear up several slices of cheese and put into mixture. Stir again. Put into casserole dish (1 1/2-quart) and cover with sliced cheese. Bake in covered casserole dish for 45 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs lightly in large bowl; add other ingredients in order given. Bake in loaf pan 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Oatmeal Apple Raisin Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs; stir in remaining ingredients mixing just until moist. Pour into 12 greased muffin cups about 3/4 full. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Bake approximately 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Old-Fashioned Bread Pudding
instructions: Cover raisins with brandy; set aside. Spread 1 1/2 teaspoons butter on each bread slice. Cut bread into 1-inch cubes; set aside. Combine brown sugar cinnamon and allspice; reserve 3 tablespoons of this mixture. Toss bread cubes with remaining sugar mixture. Place 1/2 of bread cube mixture in a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Drain raisins; place half of raisins over cube mixture. Repeat layers. Combine eggs salt and vanilla in medium bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk. Pour mixture in casserole dish. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved sugar mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve warm. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Green Chili Stewlos Alamos, New Mexico
instructions: Brown pork in small amount of oil using salt pepper and garlic to taste. While meat is browning empty large can of tomatoes in 4 qt. pan. Cup up fine with juice or use hands to pulverise. Add green chili to tomatoes and simmer. Add browned meat mixture and stir well. Simmer 1/2 hour.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs milk bananas and vanilla. Sift together flour soda baking powder and salt. Mix both dry and wet ingredients together. Bake in 2 layer cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Cake is done when straw comes out clean from the middle.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Add oil sugar zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly but well. Mix dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Add nuts. Bake in 2 loaf pans for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Pecan Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange and cherry gelatin in hot water; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Prepare 6-cup ring mold or any container or bowl with vegetable spray. Pour in container and chill. For ring mold add 1 envelope Knox gelatine. You may double or triple recipe.

title: Goodies (Bark Candy)
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bark. Melt bark in microwave according to package directions and mix with other ingredients. Drop small pieces on wax paper. Makes approximately 12 dozen candies.

title: Mulligatawny Soup
instructions: In large kettle cook onion in oil until tender. Add hot water bouillon cubes vegetables salt pepper and barley. Cook for about 45 minutes.

title: Creamere Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour gradually. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours in 10-inch tube pan. (Ingredients must be at room temperature.)

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Wash drain and chop broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Add onion. Fry drain and crumble bacon; add to broccoli cauliflower and onion.

title: Chili-Mac Skillet
instructions: In large skillet brown meat with onions. Drain off fat. Stir in kidney beans tomato sauce undrained tomatoes uncooked macaroni green pepper water chili powder and garlic salt. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes stirring often. Remove skillet from heat. Sprinkle meat mixture with Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese (both can be used). Cover and let stand for 2 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

title: Chicken Broccoli Orientale
instructions: Cook chicken in oil until browned. Add onion and pepper. Cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in soup water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over rice or noodles. Serves 4.

title: Oniony Dinner Rolls
instructions: Measure warm water into large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast. Stir to dissolve. Add sugar molasses and onion soup. Add egg and 3 cups flour. Beat well. Add shortening and remaining flour. Beat well. On lightly floured board knead bread until smooth. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk about 45 minutes. Punch down. Shape into rolls. Cover; let rise until doubled about 45 minutes. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Brush tops lightly with melted butter. Makes 4 dozen.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. Simmer until butter is melted. Ready to use on all barbecue meats. Double quantities for a crowd.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Use 1/2 the butter to dot the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix well pineapple sugar and flour; pour over butter in casserole dish. Dot with remaining butter. Place crumbs over everything. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Tuna Casserole
instructions: Place Doritos in bottom of casserole. Add tuna (do not drain). In separate bowl mix all other ingredients and pour over tuna. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven at 325\u00b0. Beat eggs until light. Add oil sugar zucchini and nuts; if desired. Combine flour baking soda salt cinnamon and baking powder. Add egg mixture and mix until well blended. Pour batter in loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 3 loaves.

title: Acini De Pepe Salad
instructions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in large bowl. Mix juice from oranges and pineapple (reserve fruit) with sugar salt flour and eggs in saucepan. Cook mixture until thick stirring constantly. Pour mixture over macaroni and refrigerate overnight. Next day add oranges pineapple and Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries.

title: *Curried Shrimp In Cream Sauce
instructions: In a medium sized pan cook onion in butter until tender but not brown. Add undiluted soup and stir until smooth. Add sour cream and curry powder. Thicken with 2 tablespoons cornstarch. Heat to boiling point; add shrimp. Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water following package directions; drain. Add oregano to spaghetti sauce. In greased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish make layers in order of half of the noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella cheese slices and spaghetti sauce. Repeat. Bake in moderate oven at about 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: Stir salad dressing mustard and honey together. Place chicken on grill on rack of broiler pan. Brush with 1/2 of sauce. Grill or broil 8 to 10 minutes. Turn and brush with remaining sauce. Continue grilling or broiling 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Serves 4.

title: Seafoam Salad
instructions: Drain pears; save juice. Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot pear juice (add water to make 1 cup if need be). Mash cream cheese and pears. Add to jello. Refrigerate until set. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Return to refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Easy Fudge
instructions: Mix ingredients together in boiler. Heat until hot. Mix in nuts and pour into buttered cake pan. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Grandma White'S Pecan Pie
instructions: Mix flour thoroughly with sugar. Beat eggs lightly; add butter salt and sugar mixture. Mix. Add syrup and nuts. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven 10 minutes then reduce heat to 350\u00b0. Bake 50 minutes more.

title: Lemon Cheese Dessert
instructions: Mix cream cheese until soft. Add pudding mix and cold milk. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed until smooth and creamy. Chill 5 minutes. Spoon into dessert shells (shortcakes). Top with whipped cream.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Sift together flour baking powder salt and baking soda. Mash bananas with rotary beater or fork. Add lemon juice and mix. Cream shortening and sugar with electric mixer at medium speed or with spoon. Add eggs and beat thoroughly until very light and fluffy (4 minutes beating in all). Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and bananas. Beat after each addition. Cook in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves (pan size 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch). Cool 10 minutes then remove from pan.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice steak into thin strips. Brown steak in butter in a large skillet. Remove from pan. Saute mushrooms and onions in pan drippings in skillet. Stir in steak and broth heating to boiling point. Combine flour and sour cream in a small bowl blending well. Add sour cream mixture to steak blending well. Season with salt and pepper. Cook over low heat until heated through stirring occasionally. Serve over buttered noodles.

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Mix eggs sugar cooking oil grated zucchini and vanilla. Combine remaining ingredients and add to mixture. Bake in greased loaf pans at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Graham Cracker Brownies
instructions: Roll graham crackers fine; add milk chocolate chips nuts and vanilla. Spread in a well-greased pan (10 x 14 x 2-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Grilled Stuffed Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the broiler. Cut each tomato into 4 slices (discard cores). Arrange slices on a baking sheet.

title: Ground Beef Quiches
instructions: Cook beef garlic powder and black pepper until beef is done; drain and set aside. Combine biscuit mix and cornmeal in a bowl. Cut in butter. Add enough water to form a soft dough. Press onto bottom and sides of miniature muffin pans. Place a teaspoon of beef mixture into each shell.

title: Slush
instructions: Stir water and sugar well. Add orange juice lemonade and whiskey. Freeze for 24 hours. To serve add 2 tablespoons to 7-Up and ice.

title: C.B.'S Quintessential Steak
instructions: Chop the horns off chop the tail off and slide it across the grill.

title: Squash Muffins
instructions: Beat egg in medium mixing bowl; add milk and squash. Combine dry ingredients; stir into squash mixture. Stir in oil. Spray muffin tins with Pam and heat at 350\u00b0 until hot. Spoon batter into tins filling cups 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes or until done and brown. Yields about 1 dozen.

title: Salmon-Caviar Mousse
instructions: Mix gelatin with 1/4 cup cold water. Let stand for 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup hot water and stir until dissolved. Refrigerate until chilled. In small bowl beat cream until peaks form; set aside. In large bowl beat salmon mayonnaise dill weed paprika hot pepper sauce and gelatin mixture until smooth. Fold in caviar then fold in cream. Spoon into greased mold. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until firm. Unmold and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix well. Bake uncovered in 350\u00b0 oven until hot and bubbly (about 25 to 30 minutes). Top with 1 can onion rings. Heat until brown.

title: Herbed Tomatoes
instructions: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Arrange on lettuce leaves and sprinkle with basil and sugar.

title: Elegant Potato Casserole
instructions: Cook potatoes; cool and shred. Heat 1/4 cup butter or margarine with green onions and soup. Then blend in sour cream and grated cheese. Stir in potatoes. Place in buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole. Mix corn flakes with 2 tablespoons melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Garnish with parsley. Serves 6.

title: Elegant Crab Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter until tender. Add flour and cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Add crab meat (dont break it up) salt pepper and milk. Cook over low heat 15 minutes. Add cream and scotch. Stir well. Warm. Sprinkle with parsley before serving. Makes 8 cups.

title: Party Casserole
instructions: Add egg noodles and salt to rapidly boiling water stirring occasionally until tender; drain. Saute onion in butter or margarine until tender stir in green pepper and cook 1 minute longer. In large bowl blend mushroom soup sour cream salt and pepper chicken ham olives pimentos and artichoke hearts. Mix gently spoon into buttered 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle with buttered crumbs. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour serve with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Walnut Hermits
instructions: Cream together shortening brown sugar and eggs. Add the dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture. Add walnuts raisins and dates. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Lemon Cake Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour salt butter and egg yolks. Beat until smooth. Add lemon juice and rind. Add milk slowly. Beat egg whites stiff but not dry. Fold in. Bake pie shell 5 minutes. Pour in filling. Bake 40 minutes or until firm in 350\u00b0 oven. Pie will have a cake-like topping.

title: Onion Casserole
instructions: Dice onions in fairly large chunks and boil in salted water for about 10 minutes. Drain and put into a quart casserole dish. Pour one small can (or less) of evaporated milk over onions. Cover generously with grated cheese and bake at 325\u00b0 until it bubbles and cheese melts. If too much liquid remains cook a little longer.

title: Hot Crab Hors D'Oeuvres
instructions: Mix above and place in pie plate. Cover with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve hot with crackers.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
instructions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with sour cream. Add vanilla flavoring. Fold in thawed coconut. Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Brownies Deluxe
instructions: Melt in top of double boiler 2 sticks of oleo and 4 squares baking chocolate. In mixing bowl beat eggs. Add sugar gradually. Add flour and baking powder. Add chocolate mixture. Do not wash boiler. Add 2 teaspoons vanilla and nut meats. Spread in large pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1/2 hour (will pull away from edge slightly).

title: Big Pot
instructions: Cover ham hocks with water; cook slowly until tender. Debone. Cook chicken in same sauce ham hocks were cooked adding enough water to cover chicken if needed. Debone when done. Put chicken and ham hocks back into broth with 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil. Add all 3 flavors of rice; cook down low and enjoy.

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Cook and peel potatoes; cube. Heat butter with soup. Blend in sour cream onions and cheese. Stir in potato cubes. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Pour into buttered casserole dish and top with crushed potato chips.

title: Caramel Frosting
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in saucepan over low heat. Stir in\tbrown sugar and salt. Cook 2 minutes over low heat stirring constantly. Add milk and stir\tconstantly until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in powdered sugar. Add 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and mix well. Stir until frosting\tstarts to \crinkle\ as it cools. Pour immediately onto\twarm cake; spread quickly. This frosting sets up fast so work very quickly.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together all ingredients and bake for 20 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Cranberry Mold
instructions: You will also need a 13 x 9 x 2-inch serving container.

title: Chocolate Mousse Brownies
instructions: In large microwave-safe bowl melt butter and chocolate chips on High for 90 seconds stirring every 30 seconds. Stir in remaining ingredients (except pecans). Beat until smooth. Stir in pecans. Spread into buttered 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Set aside.

title: Jean'S Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 9 ingredients. Top with the crushed cornflakes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Date Candy
instructions: Mix sugar milk and dates. Cook to creamy consistency. Remove from heat and add nuts. Beat until thick and pour into buttered dish.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Brown sausage onion jalapeno peppers salt and pepper. Drain. Mix cornmeal eggs salt onion milk and creamed corn. Pour 1/2 batter into greased baking dish. Add meat then cheese. Top with rest of batter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Zucchini Pilaf
instructions: Saute zucchini in oil and garlic. Remove from pan. Add rice and brown in butter. Place rice in a saucepan; add soup stock and white wine. Bring to boil without lid. Add salt. Place zucchini on top of rice. Do not stir. Cover and simmer. Add cheese when serving.

title: Cherry Delight Salad
instructions: Put Cool Whip in bowl. Add pineapple filling milk and nuts. Stir gently until mixed. Cool in refrigerator about 1 hour.

title: Carrot Casserole
instructions: Brown onion in butter in skillet. Add cream of celery soup. Cook carrots separately until almost tender. Mix carrots with onion and soup mixture in baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Good.

title: Crown Jewel Jello
instructions: Mix crumbs sugar and melted butter. Press on bottom and up sides of buttered 9-inch spring-form pan. Chill

title: Yellow Squash Casserole
instructions: Drain and save water from cooked squash. Add cheese; stir as it melts. Stir in stuffing picante onion and eggs. Add a little water from squash if it seems dry. Put in greased casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Red Rice
instructions: Fry sausages or franks in oil; add tomato sauce. Add all of the seasonings and spices. Let sauce boil. Wash rice and pour off water. Pour sauce over the rice.

title: Corned Beef Hash
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except milk. Heat milk and pour it on the mixture. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix sausage stuffing and water. Add onion eggs and baking powder. Roll into balls and bake them for 15 minutes covered at 325\u00b0. Uncover raise heat to 350\u00b0 and bake for 25 more minutes.

title: Orange Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Using a large bowl mix 1 1/2 cups flour 1/2 cup sugar salt orange peel and undissolved yeast. Combine milk water orange juice and 1/2 cup butter; heat until warm. Gradually add to dry mixture. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed. Add egg and 1/2 cup flour to make thick batter; beat 2 minutes on high. Stir in enough additional flour to make soft dough. Turn out on pastry cloth; knead until smooth. Put in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover with towel; let rise until double.

title: Crab Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Chill 2 hours before serving. Serve with crackers chips or raw vegetables. Makes 2 cups.

title: Creme De Menthe Bars
instructions: Mix and pat into 10 x 15 jelly roll pan or 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20-25 minutes. Let cool.

title: Squash Fritters
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Drop by tablespoon onto oiled griddle and cook on medium heat until lightly browned. Turn and brown other side. Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Cups
instructions: Combine 1 stick margarine and cheese; melt. Combine with flour. Chill mixture for about 1 hour; shape into cups to fit miniature muffin tins that have been sprayed with Bakers Joy cooking spray. Beat brown sugar 3 tablespoons margarine vanilla and egg together; add nuts. Fill cups about 2/3 full. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for approximately 12 minutes. You might need to cook a little longer until lightly browned depending on the temperature of your oven.

title: Cranberry Fluff
instructions: Mix cranberries marshmallows and sugar and chill overnight. Next day before serving add the remaining ingredients except for whipping cream. Whip the cream and fold into the mixture creating the Fluff. Serve in a crystal bowl. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Broiled Tomato Halves
instructions: Cut tomatoes in half. Sprinkle with salt pepper and basil. Top with buttered bread crumbs then Parmesan cheese. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Maple Apple Ice Cream Punch
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in container or electric blender; blend well. Pour mixture into punch cups; top each with a scoop of ice cream. Serves 12 to 16.

title: Sticky Buns
instructions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with walnuts and raisins. Thaw dough partially. Cut each loaf into 8 slices and each slice into 4 pieces. Line pan in row of pieces. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over top of dough pieces. Let rise until double in size or overnight in refrigerator. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Invert buns onto platter.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix salt pepper onion powder soup 1/3 c butter and cheese. Place mixture on top of homefries. Add corn flakes and 1/4 c butter to top. Bake uncovered in 13 x 9 baking pan for 1 hour.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix hamburger onion and green pepper. Cook rice. Add rice to hamburger mixture; pour tomato sauce over meat loaf. Cook 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add tomato juice while cooking. Make gravy with the tomato sauce.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Mix softened butter with white sugar eggs vanilla and almond. Add cream cheese. Add sifted flour. Beat until smooth.

title: Gingerbread
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease and flour squash 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat all ingredients in large mixer bowl on low speed scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed scraping bowl occasionally for 3 minutes. Pour into pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean about 50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or applesauce if desired. Makes 9 servings.

title: Texas Twist
instructions: Cook macaroni; drain and set to side. Cook hamburger meat; drain and set to side. In big pot mix all ingredients and cook to just a boil. Then its done. Just serve and eat!

title: Garlic Shrimp And Pasta
instructions: Mix cornstarch and broth set aside. In a skillet or medium-high heat heat oil. Cook shrimp garlic and pepper until shrimp turns pink stirring often. Set aside. Add parsley and lemon juice. Stir in cornstarch mixture and add. Cook mixture to a boil and thicken stirring often. Return to shrimp pan. Heat through. Toss with pasta. Serves 6.

title: Broccoli Quiche(For Nonfat Diets)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Spray quiche dish with Pam or canola oil cooking spray. Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting
instructions: Melt together milk sugar yolks vanilla and margarine. Stir; cook until thickened. Add coconut and pecans as desired.

title: Pasta Salad
instructions: Double the dressing if it is too dry.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Place apples (cut into pieces); mix water and cinnamon and pour over apples. Mix brown sugar butter and flour until blended well. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown sausage and ground chuck. Add sauce. Boil lasagne noodles. Mix egg in cottage cheese. Layer noodles meat sauce Parmesan cheese cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Cook 1 hour in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pizza Snack
instructions: Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Crumble fry and drain sausage. Combine with all ingredients except biscuits. Separate each biscuit into 3 pizza rounds. Spread each with meat mixture and place on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Strawberry Scones
instructions: In large bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Cut butter into flour mixture until coarse crumbs form. Stir in strawberries. Add buttermilk and mix with fork just until dough is moistened. Gather dough into a ball and roll or pat into a 3/4-inch thick circle. Cut into hearts (approximately 12) and place on greased baking sheet 1 1/2-inches apart. Brush tops of scones with cream. Place on bottom rack of a 400\u00b0 oven for 14 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Chocolate Chip Pie
instructions: Mix in the order it comes (except pie shells). Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Uncle George'S Cranberry Chutney
instructions: In large kettle over medium heat bring cranberries and water to a boil reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Remove; add balance of ingredients then put back on heat for an additional 10 minutes. Chill and serve as relish for turkey or chicken.

title: Cranberry Roast Pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Rub roast with salt and pepper. Place on rack in a broiler pan. Bake for 2 hours and 30 minutes to 3 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 175\u00b0. In a saucepan combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Remove the sauce from heat. About halfway through the baking process begin to baste the roast with the cranberry mixture. Repeat every 15 minutes until roast is done. Serve remaining sauce with sliced roast.

title: Sesame Chicken(Excellent And Easy!)
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour salt pepper and paprika. Melt margarine and oil in 9 x 13-inch glass dish in the oven. Put chicken in pan and sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seed and bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Turn chicken and add scallions remaining sesame seed mushrooms and white wine. Lower oven to 350\u00b0 and cook for another 20 minutes.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain the pineapple and oranges saving the juice. Combine with the eggs sugar and flour. Cook over low heat until thick. Add jello and stir until dissolved. Cook before adding fruit and marshmallows. Chill several hours or overnight. Makes a large salad.

title: Jello Shots
instructions: Following and adding to instructions on package add 2 cups boiling water to gelatin stirring about 2 minutes or until dissolved. Pour liquid into a storage container. Add 1 cup of cold water and 1 cup of alcoholic beverage. Stir well and refrigerate until solid.

title: No Cook Icing
instructions: Combine egg whites cream of tartar and sugar in large mixing bowl. Add vanilla and mix. Add boiling water and beat until stiff at high speed with electric mixer or by hand for approximately 10 minutes or until stiff. This will ice a large cake.

title: Sausage-Cornbread Bake
instructions: Grease 2-quart baking dish. Brown sausage and onions in skillet and drain well. Combine eggs corn meal milk and oil. Pour 1/2 of corn meal mixture into prepared dish. Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese. Pour remaining batter over top and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 420\u00b0.

title: Strawberry Pizza
instructions: Combine flour and powdered sugar; add butter mixing well. Pat dough out in a 14-inch pizza pan; bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tabbouleh With A Tang
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions. Fluff with a fork. Halve tomatoes and dice cucumber. In large bowl toss together couscous halved tomatoes diced cucumber chopped mint and citrus vinaigrette. Season with salt pepper extra lemon juice and hot pepper sauce to taste if desired. Chill. Makes 4 servings.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken
instructions: Place carrots onions and celery in crock-pot. Add chicken chicken broth water and seasonings. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
instructions: In a bowl with an electric mixer cream together 1 stick of butter oil and sugar; beat in eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition and beat in buttermilk and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Stir in 1/4 cup cocoa powder flour baking soda cloves cinnamon and salt until the mixture is just combined and fold in zucchini (patted dry with paper towels) chocolate chips and walnuts. Pour batter into 2 well buttered 9-inch round cake pans and bake in middle of preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or Bundt pan for 60 minutes until tester comes out clean. Let cool 10 minutes and turn out onto racks and cool completely.

title: Mom'S Biscuits
instructions: Combine flours sugar and baking powder in bowl. Cut in margarine. Add milk and stir lightly. Knead 10 times. Shape into balls or roll out and cut. Use greased pan. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

title: Green Bean Delight
instructions: Pour green beans into a 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream. Pour this over beans and top with Velveeta. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese bubbles.

title: Spinach Salad
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp. Cool on paper towel; crumble when cool. Add the next 4 ingredients to bacon drippings; blend well. Cook on high until mixture boils. Add sugar if desired. Remove stems and tear spinach in medium size pieces. Combine with diced onions in large bowl. Pour hot dressing over top of spinach; toss lightly. Sprinkle with grated egg and crumbled bacon. Serve immediately.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Mix beans sugar and barbecue sauce in large saucepan. Cook peppers and onions in microwave about 15 to 20 minutes. Mix with bean mixture. Add allspice. Simmer on low heat until hot. Do not boil.

title: Pretzel Surprise
instructions: Bottom Layer Mix pretzels with sugar and melted margarine. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into lightly greased 8 x 8-inch glass casserole dish.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a Bundt pan. In a large bowl combine all ingredients. Follow cake mix package directions for mixing. Pour batter into pan and bake for 50 minutes or until cake tests done.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Break spaghetti into 1-inch pieces if desired and cook according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water and drain. Combine spaghetti cucumber and next 3 ingredients. Chill. Serve on lettuce and top with tomato wedges. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Slow Cook Chili
instructions: Cook 7 to 8 hours on Number 4 in crock-pot.

title: Sweet-Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in butter in large skillet. Cover; simmer 35 to 40 minutes. Remove chicken; set aside. Drain pineapple reserving syrup. Combine sugar cornstarch and salt in skillet. Gradually stir in vinegar soy sauce and reserved syrup. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened. Add pineapple green pepper onion and reserved chicken. Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Gourmet Carrots
instructions: Combine last 7 ingredients and beat for 3 minutes. Pour over carrots and onions. Let stand in refrigerator 24 hours. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Crab Rolls
instructions: Saut green pepper and onion until tender. Add crab and heat through. Set aside to cool. Beat cream cheese with garlic and onion powder salt and pepper. Stir in cheeses and crab mixture. Beat egg white slightly and mix into crab mixture. Chill several hours. Separate crescent rolls and place one tablespoon mixture on dough and roll up and seal. Brush with egg white and bake 375 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until browned.

title: Easy Nacho Appetizer Spread
instructions: On two plates two 7-inch circles spread each item in order given in an even layer. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chicken Or Beef Borscht
instructions: Cook chicken until done. Cut into cubes to be added later. Cook vegetables until done then add the cooked chicken. Mix 1 can cream of tomato soup with 1 can of evaporated milk. Add this to the soup just before serving.

title: Easy And Basic Red (Tomato) Sauce
instructions: Basic Mixture In large pan lightly saute onions and garlic in olive oil. Add the tomatoes (i.e. whole crushed and puree); then add allspice chives and paprika. Simmer on low heat for several hours (the longer the better). You may stop here cool and store (e.g. freeze or refrigerate) for later use or use as directed.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook and drain squash. Mix and pour in casserole dish greased with butter. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until top begins to brown.

title: Chow Mein
instructions: Cook celery and onions in 2 tablespoons hot oil for 5 minutes. Add salt bean sprouts and cook covered 5 minutes. Place on platter. Fry pork in remaining oil until cooked.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Combine sour cream with cream cheese. Add celery onions salt lemon juice and red pepper. Mash 2 cans of shrimp with a fork. Add to the cheese mixture. Sprinkle red pepper on top. Mix 1 can of shrimp in whole.

title: Lasagna
instructions: Fry burger. Add Ragu in one dish. Cook lasagna in boiling salted water. In separate dish mix yogurt and cottage cheese. Then grate cheese. Grease casserole dish. Lay a layer of lasagna then a layer of white mix layer of cheese Ragu then yellow cheese. Repeat. Place in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Diet Slaw(Low-Fat, Low Sugar, Low Salt)
instructions: Beat egg; add vinegar Sweet N Low and salt. Cook until thick (about 1 to 2 minutes). Cool. Add milk. Pour over chopped cabbage.

title: Shrimp Etouffee
instructions: In a large pan melt butter. Saute diced onion until clear. Add shallots stirring constantly. Add shrimp soup; heat and stir. Add shrimp pieces. Cook until pink. Serve over rice and Italian or French bread.

title: Chicken Diane
instructions: Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap. Pound slighlty with mallet. Sprinkle with black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon each of oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Transfer to platter. Add chives lemon juice parsley and mustard to pan. Cook 15 seconds whisking constantly. Whisk in broth. Stir until smooth. Whisk remaining butter and oil. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve immediately.

title: Sicilian Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes in half. Coat well with oil. Put cut side up in greased baking dish. Mix garlic powder salt and pepper. Sprinkle potatoes with mixture along with oregano cheese and paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 until tender. Makes 8 servings.

title: Crescents
instructions: Blend all together. Roll into fingers and curve into crescent shapes. Bake on a cookie sheet at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours. Take from oven and roll in powdered sugar. (Can bake for 30 minutes in a 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0 oven.)

title: Broccoli Rice Casserole I
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a casserole except broccoli. Put in oven on low heat until butter and cheese have melted and can be blended with other ingredients. Slightly thaw broccoli; leave enough ice in it for moisture. Mix broccoli gently into mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs. Add milk saltines onion salt sage and pepper. Add beef and mix well. Shape into an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf in an ungreased shallow baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread 3/4 cup of this over meat loaf. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes until no pink remains. Drain. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with remaining sauce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Dice the potatoes eggs pickles pimento onion and tomatoes. Toss in the mayonnaise; chill. Season with the remaining ingredients; taste as you go.

title: Apple Bread Pudding And Sauce
instructions: Combine eggs sugar and flour until smooth. Add milk and blend well. Set custard in refrigerator. Butter 11 x 7 x 1 3/4-inch pan and line bottom with the sliced bread. Cover with 1/2 chopped apples and raisins and 1/3 of custard. Repeat for second layer. Top with remaining bread and custard. Drizzle melted oleo over top. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until custard is slightly firm.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Combine vegetables and water in large pan; simmer for 15 minutes. Leave in liquid. Add soup milk margarine and cheese. Heat until cheese melts.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Mix first four ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Mix the last three ingredients to make the frosting.

title: Applesauce Salad
instructions: Add cinnamon candy to 2 cups boiling water to dissolve. Add jello; stir to dissolve. Add applesauce. Chill. Makes 4 to 6 servings

title: General Glover Cheese Spread
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat with mixer on low speed until well blended. Serve with crackers.

title: Cheese Dip
instructions: Mix margarine and flour. Mix in all other ingredients. Cook over low heat until thick. (If dip gets too thick add water.) Serve warm with chips.

title: Fresh Corn Chowder
instructions: Cut corn off cob. In saucepan combine corn onion 1/2 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until corn is barely done; stir occasionally. Stir in 3 1/2 cups milk butter salt and pepper combining remaining milk and flour mixture to corn. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Slowly stir in about 1 cup of the hot mixture into beaten egg. Return to hot mixture in saucepan. Cook over low heat 2 more minutes. Stir. Do not boil. Serves 6.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Drain and mix juice from fruit and slice bananas into it. Let set for about 10 minutes. Remove bananas. Mix juice with pudding and cook over low heat until thick. Cool mixture and mix all together.

title: White Chilli
instructions: Combine beans broth garlic and onion. Cook until tender. You may need to add more liquid. Add chillies and spices to bean mixture. Add diced chicken and simmer at least 1 hour. Serve topped with grated cheese. Offer other garnishes such as sour cream ripe olives chopped tomatoes tortilla chips salsa and guacamole. Serve with wedge of crusty cornbread.

title: Leg Of Lamb With Artichokes
instructions: Rub cut edges of lamb with 1 clove of garlic; sprinkle with juice of 1/2 lemon. Roll lamb; tie at 1 1/2-inch intervals. Cut slits in lamb; insert slivers of 1 clove of garlic. Rub with remaining lemon juice oregano salt and pepper. Place in roasting pan. Roast at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350\u00b0. Roast to 130\u00b0 on meat thermometer basting frequently with pan drippings. Skim drippings. Add tomato sauce water and lemon slices. Roast for 15 minutes. Add artichoke hearts. Roast for 15 minutes or to 150\u00b0 to 160\u00b0 on meat thermometer for medium basting frequently. Place lamb on heated platter. Arrange artichoke hearts around lamb. Strain sauce; serve with lamb. Yield 10 servings.

title: Diet Zucchini Bread
instructions: Blend all together in a mixer for 3 to 4 minutes. Add 2 cups grated zucchini. Pour into Pam sprayed loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Easter Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine Eagle Brand milk Cool Whip and vanilla. Add canned fruit (drained) cherries and nuts. Chill overnight. A nice salad to serve for Christmas or Easter with ham.

title: Calico Salad
instructions: Combine cauliflower green pepper celery carrots and onions in a large bowl. Mix together remaining ingredients. Toss mixture with vegetables. Chill at least 2 hours.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken; debone and cover bottom of casserole with bite size pieces. Cover with soup. In a separate bowl mix stuffing milk chopped onion eggs sage and broth. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Very good.

title: Oatmeal With Raisins And Cinnamon
instructions: Combine water salt and raisins in a small saucepan; bring to boil. Stir in oats and cinnamon. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute or until water is absorbed. Remove from heat and serve warm. A serving amount is 1/2 cup at 93 calories. Diabetic Exchange 1 starch.

title: Chocolate Halfway Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco. Add yolks water and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients 3 times. Add to creamed Crisco mixture. Mix well. Pat out on greased pan and sprinkle chips on top. Beat egg whites stiff. Add 1 cup brown sugar slowly. Beat and spread on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Cut when cool.

title: Shoo-Fly Cake
instructions: Crumb first four ingredients together in a large bowl. Set aside 1 1/2 cups crumbs. To remaining crumb mixture add molasses water and soda. Stir until well blended do not use a mixer. Grease and flour bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Hot Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix with hands; make into small balls. Place on cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen transfer to a plastic bag. Remove only the amount needed for baking. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken about 20 minutes; add broccoli 1/2 stick butter salt and pepper to taste. Cook broccoli until tender. Combine soup and mayonnaise. Add 3 spoons of broth to soup and mayonnaise. Cut chicken into bite size pieces. In a casserole dish layer chicken broccoli cheese and soup mixture. Repeat this time making cheese come out on top. Cook 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serves 6.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup chocolate sugar butter and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Crock-Pot Roast
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Put in enough water to cover meat. Cook slow 6 to 8 hours. Remove meat; slice. (Serve with gravy.)

title: Drop Donuts
instructions: Mix all ingredients well then fry in Crisco oil in a deep fryer until golden brown. Take out and sprinkle with powdered sugar. It is easiest if the dough is rolled into little balls before frying.

title: Pizza Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain and return to pot. Halve pepperoni; add to pasta. Stir in pizza sauce 1 cup Mozzarella cheese mushrooms olives and Parmesan cheese. Transfer to 12 x 7-inch baking dish. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Drain crab meat. Pour lemon juice over crab meat. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to crab meat and juice. Put in saucepan over low heat stirring occasionally until creamy. Serve with any type of crackers.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Wash rice; place in 3-quart casserole dish. Mix mushroom soup onion soup and water. Pour 2/3 of mix over rice. Place chicken skin down on top of rice. Pour remaining mix over chicken. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover casserole with foil. Bake at 400\u00b0 about 1 hour or until done.

title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
instructions: Combine the 3/4 cup sugar cinnamon nutmeg and salt in a saucepan. Stir in the milk canned pumpkin and beaten egg yolks. Add softened gelatin and cook over medium heat until the mixture begins to thicken and boil. Remove from heat and stir in bourbon. Chill until partially set. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Slowly add the 2 tablespoons sugar. Pour into baked pie shell and brown.

title: Funnel Cakes The Amish Way
instructions: Beat eggs and add milk. Sift flour salt sugar and baking powder. Add egg and milk. Beat until smooth. Hold finger over bottom of funnel. Pour some batter into hot deep oil (375\u00b0) swirling into circles center to outer edge (3 inches round). Fry until golden brown. Drain on brown paper bags. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Spicy Blue Cheese Stuffed Celery
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Cut celery into serving size stalks and stuff with mixture. Sprinkle with parsley and chill until serving time. Makes about 12.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix crushed pretzels with 3 tablespoons sugar and melted butter. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

title: Sweet And Sour Smokies
instructions: Mix barbecue sauce and grape jelly together; pour over Little Smokies in crock-pot. Cook on high until hot; turn to low to keep warm.

title: Custard Pie Deluxe
instructions: Beat eggs until yolks and whites are well blended. Add sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly add whole milk and evaporated milk stirring constantly. Line 9-inch pan with pastry; rub few drops of cold water over pastry. Add filling; sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 325\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until a knife comes out clean.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add milk eggs oil and salt. Mix well. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Dip
instructions: Beat sour cream cream cheese oregano garlic powder and red pepper. Spread in a square pan. Pour pizza sauce on top. Layer pepperoni then pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Top with cheese. Bake another 5 minutes. Dip with tortilla chips or any kind you like.

title: Easy Punch
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Float the sherbet on top. Serves 20 to 25.

title: Christmas Nut Thins
instructions: Combine butter and sugar creaming until light and fluffy. Add eggs beaten well. Add flour and salt and mix until smooth. Stir in chopped pecans and vanilla mixing well.

title: Crab Balls
instructions: Drain squeeze and pick crab. Mix everything else and then add crab. Chill thoroughly. Form into balls. Keep well chilled until party or serving. Add a pretzel stick to each ball and pick up by pretzel stick.

title: Spanish Steak
instructions: Pound flour into meat. In large skillet brown meat in hot oil. Drain off excess fat. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over steak. Cover and simmer 45 to 50 minutes or until meat is tender. Makes 6 servings.

title: Purple Cow
instructions: Combine in blender. Process until smooth and thick. Serve in tall glasses.

title: Apple Chicken Salad
instructions: In a small bowl combine first 7 ingredients. Chill until ready to serve. Place lettuce leaf on a serving plate and top with the chilled chicken salad. Garnish with alfalfa sprouts if desired.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients until crumbly. Press half in 9-inch square pan heavily greased. Add diced apples. On stove combine cornstarch sugar water and vanilla. Cook over slow heat until thick and clear. Pour over apples. Top with remaining crumbles. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: White Fudge
instructions: Stir all ingredients (except nuts) together over low heat until Crisco is dissolved. Bring to boil and boil 8 to 10 minutes or soft ball stage stirring constantly over low or medium heat. Remove from heat and beat with mixer until thick enough to pour. Stir in nuts and pour into a greased oblong pan or baking dish.

title: Twix Type Candy Bar
instructions: Separate cookies and use only 1 side per candy bar. Top cookie with thin layer of hand-formed caramel. Place in pre-lined candy cavity and cap.

title: Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Set cooked spaghetti aside. Brown beef and onion; drain. Set aside. Melt butter; stir in flour. Add milk; stir until thick. Add salt and pepper to taste. Layer ingredients in 13 x 9-inch casserole in this order spaghetti meat mix and sausage. Repeat until ingredients are gone. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven until bubbly.

title: Oven Caramel Corn
instructions: Heat oven to 200\u00b0. Divide popcorn between 2 ungreased baking pans (13 x 9 x 2-inch). In saucepan heat sugar butter corn syrup and salt. Stir occasionally until bubbly around edges. Continue cooking over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda until foamy. Pour over popped corn stirring until corn is well coated. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes. Makes about 15 cups.

title: Ann'S Pound Cake
instructions: Mix sugar margarine and butter well then add eggs and then add remaining ingredients. Pour batter into well-greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

title: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Cook pudding as directed. Pour into cake mix the oil; mix well. Spread into 9 x 12-inch pan. (Can spray with Pam.) Sprinkle chips on top then sprinkle nuts. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Mix and set aside until cool the orange jello hot water and orange juice. Then add orange sections and can of crushed pineapple (not drained). Let set in refrigerator.

title: Coconut Pecan Frosting And Filling
instructions: Combine milk sugar egg yolks butter and vanilla in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened about 12 minutes. Remove from heat. Add coconut and pecans. Beat until cool and of spreading consistency. Makes 2 2/3 cups or enough for tops of three 8 or 9-inch layers.

title: Savory Chicken Casserole
instructions: Spread rice evenly in a greased 4-quart baking dish. Pour undiluted soup over rice and add water. Sprinkle onion soup mix over rice mixture. Lay chicken skin side up on top. Sprinkle salt pepper and paprika lightly on top. Cover with lid or foil. Bake at 225\u00b0 for approximately 2 1/3 to 3 hours or until rice and chicken are cooked to your preference.

title: Pepper Steak
instructions: Cut meat in small pieces and sprinkle with paprika. Brown meat in butter. Add garlic and broth. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in onions and green peppers. Cover and cook 5 minutes more.

title: Cherry Surprise
instructions: Layer cherry pie filling sprinkled coconut layer of crushed pineapple sprinkled coconut. Sprinkle dry cake mix over top. Cut 1 quarter margarine up over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Beat eggs add sugar oil and pumpkin. Mix dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture. Bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan for 40 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Easy Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Blend and store in sealed container.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar and set aside. In large bowl put 3 cups flour add yeast and combine. Pat egg and oil into flour mixture of yeast; mix well. Add remaining 3 cups flour and form into a large dough ball. Put in a well oiled bowl and place a wet kitchen towel over dough and refrigerate.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Drain and rinse shrimp. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients until smooth then stir in shrimp. Chill overnight for best flavor.

title: Creole Liver And Limas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cut liver into bite-size pieces and brown with onion and celery in nonstick skillet. Add remaining ingredients except limas. Place lima beans in a 1-quart casserole dish and pour liver mixture over them. Bake for 45 minutes. Divide evenly. Makes 2 servings.

title: Crackling Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Mix dry ingredients; stir in cracklings. Add milk; place in greased skillet preferably iron and bake for 30 minutes.

title: My Best Fruit Cake
instructions: Cream the butter and sugar together and add eggs. Add flour and spices. In another bowl mix all fruit well. Add nuts and sprinkle with 1/2 cup of flour. Add cake mix; mix well. Dough should drop from spoon slowly. Pour into 2 tube pans which have been well greased and floured. Cook 2 hours in oven that has been preheated to 300\u00b0.

title: Swedish Cheese Cake
instructions: The milk must be whole milk. Heat milk to lukewarm. Make a thin paste of flour with part of the milk. Soak rennet tablet in water for 3 minutes. Add paste and rennet to the milk and stir well. Let stand 40 minutes. Stir curds put in cheese cloth and drain off whey.

title: Brownies
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan. In large bowl combine all brownie ingredients. Beat 50 strokes by hand. Spread in greased pan. Bake 33 to 35 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool completely.

title: Grandma Utterback'S Sweet Rolls
instructions: Pour hot milk over sugar shortening and salt. When lukewarm add 4 cups flour and the eggs; beat well. Add yeast dissolved in 1/4 teaspoon sugar. Add more flour until beater will no longer carry it. Turn out on floured board and knead lightly working in a little more flour as needed. Put in a greased bowl and let rise to twice its bulk. Work down and let rise again.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
instructions: In heavy saucepan combine all ingredients. Stir over low heat until chocolate is melted completely. Serve warm. Yield 1 2/3 cups.

title: Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Make paste with cocoa and food coloring. Cream sugar shortening and eggs. Blend well. Add cocoa and food coloring mixture to creamed shortening and egg mixture. Combine sifted and measured flour and salt. Add alternately with buttermilk and vanilla to creamed mixture. If you use electric mixer remove blades and fold in vinegar and soda. Pour batter into three equal portions in 8-inch pans greased and lined. Bake in 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Lemon Blueberry Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg yolks in a medium bowl. Stir in sweetened condensed milk ReaLemon brand juice and rind. Pour into prepared crust. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Chill. Top with blueberry filling. Garnish with whipped topping. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Pizzelles
instructions: Beat margarine until smooth. Add sugar gradually and beat well until light. Add eggs and vanilla or anise. Beat until light and fluffy about 10 minutes with electric mixer. Add flour baking powder and salt. Allow to stand until pizzelle iron heats up. Use paper towel with oil on it and rub over iron. Throw out 1st pizzelles (too much oil absorbed). Use 1 tablespoon of mixture per mold. Pick up pizzelles with a fork put on paper towel to drain oil off and cool.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler
instructions: In 1-quart shallow casserole combine peaches sugar 1 tablespoon Bisquick and cinnamon. In medium bowl mix remaining 2/3 cup Bisquick with brown sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture is size of small peas. Stir in milk until moistened. Drop by spoonfuls onto peaches. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into crust comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Yum Yum Salad
instructions: Combine and bring pineapple and water to a boil. Add jello and stir until dissolved. Add 2 cups water and fold in Cool Whip. Add Cheddar cheese (grated). Add chopped pecans. Let sit in refrigerator until firm. This is a very good salad.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 (350\u00b0 for glass pan). In a 3-quart bowl mix brown sugar melted shortening salt and pumpkin pie spice. Add and stir until smooth sweet potatoes canned milk and egg. Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Bake 45 minutes or until firm.

title: Strawberry Squares
instructions: Combine butter and 2/3 cup sugar; cream together well. Add flour baking powder and coconut. Blend until a crumbly mixture; press 1/2 into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cinnamon 1/2 cup sugar and strawberries together. Spread over crust. Sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over berries and press lightly. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes or until golden.

title: Daddy'S Pickles
instructions: Wash and slice cucumbers. Dissolve 3 cups of pickling lime in 2 gallons of water. (Use large enamel cooker or crock.) Add sliced cucumbers and let soak for 24 hours stirring occasionally. After 24 hours rinse the cucumbers and soak in clear water for 4 more hours - change the water every hour. Drain cucumbers after 4 hours.

title: Bob Hall'S Magic Garlic And Herb Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix and shake well before serving.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook hamburger and drain. Add drained kidney beans and warm. Mix lettuce onions and tomato and toss with 1/2 bag nacho chips and 1/2 cheese. Add hamburger and beans and toss; add dressing. Garnish with remaining chips cheese and tomato.

title: Chili Cheese Ball Or Log
instructions: Mix well and shape into a ball or log. Roll in chili powder to cover completely. Chill for 2 days.

title: Pepperoni Dip
instructions: Mix well. Place in 1 loaf Hawaiian bread. Have extra loaf for dipping.

title: Fig Jam Using Strawberry Jello
instructions: Mash the figs well (can use a potato masher). Cook all three ingredients 20 minutes or until flakes from spoon.\tPour in small quantities in containers.

title: Double Apple Salad
instructions: Mix Cool Whip and mayonnaise. Mix all ingredients and chill.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Squeeze juice from celery and discard. Grind all ingredients and mix with Kraft mayonnaise to desired consistency.

title: Sauerkraut Salad
instructions: Combine first five ingredients and set aside. In a small bowl combine sugar oil and vinegar. Pour this over first mixture and chill overnight.

title: Sallie'S Special Baked Beans
instructions: Add some t.l.c. and bake for at least one hour in 325\u00b0 oven. Serve with your favorite fried chicken hot dogs baked ham or whatever. Um-m-m-m good.

title: T. J. Miracle Soup
instructions: Cut vegetables. Add soup mix. Add water until vegetables are covered. Bring to a boil and boil for 10 minutes. Cover and lower heat until vegetables are cooked (dont overcook). Place vegetables in a 5-quart pan or larger to cook.

title: Magic Chocolate Or Peanut Butter Frosting
instructions: In top of double boiler combine milk water salt and chocolate or peanut butter cooking and stirring until thick. Remove from heat; cool. Stir in vanilla and spread on cake.

title: Cream Cheese Swirled Carrot Cake
instructions: Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat cream cheese sugar vanilla and egg on medium speed until smooth. Reserve. Prepare mix as directed on package. Pour into pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture by tablespoonsful in 10 to 12 mounds onto batter not touching sides of pan. Cut through batter with knife in S-shaped curves in one continuous motion. Turn pan 1/4 turn and continue cutting to swirl. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until cake pulls from sides of pan and springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool.

title: Honey Bars
instructions: Mix well with hands. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Ice while hot with

title: J.R.'S Chili
instructions: Brown the beef with the onion powder and garlic powder. Add beans and tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Make a paste from the water chili powder flour and sugar. Add 1 teaspoon salt and stir into first mixture. Simmer until somewhat thickened.

title: Hot Crab Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Blend all but crab meat and 1/2 of Cheddar cheese in mixer. Stir crab meat in with spoon. Put into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle the half of cheese on top. Top with paprika. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Marinated Pork Chops Or Chicken
instructions: Marinate pork chops or chicken for 4 to 6 hours or overnight. Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0 or until done or cook on grill 30 to 45 minutes or until juices are clear.

title: Refried Beans
instructions: Place beans and onions in a pan with water. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat; let stand 2 hours then return to heat and bring to a boil. Simmer for either 3 hours or until beans are tender. At this point melt light spread. Using a potato masher or fork start mashing beans adding light spread slowly and combining until desired consistency.

title: Aloha Ham Loaves
instructions: (Pimiento-conical shaped sweet pepper.)

title: Pink Punch
instructions: Add boiling water to jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water and juice to sugar. Add ginger ale just before serving. Serves 40.

title: Tamales De Dulce(Sweet Tamales)
instructions: Soak corn husks in warm water overnight to soften. Pat with paper toweling. Mix tortilla flour and 2 2/3 cups water; let stand 20 minutes. Meanwhile in a large mixer bowl beat together lard sugar salt and cinnamon until fluffy. Beat in flour mixture until well combined. Mix raisins fruit peels and nuts.

title: Hearty Hamburger Soup
instructions: Melt oleo in Dutch oven. Add onion carrot and green pepper. Cook until transparent not brown. Add beef and cook until crumbly and gray. Stir in tomato juice potatoes salt and pepper. Cover and simmer (stirring occasionally) until vegetables are tender (20 to 25 minutes). Combine flour with 1 cup milk and beat until smooth. Stir into soup mixture. Add remaining milk to soup and simmer until very hot. Stir frequently. Do not boil. Makes 8 servings.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Place chicken in baking dish. Mix chicken broth and celery soup heating and stirring until smooth. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients. Pour over cut up chicken. Pour flour mixture over it all and bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

title: Savory Shrimp Stir Fry
instructions: Toss shrimp into salt and pepper mixture to coat.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. In large bowl measure all ingredients. With mixer at low speed beat ingredients until well mixed occasionally scraping bowl. Drop dough by 2 level tablespoons 3-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned. With pancake turner immediately remove cookies to wire racks; cool. Store in tightly covered container. Makes about 2 dozen.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Pick over and wash beans. Soak overnight in cold water to cover then drain. Add 2 1/2 qts. water cook over low heat about 1 1/2 hours. In soup kettle saute celery and onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour cook 1 minute. Stir into beans gradually. Add to this mixture the remaining ingredients. Simmer about 3-4 hours. Remove from heat discard bay leaves. If desired add 1/2 c. Madeira. When serving float a very thin slice of lemon on top of bowl of soup (optional).

title: Frozen Yogurt Pie
instructions: Use same flavor of yogurt and fruit. Strawberry blueberry and peach are some choices.

title: Triple Chocolate Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Mix by hand until blended 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 15 minutes; finish on rack.

title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
instructions: Line a 9 x 13 glass dish with graham crackers. Mix pudding and 3 cups milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread 1/3 of mixture over crackers and add 2 more layers. End with graham crackers.

title: Chinese Casserole
instructions: Combine ingredients in casserole except noodles. Bake 25 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve on noodles.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Bow Tie Pasta Salad
