instructions: Pour dressing over pasta asparagus tomato and mushrooms. Cover and refrigerate. Add Colby cheese just before serving; mix lightly. Arrange lettuce on serving platter. Top with pasta mixture. Sprinkle on Parmesan cheese. Makes 6 servings.

title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Blend eggs and sugar. Add Eagle Brand milk vanilla and milk. Mix well. Mixture is now ready for freezing.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Combine apple slices water sugar butter cinnamon and nutmeg in large saucepan. Bring to boil. Mix together flour and milk; cream until well blended. Drop dough from spoon into boiling apples. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until apples are tender. Serve warm or cold topped with milk.

title: Rice Krispies Squares
instructions: Mix sugar and syrup. Cook until it bubbles. Stir in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies then press in buttered pan and cool. Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips over hot water then spread over Rice Krispies.

title: Mexican Lasagne
instructions: Brown meat onions and drain. Add seasoning olives mushrooms tomato paste & Rotels - simmer (15 mins.). Add cottage cheese 1 pkg. Mexican cheese. Spray Pam in a 13 x 9 in. pan. Place noodles meat cheese. Repeat.

title: Pineapple Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Cream together margarine sugar and eggs. Add flour pineapple. milk and sweet potatoes. Pour batter into baking dish and bake for 50 minutes at 375 degrees or lower. Makes 2 quarts or 6-8 servings.

title: Dutch Potato Salad
instructions: Boil small red potatoes until tender. Do not remove skins. Let cool then cut them into smaller pieces maybe halves or quarters. Cut up onion red peppers and celery. Make mix of sour cream and mayonnaise; add salt and pepper to taste. Mix all ingredients then cut up hard-boiled eggs and mix gently into potato salad. Then enjoy.

title: Crisys Steak
instructions: Roll steak in flour. Salt and pepper to taste. Put in frying pan with 1/4 to 1/2 cup of oil (any kind). Fry until brown on both sides. Remove from frying pan into large baking pan. Lay in layers. Pour 1 1/2 quarts of water into frying pan. Cook until it boils. Pour into large baking pan with meat. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 450\u00b0. Sprinkle garlic powder on top before you cover (2 teaspoons).

title: White Cookies With Raisins
instructions: Cook on top of the stove until thickened. Cool.

title: Easy Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine potatoes onion green pepper soups sour cream salt and pepper. Toss thoroughly to coat potatoes. Spoon mixture into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Bake 75 minutes in 325\u00b0 oven. Sprinkle with cheese and bake additional 15 minutes.

title: Ham And Cheese Roll
instructions: Make this into a roll in wax paper. Roll walnuts for outside cover if you use them.

title: Spice Bread
instructions: Heat milk to lukewarm (105\u00b0). Stir in yeast and pinch of sugar. Allow it to proof for 10 minutes or until begins to foam. Stir in eggs melted butter sugar salt spices and vanilla extract. Add enough flour to make soft dough. Turn dough out onto a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic about 10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl turning to grease the top. Cover and allow to rise until doubled in volume 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Divide dough into 4 pieces. Roll each piece out into a 6-inch oval about 1/2-inch thick. Place the loaves on a greased baking sheet and leave to rise covered for 1/2 hour. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. With your thumb make indentations in the dough in decorative rows then brush the loaves with beaten egg yolk. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden. Makes 4 loaves.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs until yolks and whites are blended. Add sugar salt nutmeg and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Add milk slowly stirring constantly. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan. Bake in hot oven (425\u00b0) until an inserted knife comes out clean.

title: Sybil'S Stew
instructions: Soak the dried beans dried peas lentils etc. in water overnight. Put dried beans into kettle with water. Bring to a boil; simmer for 2 1/2 hours with stew meat. Add tomatoes onion celery potatoes carrots and seasonings; simmer 1/2 hour longer.

title: Slow-Cooked Short Ribs
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag combine flour salt and pepper. Add ribs in batches and shake to coat. In a large skillet brown ribs in butter. Transfer to a 5-quart slow cooker. In the same skillet combine remaining ingredients. Cook and stir until mixture comes to a boil; pour over ribs (slow cooker will be full). Cover and cook on low for 9-10 hours or until meat is tender. Yields 12 - 15 servings.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Cut eggplant into 1/2-inch thick sections and place in the bottom of\ta 14-inch Dutch oven.\tMix everything except Parmesan and pour on top of eggplant. Cover and cook for 50 minutes. Sprinkle on Parmesan cheese to taste.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Everlasting Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water with the 1 tablespoon sugar. Let stand in deep bowl 45 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chip Dip
instructions: Fry and drain ground beef. Set aside. Place cheese in microwavable bowl and heat approximately 3 minutes or until creamy. Add ground beef and diced tomatoes. Stir well and enjoy with tortilla chips.

title: Never Fail Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour Crisco and salt. Beat egg water and vinegar. Add to flour mixture. Mix well. Makes 2 covered pies or 4 pie shells.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Cook over high heat until it threads. Add raw peanuts. Cook until bubbles and turns amber color. Add soda salt and butter. Pour into buttered cookie sheet. Break up when cool.

title: Apple Cake
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Mix eggs oil and vanilla. Add apples and nuts. Stir until mixed. Pour into greased floured tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven. Place in heavy brown paper bag immediately. Close tightly. Let stand until cool.

title: Squash Au Gratin B
instructions: Saute onions in 3 tablespoons butter until tender. Arrange half of squash in buttered baking dish. Cover with half of onions. Repeat. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Lemon Brownies
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients like pie crust until it crumbles. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. While baking mix eggs 1 1/2 cups sugar 3 tablespoons flour and juice of 1 lemon. Pour over hot crust. Bake 20 minutes longer at same temperature. Sprinkle with 4 teaspoons sugar while still hot. Yields one 9 x 13-inch pan.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Mix ingredients except cheese. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. After baking top with cheese. Corn bread mix raises to top to make a delicious casserole.

title: Cream Cheese Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients mixing well. Make into balls the size of walnuts. Flatten with fork a little and bake in 350\u00b0 oven about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Oven-Fried Beef Chimichangas
instructions: Place steak in an ovenproof Dutch oven coated with vegetable cooking spray. Cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Remove steak from Dutch oven and let cool to touch.

title: Crumble Topping
instructions: Melt butter. Add 1/2 of it to other ingredients. Keep adding a little butter or margarine until crumbly. Good for pies cupcakes cobblers etc.

title: Cucumbers With Dairy Dressing
instructions: Place the cucumbers in a colander; sprinkle with salt. Weight the cucumbers with a heavy plate; let them drain for 1 hour then transfer to a large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers. Toss well. Serve chilled. Makes 6 servings.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes in skins. Let cool and then peel and dice. Toss in chopped onion bell pepper celery and eggs.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Put eggs in a pan and cover with water. Boil about 4 minutes until hard-boiled. Pour out hot water and slowly add cool water; let eggs stand for a few minutes (this makes the shells come off easier). Take off shells and let eggs chill before cutting in half. When cool cut eggs in half lengthwise. Mash yolks in a bowl and add the rest of the ingredients. Use enough salad dressing to make a thick paste of the yolks. Fill each half with the yolk filling and chill.

title: Seven Layer Salad
instructions: Layer in order starting with lettuce onion green pepper peas mayo mixture cheese and bacon in a 13 x 9-inch glass dish. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

title: Hoppin' John
instructions: Combine all ingredients except rice. Cook until done. Add rice. Cook 20 to 30 minutes more.

title: Seven Layer Dip
instructions: Layer in order and serve with Nacho chips.

title: Molasses Cookies
instructions: Mix together brown sugar shortening egg and molasses. Add the remaining ingredients. Chill dough. Form into 1-inch balls. Roll into sugar. Flatten slightly with bottom of glass or fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 minutes until set but not hard. If desired ice with butter icing.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Scramble and drain. Use 8 x 11-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Make 12 hours ahead. Can be frozen. For 1 1/2 recipe use 2 pounds sausage.

title: Lemon Sponge Pie
instructions: Cream the sugar and butter; add flour and beaten egg yolks. Mix in the lemon juice lemon rind and milk gradually. Add beaten egg whites but do not break whites all up. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 250\u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.

title: Dirt
instructions: Prepare pudding as directed. Blend in softened cream cheese. Fold in Cool Whip. Put whole Oreos in blender to make crumbs (will look like potting soil). Get container (if you use a real flower pot put Oreos over drain hole). Alternate crumbs with pudding mixture starting and ending with crumbs. Let sit overnight in refrigerator. Put silk or plastic flowers to look like a real plant. Fills a 8 to 10-inch pot.

title: Marzipan
instructions: Mix all ingredients; knead smooth. Paste can be softened with a very little amount of lemon juice if it is too stiff. Let stand covered 24 hours before using. When ready to use form into desired shapes.

title: Fruit Quick Bread
instructions: Dissolve raisins in boiling water and soda. Let soak 3 hours or overnight. In a large bowl cream the shortening eggs sugar and vanilla. Add flour baking powder and salt. Mix well. Stir in raisin mixture candied fruits and nuts. Pour into greased pans and bake at 325\u00b0 until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean about 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes and eggs. Get well done. Dice potatoes and mash eggs. Mix all ingredients well. Put in refrigerator for about 45 minutes to an hour. Then serve.

title: Egg White Drop Candy
instructions: Beat the egg whites until stiff then add baking powder and then sugar a little at a time. Put in vanilla and then pecans. Spoon out on a baking pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for at least 45 minutes.

title: Savory Bear
instructions: Combine the vinegar peppercorns bay leaves cinnamon onions thyme basil rosemary and celery and pour over the bear meat in a bowl. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours.

title: Spaghetti Bake
instructions: Mix ground beef tomatoes tomato sauce onion sugar salt oregano basil garlic and chili powder; simmer 30 minutes. Cook and drain spaghetti (do not rinse). Add to meat mixture and add mushrooms. Put 1/2 mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Add remainder of meat mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes covering the first 20 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix sour cream with mayonnaise. Add dry powder mix. Mix well. Add to washed and cut up cauliflower and broccoli. Toss. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Peanut Balls(Kids Love These)
instructions: Melt oleo and peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar crumbs and flavoring. Mix well. Shape into balls about the size of quarter. Place on cookie sheet and chill. Melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip balls into chocolate with toothpick or fork. Place on wax paper. Makes 40 balls.

title: Frosted Pecans
instructions: Beat egg white add sugar and vanilla. Beat well. Add 2 cups pecan halves. Mix well with spoon. With a teaspoon or your finger put 1 pecan half at a time on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Lemon-Pine Dessert
instructions: Dissolve jello with 1 cup boiling water and add 1/2 cup pineapple juice as total liquid required. Cool until partially set. Beat in sour cream and Philadelphia cream cheese. Fold in nuts and crushed pineapple. Pour into molds and chill.

title: Chocolate-Zucchini Cake
instructions: Cream margarine oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixed with cocoa baking powder soda and salt. Add zucchini. Add milk and lemon juice. Pour into greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Combine margarine butter cream cheese and sugar; beat until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Add flour and mix well. Pour into a well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Place in cold oven and set at 275\u00b0. Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until it tests done. Let cool in pan for about 15 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Spice Nut Cake
instructions: Cream shortening vanilla and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Stir in nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat until cheese is melted. Crock-pot is great for this! Stir frequently. Serve on corn chips or nachos.

title: Kids Mix
instructions: In a plastic bag mix all ingredients. Now shake the bag like the dickens. Then reach in grab a handful and munch away.

title: Cole Slaw
instructions: To the mayo slowly beat in vinegar with fork. Add sugar and then slowly blend in milk.

title: Easy Biafran Stew
instructions: Cut up and brown chuck roast. Cut up chicken. Coarsely chop onion and green pepper. Put all ingredients in stew pot and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Countryside Chicken Bake
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Spoon into glass baking dish. Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cherry Winks
instructions: Sift flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Combine shortening and sugar; cream well. Blend in eggs. Add milk and vanilla. Blend into sifted dry ingredients. Add pecans dates and cherries. Shape into balls using a level tablespoon of dough for each cookie. Roll each ball of dough in crushed cornflakes. Place on greased baking sheet. Top each cookie with 1/4 cherry. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Tangy Barbecue Wings
instructions: Cut chicken wings into 3 sections. Discard wing tip. Place chicken into 2 greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pans. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes; drain. Turn wings; bake 20 to 25 minutes longer or until juices run clear.

title: Italian Style Green Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Microwave 3 to 5 minutes. Stir and serve.

title: Festive Cranberry Mold
instructions: In saucepan combine water cranberries and sugar; bring to a boil reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until all berries pop. Add gelatin; stir until dissolved. Stir in undrained pineapple and grapes. Pour into 5-cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook ground turkey (beef) with taco seasoning and chopped onion until brown. Mix lettuce (chopped) cubed tomatoes and beans in pot. Let meat cool. Add meat to mixture. Put in cheese. Crush Doritos and mix into complete mixture. Add Italian dressing and stir. Serves 4 to 5 firefighters.

title: Strawberry Punch
instructions: Mix and boil first 3 ingredients. Let cool and add cooled remaining ingredients when ready to serve. This serves 100.

title: Breakfast Pie
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Line pie shell with cheese then sausage. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper and pour over sausage. Bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0.

title: Date Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites salt and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. Beat in vanilla and sugar until very stiff and glossy. Fold in dates and coconut. Drop from teaspoon 2-inches apart onto ungreased brown wrapping paper on a cookie sheet. Bake in 325\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool slightly. Remove from paper. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Chocolate Lover'S Ice Cream Pie
instructions: In medium bowl stir together crushed cookies and butter. Press on bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan. Freeze until firm (10 minutes). Spread ice cream over crust. Cover and freeze until firm (6 hours or longer). Just before serving drizzle pie with chocolate syrup.

title: Pizza For Breakfast Or Lunch
instructions: Place 4 pita rounds on cookie sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon of ketchup one each round. Sprinkle shredded cheese on each round. Add about 6 to 8 rounds of pepperoni to each pizza (can add chopped onions etc.). Place pizza round into 400\u00b0 oven and cook until cheese melts 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Crab Swiss Bites
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients well. Separate rolls into 3 layers each. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Spoon on crab mixture. Top each with a few water chestnuts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.

title: Saturday Brunch
instructions: Combine soup mix and rice in a 1 3/4-quart shallow casserole dish. Add boiling water stirring until soup mix is dissolved. Set aside.

title: Tortilla Chip Dip
instructions: Mix seasoning with refried beans and spread in bottom of dish. Spread a good cup of sour cream on top of beans. Sprinkle green chilies on top on sour cream. Then layer onion and tomatoes. Put cheese on top. Microwave on High (uncovered) for approximately 5 minutes or until the cheese on top has melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

title: Self-Frosted Date Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and cool. Cream together sugar and shortening. Add eggs flour soda and salt. Pour all ingredients into large greased and floured cake pan.

title: Perfect White Bread
instructions: Begin yeast in warm water. Combine milk sugar salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in 2 cups flour. Beat well. Add yeast mix. Slowly add remaining flour while mixing. Knead 8 to 10 minutes. Shape in a ball. Place in lightly buttered bowl; turn and cover. Let rise 1 1/2 hours; punch. Let rise again for 45 minutes.

title: Carolina Lemon Pound Cake
instructions: Combine sugar and butter in mixing bowl. Beat well until creamy. Add eggs. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt together and add alternately with buttermilk. Add lemon juice and rind. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake for 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spoon pie filling into pastry shell. In bowl combine flour and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly; stir in nuts. Crumble over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden and filling is bubbly. Remove to wire rack to cool. Makes 8 servings. If using a purchased frozen crust buy a \deep dish\ crust and follow package directions.

title: Death By Chocolate
instructions: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions. Cool and break into small pieces. Prepare chocolate pudding according to package directions.

title: Sausage Corn Bake
instructions: Grease and heat muffin pans corn stick mold or skillet. Beat egg with fork add milk and oil. Stir in meal sugar and sausage. Blend well. Pour batter into hot greased pans. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven 25 or 30 minutes. This bread should be baked thin and quite brown. Makes about 14 muffins 18 sticks or one medium-size skillet full.

title: (No Water) Pound Cake
instructions: Combine powdered sugar and cake flour with butter; mix thoroughly. Add eggs and powdered sugar; beat at least 3 minutes with mixer. Pour in greased loaf pan and cook at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Citrus Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine the fruit sour cream marshmallows and coconut. Cover and refrigerate for several hours. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Chicken Velvet Soup
instructions: Melt butter and whisk in flour. Cook until flour bubbles. Stir in 2 cups of chicken stock milk and cream. Stir in remaining stock chicken and broth. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Buttery Pan Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside until bubbly. Sift flour measure 2 cups of it with sugar and salt. (Dont sift instant type flour.) Add 6 tablespoons butter egg yeast mixture and cooled milk to the flour. Beat at high speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes. Add remaining flour by hand. Cover bowl and let batter rise in warm place until doubled (about 45 minutes). Pour half of the 1/4 cup butter into 9 x 13-inch pan tilting to coat bottom. Beat down batter and drop by spoonfuls into buttered pan making about 15 rolls. Drizzle remaining butter over dough. Let rise until almost doubled (about 30 minutes). Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 12 to 17 minutes.

title: Broccoli Or Spinach Quiche
instructions: Thaw broccoli or spinach; let liquid drain off. Mix first six ingredients together. Add cheese; next add broccoli or spinach. Mix well together. Put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Let set before serving.

title: Country Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl. Chill until serving time. Yields 4 servings.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Mix whipped topping and milk. Add drained fruit and mix well. Stir in lemon juice and mix until thickened. Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with coconut if desired. Refrigerate several hours. Makes 2 pies.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Place in baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Remove from oven and cover with sauce.

title: Outdoor Potatoes
instructions: After dicing potatoes bell pepper and onion put a stick of butter on a large piece of aluminum foil. Put all seasonings on to suit taste. Wrap in foil. Put on fire until done. Goes great with anything you cook outdoors.

title: Corned Beef Pasties
instructions: Combine flour lard or butter and salt in a large mixing bowl. Dig in with hands and work together until you have coarse crumbs. Sprinkle in water and work into ball. Dont use anymore water than necessary to avoid toughness. Divide dough into 6 portions. On a lightly floured board or surface roll each ball into 6-inch circles. Combine corned beef potato onion and carrot. Mix well. Divide into 6 portions and place one portion in center of each pastry circle. Fold over filling and crimp edges. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve hot warm or at room temperature. May be frozen before baking for later use.

title: Green Beans With Dill
instructions: Place frozen beans in saucepan with water dill weed or seed beef flavor base and salt. Cover; bring to a boil. Separate beans with fork. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until tender. Drain. Toss lightly with butter.

title: Filet Mignon With Madeira Wine Sauce
instructions: Sprinkle meat on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a skillet and when very hot add the meat. Cook on high heat about 5 minutes. Cook longer if you want medium or well done meat. Turn the meat and continue cooking over high heat about 5 minutes. Remove meat to warm platter and keep warm. Pour off fat from skillet. Add shallots and wine to skillet and cook over high heat for 30 seconds. Add the broth and bring to a full rolling boil stirring to dissolve the brown particles that cling to the bottom and sides of skillet. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cook until reduced by half. Meanwhile blend 2 teaspoons butter with the flour in a small mixing bowl. Stir into the simmering sauce and cook briefly until thickened. Swirl in the remaining teaspoon of butter. Strain the sauce over meat and dot the center of each filet with a dab of parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add applesauce one cup at a time with 1 teaspoon baking soda until you have used 4 cups. Mix well and then sift flour with nutmeg cloves and cinnamon. Add the sifted flour and spices to the mixture. Add raisins and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a large Bundt pan.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: In mixer bowl blend oil sugar vanilla and eggs. Sift flour salt and baking soda and add to first mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 (9-inch) round pans. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Melt butter then add to sugar and peanut butter. Mix well. In double boiler melt chocolate and paraffin wax. Make small balls with peanut butter mixture and dip with toothpick in melted chocolate. Set on wax paper and refrigerate.

title: Cherry Congealed Salad
instructions: Mix together well and set aside to congeal. Refrigerate.

title: Microwave Chili
instructions: Crumble beef in a 2-quart casserole dish. Stir in onion. Cover. Microwave 5 to 6 minutes on High. Drain and stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Microwave 14 to 18 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes covered.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Brown onion and ground beef. Add 1/2 cup sauce to mixture and 1/2 cup cheese. Heat sauce; dip tortillas in sauce. Fill each tortilla with 2 tablespoons of meat mixture; roll and place in pan seam side down. Cover enchiladas with sauce and grated cheese. Heat for 20 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix together and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 300\u00b0 and cook 30 minutes longer. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

title: Coffee Rings
instructions: Cut biscuits in half. Place in greased tube pan. Pour melted margarine on top. Sprinkle on brown sugar and nuts. Bake about 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
instructions: Cook in greased (I use Pam) pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Apple Brownies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in ungreased 8 x 8-inch pan at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Cut in squares.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening. Add sugar and cream together until fluffy. Add egg. Sift flour and add soda and salt. Add chips nuts and vanilla. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool on pan then remove into container.

title: O'Brien Potato Casserole
instructions: Thaw potatoes until they break apart. Mix other ingredients with potatoes. Add corn flake crumbs on top. Melt another 1/4 cup oleo and pour over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for at least 1 hour. Test for doneness (depends on oven).

title: Eye Of Round
instructions: Dry roast with paper towel. Pierce roast in several places across top and bottom. Sprinkle seasoned salt and lemon pepper over surface and rub in. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir well. Pour over roast. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight. Turn once or twice. I use large freezer bag for roast and marinade. Easy to turn and can be thrown away.

title: Melt Away Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. Combine butter sugar and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour salt and then the pecans. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake until peaks are very light brown approximately 7 minutes. Transfer to cooling rack. While still warm sift generously with confectioners sugar.

title: Beans And Meat
instructions: Cook pinto beans in soda water and change water. Cook ground meat chili powder and onion powder until clear. Put all together and cook at low temperature.

title: Swiss Egg Bake
instructions: In a saucepan combine soup milk onion and mustard. Cook and stir until smooth and heated through. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Pour 1 cup of sauce into each of two 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dishes.

title: King Ranch Casserole
instructions: Boil chicken and bone; save 1 cup broth. Grate cheese. Tear tortillas into pieces. Place tortillas in large casserole dish with layers of chicken onions and cheese.

title: Beans And Eggs
instructions: Note Measurements are approximate use your judgment.

title: Aunt Helen'S Pound Cake
instructions: Combine ingredients. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0.

title: Buffet Cheese-Scalloped Carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cook carrots and drain.

title: Mini Chicken Pancakes
instructions: Boil chicken parts until meat falls off the bone. Remove bones and dice chicken. Mix with cream of celery soup salt pepper and onion salt. Make a batch of Bisquick pancake mix following directions on box. Add to chicken and soup mixture. Fry like a mini pancake. Serve hot!!!

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Boil pepper pods after seeds have been removed in salt water for 5 minutes; let cool. Cook meat in skillet with onion salt and pepper together until meat is done. Add 1/2 can of tomato soup and rice all together. Stand your peppers in a baking dish and stuff each one. Add rest of soup on top of peppers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Ease out of oven and put a slice of cheese on top of each pepper. Put back in oven until cheese melts.

title: Toffee Crunch Cookies
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with a mixer until creamy. Add cake mix eggs and water beating until blended. Stir in brickle chips and pecans. Drop cookie dough by teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are browned. (Top will look moist.) Transfer to wire racks to cool. Yields 7 dozen cookies.

title: Pineapple Muffins
instructions: On wax paper or in small bowl stir together flours baking powder and salt. In a medium bowl beat together butter honey and egg until blended. Add flour mixture and undrained pineapple; stir only enough to moisten flour mixture. Batter will be thick. Fill buttered muffin pan cups (each 1/3 cup capacity) 2/3 to 3/4 full. Bake in preheated 425\u00b0 oven until a cake tester inserted in center comes out clean 15 to 18 minutes. Serve at once with butter pats. Muffins taste better fresh than reheated. Makes 12.

title: Pepsi Roast
instructions: Place roast in pan which can be tightly covered. Spread can of soup over roast. Sprinkle dry onion soup mixture over the top. Pour Pepsi into pan and cover tightly. Put into oven at 325\u00b0 and roast for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Makes its own gravy. Yield 4 to 6 servings.

title: Rocky Road Fudge Candy
instructions: In saucepan melt chips with Eagle Brand and 2 tablespoons margarine. In large bowl combine pecans and marshmallows. Pour chocolate mixture into nut mixture. Add vanilla. Spread into wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 2 hours and cut into squares. Makes about 40 squares.

title: Turkey Casserole
instructions: Combine the mayonnaise soup and milk. Cook the peas according to the directions on package. Drain. Add the peas and turkey to the soup mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Gone-All-Day Stew
instructions: Mix together tomato soup water and flour until smooth. Add remaining ingredients and cook in slow cooker for 4 to 5 hours. (Can also be cooked in covered roasting pan at 275\u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours.) Makes 8 large servings.

title: Convenient Cole Slaw(Keeps Indefinitely In Refrigerator)
instructions: Grate vegetables then cover with boiling water. Let stand 1 hour. Drain in colander then return to kettle. Pour remaining ingredients over top. Mix well and put in jars. Store in refrigerator.

title: Ranch Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes and boil until tender. Drain potatoes and place in a pan that has been sprayed with a nonstick coating spray. With potatoes spread flat pour butter over hot potatoes and sprinkle with salt and white pepper. Sprinkle cheese evenly over potatoes. Pour Ranch dressing onto cheese. Spread dressing evenly over potatoes/cheese. Sprinkle bacon and green onions on top of Ranch dressing. Serve warmed or chilled.

title: Mamaw Vera'S Boiled Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cook margarine cocoa milk and sugar for 1 1/2 minutes; hard-boil. Remove from heat. Add other ingredients quickly and mix well. Drop cookies from spoon quickly on waxed paper.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Layer Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to directions on package making 2 (8-inch) layers. When completely cooled split both layers. Combine sugar sour cream and coconut; blending well; chill. Reserve 1 cup sour cream mixture for frosting. Spread remainder between layers. Combine reserved sour cream mixture with whipped topping; blend until smooth. Spread on top and sides. Seal cake in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken With Duck Sauce
instructions: Line pan with foil. Pour mixture of first 3 ingredients over chicken and bake until done at 350\u00b0.

title: Buttermilk Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Cream butter and sugar adding sugar 1/2 cup at a time. Blend in vanilla. Add eggs one at a time. Combine flour and salt; add small amount at a time. Add buttermilk. Sprinkle pecans in bottom of prepared pie crust. Pour custard over pecans and bake for an hour and 30 minutes. Best if served at room temperature.

title: Italian Vegetable Salad
instructions: In a large salad bowl combine everything except dressing and cheese. Toss ingredients together.

title: Rainbow Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Served chilled with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Stewed Rabbit Chinon
instructions: To make bouquet garni (used to season rabbit while baking) combine parsley bay leaf thyme and marjoram in a small double cheesecloth and tie secure with a string. Set aside for later use. Season the rabbit pieces with salt and pepper then dredge in flour. Heat the bacon drippings in a frying pan then add the rabbit pieces and brown on all sides. Remove the rabbit and place in a baking dish. Add the wine broth bouquet garni (made previously) the large onion and garlic cloves then cover. Bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until the rabbit is tender.

title: Duane'S Clam Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions. Open clams; put juice into a saucepan. Bring to a slight boil. Turn heat to low and simmer. Add package of cheese and garlic; stir. Add soup and the clams; stir very well until consistency desired. Pour over linguine and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Melt; put mixture in pan. Add dab of peanut butter (which has been heated by putting jar in hot water). Cool in fridge. Put melted chocolate on top to finish.

title: Butterscotch Pie
instructions: Bring milk almost to a boil and add butter. In a bowl mix brown sugar white sugar and syrup together and add hot milk slowly. Mix remaining ingredients and add slowly to hot milk mixture. Place back on stove and cook until thick. Let cool. Pour into 9-inch pie shell.

title: Quiche
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs until foamy. Gradually add soup and cream mixing well. Add cheese meat and vegetables (onion optional) and stir until well mixed.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Drain corn. Combine flour cornmeal baking powder sugar and salt. Add milk and rest of ingredients. Drop by tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on buttered baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Serve with butter. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Sauerkraut Balls
instructions: Fry sausage onions sauerkraut; add bread crumbs. Combine cream cheese and other ingredients and to mixture.\tChill. Form into about 60 to 70 balls.\tDip into 2 beaten eggs then roll in one cup flour and 1 1/2 c. bread crumbs. Fry in skillet or oven --not to dark-- serve warm. Dip in Ketchup with horseradish. Can be made ahead and frozen; when thawed heat in shallow pan on low heated oven.

title: Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables as directed on package. Place on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut up Velveeta cheese and place on vegetables.

title: Peanut Pie
instructions: Run peanuts in blender and mix with other ingredients. Cook in uncooked pie crust. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Swedish Pancakes
instructions: Combine eggs milk and butter. Add all dry ingredients gradually. Cook 10 minutes. Makes 16 to 18 pancakes.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour cornstarch and salt; toss with blackberries. Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry. Add blackberry mixture. Adjust top crust; cut slits to allow steam to escape. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Ham Loaf
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and form into 2 loaves. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Time Holiday Squares
instructions: Cream margarine. Then at medium speed gradually add sugar. Add 1 egg at a time beating well after adding each one. At low speed gradually add flour and mix well. Finally add the lemon extract.

title: Blue Ribbon Pie Crust
instructions: Mix flour salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until mixture is cornmeal-textured. In a 1-cup measure beat together vinegar and egg then fill to 1-cup mark with cold tap water. Mix together flour and vinegar-egg-water mixtures. It will be soft and sticky. Working on a very well floured board roll out a piece of the dough to approximately 1/8-inch thick and 2 to 3-inches wider than your pie pan. Put in lightly floured pie pans. Roll out equal size circles for top crusts.

title: Love Cake For Mother
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Bake in a hearty warm oven. Serve to mother every day. Serve large slices.

title: Chocolate Pie
instructions: Mix all together. Cook until thick. Pour into baked pie shell.

title: Cherry Cranberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water in pan on burner; stir in cranberry sauce while hot and stir over heat until dissolved. Let chill until thick and syrupy. Add sour cream by folding in gently. Add pineapple pecans and marshmallows. Chill and serve. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Cook Beans a chopped onions about 10 minutes. Stir soup until all lumps are gone. Then pour in beans. Mix well. Bake about 10 minutes. Take out.

title: String Bean Salad
instructions: Boil string beans with just enough salt to season. Strain cool and chop. Mix the rest of the ingredients.

title: Skillet Barbecue Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken in hot oil. Stir in barbecue sauce water corn and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Cook all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat until thick. Pour into a precooked pie shell. Top with meringue and bake to brown meringue.

title: Kourabiedes(Greek Butter Cookies With Confectioners Sugar)
instructions: In a large bowl combine the flour and baking soda. In another bowl (large) beat well the butter until fluffy. Add the sugar egg yolks vanilla and brandy (orange juice may be used as a substitute for brandy). Then add flour mixture a little at a time mixing constantly. Soft dough will form. Knead the dough. Cut into shapes. Bake in preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes (until light brown). Let cool and dust with confectioners sugar until well coated. Makes approximately 65 cookies.

title: Herbed Potato Wedges
instructions: Scrub potatoes then cut into 8 wedges. Using an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish melt the butter in microwave using full power 45 to 60 seconds. Stir in herbs and salt to taste. Add potatoes coat with mixture. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook on High 8 to 10 minutes or until tender. Season to taste.

title: Kitchen Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix well. Cover and refrigerate. Knead once a day for 3 days. On the fourth day make 3 rolls 2 1/2 x 6-inches. Bake at 170\u00b0 for 11 hours uncovered.

title: Sage Chicken
instructions: Skin debone and cube chicken. Saute in hot oil until brown. Drain excess oil and fat. Add cream of mushroom soup sage and mushrooms with liquid. Stir well. Simmer covered 45 minutes to 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Add noodles. Stir and serve immediately.

title: Apple Pudding
instructions: Stir flour and baking powder. Blend egg and milk; add to dry ingredients. Mix well; pour over sliced apples. Dot with butter; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Test for doneness.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Saute onion and celery in butter. Butter casserole dish. Put cooked rice in bottom of pan. Combine onion and celery to the cooked broccoli and mushroom soup. Put this mixture on top of rice. Put cheese on top and bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese is melted. Pour water off of broccoli.

title: Pineapple Glaze For Ham
instructions: In a pan combine 1/4 cup juice and the cornstarch stir until smooth. Add rest of ingredients bring to boil stirring over medium heat. Glaze will be slightly thick.

title: Divinity Fudge Or Bonbons
instructions: Combine sugar water and honey. Stir while heating until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring until syrup forms a hard ball when tested in cold water (265\u00b0). Remove from heat and quickly beat salted egg whites until stiff. Slowly add syrup to egg whites beating constantly. Beat until candy thickens and begins to lose its gloss; add flavorings and quickly drop by teaspoons onto greased plate or waxed paper. Put half a nut meat on each piece while still warm.

title: Open House Punch
instructions: Combine sugar and water. Heat until dissolved. Cool and chill. Add other juices. Chill until ready to serve. Gently combine with cold ginger ale in punch bowl. Garnish. Serves 50.

title: Matador Mania
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion together in skillet. Drain and add taco seasoning refried beans and sour cream and heat mixture thoroughly.

title: Buddy Bars
instructions: In large bowl beat peanut butter and butter until smooth. Add sugar eggs and vanilla; beat until creamy. Blend in flour and salt. Fold in 1 cup chocolate chips. Spread into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Immediately sprinkle with remaining chips. Let stand about 5 minutes and then spread chips evenly over top. Cool completely and cut into bars.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Reserve 2/3 cup of the dry cake mix for filling. Combine remaining cake mix margarine and 1 egg; beat at a low speed until well blended. Press in bottom of greased pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown.

title: Almond Twist Coffee Cake
instructions: Combine margarine sugar and 1/4 teaspoon almond extract. Heat until butter is melted. Cut each bread loaf into 4 pieces. Roll pieces into 18-inch \snakes\. Coil dough on a lightly greased pizza pan. When joining \snakes\ to each other moisten the ends and pinch firmly together. Spoon butter-sugar mixture over top of dough. Let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. Bake for 15 minutes at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle sliced almonds on top. Cover with foil and continue baking for 15 minutes. Cool about 10 minutes. Make a glaze from remaining ingredients and drizzle over top of cake.

title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: In a large saucepan cook broccoli in a cup of water (do not drain). Put milk cheese chicken bouillon and flour into a blender and mix. Add this mixture to broccoli then add half and half. Cook stirring frequently over medium heat until hot and soup thickens.

title: Refrigerator Pickles
instructions: Combine sugar and vinegar; stir until clear. Let set 5 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl. Stir in sugar and vinegar mixture. Mix well; put in jars in refrigerator.

title: Tropical Garden Punch
instructions: Mix well together chill. Serve in punch bowl.

title: Pasta Plentiful Salad
instructions: In large bowl combine vinegar water oil and seasonings. Add remaining ingredients except spinach leaves. Lightly toss until evenly coated with dressing. Cover and chill to blend flavors. Garnish with spinach leaves if desired.

title: Sand Bakklse
instructions: Mix all together and add 1 3/4 cups sifted flour. Chill dough and press into sandbakklse tins as thin as possible. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350\u00b0 until delicately browned 12 to 15 minutes. Tap molds on table to loosen.

title: Banana-Nut-Ring
instructions: Drain pineapple; measuring juice add water to make 1 1/2 cups. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add measured liquid chill until thickened. Fold in bananas and nuts. Spoon into 6-cup ring mold. Chill until firm about 4 hours.

title: Dump Cake
instructions: Use 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Pour ingredients directly in pan in order given (do not stir). But it is best to smooth each layer with a big spoon. Bake 1 hour or longer at 350\u00b0.

title: 7-Up Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water then add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until set.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Wrap dried beef around breasts and place in buttered baking dish. Season with scant salt and pepper to taste. (Dried beef is salty!) Place drained mushrooms on chicken. In separate pan heat together soup milk and butter. Add wine and pour over chicken. Cook uncovered at 300\u00b0 for one hour and 15 minutes. Add sour cream and artichoke hearts and bake 30 minutes more.

title: Pizza Fondue
instructions: Brown meat and onion in oleo in a fondue pot. Mix cornstarch and seasonings in pizza sauce. Add sauce and stir well. When this bubbles add cheese by thirds stirring after each addition. When all the cheese is melted use dunkers and enjoy.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Melt the butter; stir in flour salt pepper and sugar. Cook until bubbly. Add milk and cook until thick. Stir in the corn and eggs; beat until frothy. Pour into a buttered 1 quart casserole dish and bake in a hot water bath at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until custard is set. Or mix the egg yolks into the corn mixture and beat the egg whites until stiff. Fold into the mixture and proceed baking.

title: Spaghetti Bread
instructions: Add ingredients into pan in order listed. Add oil and water last. Set bread machine on \ white bread\ setting.

title: Onion Mushroom Roast
instructions: Set oven to 275\u00b0. Put in large pan the roast on a large piece of foil. Mix onion mix with soup; spread over roast then fold foil loosely leaving room around meat but seal top. Roast 3 to 4 hours. Serves 8.

title: Italian Biscuit-Topped Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Chop green pepper and onion. Press garlic. Slice carrots zucchini and mushrooms. Cook sausage green pepper onion and garlic over medium heat until brown and crumbly (about 6 minutes); drain off excess liquid. Add carrots and cook 3 minutes stirring frequently. Add zucchini and mushrooms; cook 3 minutes stirring frequently. Stir in spaghetti sauce and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning. Bring to a simmer and cook 2 minutes. Pour sausage mixture into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Place biscuits around outer edge of dish. Melt butter and stir in cheese and remaining 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning. Brush over tops of biscuits. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Potato Cups
instructions: Cook sweet potatoes in a small amount of boiling water until tender. Cool slightly peel and mash. Add margarine raisins and orange peel. Beat until fluffy. Add a small amount of orange juice if potatoes seem too dry. Stir in raisins. Cut a slice off the top of each orange and scoop out pulp. Heap potato mixture into orange shells. Top with marshmallows and bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Cornbread
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together. Add grated cheese onions and peppers. Add eggs and oil; mix. Add creamed corn.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Trim fat from steak; cut into serving pieces. On a board with a meat mallet pound flour into steak. In skillet over medium-high heat in 2 tablespoons oil cook meat until well browned on both sides. Remove steaks from skillet. In same skillet heat other 2 tablespoons oil. Add onions green pepper and garlic. Cook until onions are lightly browned. Stir in tomatoes salt and pepper; heat to boiling. Return steaks to skillet. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is fork-tender. Remove steaks. Cook tomato mixture until thickened. Spoon over steaks. Great served over rice or noodles.

title: German Beef Dip
instructions: Slice beef into 1/4 in squares. Mix all ingredients (except bread) together in a glass bowl cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight.

title: Fuzzy Navel Cake
instructions: Place in greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Beat shortening sugar vanilla and eggs until light. Blend in flour soda and salt. Stir in nuts and chips. Drop by teaspoon 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in moderate 375\u00b0 oven.

title: Chicken Curry Salad
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and seasonings. Mix with chicken fruit and celery. Place a bed of lettuce on 2 dinner plates and spoon 1/2 of chicken mixture on top of each.

title: Chili Con Quesa
instructions: Saute onion in margarine. Puree and add tomatoes and pepper. Mix chili sauce and cornstarch and add when bubbly. Reduce to medium heat. Add cheese stirring frequently.

title: Corned Beef Delight
instructions: Cut up onion and pepper into very small pieces and put into a frying pan or electric skillet. Add a small amount of water so ingredients will not stick. Boil this for about 15 minutes. Pour off nearly all of the water and add can of corned beef. Stir in with onion and peppers and add can of tomato sauce or small amount of catsup. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir together until evenly mixed and simmer on low heat for 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Prune Cake
instructions: Mix flour sugar salt cinnamon and nutmeg in bowl. Dissolve soda in mashed prunes. In another bowl beat eggs. Add oil buttermilk and prunes. Gradually add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Fold in nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done about 30 minutes. Cut in squares while hot. Pour hot sauce over squares.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix and fry in oil.

title: Marinated Chicken Wings
instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended. Add chicken-add or decrease number of wings making sure they are well covered-marinate at least 6 hours overnight is o.k. Remove wings put on baking sheet bake. Bake 1 hour in preheated oven 350 degree. For crisper wings bake longer until they are cooked as you like.

title: Sweet Pickles
instructions: Cover cucumber slices with alum and water for 24 hours; drain. Cover with vinegar and pickling spices for 24 hours. Drain off vinegar and spice. Add 3 cups of sugar for 3 days each. Turn jar upside down and shake occasionally to dissolve sugar. Pickles may be stored in this jar. Cover tightly. There will be almost enough liquid to cover pickles.

title: Strawberry Party Punch
instructions: In large bowl combine strawberries and sugar. Mix well. Stir in 1 quart of the strawberry soda. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Stir in lemonade concentrate. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Cocoa Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add flour powder and soda alternating with milk. Add vanilla and cocoa. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done. Remove from pans and cool. Fill when cool.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine all ingredients in order and mix well. Pour into well-greased 10-inch glass pie pan and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 300\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes its own crust.

title: Creamed Onions
instructions: In medium saucepan place onions 1 teaspoon salt and enough cold water to cover. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer covered 20 to 25 minutes or until tender. Drain onions; reserve 1/2 cup liquid.

title: Hamburger-Rice Casserole
instructions: Bring water to boil in saucepan. Add rice and salt then remove from heat and set aside. Brown ground beef in hot fat. Add celery and onion; cook 5 minutes. Add butter soy sauce brown sugar mushrooms and soup. Add pan of rice and water. Mix thoroughly. Pour into buttered 3-quart baking dish. Cover and bake in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more.

title: Lena'S Uncooked Relish
instructions: Grind vegetables and cover with water and salt. Let stand 2 hours; drain. Add celery seed to taste. Pour vinegar sugar and mustard seed over the mixture. Pack in jars cold.

title: Sausage Balls(Yields 50 Balls)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Shape into small balls. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Divan Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 425\u00b0. In medium saucepan combine butter flour and pepper. Cook over low heat until mixture becomes thick and bubbly. Stir in milk and broth until mixture is thick. Add cheese and stir until melted. Fold in chicken and broccoli.

title: Fruity Tea
instructions: Put 2 tablespoons instant tea sugar and juices into plastic jug. Add water to make 2 quarts. Shake well. Chill and serve over ice.

title: Chicken Parmesagna
instructions: Dip chicken in egg and bread crumbs. Brown in oil. Place in a shallow baking pan and layer with sliced Mozzarella cheese Parmesan cheese sauce and then another layer of Parmesan cheese. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes uncovered. Add 10 minutes to cooking time if you forgo browning in oil. Serve over pasta.

title: World'S Best Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Cream together butter sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg. Mix well. Add oats corn flakes coconut and nuts. Stir well. Add flour soda salt and vanilla. Mix well. Form into balls the size of a small walnut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with a fork dipped in water. Bake for 12 minutes. Allow cookies to cool on cookie sheet before removing. Makes about 8 dozen.

title: Peanut Butter And Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: In a bowl stir together flour and baking soda. Set flour mixture aside. In a large mixing bowl beat margarine with electric mixer on medium to high speed about 30 seconds or until softened. Add peanut butter sugar and brown sugar to margarine. Beat until thoroughly combined scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Add egg whites and vanilla. Beat until well combined. Add flour mixture then beat on low speed until combined. Stir in oats.

title: Pineapple Bread Pudding
instructions: In large bowl cream butter vanilla pudding mix and cinnamon until fluffy. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each.

title: Drop Dumplings
instructions: Sift flour salt and baking powder together. Rub in shortening with knife or fingertips. Add milk to soft dough. Then drop a tablespoon at a time on chicken or meat stews the last 15 to 20 minutes. Pan must be covered closely and must not be removed during cooking.

title: Cheese-Filling For Shells
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl. Stuff cooled and drained shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes using previously described sauce.

title: Frosted Pumpkin Bars
instructions: Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased and floured cookie sheet (15 x 11-inch). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Take sirloin; cut in small strips. Salt and pepper and dredge in flour. Brown in grease. When meat is done cut up onions and green peppers; cook until soft. Take out of grease. Make a little gravy. Add can of tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add about 1/4 cup of sugar; mix well. Add meat to sauce. Simmer for about 1 hour or longer. Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Simplicity
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until tender. Add chicken strips salt and pepper and cook until chicken is done. Add can of soup and simmer about 30 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Mandarin Orange Cake
instructions: Disregard cake mix instructions. Mix cake mix orange juice eggs and oil well then add mandarin oranges. Mix again. Bake in 3 (9-inch) layers at 350\u00b0.

title: Graham Cracker Crust
instructions: Mix and put in pie pan and bake at 300\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool before filling.

title: Camp Stew
instructions: Cook chicken; debone. Cook beef and pork; cut in small pieces. Add potatoes carrots and onion. Cook until tender. Add other ingredients. Simmer for several hours.

title: Caramel Apple Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Reserve 3/4 cup apple filling. Spoon remaining filling into crust. Beat together cream cheese sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add eggs and beat well. Pour over apple filling. Bake 35 minutes or until center is set. Cool. Mix reserved apple filling and caramel topping in a small saucepan. Heat about 1 minute. Arrange apple slices around outside edge of cheesecake. Spoon caramel sauce onto the cheesecake and spread evenly. Decorate with pecan halves around edge. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

title: Crustless Egg Custard
instructions: Mix flour and sugar; add beaten eggs to this mixture. Grease pan and dust with flour. Pour mixture in pan and put butter on top in small pieces. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chess Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix butter and egg with hands; put into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Spread on bottom. Mix remaining ingredients with hands. Pour and smooth over bottom. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Top should be golden brown.

title: Ginger Sausage Balls
instructions: Combine meat garlic ginger and the egg yolks. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the meat mixture. Heat oil in a large heavy saucepan. Drop meat by teaspoonfuls into the oil a few at a time frying about 5 minutes until cooked through. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot. Makes about 40.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix pat out on pan and bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Holiday Brunch Cake
instructions: Mix dry ingredients; add apples. Mix well. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Add oil vanilla and water; mix. Add nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 using a Bundt pan for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Fudge
instructions: Mix milk and chips in pyrex dish. Microwave on high 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and stir. Return to microwave and cook high for 1 1/2 minutes more. Stir thoroughly. Add vanilla and nuts stirring well. Line 8 or 9 inch pan with foil. Spread mixture in pan and chill for 2 hours. Remove from pan and cut into squares. Store in plastic container with lid ajar until firm.

title: Cheddar Apple Bread
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add combined eggs milk and margarine; mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes; remove from pan.

title: Indian Fry Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients with tap water to form a stiff dough. Place in covered bowl and allow to set 4 to 5 hours. Pinch off small pieces of dough and pat into 5-inch circles. Fry in deep hot fat until golden brown. Serve hot with butter and honey or meat and vegetables.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Combine meal and onion in bowl. Add egg and milk; stir. Drop by teaspoons into hot fat (375\u00b0). Fry only a few at a time until golden brown. Drain on paper towel.

title: Ziti Garden Salad
instructions: Prepare pasta as directed on package; drain. Rinse with cold water and drain. Combine pasta and dressing with remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Toss; chill 1 hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: Mexican Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients together; spread on tortillas and roll up. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Slice and serve.

title: Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine and sugars. Add eggs vanilla and walnuts. Add flour salt and soda. Form into rolls on wax paper and chill one hour. Slice and bake at 400\u00b0.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Put in greased muffin pans. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Cream butter; gradually add brown sugar beating until light and fluffy. Spread creamed mixture evenly in a 9-inch cast-iron skillet. Arrange pineapple slices and cherries evenly over creamed mixture.

title: Ruby Salad
instructions: Drain beets; measure liquid. Add water to make 1 cup liquid. Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add measured liquid vinegar horseradish onion and pepper. Chill until thickened. Fold in beets and celery. Spoon into individual molds or a 1 quart mold. Chill until firm. Unmold onto crisp lettuce. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Corn Dogs
instructions: Put skewers in hot dogs and set aside. Mix corn meal flour baking powder salt and egg. Dip hot dogs in batter and then deep fry at 350\u00b0.

title: Crunchy Creamed Corn
instructions: Pour corn in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cracker mixture evenly over corn then with a teaspoon cut butter and drop pieces on top of the cracker crumbs. Cook in oven at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Jose Grinan'S Super Bowl Cider
instructions: Pour six oz. boiling water into mugs. Add one caramel cube. Stir in cider mix. Top with half of the whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon. Serves 2.

title: Angel Food Candy Fairy Food
instructions: In a heavy saucepan bring to 290\u00b0 (crack) the brown sugar and corn syrup. Add baking soda. Stir and while foaming pour onto a buttered 15 x 18-inch cookie sheet. You have to work fast. Cool until bottom of pan is cold. Turn pan over on waxed paper; bang pan until loose. Break in pieces with knife point. Dip each piece into melted chocolate. Place on wax paper to dry.

title: Sour Cream Dessert
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O sugar and salt in boiling water. Stir in light cream and vanilla (mixture may look curdled but will become smooth). Stir in sour cream. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until smooth. Pour into 3 or 4-cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold.

title: Layered Spinach Salad
instructions: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water.

title: Dilled Okra
instructions: Bring all the ingredients to a boil. Pack okra into jar cover okra with hot vinegar mixture seal.\tLet stand 2 weeks before opening.

title: Blueberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add other ingredients. After mixture is jellied cover with topping.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine chicken rice cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup onion cheese and water. Melt stick of butter on stove crumble roll of crackers and combine crackers with butter. Pour over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 30 minutes. (Check after about 20 minutes.)

title: Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Arrange in greased casserole dish by layers broccoli chicken then pour sauce over all. (Sauce is the soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder.) Top with crumbs and cheese. Dot with butter. Bake 1 hour. Serves 8.

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Mix eggs cooking oil and milk. Add flour sugar and blueberries. Spoon into muffin pan. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12. These freeze well.

title: Pasta With Fresh Vegetables In Garlic Sauce
instructions: Cut carrots and zucchini lengthwise in thin slices with peeler. Add to 1-inch boiling water in medium saucepan. Cook until crisp-tender. Drain. Set aside.

title: La-Millionaire'S Mushrooms
instructions: Melt butter in large pot. Add remaining ingredients and boil slowly uncovered until liquid is reduced to nearly all butter. Do not scorch. Serve hot in a chafing dish with toothpicks.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. In a medium bowl cream margarine. Gradually add sugar; beat well. Add eggs one at a time beat well after each addition. Stir in flavorings. In a small bowl using a fork or pastry blender mash bananas until pureed. Add to creamed mixture using mixer until smooth. With a spoon add flour until flour is just moistened. Stir in nuts. Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake for 1 hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove.

title: Nacho Dip
instructions: Brown meat and drain off fat. Melt the Velveeta cheese. Add onions tomatoes and meat to the melted cheese. Keep hot in crock-pot until time to serve and serve over chips or with chips.

title: Here'S To Your Health Hoagie
instructions: In small bowl combine cucumbers carrot green onion and salad dressing. Set aside.

title: Peanut Butter And Syrup
instructions: Mix together and enjoy. May put on bread.

title: Cracker Jacks
instructions: Cook sugar butter and syrup in saucepan for 5 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla and soda. Whip until foamy. Mix well with popcorn. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour stirring every 20 minutes. Add peanuts if desired.

title: Bubble Up
instructions: Grease Bundt pan. Spread walnuts on bottom. Separate dough into 12 balls and place in single layer on top of nuts. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar. Sprinkle on pudding. Dot with butter. Let rise. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Caramel Popcorn
instructions: Bring brown sugar sugar margarine corn syrup and salt to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes then add vanilla maple flavoring and baking soda. Cover popcorn with mixture and stir well. Bake in oven at 250\u00b0 for 1 hour and stir every 10 minutes. (May add pecans or peanuts if you wish.)

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

title: Barbecue Pork Chops
instructions: Trim excess fat from pork chops. Put pork chops in the center of a baking dish or roasting pan. Fill the side spaces with the potatoes. Mix all other ingredients together for the sauce. (You may want to double the sauce recipe if you use more chops.) Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes. Pour over the potatoes and chops. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Best Cornbread
instructions: Beat egg until light and frothy. Add milk and honey. Combine the cornmeal flour baking powder and salt. Add butter and stir well. Pour the batter into a greased baking pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve with fresh butter. Beat until stiff 1/2 pint heavy cream and 1 egg beaten. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Sticks
instructions: Wash potatoes. Cut lengthwise into quarters then each quarter into thirds. Brush potatoes with butter melted. Roll and coat them in a mixture of bread crumbs cheese salt and garlic powder. On a baking sheet spread out potatoes in a single layer and bake in a preheated 400\u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes until tender inside and crispy brown outside.

title: Black Walnut Pie
instructions: Beat eggs. Add rest\tof ingredients. Pour in crust. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Pie will have a crusty top when done.

title: Crab Apple Pickles
instructions: Wash apples. Stick cloves in some apples being sure some cloves get in jar. Heat sugar liquid and spices until sugar dissolves. Cool. Add apples and simmer until barely tender. Pack into hot jars. Makes 6 to 7 pints.

title: Herbed Chili-Spaghetti
instructions: Cook ground beef onion garlic and green pepper in Dutch oven until browned stirring to crumble meat. Drain off drippings. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 2 hours stirring occasionally. Yield 10 to 12 servings.

title: Green Beans Bundles
instructions: Cut bacon slices in half. Wrap around a bunch of green beans until all the beans and bacon are used. Place in a baking dish. Make a glaze from all of the other ingredients. Pour over the beans. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes or bake in the microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Flour fruits candy and nuts. Mix well. Add coconut and Eagle Brand milk. Press firmly into wax paper-lined stem pan. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Cream Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Heat water and butter to rolling boil. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat about 1 minute or until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs all at one time; continue beating until smooth. Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool away from draft. Cut off tops. Pull out any filaments of soft dough. Fill with Cool Whip or vanilla pudding. Dust with powdered sugar!

title: Au Gratin Potatoes
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes in a large bowl. Salt and pepper. Combine 2 tablespoons of flour with milk. Mix well until flour dissolves. Pour over potatoes; let potatoes soak in milk and seasoning while grating cheese. In a greased 2-quart casserole put a layer of potatoes and dot with butter. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon flour; cover with cheese. Repeat layers ending with 3 layers of potatoes and cheese. Stir seasoned milk and pour over casserole. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until cheese is brown. Then cover and bake until potatoes are tender about 30 minutes longer.

title: Thumbprints
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add yolks and mix in vanilla and salt. Gradually add flour. Shape in balls and dip in egg whites then in walnuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 minutes and push in center with thumb. Then\tbake another 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and fill with frosting.

title: Great Potatoes
instructions: Spray a casserole dish. Layer bottom with Tater Tots. Mix together in a medium pan over medium heat the soup sour cream and cheese. Pour over Tater Tots. Mix corn flakes and butter together in a bowl. Spread on top. Cook at 375\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until bubbly and potatoes are cooked through.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Mix eggs flavorings oil milk sugar and poppy seed. Add flour salt and baking powder and mix well. Put in 2 loaf pans bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Poke holes in top. Drizzle with following glaze

title: Ground Beef With Spaghetti Parmigiana
instructions: In saucepot prepare spaghetti as label directs; drain. Return spaghetti to saucepot.

title: Fruit Cookies
instructions: *Can use 1 pound of chipped chocolate instead of walnuts and raisins.

title: Egg Custard
instructions: Melt butter and then add the other ingredients. Pour into pie plate. Cook in the oven at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour. Will make its own crust.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients but flour and chips together. Then mix in flour. After all is mixed together add in chocolate chips. Spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 12 minutes. Makes approximately 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

title: Jello Mold
instructions: Bring jello and pineapple to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill.

title: White Chili(Low-Fat)
instructions: Cook onions in large pot until tender. Add seasonings and peppers. Stir well. Add chicken beans and broth and bring to a boil. Simmer until ready to eat. (Better if prepared the day before and refrigerated.) Serve with Mexican Cornbread (see recipe).

title: Pickle And Ham Roll-Ups
instructions: Pat ham and pickle dry with paper towel. Spread 13 ham slices with 1 tablespoon cheese. Top each with pickle spear. Roll up. Wrap each in wax paper or plastic wrap. Chill. Cut each roll in 4 to 6 pieces. Makes 62 to 78.

title: Louisiana Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix whipping cream vinegar and soda. Set aside. Blend potatoes sugar baking powder eggs vanilla cinnamon and salt in processor. Add first mixture. Blend. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Turn to 300\u00b0 and bake for 40 to 50 minutes longer.

title: Zucchini Casserole
instructions: Mix the sliced zucchini salt milk onion and milk. Sprinkle salt pepper and cracker crumbs on top then add oleo and grated cheese. Pour in 2-quart casserole. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes in uncovered casserole.

title: Fruit Pizza
instructions: Slice dough place on a jelly roll pan bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Blend the next 3 ingredients and spread on cooled cookies. Top cream cheese with the fruit. Combine cornstarch and sugar. Add water slowly and cook till thick. Add dry jello and butter. Cool slightly and spread over fruit.

title: Hines Family Jam Cake
instructions: Cream oleo and sugar. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add 1 egg at a time. Mix spices with flour and add alternately with buttermilk. Add jam nuts and cherries. Bake in stem pan at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Vicki'S Everything But The Kitchen Sink Chicken And Broccoli
instructions: Grease casserole dish and place cooked rice chicken and broccoli mixture in it. Combine remaining ingredients (except for noodles) and pour over other mixture. Stir well to blend ingredients. Cover with egg noodles. Cook at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown. (This is Charles favorite casserole.)

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on and let cool. Peel skins and grate potatoes in large bowl. Grate cheese and add all ingredients except bread crumbs and butter. Mix well. Spread mixture in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of mixture. Melt butter and pour over bread crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes uncovered.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Smash avocados with cream cheese until creamy. Add about 1/2 small jar of picante (more to taste). Squeeze some lemon in mixture. Add about a cup of grated cheese and season with salts and pepper to taste.

title: Pistachio Salad
instructions: Mix pineapple and pudding until thick; then add other ingredients. Chill and serve.

title: Red Potato Salad
instructions: Wash potatoes and boil in jackets. When done cut 1/8-inch slices. Combine mayonnaise sour cream horseradish celery seed and salt; set aside. Then mix parsley and onions in another bowl. In a large bowl put potatoes (salt each layer of potatoes lightly). Then cover with mayonnaise mixture then onion mixture. Continue layering with parsley/onion mixture on top and refrigerate. Do not stir. This needs to be made the night before. Serves 10 to 12.

title: Linda Smith'S Apple-Grape Salad
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water. Pour remaining 1 cup boiling water over cream cheese cut into chunks. Combine and refrigerate until mixture is partially set. Add apples marshmallows grapes and nuts. Chill until set.

title: Date Nut Bread(Julia Veach'S)
instructions: Mix sifted soda with chopped dates; pour boiling water over this mixture. Allow to stand until water cools. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs salt and vanilla. Combine with date mixture. Stir in flour and nuts which have been dredged in flour.

title: Gremoleta Brushchetta
instructions: In small bowl combine last four ingredients. Stir well to mix. Spread mixture over bread slices; arrange slices in single layer on cookie sheet. Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Bake about 15 minutes or until bread is golden brown.

title: Chuck'S Pasta And Fagioli(Beans And Macaroni)
instructions: Fry garlic in oil until golden brown. Add tomato sauce tomatoes and onion; cook 10 minutes. Add beans; stir gently. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Cook macaroni al dente; drain. Add to mixture. Add parsley. Serve immediately or pasta will absorb all the liquid.

title: Dream Pie
instructions: Beat whipped topping mix 1 cup milk and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on high speed for 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Cover with strips of bacon. Cover beans and bake 1 hour. Remove cover and bake another hour.

title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add strawberries bananas crushed pineapple and nuts. Pour half the mixture into mold. Let jell. Spread two 1/2 pint containers of sour cream over mixture. Pour on remaining mixture and let jell.

title: Chili Sauce
instructions: Boil 4 hours. Hot pack. Stir periodically so sauce maintains red color.

title: Carrot Ambrosia
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Chicken Pan Pie
instructions: Place 1 pan pie shell of the 2 count package of shells into the oven (4 shells will be in oven) at 300\u00b0. While shells lightly brown cook frozen vegetables on stove in pot of large size. Add 2 cans broth and 2 cans cream of chicken soup. Stir to mix. Then let simmer on warm stirring occasionally so it does not stick. Use two cups of the juice to stir in flour and make a thick stirrable paste. Pour back into the pot of vegetables. Add salt and pepper for taste.

title: That Green Stuff
instructions: Boil 1 cup water and add to marshmallows. When melted add jello and stir until dissolves. Add 1 cup cold water and pineapple. Place in refrigerator until sets up. Shred the cream cheese into it and fold in whipped cream and pecans. Fix the night before you want to serve it.

title: Tomato Salad Ring
instructions: Combine tomato juice pepper basil and onions; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to simmer; cook for 10 minutes. Strain out onions; keep liquid hot. Soak gelatin in water for 5 minutes. Add to hot tomato juice. Stir until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into mold; chill until firm. Arrange lettuce in a serving platter; unmold the salad into the lettuce.

title: Old Fashioned Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil eggs and sugar. Sift dry ingredients. Mix and stir in diced apples and nuts. Put butterscotch chips on top. Bake in a sheet pan 13 x 9-inch or 2 (9 x 9-inch) pans at 350\u00b0 until firm.

title: Cherry Yum Yum
instructions: Step 3 Spread on top of Dream Whip mixture.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash and slice squash; boil until tender. Drain and mash. Add onion eggs and crackers; mix well. In a 1-quart pot melt butter and Velveeta cheese over low heat. Add milk and 1 cup of grated cheese. Pour into squash mixture. Stir well. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bread crumbs. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Dinette Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour square 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Measure all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes high speed scraping bowl constantly. Pour into pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool if desired. Frost with peppermint cream cheese frosting.

title: Yum-Yum Salad
instructions: Heat pineapple and water; add jello. Let set until partially congealed; fold in cream salad dressing and cheese. Place in refrigerator.

title: Apple Dumplings
