instructions: Mix together the milk flour shortening salt and baking powder. Roll out on board 1/4-inch thickness. Slice apples. Lay on top of dough mixture. Mix 1 cup sugar (leaving 1 cup for later) nutmeg and cinnamon and spread over apples. Roll all together and slice off 3/4-inch in thickness. Place in large pan.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine milk and water. Add pudding mix beat well. Chill for 10 minutes. Fold in cool whip. Line bottom of pan with vanilla wafers. Slice bananas and put on top of wafers. Then pour pudding on top of that. Repeat twice.

title: Frozen Slaw
instructions: Mix first 3 and sprinkle salt over and let stand for 1 hour. Boil vinegar water sugar celery seed and mustard seed. Let cool. Squeeze cabbage out of water; pour cooled vinegar over cabbage and put in bag. Freeze.

title: Blueberry Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Drain berries. Reserve 1 cup syrup (add water to make one cup if needed). Combine reserved syrup with cornstarch and lemon juice. Cook stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in blueberries. Set aside. Combine flour oats sugar baking powder allspice and salt. Cut in butter or margarine with pastry blender. Press 2/3 of mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool in pan. Combine confectioners sugar and milk; drizzle over top. Cut into bars. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

title: Homemade Pancakes
instructions: Mix all together. Add milk to desired thickness. Cook in buttered skillet.

title: Coconut Dream Pie
instructions: Beat whipped topping mix with 1 cup milk and vanilla using large mixer bowl. Beat on high with electric mixer about 6 minutes or until topping thickens and forms peaks. Add remaining milk pie filling mix and coconut. Blend on low speed. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes scraping bowl occasionally. Spoon into pie shell. Toast coconut and sprinkle on top of pie. Chill at least 4 hours before serving.

title: Buffalo Stew
instructions: Cut the buffalo into bite size pieces; should take about 2 months. Add enough brown gravy to cover. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook over a turkey pit fire for about 4 weeks at 460\u00b0. This will serve about 2000 people. If more are expected two rabbits may be added. But do not add the rabbits unless necessary as most people do not like to find a hare in their stew. Serves approximately 2000.

title: White Trash Carrots
instructions: Steam or boil carrots and onion in a medium saucepan until tender. Remove excess water. Add milk and Velveeta cheese over a low heat until cheese is thoroughly melted. Stir in crumbled potato chips and serve.

title: French Breakfast Puffs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0. Measure Bisquick sugar nutmeg soft butter milk and egg in mixing bowl. Beat until all ingredients are moist and butter has blended (do not overmix). Grease muffin tins; fill 2/3 full. Place in oven and bake at 375\u00b0 to 400\u00b0.

title: Excellent Steak
instructions: I defrost steak in refrigerator. Then I put steak into a 9 x 13-inch pan and completely cover in soy sauce. Marinate for 24 hours. This also tenderizes steak.

title: Ham And Cheese Quiche
instructions: Saute onion and pepper in oleo. Add flour; set aside. Beat eggs milk salt and pepper. Add ham and 1 cup cheese onions and pepper. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on pie crust. Pour in ham and cheese mixture. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until firm about 30 minutes.

title: Raw Peach Pie
instructions: Put peeled peach halves (fresh) open side down in an unbaked pie shell. Mix butter flour and sugar; add egg. Beat together and pour over peaches. Bake 1 hour at 300\u00b0. Serve with whipped or ice cream.

title: Mostaccioli Salad
instructions: Cook mostaccioli noodles. Drain. Rinse and cool. Add vegetables and blend together.

title: Chocolate Chip Cake
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl. Fold in chocolate chips and grated German chocolate bar. Pour into greased Bundt pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.\tCool 10 to 15 minutes onto plate and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Catfish Stew
instructions: Cut fatback meat in pieces and fry until brown. Drain grease. Next fry onions until tender. Add fatback onions and tomato soup in a big pot. Bring to a boil. Cut heat down on medium heat; add catfish. Cover and cook until fish is done.

title: Pear Relish
instructions: Run pears onions bell peppers and hot peppers through food chopper. Mix with sugar vinegar and spices. Cook 30 minutes. Discard spices. Pack in hot sterile jars.

title: Old Fashioned Peanut Brittle
instructions: Melt butter or margarine in small saucepan over very low heat. Add peanuts and salt; allow to warm. Place sugar in large thick skillet over medium heat. Stir continuously until sugar caramelizes into golden brown syrup. Stir peanuts into syrup quickly. Pour onto large buttered surface at once. With big spoon stretch and pull candy into thin sheet. Cool; break into pieces. Yield 1 1/2 pounds.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add pineapple and pie filling to jello; mix well. Chill until set.

title: Beefy Appetizer Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat thoroughly. Stir well. Serves 5.

title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Put cubed bread in greased 9 x 9 baking pan. Beat eggs add brown sugar one stick melted butter and cinnamon.\tPour over bread. Bake one hour at 250\u00b0. Combine sugar and flour. Add 1 stick melted butter and water. Boil 3 minutes. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla and pour over baked bread.

title: Corn Bread
instructions: Beat eggs well. Stir in milk. Stir in corn meal sugar and salt. Bake in preheated 450\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cut into squares and serve hot with butter or margarine. Makes 9 servings.

title: White Trash
instructions: Toss cereal raisins and peanuts together. Melt chocolate chips peanut butter and margarine. Pour over cereal mixture. Try to coat well. Pour 1/2 box of powdered sugar in bottom of grocery bag. Pour mix in bag. Pour rest of powdered sugar on top of cereal mixture. Shake bag vigorously.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain beans. Use a medium size casserole dish. Heat soup and cheese together in a small pot. Place green beans in casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/2 onions and bacon bits over the beans. Pour cheese mixture over top and bake at 350\u00b0. Sprinkle the rest of your onions and bacon bits on top and bake about 5 more minutes. Yield 8 servings.

title: Rice With Chicken Or Turkey And Cheese
instructions: Measure fat into pan and heat over medium heat. Add chopped onion and brown slightly. Add chicken broth to boiling. Add uncooked rice; stir and reduce heat to low. Cover pan tightly and cook over low heat 20 minutes. Add chicken or turkey and cheese. Cook over very low heat until cheese melts and chicken heats. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings about 3/4 cup each.

title: Snack Dip
instructions: Cook egg vinegar and sugar until slightly thickened. Beat into softened cream cheese. Add chopped vegetables (onion pimento and pepper). Mix and refrigerate. Great with chips crackers or vegetables.

title: Green Chilies And Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package\tdirections. When done stir in\tsour cream. Layer 1/2 rice\tmixture 1/2 green chilies 1/2 cheese in greased 2-quart casserole dish. Repeat layers. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serves 6.

title: Taco Stuffed Potatoes
instructions: Bake potatoes at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour (or until done) unwrapped. Cool slightly. Brown hamburger meat. Prepare taco seasoning mix according to package directions. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out potato into a large bowl. Add cooked taco meat and 1 1/2 cups of cheese; mix well. Spoon potato mixture back into potato skins. Place potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Baked Pineapple
instructions: Crush Ritz crackers. Melt 1/2 stick butter in casserole. Drain pineapple. Mix 1/2 cup sugar and 1/3 cup flour. Add pineapple. Put in casserole. Cover with Ritz crackers. Melt 1/2 stick butter. Pour over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Green Bean Supreme
instructions: Cook onion in margarine. Mix flour salt pepper and sour cream to make a sauce. Stir in beans and put in casserole dish. Sprinkle with potato chips and top with onion rings. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: To each pound ground chuck add 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder small onion (chopped) 2 slices bread (saturated with milk) and 1 egg. Mix bread well into meat along with other ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in loaf pan.

title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
instructions: Boil water sugar and cornstarch until thick and smooth. Set aside until cool. Stir in Jell-O and strawberries. When cool pour into baked pie shells or graham cracker crumbs. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Banana And Black Walnut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add egg yolks and mix. Add vanilla bananas and walnuts. Mix and add milk. Add dry ingredients. Fold beaten egg whites in last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. (Do not preheat oven.) I like to add a little black walnut flavoring.

title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
instructions: Combine dressing and margarine. Combine soups milk and chicken broth on stove and cook. Grease a large casserole dish. Layer 1/2 of dressing and margarine mixture. Layer chicken then pour soup mixture over chicken. Top with other half of dressing and margarine mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Jello Pretzel Salad
instructions: Crust Cream 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine. Add pretzels and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool completely.

title: Old Fashion Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs until light adding sugar and salt gradually. Beat mixture well. Add cream and vanilla. Add milk last. Allow about 2 1/2 inches for swelling in freezer can. Freeze in dasher-type old fashion ice cream freezer.

title: Creamy Corn Pudding
instructions: In a small skillet over medium heat melt 2 teaspoons margarine. Add onion and green pepper. Saute until tender. In a medium bowl combine eggs corn 1/3 cup vanilla wafer crumbs salt pepper pimentos and sauteed vegetables. Pour into a 1-quart casserole dish. Set dish in shallow pan of hot water in oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Melt remaining margarine. Mix in remaining wafer crumbs. Sprinkle over top of casserole and bake 5 minutes more or until done.

title: Dump Salad
instructions: Stir in a large bowl. Refrigerate overnight. This is great served plain or on thin sliced cake.

title: Pleasant Hill Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Cook diced and peeled eggplant in salt water until tender. Mix all ingredients with enough cracker crumbs to make stuffing consistency. Pour into greased casserole. Cover top with buttered cracker crumbs and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Mamie Rhodes' Jam Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a greased and floured pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until toothpick comes out clean. It will be a little sticky but not doughy.

title: Quick Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Over medium heat in hot margarine cook onion until tender. Dont let skillet overheat. Stir in soup milk and pepper; heat to boiling. Add potatoes. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Fettucini Carbonara
instructions: Cook bacon well and crumble. Cook fettucini and place in warm serving dish. Add all remaining ingredients and toss until all fettucini is coated.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Pour tidbits in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Sprinkle sugar and flour on top. Add cheese. Crush the crackers; mix with melted oleo. Pour over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Cheesy Lamb Chops
instructions: Set oven control to broil and/or 550\u00b0. Broil lamb chops with tops about 3-inches from heat until brown about 7 minutes. Cut cheese to fit chops. Turn lamb chops. Broil until done 5 to 7 minutes longer. Place onion and cheese slice on each lamb chop. Broil until cheese begins to melt about 30 seconds.

title: Ham Balls
instructions: Mix meat with crumbs eggs and milk; blend milk. Make into large balls. Place in glass baking dish in single layer. Combine tomato soup sugar vinegar and mustard; pour over meatballs.

title: Ice Cream Dessert
instructions: Line a 13 x 9-inch or larger pan on bottom and sides with vanilla wafers. Spoon softened ice cream over the wafers. Melt chocolate chips in heavy saucepan. When melted add the evaporated milk and marshmallows. Stir constantly and cook until the chocolate mixture is thickened (and marshmallows have melted). Pour over ice cream and sprinkle with pecans. Freeze until solid.

title: Corn Casserole
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake 15 minutes longer.

title: Nana'S Spinach And Beans
instructions: In a saucepan add 1 cup of water garlic oil and some parsley. When water boils add spinach and let cook for about 10 minutes. Add the whole undrained can of beans. Cover and let cook for about 20 minutes.

title: Microwave Corn On The Cob
instructions: Shuck and wash corn. Wrap in Saran Wrap. One corn per wrap. Microwave on High 2 minutes per ear.

title: Apricot Squares
instructions: Cream sugar shortening and vanilla. Blend in egg. Add flour coconut nuts and salt. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Spread with apricot jam. Cover with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

title: Butterscotch Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler and mix well. Cook over simmering water until thick stirring frequently. Beat before using. Serve hot or cold over ice cream.

title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix peanuts sugar syrup and salt. Cook full powder (High) for 7 to 9 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add baking soda and stir very quickly and pour onto greased baking sheet. Cool 15 minutes and break into pieces.

title: Haole Lomilomi Salmon
instructions: Shred salmon. Combine all ingredients and chill for several hours or overnight. Serve as spread with an assortment of crackers.

title: Feta Pasta Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients with \Healthy Salad Dressing\. Refrigerate. Keeps for about 1 week.

title: Liver Dumpling Soup
instructions: *Use your food processor or hand grinder to grind the liver.

title: Cantina
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Combine any type of pasta (3 or 4 kinds) and cook until tender; drain. Add spaghetti sauce chopped pepperoni mushrooms and green peppers; simmer 30 minutes. After the ground beef has been drained add to sauce mixture.

title: Antipasto Salad
instructions: Mix together salad dressing milk dressing mix and pasta in large shallow bowl. Arrange remaining ingredients over pasta mixture. Cover and chill. Makes 18 servings about 14 cups.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream butter in large mixing bowl. Add sugar beating until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla mixing well. Combine flour salt and baking soda; add to creamed mixture blending well. Divide dough into thirds; roll out onto floured surface. Place on lightly greased cookie sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 375\u00b0 until lightly browned.

title: Cinnamon Diamonds
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar; beat in egg yolk and vanilla. Stir together flour and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture. Pat into ungreased baking pan. Brush with egg white. Sprinkle with nuts. Lightly press them into the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Cut into diamond shapes while warm. Makes 48.

title: Nestle Crunch Cake
instructions: Prepare a German chocolate cake according to the package directions. While still warm punch holes in the cake (I use the handle of a wooden spoon). Spread two jars of caramel ice cream topping over the cake. Cool completely. Spread Cool Whip over top. Crush Nestle Quick candy bars and sprinkle over top.

title: Heavenly Flavored Pork
instructions: Mix all together and cook slowly for 3 hours with lid. Add water as needed.

title: Noodles With Character
instructions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan over medium-high heat. Add oil garlic and anise seed and stir until fragrant about 1 minute. Mix in all remaining ingredients and toss until heated through approximately 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and serve. Makes four servings.

title: Dijon Honey Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients together well. Refrigerate. Dressing will keep about 3 weeks. Discard when oil starts to separate. (Minced garlic may be added.)

title: Caramel Pie
instructions: Blend cream cheese and condensed milk until smooth. Fold in La Creme. Put 1/4 of the mixture in each shell. Drizzle with the caramel topping (may be melted in microwave first). Sprinkle with pecans. Repeat the layers. Freeze and serve frozen.

title: Apple Dumplings
instructions: Combine sugar water cinnamon and nutmeg in a saucepan. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add butter. Set aside.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Combine soups green beans sour cream and mayonnaise. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Boil noodles as directed on package. Drain and spread in buttered pan while hot. Add layer of each chicken green beans soup mixture mushrooms potato chips and cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cheese melts.

title: Cheesy Mostaccioli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine pasta meat soup and spaghetti sauce. Add pepper seasoning and 2 cups Mozzarella cheese. Mix. Place in a baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Green Bean Casserole(Low-Fat And Sugar-Free)
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach and green beans. Combine with onion water salt garlic powder basil nutmeg and pepper. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Gradually stir vegetable mixture into beaten eggs; stir mixture well. Turn into an 8-inch baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes (or bake until set). Place cheese on top; sprinkle with paprika. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes more before serving. Serves 8.

title: Apricot Bundt Cake
instructions: Mix and bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Barbecue Sauce
instructions: Heat all ingredients together to boiling. Simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. A family favorite.

title: Cheddar Cheese Potatoes
instructions: Combine potatoes onion butter and salt. Mix well and in baking dish layer potatoes and cheese. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake 40 minutes at 425\u00b0 until potatoes are tender.

title: Strawberry Supreme
instructions: Mix all of the above and spread in an 8-inch square pan or pie plate. Bake at 350 for approximately 20 minutes stirring every 5 minutes to keep it crumbly and crunchy. This is not a \pat in\ or solid crust. Let is cool completely before filling.

title: Chicken And Dumplings
instructions: Put chicken in water and cook; remove skin and fat. Take the chicken from the broth and debone. Add butter and bouillon cubes to the broth. In a bowl add flour salt egg and enough warm water to make a soft dough. Roll out on floured surface to about 1/4-inch thick. Cut into strips about 1-inch wide. Drop dumplings into boiling broth. When done return chicken to the pot. Heat and serve.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour and salt. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir enough to just mix and stir until blended. Do not overbeat. Stir in buttermilk. Then stir in melted margarine and butter extract. Pour in 3 unbaked 9-inch pie shells and bake 40 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Tomato Soup
instructions: Saute chicken green pepper onion and garlic in oil until tender. Add other ingredients reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Garnish with sour cream chopped green onion and Cheddar cheese grated.

title: Lemon Pork Chops
instructions: Place pork chops in slow cooker. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top with onion and lemon slices. Sprinkle with brown sugar; drizzle with ketchup. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until meat juice runs clear.

title: Better Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Cut off stem and \X\ bottom of each sprout. Over low heat melt the butter with olive oil in a large pot. Add garlic; cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add sprouts; toss with butter mixture. Add chicken broth salt and pepper. Cover; cook for 10 to 15 minutes over low. Do not overcook. Drain; return to pot. Before serving toss with melted butter and parsley.

title: Creamed Hamburger
instructions: Saute onion in margarine until golden brown. Stir in beef and cook until crumbly. Add flour salt pepper and mushrooms. Stir and cook for 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Serve on baked potatoes rice or noodles.

title: Fruit Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese. Mix with marshmallow cream. Add food coloring.

title: Asparagus Ham Spirals
instructions: Place asparagus in a skillet add 1/2 inch of water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 3-5 minutes or until crisp and tender. Drain and set aside. Separate crescent dough into four rectangles seal perforations. Spread cream cheese over each rectangle to with in 1/4 inch of edges. Top each with ham leaving 1/2 inch uncovered on one long side. Place two asparagus spears along the long side with the ham roll up and press seam to seal. Cut each roll into seven pieces. Place cut side down one inch apart on greased baking sheets. Combine butter and garlic powder brush over spirals. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minute or until golden brown. Makes 28 appetizers.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and mashed bananas. Mix well. Sift flour and soda together and add to mixture. Add nuts and mix well. Pour into greased loaf or tube pan and bake in a preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 35 minutes.

title: Pizza - Healthy
instructions: Spray Za bread lightly with olive oil or Pam and spread low-fat no sugar added pasta sauce. Add your favorite vegetables and top with nonfat shredded Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 10 minutes until cheese is melted.

title: Salmon Bake(Crock-Pot Cooking)
instructions: Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water combine all ingredients together. Mix well. Pour into well-greased crock-pot. Cover and cook on high for 2 to 4 hours. Yields 4 servings about 1 1/2 quarts.

title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook 30 minutes the first 5 ingredients. Add cans of cream of celery soup (undiluted) and Velveeta cheese. Cook until cheese is melted.

title: Overnight French Toast Deluxe
instructions: Place bread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine eggs milk sugar salt orange juice and vanilla; beat well. Pour mixture over bread slices and turn slices to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate overnight. In the morning melt 2 tablespoons margarine in a large skillet; remove 4 slices bread from dish and saute 4 minutes or until browned on each side. Repeat procedure with remaining margarine and bread. Sprinkle with xxxx sugar and serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

title: Raspberry Torte
instructions: Mix like pie crust; press in cake pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Penuche Fudge
instructions: Boil milk and sugar to form a soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Heat mixture until creamy and thickened. Pour into greased pan. When cooled cut into squares.

title: Round Steak And Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Season steak with salt; dip in flour. Brown steak in oil. Arrange steak in baking dish. Place vegetables over steak. Add soups and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Penny'S Pizza
instructions: Make crust according to directions on package. Brown hamburger and sausage; drain. Spread sauce on crust. Place 1/2 of pepperoni on sauce then sausage and hamburger. Add pepper onions and garlic powder. Use 1/2 of cheese on top of this then the other 1/2 of pepperoni. Add the remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until crust is brown and cheese is melted. Makes 1 large pizza.

title: Chocolate Mousse Napoleons(With Strawberries And Cream)
instructions: 1) Thaw pastry sheet at room temperature 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Chocolate Dump Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix melted butter and egg. Pat in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese confectioners sugar eggs and cocoa. Blend with mixer. Pour over cake mix in pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Bake or boil sweet potatoes. Mash sweet potatoes and add margarine. Next add sugar Pet milk eggs and vanilla. Taste for desired sweetness. Add cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until pie is firm.

title: Watercress Omelette
instructions: Melt butter in an 8-inch omelette pan or skillet over moderate heat. Combine eggs watercress salt and pepper; add to pan. Cook lifting the edges with a fork until omelette is done. Fold omelette in half; turn out onto a serving plate. Top with sour cream and caviar. Serves 2.

title: Almond Pound Cake(Torta Di Mandorle)
instructions: From my sister Pauline.

title: Homemade Syrup
instructions: Use saucepan. Brown sugar until light brown. Add water and cook over low fire until thickened. Serve with pancakes or hot biscuits. Easy and delicious.

title: Italian Creme Cake
instructions: Cream together butter shortening and sugar. Add egg yolks one at a time. Mix together buttermilk and soda. Add flour to creamed mixture with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour. Fold in vanilla pecans coconut and beaten egg whites. Bake in 3 round 8 or 9-inch cake pans at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Pineapple Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Stir in pineapple and bread cubes. Pour into greased dish and bake for approximately 45 minutes until top is browned. Serve hot or cold. Good with ham.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients. Bake in an oblong pan at 300\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes. Take out of oven and pour on marshmallow cream. Put cake back in oven for 10 minutes longer. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mix cabbage green pepper onion and pimento together. Make a sauce of vinegar salt sugar celery seed mustard seed and turmeric.\tBring sauce to boil. Pour over cabbage. Mix well. Refrigerate 12 hours. Keeps for weeks.

title: Gourmet Zucchini
instructions: Saute the zucchini carrots and onions. Add chicken soup; bring to a boil. Add sour cream and 1 1/2 cups of stuffing mix. Put in buttered casserole. Cover with 1/2 cup stuffing mix tossed in softened 1/2 cup margarine on top. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Zucchini Bisque
instructions: In 3-quart saucepan melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add zucchini mushrooms onion and parsley. Cook over medium heat until vegetables are crispy-tender (6 to 8 minutes).

title: My Favorite Caramel Cake
instructions: Grease and flour 2 (9 1/2-inch) layer pans. Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour and sugar in a large bowl. Add oil and 2/3 of the milk. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed with electric mixer. Add remaining milk eggs and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes longer. Pour into prepared pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until centers spring back when lightly pressed with fingertip. Cool then frost.

title: Heavenly Orange Mold(Recipe Served At Club Meetings)
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups of hot water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Let thicken some and then add fruits and Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

title: Cranberry Mousse Pie
instructions: In a saucepan heat cran-raspberry juice cocktail to boiling; remove from heat. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. In a bowl beat cranberry sauce with an electric beater on high for 1 minute. Stir in gelatin mixture. Chill in refrigerator for 2 1/2 hours until thickened but not set. Fold in nondairy whipped topping until mixture is thoroughly blended. Spoon into dessert dishes or 9-inch prepared pie shell. Chill until firm. Makes 8 servings.

title: Velvety Custard Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Thoroughly mix eggs sugar salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. Pour at once into pie shell. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake pie 35 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Fruit Cake
instructions: Have all ingredients at room temperature. Chop nuts and fruits. Put in large bowl and dredge with 3/4 cup flour; set aside. Grease and line tube pan with waxed paper.

title: Canadian Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook the first 6 ingredients until tender (about 30 minutes). Add the cheese. Stir until melted. Add the soup. Return to the heat 5 to 10 minutes on low. Stir in the milk. If desired garnish with crumbled bacon.

title: Celia'S Lasagna
instructions: Brown the first 4 ingredients salt and pepper to taste. In a saucepan mix the tomato juice paste mushroom soup celery salt and sugar. Add in browned ingredients; simmer until thickened (approximately 3 hours). Boil 10 to 12 lasagna noodles for 8 minutes; drain and rinse. In a 13 x 9-inch pan place sauce on bottom noodles sauce cheese noodles sauce cheese and noodles until all used. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes covered with foil then for 15 minutes uncovered.

title: Pepper Jelly
instructions: Blend in blender. Cook for 7 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes; add Certo and put in jars.

title: Delectables(Need We Say More)
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter slowly in a double boiler. Remove from heat and combine with all ingredients. Spoon into tiny paper baking cups that have been placed in muffin tins about half full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 12 minutes. Yields 36.

title: Barbara'S Chicken, Chicken Soup
instructions: Place chicken in large casserole dish. Mix soup and milk. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with parsley. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 to 6. Enjoy.

title: Good Morning Coffee Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine flour sugar and salt; cut in shortening until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup crumb mixture. To remaining crumb mixture add baking powder milk eggs and vanilla. Beat on medium 2 minutes. Spread into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 25 minutes or until set.

title: Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Blend cream cheese and peanut butter. Add confectioners sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze. Set out to slightly soften before serving.

title: Molasses Stack Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and molasses. Sift flour. Add spices and sift again. Mix. Bake in thin layers 3 tablespoons per layer. Stack with applesauce or dried apple or apples of your choice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Microwave Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Melt butter in 8-inch glass pie plate. Add onion and cook in microwave for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients except mushrooms. Stuff mushroom caps; pile mixture high. Put 8 mushrooms on paper plate and cover with wax paper. Cook 2 minutes in microwave. Serve.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: In large pot gently saute pork until rendered. Remove pork and add butter. Stir over low heat. When bubbly add onions and continue sauteing until transparent. Add cubed potatoes and cook about 5 minutes stirring to keep moist. Add flour and cook an additional 3 minutes or so again stirring well. Add clam juice and cook until potatoes are tender. Add chopped clams and cream and heat through taking care not to bring to a boil. When well heated serve.

title: Apricot Delight
instructions: Mix and stir first 3 ingredients until melted. Add the 2 cups cold water and refrigerate to thicken. When slightly thick add crushed pineapple drained. Save pineapple juice for sauce. Add bananas. Jell until firm.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix Bisquick sausage and cheese together mixing well. Add milk and blend. Roll into balls the size of a walnut shell or smaller. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 100 to 150 sausage balls. Great to serve for breakfast or lunch!

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken until tender; debone. Reserve 2 cups of broth. Combine chicken soup and broth in large casserole dish; add vegetables if desired. Top with dough and bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Elegant Italian Chicken(Easy But Elegant!)
instructions: Mix the cream cheese soup and wine together. Set aside. In frying pan melt 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle in the Italian salad dressing mix. Lightly saute chicken in pan. Place in greased casserole dish. Top with sauce mixture. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cherry Bars($25,000 Pillsbury Bakeoff Winner)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Using solid shortening (not oil) grease and flour 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan or 13 x 9-inch pan.

title: Fruit Stuffed Pork
instructions: Cut pork loin lengthwise in 1/2 but not all the through. Open and spread flat. Arrange apricots and prunes down center. Fold pork in original shape. Secure with toothpicks.

title: Chocolate-Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg. Blend in chocolate flavorings and 2 tablespoons water. Mix flour soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt; stir into creamed mixture. Stir in oats and nuts. Form into 1-inch balls. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with sugared bottom of tumbler. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Yield 4 dozen.

title: Cranberry Salad
instructions: Mix the gelatin and water together in a large bowl. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased mold or Bundt pan. Chill until set.

title: Onion Rice
instructions: Clean rice with water. Put into big ovenproof bowl. Add 3 cups boiling water onion soup mix and margarine. Mix together. Put in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: 40 Clove Chicken Felice
instructions: Place chicken into 9 x 13-inch baking dish skin side up. Sprinkle all ingredients evenly over chicken. Squeeze juice from lemon and sprinkle over top. Cut remaining lemon rind into pieces and arrange throughout. Cover with foil and bake at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Pudding
instructions: Mix flour oleo and pecans. Mix and press in greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 375\u00b0. Mix cream cheese powdered sugar and 1 cup whipped topping and pour over cooled mixture. Chill. Next mix lemon instant pudding and milk. Whip until thick and pour on cream cheese. Top with whipped cream if desired.

title: Picture-Perfect Turkey In 45 Minutes
instructions: Rub turkey with mixture of seasonings inside and out. Heat 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil in a large deep fryer to 375\u00b0. Gently lower bird into hot oil with breast up. Cook 4 1/2 minutes; turn frequently. Bird will not brown until it is done internally.

title: Bottom'S Up Gingerbread
instructions: Melt butter in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Chop up nuts over butter. Sprinkle nuts. Pour apple pie filling over butter. Prepare gingerbread mix as directed. Pour mix over pie filling. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Turn on platter. Top with Cool Whip. Yields 45 cookies.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Layer these and add fried onion rings on top. Brown until cooked.

title: Old Fashioned Cheese Potatoes
instructions: In a saucepan melt butter or margarine. Add flour salt and pepper. Cook and stir until a thick paste forms. Gradually add milk. Cook and stir until the mixture begins to thicken. Add cheese. Cook and stir until melted. Place potatoes in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or baking dish. Pour sauce over the potatoes. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for about 1 hour or until the potatoes are tender. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Mexican Chicken Bake
instructions: Cube chicken. Mix mushroom soup milk chiles and onion together. Place 1 cup crushed Doritos in bottom of greased shallow casserole dish. Next place half the chicken. Cover it with half of soup mixture.

title: Crab Won Tons
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients until smooth. Place 1 teaspoon of mixture in center of wrapper and seal according to directions on package. Deep fat fry in hot oil until golden brown. These freeze well too!

title: Cracker Candy
instructions: Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil and spray with Pam. Boil sugar and butter for 3 minutes. Place saltine crackers on foil with edges touching. Pour mix of sugar and butter over crackers. Bake in oven at 400\u00b0 for 4 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over and put back in oven for 1 minute. Take out spread chocolate chips over crackers and refrigerate to harden.

title: White Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Cream butter shortening and sugars; beat until light and fluffy. Add egg and mix well. Combine flour soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Blend in vanilla; stir in chocolate and nuts. Chill for 1 hour. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 14 minutes or until lightly browned. Let stand a few minutes before removing. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

title: Fig Preserves
instructions: Mash figs; simmer boil for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Put into jars.

title: Appetizer
instructions: Brown meat and drain. Stir in cheese until thoroughly melted. Spread on loaves of party rye.

title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
instructions: Cook vegetables according to directions on package until just tender. Drain. Place in a greased casserole. Mix onion celery cheese mayonnaise and sour cream. Spread over vegetables. Melt oleo and mix with Ritz crackers crumbs. Spread on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Low-Fat Chocolate Cake
instructions: Lightly grease and flour two 8 x 1 1/2-inch or 9 x 1 1/2-inch round baking pans. Stir together flour cocoa powder and baking soda. In large mixer bowl beat margarine or butter with electric mixer on medium speed about 30 seconds. Add sugar and vanilla; beat until well combined. Add egg and egg white one at a time beating 1 minute after each. Stir in yogurt. Add dry ingredients and cold water alternately to beaten mixture beating on low speed after each addition just until combined. Pour batter into baking pans. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes for 9-inch layers or 30 to 35 minutes for 8-inch layers or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes on wire racks then remove from pans. Cool.

title: Modern Marble Cake
instructions: Sift flour baking powder and salt together. Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy. Beat eggs thoroughly and add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately beating well. Add vanilla. Divide batter into halves. Melt chocolate and add with 2 tablespoons milk to one half; blend well. Drop batter by tablespoons into greased pan alternating white and chocolate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. The fun of baking a marble cake is to see what designs come through.

title: Berry Good Smoothie
instructions: Combine the juice and banana in a blender. Add in strawberries according to desired thickness. Blend until smooth.

title: Smoked Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except sausage) together in crock-pot. Cut sausage into thin slices and mix into sauce. Cook about 15 minutes on high setting. Turn off and let stand about 12 hours. Turn crock-pot on (low setting) about 3 hours before serving. Serves about 25 persons.

title: Applesauce Gingerbread
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in sugar and molasses. Add eggs then beat in applesauce. Sift flour soda ginger and cinnamon into mixture. Blend well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Fried Chicken Batter
instructions: Mix in cup and pour over chicken. Let meat soak in this marinade for up to 6 hours. Salt and pepper to taste. Roll in flour and deep-fry.

title: Kraut Salad Relish
instructions: Toss ingredients and cover. Chill 4 to 12 hours. Toss again and drain before serving with entree of your choice. Good with outdoor barbecue. Will keep well in refrigerator.

title: Stuffed Pizza Florentine
instructions: Preparation Time 20 to 25 minutes. Cooking Time 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Quick Orange Nut Bread
instructions: In large bowl sift flour with sugar baking powder allspice salt and baking soda. Beat egg thoroughly and combine with orange rind juice and melted butter. Add liquid to flour mixture all at once. Stir only until well blended. Stir in nuts. Bake in well-greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch) in preheated 350\u00b0 oven for about 50 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before removing from pan. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Delicious Swiss Steak
instructions: Mix together mustard flour and salt. Pound dry mixture into steak; cover both sides. Brown both sides. Cover meat with onions carrots and tomatoes. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce salt and brown sugar over all in long pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: Dot'S Chicken
instructions: Set oven at 375\u00b0. Spray casserole with nonstick vegetable spray. Arrange chicken in baking pan. Slice oranges then cut into half moons; do not peel. Tuck orange slices around the chicken; save some for garnish. Stir together honey lemon juice mustard curry and ginger. Pour about half the mixture over the chicken. Bake chicken at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: You Name It Dessert
instructions: Mix and refrigerate overnight. Add chopped nuts (optional) and serve.

title: Hot Butterscotch Punch
instructions: Melt brown sugar in a 2-quart pan over medium low heat while stirring. Add hot water and bring the mixture to the boiling point. Add butter and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Add milk and heat. Blend in salt and vanilla extract. Garnish with cream ground nutmeg. This is an alternative to hot cocoa and tastes good in the winter!

title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
instructions: Beat eggs. Gradually beat in sugar then oil. Combine dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture alternately with zucchini. Stir in walnuts and vanilla. Turn into greased and floured 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Turn out and cool.

title: M&M Cookies
instructions: Cream shortening sugar eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Sift together flour soda and salt. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in 1/2 of the M&Ms. Reserve the rest of the M&Ms for decorating. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate with the remaining M&Ms. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 dozen cookies.

title: Savory Baked Beans
instructions: Combine all ingredients and put into large casserole dish. Bake covered in a 325\u00b0 oven for 3 hours stirring occasionally. Uncover for the last 1/2 hour of baking.

title: Fresh Vegetable Marinade
instructions: Remove flowerets from broccoli; cut in bite-size pieces. Combine broccoli mushrooms and all vegetables. Toss lightly. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour over vegetables. Garnish with celery leaves and cherry tomatoes. Chill at least 3 hours.

title: Orange Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Mix all remaining ingredients with above. Refrigerate.

title: Shrimp Casserole
instructions: Cook mushrooms garlic celery onion and green pepper in 1/4 cup butter until tender. Combine with remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup butter and place in a greased casserole. Pour remaining melted butter over casserole and bake at 300\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
instructions: Combine all ingredients except langostinos. Heat on medium heat and add langostinos. Stir and serve.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Spread apples in baking dish. Combine flour brown sugar cinnamon nutmeg oats and pecans in bowl; mix well. Add margarine; mix well. Sprinkle evenly over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Fry the sausage; drain and rinse off grease. Melt the cream cheese and sausage together. Use 13 x 9-inch pan. Open 1 package of crescent rolls and line the bottom of the pan. Add sausage-cream cheese mixture on top. Layer the top with crescent rolls like a pie top. Bake at 350\u00b0 until brown.

title: Raw Apple Cake
instructions: Beat together sugar oil eggs vanilla salt and cinnamon. Add flour and soda and beat. Stir in nuts and raw apples. The batter will be stiff. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool and frost.

title: Orange Tapioca Salad
instructions: Cook until thick pudding jello and hot water. Cool completely. Add mandarin oranges and whipped topping and mix all together and refrigerate.

title: Zucchini Quiche
instructions: Cook first five ingredients until tender. Add 1 cup grated cheese and eggs. Spread rolls in greased glass pie plate. Pour in mixture. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Oreo Supreme
instructions: Mix and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan 30 Oreo cookies crushed 3/4 stick melted margarine. Soften 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream and spread over Oreo crust. Put in freezer and let harden. Mix in saucepan chocolate squares 2 tablespoons margarine sugar evaporated milk. Boil for 8 minutes and let cool. Spread over ice cream and place in freezer to harden. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with grated Oreos if desired. Keep in freezer. Yummy.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Brown meat bell pepper onion chili powder and cumin seed. Drain and set aside. Chop tomato and lettuce; set aside. On low heat melt cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Crunch bag of Fritos. Mix all ingredients when ready to serve.

title: Banana Split Pie
instructions: Slice bananas and place in bottom of pie crust. Then put drained pineapple over bananas. Mix pudding as directed and add cream cheese. Pour over bananas. Chill 2 hours. Add whipped cream nuts and cherries and serve.

title: Pineapple Coconut Cake
instructions: Bake cake as directed. With large fork poke holes throughout cake. Pour coconut milk over cake until saturated. Refrigerate 2 hours. Spoon pineapple on top first then add Cool Whip over top of pineapple. Sprinkle coconut over top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 45 minutes. Serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: In large frying pan saute onions bell pepper and garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil until tender. Pour into large Dutch oven. Then brown meat and add to onions pepper and garlic. Mix tomatoes tomato paste and sugar into meat and vegetable mixture. Cook covered on high until mixture starts to bubble watching carefully. Turn down to low and cook 4 hours stirring every now and then. Serve over cooked spaghetti noodles. Serves about 8.

title: Easy Banana Pudding
instructions: Mix banana pudding mix with milk. Layer oblong dish with wafers then sliced bananas. Add layer of pudding; repeat until ending with pudding on top. Crumble a handful of wafers on top of pudding for decoration.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together a day ahead and let it marinate (refrigerate) overnight. Prior to serving mix remaining 1/4 bottle Viva Italian dressing. Toss or mix good.

title: French Fried Onion Rings
instructions: Peel onions; slice into 1/4-inch slices. Separate into rings. Sift flour with baking powder salt and sugar. Combine milk egg and fat; add to dry ingredients all at once. Beat until smooth. Dip onion rings in batter; fry until golden brown in deep fat at 375\u00b0. Drain on absorbent paper. Sprinkle with additional salt. Yields 4 servings.

title: Fat-Free Peach Cobbler(Serves 10)
instructions: Save out 9 tablespoons of peach juice from canned peaches. Set aside. Place all remaining peaches and juice in pot over medium heat; stir occasionally. In large bowl mix flour sugar baking soda and cinnamon. Set aside. In another bowl thoroughly beat banana until no large pieces remain. Add in peach juice and skim milk. Mix well. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients (not the warming peach mixture). Mix together well. Set aside. When peach mixture begins to bubble add in potato flakes and stir constantly for about a minute. Pour peach mixture into an 11 x 15-inch pan. Drop dough mixture by large spoonfuls onto the top of peaches. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for about 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean from the biscuits. Let stand after cooking for an hour or more. Serve warm with fat-free frozen vanilla yogurt or ice cream.

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Combine apples celery raisins and walnuts. Mix together lemon juice yogurt mayonnaise honey and salt. Stir until well blended. Add dressing to apple mixture mix well and chill. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream together oleo shortening and sugars. Add eggs; beat well. Add flour cream of tartar and vanilla. Mix well. Drop by 1/2 teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until brown.

title: Stir-Fried Vegetables
instructions: Combine soy sauce oyster sauce white wine sesame oil and pepper. Mix well and set aside. Combine mushrooms and hot water in a small bowl; let stand 15 minutes. Drain. Remove and discard stems. Thinly slice caps. Set aside.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash until tender. Drain and mash. Mix sugar mayonnaise onions egg salt and pepper together and combine with squash. Place in a casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs grated cheese and 1/2 stick butter. Cook in 350\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Frosting
instructions: Blend shortening and sugar together. Add salt water and extracts. Whip on medium speed with mixer.

title: Ted'S Pie Crust
instructions: Mix and sift flour sugar and salt; blend in Crisco with fork until well balled like small BBs. Add ice water knead and roll out to size needed.

title: Yellow Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar one cup at a time and cream well. Add eggs two at a time creaming well. Sift together flour baking powder and salt then add to batter mixing well. Add lemon and vanilla. Pour batter into a tube cake pan. Bake in preheated oven 40 minutes at 275\u00b0. Then turn heat to 300\u00b0 and bake 50 to 60 minutes longer.

title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
instructions: Mix all together and pour in baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion until meat is brown. Add rest of ingredients and desired amount of water. Let simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Strawberry Pound Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour in tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Taffy Apple Dip
instructions: Soften cream cheese at room temperature and mix in sugar vanilla and nuts. Enjoy with apple slices!

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients in order given. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Dissolve brown sugar in water. Add butter. Stir until butter is melted. Slowly pour over raisin mixture. Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Squares
instructions: Blend cream cheese and butter. Mix until smooth. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles. Seal perforation. Add 1/2 cup of mixture to center of rectangle. Wrap the crescent roll around the mixture and seal well. Brush tops of chicken squares with small amount of melted butter. Bake in an ungreased cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes at 350\u00b0 until golden brown. Makes 4 squares.

title: Potato Cakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients well. Heat skillet; use cooking oil. Spoon out potato mixture to make 2 to 3-inch cakes. Brown on each side over medium heat.

title: Sweet Potato-Pork Chop Casserole
instructions: Brown the pork chops in small amount of fat in a skillet. Place in a large casserole and sprinkle with half the salt and pepper. Place sweet potatoes over chops and sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper.

title: Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Lightly blend together in a bowl ice cream and milk. Add pudding. Beat until just mixed one minute. Pour at once into a pie shell. Let stand in refrigerator about 1 hour before serving.

title: No Cook Play Dough(For Children)
instructions: Add food coloring to water before mixing into dough. Slowly add water to dry ingredients until desired consistency. Store in refrigerator. If play dough gets gooey just add more flour.

title: Blueberry Nut Crunch
instructions: Place pineapple in bottom of baking dish. Place blueberries on top of pineapple. Sprinkle sugar on blueberries. Cover with cake mix (dry). Sprinkle chopped pecans to cover. Add melted margarine to top of pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Mallow Fruit Dip
instructions: Beat cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Serve with fresh fruit. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

title: Pecan Pies
instructions: Preheat oven at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes then turn oven down to 275\u00b0 and cook for an hour.

title: Crabmeat Spread Dip
instructions: Drain crabmeat. Mix the crabmeat with cocktail sauce. Let cream cheese soften. Spread on the bottom of a serving plate. Then spread crabmeat over the cream cheese. Refrigerate. Serve with crackers.

title: Potato Onion Soup
instructions: Boil potatoes. Pour off water and save. Mash potatoes. Fry bacon crisp. Remove and fry onions in drippings. Remove and add to mashed potatoes. Add potato water milk butter and seasonings.

title: Chocolate Mint Cookies
instructions: Melt 1 cup mint chocolate chips. In large bowl cream butter and sugar. Add melted mint chips and vanilla. Beat in eggs. Add flour baking powder and salt. Add remaining mint chips; stir well. Dough will be soft. Wrap dough in plastic wrap; freeze until firm (about 20 minutes). Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Shape dough into 1 inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Just For Kids Magic Mud Slime
instructions: Spoon cornstarch into a small bowl. Add water and food coloring; stir. It should be difficult to stir even when the water and cornstarch are fully mixed. If it is too runny add more cornstarch; if crumbly add water. Store in airtight container. When you press the slime it feels solid because you squeeze out some water. When you stop squeezing water flows back again and it becomes runny.

title: Taco Casserole
instructions: Salt meat and brown in small amount of fat until done. Season with chili powder. Drain off excess fat. Crush 3/4 of Doritos and spread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole. Spread meat mixture evenly over Doritos; chop onion and spread over meat mixture spread beans over this mixture. Spread soup over beans spread tomatoes over soup. Grate cheese and spread over tomatoes and crush rest of Doritos and spread over cheese. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 25 minutes. (This and a salad makes a meal.)

title: Fried Cheese Meltaways
instructions: In a large frying pan heat 2 inches of oil to 375\u00b0. In mixing bowl mix Bisquick milk and egg; beat with hand beaters until smooth. Dredge cheese cubes in Bisquick coating them lightly.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl stir together flour cocoa powder salt baking powder and soda. In mixer bowl beat together butter and sugar on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; beat until well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; place on ungreased cookie sheets. Press down center of dough with thumb. Drain cherries reserving juice. Place a cherry in the center of each cookie.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Grease casserole well with butter; casserole dish should be 4-quart size. Add 1 1/2 cups uncooked rice. Slice onion very thin and place over top of rice. Salt pepper and paprika 8 or 9 pieces of chicken and place over onion and rice (straight from water). Top with 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 can chicken broth (Swanson). Stir top ingredients gently into the rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes to 1 1/2 hours.

title: Chicken Divan
instructions: Cook broccoli drain and arrange in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top of broccoli. Combine soup mayonnaise lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over the top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 6.

title: Pork-Rice Casserole
instructions: Brown pork chops in a skillet seasoning to taste. Put in one layer in\ta shallow 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients then cover the pork chops with mixture. Cover baking dish with foil. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes. After 2/3 of the cooking time add a little more water if the rice needs more moisture.

title: Marie Date Roll
instructions: Stir the sugars and milk constantly until forms a soft ball. Stir in the dates and cook to hard ball. Add the nuts butter and vanilla. Beat until it holds shape. Pour out on a damp cloth and work into a roll. Chill and slice.

title: Ham Ball
instructions: Mix together shape into a ball and chill. Serve with crackers.

title: Basic Beaver
instructions: Sprinkle serving size pieces of beaver with seasoned salt. Mix Dales liquid smoke and water in large cast-iron skillet and bring to simmer. Add beaver pieces to skillet and cook until tender. Remove. Clean skillet. Add bacon drippings and reheat. Batter cooked pieces of beaver in flour and return to skillet. Fry to a golden brown.

title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease baking dish 8 x 8-inches. Cook and stir ground beef until brown. Drain. Mix sour cream mayonnaise cheese and onion. Mix baking mix and water to soft dough. Pat in pan; press 1/2 inch up sides. Layer beef tomatoes and green pepper in pan. Spoon sour cream over top. Sprinkle with paprika if desired. Bake until edges of dough are brown 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Sift together flour soda cinnamon and salt. Add sugar eggs Wesson oil and grated carrots. Mix well. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven (layers).

title: Festive Fruit
instructions: Drain fruit. Place fruit and almonds in layers in a shallow baking dish. Set aside.

title: Autumn Soup
instructions: *One 28 ounce can tomatoes can be substituted; reduce water to 3 cups.

title: Topped Strawberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water; add strawberries and pineapple. Chill until set.

title: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar. Add in Cool Whip and blend well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate for several hours.

title: Sister Farmer'S Famous Coconut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix cake mix sugar flour and baking powder together. Add butter milk and egg yolks. Beat with mixer real good. Add flavors and beat well. Cook until done. Use 3 (9-inch) cake pans. Frost when cake is cooled.

title: M Y F Cheese Nachos
instructions: Melt cheese and add chilies. Can put in crock-pot. Pour over nacho chips or Doritos.

title: Classic Macaroni Salad
instructions: In a large bowl combine mayonnaise vinegar mustard sugar salt and pepper. Add noodles celery green pepper tomato onion and cucumber. Toss to coat well. Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

title: Scalloped Pineapple
instructions: Toss together bread crumbs and pineapple chunks and place in a greased 2-quart dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pineapple. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Chip Dip
instructions: Layer in a 9 x 9-inch pan starting with cream cheese then spread chili on next. Pour as much or as little picante sauce over. Top with plenty of cheese; a mixture of Monterey Jack and Cheddar is good. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Elephant Balls
instructions: Mix sugar margarine peanut butter and Rice Krispies together with your hands (shape into balls). Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler and add paraffin as needed. Dip balls in chocolate and let set until cool.

title: Chicken And Ham Casserole
instructions: Wipe chicken breasts with damp cloth. In a large skillet bring broth to boiling. Add chicken breasts; reduce heat and simmer covered 20 minutes or until tender. Remove chicken; reserve broth.

title: Molasses Coconut Chews
instructions: Cream together the white and brown sugar and the shortening. Add the beaten eggs vanilla and molasses. Beat well. Sift together the flour soda and salt and stir in. Stir in coconut flakes. Shape into small balls and place on greased cookie sheet about 3 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Brownies
instructions: Mix ingredients together and spread on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Fruit Kabobs
instructions: Drain pineapple and cherries. Peel kiwi fruit; cut in chunks same size as cherries or pineapple. Place on picks the kiwi cherry and pineapple.

title: Shortribs With Tomatoes And Bacon
instructions: Sprinkle shortribs with paprika salt and pepper. Coat with flour. Cook bacon in Dutch oven about 5 minutes. Remove bacon using slotted spoon and reserve. Working in batches brown shortribs on all sides; set aside. Add onions and garlic to Dutch oven; over medium heat cook until tender about 8 minutes. Mix in tomato paste and 4 teaspoons rosemary. Add wine and bring to boil until liquid is reduced by half (about 6 minutes). Add tomatoes and broth. Return shortribs any juices and bacon to Dutch oven; bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until tender about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Uncover and simmer until liquid is slightly thickened about 30 minutes. (Can be made 1 day ahead. Cover and refrigerate. Re-warm over medium heat stirring occasionally about 20 minutes.) Add peas to shortribs; simmer uncovered until peas are crisp-tender about 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons rosemary.

title: Easy Chicken And Rice
instructions: Combine water with rice and onion soup in oblong casserole. Lay chicken on top. Add cream of chicken soup over chicken. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350\u00b0 uncovered.

title: Hermits
instructions: Mix shortening sugar molasses and water. Beat eggs and reserve 1 teaspoon to coat top of herbs for glazing. Add flour soda and spices which have been sifted together. Fold in raisins and nuts. Divide dough into long rolls on greased cookie sheet. Coat top with remainder of egg. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cut on the bias.

title: Reuben Sandwiches
instructions: Marinate sauerkraut and mayonnaise for 30 minutes. Arrange pieces of turkey swiss cheese and corned beef on 6 buttered slices of rye bread. Spread 1/3 cup marinate kraut on each slice of bread.

title: Turkey Burgers(Low-Fat)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Form into 4 ounce patties. Lay on a broiler pan and broil for 3 to 4 minutes per side or grill until done. Makes 4 (4 ounce) patties.

title: Jamaican Rice And Peas
instructions: Make 1\tquart of coconut milk by adding water to 1 grated coconut. Strain through sieve. Wash red beans. Add to milk with 2 pegs of garlic. Boil until tender. Add thyme hot pepper and green\tonion;\tsalt to taste. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add washed rice (liquid should be about 1 inch above rice). Bring to a\tboil cover and cook on low heat until liquid disappears and rice is cooked. Serve with Chicken Fricassee and boiled or fried plantain.

title: Roasted Mustard Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Spray roasting pan 3 times to coat with vegetable oil. Put the mustard paprika cumin chili powder and cayenne pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to blend.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Cut up lettuce cauliflower and onions into small pieces. Crumble bacon on top. Mix Miracle Whip and sugar in bowl. Dribble on top of cauliflower mixture; let set overnight. Toss when ready to serve.

title: Southern Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and mix well. Add milk. Stir over medium heat until bubbly. Reduce heat to low for 2 to 3 minutes stirring constantly. Serve over biscuits.

title: Festive Green Pea Salad
instructions: Drain peas. Add bacon onion and cheese. Mix milk mayonnaise sugar vinegar. Add to peas. Stir gently. Garnish with pimento. Serves 8 to 10. Good potluck dish. Can make ahead of time.

title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
instructions: Combine pudding sugar milk and margarine into a saucepan. Cook over medium-high heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a full boil. Lower heat and boil slowly for 3 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from heat and quickly stir in Planters peanuts. Beat until candy thickens (about 15 minutes). Quickly drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper forming clusters. Makes about 24. Refrigerate.

title: Potato Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs with sugar and shortening. Mix flour potato chips and vanilla. I roll in little balls and press down with a fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Meat Ball Sauce
instructions: Take 1 cup of friendship and add 2 cups of thoughtfulness. Cream smoothly with a pinch of gentleness and a dash of powdered kindness.

title: Swiss Steak
instructions: Cut flour and pound round steak. Then brown each piece of meat in a little oil. When well browned cover with a mixture of canned tomatoes celery onion carrots bay leaf garlic powder and salt and pepper to taste. Cover pan and cook on low heat for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Party Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Drain pineapple measuring 1/2 cup syrup. Add to Jell-O. Chill until very thick. Fold in pineapple cheese cherries and almonds. Pour into individual molds or 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Chill until firm.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Cook rice and water until rice is tender. Simmer until water is gone. Put into a 2-quart casserole the other ingredients. Add cooked rice. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Let set in oven 10 more minutes.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Blend crumbs and butter. Press firmly on bottom and around sides of 9-inch pie pan. Chill in refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours.

title: Butter Fingers
instructions: Mix in the order listed. When mixed thoroughly chill dough about 45 minutes or 1 hour. Shape like fingers and bake at 350\u00b0 about 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar after cooling some but while still warm. Store in an airtight container and keep in a cool place. Nice for the holidays.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine and mix thoroughly. Pack into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Gobble Goodies
instructions: With a parents help melt the margarine over medium heat in a large saucepan. Add the marshmallows and stir the mixture until the marshmallows are completely melted. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cereal. Stir the mixture until the cereal is well coated. Cool the mixture for 10 minutes. While its cooling twist apart some sandwich cookies. Butter your hands and shape the cereal mixture into 1 1/2-inch balls. Frost the inside of the cookie halves that have no filling on them. Press candy corns into the frosting in the shape of a fan. Add a little frosting below the candy corns. Then press a cereal ball into the center of each cookie. Spread frosting on remaining cookie halves and stick them to the bottoms of the cereal balls. Put a dab of frosting on a candy corn and stick it onto the cereal ball to make the turkeys head. Repeat for each turkey. Use the turkeys to decorate your familys Thanksgiving table. (And when youre through with dinner gobble them up.)

title: Three-Cheese Pie
instructions: Mix cheeses onion and flour. Spread in greased pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch). Beat eggs slightly; beat in milk salt mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over cheese mixture. Cook uncovered in a 350\u00b0 oven until set 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Arrange tomato slices around edge of pie overlapping slices slightly.

title: Raisin Pie
instructions: Cook ingredients together and put in unbaked 2 crust pie shell. Bake at 400\u00b0 until golden brown.

title: Tomato Soup Cake
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in bowl. Add soup and shortening. Beat at low to medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs and water. Beat 2 minutes more. Add optional ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 in greased and floured pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch pan bake 35 to 40 minutes; tube pan bake 1 hour).

title: Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Beat eggs; add milk and butter and mix into dry ingredients. Pour into muffin pans. Bake for 20 minutes at 425\u00b0.

title: Punch
instructions: Mix all together. Just before serving add 3 quarts of ginger ale. Add ice.

title: Mexican Dip Salad
instructions: Put in layers the bean dip green chilies guacamole sour cream mixed with taco seasoning cheese olives and tomatoes.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Heat margarine and syrup in saucepan and set aside. In mixing bowl mix sugar and eggs together. Pour warm syrup mixture over eggs and sugar mixture. Add vanilla and mix well. brush 1 egg white on unbaked pie crusts. Spread pecans in bottom of pie crusts. Pour above mixture in crusts over pecans. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Makes 2 pies.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Measure flour into a large bowl. Add lard. Mix until crumbly with mixer. Add water and salt; mix well with a fork. Roll out on floured board. Makes 5 crusts.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Cream first 3 ingredients. Add eggs; beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients and milk. Pour into greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour and 45 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when testing.

title: Brunch Egg Casserole
instructions: Spread bread cubes in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over bread cubes. Blend slightly beaten eggs milk salt mustard onion powder and pepper. Pour this mixture over the bread and cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 until egg mixture is set about 40 to 45 minutes. In the meantime fry 10 slices bacon until crisp. Sprinkle on casserole during the last 10 minutes of baking. Serves 10.

title: Work Of Art Fruit Pizza
instructions: Combine all glaze ingredients in a medium saucepan. Stir until smooth. Cook over medium heat stirring until mixture boils. Boil for 1 minute. Cool and spoon over pies. Yields 2 fruit pies.

title: Mini Cheese Cakes
instructions: Line muffin tin with foil cupcake liners. Place one vanilla wafer in each liner. Mix cream cheese vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs; mix well. Pour over wafers filling 3/4 full. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pan when cooled. Chill for 2 hours. Top with fruit or pie filling.

title: Rich Caramel Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0.

title: Joyce'S Chess Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into unbaked crust. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0 then turn oven to 350\u00b0 and bake until set about 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Kentucky Apple Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with a mixer until thick and light. Combine sugar and oil. Pour into eggs with mixer on medium speed. Stir together flour and cinnamon then add to egg mixture with vanilla. Beat to mix. Stir in walnuts. Spread apples in a buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour batter over apples spreading to cover. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Remove from oven and cool. Spread with Cream Cheese Icing.

title: Irish Scones
instructions: Measure and mix the flour sugar and soda. Cut in margarine until well mixed and grainy looking. In a separate bowl mix 1 1/2 cups buttermilk and beaten egg. Add raisins.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Bring water and salt to boil; add carrots celery and potatoes. Cook until tender. Cook onion in margarine; add flour milk and chicken broth. When smooth add cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Add vegetables plus the water they were cooked in. Makes 2 1/2 quarts about 5 servings.

title: Hot Tuna-Macaroni Toss(Try A Hot Salad For A Change)
instructions: Cook macaroni following package directions. Drain. In skillet mix Italian dressing mustard celery seed salt and pepper. Heat just to boiling. Add drained macaroni tuna celery and green pepper. Toss and heat through. Stir in mayonnaise. Top with green pepper rings. Serve hot. Serves four.

title: Marshmallow Delight
instructions: Dissolve marshmallows in milk on stove in top of double boiler until they are thoroughly melted then set aside to cool. Whip the cream. Roll graham crackers fine and put 1/2 of them in bottom of pan (9 x 13-inch). When the pineapple is well drained add to marshmallow mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon mixture on crumbs and sprinkle rest of crumbs on top. Place in refrigerator about 8 hours so as to serve cold.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Boil together until forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla. DO NOT BEAT. STIR.

title: Congealed Ambrosia Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange Jell-O and sugar in the hot water. Add other ingredients and stir well. Place in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to congeal. Serves 8.

title: Supreme Squash Casserole
instructions: Place croutons in bottom of casserole dish. Spread mixture on top. Cover with cracker crumbs and melted butter. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Pineapple Coleslaw
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine mayonnaise vinegar sugar and milk. Place cabbage and pineapple in a large salad bowl; add dressing and toss. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Hash Brown Casserole
instructions: Defrost hash browns. Add 1/2 cup butter salt and pepper and mix together. Add sour cream grated cheese soup and onions; blend. Pour into 3 quart casserole dish.

title: Triple Good Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In medium saucepan combine the first 4 ingredients. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly just until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat; cool slightly and set aside. Beat sugar margarine and vanilla until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients; blend until evenly mixed and crumbly. Reserve 2 cups. Press remaining mixture onto bottom of prepared pan. Spread raisin mixture to within 1/2-inch of edge. Sprinkle with remaining oat mixture; pat lightly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Cut into 2-inch bars.

title: Sesame Seed Baked Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in dressing overnight in refrigerator. One hour before serving preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Melt butter in flat pan. Roll chicken in seed. Place in pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Turn chicken; bake 30 minutes more. Serves 4.

title: Life
instructions: Mix thoroughly with tears of joy sorrow and sympathy for others. Fold in 5 cups of prayers and 4 cups of faith to lighten other ingredients and to raise the texture to great heights of Christian living. After pouring all this into your daily life bake well with the warmth of human kindness. I serve with a smile.

title: Caramel Icing
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan bring to hard boil and stir constantly. Boil one minute. Cool. Add vanilla and beat until creamy.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Mix eggs milk soup cheese and mushrooms in a bowl. In cooking dish layer sausage then hash browns. Pour liquids over the top Refrigerate 1 hour before cooking. Bake 45 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: 7 Layer Bars
instructions: Layer ingredients in order given in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. When completely cooled cut in squares.

title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix together soups and Veg-All; add chicken breasts. Use Pillsbury Ready-Crust. Bake bottom crust about 7 to 8 minutes. Pour in mixture and add top crust. Prick crust to vent. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Raspberry Dessert
instructions: Mix together cake mix eggs butter and pecans. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Cook on 325\u00b0 until done then let cool. Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar together and spread on top of cake layer. Then spread raspberries on top of that. Spread raspberry frosting on top of that. Refrigerate.

title: Aunt Mattie'S Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients; cover and let stand in refrigerator until fully chilled. Serve over lettuce.

title: St. Mark'S Soup
instructions: Brown beef and onion; add other ingredients and simmer. Good made in a crock-pot.

title: Cranberry-Raspberry Salad
instructions: Dissolve raspberry and lemon gelatins in boiling water. Stir in frozen raspberries breaking up large pieces. Break up cranberry sauce with fork; stir into gelatin mixture. Chill until partially set. Carefully pour in lemon-lime beverage stirring gently. Turn into 6-cup mold. Chill 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Unmold on crisp greens. Yield 8 to 10 servings.

title: Beef Tips
instructions: In a crock-pot set on low heat mix stew meat soups and water. Cook all day until tender.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Stir corn syrup and sugar in heavy pan over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat; add butter and chocolate. Cool slightly. Beat in eggs salt and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 55 minutes or until when knife inserted comes out clean.

title: Glazed Carrots
instructions: Combine carrots and water in a medium saucepan; cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain reserving liquid; add enough water to liquid to make 3 tablespoons. Set carrots aside. Combine carrots liquid orange juice and the next 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly. Cook for 1 minute or until thickened. Add carrots; cook 1 minute stirring well. Transfer to serving dish. Yields 4 servings (about 68 calories per 1/2 cup serving).

title: Spring Garden Special
instructions: Saute onions and meat until thoroughly cooked. Add tomatoes and seasonings and cook for a short time. Add green beans and carrots. Simmer 20 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Linguica Puffs
instructions: Brown linguica and add to Cheddar cheese and Bisquick. Mix well and then add water. Batter will be on the sticky side. Make into balls and flatten on a cookie sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Holiday Vegetable Medley
instructions: Thaw vegetables and saute with onion in 3 tablespoons oleo or butter. Mix soup and sour cream well then fold in 1 cup of croutons. Pour into a buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Heat remaining croutons in 1 tablespoon of oleo until covered and sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Pasta Fagioli
instructions: Saute beef in oil in large pot until beef starts to brown. Add onions carrots celery and tomatoes and simmer for about 10 minutes. Drain and rinse beans and add to the pot. Then add beef stock oregano pepper Tabasco spaghetti sauce and pasta. Simmer until celery and carrots are tender - about 45 minutes. Makes about 4 1/2 quarts of soup.

title: Hot Spice Tea
instructions: Combine. To serve mix with hot boiling water. Store in tight jar.

title: Granny'S Potato Soup
