instructions: Cook first five ingredients together. Mix together flour salt and pepper. Make a hole in flour and break 1 egg. Mix together so that mixture looks like pie crust before adding water. These are called rivels. When potatoes are cooked add milk and let come to a full boil. Add rivels and let cook for a few minutes (approximately 5 to 10 minutes).

title: Mocha Pound Cake
instructions: Slice cake horizontally into 3 layers. Place on serving plate. Chop candy into fine pieces reserving 2 tablespoons. Fold remaining candy into whipped topping. Stir in coffee powder. Spread between layers and over and side of cake. Sprinkle with reserved candy.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: Cream the first three ingredients. Add eggs and mix well. Add milk vanilla and pecans. Mix well. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until middle of pie does not shake.

title: Black Forest Parfaits
instructions: Pour milk into small mixer bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat at lowest speed of electric mixer until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Pour half of pudding into individual dessert dishes. Top with 1 cup of the cherries and 1 cup of whipped topping. Spoon remaining pudding over this. Add remainder of cherries and whipped topping. Serves 4.

title: Chocolate Crunch Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Add beaten eggs. Put soda into hot water and add. Add vanilla salt and flour. Beat until mixed. I use electric mixer. Add chips. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Microwave Caramel Corn
instructions: In a 2-quart dish bring brown sugar white corn syrup butter and salt to a boil for 2 minutes. Stir in soda. In brown grocery bag pour mixture over popcorn. Cook 1 1/2 minutes in bag on High. Shake. Cook 1 1/2 minutes on High again. Allow to sit 1 minute. Enjoy.

title: Nachos Ole
instructions: Combine cheese sauce and salsa; pour over chips. Top with green onions tomato pepper and sour cream.

title: Homemade Cottage Cheese
instructions: Place utensil with ingredients in a pan of hot water and heat until curd separates. Dont boil. When mixture gets too hot it becomes tough. Work in salt and cream. Drain.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Pour ingredients in baking casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pork Chops & Potato Bake
instructions: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside. Combine soup milk sour cream pepper and 1/2 tsp. seasoned salt.\tStir in potatoes 1/2 c. cheese and 1/2 can onions.\tSpoon mixture into 9 X 13 inch baking dish. Arrange chops over potatoes. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer.

title: Ham Rolls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ham. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly on one side of each ham slice; roll up and secure with a wooden pick. Cover and chill.

title: Sam'S Baked Chicken
instructions: Put chicken in butter then in crumbs in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and garlic salt. Cook for 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Red Punch
instructions: Dissolve Kool-Aid in a quart of water. Add sugar orange juice and cranapple juice; mix. Add water to make 2 gallons. Be sure to taste for right amount of sugar to suit your own taste! Freeze until slushy.

title: Escalloped Eggplant Au Gratin
instructions: Peel and cube eggplant. Cook in salted water until soft. Drain well; add bread cubes butter eggs salt pepper and all but 1/2 cup of cheese. Sprinkle half the fine bread crumbs over bottom of buttered baking dish. Add eggplant mixture. Cover with remaining bread crumbs and cheese. Cover with lid or foil and bake 30 minutes at 375\u00b0. Remove cover and brown for 5 minutes.

title: Apricot Glazed Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in shallow pan. Mix together all the ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake at 350\u00b0 for one hour. Baste during baking. (I cover with foil at about 40 minutes to keep chicken moist.) Recipe can easily be cut in half.

title: Date Loaf Candy
instructions: Cook sugar and milk until it forms a very firm ball but not hard when dropped in cold water. Add pecans and dates. Stir well and remove from fire. Beat until dates become pulpy. Pour mixture over a wet cloth. Roll and let stand until cool; slice.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Sift flour and soda together. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add buttermilk and blend. Add dry ingredients. If too thick mix with hand. Bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours in tube pan.

title: Easy Goulash
instructions: Brown ground beef in 6-quart saucepan. Season to taste. Add tomatoes onions and macaroni. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes stirring occasionally.

title: Tommy'S S'Mores
instructions: Put 1/2 Hershey bar on graham cracker. Put halved marshmallows (as many that will cover) on top of chocolate. Cover with another graham cracker. Put in a medium oven and heat until slightly melted. Serve immediately.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Microwave butter and cocoa in a 2 1/2-quart glass casserole on High for 2 minutes. Stir in sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Blend in flour salt vanilla and nuts. Pour batter into a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Microwave on High for 10 to 11 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn after 5 minutes. Leave cake in pan. Spread miniature marshmallows over warm cake. Top with Fudge Icing. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Brown beef with onions and bell peppers; drain well. Stir in tomato sauce sugar and spices. Simmer for 15 minutes; stir occasionally. Serve over hot spaghetti noodles.

title: Pam'S Punch
instructions: Combine sugar lemon juice and boiling water. Stir until dissolved; let cool. Then add pineapple juice frozen lemonade and frozen strawberry daiquiri mix. Stir. Freeze in 2-quart Ziploc bags. Before serving thaw until slushy and add 1 bottle of ginger ale per bag of frozen punch.

title: Pauline'S Pecan Pistachio Salad
instructions: Melt oleo in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Combine flour and nuts. Mix in pan with oleo. Pat in bottom of pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool. Cream the cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on crust. Mix pudding and milk; spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with remaining cream cheese and sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate.

title: Refrigerator Pickles(Good - Try It!)
instructions: Mix these ingredients and pour hot syrup over this mixture.

title: Hawaiian Cake
instructions: Mix cake according to directions on box. Bake in a rectangle 13 x 9-inch pan. After cooling cake completely frost as follows mix pudding with milk and beat very little. Beat in cream cheese then fold in Cool Whip. Frost cake with this mixture then top with drained pineapple shredded coconut chopped walnuts and chopped cherries. Refrigerate 1 hour.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown ground chuck and drain fat. Stir in tomato sauce and taco sauce. Spread mixture evenly in casserole dish. Mix corn bread according to package directions then add 1/2 of the French fried onion rings. Spoon corn bread and onion batter over the beef and bake at 425\u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and top with grated cheese and the rest of the onion rings. Put back into hot oven for 2 to 3 minutes to melt the cheese. Serve hot.

title: Raisin Spice Cake
instructions: Boil first 8 ingredients together for 3 minutes and then let cool. After mixture has cooled add 1/4 cup of cold water to which 1 teaspoon baking soda is added. Sift 2 cups of flour 1 teaspoon baking powder together and add to mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Beef Porkiepines
instructions: Mix ground beef rice onion salt and pepper in bowl. Roll into balls brown in skillet without oil. Mix tomato sauce and tomato soup; pour over meatballs; simmer about 30 minutes and serve.

title: Pineapple Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Place pineapple in saucepan. Bring to a boil stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add jello stirring until completely dissolved. Stir in buttermilk coconut and pecans; cool. Fold in Cool Whip and mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish or pan. Chill until firm. Serves 15.

title: Brisket
instructions: In a large pan salt lean side with salts. Add liquid smoke and Worcestershire sauce then flip over and do the same to the fat. Marinate in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 275\u00b0 covered for 5 hours. Bake for 1 hour uncovered. Cover with barbecue sauce; cook at 325\u00b0. Rake off the fat but leave the juices in the pan until completely finished cooking. Yields 8 servings.

title: German Chocolate Frosting
instructions: Cook and stir until thickened all ingredients except coconut and walnuts. When thick add walnuts and coconut.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour baking powder and sugar in a large mixing bowl then blend in milk egg and oil. Cook at 350\u00b0 in electric skillet. Yields 8 pancakes.

title: Pasghetti Pizza
instructions: Break spaghetti into 2-inch pieces. Cook drain and cool. Beat eggs lightly. Stir in milk 1 cup cheese and garlic powder. Add cooked spaghetti and stir together.

title: Toasted Coconut Desert
instructions: Cream flour and butter. Then add chopped pecans. Press into 9 X 13 dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

title: Spritz Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and beat well. Add salt vanilla and flour; mix well. Press through cookie press onto baking sheet. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 8 minutes.

title: Irish Freckle Bread
instructions: Cook potato in 1 cup water until tender. Mash potato and add water to make 1 cup and return to pan. Stir in currants. Cool to lukewarm. Put yeast into 1/2 cup warm water in large bowl. Stir until yeast dissolves. Stir in potato mixture eggs sugar and melted oleo. Stir in 2 cups flour with salt. Turn onto board. Knead until smooth. Place in greased bowl. Let rise 1 hour until double. Punch down. Divide in half. Makes two 8-inch round breads. Let rise again. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Shrimp Gumbo
instructions: Melt butter in Dutch oven. Stir in flour and cook over low heat until brown. Add celery onions and bell pepper. Cook slowly until tender. Add rest of ingredients except shrimp and rice. Simmer uncovered 45 minutes. Add shrimp cover and simmer about 7 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender. Serve over hot rice. Makes 8 servings.

title: Annie'S Pizza Bites
instructions: On a 9 by 13-inch cookie sheet roll out 1 can pizza dough to edges of cookie sheet. Spread pizza sauce evenly over crust leaving 1/2-inch space around the edges of the crust. Sprinkle pepperoni and cheese evenly over sauce. Roll out remaining can of dough into a 9 by 13-inch rectangle. Carefully place this on top. With a pizza cutter score into 16 rectangles. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine pretzels butter and 6 tablespoons sugar and spread in a 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 glass dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 250\u00b0 or until browned. Cool completely.

title: Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Separate cauliflower and chop up lettuce. Pour bacon bits on top of salad. Mix rest of ingredients and use as dressing for salad. Serves 12.

title: Unbelievable Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Combine peanut butter egg and sugar and mix well. Shape into small balls and flatten with fork. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Orange Jello Salad
instructions: Drain fruit. Mix in cheese and Cool Whip. Add jello (dry) then marshmallows and mix well. Let set in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours until firm.

title: No Cook Do-Dads
instructions: Boil sugar and Karo syrup together one minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and Special K; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Re-shape and cool.

title: Ham Sandwiches Au Gratin
instructions: Spread toast with 3 tablespoons butter then with deviled ham and cover with a second slice of toast. Melt remaining butter blend in flour sugar salt and pepper. Add milk and cook until thickened stirring constantly. Add chopped eggs green pepper and cheese if desired. Pour over toast. Serves 4.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
instructions: Cream together well butter cheese and sugar. Add eggs one at a time beat after each. Fold in flour. Add vanilla. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

title: Shrimp And Salmon Casserole
instructions: Saute pepper celery and onion in 1 stick butter. Mix with salmon rice cheese mushroom soup and mushrooms. Put in casserole. Mix shrimp soup and shrimp. Pour on top. Top with bread crumbs. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 20 minutes at 375\u00b0. This freezes well.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie
instructions: Bake pie shell at 425\u00b0 until shell begins to brown. Combine butter brown sugar pecans and coconut in saucepan. Heat until butter and sugar are melted stirring occasionally. Spread in bottom of hot pie shell. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until bubbly; cool. Combine pie filling mix chocolate and milk in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full bubbling boil. Cool 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Pour over coconut mixture in shell. Cover surface with plastic wrap. Chill at least 4 hours. Before serving remove plastic wrap and garnish with whipped topping and sprinkle with additional coconut if desired.

title: Snappy Barbecue Beef Sandwiches
instructions: Cut all the fat you can off of the roast. Place beef in Dutch oven. Combine all remaining ingredients; pour over beef. Cover and bake at 350\u00b0 for 5 hours turning beef occasionally. Shred beef with a fork removing any fat. Serve on rolls or buns. Yields about 24 servings.

title: Carrots Diane
instructions: Cut carrots into bite size pieces. Boil until tender to your taste. Drain. Place butter in skillet. Add carrots to butter. Add Dijon mustard and brown sugar. Stir until well coated. Serve hot. Garnish with parsley.

title: Nancy'S Dipped Chicken
instructions: Simmer for 15 minutes then dip chicken in sauce and cook on grill brushing frequently with more sauce.

title: Lisa'S Chicken Spaghetti
instructions: Boil chicken in salt water. When chicken is done remove from but save broth. Shred chicken and set aside. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth and cook 10 minutes until done drain both. Return pot with spaghetti to stove put over low heat. Add chicken soup Rotel and cheese. Season with salt pepper and garlic salt. When cheese is melted dinner is done!

title: Hot Cranberry-Apple Casserole
instructions: Put apples in casserole. Add cranberries; sprinkle white sugar over cranberries. Mix flour brown sugar oatmeal and then add melted butter. Mix with nuts. Spread over top of casserole. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. (If Jonathan apples are used add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to apples.) If canned whole cranberries are used cook apples before adding rest of ingredients.

title: No Bake Cheese Cake
instructions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Add vanilla and sour cream. Add Cool Whip and just a squeeze of lemon. Mix together. Pour into pie shell and let sit in refrigerator. Best if left overnight. Before serving add fruit of any kind.

title: Roundup Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; drain grease. Combine all ingredients. Bake in a large casserole at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Spaghetti Corn
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and put in a buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes with the cover on and 30 more minutes with the cover off. Cover with aluminum foil.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pound and cut chicken into serving pieces. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Lightly beat egg and milk. Combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour sauce to cover baking dish; set aside. Dip chicken in egg mixture then in bread crumbs. Melt Crisco in a skillet; brown chicken on both sides. Place chicken in baking dish. Place sliced cheese on top of chicken or sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Pour remaining sauce on top of chicken. Cover baking dish with foil. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chicken Liver Stroganoff
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Set aside. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Dredge livers in 2 tablespoons flour and seasonings. Add livers to skillet and brown. Sprinkle livers with any remaining flour mixture and add bacon and mushrooms. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes. Remove to a serving platter. Blend 1 tablespoon flour sour cream and 1/4 cup water and stir into pan drippings. Stir and cook until thick. Pour over livers. Serve with parsleyed noodles mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Lemon Walnut Tea Bread
instructions: Lemon Icing Stir 1 cup powdered sugar and 4 to 5 teaspoons lemon juice together until smooth and thick but pourable.

title: Cora'S Coconut Cream Pie
instructions: Mix well and press in large square or oblong dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken
instructions: Mix chicken cream of chicken and sour cream together; set aside. Melt butter and pour over cracker crumbs. Add poppy seed and mix together. Pour 1/2 cracker mixture into casserole dish then chicken mixture. Top with last half of cracker mixture. Cook for 45 minutes to 1 hour uncovered at 350\u00b0.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a saucepan combine soup milk cheese garlic and pepper. Add broccoli and carrots. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and cook for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add spaghetti and heat through.

title: Turkey Corn Chowder
instructions: In a 6-quart saucepan saute onions pepper celery slices and turkey in butter. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves six to eight.

title: Caramel Pound Cake
instructions: Cream butter and Crisco well until creamy. Add sugar and eggs one at a time beating well. Add flour with baking powder and salt sifted together. Add vanilla and evaporated milk then nuts. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300\u00b0.

title: Grandma Bounds Syrup Cookies
instructions: Beat soda into syrup until white. Add rest of ingredients. Add flour until dough is stiff. Roll and cut or pinch off small ball and press down. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Beat well. Bake in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Oyster Casserole
instructions: Drain oysters saving 1/2 cup of liquor. Mix liquor with 1/2 cup of milk; melt butter or margarine and mix with the cracker crumbs. Spread a layer of buttered crumbs in a casserole. Add 1/4 of oysters salt and pepper to taste. Pour a little of the liquor/milk mixture over the oysters and sprinkle on more crumbs. Repeat until out of oysters. Top with buttered crumbs and pour on remaining liquor. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Miraculous Microwave Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cut out a circle of wax paper to fit bottom of 8-inch round plastic or glass pan 1 1/2-inch deep. (I use square pan.) Cut another to make a collar to line sides to come up 1-inch higher.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Stew chicken with seasonings added. Remove bones and dice chicken. Melt butter in skillet or large Corning Ware casserole dish; stir in flour. Add broth and milk; cook over medium heat stirring constantly until medium sauce is made. Place chicken and vegetables in casserole. Salt and pepper if desired and mix well. Cover with latticed pir crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until golden brown and mixture is bubbly. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Mix sour cream cream cheese and 1/2 taco seasoning until smooth. Spread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate until set. Fry ground beef and drain off excess fat. Mix meat 1 cup water and 1/2 of taco seasoning and bring to boil. Let this simmer and then cool. Place meat mixture over cream cheese mixture. Layer on lettuce tomato cheese onion olives green pepper taco sauce and salsa.

title: Applesauce Cookies
instructions: In large bowl combine all ingredients; beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 1 minute. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Yield 6 dozen.

title: Oatmeal Peach Crumble
instructions: Arrange peaches in oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with the lemon juice and cinnamon. Dot with margarine.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased baking dish. Cover with topping.

title: Chocolate Lover'S Frosting
instructions: In a large bowl combine 1 cup confectioners sugar cocoa butter 2 measuring tablespoons milk and vanilla extract; beat until creamy. Gradually add remaining confectioners sugar alternately with milk. Beat until smooth. Fills and frosts one 8-inch layer cake.

title: Breakfast Casserole
instructions: Place bread in a buttered casserole dish. Put cooked sausage on top. Mix egg and sour cream together and layer with cheese. Bake at 350 degrees until brown (approx. 30 to 40 minutes).

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: Place a layer of 1/3 of the potatoes in a buttered 2-quart casserole; cover with 1/2 of the onion slices. Combine flour salt and pepper; sprinkle 1/2 the mixture over the onion layer; dot with 1/2 the butter. Repeat layers ending with a potato layer. Pour hot milk over all and dust lightly with paprika. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for about 1 1/4 hours or until potatoes are very tender and milk is nearly all absorbed. Makes 8 servings.

title: Banana Cake
instructions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Sift together sugar soda flour and salt. Add to first mixture and beat. Then add the mashed bananas and fold in 2 stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake about 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Cornbread Mix
instructions: Sift and measure cornmeal and flour. Add baking powder salt and sugar to cornmeal mixture and sift together. Cut in the shortening until it is fine grained. Store in a cool place. If you use buttermilk add 2 teaspoons soda to this recipe and use only half as much of the baking powder. If you want to cook the cornbread in a waffle iron use 1 cup of the shortening instead of 1/2 cup. To use add 1 egg and 1/2 cup of milk for each cup of the mix. Stir in the small mixing bowl until well blended. Pour into well-greased muffin tins or a 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Hominygroves, Texas
instructions: Fry bacon to a crisp. Remove back from skillet and add sliced onions and chopped green pepper to hot bacon grease. Cook 20 minutes. Add tomatoes flour and mix with a little water and all the seasonings. Cover and cook slowly one to two hours. Add hominy and let simmer 10 minutes or longer. Just before serving add the grated cheese and bacon broken up.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Mix and set aside in 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare topping and pour over chicken mixture.

title: Cherry Sauce
instructions: Mix chopped apple jelly and preserves in medium saucepan. Mix cider vinegar and cornstarch; stir into pan. Heat to boiling stirring constantly until thickened about 1 minute. Great over ham.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Toss ingredients. Serve chilled.

title: Mulled Cider
instructions: Mix the ingredients in a saucepan. Boil for 15 minutes. Add 3/8 cup brown sugar. Simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Easy Pizza Appetizers
instructions: Brown ground beef and sausage in skillet stirring until crumbly. Drain then add next 4 ingredients stirring until cheese is melted. Spread on bread. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Oyster Corn Bread Dressing
instructions: Chop oysters and combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir in enough broth until mixture is very moist. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish (or pan). Bake uncovered at 400\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

title: Bread And Butter Pickles
instructions: Wash and slice (do not peel) 6 quarts cucumbers. Soak 10 hours in canning salt and 9 cups of water. Drain.

title: Opal'S Bread
instructions: Put yeast in warm water. Do not stir; set aside and let rise or work. Mix eggs salt sugar Crisco warm milk and bread flour. Add yeast mixture and let rise in bowl. Knead and poke down and knead again. Form into 3 loaves. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix ingredients together and make bite size balls. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until golden brown.

title: German Cornbread
instructions: Melt a little grease in heavy iron skillet. Let it get hot then pour batter in. Bake at 400\u00b0 until knife inserted in center comes out clean. This will take about 25 to 30 minutes. Keeping in refrigerator will keep it moist. Good for holiday season.

title: Hot Pasta Salad Vinaigrette
instructions: In large skillet over medium-high heat heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil. Add celery onion and garlic. Cook about 10 minutes stirring frequently. Meanwhile cook shells in boiling water according to package directions. When vegetables are ready add 1/4 cup olive oil vinegar sugar mustard oregano and basil. Bring to boil stirring until blended. Remove from heat. Drain shells. Mix all ingredients together. Serve immediately sprinkled with Parmesan cheese. Makes 2 to 3 main dishes or 4 to 6 side dish servings.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: Mix ingredients. Cover 20 minutes. Roll on floured surface. Cut out rolls. Makes about 65 rolls. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Mix sugar and flour place pineapple in dish. Sprinkle sugar and flour mixture over pineapple put cheese on mixture. Pour 1/3 cup pineapple juice over it. Make a topping of crackers and Margarine and put on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

title: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Cook together mushrooms onion pepper and sausage; drain off grease. Add cubed cheese to meat mixture to melt; add noodles and rest of ingredients together. Pour in 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. You may not want this much cheese; if not cut down on the amount.

title: Apple Pie(All American)
instructions: If apples arent juicy add a little water. Bake in a 425\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes then at 375\u00b0 for 10 minutes and finally at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Guest Pie
instructions: Stir together until well mixed. Put lemon juice in last. Pour into 1 large oblong pan or 2 (9-inch) pans with a graham or vanilla wafer pie crust.

title: Salad Dressing Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients in order given. Makes a lovely moist chocolate cake. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Tuscan Bean And Cabbage Soup
instructions: Melt butter with oil in heavy large pot over medium heat. Add onion celery and garlic and cook 5 minutes stirring frequently. Add cabbage and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add stock tomatoes beans ham bone basil or pesto salt and pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes stirring occasionally. Taste and adjust seasoning. Discard bone. Can be prepared 1 day ahead. Cool cover and refrigerate. Bring soup to simmer before continuing. Makes 8 servings.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Saut onion in butter until limp. Mix chicken chilies and chicken soup. Remove from heat. Place 2 tablespoons of chicken mixture in middle of tortillas and roll. Lay rolled side down on buttered baking dish.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken(Low-Fat)
instructions: Remove skin from chicken and brush each piece with vegetable oil. Dredge lightly in flour or bread crumbs. Season with pepper and paprika. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn and bake an additional 10 to 25 minutes until tender.

title: Sara'S Chicken And Rice Soup
instructions: In a pot add chicken water onion bay leaf parsley and celery tops. Cook until tender. Strain. Add all other ingredients and simmer.

title: Cranberry Mousse
instructions: Heat juice to boiling. Stir in jello until dissolved. Add cranberry sauce. Chill until partially set. Add Cool Whip. Chill until firm. Top with Cool Whip.

title: Wagon Wheel Dip
instructions: In large mixing bowl place mayonnaise and blend with salt pepper and paprika. Put pickles olives onion green pepper and garlic through food chopper; chop fine. Drain. Add to mayonnaise. Add cheese and remaining ingredients; blend thoroughly. Store overnight in refrigerator. Serve with Melba toast crackers or chips.

title: Finger Cucumber Sandwiches
instructions: Slice cucumber very thin salt down and let stand 1/2 hour. Squeeze out the juice. Add lemon finely cut onion and a little thick cream. Spread between sandwich bread. Cut into finger shapes.

title: Old Faith Sugar-Cream Pie
instructions: In mixing bowl stir together the sugar and the flour. Add the whipping cream. Lightly cream vanilla and teaspoon salt. Beat with mixer for about 6 minutes or until fluffy and thickened. Cover and let the cream mixture stand for 1 hour in the refrigerator. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell. Bake in 415\u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce to 375\u00b0 and bake pie for about 20 minutes or until filling doesnt jiggle. Cool. Store in refrigerator.

title: The Best Date-Nut Bread(Two Bowls)
instructions: Add dash of salt to flour. Mix together all ingredients with fingers until mealy and set aside.

title: Grits Casserole
instructions: Bring tomatoes to boil. Add grits; cover and set aside. Brown ground beef and chopped onion; drain. Add to tomatoes. Add vegies beans and cheese. Pour into casserole; top with French fried onions. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Overtime Apple Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325\u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. In large bowl sift flour (or mix well) with sugar soda cinnamon salt and nutmeg. Add apples nuts 1/2 cup margarine or butter and eggs.

title: Noodles
instructions: Roll out thin. Cut and dry on table or countertop. Drop into boiling broth (chicken or turkey). Cook about 10 minutes.

title: Zito Pie
instructions: Whip cheese vanilla and sugar together. Fold in Cool Whip and divide into two pie shells. Top with pie mix. Refrigerate.

title: Seven-Up Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and beat until creamy. Put in four 9-inch cake pans that have been well-greased. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes or until cake leaves side of pan.

title: Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Brown pork in heavy skillet. Remove and place in oblong baking dish. Add 1/2 cup water to skillet and onions mushroom and celery. Saute until tender. Mix 1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon flour add to vegetables. Stir until thickened. Pour veggies over meat cover and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until fork-tender. Serves 5 to 6. Serve with rice.

title: Betty Gilchrist'S Swedish Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into balls and brown then simmer in diluted tomato soup until done.

title: Icebox Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour soda baking powder salt and cinnamon. Cream butter sugars eggs and nuts. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture; mix well. Put in rolls and put in refrigerator until chilled. Cut in slices and bake at 350\u00b0 on ungreased cookie sheet.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix all ingredients except tortillas. Spread on the 5 tortillas. Roll up and wrap in Saran Wrap. Refrigerate several hours. To serve cut into slices 3/4 to 1-inch. Serve with salsa.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream margarine and sugar thoroughly. Blend in bananas eggs and vanilla. Sift flour soda and salt together. Add to banana mixture alternating with milk. Mix thoroughly after each addition. Add nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until cake tester comes out clean. Makes 2 small loaves. Very good for the holidays!

title: Cabbage And Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage and cauliflower until tender add onions and stir. Drain the liquid from the cooked mixture. Butter and salt to taste. Pour into a well-greased casserole dish. Layer with cream of celery soup next layer of Cheddar cheese then top with crushed potato chips or saltine crackers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Marinated Flank Steak
instructions: Marinate steak overnight. Barbecue on a grill and baste often while turning. Cook according to taste. Cut meat on the diagonal.

title: Pumpkin Dessert
instructions: Mix crackers margarine and sugar. Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pumpkin milk pie spice and instant pudding until smooth. Spread over cracker crust. Spread Cool Whip over top of pudding. Top with crushed nuts. This is good easy and no cooking required.

title: Devon Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Refrigerate. Tasty as raw vegetable dip.

title: Cheese Squares
instructions: Beat together cheese and butter; add flour salt pepper and raisins. Roll in wax paper and chill overnight. Slice and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Summer Sausage
instructions: Mix all ingredients well. Form into roll and wrap in aluminum foil. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour then turn oven to 450\u00b0 for 15 more minutes.

title: It Don'T Matter(15 Minute Dish)
instructions: Brown the ground beef and drain. Cook noodles as directed on package. Combine noodles and beef with cream of mushroom. Heat over stove then serve.

title: Appetillas
instructions: Combine all ingredients except tortillas. Spread over top of tortillas. Roll tightly wrap in plastic wrap refrigerate overnight. Cut into 3/4 inch slices. Yields 64 .

title: Gooey Cake Squares
instructions: Melt butter. Add eggs and beat well. Add sugar flour and nuts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while still warm.

title: Jimmy Dean Beans
instructions: Brown sausage; drain. Add other ingredients slow bake about 2 hours.

title: Lemon Lush
instructions: Mix flour 1 tablespoon of sugar and melted butter together and spread into long baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup of pecans over and press down forming crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 until lightly browned. Cool completely.

title: Oriental Seasoning
instructions: In jar with screw-top lid combine soy sauce molasses ginger mustard garlic powder and onion powder. Shake to mix. Store covered in refrigerator for up to six weeks. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions: Split each chicken wing at joint and discard tip. Place in a shallow baking pan. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Melt margarine and toss with dressing mix. Mix half of the dressing mixture with squash soup sour cream onion carrots and pepper. Turn mixture into lightly-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; spread evenly. Sprinkle remaining dressing mixture over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Pineapple Casserole
instructions: Put bread crumbs in long cake pan and pour pineapple over it. Combine the eggs sugar and melted butter or oleo and pour over mixture in pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Low-Fat Banana Bread
instructions: Stir together the flour soda and salt. In a separate bowl mix applesauce and sugar until smooth (can use mixer). Add eggs and bananas. Beat until well mixed.

title: Dijon Chicken
instructions: Saute chicken 2 minutes on each side in skillet. Add remaining ingredients that have been mixed together. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes stirring until chicken is tender. Serves 5 175 calories per serving.

title: Crisped Dill Beans
instructions: Stem beans and pack uniformly and tightly in hot jars. To each jar add 1/4 teaspoon pepper flakes (more if you like it hotter) 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill. Heat together water salt and vinegar. Bring to a boil. Pour over beans. Adjust lids at once. Process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes. Remove jars from canner and allow to cool. Chill well before serving. Enjoy.

title: Dad'S Corn Muffins
instructions: Grease muffin cups. Mix egg and milk together. Add to flour corn meal sugar baking powder and salt. Mix together. Add the melted shortening. Mix until moist. Fill muffin cups 3/4 of the way. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Bread(Yeast)
instructions: Scald poppy seeds with hot water to cover good. Set a few hours or overnight. Grind then add sugar eggs vanilla and cinnamon. Or can also add 1/4 to 1/2 cup cream and cook till bubbles in heavy kettle that doesnt scorch easy stir all the while.

title: Nolte'S Serious Beans
instructions: Start with skillet. Brown the bacon; drain and reserve. Brown the Polish sausage; set aside. Saute the chopped onion in the remaining bacon fat. Open the kidney beans butter beans and lima beans; drain in colander. Combine the remaining ingredients except bacon fat with above ingredients. Mix all above ingredients together with the bacon fat. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature. Better the second day. (I usually double recipe.)

title: Potato Pancakes
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients. Stir until smooth. Stir in potatoes and onion. Add butter. Use lightly greased griddle. Bake to golden brown turning once. Serve with applesauce. (Potatoes may be precooked in microwave for 2 minutes before grating.)

title: Peanut Butter Balls
instructions: Mix this well and form into small balls. Melt semi-sweet chocolate chips and paraffin in top of double boiler or melt chocolate bark and dip balls in either one. Place covered balls on waxed paper to set.

title: Rocky Road
instructions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over warm water on low heat. Stir until smooth. Spread half the chocolate in foil-lined 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 the walnuts and all the raisins; cover with marshmallows. Drizzle remaining chocolate over top; press remaining walnuts into chocolate. Chill until firm. Remove from pan; peel off foil. Cut in 24 squares. Wrap; store in refrigerator.

title: Crabmeat Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Saute celery green pepper and onion in butter. Remove from heat. Add Worcestershire pepper mushrooms half and half and mayo. Combine sauce with cooked rice crabmeat and shrimp. Bake in shallow dish uncovered in a 375\u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.

title: Thumbprint Cookies
instructions: Mix thoroughly the shortening butter brown sugar egg yolk and vanilla. Sift together and stir in the flour and salt. Roll into 1-inch balls. Dip in slightly beaten egg whites. Roll in the nuts. Place about 1-inch apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a 375\u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Quickly press thumb gently on top of each cookie. Return to oven and bake 8 minutes longer. Cool. Place a bit of chopped candied fruit sparkling jelly or tinted confectioners sugar icing in thumbprints. Makes about 2 dozen 1 1/2-inch cookies.

title: Junior'S Cake
instructions: Mix together. Pour in greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Leave cake in pan. Melt together 2 sticks margarine and 1 cup sugar and pour over cake. Serve cake in the pan.

title: 9 Day Slaw
instructions: Mix cabbage onions and green pepper. Add sugar. Mix good and refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Thyme Jelly
instructions: Make infusion of thyme and water. Strain and add enough water to make one half cup. Combine with juices and honey in large saucepan. Bring to full rolling boil and add pectin stirring constantly. Boil hard 30 seconds and give sheet test for jellying point. Remove from heat and skim. Pour into hot sterilized glasses and seal. A very pretty jelly to highlight venison game poultry and cheese dishes.

title: Apple Fluff Pie
instructions: Combine applesauce lemon juice salt flour and well beaten egg yolks. Cook over hot water until thick and smooth. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan. Bake at 425\u00b0 until crust is brown and filling is firm.

title: Tuna Layered Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce macaroni cucumber tomatoes tuna peas and cheese in a 3-quart serving bowl. Spread Miracle Whip over salad sealing to edge of bowl. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Toss to serve. Makes 8 servings.

title: Famous Dill Dip
instructions: In a large bowl combine all ingredients. Refrigerate until cold.

title: Pretzel Jello Salad
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo. Mix with pretzels and press into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Cream together sugar and shortening. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla and mix. Sift together flour salt baking powder and cocoa. Gradually beat into creamed mixture. Last stir in marshmallows by hand. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crusty Baked Chicken
instructions: Wash chicken. Trim off excess fat. Pat dry. Set aside. In a bowl beat egg and milk. In another bowl combine potato flakes garlic salt paprika and poultry seasoning. Blend in cheese. Dip chicken in egg mixture. Then roll them in potato flake mixture to coat evenly on all sides. Place chicken in baking dish or pan. Sprinkle with melted butter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 35 minutes turning chicken once. Increase oven temperature to 425\u00b0. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear when pierced with fork.

title: Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: In a large bowl mix flour and shortening by hand (or you may use a cutter) until the mixture is crumbly. Add milk. Mix well to form a ball of dough. Pinch off pieces of dough and form biscuits in your hand. Press biscuits onto lightly greased cookie sheet or baking pan. \Pat\ top of each biscuit so that dough will not be too thick. Bake in 450\u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. \Brown\ tops.

title: Cod Or Haddock Baked
instructions: Combine tomatoes onion and parsley (set aside). Combine vinegar oil garlic pepper and salt (set aside). In casserole place a layer of tomato mixture then layer of fish and the layer of oil mixture. Repeat. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Melt butter in casserole dish. Add rice and stir. Add beef consomme and onion soup. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour covered. If desired add mushrooms or green pepper or sausage.

title: Sixty Minute Rolls
instructions: Insert dough hooks into mixer. Thoroughly mix 1 1/2 cups flour sugar salt and undissolved yeast. Combine milk water and margarine into saucepan and heat over low heat until liquids are warm; margarine doesnt have to melt. Gradually add to dry ingredients. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Scrape bowl occasionally. Add 1/2 cup of flour to make thick batter form into ball. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover; place bowl over pan of warm water. Let stand 15 minutes. Roll out. Cut out and place in pan. Let rise. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes.

title: Energy Drink
instructions: Mix and chill. Drain 1/2 to 3/4 cup every morning.

title: Baked Mostaccioli
instructions: Cook mostaccioli noodles according to directions. While this is cooking saute turkey Italian sausage and onions until browned. After mostacciolis are cooked drain thoroughly.

title: Jeff'S Cheesecake
instructions: Crush graham crackers. Mix in sugar and toss with melted margarine. Press into 13 x 9-inch buttered pan. Bake 10 minutes at 325\u00b0. Cool. In a small bowl mix jello with 1 cup boiling water. Put in refrigerator until it looks like egg whites.

title: Pie Crust
instructions: Mix well. Roll out to fit pie pan.

title: Refrigerator Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; set aside. Pour hot water over sugar Crisco and salt. Cool to lukewarm then add 1/2 cup flour. Add dissolved yeast egg and half of remaining flour. Beat thoroughly. Add enough flour to form soft ball of dough. Turn out on lightly floured board and let rest 5 to 10 minutes. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl turning to grease top. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Punch down grease top and cover with a damp cloth and refrigerate. When ready to bake shape into rolls and place in greased pan. Let rise until double. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 24 rolls.

title: Chicken-Potato Casserole
instructions: Just mix everything together. Sprinkle some Cheddar cheese across the top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Potato Dish
instructions: Saute onion and bacon together. Grate the peeled potatoes and rinse them with cold water. Drain. Combine the onions bacon garlic parsley cheese and pepper. Mix in with potatoes. Spread in a shallow pan (9 x13-inch). In a separate bowl whisk eggs and cream. Add salt to eggs and cream mixture. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes until top is brown. Serves 8.

title: Spicy Garden Salad
instructions: Chunk the tomatoes and cucumbers. Dice the white onion bell peppers and jalapeno peppers. Thoroughly mix all ingredients and place in a large bowl with a lid. Pour the 2 cups of Italian dressing over the mixture and stir. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: Place apples in deep baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice sugar and cinnamon. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over apples. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until apples are tender.

title: Lazy-Day Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling salt water. Drain. Combine oregano with spaghetti sauce. In greased 10 x 6 x 1/2 inch baking dish alternate layers of noodles cottage cheese Mozzarella and sauce using sauce for top layer. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Gumdrop Cake
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Sift flour salt and baking powder. Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture to mix with raisins and gumdrops. Add vanilla to milk. Add flour mixture alternately with milk to the first mixture. Add floured gumdrops raisins and nuts. Bake in large greased loaf pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Keeps well.

title: Christmas Green Rice
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Cook broccoli in 1 cup water for 5 minutes drain. Saute vegetables in 1/2 stick margarine and mix with broccoli and rice. Combine soup and milk. Pour over rice and vegetable mixture. Add cheese and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cafe Bread Pudding
instructions: Combine eggs milk sugar raisins in a large bowl. Blend in pieces of bread rolls or doughnuts. Pour mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

title: Pork Chops In Foil
instructions: Mix wine rosemary and thyme together; set aside. Take 4 pieces of foil large enough to enclose chop loosely. Place 1 tablespoon of butter on dull side of foil in center. Place chop on it cover with 1/4 of mushrooms. Fold up sides to make an unleakable pouch; pour in 1/4 cup wine mixture then fold over foil so that there is an airspace but so its sealed tightly. Repeat with other chops.

title: Stuffed Chicken Rolls
instructions: Flatten chicken to 1/8-inch thickness. Place ham and cheese on each breast. Roll up and tuck in ends. Secure with a toothpick. Combine the flour Parmesan cheese sage paprika and pepper. Coat chicken on all sides. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. In a large skillet brown chicken in oil over medium-high heat. Transfer to a 5-quart slow cooker. Combine soup and broth. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours. Remove toothpicks. Garnish with parsley if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Sausage Quiche
instructions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover bottom with bread crumbs. In skillet cook crumbled sausage and drain. Cover bread with sausage and cheese. In a bowl beat eggs dry mustard pepper and salt. Pour over sausage. Cover with aluminum foil (leave on for 1/2 baking time). Refrigerate overnight.

title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
instructions: Sift together flour salt and powder; add soda and milk. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Alternate additions of milk mixture and flour; add vanilla. Chill. Roll out and cut out. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

title: Lasagna Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and onion. Set aside. Bring to a boil the salt pepper sugar garlic powder tomato sauce tomato paste and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes; set aside. Soften cream cheese and sour cream together. Set aside. Cook noodles. Put 1 cup of the tomato sauce mixture and 1 cup hamburger on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add 1/2 cream cheese mixture then 1/2 noodles on top of that and 1/2 of the cheese then repeat the layers. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes or if baking cold bake for 40 minutes.

title: Tuna Bake Italiano
instructions: Combine macaroni tuna tomato sauce Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning in a medium size bowl. In a 1 cup measure combine instant chicken broth and boiling water; stir into tuna mixture. Spoon mixture into a 6 cup baking dish. Top with slices of Mozzarella. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot and cheese is melted.

title: Baked Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: In a large saucepan combine evaporated milk and water. Add cooked rice and cook over low heat about 25 minutes. Add sugar and vanilla. Combine a little rice mixture with beaten eggs then blend all well back into pudding. Cook two to three minutes. Pour pudding into buttered 2-quart casserole and sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon. Place casserole in pan of hot water then bake at 350\u00b0 about 45 minutes or until a knife inserted near the edge comes out clean. When cool the pudding may be served with whipped cream.

title: Chicken Crescent Squares
instructions: Blend together cream cheese butter and milk. Add salt pepper chives pimento and chicken. Separate crescent rolls into 4 squares. Spoon 1/2 cup of chicken mixture into the middle of each square. Pull 4 corners to the top and seal. Brush tops with melted butter and roll in crushed croutons. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

title: Cheesy Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Mix all ingredients including just 2 cups of cheese and excluding the tortillas. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the mixture into each tortilla and add a little extra cheese. Roll and place seam side down in a baking dish. Pour the remainder of the mixture over the filled tortillas and sprinkle more cheese on top.\tBake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Foolproof Pie Crust
instructions: With fork mix together first four ingredients. In separate dish beat remaining ingredients; combine the two mixtures stirring with fork until all ingredients are moistened. With hands mold dough into a ball. Chill at least 15 minutes before rolling. Dough can be left in refrigerator up to two weeks or can be frozen. Makes five 9-inch shells.

title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
instructions: In large bowl stir eggs corn syrup chocolate sugar butter and vanilla until blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted halfway between center and sides comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Serves 8.

title: Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix thoroughly applesauce brown sugar and shortening. Set aside. In separate bowl mix all dry ingredients. Add raisins and nuts. Add applesauce mixture. Bake 40 minutes at 350\u00b0 in a 9-inch pan.

title: Citrus Berry Cream Punch
instructions: Puree strawberries. In large punch bowl combine puree and nectar. Before serving top with scoops of ice cream. Add ginger ale. Garnish as desired. Serves 20.

title: Southern Pie
instructions: Mix cereal eggs and warm water and set aside. Mix all together and pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake for 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Tastes like pecans.

title: Festive Florentine Crescents
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Mix together spinach Cheddar cheese crumbs and bacon in saucepan. Stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Unroll dough; separate into 16 triangles. Cut each in half lengthwise forming 32 triangles. Spread each triangle with rounded teaspoonfuls spinach mixture. Roll up starting at wide end. Place on greased cookie sheet. Brush dough with beaten egg if desired. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Baked Moist Pork Chops
instructions: Use casserole dish with cover and large enough to accommodate chops. Place halved apples skin-peel side down enough to cover bottom of dish. Salt and pepper chops. Arrange over apples. Place onion slices over chops. Cover.

title: Chicken Casserole
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients and put in a buttered square casserole. Sprinkle top with corn flake crumbs. Pour melted butter over top. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Southern Salad
instructions: Beat the cream cheese until its fluffy. Add the milk a little at a time beating well between additions. Stir in the pie filling pineapple and pecans. Fold in the Cool Whip. Top with additional nuts and chill.

title: Potato-Cheese Casserole
instructions: Put hash browns in buttered large casserole dish. Mix soups with 1/2 pound grated cheese and sour cream. Layer over potatoes. Top with remaining 1/2 pound grated cheese. Bake covered at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Coconut Bars
instructions: Bottom layer Mix together and press in small square dish 1/2 cup butter 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 cup flour. Bake 10 minutes in 350 degree oven. Mix remaining ingredients together. Put this mixture on top of the bottom layer and bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares.

title: Mac And Cheese
instructions: Drain cooked macaroni; add 2 tablespoons butter. Mix. Put in 9 x 11 baking dish. In saucepan mix all other ingredients; heat until cheeses are all melted. Pour over macaroni. Top with Velveeta slices and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. I like my cheese a little on the brown side.

title: Low Calorie Milkshake
instructions: Put into a blender and mix until thick.

title: Eggnog(1 Glass)
instructions: Beat egg with electric beaters. Add sugar; beat again and add milk and vanilla. Beat thoroughly. Pour into tall glasses and sprinkle top with nutmeg.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: In a large bowl beat the cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill for 2 hours.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Thaw and drain broccoli. Add onion. Beat eggs. Mix all ingredients together. Put in well-greased 9 x 12-inch pan or skillet. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Mema'S 24 Hour Salad
instructions: Combine egg yolks sugar pineapple syrup salt vinegar and butter in a saucepan. Cook on medium heat until thick. Fold remaining ingredients into the bowl and chill for 24 hours.

title: Layer Lettuce Salad
instructions: Layer lettuce celery pepper and peas in large glass salad bowl. Spread mayonnaise on top covering completely to edges. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours. Sprinkle with bacon before serving.

title: Cornflaked Potatoes
instructions: Roll potatoes in serving size balls. Coat with diluted egg. Roll in crumbs. When ready to bake place on greased sheet. Bake at 375\u00b0 about 20 minutes.

title: Walnut - Raisin Cookies
instructions: Cream butter brown sugar egg and vanilla in mixer until light and fluffy. In separate bowl mix flour baking powder and salt. At low speed gradually add flour mixture to first mixture. Stir in raisins and walnuts. Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

title: California Strawberry Fruit Salad
instructions: Arrange fruit in sections on platter lined with salad greens. Serve with Lime Sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Double Apple Cake
instructions: Cream butter with sugar. Beat in 2 eggs. Add apples and vanilla. In a large bowl mix flour with cinnamon and baking soda. Mix the 2 mixtures. Core 2 to 3 apples; cut into thin wedges. Arrange some wedges on sides of well-greased 9-inch round 1 1/2-inch deep cake pan. Spoon in batter level. Arrange remaining wedges on top. Drizzle 2 tablespoons butter over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes. Glaze apple topping with 1/4 cup melted currant jelly.

title: Oniony Meat Loaf For 2
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine ingredients. In a shallow baking pan shape into loaf. Bake for 40 minutes or until done.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli in salted water for 5 minutes. Beat egg and add soup mayonnaise cheese and onion. Mix well. Add broccoli and place in ungreased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and add pats of butter. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

title: Corn Pudding
instructions: Mix together. Bake in a 325\u00b0 oven for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until set.

title: Drop Donut Holes
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar salt oil extract and nutmeg. Mix well. Mix flour and powder. Add alternately with milk to egg mixture. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon into deep hot fat and fry 2 1/2 minutes until brown. Donuts will rise to surface so keep them submerged to assure even cooking. Drain on paper towels. Shake with sugar in brown bag. Makes 50.

title: Shish Kabobs
instructions: Cut meat into cubes. Combine garlic salt pepper mustard chili powder onion vinegar catsup and oil in small bowl. Place cubes of meat in plastic bag and pour combined ingredients over meat. Close bag and turn bag so meat is completely covered. Refrigerate overnight. Pierce onions with ice pick several times to prevent them from falling apart when you add them to boiling water for 10 minutes. Add green pepper to same boiling water for 5 minutes stirring meat and vegetables on skewers alternately.

title: Tortilla Rolls(Servings:  6)
instructions: Slice all vegetables lengthwise in thin strips. Marinate in Herb Oil (save teaspoon for mayonnaise) for at least two hours. Season with salt and pepper to taste and grill lightly. Warm tortillas; spread with jalapeno mayonnaise. Spread grilled vegetables on tortillas evenly. Roll tortillas tightly; trim ends and cut into 3 equal parts. Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Remove Grease Stains
instructions: Mix all together. Pour on stain and let stand for a few minutes then wash.

title: Broccoli Corn Bread
instructions: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan. Set aside. Mix other ingredients; pour into buttered pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Hot Chile Dip
instructions: Put all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes or microwave on High covered for 8 to 10 minutes stirring once or twice during cooking time or until cheese is melted and blended. Serve with tortilla chips. Makes 4 cups. Stores well in refrigerator. Reheat in microwave.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Saute chopped dates in oleo or butter about 2 minutes. Add mashed potatoes and heat through. Put mixture in a casserole. Smooth top and pour syrup over mixture. Bake for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Onion Ring Batter
instructions: Combine dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and egg. Beat until smooth. Dip thinly sliced onion rings into batter. Fry in deep hot oil.

title: Sugar Cookies
instructions: Cream the butter; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs. Sift together the dry ingredients; stir into creamed mixture. Chill overnight. Roll dough thin and cook 10 to 12 minutes in moderate oven.

title: Cranberry-Orange Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Add shortening orange rind orange juice and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Fold in cranberries and pecans. Pour in greased loaf pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 large or 5 small loaves.

title: Pudding
instructions: Mix all together. Cook on medium until thickens. When its done you can put bananas or coconut in it.

title: Florida Dessert
instructions: In saucepan bring butter and sugar to a boil stirring constantly. In a bowl combine Rice Krispies nuts and coconut. Pour butter sauce over Rice Krispies mixture and mix well. Press 1/2 of mixture into bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread softened ice cream over Rice Krispies. Top with remaining 1/2 of Rice Krispies mixture. Freeze before serving.

title: Fluffy Meat Loaf
instructions: *You can change 1/2 pound of beef to 1/2 pound of lean pork (ground) for a variation.

title: Honey Bun Cake
instructions: Mix cake mix oil eggs and sour cream with spoon. Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Set aside rest of batter. Mix cinnamon and brown sugar. Spread over first layer of batter. Pour rest of batter over this part. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 40 minutes.

title: Banana Muffins
instructions: Stir all ingredients together and bake at 350\u00b0 for about 20 minutes in muffin pans that have been greased or sprayed with nonstick spray. If you use nonstick spray these have no fat and count as 2 fruits 1 milk and 1 protein. It makes 3 to 4 muffins and the exchanges are if all the muffins are eaten at one time.

title: Apricot Nut Bread
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Measure all ingredients into large mixer bowl. Beat on medium speed 1/2 minute. Pour into pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean. Remove from pan. Cool thoroughly. (If self-rising flour is used omit baking powder and salt.)

title: Fun Putty
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until blended. If colored putty is desired mix food coloring with starch before adding glue. Otherwise mix starch and glue together until blended. If the putty is too sticky add more starch until it has a smooth consistency. This recipe is surprisingly similar to commercial putty found in stores.

title: Chili For 25 People
instructions: Cook and drain ground beef cook onions and peppers and save juice. In a large pot or bowl mix all ingredients. Remember to rinse kidney beans. Pour into large baking pan or roaster and cover. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes until hot and done.

title: Frosted Pretzels
instructions: Measure 2 cups frosting. Heat it up in top of double boiler over hot water until frosting is liquid stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Dip the pretzels in the frosting with your fingers then place them on wax paper. Let dry 8 hours.

title: Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet at 375\u00b0 for 9 to 12 minutes. Makes 4 dozen good chewy cookies.

title: Harlequin Baked Beans
instructions: Cut bacon into small pieces and brown add sliced onion (rings) brown sugar vinegar garlic salt and mustard. Simmer for 20 minutes. Drain lima butter and kidney beans. Place all beans in casserole or bean pot. Pour bacon mixture over beans. Stir lightly bake 1 hour at 350.

title: Light Red Velvet Cake
instructions: Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed with electric mixer until creamy; gradually add sugar. Beat well. Gradually add egg substitute; beat well. Stir in food coloring. Combine cake flour and next 3 ingredients; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix just until blended after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour batter into 3 (9-inch) round cake pans coated with cooking spray. Bake for 18 minutes at 350\u00b0. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely on wire racks. Spread frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake.

title: Baked Spinach And Flounder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Grease 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Cook spinach as label directs adding onion; drain very well. Stir in egg garlic clove and salt. In pan layer flounder spinach and cheese; then one slice of tomato on each. Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Cooked Brisket On Grill
instructions: Trim excess fat from brisket. Mix together oil lemon juice salt pepper garlic and parsley. Marinate brisket in mixture for 3 hours at room temperature turning frequently. Drain the meat and cook on slow fire until desired doneness. Baste with barbecue sauce and serve sliced very thinly.

title: Baked Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Punch
instructions: Combine the drink mix sugar and pineapple juice in a plastic gallon container. Add water until container is full. Freeze until icy.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Boil shell noodles in salted water and let cool. Cook eggs sugar vinegar salt and juice of lemon together until thickened. Cool and then add 1 c. whipped cream. Cut up apples grapes bananas oranges or can use mandarin orange sections and pineapple chunks. Add fruit to the shell noodles and pour cooled dressing over it just before ready to serve.

title: Sour Cream-Lemon Pie
instructions: Combine sugar cornstarch lemon rind juice egg yolks and milk in heavy saucepan; cook over medium heat until thick. Stir in butter and cool mixture to room temperature. Stir in sour cream and pour filling into pie shell. Cover with whipped cream and garnish with lemon twists. Store in refrigerator.

title: Pizza Lasagna
instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Grease pan. Layer noodles in bottom of pan. Spread half of the ground beef mixture on noodles and half jar of sauce. Add 1 cup cheese. Layer noodles again with beef sauce and topping. Cook until hot. Remove from oven. Add remaining cheese. Return to oven. Cook until cheese has melted. Bake at 350\u00b0.

title: Onion Dip
instructions: Mix all together; put in a 13 x 9-inch dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with corn chips. Delish!!

title: Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Cream oil eggs and sugar. Sift together and add to cream mixture flour salt and baking powder. Add milk poppy seed vanilla and butter. Stir together mixture will be loose. Grease and flour loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: Tomato-Chive Dressing
instructions: In blender container combine all ingredients and process at high speed until blended. Makes 4 servings about 1/4 cup each.

title: Old Fashioned Dandelion Salad
instructions: Wash and pick over the greens thoroughly to be sure no grain of sand remains. Dry on paper towels; tear into pieces and chill. Fry the bacon until crisp. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat and drain the bacon on paper towels. Add the sugar flour and salt to the fat. Cook and stir 3 minutes. Add the vinegar and water and bring to a boil stirring constantly. Add the chopped onion and the greens. Toss well to coat thoroughly; cover and cook 2 or 3 minutes just to wilt the dandelions. Serve garnished with the bacon pieces. A good salad we enjoyed in Iowa when I was growing up. Dandelions were always plentiful in everyones yard.

title: Lemon Ice Cream
instructions: *May use 2 cups half and half instead of separate milk and cream.

title: Breakfast Pizza
instructions: Cook sausage until brown; drain off excess fat. Separate crescent roll dough into 8 triangles. Place triangles on an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan with points toward the center. Press over bottom and up sides to form a crust. Seal any perforations. Top with crumbled sausage hash brown potatoes and Cheddar cheese. Combine eggs milk salt and pepper in a bowl; beat until thoroughly mixed. Pour mixture over crust and toppings. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Cranberry Onion Pork Roast
instructions: Season roast with salt and pepper; place over indirect heat on grill. Stir together cranberry sauce and onion soup mix and heat covered in microwave until hot. Baste roast with cranberry mixture every 10 minutes until roast is done. Heat any leftover basting mixture to boiling stir and boil for 5-10 minutes and serve alongside roast.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in top of double boiler. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients except coconut. Cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add coconut; pour into pie shell. Top with meringue.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix together soften margarine nuts & flour. Press into bottom of 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes. Let cool. Mix sugar cream cheese & Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Mix vanilla chocolate pudding & milk with mixer. Pour over cream cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip and chill before serving.

title: Fruit Pizza(Everyone'S Favorite)
instructions: Cut sugar cookie roll and press into a pizza pan. Bake and let cool. Top with Cool Whip and fruit starting with less expensive fruit around edges. (I normally use cantaloupe.) Next circle around your fruits using the most expensive in the middle (uses less and saves money when fruit is not on sale). Cut like a pizza and enjoy!

title: Swedish Tea Ring
instructions: Mix milk 1/2 cup sugar and salt together. Dissolve yeast in warm water; stir into milk mixture. Stir in eggs and shortening. Mix in with spoon then with hand the plain flour. Add flour in two additions. Gather into ball and knead on lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl. Cover with damp cloth and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Punch down and let rise again 30 to 45 minutes. Divide dough into 2 equal parts (makes 2 large rings).

title: Potato Soup
instructions: Cook butter and onion in large pot until tender. Add soups milks salt pepper and hash browns. Cook on medium-low until hot stirring frequently.

title: Chicken Breasts With Creamy Mustard Sauce
instructions: Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Saute chicken in butter and oil in a large skillet shaking pan occasionally to prevent sticking until lightly golden about 6 minutes. Turn. Lower heat. Saute until chicken is tender about 4 minutes longer. Chicken should feel springy with no pink remaining. Cover skillet; cook 2 minutes longer to steam. Remove to warm platter. Cover and keep warm. Pour fat into a cup. Measure and return 2 tablespoons to skillet. Saute green onions 30 seconds. Add mushrooms. Cook and stir until mushrooms are lightly golden about 1 minute.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip
instructions: Melt together in microwave or cook in double boiler.

title: Cheese Cookie
instructions: Let cheese and margarine come to room temperature. Blend all ingredients except Rice Krispies. Add Rice Krispies and blend with spoon. Roll into balls. Press flat with damp fork. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes.

title: Cheese Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender in 1 quart of water. Add 2 cans of undiluted cream of celery soup. Add 1 pound of cubed Velveeta and cook until melted.

title: Cherry Cheese Brownies
instructions: Prepare brownie mix as directed on package except bake for 20 minutes. Beat vanilla egg milk and cream cheese in a large bowl until smooth. Pour over baked brownie layer. Bake in 350\u00b0 oven until cheese layer is set about 25 minutes. Cool for 2 hours. Spread with cherry pie filling. Enjoy!

title: Chocolate Strawberry Shortcakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease two 9-inch layer pans. In a large mixing bowl combine flour 1/3 cup sugar cocoa baking powder baking soda and salt. Cut in butter or margarine until the mixture resemble coarse crumbs. Add milk mixing just until moistened. Spread batter evenly into two prepared layer pans. Bake for 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool. In a medium size mixing bowl combine strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar. Let this mixture stand for 10 minutes. Cover the bottom shortcake layer with half of strawberry mixture and half of the whipped topping. Top with second shortcake layer remaining strawberry mixture and whipped topping. Drizzle with chocolate syrup.

title: Kimbo'S Chicken Salad
instructions: *I put the chicken in a food processor to chop it.

title: Microwave Fudge
instructions: Do not stir. Sift cocoa and sugar in large mixing bowl; add milk and sticks of butter on top. Remember do not stir. Cook on High for 6 minutes. Remove from microwave and stir thoroughly. Add vanilla and pecans. Stir until well mixed. Pour into buttered glass platter. Cool in refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut and serve. Do not double recipe.

title: Chocolate Delight
instructions: Mix flour margarine and pecans together. Press into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. When cool mix 1 cup of Cool Whip powdered sugar and cream cheese. Spread over crust. Mix both pudding mixes and add milk until thickened then spread over cream cheese layer. Top with rest of Cool Whip and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Keep refrigerated.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and let sit overnight. (Add anything else you like.)

title: Butterscotch Cream Cake
instructions: Prepare cake mix adding milk eggs the 1/2 cup butterscotch dessert mix and the 1 teaspoon vanilla extract. Mix and bake as directed on package in three greased and wax paper lined 9-inch layer pans. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Put the strawberries whole or halved in 9-inch pie shell. Put sugar cornstarch and water into pan and cook until boiling. Reduce heat and cook until thick and clear stirring constantly. Add the strawberry Jell-O (dry) directly from package. Pour over berries. Refrigerate immediately. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Debbie'S Luscious Dessert
instructions: Mix graham crackers sugar and butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan; freeze. Cream powdered sugar and eggs. Add butter and chocolate. Beat until fluffy 5 minutes or more. Spread over graham cracker mixture; freeze. Whip the cream. Add marshmallows and candy reserving a little of the candy. Spread on top of chocolate mixture. Sprinkle remaining candy on top of cream mixture. Freeze. Take out 15 minutes before serving.

title: Blue Cheese Olive Ball
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth. Add Blue cheese and beat well. Stir in chives and chopped olives. Mixture will be soft. Shape mixture into a ball and roll in pecans. Refrigerate overnight. (This allows the flavor to ripen.) Serve with crackers.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Beat in eggs one at a time. Then add milk vanilla and lemon. Stir in rice and cinnamon. Bake in greased 9 x 13 dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Check after 45 minutes. When knife inserted in center comes out clean it is done. Rice stays on bottom and the top is like custard and creamy.

title: Coconut Pie
instructions: Stir together sugar cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Blend milk and egg yolks. Gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Blend in butter and vanilla.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and beat. Mix in pumpkin cloves and cinnamon. Add flour baking powder and baking soda alternately with water to creamed mixture. Mix in nuts. Pour batter in 3 greased loaf pans. Bake 40 to 50 minutes in 350\u00b0 oven until done when tested.

title: No-Fat Broccoli And Pasta
instructions: Boil broccoli florets in salted water in a large pot until soft. Remove florets with strainer spoon (reserve water) and mash in a large bowl with the garlic salt pepper and cheese. Cook pasta in the same water as broccoli until al dente. Strain into colander and add to bowl of broccoli mixture. Toss thoroughly and add or correct seasonings. Serve hot.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients and blend well. Pour into 2 (9-inch) paper-lined pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until cake springs back. Freeze until cooled but not frozen. Slice in half to make 4 layers.

title: Classic Italian Spaghetti Sauce
instructions: Remove sausage meat from casings. In 8-quart Dutch oven over high heat cook sausage meat and ground beef stirring often until all pan juices evaporate and meat is browned. With slotted spoon remove mixture to bowl.

title: Soyed Chicken Wings
instructions: Place chicken wings in stock pot; sprinkle with ginger and wine. Cover and simmer over medium-high heat until wine is almost evaporated. Add remaining ingredients mixed well. Simmer and cook covered for 1 hour stirring wings often and keeping heat at medium to medium-high. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Marinated Artichoke Salad
instructions: Drain artichoke hearts reserving 3 tablespoons liquid. Combine artichoke hearts reserved liquid and next 6 ingredients in a shallow container. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Spoon salad into a lettuce lined bowl and garnish with egg slices and bacon. Yields 6 servings.

title: Good-For You Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber green pepper and lettuce in a salad bowl; toss well. In a medium bowl combine seasoned salt and yogurt. Mix well. Pour dressing on salad and mix well.

title: Pork Chops Supreme
instructions: Season chops with salt and pepper on both sides. Arrange potatoes in baking dish. Mix soup milk and onions and pour over potatoes. Place chops on top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Sausage Balls
instructions: Mix shape and broil or pan-fry until brown. Drain.

title: Desiree'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix well. Fill 3 (8-inch) layer pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until done.

title: Mom'S Apple Cake
instructions: Mix. Spread in 9-inch square pan which has been greased and floured; bake at 350\u00b0 45 to 60 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Aunt Trish'S Good Pancake Recipe
instructions: Mix \wet\ ingredients and then stir in the dry ingredients. Cook on top of stove & add a dab of butter to pancake as it comes off the griddle.

title: Baptist Pound Cake
instructions: Cream shortenings until fluffy. Add sugar gradually along with 1/2 cup milk then add eggs one at a time. Add flour mixture and rest of milk a little at a time. The longer you beat the better. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Oven-Fried Chicken And Dressing
instructions: Cut chicken in serving pieces; dip into flour seasoned with salt and pepper; brown in hot fat or Pam spray. Combine remaining ingredients using 1/2 cup soup. Arrange chicken in Dutch oven or large casserole. Pile dressing in center. Make gravy of pan drippings using 2 tablespoons flour and enough water with remaining soup to make 2 cups; pour over chicken. Cover closely; bake in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Pumpkin And Cream Cheese Roll-Up
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Grease a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Mix flour baking powder cinnamon pumpkin pie spice nutmeg and salt. Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl until fluffy. Beat in pumpkin. Stir in dry ingredients. Pour into pan. Spread evenly. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake 15 minutes. Loosen cake with a knife around edges. Invert onto clean damp towel dusted with powdered sugar. Trim 1/4-inch from all sides. Roll up cake and towel together from short side. Place seam side down on rack. Cool.

title: Date Nut Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0. Have loaf pan ready. Mix dates and pecans. Sift dry ingredients and add to dates and pecans. Mix well (its easier to use your hands). Add cherries pineapple vanilla and beaten eggs. Bake in loaf pan in slow oven (300\u00b0 to 325\u00b0) for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mexican Wedding Rings
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add flour nuts and vanilla. Chill; form into small balls. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

title: Spanish Rice With Meat
instructions: Saute onion green pepper beef and rice in oil until brown. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Cover tightly and simmer 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Lemon Squares
