instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Pat down well in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 275\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: Banana Nut Bread
instructions: Cream shortening sugar and bananas. Beat in eggs. Combine dry ingredients. Stir gently into egg mixture alternately with liquids. Fold in pecans. Pour into greased 10 x 6 x 3-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

title: Weight Watchers Salad Dressing
instructions: Mix ingredients all together. Put in a jar or bottle. Keep in refrigerator. Counts as 1/2 milk.

title: Zimmerinski
instructions: Marinate sirloin in sherry soy sauce and garlic for 1 hour. Spray frying pan with cooking spray. Stir-fry steak strips for 2 minutes. Push up onto side. Add onions and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 2 minutes then pull steaks back into vegetables and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes. Add soup; stir until heated well. Serve over noodles. Serves 4 to 6 depending on appetites. (Careful not to overcook steak.)

title: Chicken Or Turkey A La King
instructions: In 12-inch skillet over medium heat in hot margarine cook green pepper 5 minutes or until tender. Stir in flour and salt until blended. Gradually stir in milk. Cook stirring constantly until mixture is thickened. Add meat mushrooms with their liquid pimentos and bouillon; heat to boiling stirring often. Reduce heat to low; cover simmer 5 minutes. Serve over biscuits.

title: Dried Peaches
instructions: Put sugar and vinegar over peach peelings and let stand overnight. Cook until thick. Fill jars and seal. Use to make fried pies.

title: Oatmeal Jumble Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 400\u00b0. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. In large bowl combine all ingredients except jam; mix well. Reserve 1 cup mixture; press remaining on bottom of prepared pan. Spread jam evenly over base to within 1/2 inch of edge of pan; sprinkle with reserved mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely; cut into bars. Makes 13 x 9-inch pan of bars.

title: Bun Bars
instructions: Melt together chocolate and butterscotch chips. Add peanut butter. Stir until smooth. Pour half of mixture onto a lightly greased 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. (Cool in fridge for 1/2 hour.) Add peanuts to other half of mixture. Set aside. Melt margarine; add evaporated milk. Stir in pudding and sugar. Mix with mixer until smooth. Add maple flavoring. Spread over first layer. Cool in fridge for 1 hour. Cover with remaining chocolate/peanut mixture and chill. Cut into squares and refrigerate.

title: Macaroni Saled
instructions: Cook macaroni and drane. Add all of the above mix and put in frig.

title: Tabasco Chicken Salad
instructions: Blend together mayonnaise sour cream Tabasco curry powder salt lime juice onion and capers. Combine chicken celery almonds and pineapple in large bowl; add dressing and toss lightly. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Yield 4 servings.

title: Day After Thanksgiving Turkey Soup
instructions: Heat butter in a skillet and saute onion and garlic until onion is translucent. Transfer contents of the skillet into a slow cooker. Add all other ingredients except the cream. Cover turn on low and cook for about 6 hours or until the vegetables are tender. Stir in heavy cream and heat thoroughly before serving. Serves 8.

title: Fruit Salad #2
instructions: Fix pudding according to box directions. Add remaining ingredients. Mix.

title: Peanut Brittle
instructions: Mix sugar syrup and water together and cook until mixture threads. Add peanuts and stir continuously cooking until syrup mixture turns light brown in color and peanuts are done. Remove from fire; add soda salt and butter. Stir until thoroughly mixed and pour onto buttered table top as thin as possible. Stretch. Break up and bag.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes. Mix and then fold in potatoes. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Garden Casserole
instructions: Brown ground meat with onion Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper. Drain well. In large boiler add green beans corn tomatoes and English peas. Drain all vegetables. Cook the potatoes and carrots a short while. Drain. Add this mixture and the meat mixture to the vegetables in the large boiler and mix well. Heat thoroughly then pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes while you prepare cheese biscuits for the topping.

title: Lite Strawberry Plus Salad(Serves 8 To 10)
instructions: Combine Jell-O and water; dissolve well. Fold rest of ingredients in all at once and mix well. Pour half of this mixture in 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan and refrigerate 1 1/2 hours at least (leave rest of mix at room temperature). Then 1 1/2 hours later cover mixture with 1 pint of sour cream. Spoon rest of mixture very carefully over sour cream and refrigerate until set firm.

title: Pralines
instructions: Butter the sides of a heavy 2-quart saucepan. Place sugars salt corn syrup milk and butter in saucepan. Over medium heat stir mixture constantly with a wooden spoon until sugars have dissolved and mixture comes to a boil. Continue to cook to a soft ball stage approximately 236\u00b0. on a candy thermometer. If you do a cold water test the ball of candy will flatten when you take it out of the water. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes. Add vanilla and nuts; beat with a spoon by hand for approximately 2 minutes or until candy is slightly thick and begins to lose its gloss. Quickly drop heaping tablespoons onto waxed paper. If the candy becomes stiff add a few drops of hot water.

title: Make Your Own Eagle Brand Milk
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender and beat one minute. Refrigerate until thick. Makes 1 1/4 cups or same as 2 cans.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Pack firmly in a buttered baking dish apples to a depth of 1 1/2-inches. Apples should be pared and coarsely chopped. Dot apples with cinnamon. Mix white sugar butter and flour. This mixture will be crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake 45 minutes in a moderate oven. Serve with ice cream or cream.

title: Mound Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into 3 layer cake pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool.

title: Tea Time Tassies
instructions: Cream sugar butter and egg. Add vanilla and nuts. Fill the centers and bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

title: German Potato Salad
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Break into pieces. To drippings in skillet add flour water vinegar sugar salt and mustard. Lay potatoes in casserole with one layer potatoes and one layer of thinly sliced onions until casserole is filled. Pour dressing over top and bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Cream together the eggs sugar and margarine. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into eggs and sugar mixture. Add raisins nuts and coconut. Bake in unbaked pie shell at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Sausage And Artichoke Pie(9-Inch Size)
instructions: Do not add salt.

title: Coconut Custard Pie
instructions: Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar; beat well. Gradually add flour and beat well. Add milk vanilla coconut and oleo. Pour into ungreased pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

title: Better Oven Baked Barbecued Spareribs
instructions: Brown spareribs well; pour off excess fat. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over ribs. Bake covered at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours basting with sauce 3 or 4 times. Remove cover bake for 15 minutes longer. Yields 6 servings.

title: Cream Of Chicken
instructions: Cook chicken breasts. In separate pot cook butter flour salt pepper and 2 1/2 cups of broth until it bubbles. Add 1 1/2 cups of milk and reboil 1 minute. Turn on low and add chicken (that you chunked). Serve over sweet peas and egg noodles.

title: Powder House Salad Delight
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Cocktail Wieners
instructions: Saute onions peppers and tomatoes. Add all remaining ingredients including wieners and marinate overnight. Bake at 350\u00b0 until sauce thickens.

title: Impossible Pie
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and run at high for 1 minute. Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan (Pyrex). Bake for 50 minutes in a 325\u00b0 oven until crust forms on bottom custard in middle and coconut on top. Makes a large pie so use a deep pan.

title: Pinto Bean Pie
instructions: Mix oleo beans eggs and sugar. Add vanilla coconut and pecans; mix good. Pour into 3 unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Baked Salmon
instructions: Saute ingredients. Clean salmon; lay on heavy aluminum foil. Pour ingredients over and inside of fish. Top with lemon slices and onion slices. Fold over foil and seal. Can be baked in oven for 1 hour at 350\u00b0 or put on the barbecue grill; turn over once during baking time. Baking time depends on the size of the fish.

title: Hot Relish
instructions: Wash peppers remove seeds and core. In a 6 to 8-quart boiler combine sugar vinegar water and pickling salt. Bring to a boil. Add all ingredients and bring to a boil for about 5 minutes. Place a clove of garlic in each hot sterilized pint jar. Fill jars to 1/2-inch of top. Use plenty of liquid when filling. Remove air bubbles. Wipe jar tops and threads clean. Place hot lids and band on. Screw tight. Process in boiling water canner for 5 minutes to seal.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook broccoli and drain. Place in casserole dish. Layer cheese and undiluted soup. Moisten stuffing. Mix with water and crumble on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Oreo Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and sugar in bowl until stiff peaks form. fold in nuts and crushed Oreos. Spoon into buttered 8-inch pie plate. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread with whipped topping before serving.

title: Scandinavian Relish
instructions: Mix together and add the following dressing.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Cook the broccoli according to package directions. Drain well. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Combine the broccoli with the soup eggs cheese mayonnaise and onion. Mix well. Spoon in casserole and top with bread crumbs. Drizzle with butter. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Mix shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Then mix rest of ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet greased. Bake 8 to 10 minutes in a 350\u00b0 oven.

title: Double Delicious Cookie Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0 (325\u00b0 for glass dish). In a 13 x 9-inch pan melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. Pour condensed milk over crumbs. Top with chips; press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until lightly brown. Cool and cut into bars. Store at room temperature.

title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients good. Put on stove and cook until it thickens. You may want to double this recipe. Its so good youll need it for hungry folks who love chocolate pudding.

title: Lynda'S Full Meal Deal
instructions: Cover; simmer 1/2 to 3/4 hour stirring occasionally. Serve with hot biscuits or hot baked bread. Yield 1 large stew pot full.

title: Baked Barley
instructions: Melt butter in skillet; saute onion and garlic. Add barley and spices. Cook until barley is brown. Bake for 30 minutes at 325\u00b0.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: In a heavy saucepan lightly brown the garlic in oil. Add the onion and saute until translucent. Add the mushrooms broccoli zucchini eggplant celery carrots and the red and green peppers and saute just until tender. Add the wine and tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Add the cornstarch and broth mixture and stir until thickened. Add basil and marjoram. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve on a bed of hot fettucini noodles. Serve topped with freshly grated Parmesan and shredded Mozzarella cheese. Add a fresh loaf of French bread and wa la!

title: Play Doh
instructions: Heat all ingredients over low heat in saucepan stirring until ball forms. Knead.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spread beans in bottom of casserole dish 9 X 13. In large bowl combine cream cheese sour cream and taco seasoning. Mix in garlic. Spread mixture over beans in casserole. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Bake 15-18 minutes. Top with olives tomato and onion. Garnish with additional sour cream if desired. May also add fresh parsley and cilantro (2 Tbsp.) if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Danish Red Cabbage
instructions: Put cabbage in a heavy porcelain lined iron pot with vinegar. Add fat. Carefully bring to a boil. Add a little water if necessary. Add apples allspice berries salt sugar and raisins. Cabbage should be juicy but not soupy. Taste for salt and give the pepper mill a few turns.

title: Heavenly Hash
instructions: Thoroughly mix crushed pineapple Cool Whip coconut marshmallows chopped nuts cherries and milk. Chill for 1 hour.

title: Mary'S Four Cheesy Macaroni
instructions: Pour milk in pan add warm block margarine or butter. Add cheese and bread. Cook until melted. Add salt and pepper.

title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
instructions: Combine first 7 ingredients in sifter; set aside. Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; beat well after adding each. Add pumpkin; mix well. Add dry ingredients to mixture alternately with water (can use milk instead); mix well after each addition. Add pecans and blend. You can add 2/3 cup prepared mincemeat now (but I never do!). Spoon into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans; bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. (I usually bake at 325\u00b0 in cake pan or 2 pans that equal a cake pan for 20 to 30 minutes. These can also work for muffins for 12 to 15 minutes.)

title: Golash
instructions: Saute beef and butter until light brown. Add vegetables. Saute until tender. Add soup mix beef base and Worcestershire sauce. Add 1 quart water. Cook 45 minutes. May need to use more water to your taste so it wont be salty. Add Kitchen Bouquet for color. You can add more or any ingredients. If you want more beef or vegetables add.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Mix all together; pour in pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes then 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.\tTo test put knife into pie halfway between center and edge. If knife comes out dry then pie is cooked. If there is anything on the knife then leave and cook a little longer.

title: Spinach & Artichoke Casserole(Award Winner)
instructions: Coat 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray. Layer artichokes then spinach in pan. Cream together cream cheese & milk pour over vegetables. Place slices of Jack cheese over cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with parmesan. Bake at 350 for 40-60 minutes.

title: Scalloped Corn
instructions: Mix together corn crackers salt and pepper to taste and egg. Pour into well-greased pan. Garnish top with additional crumbled Club crackers (3 or 4) and strips of bacon (if you like); a few dollops of butter here and there on the crumbled crackers is nice too. Place in 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour until top is light brown and bacon is fully cooked. Check before the hour is up to be sure it doesnt burn.

title: Rye Bread Dip
instructions: Cut dried beef in small pieces. Mix together all ingredients and let stand overnight.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing
instructions: Blend all ingredients together well and refrigerate overnight. Makes enough dressing for 2 packages of tiny rolls with shaved ham in center.

title: Brown Rice
instructions: Broil onion in margarine until onion is light brown. Pour into casserole and add remaining ingredients. Cover dish with foil. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts Tarragon
instructions: Skin debone and half the chicken breasts lengthwise. Pare and slice the carrots into 1/4-inch rounds. In 6-quart dutch oven heat oil and 2 tablespoons margarine. Add chicken breasts (half at a time to cover bottom of pan); saute until brown on all sides. Remove chicken as it browns. Brown remainder of chicken. To drippings in dutch oven add shallots and carrots; saute stirring occasionally 5 minutes or until golden. Return chicken to dutch oven; heat. When hot heat Cognac in ladle; ignite and pour flaming over chicken. Add wine chopped tarragon chervil salt and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer gently covered 30 minutes. Remove chicken to heated serving platter; keep warm. Strain drippings in dutch oven and discard vegetables. In a bowl combine cream egg yolk and flour; mix well with wire whisk. Stir cream mixture into drippings in dutch oven; bring to just boiling stirring constantly. Add more wine if sauce seems too thick. Meanwhile saute mushrooms in hot margarine until tender 5 minutes. Spoon sauce over chicken and garnish with mushrooms and tarragon. Optional May be served over a bed of rice. Serves 8.

title: Fried Okra
instructions: Wash okra well and drain. Cut off tip and stem ends; cut okra crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Combine water and salt. Pour over okra and soak for 30 minutes. Drain rinse well and drain again. Roll okra in cornmeal and fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain well on absorbent towels. Yields 6 servings.

title: Sweet Potato Balls
instructions: Mash sweet potatoes. Take a handful of potatoes with a marshmallow in the middle and shape into a ball. Roll the potato ball in some coconut and pecans. Do not grease pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Watch closely.

title: Nut Tarts
instructions: Blend room temperature cheese butter and flour; chill for 1 hour. Divide into 24 equal parts; shape each part into a small ball. Press into bottom and 1/2-inch up the side of small buttered 2-inch muffin cups; chill. Blend remaining ingredients and place one teaspoon of mixture in each pastry shell. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 2 dozen small tarts.

title: Ann'S Oyster Chowder
instructions: In 5-quart crock-pot place soup milk spinach and bacon. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion and oysters. Cook 5 minutes. Add wine. Cover and cook 20 minutes on low. Add to crock-pot. Simmer 1 hour or longer. Skee-rum-ious.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes if tough otherwise just scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 425\u00b0 for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Return to oven for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside. Check for fork.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream together sugars and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour and soda. Add oatmeal; stir well. Add nuts. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0. Makes about 3 dozen.

title: One Minute Chocolate Icing
instructions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla in saucepan. Cook stirring frequently until mixtures comes to a full rolling boil. Boil 1 minute and remove from heat. Cool.

title: Kahlua Cake
instructions: Make cake; cool. Cut into small bite-size pieces. Layer bottom of large bowl with cake. Mix each pudding with 1 3/4 cups milk and 1/4 cup Kahlua. Pour over cake. Put one (8 ounce) Cool Whip on top of pudding. Repeat the layers with remaining ingredients.

title: Angel Biscuits
instructions: In a 1-cup measure dissolve yeast in water. In a large bowl stir together flour sugar baking powder soda and salt. Cut in butter until it is fine. Stir in yeast mixture and enough of the buttermilk to make a fairly soft dough.

title: Blue Cheese Dressing
instructions: Mix together the sour cream mayonnaise vinegar sugar salt and pepper. Add the Blue cheese and minced onion. Chill.

title: Crustless Egg Custard
instructions: Beat eggs and margarine; mix thoroughly. Add sugar and flour. Add milk and eggs gradually. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes or scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Use handle of spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish fan slightly. Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs and spices.

title: Chocolate Gravy
instructions: Sift together flour sugar cocoa and salt. Stir into the warm liquids; cook until thick enough for gravy. Add vanilla and serve over buttered biscuits.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: *Additional sugar to use as a dip; do not add to mix.

title: Chewy Homemade Breadsticks
instructions: In a large bowl sprinkle yeast over the 1/4 cup water. Stand for 5 minutes. Stir in salad oil sugar salt milk and 2 cups flour. Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes or until dough pulls from sides of bowl in stretchy strand. Stir in about 1 cup flour to form a stiff dough. Turn onto a lightly floured board. Knead for 10 minutes or until smooth. Turn dough over in a lightly greased bowl. Cover with plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled. Turn dough out onto board. Knead to expel trapped air. Cut into 12 equal pieces. Cover and let rest 5 minutes. Roll each piece out into a log about 12 inches long. Set breadsticks 1-inch apart on a greased baking sheet. Brush tops lightly with oil. Sprinkle with caraway seed. Let rise in a warm place for 20 minutes or until puffy. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Cool on pan for 2 minutes.

title: Pineapple Carrot Cake(Yields 1 Bundt Cake)
instructions: Mix flour sugar cinnamon baking soda salt and baking powder. Add drained pineapple juice. Add well-beaten eggs oil and vanilla. Beat for 3 minutes. Batter will be stiff. Add pineapple carrots and nuts and beat well. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Cool and frost.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Prepare veggies. If using canned bean sprouts rinse drain and pat dry. Work on high heat. Add 1 tablespoon oil; heat until hot. Add eggs; stir until soft scrambled. Put on side of wok. Add 2 tablespoons oil bean sprouts salt and mushrooms. Stir-fry 1 minute; move up on side with eggs. Remove wok from heat; wipe bowl with paper towel. Return to heat. Add remaining oil and heat; add rice and stir until hot. Add soy sauce; continue stirring until well mixed. Add green onions and meat. Return remaining ingredients to wok bowl; stir-fry for 1/2 minute.

title: Busy Day Pot Roast
instructions: Heat oven to 325\u00b0. Put meat in heavy casserole. Mix remaining ingredients and spread over meat. Cover and bake 3 hours or until done. Thicken gravy to serve.

title: Chicken And Rice
instructions: Mix water soups and rice. Put in a casserole dish. Then melt or soften butter. Add pepper and salt. Roll chicken in this mixture. Place on top of rice and soup. Add remaining butter. Cover dish and bake at 325\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Rhubarb Cake
instructions: Beat brown sugar and margarine until fluffy. Add egg and beat. Add sour milk flour soda salt and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add rhubarb and mix well. Top with 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake in glass pan at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Gooey Butter Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Melt butter then mix with yellow cake mix. In a 13 x 9-inch pan form crust on bottom. Combine cream cheese 3/4 of box of powdered sugar and eggs. Mix until creamy; pour over cake mix. Cook about 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Sprinkle with rest of powdered sugar.

title: No Cooking Play Dough
instructions: Mix all things together in a bowl. Knead. Keep dough in a plastic bag or container. Store in the refrigerator. Use food coloring if you like.

title: Sherry Cake
instructions: Dredge fruit and nuts with 1 cup flour. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat thoroughly. Add flour and mix together. Add sherry. Fold in fruit and nuts. Put into greased and floured spring-form pan and bake at 250\u00b0 for 2 hours.

title: Deviled Potato Salad
instructions: Cut eggs in half and remove yolk. Mash yolk and mix with vinegar and mustard. Add mayonnaise sour cream and celery seed. Mix well. Chop egg white and combine with potatoes celery onion and pimento. Fold in egg yolk mix.

title: Million Dollar Pie
instructions: Beat milk and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Mix in other ingredients. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Chill and serve.

title: Punch Bowl Cake
instructions: Into a punch bowl place one layer of the cake. Add one package of pudding mix prepared by the directions on the package half of the fruit cocktail pineapple and pie filling half of the nuts one container of whipped topping and one package of coconut. Add second layer of cake and repeat all the layers ending with coconut. Chill until serving time.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Drain green beans. Mix in bowl. Combine green beans celery soup and mushroom soup. Mix well. Add dried onions for topping and microwave for 30 minutes. Serve as side dish.

title: Tropical Chicken Salad
instructions: Cut chicken in chunks and combine with oil orange juice and vinegar; let stand for 30 minutes. Add rest of ingredients.

title: Zucchini Pie
instructions: Place rolls flat in oblong baking dish. Press to spread out as far as they will go. Spread a thin layer of mustard over dough (spicy mustard is good). Saute zucchini and onions in oil or butter until onions are crystal color. Mix in bowl the vegetables eggs 1/2 of cheese and the seasonings. Pour over dough; dot with butter and place balance of cheese on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes to 1/2 hour until crust is brown and cheese is bubbly.

title: Porcupine Balls
instructions: Put ingredients in pan and cook over low heat for 10 minutes stirring constantly. Remove from stove. Add 1/2 cup nuts and 2 cups Rice Krispies. Cool until able to handle and form into balls. Roll in coconut.

title: Pork Chop And Potato Casserole
instructions: Slice peeled potatoes into rounds. Layer potatoes in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Make a layer of potatoes. Dot potatoes with butter salt pepper and 1/2 can soup. Make another row of potatoes with butter salt pepper and soup. Lay pork chops on top of potatoes. Then salt and pepper them. Cover with foil and bake at 425\u00b0 for 1 hour or until pork chops look done. Then take foil off and brown for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Bean Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 300\u00b0. Put beans in Pyrex bowl; add mushroom soup. Top with onions. Bring to a slow simmer in oven for 20 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Perfect Pecan Pie
instructions: Combine sugar and syrup. Add eggs and melted margarine (not hot it will curdle eggs). Add vanilla and pecans. Pour into pastry shell and bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 minutes.

title: The Best Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in an airtight container. (Low-fat and low-sugar cocoa mix.) Use 1/3 cup mix to 1 cup boiled water.

title: Hot Chicken Chip Salad
instructions: Select cabbage that is neither too hard (shreds will be coarse) or too soft (it is difficult to shred). Cut cabbage into quarters cutting between where leaves are attached to core so leaves will hold together.

title: Sand Castle Brownie Mix
instructions: In a 1 quart glass jar layer the first seven ingredients in order listed packing well between each layer. Cover and store in a cool dry place for up to 6 months.

title: Patty'S Cooked Frosting
instructions: Combine milk flour and vanilla in a saucepan over medium heat whisking constantly until thick. This mixture must completely cool! Add remaining ingredients. Whip until sugar dissolves and frosting is fluffy. Spread on your favorite cake.

title: Puree Of Anchovies
instructions: Mince or pound anchovy fillets. Moisten bread with enough water to cover then squeeze dry. Break into bits or mince with a fork. Blend in sour cream and vinegar to make a smooth puree. Serve as a spread with dark bread rounds.

title: Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix eggs milk corn and melted Crisco. Stir in all dry ingredients. Stir lightly. Drop by spoonful in hot Crisco until golden brown (375\u00b0).

title: Cool As A Cucumber Soup
instructions: Put all ingredients into blender and blend only until cucumber is finely chopped not smooth. Chill and serve. Garnish with a sprinkle of dill or chives if desired. Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Delight
instructions: Brown ground beef and onion. Stir in taco seasonings and 1 cup water. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes; set aside. Place crushed chips in an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Layer pinto beans then ground beef mixture over chips. Top with cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Miniature Cheese Balls
instructions: Combine all ingredients except nuts and blend thoroughly. Roll mixture into balls about 1/2-inch in diameter. Roll in chopped nuts. Chill and serve with toothpicks. Makes about 24.

title: Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Stir and put in 6 muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Six muffins equal 1 bread 1 protein 1 fruit and 1 milk.

title: Mom'S Coconut Cake
instructions: Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy. Gradually add sugar beating well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each addition.

title: Northwest Cheesecake Supreme
instructions: Combine cream cheese sugar and flour mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until blended. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Blend in sour cream and vanilla; pour over crust. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 250\u00b0 and continue to bake for 1 hour. Loosen cake from rim of pan; cool before removing from pan. Chill. Top with pie filling just before serving.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Take out stems of large fresh mushrooms. Saute in 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. Add green onions bread crumbs meat and parsley or chives. Moisten with sour cream. Add seasonings. Stuff caps with mixture. Sprinkle grated cheese over. Drizzle melted butter over. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Hot Chicken Souffle
instructions: Trim crusts from bread and cube these on top of chicken mixture. Combine eggs with milk; pour over all. Cover and chill at least 1 hour (may be made the day before it is to be used).

title: Curry Rice
instructions: Cook chicken until almost done. Add carrots and potatoes and onions. Finish cooking. Add curry powder garlic powder salt and pepper. Mix all together (may make a thickening out of flour and water and add to finished product).

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Sift dry ingredients together. Beat eggs and buttermilk together. Stir into dry ingredients. Add melted butter; beat until smooth. Drop from spoon on hot griddle. Bake on one side about 2 minutes. Turn and bake about 2 minutes longer.

title: Shrimp Dip
instructions: Mix cheese Miracle Whip onion and garlic salt. Mix shrimp in last. Refrigerate and serve with crackers.

title: Kool-Aid Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Put into cooled pie shell or graham cracker crust. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add other ingredients. Pour onto well-greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and ground nuts. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cut into squares immediately.

title: Squash Casserole
instructions: Cook squash and onion in small amount of boiling water (10 to 15 minutes); drain. Season to taste. Combine squash mixture carrot sour cream and soup. Bake in 2-quart casserole at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Top with buttered crumbs for 15 minutes before finishing; brown. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Mix well all ingredients. Spread on flour tortillas. Roll tightly and refrigerate before cutting (overnight is best.) Makes about 15 to 20.

title: Spanish Rice(Serves 6)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in an oiled baking dish. Bake in moderate oven (350\u00b0) uncovered for about 1 hour or until rice is soft.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture then add buttermilk. Add bananas and pecans last. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center of loaf comes out clean. (Bake bread in loaf pan or Bundt pan.)

title: Green Beans Almondine
instructions: Cook beans according to package directions. Dont overcook. Add butter and almonds which have been sliced and browned in butter. Serves 6.

title: Oatmeal Muffins
instructions: Soak first 2 ingredients together for 1 hour. Mix shortening brown sugar and egg together thoroughly. Sift flour baking powder soda and salt together. Stir in alternately oat mixture and shortening mixture. Mix well together. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake until golden brown at 400\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 12 individual muffins.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and chill.

title: Honey Graham Treats
instructions: Line cake pan (11 x 14-inches) with honey\tgrahams (break into quarters). Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil and boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Pour over graham crackers making sure all are coated. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken. Let cool 5 minutes then take out of the pan and break into quarters.

title: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook chicken for 1 hour with enough salt to taste. After chicken cools pick meat off the bone in bite-size pieces. Add celery pickles and mayonnaise. Mix well. Good for sandwiches or eat as is.

title: Carrot Pilaf
instructions: Combine carrot and onion; cook in oil until tender. Add remaining ingredients until heated through. Garnish with chopped parsley or mint.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients and cook until it begins to thicken. Add 1 tablespoon butter and pour in uncooked crust. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. Bake on cookie sheet pan and sprinkle with nutmeg.

title: Rump Roast
instructions: In foil wrap meat with soup. Roast at 350\u00b0 for about 4 hours. Thicken gravy from juice in pan. Add mushrooms.

title: Apple Crunch
instructions: Beat egg and add melted butter and vanilla. Slice apples thinly. Put into 9-inch greased pan. Mix flour baking powder salt and sugar. Mix in egg butter and vanilla; pour over apples. Sprinkle generously with cinnamon. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350\u00b0. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Microwave Chili
instructions: Place beef onion green pepper and garlic in 3-quart casserole. Microwave on High for 4 to 5 minutes or until beef is no longer pink and vegetables are tender. Stir halfway through cooking time. Drain off excess fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Microwave on High for 25 to 30 minutes. Stir after cooking.

title: Caramel Delight
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and press into pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Place chopping blade in food processor. Chop vegetables. Cut up cream cheese into sixths. Place in processor and pulse until just blended with vegetables (on off on off). Dont let machine run too long as everything will turn to mush. Thats it. Serve with crackers Melba toast or vegetables.

title: Pineapple Pie
instructions: Mix ingredients together (do not drain pineapple). Pour in pie crust. Chill until thickened about 2 hours.

title: Rotel Dip
instructions: Melt cheese and all ingredients. Ready to serve with chips.

title: Coffee Cloud Cake
instructions: Dissolve 1 tablespoon granules in boiling water. Set aside. Combine flour baking powder and salt; set aside. Beat egg yolks in a large mixing bowl until thick and pale. Gradually add 1 1/2 cups sugar; beat until blended. Beat an additional 5 minutes at high speed. Add reserved flour mixture to egg yolk mixture alternately with reserved coffee mixture beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Stir in vanilla and 1 cup walnuts. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar at high speed of an electric mixer until foamy. Gradually add remaining 1/2 cup sugar 1 tablespoon at a time beating until stiff peaks form and sugar is dissolved (2 to 4 minutes). Fold one-fourth of egg white mixture into egg yolk mixture; carefully fold in remaining egg white mixture. Pour batter into an ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 70 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Invert pan using a narrow metal spatula; remove from pan. Place on a serving plate.

title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
instructions: Stir in pan butter Milnot and salt until butter is melted and warm. In bowl add 1 pound sugar and melted butter mixture. Knead and wrap around cherries. Chill overnight. In double boiler melt chocolate chips. Add paraffin to chips and melt. Take a fork or toothpick and dip cherry balls into chocolate. Place on waxed paper and chill. Then leave at room temperature.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Add yeast. Stir until dissolved. Mix in flour. Let dough rise 10 minutes and roll into 9 x 12-inch shape. Spread top of dough with melted butter. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle across the butter. Roll into jelly roll shape and cut into slices. Place in greased pan. Let rise and bake at 375\u00b0 for about 25 minutes. Cover hot rolls with powdered sugar glaze.

title: Creamy Chicken Tetrazzini
instructions: Cook chicken reserving 2 cups of the broth. Chill and dice chicken. Melt butter over low heat; add flour stirring about 3 to 4 minutes until blended. Slowly stir in broth cream and sherry. Season with lemon juice salt and pepper. Simmer and stir sauce with wire whisk until thick smooth and hot. Saute onion and green pepper into butter; remove. Saute mushrooms. Add onion green pepper and mushrooms to sauce. Cook spaghetti; place in bottom of greased casserole. Cover with chicken and sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Chicken Supreme
instructions: Simmer or bake chicken until tender; remove meat from bones. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Degrease liquid from cooking chicken. To the broth add enough water to measure 2 1/3 cups. Bring broth to boil; add rice and seasoning packet; cook according to directions on package until rice is tender and broth is absorbed. Combine ingredients blending well. Place in greased 2-quart casserole or 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes until hot and bubbly. Cover lightly with foil during first part of baking time; remove foil so mixture browns lightly.

title: Chicken A La King
instructions: Saute mushrooms and green pepper in butter. Blend in flour and seasonings. Cook over low heat; stir until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat and slowly stir in broth and cream. Bring to a boil over low heat stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Add chicken and pimiento. Continue cooking until meat is heated through. Serve hot in patty shells pastry cases biscuit rings timbale cases or over toast points noodles or fluffy rice. Serves 4.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Wash and drain broccoli and mushrooms. Slice into bite-size pieces. Parboil broccoli. Mix soup cheese mayonnaise and mushrooms in a large bowl. Add broccoli.

title: Rigatoni
instructions: Cook Italian sausage on low in small bottle of olive oil. Mix puree tomato sauce paste water and sugar together; cook on low while sausage is cooking. Add 4 garlic cloves to sauce. Add sausage and oil to sauce. Cover and simmer. Cook rigatoni noodles and serve sauce over noodles.

title: Ribbon Salad
instructions: First mix lime jello as directed on box. Put in long dish; set in refrigerator until set. Then mix lemon jello with 2 cups boiling water; add while hot the cheese and pineapple. Let cool. Pour on already-set lime jello. Let this set in refrigerator until firm.

title: Zucchini Appetizers
instructions: Mix and blend well all of the ingredients. Put into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cut into small squares to serve. May be frozen.

title: Cherry Squares
instructions: Cream butter. Add sugar gradually beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and vanilla (and/or lemon juice). Pour batter on a greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Spread batter with spoon.

title: Pierogi Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Saute onions in margarine until soft. Mash potatoes. Add cheese and beat with mixer. Add 1/3 of onions to potato mix. Add salt and pepper to taste.

title: Candy Bar Brownies
instructions: Combine butter sugar eggs and vanilla. Combine flour cocoa baking powder and salt. Set aside 1/4 cup. Add remaining dry ingredients to the egg mixture. Mix well. Toss Snickers pieces with reserved flour mixture. Stir into batter. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with milk chocolate candy bar pieces. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Chill before cutting.

title: Texas Salad
instructions: Mix lettuce (broken into bite size pieces) onion cheese and beans together. Wait until ready to eat; cover with crushed chips and dressing.

title: Church Supper Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef onion and celery. Drain fat. Return to pan and add tomato puree vinegar garlic brown sugar mustard and salt and pepper. Cook 10 minutes. Stir in cheese. Cook until cheese is melted. Serve on buns.

title: Rolls
instructions: Pour boiling water over margarine sugar and salt. Blend and cool. Add beaten eggs. Sprinkle yeast in cup of warm water. Add to mixture. Add flour one cup at a time. Cover and put in refrigerator for at least 4 hours.

title: Parmesan Potatoes
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into wedges no more than 1/2-inch at widest. Shake in a bag with flour and Parmesan cheese. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Put potatoes in pan taking care not to have them touch each other. Salt and pepper. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Use foil to cover the first half hour. Turn after 30 minutes and remove foil. Kids love these potatoes!

title: Hardee'S Biscuits
instructions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in Crisco and butter. Add buttermilk. Roll out; cut into biscuits. Makes about 2 dozen (according to size of biscuits you cut).

title: Browned Paprika Potatoes
instructions: Pare potatoes; brush with melted fat. Roll potatoes in mixture of cornflake crumbs paprika and salt. Bake covered in greased baking pan in hot oven (425\u00b0) about 45 minutes. Serves 6.

title: Lemon Pie(Eagle Brand Pie)
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and beat together. Add Eagle Brand milk and mix together. Add lemon juice and beat well. Pour in baked pie crust. Good to eat.

title: Key Lime Pie
instructions: Combine egg yolks and milk. Slowly add the lime juice. Pour into a baked pastry shell. Chill for 4 hours in the freezer. Before serving top with whip cream or meringue.

title: Clam Stew
instructions: Cook eggs until hard boiled and put aside. In medium pot simmer clams and butter. The add celery and onions. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add potatoes and cook until potatoes are done. Cut eggs into pieces and add to stew. Add enough milk to make stew as thick or as thin as you like.

title: Egg Custard Pie
instructions: Beat egg yolks stir in 1/2 cup sugar salt and nutmeg; add milk. Pour into pie shell and bake at 450\u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 300\u00b0 and bake about 45 minutes more or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Top with meringue and bake until brown.

title: Rich Cocoa Fudge
instructions: Stir together sugar cocoa and salt. Add milk. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture comes to a full boil. Without stirring boil to 234\u00b0. Remove from heat. Add oleo and vanilla. Do not stir. Let cool to 110\u00b0. Beat until it loses its gloss.

title: Spinach Quiche In A Rice Crust
instructions: Cook rice in water until tender; drain and mix with 1 beaten egg and tablespoon cheese. Press firmly into 9-inch pie pan to form crust. Bake crust 3 minutes in 425\u00b0 oven. Saute onion in margarine until slightly brown. Add to spinach nutmeg pepper and lemon juice. Put in crust; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Mix 2 eggs with milk and pour into quiche. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Lower temperature to 350\u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer. Done when center is firm. Makes 6 servings approximately 185 calories per serving.

title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Place in heavy-duty zip top plastic bag or shallow container. Add tenderloins turning to coat. Seal or cover and marinate in refrigerator at least 4 hours turning occasionally. Remove tenderloins from marinade discarding marinade. Grill tenderloins uncovered over medium coals (300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0) for 16 minutes or until meat thermometer inserted in thickest part registers (160\u00b0 for medium) 20 to 22 minutes for well-done (adjust thermometer) turning once. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine broccoli peanuts onion and raisins. Mix mayonnaise vinegar and sugar. Pour over other ingredients and mix well. Sunflower seeds may be used instead of peanuts.

title: Eggplant Casserole
instructions: Saute onion in bacon grease or butter and add tomatoes and eggplant (mashed slightly with potato masher). Add eggs; stir in cheese. Add bread crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Sherbet Array!
instructions: Mix ingredients in pitcher.

title: Peppermint Candy Ice Cream Pie
instructions: Combine chocolate wafer crumbs and butter in small bowl; mix well. Press over bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate. Combine ice cream and whipped topping in bowl; mix until smooth. Spoon into pie shell. Sprinkle with crushed candy. Freeze until firm. Garnish with additional crushed peppermint candy if desired. Yield 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Cut broccoli into florets. Add chopped onion and 1 cup of raisins. Mix together vinegar mayonnaise and sugar. Mix together. Crumble bacon on top.

title: Baked Apple
instructions: Spray dish. Place apple in dish and sprinkle ground cinnamon; bake in 350\u00b0 oven until tender. Remove from oven and sprinkle Equal over it.

title: Orange Slice Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs 1 at a time. Add flour alternately with buttermilk. Keep out about 1 cup of flour to roll dates and nuts in. Add coconut then add to butter mixture. Mix in dates nuts and orange slices. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. When cake is done leave in pan and put the following mixture over it.

title: Blackberry Pie
instructions: Mix sugar cornstarch and water and cook until thick and clear. Take off of heat and add jello to hot mixture. Cool. Put fresh blackberries in cooked pie crust. Pour mixture over berries. Keep in refrigerator. Serve with Cool Whip.

title: Candy Cane Cookies
instructions: If you like you may add peppermint or cherry flavoring to red coloring.

title: Green Tomato Pie
instructions: Use your favorite pie crust recipe.

title: Millie'S Picnic Punch
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Sweeten to taste. Serve over crushed ice.

title: Cherry Jello
instructions: Bring pie filling and Jell-O to boil. Add remaining ingredients. Do not drain pineapple. Refrigerate.

title: Hobo Beans By Sandra Day Peed
instructions: Drain excess juice off baked beans and kidney beans. Add to hamburger with remaining ingredients and put into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Cornstarch Bread(Modeling Clay)
instructions: Tear off bread crusts and feed to birds. Shred bread into fine crumbs in bowl. Add cornstarch and mix. Add glue and water. Mix with hands into a ball. May add more water if necessary. Knead until smooth and elastic (10 minutes). Model objects. This dough cuts and rolls thin and smooth. Dries without cracking.

title: Chicken Continental
instructions: Roll chicken in flour. Brown in butter. Remove chicken. Stir soup mixture into drippings. Cook and stir. Bring to a boil. Spread rice in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Pour all but 1/3 of soup mixture over rice. Stir to moisten. Top with chicken and rest of soup mixture. Bake covered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

title: Veggie Chili
instructions: Mix all together; simmer for an hour. Serves 4. Wonderful with crusty bread.

title: Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve the 2 boxes of jello in the boiling water mix in the cranberry sauce until smooth then add pineapple with juice. Pour into mold to gel.

title: Crescent Veggie Dinner Rolls
instructions: Place rolls in ungreased 11 x 14-inch pan. Bake until brown; let cool. Mix Miracle Whip sour cream cream cheese and Ranch dressing; spread over crust. Spread veggies over cream cheese mixture. Cover with Saran Wrap and press veggies down. Chill until ready to serve. Cut with pizza cutter and enjoy.

title: Chicken Pie
instructions: Crust Sift flour and salt together. Cut in butter and shortening until size of peas. Sprinkle water over mixture a little at a time while tossing lightly with a fork. Form into a ball. Place on floured board. Roll to form a rectangle 21 x 14-inches. Cut into six 7-inch squares.

title: Overnight Coffee Cake
instructions: Separate frozen roll dough into pieces (each cloverleaf makes 3 pieces). Combine dry pudding mix with brown sugar and chopped pecans. Melt margarine. Place pieces of frozen dough in a well-buttered Bundt pan. Pour melted margarine over frozen dough and sprinkle with dry pudding sugar and nut mixture. Leave pan out overnight covered with a towel; the dough rises beautifully by morning. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Invert on platter to serve.

title: Heavenly Pie
instructions: Fold all ingredients together and pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
instructions: Cream well shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift together 3 times and add to shortening and egg mixture flour baking powder baking soda and salt. Add half and half or sour cream. Drop batter into well-greased bread pans in layers. Between each layer sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon mix (3 parts sugar 1 part cinnamon). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Lasagna
instructions: Melt butter. Blend in flour salt and basil; stir in chicken broth and cook until thick and comes to a boil. Add chicken. Mix cottage cheese with egg. Place 1/3 of chicken mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with 1/2 of noodles 1/2 of cottage cheese 1/2 of Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers ending with chicken. Top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Split Cake
instructions: Mix 1 stick of butter and cracker crumbs. Pat into a dish. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 minutes or chill for one hour.

title: Crispy Cheese Sticks
instructions: Combine flour baking powder shortening and salt until mealy. Stir in cheese and enough milk for a soft but not sticky dough. Turn dough onto a lightly floured board; knead. Roll pieces of dough between palms to 1/2-inch in diameter and 4 inches long. Bake in an ungreased baking pan at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Cool and serve. Yields 20 to 24 sticks.

title: Frozen Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Whip the cream cheese until soft. Blend peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk; blend thoroughly. Fold in Cool Whip. Freeze in graham cracker crust.

title: Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except oleo and bread crumbs. Put in a well greased casserole dish. Put butter over top and add bread crumbs. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Nanny'S Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
instructions: Cook chicken until tender. Remove bones and cut up. Put in 12 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put soup and broth in saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over chicken and eggs. Combine oleo pepper flour and buttermilk. Mix thoroughly to form batter. Spoon or pour batter over top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Strawberry Surprise Jello
instructions: Pour gelatin into boiling water. When granules dissolve set aside to cool. Crushed bananas thawed strawberries and chopped nuts are added to cooled gelatin. One-half of the mixture is poured into pan and placed in refrigerator to congeal. Sour cream is spread over congealed gelatin and remainder of mixture is poured on top of sour cream. Pan is returned to refrigerator until top portion of the salad is congealed. Serves 6 to 8 persons. Make in 9-inch square pan.

title: Creamy First-Down Fudge
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Line 9-inch square pan with aluminum foil. Combine crumbs sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of prepared pan. Bake 8 minutes; cool. In heavy saucepan over low heat melt chocolate chips with Eagle Brand and vanilla. Remove from heat; stir in cheese until well blended. Stir in nuts. Spread over prepared crust. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Lift fudge from pan onto cutting board; peel off foil and cut into squares. Store covered in refrigerator. Makes about 2 pounds.

title: Baked Pears Delicious
instructions: Arrange pear halves cut side down in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside.

title: Lasagna(Low Cholesterol)
instructions: Brown beef in electric frypan with chopped onion. Add tomato juice tomato paste Worcestershire sauce and spices. Simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan layer 1/2 noodles 1/2 sauce 1/2 cottage cheese and 1/2 Parmesan cheese. Repeat all layers and sprinkle with parsley flakes. Cover with foil and let set at least 1/2 hour longer if desired. Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 to 25 minutes until top is brown. Let stand 20 minutes before cutting into 8 servings.

title: Pizzaburgers
instructions: Brown hamburger. Grind bologna American cheese and hamburger. Add to remaining ingredients (Prego sage garlic salt pepper and oregano). Spread on hamburger buns top with Mozzarella cheese and bake at 400\u00b0 until roll is browned and cheese is melted.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken for at least 3 hours. Remove chicken; reserve marinade. Grill chicken or bake at 350\u00b0. Baste often with marinade. Makes 4 servings. Each serving contains 151 calories and 3 g fat.

title: Shrimp And Olive Eggs(Appetizer)
instructions: Split eggs lengthwise. Mix mayonnaise mustard chopped olives and shrimp with the egg yolks. Stuff egg whites with this mixture. Garnish with baby shrimp and green olive slices. Serves 6.

title: Earthquake Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer coconut and chopped pecans. Pour cake mix over coconut and pecan layers.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Bars
instructions: Cream oleo sugar eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Mix flour soda and salt together. Add to above mixture and mix well. Spread batter in greased jelly roll pan. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over the batter. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 25 minutes.

title: Twinkie Cake
instructions: Cut Twinkies in half. Lay in bottom of cake pan. Mix pudding as box says. Drain pineapple. Add pineapple and bananas. Pour over Twinkies. Put in icebox for 30 minutes. Then take Cool Whip and spread over pudding. Add nuts.

title: Dutch Oven Meat Loaf Dinner
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly. Wrap in foil to form approximately 2-inch thick loaf. Place in center of foil-lined Dutch oven. Add chopped potatoes carrots and/or various other vegetables of your choice in the pan around the meat loaf.

title: Black Bean 'N Olive Salsa
instructions: In medium bowl mash 1/2 cup black beans with a fork. Stir in salsa remaining black beans olives corn lemon juice and remaining seasoning. Chill at least 1 hour to blend flavors. Serve as a dip with chips.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: In a mixing bowl mix the cream of chicken soup the cream of mushroom soup and the Lipton onion soup; mix together and add water to your soup cans just to get all soup out (just a little water); pour this into the mixture and stir.

title: Potatoes Duchess
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 9 1/2 x 13 casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. If desired during the last 15 minutes add 1 cup crushed potato chips on top.

title: Macaroni Beef
instructions: Saute beef macaroni onion green pepper and garlic powder in oil or water until macaroni turns slightly yellow. Drain off fat. Add tomato juice and seasonings; bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for several more minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: Morning Punch
instructions: Combine everything except ginger ale. Mix well and chill. Add ginger ale just before serving. Garnish each glass with a strawberry if desired. Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

title: **Frito Chili Pie
instructions: Mix meat and water so all meat is moist. Add all seasonings. Cook until meat is no longer pink. Alternate layers of meat and Fritos in baking dish. Add grated cheese. Add enough water to keep it moist while baking until done in a moderate oven.

title: Tufulis
instructions: Brown onion garlic and mushrooms then mix in large bowl with raw meat Mozzarella cheese eggs bread crumbs salt pepper and oregano. Mix well. Partially cook manicotti noodles in salt water. Stuff with meat mixture; place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with tomato sauce; sprinkle with cheese to taste. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes covered.

title: Oyster Soup(Servings:  8)
instructions: Melt the butter over medium heat in a 6-quart saucepan then saute the celery and green onions until tender but not browned stirring frequently. Gradually stir in the flour and cook 5 minutes longer stirring constantly over low heat. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and scoop out the bay leaves and discard. Serve immediately.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Mix first five ingredients until smooth in a bowl. On a 13 x 9-inch glass dish or large pie plate layer chopped tomatoes then lettuce. Spread on top the sauce from bowl. Sprinkle cheese on top. Stand taco chips on top. Serve others in bowl. Refrigerate.

title: Irish Coffee
instructions: Combine all ingredients except whiskey and whipping cream in 4 cup glass measure. Microwave for 8 to 9 minutes on High or until hot (about 200\u00b0). Stir in whiskey. Pour into mugs or glasses. Top with dollop of whipped cream. Do not allow liquid to boil or flavor will be bitter.

title: Zucchini Loaf
instructions: Beat eggs; gradually add sugar and oil. Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with grated zucchini. Stir in raisins and nut meats. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans (bread). Bake at 350\u00b0 for 55 minutes or until done (check). Cool at least 10 minutes before removing from pan.

title: Chicken Wing Recipe
instructions: Cut off tips and separate each wing at the joint. Sprinkle wings with salt and pepper to taste. Heat oil in deep-fat fryer or large heavy pot. When it is quite hot add half the wings and cook about 10 minutes stirring occasionally. When wings are golden brown and crisp remove them and drain well. Add remaining wings and repeat process. Meanwhile melt butter in saucepan add hot sauce to taste and vinegar. Pour hot sauce over wings and shake in bucket. Serve with Blue Cheese dressing and celery sticks.

title: Cheese Krispies
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Roll in small balls and mash with fork. Bake 15 minutes at 300\u00b0 to 350\u00b0.

title: Tea Cookies
instructions: Mix oil margarine sugar and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Slowly add flour salt and baking soda and mix well. Chill dough 1 to 2 hours. Shape dough in 1-inch balls space 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten cookie with a glass that is dipped each time in sugar. Bake 15 minutes at 300\u00b0. Cool. Store in airtight container. Makes 6 dozen.

title: Potato-Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown sausage and onions and drain. Mix milk soup and pepper together. In 9 x 9-inch dish layer one-half potatoes and one-half of soup mixture and one-half cheese and one-half sausage. Repeat. Cover with foil and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and sprinkle a little more Cheddar cheese over top. Return to oven until cheese melts.

title: Yogurt-Dill Sauce
instructions: Mix all but the last optional ingredient together adding salt and freshly ground pepper to taste. If desired sprinkle capers over top. Good for cold fish and game birds. Makes 1 cup.

title: Apple Cobbler
instructions: Melt 1 stick oleo in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place apples in a bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon. Mix flour baking powder salt and 1/2 cup margarine until it looks like crumbs. Add enough milk and mix until dough leaves sides. Boil sugar and water; let it come to a good boil and set aside. Roll dough to 1/4 inch thick. Spread apples on dough. Roll like jelly roll and slice in 16 slices. Place in buttered pan. Pour all of sugar-water syrup over apples and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Chocolate Dream Pie
instructions: Mix and pat into oblong pan. Bake 15 minutes at 400\u00b0. Remove from oven and immediately stir well with fork. Pat into pie plate reserving 1/4 cup to sprinkle on top.

title: Pennsylvania 8 Bean Soup
instructions: Wash beans and barley. Place in large kettle and cover with water to 2 inches above beans. Add 2 tablespoons salt. Soak overnight and drain in morning. Add 2 quarts water and ham bone or hock. Bring to boil and simmer slowly 2 hours stirring occasionally. Remove ham bone or hock. Cut off meat; chop and return to soup. Add onion tomatoes chili powder lemon juice sugar salt and pepper. Simmer 1 hour or more. Serve with tossed salad and corn bread or crusty French bread. Enjoy!

title: Hot Artichoke - Spinach Dip
instructions: Thaw and drain spinach and artichoke. Add all other ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Chili-Chicken Stew
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Cook chicken and next 5 ingredients in hot oil in a Dutch oven until lightly browned. Add tomatoes and next 5 ingredients; cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Top individual servings with remaining ingredients. Yield 6 servings.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Boil cabbage approximately 15 minutes then separate leaves. Cook rice and add to all the other ingredients. Put 1/4 to 1/2 cup mixture into cabbage leaves; roll and attach ends with toothpicks or put open end down.

title: Mexican Fruitcake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients well and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes 35 minutes if using glass dish.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cut steak into thin strips. Dust with flour and dash of pepper. In large skillet brown meat in butter. Add sliced mushrooms (drained) onion and garlic. Brown lightly. Stir in beef broth. Cover. Cook about 1 hour or until meat is tender. Stir occasionally. Gradually stir in sour cream. Heat about 5 minutes. Serve over 3 cups cooked noodles. Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili-Chicken Casserole
instructions: Line bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan with chips. In a large skillet over medium heat saute chicken onion and garlic in oil until chicken is opaque. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Pour over chips. Top with cheeses. Bake in a preheated oven at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

title: Cajun Ribs
instructions: Combine seasonings. Rub on all surfaces of ribs. Place ribs on covered grill over indirect heat. Grill for 1 1/2 hours. Cut ribs into serving-sized pieces. Makes 4 servings.

title: Taco Shells
instructions: Mix ingredients; add enough water for thin pancake batter consistency. Salt black skillet and heat. Put batter in by tablespoon. Put 2 to 3 tablespoons in skillet then tilt skillet until batter almost covers bottom. Fry until brown then turn.

title: Apricot Nut Bread
instructions: Soak apricots in 1 cup water for 30 minutes; drain well. Mix egg sugar and melted butter. Combine dry ingredients to sugar mixture alternately with orange juice. Fold in apricots and nuts. Pour into greased and floured bread pan. Bake in a 350\u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

title: Hot Rolls
instructions: In a large bowl dissolve dry yeast in warm water. Add sugar and salt. Beat and add shortening. Then add eggs and mix well. Add flour 2 cups at a time. I use 7 1/2 cups. Mix well. I use mixer up to 4 cups then mix the rest with my hands. Do not knead. Put into large greased bowl and let rise about 3 hours. I cover my bowl with a tea towel dampened with warm water. It keeps the dough from getting dry on top.

title: Mexican Style Potatoes
instructions: Slice potatoes thinly and lightly brown in bacon grease; set aside. Combine onions chilies tomatoes oregano cumin and garlic salt to make sauce. Mix potatoes with bacon and sauce and cook over low heat for 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Put in casserole and top with cheese. Heat in 350\u00b0 oven until the cheese melts.

title: Russian Cheese Babka
instructions: Combine cream cheese vanilla butter cherries cottage cheese raisins and pineapple; beat until smooth. With a moistened piece of cheesecloth line a clean flowerpot whole. Put in mix; put on a rack to drain in refrigerator overnight or longer. Unmold; garnish with candied cherries. Serves 6.

title: Roast Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in small bowl season with thyme garlic and seasoned salt. Brush on chicken. Season body cavity with butter mixture. Place in roasting pan. Brown in 400\u00b0 oven for 30 to 45 minutes uncovered. Stuff body cavity with cut celery sticks and onions. Add quartered potatoes and carrots to pan. Add 1 to 2 cups of water. Cover; roast in oven at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove chicken and vegetables. Thicken broth for gravy.

title: Avocado Salad
instructions: Mix together all ingredients except avocado and tomato. Fold in avocado and tomatoes.

title: Grandma Stephens' Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Sift flour soda and baking powder in a large bowl. Cream margarine and sugars; then beat eggs peanut butter and vanilla. Mix thoroughly and add to flour. Knead to form a smooth dough. Roll into hickory nut shaped balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet 1 inch apart. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Upon removing from oven place a chocolate star in the middle. Yield 7 dozen cookies.

title: Pheasant Stew With Sage Dumplings
instructions: Place pheasant pieces and the remaining ingredients in a casserole and add just enough boiling water to cover. Bring to a boil cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

title: Sausage, Tomatoes And Potatoes
instructions: Brown sausage potatoes onion and green pepper. Drain excess grease. Add seasonings and sauce. Simmer about 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Oven Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In plastic bag or bowl shake or toss all ingredients until all are coated. Empty into 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan. Bake stirring once 2 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 4 (1/2-cup) servings.

title: Chocolate Trifle
instructions: Bake brownies as directed on box let cool and then crumble into small pieces. Mix pudding as directed on box. Crumble candy into small pieces. Using a clear trifle bowl begin the layering of the ingredients-- 1/2 of the brownies next 1/2 of the pudding next 1/2 of the cool whip & 1/2 of the candy pieces -- and repeat layering all of the ingredients. Refrigerate. Enjoy after dinner!

title: Baked Steak
instructions: Heavily salt pepper and garlic salt both sides of steak. Place steak in a 1/2-inch high baking pan uncovered. Next spread ketchup over top. Add Worcestershire sauce and then place pats of butter on top. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes for medium steak. Do not cover or turn!! For well-done meat bake 5 to 10 minutes longer. Slice thin to 1/4-inch pieces. Serves 5 to 6 people.

title: Donna'S Chili
instructions: Brown meat. Saute onion and pepper. Then add all ingredients and simmer for 2 hours or more.

title: Waldorf Salad Cupcakes
instructions: Stir together flour soda salt and cinnamon. Put egg sugar and vanilla into a large bowl and beat with electric mixer at medium speed. Add mayonnaise until well blended. Add flour mixture and beat until smooth. Add apple walnuts and celery. Spoon into lined baking cups. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Makes 12.

title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugars pudding mix and vanilla in a large mixer bowl; beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheets about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 10 dozen.

title: Butterfinger Cheesecake
instructions: Make the graham cracker crust according to the side of the box. Press it into a spring-form pan and cook according to the box. Mix the cream cheese sugar and vanilla. Add the sour cream then add 1 egg at a time. Crust two of the candy bars and add to the mixture. Pour mixture into spring-form pan. Cook on 350\u00b0 for an hour or until golden brown. (It might be a little jiggly in the middle but thats okay.) Let it cool completely. Sprinkle the remaining crushed candy bar on top then remove the side of the pan.

title: Impossible Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well with electric mixer. Pour into pie plate and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Crumb Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and pour into a greased pan (11 x 17 x 1-inch). Bake 20 minutes at 350\u00b0. Meanwhile prepare the Crumb Mixture (following).

title: Libby'S Brown Rice Casserole
instructions: Butter baking dish along bottom and sides to prevent sticking. Mix ingredients and place in dish covered. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes; remove and stir. Bake an additional 30 minutes or longer or until rice has absorbed liquid. Makes a great side dish for beef chicken or pork.

title: Quick And Easy Chili
instructions: Dice onion; add to hamburger with garlic salt salt and pepper. Brown and drain. Add soup beans water and chili powder. Let simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serves about 8.

title: Fruit Sherbet
instructions: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups hot water. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Freeze stirring several times while freezing.

title: Shrimp Stew
instructions: Use twice the volume of water to the volume of ingredients. Season with a generous amount of salt and an abundance of seafood seasoning. Bring water to a boil and add first the sausage boil 7 to 8 minutes; then put the corn in and boil 8 to 10 minutes. Add shrimp and cook between 3 1/2 to 4 minutes. Drain all out preferably in a colander. Use the melted butter for the corn and cocktail sauce for the shrimp.

title: Dream Cookies
instructions: First preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Beat egg (whites) until frothy. Add pinch of salt. Gradually beat in sugar. Beat until real stiff. Add almond extract vanilla pecans and chocolate chips.

title: Meat Loaf
instructions: Mix ground beef oatmeal eggs onion spices and soup together thoroughly. Put into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix catsup mustard and brown sugar together thoroughly. Put on top of meat. Bake at 350\u00b0 to 375\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and onion. Mix with canned chili. Spread on bottom of oblong casserole dish. Spread sour cream carefully on top. Lay cheese slices on top of sour cream. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until cheese melts. Let cool then sprinkle Doritos on top. (Sour cream is optional.)

title: Strawberry Candies
instructions: Mix all ingredients except almonds food coloring and red sugar. Chill one hour or until firm. Using tablespoonfuls shape Jell-O mixture into strawberries. Roll in candied red sugar. Color almonds with green food coloring and insert into strawberry for stem.

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Combine sugar butter and milk in saucepan. Bring to a full rolling boil. Stir continually. Continue for 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir continually. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Add Marshmallow Creme and vanilla; beat until well blended. Pour into greased (butter) 9 x 13 baking dish. Cool at room temperature. Cut into squares.

title: Stir-Fry Chicken
instructions: Chicken Skin chicken and cut into chunks. In mixing bowl beat 2 eggs and 2 tablespoons of water; set aside. In a separate bowl add 1 cup of flour salt and pepper to taste. Add chicken to egg mixture then into flour mixture; coat well. In a stainless steel pan add about 1/2 cup oil. Make sure the oil is very hot. Fry chicken approximately 3 to 5 minutes or until it turns white. Remove from oil and drain well on napkins.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and oleo or oil. Add eggs and lightly hand beat. Add flour and other dry ingredients. Beat lightly again. Fold in carrots and nuts. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 40 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

title: Pita Bread
instructions: Put dry yeast in water and add sugar. Stir until yeast is dissolved. Add the flour and salt; mix well. Divide dough into 2 parts. Make into 18 or 20 equal sized balls and roll to 5-inches in diameter. Place on cookie sheet and let rise until puffy. Bake at 500\u00b0 for about 5 minutes until puffed but not too brown. Good with dips or stuffing for sandwiches.

title: Helen'S Soup
instructions: Mix chicken broth and tomato juice and bring to a boil. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for about 1/2 hour or until macaroni is done.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook on high in crock-pot for 6 or 7 hours.

title: Vegetable Chili
instructions: In large saucepot or Dutch oven saute zucchini green pepper onions celery carrots and garlic in oil until crisp-tender. Stir in tomatoes picante sauce water bouillon and cumin. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover; simmer 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in olives chili beans and garbanzo beans; simmer until thoroughly heated. Serve with cheese on top. Serves 6 (1 1/2 cups).

title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until thick. Stir constantly over low heat.

title: Pecan Pie
instructions: Sprinkle pecans in pie shell. Beat eggs in bowl. Add corn syrup melted butter and vanilla; mix well. Add mixture of flour and sugar. Pour over pecans. Let stand until pecans rise to top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield 6 servings.

title: 'Freshin' Fruit Drink
instructions: In a blender place broken bananas chunked melon and enough orange juice to help soften and mix fruits. Liquify until completely smooth. Add more orange juice if you want to thin it a bit more. Pour into tall glasses and sprinkle with cinnamon. Sip and enjoy.

title: Peanut Butter Surprise(A Recipe From Mrs. Lamberson'S Rarely Used Kitchen)
instructions: Mix sugar graham cracker crumbs peanut butter and melted butter or margarine together in medium bowl and firmly press into 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Chill for one hour.

title: Memaw Galik'S Pecan Brittles(Cookies)
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and beat until smooth. Sift flour soda baking powder and salt and add remaining ingredients Post Toasties pecans and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on well-greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 325\u00b0 until done.

title: Ham And Egg Pudding
instructions: Combine ham milk butter bread crumbs salt and pepper. Stir in egg yolks. Beat egg whites until they are stiff but not dry. Fold egg whites into egg yolk mixture. Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish that has been rubbed with butter. Bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for 20 to 25 minutes or until firm to the touch. Serve at once.

title: New Guinnies
instructions: Wilt cabbage leaves. Shape hamburger meat and other ingredients into balls except tomato juice. Roll in cabbage leaves and fasten with toothpicks. Cook 1 1/2 hours in tomato juice. Yields 40.

title: Rice Pilaf
instructions: Brown rice in butter until slightly brown; add salt and boiling broth. Cover and let simmer until liquid is absorbed about 30 minutes.

title: Raw Applesauce Cake
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients together. Sift together flour and spices. Add last 3 ingredients. Bake at 350\u00b0 for about one hour. Top with whipped cream.

title: Rotel Chicken
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Remove chicken from bones; skin and cut into pieces. Cook noodles in broth; drain and add cheese. Saute peppers and onion in butter. When soft add Ro-Tel. Then add this to noodles cheese and chicken. Stir until cheese is melted.

title: Broccoli And Rice Bake
instructions: Cook chopped celery and onion in frying pan in melted margarine until golden. Combine soup water and cheese. Thaw broccoli in water in saucepan until just thawed (about 2 minutes). Cook rice according to package directions. Combine all ingredients and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Chicken Chow Mein Noodle Casserole
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Let stand 30 minutes to 1 hour. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 6.

title: Miniature Cream Puffs
instructions: Put water and butter in saucepan and\tbring to boil melting butter. Take pan off stove and add flour and salt and stir until dough forms a ball. Add eggs one at a time until well blended. Spoon by heaping teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet covered with parchment paper. Bake at 375\u00b0 until puffed up and browned. Do not underbake as they will fall. Fill with chicken salad ham salad or pudding.

title: Baked Meat Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into balls. Place in casserole.

title: Cheese Ring
instructions: Grate cheese. Mix together cheese nuts onion and mayonnaise. Place in mold and let chill overnight. Remove from mold and serve with jam and crackers.

title: Squash Dressing
instructions: Combine all ingredients and bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

title: Meringue Pie
instructions: Beat egg whites and baking powder until whites are stiff. Beat in sugar. Fold in graham crackers and nuts. Bake in 9-inch buttered pie pan at 325\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Thaw broccoli in small amount of boiling water; drain. Combine the cottage cheese cubed Cheddar cheese broccoli unbeaten eggs and seasonings. Sprinkle flour over all and mix together. Place in buttered casserole dish. Place dish in pan of water and bake 1 hour at 350\u00b0.

title: Barbecue Beans
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Put in crock-pot and cook on low overnight.

title: Company Chicken
instructions: Remove skin from chicken breasts. Salt and pepper it to your own liking. Wrap it with a slice of bacon. Line casserole with slices of dried beef. Place slices over chicken. Mix sour cream and mushroom soup together and spread over chicken. Bake at 325\u00b0 for about 3 hours. Serve with baked potatoes or wild rice.

title: English Toffee Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter with sugar. Add unbeaten egg yolk. Add flour and salt. Spread dough into 9 x 13-inch greased glass pan. Beat egg white until stiff and spread over dough. Sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while still warm.

title: Rhubarb Punch
