instructions: Boil together the fruit water sugar and lemon juice until the fruit is soft then strain and add the Jell-O while the mixture is still hot. It may be frozen at this point to serve at a later time. To Serve Mix equal parts of the juice with 7-Up.

title: Hamburger-Spaghetti Casserole
instructions: Brown meat and drain. In a casserole (9 x 13-inch) layer hamburger meat cooked spaghetti butter and cheese. Do layers again. Heat cream of mushroom soup and milk together until smooth. Pour over casserole. Cook at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Mock Strawberry Jam
instructions: Boil first 3 ingredients for 20 minutes. Add jello. Put in sterile jars.

title: Smothered Steak
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet. Cut round steak into four pieces. Dip each piece in seasoned flour. Brown in hot oil add water. Cover and cook slowly for 1 hour. Add onions salt and pepper; cover and continue cooking until tender.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Slice carrots thin and cook until tender. Slice onion thin and arrange layers of carrots and onion until used up.

title: Dirt(Child-Approved)
instructions: Cream together butter and cream cheese. Add powdered sugar. Mix in pudding and milk until blended. Add Cool Whip. In blender or food chopper grind Oreo cookies to a fine dirt-like consistency. Layer mixture in a clear bowl (or flower pot) starting with cookie pudding cookie pudding and ending with cookie. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Add a plastic flower or gummy worms and serve. (Many thanks to Dorothy Larkin!)

title: Rainbow Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in refrigerator.

title: Never Fail Fudge
instructions: Put sugar cocoa and milk in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat; lower heat to medium high and boil for 7 minutes. Drop in margarine dont stir and cook 5 more minutes. Add vanilla and nuts and beat\tuntil set. Pour quickly into a buttered dish. Cut into squares when cool.

title: Peach Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate.

title: Banana Bread Variations
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0 and grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.

title: Mom'S Filled Cookies
instructions: Cream butter sugar and eggs. Add milk alternately with flour until have a stiff dough. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter sugars vanilla and pudding mix in large bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by teaspoonful onto ungreased baking sheet spacing about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen cookies.

title: Ground Meat Main Dish
instructions: In a bowl combine meat crumbs and milk. Mix well. Shape into 36 meat balls. Drain pineapple (keep juice). In a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish combine pineapple juice soy sauce oil and seasonings. Add meat balls. Cover. Refrigerate overnight. Turn once. Drain meat balls. Keep marinade.

title: Sparkling Cranberry Cooler
instructions: In a glass pitcher combine all ingredients except soda stirring to mix. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until well chilled. To serve stir in soda and add ice if desired. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Fry hamburger meat; drain grease. Put in casserole dish and sprinkle onion soup mix. Cook green beans and put them next. Pour mushroom soup over top then Tater Tots and cover with grated cheese.

title: Low-Fat Banana Snack Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. Lightly grease 9-inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl mix banana egg substitute buttermilk 1/2 cup of the brown sugar applesauce and vanilla extract until blended. Stir in flour baking powder and baking soda until smooth. Scrape into prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons brown sugar and cinnamon. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until pick inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Easy Chicken Pie
instructions: Mix first 3 ingredients and pour into oblong casserole dish. Slice eggs and place over chicken mixture. Mix together milk flour and butter; pour over eggs and chicken mixture. Do not stir! Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is brown.

title: Incredible Melted Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Spray Bundt pan with vegetable oil spray and dust with flour. Shake out the flour and set aside. Place cake mix melted ice cream and eggs in a large mixing bowl. Blend with electric mixer on low speed for 1 minute. Stop mixer; scrape down sides and continue beating 2 more minutes. Pour into prepared pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 38 to 42 minutes. Place on wire rack; cool for 20 minutes. Run a long sharp knife around edge and flip cake onto a small rack. Then flip again onto serving plate. Super Duper. You have to try it!

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and molasses and beat well. Add spices soda and salt. Mix well. Gradually add flour. Dough will become very stiff and may require mixing by hand. Form 1-inch balls from dough. Roll in granulated sugar and place 2-inches apart on cookie sheet. Dont flatten. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. They shouldnt be overly brown when taken out of the oven. They will be puffed up when taken from oven but will be snappy when cooled.

title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
instructions: Mix cauliflower broccoli and onion rings in a bowl. In container with lid mix the following mayonnaise sugar vegetable oil vinegar salt and pepper. Shake until mixed. Pour mixture over vegetables and chill overnight. Before serving fry 2 to 3 pieces of bacon then crumble on top of salad.

title: Nachos Grande
instructions: Place chips on large plate. Heat chili. Combine Monterey Jack and Colby cheeses; heat until melted. Pour immediately over chips. Pour chili over cheese and chips. Top with tomatoes black olives green olives and sliced peppers to taste. May add sour cream on top.

title: Spiced Hot Tea
instructions: Boil water. Pour over tea bags and steep. Place cinnamon sticks and cloves in 1 quart of water and simmer 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil and serve or store in refrigerator in covered jars. Keeps indefinitely.

title: Dishpan Cookies
instructions: Mix together and drop by spoon. Bake on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees about 8 - 10 minutes. Add 1/2 cup of raisins if you want. For a chewy cookie bake about 8 minutes.

title: Fruit Cobbler
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Pour fruit into pan with the melted butter. If using fresh fruit sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over the fruit (canned fruits can also be used). Mix all the ingredients together; pour over fruit. Crust will rise to the top. Cook for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Custard Pie
instructions: Mix sugar vanilla salt nutmeg and eggs well beaten. Add 2 cups hot milk according to the size of your crust. Stir well. Bake 10 minutes at 425\u00b0. Turn oven back to 375\u00b0 and bake until silver knife comes out clean about 25 to 30 minutes.

title: Johnny Mazette
instructions: Brown beef sausage onion and pepper together. Add celery mushrooms tomato juice and tomatoes. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Add cooked noodles. Just before serving add 3/4 package Velveeta cheese.

title: Mexican Dip
instructions: Peel pit and mash avocado with lemon juice; set aside. Combine mayonnaise taco seasoning mix and sour cream; set aside. Spread bean dip in shallow bowl 1-inch deep. Spread sour cream mix over beans. Layer avocado mix next. Sprinkle onions tomatoes and olives. Cover with cheese. Serve at room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Parm-A-Chicken
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Combine cheese flour and seasonings. Dip chicken in combined egg and milk. Coat with cheese mixture. Place in 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Pour margarine over chicken and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve sprinkled with additional cheese. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

title: Neiman'S Cookie Recipe
instructions: Cream butter and both sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with dry ingredients. Add chips candy and nuts. Roll into balls. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet and bake at 375\u00b0 for 6 minutes.

title: Meatballs Stroganoff
instructions: With fork combine hamburger milk bread crumbs parsley 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Shape into 1 3/4 inch meatballs. Brown in 2 tablespoons hot oil in 12-inch skillet. In another pan heat 2 tablespoons oil. Cook onion and mushrooms with paprika until tender 5 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle flour over mixture. While stirring add beef broth. Place meatballs in mixture. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and sour cream. Heat through careful not to boil. Serve over hot rice and sprinkle with dill.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Saute green pepper in margarine until soft. Mix with mushroom soup pimentos and mushrooms. In 9 x 12 x 2-inch casserole dish layer 1 can green beans 1/2 soup mixture 1 can French fried onions and 2 cups cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 450\u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Chicken(Good Over Rice)
instructions: Put chicken in bottom of baking dish. Blend soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken. Combine margarine crumbs and poppy seed. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Orange Punch
instructions: Mix together all ingredients to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Pepper Relish
instructions: After chopping drain peppers and onions. Add sugar vinegar mustard seed and salt. Mix together and bring to a boil then let simmer for 30 minutes. Seal in hot sterile jars.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients then chill for 1 hour.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on. When cooked slip skins off. With electric mixer whip potatoes butter sugar cinnamon nutmeg and enough milk to make potatoes smooth and creamy. Add coconut raisins and walnuts. If desired add more cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into baking dish. Cover entire top of casserole with marshmallows. Push marshmallows 1/4 way into top of potatoes. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes or until marshmallows are slightly browned.

title: Hot Stuff
instructions: I let these remain in the liquid but you may tie up the spices in a cheesecloth bag to later remove them. Add 8 garlic buds to the pickles. Bring the liquid to a boil stirring constantly and pour it cautiously little by little to avoid breaking the glass bottle. Cover and leave at least a week or 10 days. It is the sugar that makes the pickles so crisp so dont skimp on the sugar. You will be delightfully surprised at the results from this recipe.

title: Golden Coins(Marinated Carrots)
instructions: Cook carrots 10 minutes or just until tender-crisp. Drain and cool. Add sliced onion and chopped green pepper. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables. Chill. Refrigerate. Can be kept in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.

title: Stroganoff Meatballs
instructions: Combine hamburger oats egg ketchup onion and salt. Mix thoroughly and shape into 24 (1-inch) balls. Place in baking dish and bake at 450\u00b0 until done. Cook noodles in boiling water for 20 to 30 minutes stirring occasionally. Drain. Melt butter in same pan; add noodles and parsley. Toss to coat noodles with parsley butter. Cover to keep warm. Combine soup and sour cream in medium saucepan. Stir in milk and paprika. Mix well. Fold in meatballs. Cook over medium-low heat stirring frequently until hot. Serve over noodles.

title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients. Add maple syrup.

title: Cheese Rice Spinach Casserole
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350\u00b0 in a greased uncovered casserole dish for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until custard is set and not runny. Good served with meat loaf or as an appetizer.

title: Pumpkin Bread
instructions: Mix sugar oil eggs and pumpkin together. Add the other ingredients and mix until blended well. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Pumpkin Pie
instructions: Prebake 9-inch deep dish pie crust until slightly brown. Mix all ingredients and pour into crust. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 45 minutes until center is firm.

title: Japanese Fruit Pie
instructions: Beat eggs; add melted butter. Mix sugar and vinegar. Add nuts coconut and raisins. Pour in pie shell. Bake at 300\u00b0 about 1 hour.

title: Dr. Woodruff'S Poppy Seed Bread (Cake)
instructions: Mix all the ingredients and spread into a sheet cake pan or two 8-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 until doneness (according to size pan used). Frost with cream cheese icing.

title: Hush Puppies
instructions: Mix corn meal salt and baking powder. Stir in buttermilk and egg. When well mixed add onions. Drop by teaspoon into hot grease. Dip spoon in water between each hush puppy. Serves 4.

title: 1000 Springs Trout Amandine
instructions: Clean and bone trout. Lay flat on lightly oiled sheet of foil on a broiler pan. Brush the boneless trout lightly with melted butter and sprinkle Summer Savory over it. Meanwhile saute 1 tablespoon of sliced almonds in butter until nicely brown. Add lemon juice. Broil trout for about 2 minutes under high heat (about 550\u00b0). Remove from broiler. Spread the sauteed almonds lightly over the trout and return to oven for another 2 minutes at lower heat. Garnish with lemon slices and parsley and serve immediately.

title: Nancy'S Jello Mold
instructions: Oil your mold. Dissolve jello in hot water and add strawberries pineapple and nuts. Pour half of mixture in the mold and refrigerate. When it congeals about 2 or 3 hours spread sour cream over it then pour other half over that. Let congeal overnight. I serve on romaine lettuce.

title: Shrimp Jambalaya
instructions: Saute shrimp in oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat until opaque. Remove; set aside. Add garlic to skillet. Saute 30 seconds. Add enough water to broth to make 2 cups. Add tomatoes broth mixture salt thyme and pepper to skillet. Bring to boil. Add okra. Lower heat cover and simmer 10 minutes or until okra is tender. Remove from heat; stir in rice ham shrimp lemon juice and red pepper. Cover; let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle green onions on top. Serves 4.

title: Banana Pudding
instructions: Combine sugar flour and salt in double boiler. Stir in milk; cook over boiling water stirring until thickened. Cook for 15 minutes longer stirring occasionally. Cool. Beat eggs; stir into cooled mixture gradually. Cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Line bowl with wafers. Top with sliced banana. Pour part of filling over bananas. Continue layers ending with wafers crumbled on top. Chill and serve.

title: Six-Layer Dinner
instructions: Season each layer as it is placed in the baking dish with salt and pepper. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 350\u00b0.

title: Gingersnaps
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Form into ball and wrap in foil. Chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450\u00b0. In a large plastic Ziploc bag place all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty into shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered stirring occasionally for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish if desired with chopped parsley.

title: Pineapple Chess Pie
instructions: Mix sugar and flour together. Beat eggs and add to sugar and flour mixture with other ingredients. Bake in an uncooked pie shell at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Company Potatoes
instructions: In a large bowl combine potatoes undiluted soups sour cream milk and onion. Stir until well mixed and season with salt pepper and dill weed. Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle with grated cheese and paprika. Bake an additional 1/2 hour.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Cream Crisco and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add oatmeal and pecans. Shape in rolls. Wrap in waxed paper and chill. Slice thin and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes.

title: No Peek Chicken Bake
instructions: Place rice in bottom of large greased roaster. Mix soups and milk and pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle with dry ingredients. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake 3 hours at 325\u00b0.

title: Pizza Crust
instructions: Mix with mixer 30 seconds. Beat at high speed for 3 minutes or by hand. Knead by hand until smooth. Shape into ball. Let rise until double the size. Punch down and divide into 4 parts. Press into pizza pans. Bake at 500\u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes until starts to brown. Makes 4 crusts.

title: Taffy Apple Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Roll out cookie dough onto a 14-inch round pan or stone. Bake 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Blend peanut butter cream cheese brown sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread onto cookie.

title: Mocha-Peanut Sundae Sauce
instructions: Melt all ingredients together in saucepan or in microwave. Stir in vanilla. Very good served warm over any flavor ice cream.

title: Fruit Tart
instructions: Blend like for a pie crust the flour and Crisco. Add baking powder and salt. Combine with milk sugar eggs and vanilla. Take away about 1/4 of dough and add more flour to this part for the lattice work. Press the rest into 13 x 20 x 3/4-inch pan. Fill with 1 1/2 to 2 cans pie filling. Take the 1/4 of dough that you have saved and crisscross strips of dough to create a lattice work. Bake 45 minutes at 350\u00b0. The tart will be done when bubbling and a toothpick inserted at the edge comes out clean.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Pierce potatoes with fork. Bake at 425\u00b0 until tender. Slice potatoes into halves lengthwise. Scoop pulp into mixer bowl reserving shells. Add milk margarine salt pepper and 1 cup cheese to pulp; beat until smooth. Stir in half the green onions and bacon. Spoon into reserved shells; place on baking sheet. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes; increase oven temperature to 400\u00b0. Toss remaining green onions and bacon with 1/2 cup cheese in bowl. Sprinkle over potatoes. Bake for 15 minutes longer or until cheese melts. Yield 8 servings.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Combine ingredients until mixed.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Heat deep pot; add oil and butter. Add onions; season with salt pepper and 1 teaspoon thyme. Cook onions 15 to 18 minutes stirring frequently until tender sweet and caramel colored. Add bay leaf and sherry (optional) to the pot and deglaze the pan drippings. Add beef stock and cover pot to boil soup to quick boil. Arrange 4 small deep soup bowls or crocks on a cookie sheet. Place broiler on high. Once soup reaches a boil ladle into bowls. Float toasted bread on soup and cover each bowl with mound of cheese. Sprinkle remaining thyme on cheese and place pan and soup bowls under hot broiler until cheese melts and bubbles.

title: Easy Potato Soup
instructions: Put potatoes and onion in 3-quart saucepan; pour water in just enough to cover potatoes. Cook on medium heat until potatoes are done. Add salt. Mash potatoes by hand. Add cream of chicken soup and Velveeta. Turn fire down to low-medium. When cheese is melted its ready.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Allow to set at least 1/2 hour before serving.

title: Napa Cabbage Salad
instructions: Cut cabbage lengthwise and cross-wise and chopped onions to cabbage. Brown roman noodles in 1 cube oleo. Add nuts and sunflower seeds brown well. Add to cabbage and onions.

title: Zucchini Crescent Pie
instructions: Heat oven to 375\u00b0. In large pot cook zucchini and onion in margarine until tender (10 minutes). Stir in seasoning. In large bowl blend eggs and cheese. Stir in vegetable mix. Separate crescent dough and press over bottom and sides of pie dish. Pour vegetable mix evenly over crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Cheesecake (1)
instructions: Mix jello and hot water chill until jelly like. Mix graham crackers powdered sugar and melted butter; use as crust and topping in a 9 X 13 pan. Cream the cream cheese vanilla & sugar. Chill and whip the evaporated milk. Mix the cream cheese mixture with the jello mixture fold in the evaporated milk. Pour on graham cracker crust sprinkle with remaining crumbs.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Combine butter garlic chives parsley salt rosemary and pepper; mix well. Place on waxed paper. Pat into 8-inch roll. Freeze until firm. Place each piece between 2 sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap; pound with mallet until 1/4 inch thick. Divide butter into 8 portions. Place one portion in center of each chicken piece. Tuck in ends; roll up chicken tightly. Secure with toothpicks. Combine milk and egg. Dip chicken pieces in milk mixture. Roll in bread crumbs. Place chicken in a single layer in a shallow baking pan. Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Add garlic tomatoes sauce salt pepper oregano and mushrooms. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Cook lasagne noodles in boiling water about 15 minutes. Drain noodles. Layer a 9 x 13-inch casserole alternately with noodles Mozzarella cheese sauce Parmesan cheese and ending on top with a layer of sauce and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 370\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. Mix thoroughly the shortening and sugar. Gradually blend in flour. Add eggs one at a time mixing well after each addition. Spread half of the dough in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover dough with pie filling. Spoon remaining dough over pie filling (it is not necessary to cover all of the pie filling). Bake 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chicken With 40 Cloves Of Garlic
instructions: Coat the chicken pieces with olive oil. Lay the chicken in a casserole with tight fitting lid. Add the garlic cloves and herbs and all the remaining olive oil. Cover. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hrs. without removing lid. Serve with French bread.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain on paper towels and reserve drippings. Saute onion in reserved bacon drippings until tender; set aside. Combine potatoes water salt and pepper in a saucepan; cook over medium heat just until potato is tender. Stir in clams milk butter and onion; simmer 3 minutes or until well heated. Crumble bacon over each serving. Yields 2 servings.

title: Oatmeal Bread
instructions: Combine oatmeal brown sugar butter whole-wheat flour and salt. Stir in 2 cups boiling water.

title: Green Chicken Enchilada Casserole
instructions: Meat Boil Chicken breast till meat is fully cooked/cool/shred chicken.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Bake 10 minutes at 400\u00b0.

title: Ice Cream Delight
instructions: Crush crackers fine. Melt butter and mix with crackers and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream (softened) and milk. Add instant pudding. Pour on top of cracker mixture. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped nuts or crushed Ritz crackers. Put in freezer at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Chocolate Eclair
instructions: Mix pudding according to directions; combine with container of Cool Whip. Put 1 layer of graham crackers and then 1/2 of pudding mixture. Then put 1 more layer of graham crackers and remainder of pudding mixture. Then put 1 final layer of graham crackers. Open container of instant frosting. Place can in double boiler or a saucepan with some warm water. Heat until frosting melts. Pour over the mixture and refrigerate.

title: Becky'S Chocolate Icing
instructions: If you prefer dark chocolate icing use semi-sweet chips. If you prefer mild chocolate icing use milk chocolate chips.

title: Best Breakfast Gravy
instructions: Open the bacon package at one end and cut crosswise the package so that you have small pieces of bacon (about 1 to 1 1/2 cups) depending on how much gravy you want to make. Brown bacon pieces in skillet. When browned dip the pieces out leaving the drippings; set aside.

title: Minnesota Hot Dish A La Garrison
instructions: Brown hamburger and sausage. Combine all ingredients. Turn into casserole and bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

title: Mississippi Mud Cake
instructions: Melt margarine. Add cocoa and eggs. Add flour sugar and pecans. Mix well. Grease and flour a 1 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Spread mixture in pan and bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Cake is done when sides pull away from pan. Remove and while hot pour 1 small bag of miniature marshmallows over top then put pan back in oven until marshmallows are soft. Remove and spread with topping.

title: Strawberry Cheese Cake
instructions: Reserve syrup from strawberries. Blend gelatin sugar and salt in double boiler. Stir in reserved syrup and eggs. Place over boiling water and cook 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla lemon peel juice and food coloring. Beat cream cheese until fluffy and add gelatin mixture to cheese gradually beating after each addition until smoothly blended. Whip heavy cream until soft peaks form. Fold into cheese mixture. Fold in drained pineapple and strawberries. Pour mixture over crust in a 9-inch spring-form pan. Place in refrigerator to chill overnight. Garnish as desired.

title: Tangy Beef Barbecue Sandwiches
instructions: Cut meat in chunks and place in Dutch oven. Combine remaining ingredients on top of meat. Heat until boiling. Simmer in oven at 250\u00b0 for 6 hours. Pick apart meat with a fork. Makes 30 \tangy\ sandwiches.

title: Taco Dip
instructions: Spread beans on large platter. Mix sour cream mayonnaise and seasoning. Spread on beans. Top with cheese tomatoes and black olives. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Butterfinger Cake
instructions: Mix together butter powdered sugar Cool Whip vanilla butter nut flavoring and candy bars. Pinch 1/2 of angel food cake into bite size pieces in a bowl or pan with a lid. Then pour 1/2 of the Cool Whip mixture over it and 1/2 of the candy. Repeat the order 1/2 of the cake Cool Whip mixture and candy on top.

title: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease an 8 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle rice over bottom. Heat the 2 cans of soup with the milk stirring until blended. Pour over rice. Put chicken over rice and sprinkle with onion soup mix. Seal pan with foil. Bake in a slow oven (325\u00b0) for at least 2 hours.

title: Pumpkin Cake
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients; set aside. Combine sugar and eggs in a large bowl and beat at high speed with mixer until light and fluffy. Add oil vanilla and pumpkin until blended. Gradually add flour mixture until blended. Add flour mixture beating at low speed. Pour batter into 9-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

title: Rum Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour.

title: Swedish Apple Pie
instructions: Butter pie plate. Fill with apples; sprinkle on cinnamon nutmeg and sugar.

title: Saucy Pork Chops
instructions: Heat oil and brown pork chops. Pour off fat and set aside. Add soup and water to pan. bring to a boil and return chops to pan. Reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until chops are no longer pink.

title: Barbecue Short Ribs
instructions: Mix together vinegar Worcestershire sauce salt red pepper paprika chili powder catsup and water. Pour over ribs and sliced onion in Dutch oven. Cook for 2 hours over low heat.

title: Country Club Squash Casserole
instructions: Wash squash and trim off ends. Cook squash and onion in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Drain again. Combine squash sour cream salt pepper and basil. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Combine bread crumbs cheese margarine and paprika. Sprinkle over squash mixture. Top with bacon. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield 6 to 8 servings.

title: Strawberry Pie
instructions: Mix jello sugar and cornstarch then add water and cook until thick. Remove from heat and add strawberries. Pour into baked pie shell. Cool in refrigerator. Put Cool Whip on top. Very good.

title: Peanut Butter Cups
instructions: Put all ingredients in a double boiler and melt (stirring often). Spoon into bonbon cups.

title: Shrimp Ball
instructions: Let cream cheese soften outside fridge for about 20 minutes. Mix together all ingredients until well blended and form into a ball (or 2 small balls). Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: King Ranch Chicken
instructions: Boil hen until tender in water seasoned with onion celery salt and pepper. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and reserve all stock. Chop onion and bell pepper; combine soups and grated cheese. Just before putting casserole together soak the frozen tortillas in boiling chicken stock until wilted. Start layering casserole in 9 x 12-inch baking dish in following order tortillas chicken onion bell pepper soup mixture and cheese. Repeat the layers being sure the tortillas are oozing with the stock. Cover the casserole with the Ro-Tel tomatoes and all the juice. Juice in the casserole should be about half the depth of the dish if not add a little more stock. Make at least 1 day ahead so that the juices will blend. Bake uncovered at 375\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Butterscotch Pecan Pound Cake
instructions: Beat butter and cream cheese on medium speed 2 minutes until creamy. Add sugar gradually beating on medium 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs one at a time; beat until yellow just disappears. Gradually add flour and mix on low speed until blended after each addition. Stir in flavorings nuts and butterscotch morsels. Spoon into greased and floured 12-cup tube pan. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes. Remove and let cool completely.

title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
instructions: Cook rice. Combine broccoli soup milk butter and dry onion mix. Mix into a large skillet; bring to boil over medium heat. Lower heat cover and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in rice; heat jar of cheese. Pour into mixture. Pour into greased 2 quart baking dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top. Sprinkle shredded cheese over top. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Oh So Rich Lasagna
instructions: Preheat over to 350\u00b0. Brown hamburger meat drain and add sauce and let simmer. Mix egg with ricotta cheese and set aside. Cook noodles in water and a little oil until tender. Spray bottom of pan with oil and sprinkle with salt. Layer as follows noodles most of sauce noodles ricotta cheese noodles rest of sauce and mozzarella cheese. Bake about 40 minutes in 9 x 13 glass dish.

title: Texas Pecan Cake
instructions: Mix together nuts and raisins and coat with some of the flour. Mix all other ingredients together then add nuts and raisins and mix. Bake in a tube pan at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Mint Punch
instructions: Mix all juices with mint and sugar. Stir well to dissolve. Add sodas sherbet and berries. Chill well. Serves approximately 45 (6 ounce) glasses or about 2 gallons.

title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
instructions: In saucepan cook carrots covered in small amount of lightly salted water until just tender (15 minutes). Add green pepper; cover and cook 3 minutes more. Drain. Drain the pineapple reserving juice. Add water to make 1/3 cup of liquid. In saucepan combine sugar cornstarch and salt. Stir in pineapple liquid vinegar and soy sauce. Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in vegetables and pineapple. Heat through. Makes 6 servings.

title: Broccoli Casserole
instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Place in buttered 9 x 9-inch casserole. Combine bread crumbs and butter and spread over broccoli mixture. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Hot Broccoli Dip
instructions: Melt margarine and add onions and broccoli. Simmer for 5 minutes then add cheese and stir until melted. Add mushrooms and almonds; stir until heated. Serve with crackers or chips.

title: Blueberry (Or Other Fruit) Cheesecake
instructions: Blend the graham cracker crumbs 1/2 cup sugar and melted butter well. Pat firmly on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat together the cream cheese eggs vanilla and 2 cups sugar while preparing crust. Put on crust. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.

title: Scalloped Chicken
instructions: Remove bone and skin from chicken and chop. Arrange in a greased 2 to 2 1/2-quart casserole. Make thin gravy with broth flour and chicken fat. Pour 3/4 of gravy over chicken. Make dressing with dry bread salt melted oleo sage chopped onion and cream combined. Arrange dressing over chicken and gravy then pour remainder of gravy over dressing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: Rose'S Vanilla Wafer Cake
instructions: Cream margarine and Imperial granulated sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla wafer crumbs coconut pecans cherries and vanilla flavoring. Put in well-greased and floured 9-inch angel food cake pan or Bundt pan. Bake 2 hours at 275\u00b0 or until done. Let cake cool thoroughly in pan (at least 6 hours) before removing from pan.

title: Pineapple Fingers
instructions: Drain pineapple. Mix cake mix egg yolks butter and flavoring. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually beat in sugar. Fold in coconut and pineapple. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 325\u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Cut into finger strips.

title: Ice Cream Soda
instructions: Begin recipe just before serving.

title: Potato Patch Casserole
instructions: Brown hamburger and seasoning. Mix potatoes peas and carrots in bottom of a 9 x 15-inch pan. Add hamburger and cover with cheese sauce. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are done.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage until done. Drain. Saute onion in margarine; add cheese and stir until melted. Add soup. Put 3/4 cup stuffing mix in dish. Add cabbage. Pour cheese mixture over cabbage and top with remaining stuffing. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 minutes.

title: Cheese Bone Cookies For Dogs
instructions: Combine flour cheese garlic & oil in food processor. Whirl until mixture is consistency of corn meal with machine running slowly add water until mixture forms into a ball.

title: Piccalilli
instructions: Slice tomatoes and onions thin then let stand overnight. Drain next morning. Mix vinegar sugar salt and spices. Add tomatoes and onions; bring to boil. Put in jars and seal.

title: Peanut Butter Delight
instructions: Bring margarine cocoa sugar and milk to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Mix in the remaining ingredients constantly stirring. Spoon onto wax paper. Let stand 10 minutes.

title: Spicy Honey Chicken Wings
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 3-quart baking dish. Add chicken wings and toss to coat; cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Uncover dish and bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Serves 8.

title: Fire And Ice Tomatoes
instructions: Skin tomatoes and cut into quarters. Slice peppers into strips. Slice onion into thin rings. Arrange vegetables into neat sections in a large Pyrex bowl. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and boil furiously for one minute. Pour over vegetables. Cool slightly and refrigerate. Just before serving sliced cucumbers can be added.

title: Grustoli
instructions: Beat eggs sugar and oleo. Add lemon juice and dry ingredients. Roll out dough as for very very thin pie crust. Strips should be 2 1/2-inches wide any length. Cut crosswise sort of like a diamond shape. Fry in hot oil. Turn quickly as these cook fast. Remove and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Chicken And Rice Dinner
instructions: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned. Remove chicken. Add soup water paprika and pepper. Stir; heat to a boil. Stir in rice and broccoli. Top with chicken. Cook on low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
instructions: Grease bottom of pan with shortening. Put a layer of onion bell pepper tomatoes and celery. Brown chicken on both sides. Place chicken on top of vegetables. Bring 1 cup of rice and water to boiling. Pour over top of chicken. Add chicken gumbo soup. Add salt pepper and garlic salt as desired. Add a little of the onion soup mix. Bake about 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Greek Lamb Stew
instructions: Saute onions and lamb in olive oil. Add tomato sauce water bouillon oregano marjoram pepper bay leaf and garlic. Simmer covered for 45 minutes. Add green pepper and eggplant. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add tomato wedges and olives; simmer 5 minutes. Ladle into bowls and garnish with sour cream and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding into pan. Add rice and raisins. Stir over medium heat until boiling. Cool 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Preacher Cookies
instructions: Bring to a boil sugar cocoa butter and milk; cook for 1 minute. Mix in peanut butter. Mix in a separate bowl the oatmeal and vanilla. Pour heated mixture over oatmeal mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoonful onto wax paper. Let sit for 30 minutes. Can be refrigerated.

title: Chicken Wings Pacifica
instructions: De-joint chicken wings discarding bony tips. Place meatier parts in shallow baking pan. Combine soy sauce brown sugar mustard and water and heat it until sugar and butter dissolve. Pour over chicken and bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes. This is also very good over chicken breasts and works very well in the crockpot.

title: Carrot Salad
instructions: Mix carrots green pepper and onion in a bowl. Mix remaining ingredients in a pan. Heat to dissolve sugar then cool. Pour marinade over the vegetables.

title: Boiled Custard
instructions: Combine eggs salt and sugar. Add milk and cook in double boiler until mixture coats the spoon. Add vanilla and chill.

title: Mexican Casserole
instructions: Heat oven to 350\u00b0. In frypan cook onion in butter or margarine 10 minutes. Add chili corn and tomatoes. Mix well until blended. Pour into 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Prepare corn muffin dough according to package directions. Stir cheese into dough. Spoon dough around edge of baking dish. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Polish Italian Pierogies
instructions: Drain the shells prepared as directed. (Note Adding 1 tablespoon oil to water when preparing shells will help prevent sticking.) Add 1 onion grated to mashed potatoes (your favorite recipe). Gently fill shells with mashed potato mixture. Cook 5 onions diced in a medium skillet over medium-high heat until they begin to brown. Melt 3 tablespoons margarine in large skillet over medium heat. Carefully place stuffed shells in skillet and cook over medium heat until brown on bottoms. Serve with browned onions.

title: One Bowl Pound Cake
instructions: Combine all ingredients in one bowl. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour or until springs back. Cool on plate and serve.

title: Calabrese Chicken (Or Rabbit)
instructions: Cut chicken or rabbit into pieces. Brown in olive oil in heavy-duty Dutch oven. Add garlic either crushed or whole peppers olives (drained) oregano (1 teaspoon or to taste) and rosemary (2 pinches). Turn down to simmer. Cover and cook for 30 to 45 minutes stirring occasionally until chicken appears dark and ready to fall apart.

title: Cabbage And Kielbasa Soup
instructions: Saute onion in olive oil slightly. Add cabbage and cook for a few minutes. Add flour and mix well. Add wine and beef stock. Bring to a boil (boiling gets rid of the alcohol in the wine but leaves a terrific flavor). While simmering add spices. Salt and pepper to taste. After soup is ready add kielbasa and cook 15 minutes longer.

title: Corn Puffle
instructions: Frozen corn can be used.

title: Beef And Potato Casserole
instructions: Brown meat; season. Peel and slice potatoes thin. In a casserole put a layer of beef then layer of potatoes. Sprinkle onions and cheese; repeat layers. Pour soup over all. Bake at 400\u00b0 (high) until potatoes are done.

title: Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Core cabbage and steam until pliable about 5 minutes. Roll mixture in cabbage leaves. Cover with spaghetti sauce diluted with water. Bake at 300\u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

title: Buttermilk Pie
instructions: Mix sugar flour eggs and butter. Add buttermilk; mix real good. Fold in vanilla lemon extract and coconut. Pour in 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 425\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350\u00b0 and continue baking 35 minutes. Do not open oven until time is completely up.

title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
instructions: Mix all ingredients in blender. Store in refrigerator. Makes 3 cups.

title: Seafood Casserole
instructions: Mince the pepper onion and celery (I use food processor). Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly. Place in casserole and bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Do not cover. Serve with rice or angel hair pasta.

title: Tuna Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie crust. Top with pie crust. Prick top with fork. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes until crust is brown. Let stand 3 minutes before cutting. Serves 4 to 6.

title: Dark Cake
instructions: In a 9 x 9-inch cake pan mix all dry ingredients. Do not grease pan. Make 3 little pockets in the mix. Place vinegar oil and vanilla in each pocket. Pour water over everything and mix. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 minutes.

title: Pork Chops Dijon
instructions: In a small bowl combine salad dressing mustard and pepper. Brush mixture on both sides of chops. In a skillet cook chops on medium for 20 minutes. Turn chops and add onion rings. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Butterfinger Ice Cream
instructions: Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually beating until mixture thickens. Add remaining ingredients except for candy bars and mix thoroughly. Stir in candy and place in ice cream freezer to freeze. (You may need to add additional milk to fill line of ice cream freezer.)

title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
instructions: Whisk together the first five ingredients. Pour over crackers stirring to coat. Place on baking sheets and bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 11 to 12 cups.

title: Green Bean Casserole
instructions: Chop onion and saute in butter. Remove onion from butter grate cheese and combine with beans and soup in casserole dish. Top with buttered cracker crumbs. Bake at 350\u00b0 until bubbly around edges about 1/2 hour.

title: Jambalaya
instructions: Cut sausage into small pieces and brown; remove from pan. Brown chicken. Return sausage to pan. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat until rice is done 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Mandarin Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve orange Jell-O with the instant pudding in boiling water. Set jello but not hard. Mix in the drained mandarin oranges. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in mold and place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Can be used as a salad or dessert.

title: Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water and sugar. Let cool. Add other ingredients and congeal.

title: Baked Chicken With Cornbread Dressing
instructions: Saute celery onion and parsley in the margarine until tender. Mix all together with enough broth to make nice soft texture. Bake dressing about one hour at 350\u00b0. Season chicken as desired and bake one hour or until completely done.

title: Vegetable Dip
instructions: Mix all together and refrigerate. I often replace some of mayonnaise and sour cream with plain yogurt. This is also good on baked potatoes.

title: Ice Tea Punch
instructions: Pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags squeezing them gently. Stir in sugar and lemonade concentrate. Set tea aside to cool. Stir in ginger ale just before serving. Serve over ice.

title: Pretzel Salad
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients and press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool completely. Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water and add strawberries. Set this mixture in refrigerator until it is thick. (Allow at least 3 hours for this.) Combine cream cheese sugar and Cool Whip. Spread on top of pretzels. Add strawberry mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Wetback Special
instructions: Brown hamburger. Combine with one onion garlic enchilada sauce tomato sauce chili powder salt pepper and chili beans. Simmer for 2 hours. Assemble on a plate by layers. Fritos sauce lettuce grated cheese chopped onions and dried tomatoes. Top with sour cream and avocado slice if desired. Makes 10-12 servings.

title: Mixed Greens Sauté
instructions: In a large saute pan add mixed greens olive oil and garlic. Cook until slightly wilted and serve. Serves 2.

title: Coco-Nut Kisses
instructions: Beat egg whites cream of tartar salt and vanilla until stiff. Add sugar gradually and continue beating until it forms stiff peaks. Fold in chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoons onto well-greased paper bag (reversed) that has been placed on cookie sheet. Bake 20 to 23 minutes at 300\u00b0.

title: Fresh Tuna Hero
instructions: * To roast bell pepper halve core and seed them. Flatten with your hand and place skin side up on foil on a baking sheet. Broil about 3-inches from the heat until skins blacken and are charred. Remove to a paper bag and close up for 15 minutes to steam. Rub off the charred skin.

title: Breast Of Chicken With Artichokes And Mushrooms
instructions: Bring chicken celery onions salt and pepper to boil in 1 quart water. Reduce heat; simmer until breasts are tender. Strain broth and let it cool. When breasts are cool skin\tand chop into\tround slices. Wash and slice mushrooms horizontally into round slices. Saute in butter and add grated onion and lemon juice.

title: No Fail Microwave Divinity
instructions: Mix first four ingredients in a 2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Cook in microwave oven for 20 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Candy thermometer should read 260\u00b0; if not cook one or two minutes longer.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients except rhubarb and let stand while preparing the crust. Pour mixture over rhubarb in shell. Bake 45 minutes at 375\u00b0 or until done.

title: Cream Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Cream the cream cheese. Add salad dressing and pineapple and cream together. Add nuts. Spread on slices of whole wheat bread or bread of choice.

title: Green Chili Pie
instructions: Open chilies up and clean out seeds and seams. Lay out chilies flat in bottom of a 9-inch Pyrex pie plate (like a pie crust). Put cheese over chilies up to the rim. Mix beaten eggs and other ingredients. Slowly spoon eggs over cheese. Bake in a preheated 275\u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

title: Spicy Beef Dip
instructions: Brown beef onion and garlic; drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until well blended. Serve warm with your favorite chips or crackers.

title: Salted Pecans
instructions: Soak pecans in salted water for 30 minutes. Drain on paper towel for 2 hours. Bake in 300\u00b0 oven stirring every 10 minutes until of desired color of brown.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Mix all ingredients well and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell; bake in 350\u00b0 oven (325\u00b0 for glass pie plate) for 50 minutes or until brown and set.

title: White Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Cream 1 cup butter 2 cups sugar and chocolate. Beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in flour baking powder dash of salt 1 teaspoon vanilla and buttermilk. Fold in pecans and coconut. Bake in layer pans for 30 minutes or tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Mix remaining sugar butter and vanilla in saucepan. Add dash of salt and evaporated milk. Let stand for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Cook to soft ball stage. Beat until creamy. Spread on cake.

title: Untossed Tossed Salad
instructions: Place layer of spinach in large bowl. Press. Sprinkle with salt pepper and bacon. Add eggs and lettuce layer. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add peas and onion. Mix mayonnaise with sour cream. Cover salad with mixture. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least a few hours.

title: Butter Mints
instructions: Blend all ingredients; knead color as desired. Form into small balls. Press down. Let dry for at least 1 day before packaging.

title: Mayonnaise Cake
instructions: Mix mayonnaise sugar and cocoa. Add hot water and beat. Sift flour soda and baking powders. Stir in mixture. Beat until smooth. Add vanilla and bake 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Over medium heat mix sugar cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir. Serve over biscuits.

title: Hospitality Pie
instructions: Brown coconut and nuts in oven with 1 stick oleo. Stir often. Cool. Mix cheese milk and Cool Whip. Pour half into each pie shell. Pour topping over each half and cover with rest of mixture. Drizzle caramel on top of pies. Freeze before serving.

title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Let stand 1 day in refrigerator.

title: Black Eyes Peas
instructions: Cook meat until fat is rendered. Transfer meat to 6 to 8 quart pot. Saute onion green pepper and celery in meat drippings. Pour peas into pot. Add all sauted vegetables and Rotel tomatoes to pot. Add salt and pepper. Cook over medium to medium-low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Blueberry Supreme
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add pie filling and stir in pineapple plus the juice. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass dish and congeal. It only takes a little time to congeal.

title: Chicken With Apples
instructions: Mix flour salt and pepper in gallon size food storage bag. Add chicken and share until coated. Reserve 2 tablespoons flour mixture. Heat oil in large deep skillet over medium heat. Add chicken; cook 5 to 7 minutes turning once until well browned. Remove to a plate. Add onion celery and carrot to drippings in skillet. Cook 3 to 4 minutes stirring several times. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons reserved flour and cook 3 minutes longer. Stir in cider broth rosemary and garlic. Add chicken. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 25 to 30 minutes until chicken is done. Remove to serving platter and cover loosely with foil. Process liquid and vegetables in blender until smooth. Pour back into skillet; add apples. Cook over low heat 5 to 7 minutes until tender. With slotted spoon remove apples to serving platter. Serve sauce separately. Serves 6.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mix thoroughly sugar shortening and eggs. Stir in sour milk and bananas. Sift and stir in flour baking powder soda and salt. Mix well. Add nuts. Grease a loaf pan; let stand in loaf pan for 20 minutes and then bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Green Rice
instructions: Cook onions in oil until soft but not brown. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Cover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until rice is done. Toss lightly with fork.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: Pour boiling water over oatmeal. Let stand 20 minutes. Cream shortening sugar brown sugar and eggs. Add oatmeal to the mixture; stir. Add remaining ingredients.

title: Carrot Cake And Cream Cheese Filling
instructions: (Be sure to grate carrots and refrigerate before starting.) Mix oil and sugar; beat well. Add eggs. Sift all dry ingredients 2 or 3 times. Mix with sugar mixture. Add nuts and carrots a small amount at a time until well mixed. Pour into well-greased and floured pans (three 9-inch pans). Bake at 350\u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until done.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions: Combine 1/2 cup melted butter with the next 5 ingredients in a bowl. Mix well. Pour into 2-quart casserole.

title: Apricot Pineapple Salad
instructions: Combine pineapple and jello in saucepan. Cook over low heat until jello is dissolved. Remove from heat and add sugar baby food and cream cheese. Mix these ingredients well but do not beat. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in whipped topping. Chill until firm.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
instructions: Cook noodles; drain. Add tuna mushrooms and soup. Place cheese throughout casserole creating layers evenly. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 30 or 40 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Salad
instructions: Make spaghetti according to package directions. Cool spaghetti and add remaining ingredients.

title: Whiskey Slushes
instructions: Melt the sugar in the tea. Mix all other ingredients and freeze. (This takes 24 hours.) Serve by scooping out some into a glasss and pouring a small amount of Mountain Dew over it.

title: Vegetable Soup To Can Or Freeze
instructions: Fry hamburger with onions. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix and fill cans. Pressure cook for 3/4 hour or cold pack 1 1/2 hours.

title: Easy Paella
instructions: Remove meat from casing. In 12-inch skillet over medium heat cook sausage and drumsticks in hot oil stirring to break it up. Spoon off all but 1 tablespoon drippings.

title: Baked Chicken
instructions: Mix apple juice onion and mushroom sauce together. Pour over chicken parts. Put 1 cup mushrooms over the top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 2 hours. Put foil over top. Thicken your sauce for gravy.

title: Hot Swiss Chard Salad
instructions: Marinate garlic clove in oil for 1 hour; remove garlic. Wash dry and tear chard into bite-size pieces (remove stems). Just before serving heat oil vinegar salt and pepper stirring occasionally. Pour over chard; toss until well coated. Sprinkle with eggs and bacon. Toss lightly. Garnish with hard-cooked egg slices if desired.

title: Stuffed Puff Pastry(Banh Pate Chaud)
instructions: Prepare puff pastry shells as box instructions. Remove from oven and set aside. In a large skillet brown pork for about 10 minutes. Drain all fat. Add in all ingredients to the cooked pork. Cook with medium-low heat for 5 minutes. Fill pastry with pork. Serve immediately.

title: Plum Quick Bread
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine the eggs baby food oil and buttermilk. Combine dry ingredients; add to the egg mixture and beat just until moistened. Pour into two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans that have been greased and floured. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 60 to 65 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks. Yield 2 loaves.

title: Hello Dolly Cookies
instructions: Melt oleo in long 13x9 inch pan. Add each of the remaining ingredients in the order listed spreading on top of each other. Do not stir. Bake at 350 degrees. Let it cook about 25 minutes. Cut up in one inch squares.

title: Mary'S Chocolate Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs one at a time. Beat until fluffy. Add vanilla. Combine flour cocoa soda and salt. Add alternately with sour cream. Mix just until combined. Stir in water. Pour in 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 35 minutes.

title: German Potato Pancakes
instructions: In a large bowl grate potatoes let stand 5 minutes top may turn color but ignore. Remove as much excess liquid as possible. Add egg and mix well then sprinkle flour while mixing. In a well-oiled heated skillet to check drop a bit of potato mixture in and if sizzles its ready. Using a large kitchen spoon full of mixture make pancake size patties. Fry until top looks dry and bottom is golden brown turn and fry until golden brown. Using a spatula remove pancake tipping it over pan to remove excess oil.

title: Scotch Eggs
instructions: Peel eggs. Combine sausage parsley sage and pepper in a large mixing bowl mixing well. Divide meat mixture into six equal portions. Press meat mixture around eggs with hands keeping the oval shape. Sprinkle eggs with flour coating lightly on all sides. Dip into beaten egg and then roll in bread crumbs. Heat vegetable oil in deep fat fryer or deep heavy saucepan to 350 degrees on deep fat thermometer. Cook one egg at a time for about 4 - 5 minutes or until well browned. Drain on paper toweling; cool refrigerate.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve with chips.

title: Oatmeal Cake
instructions: For cake pour boiling water over oats. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Beat margarine until creamy. Gradually add sugars and beat until fluffy. Blend in vanilla and eggs. Add oat mixture. Mix well. Sift together flour soda salt cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to the other mixture. Mix well and pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Creamy Orange Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Gradually add to softened cream cheese mixing until well blended. Stir in juices and rind. Pour in 1-quart mold. (You may add mandarin oranges slices drained if desired.) Chill until firm. Unmold. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Ruth'S Lemon Stuff
instructions: Combine flour and butter; press into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 until light brown. Let cool. In bowl combine cream cheese sugar and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Spread in cooled crust. Set aside.

title: Sausage And Sauerkraut
instructions: Brown bacon in Dutch oven; add onions and cook until tender. Add potatoes salt and pepper. Cover with sauerkraut and sausage. Add juniper berries and enough beer to cover potatoes. Simmer (covered) until tender (20 to 30 minutes). Serves 6 to 8.

title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes until only tender in salted boiling water. Mix brown sugar water butter and salt in large skillet. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly. Add sweet potatoes gently stirring until glazed and heated through.

title: My Beef Stew
instructions: Note Read all directions before starting recipe.

title: Dolly'S Fudge
instructions: Melt peanut butter butter and vanilla. Cook for 5 minutes. Mix in powdered sugar. Spread into pan; let cool.

title: Mexican Corn Bread
instructions: Mix ingredients together and bake in 475\u00b0 oven until golden brown (about 30 minutes). Can also be made into muffins.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl or jar and whisk or shake well.

title: Quick Peach Dessert
instructions: Place peaches in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar. Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar beating well. Add self-rising flour and egg; mix well. Stir in vanilla. Spoon mixture over sugared peaches. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chicken And Broccoli Hot Dish
instructions: Place cooked drained broccoli on bottom of pan. Place chicken over broccoli. Pour sauce made from soup mayonnaise and lemon juice over the chicken. Sprinkle cheese over the sauce to cover it. Place bread crumbs mixed with butter over the cheese. Cook for 30 minutes.

title: Fried Apples
instructions: Core and quarter unpared apples then slice in 1/4-inch slices. Heat fat in skillet and add apples. Cover and cook slowly for 6 to 8 minutes. Add sugar and cook until transparent and tender lifting and turning with spatula until done.

title: Pistachio Cake
instructions: Stir cake mix with pudding. Add a few drops of green coloring if desired. Add water and oil to the mix. Then add extract. Add the eggs one at a time using low speed. Beat 5 minutes. Grease an angel food cake pan or a Bundt pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool; then remove from pan.

title: Saute Of Vegetable Fermiere
instructions: Trim and cut vegetables into very thin slices. Rinse and drain mushrooms; dry and slice thinly. Melt butter in skillet. Add carrots and turnips; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook tossing and stirring over high heat for about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook tossing and stirring for about 2 minutes. Add the shallots and toss. Cook briefly. Serve sprinkled with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

title: Jennifer'S Generous Ginger Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs until fluffy about 2 minutes. Add sugar and beat another 2 minutes. Sift flour over batter and fold in with rubber spatula. Fold in cooled margarine.

title: Taco Salad
instructions: Cook and drain hamburg. Add taco seasoning mix and water. Boil away. Add rinsed and drained pinto beans onion and green pepper. Let mixture sit overnight. Add shredded lettuce tomatoes crushed Doritos Catalina dressing and cheese. Mix well.

title: French Bread(Bread Machine)
instructions: Whip the whites until stiff and set aside. Put ingredients in bread machine in the order required by your machine. Start machine; after all ingredients are mixed stop machine and add beaten egg whites. (Note Use the dough cycle.) When dough is ready to form into loaf let rest for 30 minutes. Sprinkle or mist with water and cut slits in top. Bake at 400\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Flu Soup
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes. Cover with water and let them start cooking good; add onion tomatoes salt and pepper. Season with Mazola butter or meat grease. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes; if too thick add tomato juice or water. My mothers answer to chicken noodle soup when we had colds or flu.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole
instructions: Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 minutes to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Mash potatoes gradually stirring in mayonnaise cream cheese and onion powder salt and pepper until light and fluffy. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes.

title: Darlene'S Easy Fudgediagonal, Iowa
instructions: Stir butter milk and sugar together on high until rolling boil. Turn down to medium-high and cook to soft ball stage.

title: Easy Easy Pecan Pralines
instructions: Lay wax paper on top of folded newspaper. You will need two pieces about 12 to 18 inches long (the newspaper will help the pralines release after cooling). Mix sugars milk butter and pecans in saucepan over medium high heat until mixture comes to a boil. Boil exactly 1 1/2 minutes and while continuing to stir. Remove from heat and stir for another 30 seconds. Add vanilla and beat until mixture cools to the thickness of cream. Immediately spoon out onto wax paper. Allow to cool a few minutes. May not be doubled.

title: Chocolate Kiss Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375\u00b0. Sift flour salt and baking powder; set aside. In large bowl with electric mixer at medium speed beat butter and peanut butter until blended. Add 1 cup sugar and then brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add both eggs and vanilla; beat until smooth. Stir in flour mixture until well combined.

title: Best Nut Loaf
instructions: Sift together dry ingredients. Combine egg milk and salad oil. Applesauce can replace oil in all recipes calling for oil or shortening. Add to dry items; beat well and add nuts. Turn into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350\u00b0 about 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until done. Remove from pan. Cool on rack.

title: Baked Chop Suey
instructions: Brown the meat (adding no salt). Mix rest of ingredients together. Bake for 1 hour at 350\u00b0. Add more noodles on top the last 15 minutes.

title: Christmas Carol Punch
instructions: Core apples; slice into 1/2-inch rings. In Dutch oven combine cider cinnamon cloves apple rings and raisins. Bring to boil over high heat; reduce heat to low and simmer 5 to 8 minutes or until apples are just tender. Remove cloves; add oranges lemon slices and lemon juice. Pour into punch bowl. Ladle into large mugs including an apple ring some raisins and citrus slices in each serving. Makes 2 quarts.

title: Party Punch
instructions: Mix jello in boiling water. Mix strawberry Kool-Aid sugar and water. Add pineapple juice. When ready to serve add sherbet and 7-Up.

title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
instructions: Mix water with soda; cool. Cream shortening with sugar; beat in eggs. Sift flour with salt. Add creamed mixture alternately with cooled liquid. Stir in cereals and buttermilk; put in covered container in refrigerator. Can be used for weeks as needed. Bake at 375\u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Mixture improves after second day.

title: Sweet Potato Pie
instructions: Boil potatoes with skins on. Peel potatoes and mash. Add in eggs. Add milk. Add sugar to taste. Add butter. Add flour. Mix very well and put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350\u00b0 for approximately 40 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Simmer carrots until barely tender. Drain and add to salad dressing in large bowl. Simmer broccoli about 8 minutes until not quite tender. Add onion and green pepper; simmer 3 to 4 more minutes. Drain and add to carrots. Add mushrooms. Stir to coat. Refrigerate overnight stirring occasionally to re-coat. Should be tightly covered. Tastes best if allowed to warm up slightly not heated just stand at room temperature for 1/2 hour or 1 hour before serving.

title: Crackling Bread
instructions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Add milk and egg; beat well. Add cracklings and pour into well-greased skillet or muffin tins. Bake at 450\u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serves 8.

title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
instructions: Mix and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan the pretzels 3 tablespoons sugar and margarine (melted). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool. Beat together the cream cheese and 1 cup sugar and add Cool Whip. Pour mixture over crumbs. Mix strawberry jello with boiling water. Add strawberries. Let stand 10 minutes. Pour over cheese mixture. Garnish with chopped walnuts.

title: Butternut Cake
instructions: Cream sugar and shortening at high speed 10 minutes. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add one cup flour. Beat at a low speed one minute. Add remaining flour and milk. Beat well. Add flavoring. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 1 hour in greased tube pan.

title: Patrick'S Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients together until batter is smooth. Pour each pancake into preheated electric frying pan at 325\u00b0 lightly sprayed with Pam. Turn over when bubbly cook until golden.

title: Coulibiac Wreath
instructions: Drain bone and break salmon into chunks or flake. Combine rice 1/2 cup sour cream 1/4 cup melted butter lemon juice dill and salt. Mix well. Stir in salmon.

title: Strawberry-Pineapple Jello Salad
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O; put in complete package of frozen strawberries. Add pineapple when strawberries melt. Add 1/2 cup pineapple juice.

title: Good Cake
instructions: Combine mix 1/2 cup brown sugar 3/4 cup oil eggs and sour cream. Beat on high for 2 minutes. Place 1/3 of batter in well-greased pan. Mix 3 tablespoons brown sugar and 3 teaspoons cinnamon. Sprinkle 1/2 on batter in pan. Sprinkle with remaining sugar/cinnamon mix. Top with remaining batter. Bake in oven at 375\u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

title: Hummingbird Pie
instructions: Place margarine almonds and coconut in skillet and brown lightly; set aside and let cool. Mix together the cream cheese milk and Cool Whip.

title: Green Beans Almondine
instructions: Combine almonds and butter in a 2-cup glass measure. Microwave uncovered at power level High for 4 to 6 minutes or until almonds are lightly toasted. Set aside.

title: Frozen Lemonade Icebox Pie
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients until creamy. Pour into pie crust. Chill for 2 hours or until set.

title: Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Cook cabbage and carrots in boiling salted water until crisp tender. Meanwhile in saucepan saute the onion in 3 tablespoons of butter until tender. Stir in the flour salt and pepper. Cook until bubbly. Gradually add the milk; cook and stir until thickened. Drain the cabbage and carrots. Place half in a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with 1/2 the sauce; sprinkle with half the cheese. Repeat the layers. In a small skillet melt the remaining butter. Add the bread crumbs marjoram and thyme; cook and stir until lightly browned. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake uncovered at 350\u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until cabbage is tender and top is browned. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

title: Smoked Salmon Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine cream cheese Parmesan hot sauce lemon juice and pepper in food processor. Cut smoked salmon into 32 small pieces and place a piece in each toast cup. Spoon about 1 1/2 to 2 teaspoons of cheese mixture over salmon and top with dill. Bake approximately 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Mincemeat Pies
instructions: Mix with cider or fruit juice (about 1/2 gallon).

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
instructions: Sift together plain flour baking powder salt and cocoa. Set aside. Cream shortening butter and sugar well. Add eggs one at a time beating after each. Add flour mixture one spoonful at a time alternating with milk. Add vanilla; stir. Pour batter into well-greased pan(s). Bake 1 hour at 325\u00b0 20 minutes at 350\u00b0.

title: Spinach Dip
instructions: Cook frozen spinach as directed on package. Drain well. Mix all ingredients together. Prepare the day before. Use as dip for vegetables.

title: Peanut Butter Crunch
instructions: Spread peanut butter on buttered surface about the size of a cookie sheet. (Wooden table or countertop is best).

title: Old Fashioned Apple Cake
instructions: Mix oil eggs and sugar; add flour and cinnamon. Stir in nuts and chopped apples. Spread mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 50 to 55 minutes at 350\u00b0. Good with butterscotch chips distributed on cake before baking.
